Instructions: Lesen Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS und fügen Sie ein berechnetes Feld hinzu, das den Status des Fluges basierend auf dem Preis angibt (z.B. 'Günstig' < 200, 'Normal' >= 200 und < 500, 'Teuer' >= 500). Nutzen Sie einen CASE-Ausdruck direkt im SELECT-Statement.
hint: Verwenden Sie CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END AS flight_status.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dba_select_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dba_select_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price,
           CASE
             WHEN price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
             WHEN price >= 200 AND price < 500 THEN 'Normal'
             ELSE 'Teuer'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dba_select_case( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).

    DATA(ls_flight_cheap) TYPE zcl_dba_select_case=>ty_flight_status.
    DATA(ls_flight_normal) TYPE zcl_dba_select_case=>ty_flight_status.
    DATA(ls_flight_expensive) TYPE zcl_dba_select_case=>ty_flight_status.

    " Find an example for each status (if data allows) and assert
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price < 200 AND ls_flight_cheap IS INITIAL.
        ls_flight_cheap = ls_flight.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-price >= 200 AND ls_flight-price < 500 AND ls_flight_normal IS INITIAL.
        ls_flight_normal = ls_flight.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-price >= 500 AND ls_flight_expensive IS INITIAL.
        ls_flight_expensive = ls_flight.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF ls_flight_cheap IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_cheap-flight_status exp = 'Günstig' ).
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_flight_normal IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_normal-flight_status exp = 'Normal' ).
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_flight_expensive IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_expensive-flight_status exp = 'Teuer' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von CASE-Ausdrücken direkt in SELECT-Statements (seit ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik auf Datenbankebene auszuführen. Dies ist sehr effizient, da die Berechnung direkt im Datenbanksystem erfolgt und nicht erst nach dem Laden der Daten in ABAP.
keywords: SELECT, CASE, Conditional Logic, Database Access, Calculated Field, ASSERT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge des Carriers 'LH' aus `sflights` enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'No LH flights found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight carrier is not LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Erstellung und Filterung von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, ohne explizite `APPEND`- oder `LOOP`-Schleifen.
keywords: LOOP, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights, Filter

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in `sflights` unter Verwendung einer modernen Aggregationsmethode.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression mit `FOR` zur Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_total_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_total_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights 
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_total_price( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total > 0 msg = 'Total price should be positive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und funktionaler als eine traditionelle `LOOP`-Schleife mit einer expliziten Summenvariable.
keywords: LOOP, REDUCE, FOR, Math, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Verdoppeln Sie den Preis aller Flüge in einer lokalen Kopie einer `sflights`-Tabelle. Die Änderungen sollen direkt in der Tabelle erfolgen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und den Operator `*=`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_doubler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS double_flight_prices IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_doubled_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_doubler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD double_flight_prices.
    rt_doubled_flights = it_flights. " Create a copy to modify

    LOOP AT rt_doubled_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price *= 2.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_double_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_double_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_doubler( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->double_flight_prices( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Price was not doubled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ist die effizienteste Methode, um Einträge einer internen Tabelle direkt zu modifizieren, da keine unnötigen Datenkopien erstellt werden. Der `*=` Operator ist eine Kurzform für die Multiplikation und Zuweisung.
keywords: LOOP, ASSIGNING, MULTIPLY, Internal Tables, Field Symbols, *= Operator

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Strings, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` den Carrier, die Verbindungsnummer und den Preis in einem formatierten String kombiniert.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_formatted_strings = VALUE string_table(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge für jeden Carrier in `sflights` und geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR GROUPS OF`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE tt_carrier_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING WITHOUT MEMBERS
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle von Flugstatus: 'Active', wenn das Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, 'Completed' sonst. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR`-Expression mit `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_statuses RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE tt_flight_status(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        fldate = flight-fldate
        status = COND string( WHEN flight-fldate > sy-datum THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Completed' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_statuses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_statuses.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_statuses( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    DATA lv_active_found TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_completed_found TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_status).
      IF ls_status-status = 'Active'.
        lv_active_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_status-status = 'Completed'.
        lv_completed_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_active_found OR lv_completed_found msg = 'Neither Active nor Completed status found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht bedingte Zuweisungen direkt in Ausdrücken, was den Code deutlich kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `IF`-Anweisungen. In Kombination mit der `FOR`-Expression können so Tabellen mit berechneten Werten effizient erstellt werden.
keywords: LOOP, FOR, COND, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, sy-datum

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei die Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_sflights_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS um einen festen Betrag. Nutzen Sie dabei Host-Variablen und eine arithmetische Operation direkt in der `SET`-Klausel.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    UPDATE sflight
      SET price = price + @iv_increase
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_update( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_increase) = 100.

    " Vorbereitung: Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE #( ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_initial_price) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_initial_price WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lv_rows) = lo_cut->update_flight_prices( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_increase = lv_increase ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_updated_price) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_updated_price WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = '0001'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should be updated' act = lv_updated_price exp = lv_initial_price + lv_increase ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'No rows updated' act = lv_rows exp = 0 ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = '0001'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne Open SQL-Syntax erlaubt die direkte Verwendung von Host-Variablen (gekennzeichnet durch `@`) und arithmetischen Ausdrücken in der `SET`-Klausel von `UPDATE`-Anweisungen. Dies macht den Code prägnanter und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit, Daten zuerst in ABAP zu lesen, zu bearbeiten und dann zurückzuschreiben.
keywords: UPDATE, Open SQL, Host-Variablen, Arithmetik, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft und filtern Sie nur jene, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `COUNT`, `AVG`, `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_statistics
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result).

    rt_stats = lt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_stats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_stats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_aggregates( ).

    " Vorbereitung: Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind (mind. 6 Flüge für eine Airline)
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0004' fldate = sy-datum price = 250 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0005' fldate = sy-datum price = 300 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0006' fldate = sy-datum price = 350 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_carrier_statistics( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find statistics for at least one carrier' act = lt_stats ).
    DATA(ls_stat) = lt_stats[ carrid = 'XX' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight count for XX should be 6' act = ls_stat-flight_count exp = 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price for XX should be 225' act = ls_stat-avg_price exp = 225 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'YY should not be in results (less than 6 flights)' act = lt_stats[ carrid = 'YY' DEFAULT INITIAL ] ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' OR carrid = 'YY'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT` und `AVG` zusammen mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in einer einzigen `SELECT`-Anweisung ist Standard in modernem Open SQL. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(lt_result)` macht den Code zudem kompakter.
keywords: SELECT, Aggregatfunktionen, GROUP BY, HAVING, Open SQL, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Währung für eine Liste von Flügen in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Die zu aktualisierenden Flüge und die neue Währung werden in einer internen Tabelle bereitgestellt. Nutzen Sie `UPDATE FROM TABLE`.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_currencies
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_sflight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_currencies.
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @it_updates.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_update_table( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'UA'.
    DATA(lv_connid1) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_connid2) = '0002'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Vorbereitung: Testdaten einfügen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate price = 100 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_sflights_update_table=>tt_sflight_update(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate currency = 'GBP' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate currency = 'JPY' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_rows) = lo_cut->update_currencies( lt_updates ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_currency1) = ''.
    DATA(lv_currency2) = ''.
    SELECT SINGLE currency FROM sflight INTO @lv_currency1 WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid1 AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    SELECT SINGLE currency FROM sflight INTO @lv_currency2 WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid2 AND fldate = @lv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Currency for flight 1 should be GBP' act = lv_currency1 exp = 'GBP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Currency for flight 2 should be JPY' act = lv_currency2 exp = 'JPY' ).

CLASS zcl_sflights_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_sflights_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_sflights_union IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid2
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Common Table Expressions (CTEs), um alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS zu finden, die teurer sind als der Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge der gleichen Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Definieren Sie ein CTE, das den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft berechnet, und verwenden Sie es dann in der Haupt-`SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_cte DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_expensive,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_expensive.
    TYPES tt_sflight_expensive TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_expensive WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_expensive.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_cte IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    WITH +avg_prices AS (
      SELECT carrid, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
        FROM sflight
        GROUP BY carrid
    )
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, s~currency
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN +avg_prices AS ap ON s~carrid = ap~carrid
      WHERE s~price > ap~avg_price
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result).

    rt_flights = lt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                                          ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = lv_fldate price = 200 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0003' fldate = lv_fldate price = 300 currency = 'EUR' ) ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( ).

    DATA(ls_flight) = lt_flights[ carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = '0003' DEFAULT INITIAL ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flight 0001 should not be found (price 100 < avg 200)' act = lt_flights[ carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = '0001' DEFAULT INITIAL ] ).

CLASS zcl_sflights_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update_from DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_lh OR carrid = @lv_carrid_aa.
    DELETE FROM scarr WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_lh OR carrid = @lv_carrid_aa.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = lv_carrid_lh connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate price = 100 currency = 'EUR' )
                                          ( carrid = lv_carrid_aa connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ) ) ).
    INSERT scarr FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = lv_carrid_lh carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
                                          ( carrid = lv_carrid_aa carrname = 'American Airlines' ) ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_new_price) = 999.
    DATA(lv_rows) = lo_cut->update_price_by_carrier_name( lv_new_price ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_price_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_price_aa) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_price_lh WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_lh AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_price_aa WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_aa AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = @lv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price for Lufthansa flight should be updated' act = lv_price_lh exp = lv_new_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price for American Airlines flight should remain unchanged' act = lv_price_aa exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'One row should be updated' act = lv_rows exp = 1 ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_lh OR carrid = @lv_carrid_aa.
    DELETE FROM scarr WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_lh OR carrid = @lv_carrid_aa.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung einer Subquery in der `WHERE`-Klausel einer `UPDATE`-Anweisung (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ist ein fortgeschrittenes und sehr flexibles Feature. Es ermöglicht die Aktualisierung von Zeilen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen, die aus einer anderen Tabelle oder einer komplexen Abfrage stammen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Daten zuerst in ABAP zu lesen und dann zu verarbeiten.
keywords: UPDATE, Subquery, WHERE IN, Open SQL, SFLIGHTS, SCARR, Bedingte Aktualisierung

CLASS zcl_sflight_compute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_occupancy_rate
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_occupancy_rate) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_compute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_occupancy_rate.
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights
      FIELDS seatsocc, seatsmax
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0.
      rv_occupancy_rate = ( ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax ) * 100.
    ELSE.
      rv_occupancy_rate = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT FROM sflights
      FIELDS seatsocc
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with seatsocc 100, 150, 200. Total should be 450.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 450 ). " Adjust expected value based on actual SFLIGHTS data
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_occupied_seats_empty.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren und einen einzelnen Wert zu berechnen. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, COMPUTE, Interne Tabelle

CLASS zcl_sflight_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_case_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT SINGLE
      carrid,
      connid,
      fldate,
      CASE
        WHEN seatsocc = 0 THEN 'Empty'
        WHEN seatsocc < seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Low Occupancy'
        WHEN seatsocc = seatsmax THEN 'Full'
        ELSE 'Normal Occupancy'
      END AS flight_status
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_result).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_status = ls_result-flight_status.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'Flight Not Found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Bonusbetrag basierend auf der Auslastung eines Fluges. Wenn die Auslastung über 80% liegt, beträgt der Bonus 100, sonst 50. Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_bonus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_bonus
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_bonus) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_bonus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights
      FIELDS seatsocc, seatsmax
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0.
      DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = ( ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax ) * 100.
      rv_bonus = COND #( WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > 80 THEN 100 ELSE 50 ).
    ELSE.
      rv_bonus = 0. " No bonus if flight not found or invalid data
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (Feld `price`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Währung (z.B. 'EUR').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `FOR ... IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price IMPORTING iv_currency TYPE s_currcode RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE s_price
                                   FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( currency = iv_currency ) 
                                   NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflights,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflights.
    TYPES: sflights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_after_date
      IMPORTING iv_date TYPE s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_after_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE sflights_tab.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE ( fldate > iv_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flights_after_date FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_after_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_date( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 365. " Ein Jahr zurück, sollte Flüge finden
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_after_date( lv_test_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Sollte Flüge nach dem Testdatum finden' act = lt_flights ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Das erste Flugdatum sollte nach dem Testdatum liegen' act = lt_flights[1]-fldate > lv_test_date ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_after_date_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_date( ).
    DATA(lv_future_date) = sy-datum + 365 * 10. " Weit in der Zukunft, sollte keine Flüge finden
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_after_date( lv_future_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sollte keine Flüge nach dem zukünftigen Datum finden' act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Elemente enthält, die einer bestimmten Bedingung genügen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND`.

Instructions: Nehmen Sie einen String, konvertieren Sie ihn in Kleinbuchstaben, entfernen Sie führende und abschließende Leerzeichen und ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen von 'abap' durch 'modern abap'.

      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_string_manipulation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_string.
    rv_output = to_lower( iv_input ).
    rv_output = trim( rv_output ).
    rv_output = replace( val = rv_output old = 'abap' new = 'modern abap' occ = 0 ). " occ = 0 für alle Vorkommen
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'String-Manipulation fehlgeschlagen' act = lv_output exp = lv_expected ).

explanation: Die Verwendung funktionaler Methoden, die direkt den Rückgabewert der vorherigen Operation als Eingabe für die nächste verwenden, ermöglicht eine elegante und lesbare Kette von Operationen. Dies ist eine moderne Art der String-Manipulation im Vergleich zu prozeduralen Ansätzen.
keywords: Functional Methods, String Processing, to_lower, trim, replace

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen als Wert entgegennimmt, deren Summe als Wert zurückgibt und das Produkt der beiden Zahlen per Referenz in einem Exportparameter zurückschreibt.

                                   FOR char IN iv_input CHARS

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine bestimmte Währung haben, und geben Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Flugnummern und Preisen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke mit `COND` oder `LET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_prices = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND currency = iv_currency )
                                  ( connid = flight-connid, price = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flight_prices_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_nested_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_prices( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Sollte Flüge für LH und EUR finden' act = lt_prices ).
    IF lines( lt_prices ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flugnummer sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_prices[1]-connid IS NOT INITIAL ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Preis sollte größer als 0 sein' act = lt_prices[1]-price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_filtered_flight_prices_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_nested_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_prices( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_currency = 'YYY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sollte keine Flüge für nicht existierende Kriterien finden' act = lt_prices ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR ... IN` mit einer komplexen `WHERE`-Bedingung innerhalb des `VALUE`-Operators ermöglicht eine präzise Filterung und Transformation von Daten in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Dies ist effizienter als manuelle Schleifen und `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Nested Loops

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch ein Attribut eines Objekts basierend auf einem übergebenen Attributnamen ausliest und dessen Wert als String zurückgibt. (Nur für einfache Datentypen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` oder RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.
    METHODS get_attribute_value
      IMPORTING iv_attribute_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_attribute_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_attribute_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    CASE iv_attribute_name.
      WHEN 'MV_VALUE'.
        ASSIGN mv_value TO <fs_value>.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Hier könnte eine RTTI-Implementierung folgen für komplexere Szenarien
        " Für dieses Beispiel beschränken wir uns auf mv_value
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value.
    ENDCASE.

    IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_attribute_value = <fs_value>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_attribute_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_attribute_value_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_attribute_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_attribute_reader( 'Testwert' ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_attribute_value( 'MV_VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Attributwert ist falsch' act = lv_value exp = 'Testwert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_attribute_value_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_attribute_reader( 'Testwert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>raise_exception( 
        NEW zcl_dynamic_attribute_reader( 'Test' )->get_attribute_value( 'INVALID_ATTRIBUTE' ) 
      ) 
      exp = 'CX_ABAP_INVALID_VALUE' 
      msg = 'Sollte eine Ausnahme für ungültiges Attribut auslösen' 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Attributzugriff über `ASSIGN COMPONENT` oder RTTI ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Programmierung. Obwohl hier vereinfacht, demonstriert es die Möglichkeit, zur Laufzeit auf Objektattribute zuzugreifen, was in modernen Frameworks oft genutzt wird.
keywords: METHOD, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RTTI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Geben Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und Anzahl zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_count.
    TYPES: tt_carr_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_carr_counts) TYPE tt_carr_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carr_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                               ( carrid = flight-carrid, count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Sollte Fluggesellschaften mit Zählungen finden' act = lt_counts ).
    IF lines( lt_counts ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_counts[1]-carrid IS NOT INITIAL ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Anzahl sollte größer als 0 sein' act = lt_counts[1]-count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier_empty.
    " Für diesen Test müsste sflights leer sein, was schwer zu simulieren ist.
    " Stattdessen testen wir, dass bei einer leeren Quelltabelle eine leere Ergebnistabelle zurückkommt.
    DATA lt_empty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Normalerweise würde man hier eine Mock-Implementierung verwenden.
    " Da wir direkt auf sflights zugreifen, ist dieser Test weniger aussagekräftig, 
    " es sei denn, sflights ist tatsächlich leer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    IF lines( lt_counts ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Bei leeren sflights sollte Ergebnis leer sein' act = lt_counts ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... BY` Syntax ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe, was den Code extrem kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, GROUP SIZE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit allen Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und markieren Sie diese als 'Premium'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `COND` für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_assignment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_premium_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             is_premium TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_premium_flight.
    TYPES: tt_premium_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_premium_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_premium_flights
      IMPORTING iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_premium_flights) TYPE tt_premium_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_assignment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_premium_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_premium_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                    connid = flight-connid,
                                    price = flight-price,
                                    is_premium = COND #( WHEN flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_premium_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_premium_flights_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_premium_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_assignment( ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 500.00. " Beispiel-Schwellenwert
    DATA(lt_premium_flights) = lo_cut->get_premium_flights( lv_threshold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Sollte Premium-Flüge finden' act = lt_premium_flights ).
    IF lines( lt_premium_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_first_premium) = lt_premium_flights[1].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Erster Flug sollte Premium sein' act = lv_first_premium-is_premium ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Preis des ersten Fluges sollte über dem Schwellenwert liegen' act = lv_first_premium-price > lv_threshold ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_premium_flights_none.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_assignment( ).
    DATA(lv_high_threshold) = 999999.00. " Sehr hoher Schwellenwert
    DATA(lt_premium_flights) = lo_cut->get_premium_flights( lv_high_threshold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sollte keine Premium-Flüge finden' act = lt_premium_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht bedingte Zuweisungen direkt in Ausdrücken, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN` kann eine interne Tabelle mit transformierten Daten und bedingten Werten in einer einzigen Anweisung erstellt werden.
keywords: FOR, COND, VALUE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine finale Klasse, die eine einfache mathematische Operation (z.B. Quadrat einer Zahl) als statische Methode bereitstellt. Die Klasse soll nicht vererbbar sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS ... DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL` und `CLASS-METHODS` für die statische Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_utils_final DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_square IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_square) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_utils_final IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_square.
    rv_square = iv_number * iv_number.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_square FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_square.
    DATA(lv_result) = zcl_math_utils_final=>get_square( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 25 msg = 'Test for 5 squared failed' ).

    lv_result = zcl_math_utils_final=>get_square( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Test for 0 squared failed' ).

    lv_result = zcl_math_utils_final=>get_square( -3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 9 msg = 'Test for -3 squared failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration einer Klasse als `FINAL` verhindert, dass sie von anderen Klassen geerbt werden kann, was die Stabilität und Vorhersehbarkeit des Designs erhöht. `CLASS-METHODS` definieren statische Methoden, die ohne Instanziierung der Klasse direkt aufgerufen werden können, ideal für Utility-Funktionen.
keywords: FINAL, CLASS-METHODS, UTILITY, STATIC

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse mit einer Methode, die als `FINAL` deklariert ist. Demonstrieren Sie, dass diese Methode in einer Unterklasse nicht überschrieben werden kann (im Solution-Code wird nur die Basisklasse gezeigt und die Implikation erklärt).
hint: Verwenden Sie `METHODS ... FINAL` in der Basisklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string FINAL.
    METHODS get_status ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_final_method.
    " Da zcl_base_processor ABSTRACT ist, können wir sie nicht direkt instanziieren.
    " Wir erstellen eine Dummy-Implementierung für den Test.
    CLASS lcl_concrete_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_processor.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_status REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_concrete_processor IMPLEMENTATION.

        rv_status = 'OK'.

    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW lcl_concrete_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_data( 'Hello' ).

explanation: Die Deklaration einer Methode als `FINAL` in einer Superklasse verhindert, dass diese Methode in Unterklassen überschrieben werden kann.       PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine finale Klasse, deren Instanziierung nur über eine statische Fabrikmethode möglich ist (`CREATE PRIVATE`). Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Singleton-Muster, das sicherstellt, dass nur eine Instanz der Klasse existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS ... DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE` und eine `CLASS-METHODS GET_INSTANCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_config.
    METHODS get_setting IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
    METHODS set_setting IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string iv_value TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_config.
    DATA mt_settings TYPE string_table VALUE IS INITIAL.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Private Konstruktor, um externe Instanziierung zu verhindern
    APPEND 'DefaultValue1' TO mt_settings.
    APPEND 'DefaultValue2' TO mt_settings.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS NOT BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT go_instance.
    ENDIF.
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_setting.
    READ TABLE mt_settings INDEX 1 INTO rv_value.
    " Vereinfachte Logik, in Realität komplexere Key-Value-Paare
    IF iv_key = 'Setting1' AND lines( mt_settings ) >= 1.
      rv_value = mt_settings[1].
    ELSEIF iv_key = 'Setting2' AND lines( mt_settings ) >= 2.
      rv_value = mt_settings[2].
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'NotFound'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_setting.
    " Vereinfachte Logik
    IF iv_key = 'Setting1'.
      IF lines( mt_settings ) >= 1.
        mt_settings[1] = iv_value.
      ELSE.
        APPEND iv_value TO mt_settings.
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF iv_key = 'Setting2'.
      IF lines( mt_settings ) >= 2.
        mt_settings[2] = iv_value.
      ELSEIF lines( mt_settings ) = 1.
        APPEND iv_value TO mt_settings.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_singleton_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_singleton_pattern.
    DATA(lo_instance1) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_instance2) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_instance( ).

    " Überprüfen, ob beide Referenzen auf dasselbe Objekt zeigen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance1 exp = lo_instance2 msg = 'Singleton instances are not the same' ).

    " Testen der Funktionalität
    lo_instance1->set_setting( iv_key = 'Setting1' iv_value = 'NewValue' ).
    DATA(lv_setting) = lo_instance2->get_setting( 'Setting1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_setting exp = 'NewValue' msg = 'Setting not updated correctly via singleton' ).

    " Zurücksetzen des Singletons für weitere Tests (optional, aber gut für Unit Tests)
    CLEAR zcl_singleton_config=>go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Singleton-Muster stellt sicher, dass eine Klasse nur eine einzige Instanz hat und einen globalen Zugriffspunkt darauf bietet. Dies wird durch `CREATE PRIVATE` (verhindert externe Instanziierung), einen privaten Konstruktor und eine statische Fabrikmethode (`get_instance`) erreicht, die die einzige Instanz verwaltet. Die Klasse ist zudem `FINAL`, um eine Vererbung und damit die Umgehung des Singleton-Prinzips zu verhindern.
keywords: FINAL, CREATE PRIVATE, SINGLETON, DESIGN PATTERNS, GLOBAL ACCESS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für einen Daten-Transformator mit einer Methode `transform_data`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer finalen Klasse, die Flugdaten (aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`) transformiert, indem sie beispielsweise den Preis in eine andere Währung umrechnet (vereinfacht).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und eine `FINAL` Klasse, die das `INTERFACE` implementiert.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_transformer PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
           carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
           connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           fldate   TYPE s_date,
           price    TYPE s_price,
           currency TYPE s_currcode,
           new_price TYPE s_price,
           new_currency TYPE s_currcode,
         END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
  TYPES: tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS transform_data
    IMPORTING
      it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      iv_target_currency TYPE s_currcode
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_transformer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_transformer~transform_data.
    DATA: lv_exchange_rate TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '1.2'. " Fester Wechselkurs für Demo

    rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                   ( carrid       = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                     connid       = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                     fldate       = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                                     price        = <fs_sflight>-price
                                     currency     = <fs_sflight>-currency
                                     new_price    = <fs_sflight>-price * lv_exchange_rate
                                     new_currency = iv_target_currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sflight_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_transformation.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid   = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid   = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate   = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price    = '100.00'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid   = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid   = '0017'.
    ls_sflight-fldate   = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price    = '200.00'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_sflight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->zif_data_transformer~transform_data( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_target_currency = 'GBP' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of transformed entries' ).

    DATA(ls_transformed_lh) = lt_transformed[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_transformed_lh-new_price exp = '120.00' msg = 'LH price transformation incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_transformed_lh-new_currency exp = 'GBP' msg = 'LH currency incorrect' ).

    DATA(ls_transformed_aa) = lt_transformed[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_transformed_aa-new_price exp = '240.00' msg = 'AA price transformation incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_transformed_aa-new_currency exp = 'GBP' msg = 'AA currency incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FINAL` und `INTERFACE` für eine robuste Daten-Transformationslogik. Das Interface `zif_data_transformer` definiert den Vertrag für die Transformation, während die `FINAL` Klasse `zcl_sflight_transformer` eine spezifische, unveränderliche Implementierung für `SFLIGHTS` bereitstellt. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature für die kompakte Initialisierung von internen Tabellen.
keywords: FINAL, INTERFACE, DATA TRANSFORMATION, SFLIGHTS, VALUE, FOR, MODERN ABAP

  METHOD test_optional_parameter.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_item_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_processor->zif_processor~process_item( iv_item = 'Apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Item: Apple, Mode: DEFAULT_MODE' msg = 'Optional parameter default failed' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_processor->zif_processor~process_item( iv_item = 'Banana' iv_mode = 'CUSTOM_MODE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'Item: Banana, Mode: CUSTOM_MODE' msg = 'Optional parameter custom value failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50 ermöglicht die Definition von optionalen Parametern mit Standardwerten direkt in Interface-Methoden. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität der Interface-Definition, da Implementierungen nicht alle Parameter explizit übergeben müssen, wenn der Standardwert ausreichend ist. Es fördert auch die Abwärtskompatibilität bei der Erweiterung von Interfaces.
keywords: INTERFACE, OPTIONAL PARAMETER, DEFAULT VALUE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer funktionalen Methode, die zwei Zahlen addiert und das Ergebnis zurückgibt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von funktionalen Methoden und Methodenverkettung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `RETURNING VALUE` für die funktionale Methode und rufen Sie die Methode direkt im Ausdruck auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS calculate_sum_and_product IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    rv_result = iv_num1 * iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sum_and_product.
    rv_result = me->add( iv_num1 = iv_num1 iv_num2 = iv_num2 ) * me->multiply( iv_num1 = iv_num1 iv_num2 = iv_num2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum_and_product FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_sum_and_product.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->calculate_sum_and_product( iv_num1 = 2 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    " (2+3) * (2*3) = 5 * 6 = 30
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Funktionale Methoden (mit `RETURNING VALUE`) ermöglichen die direkte Verwendung des Methodenrückgabewerts in Ausdrücken und die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.
keywords: METHOD, FUNCTIONAL, CHAINING, OBJECT ORIENTATION

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ab und werfen Sie eine eigene, anwendungsspezifische Ausnahme `ZCX_DIVISION_ERROR` mit einer aussagekräftigen Fehlermeldung.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_numerator TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_denominator TYPE i OPTIONAL.

    DATA mv_numerator TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_denominator TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_numerator = iv_numerator.
    me->mv_denominator = iv_denominator.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_division_error.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        zcx_division_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_num1 / iv_num2.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_division_error=>default_text
            iv_numerator = iv_num1
            iv_denominator = iv_num2.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_division_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_ops) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_ops->divide( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_exception.
    DATA(lo_ops) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    TRY.
        lo_ops->divide( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected ZCX_DIVISION_ERROR was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_division_error INTO DATA(lx_div_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_div_error->mv_numerator exp = 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_div_error->mv_denominator exp = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lx_div_error->get_text( ) ). " Default text is empty if not set
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von anwendungsspezifischen Ausnahme-Klassen (hier `ZCX_DIVISION_ERROR`) verbessert die Fehlerbehandlung und -diagnose. `RAISING` in der Methodensignatur deklariert die möglichen Ausnahmen, und `TRY...CATCH` ermöglicht eine strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: RAISE, EXCEPTION, TRY, CATCH, CLASS, ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in eine interne Tabelle. Verwenden Sie die neue Open SQL Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FOR` für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_table_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_key.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_table_entry
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_no_table_entry=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_no_entry FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_no_table_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_success.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_key( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_no_entry.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_flights_by_key( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_NO_TABLE_ENTRY was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_table_entry.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue Open SQL Syntax mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Ziel-Tabelle, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist obligatorisch. Eine Ausnahme wird geworfen, wenn keine Einträge gefunden werden.
keywords: SELECT, OPEN SQL, DATA, INLINE, TABLE, METHOD, RAISE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und geben Sie die gefilterten Flüge zurück. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_price.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).

    IF rt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_table_line_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_success.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 1000.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-price = 500.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-price = 1200.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_price( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_min_price = 900 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_filter->filter_flights_by_price( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_min_price = 200 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_TABLE_LINE_NOT_FOUND was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne und deklarative Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte. Eine Ausnahme wird geworfen, wenn das Filterergebnis leer ist.
keywords: FILTER, INTERNAL TABLES, METHOD, RAISE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften verwaltet. Die Klasse soll eine Methode `add_airline` haben, die eine Fluggesellschaft hinzufügt, und eine Methode `get_airline_names`, die alle Namen der Fluggesellschaften als String-Tabelle zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Initialisierung und Transformation der Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` für die Initialisierung und Transformation von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_airline_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_airline_name TYPE s_carr_id.
    TYPES tt_airline_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline_name TYPE ty_airline_name
      RAISING
        cx_sy_duplicate_key.

    METHODS get_airline_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_airline_names) TYPE tt_airline_names.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_airlines TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_airline_name WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airline_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_airline.
    INSERT iv_airline_name INTO TABLE mt_airlines.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_duplicate_key
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_duplicate_key=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_airline_names.
    rt_airline_names = VALUE #( FOR airline IN mt_airlines ( airline ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_and_get_airlines FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_airline FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_duplicate_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_and_get_airlines.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_airline_manager( ).
    lo_manager->add_airline( 'LH' ).
    lo_manager->add_airline( 'UA' ).
    DATA(lt_names) = lo_manager->get_airline_names( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_names ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_names[ 1 ] exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_names[ 2 ] exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_airline.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_airline_manager( ).
    lo_manager->add_airline( 'LH' ).
    TRY.
        lo_manager->add_airline( 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_DUPLICATE_KEY was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_duplicate_key.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Initialisierung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um Daten aus einer Tabelle in eine andere zu kopieren oder zu projizieren. Die Verwendung einer `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine Duplikate hinzugefügt werden, und löst bei Versuch eine Ausnahme aus.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, INTERNAL TABLES, METHOD, RAISE, OBJECT ORIENTATION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Status-Code eine Statusbeschreibung zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator für die bedingte Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH` Operator für eine kompakte Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    TYPES ty_status_text TYPE string.

    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE ty_status_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE ty_status_text
      RAISING
        cx_sy_switch_no_case.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH ty_status_text(
      iv_status_code
      WHEN 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'
      WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blockiert'
      WHEN 'C' THEN 'Geschlossen'
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_switch_no_case
                 EXPORTING
                   textid = cx_sy_switch_no_case=>default_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein beliebiges Datenobjekt entgegennimmt und dessen Typinformationen (z.B. Name, Typkategorie) mittels RTTI ausliest. Wenn das Objekt eine Struktur ist, soll eine Ausnahme geworfen werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für RTTI. Prüfen Sie mit `IS INSTANCE OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_is_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_is_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_is_structure=>default_text.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_type_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_type_info,
             name        TYPE string,
             kind        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_type_info.

    METHODS get_type_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_type_info) TYPE ty_type_info
      RAISING
        zcx_is_structure
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_type_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_info.
    IF ir_data IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_ref_is_initial=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_is_structure
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_is_structure=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rs_type_info-name = lo_typedescr->get_name( ).
    rs_type_info-kind = lo_typedescr->type_kind.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) und einen Feldnamen als String entgegennimmt. Die Methode soll den Wert dieses Feldes für den ersten Eintrag der Tabelle dynamisch auslesen und zurückgeben. Wenn das Feld nicht existiert, soll eine Ausnahme geworfen werden.

CLASS zcx_field_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_field_name TYPE string OPTIONAL.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_field_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_field_name = iv_field_name.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.

    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_flights  TYPE tt_flights
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_field_not_found
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    READ TABLE it_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_table_line_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_field_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_field_not_found=>default_text
          iv_field_name = iv_field_name.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <fs_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
