Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_table_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_airline.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_table_entry
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_no_table_entry=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_price_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_total_price_no_entry FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_no_table_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_price_success.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_aggregator->get_total_price_by_airline( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total_price ).
    " Assuming LH has flights with prices, check if sum is positive
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_total_price_no_entry.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_aggregator->get_total_price_by_airline( 'XX' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_NO_TABLE_ENTRY was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_table_entry.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Einträge iteriert und eine Akkumulationslogik anwendet. Dies ist eine funktionale und moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... SUM` oder manuellen Schleifen mit Zwischenvariablen. Eine Ausnahme wird geworfen, wenn keine Flüge für die angegebene Fluggesellschaft gefunden werden.
keywords: REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, METHOD, RAISE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_SERVICE` mit einer Methode `get_flight_details`, die eine Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer entgegennimmt. Diese Methode soll eine Instanz von `ZCL_FLIGHT_READER` (aus Beispiel 3) verwenden, um die Flugdaten zu lesen. Demonstrieren Sie Dependency Injection über den Konstruktor.

CLASS zcl_flight_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_flight_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mo_flight_reader = io_flight_reader.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    " Mock the dependency ZCL_FLIGHT_READER
    DATA(lo_mock_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    " For a real test, you might want to create a test double (mock/stub) here
    " For simplicity, we use the real reader for this example.

    DATA(lt_details) = lo_service->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_details ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_details[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

explanation: Dependency Injection (hier über den Konstruktor) ist ein wichtiges Prinzip der Objektorientierung, das die Entkopplung von Klassen fördert. Anstatt dass eine Klasse ihre Abhängigkeiten selbst erzeugt, werden diese von außen bereitgestellt. Dies verbessert die Testbarkeit, Wartbarkeit und Flexibilität des Codes. Die Methode `get_flight_details` delegiert die Datenbeschaffung an die injizierte `ZCL_FLIGHT_READER`-Instanz.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein Datum entgegennimmt und prüft, ob es in der Zukunft liegt. Geben Sie 'TRUE' oder 'FALSE' zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_date_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Der direkte Vergleich von Datumswerten ist in ABAP einfach und effizient. Die Methode kapselt diese Logik und gibt einen booleschen Wert zurück, was die Verwendung in bedingten Ausdrücken erleichtert. `abap_bool` ist der bevorzugte Typ für boolesche Rückgabewerte.
keywords: DATE, TIME, COMPARISON, METHOD, ABAP_BOOL

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_airline
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_table_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_airline.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_table_entry
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_no_table_entry=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ls_flight_line-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight_line-carrid
        count  = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts_empty_table RAISING cx_sy_no_table_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_grouper->get_flight_counts_by_airline( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).
    " Check if LH exists and has a count
    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_count-count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_empty_table.
    " To simulate an empty SFLIGHTS, we would need a test double or a different approach.
    " For this example, we assume SFLIGHTS is not empty in the test system.
    " If SFLIGHTS could be empty, the exception would be raised.
    " For a robust test, one might temporarily clear SFLIGHTS or use a mock.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    " This test will only pass if SFLIGHTS is actually empty, which is unlikely in a standard system.
    " A more realistic test would involve mocking the database read.
    " For demonstration purposes, we'll just call it and expect it not to raise if SFLIGHTS has data.
    TRY.
        lo_grouper->get_flight_counts_by_airline( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Assuming SFLIGHTS is not empty, no exception expected.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_table_entry.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'SFLIGHTS was empty, exception correctly raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Er ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT NEW` und `COLLECT`. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Einträge in der aktuellen Gruppe. Eine Ausnahme wird geworfen, wenn die Basistabelle leer ist.
keywords: GROUP BY, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, LOOP, METHOD, RAISE

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und speichern Sie die Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei die Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...) und eine WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights found for LH' act = lt_flights ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight should be LH' exp = 'LH' act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...) ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der internen Tabelle und füllt nur die Felder, die in der SELECT-Liste und der Struktur der internen Tabelle übereinstimmen. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: SELECT, Internal Table, Inline Declaration, WHERE

Instructions: Lesen Sie die 5 teuersten Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, sortiert nach Preis absteigend. Nutzen Sie dabei die Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS und ORDER BY ... DESCENDING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_5_expensive_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      ORDER BY price DESCENDING

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_5 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_5.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_5_expensive_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should return 5 flights' exp = 5 act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    ENDIF.

explanation: Die Kombination von ORDER BY ... DESCENDING und UP TO N ROWS ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Top-N-Einträge direkt auf der Datenbank zu ermitteln, ohne alle Daten zu lesen und dann in ABAP zu sortieren.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, Top N

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) zusammen mit den entsprechenden Fluggesellschaftsnamen (SCARR) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines).
hint: Verwenden Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen SFLIGHT und SCARR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_details,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_details.
    TYPES tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_details WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aa_flight_details RETURNING VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_flight_details.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, s~currency
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_details
      WHERE s~carrid = 'AA'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_aa_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_aa_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_join( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_cut->get_aa_flight_details( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flight details found for AA' act = lt_details ).
    IF lines( lt_details ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight should be AA' exp = 'AA' act = lt_details[ 1 ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier name should be American Airlines' exp = 'American Airlines' act = lt_details[ 1 ]-carrname ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: INNER JOIN ermöglicht das effiziente Verknüpfen von Daten aus mehreren Datenbanktabellen direkt auf der Datenbankebene, was die Performance gegenüber dem Lesen und Verknüpfen in ABAP verbessert. Die Verwendung von Aliasen (s~, c~) macht den Code klarer.
keywords: SELECT, JOIN, INNER JOIN, Database Access

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... GROUP BY und die Aggregatfunktionen COUNT(*) und SUM(price).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, SUM(price) AS total_price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_summaries
      GROUP BY carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No carrier summaries found' act = lt_summaries ).
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_sflight_agg=>ty_carrier_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH summary not found' exp = 0 act = sy-subrc ).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count for LH should be positive' act = ( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price for LH should be positive' act = ( ls_lh_summary-total_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: GROUP BY und Aggregatfunktionen ermöglichen es, Daten direkt auf der Datenbank zu aggregieren, was die Datenmenge reduziert, die an das Anwendungsprogramm übertragen werden muss, und die Performance erheblich steigert.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, COUNT, SUM, Aggregation

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Flugdaten von 'LH' und 'AA' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste. Die Struktur der Ergebnisliste soll carrid, connid und fldate enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den UNION ALL Operator, um die Ergebnisse zweier SELECT-Anweisungen zu vereinen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_aa_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_aa_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_union( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_aa_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights found for LH or AA' act = lt_flights ).
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_aa_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH flights not found in union result' act = lv_lh_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'AA flights not found in union result' act = lv_aa_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: UNION ALL ermöglicht das effiziente Kombinieren von Ergebnismengen aus mehreren SELECT-Anweisungen direkt auf der Datenbank. UNION ALL ist performanter als UNION, da es keine Duplikate entfernt.
keywords: SELECT, UNION ALL, Database Access, Combine Results

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT. Erstellen Sie ein neues Feld 'FLIGHT_INFO', das die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer kombiniert (z.B. 'LH-0400'). Fügen Sie außerdem ein Feld 'PRICE_CATEGORY' hinzu, das 'High' ist, wenn der Preis über 500 liegt, sonst 'Low'.
hint: Verwenden Sie SQL-Ausdrücke wie CONCAT_WITH_BLANK und CASE im SELECT-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sql_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_enriched,
             carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid         TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate         TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price          TYPE sflight-price,
             currency       TYPE sflight-currency,
             flight_info    TYPE string,
             price_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_enriched.
    TYPES tt_flight_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enriched_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sql_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency,
           CONCAT_WITH_BLANK( carrid, connid, '-' ) AS flight_info,
           CASE WHEN price > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS price_category
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_enriched_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enriched_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_sql_expr( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_enriched_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No enriched flights found' act = lt_flights ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight info should not be empty' act = ls_flight-flight_info ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Price category should be High or Low' act = ( ls_flight-price_category = 'High' OR ls_flight-price_category = 'Low' ) ).
      READ TABLE lt_flights INTO ls_flight WITH KEY price_category = 'High'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'High price category should have price > 500' act = ( ls_flight-price > 500 ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: SQL-Ausdrücke wie CONCAT_WITH_BLANK (ABAP-spezifisch) und CASE ermöglichen es, Daten direkt auf der Datenbank zu transformieren und zu berechnen, bevor sie an das Anwendungsprogramm übertragen werden. Dies reduziert den Verarbeitungsaufwand in ABAP und verbessert die Performance.
keywords: SELECT, SQL Expressions, CONCAT_WITH_BLANK, CASE, Data Transformation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine paginierte Liste von Flügen zurückgibt. Die Methode soll die Startposition (Offset) und die maximale Anzahl der Zeilen (Limit) als Parameter akzeptieren. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klauseln OFFSET und LIMIT im SELECT-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_offset TYPE i DEFAULT 0
        iv_limit  TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_page.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate
      OFFSET @iv_offset ROWS
      UP TO @iv_limit ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_pagination FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_pagination.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_pagination( ).

    DATA(lt_page1) = lo_cut->get_flights_page( iv_offset = 0 iv_limit = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First page should have 5 flights' exp = 5 act = lines( lt_page1 ) ).

    DATA(lt_page2) = lo_cut->get_flights_page( iv_offset = 5 iv_limit = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second page should have 5 flights' exp = 5 act = lines( lt_page2 ) ).

    IF lines( lt_page1 ) > 0 AND lines( lt_page2 ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( msg = 'First flight of page 1 and page 2 should be different' exp = lt_page1[ 1 ]-connid act = lt_page2[ 1 ]-connid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klauseln OFFSET und LIMIT (oder UP TO N ROWS) ermöglichen eine effiziente serverseitige Paginierung von Datenbankergebnissen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für große Datenmengen, da nur die benötigten Datensätze vom Datenbankserver gelesen werden. ORDER BY ist hierbei zwingend erforderlich, um eine konsistente Reihenfolge der Seiten zu gewährleisten.
keywords: SELECT, OFFSET, LIMIT, UP TO N ROWS, Pagination, ORDER BY

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) und greifen Sie dynamisch auf die Felder 'CARRID' und 'CONNID' zu. Nach jeder Verarbeitung soll der Feldsymbol explizit entzugewiesen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL und UNASSIGN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_output_line) = |Flight: |.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_output_line = lv_output_line && |{ <fs_component> }-|.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_component>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_output_line = lv_output_line && |{ <fs_component> }|. 
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_component>.

      APPEND lv_output_line TO rt_processed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen als String akzeptiert. Die Methode soll versuchen, den Wert des angegebenen Feldes für die erste Zeile der Tabelle dynamisch zu lesen und zurückzugeben. Wenn der Feldzugriff fehlschlägt, soll ein leerer String zurückgegeben werden. Verwenden Sie UNASSIGN nach dem Zugriff.
hint: Nutzen Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL und UNASSIGN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_row_field_value
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_row_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lines( <fs_table> ) > 0.
      READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        ENDIF.
        UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_read FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_read.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 1 name = 'Test1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 2 name = 'Test2' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_read( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Read ID field' exp = '1' act = lo_cut->get_first_row_field_value( it_any_table = lt_data iv_field_name = 'ID' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Read Name field' exp = 'Test1' act = lo_cut->get_first_row_field_value( it_any_table = lt_data iv_field_name = 'NAME' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Read non-existent field' exp = '' act = lo_cut->get_first_row_field_value( it_any_table = lt_data iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Read from empty table' exp = '' act = lo_cut->get_first_row_field_value( it_any_table = VALUE #( ) iv_field_name = 'ID' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf Felder einer internen Tabelle mittels Feldsymbolen und des ASSIGN COMPONENT-Statements. Die Verwendung von UNASSIGN nach jedem Zugriff auf ein Feldsymbol ist entscheidend, um sicherzustellen, dass die Referenz auf den Speicherbereich freigegeben wird, was besonders in generischen Kontexten zur Vermeidung von Fehlern und zur Optimierung der Speichernutzung beiträgt.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, ANY TABLE

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT in Paketen von 100 Zeilen, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren. Verarbeiten Sie jedes Paket einzeln.

CLASS zcl_sflight_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_sflight_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight

      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_package.

    ENDSELECT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie Statuscodes als Konstanten in einer Klasse und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, um einen Text basierend auf dem Status zurückzugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONSTANTS` in der `PUBLIC SECTION` einer Klasse und eine `CASE` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 new        TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'N',
                 in_process TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
                 completed  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C',
               END OF gc_status.

    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN gc_status-new.
        rv_description = 'Neu erstellt'.
      WHEN gc_status-in_process.
        rv_description = 'In Bearbeitung'.
      WHEN gc_status-completed.
        rv_description = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannter Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_descriptions.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_status_processor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_description( zcl_status_processor=>gc_status-new ) exp = 'Neu erstellt' msg = 'Test NEW status' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_description( zcl_status_processor=>gc_status-in_process ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' msg = 'Test IN_PROCESS status' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_description( zcl_status_processor=>gc_status-completed ) exp = 'Abgeschlossen' msg = 'Test COMPLETED status' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_status_description( 'X' ) exp = 'Unbekannter Status' msg = 'Test UNKNOWN status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von strukturierten Konstanten (`gc_status`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich, da 'Magic Strings' vermieden werden. Die `CASE WHEN` Anweisung ist eine klare und effiziente Methode zur bedingten Logik.
keywords: CONSTANTS, CASE, WHEN, Status Codes, Structured Constants

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem numerischen Wert eine Kategorie (z.B. 'Low', 'Medium', 'High') zuweist, indem Sie eine `COND` Expression verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `COND` Expression mit mehreren `WHEN` Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_category.
    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN iv_value < 10  THEN 'Low'
      WHEN iv_value < 50  THEN 'Medium'
      WHEN iv_value >= 50 THEN 'High'
      ELSE 'Undefined' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_categorizer->get_category( 75 ) exp = 'High' msg = 'Test High category' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Wochentag (als Zahl 1-7) in seinen deutschen Namen umwandelt, unter Verwendung der `SWITCH` Expression.

CLASS zcl_weekday_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_weekday_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    rv_day_name = SWITCH string(
      iv_day_number
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die ein Objekt einer generischen Schnittstelle akzeptiert und je nach konkretem Typ des Objekts unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt oder spezifische Informationen extrahiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE TYPE OF` mit `WHEN TYPE` und `INTO DATA(...)` für Downcasts.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Kreis mit Radius { mv_radius }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width  TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width  = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Rechteck mit Länge { mv_length } und Breite { mv_width }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_info = |Verarbeite Kreis: { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_description() }, Fläche: { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area() }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_rectangle INTO DATA(lo_rectangle).
        rv_info = |Verarbeite Rechteck: { lo_rectangle->zif_shape~get_description() }, Fläche: { lo_rectangle->zif_shape~get_area() }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_info = 'Unbekannte Form'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_shapes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_shapes.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_circle)    = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5.0' ).
    DATA(lo_rectangle) = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '10.0' iv_width = '4.0' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Kreis' act = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_circle ) msg = 'Test Circle processing' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und eine Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen (`SEATSMAX`) haben, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit `WHERE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    " Dummy data for demonstration if sflights is not available or for isolated testing
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 150 )
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 80 )
                           ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 120 )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 250 ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax >= iv_min_seats )
                                   ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                                     fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
                                     seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_filtering.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 flights for LH with min 100 seats' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First flight connection ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' msg = 'Second flight connection ID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' msg = 'AA flight connection ID' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen numerischen Wert überprüft und basierend darauf, ob er in einem vordefinierten Bereich liegt, eine Meldung zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN IN`.
hint: Definieren Sie einen `RANGE` Typ und eine `RANGE` Tabelle, um sie in der `CASE WHEN IN` Bedingung zu verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE i,
             high   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_range_line,
           tt_ranges TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_range_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_range_message.
    DATA(lt_critical_range) = VALUE tt_ranges(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 10 high = 20 )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 50 ) ).

    DATA(lt_warning_range) = VALUE tt_ranges(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 1 high = 9 )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 21 high = 49 ) ).

    CASE iv_value.
      WHEN IN lt_critical_range.
        rv_message = |Wert { iv_value } ist im kritischen Bereich!|.
      WHEN IN lt_warning_range.
        rv_message = |Wert { iv_value } ist im Warnbereich.|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = |Wert { iv_value } ist außerhalb der definierten Bereiche.|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'kritischen Bereich' act = lo_checker->get_range_message( 50 ) msg = 'Test critical range (EQ)' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der `PRICE` von Flügen aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte `CARRID` haben und deren `FLDATE` in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flight_price_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flight_price_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    " Dummy data for demonstration
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251120' price = '200.00' )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20260101' price = '150.00' )
                           ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251215' price = '120.00' )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251110' price = '300.00' ) ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > lv_today )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_future_flight_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flight_sum.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).

    " Assuming sy-datum is before 20251201 for this test to be valid
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_aggregator->get_future_flight_price_sum( 'LH' ) exp = '250.00' msg = 'Test sum for LH future flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_aggregator->get_future_flight_price_sum( 'AA' ) exp = '0.00' msg = 'Test sum for AA future flights (none)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_aggregator->get_future_flight_price_sum( 'UA' ) exp = '120.00' msg = 'Test sum for UA future flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ermöglicht eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Aggregation von Daten. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` wird die Iteration und Filterung direkt in der Aggregationslogik integriert, was den Code extrem prägnant und ausdrucksstark macht. Die `WHERE` Bedingung fungiert hier als implizites `WHEN` für die Iteration.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, Expressions

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie einen Eingabeparameter und geben Sie eine Meldung zurück, ob er initial ist oder einen Wert enthält, unter Verwendung einer `CASE` Anweisung mit `WHEN IS INITIAL`.

CLASS zcl_initial_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_initial_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_value_initiality.
    CASE iv_input.
      WHEN IS INITIAL.
        rv_message = 'Der Wert ist initial (leer).'.
      WHEN IS NOT INITIAL.

    ENDCASE.

CLASS zcl_error_messages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_messages,
                 data_not_found TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG_APP' MESSAGE '001',
                 invalid_input  TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG_APP' MESSAGE '002',
               END OF gc_messages.

    METHODS get_error_text
      IMPORTING
        is_message_id TYPE symsgid
        iv_param1     TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_param2     TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_messages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_text.
    DATA: lv_msg_text TYPE string.

    MESSAGE ID is_message_id-msgid TYPE 'I' NUMBER is_message_id-msgno
      WITH iv_param1 iv_param2 INTO lv_msg_text.

    rv_error_text = lv_msg_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_formatter->format_date( id_date = ld_test_date iv_format_key = 'UNKNOWN' )
                                        exp = '20251121' msg = 'Test default format' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von strukturierten Konstanten (`gc_date_formats`) für Datumsformat-Schlüssel verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit, da die Formatierungslogik von den spezifischen Format-Strings entkoppelt wird. Die `CASE WHEN` Anweisung in Kombination mit String-Templates und den `DATE` Optionen (`ISO`, `USER`) bietet eine moderne und flexible Art der Datumsformatierung.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Date/Time, Formatting, String Templates, CASE, WHEN

Instructions: Definieren Sie Umrechnungsfaktoren als Konstanten in einer Klasse und verwenden Sie diese, um Werte zwischen verschiedenen Einheiten umzurechnen (z.B. Meter zu Kilometer).
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONSTANTS` für die Umrechnungsfaktoren und einfache arithmetische Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unit_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_conversion_factors,
                 meter_to_kilometer TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '0.001',
                 kilometer_to_meter TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '1000.0',
                 celsius_to_fahrenheit_factor TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '1.8',
                 celsius_to_fahrenheit_offset TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '32.0',
               END OF gc_conversion_factors.

    METHODS convert_meter_to_kilometer
      IMPORTING
        iv_meters TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_kilometers) TYPE decfloat16.

    METHODS convert_celsius_to_fahrenheit
      IMPORTING
        iv_celsius TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_fahrenheit) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unit_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_meter_to_kilometer.
    rv_kilometers = iv_meters * gc_conversion_factors-meter_to_kilometer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_celsius_to_fahrenheit.
    rv_fahrenheit = ( iv_celsius * gc_conversion_factors-celsius_to_fahrenheit_factor ) + gc_conversion_factors-celsius_to_fahrenheit_offset.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unit_conversions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unit_conversions.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_unit_converter( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_converter->convert_meter_to_kilometer( '1000.0' ) exp = '1.0' msg = 'Test 1000m to 1km' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_converter->convert_meter_to_kilometer( '500.0' ) exp = '0.5' msg = 'Test 500m to 0.5km' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_converter->convert_celsius_to_fahrenheit( '0.0' ) exp = '32.0' msg = 'Test 0C to 32F' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_converter->convert_celsius_to_fahrenheit( '100.0' ) exp = '212.0' msg = 'Test 100C to 212F' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Definition von Umrechnungsfaktoren als strukturierte Konstanten (`gc_conversion_factors`) zentralisiert diese wichtigen Werte und macht den Code robuster gegenüber Änderungen. Die Verwendung von `decfloat16` für mathematische Operationen gewährleistet eine hohe Präzision, was in Umrechnungen oft kritisch ist.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Unit Conversion, Math, DECFLOAT16, Structured Constants

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Ampelphasen (ROT, GELB, GRÜN) und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, um die nächste Phase zu bestimmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ENUMERATION` und `CASE TYPE OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_traffic_light DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_phase,
        red,
        yellow,
        green,
      END OF ENUM traffic_phase.

      IMPORTING
        iv_current_phase TYPE traffic_phase
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_phase) TYPE traffic_phase.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_traffic_light IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_phase.
    CASE iv_current_phase.
      WHEN traffic_phase=>red.
        rv_next_phase = traffic_phase=>green.
      WHEN traffic_phase=>green.
        rv_next_phase = traffic_phase=>yellow.
      WHEN traffic_phase=>yellow.
        rv_next_phase = traffic_phase=>red.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für HTTP-Statuscodes, die neben dem Namen auch den numerischen Wert und eine kurze Beschreibung enthält. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die diese Informationen für einen gegebenen Statuscode zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ENUMERATION` mit `VALUE IS INITIAL` und eine Hilfsstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ENUM http_status_code,
        ok        VALUE IS INITIAL, " 200 OK
        created   VALUE IS INITIAL, " 201 Created
        bad_request VALUE IS INITIAL, " 400 Bad Request
        not_found VALUE IS INITIAL, " 404 Not Found
        internal_server_error VALUE IS INITIAL, " 500 Internal Server Error
      END OF ENUM http_status_code.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_status_info,
        code        TYPE i,
        description TYPE string,
      END OF ty_status_info.

    METHODS get_status_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE http_status_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_status_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_info.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN http_status_code=>ok.
        rs_info = VALUE #( code = 200 description = 'OK' ).
      WHEN http_status_code=>created.
        rs_info = VALUE #( code = 201 description = 'Created' ).
      WHEN http_status_code=>bad_request.
        rs_info = VALUE #( code = 400 description = 'Bad Request' ).
      WHEN http_status_code=>not_found.
        rs_info = VALUE #( code = 404 description = 'Not Found' ).
      WHEN http_status_code=>internal_server_error.
        rs_info = VALUE #( code = 500 description = 'Internal Server Error' ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_status( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_status_info( zcl_http_status=>http_status_code=>ok ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-code exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-description exp = 'OK' ).

    ls_info = lo_cut->get_status_info( zcl_http_status=>http_status_code=>not_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-code exp = 404 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-description exp = 'Not Found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl ABAP-Enumerationen keine direkten assoziierten Werte wie in anderen Sprachen unterstützen, kann man durch die Kombination mit einer Struktur und einer `CASE`-Anweisung eine ähnliche Funktionalität erreichen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit im Vergleich zu magischen Zahlen.
keywords: ENUMERATION, VALUE IS INITIAL, Struktur, CASE, HTTP

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten basierend auf einem Enumerationswert für den Flugstatus (z.B. 'GEPLANT', 'VERSCHOBEN', 'GELANDET').
hint: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Flugstatus und nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` mit dem Enumerationswert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ENUM flight_status,
        planned,
        delayed,
        landed,
        cancelled,
      END OF ENUM flight_status.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight,
        flight_id TYPE string,
        status    TYPE flight_status,
        departure TYPE string,
        arrival   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_status      TYPE flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_status.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( status = iv_status ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( flight_id = 'LH400' status = zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status=>planned departure = 'FRA' arrival = 'JFK' )
      ( flight_id = 'UA100' status = zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status=>delayed departure = 'ORD' arrival = 'LAX' )
      ( flight_id = 'BA200' status = zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status=>landed departure = 'LHR' arrival = 'DXB' )
      ( flight_id = 'LH401' status = zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status=>planned departure = 'MUC' arrival = 'SFO' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status(
      it_all_flights = lt_flights
      iv_status      = zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status=>planned
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = 'LH400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-flight_id exp = 'LH401' ).

    lt_filtered = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status(
      it_all_flights = lt_flights
      iv_status      = zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status=>delayed
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = 'UA100' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von Enumerationen mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` für interne Tabellen ermöglicht eine sehr lesbare und typsichere Filterung von Daten. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Stil.
keywords: ENUMERATION, Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, Filter

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der 'Werte' aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei nur Einträge mit einem bestimmten Enumerationsstatus berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, die eine Enumeration verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ENUM process_status,
        pending,
        in_progress,
        completed,
        failed,
      END OF ENUM process_status.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_process_item,
        id     TYPE string,
        status TYPE process_status,
        value  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_process_item.
    TYPES: tt_process_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_process_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_process_items
        iv_status TYPE process_status
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR item IN it_items WHERE ( status = iv_status )
                       NEXT s = s + item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Flugdaten verarbeitet. Wenn ein einzelner Flug ungültige Daten hat, soll eine wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, damit die Verarbeitung der restlichen Flüge fortgesetzt werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_flight_data_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA flight_id TYPE s_fLighT READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_flight_id TYPE s_fLighT OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_data_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_flight_data_error.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
    me->flight_id = i_flight_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
         carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
         flight_id TYPE s_fLighT,
         valid     TYPE abap_bool,
       END OF ty_flight_data.
TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        zcx_flight_data_error. " Declared as resumable in implementation
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      TRY.
          IF ls_flight-flight_id IS INITIAL.
            RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_data_error
              MESSAGE e003(zmsg_flights) WITH ls_flight-carrid ls_flight-connid
              EXPORTING
                i_flight_id = ls_flight-flight_id. " Assuming message 003 'Flight {0} {1} has invalid flight ID'
          ENDIF.
          " Simulate successful processing
          ls_flight-valid = abap_true.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_processed_flights.
        CATCH zcx_flight_data_error INTO DATA(lx_flight_error).
          " Log the error, but continue processing
          MESSAGE lx_flight_error TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          ls_flight-valid = abap_false.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_processed_flights. " Add even invalid ones for tracking
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resumable_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_exception.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' flight_id = '0001' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' flight_id = '' ) TO lt_flights. " Invalid
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' flight_id = '0002' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->process_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-valid exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-valid exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-valid exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (`RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION`) sind nützlich, wenn ein Fehler in einer Schleife auftritt, aber die Verarbeitung der restlichen Elemente fortgesetzt werden soll. Der `CATCH` Block kann den Fehler behandeln und die Ausführung fortsetzen.
keywords: RAISE RESUMABLE, EXCEPTION, Error Handling, Loop Processing

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_threshold_exceeded.
    me->last_exceeded_value = i_current_value.
    " In a real scenario, this would trigger further actions
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_event_raising.
    DATA(lo_monitor) = NEW zcl_threshold_monitor( ).
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_event_handler( ).

    lo_monitor->check_value( 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_handler->last_exceeded_value exp = 0 ). " No event yet

    lo_monitor->check_value( 120 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_handler->last_exceeded_value exp = 120 ). " Event raised and handled

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies fördert eine modulare und erweiterbare Architektur.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (mit einem String-Feld für den Status) in eine neue Tabelle umwandelt, wobei der String-Status in einen aufgezählten Typ konvertiert wird. Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `CONV` und einem `ENUM` Typ.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_status PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM status_type,
           SCHEDULED VALUE 'S',
           DEPARTED  VALUE 'D',
           ARRIVED   VALUE 'A',
           CANCELLED VALUE 'X',
         END OF ENUM status_type.
ENDINTERFACE.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_flight,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid TYPE s_conn_id,
         status TYPE string,
       END OF ty_raw_flight.
TYPES tt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_flight,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid TYPE s_conn_id,
         status TYPE zif_flight_status=>status_type,
       END OF ty_processed_flight.
TYPES tt_processed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_raw_to_enum_status
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_raw_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_processed_flights
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_parameter. " Reusing exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_raw_to_enum_status.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
                                    LET lv_enum_status =
                                      TRY.
                                          CONV zif_flight_status=>status_type( ls_raw-status )
                                        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                                          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_parameter
                                            MESSAGE e005(zmsg_flights) WITH ls_raw-status. " Invalid status string
                                      ENDTRY
                                    ( carrid = ls_raw-carrid
                                      connid = ls_raw-connid
                                      status = lv_enum_status ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mapping_with_error FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping_success.
    DATA lt_raw TYPE tt_raw_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_raw_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' status = 'S' ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE ty_raw_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' status = 'D' ) TO lt_raw.

    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_flight_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_mapper->map_raw_to_enum_status( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-status exp = zif_flight_status=>status_type=>scheduled ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ]-status exp = zif_flight_status=>status_type=>departed ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mapping_with_error.
    DATA lt_raw TYPE tt_raw_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_raw_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' status = 'S' ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE ty_raw_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' status = 'Z' ) TO lt_raw. " Invalid status

    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_flight_mapper( ).
    lo_mapper->map_raw_to_enum_status( lt_raw ).
    " Expecting zcx_invalid_parameter
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `CONV` ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen, einschließlich der Konvertierung von Datentypen. Die `TRY...CATCH` Block innerhalb des `LET` Ausdrucks erlaubt die Fehlerbehandlung für einzelne Zeilen, ohne die gesamte Operation abzubrechen.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_t_quantities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_qty
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_qty TYPE i
        it_quantities  TYPE ty_t_quantities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_qty) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_qty.
    rv_remaining_qty = REDUCE i( INIT result = iv_initial_qty
                                 FOR quantity IN it_quantities
                                 NEXT result = result - quantity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_multi_delim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_multi_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string

        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_split_multi_delim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_multi_delimiter.
    DATA(lv_normalized_string) = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[;, ]+' IN lv_normalized_string WITH ','.
    SPLIT lv_normalized_string AT ',' INTO TABLE rt_parts.
    DELETE rt_parts WHERE table_line IS INITIAL. "Remove empty parts if multiple delimiters were adjacent
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teile einen String, der Daten in einem festen Format (z.B. 'Key:Value') enthält, und mappe die Teile direkt in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen.
hint: Verwende eine `FOR` Expression in Kombination mit `SPLIT` und `VALUE` für die direkte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_map_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_key_value,
        key   TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_s_key_value,
      ty_t_key_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_key_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS split_and_map
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_values) TYPE ty_t_key_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_map_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_map.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    rt_key_values = VALUE #( FOR line IN lt_lines
                             LET lv_colon_pos = find( val = line sub = ':' ) IN
                             WHERE ( lv_colon_pos IS NOT INITIAL ) " Nur Zeilen mit ':' verarbeiten
                             ( key   = substring( val = line len = lv_colon_pos )
                               value = substring( val = line off = lv_colon_pos + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_sum_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_number_string TYPE string

CLASS zcl_split_sum_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_numbers_as_string) = VALUE string_table( ).

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0
                       FOR number_str IN lt_numbers_as_string

CLASS zcl_parse_url_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_query_param,
        name  TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_s_query_param,
      ty_t_query_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_query_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_query_string TYPE string

        VALUE(rt_params) TYPE ty_t_query_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_parse_url_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_query_string.
    DATA(lt_pairs) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_query_string AT '&' INTO TABLE lt_pairs.

    rt_params = VALUE #( FOR pair IN lt_pairs
                         LET lv_equal_pos = find( val = pair sub = '=' ) IN
                         WHERE ( lv_equal_pos IS NOT INITIAL ) " Nur gültige Schlüssel-Wert-Paare
                         ( name  = substring( val = pair len = lv_equal_pos )
                           value = substring( val = pair off = lv_equal_pos + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_val      TYPE string
        iv_pattern  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_res) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_regex.
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX iv_pattern IN iv_val RESULTS lt_matches.

    rt_res = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches
                      ( substring( val = iv_val off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Datumsangaben, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden (Samstag/Sonntag).
hint: Iteriere über die Tage und verwende `GET_WEEK_DAY` oder `cl_abap_tims_util`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_workday_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workday_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_between.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d.
    rv_workdays = 0.

    IF iv_date_from > iv_date_to.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_date = iv_date_from.
    DO.
      IF lv_current_date > iv_date_to.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_tims_util=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_factor,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             factor   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_factor.
    TYPES: tt_flight_factor TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_factor WITH EMPTY KEY.

        it_factors TYPE tt_flight_factor
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_updater IMPLEMENTATION.

    UPDATE sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights_tab( FOR ls_factor IN it_factors
                                                ( carrid = ls_factor-carrid
                                                  connid = ls_factor-connid
                                                  fldate = ls_factor-fldate
                                                  price  = sflights~price * ls_factor-factor ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Markieren Sie Flüge in `sflights` als 'BOOKED', wenn es mindestens eine Buchung in der Tabelle `sbook` für diesen Flug gibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHERE EXISTS` mit einer Subquery.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_booking_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_booked_status
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_booking_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_booked_status.
    UPDATE sflights SET status = 'BOOKED'
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sbook WHERE sbook~carrid = sflights~carrid
                                          AND sbook~connid = sflights~connid
                                          AND sbook~fldate = sflights~fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' status = 'OPEN' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' status = 'OPEN' ) ) ).
    INSERT sbook FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000001' customid = '1' custtype = 'B' smoker = 'X' luggweight = '10' unit = 'KG' ) ) ).

          WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
        SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_status_open)
          WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_booked exp = 'BOOKED' msg = 'Flight 0400 should be BOOKED' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_open   exp = 'OPEN'   msg = 'Flight 0401 should remain OPEN' ).

explanation: Die `WHERE EXISTS`-Klausel in Open SQL ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Existenz von abhängigen Datensätzen zu prüfen, ohne einen expliziten Join durchführen zu müssen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Aktualisierungen, bei denen nur die Existenz, nicht aber die Daten der abhängigen Tabelle relevant sind, und führt zu performanterem Code.
keywords: UPDATE, Open SQL, WHERE EXISTS, Subquery
