Instructions: Entwerfen Sie ein Strategie-Muster zur Berechnung von Rabatten. Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_DISCOUNT_STRATEGY` mit einer Methode `CALCULATE_DISCOUNT`. Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen: `CL_PERCENT_DISCOUNT` (prozentualer Rabatt) und `CL_FIXED_DISCOUNT` (fester Betrag). Eine Kontextklasse soll die Strategie zur Laufzeit wechseln können.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS` und Dependency Injection.
solution:
INTERFACE if_discount_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate_discount
    IMPORTING
      iv_amount TYPE decfloat16
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_discounted_amount) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_percent_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_discount_strategy.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_percentage TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_percent_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_percentage = iv_percentage.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_discount_strategy~calculate_discount.
    rv_discounted_amount = iv_amount * ( 1 - mv_percentage / 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_fixed_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_discount_strategy.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_fixed_amount TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_fixed_amount TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_fixed_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_fixed_amount = iv_fixed_amount.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_discount_strategy~calculate_discount.
    rv_discounted_amount = iv_amount - mv_fixed_amount.
    IF rv_discounted_amount < 0. " Discount cannot make amount negative
      rv_discounted_amount = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_discount_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO if_discount_strategy.
    METHODS apply_discount
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_amount) TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO if_discount_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_discount_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD apply_discount.
    rv_final_amount = mo_strategy->calculate_discount( iv_amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_percent_discount FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_fixed_discount FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_percent_discount.
    DATA(lo_percent_strategy) = NEW cl_percent_discount( iv_percentage = 10 ). " 10% discount
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW cl_discount_context( lo_percent_strategy ).

    DATA(lv_amount) = '100.00'.
    DATA(lv_discounted) = lo_context->apply_discount( lv_amount ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_discounted exp = '90.00' msg = '10% discount on 100 should be 90' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fixed_discount.
    DATA(lo_fixed_strategy) = NEW cl_fixed_discount( iv_fixed_amount = 20 ). " Fixed 20 discount
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW cl_discount_context( lo_fixed_strategy ).

    DATA(lv_amount) = '100.00'.
    DATA(lv_discounted) = lo_context->apply_discount( lv_amount ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_discounted exp = '80.00' msg = 'Fixed 20 discount on 100 should be 80' ).

    lv_amount = '15.00'.
    lv_discounted = lo_context->apply_discount( lv_amount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_discounted exp = '0.00' msg = 'Fixed discount should not result in negative amount' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster, implementiert mit Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`), ermöglicht es, Algorithmen (hier: Rabattberechnungen) zur Laufzeit auszutauschen. Die Kontextklasse (`cl_discount_context`) ist von den konkreten Implementierungen entkoppelt und arbeitet nur mit dem Interface (`if_discount_strategy`). Dies fördert Flexibilität, Wiederverwendbarkeit und Testbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Dependency Injection

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Factory-Method-Muster zur Erstellung verschiedener Berichtstypen. Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_REPORT` mit einer Methode `GENERATE_OUTPUT`. Erstellen Sie konkrete Implementierungen wie `CL_PDF_REPORT` und `CL_EXCEL_REPORT`. Eine Factory-Klasse soll Instanzen dieser Berichte basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS` und eine statische Factory-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE if_report PUBLIC.
  METHODS generate_output
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_pdf_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_pdf_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_report~generate_output.
    rv_output = 'PDF Report Content'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_excel_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_excel_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_report~generate_output.
    rv_output = 'Excel Report Content'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_report_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_report
      IMPORTING
        iv_report_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_report) TYPE REF TO if_report
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_report_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_report.
    CASE iv_report_type.
      WHEN 'PDF'.
        ro_report = NEW cl_pdf_report( ).
      WHEN 'EXCEL'.
        ro_report = NEW cl_excel_report( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown report type: { iv_report_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_pdf_report FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_excel_report FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_report_type FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_pdf_report.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_pdf_report) = cl_report_factory=>create_report( 'PDF' ).
        DATA(lv_output) = lo_pdf_report->generate_output( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'PDF Report Content' msg = 'Should create PDF report' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_excel_report.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_excel_report) = cl_report_factory=>create_report( 'EXCEL' ).
        DATA(lv_output) = lo_excel_report->generate_output( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'Excel Report Content' msg = 'Should create Excel report' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_report_type.
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        cl_report_factory=>create_report( 'UNKNOWN' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_true = lv_exception_caught msg = 'Should raise exception for unknown type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory-Method-Muster, kombiniert mit Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`), entkoppelt die Erstellung von Objekten von ihrer Verwendung. Die Factory-Klasse (`cl_report_factory`) ist für die Instanziierung der konkreten Berichtsklassen verantwortlich, während der Client nur mit dem Interface (`if_report`) interagiert. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Erweiterung um neue Berichtstypen, ohne bestehenden Client-Code ändern zu müssen.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Factory Method Pattern, Object Orientation, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_EVENT_HANDLER` mit einer Methode `HANDLE_EVENT`. Definieren Sie eine Klasse `CL_EVENT_SOURCE`, die ein Ereignis auslöst. Implementieren Sie `IF_EVENT_HANDLER` in einer Klasse `CL_CUSTOM_HANDLER` und registrieren Sie diese als Handler für das Ereignis.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `EVENTS`, `FOR EVENT OF` und `SET HANDLER`.
solution:
INTERFACE if_event_handler PUBLIC.
  METHODS handle_event
    FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_event_source
    IMPORTING
      sender
      iv_new_data TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_event_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS data_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_new_data) TYPE string.
    METHODS trigger_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_event_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_event.
    RAISE EVENT data_changed EXPORTING iv_new_data = iv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_custom_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_event_handler.
    DATA mv_received_data TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_custom_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_event_handler~handle_event.
    mv_received_data = iv_new_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_event_source) = NEW cl_event_source( ).
    DATA(lo_custom_handler) = NEW cl_custom_handler( ).

    SET HANDLER lo_custom_handler->if_event_handler~handle_event FOR lo_event_source.

    DATA(lv_test_data) = 'Important Data Change'.
    lo_event_source->trigger_event( lv_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_custom_handler->mv_received_data exp = lv_test_data msg = 'Handler should receive the event data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`) mit dem ABAP-Ereignissystem ermöglicht eine lose Kopplung zwischen Event-Auslösern und Event-Handlern. Das Interface definiert den Vertrag für Event-Handler, was die Flexibilität erhöht und es erlaubt, verschiedene Handler-Implementierungen nahtlos auszutauschen. Dies ist ein modernes Muster für reaktive Architekturen in ABAP.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Events, Event Handling, Object Orientation, SET HANDLER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_DATA_PROVIDER` mit einer Methode `GET_DATA` (die eine generische Tabelle zurückgibt). Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: `CL_ITAB_DATA_PROVIDER` (liefert Daten aus einer internen Tabelle) und `CL_DB_DATA_PROVIDER` (liefert Daten aus `sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS` und generische Tabellentypen.
solution:
INTERFACE if_data_provider PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_generic_data,
           field1 TYPE string,
           field2 TYPE string,
         END OF ty_generic_data.
  TYPES: tt_generic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_generic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_generic_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_itab_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_provider.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_data TYPE if_data_provider=>tt_generic_data.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE if_data_provider=>tt_generic_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_itab_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_data = it_initial_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_data_provider~get_data.
    rt_data = mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_db_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_db_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_provider~get_data.
    SELECT FROM sflights FIELDS carrid AS field1, connid AS field2
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data) UP TO 2 ROWS.

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_data
                         ( field1 = ls_sflight-field1
                           field2 = ls_sflight-field2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_itab_data_provider FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_db_data_provider FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ) ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate = '20250101'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_itab_data_provider.
    DATA(lt_initial_data) = VALUE if_data_provider=>tt_generic_data(
      ( field1 = 'ITAB_A' field2 = 'ITAB_B' )
      ( field1 = 'ITAB_C' field2 = 'ITAB_D' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_itab_provider) = NEW cl_itab_data_provider( lt_initial_data ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_itab_provider->get_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 msg = 'ITAB provider should return 2 lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[1]-field1 exp = 'ITAB_A' msg = 'First field of first line incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_db_data_provider.
    DATA(lo_db_provider) = NEW cl_db_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_db_provider->get_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 msg = 'DB provider should return 2 lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[1]-field1 exp = 'AA' msg = 'First field of first line from DB incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Data Provider Interface (`IMPLEMENTS`) ist ein klassisches Beispiel für Abstraktion in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Es ermöglicht es, verschiedene Datenquellen (interne Tabelle, Datenbanktabelle, etc.) über eine einheitliche Schnittstelle anzusprechen. Dies fördert die Modularität, erleichtert den Austausch von Datenquellen und verbessert die Testbarkeit, da Datenquellen leicht durch Mock-Objekte ersetzt werden können.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Data Provider, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Generic Types

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis und die Währung in `sflights` für Flüge, die in einer internen Tabelle definiert sind, wobei die Währung aus einer anderen internen Tabelle (`lt_currencies`) stammt, die dem Carrier zugeordnet ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM @(itab)` mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und `COND` für die Währungssuche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_complex_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             new_price TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES: tt_flight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_currency,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             currency TYPE scarr-currcode,
           END OF ty_carrier_currency.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_currency TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_currency WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flights_with_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_updates   TYPE tt_flight_update
        it_currencies TYPE tt_carrier_currency
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_complex_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_with_currency.
    UPDATE sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights_tab( FOR ls_update IN it_updates
                                                ( carrid   = ls_update-carrid
                                                  connid   = ls_update-connid
                                                  fldate   = ls_update-fldate
                                                  price    = ls_update-new_price
                                                  currency = COND #( WHEN line_exists( it_currencies[ carrid = ls_update-carrid ] ) THEN it_currencies[ carrid = ls_update-carrid ]-currency ELSE sflights~currency ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_complex_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE fldate = '20250101'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_complex_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_complex_update( ).

    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_sflight_complex_update=>tt_flight_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '250.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_currencies) = VALUE zcl_sflight_complex_update=>tt_carrier_currency(
      ( carrid = 'LH' currency = 'GBP' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' currency = 'CAD' )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->update_flights_with_currency( it_updates = lt_updates it_currencies = lt_currencies ).
        COMMIT WORK.

        SELECT SINGLE price, currency FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_flight_lh)
          WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
        SELECT SINGLE price, currency FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_flight_ua)
          WHERE carrid = 'UA' AND connid = '0010' AND fldate = '20250101'.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-price    exp = '120.00' msg = 'LH Price incorrect' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-currency exp = 'GBP'    msg = 'LH Currency incorrect' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_ua-price    exp = '250.00' msg = 'UA Price incorrect' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_ua-currency exp = 'CAD'    msg = 'UA Currency incorrect' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_sql->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `UPDATE ... FROM @(itab)` mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und der `COND`-Expression. Dies ermöglicht eine hochflexible und kompakte Definition der zu aktualisierenden Daten, wobei Werte aus mehreren internen Tabellen dynamisch zur Laufzeit ermittelt werden können. Es ist ein sehr modernes Muster für komplexe Massenaktualisierungen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Observer-Muster, bei dem ein Subjekt (`CL_SUBJECT`) Änderungen an seinen Beobachtern (`IF_OBSERVER`) mitteilt. Die Beobachter sollen ein Interface implementieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `REGISTER`, `DEREGISTER` und `NOTIFY` Methoden.
solution:
INTERFACE if_observer PUBLIC.
  METHODS update_state
    IMPORTING
      iv_new_state TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_subject DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_observer
      IMPORTING
        io_observer TYPE REF TO if_observer.
    METHODS deregister_observer
      IMPORTING
        io_observer TYPE REF TO if_observer.
    METHODS set_state
      IMPORTING
        iv_state TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_observers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_observer WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mv_state TYPE string.
    METHODS notify_observers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_subject IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_observer.
    INSERT io_observer INTO TABLE mt_observers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deregister_observer.
    DELETE mt_observers WHERE table_line = io_observer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_state.
    mv_state = iv_state.
    notify_observers( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD notify_observers.
    LOOP AT mt_observers INTO DATA(lo_observer).
      lo_observer->update_state( mv_state ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_concrete_observer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_observer.
    DATA mv_last_state TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_concrete_observer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_observer~update_state.
    mv_last_state = iv_new_state.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_observer_pattern FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_deregister_observer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_observer_pattern.
    DATA(lo_subject) = NEW cl_subject( ).
    DATA(lo_observer1) = NEW cl_concrete_observer( ).
    DATA(lo_observer2) = NEW cl_concrete_observer( ).

    lo_subject->register_observer( lo_observer1 ).
    lo_subject->register_observer( lo_observer2 ).

    lo_subject->set_state( 'State A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer1->mv_last_state exp = 'State A' msg = 'Observer 1 should receive State A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer2->mv_last_state exp = 'State A' msg = 'Observer 2 should receive State A' ).

    lo_subject->set_state( 'State B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer1->mv_last_state exp = 'State B' msg = 'Observer 1 should receive State B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer2->mv_last_state exp = 'State B' msg = 'Observer 2 should receive State B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deregister_observer.
    DATA(lo_subject) = NEW cl_subject( ).
    DATA(lo_observer1) = NEW cl_concrete_observer( ).
    DATA(lo_observer2) = NEW cl_concrete_observer( ).

    lo_subject->register_observer( lo_observer1 ).
    lo_subject->register_observer( lo_observer2 ).
    lo_subject->deregister_observer( lo_observer1 ).

    lo_subject->set_state( 'State C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_initial = lo_observer1->mv_last_state msg = 'Observer 1 should not receive State C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_observer2->mv_last_state exp = 'State C' msg = 'Observer 2 should receive State C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Observer-Muster, implementiert mit Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`), ist ein Verhaltensmuster, das eine Eins-zu-Viele-Abhängigkeit zwischen Objekten definiert, sodass bei einer Zustandsänderung eines Objekts alle seine Abhängigen automatisch benachrichtigt und aktualisiert werden. Dies fördert eine lose Kopplung und ist ideal für reaktive Systeme und UI-Updates.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Observer Pattern, Object Orientation, Events, Loose Coupling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_VALIDATOR` mit einer Methode `IS_VALID`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: `CL_EMAIL_VALIDATOR` und `CL_DATE_VALIDATOR`, um jeweils E-Mail-Adressen und Datumsformate zu validieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS` und String-Funktionen/Regex für die Validierung.
solution:
INTERFACE if_validator PUBLIC.
  METHODS is_valid
    IMPORTING
      iv_value TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_email_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_validator~is_valid.
    " Simple regex for email validation (can be more complex)
    FIND REGEX '^\S+@\S+\.\S+$' IN iv_value.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_date_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_date_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_validator~is_valid.
    " Checks for YYYYMMDD format and if it's a valid date
    IF strlen( iv_value ) = 8 AND iv_value CO '0123456789'.
      TRY.
          DATA(lv_date) = CONV d( iv_value ).
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_email_validator FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_date_validator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_email_validator.
    DATA(lo_email_validator) = NEW cl_email_validator( ).
    DATA(li_validator) = CAST if_validator( lo_email_validator ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_true = li_validator->is_valid( 'test@example.com' ) msg = 'Valid email should be true' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( iv_false = li_validator->is_valid( 'invalid-email' ) msg = 'Invalid email should be false' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( iv_false = li_validator->is_valid( 'test@.com' ) msg = 'Invalid email should be false' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_date_validator.
    DATA(lo_date_validator) = NEW cl_date_validator( ).
    DATA(li_validator) = CAST if_validator( lo_date_validator ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_true = li_validator->is_valid( '20231231' ) msg = 'Valid date should be true' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( iv_false = li_validator->is_valid( '20231301' ) msg = 'Invalid month should be false' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( iv_false = li_validator->is_valid( '20230132' ) msg = 'Invalid day should be false' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( iv_false = li_validator->is_valid( '2023-01-01' ) msg = 'Wrong format should be false' ).

explanation: Das `IF_VALIDATOR` Interface (`IMPLEMENTS`) ermöglicht die Definition eines einheitlichen Vertrags für Validierungslogik. Verschiedene Validierungsregeln (E-Mail, Datum, etc.) können in separaten Klassen implementiert werden, die alle dasselbe Interface nutzen. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit, Modularität und ermöglicht es, Validatoren dynamisch zur Laufzeit auszuwählen und zu kombinieren.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Validation, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Regex, String Processing

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_PROCESSOR` mit einer Methode `PROCESS`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `CL_CHAIN_PROCESSOR`, die eine Kette von `IF_PROCESSOR`-Implementierungen ausführt (Chain of Responsibility Pattern).
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS` und eine Liste von Interface-Referenzen für die Kette.
solution:
INTERFACE if_processor PUBLIC.
  METHODS process
    IMPORTING
      io_data TYPE REF TO object
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_processed) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_step_a_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_step_a_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_processor~process.
    " Simulate processing step A
    WRITE: / 'Processing Step A'.
    rv_processed = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_step_b_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_step_b_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_processor~process.
    " Simulate processing step B
    WRITE: / 'Processing Step B'.
    rv_processed = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_chain_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_processor.
    METHODS add_processor
      IMPORTING
        io_processor TYPE REF TO if_processor.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_processors TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_processor WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_chain_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_processor.
    INSERT io_processor INTO TABLE mt_processors.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_processor~process.
    rv_processed = abap_true.
    LOOP AT mt_processors INTO DATA(lo_processor).
      IF lo_processor->process( io_data ) = abap_false.
        rv_processed = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chain_of_responsibility FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chain_of_responsibility.
    DATA(lo_chain) = NEW cl_chain_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_step_a) = NEW cl_step_a_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_step_b) = NEW cl_step_b_processor( ).

    lo_chain->add_processor( lo_step_a ).
    lo_chain->add_processor( lo_step_b ).

    DATA(lo_dummy_data) = NEW object( ). " Dummy data object
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_chain->if_processor~process( lo_dummy_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_true = lv_result msg = 'All steps in chain should process successfully' ).

    " For console output, direct assertion is difficult. We assert no dump occurs.
    " In a real scenario, you might use a test double or capture output streams.
    TRY.
        lo_chain->if_processor~process( lo_dummy_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_initial = '' msg = 'No dump should occur' ). " Placeholder assertion
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Chain of Responsibility Pattern, implementiert mit Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`), ermöglicht es, eine Anfrage durch eine Kette von Handlern zu leiten. Jeder Handler in der Kette entscheidet, ob er die Anfrage verarbeitet oder an den nächsten Handler weiterleitet. Dies fördert eine lose Kopplung und Flexibilität, da Handler zur Laufzeit hinzugefügt, entfernt oder neu angeordnet werden können.
keywords: IMPLEMENTS, Interface, Chain of Responsibility, Object Orientation, Design Patterns

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis in `sflights` für Flüge, die in einer internen Tabelle `lt_flight_updates` enthalten sind, aber nur, wenn der aktuelle Preis niedriger ist als der neue Preis in der internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM @(itab)` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die auf die interne Tabelle zugreift.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_conditional_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             new_price TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price_update.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_if_lower
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_flight_price_update
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_conditional_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_if_lower.
    UPDATE sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights_tab( FOR ls_update IN it_updates
                                                ( carrid   = ls_update-carrid
                                                  connid   = ls_update-connid
                                                  fldate   = ls_update-fldate
                                                  price    = ls_update-new_price ) ) )
      WHERE carrid = sflights_tab~carrid
        AND connid = sflights_tab~connid
        AND fldate = sflights_tab~fldate
        AND price < sflights_tab~price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_prices_if_lower FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE fldate = '20250101'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_prices_if_lower.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_conditional_update( ).

    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_sflight_conditional_update=>tt_flight_price_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '120.00' ) " Should update (100 < 120)
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '140.00' ) " Should NOT update (150 !< 140)
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->update_prices_if_lower( lt_updates ).
        COMMIT WORK.

        SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_price_0400)
          WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
        SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_price_0401)
          WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_0400 exp = '120.00' msg = 'Price for 0400 should be updated' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_0401 exp = '150.00' msg = 'Price for 0401 should NOT be updated' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_sql->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `UPDATE ... FROM @(itab)` in Kombination mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die auf die Felder der internen Tabelle zugreift. Dies ermöglicht komplexe, datengetriebene und bedingte Massenaktualisierungen direkt auf der Datenbank, was die Performance optimiert und die Code-Komplexität im ABAP-Anwendungsserver reduziert.
keywords: UPDATE, Open SQL, Table Expression, Conditional Update, Mass Update

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen Pfad-String in maximal zwei Teile auf: den Verzeichnispfad und den Rest.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT ... AT ... INTO ... MAXIMUM NUMBER OF SUBSTRINGS 2`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_max_substrings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_full_path TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_path_part TYPE string
        ev_file_part TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_max_substrings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_path.
    DATA: lt_parts TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_full_path AT '/' INTO TABLE lt_parts MAXIMUM NUMBER OF SUBSTRINGS 2.
    IF lines( lt_parts ) = 2.
      ev_path_part = lt_parts[1].
      ev_file_part = lt_parts[2].
    ELSEIF lines( lt_parts ) = 1.
      ev_file_part = lt_parts[1]. "No delimiter found, whole string is file part
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie Konstanten für Statuscodes (z.B. 'SUCCESS', 'ERROR') und verwenden Sie diese in einer `IF`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONSTANTS` für die Statuscodes und vergleichen Sie diese in einer `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_const_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      gc_status_success TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'SUCCESS',
      gc_status_error   TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'ERROR'.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_const_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_status_message = |Processing { gc_status_error }: Input data is empty.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_status_message = |Processing { gc_status_success }: Data '{ iv_data }' processed.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String und verarbeiten Sie die einzelnen Teile direkt in einer `FOR`-Schleife, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die die Teile in Großbuchstaben enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SPLIT ... INTO TABLE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_uppercase
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_uppercase_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_uppercase.
    DATA(lt_parts) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rt_uppercase_parts = VALUE #( FOR <part> IN lt_parts ( to_upper( <part> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'APPLE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'BANANA' ).

explanation: Demonstriert die Kombination von `SPLIT` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `VALUE #` zur kompakten und funktionalen Verarbeitung der aufgeteilten String-Teile. Dies ist ein Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax, die Schleifen und Zuweisungen in einer Zeile zusammenfasst.
keywords: SPLIT, FOR, VALUE #, String Processing, Internal Tables

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Für jeden Flug, dessen `CONNID` einen Bindestrich enthält, teilen Sie den `CONNID` in zwei Teile (z.B. '0001-01' -> '0001', '01') und geben Sie diese zusammen mit der `CARRID` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE` und `VALUE #` mit `FOR` und `LET` Ausdrücken, um den `CONNID` bedingt aufzuteilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid_part1 TYPE string,
        connid_part2 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_flight_info,
      tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_split_connids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_split_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for demo purposes

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                              WHERE ( <fs_flight>-connid CA '-' )
                              LET lt_parts = VALUE string_table( ) IN
                              ( SPLIT <fs_flight>-connid AT '-' INTO TABLE lt_parts
                                IN
                                ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                  connid_part1 = lt_parts[1]
                                  connid_part2 = lt_parts[2] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_split_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_split_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_split( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_split_connids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ). "Expect some results
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight_info-connid_part1 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight_info-connid_part2 ).
      " Further checks could be added, e.g., specific values if test data is controlled
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Verwendung von `SELECT` und `VALUE #` mit `FOR` und `LET` Ausdrücken, um Daten aus `sflight` zu lesen und den `CONNID` bedingt aufzuteilen. Die `LET`-Anweisung ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb des `VALUE #` Ausdrucks, was den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht.
keywords: SPLIT, sflights, Database Access, Internal Tables, VALUE #, FOR, LET

Instructions: Definieren Sie Konstanten für Feldnamen, die dynamisch in einer internen Tabelle angesprochen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONSTANTS` für die Feldnamen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_const_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS:
      gc_field1_name TYPE string VALUE 'FIELD1',
      gc_field2_name TYPE string VALUE 'FIELD2'.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_fieldname TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_const_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_field1 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_field2 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_invalid FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_field1.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_const_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_const_dynamic_access=>ty_data( field1 = 'Value A' field2 = 'Value B' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_fieldname = zcl_const_dynamic_access=>gc_field1_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Value A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_field2.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_const_dynamic_access( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_fieldname = zcl_const_dynamic_access=>gc_field2_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Value B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_const_dynamic_access( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Konstanten verwendet werden können, um Feldnamen für den dynamischen Zugriff zu speichern. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien, in denen Feldnamen zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden müssen, und verbessert die Typsicherheit und Wartbarkeit im Vergleich zu hartkodierten Strings.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch verschiedene Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma oder Semikolon) getrennt ist, in eine interne Tabelle auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE` mit regulären Ausdrücken, um mehrere Trennzeichen zu vereinheitlichen, und anschließend `SPLIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_multi_delimiter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_with_multiple_delimiters
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_multi_delimiter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_with_multiple_delimiters.
    " Modern approach: Replace multiple delimiters with a single one, then split
    DATA(lv_processed_string) = replace( val = iv_input_string regex = `[,;]` with = `|` ).
    SPLIT lv_processed_string AT '|' INTO TABLE rt_parts.
    " Remove empty entries that might result from consecutive delimiters or leading/trailing delimiters
    DELETE rt_parts WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_comma_semicolon FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_split_consecutive_delimiters FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_split_leading_trailing_delimiters FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_comma_semicolon.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_multi_delimiter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_with_multiple_delimiters( 'Apple,Banana;Cherry' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Banana' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'Cherry' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_split_consecutive_delimiters.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_multi_delimiter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_with_multiple_delimiters( 'A,,B;;C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_split_leading_trailing_delimiters.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_multi_delimiter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_with_multiple_delimiters( ',A;B,' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine moderne Technik, um Strings mit mehreren verschiedenen Trennzeichen aufzuteilen. Durch die Verwendung der `replace`-Funktion mit regulären Ausdrücken werden alle definierten Trennzeichen in ein einziges, konsistentes Trennzeichen umgewandelt, bevor der `SPLIT`-Befehl ausgeführt wird. Dies ist effizienter und flexibler als verschachtelte `SPLIT`-Operationen. `DELETE ... WHERE table_line IS INITIAL` entfernt leere Einträge, die durch aufeinanderfolgende oder führende/nachfolgende Trennzeichen entstehen können.
keywords: SPLIT, String Processing, REGEX, REPLACE, Multiple Delimiters

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die nach einem bestimmten Datum starten und eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben. Geben Sie die Anzahl der gefundenen Flüge zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate >= iv_fldate.
      rv_count = rv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    " Assuming there are some LH flights after 20250101 in sflights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'No flights found for LH after 20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Syntax ermöglicht eine direkte Filterung von internen Tabellen. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(ls_flight)` macht den Code kürzer und lesbarer, da der Typ des Arbeitsbereichs automatisch abgeleitet wird.
keywords: LOOP AT, WHERE, INTERNAL TABLE, DATA, FILTER

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden Leerzeichen aus einer Zeichenkette.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_leading_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_leading_spaces.
    rv_output = iv_input.
    SHIFT rv_output LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_remove_leading_spaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_leading_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->remove_leading_spaces( '   Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' msg = 'Führende Leerzeichen wurden nicht korrekt entfernt.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->remove_leading_spaces( 'Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' msg = 'String ohne Leerzeichen wurde verändert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE` ist eine sehr effiziente und direkte Methode, um führende Leerzeichen aus einer Zeichenkette zu entfernen, ohne temporäre Variablen oder komplexe String-Operationen zu benötigen.
keywords: SHIFT, STRING, CLEANUP, LEADING SPACE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Geben Sie eine Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und der jeweiligen Fluganzahl zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (`price`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `LOOP AT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Da die genaue Summe von Testdaten abhängt, prüfen wir auf einen plausiblen Wert.
    " Hier nehmen wir an, dass die Summe für LH-Flüge nicht 0 ist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 0 msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH ist 0, was unwahrscheinlich ist.' ).

    " Optional: Wenn Testdaten bekannt sind, könnte man einen exakten Wert prüfen.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = <expected_value> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren (z.B. zu summieren, zu zählen oder den Maximalwert zu finden) und das Ergebnis in einer einzigen Anweisung zurückzugeben. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` bietet es eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Syntax für Aggregationsaufgaben.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, LOOP AT, AGGREGATION, SUM, INTERNAL TABLE

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens aus einer Zeichenkette, indem Sie `SHIFT` in einer Schleife verwenden. (Hinweis: Für moderne ABAP-Versionen wäre `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` einfacher, aber hier soll `SHIFT` demonstriert werden.)
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FIND` und `SHIFT LEFT DELETING` in einer `DO`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_remover DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_char_with_shift
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_char  TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_remover IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_char_with_shift.
    rv_output = iv_input.
    DATA lv_offset TYPE i.

    DO.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_char IN rv_output STARTING AT lv_offset MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        SHIFT rv_output LEFT BY lv_offset PLACES.
        rv_output = rv_output+1.
        lv_offset = 0. " Reset offset to search from beginning of remaining string
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_remove_char FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_char.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_remover( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->remove_char_with_shift( iv_input = 'A-B-C-D' iv_char = '-' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABCD' msg = 'Bindestriche wurden nicht korrekt entfernt.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->remove_char_with_shift( iv_input = 'XXHelloXXWorldXX' iv_char = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HelloWorld' msg = 'Buchstabe X wurde nicht korrekt entfernt.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->remove_char_with_shift( iv_input = 'NoChange' iv_char = 'Z' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'NoChange' msg = 'String wurde fälschlicherweise verändert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `SHIFT` in einer `DO`-Schleife in Kombination mit `FIND`, um alle Vorkommen eines Zeichens zu entfernen. Obwohl `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` in modernen ABAP-Versionen die bevorzugte Methode wäre, zeigt dies eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von `SHIFT` für zeichenweise Manipulationen.
keywords: SHIFT, FIND, LOOP, STRING, CHARACTER REMOVAL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und das Flugdatum (`fldate`) aus `sflights` enthält, für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum starten. Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN` und `VALUE #()`.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE #()` für die Transformation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_info.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( fldate >= iv_min_fldate )
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_info msg = 'Die Ergebnistabelle ist leer.' ).

    " Prüfen, ob alle Einträge das korrekte Datumskriterium erfüllen
    LOOP AT lt_info INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_entry-fldate >= '20250101' )
                                        msg = |Datum { ls_entry-fldate } ist kleiner als '20250101'| ).
    ENDLOOP.

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #()` ist ein sehr modernes und ausdrucksstarkes Feature (ABAP 7.40+), um interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig zu transformieren. Es ersetzt die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten `LOOP AT`-Schleife mit `APPEND` und `IF`-Bedingungen, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, INTERNAL TABLE, FILTER, TRANSFORMATION, LOOP AT

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus `sflights`, die entweder von 'FRA' nach 'JFK' gehen oder von 'MUC' nach 'LAX', und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Nutzen Sie einen `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit komplexen logischen Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_complex_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_complex_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( ( fldate > lv_today AND
                                              ( ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) OR
                                                ( cityfrom = 'MUNICH' AND cityto = 'LOS ANGELES' ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_complex_filtered_flights( ).

    " Da sflights statische Daten hat, ist es schwierig, zukünftige Flüge zu garantieren.
    " Wir prüfen, ob die Filterung syntaktisch korrekt ist und keine Fehler wirft.
    " Für einen echten Test müsste man Testdaten in sflights einfügen oder mocken.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Es wurden Flüge gefunden, obwohl sflights keine zukünftigen Daten haben sollte.' ).
    " Alternativ, wenn Testdaten vorhanden wären:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Keine Flüge gefunden.' ).
    " LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) ).
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ( ls_flight-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND ls_flight-cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) OR
    "                                            ( ls_flight-cityfrom = 'MUNICH' AND ls_flight-cityto = 'LOS ANGELES' ) ) ).
    " ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (ABAP 7.50+) bietet eine deklarative und sehr leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist effizient und führt zu sehr lesbarem Code, insbesondere bei der Kombination mehrerer Kriterien.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Strings und entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen von jedem String. Geben Sie die bereinigte Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `SHIFT LEFT/RIGHT DELETING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS clean_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cleaned_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string_table.
    rt_cleaned_strings = it_input_strings.

    LOOP AT rt_cleaned_strings ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_string>).
      SHIFT <fs_string> LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
      SHIFT <fs_string> RIGHT DELETING TRAILING SPACE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_clean_string_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_string_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_table_string_cleaner=>tt_strings(
      ( `  String 1  ` )
      ( `String 2   ` )
      ( `   String 3` )
      ( `No Spaces` )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_table_string_cleaner=>tt_strings(
      ( `String 1` )
      ( `String 2` )
      ( `String 3` )
      ( `No Spaces` )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->clean_string_table( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen stimmt nicht überein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Bereinigte Tabelle stimmt nicht überein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ermöglicht die direkte, in-place Modifikation von Elementen einer internen Tabelle. Zusammen mit `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE` und `SHIFT RIGHT DELETING TRAILING SPACE` ist dies eine effiziente Methode zur Bereinigung von String-Daten innerhalb einer Tabelle.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGNING, FIELD-SYMBOL, SHIFT, STRING, CLEANUP, INTERNAL TABLE

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in `sflights` einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, dessen Flugdatum nach einem gegebenen Datum liegt. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `EXIT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und beenden Sie die Schleife mit `EXIT`, sobald der erste Treffer gefunden wurde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO rs_flight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate >= iv_min_fldate.
      EXIT. " Ersten Treffer gefunden, Schleife beenden
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_first_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_finder( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->find_first_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_fldate = '20000101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid msg = 'Kein Flug für AA nach 20000101 gefunden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Falsche Fluggesellschaft gefunden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate >= '20000101' ) msg = 'Falsches Flugdatum gefunden.' ).

    " Testfall, wo kein Flug gefunden werden sollte
    CLEAR ls_flight.
    ls_flight = lo_cut->find_first_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid msg = 'Flug für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft gefunden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... INTO ... WHERE` mit `EXIT` ist eine klassische und effiziente Methode, um den ersten Treffer in einer internen Tabelle zu finden, der bestimmte Kriterien erfüllt. `EXIT` stellt sicher, dass die Schleife nicht unnötig weiterläuft, sobald das gewünschte Element gefunden wurde.
keywords: LOOP AT, WHERE, EXIT, INTERNAL TABLE, FIND, FIRST OCCURRENCE

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Zeichen nach dem ersten Vorkommen eines bestimmten Trennzeichens in einer Zeichenkette, einschließlich des Trennzeichens selbst. Nutzen Sie `SHIFT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` und `SHIFT LEFT DELETING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_truncator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS truncate_after_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input    TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_truncator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD truncate_after_delimiter.
    rv_output = iv_input.
    DATA lv_offset TYPE i.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_delimiter IN rv_output MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Shift everything from the delimiter onwards to the left, effectively deleting it
      SHIFT rv_output LEFT BY lv_offset PLACES.
      rv_output = rv_output+0(lv_offset). " Keep only the part before the delimiter
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_truncate_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_truncate_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_truncator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->truncate_after_delimiter( iv_input = 'file.txt.backup' iv_delimiter = '.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'file' msg = 'Abschneiden nach erstem Punkt fehlgeschlagen.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->truncate_after_delimiter( iv_input = 'path/to/file' iv_delimiter = '/' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'path' msg = 'Abschneiden nach erstem Schrägstrich fehlgeschlagen.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->truncate_after_delimiter( iv_input = 'NoDelimiter' iv_delimiter = '-' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'NoDelimiter' msg = 'String ohne Trennzeichen wurde verändert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `FIND` und `SHIFT` kombiniert werden können, um einen Teil einer Zeichenkette basierend auf einem Trennzeichen zu entfernen. Zuerst wird die Position des Trennzeichens gefunden, dann wird der String so verschoben, dass der Teil nach dem Trennzeichen effektiv abgeschnitten wird. Dies ist eine manuelle, aber effektive Methode zur String-Manipulation mit `SHIFT`.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights-ähnlich) unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( ) )
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_tab_reduce_sum=>ty_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '450.00' ).

    CLEAR lt_flights.
    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen, hier zur Berechnung einer Summe.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ADD, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Endwert, indem Sie einen Bonus hinzufügen, wenn ein bestimmter Schwellenwert überschritten wird, oder einen Abzug vornehmen, wenn er unterschritten wird. Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator.
hint: Der COND-Operator ist ideal für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_adjusted_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_value TYPE i
        iv_threshold  TYPE i
        iv_bonus      TYPE i
        iv_deduction  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_adjusted_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_adjusted_value.
    rv_adjusted_value = COND #( WHEN iv_base_value > iv_threshold THEN iv_base_value + iv_bonus
                                WHEN iv_base_value < iv_threshold THEN iv_base_value - iv_deduction
                                ELSE iv_base_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_adjusted_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjusted_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_adjusted_value( iv_base_value = 100 iv_threshold = 50 iv_bonus = 10 iv_deduction = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 110 ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_adjusted_value( iv_base_value = 30 iv_threshold = 50 iv_bonus = 10 iv_deduction = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 25 ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_adjusted_value( iv_base_value = 50 iv_threshold = 50 iv_bonus = 10 iv_deduction = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante und lesbare Implementierung von bedingter Logik, die direkt einen Wert zurückgibt, anstatt mehrere IF-Anweisungen zu verwenden.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, ADD, SUBTRACT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Saldo einer Reihe von Transaktionen (Gutschriften und Lastschriften) in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Initialisieren Sie den REDUCE-Akku mit 0 und addieren/subtrahieren Sie basierend auf dem Transaktionstyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_balance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transaction,
             type   TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'C' for Credit, 'D' for Debit
             amount TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_transaction.
    TYPES ty_transactions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transaction WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_balance
      IMPORTING
        it_transactions TYPE ty_transactions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_balance) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_balance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_balance.
    rv_balance = REDUCE #( INIT balance = ( VALUE s_price( ) )
                           FOR <fs_trans> IN it_transactions
                           NEXT balance = COND #( WHEN <fs_trans>-type = 'C' THEN balance + <fs_trans>-amount
                                                  WHEN <fs_trans>-type = 'D' THEN balance - <fs_trans>-amount
                                                  ELSE balance ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_balance_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_balance_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_reduce_balance( ).
    DATA(lt_transactions) = VALUE zcl_tab_reduce_balance=>ty_transactions(
      ( type = 'C' amount = '100.00' )
      ( type = 'D' amount = '30.00' )
      ( type = 'C' amount = '50.00' )
      ( type = 'D' amount = '20.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_balance) = lo_cut->calculate_balance( lt_transactions ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_balance exp = '100.00' ).

    CLEAR lt_transactions.
    lv_balance = lo_cut->calculate_balance( lt_transactions ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_balance exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert REDUCE mit COND, um eine komplexe Aggregation (Saldo) in einer einzigen, lesbaren Ausdruckskette zu realisieren. Es demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Operatoren.
keywords: REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ADD, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Eintrag einer Quelltabelle einen berechneten Wert enthält, der durch Addition und Subtraktion abgeleitet wird. Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator mit FOR.
hint: Der VALUE-Operator mit FOR ist ideal, um neue Tabellen basierend auf bestehenden zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_value_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
             bonus TYPE i,
             deduct TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_calculated_item,
             id      TYPE i,
             net_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_calculated_item.
    TYPES ty_calculated_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_calculated_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_net_values
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_calculated_items) TYPE ty_calculated_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_value_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_values.
    rt_calculated_items = VALUE #( FOR <fs_item> IN it_items
                                   ( id = <fs_item>-id
                                     net_value = <fs_item>-value + <fs_item>-bonus - <fs_item>-deduct ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_net_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_net_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_value_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_tab_value_calc=>ty_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 100 bonus = 10 deduct = 5 )
      ( id = 2 value = 200 bonus = 20 deduct = 10 )
      ( id = 3 value = 50  bonus = 5  deduct = 2 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_calculated) = lo_cut->calculate_net_values( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_calculated ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_calculated[ 1 ]-net_value exp = 105 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_calculated[ 2 ]-net_value exp = 210 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_calculated[ 3 ]-net_value exp = 53 ).

    CLEAR lt_items.
    lt_calculated = lo_cut->calculate_net_values( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_calculated ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit FOR ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen, wobei berechnete Felder direkt während der Konstruktion zugewiesen werden können.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, ADD, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Lagerbewegungen nach einem Material und berechnen Sie die Gesamtmenge (Zugänge minus Abgänge) unter Verwendung von FILTER und REDUCE.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILTER zum Vorfiltern und REDUCE zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_stock_movement,
             material TYPE matnr,
             movement_type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'A' for Add, 'S' for Subtract
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_stock_movement.
    TYPES ty_stock_movements TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_stock_movement WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_material_balance
      IMPORTING
        it_movements TYPE ty_stock_movements
        iv_material  TYPE matnr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_balance_quantity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_material_balance.
    DATA(lt_filtered_movements) = FILTER #( it_movements WHERE material = iv_material ).

    rv_balance_quantity = REDUCE #( INIT balance = 0
                                    FOR <fs_movement> IN lt_filtered_movements
                                    NEXT balance = COND #( WHEN <fs_movement>-movement_type = 'A' THEN balance + <fs_movement>-quantity
                                                           WHEN <fs_movement>-movement_type = 'S' THEN balance - <fs_movement>-quantity
                                                           ELSE balance ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_material_balance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_material_balance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_movements) = VALUE zcl_tab_filter_reduce=>ty_stock_movements(
      ( material = 'MAT1' movement_type = 'A' quantity = 100 )
      ( material = 'MAT2' movement_type = 'A' quantity = 50 )
      ( material = 'MAT1' movement_type = 'S' quantity = 30 )
      ( material = 'MAT1' movement_type = 'A' quantity = 20 )
      ( material = 'MAT2' movement_type = 'S' quantity = 10 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_balance_mat1) = lo_cut->calculate_material_balance( it_movements = lt_movements iv_material = 'MAT1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_balance_mat1 exp = 90 ).

    DATA(lv_balance_mat2) = lo_cut->calculate_material_balance( it_movements = lt_movements iv_material = 'MAT2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_balance_mat2 exp = 40 ).

    DATA(lv_balance_mat3) = lo_cut->calculate_material_balance( it_movements = lt_movements iv_material = 'MAT3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_balance_mat3 exp = 0 ).
