explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von FILTER zum Selektieren relevanter Daten und REDUCE zur anschließenden Aggregation, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, ADD, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming, Grouping

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Addition oder Subtraktion auf einem Feld einer Struktur durch, dessen Name dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole (FIELD-SYMBOLS) und den ASSIGN COMPONENT Befehl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_arith DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS perform_dynamic_operation
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE i
        iv_operation  TYPE c LENGTH 1. " 'A' for Add, 'S' for Subtract
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_arith IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_dynamic_operation.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF iv_operation = 'A'.
        <fs_field> = <fs_field> + iv_value.
      ELSEIF iv_operation = 'S'.
        <fs_field> = <fs_field> - iv_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_op FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_op.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_arith( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_arith=>ty_data( field1 = 10 field2 = 20 field3 = 30 ).

    lo_cut->perform_dynamic_operation( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                       IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' iv_value = 5 iv_operation = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 20 ).

    lo_cut->perform_dynamic_operation( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                       IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' iv_value = 10 iv_operation = 'S' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 10 ).

    lo_cut->perform_dynamic_operation( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                       IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' iv_value = 100 iv_operation = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 15 ). " Should not change
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Feldmanipulation mit FIELD-SYMBOLS und ASSIGN COMPONENT ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die in modernen ABAP-Anwendungen für flexible Datenverarbeitung eingesetzt werden kann.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, ADD, SUBTRACT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Mengen für alle Einträge in einer internen Tabelle, die einen bestimmten Status haben, und subtrahieren Sie die Summe der Mengen für Einträge mit einem anderen Status. Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit bedingter Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE und COND, um basierend auf dem Status zu addieren oder zu subtrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_cond_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_status,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'A' for Added, 'S' for Subtracted
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_status.
    TYPES ty_item_statuses TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_net_quantity
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_item_statuses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_quantity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_cond_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_quantity.
    rv_net_quantity = REDUCE #( INIT net_qty = 0
                                 FOR <fs_item> IN it_items
                                 NEXT net_qty = COND #( WHEN <fs_item>-status = 'A' THEN net_qty + <fs_item>-quantity
                                                        WHEN <fs_item>-status = 'S' THEN net_qty - <fs_item>-quantity
                                                        ELSE net_qty ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_net_quantity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_net_quantity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_reduce_cond_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_tab_reduce_cond_sum=>ty_item_statuses(
      ( id = 1 status = 'A' quantity = 100 )
      ( id = 2 status = 'S' quantity = 30 )
      ( id = 3 status = 'A' quantity = 50 )
      ( id = 4 status = 'X' quantity = 20 ) " Ignored
    ).
    DATA(lv_net_qty) = lo_cut->calculate_net_quantity( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_net_qty exp = 120 ). " 100 - 30 + 50 = 120

    CLEAR lt_items.
    lv_net_qty = lo_cut->calculate_net_quantity( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_net_qty exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die flexible Anwendung des REDUCE-Operators in Kombination mit COND, um eine Summe zu bilden, bei der Werte basierend auf einer Bedingung addiert oder subtrahiert werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Aggregation in modernen ABAP-Programmen.
keywords: REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, ADD, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_price_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_price_calc IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (Feld `PRICE`) aus der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Preise zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Städtenamen (`CITYFROM`) aus der Tabelle `sflight` für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_cities_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cities) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cities_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_cities = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN <fs_sflight>-cityfrom ELSE |{ result }, { <fs_sflight>-cityfrom }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concat_cities_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_concat_cities_aa FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_concat_cities_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_cities_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_cities( ).
    " Expected value depends on actual data in sflight for 'LH'
    " For a robust test, one might fetch and sort the cities first.
    DATA lv_expected_cities TYPE string.
    SELECT DISTINCT cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_cities) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    SORT lt_cities ASCENDING.
    lv_expected_cities = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR city IN lt_cities
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN city ELSE |{ result }, { city }| ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_cities_string( 'LH' )
      exp = lv_expected_cities
      msg = 'Concatenated cities for LH should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concat_cities_aa.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_cities( ).
    DATA lv_expected_cities TYPE string.
    SELECT DISTINCT cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_cities) WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    SORT lt_cities ASCENDING.
    lv_expected_cities = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR city IN lt_cities
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN city ELSE |{ result }, { city }| ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_cities_string( 'AA' )
      exp = lv_expected_cities
      msg = 'Concatenated cities for AA should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concat_cities_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_cities( ).

      act = lo_cut->get_cities_string( 'XX' )

      msg = 'Should return empty string for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` wird hier verwendet, um eine Liste von Städtenamen zu einem einzigen String zu verketten. Die `COND` Expression innerhalb von `NEXT` sorgt dafür, dass das Komma nur zwischen den Elementen hinzugefügt wird und nicht am Anfang. String Templates (`|...|`) machen die String-Verkettung sehr lesbar.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Concatenation, COND

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines numerischen Feldes in allen Zeilen einer internen Tabelle um einen bestimmten Betrag. Der Feldname ist zur Laufzeit bekannt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_modify_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_table_field
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_increment  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_modify_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_table_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>      TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_table_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_table_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Check if the field is numeric before adding
        IF <fs_field> IS SUPPLIED AND <fs_field> IS NUMERIC.
          <fs_field> = <fs_field> + iv_increment.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_numeric FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_price.
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_test UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_modify_table( ).
    DATA(lv_original_price1) = lt_sflights_test[ 1 ]-price.
    DATA(lv_original_price2) = lt_sflights_test[ 2 ]-price.
    DATA(lv_increment_val) = 100.

    lo_cut->modify_table_field( CHANGING ct_data = lt_sflights_test
                                iv_field_name = 'PRICE'
                                iv_increment  = lv_increment_val ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights_test[ 1 ]-price
      exp = lv_original_price1 + lv_increment_val
      msg = 'Price of first flight should be incremented' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights_test[ 2 ]-price
      exp = lv_original_price2 + lv_increment_val
      msg = 'Price of second flight should be incremented' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_numeric.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_data,
            id   TYPE i VALUE 1,
            text TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',
          END OF ls_test_data.
    DATA lt_test_table LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_test_data.
    APPEND ls_test_data TO lt_test_table.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_modify_table( ).
    DATA(lv_original_text) = lt_test_table[ 1 ]-text.

    lo_cut->modify_table_field( CHANGING ct_data = lt_test_table
                                iv_field_name = 'TEXT'
                                iv_increment  = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_table[ 1 ]-text
      exp = lv_original_text
      msg = 'Non-numeric field should not be modified' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_existent.
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_test UP TO 1 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_modify_table( ).
    DATA(lv_original_price) = lt_sflights_test[ 1 ]-price.

    lo_cut->modify_table_field( CHANGING ct_data = lt_sflights_test
                                iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
                                iv_increment  = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights_test[ 1 ]-price
      exp = lv_original_price
      msg = 'Table should not be modified if field does not exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` kann eine interne Tabelle generisch bearbeitet werden. Das Feldsymbol `<fs_table_line>` verweist direkt auf die Zeile der Tabelle, und `<fs_field>` auf die dynamisch bestimmte Komponente, was eine effiziente In-Place-Modifikation ermöglicht.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, Dynamic Modification, LOOP AT ASSIGNING

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis aus der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie dessen gesamte Struktur zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und eine `COND` Expression, um den Flug mit dem maximalen Preis zu verfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rs_flight = REDUCE sflight(
      INIT max_flight TYPE sflight
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-price > max_flight-price OR max_flight-carrid IS INITIAL THEN <fs_sflight> ELSE max_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_price( ).
    DATA ls_expected_flight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_expected_flight WHERE carrid = 'LH' ORDER BY price DESCENDING, fldate DESCENDING. " Added fldate for deterministic result

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( 'LH' )-price
      exp = ls_expected_flight-price
      msg = 'Max price for LH should match' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( 'LH' )-fldate
      exp = ls_expected_flight-fldate
      msg = 'Flight date for max price LH should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_price_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_price( ).
    DATA ls_empty_flight TYPE sflight.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( 'XX' )-carrid
      exp = ls_empty_flight-carrid
      msg = 'Should return initial flight for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser `REDUCE` Ausdruck iteriert über die Flüge und behält den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis bei. Die `COND` Expression ist entscheidend, um die Logik für die Auswahl des Maximums kompakt zu halten. Die Initialisierung mit einer leeren Struktur stellt sicher, dass der erste Flug korrekt als Maximum gesetzt wird.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Max Value, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle durchläuft und für jede Zeile den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes ausliest. Die Methode soll eine Tabelle von Strings zurückgeben, die die ausgelesenen Werte enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_generic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_column_values
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE any TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_generic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>      TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_table_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_table_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existent FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_test UP TO 3 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_generic_read( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->read_column_values( it_data = lt_sflights_test iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_carrids )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should return 3 carrier IDs' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_carrids[ 1 ]
      exp = lt_sflights_test[ 1 ]-carrid
      msg = 'First carrier ID should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_price.
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_test UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_generic_read( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_cut->read_column_values( it_data = lt_sflights_test iv_field_name = 'PRICE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_prices )
      exp = 2

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight` und geben Sie das Ergebnis als Hash-Tabelle (`HASHED TABLE`) zurück, wobei der Fluggesellschaftscode der Schlüssel und die Anzahl der Flüge der Wert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `HASHED TABLE` als Akkumulator und `FOR GROUPS ... IN GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR GROUPS <key> OF lt_sflights IN GROUP BY ( carrid = lt_sflights-carrid )
      GROUP SIZE gsize
      NEXT counts = VALUE tt_flight_count( BASE counts ( carrid = <key>-carrid count = gsize ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben und keine Parameter haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(CLASS_NAME)=>METHOD_NAME') TO <field_symbol>` und `CALL METHOD <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_method> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_method_path TYPE string.

    " Construct the full path for the method call
    " This assumes the method has no parameters and returns a string
    " For methods with parameters or different return types, more complex handling is needed.
    lv_method_path = |({ cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( io_object ) })=>{ iv_method_name }|.

    ASSIGN (lv_method_path) TO <fs_method> CASTING.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_method> IS ASSIGNED.
      CALL METHOD <fs_method> RECEIVING r = rv_result.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Method not found or invalid signature'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie eine neue interne Tabelle zurück, die nur die Flugnummern (`FLDATE`) der Flüge enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN FILTER` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_expensive_flight_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fldates) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flight_dates.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_fldates = REDUCE #( 
      INIT dates = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-fldate ( )
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price )
      NEXT dates = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-fldate( BASE dates ( flight-fldate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld sortiert. Die Sortierreihenfolge (auf- oder absteigend) soll ebenfalls dynamisch sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT ... BY (<field_name>)` mit einem Feldsymbol oder dynamischem Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_direction  TYPE string. " 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_data TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. " Cannot assign table
    ENDIF.

    " Check if field exists in the first row (if table not empty)
    IF lines( <fs_table> ) > 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_table>[ 1 ] TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RETURN. " Field does not exist
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    CASE iv_direction.
      WHEN 'ASCENDING'.
        SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
      WHEN 'DESCENDING'.
        SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name) DESCENDING.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default to ascending or do nothing
        SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass keine Flüge gefunden werden, indem Sie 0 zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch alle Felder einer Struktur aus und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte als Tabelle von Name-Wert-Paaren zurück. Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Feldinformationen zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_rtti_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name_value.
    TYPES tt_name_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_name_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fields) TYPE tt_name_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_rtti_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_fields.
    DATA lo_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field_value> TYPE any.
    DATA ls_name_value TYPE ty_name_value.

    TRY.
        lo_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        lt_components = lo_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field_value> IS ASSIGNED.
            ls_name_value-name = ls_component-name.
            ls_name_value-value = |{ <fs_field_value> }|.
            APPEND ls_name_value TO rt_fields.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error if is_data is not a structure
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_all_expensive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_all_flights_expensive
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_expensive) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_all_expensive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_all_flights_expensive.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      rv_all_expensive = abap_true. " If no flights, then all (zero) flights are 'expensive'
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_all_expensive = REDUCE abap_bool(
      INIT result = abap_true
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = COND abap_bool( WHEN flight-price > iv_min_price AND result = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie den Inhalt einer generischen internen Tabelle in eine andere generische interne Tabelle, wobei nur bestimmte, dynamisch angegebene Felder kopiert werden sollen. Die Zielfelder in der Zieltabelle müssen die gleichen Namen haben wie die Quellfelder.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für Quell- und Zielfelder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_fields_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE any TABLE
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      CHANGING
        ct_target_data TYPE any TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_fields_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    DATA lo_source_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_target_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    IF lines( it_source_data ) = 0.
      CLEAR ct_target_data.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get structure descriptions for type checking
    TRY.
        lo_source_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_data[ 1 ] ).
        lo_target_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ct_target_data[ 1 ] ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        RETURN. " Not structures or empty tables
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT it_source_data ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA ct_target_data LINE OF <fs_target_line>.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO ct_target_data ASSIGNING <fs_target_line>.

      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_field>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Check if types are compatible (basic check)
          IF cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_field> )->type_kind = 
             cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_target_field> )->type_kind.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle eindeutigen Wörter (mindestens 3 Zeichen lang) aus einer Liste von Sätzen und geben Sie sie als sortierte Tabelle von Strings zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `SPLIT`, `FOR`, `COND` und einer `SORTED TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_words
      IMPORTING
        it_sentences TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_words) TYPE SORTED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_words.
    rt_unique_words = REDUCE #( 
      INIT words = VALUE SORTED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line ( )
      FOR sentence IN it_sentences
      FOR word IN ( SPLIT sentence AT ` ` ) " Split by space
      WHERE ( strlen( word ) >= 3 AND word IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT words = VALUE SORTED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line( BASE words ( CONV string( to_upper( word ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen in eine interne Tabelle von Name-Wert-Paaren umwandelt. Die Namen der Felder sollen dabei als Strings in der Zieltabelle erscheinen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_table_to_nvp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name_value.
    TYPES tt_name_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_name_value WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_nvp_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_name_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_to_nvp
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nvp_table) TYPE tt_nvp_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_table_to_nvp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_nvp.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field_value> TYPE any.
    DATA lo_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA lt_current_nvp_line TYPE tt_name_value.
    DATA ls_name_value TYPE ty_name_value.

    IF lines( it_source_table ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table[ 1 ] ).
        lt_components = lo_descr->get_components( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        RETURN. " Not a table of structures
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CLEAR lt_current_nvp_line.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_field_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field_value> IS ASSIGNED.
          ls_name_value-name = ls_component-name.
          ls_name_value-value = |{ <fs_field_value> }|.
          APPEND ls_name_value TO lt_current_nvp_line.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lt_current_nvp_line TO rt_nvp_table.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft aus `sflight` die Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und die Anzahl der Flüge (`FLIGHT_COUNT`) enthält, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS ... IN GROUP BY` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung für die Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_count,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_count.
    TYPES tt_carr_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_volume_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_high_volume_carriers) TYPE tt_carr_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_volume_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_high_volume_carriers = REDUCE tt_carr_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carr_count( )
      FOR GROUPS <key> OF lt_sflights IN GROUP BY ( carrid = lt_sflights-carrid )
      GROUP SIZE gsize
      WHERE ( gsize > iv_min_flights )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carr_count( BASE result ( carrid = <key>-carrid flight_count = gsize ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_high_volume_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_high_volume_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_min_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_volume_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_carriers) = lo_cut->get_high_volume_carriers( 5 ).

    DATA lt_expected_carriers TYPE zcl_reduce_group_filter=>tt_carr_count.
    DATA lv_count_lh TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_count_lh WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    IF lv_count_lh > 5.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' flight_count = lv_count_lh ) TO lt_expected_carriers.
    ENDIF.
    DATA lv_count_aa TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_count_aa WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    IF lv_count_aa > 5.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' flight_count = lv_count_aa ) TO lt_expected_carriers.
    ENDIF.
    SORT lt_expected_carriers BY carrid.
    SORT lt_actual_carriers BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_carriers )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_carriers )
      msg = 'Number of high volume carriers should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_carriers
      exp = lt_expected_carriers
      msg = 'High volume carriers should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_high_volume_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_carriers) = lo_cut->get_high_volume_carriers( 9999 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_actual_carriers
      msg = 'Should return empty table if no carriers meet high volume criteria' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_min_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_carriers) = lo_cut->get_high_volume_carriers( 0 ).

    DATA lt_expected_carriers TYPE zcl_reduce_group_filter=>tt_carr_count.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM sflight GROUP BY carrid INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_counts).
    LOOP AT lt_all_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      IF ls_count-flight_count > 0.
        APPEND ls_count TO lt_expected_carriers.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    SORT lt_expected_carriers BY carrid.
    SORT lt_actual_carriers BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_carriers )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_carriers )
      msg = 'Should return all carriers with flights if min_flights is 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_carriers
      exp = lt_expected_carriers
      msg = 'All carriers with flights should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Gruppierungsfunktionalität von `REDUCE` durch die Hinzufügung einer `WHERE`-Bedingung für die Gruppen (`WHERE ( gsize > iv_min_flights )`). Dies ermöglicht es, Gruppen basierend auf aggregierten Werten zu filtern, was eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode zur Datenanalyse direkt in ABAP ist.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, WHERE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Filtering

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle durchläuft und für jede Zeile einen dynamisch angegebenen Wert in ein dynamisch angegebenes Feld schreibt. Der Wert soll dabei aus einer anderen dynamisch angegebenen Quelle stammen (z.B. einem anderen Feld der gleichen Zeile oder einem festen Wert).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `ASSIGN (source_field_name) TO <fs_source_value>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_table_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_field_name TYPE string
        iv_source_field_name TYPE string OPTIONAL " If empty, use iv_fixed_value
        iv_fixed_value       TYPE string OPTIONAL
      CHANGING
        ct_data              TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_table_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_table_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_target_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_table_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        IF iv_source_field_name IS NOT INITIAL.
          " Source is another field in the same line
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_source_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_table_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE IF iv_fixed_value IS SUPPLIED.
          " Source is a fixed value
          <fs_target_field> = iv_fixed_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_group_by_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_bookings_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid total_bookings = lv_count ) TO rt_booking_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis (`price`) pro Flugverbindung (`carrid`, `connid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF DATA(group_key)` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ts_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_by_connection
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_connection.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
         INTO DATA(group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_group_flight-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        connid = group_key-connid
        average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 )
      ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Listen Sie alle Flüge für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` auf. Das Ergebnis soll eine Tabelle sein, die pro Fluggesellschaft eine Untertabelle mit deren Flügen enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref)` und `LOOP AT GROUP group_ref`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights_per_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ts_carrier_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights_per_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).

      DATA ls_carrier_flights TYPE ts_carrier_flights.
      ls_carrier_flights-carrid = group_ref->*-carrid. " Access key from first element of group

      LOOP AT GROUP group_ref INTO DATA(ls_group_flight).
        APPEND VALUE #(
          fldate = ls_group_flight-fldate
          connid = ls_group_flight-connid
          price  = ls_group_flight-price
        ) TO ls_carrier_flights-flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_carrier_flights TO rt_carrier_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_group_by_group_size IMPLEMENTATION.

         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         WHERE ( GROUP SIZE > iv_min_flights )
         INTO DATA(group_key).

      APPEND VALUE #(

CLASS zcl_shift_extract_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_and_concatenate
      IMPORTING it_input_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_extract_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_and_concatenate.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR ls_string IN it_input_strings
      NEXT result = result &&
        ( LET lv_shifted = ls_string IN
            SHIFT lv_shifted LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
            COND string(
              WHEN strlen( lv_shifted ) >= 3 THEN lv_shifted(1,3)
              ELSE lv_shifted
            )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_detail,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ts_flight_detail.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_max_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             max_price_flight TYPE ts_flight_detail,
           END OF ts_carrier_max_flight.
    TYPES tt_carrier_max_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_max_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_flight_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_max_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flight_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(group_key).

      DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE ts_flight_detail(
        INIT max_f = VALUE ts_flight_detail( price = 0 )
        FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT max_f = COND #(
          WHEN ls_group_flight-price > max_f-price THEN VALUE ts_flight_detail(
            fldate = ls_group_flight-fldate
            connid = ls_group_flight-connid
            price  = ls_group_flight-price
          )
          ELSE max_f
        )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        max_price_flight = ls_max_flight
      ) TO rt_max_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_count_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ts_carrier_summary.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.

CLASS zcl_group_by_count_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_group_flight-price
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lines( GROUP group_key )
        total_price = lv_total_price
      ) TO rt_summary.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer Liste von Strings alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens durch ein anderes, indem Sie `SHIFT` und `REPLACE` in einer `FOR`-Expression verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `SHIFT` und `REPLACE SECTION` oder `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_replace_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_char_in_strings
      IMPORTING it_input_strings TYPE tt_strings
                iv_old_char      TYPE c LENGTH 1
                iv_new_char      TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_replace_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_char_in_strings.
    rt_modified_strings = VALUE tt_strings(
      FOR ls_string IN it_input_strings
      ( LET lv_temp = ls_string IN
          DO.
            FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_old_char IN lv_temp MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              REPLACE SECTION OFFSET lv_offset LENGTH 1 OF lv_temp WITH iv_new_char.
              " To continue searching after the replaced character, shift the string
              SHIFT lv_temp BY ( lv_offset + 1 ) PLACES.
            ELSE.
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
          ENDDO.
          " Restore the original string for the next iteration, but with replacements
          " This approach is a bit convoluted for SHIFT, a simple REPLACE ALL is better.
          " Let's use REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES for a more modern approach.
          REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_char IN ls_string WITH iv_new_char.
          ls_string " Return the modified string
      )
    ).
  ENDENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_shift_replace_char=>tt_strings(
      ( 'Hello World' )
      ( 'ABAP' )
      ( 'Test' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_old) = 'o'.
    DATA(lv_new) = 'x'.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_shift_replace_char=>tt_strings(
      ( 'Hellx Wxrld' )
      ( 'ABAP' )
      ( 'Test' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_char_in_strings( it_input = lt_input iv_old_char = lv_old iv_new_char = lv_new ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Produkt aller Flugpreise (Feld 'PRICE') aus einer internen Tabelle von 'sflights' Einträgen, die einen Preis größer als Null haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `MULTIPLY` Operator. Achten Sie auf den Initialwert für das Produkt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mul_reduce_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_product RETURNING VALUE(rv_product) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mul_reduce_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_product.
    DATA(lt_sflights_db) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS WHERE price > 0 ).

    rv_product = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2(
      INIT product = 1
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_db
      NEXT product = product * ls_sflight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_price_product FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_price_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mul_reduce_product( ).
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_cut->get_price_product( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge mit Preisen > 0 in sflights.
    " Ein präziser Testwert erfordert Mocking oder feste Testdaten.
    " Hier prüfen wir, ob das Produkt größer als 1 ist, wenn Daten vorhanden sind.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_product >= 1 )
      msg = 'Das Produkt der Preise sollte größer oder gleich 1 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, Aggregationen über interne Tabellen durchzuführen. Hier wird sie verwendet, um das Produkt aller `PRICE`-Werte zu berechnen. Der `INIT`-Teil setzt den Startwert auf 1, was für eine Produktberechnung korrekt ist. Die `NEXT`-Anweisung führt die Multiplikation in jedem Schritt aus. Dies ist eine moderne, funktionale und kompakte Art der Aggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von Lufthansa (Carrier 'LH') enthält, deren Preis über 500 liegt. Die neue Tabelle soll nur 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'PRICE' enthalten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` mit Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_filter_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES: tt_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_filter_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights_db) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_db
                              WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND price > 500 ) ( 
                                carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                price  = ls_sflight-price
                              ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_filter_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Überprüfen, ob alle Flüge von LH sind und Preis > 500
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'CARRID sollte LH sein.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-price > 500 )
        msg = 'PRICE sollte größer als 500 sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    " Prüfen, ob mindestens ein Flug gefunden wurde (Annahme: sflights enthält solche Daten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_flights ) >= 0 )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden oder die Tabelle leer sein, wenn keine passenden Daten existieren.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge direkt während der Iteration, was zu sehr prägnantem und effizientem Code führt. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Daten zu filtern und zu transformieren.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf 'sflights', in der der Flugpreis jedes Eintrags verdoppelt wird. Die neue Tabelle soll alle Felder der Originaltabelle enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( BASE ... price = original_price * 2 ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mul_transform_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_doubled_price_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mul_transform_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_doubled_price_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights_db) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_db ( 
                            BASE ls_sflight
                            price = ls_sflight-price * 2
                          ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_doubled_price_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_doubled_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mul_transform_price( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_doubled_price_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Es sollten 5 Flüge transformiert werden.'
    ).

    " Prüfen Sie den Preis des ersten Eintrags (Annahme: Preis > 0)
    DATA(ls_original_flight) = VALUE sflight( FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 1 ROWS ).
    IF ls_original_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price
        exp = ls_original_flight-price * 2
        msg = 'Der Preis des ersten Fluges sollte verdoppelt sein.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression wird hier verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, wobei die `FOR`-Iteration jeden Eintrag der Quelltabelle durchläuft. Mit `BASE ls_sflight` werden alle Felder des Originaleintrags übernommen, und nur das `price`-Feld wird mit dem `MULTIPLY`-Operator transformiert. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Transformation von Tabellendaten.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, BASE, MULTIPLY, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine komplexe Datenstruktur, die eine Kopfzeile mit 'CARRID' und 'TOTAL_PRICE' sowie eine interne Tabelle von Positionen ('CONNID', 'PRICE') enthält. Initialisieren Sie diese Struktur vollständig mit `VALUE` basierend auf 'sflights' Daten für einen bestimmten Carrier.
hint: `VALUE` kann auch für verschachtelte Strukturen und Tabellen verwendet werden. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die `TOTAL_PRICE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_nested_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
             items       TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_header.
    METHODS get_complex_flight_data IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rs_complex_data) TYPE ty_header.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_nested_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_complex_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights_for_carrier) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    rs_complex_data = VALUE #( 
      carrid      = iv_carrid
      total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_for_carrier NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price )
      items       = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_for_carrier ( 
                               connid = ls_sflight-connid
                               price  = ls_sflight-price
                             ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_complex_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_complex_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_nested_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_complex_data) = lo_cut->get_complex_flight_data( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_complex_data-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'CARRID sollte LH sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( ls_complex_data-items ) >= 0 )
      msg = 'Es sollten Positionen vorhanden sein oder die Tabelle leer sein.'
    ).
    " Prüfen, ob die Summe korrekt ist (Annahme: Preise > 0)
    DATA(lv_expected_total) = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                              FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS WHERE carrid = 'LH'
                                              NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_complex_data-total_price
      exp = lv_expected_total
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis sollte korrekt berechnet werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die mächtige Fähigkeit von `VALUE`, verschachtelte Datenstrukturen in einem einzigen Ausdruck zu initialisieren. Die Kopfzeile und die interne Tabelle der Positionen werden gleichzeitig erstellt. Die `REDUCE`-Expression wird innerhalb von `VALUE` verwendet, um den `total_price` zu aggregieren, was die Kompaktheit und Funktionalität des Codes weiter erhöht.
keywords: VALUE, Nested Structures, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine Liste von Ganzzahlen. Erstellen Sie eine neue Liste, in der jede Zahl mit einem Faktor von 3 multipliziert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... * factor ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mul_list_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_list IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_multiplied_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mul_list_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_list.
    CONSTANTS: lc_factor TYPE i VALUE 3.

    rt_multiplied_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_numbers ( number * lc_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiply_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiply_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mul_list_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_input_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 3 ) ( 6 ) ( 9 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie einfach und elegant Listen mit `VALUE` und `FOR` transformiert werden können. Jedes Element der Quellliste wird iteriert, und der `MULTIPLY`-Operator wird direkt im Ausdruck verwendet, um den neuen Wert für die Zielliste zu berechnen. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr lesbare Methode zur Listenmanipulation.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, MULTIPLY, List Processing, Transformation

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie eine bestehende interne Tabelle von Flugdaten ('sflights'), indem Sie den Preis für alle Flüge des Carriers 'LH' um 100 erhöhen. Die anderen Flüge sollen unverändert bleiben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( BASE ... FOR ... IN ... ( COND #( ... ) ) )` für die bedingte Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_base_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_prices IMPORTING it_flights TYPE sflights_tab
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_base_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_prices.
    CONSTANTS: lc_price_increase TYPE s_price VALUE 100.

    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( BASE it_flights FOR ls_flight IN it_flights ( 
                                     COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN
                                               VALUE sflight( BASE ls_flight price = ls_flight-price + lc_price_increase )
                                             ELSE
                                               ls_flight ) 
                                   ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_base_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '300.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->modify_flight_prices( lt_initial_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_modified_flights[ 1 ]-price
      exp = '200.00'
      msg = 'Preis für LH-Flug 1 sollte um 100 erhöht sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_modified_flights[ 2 ]-price
      exp = '200.00'
      msg = 'Preis für AA-Flug sollte unverändert sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_modified_flights[ 3 ]-price
      exp = '400.00'
      msg = 'Preis für LH-Flug 2 sollte um 100 erhöht sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression mit `BASE` ermöglicht die Erstellung einer neuen Tabelle, die auf einer bestehenden basiert, wobei einzelne Einträge bedingt modifiziert werden können. Die `FOR`-Iteration in Kombination mit `COND` erlaubt es, nur bestimmte Zeilen zu ändern, während andere unverändert bleiben. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Methode zur Transformation von Tabellen.
keywords: VALUE, BASE, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Modification, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Produkte aus Flugpreis ('PRICE') und Sitzplatzkapazität ('SEATSMAX') für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers aus der 'sflights' Tabelle.
hint: `REDUCE` kann komplexe Aggregationen durchführen. Nutzen Sie den `MULTIPLY`-Operator innerhalb der `NEXT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mul_reduce_weighted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weighted_sum IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_weighted_sum) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mul_reduce_weighted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_sum.
    DATA(lt_sflights_db) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    rv_weighted_sum = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2( 
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_db
      NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_sflight-price * ls_sflight-seatsmax )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_weighted_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_weighted_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mul_reduce_weighted( ).
    DATA(lv_weighted_sum) = lo_cut->get_weighted_sum( 'LH' ).

    " Erwarteten Wert manuell berechnen für Vergleich
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2( INIT sum = 0
                                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS WHERE carrid = 'LH'
                                                NEXT sum = sum + ( <fs_sflight>-price * <fs_sflight>-seatsmax ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_weighted_sum
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Die gewichtete Summe sollte korrekt berechnet werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` für eine komplexere Aggregation, bei der in jedem Schritt das Produkt aus `PRICE` und `SEATSMAX` gebildet und zur Gesamtsumme addiert wird. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit arithmetischen Operatoren, um maßgeschneiderte Aggregationen in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck zu realisieren.
keywords: REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Aggregation, Math, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Struktur, deren Felder basierend auf Eingabeparametern gesetzt werden. Demonstrieren Sie die flexible Initialisierung mit `VALUE`.
hint: `VALUE` kann auch mit Variablen und Ausdrücken verwendet werden, um Strukturen dynamisch zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_dynamic_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.
    METHODS create_dynamic_struct IMPORTING iv_text   TYPE string
                                          iv_number TYPE i
                                          iv_flag   TYPE abap_bool
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_dynamic_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_dynamic_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_struct.
    rs_data = VALUE #( field1 = iv_text && ' - processed'
                       field2 = iv_number * 10
                       field3 = iv_flag ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_struct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_struct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_dynamic_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_struct( iv_text = 'Test' iv_number = 5 iv_flag = abap_true ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_data-field1
      exp = 'Test - processed'
      msg = 'Field1 sollte korrekt verarbeitet sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_data-field2
      exp = 50
      msg = 'Field2 sollte korrekt multipliziert sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_data-field3
      exp = abap_true

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den 'Rabattpreis' für eine Liste von Produkten. Wenn der Originalpreis über 100 liegt, wird ein Rabatt von 10% angewendet (Preis * 0.9), ansonsten bleibt der Preis gleich. Nutzen Sie `COND` und den `MULTIPLY`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... * factor ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mul_cond_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             price TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_discount_prices IMPORTING it_products TYPE tt_products
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rt_discounted_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mul_cond_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discount_prices.
    CONSTANTS: lc_discount_factor TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.90'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_threshold       TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '100.00'.

    rt_discounted_products = VALUE #( FOR ls_product IN it_products ( 
                                       id    = ls_product-id,
                                       price = COND p DECIMALS 2( WHEN ls_product-price > lc_threshold
                                                                 THEN ls_product-price * lc_discount_factor
                                                                 ELSE ls_product-price )
                                     ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_input_products) = VALUE zcl_mul_cond_discount=>tt_products(
      ( id = 'P1' price = '120.00' )
      ( id = 'P2' price = '80.00' )
      ( id = 'P3' price = '200.00' )

    DATA(lt_expected_products) = VALUE zcl_mul_cond_discount=>tt_products(

    ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa), die eine maximale Sitzplatzkapazität von 200 überschreiten. Verwenden Sie dabei eine Methode, um die Filterbedingung zu kapseln.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FILTER`-Expression in Kombination mit einer privaten Methode, die die Filterlogik enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS is_flight_matching
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING CONTROL is_flight_matching
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND seatsmax > iv_min_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_flight_matching.
    IF is_flight-carrid = iv_carrier AND is_flight-seatsmax > iv_min_capacity.
      rv_match = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_match = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_min_capacity = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Capacity should be > 200' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 200 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Verwendung von `USING CONTROL` kann eine Methode als Filterkriterium angegeben werden, was die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Lesbarkeit der Filterlogik verbessert. Die Methode `is_flight_matching` kapselt die komplexe Bedingung.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der freien Sitzplätze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines), die am 28. Februar 2025 stattfinden. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einer Methode zur Berechnung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` für die Auswahl und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation. Eine Methode kann die Summenbildung übernehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_sum TYPE i
        is_flight      TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND fldate = iv_fldate )
      NEXT sum = calculate_sum( iv_current_sum = sum is_flight = ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_new_sum = iv_current_sum + is_flight-seatsocc.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrier = 'AA' iv_fldate = '20250228' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge von AA am 28.02.2025 mit belegten Sitzen.
    " Der genaue Wert hängt von den Testdaten in SFLIGHT ab.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Total seats should not be zero' act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 ).
    " Beispiel für einen erwarteten Wert, falls SFLIGHT bekannt ist:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats for AA on 20250228' act = lv_total_seats exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Zuerst werden die relevanten Flüge mit `FILTER` ausgewählt. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die `seatsocc`-Werte dieser gefilterten Flüge zu aggregieren. Die Methode `calculate_sum` kapselt die einfache Addition, was bei komplexeren Aggregationen von Vorteil wäre.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Verwenden Sie eine Methode, um die dynamische Filterung zu implementieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck, der durch eine Methode konstruiert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_field_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_filter_condition
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_field_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_condition) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_condition) = get_filter_condition( iv_field_name = iv_field_name iv_field_value = iv_field_value ).

    TRY.
        rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE (lv_condition) ).
    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filter_condition.
    " Basic example, for production, consider proper escaping and validation
    rv_condition = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_field_value }'|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_filtered_flights( iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_field_value = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_filter_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( )->get_dynamic_filtered_flights( iv_field_name = 'INVALID_FIELD' iv_field_value = 'X' ) exp_type = 'CX_SY_DYN_TABLE_ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `get_filter_condition` erstellt den dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck als String, der dann in der `FILTER`-Expression verwendet wird. Dies ist nützlich für flexible Suchfunktionen, bei denen die Filterkriterien zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die Kapselung in Methoden erhöht die Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit.
