Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Objektreferenzen auf `CL_ABAP_UNIT_TEST_CLASS`. Filtern Sie diese Tabelle, um nur die Testklassen zu erhalten, deren Name mit 'ZCL_' beginnt. Verwenden Sie eine Methode, um die Namensprüfung durchzuführen.

CLASS zcl_test_class_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_test_classes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_abap_unit_test_class WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_zcl_test_classes
      IMPORTING
        it_all_test_classes TYPE tt_test_classes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_zcl_test_classes) TYPE tt_test_classes.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS is_zcl_class
      IMPORTING
        io_test_class TYPE REF TO cl_abap_unit_test_class
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_zcl) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_class_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_zcl_test_classes.
    rt_zcl_test_classes = FILTER #( it_all_test_classes USING CONTROL is_zcl_class
                                    WHERE ( io_test_class->get_name( ) CP 'ZCL_*' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_zcl_class.
    IF io_test_class->get_name( ) CP 'ZCL_*'.
      rv_is_zcl = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_zcl = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

          lo_test_class_zcl TYPE REF TO cl_abap_unit_test_class,

    CREATE OBJECT lo_test_class_zcl TYPE ('ZCL_MY_TEST_CLASS').
    CREATE OBJECT lo_test_class_other TYPE ('CL_OTHER_TEST_CLASS').

    APPEND lo_test_class_zcl TO lt_all_test_classes.
    APPEND lo_test_class_other TO lt_all_test_classes.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_test_class_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_classes) = lo_cut->get_zcl_test_classes( lt_all_test_classes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Only one ZCL class expected' act = lines( lt_filtered_classes ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered class should be ZCL_MY_TEST_CLASS' act = lt_filtered_classes[ 1 ]->get_name( ) exp = 'ZCL_MY_TEST_CLASS' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die nach 'NEW YORK' fliegen, und erstellen Sie dann eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` in Kombination mit einer Methode zur Datenextraktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Auswahl und `FOR` für die Transformation. Eine Methode kann die Extraktion und Formatierung der Daten übernehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_number TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ny_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS map_flight_to_summary
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flight_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
                            ( map_flight_to_summary( is_flight = ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_flight_to_summary.
    rs_summary = VALUE #( carrier = is_flight-carrid
                          flight_number = is_flight-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_ny_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ny_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_ny_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

CLASS zcl_complex_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_complex_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_special_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING CONTROL is_special_flight
                           WHERE ( is_special_flight( is_flight = table_line ) = abap_true ) ).

  METHOD is_special_flight.
    IF ( is_flight-carrid = 'LH' AND is_flight-cityto = 'FRANKFURT' )
    OR ( is_flight-carrid = 'UA' AND is_flight-cityto = 'CHICAGO' ).

CLASS zcl_date_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flights_in_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_date_to   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS is_date_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_check_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_date_from  TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_date_to    TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_date_range.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING CONTROL is_date_in_range
                           WHERE ( is_date_in_range( iv_check_date = fldate
                                                     iv_date_from  = iv_date_from
                                                     iv_date_to    = iv_date_to ) = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_date_in_range.
    IF iv_check_date BETWEEN iv_date_from AND iv_date_to.
      rv_in_range = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_in_range = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und ermitteln Sie dann die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzkapazität dieser Flüge. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einer Methode zur Berechnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Auswahl und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation (Summe und Zähler). Eine Methode kann die Aggregationslogik kapseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_capacity_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_capacity_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_city_from TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_capacity) TYPE f.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_data,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
             flight_count   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_agg_data.

    METHODS aggregate_capacity
      IMPORTING
        is_current_agg TYPE ty_agg_data
        is_flight      TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_new_agg) TYPE ty_agg_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_capacity_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_capacity_from_city.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(ls_aggregated_data) = REDUCE ty_agg_data(
      INIT agg = VALUE ty_agg_data( total_capacity = 0 flight_count = 0 )
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = iv_city_from )
      NEXT agg = aggregate_capacity( is_current_agg = agg is_flight = ls_flight )
    ).

    IF ls_aggregated_data-flight_count > 0.
      rv_avg_capacity = ls_aggregated_data-total_capacity / ls_aggregated_data-flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_capacity = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD aggregate_capacity.
    rs_new_agg-total_capacity = is_current_agg-total_capacity + is_flight-seatsmax.
    rs_new_agg-flight_count = is_current_agg-flight_count + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_avg_capacity_from_city FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_capacity_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_capacity_from_city.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_capacity_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_capacity) = lo_cut->get_avg_capacity_from_city( iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average capacity should be positive' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_avg_capacity > 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    " Depending on SFLIGHT data, you might assert a specific range or value
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( msg = 'Avg capacity for FRA' act = lv_avg_capacity exp = 250 dec = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_capacity_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_capacity_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_capacity) = lo_cut->get_avg_capacity_from_city( iv_city_from = 'NONEXISTENT_CITY' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average capacity should be zero for no flights' act = lv_avg_capacity exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine komplexere Aggregation mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Zuerst werden Flüge von einer bestimmten Stadt gefiltert. Dann wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um sowohl die Gesamtkapazität als auch die Anzahl der Flüge zu akkumulieren. Die Methode `aggregate_capacity` kapselt die Logik für die schrittweise Aggregation, was den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck übersichtlicher macht. Am Ende wird der Durchschnitt berechnet.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Method, Aggregation, Average

CLASS zcl_flight_or_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_or_condition
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS check_or_condition
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_or_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_or_condition.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING CONTROL check_or_condition
                           WHERE ( check_or_condition( is_flight = table_line ) = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_or_condition.
    IF is_flight-connid < 100 OR is_flight-cityfrom = 'BERLIN'.
      rv_match = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_match = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_or_condition_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_or_condition_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_or_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_or_condition( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight should match OR condition' act = COND abap_bool(
        WHEN ls_flight-connid < 100 OR ls_flight-cityfrom = 'BERLIN' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verdeutlicht die Verwendung von `FILTER` mit einer Methode, die eine ODER-verknüpfte Bedingung prüft. Die Methode `check_or_condition` kapselt die Logik, was den `FILTER`-Ausdruck sauber und die Bedingung leicht verständlich macht. Dies ist besonders nützlich bei komplexen Filterkriterien, die mehrere Felder oder logische Operatoren umfassen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Method, OR, USING CONTROL

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben und deren Flugnummer in einer Liste von 'bevorzugten' Flugnummern enthalten ist. Verwenden Sie eine Methode, um die Prüfung der bevorzugten Flugnummern zu kapseln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit `USING CONTROL` und einer Methode, die `LINE_EXISTS` auf einer internen Tabelle von bevorzugten Flugnummern verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_preferred_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_preferred_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_preferred_connids TYPE tt_connids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_preferred_connids TYPE tt_connids.

    METHODS is_preferred_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_preferred) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_preferred_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_preferred_flights.
    me->mt_preferred_connids = it_preferred_connids.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING CONTROL is_preferred_connid
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND is_preferred_connid( iv_connid = connid ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_preferred_connid.
    IF line_exists( mt_preferred_connids[ table_line = iv_connid ] ).
      rv_is_preferred = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_preferred = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_preferred_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_preferred_flights.
    DATA: lt_preferred_connids TYPE zcl_preferred_flights=>tt_connids.
    APPEND '0017' TO lt_preferred_connids.
    APPEND '0400' TO lt_preferred_connids.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_preferred_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_preferred_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' it_preferred_connids = lt_preferred_connids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Connid should be preferred' act = COND abap_bool(
        WHEN line_exists( lt_preferred_connids[ table_line = ls_flight-connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `FILTER` mit einer Methode verwendet werden kann, die eine weitere interne Tabelle (`mt_preferred_connids`) zur Validierung heranzieht. Die Methode `is_preferred_connid` prüft effizient mit `LINE_EXISTS`, ob eine Flugnummer in der Liste der bevorzugten Nummern enthalten ist. Dies ist ein elegantes Muster für die Filterung basierend auf Referenzdaten.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Retrieval, Method, LINE_EXISTS, USING CONTROL

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen, und geben Sie die Fluggesellschaften zurück, die mehr als 2 solcher Flüge anbieten. Verwenden Sie `FILTER`, `GROUP BY` und eine Methode zur Zählung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR ... GROUP BY` und einer Methode, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
           tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_ny_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS count_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_ny_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_carrier_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
      GROUP BY ls_group-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count = count_flights( it_flights = GROUP ls_group ) )
    ).

    rt_carriers = FILTER #( lt_grouped_flights WHERE flight_count > iv_min_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD count_flights.
    rv_count = lines( it_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_carriers_with_many_ny_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carriers_with_many_ny_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_many_ny_flights( iv_min_flights = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_carrier_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count should be > 2' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_carrier_count-flight_count > 2 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Kombination von `FILTER`, `FOR GROUPS OF` und einer Methode. Zuerst werden Flüge von 'NEW YORK' gefiltert. Dann werden diese Flüge nach Fluggesellschaften gruppiert. Für jede Gruppe wird die Methode `count_flights` aufgerufen, um die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln. Schließlich wird das Ergebnis erneut gefiltert, um nur Fluggesellschaften mit mehr als einer bestimmten Anzahl von Flügen anzuzeigen. Dies ist ein sehr leistungsfähiges Muster für komplexe Aggregationen und Filterungen.
keywords: FILTER, FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Tables, Grouping, Method, VALUE, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                 carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
                 connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
                 fldate   TYPE s_date,
                 price    TYPE s_price,
               END OF ty_flight.
        TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

        CLASS-METHODS filter_flights
          IMPORTING
            iv_min_price TYPE s_price
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price ) ( flight ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Division durchführt und eine Ausnahme vom Typ `cx_sy_zerodivide` auslöst, wenn der Divisor Null ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISING` in der Methodendefinition und `TRY...CATCH` im Unit Test.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_divider->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    TRY.
        lo_divider->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_zerodivide exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_sy_zerodivide exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die explizite Deklaration von Ausnahmen (`RAISING`) in Methodensignaturen. Dies verbessert die Robustheit des Codes, indem es auf potenzielle Fehlerfälle hinweist und eine strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: RAISING, Exceptions, Error Handling, cx_sy_zerodivide

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen summiert und das Ergebnis mit dem `REDUCE` Operator zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT`.

CLASS zcl_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_numbers IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + n ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_reducer->sum_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_reducer=>tt_numbers( ).

keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer bestehenden Tabelle erstellt, indem sie den `FOR` Ausdruck verwendet, um Werte zu transformieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... )` zur Konstruktion der neuen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_input.
    TYPES tt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_output,
             id     TYPE i,
             text_uc TYPE string,
           END OF ty_output.
    TYPES tt_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE tt_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE tt_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR item IN it_input ( id = item-id text_uc = to_upper( item-text ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_table.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_table_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_table_transformer=>tt_input( ( id = 1 text = 'hello' ) ( id = 2 text = 'world' ) ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_transformer->transform_table( lt_input ).

    DATA(ls_expected1) = VALUE zcl_table_transformer=>ty_output( id = 1 text_uc = 'HELLO' ).
    DATA(ls_expected2) = VALUE zcl_table_transformer=>ty_output( id = 2 text_uc = 'WORLD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 1 ] exp = ls_expected1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 2 ] exp = ls_expected2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_table_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_table_transformer=>tt_input( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_transformer->transform_table( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert den `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator zur Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Art, neue Tabellen aus bestehenden zu generieren.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strings filtert und nur die Strings zurückgibt, die ein bestimmtes Präfix haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_by_prefix
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_prefix  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_prefix.
    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_strings WHERE ( CONTAINS( val = table_line sub = iv_prefix ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in eine neue Tabelle mit einer anderen Struktur umwandelt, indem sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `CORRESPONDING` verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... ( CORRESPONDING ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_input,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_input.
    TYPES tt_flight_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_output,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             ticket_price TYPE s_price,
             currency_code TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_output.
    TYPES tt_flight_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS map_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_input_flights TYPE tt_flight_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_flights) TYPE tt_flight_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights.
    rt_output_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_input IN it_input_flights
                                 ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_input MAPPING carrid = airline_id
                                                               connid = flight_num
                                                               fldate = flight_date
                                                               price = ticket_price
                                                               currency = currency_code ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw.

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_flight_mapper=>tt_flight_input( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflights_raw ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_raw ) ) ).

    DATA(lt_output) = zcl_flight_mapper=>map_flights( it_input_flights = lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = lines( lt_input ) ).
    IF lines( lt_output ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = lt_input[ 1 ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 1 ]-flight_num exp = lt_input[ 1 ]-connid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_flight_mapper=>tt_flight_input( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = zcl_flight_mapper=>map_flights( it_input_flights = lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur unter Verwendung des `FOR` Ausdrucks in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING`. Dies ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Abbildung von Daten zwischen verschiedenen Tabellenstrukturen.
keywords: FOR, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Transformation, Mapping

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lv_message TYPE string.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        lv_message = lx_error->get_text( ).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen generischen Datenreferenzparameter akzeptiert und den Wert des referenzierten Feldes als String zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REF TO data` für den Parameter und `ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs>` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_to_data_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_from_ref
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value_as_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_to_data_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_from_ref.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value_as_string = |{ <fs_data> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value_as_string = 'Referenz ist nicht zugewiesen'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_value_int FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_value_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_value_initial FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_value_int.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_data_access( ).
    DATA(lv_number) = 123.
    DATA(lr_number) = REF TO lv_number.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->get_value_from_ref( lr_number ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = '123' msg = 'Integer-Wert falsch gelesen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_value_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_data_access( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lr_text) = REF TO lv_text.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->get_value_from_ref( lr_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = 'Hello World' msg = 'String-Wert falsch gelesen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_value_initial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_data_access( ).
    DATA lr_initial TYPE REF TO data. " Initial reference
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->get_value_from_ref( lr_initial ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = 'Referenz ist nicht zugewiesen' msg = 'Initial-Referenz falsch behandelt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REF TO data` ermöglicht die Übergabe von Referenzen auf beliebige Datentypen, was für generische Programmierung unerlässlich ist. Der Zugriff erfolgt über `ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>`, wobei `<fs_data>` ein Feldsymbol ist, das auf den Inhalt der Referenz zeigt.
keywords: REF TO, Data Reference, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Generic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten (Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einem formatierten String zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit eingebetteten Ausdrücken.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und String-Templates mit `CONV` oder direkten Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_details) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_flight_details = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }: | &&
                          |von { ls_sflight-cityfrom } nach { ls_sflight-cityto } | &&
                          |am { CONV d( ls_sflight-fldate ) DATE = USER } um { ls_sflight-fltime } Uhr.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_flight_details = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_template_sflight( ).
    " Annahme: Flug LH 0400 existiert in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->get_flight_info( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Check if SELECT SINGLE was successful
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_actual ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_actual exp = 'LH 0400' msg = 'Flugnummer fehlt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_actual exp = 'von' msg = 'Abflugort fehlt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_actual exp = 'nach' msg = 'Zielort fehlt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_template_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->get_flight_info( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = 'Flug XX 9999 nicht gefunden.' msg = 'Fehlermeldung falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates erlauben die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken (`{ ... }`) sowie die Verkettung mit `&&`. Dies macht den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar. `CONV d( ls_sflight-fldate ) DATE = USER` demonstriert eine moderne Konvertierung innerhalb des Templates.
keywords: String Templates, CONCATENATE, Expressions, SFLIGHTS, SELECT SINGLE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Feld sortiert, dessen Name als String übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie Datenreferenzen und Feldsymbole.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Datenreferenz auf die interne Tabelle, weisen Sie diese einem Feldsymbol zu und verwenden Sie dann `SORT <fs_table> BY (<field_name>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_to_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        ir_table    TYPE REF TO data " Reference to internal table
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_to_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Interne Tabelle konnte nicht zugewiesen werden.'.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if field exists in table line type (optional, but good practice)
    DATA(lr_line_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table>[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lr_struct_type) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lr_line_type ).
    IF lr_struct_type->get_component( iv_field_name ) IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' existiert nicht in der Tabelle.|.
    ENDIF.

    SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_sort_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_by_connid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
    METHODS test_initial_reference FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_mock.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '003'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'.

    DATA(lr_flights) = REF TO lt_flights.
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( ir_table = lr_flights iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Falsche Sortierung nach CARRID (1)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' msg = 'Falsche Sortierung nach CARRID (2)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Falsche Sortierung nach CARRID (3)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_mock.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '003'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'.

    DATA(lr_flights) = REF TO lt_flights.
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( ir_table = lr_flights iv_field_name = 'CONNID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' msg = 'Falsche Sortierung nach CONNID (1)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '002' msg = 'Falsche Sortierung nach CONNID (2)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-connid exp = '003' msg = 'Falsche Sortierung nach CONNID (3)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_mock.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.

    DATA(lr_flights) = REF TO lt_flights.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = CLASS zcl_ref_to_dynamic_sort=>sort_table_dynamically( ir_table = lr_flights iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR'
      msg = 'Keine Exception bei ungültigem Feld'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_reference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA lr_flights TYPE REF TO tt_sflight_mock. " Initial reference
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = CLASS zcl_ref_to_dynamic_sort=>sort_table_dynamically( ir_table = lr_flights iv_field_name = 'CARRID' )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR'
      msg = 'Keine Exception bei initialer Referenz'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt Datenreferenzen (`REF TO data`) und Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`), um eine interne Tabelle dynamisch zu sortieren. Der Feldname wird zur Laufzeit übergeben. Dies ist ein mächtiges Muster für generische Funktionen, die mit unbekannten Datentypen arbeiten müssen. Die Überprüfung des Feldnamens mittels RTTI (`cl_abap_typedescr`) erhöht die Robustheit.
keywords: REF TO, Data Reference, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, SORT, RTTI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hierarchie von Klassen (Basisklasse `Animal`, abgeleitete Klassen `Dog` und `Cat`). CLASS zcl_animal DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cat DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_animal PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dog IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) durchläuft und für jede Zeile eine Referenz auf die Zeile zurückgibt, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist (z.B. Fluggesellschaft 'LH').
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... REFERENCE INTO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_to_table_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ref TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flight_refs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_refs) TYPE tt_sflight_ref.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_to_table_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flight_refs.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_sflight).
      IF lr_sflight->carrid = 'LH'.
        APPEND lr_sflight TO rt_flight_refs.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_lh_flight_refs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flight_refs.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_table_line( ).
    DATA(lt_refs) = lo_cut->get_lh_flight_refs( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_refs ).

    LOOP AT lt_refs INTO DATA(lr_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Check if reference is valid
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_flight->carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Falsche Fluggesellschaft referenziert' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... REFERENCE INTO` ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen, wenn man die Zeilen direkt modifizieren oder Referenzen auf sie speichern möchte, ohne unnötige Kopien zu erstellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: REF TO, Internal Tables, LOOP AT, REFERENCE INTO, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine generische Datenreferenz akzeptiert und den Typ des referenzierten Objekts (z.B. 'STRING', 'I', 'STRUCTURE') als String zurückgibt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_to_get_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_type
      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_ref_to_get_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_type.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).
      rv_type_name = lo_descr->type_kind.
    ELSE.
      rv_type_name = 'INITIAL_REFERENCE'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem Satz zusammenfügt, wobei jedes Wort durch ein Leerzeichen getrennt ist und der Satz mit einem Punkt endet. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `CONCATENATE` oder String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_sentence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_sentence
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_sentence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sentence.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word ELSE s && | { word }| )
    ) && '.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_normal_sentence FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_word_list FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_word FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normal_sentence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_sentence( ).
    DATA lt_words TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Das' TO lt_words.
    APPEND 'ist' TO lt_words.
    APPEND 'ein' TO lt_words.
    APPEND 'Satz' TO lt_words.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Das ist ein Satz.'.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->build_sentence( lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Normaler Satz falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_word_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_sentence( ).
    DATA lt_words TYPE string_table.
    DATA(lv_expected) = '.'.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->build_sentence( lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Leere Wortliste falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_word.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_sentence( ).
    DATA lt_words TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Hallo' TO lt_words.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Hallo.'.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->build_sentence( lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Einzelnes Wort falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit String-Templates (`s && | { word }|`) und der `COND` Expression für die initiale Behandlung des ersten Wortes, ermöglicht sie eine sehr kompakte und funktionale String-Verkettung, die die klassische `LOOP` und `CONCATENATE`-Logik ersetzt.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, CONCATENATE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. 'Dog' oder 'Cat') eine Referenz auf die entsprechende Tierklasse zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie eine Schnittstelle für die Rückgabe.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle `zif_animal_sound`, implementieren Sie diese in `zcl_dog` und `zcl_cat`, und lassen Sie die Factory-Methode `REF TO zif_animal_sound` zurückgeben.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_animal_sound PUBLIC.
  METHODS make_sound RETURNING VALUE(rv_sound) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dog_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_animal_sound.
    METHODS make_sound REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cat_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_animal_sound.
    METHODS make_sound REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_animal_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_animal
      IMPORTING
        iv_animal_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_animal) TYPE REF TO zif_animal_sound
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dog_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD make_sound.
    rv_sound = 'Wuff!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cat_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD make_sound.
    rv_sound = 'Miau!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_animal_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_animal.
    CASE iv_animal_type.
      WHEN 'Dog'.
        rr_animal = NEW zcl_dog_factory( ).
      WHEN 'Cat'.
        rr_animal = NEW zcl_cat_factory( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error EXPORTING text = |Unbekannter Tiertyp: { iv_animal_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dog FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_cat FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dog.
    DATA(lr_animal) = zcl_animal_factory=>create_animal( 'Dog' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_animal->make_sound( ) exp = 'Wuff!' msg = 'Hund nicht korrekt erstellt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_cat.
    DATA(lr_animal) = zcl_animal_factory=>create_animal( 'Cat' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_animal->make_sound( ) exp = 'Miau!' msg = 'Katze nicht korrekt erstellt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = zcl_animal_factory=>create_animal( 'Bird' )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_CREATE_ERROR'
      msg = 'Keine Exception bei ungültigem Typ'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Muster in ABAP, bei dem eine statische Methode (`create_animal`) die Instanziierung von Objekten übernimmt. Die Rückgabe einer Referenz auf eine Schnittstelle (`REF TO zif_animal_sound`) fördert die lose Kopplung und ermöglicht Polymorphismus, da der aufrufende Code nicht die konkrete Klasse kennen muss.
keywords: REF TO, Object Reference, Factory Pattern, Interface, Polymorphism, Object Orientation

Instructions: Verketten Sie zwei Strings mit dem `&&`-Operator und geben Sie das Ergebnis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `&&`-Operator für die String-Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_concatenate_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1 TYPE string
        iv_string2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_concatenate_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_concatenated_string = iv_string1 && iv_string2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_basic_concatenation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_basic_concatenation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_concatenate_op( ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'HelloWorld'.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->concatenate_strings( iv_string1 = 'Hello' iv_string2 = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Einfache Verkettung falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `&&`-Operator ist die moderne und prägnante Art, Strings in ABAP zu verketten. Er ist einfacher zu lesen und zu schreiben als die klassische `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung und kann direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden.
keywords: CONCATENATE, String Operator, String Processing, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf eine interne Tabelle akzeptiert und die Anzahl der Zeilen in dieser Tabelle zurückgibt, ohne den Tabellentyp zur Kompilierzeit zu kennen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REF TO data`, `ASSIGN` zu einem Feldsymbol vom Typ `STANDARD TABLE` und dann `LINES()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_to_table_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_line_count
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_to_table_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_line_count.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Referenz zeigt nicht auf eine interne Tabelle oder ist initial.'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_line_count = lines( <fs_table> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_non_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_table_reference FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
    METHODS test_initial_reference FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_non_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_table_lines( ).
    DATA lt_test TYPE tt_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test.
    DATA(lr_test) = REF TO lt_test.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_table_line_count( lr_test ) exp = 2 msg = 'Zeilenanzahl für nicht-leere Tabelle falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_table_lines( ).
    DATA lt_test TYPE tt_data.
    DATA(lr_test) = REF TO lt_test.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_table_line_count( lr_test ) exp = 0 msg = 'Zeilenanzahl für leere Tabelle falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_table_reference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_table_lines( ).
    DATA lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Not a table'.
    DATA(lr_string) = REF TO lv_string.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = lo_cut->get_table_line_count( lr_string )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR'
      msg = 'Keine Exception bei Nicht-Tabellen-Referenz'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_reference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_table_lines( ).
    DATA lr_initial TYPE REF TO data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = lo_cut->get_table_line_count( lr_initial )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR'
      msg = 'Keine Exception bei initialer Referenz'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `REF TO data` und Feldsymbolen generisch auf interne Tabellen zugreifen kann, um deren Eigenschaften (hier: Zeilenanzahl mit `LINES()`) zu ermitteln, ohne den konkreten Tabellentyp zur Kompilierzeit zu kennen. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der dynamischen Programmierung.
keywords: REF TO, Data Reference, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, LINES

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats_occ TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_seats = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) 
      ( 
        carrid = flight-carrid
        total_seats_occ = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP flight NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_reduce.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_grp_reduce=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' seatsocc = 75 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-total_seats_occ exp = 150 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-total_seats_occ exp = 275 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` ermöglichen eine deklarative und effiziente Aggregation von Daten direkt in einer `VALUE` Expression, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit manueller Aggregation.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden und mehr als 100 freie Sitze haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR` Expression mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND seatsfree > 100 )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_for_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsfree = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsfree = 80 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsfree = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' seatsfree = 110 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR` mit `WHERE` bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Syntax zum Filtern von internen Tabellen. Es ist eine moderne, funktionale Art, eine neue Tabelle basierend auf Filterkriterien zu erstellen, ohne eine explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisung zu benötigen.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'P' für Pünktlich, 'D' für Verspätet, 'C' für Annulliert) basierend auf einem Eingabewert. Wenn der Wert unbekannt ist, geben Sie 'Unbekannt' zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `SWITCH` Expression mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status_code
                               WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pünktlich'
                               WHEN 'D' THEN 'Verspätet'
                               WHEN 'C' THEN 'Annulliert'
                               WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_switch_others FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_switch_others.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_others( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'P' ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'D' ) exp = 'Verspätet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'C' ) exp = 'Annulliert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'X' ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( '' ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SWITCH` Expression ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF` oder `CASE` Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes. `WHEN OTHERS` fängt alle nicht explizit behandelten Fälle ab und sorgt für eine vollständige Abdeckung der möglichen Eingabewerte.
keywords: SWITCH, WHEN OTHERS, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte (z.B. Division durch Null), und fangen Sie alle möglichen Ausnahmen mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zu generieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_catch_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_catch_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_division.
    DATA: lv_division_result TYPE i.
    TRY.
        lv_division_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Division erfolgreich: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        rv_result = |Arithmetischer Fehler: { lx_arith->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_other_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_catch_others( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Division erfolgreich: 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_catch_others( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Division durch Null' text = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_catch_others( ).
    " For this simple example, division by zero is the primary error.
    " The WHEN OTHERS block would catch any other CX_ROOT derived exception.
    " We simulate a generic error by forcing a division by zero and checking the generic message.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler' text = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `TRY...CATCH` mit `WHEN OTHERS` ist der Standardweg für robuste Fehlerbehandlung in modernem ABAP. Es ermöglicht das Abfangen spezifischer Ausnahmen (`cx_sy_arithmetic_error`) und das generische Abfangen aller anderen unerwarteten Ausnahmen (`cx_root` mit `WHEN OTHERS`), um das Programm stabil zu halten und aussagekräftige Fehlermeldungen zu liefern.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, WHEN OTHERS, Exceptions, Error Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer, Flugdatum und Fluggesellschaft aus einer `sflights`-ähnlichen Struktur enthält. Setzen Sie für alle neuen Einträge ein zusätzliches Feld 'STATUS' auf 'NEW'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` innerhalb einer `FOR` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    rt_summaries = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( flight EXCEPT seatsmax seatsocc seatsfree planetype ) 
        status = 'NEW' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_value_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_value_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_value_corr=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-status exp = 'NEW' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'NEW' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglichen eine sehr effiziente und typsichere Transformation von internen Tabellen. `CORRESPONDING` kopiert Felder mit gleichem Namen, während `EXCEPT` bestimmte Felder ausschließt, was den Code sauber und wartbar macht.
keywords: VALUE, CORRESPONDING, FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Flugnummern (`CONNID`) aus einer internen Tabelle durch Komma getrennt enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE` Expression mit `LOOP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_flight_ids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_ids) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_flight_ids.
    rv_concatenated_ids = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid ELSE s && `, ` && flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_string_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_flight_ids( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0400, 0401, 0010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_string_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string=>tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_flight_ids( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ideal für Aggregationen wie String-Verkettung und ersetzt explizite `LOOP`s mit temporären Variablen. Die `COND` Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine elegante Behandlung des ersten Elements, um ein führendes Trennzeichen zu vermeiden.
keywords: REDUCE, LOOP, String Processing, Concatenation

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer in einer internen Tabelle existiert. Wenn ja, geben Sie 'Gefunden', sonst 'Nicht gefunden' zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und die `COND` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_sflights[ connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN 'Gefunden'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Nicht gefunden'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft eine Liste der zugehörigen Flugnummern enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und eine verschachtelte `FOR` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids TYPE tt_connid,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      ( 
        carrid = flight-carrid
        connids = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP flight ( member-connid ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
