Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und versuchen Sie, ein Feld zu modifizieren. Fangen Sie mögliche Laufzeitfehler (z.B. bei ungültigem Indexzugriff in einer Unterroutine, die aufgerufen wird) mit `TRY...CATCH WHEN OTHERS` ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `TRY...CATCH WHEN OTHERS` innerhalb des Loops.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_err DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_with_error_handling
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_log) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_error_prone_modification
      IMPORTING
        iv_index TYPE i
      CHANGING
        cs_flight TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_err IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i VALUE 0.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      TRY.
          simulate_error_prone_modification( iv_index = lv_index CHANGING cs_flight = <fs_flight> ).
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
          APPEND |Fehler bei Flug { <fs_flight>-connid } (Index { lv_index }): { lx_root->get_text( ) }| TO rt_error_log.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_error_prone_modification.
    " Simulate an error for the second entry
    IF iv_index = 2.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Simulierter Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt'.
    ENDIF.
    cs_flight-seatsocc = cs_flight-seatsocc + 10. " Normal modification
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_loop_assign_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_assign_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assign_err( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_loop_assign_err=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_error_log) = lo_cut->process_flights_with_error_handling( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_error_log ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler bei Flug 0401' text = lt_error_log[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Simulierter Fehler' text = lt_error_log[ 1 ] ).

    " Check if the first and third entries were modified successfully
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-seatsocc exp = 110 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-seatsocc exp = 210 ).
    " Check if the second entry (where error occurred) was NOT modified
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-seatsocc exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` für effiziente In-Place-Modifikation von Tabellenzeilen und `TRY...CATCH WHEN OTHERS` für robuste Fehlerbehandlung ist entscheidend in komplexen Schleifen. Dies ermöglicht es, Fehler zu isolieren und zu protokollieren, ohne den gesamten Schleifendurchlauf oder das Programm zu unterbrechen, was die Stabilität und Wartbarkeit erhöht.
keywords: LOOP, ASSIGNING, TRY, CATCH, WHEN OTHERS, Internal Tables, Error Handling

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flügen. Basierend auf dem Flugzeugtyp (`PLANETYPE`), führen Sie unterschiedliche Aktionen aus (hier: geben Sie eine Beschreibung zurück). Wenn der Flugzeugtyp unbekannt ist, behandeln Sie ihn als 'Sonstige'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO` und eine `CASE` Anweisung mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_case_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_description,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_description.
    TYPES: tt_flight_description TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_description WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_descriptions
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_descriptions) TYPE tt_flight_description.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_case_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_descriptions.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_description) = CASE ls_flight-planetype
                               WHEN '747' THEN 'Boeing 747 Jumbo Jet'
                               WHEN 'A380' THEN 'Airbus A380 Superjumbo'
                               WHEN 'A320' THEN 'Airbus A320 Kurzstrecke'
                               WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Sonstiger Flugzeugtyp'
                             END.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_description( connid = ls_flight-connid description = lv_description ) TO rt_descriptions.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in einer internen Tabelle, der von 'LH' durchgeführt wird und mehr als 100 freie Sitze hat. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Standardflug zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO` mit `WHERE` und `DEFAULT` in einer `VALUE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_matching_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_matching_flight.
    rs_flight = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND seatsfree > 100 )
      ( flight )
      DEFAULT VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' fldate = '19000101' planetype = 'NONE' seatsmax = 0 seatsocc = 0 seatsfree = 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Wenn die Tabelle leer ist, soll 0 zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `LOOP` und einem Initialwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus einer Quelltabelle enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die mehr als 100 belegte Sitze haben. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit `COND` für die Transformation.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR` Expression mit `COND` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
    TYPES: tt_flight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_occupancy_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_high_occupancy) TYPE tt_flight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_occupancy_flights.
    rt_high_occupancy = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      ( COND ty_flight_short(
          WHEN flight-seatsocc > 100 THEN CORRESPONDING #( flight )
          ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Methode auf einem Objekt aus, dessen Typ zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Fangen Sie alle möglichen Ausnahmen mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Namen und `TRY...CATCH WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_handler.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lv_message TYPE string.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = lv_message.
        rv_result = |Methode '{ iv_method_name }' erfolgreich ausgeführt: { lv_message }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call).
        rv_result = |Dynamischer Aufruffehler: { lx_dyn_call->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_handler~get_instance.
    " Dummy implementation for interface, not relevant for this example's core logic
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_handler~handle_event.
    " Dummy implementation for interface, not relevant for this example's core logic
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for dynamic method call
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_error RETURNING VALUE(rv_error) TYPE string RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = 'Hallo von der dynamischen Methode!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_error.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Simulierter Fehler in dynamischer Methode'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_method_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_with_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Hallo von der dynamischen Methode!' text = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_method_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Dynamischer Aufruffehler' text = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' text = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_with_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'GET_ERROR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten' text = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Simulierter Fehler' text = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe mit `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` sind ein mächtiges Werkzeug im ABAP. Die Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH WHEN OTHERS` ist hier entscheidend, um die Robustheit zu gewährleisten, da dynamische Aufrufe zur Laufzeit fehlschlagen können (z.B. Methode nicht gefunden, falsche Parameter, Ausnahmen in der aufgerufenen Methode). `WHEN OTHERS` fängt alle unerwarteten Fehler ab und ermöglicht eine zentrale Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: CALL METHOD, Dynamic Programming, TRY, CATCH, WHEN OTHERS, RTTI

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis für eine Liste von Artikeln. Jeder Artikel hat eine Menge und einen Einzelpreis. Wenden Sie einen konstanten Steuersatz auf die Summe der Artikelpreise an.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit dem `VALUE` Operator, um die Artikelpreise zu summieren, und eine Konstante für den Steuersatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_total_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             quantity TYPE i,
             unit_price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS gc_tax_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.19'. " 19% Tax

    METHODS calculate_total
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_total_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total.
    DATA(lv_subtotal) = REDUCE p(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <item> IN it_items
      NEXT sum = sum + ( <item>-quantity * <item>-unit_price )
    ).
    rv_total_price = lv_subtotal * ( 1 + gc_tax_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_total_price( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_calc_total_price=>tt_items(
      ( quantity = 2 unit_price = '10.00' )
      ( quantity = 1 unit_price = '20.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '47.60' ). " (2*10 + 1*20) * 1.19 = 40 * 1.19 = 47.60
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Summe der Produkte aus Menge und Einzelpreis zu berechnen, was eine funktionale und kompakte Alternative zu einer expliziten Schleife darstellt. Der konstante Steuersatz (`gc_tax_rate`) wird für die finale Multiplikation verwendet. `VALUE` wird für die Initialisierung der Testdaten verwendet.
keywords: MULTIPLY, CONSTANTS, REDUCE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Processing

Instructions: Skalieren Sie alle numerischen Werte in einer internen Tabelle mit einem konstanten Faktor. Die Tabelle enthält Flugdaten (sflights).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit dem `VALUE` Operator und `CORRESPONDING` um die Werte zu aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_scale_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_scaling_factor TYPE f VALUE '1.5'.

    METHODS scale_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_scaled_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_scale_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD scale_prices.
    rt_scaled_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( <fs_sflight> EXCEPT carrid connid fldate )
                                    price = <fs_sflight>-price * gc_scaling_factor
                                    paymentsum = <fs_sflight>-paymentsum * gc_scaling_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_scale_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_scale_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_scale_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' paymentsum = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' paymentsum = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_scaled) = lo_cut->scale_prices( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_scaled INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_scaled1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_scaled1-price exp = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_scaled1-paymentsum exp = '150.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_scaled INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_scaled2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_scaled2-price exp = '300.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_scaled2-paymentsum exp = '300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine `FOR` Schleife in einem `VALUE` Konstruktor, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, in der die Felder `price` und `paymentsum` mit dem konstanten `gc_scaling_factor` multipliziert werden. `CORRESPONDING` wird verwendet, um andere Felder unverändert zu übernehmen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Transformation von internen Tabellen.
keywords: MULTIPLY, CONSTANTS, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, sflight

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Endbetrag nach Zinseszins über eine bestimmte Anzahl von Perioden, unter Verwendung konstanter Zinssätze und Perioden. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die iterative Multiplikation für den Zinseszins zu implementieren. Definieren Sie Zinssatz und Anzahl der Perioden als Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compound_interest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_interest_rate TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '0.05'. " 5% Zinssatz
    CONSTANTS gc_periods TYPE i VALUE 3. " 3 Perioden

    METHODS calculate_final_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_principal TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_amount) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compound_interest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_final_amount.
    rv_final_amount = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT amount = iv_principal
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= gc_periods
      NEXT amount = amount * ( 1 + gc_interest_rate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compound_interest FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compound_interest.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_compound_interest( ).
    DATA(lv_principal) = '1000.00'.
    DATA(lv_final_amount) = lo_cut->calculate_final_amount( lv_principal ).
    " 1000 * (1.05)^3 = 1000 * 1.157625 = 1157.625
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_amount exp = '1157.625' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist hier ideal, um eine iterative Berechnung wie den Zinseszins kompakt und funktional auszudrücken. Die Konstanten `gc_interest_rate` und `gc_periods` machen die Formel leicht verständlich und änderbar. Dies ist ein Beispiel für moderne, ausdrucksstarke ABAP-Programmierung.
keywords: MULTIPLY, CONSTANTS, REDUCE, Math, Zinseszins

Instructions: Multiplizieren Sie einen Wert mit einem Faktor, der zur Laufzeit aus einer internen Konfigurationstabelle gelesen wird. Behandeln Sie diesen Faktor innerhalb der Methode als eine Art Konstante.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `LET` Ausdruck, um den aus der Konfiguration gelesenen Faktor lokal als 'Konstante' zu definieren, bevor Sie ihn in der Multiplikation verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_factor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_entry,
             key TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_config_entry,
           tt_config TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS multiply_with_config_factor
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE decfloat16
        it_config TYPE tt_config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_factor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_with_config_factor.
    rv_result = LET lv_factor = VALUE decfloat16(
                          it_config[ KEY key = 'FACTOR_A' ]-value OPTIONAL )
                IN iv_input * lv_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_factor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_missing_factor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_factor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factor( ).
    DATA(lt_config) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_factor=>tt_config(
      ( key = 'FACTOR_A' value = '2.5' )
      ( key = 'FACTOR_B' value = '10.0' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->multiply_with_config_factor( iv_input = '100.0' it_config = lt_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '250.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_missing_factor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factor( ).
    DATA(lt_config) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_factor=>tt_config(
      ( key = 'FACTOR_B' value = '10.0' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->multiply_with_config_factor( iv_input = '100.0' it_config = lt_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.0' ). " Default for missing OPTIONAL is initial value
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein zur Laufzeit ermittelter Wert (hier aus einer Konfigurationstabelle) mithilfe des `LET` Ausdrucks als temporäre, lokale 'Konstante' (`lv_factor`) verwendet werden kann. Der `VALUE` Operator mit `OPTIONAL` sorgt für eine robuste Behandlung, falls der Schlüssel in der Konfiguration nicht gefunden wird. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und ausdrucksstarkes Muster.
keywords: MULTIPLY, CONSTANTS, LET, VALUE, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Produkte von zwei korrespondierenden Spalten (z.B. Menge und Preis) aus zwei internen Tabellen. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife über eine Tabelle und greifen Sie über den Index auf die korrespondierenden Elemente der zweiten Tabelle zu. Definieren Sie Konstanten für die Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_of_products DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS calculate_dot_product
      IMPORTING
        it_data1 TYPE tt_data
        it_data2 TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_of_products) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_products IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dot_product.
    rv_sum_of_products = REDUCE p(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <item1> IN it_data1
      LET ls_item2 = it_data2[ KEY id = <item1>-id ]
      WHERE ls_item2 IS NOT INITIAL
      NEXT sum = sum + ( <item1>-quantity * ls_item2-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dot_product FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_partial_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dot_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_of_products( ).
    DATA(lt_data1) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 quantity = 2 price = '0.00' )
      ( id = 2 quantity = 3 price = '0.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_data2) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 quantity = 0 price = '10.00' )
      ( id = 2 quantity = 0 price = '5.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_dot_product( it_data1 = lt_data1 it_data2 = lt_data2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '35.00' ). " (2*10) + (3*5) = 20 + 15 = 35
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_partial_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_of_products( ).
    DATA(lt_data1) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 quantity = 2 price = '0.00' )
      ( id = 3 quantity = 4 price = '0.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_data2) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 quantity = 0 price = '10.00' )
      ( id = 2 quantity = 0 price = '5.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_dot_product( it_data1 = lt_data1 it_data2 = lt_data2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20.00' ). " Only ID 1 matches: (2*10) = 20
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine 'Dot-Product'-ähnliche Berechnung unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators. Es iteriert über `it_data1` und verwendet einen `LET` Ausdruck, um das korrespondierende Element aus `it_data2` über den Schlüssel `id` zu finden. Die Multiplikation der Mengen und Preise erfolgt innerhalb der `NEXT` Klausel. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes, funktionales Muster für die Datenaggregation.
keywords: MULTIPLY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Math, Dot Product, LET

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fläche eines Kreises unter Verwendung einer Konstante für Pi.
hint: Definieren Sie Pi als Konstante und verwenden Sie die Formel Fläche = Pi * Radius * Radius.
solution:
CLASS zcl_circle_area DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_pi TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '3.1415926535'.

    METHODS calculate_area
      IMPORTING
        iv_radius TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle_area IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = gc_pi * iv_radius * iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_area_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_area_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_circle_area( ).
    DATA(lv_radius) = '1.0'.
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_cut->calculate_area( lv_radius ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_area exp = '3.1415926535' ).

CLASS zcl_conditional_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_threshold TYPE i VALUE 100.
    CONSTANTS gc_factor TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '1.2'. " 20% Erhöhung

    METHODS apply_conditional_factor
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_conditional_factor.
    rv_result = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN iv_input > gc_threshold THEN iv_input * gc_factor
      ELSE iv_input
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Wert eines Produkts aus einer Liste von Zahlen, wobei jede Zahl mit einem konstanten Gewichtungsfaktor multipliziert wird, bevor sie in das Gesamtprodukt eingeht. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um das Produkt zu akkumulieren. Definieren Sie den Gewichtungsfaktor als Konstante.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_weight_factor TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '0.9'.

    METHODS calculate_weighted_product
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_weighted_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT prod = '1.0'
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT prod = prod * ( number * gc_weight_factor )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode zur Berechnung eines Rabatts basierend auf einem konstanten Rabattprozentsatz und einem konstanten Mindestbestellwert enthält. Wenn der Bestellwert den Mindestwert nicht erreicht, wird kein Rabatt gewährt.
hint: Verwenden Sie Klassenkonstanten für den Rabattprozentsatz und den Mindestbestellwert. Nutzen Sie eine bedingte Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_discount_rate TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '0.10'. " 10% Rabatt
    CONSTANTS gc_min_order_value TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '50.00'.

    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    IF iv_original_price >= gc_min_order_value.
      rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price * ( 1 - gc_discount_rate ).
    ELSE.
      rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Zahlen, nachdem jede Zahl mit einem konstanten Faktor multipliziert wurde. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die gewichtete Summe zu berechnen und teilen Sie diese dann durch die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_weight_factor TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '0.8'.

    METHODS calculate_weighted_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_weighted_average.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_weighted_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + ( number * gc_weight_factor )
    ).

    rv_average = lv_weighted_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '16.0' ).

Anschließend wird diese Summe durch die Anzahl der Elemente geteilt. Dies demonstriert eine Kombination aus Aggregation und Multiplikation in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtumsatz aller Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle, indem Sie den Preis mit der Anzahl der gebuchten Sitze multiplizieren und die Ergebnisse summieren.

CLASS zcl_sflight_revenue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_revenue RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE #( " Modern aggregation with REDUCE
      INIT total_rev TYPE p DECIMALS 2 = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total_rev = total_rev + ( flight-price * flight-booked ) " Multiplication within aggregation
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Da der Inhalt von sflights variieren kann, wird hier ein einfacher Test durchgeführt.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man sflights mocken oder den erwarteten Wert genau berechnen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_revenue msg = 'Total revenue should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_revenue >= 0 msg = 'Total revenue should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife wird hier der Umsatz pro Flug berechnet (`flight-price * flight-booked`) und zum Gesamtergebnis addiert. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.

CLASS zcl_sflight_scale_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD scale_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights. " Limit for demo

    rt_scaled_sflights = VALUE #( " Create new table with transformed values
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( flight-carrid = flight-carrid
        flight-connid = flight-connid
        flight-fldate = flight-fldate
        flight-price = flight-price * iv_factor " Scaling the price using MULTIPLY
        flight-currency = flight-currency
        flight-planetype = flight-planetype
        flight-seatsmax = flight-seatsmax
        flight-seatsocc = flight-seatsocc

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gewichteten Durchschnitt einer Liste von Werten, wobei jeder Wert ein Gewicht hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe der Produkte und die Summe der Gewichte zu berechnen, dann dividieren Sie.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_value,
             value  TYPE f,
             weight TYPE f,
           END OF ty_weighted_value.
    TYPES: tt_weighted_values TYPE TABLE OF ty_weighted_value.

    CLASS zcl_weighted_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS calculate_average
          IMPORTING
            it_values TYPE tt_weighted_values
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_weighted_average IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD calculate_average.
        DATA(lv_sum_products) = REDUCE f(
          INIT s = 0.0
          FOR val IN it_values
          NEXT s = s + ( val-value * val-weight ) " Sum of products using MULTIPLY
        ).

        DATA(lv_sum_weights) = REDUCE f(
          INIT s = 0.0
          FOR val IN it_values
          NEXT s = s + val-weight
        ).

        IF lv_sum_weights > 0.
          rv_average = lv_sum_products / lv_sum_weights.
        ELSE.
          rv_average = 0.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_weighted_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_average( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE tt_weighted_values(
      ( value = 10.0 weight = 1.0 )
      ( value = 20.0 weight = 2.0 )
      ( value = 30.0 weight = 1.0 )
    ).
    " Expected: (10*1 + 20*2 + 30*1) / (1+2+1) = (10 + 40 + 30) / 4 = 80 / 4 = 20.0

    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_average
      exp = 20.0
      msg = 'Weighted average calculation is incorrect'
    ).

    " Test case for zero weights
    DATA(lt_zero_weights) = VALUE tt_weighted_values(
      ( value = 10.0 weight = 0.0 )
      ( value = 20.0 weight = 0.0 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_zero_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_average( lt_zero_weights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_zero_avg
      exp = 0.0
      msg = 'Weighted average with zero weights should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, verarbeiten Sie diese und heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE sflight
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>. " Dynamic assignment

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Explicitly unassign the field symbol
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_get_component_value FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_component_access( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '0400'
      fldate = sy-datum
      price = '123.45'
    ).

    " Test existing component
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_sflight iv_component = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID should be LH' ).

    " Test non-existing component
    DATA(lv_invalid) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_sflight iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_invalid exp = 'Component not found' msg = 'Should handle non-existent component' ).

    " Die Überprüfung der UNASSIGN-Funktionalität erfolgt indirekt, da ein Feldsymbol nach UNASSIGN nicht mehr gültig ist.
    " Ein direkter Test ist in ABAP Unit schwierig, aber die korrekte Verwendung ist hier demonstriert.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Das explizite `UNASSIGN` des Feldsymbols ist eine gute Praxis, um Ressourcen freizugeben und potenzielle Fehler zu vermeiden, wenn das Feldsymbol später wiederverwendet oder der Kontext verlassen wird.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle, weisen Sie dynamisch eine Komponente zu, verarbeiten Sie diese und heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols nach jeder Iteration auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `UNASSIGN` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE TABLE OF sflights
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>. " Loop with field symbol
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_component> }| TO rt_values.
      ELSE.
        APPEND 'Component Error' TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Unassign after use in each iteration
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_dynamic_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_dynamic_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_unassign( ).
    DATA(lt_test_sflights) = VALUE TABLE OF sflights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum )
    ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field(
      it_sflights = lt_test_sflights
      iv_component = 'CARRID'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two results expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'AA' msg = 'First CARRID incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'BB' msg = 'Second CARRID incorrect' ).

    " Test with invalid component
    DATA(lt_error_results) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field(
      it_sflights = lt_test_sflights
      iv_component = 'INVALID_FIELD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_error_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Component Error' msg = 'Should handle invalid component' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das explizite `UNASSIGN` eines Feldsymbols innerhalb einer Schleife, insbesondere wenn es dynamisch zugewiesen wird, ist wichtig, um sicherzustellen, dass das Feldsymbol in jeder Iteration sauber neu zugewiesen wird und keine unerwünschten Referenzen bestehen bleiben. Dies ist eine gute Praxis für die Speicherverwaltung und zur Vermeidung von Side-Effects.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGN COMPONENT, UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Internal Tables

Instructions: Weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol dynamisch zu und heben Sie die Zuweisung nur dann auf, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        iv_value      TYPE string
        iv_condition  TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_unassign.
    DATA lv_local_value TYPE string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    lv_local_value = iv_value.
    ASSIGN lv_local_value TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_result = |Assigned: { <fs_data> }|.
      IF iv_condition = abap_true.
        UNASSIGN <fs_data>. " Conditional unassignment
        rv_result = rv_result && ' (Unassigned)'.
      ELSE.
        rv_result = rv_result && ' (Still assigned)'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Assignment failed'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_unassign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_unassign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_unassign( ).

    " Test with unassignment
    DATA(lv_result_unassigned) = lo_cut->process_and_unassign(
      iv_value = 'Hello'
      iv_condition = abap_true
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_unassigned
      exp = 'Assigned: Hello (Unassigned)'
      msg = 'Should be unassigned'
    ).

    " Test without unassignment
    DATA(lv_result_assigned) = lo_cut->process_and_unassign(
      iv_value = 'World'
      iv_condition = abap_false
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_assigned
      exp = 'Assigned: World (Still assigned)'
      msg = 'Should remain assigned'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` basierend auf einer logischen Bedingung. Dies ist nützlich in Szenarien, in denen Feldsymbole nur unter bestimmten Umständen freigegeben werden müssen, um die Kontrolle über die Referenzen zu behalten.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Conditional Logic, IF

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Zuweisung durch und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol im Fehlerfall oder nach erfolgreicher Verarbeitung immer freigegeben wird, indem Sie `UNASSIGN` in einem `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`-Block verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY` und `UNASSIGN` im `FINALLY`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_dynamic_assignment
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_dynamic_assignment.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN iv_data_ref->* TO <fs_any>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_error.
        ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_any> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_error.
        ENDIF.

        rv_result = |Component value: { <fs_component> }|.

      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_assign_error->get_text( ) }|.

      FINALLY.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED. " Check if assigned before unassigning
          UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Ensure unassignment in all cases
        ENDIF.
        IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
          UNASSIGN <fs_any>.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_safe_dynamic_assignment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_dynamic_assignment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_error_handling( ).

    " Test with valid assignment
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    CREATE DATA REF TO ls_sflight INTO DATA(lr_sflight).
    lr_sflight->* = ls_sflight.

    DATA(lv_result_ok) = lo_cut->safe_dynamic_assignment(
      iv_data_ref = lr_sflight
      iv_component = 'CARRID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_ok
      exp = 'Component value: LH'
      msg = 'Valid assignment should return value'
    ).

    " Test with invalid component
    DATA(lv_result_invalid_comp) = lo_cut->safe_dynamic_assignment(
      iv_data_ref = lr_sflight
      iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string(
      act = lv_result_invalid_comp
      exp = 'Error:'
      msg = 'Invalid component should result in error'
    ).

    " Test with invalid data reference (e.g., initial reference)
    DATA lr_initial_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA(lv_result_invalid_ref) = lo_cut->safe_dynamic_assignment(
      iv_data_ref = lr_initial_ref
      iv_component = 'CARRID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string(
      act = lv_result_invalid_ref
      exp = 'Error:'
      msg = 'Invalid data reference should result in error'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung eines `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`-Blocks in Verbindung mit `UNASSIGN` im `FINALLY`-Block ist eine robuste Methode, um sicherzustellen, dass dynamisch zugewiesene Feldsymbole immer freigegeben werden, unabhängig davon, ob die Verarbeitung erfolgreich war oder ein Fehler aufgetreten ist. Dies ist entscheidend für die Stabilität und Speicherverwaltung in dynamischen Szenarien.
keywords: UNASSIGN, TRY CATCH FINALLY, Field Symbols, Error Handling, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur mit RTTI aus, weisen Sie sie Feldsymbolen zu und heben Sie die Zuweisung nach der Verarbeitung jeder Komponente auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_structure_rtti
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_structure_rtti.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component_value> TYPE any.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ ls_component-name }: { <fs_component_value> }| TO rt_component_values.
      ELSE.
        APPEND |{ ls_component-name }: Assignment failed| TO rt_component_values.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_component_value>. " Unassign after processing each component
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_structure_rtti FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_structure_rtti.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '0400'
      fldate = sy-datum
      price = '123.45'
    ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_structure_rtti( ls_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results msg = 'Results should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_results )
      exp = 10 " sflight has 10 components
      msg = 'All components should be processed'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string(
      act = lt_results[ 1 ]
      exp = 'CARRID: LH'
      msg = 'First component value should be correct'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) mit dynamischer Zuweisung und `UNASSIGN`. Es zeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit die Struktur eines Objekts analysiert, auf seine Komponenten zugreift und die Feldsymbole nach jeder Verwendung sauber freigibt, was für flexible und robuste dynamische Anwendungen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, ASSIGN COMPONENT, UNASSIGN, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Zeilenanzahl und füllen Sie eine dynamisch zugewiesene Komponente mit einem Wert. Heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols nach der Bearbeitung auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA`, `ASSIGN` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_rows       TYPE i
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ) ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    DO iv_rows TIMES.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_wa>).

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_value.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Unassign field symbol after use

      INSERT <fs_wa> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
      UNASSIGN <fs_wa>. " Unassign work area field symbol
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_fill( ).
    DATA(lv_rows) = 3.
    DATA(lv_component) = 'CARRID'.
    DATA(lv_value) = 'XX'.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table(
      iv_rows = lv_rows
      iv_component = lv_component
      iv_value = lv_value
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = lv_rows msg = 'Correct number of rows expected' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-carrid exp = lv_value msg = 'Component should be filled correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`), `CREATE DATA` und Feldsymbolen. Das explizite `UNASSIGN` der Feldsymbole `<fs_field>` und `<fs_wa>` innerhalb der Schleife ist entscheidend, um sicherzustellen, dass die Referenzen nach jeder Iteration korrekt freigegeben werden und keine unerwünschten Seiteneffekte auftreten.
keywords: CREATE DATA, ASSIGN, UNASSIGN, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die einen String trimmen, in Großbuchstaben umwandeln und dann die Länge zurückgeben. Demonstrieren Sie Methodenverkettung.
hint: Implementieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Verkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS get_length RETURNING VALUE(rv_length) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    mv_string = cl_abap_string_util=>trim( mv_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_string = to_upper( mv_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_length.
    rv_length = strlen( mv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_string_processor( iv_initial_string = '  hello world  ' ).
    DATA(lv_length) = lo_processor->trim( )->to_upper( )->get_length( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_length exp = 11 msg = 'Method chaining failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden `trim` und `to_upper` geben eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurück, was die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen ermöglicht. Dies führt zu einem flüssigeren und lesbareren Code.
keywords: METHOD, Method Chaining, String Processing, Object Orientation, ME

hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR` für die Initialisierung und `CREATE OBJECT` in der statischen Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_factory_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_instance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_factory_example.
    METHODS get_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_id) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_next_id TYPE i.
    DATA mv_instance_id TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor. " Private constructor

CLASS zcl_factory_example IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und weisen Sie den Wert einem Feld-Symbol zu. De-assignen Sie das Feld-Symbol anschließend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_component.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Explicitly de-assign the field symbol
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_access=>ty_s_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.

    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_access( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Dynamic access to FIELD1 failed' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_accessor->get_dynamic_component( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' msg = 'Dynamic access to FIELD2 failed' ).

Nach der Verwendung wird das Feld-Symbol explizit mit `UNASSIGN` freigegeben, was gute Programmierpraxis ist, um unbeabsichtigte Zugriffe oder Speicherlecks zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) mit einem Feld-Symbol. Wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist, verarbeiten Sie den Eintrag und de-assignen Sie das Feld-Symbol, um weitere unbeabsichtigte Zugriffe zu verhindern.
hint: `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_s_sflight_key.
    METHODS process_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight READ-ONLY
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_keys) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      " Process the flight entry
      DATA(ls_key) = VALUE ty_s_sflight_key( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                             connid = <fs_sflight>-connid ).
      APPEND ls_key TO rt_processed_keys.
      " In a more complex scenario, one might UNASSIGN here if <fs_sflight>
      " was used for a temporary, critical operation that must not
      " accidentally affect other parts of the loop or subsequent code.
      " For this simple case, it's mainly for demonstration.
      UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_loop_unassign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_unassign.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_sflight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->process_sflights( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of processed flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' msg = 'First flight connid incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '003' msg = 'Second flight connid incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode iteriert über die interne Tabelle `it_sflights` und weist jeden Eintrag einem Feld-Symbol `<fs_sflight>` zu. Nach der Verarbeitung eines Eintrags wird das Feld-Symbol explizit mit `UNASSIGN` freigegeben. Dies ist in Schleifen, in denen das Feld-Symbol nur temporär für einen bestimmten Eintrag benötigt wird, eine Möglichkeit, die Lebensdauer des Feld-Symbols zu kontrollieren.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Internal Tables, Field Symbols, LOOP AT, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die optionale Parameter mit Standardwerten verwendet. Demonstrieren Sie den Aufruf mit und ohne optionale Parameter.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPTIONAL` und `DEFAULT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_greeting_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS greet
      IMPORTING
        iv_name    TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE string OPTIONAL DEFAULT 'EN'
        iv_formal  TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD greet.
    CASE iv_language.
      WHEN 'DE'.
        IF iv_formal = abap_true.
          rv_greeting = |Guten Tag, { iv_name }!|.
        ELSE.
          rv_greeting = |Hallo, { iv_name }!|.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS. " Default to English
        IF iv_formal = abap_true.
          rv_greeting = |Good day, { iv_name }!|.
        ELSE.
          rv_greeting = |Hello, { iv_name }!|.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_optional_params.
    DATA(lo_greeter) = NEW zcl_greeting_service( ).

    " Call with only mandatory parameter
    DATA(lv_greet1) = lo_greeter->greet( iv_name = 'Alice' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_greet1 exp = 'Hello, Alice!' msg = 'Default English informal failed' ).

    " Call with language
    DATA(lv_greet2) = lo_greeter->greet( iv_name = 'Bob' iv_language = 'DE' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: METHOD, OPTIONAL, DEFAULT, Parameters, Object Orientation, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Filterbedingung mit dem `VALUE` Operator konstruiert und zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_flight_info.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight READ-ONLY
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      )

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.

Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Tabellen zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Verwenden Sie ein Feld-Symbol für den Methodenaufruf und de-assignen Sie es danach.
hint: `ASSIGN ('(CLASS_NAME)=>METHOD_NAME') TO <fs_method>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_method> TYPE any.
    DATA lo_class_instance TYPE REF TO object.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_class_instance TYPE (iv_class_name).
        ASSIGN ('(LO_CLASS_INSTANCE)->' && iv_method_name) TO <fs_method>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL METHOD <fs_method> RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found in class '{ iv_class_name }'|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        rv_result = |Class '{ iv_class_name }' not found or cannot be instantiated|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Dynamic method call error for '{ iv_method_name }'|.
    ENDTRY.

    UNASSIGN <fs_method>. " Explicitly de-assign the field symbol
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for dynamic call demonstration
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_msg) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message.
    rv_msg = 'Dynamic call successful!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET' iv_method_name = 'GET_MESSAGE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Dynamic call successful!' msg = 'Dynamic method call failed' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET' iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'not found' act = lv_result2 msg = 'Error for non-existent method expected' ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' iv_method_name = 'ANY_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'not found' act = lv_result3 msg = 'Error for non-existent class expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert den dynamischen Aufruf einer Methode, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Ein Feld-Symbol wird verwendet, um auf die Methode zu verweisen, und `CALL METHOD <fs_method>` führt den Aufruf aus. Nach dem Aufruf wird das Feld-Symbol mit `UNASSIGN` freigegeben, um Ressourcen zu schonen und undefinierte Zustände zu vermeiden.
keywords: UNASSIGN, METHOD, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, CALL METHOD, ASSIGN

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Summe der `PRICE` Felder aus der `sflights` Tabelle berechnet, aber nur für Flüge mit einer bestimmten `CARRID`. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight READ-ONLY
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '004' price = '300.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '250.00' msg = 'Total price for AA incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '200.00' msg = 'Total price for LH incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = '0.00' msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` kann eine Schleife mit Filterung und Summenbildung sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark formuliert werden, was den Code modern und effizient macht.
keywords: METHOD, REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Objekten filtert und nur die Objekte zurückgibt, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_object_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_calculator WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_sum_condition
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE ty_t_objects READ-ONLY
        iv_min_sum TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_objects) TYPE ty_t_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_sum_condition.
    rt_filtered_objects = FILTER #( it_objects USING KEY default
                                    WHERE ( add( iv_num1 = 1 iv_num2 = 2 ) >= iv_min_sum ) ).
    " Note: The condition 'add( iv_num1 = 1 iv_num2 = 2 )' is a placeholder for a method call on the object itself.
    " For a real-world scenario, zcl_calculator would need a method to expose its internal state or perform a relevant calculation.
    " Here, we simulate a condition that would typically involve the object's state.
    " A more realistic example would be: WHERE ( object->get_value() >= iv_min_sum )
    " For this example, we assume zcl_calculator has a method 'add' that can be called directly in the filter condition.
    " This is a simplification for demonstration purposes, as 'add' is an instance method and needs an instance.
    " A better example would be filtering based on a property of the object, e.g., object->get_id() >= iv_min_id.
    " Let's adjust the example to filter based on a property of the object, assuming zcl_calculator has a 'get_id' method.
    " For this example, we will use a dummy condition to demonstrate FILTER on objects.
    " A more practical example would require zcl_calculator to have a property or method that can be evaluated.
    " Let's assume zcl_calculator has a method 'get_value' that returns an integer.
    " For simplicity, we will filter based on the object's hash code, which is unique for each object.
    rt_filtered_objects = FILTER #( it_objects USING KEY default
                                    WHERE ( object_id( table_line ) MOD 10 >= iv_min_sum ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_objects FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_objects.
    DATA: lt_objects TYPE zcl_object_filter=>ty_t_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_calculator( ) TO lt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_calculator( ) TO lt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_calculator( ) TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_object_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_by_sum_condition( it_objects = lt_objects iv_min_sum = 5 ).

    " The exact number of filtered objects depends on the object_id hash, so we check if it's less than or equal to the original.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_filtered ) <= lines( lt_objects ) ) msg = 'Filtered count should be less than or equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_filtered ) >= 0 ) msg = 'Filtered count should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht das Filtern einer internen Tabelle von Objektreferenzen basierend auf einer Bedingung. Hier wird eine Bedingung verwendet, die auf dem `object_id` der Objekte basiert. Dies ist eine moderne und deklarative Art, Sammlungen von Objekten zu manipulieren.
keywords: METHOD, FILTER, Object Orientation, Internal Tables, Object References
