Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld sortiert. Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole und `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT itab BY (<field_name>)` mit einem dynamischen Feld-Symbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data       TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_sort_field TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_sort_field OF STRUCTURE ct_data[ 1 ] TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SORT ct_data BY (<fs_field>).
    ELSE.
      " Handle error: field not found
      MESSAGE |Sort field '{ iv_sort_field }' not found.| TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sort FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sort.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_sorter=>ty_t_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_dynamic_sorter=>ty_s_data( id = 3 name = 'Charlie' value = 30 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_dynamic_sorter=>ty_s_data( id = 1 name = 'Alice'   value = 10 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_dynamic_sorter=>ty_s_data( id = 2 name = 'Bob'     value = 20 ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sorter( ).

    " Sort by ID
    lo_sorter->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data iv_sort_field = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'Sort by ID failed (first entry)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-id exp = 3 msg = 'Sort by ID failed (last entry)' ).

    " Sort by Name
    lo_sorter->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data iv_sort_field = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Alice' msg = 'Sort by Name failed (first entry)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-name exp = 'Charlie' msg = 'Sort by Name failed (last entry)' ).

    " Sort by Value
    lo_sorter->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data iv_sort_field = 'VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value exp = 10 msg = 'Sort by Value failed (first entry)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-value exp = 30 msg = 'Sort by Value failed (last entry)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert das dynamische Sortieren einer internen Tabelle. Der Name des Sortierfeldes wird zur Laufzeit übergeben. Ein Feld-Symbol wird verwendet, um dynamisch auf das Feld zuzugreifen, und `SORT itab BY (<fs_field>)` führt die Sortierung aus. `UNASSIGN` wird verwendet, um das Feld-Symbol nach Gebrauch freizugeben.
keywords: UNASSIGN, METHOD, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, SORT, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise in einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( 0 ) )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sum_flight_prices=>tt_sflight_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total,
      exp = '350.00',
      msg = 'Total price should be 350.00'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Sie initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei der Wert in jedem Schritt aktualisiert wird. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und lesbarer als eine klassische `LOOP`-Anweisung mit einer expliziten Summenvariable.
keywords: REDUCE, SUM, Internal Tables, COMPUTE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Kombiniere `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine elegante Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_prices
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) = 0.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( 0 ) )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_prices.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_avg_flight_price=>tt_sflight_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_average_lh) = lo_cut->get_average_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_average_aa) = lo_cut->get_average_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_average_lh,
      exp = '150.00',
      msg = 'Average price for LH should be 150.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_average_aa,
      exp = '50.00',
      msg = 'Average price for AA should be 50.00'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_no_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_avg_flight_price=>tt_sflight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->get_average_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_average,
      exp = '0.00',
      msg = 'Average price for non-existent carrier should be 0.00'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Berechnung des Durchschnitts. Zuerst wird die Tabelle mit `FILTER` auf die gewünschte Fluggesellschaft reduziert, dann wird mit `REDUCE` die Summe berechnet und anschließend durch die Anzahl der Zeilen geteilt. Dies vermeidet explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, AVERAGE, Internal Tables, COMPUTE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Finde den höchsten Flugpreis in einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit einem Vergleichsoperator und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_price = ( it_flights[ 1 ]-price )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
      NEXT max_price = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > max_price THEN <fs_flight>-price ELSE max_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_prices.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_max_flight_price=>tt_sflight_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_max) = lo_cut->get_max_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_max,
      exp = '250.00',
      msg = 'Max price should be 250.00'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_max_flight_price=>tt_sflight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_max) = lo_cut->get_max_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_max,
      exp = '0.00',
      msg = 'Max price for empty table should be 0.00'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung wird hier verwendet, um den Maximalwert zu finden. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert den `max_price` mit dem Preis des ersten Elements. In jedem `NEXT`-Schritt wird `COND` verwendet, um den aktuellen `max_price` mit dem Preis des aktuellen Flugs zu vergleichen und den höheren Wert zu übernehmen. Dies ist eine prägnante Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, MAX, Internal Tables, COMPUTE, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechne einen Rabatt auf den Flugpreis basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft. Wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist, gibt es 10% Rabatt, sonst 5%.

CLASS zcl_calc_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_calc_discount IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_discounted_price = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_carrid = 'LH' THEN iv_price * '0.90'
      ELSE iv_price * '0.95'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus SFLIGHTS den doppelten Flugpreis enthält.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_double_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_doubled_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             doubled_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_doubled_price.
    TYPES tt_doubled_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_doubled_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_doubled_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_doubled_flights) TYPE tt_doubled_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_double_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_doubled_prices.
    rt_doubled_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
      ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
        connid = <fs_flight>-connid
        fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate
        doubled_price = <fs_flight>-price * 2 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_doubled[ 2 ]-doubled_price exp = '100.00' ).

explanation: Die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration ermöglicht die Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle mit transformierten Daten in einer einzigen, sehr lesbaren Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation, die explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen überflüssig macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, COMPUTE, Functional Programming, Transformation

Instructions: Aktualisiere den Flugpreis eines spezifischen Fluges in der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwende `MODIFY` mit `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` und einer Tabellenexpression, um den Datensatz zu lesen und zu aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
    ).

    TRY.
        " Read the existing record using a table expression
        DATA(ls_existing_flight) = CORRESPONDING sflight( sflight[
          carrid = iv_carrid
          connid = iv_connid
          fldate = iv_fldate
        ] ).

        ls_existing_flight-price = iv_new_price.

        MODIFY sflight FROM ls_existing_flight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Record not found, cannot update
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA',
          lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0017',
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date    VALUE '20250101',
          lv_old_price TYPE s_price,
          lv_new_price TYPE s_price VALUE '999.99'.

    " Ensure a test record exists
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO lv_old_price
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ).
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
      iv_new_price = lv_new_price
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_actual_price)
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_new_price msg = 'Price should be updated' ).

    " Restore old price for idempotency
    UPDATE sflight SET price = lv_old_price WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = 'XX'
      iv_connid = '9999'
      iv_fldate = '19000101'
      iv_new_price = '1.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Update should fail for non-existing flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Aktualisierung eines einzelnen Datenbankdatensatzes mit modernen ABAP-Features. Der Datensatz wird zunächst über eine Tabellenexpression (`sflight[...]`) gelesen, was eine kompakte und typsichere Art des Zugriffs ist. Anschließend wird das Feld `price` aktualisiert und der Datensatz mit `MODIFY sflight FROM ls_existing_flight` in die Datenbank zurückgeschrieben. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ist ebenfalls eine moderne Praxis.

Instructions: Erhöhe den Flugpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen Prozentsatz und aktualisiere die Währung, falls der Preis einen Schwellenwert überschreitet. Verwende eine interne Tabelle für die Massenaktualisierung.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `VALUE` zur Vorbereitung der Daten und `MODIFY TABLE` für die Massenaktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mass_update_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS mass_update_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mass_update_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(lt_updated_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      LET lv_new_price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 )
      IN
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight EXCEPT price currency )
        price = lv_new_price
        currency = COND #( WHEN lv_new_price > iv_price_threshold THEN 'EUR' ELSE ls_flight-currency ) )
    ).

    MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_updated_flights.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      )
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mass_update_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->mass_update_flights(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid

Schließlich werden diese Änderungen mit `MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_updated_flights` effizient in die Datenbank geschrieben. `CORRESPONDING #` wird verwendet, um Felder zu kopieren, die nicht explizit geändert werden sollen.

Instructions: Aktualisiere den Flugpreis und die Währung für Flüge basierend auf verschiedenen Kriterien in einem einzigen `UPDATE`-Statement direkt auf der Datenbank.
hint: Verwende `UPDATE` mit `SET` und `CASE` Ausdruck in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_case_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_case_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_data.
    UPDATE sflight SET
      price = CASE
                WHEN carrid = iv_carrid AND price < 500 THEN price * '1.10'
                WHEN carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= 500 THEN price * '1.05'
                ELSE price
              END,
      currency = CASE
                   WHEN carrid = iv_carrid AND price < 500 THEN 'USD'
                   WHEN carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= 500 THEN 'EUR'
                   ELSE currency
                 END
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füge einen neuen Flugdatensatz in SFLIGHTS ein oder aktualisiere ihn, falls er bereits existiert, unter Verwendung einer Inline-Struktur.
hint: Verwende `MODIFY` mit `VALUE` für die Inline-Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_or_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS save_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_or_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_flight_data.
    MODIFY sflight FROM is_flight_data.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_new_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_new_flight.
    DATA: ls_new_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_new_flight = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101'
      price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747'
    ).

    " Ensure record does not exist initially
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = ls_new_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_new_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_new_flight-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_or_update( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->save_flight_data( is_flight_data = ls_new_flight ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Insert should be successful' ).

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO DATA(ls_check)
      WHERE carrid = ls_new_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_new_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_new_flight-fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Record should exist' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-price exp = '150.00' msg = 'Price should match' ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = ls_new_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_new_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_new_flight-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    DATA: ls_existing_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_existing_flight = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102'
      price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A380'
    ).

    " Ensure record exists initially
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_existing_flight.
    COMMIT WORK.

    ls_existing_flight-price = '250.00'. " Update price
    ls_existing_flight-currency = 'EUR'. " Update currency

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_or_update( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->save_flight_data( is_flight_data = ls_existing_flight ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO DATA(ls_check)
      WHERE carrid = ls_existing_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_existing_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_existing_flight-fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Record should still exist' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-price exp = '250.00' msg = 'Price should be updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-currency exp = 'EUR' msg = 'Currency should be updated' ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = ls_existing_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_existing_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_existing_flight-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY` Anweisung in ABAP ist vielseitig und kann sowohl zum Einfügen neuer Datensätze als auch zum Aktualisieren bestehender Datensätze verwendet werden. In Kombination mit der `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression für die Inline-Erstellung der Struktur `is_flight_data` wird der Code sehr kompakt und lesbar. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Datenbankoperationen durchzuführen, ohne explizit zwischen `INSERT` und `UPDATE` unterscheiden zu müssen.
keywords: MODIFY, Database, INSERT, UPDATE, VALUE, Inline Structure

Instructions: Erhöhe die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die noch nicht ausgebucht sind.
hint: Verwende `UPDATE` mit `SET` und einer arithmetischen Operation direkt in der Datenbank.
solution:
CLASS zcl_increment_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increment_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_increment_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increment_occupied_seats.
    UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = seatsocc + 1
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc < seatsmax.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne für jeden Flug in einer internen Tabelle den 'Auslastungsgrad' (seatsocc / seatsmax) und speichere ihn in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `LET` für Zwischenberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy_rate,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_occupancy_rate.
    TYPES tt_occupancy_rates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy_rate WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_rates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_occupancy_rates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_rates.
    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      LET lv_rate = COND p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2(
                      WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ) * 100
                      ELSE 0
                    )
      IN
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        occupancy_rate = lv_rate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_occupancy_rates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_occupancy_zero_max FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_rates.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_calc_occupancy=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 75 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_cut->get_occupancy_rates( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_occupancy ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_occupancy[ 1 ]-occupancy_rate exp = '75.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_occupancy[ 2 ]-occupancy_rate exp = '50.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_occupancy_zero_max.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_calc_occupancy=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 0 seatsocc = 0 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_cut->get_occupancy_rates( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_occupancy ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_occupancy[ 1 ]-occupancy_rate exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FOR`-Iteration mit `VALUE` und der `LET`-Klausel, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit berechneten Werten zu erstellen. Die `LET`-Klausel ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen (`lv_rate`) innerhalb der Expression, was den Code sauberer und lesbarer macht. Der `COND`-Operator wird verwendet, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden und den Auslastungsgrad korrekt zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation und -transformation.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, LET, COND, Internal Tables, COMPUTE, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechne für jede Gruppe die Summe der Flugpreise und die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_aggregate
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_aggregate.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = COUNT( GROUP ls_flight ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_price = lv_total_price
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_aggregate FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_aggregate.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_group_flights=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0004' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_and_aggregate( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-total_price exp = '450.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-flight_count exp = 1 ).

  METHOD test_group_empty_table.

Innerhalb der Gruppenschleife können `REDUCE` und `COUNT` auf die `GROUP`-Expression angewendet werden, um Summen und Anzahlen für jede Gruppe zu berechnen. Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert enthält und deren Preise um einen Bonus erhöht werden.
hint: Kombiniere `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_bonus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_bonus_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_prices
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
        iv_bonus_amount TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_bonus_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_bonus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_bonus_flights.
    rt_bonus_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_price_threshold )
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight EXCEPT price )
        price = ls_flight-price + iv_bonus_amount )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_bonus[ 1 ]-price exp = '125.00' ).

Instructions: Berechne die Standardabweichung der Flugpreise für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mehrfach, um Summe und Summe der Quadrate zu berechnen, und dann die Formel für die Standardabweichung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stddev_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_std_deviation
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_prices
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_std_dev) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stddev_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_std_deviation.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) < 2. " Need at least 2 data points for std dev
      rv_std_dev = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).

    DATA(lv_sum_prices) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_mean) = lv_sum_prices / lv_count.

    DATA(lv_sum_sq_diff) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum_sq = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      LET lv_diff = <fs_flight>-price - lv_mean
      NEXT sum_sq = sum_sq + ( lv_diff * lv_diff )
    ).

    rv_std_dev = sqrt( lv_sum_sq_diff / ( lv_count - 1 ) ). " Sample standard deviation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_std_deviation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_std_deviation_single_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_std_deviation_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_std_deviation.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_stddev_prices=>tt_sflight_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '10.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '12.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' price = '14.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0004' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stddev_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_std_dev) = lo_cut->get_std_deviation( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    " Expected: (10+12+14)/3 = 12.00
    " Diff: -2, 0, 2
    " Sq Diff: 4, 0, 4. Sum = 8
    " Variance = 8 / (3-1) = 4
    " Std Dev = sqrt(4) = 2
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_std_dev exp = 2.0000000000000000E+00 msg = 'Standard deviation for LH incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_std_deviation_single_flight.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_stddev_prices=>tt_sflight_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '10.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stddev_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_std_dev) = lo_cut->get_std_deviation( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_std_dev exp = 0.0000000000000000E+00 msg = 'Standard deviation for single flight should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_std_deviation_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_stddev_prices=>tt_sflight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stddev_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_std_dev) = lo_cut->get_std_deviation( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_std_dev exp = 0.0000000000000000E+00 msg = 'Standard deviation for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine komplexere statistische Berechnung (Standardabweichung) unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Features. Es kombiniert `FILTER` zur Vorselektion der Daten und mehrfache `REDUCE`-Operationen. Die erste `REDUCE`-Operation berechnet die Summe, um den Mittelwert zu ermitteln. Die zweite `REDUCE`-Operation berechnet die Summe der quadrierten Abweichungen vom Mittelwert, wobei die `LET`-Klausel für eine temporäre Variable (`lv_diff`) genutzt wird. Dies demonstriert die Flexibilität von `REDUCE` für fortgeschrittene Aggregationen und Berechnungen (`COMPUTE`).
keywords: REDUCE, FILTER, LET, COMPUTE, Math, Statistics, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Führe eine Massenaktualisierung von Flugpreisen in SFLIGHTS durch, wobei die neuen Preise aus einer internen Tabelle stammen, die mit einer `FOR`-Expression erstellt wurde, und nur bestimmte Felder aktualisiert werden.
hint: Verwende `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @( ... )` mit einer `FOR`-Expression und `CORRESPONDING #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_from_itab_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             new_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES tt_flight_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_from_list
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_flight_updates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_from_itab_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_from_list.
    " Prepare the data for update, ensuring only relevant fields are passed
    DATA(lt_sflight_updates) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_update IN it_updates
      ( carrid = ls_update-carrid
        connid = ls_update-connid
        fldate = ls_update-fldate
        price = ls_update-new_price )
    ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight_updates.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_prices_from_list FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_prices_empty_list FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices_from_list.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'DL'.

    " Ensure test data exists and is in a known state
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE (
      VALUE sflight_tab(
        ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
        ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      )
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA: lt_updates TYPE zcl_update_from_itab_for=>tt_flight_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '120.00' ) TO lt_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '240.00' ) TO lt_updates.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_from_itab_for( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_prices_from_list( it_updates = lt_updates ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 2 msg = '2 flights should be updated' ).

    DATA: lt_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_results WHERE carrid = lv_carrid ORDER BY connid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-price exp = '120.00' msg = 'Flight 0001 price incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-price exp = '240.00' msg = 'Flight 0002 price incorrect' ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_prices_empty_list.
    DATA: lt_updates TYPE zcl_update_from_itab_for=>tt_flight_updates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_from_itab_for( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_prices_from_list( it_updates = lt_updates ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 0 msg = '0 flights should be updated for empty list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.55 kann die `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @( ... )`-Syntax verwendet werden, um eine interne Tabelle direkt als Quelle für die Aktualisierung zu nutzen. Hier wird die interne Tabelle `lt_sflight_updates` mit einer `FOR`-Expression aus der Eingabetabelle `it_updates` erstellt. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Massenaktualisierung, da die Daten direkt aus der internen Tabelle in die Datenbank geschrieben werden, ohne dass eine explizite Schleife oder `MODIFY` pro Zeile erforderlich ist.
keywords: UPDATE, FROM TABLE, FOR, VALUE, Database, Mass Update, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Aktualisiere die Währung eines Fluges in SFLIGHTS basierend auf dem aktuellen Preis, indem du eine SQL-Funktion in der `SET`-Klausel verwendest.
hint: Verwende `UPDATE` mit `SET` und einer SQL-Funktion wie `CASE` oder einer benutzerdefinierten Funktion (falls verfügbar). Hier `CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_with_sql_func DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_currency_by_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_sql_func IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_currency_by_price.
    UPDATE sflight SET
      currency = CASE
                   WHEN price > 500 THEN 'EUR'
                   WHEN price <= 500 THEN 'USD'
                   ELSE currency
                 END
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `CASE`-Ausdruck wird hier verwendet, um die Währung (`currency`) basierend auf dem aktuellen Wert des Flugpreises (`price`) zu bestimmen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, da die gesamte Logik zur Bestimmung des neuen Währungswertes direkt auf der Datenbank ausgeführt wird, was die Performance optimiert und den Code im Applikationsserver schlank hält.

Instructions: Rufe eine Methode dynamisch über einen Referenztyp auf und übergebe Parameter.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit Typreferenz und `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)` für den dynamischen Aufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_handler.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lr_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        " Dynamische Objekterzeugung
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        " Parameter für den Methodenaufruf vorbereiten
        ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Annahme: Methode erwartet einen Parameter namens IV_INPUT
        GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
        INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

        " Dynamischer Methodenaufruf
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING
            RESULT rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic call failed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( iv_class_name = 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT'
                                                    iv_method_name = 'ASSERT_EQUALS'
                                                    iv_param_value = 'Test' ).
    " Der Assert_equals Aufruf wird hier nicht wirklich getestet, da er keine Rückgabe hat.
    " Dies ist ein Beispiel für einen dynamischen Aufruf. Für einen echten Test müsste die aufgerufene Methode eine Rückgabe haben.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result ). " Erwarten, dass keine Exception geworfen wurde und rv_result leer ist.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( iv_class_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
                                                    iv_method_name = 'SOME_METHOD'
                                                    iv_param_value = 'Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Dynamic call failed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `REF TO object` und `CALL METHOD lo_object->(method_name)` ermöglicht es, Methoden zur Laufzeit dynamisch aufzurufen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Handler, die auf unterschiedliche Implementierungen reagieren müssen. Die Parameterübergabe erfolgt über `abap_parmbind_tab` und `GET REFERENCE OF`, was eine flexible Parameterbindung erlaubt.
keywords: REF TO, Dynamic Call, Object Reference, CALL METHOD, PARAMETER-TABLE

Instructions: Verarbeite eine interne Tabelle generisch mit Feldsymbolen, die auf Zeilenreferenzen zeigen, um Werte zu ändern.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)` und `REF TO` für den Zugriff auf die Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      " Beispiel: Preis um 10% erhöhen
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.1'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_generic_table_processor=>ty_t_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_table_processor( ).

    INSERT zcl_generic_table_processor=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00'
    ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT zcl_generic_table_processor=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00'
    ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    lo_cut->process_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '110.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '220.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)` ist der moderne und effiziente Weg, um interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten, wenn Zeileninhalte geändert werden sollen. Das Feldsymbol `<fs_flight>` zeigt direkt auf die Tabellenzeile, wodurch Änderungen ohne explizites `MODIFY` wirksam werden. Dies vermeidet unnötige Datenkopien und verbessert die Performance.
keywords: REF TO, Field Symbol, Internal Table, LOOP AT, ASSIGNING

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die verschiedene Objekttypen polymorph behandelt, indem sie `CASE TYPE OF` verwendet.
hint: Nutze `CASE TYPE OF o_ref WHEN TYPE class_a THEN ... WHEN TYPE class_b THEN ...` für typspezifische Logik.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * cl_abap_math=>pi( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_description = |Circle with area: { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area() }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
        rv_description = |Square with area: { lo_square->zif_shape~get_area() }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unknown shape type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_circle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_square FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_circle.
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_circle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description sub = 'Circle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description sub = '78.5398' ). " Pi * 5^2
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_square.
    DATA(lo_square) = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = '4' ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_square ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description sub = 'Square' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description sub = '16' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_unknown.
    DATA lo_unknown TYPE REF TO zif_shape.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_unknown ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_description exp = 'Unknown shape type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` ermöglicht eine typspezifische Verzweigung bei der Verarbeitung von Objektreferenzen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die polymorphe Programmierung, da es erlaubt, spezifische Implementierungen basierend auf dem tatsächlichen Typ des Objekts zur Laufzeit auszuführen, ohne auf Downcasts angewiesen zu sein, die zu Laufzeitfehlern führen könnten. Die `INTO DATA(lo_circle)` Syntax deklariert und weist die Referenz direkt zu.
keywords: WHEN TYPE, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, CASE TYPE OF, REF TO

Instructions: Weise einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen mit dem `SWITCH`-Ausdruck zu.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_type) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_type.
    rv_day_type = SWITCH #( iv_day
                              WHEN 1 THEN 'Sunday'
                              WHEN 2 THEN 'Monday'
                              WHEN 3 THEN 'Tuesday'
                              WHEN 4 THEN 'Wednesday'
                              WHEN 5 THEN 'Thursday'
                              WHEN 6 THEN 'Friday'
                              WHEN 7 THEN 'Saturday'
                              ELSE 'Invalid Day' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Datenreferenz auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle und ändere den Inhalt über die Referenz.
hint: Nutze `GET REFERENCE OF line INTO data_ref` oder `REF TO` in `READ TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_ref_table_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_ref_table_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA lr_flight TYPE REF TO ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE ct_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid REFERENCE INTO lr_flight.

    IF lr_flight IS BOUND.
      lr_flight->price = iv_new_price.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks und sammle die Ergebnisse.
hint: Nutze `FOR ... WHERE ...` um die Filterung direkt im Ausdruck vorzunehmen.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                    ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_for_filter_expression=>ty_t_sflight.

    INSERT zcl_for_filter_expression=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR'
    ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_expensive ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_expensive INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.

explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE`-Bedingung ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP. Es ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Zeile. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` zu verwenden, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus den gefilterten Elementen der Quelltabelle konstruiert, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht.

Instructions: Übergib ein Objekt als Referenz an eine Methode, um Änderungen am Originalobjekt zu ermöglichen, und demonstriere die Verwendung von `REF TO`.

CLASS zcl_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_counter IMPLEMENTATION.

    mv_count = iv_initial_value.

        io_counter TYPE REF TO zcl_counter.

CLASS zcl_counter_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_counter.
    " Zugriff auf das Objekt über die Referenz und Aufruf einer Methode
    io_counter->increment( ).
    io_counter->increment( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Dies ist effizient, da keine unnötigen Datenkopien erstellt werden, und ermöglicht die Implementierung von Verhaltensweisen, die den Zustand von Objekten beeinflussen.

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem Referenztyp und fülle sie mit Daten.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA dref TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)` und Feldsymbole für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
        iv_num_rows  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE ANY.

    " Dynamische Erzeugung der internen Tabelle
    CREATE DATA rr_table_ref TYPE TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_table_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
        " Dynamische Erzeugung einer Zeile
        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE (iv_type_name).
        ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

        IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Annahme: Der Typ hat Felder 'FIELD1' und 'FIELD2'
          TRY.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
              IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_field1> = |Value { sy-index }|.
              ENDIF.

              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
              IF <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_field2> = sy-index * 10.
              ENDIF.
            CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
              " Handle error if component does not exist
          ENDTRY.

          INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creation( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( iv_type_name = 'LTCL_TEST=>TY_TEST_STRUCT' iv_num_rows = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_dynamic_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Value 1' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field2> exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creation( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( iv_type_name = 'LTCL_TEST=>TY_TEST_STRUCT' iv_num_rows = 0 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_dynamic_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_table> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erzeugung von internen Tabellen mittels `CREATE DATA dref TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das Flexibilität in generischen Programmen bietet. Es erlaubt, die Struktur einer Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Der Zugriff auf die dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle und ihre Zeilen erfolgt über Datenreferenzen (`REF TO data`) und Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS <...> TYPE ANY TABLE/ANY`), was eine typlose Bearbeitung ermöglicht. Dies ist essenziell für Frameworks oder Tools, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen.
keywords: REF TO, Dynamic Table, CREATE DATA, Field Symbol, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Aggregiere Daten aus einer internen Tabelle mit `REDUCE`, wobei die Aggregation von einer Bedingung abhängt.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE ... FOR ... WHERE ... NEXT ...` um bedingte Aggregationen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_for_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein Kernstück der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP und ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `FOR ... WHERE` kann eine bedingte Aggregation direkt im Ausdruck formuliert werden. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code, der die Absicht klar ausdrückt und die Notwendigkeit manueller Schleifen und Akkumulatoren eliminiert. `INIT` setzt den Startwert für die Aggregation.

CLASS zcl_find_table_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_find_table_ref IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.

                                WHEN iv_total_amount >= 200 THEN 'Silver'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_loggable PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_loggable.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_file_path TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_file_path = iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_loggable~log_message.
    " In einer echten Implementierung würde hier in eine Datei geschrieben.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |File Logger: { iv_message } to { mv_file_path }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_loggable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_loggable~log_message.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Console Logger: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_logger
      IMPORTING
        iv_logger_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_logger) TYPE REF TO zif_loggable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_logger.
    CASE iv_logger_type.
      WHEN 'FILE'.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_file_logger( iv_file_path = '/tmp/app.log' ).
      WHEN 'CONSOLE'.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default oder Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_logger
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_loggable
        iv_log_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_logger.
    DATA(lr_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_logger ).
    DATA(lv_class_name) = lr_type_descr->get_name( ).

    CASE TYPE OF io_logger.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_file_logger INTO DATA(lo_file_logger).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Processing File Logger ({ lv_class_name })| ).
        lo_file_logger->zif_loggable~log_message( iv_log_message ).
      WHEN TYPE zcl_console_logger INTO DATA(lo_console_logger).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Processing Console Logger ({ lv_class_name })| ).
        lo_console_logger->zif_loggable~log_message( iv_log_message ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Unknown logger type: { lv_class_name }| ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zusammen mit `CASE TYPE OF` kann dann typspezifische Logik ausgeführt werden, was eine flexible und erweiterbare Architektur ermöglicht, ohne dass der Aufrufer den konkreten Typ des Objekts kennen muss. Instructions: Iteriere über eine interne Tabelle und weise jeder Zeile einen Wert zu, der von der aktuellen Zeile abhängt, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `WHEN`.
hint: Nutze `FOR ... THEN ...` und `WHEN` für bedingte Zuweisungen innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_then_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id     TYPE i,
             value  TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES ty_t_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_t_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE ty_t_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_then_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    rt_processed_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_items
                                  ( id    = ls_item-id
                                    value = ls_item-value
                                    status = COND #( WHEN ls_item-value > 100 THEN 'High'
                                                     WHEN ls_item-value > 50 THEN 'Medium'
                                                     ELSE 'Low' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_items FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_empty_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_items.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_for_then_when=>ty_t_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_then_when( ).

    INSERT zcl_for_then_when=>ty_item( id = 1 value = 120 ) INTO TABLE lt_items.
    INSERT zcl_for_then_when=>ty_item( id = 2 value = 70 ) INTO TABLE lt_items.
    INSERT zcl_for_then_when=>ty_item( id = 3 value = 30 ) INTO TABLE lt_items.

    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_items( it_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_item1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item1-status exp = 'High' ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_item2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item2-status exp = 'Medium' ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_item3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item3-status exp = 'Low' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_empty_items.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_for_then_when=>ty_t_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_then_when( ).

    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_items( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_processed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Ausdruck und `COND`-Ausdruck mit `WHEN` ermöglicht eine sehr deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben und dann in jeder Iteration eine `IF-ELSE IF`-Struktur zu verwenden, wird die gesamte Logik zur Erstellung der neuen Tabelle und zur bedingten Zuweisung von Werten in einem einzigen Ausdruck gekapselt. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FOR, WHEN, COND, Internal Table, Functional Programming, VALUE

Instructions: Implementiere eine Factory-Methode, die Objekte basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter dynamisch erzeugt und eine Referenz auf das erzeugte Objekt zurückgibt. Nutze `WHEN TYPE` für die typsichere Zuweisung.
hint: Verwende `CREATE OBJECT` mit einem Referenztyp und `CASE TYPE OF` für die Rückgabe.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    DATA lo_temp_product TYPE REF TO object.

    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_temp_product TYPE zcl_product_a.
      WHEN 'B'.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_temp_product TYPE zcl_product_b.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fehlerbehandlung oder Standardprodukt
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    " Typsichere Zuweisung zur Interface-Referenz
    CASE TYPE OF lo_temp_product.
      WHEN TYPE zif_product INTO ro_product.
        " Zuweisung erfolgreich
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Sollte nicht passieren, wenn die Klassen das Interface implementieren
        CLEAR ro_product.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine Factory-Methode, die `CREATE OBJECT` mit einem generischen Referenztyp (`REF TO object`) verwendet, um Objekte dynamisch zu instanziieren. Die anschließende typsichere Zuweisung zur Interface-Referenz (`REF TO zif_product`) erfolgt über `CASE TYPE OF ... WHEN TYPE zif_product INTO ro_product`. Dies ist ein modernes Designmuster, das die Entkopplung von Erzeugung und Nutzung von Objekten fördert und die Erweiterbarkeit des Systems verbessert, da neue Produkttypen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne die aufrufende Logik ändern zu müssen.

Instructions: Fange eine spezifische Exception ab und behandle sie, indem du `CATCH ... INTO DATA(lx_exception)` verwendest, um auf die Details der Exception zuzugreifen.
hint: Nutze `TRY ... CATCH cx_sy_... INTO DATA(lx_exception) ... ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_division_result) = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
        rv_result = |Division successful: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die moderne Exception-Behandlung in ABAP verwendet `TRY ... CATCH ... ENDTRY`. Die `INTO DATA(lx_exception)`-Syntax innerhalb der `CATCH`-Klausel ist besonders nützlich, da sie eine Referenz (`REF TO`) auf das Exception-Objekt bereitstellt. Dies ermöglicht den Zugriff auf detaillierte Informationen über die aufgetretene Exception, wie z.B. die Fehlermeldung (`get_text()`), was für eine präzise Fehlerbehandlung und Protokollierung unerlässlich ist. Dies ist wesentlich robuster als die Verwendung von `SY-SUBRC`.

Instructions: Eine Methode soll zwei Strings konkatenieren. Wenn einer der Strings leer ist, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_... EXPORTING i_message = ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_empty_string DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        i_message TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_empty_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_message = i_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concatenator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1 TYPE string
        iv_string2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_empty_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concatenator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    IF iv_string1 IS INITIAL OR iv_string2 IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_string
        EXPORTING
          i_message = 'Einer der Strings ist leer oder initial.'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = |{ iv_string1 }{ iv_string2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
