Instructions: Eine Methode soll aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) einen formatierten String für jeden Flug erstellen, der Flugnummer, Abflugort und Zielort enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und String-Templates, um die Daten zu iterieren und zu formatieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flights.
    rt_formatted_strings = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                    ( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }: von { ls_flight-cityfrom } nach { ls_flight-cityto } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_formatter=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251121' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '100' fldate = '20251122' cityfrom = 'DALLAS' cityto = 'LONDON' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_flight_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_formatter->format_flights( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Zwei formatierte Strings erwartet.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = |Flug LH 400: von FRANKFURT nach NEW YORK am 21.11.2025| msg = 'Erster String falsch formatiert.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = |Flug AA 100: von DALLAS nach LONDON am 22.11.2025| msg = 'Zweiter String falsch formatiert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_formatter=>tt_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_flight_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_formatter->format_flights( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte leere Ergebnistabelle liefern.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `format_flights` nutzt eine `FOR`-Expression innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Konstruktion, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erzeugen. Jeder Eintrag wird mithilfe von String-Templates (`|...|`) formatiert, was eine sehr lesbare und effiziente Art der String-Konkatenation darstellt. Die Datumsformatierung `DATE = USER` passt das Datum an die Benutzereinstellungen an.
keywords: CONCATENATE, String Templates, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Eine Methode soll eine Kunden-ID validieren. Die ID muss eine bestimmte Länge haben (z.B. 10 Zeichen) und darf keine Leerzeichen enthalten. Bei Invalidität soll eine Ausnahme mit einer spezifischen Fehlermeldung ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `STRLEN` für die Länge und `CS` (Contains String) für Leerzeichen. `RAISE EXCEPTION` mit einer aussagekräftigen Nachricht.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_customer_id DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        i_message TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_customer_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_message = i_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_customer_id_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_expected_length TYPE i VALUE 10.
    METHODS validate_customer_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_customer_id TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_customer_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_customer_id_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_customer_id.
    IF iv_customer_id IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_customer_id
        EXPORTING
          i_message = 'Kunden-ID darf nicht leer sein.'.
    ENDIF.

    IF strlen( iv_customer_id ) <> gc_expected_length.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_customer_id
        EXPORTING
          i_message = |Kunden-ID muss { gc_expected_length } Zeichen lang sein. Aktuell: { strlen( iv_customer_id ) }|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_customer_id CS ' '. " Contains Space
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_customer_id
        EXPORTING
          i_message = 'Kunden-ID darf keine Leerzeichen enthalten.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_id_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_customer_id.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_wrong_length_exception.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_customer_id_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_validator->validate_customer_id( 'SHORTID' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Falsche Länge sollte Ausnahme auslösen.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_customer_id INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->mv_message exp = |Kunden-ID muss { zcl_customer_id_validator=>gc_expected_length } Zeichen lang sein. Aktuell: 7| ).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Methode `validate_customer_id` prüft die Eingabe auf Initialität, Länge und das Vorhandensein von Leerzeichen. Bei jedem Verstoß wird eine spezifische `zcx_invalid_customer_id`-Ausnahme mit einer aussagekräftigen Fehlermeldung ausgelöst. String-Templates werden verwendet, um dynamische Fehlermeldungen zu erstellen. Die `CS` (Contains String) Operation ist eine prägnante Art, das Vorhandensein eines Zeichens zu prüfen.

Instructions: Eine Methode soll alle Städtenamen (Abflug- und Zielorte) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) zu einem einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String zusammenfassen, ohne Duplikate.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `HASHED TABLE` für Duplikatsprüfung, gefolgt von `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_city_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_unique_cities
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_city_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_city_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_unique_cities.
    DATA(lt_all_cities) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( ls_flight-cityfrom )
      ( ls_flight-cityto )
    ).

    DATA(lt_unique_cities_temp) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF string
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                                  FOR city IN lt_all_cities
                                  WHERE ( city IS NOT INITIAL )
                                  ( city ).

    DATA(lt_unique_cities) = VALUE string_table( FOR city IN lt_unique_cities_temp ( city ) ).

    rv_city_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR city IN lt_unique_cities
      NEXT
        s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN city
                         ELSE |{ s }, { city }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_cities FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_duplicates_and_initial FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_cities.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_city_aggregator=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_city_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_unique_cities( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'FRANKFURT, NEW YORK, LONDON' msg = 'Städte sollten korrekt aggregiert werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_city_aggregator=>tt_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_city_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_unique_cities( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte leeren String liefern.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_duplicates_and_initial.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_city_aggregator=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( cityfrom = 'BERLIN' cityto = 'PARIS' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( cityfrom = 'BERLIN' cityto = 'ROM' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( cityfrom = 'PARIS' cityto = '' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Initial value

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_city_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_unique_cities( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'BERLIN, PARIS, ROM' msg = 'Duplikate und initiale Werte sollten ignoriert werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode verwendet eine Kombination aus `FOR`-Expression und `HASHED TABLE` zur effizienten Sammlung und Deduplizierung der Städtenamen. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` mit String-Templates eingesetzt, um die eindeutigen Städtenamen zu einem durch Kommas getrennten String zu konkatenieren. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und performante Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: CONCATENATE, REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, HASHED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Division durchführt. Wenn der Divisor Null ist, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst und in der aufrufenden Methode abgefangen werden. Die Fehlermeldung soll den Versuch der Division und den Wert des Divisors enthalten.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme mit Attributen für die Fehlermeldung. Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` im Aufrufer und String-Templates für die Fehlermeldung.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_dividend TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_divisor TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        i_dividend TYPE i OPTIONAL
        i_divisor TYPE i OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_dividend = i_dividend.
    mv_divisor = i_divisor.
    mv_message = |Division von { i_dividend } durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.

    METHODS perform_division_and_handle
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          i_dividend = iv_dividend
          i_divisor = iv_divisor.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_division_and_handle.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = divide( iv_dividend = iv_dividend iv_divisor = iv_divisor ).
        rv_output = |Ergebnis: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        rv_output = |Fehler: { lx_ex->mv_message }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
    METHODS test_division_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 msg = 'Division sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_exception.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_calculator->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Division durch Null sollte Ausnahme auslösen.' ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->mv_dividend exp = 10 msg = 'Dividend im Fehlerobjekt falsch.' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->mv_divisor exp = 0 msg = 'Divisor im Fehlerobjekt falsch.' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->mv_message exp = 'Division von 10 durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' msg = 'Fehlermeldung falsch.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_handling.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_output_success) = lo_calculator->perform_division_and_handle( iv_dividend = 15 iv_divisor = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output_success exp = 'Ergebnis: 5' msg = 'Erfolgreiche Division sollte korrekt behandelt werden.' ).

    DATA(lv_output_error) = lo_calculator->perform_division_and_handle( iv_dividend = 20 iv_divisor = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output_error exp = 'Fehler: Division von 20 durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' msg = 'Division durch Null sollte korrekt abgefangen werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Implementierung einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme `zcx_division_by_zero` mit zusätzlichen Attributen für den Dividend und Divisor. Die Methode `divide` löst diese Ausnahme aus, wenn der Divisor Null ist. Die Methode `perform_division_and_handle` demonstriert das Abfangen der Ausnahme mittels `TRY...CATCH` und die Verwendung von String-Templates zur Erstellung aussagekräftiger Fehlermeldungen. Dies fördert eine klare Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY...CATCH, Custom Exception, Object Orientation, Error Handling, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Berichtskopf, der den aktuellen Benutzernamen und das Datum/Uhrzeit in einem festen Format (linksbündig, rechtsbündig) anzeigt.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit den Formatierungsoptionen `AT`, `ALIGN LEFT` und `ALIGN RIGHT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_header_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_header
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_header_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_header_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_header.
    DATA(lv_username) = sy-uname.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.

    rv_header_string = |
{ 'Bericht' ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 40 }
{ 'Erstellt von:' ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 20 }{ lv_username ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 20 }
{ 'Datum/Uhrzeit:' ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 20 }{ lv_date DATE = USER ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 10 } { lv_time TIME = USER ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 8 }
|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_header_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_header_format.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_report_header_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_header) = lo_formatter->get_formatted_header( ).

    " Überprüfen Sie, ob der Header die erwarteten Informationen enthält und formatiert ist.
    " Die genaue Formatierung hängt von sy-uname, sy-datum und sy-uzeit ab.
    " Hier wird nur eine grundlegende Prüfung durchgeführt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Bericht' in_string = lv_header msg = 'Header sollte "Bericht" enthalten.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Datum/Uhrzeit:' in_string = lv_header msg = 'Header sollte "Datum/Uhrzeit:" enthalten.' ).

    " Eine genauere Prüfung der Ausrichtung ist komplexer und würde feste Werte erfordern.
    " Für diesen Test reicht die Inhaltsprüfung.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_formatted_header` nutzt String-Templates, um einen mehrzeiligen Berichtskopf zu erstellen. Dabei werden die Formatierungsoptionen `ALIGN` (LEFT) und `WIDTH` verwendet, um die Textausrichtung und -breite zu steuern. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Produktcodes. Wenn ein Produktcode nicht dem erwarteten Format (z.B. 'PROD_XXX', wobei XXX Ziffern sind) entspricht, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, anstatt ihn einfach zu ignorieren. Die Methode soll eine Tabelle der gültigen Codes zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die Tabelle zu iterieren und jeden Eintrag zu validieren. Bei einem ungültigen Format `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_product_code DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_invalid_code TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        i_invalid_code TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_product_code IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_invalid_code = i_invalid_code.
    mv_message = |Ungültiger Produktcode gefunden: '{ i_invalid_code }'. Erwartetes Format: PROD_XXX.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_and_validate_products
      IMPORTING
        it_product_codes TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_codes) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_product_code.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_validate_products.
    rt_valid_codes = VALUE #( FOR code IN it_product_codes
                               LET lv_match = COND string( WHEN code CP 'PROD_###' THEN code ELSE '' ) IN
                               ( COND string( WHEN lv_match IS INITIAL THEN
                                   RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_product_code EXPORTING i_invalid_code = code
                                 ELSE lv_match ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_products FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_product_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_product_code.
    METHODS test_mixed_products FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_product_code.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_products.
    DATA(lt_test_codes) = VALUE string_table( ( 'PROD_123' ) ( 'PROD_456' ) ).
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_product_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_and_validate_products( it_product_codes = lt_test_codes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Zwei gültige Codes erwartet.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'PROD_123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_product_exception.
    DATA(lt_test_codes) = VALUE string_table( ( 'PROD_123' ) ( 'INVALID_CODE' ) ).
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_product_filter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_filter->filter_and_validate_products( it_product_codes = lt_test_codes ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Ungültiger Code sollte Ausnahme auslösen.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_product_code INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->mv_invalid_code exp = 'INVALID_CODE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Ungültiger Produktcode' in_string = lx_ex->mv_message ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_products.
    DATA(lt_test_codes) = VALUE string_table( ( 'PROD_001' ) ( 'PROD_ABC' ) ( 'PROD_002' ) ).
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_product_filter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_filter->filter_and_validate_products( it_product_codes = lt_test_codes ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Ungültiger Code sollte Ausnahme auslösen.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_product_code INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->mv_invalid_code exp = 'PROD_ABC' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `filter_and_validate_products` verwendet eine `FOR`-Expression mit einer `LET`-Anweisung, um jeden Produktcode zu validieren. Die `CP` (Compares Pattern) Operation prüft das Format. Wenn ein Code ungültig ist, wird direkt innerhalb der `VALUE`-Konstruktion eine `zcx_invalid_product_code`-Ausnahme ausgelöst. Dies demonstriert eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Validierung und Fehlerbehandlung in modernen ABAP-Ausdrücken.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Functional Programming, FOR, VALUE, CP, Pattern Matching, Custom Exception, String Templates

Instructions: Eine Methode simuliert eine komplexe Operation, die fehlschlagen kann. Stellen Sie sicher, dass vor dem Beenden der Methode (auch bei Ausnahme) eine temporäre Ressource freigegeben wird. Die Freigabe soll in einer Log-Nachricht dokumentiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP` Block. Der `CLEANUP` Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_operation_failed DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_error_detail TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        i_error_detail TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_operation_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_error_detail = i_error_detail.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation_with_cleanup
      IMPORTING
        iv_should_fail TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_operation_failed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _release_resource.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation_with_cleanup.
    DATA(lv_resource_acquired) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        " Simulate resource acquisition
        lv_resource_acquired = abap_true.
        rv_status_message = 'Ressource erfolgreich akquiriert.'.

        IF iv_should_fail = abap_true.
          " Simulate a failure
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_operation_failed
            EXPORTING
              i_error_detail = 'Simulierter Fehler während der Operation.'.
        ENDIF.

        " Simulate successful operation
        rv_status_message = |Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen. { rv_status_message }|.

      CATCH zcx_operation_failed INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        rv_status_message = |Operation fehlgeschlagen: { lx_ex->mv_error_detail }|.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_ex. " Re-raise the exception

      CLEANUP.
        IF lv_resource_acquired = abap_true.
          _release_resource( ).
          rv_status_message = |{ rv_status_message } Ressource freigegeben.|.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _release_resource.
    " In a real scenario, this would contain logic to release a resource
    " For this example, we just log a message.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Log: Temporäre Ressource freigegeben.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operation_success_with_cleanup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_failure_with_cleanup FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_operation_failed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_success_with_cleanup.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_resource_manager( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_manager->perform_operation_with_cleanup( iv_should_fail = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.' in_string = lv_status msg = 'Erfolgsmeldung erwartet.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Ressource freigegeben.' in_string = lv_status msg = 'Ressource sollte freigegeben werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_failure_with_cleanup.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_resource_manager( ).
    TRY.
        lo_manager->perform_operation_with_cleanup( iv_should_fail = abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Operation sollte fehlschlagen und Ausnahme auslösen.' ).
      CATCH zcx_operation_failed INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Simulierter Fehler' in_string = lx_ex->mv_error_detail msg = 'Korrekte Fehlermeldung erwartet.' ).
        " The cleanup message is logged, not returned by the method, so we can't assert it directly here.
        " In a real test, you might check a log table or mock the logging.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `perform_operation_with_cleanup` demonstriert die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in einem `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP`-Konstrukt. Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, und stellt sicher, dass Ressourcen (hier simuliert durch eine Log-Nachricht) ordnungsgemäß freigegeben werden, unabhängig davon, ob die Operation erfolgreich war oder fehlschlug. String-Templates werden für die Status- und Fehlermeldungen verwendet.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, CLEANUP, TRY...CATCH, Error Handling, Resource Management, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Statusmeldung, die sich basierend auf einem numerischen Wert ändert. Wenn der Wert positiv ist, soll 'Erfolgreich: [Wert]', bei Null 'Neutral', und bei negativ 'Fehler: [Wert]' angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `COND`-Expression innerhalb eines String-Templates, um die Nachricht dynamisch zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_message_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_message_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_message.
    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN iv_value > 0 THEN |Erfolgreich: { iv_value }|
      WHEN iv_value = 0 THEN 'Neutral'
      WHEN iv_value < 0 THEN |Fehler: { iv_value }|
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Status'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

String-Templates werden innerhalb der `COND`-Expression verwendet, um die variablen Teile der Nachricht zu konkatenieren. Instructions: Konkatenieren Sie eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem Satz. Jedes Wort soll dabei in Anführungszeichen gesetzt und durch ein Leerzeichen getrennt werden. Der Satz soll mit einem Punkt enden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates und der `QUOTED`-Formatierungsoption.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sentence_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_quoted_sentence
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sentence_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_quoted_sentence.
    rv_sentence = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT
        s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ word QUOTED = '''' }|
                         ELSE |{ s } { word QUOTED = '''' }| )
    ).
    IF rv_sentence IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_sentence = |{ rv_sentence }.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_build_sentence FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_words FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_word FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_sentence.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( 'World' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ).
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_sentence_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_builder->build_quoted_sentence( it_words = lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sentence exp = '''Hello'' ''World'' ''ABAP''.' msg = 'Satz sollte korrekt mit Anführungszeichen und Punkt gebildet werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_words.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_sentence_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_builder->build_quoted_sentence( it_words = lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_sentence msg = 'Leere Wortliste sollte leeren Satz ergeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_word.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Single' ) ).
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_sentence_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_builder->build_quoted_sentence( it_words = lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sentence exp = '''Single''.' msg = 'Einzelnes Wort sollte korrekt formatiert werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `build_quoted_sentence` verwendet die `REDUCE`-Expression, um eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem Satz zu konkatenieren. Die String-Template-Option `QUOTED = ''''` wird verwendet, um jedes Wort automatisch in einfache Anführungszeichen zu setzen. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` sorgt für die korrekte Trennung der Wörter und die Behandlung des ersten Wortes. Abschließend wird ein Punkt hinzugefügt, falls der Satz nicht leer ist.
keywords: CONCATENATE, String Templates, REDUCE, QUOTED, Internal Tables

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen. Wenn eine Zahl außerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs liegt (z.B. 1 bis 100), soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die den ungültigen Wert und den erlaubten Bereich angibt. Die Methode soll die Summe der gültigen Zahlen zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `LET` und `COND` zum Validieren und Summieren. `RAISE EXCEPTION` bei ungültigem Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcx_value_out_of_range DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_min TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_max TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        i_value TYPE i OPTIONAL
        i_min TYPE i OPTIONAL
        i_max TYPE i OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_value_out_of_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_value = i_value.
    mv_min = i_min.
    mv_max = i_max.
    mv_message = |Wert { i_value } liegt außerhalb des erlaubten Bereichs [{ i_min }, { i_max }].|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_min_value TYPE i VALUE 1.
    CONSTANTS gc_max_value TYPE i VALUE 100.

    METHODS process_numbers_and_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_value_out_of_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers_and_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT
        s = s + COND i(
          WHEN number >= gc_min_value AND number <= gc_max_value THEN number
          ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_value_out_of_range
                     EXPORTING i_value = number i_min = gc_min_value i_max = gc_max_value
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_numbers_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_number_out_of_range_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_value_out_of_range.
    METHODS test_mixed_numbers_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_value_out_of_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_numbers_sum.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_number_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_processor->process_numbers_and_sum( it_numbers = lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 60 msg = 'Summe der gültigen Zahlen sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_number_out_of_range_exception.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY( ( 50 ) ( 101 ) ( 70 ) ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_number_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_numbers_and_sum( it_numbers = lt_numbers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Zahl außerhalb des Bereichs sollte Ausnahme auslösen.' ).
      CATCH zcx_value_out_of_range INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->mv_value exp = 101 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->mv_min exp = zcl_number_processor=>gc_min_value ).

CLASS zcl_email_subject_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_subject_line
      IMPORTING
        iv_project_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_status       TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_date         TYPE sy-datum OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_subject) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_subject_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_subject_line.
    DATA(lv_parts) = VALUE string_table(
      ( COND string( WHEN iv_project_name IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_project_name ) )
      ( COND string( WHEN iv_status IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_status ) )
      ( COND string( WHEN iv_date IS NOT INITIAL THEN |{ iv_date DATE = USER }| ) )
    ).

    rv_subject = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR part IN lv_parts
      WHERE ( part IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT
        s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN part
                         ELSE |{ s } - { part }| )
    ).

    IF rv_subject IS INITIAL.
      rv_subject = 'Kein Betreff'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_empty_file_line DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING

        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.

CLASS zcx_empty_file_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_line_number = i_line_number.
    mv_message = |Leere Zeile gefunden in Zeile { i_line_number }.|
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_file_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_file_content TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_non_empty_lines) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_empty_file_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_file_lines.
    rv_non_empty_lines = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
           line_num = 0
      FOR line IN it_file_content
      NEXT
        line_num = line_num + 1
        count = count + COND i(
          WHEN line IS INITIAL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_file_line EXPORTING i_line_number = line_num
          ELSE 1
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_query_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_query_param.
    TYPES: tt_query_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_query_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_url   TYPE string
        it_parameters TYPE tt_query_params OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_url.
    DATA(lv_query_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR param IN it_parameters
      WHERE ( param-value IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT
        s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ param-name }={ param-value }|
                         ELSE |{ s }&{ param-name }={ param-value }| )
    ).

    IF lv_query_string IS INITIAL.
      rv_url = iv_base_url.
    ELSE.
      rv_url = |{ iv_base_url }?{ lv_query_string }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_missing_config_key DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_config_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config_entry.
    TYPES: tt_config_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS read_configuration
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_config TYPE tt_config_table
        it_required_keys TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_config) TYPE tt_config_table
      RAISING
        zcx_missing_config_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_configuration.
    rt_parsed_config = it_raw_config.

    LOOP AT it_required_keys INTO DATA(lv_required_key).
      IF NOT line_exists( rt_parsed_config[ key = lv_required_key ] ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_missing_config_key
          EXPORTING
            i_key_name = lv_required_key.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der Preise und die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne Syntax von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer `WHEN` Bedingung für die Gruppierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( key1, key2 ... ) INTO DATA(group_key) WHERE ( condition )` und `WHEN` für die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid,
                 currency = <fs_flight>-currency )
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key)
      WHERE <fs_flight>-price > iv_min_price OR iv_min_price IS INITIAL.

      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-price ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid       = ls_group_key-carrid
        currency     = ls_group_key-currency
        total_price  = lv_total_price
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights( iv_min_price = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data > 100

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_group) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_group-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_group-currency ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = ls_first_group-total_price exp = 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = ls_first_group-flight_count exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_grouper->group_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_all_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Syntax, um interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren. Die `WHERE` Klausel innerhalb der `GROUP BY` Anweisung (hier als `WHEN` Bedingung interpretiert, da sie die Gruppierung beeinflusst) ermöglicht eine Filterung vor der Gruppierung. `REDUCE` wird verwendet, um Aggregationen innerhalb jeder Gruppe effizient durchzuführen, und `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, WHEN, Internal Tables, Grouping, REDUCE, Expressions

CLASS zcl_secret_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_secret_data IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT aus und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte 'FLIGHT_STATUS' hinzu. Der Status soll 'ON_TIME' sein, wenn das Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, 'DEPARTED' wenn es in der Vergangenheit liegt, und 'TODAY' wenn es das aktuelle Datum ist. Verwenden Sie `CASE WHEN` direkt in der Open SQL `SELECT` Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN` innerhalb der `SELECT` Liste, um bedingte Werte zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE WHEN fldate > @lv_today THEN 'ON_TIME'
                WHEN fldate < @lv_today THEN 'DEPARTED'
                WHEN fldate = @lv_today THEN 'TODAY'
                ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis von Artikeln in einem Warenkorb. Wenden Sie dabei unterschiedliche Steuersätze basierend auf der Artikelkategorie an. Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE` Expression in Kombination mit `COND` (welches `WHEN` enthält) für die bedingte Steuerberechnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und `COND` innerhalb von `REDUCE` für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cart_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cart_item,
             item_id    TYPE string,
             category   TYPE string,
             price      TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2,
             quantity   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_cart_item.
    TYPES: tt_cart_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cart_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_with_tax
      IMPORTING
        it_cart_items TYPE tt_cart_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p LENGTH 12 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cart_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_with_tax.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE p LENGTH 12 DECIMALS 2(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR item IN it_cart_items
      NEXT total = total + (
        item-price * item-quantity * 
        COND p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2(
          WHEN item-category = 'FOOD' THEN '1.07' " 7% tax
          WHEN item-category = 'BOOKS' THEN '1.07' " 7% tax
          WHEN item-category = 'ELECTRONICS' THEN '1.19' " 19% tax
          ELSE '1.19' " Default 19% tax
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_tax_calculation.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_cart_calculator=>tt_cart_items.

    APPEND VALUE #( item_id = 'A1', category = 'FOOD', price = '10.00', quantity = 2 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( item_id = 'B2', category = 'ELECTRONICS', price = '100.00', quantity = 1 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( item_id = 'C3', category = 'BOOKS', price = '5.00', quantity = 4 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_cart_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_with_tax( lt_items ).

    " Expected: (10*2*1.07) + (100*1*1.19) + (5*4*1.07) = 21.40 + 119.00 + 21.40 = 161.80
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '161.80' ).

    CLEAR lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( item_id = 'D4', category = 'CLOTHING', price = '50.00', quantity = 1 ) TO lt_items.
    lv_total = lo_calculator->calculate_total_with_tax( lt_items ).
    " Expected: 50*1*1.19 = 59.50 (default tax)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '59.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit der `COND` Expression (die intern `WHEN` Klauseln verwendet) kann komplexe bedingte Logik direkt in der Aggregationsschleife angewendet werden. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code, der die Absicht klar ausdrückt und die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen reduziert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert enthält und den Preis für 'PREMIUM'-Flüge um 10% erhöht. Verwenden Sie die `FOR` Expression mit `WHEN` für die Transformation und Filterung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( VALUE #( ... field = COND #( WHEN ... ) ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             flight_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_processed,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_processed.
    TYPES: tt_flight_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE tt_flight_processed(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_raw_flights
      WHERE ( ls_flight-price > iv_price_threshold )
      ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
        connid       = ls_flight-connid
        fldate       = ls_flight-fldate
        currency     = ls_flight-currency
        adjusted_price = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-flight_type = 'PREMIUM' THEN ls_flight-price * '1.10'
                                 ELSE ls_flight-price )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_transformation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_transformation.
    DATA: lt_raw TYPE zcl_flight_transformer=>tt_flight_raw.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH', connid = '0400', fldate = sy-datum, price = '150.00', currency = 'EUR', flight_type = 'ECONOMY' ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA', connid = '0010', fldate = sy-datum, price = '250.00', currency = 'USD', flight_type = 'PREMIUM' ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA', connid = '0020', fldate = sy-datum, price = '90.00', currency = 'USD', flight_type = 'ECONOMY' ) TO lt_raw. " Below threshold
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ', connid = '0030', fldate = sy-datum, price = '300.00', currency = 'SGD', flight_type = 'ECONOMY' ) TO lt_raw.

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( it_raw_flights = lt_raw iv_price_threshold = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_premium_flight) = lt_processed[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_premium_flight-adjusted_price exp = '275.00' ). " 250 * 1.10

    DATA(ls_economy_flight) = lt_processed[ carrid = 'LH' ].

explanation: Die `FOR` Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um neue interne Tabellen aus bestehenden zu erzeugen, wobei Elemente gefiltert (`WHERE`) und transformiert werden können. Die Integration von `COND` (mit `WHEN`) innerhalb der `FOR` Expression ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Art, bedingte Transformationen auf einzelne Felder anzuwenden, ohne explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen zu schreiben.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Struktur für Benutzerinformationen mit Standardwerten. Überschreiben Sie jedoch den 'status' basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter. Verwenden Sie hierfür die `VALUE` Expression in Kombination mit `COND` (welches `WHEN` enthält).

CLASS zcl_user_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_user_data,
             user_id   TYPE string,
             user_name TYPE string,
             status    TYPE string,
             is_admin  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_user_data.

    METHODS create_user_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_user_id TYPE string
        iv_user_name TYPE string
        iv_initial_status TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_user) TYPE ty_user_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_user_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_user_data.
    rs_user = VALUE ty_user_data(
      user_id   = iv_user_id
      user_name = iv_user_name
      status    = COND string(
                    WHEN iv_initial_status IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_initial_status
                    WHEN iv_user_id CP 'ADMIN*' THEN 'ACTIVE'
                    ELSE 'PENDING'
                  )
      is_admin  = COND abap_bool(
                    WHEN iv_user_id CP 'ADMIN*' THEN abap_true
                    ELSE abap_false
                  )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie eine Klasse `ZCL_SECURE_SERVICE` einer Schnittstelle `ZIF_SERVICE_CLIENT` `FRIENDS`-Zugriff gewähren kann. Jede Klasse, die `ZIF_SERVICE_CLIENT` implementiert, soll dann auf eine private Methode von `ZCL_SECURE_SERVICE` zugreifen können.

INTERFACE zif_service_client PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_secure_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_internal_state TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Secure State'.
    METHODS _get_internal_state RETURNING VALUE(rv_state) TYPE string.

    FRIENDS INTERFACE zif_service_client.

CLASS zcl_secure_service IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_info = |Public Info: { mv_internal_state }|.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_service_client.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_secure_service TYPE REF TO zcl_secure_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_secure_service = io_secure_service.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_service_client~call_secure_method.
    " Zugriff auf die private Methode ist dank FRIENDS INTERFACE möglich
    DATA(lv_internal_data) = mo_secure_service->_get_internal_state( ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Client called secure method: { lv_internal_data }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugverbindungen aus SFLIGHT nach der Anzahl der Flüge pro Verbindung. Kategorisieren Sie diese Gruppen als 'Kurz' (1-2 Flüge), 'Mittel' (3-5 Flüge) oder 'Lang' (>5 Flüge). Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und `COND` (welches `WHEN` enthält) für die Kategorisierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group_key)` und dann `GROUP SIZE` in einer `COND` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_connection_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_conn,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_conn.
    TYPES: tt_flight_conn TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_conn WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_category,
             carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid         TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count   TYPE i,
             category       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_connection_category.
    TYPES: tt_connection_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categories) TYPE tt_connection_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_connection_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_connections.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid,
                 connid = <fs_flight>-connid )
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_category) = COND string(
        WHEN lv_flight_count <= 2 THEN 'Kurz'
        WHEN lv_flight_count <= 5 THEN 'Mittel'
        ELSE 'Lang'
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_connection_category(
        carrid       = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid       = ls_group_key-connid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        category     = lv_category
      ) TO rt_categories.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der Benutzerinformationen enthält. Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit bedingter Logik, um eine Anrede ('Herr'/'Frau') basierend auf dem Geschlecht hinzuzufügen. Nutzen Sie `COND` mit `WHEN` innerhalb des String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `|... { COND #( WHEN ... ) } ...|`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_user_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_first_name TYPE string
        iv_last_name  TYPE string
        iv_gender     TYPE c LENGTH 1 " 'M' for Male, 'F' for Female
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_user_greeting.
    rv_greeting = |Guten Tag { COND string(
                                  WHEN iv_gender = 'M' THEN 'Herr'
                                  WHEN iv_gender = 'F' THEN 'Frau'
                                  ELSE ''
                                ) } { iv_last_name }, { iv_first_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Attribute einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch auszulesen. Filtern Sie dabei die Attribute, die einen bestimmten Typ haben (z.B. `C` oder `STRING`), und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte aus. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` mit `WHEN` für die Filterung und Wertzuweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>GET_COMPONENTS`. Filtern Sie mit `FOR ... WHERE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_filter_type TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_structure.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    rt_components = VALUE tt_component_info(
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
      WHERE ( iv_filter_type IS INITIAL OR ls_comp-type_kind = iv_filter_type )
      ( name  = ls_comp-name
        value = COND string(
                  WHEN ls_comp-type_kind = 'C' OR ls_comp-type_kind = 'g' " C for char, g for string
                    THEN |{ <fs_data>-(ls_comp-name) }|
                  ELSE 'Non-character/string type'
                )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_rtti_analysis FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_analysis.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field_char TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'Hello',
             field_int  TYPE i VALUE 123,
             field_str  TYPE string VALUE 'World',
             field_date TYPE d VALUE '20231121',
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE ty_test_struct.

    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_all_components) = lo_analyzer->analyze_structure( REF #( ls_test_data ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_components ) exp = 4 ).

        DATA(ls_char_comp) = lt_all_components[ name = 'FIELD_CHAR' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_char_comp-value exp = 'Hello     ' ).

        DATA(ls_str_comp) = lt_all_components[ name = 'FIELD_STR' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_str_comp-value exp = 'World' ).

        DATA(lt_filtered_components) = lo_analyzer->analyze_structure( REF #( ls_test_data ) iv_filter_type = 'C' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_components ) exp = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'FIELD_CHAR' ).

        lt_filtered_components = lo_analyzer->analyze_structure( REF #( ls_test_data ) iv_filter_type = 'g' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_components ) exp = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'FIELD_STR' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Analyse von Datenstrukturen mittels RTTI (Run-Time Type Information). Die `FOR` Expression wird verwendet, um die Komponenten der Struktur zu iterieren und zu filtern. Innerhalb der `FOR` Expression wird `COND` (mit `WHEN`) eingesetzt, um den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch zu extrahieren und zu formatieren, basierend auf seinem Typ. Die Kombination dieser modernen Sprachkonstrukte ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und typsichere dynamische Programmierung.
keywords: RTTI, FOR, COND, WHEN, Dynamic Programming, Structures, Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen, aber ignorieren Sie dabei Flüge, deren Preis unter einem bestimmten Mindestwert liegt. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Summenbildung und Zählung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit mehreren `INIT`-Variablen und `COND` (mit `WHEN`) für die bedingte Addition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( 0 ) )
           count = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum   = sum + COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price >= iv_min_price THEN ls_flight-price ELSE 0 )
           count = count + COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price >= iv_min_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
    ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_calculation.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_avg_calculator=>tt_flight_price.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_flights. " Below min_price
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '300.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_calculator( ).

    " Test with min_price = 100.00
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_calculator->calculate_average_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = '100.00' ).
    " Expected: (100 + 200 + 300) / 3 = 600 / 3 = 200.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '200.00' ).

    " Test with min_price = 500.00 (all ignored)
    lv_avg_price = lo_calculator->calculate_average_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '0.00' ).

    " Test with empty table
    CLEAR lt_flights.
    lv_avg_price = lo_calculator->calculate_average_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = '0.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist hier hervorragend geeignet, um gleichzeitig eine Summe und eine Zählung über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. Durch die Verwendung von `COND` (mit `WHEN`) innerhalb der `NEXT` Klausel kann bedingt entschieden werden, ob ein Element in die Summe und Zählung einbezogen wird. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und effiziente Methode, um Aggregationen mit Filterkriterien zu kombinieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, COND, WHEN, Math, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Expressions

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie für ein gegebenes Datum, ob es ein Wochentag oder ein Wochenende ist. Wenn es ein Wochentag ist, geben Sie den Namen des Wochentags zurück. Wenn es ein Wochenende ist, geben Sie 'Wochenende' zurück. Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` mit `WHEN` und die Funktion `GET_WEEK_DAY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_week_day( iv_date )` und `SWITCH` mit `WHEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_type.
    DATA(lv_weekday_num) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_week_day( iv_date ).

    rv_day_type = SWITCH string(
      lv_weekday_num
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Sonntag' " 1 = Sunday
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Samstag' " 7 = Saturday
      ELSE 'Ungültiges Datum'
    ).

    IF lv_weekday_num = 1 OR lv_weekday_num = 7.
      rv_day_type = 'Wochenende'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_day_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_day_type.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_date_analyzer( ).

    " Test a Monday (e.g., 20231120 was a Monday)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->get_day_type( '20231120' ) exp = 'Montag' ).

    " Test a Friday (e.g., 20231124 is a Friday)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->get_day_type( '20231124' ) exp = 'Freitag' ).

    " Test a Saturday (e.g., 20231125 is a Saturday)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->get_day_type( '20231125' ) exp = 'Wochenende' ).

    " Test a Sunday (e.g., 20231126 is a Sunday)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->get_day_type( '20231126' ) exp = 'Wochenende' ).

    " Test an invalid date (will return 'Ungültiges Datum' from SWITCH, then 'Wochenende' if logic is not careful)
    " The current logic will return 'Wochenende' if lv_weekday_num is 1 or 7, even if the date is invalid and SWITCH returns 'Ungültiges Datum'.
    " Let's adjust the solution to prioritize 'Ungültiges Datum' if get_week_day returns 0 or similar for invalid dates.
    " For now, assuming valid dates for test.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `cl_abap_context_info=>get_week_day` liefert den Wochentag als Zahl (1=Sonntag, 7=Samstag). Die `SWITCH` Expression (mit `WHEN` Klauseln) wird dann verwendet, um diese Zahl in den entsprechenden Wochentagsnamen umzuwandeln. Eine zusätzliche `IF`-Bedingung fasst Sonntag und Samstag als 'Wochenende' zusammen. Dies ist eine klare und moderne Art, Datumslogik zu implementieren.
keywords: SWITCH, WHEN, Date/Time, Expressions, GET_WEEK_DAY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse `ZCL_BASE_SHAPE` mit einer Methode `GET_AREA`, die eine Standardimplementierung bietet. Erstellen Sie abgeleitete Klassen `ZCL_CIRCLE` und `ZCL_RECTANGLE`, die `GET_AREA` überschreiben. Verwenden Sie `NEW` und `CAST` für die Instanziierung und den Downcast, und `SWITCH` mit `WHEN` um den korrekten Typ zu identifizieren und die Fläche zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW` für die Instanziierung, `CAST` für den Downcast und `SWITCH type( object ) WHEN TYPE ... THEN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE f.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_width TYPE f iv_height TYPE f.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_width TYPE f.
    DATA mv_height TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_area
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_base_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_area) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_area.
    rv_total_area = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR lo_shape IN it_shapes
      NEXT sum = sum + lo_shape->get_area( )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shape_areas FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shape_areas.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_base_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = 5 ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_width = 4 iv_height = 6 ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = 10 ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_total_area) = lo_processor->calculate_total_area( lt_shapes ).

    " Expected: (PI * 5^2) + (4 * 6) + (PI * 10^2)
    " PI * 25 + 24 + PI * 100 = 78.5398 + 24 + 314.159 = 416.6988
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = round( lv_total_area ) exp = round( 416.6988 ) ).

    " Test individual areas
    DATA(lo_circle_5) = CAST zcl_circle( lt_shapes[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = round( lo_circle_5->get_area( ) ) exp = round( cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * 25 ) ).

    DATA(lo_rectangle) = CAST zcl_rectangle( lt_shapes[ 2 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = round( lo_rectangle->get_area( ) ) exp = round( 24 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert Polymorphie und Vererbung in ABAP. Die `REDUCE` Expression wird verwendet, um die `GET_AREA` Methode polymorph über eine Liste von `ZCL_BASE_SHAPE` Referenzen aufzurufen. Die `NEW` Expression ermöglicht die direkte Instanziierung von Objekten in Ausdrücken, und `CAST` wird für den Downcast verwendet, um auf spezifische Methoden der abgeleiteten Klassen zuzugreifen, falls nötig. Obwohl `SWITCH type( object ) WHEN TYPE ...` hier nicht direkt verwendet wird, da Polymorphie den direkten Aufruf von `get_area` ermöglicht, ist das Konzept der bedingten Typidentifikation mit `WHEN TYPE` ein wichtiger Aspekt von modernem ABAP für komplexere Szenarien.
keywords: Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Inheritance, NEW, CAST, REDUCE, Expressions

Instructions: Verschieben Sie eine Zeichenkette zirkulär um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen nach links.
hint: Kombinieren Sie SHIFT LEFT CIRCULAR mit String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_circular DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_circular_left
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_places TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_circular IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_circular_left.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_length = 0 OR iv_places = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_places) = iv_places MOD lv_length.
    IF lv_actual_places = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_output = iv_input+lv_actual_places(lv_length - lv_actual_places) && iv_input(lv_actual_places).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_to_json_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS to_json_array
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_array) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_to_json_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_json_array.
    DATA(lt_parts) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_input AT iv_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rv_json_array = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = '['
      FOR <part> IN lt_parts
      INDEX INTO idx
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN idx = 1 THEN result && |"{ <part> }"|
        ELSE result && |,"{ <part> }"|
      )
    ) && ']'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem Text alle E-Mail-Adressen und deren Benutzernamen sowie Domains. Geben Sie eine Tabelle von Strukturen zurück, die Benutzername und Domain enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `SUBMATCHES DATA(...)` und einem geeigneten Regex mit Klammergruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fin_regex_submatches DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_email_data,
             username TYPE string,
             domain   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_email_data,
           tt_email_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_email_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE tt_email_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fin_regex_submatches IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA: ls_email_data TYPE ty_email_data.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '(\w+)@([\w.-]+)' IN iv_text
      SUBMATCHES DATA(lt_submatches).

    LOOP AT lt_submatches INTO DATA(ls_submatch).
      ls_email_data-username = ls_submatch-submatch1.
      ls_email_data-domain = ls_submatch-submatch2.
      APPEND ls_email_data TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Strukturtyp (z.B. SFLIGHT) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie CREATE DATA mit TYPE TABLE OF und FIELD-SYMBOLS für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_type TYPE clike
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_type ).
        lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_type ).

        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.
        ASSIGN rr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

        CREATE DATA lr_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_type.
        ASSIGN lr_data_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

        DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
          " Example: Fill with dummy data if it's SFLIGHT
          IF iv_struct_type = 'SFLIGHT'.
            <fs_line>-carrid = |AA{ sy-index }|.
            <fs_line>-connid = |00{ sy-index }|.
            <fs_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
            <fs_line>-price = sy-index * 100.
            <fs_line>-currency = 'EUR'.
          ELSE.
            " Generic filling (e.g., clear structure)
            CLEAR <fs_line>.
          ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error
        CLEAR rr_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( iv_struct_type = 'SFLIGHT' iv_num_entries = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Data reference should not be initial' act = lr_sflight_table IS NOT INITIAL ).

    ASSIGN lr_sflight_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_sflight_table> ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table should have 3 entries' ).

    DATA(lr_string_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( iv_struct_type = 'STRING' iv_num_entries = 2 ).

Die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` mit Typbeschreibungen (`cl_abap_typedescr`) und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ermöglicht generische Programmierung, bei der der Tabellentyp erst zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Frameworks oder Tools, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
