Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Szenario, in dem verschiedene Klassen eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle implementieren und über eine Referenz auf diese Schnittstelle polymorph aufgerufen werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle und mehrere implementierende Klassen. Verwenden Sie REF TO auf die Schnittstelle.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_operation.
  METHODS execute
    IMPORTING
      iv_val1 TYPE i
      iv_val2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_operation~execute.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_operation~execute.
    rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_operation
      IMPORTING
        io_operation TYPE REF TO zif_operation
        iv_operand1  TYPE i
        iv_operand2  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_operation.
    rv_result = io_operation->execute( iv_val1 = iv_operand1 iv_val2 = iv_operand2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_calculator_processor( ).

    DATA(lo_add) = NEW zcl_add( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_processor->process_operation( io_operation = lo_add iv_operand1 = 5 iv_operand2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 8 msg = 'Addition failed' ).

    DATA(lo_multiply) = NEW zcl_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_processor->process_operation( io_operation = lo_multiply iv_operand1 = 5 iv_operand2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_product exp = 15 msg = 'Multiplication failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht Polymorphie durch Schnittstellenreferenzen. Die Methode `process_operation` akzeptiert eine Referenz auf die Schnittstelle `zif_operation`. Unabhängig davon, welche konkrete Klasse (z.B. `zcl_add` oder `zcl_multiply`) die Schnittstelle implementiert, kann die Methode `execute` aufgerufen werden. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert die Erweiterung des Systems um neue Operationen, ohne bestehenden Code ändern zu müssen.
keywords: REF TO INTERFACE, Polymorphism, Interface, Object Orientation, METHOD

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, indem Sie eine funktionale Methode und die REDUCE-Anweisung verwenden.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Flugpreis zurückgibt, und verwenden Sie REDUCE mit dieser Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    rv_price = is_flight-price.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + get_flight_price( CORRESPONDING ty_flight_data( flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_with_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_with_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has some flights in SFLIGHT for testing
    " For a real test, you might need to mock SFLIGHT or ensure test data.
    " Here, we'll just assert it's not initial and greater than 0 if data exists.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_total_price msg = 'Total price should be calculated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_price >= 0 msg = 'Total price should be non-negative' ).

    " Example with a known value if SFLIGHT data is controlled
    " DATA(lv_expected_price) = 1234.56.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Calculated price mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `REDUCE`-Anweisung, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. Die Besonderheit ist die Integration einer funktionalen Methode (`get_flight_price`) innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks. Dies ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung der Logik zur Preisermittlung und macht den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar. Die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um die `sflight`-Zeile in den passenden Typ für die Methode zu konvertieren.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Method, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, METHOD

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie CALL METHOD mit (method_name) und PARAMETER-TABLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

    METHODS subtract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_operand1    TYPE i
        iv_operand2    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind,
          lr_result     TYPE REF TO data.

    CREATE DATA lr_result TYPE i.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM1'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_operand1 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM2'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_operand2 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_RESULT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF lr_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

    ASSIGN lr_result->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).
    IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_result = <fs_result>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result_add) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'ADD_NUMBERS' iv_operand1 = 10 iv_operand2 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_add exp = 15 msg = 'Dynamic ADD failed' ).

    DATA(lv_result_sub) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'SUBTRACT_NUMBERS' iv_operand1 = 10 iv_operand2 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_sub exp = 5 msg = 'Dynamic SUBTRACT failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' iv_operand1 = 1 iv_operand2 = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_call_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den dynamischen Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE`. Der Methodenname wird zur Laufzeit als String übergeben, und die Parameter werden in einer internen Tabelle (`abap_parmbind_tab`) gesammelt. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Frameworks, die Methoden basierend auf Konfigurationen oder Benutzereingaben aufrufen müssen. Die Verwendung von `REF TO DATA` für die Parameterübergabe ist hierbei zentral.
keywords: CALL METHOD, Dynamic Method Call, PARAMETER-TABLE, Dynamic Programming, REF TO DATA, METHOD

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine funktionale Schnittstelle als Parameter akzeptiert, um eine benutzerdefinierte Logik auszuführen (z.B. Filterung einer internen Tabelle).
hint: Definieren Sie eine funktionale Schnittstelle und verwenden Sie FOR mit einer Lambda-Expression.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_predicate FUNCTIONAL METHODS test IMPORTING is_flight TYPE sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        io_predicate  TYPE REF TO zif_flight_predicate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING io_predicate->test ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_with_lambda FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_with_lambda.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).

    " Filter for Lufthansa flights
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_filter->filter_flights(
      it_flights = lt_sflight
      io_predicate = NEW zif_flight_predicate( test = >( is_flight-carrid = 'LH' ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_lh_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'LH filter failed' ).

    " Filter for flights with price > 100
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = lo_filter->filter_flights(
      it_flights = lt_sflight
      io_predicate = NEW zif_flight_predicate( test = >( is_flight-price > 100 ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_expensive_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expensive filter failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung einer funktionalen Schnittstelle (`FUNCTIONAL METHODS`) in Kombination mit Lambda-Ausdrücken. Die Methode `filter_flights` akzeptiert eine Referenz auf die funktionale Schnittstelle `zif_flight_predicate`. Der Aufrufer kann dann eine beliebige Filterlogik als Lambda-Ausdruck übergeben, der zur Laufzeit ausgeführt wird. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und wiederverwendbare Filterung von Daten, ohne für jede Bedingung eine eigene Methode schreiben zu müssen. Die `FILTER`-Anweisung nutzt die funktionale Schnittstelle direkt.
keywords: Functional Interface, Lambda, METHOD PARAMETER, FILTER, Internal Tables, REF TO INTERFACE, METHOD

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie GET REFERENCE OF und ASSIGN COMPONENT mit FIELD-SYMBOLS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure    TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value    TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF <fs_structure> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Structure reference not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component>.
    IF <fs_component> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Component not found or not assignable'.
    ENDIF.

    " Attempt to assign the new value, type conversion might be needed in real scenarios
    <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_component_set FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_component_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_component_set.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_struct_access( ).

    lo_cut->set_component_value( ir_structure = REF TO ls_sflight iv_component_name = 'CARRID' iv_new_value = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID not updated dynamically' ).

    lo_cut->set_component_value( ir_structure = REF TO ls_sflight iv_component_name = 'CONNID' iv_new_value = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'CONNID not updated dynamically' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_component_error.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_struct_access( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_component_value( ir_structure = REF TO ls_sflight iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_new_value = 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for non-existent component' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception for non-existent component' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den dynamischen Zugriff und die Manipulation von Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. Mittels `REF TO DATA` wird eine Referenz auf die Struktur übergeben, und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf eine Komponente, deren Name als String bekannt ist. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Muster für Metaprogrammierung, bei der die genaue Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist oder generisch verarbeitet werden soll.
keywords: REF TO DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Access, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Factory-Muster, das Objekte verschiedener Typen (die eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle implementieren) basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt und eine Referenz auf die Schnittstelle zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie CREATE OBJECT mit TYPE und geben Sie eine Schnittstellenreferenz zurück.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document.
  METHODS get_content
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_text_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
    DATA mv_text TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_text = iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document~get_content.
    rv_content = mv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
    DATA mv_html TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_html TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_html = iv_html.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document~get_content.
    rv_content = |<HTML>{ mv_html }</HTML>|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zif_document
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'TEXT'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_text_document( iv_text = iv_data ).
      WHEN 'HTML'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_html_document( iv_html = iv_data ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error EXPORTING text = 'Unknown document type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test: CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. PRIVATE SECTION: METHODS test_factory_pattern FOR TESTING. METHODS test_factory_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error. ENDCLASS. CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD test_factory_pattern. DATA(lo_text_doc) = zcl_document_factory=>create_document( iv_type = 'TEXT' iv_data = 'Hello World' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_text_doc->get_content( ) exp = 'Hello World' msg = 'Text document content mismatch' ). DATA(lo_html_doc) = zcl_document_factory=>create_document( iv_type = 'HTML' iv_data = 'Bold Text' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_html_doc->get_content( ) exp = 'Bold Text' msg = 'HTML document content mismatch' ). ENDMETHOD. METHOD test_factory_error. TRY. zcl_document_factory=>create_document( iv_type = 'PDF' iv_data = 'Some data' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_create_object_error' ). CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error. cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception' ). ENDTRY. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Factory-Muster, um die Erzeugung von Objekten von ihrer Verwendung zu entkoppeln. Die statische Methode `create_document` in `zcl_document_factory` erstellt je nach Eingabetyp unterschiedliche konkrete Dokumentobjekte (`zcl_text_document`, `zcl_html_document`), gibt aber immer eine Referenz auf die gemeinsame Schnittstelle `zif_document` zurück. Dies ermöglicht es dem Client-Code, mit den Objekten polymorph zu arbeiten, ohne deren konkreten Typ kennen zu müssen, was die Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit des Systems verbessert. Die Verwendung von `NEW` für die Objekterzeugung ist hierbei modern.
keywords: Factory Pattern, REF TO INTERFACE, CREATE OBJECT, Object Orientation, METHOD

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur ausgewählte Felder und berechnete Werte enthält, indem Sie eine Methode und die FOR-Anweisung verwenden.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Zeile transformiert, und verwenden Sie FOR mit VALUE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency_code TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_transformed) TYPE ty_transformed_flight.

    METHODS transform_flight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_single_flight.
    rs_transformed = VALUE ty_transformed_flight(
      carrier_id     = is_sflight-carrid
      flight_num     = is_sflight-connid
      flight_date    = is_sflight-fldate
      adjusted_price = is_sflight-price * '1.10' " 10% increase for example
      currency_code  = is_sflight-currency
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_flight_table.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE tt_transformed_flights(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      ( transform_single_flight( flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_for_with_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_with_method.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flight_table( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 msg = 'Transformed table size mismatch' ).

    DATA(ls_first_transformed) = lt_transformed[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_transformed-carrier_id exp = 'LH' msg = 'First entry carrier_id mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_transformed-adjusted_price exp = 110 msg = 'First entry adjusted_price mismatch' ).

    DATA(ls_second_transformed) = lt_transformed[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_second_transformed-carrier_id exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second entry carrier_id mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_second_transformed-adjusted_price exp = 220 msg = 'Second entry adjusted_price mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne und deklarative Art, Daten mit der `FOR`-Anweisung und funktionalen Methoden zu transformieren. Die Methode `transform_single_flight` kapselt die Logik für die Transformation einer einzelnen Flugzeile. Die Methode `transform_flight_table` verwendet dann `FOR` in Kombination mit `VALUE`, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, wobei für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle die Transformationsmethode aufgerufen wird. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem, lesbarem und wartbarem Code für Datenmanipulationen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit alle öffentlichen Methoden einer Klasse und deren Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR und CL_ABAP_METHDESCR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_class_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE string_table,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_methods_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_info) TYPE tt_method_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_unknown_class.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_class_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_methods_info.
    DATA: lr_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lt_methods     TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>method_table,
          ls_method_info TYPE ty_method_info.

    lr_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    lt_methods = lr_class_descr->get_methods( p_visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public ).

    LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method_descr).
      ls_method_info-name = ls_method_descr-name.
      CLEAR ls_method_info-parameters.

      LOOP AT ls_method_descr-parameters INTO DATA(ls_param_descr).
        APPEND |{ ls_param_descr-name } ({ ls_param_descr-parameter_type })| TO ls_method_info-parameters.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_method_info TO rt_method_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_class_inspection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_class_inspection_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_unknown_class.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_class_inspection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_class_inspector( ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_cut->get_public_methods_info( 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_methods IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Methods list should not be empty' ).

    DATA(ls_assert_equals) = VALUE zcl_class_inspector=>ty_method_info(
      name = 'ASSERT_EQUALS'
      parameters = VALUE string_table(
        ( |ACT (IMPORTING)| )
        ( |EXP (IMPORTING)| )
        ( |MSG (IMPORTING)| )
        ( |TOLERANCE (IMPORTING)| )
        ( |QUIT (IMPORTING)| )
      )
    ).

    " Check if ASSERT_EQUALS method is found and has expected parameters
    READ TABLE lt_methods WITH KEY name = 'ASSERT_EQUALS' INTO DATA(ls_found_method).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_found_method IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'ASSERT_EQUALS method not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_found_method-parameters ) exp = lines( ls_assert_equals-parameters ) msg = 'Parameter count mismatch for ASSERT_EQUALS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_method-parameters[1] exp = ls_assert_equals-parameters[1] msg = 'First parameter mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_class_inspection_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_class_inspector( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_public_methods_info( 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_unknown_class' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_class.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von ABAP-Reflection, um Metadaten von Klassen und Methoden zur Laufzeit zu untersuchen. Mittels `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` wird eine Typbeschreibung für eine Klasse abgerufen. Anschließend können mit `get_methods` Informationen über deren Methoden, einschließlich ihrer Parameter, ermittelt werden. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Entwicklung von generischen Tools, Code-Generatoren oder Frameworks, die zur Laufzeit auf die Struktur von Objekten zugreifen müssen.
keywords: Reflection, CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR, CL_ABAP_METHDESCR, Dynamic Programming, METHOD

Instructions: Manipulieren Sie eine Komponente innerhalb einer tiefen Struktur (z.B. eine interne Tabelle in einer Struktur) mithilfe von Datenreferenzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte GET REFERENCE OF und ASSIGN mit FIELD-SYMBOLS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_deep_struct_manipulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_data,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_carrier_data.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        ir_carrier_data TYPE REF TO ty_carrier_data
        iv_connid       TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price    TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_deep_struct_manipulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_carrier_data> TYPE ty_carrier_data,
                   <fs_flights>      TYPE tt_flight_details,
                   <fs_flight_detail> TYPE ty_flight_detail.

    ASSIGN ir_carrier_data->* TO <fs_carrier_data>.
    IF <fs_carrier_data> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Carrier data reference not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN <fs_carrier_data>-flights TO <fs_flights>.
    IF <fs_flights> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Flights table not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE <fs_flights> ASSIGNING <fs_flight_detail> WITH KEY connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight_detail>-price = iv_new_price.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT VALUE zcl_deep_struct_manipulator=>ty_flight_detail( connid = '0401' price = 150 ) INTO TABLE ls_carrier_data-flights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrier_data-flights[ connid = '0400' ]-price exp = 120 msg = 'Price not updated in deep structure' ).

Durch die Übergabe einer Referenz auf die Hauptstruktur (`REF TO ty_carrier_data`) und die anschließende Zuweisung von Referenzen auf die verschachtelten Komponenten (`ASSIGN <fs_carrier_data>-flights TO <fs_flights>`) kann der Code generisch auf die inneren Daten zugreifen und diese ändern. CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error EXPORTING text = 'Table reference not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error EXPORTING text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objektreferenzen akzeptiert und eine Methode auf jedem Objekt in der Liste aufruft (Iterator-Muster).

INTERFACE zif_actionable.
  METHODS perform_action IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_actionable~perform_action.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log, here just simulate.
    WRITE: / |Logger { mv_name }: { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_notifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_type TYPE string.
    DATA mv_type TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_notifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_type = iv_type.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_actionable~perform_action.
    " In a real scenario, this would send a notification.
    WRITE: / |Notifier { mv_type }: { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        it_actionables TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_actionable
        iv_message     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_actions.
    LOOP AT it_actionables ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_actionable>).
      <fs_actionable>->perform_action( iv_message ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Methode iteriert über diese Liste und ruft polymorph eine definierte Methode (`perform_action`) auf jedem Objekt auf. Dies ermöglicht es, eine Reihe von Aktionen auf verschiedenen Objekttypen auszuführen, ohne deren konkreten Typ zu kennen, was die Flexibilität und Erweiterbarkeit des Systems erheblich verbessert. Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere funktionale Methodenaufrufe, um eine Datenpipeline zu erstellen, die eine interne Tabelle filtert und dann transformiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Ergebnisse einer funktionalen Methode direkt als Eingabe für die nächste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_pipeline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES tt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             processed_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_data.
    TYPES tt_processed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_active_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_raw_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_raw_data.

    METHODS transform_data_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_raw_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE tt_processed_data.

    METHODS process_pipeline
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_data TYPE tt_raw_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_final_data) TYPE tt_processed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_pipeline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_active_data.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data WHERE status = 'A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_data_to_upper.
    rt_transformed_data = VALUE tt_processed_data(
      FOR ls_data IN it_data
      ( id = ls_data-id, processed_value = to_upper( ls_data-value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_pipeline.
    rt_final_data = transform_data_to_upper(
                      filter_active_data( it_initial_data )
                    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_data_pipeline FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_pipeline.
    DATA: lt_initial_data TYPE zcl_data_pipeline=>tt_raw_data.
    INSERT VALUE zcl_data_pipeline=>ty_raw_data( id = 1 value = 'apple' status = 'A' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_data.
    INSERT VALUE zcl_data_pipeline=>ty_raw_data( id = 2 value = 'banana' status = 'I' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_data.
    INSERT VALUE zcl_data_pipeline=>ty_raw_data( id = 3 value = 'cherry' status = 'A' ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_pipeline( ).
    DATA(lt_final_data) = lo_cut->process_pipeline( lt_initial_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_final_data ) exp = 2 msg = 'Final table size mismatch' ).

    DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_final_data[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-id exp = 1 msg = 'First entry ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-processed_value exp = 'APPLE' msg = 'First entry processed value mismatch' ).

    DATA(ls_second_entry) = lt_final_data[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_second_entry-id exp = 3 msg = 'Second entry ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_second_entry-processed_value exp = 'CHERRY' msg = 'Second entry processed value mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verkettung von funktionalen Methodenaufrufen, um eine Datenpipeline zu erstellen. Die Methode `process_pipeline` ruft `filter_active_data` auf, dessen Ergebnis direkt als Eingabe für `transform_data_to_upper` dient. Diese Art der Verkettung, oft als Method Chaining bezeichnet, ist ein Kennzeichen moderner funktionaler Programmierung. Sie macht den Code sehr lesbar, da die Datenflusslogik klar und sequenziell dargestellt wird, und fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit kleiner, fokussierter Methoden.
keywords: Functional Method, Method Chaining, Data Pipeline, FILTER, FOR, Internal Tables, METHOD

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld gruppiert und die Anzahl der Elemente pro Gruppe zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie GROUP BY mit (field_name) und FIELD-SYMBOLS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             key_value TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_result.
    TYPES tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_group_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_counts) TYPE tt_group_result
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_group_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_key_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_group_error EXPORTING text = 'Table reference not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line> GROUP BY (iv_group_field) INTO DATA(group_key).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_key_field>.
      IF <fs_key_field> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_group_error EXPORTING text = 'Group field not found or not assignable'.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE ty_group_result( key_value = <fs_key_field> count = group_key-size ) TO rt_group_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_group_by FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_group_by_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_group_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_group_by.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item.

    INSERT VALUE ty_item( category = 'A' value = 10 ) INTO TABLE lt_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( category = 'B' value = 20 ) INTO TABLE lt_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( category = 'A' value = 30 ) INTO TABLE lt_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( category = 'C' value = 40 ) INTO TABLE lt_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( category = 'A' value = 50 ) INTO TABLE lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_grouper( ).

    DATA(lt_group_counts) = lo_cut->group_table_dynamically( ir_table = REF TO lt_items iv_group_field = 'CATEGORY' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_group_counts ) exp = 3 msg = 'Number of groups mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_group_counts WITH KEY key_value = 'A' INTO DATA(ls_group_a).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_a-count exp = 3 msg = 'Count for group A mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_group_counts WITH KEY key_value = 'B' INTO DATA(ls_group_b).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_b-count exp = 1 msg = 'Count for group B mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_group_by_error.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_grouper( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->group_table_dynamically( ir_table = REF TO lt_items iv_group_field = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_table_group_error for non-existent field' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_group_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception for non-existent field' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Gruppierung einer internen Tabelle. Die Methode `group_table_dynamically` akzeptiert eine Datenreferenz auf eine beliebige interne Tabelle und den Namen des Gruppierungsfeldes als String. Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY (field_name)`-Anweisung ermöglicht es, die Gruppierung zur Laufzeit zu definieren. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für generische Analysen und Berichte, bei denen die Gruppierungskriterien flexibel sein müssen. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist hierbei unerlässlich, um generisch auf die Tabellenzeilen und Gruppenfelder zuzugreifen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf eine Methode (Methoden-Referenz) als Parameter akzeptiert und diese Methode auf einem gegebenen Objekt aufruft.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine funktionale Schnittstelle mit einer Methode, die die Signatur der aufzurufenden Methode widerspiegelt.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_string_processor FUNCTIONAL METHODS process IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_string_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS to_upper IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS to_lower IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS reverse_string IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS apply_processor
      IMPORTING
        io_processor TYPE REF TO zif_string_processor
        iv_input     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_upper.
    rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_lower.
    rv_output = to_lower( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reverse_string.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    DATA(lv_reversed) = ``.
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_reversed = lv_reversed && iv_input+((lv_length - sy-index - 1))(1).
    ENDDO.
    rv_output = lv_reversed.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD apply_processor.
    rv_result = io_processor->process( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_reference_as_param FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_reference_as_param.
    DATA(lo_utils) = NEW zcl_string_utils( ).

    " Pass TO_UPPER method as a reference
    DATA(lv_upper) = lo_utils->apply_processor(
      io_processor = NEW zif_string_processor( process = lo_utils->to_upper )
      iv_input = 'Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_upper exp = 'HELLO WORLD' msg = 'TO_UPPER via method reference failed' ).

    " Pass TO_LOWER method as a reference
    DATA(lv_lower) = lo_utils->apply_processor(
      io_processor = NEW zif_string_processor( process = lo_utils->to_lower )
      iv_input = 'Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lower exp = 'hello world' msg = 'TO_LOWER via method reference failed' ).

    " Pass REVERSE_STRING method as a reference
    DATA(lv_reversed) = lo_utils->apply_processor(
      io_processor = NEW zif_string_processor( process = lo_utils->reverse_string )
      iv_input = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_reversed exp = 'olleH' msg = 'REVERSE_STRING via method reference failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie eine Referenz auf eine Methode als Parameter übergeben werden kann, indem eine funktionale Schnittstelle verwendet wird. Die Schnittstelle `zif_string_processor` definiert eine Methode `process`, die die Signatur der Methoden in `zcl_string_utils` widerspiegelt. Die Methode `apply_processor` akzeptiert eine Referenz auf diese Schnittstelle. Beim Aufruf wird eine Instanz der funktionalen Schnittstelle mit einer Referenz auf die gewünschte Methode (`lo_utils->to_upper`, `lo_utils->to_lower` etc.) erstellt. Dies ermöglicht eine hochflexible und erweiterbare Architektur, bei der Verhaltensweisen zur Laufzeit ausgetauscht werden können, ähnlich wie bei Callbacks oder Strategie-Mustern in anderen Sprachen.
keywords: REF TO METHOD, Functional Interface, Method Reference, Callback, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, METHOD

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach mehreren zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feldern sortiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie SORT mit einer internen Tabelle von Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_multi_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_by_multiple_fields
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_multi_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_by_multiple_fields.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error EXPORTING text = 'Table reference not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sort_criteria) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR field IN it_field_names NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && ` ` && field ) ).

    IF lv_sort_criteria IS INITIAL.
      " No sort fields provided, consider it a success (no change) or raise error
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        SORT <fs_table> BY (lv_sort_criteria).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error EXPORTING text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_multi_sort FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_multi_sort_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_multi_sort.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_segment.
    DATA: lt_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment.

    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_segment( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) INTO TABLE lt_segments.
    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_segment( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' ) INTO TABLE lt_segments.
    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_segment( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' ) INTO TABLE lt_segments.
    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_segment( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' ) INTO TABLE lt_segments.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_multi_sorter( ).

    " Sort by CARRID, then FLDATE, then CONNID
    DATA(lt_sort_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->sort_table_by_multiple_fields( ir_table = REF TO lt_segments it_field_names = lt_sort_fields ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Multi-field sort failed' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First entry carrid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[1]-fldate exp = '20251201' msg = 'First entry fldate mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[1]-connid exp = '0017' msg = 'First entry connid mismatch' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[2]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second entry carrid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[2]-fldate exp = '20251202' msg = 'Second entry fldate mismatch' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[3]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Third entry carrid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[3]-fldate exp = '20251201' msg = 'Third entry fldate mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[3]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Third entry connid mismatch' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[4]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Fourth entry carrid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[4]-fldate exp = '20251201' msg = 'Fourth entry fldate mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_segments[4]-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'Fourth entry connid mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_multi_sort_error.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_multi_sorter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->sort_table_by_multiple_fields( ir_table = REF TO lt_items it_field_names = VALUE string_table( ( 'ID' ) ( 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ) ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error for non-existent field' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception for non-existent field' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die dynamische Sortierung auf mehrere Felder. Die Methode `sort_table_by_multiple_fields` akzeptiert eine Datenreferenz auf eine beliebige interne Tabelle und eine interne Tabelle von Feldnamen. Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um die einzelnen Feldnamen zu einem einzigen String zusammenzufügen, der dann in der `SORT`-Anweisung mit `BY (lv_sort_criteria)` verwendet wird. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Sortierung nach mehreren Kriterien, die zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden können, was für komplexe Benutzeroberflächen oder Konfigurationen sehr nützlich ist.
keywords: REF TO DATA, Dynamic Sort, Internal Tables, REDUCE, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, indem Sie den Preis jedes Fluges mit einer gegebenen Anzahl von Passagieren multiplizieren und die Summe bilden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit einer Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_revenue
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_sum TYPE s_price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT total_sum = total_sum + ( flight-price * flight-passengers )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_revenue FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_revenue.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_multiply( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_multiply=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' passengers = 2 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' passengers = 3 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '800.00' ). " (100*2) + (200*3) = 200 + 600 = 800
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_multiply( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_multiply=>tt_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine Summe von multiplizierten Werten zu bilden, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_multi_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             max_seats TYPE s_maxseats,
             occup_seats TYPE s_occseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS filter_by_carrier_and_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_multi_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_carrier_and_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' max_seats = 300 occup_seats = 250 ) " 50 free
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A380' max_seats = 500 occup_seats = 400 ) " 100 free
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' max_seats = 300 occup_seats = 280 ) " 20 free
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' max_seats = 180 occup_seats = 100 ) " 80 free
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND ( max_seats - occup_seats ) > iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle um einen bestimmten Prozentsatz (z.B. 10%).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck, um die Preise zu multiplizieren und eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1 " e.g., 10.0 for 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    DATA(lv_factor) = 1 + ( iv_percentage / 100 ).

    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( 
        carrid   = flight-carrid,
        connid   = flight-connid,
        price    = flight-price * lv_factor,
        currency = flight-currency
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_multiply( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_multiply=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->increase_prices( it_flights = lt_flights iv_percentage = '10.0' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '220.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_percentage.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_multiply( ).

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->increase_prices( it_flights = lt_flights iv_percentage = '0.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_filter_chained DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_chained IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_chained.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
                            FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier )

                          ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gewichteten Durchschnitt von Werten, wobei jeder Wert mit einem zugehörigen Gewicht multipliziert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe der Produkte und die Summe der Gewichte zu berechnen, und dann teilen Sie die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value  TYPE f,
             weight TYPE f,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_weighted_average
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weighted_avg) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_weighted_average.
    DATA(ls_sums) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_value_sum TYPE f VALUE 0
           total_weight_sum TYPE f VALUE 0
      FOR item IN it_data
      NEXT total_value_sum = total_value_sum + ( item-value * item-weight )
           total_weight_sum = total_weight_sum + item-weight
    ).

    IF ls_sums-total_weight_sum > 0.
      rv_weighted_avg = ls_sums-total_value_sum / ls_sums-total_weight_sum.
    ELSE.
      rv_weighted_avg = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weighted_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_weights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weighted_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_average( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_weighted_average=>tt_data(
      ( value = 10.0 weight = 1.0 )
      ( value = 20.0 weight = 2.0 )
      ( value = 30.0 weight = 1.0 )
    ). " (10*1 + 20*2 + 30*1) / (1+2+1) = (10 + 40 + 30) / 4 = 80 / 4 = 20

    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_weighted_average( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = 20.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_average( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_weighted_average=>tt_data( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_weighted_average( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_weights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_average( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_weighted_average=>tt_data(
      ( value = 10.0 weight = 0.0 )
      ( value = 20.0 weight = 0.0 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_weighted_average( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für komplexe Aggregationen, bei denen mehrere Zwischenwerte (hier `total_value_sum` und `total_weight_sum`) gleichzeitig berechnet werden müssen. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Aggregation, Weighted Average, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flugobjekten nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Plätzen haben.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse für Flugobjekte und verwenden Sie dann `FILTER` auf einer Tabelle dieser Objekte.

CLASS zcl_flight_object DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY,
          mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY,
          mv_max_seats TYPE s_maxseats READ-ONLY,
          mv_occup_seats TYPE s_occseats READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_max_seats TYPE s_maxseats
        iv_occup_seats TYPE s_occseats.

    METHODS get_free_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_free_seats) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_flight_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
    mv_max_seats = iv_max_seats.
    mv_occup_seats = iv_occup_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_free_seats.
    rv_free_seats = mv_max_seats - mv_occup_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_filter_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_objects
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_free_seats.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE table_line->get_free_seats( ) > iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtumsatz für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, wobei der Preis jedes Fluges mit der Anzahl der belegten Sitze multipliziert wird. Berücksichtigen Sie nur Flüge, deren Preis über einem Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` Operatoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
             occup_seats TYPE s_occseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_revenue_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_revenue_filtered.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' occup_seats = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' occup_seats = 400 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' occup_seats = 280 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '80.00' currency = 'EUR' occup_seats = 100 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND price > iv_min_price ).

    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_sum TYPE s_price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT total_sum = total_sum + ( flight-price * flight-occup_seats )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_revenue_filtered FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_revenue_filtered.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_revenue) = lo_cut->calculate_revenue_filtered( 
      it_flights = VALUE zcl_filter_reduce_multiply=>tt_sflight(
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' occup_seats = 250 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' occup_seats = 400 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' occup_seats = 280 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '80.00' currency = 'EUR' occup_seats = 100 )
      )
      iv_carrier = 'LH'
      iv_min_price = '90.00'
    ). " LH 0400 (100*250) + LH 0401 (150*280) = 25000 + 42000 = 67000

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_revenue exp = '67000.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_revenue) = lo_cut->calculate_revenue_filtered( 
      it_flights = VALUE zcl_filter_reduce_multiply=>tt_sflight(
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' occup_seats = 250 )
      )
      iv_carrier = 'XX'
      iv_min_price = '50.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_revenue exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht komplexe Datenverarbeitungs-Pipelines in einer funktionalen und gut lesbaren Weise. Zuerst wird die Tabelle gefiltert, dann werden die gefilterten Ergebnisse aggregiert, was die Effizienz und Wartbarkeit des Codes erhöht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Produkt aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_product_of_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_of_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE #( 
      INIT product TYPE i VALUE 1
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT product = product * number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft den durchschnittlichen Umsatz pro Sitzplatz, indem Sie den Gesamtumsatz (Preis * belegte Sitze) durch die Gesamtzahl der Sitze teilen. Berücksichtigen Sie nur Flüge mit mehr als 100 belegten Sitzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` mit `FOR` und `REDUCE` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck, um die Aggregationen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_multiply_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             price       TYPE s_price,
             occup_seats TYPE s_occseats,
             max_seats   TYPE s_maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_revenue_per_seat TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_revenue_per_seat
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_averages) TYPE tt_carrier_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_multiply_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_revenue_per_seat.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' occup_seats = 250 max_seats = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' occup_seats = 400 max_seats = 500 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' occup_seats = 280 max_seats = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '80.00' occup_seats = 80 max_seats = 180 ) " Excluded by filter
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '180.00' occup_seats = 350 max_seats = 500 )
    ).

    rt_carrier_averages = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE occup_seats > 100 ) GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) 
      ( 
        carrid = GROUP carrid,
        avg_revenue_per_seat = REDUCE f(
          INIT total_revenue TYPE f VALUE 0
               total_seats TYPE f VALUE 0
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          NEXT total_revenue = total_revenue + ( member-price * member-occup_seats )
               total_seats = total_seats + member-max_seats
        ) / COND f( WHEN total_seats > 0 THEN total_seats ELSE 1 ) " Avoid division by zero
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_avg_revenue FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_avg_revenue.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_multiply_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_multiply_avg=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' occup_seats = 250 max_seats = 300 ) " Rev: 25000, Seats: 300
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' occup_seats = 400 max_seats = 500 ) " Rev: 80000, Seats: 500
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' occup_seats = 280 max_seats = 300 ) " Rev: 42000, Seats: 300
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '80.00' occup_seats = 80 max_seats = 180 ) " Excluded
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '180.00' occup_seats = 350 max_seats = 500 ) " Rev: 63000, Seats: 500
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_revenue_per_seat( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    " LH: (25000 + 42000) / (300 + 300) = 67000 / 600 = 111.666...
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-avg_revenue_per_seat exp = '111.66666666666667' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    " AA: (80000 + 63000) / (500 + 500) = 143000 / 1000 = 143.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-avg_revenue_per_seat exp = '143.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_multiply_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_revenue_per_seat( VALUE zcl_group_multiply_avg=>tt_sflight( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_multiply_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_multiply_avg=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '80.00' occup_seats = 80 max_seats = 180 ) " Excluded by filter
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_revenue_per_seat( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER`, `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` ab ABAP 7.55. Es ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Aggregation von Daten, die zuerst gefiltert und dann nach bestimmten Kriterien gruppiert werden, um komplexe Berechnungen wie den gewichteten Durchschnitt durchzuführen. Die Verwendung von `COND` verhindert eine Division durch Null.
keywords: FILTER, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Math, Grouping, Aggregation, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `SWITCH`-Expression, um den Status eines Fluges (aus `sflights`) basierend auf der verbleibenden Kapazität zu bestimmen. 'Verfügbar' (>100), 'Begrenzt' (11-100), 'Knapp' (1-10), 'Ausgebucht' (0).
hint: Nutzen Sie die `SWITCH`-Expression mit `WHEN OTHERS` für den Standardfall.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                 ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                   fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                   status = SWITCH #( WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc < 1 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
                                                      WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc <= 10 THEN 'Knapp'
                                                      WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc <= 100 THEN 'Begrenzt'
                                                      ELSE 'Verfügbar'
                                                    ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 0. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0402'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 50. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0403'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

In Kombination mit dem `FOR`-Operator für interne Tabellen ermöglicht sie eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von Daten. Die `WHEN OTHERS`-Klausel (implizit durch die Reihenfolge der `WHEN`-Bedingungen abgedeckt) sorgt für einen Fallback.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_action_handler.

CLASS zcl_object_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_action_handler~handle_object.
    CASE TYPE OF io_object.
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_unit_assert.
        " Beispielaktion für cl_abap_unit_assert
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Object is of type CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT| ).
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_math.
        " Beispielaktion für cl_abap_math
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Object is of type CL_ABAP_MATH| ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Standardaktion für alle anderen Typen
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Object is of unknown type: { cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( io_object ) }| ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und dem Status (bestimmt durch die Anzahl der belegten Sitze) und geben Sie nur 'Verfügbare' oder 'Begrenzte' Flüge zurück. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer `COND`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_status.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                    AND   ( COND string(
                                              WHEN seatsocc < 1 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
                                              WHEN seatsocc <= 10 THEN 'Knapp'
                                              WHEN seatsocc <= 100 THEN 'Begrenzt'
                                              ELSE 'Verfügbar'
                                            ) = 'Verfügbar'
                                    OR    COND string(
                                              WHEN seatsocc < 1 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
                                              WHEN seatsocc <= 10 THEN 'Knapp'
                                              WHEN seatsocc <= 100 THEN 'Begrenzt'
                                              ELSE 'Verfügbar'
                                            ) = 'Begrenzt' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
