Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und bestimmen Sie für jede Gruppe den 'Hauptstatus' (z.B. 'Gemischt', 'Alle Verfügbar', 'Alle Ausgebucht'). Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT GROUP BY` mit einer `COND`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Schleife eine `COND`-Expression, um den Status der Gruppe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             group_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_grouped_status.
    TYPES tt_grouped_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_status) TYPE tt_grouped_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_status.
    DATA: lv_all_available TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_all_booked    TYPE abap_bool.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      lv_all_available = abap_true.
      lv_all_booked    = abap_true.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight INTO DATA(ls_group_flight).
        IF ls_group_flight-seatsocc < 1.
          lv_all_available = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_group_flight-seatsocc > 0.
          lv_all_booked = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_status(
               carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
               group_status = COND string(
                                WHEN lv_all_available = abap_true THEN 'Alle Verfügbar'
                                WHEN lv_all_booked = abap_true THEN 'Alle Ausgebucht'
                                ELSE 'Gemischt'
                              )
             ) TO rt_grouped_status.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    " LH: Gemischt
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 0. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0401'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 50. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    " AA: Alle Verfügbar
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 120. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0002'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 100. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    " UA: Alle Ausgebucht
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0003'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 0. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0004'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 0. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_status( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-group_status exp = 'Gemischt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-group_status exp = 'Alle Verfügbar' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ]-group_status exp = 'Alle Ausgebucht' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist ein mächtiges Feature für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Innerhalb der Gruppen-Schleife wird eine `COND`-Expression verwendet, um den aggregierten Status der Gruppe zu bestimmen. Dies zeigt, wie bedingte Ausdrücke in komplexeren Schleifenstrukturen eingesetzt werden können, um den Code deklarativer und kompakter zu gestalten. Die `ELSE`-Klausel in der `COND`-Expression ist hier für den 'Gemischt'-Status zuständig.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, COND, Internal Tables, Grouping, sflights, ELSE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch einen Feldkatalog für eine interne Tabelle generiert. Die Spaltenüberschrift soll basierend auf dem Feldnamen mit einer `CASE`-Expression bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` zur Feldanalyse und eine `CASE`-Expression für die dynamische Überschrift.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_fieldcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fieldcat_line,
             fieldname TYPE fieldname,
             coltext   TYPE lvc_coltext,
           END OF ty_fieldcat_line.
    TYPES tt_fieldcat TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fieldcat_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_catalog
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fieldcat) TYPE tt_fieldcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_fieldcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_fieldcat = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
                             ( fieldname = ls_comp-name
                               coltext   = CASE ls_comp-name
                                             WHEN 'CARRID' THEN 'Fluggesellschaft'
                                             WHEN 'CONNID' THEN 'Flugnummer'
                                             WHEN 'FLDATE' THEN 'Flugdatum'
                                             WHEN 'PRICE'  THEN 'Preis'
                                             ELSE ls_comp-name " Standard: Feldname als Überschrift
                                           END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_medium_priority_important.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_task_priority( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_priority( iv_urgent = abap_false iv_important = abap_true ) exp = 'Mittel' ).

explanation: Verschachtelte `COND`-Expressions ermöglichen die kompakte Darstellung komplexer bedingter Logik, die normalerweise mehrere `IF-ELSIF-ELSE`-Blöcke erfordern würde. Jede `COND`-Expression muss eine `ELSE`-Klausel haben, um sicherzustellen, dass immer ein Ergebnis zurückgegeben wird. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Codezeilen für bedingte Zuweisungen erheblich.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Struktur, wobei ein Feld 'Reiseklasse' basierend auf dem Flugzeugtyp (`planetype`) zugewiesen wird. Nutzen Sie `MAP` mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `MAP`-Operator, um die Transformation durchzuführen, und eine `SWITCH`-Expression für die bedingte Zuweisung der Reiseklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_class_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_class,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype   TYPE sflight-planetype,
             travel_class TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_class.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_class TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_class WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights_to_class
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_class) TYPE tt_flight_with_class.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_class_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights_to_class.
    rt_flights_with_class = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                     ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
                                       connid      = ls_sflight-connid
                                       fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate
                                       planetype   = ls_sflight-planetype
                                       travel_class = SWITCH #( ls_sflight-planetype
                                                                WHEN '747' THEN 'First Class'
                                                                WHEN 'A380' THEN 'Business Class'
                                                                WHEN 'A320' THEN 'Economy Class'
                                                                ELSE 'Unbekannt'
                                                              ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0403'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-planetype = 'CRJ'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und fangen Sie mögliche Datenbankfehler mit TRY...CATCH ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie die UPDATE-Anweisung und fangen Sie CX_SY_SQL_ERROR ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_sflights_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_sflights_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    " Read existing record to ensure it exists for update
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_sflight-price = iv_price.
      TRY.
          UPDATE sflight SET price = ls_sflight-price
            WHERE carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
              AND connid = ls_sflight-connid
              AND fldate = ls_sflight-fldate.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            " Update failed, but no exception raised (e.g., no record found, which is handled above)
            rv_success = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
          " Handle database error
          MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'. " For demo, usually log or raise custom exception
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Record not found
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    METHODS test_update_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existent FOR TESTING.
  DATA: mv_original_price TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure a test record exists and save its original price
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Insert a test record if it doesn't exist
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101'
                                   planetype = 'BOEING747' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ).
      mv_original_price = 1000.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK. " Ensure data is committed for test
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original price
    UPDATE sflight SET price = mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_sflights_single( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = mv_original_price + 100.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight(
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
      iv_connid = '0017'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_price  = lv_new_price
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    " Verify update
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_actual_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_new_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_sflights_single( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight(
      iv_carrid = 'XX' " Non-existent carrier
      iv_connid = '9999'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_price  = 500
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: TRY...CATCH ist der moderne Weg, um Ausnahmen in ABAP zu behandeln, anstatt nur sy-subrc zu prüfen. CX_SY_SQL_ERROR fängt generische Datenbankfehler ab, die während der UPDATE-Operation auftreten können. Die explizite Prüfung, ob der Datensatz vor dem Update existiert, ist eine gute Praxis.
keywords: UPDATE, TRY, CATCH, CX_SY_SQL_ERROR, SY-SUBRC, SFLIGHTS, Database Operations

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Flugdatensatz. Bei Erfolg soll die Änderung dauerhaft gespeichert werden (COMMIT WORK), bei einem Fehler soll die Änderung rückgängig gemacht werden (ROLLBACK WORK).
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH um den Fehler abzufangen und dann COMMIT WORK oder ROLLBACK WORK.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_commit_rollback DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_and_commit
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
        iv_fail_sim TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false " For test simulation
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_commit_rollback IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_and_commit.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    " Read existing record
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          " Simulate a failure if iv_fail_sim is true
          IF iv_fail_sim = abap_true.
            " This will cause a short dump if not caught, or a SQL error if it's a real DB issue
            " For simulation, we can try to update a non-existent table to force CX_SY_SQL_ERROR
            UPDATE ( 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE' ) SET field = 'X' WHERE key = 'Y'.
          ENDIF.

          UPDATE sflight SET price = iv_price
            WHERE carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
              AND connid = ls_sflight-connid
              AND fldate = ls_sflight-fldate.

          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            COMMIT WORK.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            ROLLBACK WORK.
            rv_success = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
          ROLLBACK WORK.
          MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Record not found, no update performed
      ROLLBACK WORK. " No pending changes, but good practice
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    METHODS test_update_commit FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_rollback FOR TESTING.
  DATA: mv_original_price TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101'
                                   planetype = 'BOEING747' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ).
      mv_original_price = 1000.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    UPDATE sflight SET price = mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_commit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_commit_rollback( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = mv_original_price + 200.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_and_commit(
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
      iv_connid = '0017'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_price  = lv_new_price
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_actual_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_new_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_rollback.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_commit_rollback( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = mv_original_price + 300.
    " Simulate failure by trying to update a non-existent table
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_and_commit(
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
      iv_connid = '0017'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_price  = lv_new_price
      iv_fail_sim = abap_true " This will trigger the simulated error
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
    " Verify that the price was NOT updated due to ROLLBACK
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_actual_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = mv_original_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von COMMIT WORK und ROLLBACK WORK in Verbindung mit TRY...CATCH. Bei einem erfolgreichen Datenbank-Update werden die Änderungen mit COMMIT WORK dauerhaft gespeichert. Tritt eine CX_SY_SQL_ERROR auf, werden alle Änderungen der aktuellen logischen Arbeitseinheit (LUW) mit ROLLBACK WORK rückgängig gemacht.
keywords: UPDATE, TRY, CATCH, COMMIT WORK, ROLLBACK WORK, CX_SY_SQL_ERROR, Database Operations, Transaction Management

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine Liste von Flugdatensätzen in einer Schleife. Fangen Sie dabei Fehler für jeden einzelnen Datensatz ab, sodass die Verarbeitung der anderen Datensätze fortgesetzt werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine LOOP-Anweisung und platzieren Sie TRY...CATCH innerhalb der Schleife um die UPDATE-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_loop_error_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             new_price TYPE s_price,
             success  TYPE abap_bool,
             message  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES: tt_flight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flights_in_loop
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_flight_update.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_loop_error_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_in_loop.
    rt_results = it_flight_data. " Initialize results with input data

    LOOP AT rt_results ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      TRY.
          UPDATE sflight SET price = <fs_flight>-new_price
            WHERE carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
              AND connid = <fs_flight>-connid
              AND fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.

          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_flight>-success = abap_true.
            <fs_flight>-message = 'Update successful'.
          ELSE.
            <fs_flight>-success = abap_false.
            <fs_flight>-message = 'Record not found or update failed'.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
          <fs_flight>-success = abap_false.
          <fs_flight>-message = lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK. " Commit all successful changes at the end
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    METHODS test_update_loop FOR TESTING.
  DATA: mt_original_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure test records exist and save original state
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_original_sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND ( connid = '0017' OR connid = '0018' ).
    IF lines( mt_original_sflights ) < 2.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101'
                                   planetype = 'BOEING747' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ).
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101'
                                   planetype = 'AIRBUS320' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 150 price = 500 currency = 'EUR' ).
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_original_sflights
        WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND ( connid = '0017' OR connid = '0018' ).
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original prices
    MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE mt_original_sflights.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_loop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_loop_error_handle( ).
    DATA(lt_update_data) = VALUE zcl_update_loop_error_handle=>tt_flight_update(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' new_price = 1100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' new_price = 600 )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = '20250101' new_price = 1000 ) " Non-existent record
    ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->update_flights_in_loop( lt_update_data ).

    " Assertions
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).

    " Check first record (successful update)
    READ TABLE lt_results ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_res1>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_res1>-success ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_price1)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price1 exp = 1100 ).

    " Check second record (successful update)
    READ TABLE lt_results ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_res2>) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_res2>-success ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_price2)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0018' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price2 exp = 600 ).

    " Check third record (failed update - non-existent)
    READ TABLE lt_results ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_res3>) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( <fs_res3>-success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = <fs_res3>-message exp = 'Record not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man UPDATE-Operationen in einer Schleife durchführt und dabei individuelle Fehler für jeden Datensatz mit TRY...CATCH abfängt. Dies stellt sicher, dass ein Fehler bei einem Datensatz die Verarbeitung der nachfolgenden Datensätze nicht unterbricht. Die Ergebnisse werden in einer internen Tabelle mit Erfolgsstatus und Fehlermeldung zurückgegeben.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen Flugdatensatz mit einem nicht existierenden Schlüssel zu aktualisieren und fangen Sie den erwarteten Fehler ab.
hint: Die UPDATE-Anweisung setzt sy-subrc auf 4, wenn kein Datensatz gefunden wird. Ein TRY...CATCH CX_SY_SQL_ERROR fängt jedoch nur echte Datenbankfehler ab, nicht das 'Nicht-Finden' eines Datensatzes. Hier wird der sy-subrc-Check innerhalb des TRY-Blocks verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_non_existent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_non_existent_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_non_existent IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_non_existent_flight.
    TRY.
        UPDATE sflight SET price = iv_price
          WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
            AND connid = iv_connid
            AND fldate = iv_fldate.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true. " Should not happen for non-existent key
        ELSE.
          " sy-subrc = 4 means record not found, not a SQL error exception
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

Instructions: Führen Sie ein cross-client Update auf der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle durch und fangen Sie mögliche Datenbankfehler ab.

solution:
CLASS zcl_update_client_specified DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_cross_client
      IMPORTING
        iv_client   TYPE mandt
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_client_specified IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_cross_client.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    " Read existing record in the specified client
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight CLIENT SPECIFIED INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
      WHERE mandt = iv_client
        AND carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          UPDATE sflight CLIENT SPECIFIED SET price = iv_price
            WHERE mandt = iv_client
              AND carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
              AND connid = ls_sflight-connid
              AND fldate = ls_sflight-fldate.

          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            rv_success = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
          MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Record not found in specified client
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_from_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data

CLASS zcl_update_from_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_from_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Map input data to database table structure
    lt_sflight_update = CORRESPONDING #( it_flights MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid fldate = fldate price = price ).

    TRY.
        UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight_update.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          " Some records might not have been found or updated
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie UPDATE CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF. Fangen Sie CX_SY_SQL_ERROR ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             some_other_field TYPE string, " Example of an extra field not in SFLIGHTS
           END OF ty_flight_update_data.

    METHODS update_flight_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_update TYPE ty_flight_update_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_corresponding.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    " Read existing record to ensure it exists for update
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = is_flight_update-carrid
        AND connid = is_flight_update-connid
        AND fldate = is_flight_update-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          UPDATE sflight CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF is_flight_update
            WHERE carrid = is_flight_update-carrid
              AND connid = is_flight_update-connid
              AND fldate = is_flight_update-fldate.

          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            rv_success = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
          MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Record not found
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    METHODS test_update_corresponding_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_corresponding_non_existent FOR TESTING.
  DATA: mv_original_price TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101'
                                   planetype = 'BOEING747' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ).
      mv_original_price = 1000.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    UPDATE sflight SET price = mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_corresponding_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = mv_original_price + 120.
    DATA(ls_update_data) = VALUE zcl_update_corresponding=>ty_flight_update_data(
      carrid = 'AA'
      connid = '0017'
      fldate = '20250101'
      price  = lv_new_price
      some_other_field = 'Test'
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_corresponding( ls_update_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_actual_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_new_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_corresponding_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_corresponding( ).
    DATA(ls_update_data) = VALUE zcl_update_corresponding=>ty_flight_update_data(
      carrid = 'WW'
      connid = '2222'
      fldate = '20250101'
      price  = 999
      some_other_field = 'Fail'
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_corresponding( ls_update_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF-Klausel ermöglicht das Aktualisieren von Datenbanktabellen aus einer Struktur, deren Felder teilweise mit denen der Datenbanktabelle übereinstimmen. Dies ist nützlich, um Daten aus einer flexiblen Quellstruktur zu verwenden. TRY...CATCH CX_SY_SQL_ERROR ist hier entscheidend, um Datenbankfehler abzufangen, die während der Operation auftreten können.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Enumerationstyp für Ampelphasen (ROT, GELB, GRÜN) und implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den nächsten Zustand in der Reihenfolge ROT -> GELB -> GRÜN -> ROT zurückgibt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_traffic_light DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_traffic_light_state.
             ENUM VALUE RED,
             ENUM VALUE YELLOW,
             ENUM VALUE GREEN.
           END OF ENUM t_traffic_light_state.

    METHODS: get_next_state
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_state TYPE t_traffic_light_state
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_state) TYPE t_traffic_light_state.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_traffic_light IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_state.
    CASE iv_current_state.
      WHEN RED.
        rv_next_state = YELLOW.
      WHEN YELLOW.
        rv_next_state = GREEN.
      WHEN GREEN.
        rv_next_state = RED.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem übergebenen Ampelphasen-Enumerationswert eine entsprechende Aktion (z.B. 'Stopp', 'Vorsicht', 'Fahren') als String zurückgibt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_traffic_light_state.
             ENUM VALUE RED,
             ENUM VALUE YELLOW,
             ENUM VALUE GREEN.
           END OF ENUM t_traffic_light_state.

    METHODS: get_action_for_state
      IMPORTING
        iv_state TYPE t_traffic_light_state
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_action_for_state.
    rv_action_text = SWITCH #( iv_state
      WHEN RED    THEN 'Stopp'
      WHEN YELLOW THEN 'Vorsicht'
      WHEN GREEN  THEN 'Fahren'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Zustand' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die Ampelphasen-Enumerationswerte enthält. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die alle Phasen durchläuft und deren String-Repräsentation zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration und `SWITCH` für die String-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_itabs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_traffic_light_state.
             ENUM VALUE RED,
             ENUM VALUE YELLOW,
             ENUM VALUE GREEN.
           END OF ENUM t_traffic_light_state.

    METHODS: get_all_states_as_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_state_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_itabs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_states_as_string.
    DATA(lt_states) = VALUE #( 
      ( zcl_enum_itabs=>t_traffic_light_state=>RED )
      ( zcl_enum_itabs=>t_traffic_light_state=>YELLOW )
      ( zcl_enum_itabs=>t_traffic_light_state=>GREEN )
    ).

    rt_state_names = VALUE #( FOR ls_state IN lt_states
      ( SWITCH #( ls_state
          WHEN zcl_enum_itabs=>t_traffic_light_state=>RED    THEN 'Rot'
          WHEN zcl_enum_itabs=>t_traffic_light_state=>YELLOW THEN 'Gelb'
          WHEN zcl_enum_itabs=>t_traffic_light_state=>GREEN  THEN 'Grün'
          ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS: test_get_all_states FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_states.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_enum_itabs( ).
    DATA(lt_state_names) = lo_cut->get_all_states_as_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_state_names ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_state_names[ 1 ] exp = 'Rot' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_state_names[ 2 ] exp = 'Gelb' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_state_names[ 3 ] exp = 'Grün' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von Enumerationstypen in internen Tabellen. Mit der `VALUE`-Operator-Syntax für die Initialisierung und der `FOR`-Iteration mit `SWITCH`-Expression wird eine sehr funktionale und moderne Art der Datenverarbeitung demonstriert, die den Code kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: ENUMERATION, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, SWITCH

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit einem Enumerationstyp für Wochentage (MONTAG bis SONNTAG). Die Klasse soll eine Methode `set_current_day` haben, die einen Wochentags-Enumerationswert als Importparameter akzeptiert und diesen in einem privaten Attribut speichert. Eine weitere Methode `get_current_day_name` soll den Namen des gespeicherten Tages als String zurückgeben.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Parameter und das Attribut mit dem Enumerationstyp. Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für die Namenskonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_day_param DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_weekday.
             ENUM VALUE MONDAY,
             ENUM VALUE TUESDAY,
             ENUM VALUE WEDNESDAY,
             ENUM VALUE THURSDAY,
             ENUM VALUE FRIDAY,
             ENUM VALUE SATURDAY,
             ENUM VALUE SUNDAY.
           END OF ENUM t_weekday.

    METHODS: set_current_day
      IMPORTING
        iv_day TYPE t_weekday.

    METHODS: get_current_day_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_name) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_current_day TYPE t_weekday.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_day_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_current_day.
    mv_current_day = iv_day.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_day_name.
    rv_day_name = SWITCH #( mv_current_day
      WHEN MONDAY    THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN TUESDAY   THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN WEDNESDAY THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN THURSDAY  THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN FRIDAY    THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN SATURDAY  THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN SUNDAY    THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_enum_day_param( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von Enumerationstypen als Methodenparameter und Klassenattribute. Dies fördert die Typsicherheit und Lesbarkeit des Codes, da die möglichen Werte für Wochentage klar definiert sind und nicht als generische Strings oder Integers übergeben werden müssen. Die `SWITCH`-Expression wird erneut für eine elegante Konvertierung verwendet.
keywords: ENUMERATION, Object Orientation, Methods, Parameters, Attributes

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String-Wert (z.B. 'RED') in den entsprechenden Ampelphasen-Enumerationswert umwandelt. Behandeln Sie ungültige Eingaben, indem Sie eine Ausnahme zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `COND` Expression mit `THROW` für die Konvertierung und Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_string_to_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_traffic_light_state.
             ENUM VALUE RED,
             ENUM VALUE YELLOW,
             ENUM VALUE GREEN.
           END OF ENUM t_traffic_light_state.

    METHODS: get_state_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_state_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_state) TYPE t_traffic_light_state
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_enum_error.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_string_to_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_state_from_string.
    rv_state = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_state_name = 'RED'    THEN RED
      WHEN iv_state_name = 'YELLOW' THEN YELLOW
      WHEN iv_state_name = 'GREEN'  THEN GREEN
      ELSE THROW cx_sy_dyn_enum_error( textid = cx_sy_dyn_enum_error=>invalid_enum_value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS: test_string_to_enum FOR TESTING,

  METHOD test_string_to_enum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_enum_string_to_enum( ).

    DATA(lv_state) = lo_cut->get_state_from_string( 'RED' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_state exp = zcl_enum_string_to_enum=>t_traffic_light_state=>RED ).

    lv_state = lo_cut->get_state_from_string( 'GREEN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_state exp = zcl_enum_string_to_enum=>t_traffic_light_state=>GREEN ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Umwandlung eines String-Wertes in einen Enumerationstyp unter Verwendung der `COND`-Expression mit `THROW`. Dies ist eine moderne und typsichere Methode, um dynamisch auf Enumerationswerte zuzugreifen und gleichzeitig eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für ungültige Eingaben zu gewährleisten, indem eine Ausnahme ausgelöst wird.
keywords: ENUMERATION, Dynamic Programming, COND, THROW, Exceptions

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und verknüpfen Sie diese mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft aus `SCARR`. Geben Sie Flugnummer, Datum und Fluggesellschaftsnamen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INNER JOIN ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: get_flights_with_carrier_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` und verknüpfen Sie diese mit der Anzahl der Buchungen aus `SBOOK`. Zeigen Sie auch Flüge ohne Buchungen an. Geben Sie Flugnummer, Datum und die Anzahl der Buchungen zurück (0, wenn keine Buchungen vorhanden sind).
hint: Nutzen Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und `COALESCE` oder `COUNT` mit `GROUP BY` für die Null-Behandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_left_outer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             booking_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_booking_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_booking_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: get_flights_with_booking_count
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_booking_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_left_outer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_booking_count.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, COUNT( b~carrid ) AS booking_count
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b
        ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      GROUP BY s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS: test_get_flights_with_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_left_outer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_booking_count( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_info ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_found_zero_bookings) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        IF ls_flight-booking_count = 0.
          lv_found_zero_bookings = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_zero_bookings msg = 'Should find flights with zero bookings' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und `COUNT` mit `GROUP BY`, um alle Flüge und deren Buchungsanzahl zu ermitteln, auch wenn keine Buchungen vorhanden sind. Die Aggregatfunktion `COUNT` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Anzahl der verknüpften Einträge zu erhalten, wobei `LEFT OUTER JOIN` sicherstellt, dass alle Flüge berücksichtigt werden.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SFLIGHTS, SBOOK, Database, COUNT, GROUP BY

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge von 'Frankfurt' nach 'New York' mit der Fluggesellschaft 'Lufthansa'. Geben Sie Flugnummer, Datum, Fluggesellschaftsnamen und Abflug-/Ankunftsstadt zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `INNER JOIN`s und eine `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_multiple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_route_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights).

CLASS zcl_join_cte DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_above_avg_bookings,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookings TYPE i,
             avg_bookings_per_carrier TYPE p DECIMALS 2,

CLASS zcl_join_cte IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_avg_bookings.
    WITH
      +avg_bookings AS (
        SELECT carrid, AVG( bookings ) AS avg_bks
          FROM sflight
          GROUP BY carrid
      )
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, s~bookings, a~avg_bks AS avg_bookings_per_carrier
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN +avg_bookings AS a ON s~carrid = a~carrid
      WHERE s~bookings > a~avg_bks
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid fldate. "Wichtig für aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate

  ENDMETHOD.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ).
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights. "Duplikat

    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights. "Duplikat

    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch und fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab, falls eine Division durch Null versucht wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_handle_zerodivide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. "General arithmetic error for other cases
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_handle_zerodivide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " Handle division by zero specifically
        MESSAGE 'Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        " Alternativ, einen Standardwert setzen oder eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslösen
        " rv_result = 0. " Oder ein anderer Standardwert
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Andere arithmetische Fehler abfangen
        MESSAGE 'Ein arithmetischer Fehler ist aufgetreten.' TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_handle_zerodivide( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 5.0
      msg = 'Die Division sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_handle_zerodivide( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE sollte ausgelöst werden.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE wurde korrekt abgefangen.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR wurde korrekt abgefangen.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH` Anweisung ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung. Spezifische Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` können gezielt abgefangen werden, um auf bestimmte Fehlerzustände zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Dies verbessert die Stabilität und Benutzerfreundlichkeit der Anwendung.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation durch, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ressourcen im `CLEANUP` Block freigegeben werden, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_resource_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Beispiel-Ausnahme
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA: lv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Simulieren des Öffnens einer Ressource
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        " Simulieren einer Operation, die fehlschlagen könnte
        IF iv_input = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide. " Beispiel-Ausnahme
        ELSEIF iv_input < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Ein weiteres Beispiel
        ENDIF.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        " Spezifische Ausnahme behandeln
        MESSAGE lx_arith->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CLEANUP.
        " Dieser Block wird immer ausgeführt, unabhängig von Ausnahmen
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          " Simulieren des Schließens der Ressource
          " z.B. CLOSE DATASET, FREE OBJECT, etc.
          lv_resource_open = abap_false.
          " cl_demo_output=>display( 'Resource wurde im CLEANUP geschlossen.' ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operation_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_exception RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resource_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_operation( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Operation sollte erfolgreich sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resource_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_operation( 0 ). " Dies wird CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE auslösen
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Ausnahme sollte ausgelöst werden.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Ausnahme wurde korrekt abgefangen.' ).
        " In einem realen Szenario könnte man prüfen, ob die Ressource geschlossen wurde.
        " Für dieses Beispiel gehen wir davon aus, dass der CLEANUP-Block funktioniert.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP` Block in einer `TRY...CATCH` Struktur ist entscheidend für die Sicherstellung der Ressourcenfreigabe. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY` Block verlassen wird, sei es durch normalen Programmfluss oder durch eine Ausnahme. Dies ist vergleichbar mit `finally` Blöcken in anderen Sprachen und hilft, Ressourcenlecks zu vermeiden und die Robustheit des Codes zu erhöhen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Exception Handling, Resource Management

Instructions: Löschen Sie Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer komplexen Bedingung, die mehrere Felder und logische Operatoren verwendet, unter Verwendung von `FOR` Iterationen und `CONDENSE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` Iterationen, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die zu behaltenden Zeilen enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_complex_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_complex_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_max_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_exclude_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_complex_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_complex_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE ty_t_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( ls_flight-price >= iv_min_price AND
              ls_flight-fldate <= iv_max_date AND
              ls_flight-carrid <> iv_exclude_carrid )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_complex_delete FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_delete.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_complex_cond=>ty_t_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights. " Keep
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20241231' price = '50'  currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights. " Delete (price < min_price)
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights. " Delete (date > max_date)
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '120' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights. " Keep
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20250101' price = '110' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights. " Delete (carrid = exclude_carrid)

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_complex_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_complex_flights(
      it_flights        = lt_flights
      iv_min_price      = '80'
      iv_max_date       = '20250101'
      iv_exclude_carrid = 'AA'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Es sollte 1 Eintrag nach dem komplexen Löschen übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[1]-carrid
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Der verbleibende Flug sollte UA sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FOR` Iterationen in Kombination mit einer `WHERE` Klausel innerhalb eines `VALUE` Ausdrucks ist ein sehr moderner und funktionaler Ansatz, um interne Tabellen zu manipulieren. Anstatt Zeilen explizit zu löschen, wird eine neue Tabelle erstellt, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die die komplexen Bedingungen erfüllen. Dies führt zu deklarativem und oft performanterem Code.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, VALUE, Functional Programming, Complex Condition

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, die beim Versuch auftritt, eine Methode dynamisch aufzurufen, die nicht existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_DYN_METH_NOT_FOUND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_call_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS dummy_method.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_call_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) EXPORTING dummy = 'X'. " Dummy-Export, falls Methode Parameter erwartet
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_not_found.
        MESSAGE 'Dynamisch aufgerufene Methode existiert nicht.' TYPE 'W'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim dynamischen Methodenaufruf.' TYPE 'W'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method.
    " Eine Methode, die existiert
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, die beim Versuch auftritt, auf ein nicht existierendes Feld einer Struktur dynamisch zuzugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_ASSIGN_CAST_ERROR` oder `CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE ty_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        ELSE.
          " Dies sollte normalerweise nicht erreicht werden, wenn CX_SY_ASSIGN_CAST_ERROR greift
          " Aber als Fallback für ältere Versionen oder andere Fehler
          MESSAGE 'Feld nicht gefunden.' TYPE 'W'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error. " Für nicht existierende Komponenten
        MESSAGE 'Feld ' && iv_field_name && ' existiert nicht in der Struktur.' TYPE 'W'.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error. " Für Typkonflikte beim Zuweisen
        MESSAGE 'Typkonflikt beim Zugriff auf Feld ' && iv_field_name && '.' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die in einer anderen internen Tabelle (als Referenz) enthalten sind, unter Verwendung eines funktionalen Ansatzes.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` oder `FOR` mit `NOT IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_by_reference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_key.
    TYPES ty_t_key TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        it_keys_to_delete TYPE ty_t_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_by_reference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_key.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights EXCEPT IN it_keys_to_delete WHERE carrid = carrid AND connid = connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_with_reference FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_delete_with_reference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_with_reference.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_by_reference=>ty_t_sflight,
          lt_keys    TYPE zcl_delete_by_reference=>ty_t_key.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights. " Delete
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' ) TO lt_flights. " Keep
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' ) TO lt_flights. " Keep

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_keys.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_reference( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_key(
      it_flights        = lt_flights
      it_keys_to_delete = lt_keys
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge nach dem Löschen übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[1]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Erster verbleibender Flug sollte LH sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_delete_with_reference.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_by_reference=>ty_t_sflight,
          lt_keys    TYPE zcl_delete_by_reference=>ty_t_key.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ) TO lt_keys.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_reference( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_key(
      it_flights        = lt_flights
      it_keys_to_delete = lt_keys
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Kein Eintrag sollte gelöscht werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator mit der `EXCEPT IN` Klausel ist ein sehr leistungsfähiges und modernes Feature, um Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, die in einer anderen Referenztabelle vorhanden sind. Dies ist eine deklarative und performante Alternative zu Schleifen mit `READ TABLE` oder `LOOP AT ... WHERE NOT LINE_EXISTS`. Es verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Effizienz bei der Tabellenmanipulation.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, FILTER, EXCEPT IN, Functional Programming, Reference Table

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, die beim Versuch auftritt, eine Datenbankoperation (z.B. `DELETE`) durchzuführen, die gegen eine Fremdschlüsselbeziehung verstößt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_SQL_ERROR` und prüfen Sie `SY-SUBRC` nach der Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_delete_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS delete_sflight_entry
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_delete_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_sflight_entry.
    TRY.
        DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = is_key-carrid
                               AND connid = is_key-connid
                               AND fldate = is_key-fldate.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
          MESSAGE 'Eintrag nicht gefunden oder anderer DB-Fehler.' TYPE 'W'.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_delete FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_foreign_key_violation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_delete.
    " Annahme: Ein Testeintrag existiert und kann gelöscht werden
    DATA: ls_key TYPE zcl_db_delete_handler=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_key = VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251231' ).

    " Sicherstellen, dass der Eintrag existiert (für den Test)
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251231' 
                                 planetype = '747' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 
                                 price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_delete_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->delete_sflight_entry( ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Löschen sollte erfolgreich sein.'
    ).
    " Aufräumen, falls der Test fehlschlägt und der Eintrag noch da ist
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = '20251231'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_foreign_key_violation.
    " Dieser Test ist schwierig ohne eine explizite Fremdschlüsselverletzung zu erzeugen.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde man versuchen, einen Flug zu löschen,
    " der noch in einer anderen Tabelle referenziert wird (z.B. SBOOK).
    " Für diesen Test simulieren wir einen Fehler, indem wir versuchen, einen nicht existierenden Flug zu löschen.
    DATA: ls_key TYPE zcl_db_delete_handler=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_key = VALUE #( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_delete_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->delete_sflight_entry( ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Löschen sollte fehlschlagen (z.B. wegen nicht existierendem Eintrag oder FK-Verletzung).' 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Datenbankoperationen wie `DELETE` können Ausnahmen auslösen, insbesondere wenn Integritätsbedingungen (wie Fremdschlüssel) verletzt werden. `CX_SY_SQL_ERROR` fängt generische SQL-Fehler ab. Die Kombination von `TRY...CATCH` mit der Prüfung von `SY-SUBRC` und explizitem `COMMIT WORK` / `ROLLBACK WORK` ist entscheidend für die robuste Behandlung von Datenbanktransaktionen in modernem ABAP.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception Handling, Database Operations, DELETE, SQL, CX_SY_SQL_ERROR, COMMIT, ROLLBACK

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine generische Ausnahme ab, wenn Sie nicht wissen, welche spezifische Ausnahme auftreten könnte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_ROOT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          " Simulieren einer beliebigen Ausnahme
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Alle Ausnahmen abfangen, die von CX_ROOT erben
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_no_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Operation sollte erfolgreich sein, wenn kein Fehler ausgelöst wird.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Operation sollte fehlschlagen und Ausnahme abfangen.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CATCH CX_ROOT` Block ist die umfassendste Möglichkeit, Ausnahmen abzufangen, da alle ABAP-Ausnahmen von `CX_ROOT` erben. Dies ist nützlich als Fallback-Mechanismus, um sicherzustellen, dass keine unerwarteten Ausnahmen das Programm zum Absturz bringen. In modernem ABAP wird jedoch empfohlen, spezifischere Ausnahmen abzufangen, wo immer möglich, um eine präzisere Fehlerbehandlung zu ermöglichen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception Handling, CX_ROOT, Generic Exception

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen Datensatz in eine Datenbanktabelle einzufügen. Fangen Sie spezifisch `cx_sy_open_sql_db` für Duplikate ab und alle anderen Fehler mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie mehrere `CATCH` Blöcke, beginnend mit der spezifischsten Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_specific_and_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flight_with_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_specific_and_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_with_handling.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = iv_carrid.
    ls_sflight-connid = iv_connid.
    ls_sflight-fldate = iv_fldate.
    ls_sflight-price = '500'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'USD'.

    TRY.
        INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_message = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } on { iv_fldate } inserted successfully.|.
        ELSE.
          " This branch is reached if INSERT fails without raising an exception (e.g., duplicate key without ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS)
          rv_message = |Insert failed for { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } on { iv_fldate } (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }).|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        IF lx_db_error->is_duplicate_key( ).
          rv_message = |Duplicate key error for flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } on { iv_fldate }.|.
        ELSE.
          rv_message = |Database error: { lx_db_error->get_text( ) }|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_modify_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

  METHOD upsert_flight.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_message = |Flight { is_flight_data-carrid } { is_flight_data-connid } on { is_flight_data-fldate } upserted successfully.|.

        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = |An unexpected error during upsert: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_upsert_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_modify_when_others( ).
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_db_modify_when_others=>ty_sflight_data.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'YY'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0002'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_flight-price = '200'.
    ls_flight-currency = 'USD'.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    INSERT INTO sflights VALUES ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid fldate = ls_flight-fldate price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    ls_flight-price = '250'. " Update price
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->upsert_flight( ls_flight ).

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Rohdaten. Fügen Sie nur gültige Datensätze in eine interne Tabelle ein und behandeln Sie ungültige Datensätze mit `WHEN OTHERS` innerhalb einer `REDUCE` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Tabelle zu aggregieren und `TRY...CATCH` für die Validierung jeder Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_processed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_raw_data
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data TYPE ty_t_raw_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE ty_t_processed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_when_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_raw_data.
    rt_processed_data = REDUCE ty_t_processed_data(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_t_processed_data( )
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
      LET lv_id_int = 0 IN
      TRY.
          lv_id_int = CONV i( ls_raw-id ).
          result = VALUE #( BASE result ( id = lv_id_int value = ls_raw-value ) ).
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
          " Log invalid data, e.g., to a separate internal table or CL_DEMO_OUTPUT
          cl_demo_output=>display( |Invalid data skipped: ID '{ ls_raw-id }', Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
      ENDTRY.
      IN result
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_itb_reduce_when_others=>ty_t_raw_data(
      ( id = '1' value = 'Valid A' )

      ( id = '2' value = 'Valid C' )

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_when_others( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).

Durch die Integration eines `TRY...CATCH WHEN OTHERS` Blocks innerhalb der `REDUCE` Schleife können ungültige Datensätze elegant übersprungen und Fehler protokolliert werden, ohne die Verarbeitung der gültigen Daten zu unterbrechen. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster für die Datenbereinigung und -transformation.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `INSERT FROM TABLE` mit `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` und einem `TRY...CATCH WHEN OTHERS` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_table_exc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flights_robust
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_table_exc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_robust.
    TRY.
        INSERT sflights FROM TABLE it_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
        rv_success_count = sy-dbcnt.
        IF sy-subrc = 4.
          cl_demo_output=>display( |{ lines( it_flights ) - sy-dbcnt } duplicate keys were skipped during insert.| ).
        ELSEIF sy-subrc <> 0.
          cl_demo_output=>display( |Unexpected error during mass insert (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }).| ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Critical error during mass insert: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
        rv_success_count = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `WHEN OTHERS` Block fängt alle anderen unerwarteten Systemfehler ab und verhindert Programmabbrüche.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation durch, die eine vordefinierte Ausnahme auslösen kann, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme sowie alle anderen möglichen Ausnahmen mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` für die spezifische Ausnahme und `TRY...CATCH` mit mehreren `CATCH` Blöcken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_raise_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE fltp
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_raise_when_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result_string = |Result: { divide_numbers( iv_numerator, iv_denominator ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result_string = |Arithmetic error: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result_string = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, indem Sie Daten aus einer Quelltabelle filtern und transformieren. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` mit `WHEN OTHERS` für die Fehlerbehandlung während der Transformation.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `COND` und `TRY...CATCH WHEN OTHERS` für eine deklarative und robuste Datenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_cond_exc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_transformed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_data_robust
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data TYPE ty_t_raw_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE ty_t_transformed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_cond_exc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data_robust.
    rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
                                   LET lv_id_int = 0 IN
                                   COND #( WHEN ls_raw-id IS NOT INITIAL
                                           THEN TRY.
                                                    lv_id_int = CONV i( ls_raw-id ).
                                                    ( id = lv_id_int value = ls_raw-value )
                                                  CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
                                                    cl_demo_output=>display( |Skipping invalid ID '{ ls_raw-id }': { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
                                                    " Return an empty structure to effectively skip this entry
                                                    VALUE zcl_itb_for_cond_exc=>ty_transformed_data( )
                                           ENDTRY
                                           ELSE
                                             cl_demo_output=>display( |Skipping empty ID for value '{ ls_raw-value }'.| ).
                                             VALUE zcl_itb_for_cond_exc=>ty_transformed_data( ) ) ).
    " Remove empty entries that resulted from skipped invalid data
    DELETE rt_transformed_data WHERE id IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( id = '2' value = 'Item Two' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ermöglicht eine hochgradig deklarative und robuste Datenverarbeitung, bei der ungültige Einträge elegant übersprungen und Fehler protokolliert werden, ohne den Fluss der gültigen Daten zu unterbrechen.
