ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_traffic_light_enum IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_phases = VALUE #( FOR phase IN ENUM OF traffic_light_phase ( phase ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_phases FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_phases.
    DATA(lo_traffic_light) = NEW zcl_traffic_light_enum( ).
    DATA(lt_phases) = lo_traffic_light->get_all_phases( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_phases ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_phases[ 1 ] ). " First enum value is initial by default
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_phases[ 2 ] exp = zcl_traffic_light_enum=>traffic_light_phase-yellow ).

explanation: Die `FOR ... IN ENUM OF` Syntax in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Iteration über alle Werte einer Enumeration. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, mit Enumerationsmengen zu arbeiten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String-Namen (z.B. 'RED') erhält und den entsprechenden Enumerationswert für eine Ampelphase (Rot, Gelb, Grün) zurückgibt. Falls der Name ungültig ist, soll ein Initialwert zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) über `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR` um dynamisch auf Enumerationswerte zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_light_phase,
             red,
             yellow,
             green,
           END OF ENUM traffic_light_phase.

    METHODS get_phase_by_name IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_phase) TYPE traffic_light_phase.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_phase_by_name.
    DATA: lo_enum_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_enumdescr.
    DATA: lv_value      TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_enum_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_ENUM_DYNAMIC_ACCESS=>TRAFFIC_LIGHT_PHASE' ).
        lv_value = lo_enum_descr->get_value_by_name( iv_name ).
        rv_phase = lv_value.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Name not found or other RTTI error, rv_phase remains initial
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_phase_by_name FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_phase_by_name.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_enum_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(lv_phase) = lo_accessor->get_phase_by_name( 'RED' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_phase exp = zcl_enum_dynamic_access=>traffic_light_phase-red ).

    lv_phase = lo_accessor->get_phase_by_name( 'GREEN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_phase exp = zcl_enum_dynamic_access=>traffic_light_phase-green ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_name.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_enum_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(lv_phase) = lo_accessor->get_phase_by_name( 'BLUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_phase ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) dynamisch auf Enumerationswerte zugreifen kann. Dies ist nützlich, wenn der Enumerationswert zur Laufzeit als String vorliegt, z.B. aus Konfigurationen oder externen Systemen. Die `CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR` Klasse bietet Methoden, um Enumerationen zu inspizieren und Werte zu konvertieren.
keywords: ENUMERATION, RTTI, DYNAMISCH, STRING ZU ENUM, CLASS

explanation: Die `FINAL`-Eigenschaft in der Klassendefinition verhindert die Vererbung der Klasse, was die Architektur klarer macht und unerwünschte Erweiterungen unterbindet. Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_SHAPE` mit einer Methode `GET_AREA`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: `ZCL_CIRCLE` und `ZCL_RECTANGLE`. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie, indem Sie die Fläche beider Formen über eine Interface-Referenz berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACES` in den Klassendefinitionen und `CREATE OBJECT` mit einer Interface-Referenz.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_width  TYPE decfloat16
                                  iv_height TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_width  TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_height TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_area IMPORTING it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_area.
    LOOP AT it_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      rv_total_area = rv_total_area + lo_shape->get_area( ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA: lo_shape_ref TYPE REF TO zif_shape.
    DATA: lt_shapes    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '7.0' ).
    DATA(lo_rectangle) = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_width = '5.0' iv_height = '10.0' ).

    APPEND lo_circle TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND lo_rectangle TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_total_area) = lo_processor->calculate_total_area( lt_shapes ).

    " Expected: Circle Area (approx 153.938) + Rectangle Area (50) = approx 203.938
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_area exp = '203.9380000000000000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces (`INTERFACE`) definieren einen Vertrag, den Klassen (`CLASS`) implementieren können. Dies ermöglicht Polymorphie, bei der verschiedene Objekte über eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle angesprochen werden können, obwohl sie unterschiedliche Implementierungen haben. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und flexible Architekturen.
keywords: INTERFACE, POLYMORPHIE, KLASSE, OBJEKTORIENTIERUNG, FINAL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DOCUMENT_FACTORY` mit einer statischen Methode `CREATE_DOCUMENT`, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. 'PDF', 'WORD') Instanzen von `ZIF_DOCUMENT` (mit Implementierungen `ZCL_PDF_DOCUMENT`, `ZCL_WORD_DOCUMENT`) zurückgibt. Die Factory soll die Erzeugung der konkreten Dokumentenobjekte kapseln.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_document PUBLIC.
  METHODS render_content RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document IMPLEMENTATION.

    mv_text = iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.

    rv_content = |PDF Content: { mv_text }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_text = iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document~render_content.
    rv_content = |Word Content: { mv_text }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_document IMPORTING iv_type TYPE string
                                            iv_text TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zif_document
                                  RAISING   cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    CASE iv_type CA 'PDF'.
      CREATE OBJECT ro_document TYPE zcl_pdf_document EXPORTING iv_text = iv_text.
    WHEN 'WORD'.
      CREATE OBJECT ro_document TYPE zcl_word_document EXPORTING iv_text = iv_text.
    WHEN OTHERS.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Unsupported document type: { iv_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_pdf FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_word FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_QUERY_BUILDER`, die Methoden wie `SELECT`, `FROM`, `WHERE` und `ORDER_BY` bereitstellt. Jede Methode soll die Instanz der Klasse zurückgeben, um Methodenaufrufe zu verketten (Fluent Interface). Fügen Sie eine `BUILD`-Methode hinzu, die den finalen SQL-String zurückgibt.
hint: Jede verkettenbare Methode muss `RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO ZCL_QUERY_BUILDER` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_query_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_fields IMPORTING it_fields TYPE string_table
                          RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_query_builder.
    METHODS from_table IMPORTING iv_table_name TYPE string
                         RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_query_builder.
    METHODS where_condition IMPORTING iv_condition TYPE string
                            RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_query_builder.
    METHODS order_by_fields IMPORTING it_fields TYPE string_table
                            RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_query_builder.
    METHODS build_query RETURNING VALUE(rv_query_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_select_clause TYPE string.
    DATA mv_from_clause   TYPE string.
    DATA mv_where_clause  TYPE string.
    DATA mv_order_by_clause TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_query_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_fields.
    mv_select_clause = |SELECT { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR field IN it_fields NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE |{ s }, { field }| ) ) }|.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD from_table.
    mv_from_clause = |FROM { iv_table_name }|.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD where_condition.
    mv_where_clause = |WHERE { iv_condition }|.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD order_by_fields.
    mv_order_by_clause = |ORDER BY { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR field IN it_fields NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE |{ s }, { field }| ) ) }|.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_query.
    rv_query_string = |{ mv_select_clause } { mv_from_clause } { mv_where_clause } { mv_order_by_clause }|.
    CONDENSE rv_query_string NO-GAPS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_query_builder FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_query_builder.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_query_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_query) = lo_builder->select_fields( VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ) )
                               ->from_table( 'SFLIGHTS' )
                               ->where_condition( 'CARRID = ''LH''' )
                               ->order_by_fields( VALUE string_table( ( 'CONNID' ) ) )
                               ->build_query( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_query) = 'SELECT CARRID,CONNID FROM SFLIGHTS WHERE CARRID = ''LH'' ORDER BY CONNID'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_query exp = lv_expected_query ).

    " Test with fewer clauses
    lv_query = lo_builder->select_fields( VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ) )
                          ->from_table( 'SFLIGHTS' )
                          ->build_query( ).
    lv_expected_query = 'SELECT CARRID FROM SFLIGHTS'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_query exp = lv_expected_query ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein Fluent Interface ermöglicht es, Methodenaufrufe zu verketten, was zu einem sehr lesbaren und kompakten Code führt, der oft einer natürlichen Sprache ähnelt. Jede Methode gibt dabei die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`me`) zurück. Dies ist ein modernes Designmuster, das die API-Nutzung intuitiver macht. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` und String-Templates trägt zur Modernität bei.
keywords: KLASSE, FLUENT INTERFACE, METHOD CHAINING, OBJEKTORIENTIERUNG, REDUCE, STRING TEMPLATES

Instructions: In einem Report, definieren Sie eine lokale Klasse `LCL_STRING_UTIL` zur Kapselung einer Hilfsfunktion (z.B. String-Umkehrung), die nur innerhalb dieses Reports benötigt wird. Verwenden Sie die lokale Klasse, um einen String umzukehren.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Klasse direkt im Report mit `CLASS LCL_... DEFINITION` und `CLASS LCL_... IMPLEMENTATION`.
solution:
REPORT z_local_class_demo.

CLASS lcl_string_util DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS reverse_string IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_reversed) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_string_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reverse_string.
    DATA: lv_length TYPE i.
    lv_length = strlen( iv_input ).
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      rv_reversed = rv_reversed && iv_input+((lv_length - sy-index)*1)(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DATA(lv_original) = 'Hello ABAP'.
  DATA(lv_reversed) = lcl_string_util=>reverse_string( lv_original ).

  WRITE: / 'Original:', lv_original.
  WRITE: / 'Reversed:', lv_reversed.

* Unit Test for local class (typically in a separate test include for global classes)
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reverse_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reverse_string.
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'SAP'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lcl_string_util=>reverse_string( lv_test_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'PAS' ).

    lv_test_string = '12345'.
    lv_result = lcl_string_util=>reverse_string( lv_test_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '54321' ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Lokale Klassen (`CLASS LCL_...`) ermöglichen die Kapselung von Hilfslogik direkt in der Programmeinheit, in der sie benötigt wird. Dies verbessert die Modularität und Lesbarkeit des Reports, da die Hilfsfunktionen klar abgegrenzt sind und keine globalen Objekte oder Prozeduren verschmutzen. `CLASS-METHODS` werden für Utility-Methoden verwendet, die keinen Objektzustand benötigen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_PROCESSOR`, die eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` Daten im Konstruktor erhält. Implementieren Sie eine Methode `get_flights_by_carrid`, die alle Flüge für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) zurückgibt, und nutzen Sie dabei moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die Tabellenoperation im `get_flights_by_carrid` Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DIVIDER` mit einer Methode `divide`, die zwei Zahlen dividiert. Fangen Sie die Division durch Null mit einer eigenen Exception-Klasse `ZCX_DIVISION_BY_ZERO` ab und werfen Sie diese bei Bedarf.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und nutzen Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide IMPORTING iv_numerator   TYPE i
                             iv_denominator TYPE i
                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
                   RAISING   zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_division_by_zero=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_divider( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_divider->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '5.0' ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected ZCX_DIVISION_BY_ZERO exception' ).

Durch das Erben von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` wird die Exception zu einer prüfbaren Exception, die vom Aufrufer explizit behandelt werden muss. Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Singleton-Designmuster für eine Klasse `ZCL_SINGLETON_LOGGER`. Die Klasse soll sicherstellen, dass nur eine Instanz existiert, und eine Methode `log_message` bereitstellen.
hint: Setzen Sie den Konstruktor auf `PRIVATE` und erstellen Sie eine statische `GET_INSTANCE`-Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_logger.
    METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_logger.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Private constructor to prevent direct instantiation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS NOT BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT go_instance.
    ENDIF.
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log file/table
    WRITE: / 'Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_logger1) = zcl_singleton_logger=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_logger2) = zcl_singleton_logger=>get_instance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_logger1 IS BOUND ).

    DATA(lo_logger) = zcl_singleton_logger=>get_instance( ).
    " This test primarily checks if the method can be called without error.

explanation: Das Singleton-Designmuster stellt sicher, dass eine Klasse nur eine einzige Instanz hat und einen globalen Zugriffspunkt auf diese Instanz bietet. Dies wird erreicht, indem der Konstruktor auf `PRIVATE` gesetzt und eine statische Methode (`GET_INSTANCE`) zur Instanziierung verwendet wird. Dies ist nützlich für Ressourcen wie Logger, Konfigurationsmanager oder Datenbankverbindungen, die systemweit einzigartig sein sollen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_LIST_PROCESSOR` mit einer Methode `process_list`, die eine Liste von Zahlen entgegennimmt und eine neue Liste zurückgibt, in der jede Zahl verdoppelt und dann nur die geraden Zahlen behalten werden. Nutzen Sie moderne funktionale Operatoren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `MAP` und `FILTER` für eine funktionale Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_list IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
                           RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_list.
    rt_processed_numbers = FILTER #( 
                                    FOR number IN it_numbers 
                                    LET doubled_number = number * 2 IN 
                                    WHERE ( doubled_number MOD 2 = 0 ) 
                                    ( doubled_number ) 
                                  ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY ( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
      DATA(lt_output) = lo_processor->process_list( lt_input ).

      DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY ( ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ( 6 ) ( 8 ) ( 10 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output exp = lt_expected ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_SALES_AGGREGATOR` mit einer Methode `aggregate_sales`, die eine interne Tabelle von Verkaufsdaten (z.B. `CARRID`, `PRICE`, `CURRENCY` aus `SFLIGHTS`) entgegennimmt und die Gesamtsumme des Preises pro Fluggesellschaft zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `GROUP BY` Klausel, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sales_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES: tt_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_sales,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_aggregated_sales.
    TYPES: tt_aggregated_sales TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_aggregated_sales WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS aggregate_sales IMPORTING it_sales_data TYPE tt_sales_items
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_sales) TYPE tt_aggregated_sales.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_sales.
    rt_aggregated_sales = REDUCE tt_aggregated_sales(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_aggregated_sales( )
      FOR GROUPS OF sales_item IN it_sales_data GROUP BY sales_item-carrid ASCENDING
      LET current_carrid = sales_item-carrid IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = current_carrid
                                           total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                                             INIT sum_price = 0
                                                             FOR member IN GROUP sales_item
                                                             NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_sales FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sales_data FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD test_aggregate_sales.
      DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sales_aggregator( ).
      DATA(lt_sales_data) = VALUE zcl_sales_aggregator=>tt_sales_items(
        ( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
        ( carrid = 'LH' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' )
        ( carrid = 'BA' price = '300.00' currency = 'GBP' )
      ).

      DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_sales( lt_sales_data ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 3 ).

      DATA(ls_lh_sales) = lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'LH' ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_sales-total_price exp = '250.00' ).

      DATA(ls_aa_sales) = lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'AA' ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_sales-total_price exp = '250.00' ).

      DATA(ls_ba_sales) = lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'BA' ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ba_sales-total_price exp = '300.00' ).
    ENDMETHOD.

    METHOD test_empty_sales_data.
      DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sales_aggregator( ).
      DATA(lt_sales_data) = VALUE zcl_sales_aggregator=>tt_sales_items( ).
      DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_sales( lt_sales_data ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_aggregated ).
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator mit `FOR GROUPS OF` ist ein sehr mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Aggregationslogik in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert. Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_SHAPE` mit einer Methode `GET_AREA`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen, `CL_CIRCLE` und `CL_RECTANGLE`. Erstellen Sie eine Liste von `IF_SHAPE`-Referenzen, die Instanzen beider Klassen enthält, und iterieren Sie durch diese Liste, um die Fläche jeder Form zu berechnen und auszugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACES` für die Definition und `LOOP AT` für die Iteration.
solution:
INTERFACE if_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_circle DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.1415926535'. " Simplified PI
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_rectangle DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_width TYPE decfloat16 iv_height TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_height TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shapes RETURNING VALUE(rt_areas) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW cl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW cl_rectangle( iv_width = '4' iv_height = '6' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW cl_circle( iv_radius = '10' ) TO lt_shapes.

    LOOP AT lt_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      APPEND lo_shape->get_area( ) TO rt_areas.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_shapes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_shapes.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_areas) = lo_processor->process_shapes( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_areas ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_areas[1] exp = '78.5398163375' ). " 5*5*PI
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_areas[2] exp = '24' ). " 4*6
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_areas[3] exp = '314.15926535' ). " 10*10*PI
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Eine Liste von Objekten, die dasselbe Interface implementieren, kann in einer Schleife verarbeitet werden, wobei die spezifische Implementierung der Methode zur Laufzeit aufgerufen wird. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und Erweiterbarkeit.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`). Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und die um 10% erhöhten Preise für Flüge von 'FRA' enthält, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_origin   TYPE sflight-airpfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
        WHERE ( airpfrom = iv_origin )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        price  = ls_sflight-price * '1.10' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Strategie-Muster zur Berechnung von Gesamtwerten. Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_AGGREGATION_STRATEGY` mit einer Methode `AGGREGATE` (nimmt eine Tabelle von Zahlen und gibt einen Einzelwert zurück). Implementieren Sie zwei Strategien: `CL_SUM_STRATEGY` (summiert alle Werte) und `CL_AVERAGE_STRATEGY` (berechnet den Durchschnitt). Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in einer Schleife, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `LOOP AT` über eine Liste von Strategien.
solution:
INTERFACE if_aggregation_strategy.
  METHODS aggregate
    IMPORTING
      it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_sum_strategy DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_aggregation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_sum_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_aggregation_strategy~aggregate.
    rv_result = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = '0' FOR value IN it_values NEXT sum = sum + value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_average_strategy DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_aggregation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_average_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_aggregation_strategy~aggregate.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = '0' FOR value IN it_values NEXT sum = sum + value ).
    IF lines( it_values ) > 0.
      rv_result = lv_sum / lines( it_values ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = '0'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregation_result,
             strategy_name TYPE string,
             result        TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_aggregation_result.
    TYPES: tt_aggregation_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregation_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_aggregations
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_aggregation_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_aggregations.
    DATA: lt_strategies TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_aggregation_strategy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW cl_sum_strategy( ) TO lt_strategies.
    APPEND NEW cl_average_strategy( ) TO lt_strategies.

    LOOP AT lt_strategies INTO DATA(lo_strategy).
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_strategy->aggregate( it_data ).
      DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_aggregation_result( result = lv_result ).

      " Determine strategy name for output (simplified, could use RTTI)
      IF lo_strategy IS INSTANCE OF cl_sum_strategy.
        ls_result-strategy_name = 'Sum'.
      ELSEIF lo_strategy IS INSTANCE OF cl_average_strategy.
        ls_result-strategy_name = 'Average'.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregations FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregations.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16( ( '10' ) ( '20' ) ( '30' ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_aggregator->perform_aggregations( it_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_sum_result) = lt_results[1].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sum_result-strategy_name exp = 'Sum' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sum_result-result exp = '60' ).

    DATA(ls_avg_result) = lt_results[2].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_avg_result-strategy_name exp = 'Average' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_avg_result-result exp = '20' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_data.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_aggregator->perform_aggregations( it_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_sum_result) = lt_results[1].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sum_result-strategy_name exp = 'Sum' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sum_result-result exp = '0' ).

    DATA(ls_avg_result) = lt_results[2].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_avg_result-strategy_name exp = 'Average' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_avg_result-result exp = '0' ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugnummer (`connid`). Für jede Gruppe sollen die Gesamtanzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) und die maximale Anzahl der Sitze (`seatsmax`) berechnet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             max_seats_available  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid )
                                                ASCENDING
                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_occupied) = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsocc
      ).
      DATA(lv_max_available) = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax(
        INIT max_val = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT max_val = nmax( val1 = max_val val2 = <fs_member>-seatsmax )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_flight(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid = ls_group_key-connid
        total_seats_occupied = lv_total_occupied
        max_seats_available = lv_max_available
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights( it_sflights = lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_group1) = lt_result[1]. " LH 0400

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_FLIGHT_FILTER` mit einer Methode `IS_MATCHING` (nimmt eine `sflight`-Struktur und gibt einen Boolean zurück). Implementieren Sie zwei Filterklassen: `CL_FILTER_BY_CARRIER` (filtert nach Fluggesellschaft) und `CL_FILTER_BY_MIN_PRICE` (filtert nach Mindestpreis). Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Filtern und wenden Sie diese in einer Schleife auf eine Tabelle von Flugdaten an, um nur die Flüge zu erhalten, die alle Filterkriterien erfüllen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT` über die Filterliste und `FILTER` für die Daten.
solution:
INTERFACE if_flight_filter.
  METHODS is_matching
    IMPORTING
      is_flight TYPE sflight
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_matches) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_filter_by_carrier DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_flight_filter.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_filter_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_flight_filter~is_matching.
    rv_matches = COND abap_bool( WHEN is_flight-carrid = mv_carrid THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_filter_by_min_price DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_flight_filter.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_min_price TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_filter_by_min_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min_price = iv_min_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_flight_filter~is_matching.
    rv_matches = COND abap_bool( WHEN is_flight-price >= mv_min_price THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS apply_filters
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_filters TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_flight_filter WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_filters.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.

    LOOP AT it_filters INTO DATA(lo_filter).
      rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( rt_filtered_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE is_matching( lo_filter = lo_filter ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_apply_filters FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_filters FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_apply_filters.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-price = '1000.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '1000'. <fs_sflight>-price = '500.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_sflight>-price = '1200.00'.

    DATA: lt_filters TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_flight_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND NEW cl_filter_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_filters.
    APPEND NEW cl_filter_by_min_price( iv_min_price = '800.00' ) TO lt_filters.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->apply_filters( it_flights = lt_test_sflights it_filters = lt_filters ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Strings. Iterieren Sie durch diese Tabelle und erstellen Sie einen einzelnen String, der alle Elemente durch ein Komma und Leerzeichen getrennt enthält, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die String-Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concatenator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concatenator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR ls_string IN it_strings
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN ls_string
        ELSE result && ', ' && ls_string
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_DATA_PROVIDER` mit einer Methode `GET_DATA` (gibt eine generische Tabelle zurück). Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen: `CL_FLIGHT_PROVIDER` (liefert `sflights`) und `CL_BOOKING_PROVIDER` (liefert `sbook`). Erstellen Sie eine Liste von `IF_DATA_PROVIDER`-Referenzen und iterieren Sie durch diese, um Daten abzurufen und die Anzahl der Zeilen jeder Tabelle auszugeben. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um den Typ der abgerufenen Daten zu identifizieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT` über die Provider-Liste und RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`) zur Typanalyse.
solution:
INTERFACE if_data_provider.
  METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_flight_provider DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_flight_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_provider~get_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_sflights INTO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_booking_provider DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_booking_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_provider~get_data.
    DATA: lt_sbook TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook.
    SELECT * FROM sbook INTO TABLE lt_sbook UP TO 10 ROWS.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_sbook INTO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_info,
             provider_name TYPE string,
             data_type     TYPE string,
             row_count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_info.
    TYPES: tt_data_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_providers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_data_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_providers.
    DATA: lt_providers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_data_provider WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW cl_flight_provider( ) TO lt_providers.
    APPEND NEW cl_booking_provider( ) TO lt_providers.

    LOOP AT lt_providers INTO DATA(lo_provider).
      DATA(lr_data) = lo_provider->get_data( ).
      CHECK lr_data IS BOUND.

      DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_data ).
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

      DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_data_info(
        data_type = lo_struct_descr->get_name( )
      ).

      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_result-row_count = lines( <fs_table> ).
      ENDIF.

      IF lo_provider IS INSTANCE OF cl_flight_provider.
        ls_result-provider_name = 'Flight Provider'.
      ELSEIF lo_provider IS INSTANCE OF cl_booking_provider.
        ls_result-provider_name = 'Booking Provider'.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND ls_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_providers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_providers.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_providers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_flight_result) = lt_results[1].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_result-provider_name exp = 'Flight Provider' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_result-data_type exp = 'SFLIGHT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight_result-row_count > 0 ). " Assuming sflight has data

    DATA(ls_booking_result) = lt_results[2].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_booking_result-provider_name exp = 'Booking Provider' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_booking_result-data_type exp = 'SBOOK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_booking_result-row_count > 0 ). " Assuming sbook has data
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Interfaces für polymorphes Daten-Retrieval mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um dynamisch den Typ und die Zeilenanzahl der abgerufenen Daten zu bestimmen. Die `LOOP AT`-Anweisung ermöglicht die Verarbeitung verschiedener Datenquellen über ein gemeinsames Interface, während RTTI die notwendige Flexibilität für die Typanalyse zur Laufzeit bietet.
keywords: INTERFACE, LOOP, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, Data References, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur Flüge enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt UND die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit mehreren `WHERE`-Bedingungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit verketteten `WHERE`-Klauseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
        WHERE ( price >= iv_min_price AND carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-price = '1000.00'.

    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_sflight>-price = '1200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '2000'. <fs_sflight>-price = '1500.00'.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights( it_sflights = lt_test_sflights
                                                iv_min_price = '900.00'
                                                iv_carrid    = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '1000'. <fs_sflight>-price = '500.00'.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights( it_sflights = lt_test_sflights
                                                iv_min_price = '900.00'
                                                iv_carrid    = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights( it_sflights = VALUE #( )
                                                iv_min_price = '900.00'

explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit mehreren `WHERE`-Bedingungen ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und lesbare Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt verschachtelte `IF`-Anweisungen in einer `LOOP AT`-Schleife zu verwenden, können komplexe Filterkriterien direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel formuliert werden, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht.
keywords: LOOP, FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Filtering

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_VALIDATOR` mit einer Methode `VALIDATE` (nimmt einen String und wirft eine Ausnahme, wenn ungültig). Implementieren Sie zwei Validatoren: `CL_NOT_EMPTY_VALIDATOR` und `CL_MIN_LENGTH_VALIDATOR`. Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Validatoren und iterieren Sie durch diese, um einen Eingabestring zu validieren. Fangen Sie die Ausnahmen in der Schleife ab und protokollieren Sie diese.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT` über die Validatoren und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcx_validation_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_validation_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_validator.
  METHODS validate IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RAISING zcx_validation_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_not_empty_validator DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_not_empty_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_validator~validate.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_validation_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_validation_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_min_length_validator DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_validator.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_min_length TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_min_length TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_min_length_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min_length = iv_min_length.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_validator~validate.
    IF strlen( iv_input ) < mv_min_length.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_validation_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_validation_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_validation_result,
             validator_name TYPE string,
             status         TYPE string,
             message        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_validation_result.
    TYPES: tt_validation_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_validation_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_validation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input     TYPE string
        it_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_validator WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_validation_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_validation.
    LOOP AT it_validators INTO DATA(lo_validator).
      DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_validation_result(
        status = 'OK'
      ).

      IF lo_validator IS INSTANCE OF cl_not_empty_validator.
        ls_result-validator_name = 'Not Empty Validator'.
      ELSEIF lo_validator IS INSTANCE OF cl_min_length_validator.
        ls_result-validator_name = 'Min Length Validator'.
      ENDIF.

      TRY.
          lo_validator->validate( iv_input ).
        CATCH zcx_validation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          ls_result-status = 'ERROR'.
          ls_result-message = lx_error->get_text( ).
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von Interfaces für ein flexibles Validierungssystem. Verschiedene Validierungsregeln werden als separate Klassen implementiert, die ein gemeinsames Interface teilen. Die `LOOP AT`-Anweisung ermöglicht die sequentielle Anwendung aller Validatoren auf einen Eingabestring. Die `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke innerhalb der Schleife fangen spezifische Validierungsfehler ab und ermöglichen eine detaillierte Fehlerprotokollierung, ohne den gesamten Prozess zu unterbrechen.
keywords: INTERFACE, LOOP, Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY CATCH, Object Orientation, Validation

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug das Flugdatum im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' und den Wochentag (z.B. 'Montag') enthält. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit String-Templates und Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR`, `VALUE`, String-Templates und `cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_date_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE string,
             weekday     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_flight.
    TYPES: tt_formatted_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_formatted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_flight_dates
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_data) TYPE tt_formatted_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_date_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_dates.
    rt_formatted_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        connid      = ls_flight-connid
        flight_date = |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|
        weekday     = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday_name( ls_flight-fldate ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_dates.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20251121'. " Friday

    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_flight_date_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_formatter->format_flight_dates( it_sflights = lt_test_sflights ).

    DATA(ls_flight1) = lt_result[1].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-flight_date exp = '2025-11-21' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_REPORT_SECTION` mit einer Methode `GET_CONTENT` (gibt einen String zurück). Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen: `CL_HEADER_SECTION` und `CL_DATA_SECTION` (nimmt eine Tabelle von Strings). Erstellen Sie eine Liste von `IF_REPORT_SECTION`-Referenzen und iterieren Sie durch diese, um einen vollständigen Bericht zu generieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT` über die Report-Sektionen und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
INTERFACE if_report_section.
  METHODS get_content RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_header_section DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_report_section.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_title TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_title TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_header_section IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_title = iv_title.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_report_section~get_content.
    rv_content = |Report: { mv_title }
{ sy-uline( strlen( mv_title ) + 8 ) }
|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_data_section DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_report_section.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_data_section IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_data = it_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_report_section~get_content.
    rv_content = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR ls_line IN mt_data
      NEXT result = result && ls_line && |
|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report
      IMPORTING
        iv_report_title TYPE string
        it_report_data  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_report) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA: lt_sections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_report_section WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW cl_header_section( iv_title = iv_report_title ) TO lt_sections.
    APPEND NEW cl_data_section( it_data = it_report_data ) TO lt_sections.

    rv_full_report = REDUCE string(
      INIT report = ``
      FOR lo_section IN lt_sections
      NEXT report = report && lo_section->get_content( )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen. Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Zahlen, die größer als 10 sind, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `REDUCE` und `WHERE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR`, `REDUCE` und `WHERE` für die bedingte Summierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_greater_than_ten
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_greater_than_ten.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
        WHERE ( lv_number > 10 )
      NEXT total = total + lv_number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_DATA_PROCESSOR` mit einer Methode `PROCESS` (nimmt eine generische Tabelle und gibt eine generische Tabelle zurück). Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen: `CL_UPPERCASE_PROCESSOR` (konvertiert alle String-Felder zu Großbuchstaben) und `CL_TRIM_PROCESSOR` (entfernt führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen von String-Feldern). Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Prozessoren und iterieren Sie durch diese, um eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) schrittweise zu transformieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT` über die Prozessoren und dynamische Feldzugriffe mit Feldsymbolen.
solution:
INTERFACE if_data_processor.
  METHODS process
    IMPORTING
      ir_input_data TYPE REF TO data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rr_output_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_uppercase_processor DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_uppercase_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_processor~process.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE string.

    ASSIGN ir_input_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA rr_output_data LIKE <lt_data>.
    ASSIGN rr_output_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lt_output>).

    LOOP AT <lt_data> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_output> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_output_line>).
      <ls_output_line> = <ls_line>.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_line> ) ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_output_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_component-type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          <lv_field> = to_upper( <lv_field> ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_trim_processor DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_trim_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_processor~process.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE string.

    ASSIGN ir_input_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA rr_output_data LIKE <lt_data>.
    ASSIGN rr_output_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lt_output>).

    LOOP AT <lt_data> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_output> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_output_line>).
      <ls_output_line> = <ls_line>.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_line> ) ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_output_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_component-type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          <lv_field> = trim( <lv_field> ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pipeline_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_pipeline
      IMPORTING
        ir_initial_data TYPE REF TO data
        it_processors   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_data_processor WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_processed_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pipeline_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_pipeline.
    rr_processed_data = ir_initial_data.

    LOOP AT it_processors INTO DATA(lo_processor).
      rr_processed_data = lo_processor->process( rr_processed_data ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,

    TYPES: tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES: tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_initial_data) = VALUE tt_test_data( ( id = 1 text = `  hello world  ` ) ).
    DATA lr_initial_data TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_initial_data INTO lr_initial_data.

    DATA(lo_pipeline) = NEW zcl_pipeline_processor( ).
    DATA(lr_processed_data) = lo_pipeline->process_data_pipeline( ir_initial_data = lr_initial_data it_processors = VALUE #( ) ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_result> TYPE tt_test_data.
    ASSIGN lr_processed_data->* TO <lt_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <lt_result> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_result> ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_result>[1]-text exp = `  hello world  ` ). " No change expected
  ENDMETHOD.

Jede Verarbeitungsschritt (Großbuchstaben, Trimmen) wird als separate Klasse implementiert, die ein gemeinsames Interface teilt. Die `LOOP AT`-Anweisung ermöglicht die sequentielle Anwendung dieser Prozessoren auf eine generische Tabelle. Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug eine Statusmeldung enthält: 'On Time' wenn das Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, 'Departed' wenn es in der Vergangenheit liegt, und 'Today' wenn es das aktuelle Datum ist. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR`, `VALUE` und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        connid      = ls_flight-connid
        flight_date = ls_flight-fldate
        status      = COND string(
          WHEN ls_flight-fldate > lv_today THEN 'On Time'
          WHEN ls_flight-fldate < lv_today THEN 'Departed'
          ELSE 'Today'
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_statuses FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_statuses.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_yesterday) = sy-datum - 1.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = sy-datum + 1.

    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = lv_tomorrow.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '1000'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = lv_today.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '2000'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = lv_yesterday.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_checker->get_flight_status( it_sflights = lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_flight1) = lt_result[1].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-status exp = 'On Time' ).

    DATA(ls_flight2) = lt_result[2].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-status exp = 'Today' ).

    DATA(ls_flight3) = lt_result[3].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-status exp = 'Departed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_checker->get_flight_status( it_sflights = VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` und der `COND`-Operator ermöglichen eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten während der Transformation einer internen Tabelle. Anstatt einer expliziten `LOOP AT`-Schleife mit `IF`-Anweisungen wird der Status direkt basierend auf dem Flugdatum zugewiesen, was den Code kürzer und funktionaler macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_DATA_ENRICHER` mit einer Methode `ENRICH` (nimmt eine `sflight`-Struktur und gibt eine angereicherte Struktur zurück). Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen: `CL_CURRENCY_CONVERTER` (fügt eine umgerechnete Währung hinzu) und `CL_ROUTE_CALCULATOR` (fügt die Flugdauer hinzu). Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Enrichern und iterieren Sie durch diese, um Flugdaten schrittweise anzureichern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT` über die Enricher und `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
INTERFACE if_data_enricher.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_enriched_flight,
           sflight_data TYPE sflight,
           additional_info TYPE string,
         END OF ty_enriched_flight.
  TYPES: tt_enriched_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_enriched_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS enrich
    IMPORTING
      is_flight TYPE sflight
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_enriched_flight) TYPE ty_enriched_flight.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_currency_converter DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_enricher.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_target_currency TYPE sflight-currency.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_target_currency TYPE sflight-currency.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_currency_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_target_currency = iv_target_currency.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_data_enricher~enrich.
    rs_enriched_flight-sflight_data = is_flight.
    " Simplified conversion: just append target currency
    rs_enriched_flight-additional_info = |Converted to { mv_target_currency }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_route_calculator DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_enricher.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_route_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_enricher~enrich.
    rs_enriched_flight-sflight_data = is_flight.
    " Simplified duration calculation
    rs_enriched_flight-additional_info = |Duration: { 2 + ( sy-tabix MOD 3 ) }h|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_enrichment_pipeline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_final_enriched_flight,
             sflight_data TYPE sflight,
             currency_info TYPE string,
             route_info    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_final_enriched_flight.
    TYPES: tt_final_enriched_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_final_enriched_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS run_enrichment_pipeline
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_enrichers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_data_enricher WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_final_enriched_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_enrichment_pipeline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_enrichment_pipeline.
    DATA: lt_intermediate_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF if_data_enricher=>ty_enriched_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(ls_current_enriched) = VALUE if_data_enricher=>ty_enriched_flight( sflight_data = ls_flight ).
      DATA(lv_currency_info) TYPE string.
      DATA(lv_route_info) TYPE string.

      LOOP AT it_enrichers INTO DATA(lo_enricher).
        DATA(ls_temp_enriched) = lo_enricher->enrich( ls_current_enriched-sflight_data ).
        IF lo_enricher IS INSTANCE OF cl_currency_converter.
          lv_currency_info = ls_temp_enriched-additional_info.
        ELSEIF lo_enricher IS INSTANCE OF cl_route_calculator.
          lv_route_info = ls_temp_enriched-additional_info.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_final_enriched_flight(
        sflight_data = ls_flight
        currency_info = lv_currency_info
        route_info = lv_route_info
      ) TO rt_enriched_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_enrichment_pipeline FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_enrichers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enrichment_pipeline.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-price = '1000.00'. <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '1000'. <fs_sflight>-price = '500.00'. <fs_sflight>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA: lt_enrichers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_data_enricher WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND NEW cl_currency_converter( iv_target_currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_enrichers.
    APPEND NEW cl_route_calculator( ) TO lt_enrichers.

    DATA(lo_pipeline) = NEW zcl_flight_enrichment_pipeline( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_pipeline->run_enrichment_pipeline( it_flights = lt_test_sflights it_enrichers = lt_enrichers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Strings, die jeweils durch Semikolon getrennte Werte enthalten (z.B. 'Wert1;Wert2;Wert3'). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Zeile eine interne Tabelle der einzelnen Werte enthält. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `SPLIT`.

CLASS zcl_string_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_string_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_split_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_string_list WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS split_lines_into_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_lines TYPE string_table
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_split_data) TYPE tt_split_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_lines_into_tables.
    rt_split_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_line IN it_lines
      ( VALUE tt_string_list(
          FOR <fs_part> IN ( SPLIT ls_line AT iv_delimiter )
          ( <fs_part> )
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_DATA_SERIALIZER` mit einer Methode `SERIALIZE` (nimmt eine generische Tabelle und gibt einen String zurück). Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen: `CL_CSV_SERIALIZER` und `CL_JSON_SERIALIZER`. Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Serializern und iterieren Sie durch diese, um eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in verschiedene Formate zu serialisieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT` über die Serializer und dynamische Feldzugriffe mit Feldsymbolen für die Serialisierung.
solution:
INTERFACE if_data_serializer.
  METHODS serialize
    IMPORTING
      ir_input_data TYPE REF TO data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_serialized_data) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_csv_serializer DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_serializer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_csv_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_serializer~serialize.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_input_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_header) TYPE string.
    DATA(lt_lines) TYPE string_table.

    IF <lt_data> IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_data>[1] ) ).
      lv_header = REDUCE string(
        INIT h = ``
        FOR ls_comp IN lo_struct_descr->components
        NEXT h = COND string( WHEN h IS INITIAL THEN ls_comp-name ELSE h && ',' && ls_comp-name )
      ).
      APPEND lv_header TO lt_lines.

      LOOP AT <lt_data> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
        DATA(lv_line_content) = REDUCE string(
          INIT l = ``
          FOR ls_comp IN lo_struct_descr->components
          NEXT l = COND string(
            WHEN l IS INITIAL THEN |
              { CONV string( COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> ) }|
            ELSE l && ',' && |
              { CONV string( COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> ) }|
          )
        ).
        APPEND lv_line_content TO lt_lines.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    rv_serialized_data = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_output_line IN lt_lines
      NEXT s = s && ls_output_line && |
|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_json_serializer DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_serializer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_json_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_serializer~serialize.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_input_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( EXPORTING data = <lt_data> PRETTY_PRINT = abap_true IMPORTING json = rv_serialized_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_serialization_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_serialized_output,
             format TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_serialized_output.
    TYPES: tt_serialized_outputs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_serialized_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_data_to_formats
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_to_serialize TYPE REF TO data
        it_serializers       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_data_serializer WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_outputs) TYPE tt_serialized_outputs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_serialization_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_data_to_formats.
    LOOP AT it_serializers INTO DATA(lo_serializer).
      DATA(ls_output) = VALUE ty_serialized_output(
        content = lo_serializer->serialize( ir_data_to_serialize )
      ).

      IF lo_serializer IS INSTANCE OF cl_csv_serializer.
        ls_output-format = 'CSV'.
      ELSEIF lo_serializer IS INSTANCE OF cl_json_serializer.
        ls_output-format = 'JSON'.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_output TO rt_outputs.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft, die Flugnummer und eine Liste der Passagiere (aus `sbook`) enthält, die diesen Flug gebucht haben. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und einer geschachtelten `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und einer geschachtelten `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE` für die Verknüpfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_info,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             custtype TYPE sbook-custtype,
             passname TYPE sbook-passname,
           END OF ty_passenger_info.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_passengers,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             passengers  TYPE tt_passenger_info,
           END OF ty_flight_with_passengers.
    TYPES: tt_flights_with_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_passengers_to_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_sbook    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_passengers) TYPE tt_flights_with_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_passengers_to_flights.
    rt_flights_with_passengers = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        connid      = ls_flight-connid
        fldate      = ls_flight-fldate
        passengers  = VALUE tt_passenger_info(
          FOR ls_booking IN it_sbook
            WHERE ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
          ( bookid = ls_booking-bookid
            custtype = ls_booking-custtype
            passname = ls_booking-passname )
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Preise aller Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine LOOP-Anweisung mit Inline-Deklaration und die ADD-Anweisung zur Akkumulation.

CLASS zcl_add_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      ADD ls_flight-price TO rv_total_price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_add_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
