Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden und eine bestimmte Währung haben.
hint: Kombiniere `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine effiziente Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filtered_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_date     TYPE s_date
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filtered_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN FILTER #( lt_sflights
                                                               WHERE fldate > iv_date AND currency = iv_currency )
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filtered_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_filter_date) = '19900101'. " Choose a date that will likely yield results
    DATA(lv_filter_currency) = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight WHERE fldate > lv_filter_date AND currency = lv_filter_currency INTO lv_expected_sum.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sum( iv_date = lv_filter_date iv_currency = lv_filter_currency ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Filtered sum should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filtered_sum( ).

    DATA(lv_filter_currency) = 'XYZ'. " Non-existent currency

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sum( iv_date = lv_filter_date iv_currency = lv_filter_currency ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = 0 msg = 'Sum for no matching flights should be 0' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination des `FILTER`-Operators mit `REDUCE`. Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle `lt_sflights` mit `FILTER` basierend auf dem Flugdatum und der Währung gefiltert. Anschließend wird der `REDUCE`-Operator auf die gefilterte Ergebnismenge angewendet, um die Summe der Preise zu berechnen. Instructions: Erstelle eine Hash-Map (interne Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel), die die Flugnummer (CONNID) als Schlüssel und den Flugpreis (PRICE) als Wert enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die noch nicht storniert wurden (angenommen, ein Status 'C' bedeutet storniert).
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` um eine Hash-Map zu füllen. Beachte, dass `sflight` keinen Status hat, daher wird hier ein fiktiver Status 'X' für nicht storniert angenommen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_map_entry,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price_map_entry.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_price_map_entry
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY connid.

    METHODS get_flight_price_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_map) TYPE tt_flight_price_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_map.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Fiktiver Status: Wir nehmen an, dass alle Flüge in sflight nicht storniert sind
    " oder filtern nach einem fiktiven Statusfeld, falls vorhanden.
    " Da sflight keinen Status hat, filtern wir hier nicht, sondern fügen alle hinzu.
    " Wenn ein Statusfeld existieren würde, könnte man es in der WHERE-Klausel nutzen.

    rt_flight_map = REDUCE tt_flight_price_map(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_price_map( )
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      " WHERE ( status <> 'C' ) " <--- Würde hier stehen, wenn sflight ein Statusfeld hätte
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                              ( connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                price  = <fs_sflight>-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unique_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_to_map( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_map) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_map( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_map msg = 'Map should not be empty' ).

    " Check a specific entry (adjust based on sflight data)
    DATA(ls_entry) = lt_flight_map[ connid = '0400' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    IF ls_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-price exp = '400.00' msg = 'Price for CONNID 0400 should be 400.00' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unique_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_to_map( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_map) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_map( ).

    DATA(lv_count_sflight) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_count_sflight.

    " Note: sflight can have duplicate CONNID for different FLDATE. 
    " The HASHED TABLE will only keep the first entry for a given CONNID.
    " So, the count of the map might be less than the total sflight entries.
    " We assert that the map size is at most the number of sflight entries.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_flight_map ) <= lv_count_sflight ) msg = 'Map size should be <= sflight count' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet werden kann, um eine interne Tabelle in eine Hash-Map (hier eine `HASHED TABLE` mit eindeutigem Schlüssel) umzuwandeln. Für jeden Eintrag in der Quelltabelle wird ein neuer Eintrag in die Ziel-Hash-Map eingefügt. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Datenstrukturen zu transformieren und gleichzeitig die Vorteile von Hash-Tabellen (schneller Zugriff) zu nutzen.
keywords: REDUCE, Hash Map, Data Structures, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge pro Währung in der Tabelle `sflight` und gib das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle mit Währung und Anzahl zurück.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_currency_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_count,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_currency_count.
    TYPES tt_currency_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_currency_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_currency_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_currency_counts) TYPE tt_currency_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_currency_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_currency_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_currency_counts = REDUCE tt_currency_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_currency_count( )
      FOR GROUPS <fs_group> OF sflight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( currency = sflight-currency )
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                              ( currency = <fs_group>-currency
                                count    = GROUP SIZE IN <fs_group> ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme für ein gegebenes Flugdatum, ob es in der Vergangenheit, Gegenwart oder Zukunft liegt. Gib einen entsprechenden Text zurück.
hint: Verwende `COND` mit `WHEN` und Datumsvergleichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_time_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_period_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_flight_date.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rv_period_text = COND string(
                       WHEN iv_fldate < lv_current_date THEN 'Vergangenheit'
                       WHEN iv_fldate = lv_current_date THEN 'Gegenwart'
                       WHEN iv_fldate > lv_current_date THEN 'Zukunft'
                       ELSE 'Ungültiges Datum'
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis enthält, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Mindestwert liegt.
hint: Kombiniere `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price_per_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_stats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price_per_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_stats = REDUCE tt_carrier_stats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_stats( )
      FOR GROUPS <fs_group> OF sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price )
      GROUP BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid )
      LET flight_count = GROUP SIZE IN <fs_group>
          total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight IN <fs_group> NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                              ( carrid        = <fs_group>-carrid
                                flight_count  = flight_count
                                avg_price     = COND s_price(
                                                    WHEN flight_count > 0 THEN total_price / flight_count
                                                    ELSE 0
                                                  )
                              ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_carrier_stats_with_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_carrier_stats_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_stats_with_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_avg_price_per_carr( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = '300.00'. " Filter for prices > 300
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_carrier_stats( lv_min_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_stats msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Example assertion for LH (adjust based on sflight data and filter)
    DATA(ls_lh_stats) = lt_stats[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    IF ls_lh_stats IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND price > lv_min_price INTO lv_expected_count.
      SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND price > lv_min_price INTO lv_expected_sum.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_stats-flight_count exp = lv_expected_count msg = 'LH flight count should match' ).
      IF lv_expected_count > 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_stats-avg_price exp = ( lv_expected_sum / lv_expected_count ) msg = 'LH average price should match' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_stats-avg_price exp = 0 msg = 'LH average price should be 0 if no flights' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_carrier_stats_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_avg_price_per_carr( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = '99999.00'. " Filter for very high prices, likely no matches
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_carrier_stats( lv_min_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_stats msg = 'Result table should be empty if no matches' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE`, `FOR GROUPS` und `FILTER` für eine mehrstufige Datenaggregation. Zuerst wird die `sflight`-Tabelle nach einem Mindestpreis gefiltert. Dann werden die gefilterten Flüge nach `CARRID` gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird die Anzahl der Flüge (`GROUP SIZE`) und die Summe der Preise (erneut mit `REDUCE`) berechnet. Schließlich wird der Durchschnittspreis mit `COND` ermittelt, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Ausdrücke für komplexe Analysen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, FILTER, COND, WHEN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping, Average, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) und Flugnummern (CONNID) aus `sflight` enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_future_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_future_flight.
    TYPES tt_future_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_future_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_future_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE tt_future_flights(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
      ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
        connid = <fs_sflight>-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_future_flights_exist FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_future_flights_content FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights_exist.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE fldate > sy-datum INTO lv_expected_count.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_future_flights ) exp = lv_expected_count msg = 'Number of future flights should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_future_flights_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Check if all entries in the result actually have a future date
    LOOP AT lt_future_flights INTO DATA(ls_future_flight).
      DATA(ls_original_sflight) = VALUE sflight( ).
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_original_sflight
        WHERE carrid = ls_future_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_future_flight-connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_original_sflight-fldate > sy-datum ) msg = 'Flight date should be in the future' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Bestimme für einen gegebenen Flugpreis, ob er als 'Günstig', 'Normal' oder 'Teuer' einzustufen ist, basierend auf vordefinierten Schwellenwerten (z.B. < 200 Günstig, 200-500 Normal, > 500 Teuer).

CLASS zcl_price_category_determiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_price_category_determiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_category.
    rv_category = COND string(

                    WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN 'Teuer'
                    ELSE 'Unbekannt'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die von 'NEW YORK' (CITYFROM) starten und deren Währung 'USD' ist.
hint: Kombiniere `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und `FILTER` für die Vorfilterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_ny_usd_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ny_usd_stats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_ny_usd_stats.
    TYPES tt_ny_usd_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ny_usd_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ny_usd_flight_stats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ny_usd_stats) TYPE tt_ny_usd_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_ny_usd_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_usd_flight_stats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_ny_usd_stats = REDUCE tt_ny_usd_stats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_ny_usd_stats( )
      FOR GROUPS <fs_group> OF sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND currency = 'USD' )
      GROUP BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid )
      LET flight_count = GROUP SIZE IN <fs_group>
          total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight IN <fs_group> NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                              ( carrid        = <fs_group>-carrid
                                flight_count  = flight_count
                                total_price   = total_price
                              ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_ny_usd_stats FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ny_usd_stats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_ny_usd_stats( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_ny_usd_flight_stats( ).

    " Assuming there are flights from 'NEW YORK' with 'USD' currency in sflight
    DATA(lv_expected_count_aa) = 0.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum_aa) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND currency = 'USD' INTO lv_expected_count_aa.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND currency = 'USD' INTO lv_expected_sum_aa.

    DATA(ls_aa_stats) = lt_stats[ carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    IF ls_aa_stats IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_stats-flight_count exp = lv_expected_count_aa msg = 'AA flight count from NY in USD should match' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_stats-total_price exp = lv_expected_sum_aa msg = 'AA total price from NY in USD should match' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_ny_usd_flights.
    " This test assumes no flights from 'BERLIN' with 'JPY' currency exist in sflight
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_ny_usd_stats( ).
    " Temporarily modify sflight data for testing if needed, or rely on typical sflight content
    " For this test, we'll just check if the result is initial if no such data exists.
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_ny_usd_flight_stats( ).

    DATA(lv_check_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND currency = 'USD' INTO lv_check_count.

    IF lv_check_count = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_stats msg = 'Result table should be empty if no matching flights' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_stats msg = 'Result table should not be empty if matching flights exist' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine weitere komplexe Datenaggregation unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`, `FOR GROUPS` und `FILTER`. Zuerst wird die `sflight`-Tabelle nach Flügen gefiltert, die von 'NEW YORK' starten und in 'USD' bezahlt werden. Anschließend werden diese gefilterten Flüge nach `CARRID` gruppiert. Für jede Gruppe werden die Anzahl der Flüge (`GROUP SIZE`) und der Gesamtpreis (mittels eines verschachtelten `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks) berechnet. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Art, spezifische Datenanalysen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, FILTER, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping, Sum, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzauslastung (`seatsocc` / `seatsmax`) und die Gesamtzahl der Flüge. Zeigen Sie nur Gesellschaften an, die mehr als 10 Flüge haben. Verwenden Sie moderne Open SQL-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `AVG`, `COUNT`, `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_agg_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_stats RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_agg_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    SELECT carrid,
           AVG( CAST( seatsocc AS FLTP ) / CAST( seatsmax AS FLTP ) ) AS avg_occupancy,
           COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_agg_group( ).

    ELSE.

CLASS zcl_select_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_select_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lv_min_price) = 500.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)
      WHERE price > @lv_min_price.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_from_defunct_carriers.
    " For demonstration, we assume SCARR has a 'status' field and some carriers are 'defunct'.
    " In a real scenario, SCARR would need to be extended or a custom table used.
    " We'll simulate a defunct carrier 'XX' for testing.

    " Simulate defunct carrier 'XX' in SCARR for testing purposes
    INSERT scarr FROM @( VALUE scarr( carrid = 'XX' carrname = 'Defunct Airlines' currcode = 'USD' url = 'http://defunct.com' ) ).
    " Insert some flights for 'XX'
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'BOEING' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20230102' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'AIRBUS' seatsmax = 120 seatsocc = 60 )
    ) ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN (
      SELECT carrid FROM scarr WHERE carrid = 'XX' " Simulating 'status = defunct'
    ).

Instructions: Löschen Sie aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen alle Einträge, bei denen der Preis unter 100 liegt ODER die Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist und das Flugdatum vor 2022 liegt. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Löschbedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE it_flights WHERE ( COND #( WHEN price < 100 THEN abap_true WHEN carrid = 'AA' AND fldate < '20220101' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_cond_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_conditional_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_cond_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_conditional_flights.
    rt_remaining_flights = it_flights.

    DELETE rt_remaining_flights WHERE ( COND #( WHEN price < 100 THEN abap_true
                                                WHEN carrid = 'AA' AND fldate < '20220101' THEN abap_true
                                                ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_conditional_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_conditional_flights.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_delete_cond_logic=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' price = '50.00' )   " Delete (price < 100)"
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20230102' price = '150.00' )  " Keep
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20210101' price = '200.00' )  " Delete (carrid = AA AND fldate < 2022)"
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20230101' price = '250.00' )  " Keep
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' price = '90.00' )   " Delete (price < 100)"
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_cond_logic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_conditional_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of remaining flights' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH 0002 should remain' act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0002 should remain' act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung des `COND`-Operators innerhalb der `WHERE`-Klausel einer `DELETE`-Anweisung für interne Tabellen ermöglicht die Definition komplexer, mehrteiliger Löschbedingungen auf eine sehr deklarative und lesbare Weise. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Statements.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT und transformieren Sie die Daten direkt in eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer den Preis als String mit Währungssymbol enthält (z.B. '123.45 EUR'). Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FROM sflight FOR ALL ENTRIES IN ...` und `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... ) )` mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_flight.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_data.

    rt_formatted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_data
                                    ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                      connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                      fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                      price_text = |{ ls_flight-price ALPHA = OUT } { ls_flight-currency }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugnummern (`connid`) der Fluggesellschaft 'AZ' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in eine interne Tabelle von skalaren Werten. Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE` um einen einzelnen Flug zu sperren und dann `SELECT DISTINCT` um alle eindeutigen Flugnummern zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT DISTINCT connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_connids) WHERE carrid = 'AZ'.`
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_distinct_az_connids RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_az_connids.
    " First, demonstrate SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE (conceptual, as it requires a COMMIT/ROLLBACK context)
    DATA(lv_carrid_for_lock) = 'AZ'.
    DATA(lv_connid_for_lock) = '0001'. " Assuming this flight exists
    DATA ls_sflight_lock TYPE sflight.

    " This part is conceptual for demonstration of FOR UPDATE. In a real scenario,
    " it would be part of a transaction and require error handling for locks.
    TRY.
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight_lock
          WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_for_lock AND connid = @lv_connid_for_lock
          FOR UPDATE.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db_error.
        " Handle locking error
    ENDTRY.

    " Now, the actual request: SELECT DISTINCT
    SELECT DISTINCT connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_connids
      WHERE carrid = 'AZ'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `SELECT DISTINCT` ist die Standardmethode, um nur eindeutige Werte für die selektierten Felder zu erhalten. `SELECT FOR UPDATE` wird verwendet, um Zeilen in der Datenbank zu sperren und so Konsistenz bei Schreibzugriffen zu gewährleisten, ist aber transaktionsabhängig.
keywords: SELECT, DISTINCT, FOR UPDATE, Database Access, Locking

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, deren Flugnummern in einer internen Tabelle von Flugnummern enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM ... WHERE IN`.

CLASS zcl_delete_where_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_delete_where_in IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT, deren Flugdatum im aktuellen Jahr liegt und deren Preis über einem dynamisch übergebenen Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit String-Templates für die `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FROM sflight WHERE (lv_dynamic_where) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).` und String-Templates für `lv_dynamic_where`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_current_year_dynamic_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_current_year_dynamic_price.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_date_from) = lv_current_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_date_to) = lv_current_year && '1231'.

    DATA(lv_dynamic_where) = |
      fldate BETWEEN '{ lv_date_from }' AND '{ lv_date_to }'
      AND price > { iv_min_price }
    |.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE (lv_dynamic_where).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_current_year_dynamic_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_current_year_dynamic_price.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    " Setup: Insert test data for current year
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = lv_current_year && '0301' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = lv_current_year && '0601' price = '250.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = lv_current_year && '0901' price = '350.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0004' fldate = ( lv_current_year - 1 ) && '0101' price = '400.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 ) " Old year
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_current_year_dynamic_price( iv_min_price = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of flights' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH 0002 should be present' act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0003 should be present' act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).

    " Cleanup
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'BA') AND connid IN ('0001', '0002', '0003', '0004').
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' und 'LH' unter Verwendung des VALUE-Operators und einer FOR-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' OR carrid = 'LH' )
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                             connid = flight-connid,
                             fldate = flight-fldate,
                             price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrier must be AA or LH' act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering

CLASS zcl_flights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.

CLASS zcl_flights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flights( carrid = ls_flight-carrid

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion in modernem ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu aggregieren. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was die Berechnung von Aggregaten wie der Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft vereinfacht.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seinem Preis einen Status ('Günstig', 'Normal', 'Teuer') zu. Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                             connid = flight-connid,
                             price  = flight-price,
                             status = COND string( WHEN flight-price < 500 THEN 'Günstig'
                                                    WHEN flight-price >= 500 AND flight-price < 1000 THEN 'Normal'
                                                    ELSE 'Teuer' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_status_assignment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_assignment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price < 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Günstig' act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Günstig' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-price >= 500 AND ls_flight-price < 1000.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Normal' act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Normal' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Teuer' act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Teuer' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen, ähnlich einem `CASE`-Statement oder verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen, jedoch in einem Ausdruck. Dies macht den Code kompakter und besser lesbar, insbesondere in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
keywords: VALUE, COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und modifizieren Sie Einträge direkt mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_name>)` für direkten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      CHANGING ct_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
        <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.10'. " Preise um 10% erhöhen
      ELSEIF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
        <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.05'. " Preise um 5% erhöhen
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_price_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_update.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' price = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' price = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '003' price = 300 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_update( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_prices( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_aa) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA price should be updated by 10%' act = ls_aa-price exp = 110 ).

    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_lh) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH price should be updated by 5%' act = ls_lh-price exp = 210 ).

    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_ba) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'BA price should not change' act = ls_ba-price exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>`-Anweisung ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung von Tabellenzeilen, ohne dass die Zeile explizit modifiziert und dann wieder in die Tabelle geschrieben werden muss. Dies ist effizienter und führt zu kürzerem Code, da der Field-Symbol direkt auf den Speicherbereich der Tabellenzeile zeigt.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGNING, Field-Symbols, Internal Tables, Modification

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft eine Liste ihrer Flüge enthält. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ... ( ... VALUE #( FOR ... IN GROUP ... ) ) )`.

CLASS zcl_nested_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights_nested,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_details,

CLASS zcl_nested_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    rt_nested_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                                  GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                    flights = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                       ( connid = member-connid,
                                                         fldate = member-fldate,
                                                         price  = member-price ) ) ) ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

Anstatt manuell zu gruppieren und Untertabellen zu befüllen, kann dies in einem einzigen Ausdruck erfolgen, was den Code extrem kompakt und verständlich macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('AA') unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price_aa) = lo_cut->get_average_price_for_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average price for AA should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_avg_price_aa > 0 ) ).

    DATA(lv_avg_price_xx) = lo_cut->get_average_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price for non-existent carrier should be 0' act = lv_avg_price_xx exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen, die eine Iteration über eine Datenmenge erfordern, um einen einzelnen Wert zu berechnen. Er macht den Code für solche Szenarien sehr prägnant und funktional, indem er eine Initialisierung, eine Schleife und eine Akkumulationslogik in einem Ausdruck zusammenfasst.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Math, Internal Tables, Expressions

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation auf einer internen Tabelle durch, indem Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `LET` für lokale Hilfsvariablen verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... LET ... IN ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             original_price TYPE sflight-price,
             discounted_price TYPE sflight-price,
             discount_applied TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_discounted_flights
      IMPORTING iv_discount_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           LET lv_is_expensive = COND abap_bool( WHEN flight-price > 800 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
                               lv_discount = COND sflight-price( WHEN lv_is_expensive = abap_true THEN flight-price * iv_discount_rate ELSE 0 )
                           IN
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                             connid = flight-connid,
                             original_price = flight-price,
                             discounted_price = flight-price - lv_discount,
                             discount_applied = lv_is_expensive ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_discount_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discount_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_discounted_flights( '0.10' ). " 10% Rabatt

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-original_price > 800.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Discount should be applied for expensive flights' act = ls_flight-discount_applied ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Discounted price calculation incorrect' act = ls_flight-discounted_price exp = ls_flight-original_price * '0.90' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Discount should not be applied for cheap flights' act = ls_flight-discount_applied ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should not change for cheap flights' act = ls_flight-discounted_price exp = ls_flight-original_price ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LET`-Operator innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen, die nur innerhalb des Ausdrucks gültig sind. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung komplexer Transformationen, indem Zwischenergebnisse oder bedingte Werte klar definiert werden können, ohne den globalen Kontext zu belasten.

CLASS zcl_carrier_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_carrier_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_list_string.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

      INIT result = ``
      FOR carrier IN lt_scarr

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('AA') unter Verwendung von `LOOP AT` und `MAX` in einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )` mit einer Vergleichslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_highest_price_flight
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight_key) TYPE ty_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      CLEAR rs_flight_key.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_highest_price_flight) = REDUCE sflight(
      INIT max_flight = VALUE sflight( price = 0 )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_flight = COND sflight( WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price THEN flight ELSE max_flight )
    ).

    rs_flight_key = CORRESPONDING #( ls_highest_price_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_highest_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_highest_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_result_aa) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_flight( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result for AA should not be initial' act = ls_result_aa ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result for AA should not be empty' act = ls_result_aa ).

    " Verify the price of the found flight is indeed the highest for AA
    DATA lt_aa_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_aa_flights WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

    DATA(lv_max_price) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_aa_flights INTO DATA(ls_aa_flight).
      IF ls_aa_flight-price > lv_max_price.
        lv_max_price = ls_aa_flight-price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    READ TABLE lt_aa_flights INTO DATA(ls_found_flight) WITH KEY carrid = ls_result_aa-carrid connid = ls_result_aa-connid fldate = ls_result_aa-fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Found flight should have the highest price' act = ls_found_flight-price exp = lv_max_price ).

    DATA(ls_result_xx) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_flight( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result for non-existent carrier should be initial' act = ls_result_xx ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann nicht nur für numerische Aggregationen, sondern auch zum Finden von Elementen mit bestimmten Eigenschaften (z.B. Maximum, Minimum) verwendet werden. Durch die Initialisierung mit einem 'Startwert' und einer bedingten Zuweisung (`COND`) in der `NEXT`-Klausel kann das gewünschte Element iterativ ermittelt werden. `CORRESPONDING` wird hier verwendet, um die gefundenen Felder in die Rückgabestruktur zu mappen.
keywords: REDUCE, MAX, Internal Tables, Aggregation, COND, CORRESPONDING

CLASS zcl_itb_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_scarr    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM scarr    INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_flight_details = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        FOR carrier IN lt_scarr WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid )
          ( carrid   = flight-carrid
            carrname = carrier-carrname
            connid   = flight-connid
            fldate   = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN zwischen `sflights` und `sbook` durch, um alle Flüge und deren zugehörige Buchungsdetails zu erhalten. Flüge ohne Buchungen sollen ebenfalls in der Ergebnismenge erscheinen. Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             bookid   TYPE s_book_id, " Booking ID from sbook
             customid TYPE s_cust_id, " Customer ID from sbook
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_bookings
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_bookings) TYPE tt_flight_bookings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_left_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND
                                     s~connid = b~connid AND
                                     s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_bookings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_bookings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ). " Check if it's not empty
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      " Verify that some entries have booking data and some might not (for LEFT OUTER JOIN)
      DATA(lv_has_booking) = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_no_booking) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
        IF ls_entry-bookid IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_has_booking = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          lv_no_booking = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = lv_has_booking
        msg = 'Expected at least one flight with booking data.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = lv_no_booking
        msg = 'Expected at least one flight without booking data (due to LEFT OUTER JOIN).'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` in einem `SELECT`-Statement ermöglicht es, Daten aus zwei Tabellen zu kombinieren, wobei alle Einträge der linken Tabelle (hier `sflights`) erhalten bleiben, auch wenn keine passenden Einträge in der rechten Tabelle (`sbook`) gefunden werden. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_bookings` füllt die Ergebnistabelle automatisch basierend auf übereinstimmenden Feldnamen.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine durch Kommas getrennte Liste aller Fluggesellschafts-IDs aus der Tabelle `scarr`. Verwenden Sie dabei die `REDUCE`-Expression in Kombination mit String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine Zeichenkette iterativ aufzubauen und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_list
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_list.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT carrid FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR car IN lt_scarr
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ car-carrid }| ELSE |{ s }, { car-carrid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier_list) = lo_cut->get_carrier_list( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_carrier_list
      msg = 'The carrier list should not be empty.'
    ).
    " Check if it contains known carriers (e.g., 'LH', 'AA')
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = contains( val = lv_carrier_list sub = 'LH' )
      msg = 'The carrier list should contain LH.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = contains( val = lv_carrier_list sub = 'AA' )
      msg = 'The carrier list should contain AA.'
    ).
    " Check for comma separation
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = contains( val = lv_carrier_list sub = ',' )
      msg = 'The carrier list should be comma-separated.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal, um eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable (hier eine Zeichenkette) aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit `COND` und String-Templates kann man elegant eine durch Kommas getrennte Liste erstellen, die korrekt mit dem ersten Element beginnt und nachfolgende Elemente mit einem Präfix versieht.
keywords: CONCATENATE, REDUCE, String Templates, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge aus `sflights` und deren Fluggesellschaftsnamen aus `scarr` basierend auf einer dynamisch bereitgestellten Fluggesellschafts-ID und Verbindungs-ID. Die `WHERE`-Klausel soll dynamisch aufgebaut werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... JOIN ... WHERE (itab_where_clause)` mit einer internen Tabelle, die die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_join_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_join_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA lt_where_clauses TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |s~carrid = '{ iv_carrid }'| TO lt_where_clauses.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |s~connid = '{ iv_connid }'| TO lt_where_clauses.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_dynamic_where) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR clause IN lt_where_clauses
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN clause ELSE |{ s } AND { clause }| )
    ).

    IF lv_dynamic_where IS INITIAL.
      " If no dynamic conditions, select all (or handle as error)
      " For this example, we'll select all if no criteria provided.
      lv_dynamic_where = '1 = 1'. " Always true condition
    ENDIF.

    SELECT s~carrid, ca~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS ca ON s~carrid = ca~carrid
      WHERE (lv_dynamic_where)
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_dynamic FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_dynamic_filtered FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_dynamic_no_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_join_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ). " Check if not empty
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ). " Assuming Lufthansa for LH
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_dynamic_filtered.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_join_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ). " Assuming American Airlines for AA
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_dynamic_no_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_join_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result_all) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result_all ). " Should not be empty if '1=1' is used
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result_all ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel wird als Zeichenkette in einer internen Tabelle aufgebaut und dann mit `(lv_dynamic_where)` im `SELECT`-Statement verwendet. Dies ermöglicht flexible Abfragen, deren Kriterien zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die `REDUCE`-Expression wird hier erneut verwendet, um die einzelnen Bedingungsteile mit `AND` zu verknüpfen.
keywords: JOIN, Dynamic Programming, SELECT, WHERE, String Templates, REDUCE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Statusmeldung für einen Flug. Wenn der Flug aktiv ist (z.B. `iv_is_active` ist `X`), soll die Meldung 'Flug {carrid} {connid} ist aktiv.' lauten. Andernfalls soll sie 'Flug {carrid} {connid} ist storniert.' lauten. Verwenden Sie dabei die `COND`-Expression und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` um bedingt eine Zeichenkette zu erzeugen und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_str_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_is_active TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_str_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_message.
    rv_status_message = COND string(
      WHEN iv_is_active = abap_true
        THEN |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } ist aktiv.|
      ELSE |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } ist storniert.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Fügen Sie dabei den Namen der Fluggesellschaft aus `scarr` hinzu. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `JOIN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN` in Kombination mit `JOIN` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_for_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_for_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_scarr    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( LET carrier_name = VALUE s_carrname( 
            FOR car IN lt_scarr WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ( car-carrname ) OPTIONAL ) IN
        carrid       = flight-carrid
        carrname     = carrier_name
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_for_groups( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      " Check if known carriers exist and have a count
      READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_entry-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_entry-flight_count > 0 ).
      ENDIF.

      READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_entry-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_aa_entry-flight_count > 0 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR GROUPS` ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE #` und einer geschachtelten `FOR` Schleife (oder `VALUE` mit `FOR`) kann man Aggregationen durchführen und gleichzeitig Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle (hier `scarr`) joinen, um zusätzliche Informationen wie den Fluggesellschaftsnamen hinzuzufügen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: JOIN, FOR GROUPS, Grouping, Internal Tables, VALUE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Flugnummern für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einer einzigen Zeichenkette, getrennt durch Semikolons. Verwenden Sie dabei die `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine Zeichenkette iterativ aufzubauen und `FILTER` um die relevanten Flüge zu selektieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_numbers_as_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_flight_numbers) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_numbers_as_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_flight_numbers = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ flight-connid }| ELSE |{ s };{ flight-connid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_numbers_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_numbers_empty FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_numbers_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_flight_numbers) = lo_cut->get_flight_numbers_as_string( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_flight_numbers

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

    ).

  METHOD test_get_flight_numbers_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_flight_numbers) = lo_cut->get_flight_numbers_as_string( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_flight_numbers
      msg = 'Flight numbers for non-existent carrier should be empty.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression wird verwendet, um eine einzelne Zeichenkette aus einer gefilterten internen Tabelle zu erstellen. `FILTER #` selektiert effizient die relevanten Einträge. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` sorgt für die korrekte Semikolon-Trennung, ohne ein führendes oder nachgestelltes Trennzeichen.
keywords: CONCATENATE, REDUCE, FILTER, String Templates, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft aus `scarr` in eine interne Tabelle aus. Die Felder der Zieltabelle sollen automatisch durch übereinstimmende Namen gefüllt werden. Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INNER JOIN` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INNER JOIN ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_and_carrier_info
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_infos) TYPE tt_flight_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_and_carrier_info.
    SELECT s~carrid, ca~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~planetype
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS ca ON s~carrid = ca~carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_infos.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_and_carrier_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_and_carrier_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_and_carrier_info( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-carrid ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-carrname ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-connid ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klausel `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` in einem `SELECT`-Statement ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten aus einer Datenbankabfrage in eine interne Tabelle zu übertragen. Sie füllt automatisch Felder in der Zieltabelle, deren Namen mit den ausgewählten Spalten der Datenbank übereinstimmen, was den Code vereinfacht und Fehler reduziert.
keywords: JOIN, SELECT, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie einen Platzhalter in einer Vorlagenzeichenkette durch dynamische Fluginformationen. Die Vorlage soll 'Der Flug [FLUG_INFO] ist bereit.' sein. Ersetzen Sie '[FLUG_INFO]' durch eine String-Template, die Fluggesellschafts-ID, Verbindungs-ID und Flugdatum enthält. Verwenden Sie `REPLACE` und String-Templates.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REPLACE` mit einer String-Template, um den Platzhalter dynamisch zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_flight_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flight_message.
    DATA(lv_template) = 'Der Flug [FLUG_INFO] ist bereit.'.
    DATA(lv_flight_info) = |{ iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER }|.

    REPLACE '[FLUG_INFO]' IN lv_template WITH lv_flight_info.
    rv_message = lv_template.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_flight_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_flight_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_template( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_expected_flight_info) = |LH 0400 am { sy-datum DATE = USER }|.
    DATA(lv_expected_message) = |Der Flug { lv_expected_flight_info } ist bereit.|.
    DATA(lv_actual_message) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_flight_message(
                                   iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                   iv_connid = lv_connid
                                   iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_message
      exp = lv_expected_message
      msg = 'Dynamic flight message should be correctly constructed.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Kombination von String-Templates zur Erstellung komplexer dynamischer Inhalte und der `REPLACE`-Anweisung zum Einfügen dieser Inhalte in eine Vorlagenzeichenkette. Dies ist eine flexible Methode zur Generierung von Nachrichten mit variablen Daten.
keywords: CONCATENATE, REPLACE, String Templates, String Manipulation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen `sflights` und `scarr` durch und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Anzahl von freien Plätzen haben (z.B. `seatsmax - seatsocc > 10`). Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INNER JOIN` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INNER JOIN ... WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_join_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_available_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_available_flight.
    TYPES tt_available_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_available_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_available_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_join_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    SELECT s~carrid, ca~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, ( s~seatsmax - s~seatsocc ) AS free_seats
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS ca ON s~carrid = ca~carrid
      WHERE ( s~seatsmax - s~seatsocc ) > @iv_min_free_seats
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_free_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_no_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_join_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-free_seats > 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrname ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_with_no_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_join_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( 9999 ). " Very high number, should yield no results

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'No flights expected with such a high number of free seats.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert einen `INNER JOIN` in einem `SELECT`-Statement, kombiniert mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die eine Berechnung (`seatsmax - seatsocc`) verwendet. Dies ermöglicht das Filtern von Daten direkt auf der Datenbankebene, was effizienter ist als das Filtern nach dem Laden der Daten in ABAP. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist die moderne Syntax.
keywords: JOIN, SELECT, WHERE, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Verketten Sie die Fluggesellschafts-ID und die Verbindungs-ID eines Fluges mit einem Bindestrich dazwischen. Verwenden Sie die `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung.
