Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen `sflights` und `scarr` durch und projizieren Sie nur die benötigten Felder in eine neue interne Tabelle. Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INNER JOIN` und `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... AS ... FROM ... INNER JOIN ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_join_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_projected_flight,
             carrier_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrier_name TYPE s_carrname,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_projected_flight.
    TYPES tt_projected_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_projected_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_projected_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_projected_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_join_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_projected_flight_data.
    SELECT s~carrid   AS carrier_id,
           ca~carrname AS carrier_name,
           s~connid   AS connection_id,
           s~fldate   AS flight_date
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS ca ON s~carrid = ca~carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_temp_flights).

    rt_flights = lt_temp_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_projected_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_projected_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_join_projection( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_projected_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-carrier_id ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-carrier_name ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-connection_id ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-flight_date ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die explizite Projektion von Feldern mit `AS` im `SELECT`-Statement ermöglicht es, die Spaltennamen im Ergebnis anzupassen und nur die tatsächlich benötigten Daten zu laden. Die Verwendung von `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` deklariert die interne Tabelle direkt im `SELECT`-Statement, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.
keywords: JOIN, SELECT, Projection, Internal Tables, DATA, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Liste von Fluggesellschaften, wobei jede Zeile die ID und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft enthält. Die Zeilen sollen durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt sein. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates und dem Zeilenumbruchzeichen `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und String-Templates mit `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` für Zeilenumbrüche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_carrier_list
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_carrier_list.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rv_formatted_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR car IN lt_scarr
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL
                   THEN |{ car-carrid } - { car-carrname }|
                 ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ car-carrid } - { car-carrname }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_formatted_carrier_list FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_formatted_carrier_list_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_carrier_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_lines( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_list) = lo_cut->get_formatted_carrier_list( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_formatted_list
      msg = 'Formatted list should not be empty.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = contains( val = lv_formatted_list sub = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf )
      msg = 'List should contain line breaks.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = contains( val = lv_formatted_list sub = 'LH - Lufthansa' )
      msg = 'List should contain LH - Lufthansa.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_formatted_carrier_list_empty.
    " To test an empty scenario, we would need to mock scarr or ensure it's empty.
    " For simplicity, we assume scarr has data. If it were empty, REDUCE would return initial string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_lines( ).
    " Simulate empty scarr by not selecting anything (not directly possible here without mocking)
    " If scarr was empty, the result would be initial.
    DATA(lv_formatted_list) = lo_cut->get_formatted_carrier_list( ).
    IF lines( VALUE #( FOR car IN lt_scarr ( car ) ) ) = 0. " This part is conceptual, assuming lt_scarr is empty
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = lv_formatted_list
        msg = 'Formatted list should be empty if no carriers exist.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression wird verwendet, um eine mehrzeilige Zeichenkette aus einer internen Tabelle zu erstellen. String-Templates formatieren jede Zeile, und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` fügt plattformunabhängige Zeilenumbrüche ein. Die `COND`-Expression verhindert einen führenden Zeilenumbruch.
keywords: CONCATENATE, REDUCE, String Templates, Line Break, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der Aggregatfunktion `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Einträge in der aktuellen Gruppe, was die Aggregation vereinfacht.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Verbindungsnummer (CONNID) und berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis (PRICE) für jede Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der Aggregatfunktion `SUM( price )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_total_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      connid = ls_sflight-connid

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und sammeln Sie alle Verbindungsnummern (CONNID) für jede Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppenschleife `FOR ... IN GROUP` in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_connids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_connids,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids TYPE tt_connid,
           END OF ty_carrid_connids.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_connids) TYPE tt_carrid_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_connids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lt_connids) = VALUE tt_connid( FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight ( <fs_group_member>-connid ) ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      connids = lt_connids ) TO rt_carrid_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_connids_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_connids_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '004' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_connids( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_connids_by_carrid( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_aa-connids ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-connids[1] exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-connids[3] exp = '004' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Innerhalb der `LOOP AT GROUP`-Schleife kann mit `FOR ... IN GROUP` auf die einzelnen Elemente der Gruppe zugegriffen werden. In Kombination mit `VALUE #( ... )` können so dynamisch interne Tabellen pro Gruppe aufgebaut werden.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR IN GROUP, LOOP AT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie den höchsten Preis (PRICE) für jede Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der Aggregatfunktion `MAX( price )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             max_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_max_price.
    TYPES: tt_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_prices.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      max_price = MAX( ls_sflight-price ) ) TO rt_max_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' price = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' price = 250 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' price = 150 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '004' price = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_max_price( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_prices( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-max_price exp = 250 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-max_price exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Aggregatfunktion `MAX()` innerhalb von `LOOP AT GROUP BY` findet den höchsten Wert eines Feldes für alle Einträge in der jeweiligen Gruppe. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte Art, Maximalwerte zu ermitteln.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, MAX, LOOP AT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaften zurück, die mehr als 2 Flüge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und eine `IF`-Bedingung mit `GROUP SIZE`, um die Gruppen zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filtered_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_group,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_filtered_group.
    TYPES: tt_filtered_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrids_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_groups) TYPE tt_filtered_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filtered_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_with_min_flights.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      IF GROUP SIZE > iv_min_flights.
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_filtered_groups.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_groups FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_groups.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' ) TO lt_sflights. " 3 flights for AA
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '004' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '005' ) TO lt_sflights. " 2 flights for LH

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filtered_groups( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrids_with_min_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_flights = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-flight_count exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `LOOP AT GROUP BY` mit einer `IF`-Bedingung, die `GROUP SIZE` verwendet, können Gruppen basierend auf Aggregatwerten gefiltert werden. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, komplexe Gruppierungsanforderungen zu erfüllen.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, GROUP SIZE, LOOP AT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `ZIF_VALIDATOR` mit einer Methode `IS_VALID` (IMPORTING `iv_value` TYPE `any`, RETURNING `rv_is_valid` TYPE `abap_bool`). Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `ZCL_POSITIVE_NUMBER_VALIDATOR`, die prüft, ob ein übergebener Wert eine positive Zahl ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein Interface für eine gemeinsame Validierungslogik und implementieren Sie die spezifische Prüfung in der Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_validator PUBLIC.
  METHODS is_valid
    IMPORTING
      iv_value    TYPE any
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_positive_number_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_positive_number_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_validator~is_valid.
    DATA: lv_number TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
    TRY.
        lv_number = iv_value.
        IF lv_number > 0.
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error. " Wenn iv_value keine Zahl ist
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_valid.
    DATA(lo_validator) = CAST zif_validator( NEW zcl_positive_number_validator( ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_validator->is_valid( -5 ) ).

Die Implementierung in `ZCL_POSITIVE_NUMBER_VALIDATOR` zeigt, wie typsichere Prüfungen und Fehlerbehandlung (mittels `TRY...CATCH`) in modernen ABAP-Klassen erfolgen können.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `ZIF_CALCULATION_STRATEGY` mit einer Methode `CALCULATE` (IMPORTING `iv_num1` TYPE `i`, `iv_num2` TYPE `i`, RETURNING `rv_result` TYPE `i`). Implementieren Sie zwei Klassen, `ZCL_ADD_STRATEGY` und `ZCL_MULTIPLY_STRATEGY`, die dieses Interface implementieren und Addition bzw. Multiplikation durchführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie das Strategy Pattern mit Interfaces, um verschiedene Berechnungsalgorithmen austauschbar zu machen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculation_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate
    IMPORTING
      iv_num1 TYPE i
      iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_num1 * iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Kontextklasse, die die Strategie verwendet
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy
        iv_num1     TYPE i
        iv_num2     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    rv_result = io_strategy->calculate( iv_num1 = iv_num1 iv_num2 = iv_num2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategies FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategies.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).

    " Test Addition
    DATA(lo_add_strategy) = CAST zif_calculation_strategy( NEW zcl_add_strategy( ) ).
    DATA(lv_add_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( io_strategy = lo_add_strategy iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_add_result exp = 8 ).

    " Test Multiplikation
    DATA(lo_multiply_strategy) = CAST zif_calculation_strategy( NEW zcl_multiply_strategy( ) ).
    DATA(lv_multiply_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( io_strategy = lo_multiply_strategy iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_multiply_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Strategy Pattern, ein Entwurfsmuster, das es ermöglicht, Algorithmen zur Laufzeit auszutauschen. Das Interface `ZIF_CALCULATION_STRATEGY` definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle, während `ZCL_ADD_STRATEGY` und `ZCL_MULTIPLY_STRATEGY` konkrete Implementierungen liefern. Die Kontextklasse `ZCL_CALCULATOR` verwendet das Interface, um die Strategie dynamisch aufzurufen.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Object Orientation, Strategy Pattern, Polymorphism, Design Patterns

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `ZIF_FLIGHT_REPORT` mit einer Methode `GET_REPORT_DATA` (RETURNING `rt_report_lines` TYPE `string_table`). Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, `ZCL_FLIGHT_SUMMARY_REPORT` und `ZCL_FLIGHT_DETAIL_REPORT`, die dieses Interface implementieren und unterschiedliche Berichtsdaten aus `sflights` liefern. Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse `ZCL_REPORT_FACTORY` mit einer Methode `CREATE_REPORT` (IMPORTING `iv_report_type` TYPE `string`, RETURNING `ro_report` TYPE REF TO `zif_flight_report`).
hint: Verwenden Sie das Factory Pattern mit Interfaces, um verschiedene Berichtstypen zu erzeugen und die Erstellung von der Nutzung zu entkoppeln.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_report PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_report_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_report_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_report~get_report_data.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_summary).

    APPEND 'Flight Summary Report:' TO rt_report_lines.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      APPEND |  { ls_summary-carrid }: { ls_summary-flight_count } flights| TO rt_report_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_detail_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_detail_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_report~get_report_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 3 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_details).

    APPEND 'Flight Detail Report (first 3 entries):' TO rt_report_lines.
    LOOP AT lt_details INTO DATA(ls_detail).
      APPEND |  { ls_detail-carrid } { ls_detail-connid } { ls_detail-fldate } { ls_detail-price }| TO rt_report_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_report
      IMPORTING
        iv_report_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_report) TYPE REF TO zif_flight_report
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_report.
    CASE iv_report_type.
      WHEN 'SUMMARY'.
        ro_report = NEW zcl_flight_summary_report( ).
      WHEN 'DETAIL'.
        ro_report = NEW zcl_flight_detail_report( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown report type: { iv_report_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_summary FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_detail FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_summary.
    DATA(lo_report) = zcl_report_factory=>create_report( 'SUMMARY' ).
    DATA(lt_report_data) = lo_report->get_report_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_report_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_report_data[1] needle = 'Summary' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Factory Pattern. Das Interface `ZIF_FLIGHT_REPORT` definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle für Berichte. Die Factory-Klasse `ZCL_REPORT_FACTORY` ist für die Erstellung konkreter Berichtsobjekte zuständig, basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter. Dies entkoppelt die Erstellung von Objekten von ihrer Nutzung und fördert die Erweiterbarkeit, da neue Berichtstypen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne den Client-Code zu ändern. Es nutzt auch `SELECT ... GROUP BY` und String-Templates für die Berichtsgenerierung.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Polymorphism, SELECT GROUP BY, String Templates

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie den Durchschnittspreis (PRICE) pro Fluggesellschaft. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei nur Flüge, deren Preis größer als 0 ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `AVG( price )` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung im `SELECT` oder `FILTER` vor der Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.

      IMPORTING

        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_prices.
    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER sflight_tab FROM it_sflights WHERE price > 0.

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      avg_price = AVG( ls_sflight-price ) ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Durchschnittswerte unter bestimmten Bedingungen zu berechnen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe den Flug mit dem frühesten Datum (FLDATE).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppenschleife `MIN( fldate )` oder eine `SORT`-Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_earliest_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_earliest_flight,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate  TYPE s_date,
             connid  TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_earliest_flight.
    TYPES: tt_earliest_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_earliest_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_earliest_flight_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_earliest_flights) TYPE tt_earliest_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_earliest_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_earliest_flight_per_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_earliest_date) = MIN( ls_sflight-fldate ).
      " Um den gesamten Eintrag zu bekommen, muss man ggf. erneut filtern oder sortieren
      DATA(ls_earliest_flight) = VALUE sflight( 
                                   FOR flight IN GROUP ls_sflight 
                                   WHERE ( fldate = lv_earliest_date ) 
                                   ( flight ) OPTIONAL ).
      IF ls_earliest_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_earliest_flight-carrid
                        fldate = ls_earliest_flight-fldate
                        connid = ls_earliest_flight-connid ) TO rt_earliest_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_earliest_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_earliest_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20230105' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = '20230210' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '004' fldate = '20230110' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_earliest_date( ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und erstellen Sie für jede Gruppe eine kommagetrennte Liste der Verbindungsnummern (CONNID).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit String-Templates, um die Liste zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_connid_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_connid_list,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid_list TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrid_connid_list.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_connid_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_connid_list WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connid_lists_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_connid_lists) TYPE tt_carrid_connid_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_connid_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_lists_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_connid_list) = REDUCE string(
                                INIT s = ``
                                FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                  NEXT s = COND string(
                                             WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_group_member>-connid
                                             ELSE s && `,` && <fs_group_member>-connid ) ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      connid_list = lv_connid_list ) TO rt_carrid_connid_lists.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' ) TO lt_sflights.

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-connid_list exp = '003' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Innerhalb der Gruppenschleife wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um alle `CONNID`s der aktuellen Gruppe zu einer kommagetrennten Zeichenkette zu aggregieren. Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte (z.B. Division durch Null). Fangen Sie spezifische Ausnahmen ab und behandeln Sie alle anderen Ausnahmen generisch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit spezifischen Ausnahmen und `WHEN OTHERS` (implizit `CATCH cx_root`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_division.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        MESSAGE lx_arith->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " WHEN OTHERS ist implizit cx_root
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Methode, die einen beliebigen Wert in einen String konvertiert. Behandeln Sie dabei verschiedene Datentypen und geben Sie für nicht unterstützte Typen einen Standardstring zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` und `CASE TYPE OF` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_any> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN iv_value->* TO <lv_any>.

    IF <lv_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_string = CASE TYPE OF <lv_any>.
                    WHEN TYPE i THEN CONV string( <lv_any> ).
                    WHEN TYPE d THEN CONV string( <lv_any> ).
                    WHEN TYPE t THEN CONV string( <lv_any> ).
                    WHEN TYPE c THEN CONV string( <lv_any> ).
                    WHEN TYPE string THEN CONV string( <lv_any> ).
                    WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Nicht unterstützter Typ'.
                  ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      rv_string = 'Initialer Wert'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den absoluten Wert einer Zahl. Falls die Eingabe nicht numerisch ist, soll 0 zurückgegeben werden.

CLASS zcl_math_abs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_abs IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten eines Basistyps akzeptiert und diese in eine Liste von Objekten eines abgeleiteten Typs konvertiert, falls die Konvertierung möglich ist. Für nicht konvertierbare Objekte soll ein Standardobjekt oder NULL zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` für die Down-Cast-Konvertierung und `FOR` mit `COND` oder `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_shape_base DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape_base FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat34 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat34.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_area REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_circles
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_circles) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_circle WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_circles.
    rt_circles = VALUE #( FOR <ls_shape> IN it_shapes
                           LET lo_circle = CAST zcl_circle( <ls_shape> ) IN
                           ( lo_circle ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_failure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_success.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lo_circle TYPE REF TO zcl_circle.

    lo_circle = NEW zcl_circle( 5 ).
    APPEND lo_circle TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_shape_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_circles) = lo_converter->convert_to_circles( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_circles ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_circles[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_circles[ 1 ]->mv_radius exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_failure.
    CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape_base FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS zif_shape~get_area REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_shape~get_area. rv_area = 10. ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lo_square TYPE REF TO zcl_square.

    lo_square = NEW zcl_square( ).
    APPEND lo_square TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_shape_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_circles) = lo_converter->convert_to_circles( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_circles ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_circles[ 1 ] ). " CAST returns initial for failed cast
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_list.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lo_circle TYPE REF TO zcl_circle,
          lo_square TYPE REF TO zcl_square.

    lo_circle = NEW zcl_circle( 3 ).
    APPEND lo_circle TO lt_shapes.

    CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape_base FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS zif_shape~get_area REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_shape~get_area. rv_area = 9. ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
    lo_square = NEW zcl_square( ).
    APPEND lo_square TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_shape_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_circles) = lo_converter->convert_to_circles( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_circles ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_circles[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_circles[ 1 ]->mv_radius exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_circles[ 2 ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt einen Down-Cast von einer Basistyp-Referenz (`zif_shape`) zu einer abgeleiteten Typ-Referenz (`zcl_circle`) unter Verwendung des `CAST` Operators (der intern `CONV` für Referenzen verwendet). Der `FOR` Operator wird verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, wobei nicht konvertierbare Objekte automatisch als initial (NULL) in der Zieltabelle erscheinen, was eine elegante Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: Object Orientation, CONV, CAST, FOR Operator, Down-Cast, Polymorphism

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflight` nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Konvertieren Sie dabei den Preis in `decfloat34` für den Vergleich. Falls keine Flüge gefunden werden, soll eine leere Tabelle zurückgegeben werden.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_filtered,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_flight_price_filtered.
    TYPES ty_flight_prices_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_expensive_flights
          IMPORTING
            it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
            iv_min_price TYPE decfloat34
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flight_prices_filtered.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_expensive_flights.
        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER ty_flight_prices_filtered(
                                FROM it_sflights
                                ( WHERE CONV decfloat34( price ) > iv_min_price
                                  ( carrid = carrid, connid = connid, price = CONV decfloat34( price ) ) ) ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Kategorie eines Flugpreises: 'Günstig' (<100), 'Standard' (100-500), 'Teuer' (>500). Für ungültige Preise (z.B. negative Werte) soll 'Ungültig' zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `COND` Expression mit mehreren `WHEN` Bedingungen und `WHEN OTHERS`.

CLASS zcl_price_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_category.
    rv_category = COND string(
                    WHEN iv_price < 0 THEN 'Ungültig'
                    WHEN iv_price < 100 THEN 'Günstig'
                    WHEN iv_price >= 100 AND iv_price <= 500 THEN 'Standard'
                    WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN 'Teuer'
                    WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle E-Mail-Adressen in einem gegebenen Text und gib sie als interne Tabelle von Strings zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_emails.
    " Regex for a simple email pattern
    CONSTANTS lc_email_regex TYPE string VALUE `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b`.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lc_email_regex IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_case_insens DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_types_range_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Definiere zwei interne Tabellentypen: eine Standardtabelle ohne Schlüssel und eine sortierte Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel für Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern. Fülle beide mit Daten aus `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `TYPES TABLE OF ... WITH EMPTY KEY` und `TYPES TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_types_table_keys DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    TYPES tt_standard_no_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_sorted_unique_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_tables
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_tables) TYPE BEGIN OF ty_return_tables,
                                 standard_table TYPE tt_standard_no_key,
                                 sorted_table   TYPE tt_sorted_unique_key,
                               END OF ty_return_tables.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_table_keys IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_tables.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    rs_tables-standard_table = lt_all_sflights.

    rs_tables-sorted_table = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_sflights
                                      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_tables.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_table_keys( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_tables( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_result-standard_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_result-sorted_table ).

    " Check uniqueness of sorted table
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ls_result-sorted_table ).
    SORT ls_result-sorted_table BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ls_result-sorted_table COMPARING carrid connid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_initial_lines exp = lines( ls_result-sorted_table ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die explizite Definition von internen Tabellentypen mit Schlüsseln (`WITH EMPTY KEY`, `WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY`). Dies ist entscheidend für die Performance und Datenintegrität. `WITH EMPTY KEY` ist die moderne Standarddefinition für Standardtabellen. `WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY` gewährleistet, dass Einträge eindeutig sind und die Tabelle immer sortiert bleibt. Die Befüllung der sortierten Tabelle erfolgt effizient mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck.
keywords: TYPES, Internal Tables, EMPTY KEY, UNIQUE SORTED KEY, FOR, VALUE

CLASS zcl_math_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_divide IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error

    rv_result = CONV decfloat34( iv_dividend ) / iv_divisor.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das ganzzahlige Ergebnis und den Rest einer Division.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Operatoren `DIV` für die ganzzahlige Division und `MOD` für den Rest.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_int_div DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_division_result,
        quotient TYPE i,
        remainder TYPE i,
      END OF ty_division_result.

    METHODS calculate_int_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_division_result
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_int_div IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_int_division.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.
    rs_result = VALUE #( 
      quotient  = iv_dividend DIV iv_divisor
      remainder = iv_dividend MOD iv_divisor
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_int_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_int_division_by_zero EXPECTING cx_sy_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_avg_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Verteilen Sie einen Gesamtbetrag proportional auf mehrere Posten basierend auf deren individuellen Anteilen.
hint: Berechnen Sie zuerst den Gesamtanteil mit `REDUCE` und dann den Faktor für jeden Posten durch Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_proportional_dist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id      TYPE string,
        share   TYPE decfloat34,
        amount  TYPE decfloat34,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS distribute_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_amount TYPE decfloat34
      CHANGING
        ct_items      TYPE ty_items
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_proportional_dist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD distribute_amount.
    IF ct_items IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_share) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN ct_items NEXT s = s + item-share ).

    IF lv_total_share = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Total share cannot be zero for proportional distribution.'.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT ct_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
      <fs_item>-amount = iv_total_amount * ( <fs_item>-share / lv_total_share ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    READ TABLE lt_items WITH KEY id = 'A' INTO DATA(ls_item_a).

    READ TABLE lt_items WITH KEY id = 'B' INTO DATA(ls_item_b).

    READ TABLE lt_items WITH KEY id = 'C' INTO DATA(ls_item_c).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item_c-amount exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_distribution_zero_share.

      ( id = 'A' share = 0 )
      ( id = 'B' share = 0 )

Instructions: Verwenden Sie die `COMPUTE` Anweisung, um eine komplexere mathematische Formel zu berechnen, die Divisionen beinhaltet.
hint: `COMPUTE` kann für Ausdrücke mit mehreren Operatoren und Klammern verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_complex_compute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_formula
      IMPORTING
        iv_a TYPE decfloat34
        iv_b TYPE decfloat34
        iv_c TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_complex_compute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_formula.
    IF iv_b = 0 OR iv_c = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Divisor cannot be zero.'.
    ENDIF.
    COMPUTE rv_result = ( iv_a + ( iv_b / iv_c ) ) * ( iv_c / iv_b ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_complex_compute( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_formula( iv_a = 10 iv_b = 2 iv_c = 4 ).
    " (10 + (2/4)) * (4/2) = (10 + 0.5) * 2 = 10.5 * 2 = 21
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 21 ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_formula( iv_a = 5 iv_b = 10 iv_c = 2 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gleitenden Durchschnitt (Moving Average) einer Zahlenreihe für eine gegebene Fenstergröße.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` in Kombination, um über Teilmengen der Daten zu iterieren und den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_moving_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_moving_average
      IMPORTING
        it_values    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 READ ONLY
        iv_window_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_moving_avg) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_moving_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_moving_average.
    IF iv_window_size <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Window size must be positive.'.
    ENDIF.

    IF lines( it_values ) < iv_window_size.
      RETURN. " Nicht genügend Daten für das Fenster
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_num_values) = lines( it_values ).

    rt_moving_avg = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lv_num_values - iv_window_size
                               LET lt_window = it_values[ i + 1 .. i + iv_window_size ] IN
                               ( REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR val IN lt_window NEXT s = s + val ) / iv_window_size ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_moving_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_moving_average_small_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_moving_average_invalid_window EXPECTING cx_sy_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_moving_average_empty_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_moving_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_moving_average( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ( 40 ) ( 50 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_moving_average( it_values = lt_values iv_window_size = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 20 ). " (10+20+30)/3
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 30 ). " (20+30+40)/3
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 40 ). " (30+40+50)/3
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_moving_average_small_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_moving_average( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_moving_average( it_values = lt_values iv_window_size = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_moving_average_invalid_window.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_moving_average( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Quotienten zweier Zahlen und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf eine bestimmte Anzahl von Dezimalstellen.
hint: Führen Sie die Division durch und verwenden Sie dann die `ROUND` Funktion oder `DECFLOAT_ARITHMETIC` für präzises Runden.

CLASS zcl_math_rounded_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_and_round
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE decfloat34
        iv_divisor  TYPE decfloat34
        iv_decimals TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_rounded_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_and_round.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_raw_result) = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.

    " Runden mit der ROUND-Funktion (ABAP 7.50+)
    rv_result = round( val = lv_raw_result dec = iv_decimals ).

    " Alternative für ältere Versionen oder spezifische Rundungsmodi:
    " DATA(lv_packed_result) TYPE p DECIMALS iv_decimals.
    " lv_packed_result = lv_raw_result.
    " rv_result = lv_packed_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle, aber nur für Zeilen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um die relevanten Zeilen auszuwählen und dann `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_filtered_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE decfloat34,
        category TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data,
      ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_filtered_average
      IMPORTING
        it_data    TYPE ty_data_tab READ ONLY
        iv_category TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_filtered_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_filtered_average.
    DATA(lt_filtered_data) = FILTER ty_data_tab( it_data WHERE category = iv_category ).

    IF lt_filtered_data IS INITIAL.
      " Wenn keine passenden Daten gefunden wurden, kann 0 zurückgegeben oder eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_data IN lt_filtered_data NEXT s = s + ls_data-value ).
    rv_average = lv_sum / lines( lt_filtered_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Anteil jedes Postens an der Gesamtsumme und geben Sie diesen als Dezimalwert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Gesamtsumme und dann `FOR` für die proportionale Berechnung jedes Postens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_proportional_share DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id    TYPE string,
        value TYPE decfloat34,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item_share,
        id    TYPE string,
        value TYPE decfloat34,
        share TYPE decfloat34,
      END OF ty_item_share,
      ty_item_shares TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_share WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_proportional_shares
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_items READ ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_item_shares) TYPE ty_item_shares
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_proportional_share IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_proportional_shares.
    IF it_items IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_value) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN it_items NEXT s = s + item-value ).

    IF lv_total_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Total value cannot be zero for share calculation.'.
    ENDIF.

    rt_item_shares = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_items
                                ( id = ls_item-id
                                  value = ls_item-value
                                  share = ls_item-value / lv_total_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_proportional_shares FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_proportional_shares_zero_total EXPECTING cx_sy_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_proportional_shares_empty_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_proportional_shares.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_proportional_share( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_math_proportional_share=>ty_items(
      ( id = 'X' value = 10 )
      ( id = 'Y' value = 20 )
      ( id = 'Z' value = 70 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_shares) = lo_cut->calculate_proportional_shares( it_items ).

    READ TABLE lt_shares WITH KEY id = 'X' INTO DATA(ls_share_x).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_share_x-share exp = '0.1' ).
    READ TABLE lt_shares WITH KEY id = 'Y' INTO DATA(ls_share_y).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_share_y-share exp = '0.2' ).
    READ TABLE lt_shares WITH KEY id = 'Z' INTO DATA(ls_share_z).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_share_z-share exp = '0.7' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_proportional_shares_zero_total.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_proportional_share( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_math_proportional_share=>ty_items(
      ( id = 'X' value = 0 )
      ( id = 'Y' value = 0 )
    ).
    lo_cut->calculate_proportional_shares( lt_items ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_proportional_shares_empty_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_proportional_share( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_math_proportional_share=>ty_items( ).
    DATA(lt_shares) = lo_cut->calculate_proportional_shares( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_shares ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zuerst wird die Gesamtsumme aller Werte in der Tabelle mit `REDUCE` berechnet. Anschließend wird der `FOR` Operator verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, wobei für jeden Posten der Anteil an der Gesamtsumme durch Division berechnet wird. Dies ist ein funktionaler und effizienter Weg, um proportionale Anteile zu ermitteln.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Proportional Share, DIVIDE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (`PRICE`) aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0 FOR ... IN ... NEXT sum = sum + ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0
                                        FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                        NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Wert eines Feldsymbols, das auf ein beliebiges Datenobjekt zeigt, dynamisch in einen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` mit einem Feldsymbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_field_symbol DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_fs_to_string IMPORTING ir_data TYPE REF TO data
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_field_symbol IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_fs_to_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_value>.

      rv_string = CONV string( <fs_value> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Datum (`sy-datum`) in einen String im Format 'DD.MM.YYYY' unter Verwendung von `CONV` und String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_conv_date_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD format_date.
    DATA(lv_date_str) = CONV string( iv_date ). " YYYYMMDD

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corr_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_x TYPE i, " Different field name
             field_c TYPE string,
             field_d TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS copy_corresponding_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_corresponding_fields.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING is_source TO rs_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_corr_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_move_corr_struct=>ty_source_data(
      field_a = 'Hello'
      field_b = 123
      field_c = 'World' ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->copy_corresponding_fields( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_a exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field A should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_x msg = 'Field X should be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_c exp = 'World' msg = 'Field C should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_d msg = 'Field D should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` ist eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen zu kopieren, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen und kompatiblen Typen berücksichtigt werden. Dies reduziert den manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand.
keywords: MOVE-CORRESPONDING, STRUCTURE, Data Operations

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quell-internen Tabelle in eine Ziel-interne Tabelle, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen für alle Zeilen übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` innerhalb einer Schleife. Ab 7.50 kann der `CORRESPONDING #` Operator verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corr_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid, " Renamed
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate, " Renamed
             price      TYPE sflight-price, " New field
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_corresponding_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_corresponding_tables.
    DATA(lt_temp_target) = VALUE tt_target_table( ).

    LOOP AT it_source INTO DATA(ls_source).
      DATA(ls_target_wa) = VALUE ty_target_line( ).
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_source TO ls_target_wa.
      APPEND ls_target_wa TO lt_temp_target.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_target = lt_temp_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Struktur, indem Sie Felder aus einer Basisstruktur kopieren und anschließend übereinstimmende Felder aus einer anderen Quellstruktur überschreiben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_base_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_base_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,

           END OF ty_base_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    METHODS merge_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_base   TYPE ty_base_data
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_merged) TYPE ty_base_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_base_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_structures.
    rs_merged = CORRESPONDING #(
      BASE ( is_base )
      is_source
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      comment = 'Some comment' ). " This field is ignored as it's not in base

    DATA(ls_merged) = lo_cut->merge_structures(

explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` ermöglicht eine elegante und moderne Art, Strukturen zu mergen. CLASS zcl_corr_mapping_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_no_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_unique_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_unique_item.
    TYPES: tt_unique_items TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_unique_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_unique_item
      IMPORTING
        is_new_item TYPE ty_unique_item
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE tt_unique_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_no_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_unique_item.
    INSERT is_new_item INTO TABLE ct_items REJECTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_inserted = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_inserted = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quell-internen Tabelle in eine Ziel-interne Tabelle, wobei Sie Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zuordnen und zusätzlich eine Transformation auf ein Feld anwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING #( ... MAPPING ... EXCEPT ... )` Operator mit einer Inline-Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_mapping_trans DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_product,
             product_id   TYPE i,
             product_name TYPE string,
             unit_price   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_product.
    TYPES: tt_source_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             item_number TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             net_value   TYPE decfloat16,
             currency    TYPE c LENGTH 3,
           END OF ty_target_item.
    TYPES: tt_target_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_products_with_transform
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_mapping_trans IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_products_with_transform.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #(
      it_source MAPPING
        item_number = product_id
        description = product_name
      EXCEPT
        net_value = unit_price * '1.19', " Add 19% VAT
        currency  = 'EUR'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_mapping_trans( ).

      ( product_id = 10 product_name = 'Book' unit_price = '10.00' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target1-description exp = 'Book' msg = 'Description should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target1-net_value exp = '11.90' msg = 'Net value should include VAT' ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, aber nur die Zeilen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression mit `COND`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_active_products
      IMPORTING
        it_source_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_active_products.
    DATA(lt_filtered_products) = VALUE tt_products(
      FOR ls_product IN it_source_products
      WHERE ( ls_product-active = abap_true )
      ( ls_product ) ).

    INSERT LINES OF lt_filtered_products INTO TABLE rt_target_products.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_fds_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_prices.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights. " Copy table

    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.10'. " Increase price by 10%
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu und ändern Sie deren Wert mithilfe eines Feldsymbols.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_value.
    rs_data = is_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE rs_data TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_value> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error if new_value cannot be assigned to component type
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_fds_dynamic_access=>ty_data( field1 = 'Initial' field2 = 10 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_dynamic_access( ).

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->set_component_value(
      is_data      = ls_data

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field1 exp = 'Changed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field2 exp = 10 ).

    ls_result = lo_cut->set_component_value(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field2 exp = 20 ).

CLASS zcl_fds_read_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate

CLASS zcl_fds_read_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights.

    READ TABLE rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur und fügen Sie Einträge hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` für die dynamische Tabellenbearbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_structure,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_structure.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_type TYPE string " e.g., 'ZCL_FDS_DYNAMIC_TABLE=>TY_DYNAMIC_STRUCTURE'
        it_data_to_add    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " Get description of the structure type
    TRY.
        lr_struct_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_structure_type ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error: type not found
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Create a table type based on the structure
    lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lr_struct_type
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT it_data_to_add ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data_to_add>).
        APPEND <fs_data_to_add> TO <fs_table>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, wobei Sie Feldsymbole verwenden, um die Quelltabelle effizient zu verarbeiten und zu modifizieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_discounted_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
        iv_discount_rate TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_flights.
    " Using FOR loop with ASSIGNING to directly modify and collect entries
    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
        WHERE ( price > 100 ) " Only discount flights over 100
        ( VALUE #( <fs_flight> price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_discounted_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_discount_below_threshold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discounted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fds_for_loop=>ty_sflight_tab.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie eine Menge von einer anderen, wobei die Einheiten berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Einheiten vor der Subtraktion konsistent sind oder verwenden Sie `cl_abap_unit_conversion` für komplexe Szenarien.

CLASS zcl_quantity_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_quantity,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
             unit  TYPE meins,
           END OF ty_quantity.

    METHODS subtract_quantities
      IMPORTING
        is_quantity1 TYPE ty_quantity
        is_quantity2 TYPE ty_quantity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result_quantity) TYPE ty_quantity
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " For unit mismatch or other arithmetic issues
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_quantity_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_quantities.
    IF is_quantity1-unit <> is_quantity2-unit.
      " In a real scenario, you'd convert units here using CL_ABAP_UNIT_CONVERSION
      " For simplicity, we raise an error for mismatch
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Units do not match for subtraction'.
    ENDIF.

    rs_result_quantity-value = is_quantity1-value - is_quantity2-value.
    rs_result_quantity-unit = is_quantity1-unit.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Differenzen zwischen aufeinanderfolgenden Preisen in einer Liste von Flügen unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer internen Tabelle und einer Hilfsvariable für den vorherigen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_price_difference_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_diff) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_difference_sum.
    DATA(lv_previous_price) = VALUE sflight-price( ).

    rv_total_diff = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_diff = VALUE sflight-price( 0 )
           prev_price = VALUE sflight-price( 0 )
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT
        sum_diff = sum_diff + ( flight-price - prev_price )
        prev_price = flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '150.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '100.00' ).

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '120.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen bestimmten Betrag von Preisen in einer internen Tabelle, aber nur, wenn der Preis einen Schwellenwert überschreitet. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` mit einer bedingten Subtraktion im `VALUE`-Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS apply_conditional_discount
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights      TYPE ty_sflight_tab
        iv_threshold     TYPE sflight-price
        iv_discount_amount TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_conditional_discount.
    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      ( VALUE #(
          flight
          price = COND sflight-price(
            WHEN flight-price > iv_threshold THEN flight-price - iv_discount_amount
            ELSE flight-price
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
