Instructions: Berechnen Sie die verbleibende Kapazität eines Flugzeugs, indem Sie die Anzahl der gebuchten Sitze von der Gesamtkapazität subtrahieren. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` über die Flugtabelle, um die Summe der gebuchten Sitze zu erhalten, und subtrahieren Sie diese dann von der Gesamtkapazität.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             booked_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES ty_flight_booking_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_remaining_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
        it_bookings       TYPE ty_flight_booking_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_remaining_capacity.
    DATA(lv_booked_total) = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc(
      INIT sum_booked = 0
      FOR booking IN it_bookings
      NEXT
        sum_booked = sum_booked + booking-booked_seats
    ).

    rv_remaining_seats = iv_total_capacity - lv_booked_total.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flügen und berechnen Sie für die verbleibenden Flüge die Differenz zwischen dem aktuellen Datum und dem Flugdatum in Tagen. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `MAP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Auswahl und `MAP` für die Transformation, wobei die Datumsarithmetik direkt angewendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_map_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_days_left,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             days_left TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_with_days_left.
    TYPES ty_flight_with_days_left_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_days_left WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_upcoming_flights_with_days
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
        iv_current_date TYPE sy-datum DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_upcoming_flights) TYPE ty_flight_with_days_left_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_map_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_upcoming_flights_with_days.
    rt_upcoming_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN FILTER zcl_filter_map_subtract=>ty_sflight_tab(
        it_sflights WHERE fldate >= iv_current_date
      )
      ( VALUE #(
          carrid = flight-carrid
          connid = flight-connid
          fldate = flight-fldate
          days_left = flight-fldate - iv_current_date " Direct date subtraction
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie eine Zahl von einem String, der eine Zahl darstellt, und geben Sie das Ergebnis als String zurück. Behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler bei der Konvertierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` für die Typumwandlung und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_numeric_string TYPE string
        iv_value_to_subtract TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_string.
    DATA: lv_numeric_value TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lv_numeric_value = CONV i( iv_numeric_string ).
        lv_numeric_value = lv_numeric_value - iv_value_to_subtract.
        rv_result_string = CONV string( lv_numeric_value ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'String cannot be converted to a number for subtraction.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Datumsangaben, wobei Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag) ausgeschlossen werden. Verwenden Sie eine Schleife mit Datumsarithmetik.
hint: Iterieren Sie Tag für Tag und prüfen Sie den Wochentag mit `cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_weekday`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_workday_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE sy-datum
        iv_date_to   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workday_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_between.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_weekday      TYPE i.

    IF iv_date_from > iv_date_to.
      " Swap dates if in wrong order
      DATA(lv_temp_date) = iv_date_from.
      iv_date_from = iv_date_to.
      iv_date_to = lv_temp_date.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_date = iv_date_from.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_date_to.
      lv_weekday = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      " 1 = Monday, ..., 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7.
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1. " Add one day
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die kumulative Differenz zwischen dem aktuellen Preis und dem Startpreis für jeden Flug in einer sortierten Liste. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer Hilfsvariable.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... LET` um eine temporäre Variable für den Startpreis zu definieren und die Differenz zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cumulative_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_diff,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             price_diff_from_start TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_with_diff.
    TYPES ty_flight_with_diff_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_diff WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cumulative_price_differences
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_diff) TYPE ty_flight_with_diff_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cumulative_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_price_differences.
    DATA(lv_start_price) = VALUE sflight-price( 0 ).

    IF it_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_start_price = it_sflights[ 1 ]-price.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flights_with_diff = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      LET current_start_price = lv_start_price IN
      ( VALUE #(
          flight
          price_diff_from_start = flight-price - current_start_price
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_loop_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      APPEND ls_flight-connid TO rt_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines) in einer internen Tabelle SFLIGHT die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (MAX_SEATS) um 10%.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für die direkte Modifikation der Tabellenzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_aa_seats IMPORTING io_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH DEFAULT KEY
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_updated_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH DEFAULT KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_aa_seats.
    rt_updated_sflights = io_sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflight.

    LOOP AT rt_updated_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
      <fs_flight>-max_seats = <fs_flight>-max_seats * 1.1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und die `GROUP SIZE` Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ts_flight_count.
    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen, ob 'LH' existiert und eine Anzahl > 0 hat
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Überprüfen der Gesamtzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften
    DATA(lv_distinct_carrids) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT carrid ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_distinct_carrids.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_distinct_carrids ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion zur Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und Aggregatfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` direkt im Loop zu verwenden, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert, verglichen mit manuellen Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze (MAX_SEATS) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AZ' (Alitalia) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_az_total_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_az_total_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'AZ' )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-max_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_az_total_seats FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_az_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_az_total_seats( ).

    " Um den Test deterministischer zu machen, berechnen wir die erwartete Summe
    DATA lv_expected_sum TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( max_seats ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AZ' INTO @lv_expected_sum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und einer `WHERE` Bedingung bietet er eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Syntax für Aggregationen, die früher mehrere Zeilen Code erforderten.
keywords: REDUCE, LOOP, FOR, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_conv_date_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE dats.

CLASS zcl_conv_date_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_date.
    " CONV dats(...) erwartet 'YYYYMMDD'. Daher Bindestriche entfernen.

Hier wird gezeigt, wie ein Datumsstring in ein internes ABAP-Datumsformat (DATS) umgewandelt wird. Es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass `CONV dats(...)` einen String im Format 'YYYYMMDD' erwartet. Daher wird der Eingabestring zuerst mit `REPLACE` angepasst. Bei ungültigen Datumsformaten wird eine Ausnahme ausgelöst, was eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und die Flugnummer (CONNID) aller Flüge aus SFLIGHT enthält, deren Flugzeugtyp (PLANETYPE) '747' ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und einer `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ts_flight_summary.
    METHODS get_747_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_747_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_747_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_747_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( planetype = '747' )
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_747_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_747_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_747_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).

    " Überprüfen, ob alle Einträge den PLANETYPE '747' haben (indirekt)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_summary).
      DATA ls_original_flight TYPE sflight.
      READ TABLE lt_sflight_all INTO ls_original_flight WITH KEY carrid = ls_flight_summary-carrid connid = ls_flight_summary-connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_original_flight-planetype exp = '747' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Überprüfen der Anzahl der 747-Flüge
    DATA lv_expected_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE planetype = '747' INTO @lv_expected_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  " Hilfsmethode zum Laden aller SFLIGHT-Daten für den Test
  CLASS-METHODS class_setup.
    DATA SHARED MEMORY zcl_for_transform_shm_area.
    DATA lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all.
    " Speichern in einem statischen Attribut oder Shared Memory für den Test
    " Hier nur als Beispiel, da SFLIGHT eine globale Tabelle ist.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu transformieren und neue Tabellen zu erstellen. Er ermöglicht es, Schleifen, Filter und Zuweisungen in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung zu kombinieren, was den Code deutlich lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: LOOP, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in eine Integer-Zahl. Falls der String leer ist, soll der Wert 0 zurückgegeben werden, anstatt eine Ausnahme auszulösen.

CLASS zcl_conv_cond_empty DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT, die eine maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (MAX_SEATS) von mehr als 300 haben, und speichern Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für eine deklarative Filterung.

CLASS zcl_filter_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_large_capacity_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_filter_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_capacity_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE max_seats > 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Dezimalzahl (Typ `p` mit 2 Dezimalstellen) in einen String und formatieren Sie sie mit einem Tausender-Trennzeichen und einem Komma als Dezimaltrennzeichen (z.B. 1234.56 soll zu '1.234,56' werden).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` in Kombination mit `WRITE TO` oder `cl_abap_format=>get_instance( )->format_number(...)` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_decimal_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_decimal_to_string IMPORTING iv_decimal TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_decimal_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_decimal_to_string.
    " Für einfache Formatierung kann WRITE TO verwendet werden, aber für spezifische
    " Dezimal-/Tausender-Trennzeichen ist CL_ABAP_FORMAT besser.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( ).
    rv_formatted_string = lo_formatter->format_number(
      val = iv_decimal
      decimals = 2
      thousand_separator = cl_abap_format=>thousand_separator_dot
      decimal_separator = cl_abap_format=>decimal_separator_comma
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_decimal FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_format_decimal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_decimal_format( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->format_decimal_to_string( '1234.56' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = '1.234,56' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->format_decimal_to_string( '123.45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = '123,45' ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->format_decimal_to_string( '1234567.89' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = '1.234.567,89' ).

    DATA(lv_result4) = lo_cut->format_decimal_to_string( '0.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result4 exp = '0,00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Tausender- und Dezimaltrennzeichen). Dies ist der moderne Ansatz, um lokalisierte oder spezifisch formatierte Zahlenstrings zu erzeugen, anstatt auf veraltete `WRITE TO` Anweisungen mit `EDIT MASK` zurückzugreifen.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen strukturierten Typ für Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) und einen internen Tabellentyp basierend darauf. Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle dieses Typs mit Beispieldaten unter Verwendung von `VALUE #`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Struktur und `TYPES TABLE OF ... WITH EMPTY KEY` für den Tabellentyp. Nutzen Sie `VALUE #` zur Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_flight_key.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sample_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '9300' fldate = '20250103' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sample_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_data_types( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sample_flights( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Deklaration von strukturierten und Tabellentypen innerhalb einer Klasse. Die Initialisierung der internen Tabelle erfolgt kompakt und lesbar mit einem `VALUE #` Ausdruck, der direkt die Daten zuweist.
keywords: TYPES, STRUCTURE, INTERNAL TABLE, VALUE, INLINE DECLARATION

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten (Fluggesellschafts-ID, Fluggesellschaftsname, Flugnummer, Flugdatum, Preis, Währung) aus den Tabellen `sflights` und `scarr` unter Verwendung eines `INNER JOIN` aus. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer inline-deklarierten internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... INNER JOIN ... ON ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` für die Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_s_flight_info.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE ty_t_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, s~currency
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_inner_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_details) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found in SFLIGHTS/SCARR' act = lines( lt_flight_details ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_details[ 1 ]-carrname ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INNER JOIN` Syntax ermöglicht das effiziente Verknüpfen von Daten aus zwei Tabellen direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung. Die Verwendung von Tabellen-Aliasen (`AS s`, `AS c`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit. Das Ergebnis wird direkt in eine inline-deklarierte interne Tabelle (`@rt_flight_details`) geschrieben.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, SCARR, INLINE DECLARATION

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen globalen Typ für einen Flugschlüssel (Fluggesellschafts-ID, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) und verwenden Sie diesen als Importparameter in einer Methode einer globalen Klasse. Die Methode soll diesen Schlüssel zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES` im globalen Klassen-Definitionsteil und referenzieren Sie ihn in der Methodensignatur.

CLASS zcl_global_flight_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_global_flight_types IMPLEMENTATION.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_key.

    DATA(ls_input_key) = VALUE zcl_global_flight_types=>ty_s_flight_key(

explanation: Globale Typen, die im `PUBLIC SECTION` einer Klasse definiert werden, können von außerhalb der Klasse referenziert und verwendet werden. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Konsistenz von Datenstrukturen über verschiedene Methoden und Klassen hinweg.
keywords: TYPES, GLOBAL TYPES, OBJECT ORIENTATION, METHOD PARAMETERS, STRUCTURE

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `sbook` durch, um Flugdetails und Buchungsinformationen abzurufen. Wenn für einen Flug keine Buchung existiert, sollen die Buchungsfelder initial sein. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH').
hint: Verwenden Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel. Beachten Sie, dass Felder aus `sbook` `NULL` sein können, wenn keine Übereinstimmung gefunden wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_booking_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,
           END OF ty_s_flight_booking_info.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_booking_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_booking_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_bookings
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_bookings) TYPE ty_t_flight_booking_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_left_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_bookings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_bookings) = lo_cut->get_flight_bookings( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found for LH' act = lines( lt_flight_bookings ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    " Check if some entries have booking info and some don't (if applicable in test data)
    DATA(lv_has_booking) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_no_booking) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_flight_bookings INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-bookid IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_has_booking = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        lv_has_no_booking = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should have at least one flight with or without booking' act = lv_has_booking OR lv_has_no_booking ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` ist ideal, um alle Einträge der linken Tabelle (`sflights`) beizubehalten und passende Einträge aus der rechten Tabelle (`sbook`) hinzuzufügen. Wenn keine Übereinstimmung gefunden wird, sind die Felder der rechten Tabelle initial. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Ergebnisse vor der Rückgabe.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, SBOOK, WHERE

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Hash-Tabellentyp mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel für Flugverbindungen (Fluggesellschafts-ID, Flugnummer). Füllen Sie diesen mit Daten aus `sflights` unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE #`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE HASHED KEY ...` und die `FOR`-Iteration mit `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_connection,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_s_flight_connection.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_connections TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_s_flight_connection
                                   WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_unique_connections RETURNING VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE ty_t_flight_connections.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_connections.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connections = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_types( ).
    DATA(lt_connections) = lo_cut->get_unique_connections( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found in SFLIGHTS' act = lines( lt_connections ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    " Check for uniqueness (hashed table ensures this, but we can verify logic)
    DATA(lt_check_duplicates) = lt_connections.
    SORT lt_check_duplicates BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_check_duplicates COMPARING carrid connid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connections ) exp = lines( lt_check_duplicates ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Hash-Tabellen bieten schnellen Zugriff auf Einträge über ihren Schlüssel. Die Definition mit `WITH UNIQUE HASHED KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Schlüssel existieren. Die `FOR`-Iteration in Verbindung mit `VALUE #` ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, interne Tabellen basierend auf anderen Tabellen zu füllen und dabei Transformationen durchzuführen.
keywords: TYPES, HASHED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, FOR, VALUE, INTERNAL TABLE

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` und die entsprechenden Flughafennamen (für Abflug- und Ankunftsflughafen) aus `sairport` unter Verwendung von zwei `INNER JOIN`s aus. Verwenden Sie Aliase für die `sairport`-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie zwei `INNER JOIN` Klauseln mit unterschiedlichen Aliasen für `sairport` (z.B. `AS dep_airport`, `AS arr_airport`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_multi_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_airport_info,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom    TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             airportfrom TYPE sairport-name,
             cityto      TYPE sflight-cityto,
             airportto   TYPE sairport-name,
           END OF ty_s_flight_airport_info.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_airport_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_airport_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_airport_details RETURNING VALUE(rt_details) TYPE ty_t_flight_airport_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_multi_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_airport_details.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, s~cityfrom, dep~name AS airportfrom,
           s~cityto, arr~name AS airportto
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN sairport AS dep ON s~airportfrom = dep~id
      INNER JOIN sairport AS arr ON s~airportto = arr~id
      INTO TABLE @rt_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_airport_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_airport_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_multi_join( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_cut->get_flight_airport_details( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found in SFLIGHTS/SAIRPORT' act = lines( lt_details ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_details[ 1 ]-airportfrom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_details[ 1 ]-airportto ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie mehrere `INNER JOIN`s verwendet werden können, um Daten aus mehr als zwei Tabellen zu kombinieren. Durch die Verwendung von Aliasen für dieselbe Tabelle (`sairport`) kann sie mehrfach in einer `JOIN`-Klausel verwendet werden, um unterschiedliche Beziehungen (Abflug- und Ankunftsflughafen) abzubilden.
keywords: JOIN, MULTIPLE JOIN, INNER JOIN, ALIAS, SAIRPORT, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen verschachtelten strukturierten Typ: eine Flugstruktur, die grundlegende Flugdaten und eine interne Tabelle von Buchungsdetails enthält. Erstellen Sie eine Instanz und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Hauptstruktur und für den verschachtelten Tabellentyp. Nutzen Sie `VALUE #` für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_booking_detail,

    TYPES: ty_t_booking_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_booking_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_with_bookings,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

           END OF ty_s_flight_with_bookings.

    METHODS get_flight_with_bookings RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_s_flight_with_bookings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_bookings.
    rs_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA'
                         connid = '0017'
                         fldate = '20250101'
                         bookings = VALUE #( ( bookid = '00000001' customid = '123' passname = 'John Doe' )
                                             ( bookid = '00000002' customid = '456' passname = 'Jane Smith' ) ) ).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_with_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_with_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_types( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_bookings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_flight-bookings ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: Verschachtelte Typen ermöglichen die Modellierung komplexer Datenstrukturen, bei denen eine Struktur eine interne Tabelle oder eine andere Struktur als Komponente enthält. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Darstellung hierarchischer Daten. Die Initialisierung mit `VALUE #` ist auch hier sehr ausdrucksstark und kompakt.
keywords: TYPES, NESTED STRUCTURE, INTERNAL TABLE IN STRUCTURE, VALUE

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `RIGHT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `scarr` und `sflights`, um alle Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge zu finden, einschließlich Fluggesellschaften ohne Flüge. Ordnen Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaftsnamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RIGHT OUTER JOIN` und `ORDER BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_right_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_carrier_flight_info.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrier_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_carriers_with_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_details) TYPE ty_t_carrier_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_right_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_carriers_with_flights.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      RIGHT OUTER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      ORDER BY c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_carriers_with_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_carriers_with_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_right_join( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_cut->get_all_carriers_with_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found in SCARR' act = lines( lt_details ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    " Check if there are carriers without flights (connid/fldate initial)
    DATA(lv_has_carrier_no_flight) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_details INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-connid IS INITIAL AND ls_entry-fldate IS INITIAL.
        lv_has_carrier_no_flight = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should include carriers without flights' act = lv_has_carrier_no_flight ).

    " Check order by
    DATA(lv_prev_carrname) = ''.
    LOOP AT lt_details INTO ls_entry.
      IF lv_prev_carrname IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_entry-carrname < lv_prev_carrname.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Results are not ordered correctly' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrname = ls_entry-carrname.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `RIGHT OUTER JOIN` ist das Gegenstück zum `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und stellt sicher, dass alle Einträge der rechten Tabelle (`scarr`) im Ergebnis enthalten sind, auch wenn keine passenden Einträge in der linken Tabelle (`sflights`) gefunden werden. Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel sortiert das Ergebnis direkt in der Datenbankabfrage.
keywords: JOIN, RIGHT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, SCARR, SFLIGHTS, ORDER BY

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Typ für eine Flugzusammenfassung (Fluggesellschafts-ID, Gesamtanzahl der Flüge, Gesamtkapazität). Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle dieses Typs, indem Sie `sflights`-Daten nach Fluggesellschaft gruppieren und `REDUCE` verwenden, um die Anzahl der Flüge und die Gesamtkapazität zu aggregieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Zusammenfassungsstruktur und `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_summary_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             total_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_s_flight_summary.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE ty_t_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = REDUCE ty_t_flight_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_t_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( LET current_carrid = ls_flight-carrid IN
        VALUE #( carrid = current_carrid
                 total_flights = GROUP SIZE
                 total_capacity = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_member IN GROUP ( sum = sum + ls_member-seatsmax ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_summary_types( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found in SFLIGHTS' act = lines( lt_summaries ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    " Find a specific carrier and check its aggregated values
    DATA(ls_summary_aa) = lt_summaries[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ].
    IF ls_summary_aa IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary_aa-total_flights ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary_aa-total_capacity ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Definition eines benutzerdefinierten Typs mit der leistungsstarken `REDUCE`-Ausdrucksfunktion und `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`. Dies ermöglicht eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Aggregation von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle, was zu deutlich weniger Code und besserer Lesbarkeit führt als traditionelle Schleifen und `COLLECT`.
keywords: TYPES, REDUCE, GROUP BY, INTERNAL TABLE, AGGREGATION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` und `scarr` unter Verwendung eines `INNER JOIN` aus. Verwenden Sie zusätzlich einen `CASE`-Ausdruck in der `SELECT`-Anweisung, um Flüge basierend auf ihrem Preis zu kategorisieren (z.B. 'Cheap', 'Standard', 'Expensive').
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN` mit einem `CASE`-Ausdruck in der `SELECT`-Liste. Nutzen Sie `sflight-price` für die Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_case_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_categorized_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             currency    TYPE sflight-currency,
             price_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_categorized_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_categorized_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_categorized_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_categorized_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_case_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, s~currency,
           CASE
             WHEN s~price < 200 THEN 'Cheap'
             WHEN s~price >= 200 AND s~price < 500 THEN 'Standard'
             ELSE 'Expensive'
           END AS price_category
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_categorized_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_categorized_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_case_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found in SFLIGHTS/SCARR' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    " Check for at least one 'Cheap' category (assuming data exists)
    DATA(lv_found_cheap) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price_category = 'Cheap'.
        lv_found_cheap = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should find at least one cheap flight' act = lv_found_cheap ).

    " Check for at least one 'Expensive' category (assuming data exists)
    DATA(lv_found_expensive) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO ls_flight.
      IF ls_flight-price_category = 'Expensive'.
        lv_found_expensive = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should find at least one expensive flight' act = lv_found_expensive ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CASE`-Ausdrücken direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste ist eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten während der Abfrage zu transformieren oder zu kategorisieren. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing in ABAP und verbessert die Performance, da die Logik direkt in der Datenbank ausgeführt wird. Kombiniert mit `INNER JOIN` ermöglicht dies komplexe Datenabrufe in einem einzigen Statement.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, CASE, SELECT EXPRESSION, SFLIGHTS, SCARR, CATEGORIZATION

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Tabellentyp für Fluggesellschafts-IDs mit einem eindeutigen nicht-primären Schlüssel. Füllen Sie diesen mit eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs aus der Tabelle `scarr`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE NON-UNIQUE KEY ...` und `SELECT DISTINCT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carrid_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH UNIQUE NON-UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_carrids RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE ty_t_carrids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carrid_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM scarr INTO TABLE @rt_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_carrid_types( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found in SCARR' act = lines( lt_carrids ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    " Check for uniqueness
    DATA(lt_check_duplicates) = lt_carrids.
    SORT lt_check_duplicates ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_check_duplicates.

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Definition eines Tabellentyps mit `WITH UNIQUE NON-UNIQUE KEY table_line` ist nützlich, wenn Sie eine interne Tabelle von Skalaren (wie hier `carrid`) haben und sicherstellen möchten, dass jeder Eintrag eindeutig ist. `SELECT DISTINCT` ist die effiziente Datenbankmethode, um nur eindeutige Werte abzurufen.
keywords: TYPES, INTERNAL TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, NON-UNIQUE KEY, SELECT DISTINCT, SCARR

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `scarr` durch. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse so, dass nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschafts-ID und einem Flugdatum nach einem bestimmten Stichtag zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN` und mehrere Bedingungen in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filtered_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_filtered_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

        iv_fldate_from TYPE sflight-fldate

CLASS zcl_flight_filtered_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND s~fldate >= @iv_fldate_from
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination eines `INNER JOIN` mit einer komplexeren `WHERE`-Klausel, die mehrere Bedingungen enthält. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist die moderne Art, ABAP-Variablen in Open SQL-Anweisungen zu verwenden, was die Sicherheit und Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Typ für eine generische Schlüssel-Wert-Paar-Struktur und einen Tabellentyp davon. Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dieser Schlüssel-Wert-Paare zurückgibt, die aus Flugdaten (z.B. Fluggesellschafts-ID als Schlüssel, Flugnummer als Wert) generiert wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Schlüssel-Wert-Struktur und `TYPES TABLE OF ...` für den Tabellentyp. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_kv_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_key_value_pair,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_key_value_pair.
    TYPES: ty_t_key_value_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_key_value_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_kv_pairs RETURNING VALUE(rt_kv_pairs) TYPE ty_t_key_value_pairs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_kv_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_kv_pairs.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_kv_pairs = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                             ( key = ls_flight-carrid
                               value = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_kv_types( ).
    DATA(lt_kv_pairs) = lo_cut->get_flight_kv_pairs( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_kv_pairs[ 1 ]-key ).

explanation: Generische Schlüssel-Wert-Paar-Typen sind flexibel für die Darstellung von Daten, bei denen die Semantik der Felder dynamisch ist. Die Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE #` ermöglicht eine einfache Transformation von Datenbankdaten in diese generische Struktur, was oft in Integrationsszenarien oder bei der dynamischen Datenverarbeitung nützlich ist.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `scarr` durch. Verwenden Sie eine `HAVING`-Klausel, um nur Fluggesellschaften zurückzugeben, die eine Mindestanzahl von Flügen haben (z.B. mehr als 10 Flüge).
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN`, `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_having_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE ty_t_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_having_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT( * ) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carriers_with_min_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_having_join( ).
    DATA(lv_min_flights) = 10.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_min_flights( iv_min_flights = lv_min_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found for carriers with > 10 flights' act = lines( lt_carriers ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_carrier-flight_count > lv_min_flights ).
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `HAVING`-Klausel wird in Verbindung mit `GROUP BY` verwendet, um Gruppen basierend auf aggregierten Werten zu filtern. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in Open SQL, um komplexe Filterbedingungen direkt in der Datenbankabfrage zu implementieren, anstatt die Aggregation in ABAP durchzuführen und dann zu filtern.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, AGGREGATION, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, SCARR

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle möglichen Werte einer Enumeration zur Laufzeit.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI-Funktionen wie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_NAME` und `CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM color_enum,
             red,
             green,
             blue,
           END OF ENUM color_enum.

    METHODS get_enum_values IMPORTING iv_enum_type_name TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enum_values.
    DATA: lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_enum_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_enumdescr,
          ls_enum_value TYPE cl_abap_enumdescr=>enum_value.

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_enum_type_name ).
        lo_enum_descr ?= lo_type_descr. "Downcast to enum descriptor

        LOOP AT lo_enum_descr->get_values( ) INTO ls_enum_value.
          APPEND ls_enum_value-name TO rt_values.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., type not found or not an enum
        MESSAGE 'Invalid enum type name' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Enumerationswert unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung mit den Enumerationswerten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM operation_type,
             add,
             subtract,
             multiply,
             divide,
           END OF ENUM operation_type.

    METHODS perform_operation IMPORTING iv_op_type TYPE operation_type
                                        iv_val1    TYPE i
                                        iv_val2    TYPE i
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    CASE iv_op_type.
      WHEN operation_type=>add.
        rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
      WHEN operation_type=>subtract.
        rv_result = iv_val1 - iv_val2.
      WHEN operation_type=>multiply.
        rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
      WHEN operation_type=>divide.
        IF iv_val2 <> 0.
          rv_result = iv_val1 / iv_val2.
        ELSE.
          " Handle division by zero
          rv_result = 0.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Should not happen with enum, but good practice
        rv_result = 0.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operations.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_enum_case( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->perform_operation( iv_op_type = zcl_enum_case=>operation_type=>add iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ) exp = 8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->perform_operation( iv_op_type = zcl_enum_case=>operation_type=>subtract iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->perform_operation( iv_op_type = zcl_enum_case=>operation_type=>multiply iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ) exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->perform_operation( iv_op_type = zcl_enum_case=>operation_type=>divide iv_val1 = 6 iv_val2 = 3 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->perform_operation( iv_op_type = zcl_enum_case=>operation_type=>divide iv_val1 = 6 iv_val2 = 0 ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Enumerationen in `CASE`-Anweisungen verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Typsicherheit des Codes erheblich, da der Compiler die Gültigkeit der Werte überprüfen kann.

CLASS zcl_enum_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM status_enum,
             new,
             in_progress,
             completed,
             cancelled,
           END OF ENUM status_enum.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_task,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE status_enum,
           END OF ty_s_task.
    TYPES: ty_t_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_tasks RETURNING VALUE(rt_tasks) TYPE ty_t_tasks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_tasks.
    rt_tasks = VALUE #( 
      ( id = 1 name = 'Implement Feature A' status = status_enum=>new )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Fix Bug B'           status = status_enum=>in_progress )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Write Documentation' status = status_enum=>completed )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Review Code C'       status = status_enum=>cancelled )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in `sflights` den Gesamtpreis für 2 Passagiere und geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit Flugnummer und Gesamtpreis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... LET ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_let_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_price.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_prices) TYPE ty_t_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_let_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_prices = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_passengers = 2 IN
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        total_price = ls_flight-price * lv_passengers )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_flights_let->calculate_total_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_prices ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_prices ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_prices[ 1 ]-total_price exp = lt_prices[ 1 ]-total_price / 2 * 2 ). " Check calculation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LET`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks, was den Code lesbarer und modularer macht, insbesondere bei komplexeren Berechnungen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.

solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_carrier_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_t_carrier_counts.

CLASS zcl_for_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der `sflights`-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_flights_reduce) = NEW zcl_for_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_flights_reduce->calculate_total_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total_price ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight-price.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Wochentage und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, die den Namen des Tages zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM ... END OF ENUM` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM weekday,
             monday,
             tuesday,
             wednesday,
             thursday,
             friday,
             saturday,
             sunday,
           END OF ENUM weekday.

    METHODS get_day_name IMPORTING iv_day TYPE weekday RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_name.
    CASE iv_day.
      WHEN weekday=>monday.    rv_name = 'Montag'.
      WHEN weekday=>tuesday.   rv_name = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN weekday=>wednesday. rv_name = 'Mittwoch'.
      WHEN weekday=>thursday.  rv_name = 'Donnerstag'.
      WHEN weekday=>friday.    rv_name = 'Freitag'.
      WHEN weekday=>saturday.  rv_name = 'Samstag'.
      WHEN weekday=>sunday.    rv_name = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN OTHERS.             rv_name = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_weekday_names.
    DATA(lo_weekday) = NEW zcl_enum_weekday( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_weekday->get_day_name( zcl_enum_weekday=>weekday=>monday ) exp = 'Montag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_weekday->get_day_name( zcl_enum_weekday=>weekday=>sunday ) exp = 'Sonntag' ).

Instructions: Lese die Flugdaten für einen bestimmten Flug (Carrier, Connection, Date) in eine Struktur. Nutze dabei die moderne Inline-Deklaration für die Zielstruktur.
hint: Verwende `SELECT SINGLE * INTO @DATA(ls_flight) WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight_data ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_single_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_single_flight.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_reader->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight-carrid ). " Assuming no data for 20250101, adjust if sflights has data

    " Example with existing data (adjust if needed)
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    SELECT SINGLE fldate FROM sflight INTO @lv_fldate WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight = lo_reader->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SELECT SINGLE * INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data)` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Zielstruktur, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. `CORRESPONDING #` wird für die Zuweisung verwendet.
keywords: SELECT, SINGLE, INTO, DATA, Inline-Deklaration, Struktur

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge für eine Liste von Carriern und Verbindungen. Nutze dabei `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer vorbereiteten internen Tabelle.
hint: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit den Suchkriterien und verwende `FOR ALL ENTRIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_fae_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_criteria,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_criteria.
    TYPES tt_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_criteria WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_criteria TYPE tt_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_fae_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_criteria.
    IF it_criteria IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_data)
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_criteria
        WHERE carrid = @it_criteria-carrid
          AND connid = @it_criteria-connid.
      IF lt_flights_data IS NOT INITIAL.
        rt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_flights_data ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_criteria FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_criteria.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_fae_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_flight_fae_reader=>tt_criteria(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_criteria( lt_criteria ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ). " Assuming these two flights exist

    CLEAR lt_criteria.
    lt_flights = lo_reader->get_flights_by_criteria( lt_criteria ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisiere den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges. Nutze dabei die moderne Syntax für `UPDATE`.
hint: Verwende `UPDATE sflight SET price = @new_price WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    UPDATE sflight SET price = @iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_flight_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_price.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_old_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA(lv_new_price) TYPE sflight-price VALUE '999.99'.

    " Ensure a flight exists for testing
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_old_price
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Insert a dummy flight if not found
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
        carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
        price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 150
      ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.
      lv_old_price = '100.00'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_updater->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_connid = lv_connid iv_fldate = lv_fldate iv_new_price = lv_new_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    DATA(lv_check_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_check_price
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_check_price exp = lv_new_price ).

    " Revert change for other tests
    UPDATE sflight SET price = @lv_old_price
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisiere die Anzahl der belegten Sitze für mehrere Flüge basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Update-Strukturen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_mass_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_mass_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_seats.
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @it_updates.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mass_update_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mass_update_seats.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_mass_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid1) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_connid2) = '0018'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_old_seats1) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
    DATA(lv_old_seats2) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.

    " Ensure flights exist for testing
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflight INTO @lv_old_seats1
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid1 AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
        carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate
        price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 150
      ) ).
    ENDIF.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflight INTO @lv_old_seats2
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid2 AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
        carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate
        price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 100
      ) ).
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_flight_mass_updater=>tt_flight_update(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate seatsocc = 160 )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate seatsocc = 110 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_rows) = lo_updater->mass_update_seats( lt_updates ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_check_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflight INTO @lv_check_seats
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid1 AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_check_seats exp = 160 ).

    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflight INTO @lv_check_seats
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid2 AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_check_seats exp = 110 ).

    " Revert changes
    UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = @lv_old_seats1
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid1 AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = @lv_old_seats2
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid2 AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @it_updates`-Statement ermöglicht die Massenaktualisierung von Datenbankzeilen direkt aus einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist sehr effizient, da es die Anzahl der Datenbankzugriffe minimiert.
keywords: UPDATE, FROM TABLE, Interne Tabelle, Massenaktualisierung

Instructions: Ermittle für jeden Carrier die durchschnittliche Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) für Flüge, bei denen die durchschnittliche Auslastung über 70% liegt. Nutze dabei `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
hint: Verwende `SELECT carrid, AVG( seatsocc / seatsmax ) ... GROUP BY carrid HAVING AVG(...) > 0.7`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_carrier_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_high_occupancy_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_carrier_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_occupancy_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( CAST( seatsocc AS FLTP ) / CAST( seatsmax AS FLTP ) ) AS avg_occupancy
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING AVG( CAST( seatsocc AS FLTP ) / CAST( seatsmax AS FLTP ) ) > 0.7
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result).
    IF lt_result IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_occupancy = lt_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_analyzer->get_high_occupancy_carriers( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_occupancy ).

    " Check if 'AA' is in the result (assuming it has high occupancy)
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
      lv_found = abap_true.
