    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in einem `SELECT`-Statement ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Filterungen auf Gruppenebene direkt in der Datenbank. Die Verwendung von `CAST` für die Division stellt sicher, dass eine Gleitkommadivision durchgeführt wird.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, HAVING, Aggregatfunktionen, AVG, CAST, SQL Expressions

Instructions: Kombiniere eine Liste von Flügen mit hoher Auslastung (seatsocc > 80% von seatsmax) und eine Liste von Flügen mit niedrigem Preis (price < 100) in einer einzigen Abfrage. Nutze `UNION ALL`.
hint: Verwende `SELECT ... UNION ALL SELECT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_union_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_special_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_union_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_special_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, 'HIGH_OCCUPANCY' AS category
      FROM sflight
      WHERE seatsocc > ( seatsmax * 0.8 )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, 'LOW_PRICE' AS category
      FROM sflight
      WHERE price < 100
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result).
    IF lt_result IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_flights = lt_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_special_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_special_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_union_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_special_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    DATA(lv_high_occ_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_low_price_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-category = 'HIGH_OCCUPANCY'.
        lv_high_occ_count = lv_high_occ_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-category = 'LOW_PRICE'.
        lv_low_price_count = lv_low_price_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lv_high_occ_count exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lv_low_price_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` ermöglicht das Kombinieren der Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Statements in einer einzigen Ergebnismenge. Dies ist nützlich, um Daten aus verschiedenen Kriterien oder Quellen zu aggregieren. Die Verwendung von Literalen (`'HIGH_OCCUPANCY' AS category`) ist eine moderne Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Informationen hinzuzufügen.
keywords: SELECT, UNION ALL, SQL Expressions, Literale, Kombinieren

Instructions: Aktualisiere den Flugstatus (angenommen, es gibt ein Feld `status` vom Typ `string` in `sflight`) basierend auf der Auslastung: 'FULL' wenn seatsocc = seatsmax, 'HIGH' wenn seatsocc > 0.8 * seatsmax, sonst 'NORMAL'.
hint: Verwende `UPDATE ... SET status = CASE WHEN ... END WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    " Annahme: sflight hat ein Feld 'status' vom Typ string
    " Wenn nicht, müsste sflight erweitert oder ein anderes Feld als Proxy verwendet werden.
    UPDATE sflight SET
      status = CASE
                 WHEN seatsocc = seatsmax THEN 'FULL'
                 WHEN seatsocc > ( seatsmax * 0.8 ) THEN 'HIGH'
                 ELSE 'NORMAL'
               END.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_status_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_old_seatsocc) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
    DATA(lv_old_seatsmax) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
    DATA(lv_old_status) TYPE string.

    " Ensure a flight exists and get original values
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc, seatsmax, status FROM sflight INTO (@lv_old_seatsocc, @lv_old_seatsmax, @lv_old_status)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
        carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
        price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 status = 'NORMAL'
      ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.
      lv_old_seatsocc = 250.
      lv_old_seatsmax = 300.
      lv_old_status = 'NORMAL'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_rows) = lo_updater->update_flight_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lv_rows exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lv_check_status) TYPE string.
    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflight INTO @lv_check_status
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.

    IF lv_old_seatsocc = lv_old_seatsmax.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_check_status exp = 'FULL' ).
    ELSEIF lv_old_seatsocc > ( lv_old_seatsmax * 0.8 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_check_status exp = 'HIGH' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_check_status exp = 'NORMAL' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Revert changes
    UPDATE sflight SET status = @lv_old_status
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Expression im `SET`-Teil eines `UPDATE`-Statements (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.55) ermöglicht eine bedingte Aktualisierung von Feldern direkt in der Datenbank. Dies ist sehr leistungsfähig und reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Daten zuerst in ABAP zu lesen und dann zu aktualisieren.
keywords: UPDATE, SET, CASE, WHEN, SQL Expressions, Bedingte Aktualisierung

Instructions: Lese die Top 5 der teuersten Flüge für einen bestimmten Carrier. Nutze dabei `ORDER BY` und `UP TO n ROWS`.
hint: Verwende `SELECT ... ORDER BY price DESC UP TO 5 ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_top_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_top_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_limit  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_top_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_expensive_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY price DESC
      UP TO @iv_limit ROWS.
    IF lt_result IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_flights = lt_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_top_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_top_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_top_expensive_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 ).

    " Check if prices are in descending order
    DATA(lv_prev_price) TYPE sflight-price VALUE '9999999.99'.

      lv_prev_price = ls_flight-price.

    lt_flights = lo_reader->get_top_expensive_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ORDER BY` in Kombination mit `UP TO n ROWS` ist eine effiziente Methode, um eine begrenzte Anzahl von Datensätzen basierend auf einer Sortierreihenfolge zu erhalten. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Ranglisten oder Paginierung.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY, UP TO n ROWS, Sortierung, Limit

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge, die in den nächsten 30 Tagen stattfinden, und gib zusätzlich an, ob der Flug bereits ausgebucht ist (seatsocc = seatsmax). Nutze dabei eine SQL-Expression für die Datumsberechnung und ein `CASE` für den Status.
hint: Verwende `SELECT ... WHERE fldate BETWEEN sy-datum AND sy-datum + 30 AND CASE WHEN ... END`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_future_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_future_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             is_booked_out TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_future_flight.
    TYPES tt_future_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_future_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_upcoming_flights_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_future_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_future_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_upcoming_flights_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE WHEN seatsocc = seatsmax THEN @abap_true ELSE @abap_false END AS is_booked_out
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result)
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN @sy-datum AND @( sy-datum + 30 ).
    IF lt_result IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_flights = lt_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_upcoming_flights_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_upcoming_flights_status.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_future_status( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_upcoming_flights_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    " Check if all flights are in the next 30 days
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_equal( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = sy-datum ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = sy-datum + 30 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check a specific flight's booked out status (requires test data setup)
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum + 1.
    DATA(lv_seatsmax) TYPE sflight-seatsmax VALUE 200.
    DATA(lv_seatsocc) TYPE sflight-seatsocc VALUE 200.

    " Insert a dummy flight for testing booked out status
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
      price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsmax = lv_seatsmax seatsocc = lv_seatsocc
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    lt_flights = lo_reader->get_upcoming_flights_status( ).
    DATA(ls_booked_out_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_future_status=>ty_future_flight(
      carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO ls_booked_out_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_booked_out_flight-is_booked_out exp = abap_true ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: SQL-Expressions im `WHERE`-Teil (`sy-datum + 30`) und im `SELECT`-Teil (`CASE WHEN ... END`) ermöglichen komplexe Logik direkt in der Datenbankabfrage. Dies reduziert den Datenverkehr und die Verarbeitungszeit im Applikationsserver. Die Verwendung von `@abap_true` und `@abap_false` ist eine moderne Art, boolesche Werte zu handhaben.
keywords: SELECT, WHERE, CASE, SQL Expressions, Datum, abap_bool

Instructions: Erhöhe die belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers um einen festen Wert, aber nur, wenn die neuen belegten Sitze die maximale Kapazität (`seatsmax`) nicht überschreiten.
hint: Verwende `UPDATE ... SET seatsocc = seatsocc + @increase_value WHERE ... AND seatsocc + @increase_value <= seatsmax`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_seat_incrementer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increment_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_seat_incrementer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increment_seats.
    UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = seatsocc + @iv_increase_value
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND seatsocc + @iv_increase_value <= seatsmax.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_increment_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increment_seats.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_seat_incrementer( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_old_seatsocc) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
    DATA(lv_old_seatsmax) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.

    " Ensure a flight exists and get original values
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO (@lv_old_seatsocc, @lv_old_seatsmax)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
        carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
        price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 150
      ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.
      lv_old_seatsocc = 150.
      lv_old_seatsmax = 300.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_increase) = 10.
    DATA(lv_rows) = lo_updater->increment_seats( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_increase_value = lv_increase ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lv_rows exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lv_check_seatsocc) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflight INTO @lv_check_seatsocc
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_check_seatsocc exp = lv_old_seatsocc + lv_increase ).

    " Test with an increase that would exceed max seats
    lv_increase = 500.
    lv_rows = lo_updater->increment_seats( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_increase_value = lv_increase ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows exp = 0 ). " No rows should be updated

    " Revert changes
    UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = @lv_old_seatsocc
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Möglichkeit, arithmetische Operationen (`seatsocc + @iv_increase_value`) direkt im `SET`-Teil des `UPDATE`-Statements und auch im `WHERE`-Teil zu verwenden, ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature von modernem ABAP SQL. Es ermöglicht komplexe Aktualisierungslogik direkt in der Datenbank, was die Performance verbessert und Race Conditions minimiert.
keywords: UPDATE, SET, WHERE, Arithmetische Operationen, SQL Expressions

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen multipliziert. Wenn das Ergebnis einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse (z.B. ZCX_OVERFLOW) und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_overflow DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        value    TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_overflow IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_value = value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_with_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_with_check.
    rv_result = iv_num1 * iv_num2.
    IF rv_result > iv_threshold.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_overflow
        EXPORTING
          value = rv_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiply_ok FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiply_overflow FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiply_ok.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->multiply_with_check( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 10 iv_threshold = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply_overflow.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_calc->multiply_with_check( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 20 iv_threshold = 100 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_overflow was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_overflow.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception zcx_overflow caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme-Klasse (ZCX_OVERFLOW) und das Auslösen dieser Ausnahme mit `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` bei einer bestimmten Bedingung. Die Ausnahme wird dann im Unit-Test mit einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block abgefangen, was eine moderne und robuste Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP darstellt.
keywords: RAISE, EXCEPTION, CLASS, TRY, CATCH, MULTIPLY, Error Handling

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Produkt aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für eine funktionale Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i( INIT p = 1 FOR <num> IN it_numbers NEXT p = p * <num> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_product_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_product_with_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_product_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_product_positive.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_product_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_calc->calculate_product( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_product exp = 24 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_product_with_zero.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_product_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 2 ) ( 0 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_calc->calculate_product( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_product exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_product_empty.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_product_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_calc->calculate_product( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_product exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das eine kompakte und funktionale Möglichkeit bietet, Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um das Produkt aller Elemente zu berechnen, beginnend mit einem Initialwert von 1.
keywords: REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights). Wenn ein Flug eine maximale Sitzplatzkapazität von 0 hat, lösen Sie eine Standardausnahme aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` und `IF ... RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_capacity.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-seatsmax = 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_capacity_flight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_flights.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 200 )
    ).
    lo_checker->check_flight_capacity( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected for valid flights.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_capacity_flight.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0888' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 0   )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_checker->check_flight_capacity( lt_flights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_sy_zerodivide was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception cx_sy_zerodivide caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von `RAISE EXCEPTION` innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Anweisung zur Validierung von Daten. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen ist ein modernes Feature ab ABAP 7.40.
keywords: RAISE, LOOP, IF, Internal Tables, sflights, Error Handling

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis für eine bestimmte Menge eines Artikels, wobei der Preis und die Menge als Eingabe gegeben sind.

CLASS zcl_simple_math DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_simple_math IMPLEMENTATION.

unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft. Wenn die Methode nicht existiert, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_OBJECT_REF`) und `CALL METHOD ... PARAMETER-TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_method_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_method_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        method_name TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_method_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_method_name = method_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.
    DATA mv_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_data = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS invoke_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE abap_parmbind_tab
      RAISING
        zcx_method_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invoke_method_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_invalid_descr_type cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_method_not_found
          EXPORTING
            method_name = iv_method_name.
    ENDTRY.

    CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE it_parameters
      RECEIVING
        PARAMETER-TABLE rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invoke_existing_method FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invoke_non_existing_method FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_method_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invoke_existing_method.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_invoker) = NEW zcl_dynamic_invoker( ).
    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
      ( name = 'IV_VALUE' kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>importing value = REF #( 'Hello Dynamic!' ) )
    ).
    lo_invoker->invoke_method_dynamically( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'SET_VALUE' it_parameters = lt_params ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_target->mv_data exp = 'Hello Dynamic!' ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_invoker->invoke_method_dynamically( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'GET_VALUE' ).
    DATA(lv_result_value) = CAST cl_abap_parmbind( lt_results[ 1 ] )->value.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_value->* exp = 'Hello Dynamic!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invoke_non_existing_method.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_invoker) = NEW zcl_dynamic_invoker( ).
    TRY.
        lo_invoker->invoke_method_dynamically( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_method_not_found was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_method_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception zcx_method_not_found caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) mit dynamischem Methodenaufruf und benutzerdefinierter Fehlerbehandlung. Es zeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit die Existenz einer Methode prüft und bei Nichtexistenz eine spezifische Ausnahme auslöst, was für flexible und robuste dynamische Programmierung unerlässlich ist.
keywords: RAISE, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, EXCEPTION, Advanced

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in einer Quelltabelle den doppelten Wert der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität enthält, zusammen mit den Flugidentifikationsdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity_doubled,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax_doubled TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity_doubled.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity_doubled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity_doubled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS double_capacity_table
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_doubled_capacities) TYPE tt_flight_capacity_doubled.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD double_capacity_table.
    rt_doubled_capacities = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen. Wenn bei der Verarbeitung einer Zahl eine Division durch Null auftritt, fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler, ohne die gesamte Verarbeitung zu stoppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ...` mit einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_robust_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_errors TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_numbers_with_error_logging
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_divisor TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        et_results TYPE tt_results
        et_errors  TYPE tt_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers_with_error_logging.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      TRY.
          DATA(lv_result) = lv_number / iv_divisor.
          APPEND lv_result TO et_results.
        CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
          APPEND |Error: Division by zero for number { lv_number }| TO et_errors.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA lt_results TYPE zcl_robust_processor=>tt_results.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    rv_final_bonus = COND #( WHEN iv_base_bonus > iv_threshold_value THEN iv_base_bonus * 2 ELSE iv_base_bonus ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights), um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl an Sitzplätzen zu erhalten. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.

CLASS zcx_no_flights_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL.

  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_carrid = carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats   TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flights_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax >= iv_min_seats ).

    IF lines( rt_filtered_flights ) = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_found
        EXPORTING
          carrid = iv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Produkte von zwei Feldern (z.B. `PRICE` und `SEATSMAX`) für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer Multiplikation innerhalb der Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_revenue_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_potential_revenue
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_revenue_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_potential_revenue.
    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE p( INIT total_rev = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT total_rev = total_rev + ( ls_flight-price * ls_flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_value DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_value = value.

CLASS zcl_value_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_value.

CLASS zcl_value_setter IMPLEMENTATION.

        EXPORTING
          value = iv_value.
    ENDIF.
    mv_stored_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: In der objektorientierten Programmierung ist die Validierung von Eingabewerten in Setter-Methoden eine Best Practice. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme (`ZCX_INVALID_VALUE`) verwendet wird, um ungültige Werte zu signalisieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String, der eine Zahl darstellt, in eine Integer umwandelt und diese mit einem Faktor multipliziert. Wenn der String keine gültige Zahl ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` für die Typumwandlung und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung bei der Umwandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_math DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_string_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_string_num TYPE string
        iv_factor     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_math IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_string_number.
    DATA(lv_number) = 0.
    TRY.
        lv_number = CONV i( iv_string_num ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_result = lv_number * iv_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_string_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_string_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_string_conversion.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_string_math( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_math->multiply_string_number( iv_string_num = '15' iv_factor = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 45 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_string_conversion.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_string_math( ).
    TRY.
        lo_math->multiply_string_number( iv_string_num = 'abc' iv_factor = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_sy_conversion_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception cx_sy_conversion_error caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Typumwandlung mit `CONV` und die robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` beim Umgang mit Benutzereingaben. Wenn der String nicht in eine Zahl umgewandelt werden kann, wird eine `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` ausgelöst und weitergegeben, was eine klare Trennung von Logik und Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: CONV, TRY, CATCH, RAISE, MULTIPLY, String Processing, Type Conversion, Error Handling

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugdaten (FLDATE) für Flüge mit einer bestimmten Verbindungsnummer (CONNID) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen FOR-Ausdruck mit VALUE #(...) und einer WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_fldate TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_date WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_dates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fldates) TYPE tt_fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_dates.
    rt_fldates = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( connid = iv_connid ) ( flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_processor=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result_dates) = lo_cut->get_flight_dates( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_dates ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_dates[ 1 ] exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_dates[ 2 ] exp = '20250102' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_dates) = lo_cut->get_flight_dates( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_empty_dates ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Hier wird eine neue Tabelle mit den Flugdaten für eine spezifische Verbindungsnummer erstellt.
keywords: FOR, VALUE #, Internal Tables, 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität (seatsmax) aller Flüge in SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, wobei die Fluggesellschaft als Konstante definiert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Ausdruck zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_airline TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA'.
    METHODS get_total_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      WHERE carrid = gc_airline.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity( ).

    " Assuming some 'AA' flights exist in SFLIGHTS for a meaningful test
    " For a robust test, SFLIGHTS would need to be mocked or test data inserted.
    " Here, we just assert it's not negative.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_capacity >= 0 ).

    " Example with known data (if SFLIGHTS was mocked):
    " DATA(lt_mock_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_reducer=>tt_sflight(
    "   ( carrid = 'AA' seatsmax = 100 )
    "   ( carrid = 'AA' seatsmax = 150 )
    "   ( carrid = 'LH' seatsmax = 200 ) ).
    " lo_cut->set_mock_flights( lt_mock_flights ). " Hypothetical setter for mock data
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_total_capacity( ) exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Verbindungs-ID und einer Mindestanzahl verfügbarer Sitzplätze zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie Konstanten für beide Kriterien.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CONSTANTS gc_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0017'.
    CONSTANTS gc_min_avail_seats TYPE i VALUE 10.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE connid = gc_connid AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= gc_min_avail_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) " Avail: 50 (match)
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 95 seatsmax = 100 ) " Avail: 5 (no match)
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 20 )  " Avail: 10 (no match connid)
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 90 )  " Avail: 10 (match)
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsmax - lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsocc exp = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-seatsmax - lt_result[ 2 ]-seatsocc exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine elegante und deklarative Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Die Verwendung von `CONSTANTS` für die Filterwerte macht den Code flexibler und leichter anpassbar.
keywords: FILTER, CONSTANTS, Internal Tables, 7.50

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen einzelnen Flug aus SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer konstanten Fluggesellschafts-ID und Verbindungs-ID in eine Struktur mit Inline-Deklaration aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT SINGLE ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...).
solution:
CLASS zcl_single_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    CONSTANTS gc_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA'.
    CONSTANTS gc_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0017'.
    METHODS get_flight_detail
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_single_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_detail.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = gc_carrid AND connid = gc_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_detail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_detail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_single_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_detail( ).

    " Assuming a flight 'AA' '0017' exists in SFLIGHTS for a meaningful test.
    " For a robust test, SFLIGHTS would need to be mocked or test data inserted.
    IF ls_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No flight AA 0017 found in SFLIGHTS for test.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SELECT SINGLE`-Anweisung mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)` ermöglicht das direkte Auslesen von Daten in eine Struktur, wobei nur die passenden Felder gefüllt werden. Die Verwendung von Konstanten in der `WHERE`-Klausel macht die Abfrage dynamisch und gut lesbar.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, DATA, CONSTANTS, sflights, 7.40

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Beschreibung basierend auf der Fluggesellschafts-ID (carrid) eines Fluges zurückgibt, unter Verwendung des SWITCH-Ausdrucks und Konstanten für die Airline-Codes.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_airline_desc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_lh TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH'.
    CONSTANTS gc_aa TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA'.
    CONSTANTS gc_ua TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'UA'.
    METHODS get_airline_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airline_desc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH string( iv_carrid
                                    WHEN gc_lh THEN 'Lufthansa'
                                    WHEN gc_aa THEN 'American Airlines'
                                    WHEN gc_ua THEN 'United Airlines'
                                    ELSE 'Unbekannte Fluggesellschaft' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_airline_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_airline_description.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_airline_desc( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_airline_description( 'LH' ) exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_airline_description( 'AA' ) exp = 'American Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_airline_description( 'UA' ) exp = 'United Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_airline_description( 'XX' ) exp = 'Unbekannte Fluggesellschaft' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen für bedingte Zuweisungen. Die Verwendung von Konstanten für die Vergleichswerte verbessert die Wartbarkeit und vermeidet Hardcoding.
keywords: SWITCH, CONSTANTS, Conditional Logic, 7.50

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und Verbindungs-ID (connid) und zählen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Klasse mit Konstanten für verschiedene Statuscodes (z.B. 'A' für Aktiv, 'I' für Inaktiv) und einer Methode, die prüft, ob ein gegebener Statuscode gültig ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie Konstanten und eine einfache IF-Bedingung oder ein CASE-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_status_active   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'A'.
    CONSTANTS gc_status_inactive TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I'.
    CONSTANTS gc_status_blocked  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'B'.

    METHODS is_valid_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_status.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN gc_status_active OR gc_status_inactive OR gc_status_blocked.
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_is_valid_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_valid_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_status_checker( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_status( zcl_status_checker=>gc_status_active ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_status( zcl_status_checker=>gc_status_inactive ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_status( zcl_status_checker=>gc_status_blocked ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_status( 'X' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_valid_status( '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Definition von Statuscodes als Klassenkonstanten verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich. Anstatt 'magische Zeichen' direkt im Code zu verwenden, wird auf selbsterklärende Konstanten verwiesen, was Fehler reduziert und die Anpassung erleichtert.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Conditional Logic, CASE, 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschafts-IDs (carrid) aus SFLIGHTS, die nur eindeutige Einträge enthält. Verwenden Sie eine Konstante für die maximale Anzahl der zurückzugebenden Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ... IN ... mit DISTINCT und VALUE #(...).
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE SORTED TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    CONSTANTS gc_max_entries TYPE i VALUE 5.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_carriers).

    rt_unique_carrids = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= gc_max_entries AND i <= lines( lt_all_carriers )
                                 ( lt_all_carriers[ i ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_carrids) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers( ).

    " Assert that the number of entries does not exceed the constant
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_unique_carrids ) <= zcl_unique_carriers=>gc_max_entries ).

    " Assert that all entries are unique (guaranteed by SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY)
    " If SFLIGHTS has at least 5 unique carriers, assert count is 5.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_carrids ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `SELECT DISTINCT INTO TABLE` zur Beschaffung eindeutiger Werte mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, der die Anzahl der zurückgegebenen Einträge auf eine definierte Konstante begrenzt. Dies ist eine moderne Art, Daten zu filtern und zu begrenzen, ohne explizite Schleifen und Zähler.

Instructions: In einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`), ersetzen Sie im Feld `CARRID` alle Kleinbuchstaben durch Großbuchstaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife und `REPLACE` in Kombination mit `TO UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_replace_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS normalize_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_normalized_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_replace_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_carrid.
    rt_normalized_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                      ( ls_sflight WITH carrid = to_upper( ls_sflight-carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_normalize_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normalize_carrid.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_it_replace_carrid=>tt_sflight_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'lh' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'aa' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '300' currency = 'SGD' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_it_replace_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->normalize_carrid( lt_test_data ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_result_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_1-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_result_2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_2-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_result_3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_3-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung eines `FOR` Ausdrucks in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation der internen Tabelle. `TO_UPPER` ist eine moderne String-Funktion, die hier direkt angewendet wird, um die Groß-/Kleinschreibung zu normalisieren.
keywords: REPLACE, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, TO_UPPER

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen mit einem Cursor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPENCURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             mandt    TYPE sflight-mandt,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights_paged
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights_paged.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_flights_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT mandt, carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_flights_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_package TO rt_all_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_all_flights_paged FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_flights_paged.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_db_opencursor_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_all_flights_paged( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ) ##NO_TEXT.
    " Since SFLIGHTS might be empty or have few entries in test systems,
    " we assert it's not initial. For a real test, one would insert test data.
    " For demonstration, we assume some data might exist.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ) ##NO_TEXT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `OPENCURSOR` mit `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE` ist die klassische und immer noch gültige Methode, um große Datenmengen effizient in Paketen zu verarbeiten. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` ist eine moderne Syntax, die das manuelle Mapping von Feldern überflüssig macht.
keywords: OPENCURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, PACKAGE SIZE, Database Access, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für Flüge aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' durchgeführt werden und nach Flugdatum absteigend sortiert sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHERE` und `ORDER BY` in der `SELECT` Anweisung des Cursors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights_sorted.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_flight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
       WHERE carrid = 'LH'
       ORDER BY fldate DESC.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights_sorted FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights_sorted.
    " Testdaten einfügen (falls nicht vorhanden)
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' )

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie mit einem Cursor die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHTS`, die mindestens 2 Flüge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in der `SELECT` Anweisung des Cursors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_having
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_having.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_flight_count TYPE ty_flight_count.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
        FROM sflights
       GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_flight_count.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, um Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` und die zugehörigen Fluggesellschaftsnamen aus `SCARR` zu verknüpfen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `JOIN` in der `SELECT` Anweisung des Cursors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_name,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_with_name.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_name) TYPE tt_flight_with_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_flight_with_name TYPE ty_flight_with_name.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
        FROM sflights AS s
        JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_flight_with_name.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_with_name TO rt_flights_with_name.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 50 Zeilen und verwenden Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` für eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `OPENCURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    TYPES tt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_package_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 50
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_subset.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_package_size.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_flights_buffer TYPE tt_sflight_subset.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_flights_buffer PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_buffer TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DO 60 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE sflight(
        mandt = sy-mandt
        carrid = 'XX'
        connid = |{ sy-index ALPHA = IN }|
        fldate = sy-datum
        price = '100'
        currency = 'EUR'
      ) TO lt_insert_data.
    ENDDO.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE lt_insert_data.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_db_opencursor_package( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` ist eine sehr nützliche Erweiterung, die es erlaubt, Daten aus der Datenbank in eine interne Tabelle zu lesen, wobei die Feldnamen automatisch gemappt werden. In Kombination mit `PACKAGE SIZE` bietet dies eine flexible und effiziente Möglichkeit, große Datenmengen zu verarbeiten, ohne alle Felder der Datenbanktabelle explizit angeben zu müssen.
keywords: OPENCURSOR, FETCH, PACKAGE SIZE, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Database Access, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem String alle Vorkommen von 'EUR' durch '€' und 'USD' durch '$' unter Verwendung von String-Templates und `REPLACE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates in Kombination mit `REPLACE` für eine lesbare Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_currencies
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_currencies.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.

    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'EUR' IN lv_temp_string WITH '€'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'USD' IN lv_temp_string WITH '$'.

    rv_result_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_currencies FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_currencies.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_str_replace_template( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_currencies( 'Price: 100 EUR, 200 USD.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Price: 100 €, 200 $.' ).

    lv_result = lo_replacer->replace_currencies( 'Only GBP here.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Only GBP here.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `REPLACE` in modernen ABAP-Programmen verwendet werden kann, um mehrere Ersetzungen sequentiell durchzuführen. Obwohl String-Templates selbst keine direkte Ersetzungsfunktion bieten, können sie für die Konstruktion des ursprünglichen Strings oder des Ersatzstrings verwendet werden, was die Lesbarkeit verbessert. Die eigentliche Ersetzung erfolgt hier durch zwei separate `REPLACE`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REPLACE, String Templates, String Processing

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem String alle Vorkommen von 'A' durch 'X', aber nur wenn 'A' von einem Leerzeichen gefolgt wird. Nutzen Sie `REPLACE` mit `REGEX`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem Lookahead-Assertion im Regex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_regex_la DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_a_with_x_lookahead
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_regex_la IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_a_with_x_lookahead.
    rv_result_string = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX 'A(?= )' IN rv_result_string WITH 'X'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_a_lookahead FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_a_lookahead.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_str_replace_regex_la( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_a_with_x_lookahead( 'A B C A D E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'X B C X D E' ).

    lv_result = lo_replacer->replace_a_with_x_lookahead( 'APPLE BANANA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'APPLE BANANA' ).

    lv_result = lo_replacer->replace_a_with_x_lookahead( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von regulären Ausdrücken mit Lookahead-Assertions (`(?= )`) in der `REPLACE`-Anweisung. Dies ermöglicht kontextabhängige Ersetzungen, bei denen ein Muster nur dann ersetzt wird, wenn es von einem bestimmten anderen Muster gefolgt wird, ohne dass das nachfolgende Muster selbst Teil der Ersetzung wird. Dies ist sehr mächtig für komplexe String-Manipulationen.
keywords: REPLACE, REGEX, Lookahead, String Processing, Advanced

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPENCURSOR` mit `UNION ALL`, um Flugdaten von `SFLIGHTS` und `SBOOK` (falls relevant) zu kombinieren und in Paketen zu lesen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             source   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined_data.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_db_opencursor_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flight_data.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_data_package TYPE tt_combined_data.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, 'SFLIGHTS' AS source
        FROM sflights
      UNION ALL
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, 'SBOOK' AS source
        FROM sbook.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_data_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_data_package TO rt_combined_data.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Quadratwert einer übergebenen Zahl.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_square( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_square( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 25 msg = 'Test with 5 failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_square( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Test with 0 failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_square( -3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 9 msg = 'Test with -3 failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Anstatt des veralteten 'COMPUTE rv_square = iv_number * iv_number.' wird der arithmetische Ausdruck direkt zugewiesen. Dies ist kürzer und lesbarer.
keywords: COMPUTE, Math, Arithmetic, Inline Declaration, Assignment

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur die übereinstimmenden Feldnamen kopiert werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Operator CORRESPONDING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_struct_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
        field3 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_source,
      BEGIN OF ty_target,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
        field_x TYPE string, " This field will not be filled by CORRESPONDING
      END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structure IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_struct_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_struct_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_struct_mapping=>ty_source( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 field3 = 'World' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field1 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 msg = 'Field2 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field_x msg = 'Field_x should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING Operator ersetzt die explizite Zuweisung von Feldern mit gleichem Namen (MOVE-CORRESPONDING). Er ist prägnanter und weniger fehleranfällig.
keywords: MOVE, CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Transformation, Assignment

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und das Datum aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS enthält, und benennen Sie die Felder um.
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE Operator mit FOR und CORRESPONDING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
        flight_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
      END OF ty_sflight_reduced,
      ty_sflight_reduced_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_reduced_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_reduced_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_reduced_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_reduced_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS. " Example data

    rt_reduced_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                  ( flight_id = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                    flight_date = <fs_sflight>-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_reduced_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_reduced_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_reduced) = lo_cut->get_reduced_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_reduced msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_reduced INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-flight_id msg = 'Flight ID should be filled' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-flight_date msg = 'Flight Date should be filled' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE Operator in Kombination mit FOR-Iteratoren ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt explizite LOOP- und MOVE-Anweisungen.
keywords: MOVE, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Länge eines Strings und geben Sie ihn in Großbuchstaben zurück, formatiert in einem String-Template.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen den Wert 'Positive' zu, wenn eine Zahl größer als Null ist, 'Negative' wenn kleiner als Null, und 'Zero' wenn gleich Null.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_conditional_assign IMPLEMENTATION.

                      WHEN iv_number < 0 THEN 'Negative'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

keywords: MOVE, COND, Conditional Logic, Assignment

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Example data

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( ).

    " Since SFLIGHT data can vary, we just assert it's not negative.
    " A more robust test would mock SFLIGHT data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total >= 0 ) msg = 'Total passengers should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Dies ersetzt explizite LOOP- und COMPUTE-Anweisungen für Summenbildung oder andere Reduktionsoperationen.
keywords: COMPUTE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie ein Datum, das eine bestimmte Anzahl von Tagen in der Zukunft liegt.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                       iv_days TYPE i
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE d.

unit_test:

    METHODS test_add_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20230101'.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lo_cut->add_days_to_date( iv_date = lv_date iv_days = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_future_date exp = '20230111' msg = 'Adding 10 days failed' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und weisen Sie die Ergebnisse einer neuen internen Tabelle zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Example data

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ). " Lufthansa

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Filtered table for LH should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).

keywords: MOVE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Filtering, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der eine Zahl darstellt, in eine Integer-Zahl.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CONV Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_type_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS string_to_int IMPORTING iv_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_int) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_type_converter( ).

CLASS zcl_itab_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtere eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Datensätzen nach Flügen, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' durchgeführt werden, unter Verwendung des FILTER-Operators.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
