             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aa_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_aa_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).

    rt_aa_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (seatsocc) für alle Flüge in sflights unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutze REDUCE INT TO sum = 0 FOR flight IN lt_flights NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Total seats should not be zero' act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und prägnanten Weise. Er ist ideal für Summen, Zählungen oder andere Reduktionsoperationen.

Instructions: Lese den Flug mit der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und der Flugnummer '0400' aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Datensätzen mittels Tabellenausdruck. Behandle den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwende lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] oder lt_flights[ <index> ] und fange CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    lt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).

    TRY.
        rs_flight = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_table_expression( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_key( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connection should be 0400' act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_table_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_exception_class = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
        i_expected_message = ''
    ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_by_key( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke bieten einen direkten und typsicheren Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. Sie sind eine moderne und prägnante Alternative zu READ TABLE und ermöglichen die direkte Zuweisung des Ergebnisses. Das Abfangen der Ausnahme CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND ist wichtig für die Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: Table Expressions, Internal Tables, READ TABLE, Exception Handling

Instructions: Ermittle die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle sflights. Nutze dabei SELECT mit GROUP BY und impliziter Tabellendeklaration.
hint: Verwende SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights, SUM(seatsocc) AS total_seats FROM sflights GROUP BY carrid INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_stats).

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             num_flights TYPE i,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_stats_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid,
           COUNT(*) AS num_flights,

      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid

unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).

keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, Aggregation, Internal Tables, DATA

Instructions: Entferne aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (carrid). Die Tabelle soll zuvor nach carrid sortiert sein.
hint: Verwende SORT lt_carrids BY table_line. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_carrids COMPARING table_line.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_carrids = it_carrids.
    SORT rt_unique_carrids BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_carrids COMPARING table_line.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_itab_delete_duplicates=>tt_carrid(
      ( 'LH' )
      ( 'AA' )
      ( 'LH' )
      ( 'LH' )
      ( 'BA' )
      ( 'AA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_itab_delete_duplicates=>tt_carrid(
      ( 'AA' )
      ( 'BA' )
      ( 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of unique entries' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result table content incorrect' act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES ist effizient, um direkt aufeinanderfolgende doppelte Zeilen zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, damit alle Duplikate nebeneinander liegen. COMPARING table_line wird verwendet, wenn die interne Tabelle einen elementaren Typ hat.
keywords: DELETE, Duplicates, Internal Tables, SORT

Instructions: Füge einen neuen Flugdatensatz in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT ein.
hint: Nutze INSERT LINE OF ls_new_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight_key
        CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE ct_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_line( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_itab_insert_line=>tt_sflight_key.
    DATA(ls_flight1) = VALUE zcl_itab_insert_line=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).
    DATA(ls_flight2) = VALUE zcl_itab_insert_line=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ).

    lo_cut->add_flight( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_flight1 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 1 entry' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry carrid incorrect' act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    lo_cut->add_flight( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_flight2 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry carrid incorrect' act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die INSERT-Anweisung fügt eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein. Bei Standardtabellen wird die Zeile am Ende angefügt. Bei Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel wird geprüft, ob der Schlüssel bereits existiert, und ggf. ein Laufzeitfehler ausgelöst, wenn der Schlüssel nicht eindeutig ist.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Tables, LINE OF, Modification

Instructions: Aktualisiere einen bestehenden Flugdatensatz in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT basierend auf dem Schlüssel.
hint: Nutze MODIFY TABLE lt_flights FROM ls_updated_flight.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_modify_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_update TYPE ty_sflight_data
      CHANGING
        ct_flights       TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_modify_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM is_flight_update.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_modify_table( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_itab_modify_table=>tt_sflight_data.
    lt_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '1000' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '500' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_update) = VALUE zcl_itab_modify_table=>ty_sflight_data( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '1200' fldate = '20250101' ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( EXPORTING is_flight_update = ls_update CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should be updated' act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = '1200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Other fields should remain unchanged' act = ls_updated_flight-fldate exp = '20250101' ).

    DATA(ls_non_existent_update) = VALUE zcl_itab_modify_table=>ty_sflight_data( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' price = '300' fldate = '20250101' ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( EXPORTING is_flight_update = ls_non_existent_update CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should not change for non-existent entry' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die MODIFY-Anweisung aktualisiert eine Zeile in einer internen Tabelle. Wenn eine Zeile mit dem gleichen Schlüssel wie die übergebene Arbeitsbereichszeile existiert, wird sie aktualisiert. Andernfalls wird die Zeile eingefügt. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode zur Aktualisierung von Tabelleneinträgen.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, Update, Modification

Instructions: Iteriere über eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Datensätzen und gib die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer aus. Nutze dabei LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...).

CLASS zcl_itab_loop_into_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itab_loop_into_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_loop_into_data( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_itab_loop_into_data=>tt_sflight_key(

keywords: LOOP AT, INTO DATA, Internal Tables, Iteration, String Templates

Instructions: Lese Daten aus der Tabelle sflights in eine interne Tabelle, wobei die Spalten dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Nutze SELECT (iv_columns) FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_dynamic_flights).
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_dynamic_flight.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_columns TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights.
    " For dynamic column selection, the target table must be generic (STANDARD TABLE)
    " or dynamically created. Here, we use a generic table type.
    " Note: The structure of rt_dynamic_flights will be determined at runtime
    " based on the selected columns. For a strongly typed return, dynamic table creation
    " with RTTS would be necessary, which is more complex for a simple example.
    " For demonstration, we assume a simple case where the caller knows the structure.

    SELECT (iv_columns)
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_dynamic_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_dynamic_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_dynamic_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA lt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_itab_dynamic_select=>ty_dynamic_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Test with specific columns
    lt_result = CAST #( lo_cut->get_dynamic_flights( 'carrid, connid' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Table should contain entries' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'First entry carrid should not be initial' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'First entry connid should not be initial' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid ).

    " Test with different columns (requires casting to a compatible type or dynamic handling)
    " For simplicity, we stick to the defined type for assertion.
    " In a real scenario, you'd use RTTS to analyze the dynamic table structure.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Spaltenauswahl in einem SELECT-Statement mittels (iv_columns) ermöglicht es, die abzufragenden Felder zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für flexible Berichte oder Schnittstellen, bei denen die benötigten Datenfelder variieren können. Die Zieltabelle muss dabei generisch oder dynamisch erzeugt werden.
keywords: SELECT, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, INTO TABLE, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein Interface implementiert, um eine einfache Datenverarbeitung durchzuführen. Nutzen Sie dabei einen FOR-Ausdruck in Kombination mit VALUE #( ) zur Transformation einer Eingabetabelle.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine Tabelle als Eingabe und eine transformierte Tabelle als Rückgabe hat. Implementieren Sie diese Methode in einer Klasse und verwenden Sie VALUE #( FOR ... ) für die Rückgabe.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_processor.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
           id   TYPE i,
           text TYPE string,
         END OF ty_data.
  TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      it_input TYPE tt_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_output) TYPE tt_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_processor~process_data.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR <fs_line> IN it_input ( id = <fs_line>-id * 10 text = <fs_line>-text && `_processed` ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_data.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zif_data_processor=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zif_data_processor=>tt_data(
      ( id = 10 text = 'Item A_processed' )
      ( id = 20 text = 'Item B_processed' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->zif_data_processor~process_data( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = lines( lt_expected )
      msg = 'Number of lines should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id
      exp = lt_expected[ 1 ]-id
      msg = 'First item ID should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]-text
      exp = lt_expected[ 2 ]-text
      msg = 'Second item text should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse implementiert ein Interface, um eine klare Schnittstelle für die Datenverarbeitung zu definieren. Die Methode nutzt einen modernen FOR-Ausdruck in Kombination mit VALUE #( ) zur Transformation der Eingabetabelle. Dies ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Datenmanipulation ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hauptklasse, die eine private Hilfsmethode in einer anderen Klasse aufrufen muss. Gewähren Sie der Hauptklasse über die FRIENDS-Deklaration Zugriff auf diese private Methode.
hint: Nutzen Sie die FRIENDS-Anweisung in der Definition der Hilfsklasse, um der Hauptklasse Zugriff zu gewähren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_helper_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS format_internal
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted) TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_main_processor. " Grant access to zcl_main_processor
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_main_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_display
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_date.
    rv_formatted_date = format_internal( iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_internal.
    " Simulate some complex internal formatting
    rv_formatted = |{ iv_date DATE = ISO }|. " String Template
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_main_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_display.
    DATA(lo_helper) = NEW zcl_helper_class( ).
    " Direct call to private method of zcl_helper_class is possible due to FRIENDS
    rv_output = lo_helper->format_internal( iv_date ).
    rv_output = |Processed date: { rv_output }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friends_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friends_access.
    DATA(lo_main_processor) = NEW zcl_main_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_expected_output) = |Processed date: { lv_date DATE = ISO }|.
    DATA(lv_actual_output) = lo_main_processor->process_and_display( lv_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_output
      exp = lv_expected_output
      msg = 'The main processor should correctly format the date using the helper''s private method.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FRIENDS-Deklaration in der Hilfsklasse ZCL_HELPER_CLASS erlaubt der Klasse ZCL_MAIN_PROCESSOR, auf die private Methode FORMAT_INTERNAL zuzugreifen. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen eine enge Kopplung zwischen Klassen erforderlich ist, aber die Kapselung der Hilfsklasse für andere externe Konsumenten beibehalten werden soll. String Templates werden für die Formatierung verwendet.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die zwei Interfaces implementiert: eines für die Aggregation von Zahlen und eines für die Protokollierung. Nutzen Sie einen REDUCE-Ausdruck, um die Summe einer Tabelle zu berechnen.
hint: Definieren Sie zwei Interfaces. Implementieren Sie beide in einer Klasse. Verwenden Sie REDUCE #( ) für die Summenbildung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_aggregatable.
  TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
  METHODS calculate_sum
    IMPORTING
      it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

INTERFACE zif_loggable.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_aggregatable.
    INTERFACES zif_loggable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_aggregatable~calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT sum = sum + num ).
    zif_loggable~log_message( |Sum calculated: { rv_sum }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_loggable~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log file or system log
    " For demo, we just simulate logging
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation_and_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation_and_log.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_data_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zif_aggregatable=>tt_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_aggregator->zif_aggregatable~calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 60
      msg = 'The sum should be 60'
    ).
    " For logging, we can't easily assert output without mocking,
    " but the call itself demonstrates the interface usage.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse implementiert zwei Interfaces, was die Einhaltung des Prinzips der Interface-Segregation fördert. Die Methode zur Summenberechnung nutzt den REDUCE-Ausdruck, eine moderne und funktionale Art, Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle LOOP-Anweisungen. Die Log-Methode demonstriert die Nutzung des zweiten Interfaces.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Object Orientation, Aggregation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory-Pattern, indem Sie eine Klasse mit einem privaten Konstruktor erstellen. Nur eine dedizierte Factory-Klasse soll Instanzen dieser Klasse erzeugen dürfen. Gewähren Sie der Factory-Klasse über FRIENDS Zugriff auf den privaten Konstruktor.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Konstruktor der zu erzeugenden Klasse als PRIVATE und fügen Sie die Factory-Klasse als FRIEND hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zcl_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_product_factory. " Grant access to zcl_product_factory's constructor
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    ro_product = NEW zcl_product( iv_name ). " Can call private constructor
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_private_constructor FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'MyNewProduct' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_product
      msg = 'Product object should be created by factory'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_product->get_name( )
      exp = 'MyNewProduct'
      msg = 'Product name should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_private_constructor.
    " This test should fail if CREATE PUBLIC is used for zcl_product
    " It should pass if CREATE PRIVATE or CREATE PROTECTED is used and factory is friend
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_product) = NEW zcl_product( 'DirectCreationAttempt' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Direct creation of product should not be possible' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Direct creation correctly prevented' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Pattern, bei dem die Erzeugung von Objekten einer Klasse (ZCL_PRODUCT) durch eine separate Factory-Klasse (ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY) gekapselt wird. Der Konstruktor von ZCL_PRODUCT ist privat, und nur die Factory-Klasse erhält über die FRIENDS-Deklaration das Recht, Instanzen zu erzeugen. Dies stellt sicher, dass Objekte nur über die definierte Factory-Methode erstellt werden, was die Kontrolle über den Objektlebenszyklus verbessert.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Private Constructor, Design Patterns

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategy-Pattern, indem Sie ein Interface für verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien definieren. Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, die dieses Interface implementieren, und nutzen Sie in den Implementierungen REDUCE-Ausdrücke zur Datenverarbeitung. Eine Kontextklasse soll die Strategie zur Laufzeit auswählen und ausführen.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für die Strategie. Implementieren Sie es in mehreren Klassen. Nutzen Sie REDUCE #( ) für die Aggregation in den Strategie-Methoden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculation_strategy.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
           value TYPE i,
         END OF ty_item.
  TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS execute
    IMPORTING
      it_input TYPE tt_items
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_strategy_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strategy_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strategy_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~execute.
    rv_result = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR item IN it_input NEXT sum = sum + item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strategy_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~execute.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR item IN it_input NEXT sum = sum + item-value ).
    IF lines( it_input ) > 0.
      rv_result = lv_sum / lines( it_input ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_strategy
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy.
    METHODS calculate
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE zif_calculation_strategy=>tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_result = mo_strategy->execute( it_input ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle error or default strategy
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_strategy_average FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_sum.
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW zcl_calculator_context( ).
    DATA(lo_sum_strategy) = NEW zcl_strategy_sum( ).
    lo_context->set_strategy( lo_sum_strategy ).

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zif_calculation_strategy=>tt_items( ( value = 10 ) ( value = 20 ) ( value = 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_context->calculate( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 60
      msg = 'Sum strategy should return 60'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_strategy_average.
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW zcl_calculator_context( ).
    DATA(lo_average_strategy) = NEW zcl_strategy_average( ).
    lo_context->set_strategy( lo_average_strategy ).

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zif_calculation_strategy=>tt_items( ( value = 10 ) ( value = 20 ) ( value = 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_context->calculate( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 20
      msg = 'Average strategy should return 20'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Strategy-Pattern, bei dem verschiedene Algorithmen (Summe, Durchschnitt) in separaten Klassen gekapselt werden, die ein gemeinsames Interface implementieren. Eine Kontextklasse wählt die Strategie zur Laufzeit aus. Die Strategie-Implementierungen nutzen den REDUCE-Ausdruck für effiziente Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, REDUCE, Design Patterns

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer privaten Methode, die komplexe interne Logik enthält. Gewähren Sie einer dedizierten ABAP Unit Testklasse über die FRIENDS-Deklaration Zugriff auf diese private Methode, um sie direkt testen zu können.
hint: Fügen Sie die Testklasse als FRIEND in der Definition der zu testenden Klasse hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_public_result
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _internal_complex_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_intermediate_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_calculated_value) TYPE i.
    FRIENDS ltcl_test. " Grant access to the test class
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_public_result.
    DATA(lv_intermediate) = iv_input * 2.
    rv_result = _internal_complex_calculation( lv_intermediate ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _internal_complex_calculation.
    " Simulate complex logic, e.g., involving multiple steps or edge cases
    rv_calculated_value = iv_intermediate_value + 5.
    IF iv_intermediate_value MOD 3 = 0.
      rv_calculated_value = rv_calculated_value * 2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_public_method FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_private_method_direct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_public_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_public_result( 10 ). " (10 * 2) + 5 = 25
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 25
      msg = 'Public method result should be 25'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_private_method_direct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_logic( ).
    " Direct call to private method due to FRIENDS declaration
    DATA(lv_result_1) = lo_cut->_internal_complex_calculation( 10 ). " 10 + 5 = 15
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_1
      exp = 15
      msg = 'Private method result for 10 should be 15'
    ).

    DATA(lv_result_2) = lo_cut->_internal_complex_calculation( 6 ). " (6 + 5) * 2 = 22 (because 6 MOD 3 = 0)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_2
      exp = 22
      msg = 'Private method result for 6 should be 22'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FRIENDS-Deklaration ist hier ein Best Practice für ABAP Unit Tests. Sie ermöglicht es der Testklasse (LTCL_TEST), direkt auf private Methoden der zu testenden Klasse (ZCL_COMPLEX_LOGIC) zuzugreifen. Dies ist entscheidend für das Testen komplexer interner Logik, die sonst nur indirekt über öffentliche Methoden getestet werden könnte. Es verbessert die Testabdeckung und die Granularität der Tests, ohne die Kapselung für andere Produktivklassen zu verletzen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Testing, ABAP Unit, Object Orientation, Private Methods

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für Datenvalidierungsregeln. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (z.B. aus SFlight) validiert. Nutzen Sie einen FILTER-Ausdruck, um ungültige Einträge effizient zu identifizieren.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Validierungsmethode. Implementieren Sie diese und verwenden Sie FILTER #( ) für die Selektion ungültiger Daten.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_validator.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           price    TYPE sflight-price,
           currency TYPE sflight-currency,
         END OF ty_sflight_data.
  TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS validate_flights
    IMPORTING
      it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_invalid_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_validator~validate_flights.
    " Example validation: price must be positive, currency must be 'EUR' or 'USD'
    rt_invalid_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY default
                                   WHERE price <= 0
                                   OR ( currency <> 'EUR' AND currency <> 'USD' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_validation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_validation.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_sflight_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zif_data_validator=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' price = -50 currency = 'USD' ) " Invalid price
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' price = 200 currency = 'GBP' ) " Invalid currency
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' fldate = '20250104' price = 300 currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_invalid) = lo_validator->zif_data_validator~validate_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_invalid )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'There should be 2 invalid flights'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_invalid[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'First invalid flight should be AA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_invalid[ 2 ]-carrid
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Second invalid flight should be UA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt ein Interface zur Definition einer Validierungsregel, die in einer Klasse implementiert wird. Der FILTER-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu selektieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Datenvalidierungen, da es den Code kompakt und lesbar hält, ohne explizite Schleifen zu benötigen.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Validation, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit privaten Attributen, die serialisiert und deserialisiert werden sollen. Implementieren Sie eine separate Utility-Klasse für die JSON-Serialisierung/Deserialisierung und gewähren Sie dieser Utility-Klasse über FRIENDS Zugriff auf die privaten Attribute der Datenklasse.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Utility-Klasse als FRIEND in der Datenklasse. Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING für die Datenübertragung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_value TYPE string.
    METHODS get_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE i.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_json_serializer. " Grant access to serializer
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_json_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_json_data.

    CLASS-METHODS serialize
      IMPORTING
        io_data_object TYPE REF TO zcl_data_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS deserialize
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_object) TYPE REF TO zcl_data_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
    mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_id.
    rv_id = mv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize.
    DATA(ls_json_data) = VALUE ty_json_data(
      id    = io_data_object->mv_id
      value = io_data_object->mv_value
    ).
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = ls_json_data
        pretty_print = abap_false
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize.
    DATA(ls_json_data) = VALUE ty_json_data( ).
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json        = iv_json_string
      CHANGING
        data        = ls_json_data
    ).
    ro_data_object = NEW zcl_data_object( iv_id = ls_json_data-id iv_value = ls_json_data-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialization_deserialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialization_deserialization.
    DATA(lo_original) = NEW zcl_data_object( iv_id = 123 iv_value = 'Test Value' ).
    DATA(lv_json) = zcl_json_serializer=>serialize( lo_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_json
      msg = 'Serialized JSON string should not be empty'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_json
      needle   = '"id":123'
      msg      = 'JSON should contain ID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_json
      needle   = '"value":"Test Value"'
      msg      = 'JSON should contain Value'
    ).

    DATA(lo_deserialized) = zcl_json_serializer=>deserialize( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_deserialized
      msg = 'Deserialized object should not be initial'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_deserialized->get_id( )
      exp = lo_original->get_id( )
      msg = 'Deserialized ID should match original'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_deserialized->get_value( )
      exp = lo_original->get_value( )
      msg = 'Deserialized Value should match original'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FRIENDS-Deklaration ermöglicht der Serialisierungs-Utility-Klasse (ZCL_JSON_SERIALIZER) den direkten Zugriff auf die privaten Attribute der Datenklasse (ZCL_DATA_OBJECT). Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für Serialisierungs-/Deserialisierungsaufgaben, da es die Kapselung der Datenklasse für andere Konsumenten aufrechterhält, aber der Utility-Klasse die notwendigen Rechte für den Zugriff auf interne Daten gewährt. Die Serialisierung erfolgt über die Standardklasse /UI2/CL_JSON.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Data Serialization, JSON, Private Attributes

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie ein Szenario, in dem eine Manager-Klasse ein Interface implementiert und gleichzeitig eine private Hilfsklasse verwendet, der über FRIENDS Zugriff gewährt wird. Die Manager-Klasse soll Flugdaten verarbeiten (z.B. aus SFlight) und dabei die Hilfsklasse für eine interne, komplexe Berechnung nutzen. Verwenden Sie Open SQL mit Inline-Deklaration und Table Expressions.
hint: Kombinieren Sie INTERFACES und FRIENDS. Nutzen Sie SELECT mit INTO TABLE @DATA(...) und Table Expressions für den Datenzugriff.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_manager.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           price    TYPE sflight-price,
           currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
         END OF ty_flight_info.
  TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_enriched_flights
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
        iv_occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_occupancy_percent) TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _internal_ratio_calc
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_ratio) TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2.
    FRIENDS zcl_flight_manager. " Grant access to manager class
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_manager.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_occupancy.
    IF iv_max_seats > 0.
      rv_occupancy_percent = _internal_ratio_calc( iv_occupied_seats iv_max_seats ).
    ELSE.
      rv_occupancy_percent = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _internal_ratio_calc.
    IF iv_denominator > 0.
      rv_ratio = ( CONV decfloat34( iv_numerator ) / iv_denominator ) * 100.
    ELSE.
      rv_ratio = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_manager~get_enriched_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_calculator( ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                           ( carrid    = ls_raw-carrid
                             connid    = ls_raw-connid
                             fldate    = ls_raw-fldate
                             price     = ls_raw-price
                             currency  = ls_raw-currency
                             occupancy = lo_calculator->_internal_ratio_calc( " Access private method via FRIENDS
                                           iv_numerator   = ls_raw-seatsocc
                                           iv_denominator = ls_raw-seatsmax ) )
                         ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_enriched_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_private_calc_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enriched_flights.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_flight_manager( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_manager->zif_flight_manager~get_enriched_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Flight data should not be empty'
    ).

    " Find a flight with known seatsmax/seatsocc to test occupancy calculation
    DATA(ls_test_flight) = VALUE zif_flight_manager=>ty_flight_info(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' occupancy = 50.00 ).

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE seatsmax > 0
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_entry).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_occupancy) = ( CONV decfloat34( ls_sflight_entry-seatsocc ) / ls_sflight_entry-seatsmax ) * 100.
      DATA(ls_found_flight) = lt_flights[ KEY default WHERE carrid = ls_sflight_entry-carrid AND connid = ls_sflight_entry-connid AND fldate = ls_sflight_entry-fldate ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_found_flight-occupancy
        exp = lv_expected_occupancy
        msg = 'Occupancy calculation should be correct'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_private_calc_access.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_calculator( ).
    " Direct access to private method due to FRIENDS declaration in zcl_flight_calculator
    DATA(lv_ratio) = lo_calculator->_internal_ratio_calc( iv_numerator = 50 iv_denominator = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_ratio
      exp = 50.00
      msg = 'Private ratio calculation should be correct'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von Interface-Implementierung und FRIENDS-Deklaration. Die Manager-Klasse implementiert ein Interface für die Bereitstellung von Flugdaten. Eine separate Hilfsklasse führt eine interne, komplexe Berechnung durch, auf die die Manager-Klasse über FRIENDS zugreifen darf. Die Datenbeschaffung erfolgt über modernes Open SQL mit Inline-Deklaration, und die Transformation der Daten inklusive der Berechnung der Auslastung wird effizient mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und Table Expressions durchgeführt.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Table Expressions, FOR, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein Interface für die Transformation von Daten implementiert. Die Transformationsmethode soll eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine Tabelle von strukturierten Daten umwandeln. Nutzen Sie dabei den CORRESPONDING-Operator für die effiziente Zuweisung von Daten.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Transformationsmethode. Implementieren Sie diese und verwenden Sie CORRESPONDING #( ) für die Datenübertragung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_transformer.
  TYPES: tt_raw_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_data,
           line_number TYPE i,
           content     TYPE string,
           length      TYPE i,
         END OF ty_transformed_data.
  TYPES: tt_transformed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS transform_strings
    IMPORTING
      it_raw_strings TYPE tt_raw_strings
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_transformed_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_string_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_transformer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_transformer~transform_strings.
    DATA(lv_line_num) = 0.
    rt_transformed = VALUE #( FOR ls_string IN it_raw_strings
                               LET lv_line_num = lv_line_num + 1 IN
                               ( line_number = lv_line_num
                                 content     = ls_string
                                 length      = strlen( ls_string ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_transformation.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_string_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zif_data_transformer=>tt_raw_strings(
      ( 'First line' )
      ( 'Second, longer line' )
      ( 'Short' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->zif_data_transformer~transform_strings( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_transformed )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Number of transformed lines should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-line_number
      exp = 1
      msg = 'First line number should be 1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-content
      exp = 'First line'
      msg = 'First line content should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-length
      exp = 21
      msg = 'Second line length should be 21'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse implementiert ein Interface zur Definition einer Daten-Transformationsregel. Die Methode nutzt einen FOR-Ausdruck in Kombination mit VALUE #( ) und einer LET-Expression, um die rohen String-Daten in eine strukturierte Form zu überführen. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation, die den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht. Der CORRESPONDING-Operator ist hier nicht direkt im FOR-Ausdruck verwendet, aber das Beispiel zeigt eine moderne Transformation.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, FOR, VALUE, LET, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für eine Fehlerbehandlungsstrategie. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse, die eine benutzerdefinierte Exception auslöst. Eine aufrufende Klasse soll diese Strategie nutzen und die Exception mit CATCH-Blöcken abfangen.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine Exception auslösen kann. Implementieren Sie diese Methode und verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...
solution:
INTERFACE zif_error_handler.
  METHODS handle_error
    IMPORTING
      iv_error_message TYPE string
    RAISING
      zcx_custom_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_error_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_error_handler~handle_error.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error
      EXPORTING
        textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text
        previous = NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
        io_error_handler TYPE REF TO zif_error_handler
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      io_error_handler->handle_error( 'Input value cannot be negative.' ).
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = |Processing successful for input { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_positive_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_input_raises_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_custom_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_input.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_application_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_error_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_strategy( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_data( iv_input = 10 io_error_handler = lo_error_handler ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Processing successful for input 10'
      msg = 'Positive input should be processed successfully'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_input_raises_exception.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_application_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_error_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_strategy( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_data( iv_input = -5 io_error_handler = lo_error_handler ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception ZCX_CUSTOM_ERROR was expected but not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_custom_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception ZCX_CUSTOM_ERROR correctly raised for negative input.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Implementierung eines Interfaces für eine Fehlerbehandlungsstrategie. Die Strategieklasse löst eine benutzerdefinierte statische Exception aus, die von der aufrufenden Klasse abgefangen wird. Dies fördert eine saubere Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung und ermöglicht eine flexible Reaktion auf Fehlerfälle. Die Verwendung von CATCH-Blöcken ist der Standardweg zur Behandlung von Exceptions in ABAP.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Exception Handling, RAISE EXCEPTION, CATCH, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein Interface implementiert, um dynamisch auf Attribute eines Objekts zuzugreifen und diese zu manipulieren. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und den Operator REF #( ) für den Zugriff auf Attribute. Gewähren Sie einer Hilfsklasse, die die RTTI-Logik kapselt, über FRIENDS Zugriff auf die privaten Attribute der Datenklasse.
hint: Kombinieren Sie INTERFACES, FRIENDS und RTTI. Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR und REF #( ) für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_dynamic_accessor.
  METHODS get_attribute_value
    IMPORTING
      io_object     TYPE REF TO object
      iv_attribute_name TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
    RAISING
      cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

  METHODS set_attribute_value
    IMPORTING
      io_object     TYPE REF TO object
      iv_attribute_name TYPE string
      iv_new_value  TYPE string
    RAISING
      cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_name TYPE string.
    METHODS get_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE i.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE i.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_rtti_helper. " Grant access to RTTI helper
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_accessor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_id.
    rv_id = mv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_accessor~get_attribute_value.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF #( io_object->(iv_attribute_name) ).
    rv_value = lr_data->*.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_dynamic_accessor~set_attribute_value.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF #( io_object->(iv_attribute_name) ).
    lr_data->* = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lo_data) = NEW zcl_data_container( iv_id = 100 iv_name = 'Initial Name' ).
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_rtti_helper( ).

    " Test get_attribute_value
    DATA(lv_name) = lo_accessor->zif_dynamic_accessor~get_attribute_value( io_object = lo_data iv_attribute_name = 'MV_NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_name
      exp = 'Initial Name'
      msg = 'Dynamically retrieved name should match'
    ).

    " Test set_attribute_value
    lo_accessor->zif_dynamic_accessor~set_attribute_value( io_object = lo_data iv_attribute_name = 'MV_NAME' iv_new_value = 'Updated Name' ).
    lv_name = lo_data->get_name( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_name
      exp = 'Updated Name'
      msg = 'Dynamically set name should be updated'
    ).

    " Test dynamic access to ID (requires conversion)
    DATA(lv_id_str) = lo_accessor->zif_dynamic_accessor~get_attribute_value( io_object = lo_data iv_attribute_name = 'MV_ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_id_str
      exp = '100'
      msg = 'Dynamically retrieved ID should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Interface-Implementierung, FRIENDS-Deklaration und RTTI für dynamischen Attributzugriff. Die Hilfsklasse (ZCL_RTTI_HELPER) implementiert ein Interface für generischen Attributzugriff und erhält über FRIENDS Zugriff auf die privaten Attribute der Datenklasse (ZCL_DATA_CONTAINER). Der REF #( ) Operator ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Attribute zur Laufzeit, was für flexible Frameworks oder Metaprogrammierung nützlich ist. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die die Kapselung durch FRIENDS bewahrt, während sie dynamische Interaktionen ermöglicht.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, FRIENDS, RTTI, REF, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, Attributes

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode (z.B. 'LH') und filtern Sie diese, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer (z.B. '0400') zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration und eine `FILTER`-Expression für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights) WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE connid = iv_connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Es sollte genau ein Flug gefunden werden.'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet eine Inline-Deklaration (`DATA(lt_all_flights)`) im `SELECT`-Statement, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. Anschließend wird eine `FILTER`-Expression verwendet, um die interne Tabelle basierend auf der Flugnummer zu filtern, was eine funktionale und moderne Art der Datenmanipulation darstellt.
keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE @DATA, FILTER, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40, ASSERT

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode und eine Flugnummer. Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_single_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_single_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_single_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_single_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS divide

        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING

      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE'

    zcl_exception_demo=>divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die basierend auf einem numerischen Eingabewert einen Status-Text zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie hierfür die `COND` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung. Beispiel: 1 = 'Grün', 2 = 'Gelb', sonst 'Rot'.

CLASS zcl_cond_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `zcl_flight_processor`, die eine abstrakte Methode `process_flight_data` definiert. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Unterklassen, die diese Methode unterschiedlich implementieren (z.B. eine für Kurzstreckenflüge, eine für Langstreckenflüge).
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS`. Die konkreten Klassen müssen die abstrakte Methode implementieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             distance TYPE s_distance,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_info) TYPE string_table
      ABSTRACT.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_short_haul_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_flight_processor FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_short_haul_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE distance < 1000.
      APPEND |Kurzstrecke: Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } ({ ls_flight-distance } km)| TO rt_processed_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_long_haul_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_flight_processor FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_long_haul_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE distance >= 1000.
      APPEND |Langstrecke: Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } ({ ls_flight-distance } km)| TO rt_processed_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_processing.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_processor=>tt_flight_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251121' distance = 500 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '010' fldate = '20251121' distance = 8000 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '100' fldate = '20251121' distance = 1200 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_short_haul) = NEW zcl_short_haul_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_short_info) = lo_short_haul->process_flight_data( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_short_info ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_short_info[1] exp = 'Kurzstrecke' ).

    DATA(lo_long_haul) = NEW zcl_long_haul_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_long_info) = lo_long_haul->process_flight_data( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_long_info ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_long_info[1] exp = 'Langstrecke' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Abstrakte Klassen und Methoden ermöglichen es, eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle und einen Teil der Implementierung in einer Basisklasse zu definieren, während spezifische Details den Unterklassen überlassen werden. Dies fördert Polymorphie und das Template Method Pattern, was den Code flexibler und erweiterbarer macht.
keywords: ABSTRACT, CLASS, METHODS, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Object Orientation

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `IF` mit Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE` Bedingung und `IF` mit `DATA(...)` für die Inline-Deklaration des Filterergebnisses.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                    AND   seatsocc <= ( seatsmax - iv_min_seats ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 100 ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt LH-Flüge mit mindestens 100 freien Sitzen in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ). " Initial, da SFLIGHTS nicht manipuliert wird

    " Um einen echten Test zu ermöglichen, müsste SFLIGHTS gemockt oder Testdaten eingefügt werden.
    " Hier ein Beispiel mit fiktiven Daten für den Test der Logik:
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251121' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251121' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20251121' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    " Manuell filtern, um die Logik zu prüfen
    DATA(lt_expected) = FILTER #( lt_test_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                  WHERE carrid = 'LH'
                                  AND   seatsocc <= ( seatsmax - 100 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_expected ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_expected[1]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER` Expression in Kombination mit `WHERE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(...)` macht den Code kürzer und lesbarer, da Variablen direkt dort deklariert werden, wo sie benötigt werden.
keywords: FILTER, IF, Inline Declaration, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String leer ist, und geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung aus. Nutzen Sie `IF` mit der Prädikatfunktion `is_empty`.

CLASS zcl_string_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_input_string TYPE string

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `zcl_report_generator` mit einer Template-Methode `generate_report` und abstrakten Methoden für spezifische Schritte (z.B. `get_data`, `format_header`, `format_body`). Implementieren Sie konkrete Unterklassen für verschiedene Berichtsformate.
hint: Die Template-Methode definiert den Algorithmus-Skelett, während die abstrakten Methoden die variablen Schritte den Unterklassen überlassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_report_output) TYPE string FINAL.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table ABSTRACT.
    METHODS format_header IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_header) TYPE string ABSTRACT.
    METHODS format_body IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_body) TYPE string ABSTRACT.
    METHODS format_footer IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_footer) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_data( ).
    DATA(lv_header) = format_header( lt_data ).
    DATA(lv_body) = format_body( lt_data ).
    DATA(lv_footer) = format_footer( lt_data ).

    rv_report_output = |{ lv_header }{ lv_body }{ lv_footer }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_footer.
    rv_footer = |\n--- Ende des Berichts ---|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_text_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_report_generator FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_header REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_body REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_text_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    APPEND 'Zeile 1 Daten' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Zeile 2 Daten' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_header.
    rv_header = |Einfacher Textbericht\n--------------------\n|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_body.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(lv_line).
      rv_body = rv_body && |* { lv_line }\n|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_report_generator FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_header REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_body REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_footer REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    APPEND 'A;B;C' TO rt_data.
    APPEND '1;2;3' TO rt_data.
    APPEND '4;5;6' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_header.
    rv_header = 'CSV Report\n'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_body.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(lv_line).
      rv_body = rv_body && |{ lv_line }\n|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_footer.
    rv_footer = |Total Rows: { lines( it_data ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie für jeden Flug eine Statusmeldung aus: 'Pünktlich' wenn `ACTUAL_DEPARTURE_TIME` leer ist, 'Verspätet' wenn `ACTUAL_DEPARTURE_TIME` nach `SCHEDULED_DEPARTURE_TIME` liegt, sonst 'Abgeflogen'. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `IF`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren, und `IF` oder `COND` innerhalb der Schleife für die Statusprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_reporter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_statuses) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_reporter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    rt_statuses = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      LET lv_status = COND string(
                          WHEN ls_flight-acttime IS INITIAL THEN 'Pünktlich'
                          WHEN ls_flight-acttime > ls_flight-deptime THEN 'Verspätet'
                          ELSE 'Abgeflogen'
                        )
      IN
        ( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate }: { lv_status }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_statuses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_statuses.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251121' deptime = '100000' acttime = '' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Pünktlich
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251121' deptime = '110000' acttime = '113000' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Verspätet
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20251121' deptime = '120000' acttime = '120000' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Abgeflogen

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_reporter( ).
    DATA(lt_statuses) = lo_cut->get_flight_statuses( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_statuses ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_statuses[1] exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_statuses[2] exp = 'Verspätet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_statuses[3] exp = 'Abgeflogen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR` Expression ermöglicht eine funktionale Iteration über interne Tabellen, die sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark ist. In Kombination mit `LET` für lokale Variablen und `COND` für bedingte Logik innerhalb der Schleife wird der Code extrem lesbar und effizient, da keine expliziten `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen mehr nötig sind.
keywords: FOR, IF, COND, Internal Tables, Date/Time, Expression

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `zcl_data_validator` mit einer abstrakten Methode `validate`. Erstellen Sie konkrete Validatoren für verschiedene Datentypen (z.B. `zcl_string_validator`, `zcl_numeric_validator`) und verwenden Sie diese in einer Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie Polymorphie, um verschiedene Validatoren über die abstrakte Basisklasse aufzurufen und zu verwalten.

CLASS zcl_data_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string

    METHODS get_error_message REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_is_valid TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_string_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    " Beispiel: String darf nicht leer sein
    IF is_empty( iv_value ).
      mv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      mv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
    rv_is_valid = mv_is_valid.

  METHOD get_error_message.
    IF mv_is_valid = abap_false.
      rv_message = 'String darf nicht leer sein.'.
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_numeric_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_data_validator FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS validate REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_error_message REDEFINITION.

    DATA mv_is_valid TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    " Beispiel: Wert muss eine Zahl sein und > 0
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_number) = CONV i( iv_value ).
        IF lv_number > 0.
          mv_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          mv_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        mv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_is_valid = mv_is_valid.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_error_message.
    IF mv_is_valid = abap_false.
      rv_message = 'Wert muss eine positive Zahl sein.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
