CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_number.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_number_checker( ).
    lo_checker->check_positive( 10 ). " Should not raise an exception
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Positive number checked successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_number_checker( ).
    TRY.
        lo_checker->check_positive( -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_negative_number was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_number INTO DATA(lx_neg_num).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_neg_num->mv_number exp = -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Expected exception zcx_negative_number raised for negative number.' ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
        lo_checker->check_positive( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_negative_number was not raised for zero.' ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_number INTO lx_neg_num.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_neg_num->mv_number exp = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Expected exception zcx_negative_number raised for zero.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht eine strukturierte und typsichere Fehlerbehandlung, bei der der Aufrufer gezwungen ist, die Ausnahme zu behandeln oder weiterzuleiten.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             price TYPE s_price,

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.

      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight_data.

          textid = zcx_flight_not_found=>default_text

          iv_connid = iv_connid.

    IF iv_input = 'UNSUITABLE'.

    METHODS set_strategy

      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string

    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_strategy.

CLASS zcl_strategy_context IMPLEMENTATION.

    mo_strategy = io_strategy.

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_strategy
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_strategy=>default_text
          iv_strategy_name = 'No Strategy Set'.

    rv_output = mo_strategy->apply_strategy( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null verhindert, indem sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn der Divisor Null ist.

solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL

  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->mv_numerator = iv_numerator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_division_by_zero=>default_text
          iv_numerator = iv_numerator.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.

    METHODS check_future_date
      IMPORTING

      RAISING

CLASS zcl_date_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_future_date.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    IF iv_date < lv_current_date.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_past_date_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_past_date_error=>default_text
          iv_date = iv_date.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_date_checker( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine abstrakte Klasse (`zcl_abstract_report_output`), um eine einheitliche Schnittstelle für die Ausgabe verschiedener Berichtstypen zu definieren. Die abstrakte Methode `display_report` deklariert eine `RAISING`-Klausel für `zcx_report_display_error`. Dies stellt sicher, dass alle konkreten Berichtsausgabe-Implementierungen eine konsistente Fehlerbehandlung für Anzeigeprobleme implementieren, was die Robustheit der Berichtsfunktionalität erhöht.
keywords: ABSTRACT, REPORTING, RAISE EXCEPTION, Object Orientation, Error Handling

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die versucht, einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle anhand eines Schlüssels zu lesen. Wenn der Schlüssel nicht gefunden wird, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`. Lösen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme aus.
solution:
CLASS zcx_table_entry_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_key_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_key_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_table_entry_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->mv_key_value = iv_key_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_entry_by_id
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        zcx_table_entry_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_entry_by_id.
    READ TABLE it_data INTO rs_entry WITH KEY id = iv_id.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_table_entry_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_table_entry_not_found=>default_text
          iv_key_value = |ID: { iv_id }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_existing_entry FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_table_entry_not_found.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_entry.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_table_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_reader=>tt_data( ( id = 1 value = 'Alpha' ) ( id = 2 value = 'Beta' ) ).
    DATA(ls_entry) = lo_reader->get_entry_by_id( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-value exp = 'Alpha' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_entry.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_table_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_reader=>tt_data( ( id = 1 value = 'Alpha' ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_entry_by_id( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 99 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_table_entry_not_found was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_table_entry_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_not_found->mv_key_value exp = 'ID: 99' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Expected exception zcx_table_entry_not_found raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man das Fehlen eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme (`zcx_table_entry_not_found`) signalisiert. Anstatt nur `sy-subrc` zu prüfen, wird durch das Auslösen einer Ausnahme eine explizite und strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung erzwungen, die den Aufrufer über das Problem informiert und spezifische Kontextinformationen bereitstellt.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Internal Tables, Error Handling, Custom Exception, READ TABLE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle filtern und transformieren, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( FIELD = ... )` um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_for_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             price_eur TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_for_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_raw_flights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND price > 150 )
                                   ( flight_id = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }|
                                     price_eur = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_filtered).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_filtered-flight_id exp = 'LH-0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_filtered-price_eur exp = '200.00' ).

CLASS zcl_update_from_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_from_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights.
    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @it_flights_to_update.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

        ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = gc_carrid connid = gc_connid fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' curr = 'EUR' )

      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = gc_carrid connid = gc_connid fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' currency = 'EUR' )

explanation: Die Syntax `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @(internal_table)` ermöglicht das Aktualisieren mehrerer Datenbankzeilen in einem einzigen Open SQL-Statement. Dies ist effizienter als das Iterieren über die interne Tabelle und das Ausführen einzelner `UPDATE`-Statements, da es die Anzahl der Datenbankzugriffe reduziert.
keywords: UPDATE, Database, SFLIGHTS, Internal Table, Mass Update, Open SQL

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe eines Feldes aus einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... NEXT ...` um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_items
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( CONV decfloat16( 0 ) )
                       FOR ls_item IN it_items
                       NEXT sum = sum + ls_item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_data_reduce_sum=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = '10.5' )
      ( id = 2 value = '20.0' )
      ( id = 3 value = '5.5' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( it_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '36.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_sum_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_data_reduce_sum=>tt_items( ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( it_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '0.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Er ist sehr flexibel und kann für Summen, Zählungen, String-Verkettungen und komplexere Aggregationen verwendet werden, was den Code sehr ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: DATA, REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_data_filter_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle und aggregieren Sie Daten pro Gruppe unter Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(...)` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES: tt_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_region_summary,
             region TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE decfloat16,
             product_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_region_summary.
    TYPES: tt_region_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_region_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_sales_by_region IMPORTING it_sales_items TYPE tt_sales_items
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_region_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_sales_by_region.
    LOOP AT it_sales_items INTO DATA(ls_item) GROUP BY ls_item-region ASCENDING
                                               INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_amount) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = ( CONV decfloat16( 0 ) )
        FOR <fs_item> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_item>-amount
      ).
      DATA(lv_product_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR <fs_item> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT count = count + 1
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_region_summary( region = ls_group_key-region
                                      total_amount = lv_total_amount
                                      product_count = lv_product_count ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( region = 'South' product = 'B' amount = '200.00' )

        mandt = sy-mandt carrid = gc_carrid connid = gc_connid fldate = gc_fldate
        price = '100.00' curr = 'EUR' )
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = gc_carrid AND connid = gc_connid AND fldate = gc_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_increase_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_arithmetic( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->increase_flight_price(
      iv_carrid     = gc_carrid
      iv_connid     = gc_connid
      iv_fldate     = gc_fldate
      iv_percentage = '10'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_new_price)
      WHERE carrid = gc_carrid AND connid = gc_connid AND fldate = gc_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_price exp = '110.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Open SQL in modernen ABAP-Versionen erlaubt die direkte Verwendung von arithmetischen Ausdrücken in der `SET`-Klausel von `UPDATE`-Statements. Dies ermöglicht es, Feldwerte basierend auf Berechnungen mit anderen Feldern oder Hostvariablen zu aktualisieren, ohne die Daten zuerst in den Anwendungsserver lesen zu müssen.
keywords: UPDATE, Database, SFLIGHTS, Arithmetic, Open SQL

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_ita_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ita_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ita_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ita_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group_key) = CORRESPONDING ty_carrier_flight_count( ls_sflight ).
      ls_group_key-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_group_key TO rt_grouped_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table is empty' act = lt_result ).
    " Check if a specific carrier exists and has a count

    IF ls_lufthansa IS NOT INITIAL.

Instructions: Greifen Sie direkt auf einen Flug in `sflights` anhand seiner Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke (`[]`) mit `OPTIONAL` oder `DEFAULT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ita_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ita_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    " Access a line using table expression. If not found, initial value is returned.
    rs_sflight = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid ] OPTIONAL.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    " Check existence using table expression with OPTIONAL
    IF lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid ] IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_check_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ita_table_expression( ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_ita_table_expression=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ). " Example key

    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ls_key ).
    " Assert that a known flight is found (adjust key if needed for your SFLIGHTS data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight AA 0017 not found, check SFLIGHTS data' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier mismatch' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connection mismatch' act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).

    " Test for a non-existent flight
    ls_key = VALUE zcl_ita_table_expression=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).
    ls_flight = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ls_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Non-existent flight found' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ita_table_expression( ).
    DATA(ls_key_exists) = VALUE zcl_ita_table_expression=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ). " Example key
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( ls_key_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Existing flight not found, check SFLIGHTS data' act = lv_exists ).

    DATA(ls_key_not_exists) = VALUE zcl_ita_table_expression=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).
    DATA(lv_not_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( ls_key_not_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Non-existent flight reported as existing' act = lv_not_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`[]`) bieten einen direkten und prägnanten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit `OPTIONAL` oder `DEFAULT` können Fehler bei nicht gefundenen Zeilen vermieden werden, was zu robusterem Code führt.
keywords: TABLES, Table Expressions, Line Access, OPTIONAL, DEFAULT

Instructions: Weisen Sie eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle, die über einen Tabellenausdruck gefunden wurde, einem Feldsymbol zu, um sie zu modifizieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (table_expression) TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_assign_table_exp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mod,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_mod.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mod WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_mod.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_assign_table_exp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_mod.

    ASSIGN ct_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] TO <fs_flight>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_price.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_fld_assign_table_exp=>tt_sflight_mod.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_assign_table_exp( ).

    " Update an existing flight
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_new_price = 150 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price not updated for AA 0017' act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = 150 ).

    " Try to update a non-existent flight (should not change anything)
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_new_price = 500 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    DATA(ls_original_flight) = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Non-existent flight update affected other data' act = ls_original_flight-price exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `ASSIGN` mit Tabellenausdrücken ermöglicht eine direkte und effiziente Zuweisung einer gefundenen Tabellenzeile zu einem Feldsymbol. Dies ist ideal für die In-Place-Modifikation von Zeilen, ohne dass ein expliziter `MODIFY` Befehl erforderlich ist.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, TABLES, Table Expressions, Modification

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und greifen Sie mit einem Feldsymbol auf die Zeilen zu, um sie zu verarbeiten oder zu modifizieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_loop_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increment_values
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE tt_items.

    METHODS sum_values
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_loop_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increment_values.
    LOOP AT ct_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
      <fs_item>-value = <fs_item>-value + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD sum_values.
    LOOP AT it_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
      rv_sum = rv_sum + <fs_item>-value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increment_values FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increment_values.
    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_fld_loop_assign=>tt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 10 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 20 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_loop_assign( ).
    lo_cut->increment_values( CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item value not incremented' act = lt_items[ 1 ]-value exp = 11 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second item value not incremented' act = lt_items[ 2 ]-value exp = 21 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_values.
    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_fld_loop_assign=>tt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 10 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 20 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_loop_assign( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_values( it_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum mismatch' act = lv_sum exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine globale Variable oder ein Attribut zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String vorliegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM)VARIABLE') TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_variable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA gv_global_value TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Global Value'.

    METHODS get_dynamic_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_variable_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS set_dynamic_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_variable_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_variable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN (iv_variable_name) TO <fs_any>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_any>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Variable not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_dynamic_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN (iv_variable_name) TO <fs_any>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_any> = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluginformationen aus `sflights` und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte für den Status (z.B. 'On Time', 'Delayed') hinzu, basierend auf einer Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `COND` oder `CASE` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ita_cond_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ita_cond_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    rt_flights_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                   fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                   status = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc < ls_sflight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Low Occupancy'
                                                        WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc >= ls_sflight-seatsmax / 2 AND
                                                             ls_sflight-seatsocc < ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN 'Medium Occupancy'
                                                        ELSE 'Full' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ita_cond_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table is empty' act = lt_result ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Status is empty' act = ls_first_entry-status ).
      " Further assertions could check specific status values based on SFLIGHTS data
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit dem `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine prägnante und funktionale Erstellung neuer Tabellenzeilen mit bedingten Werten. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu komplexen `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen innerhalb von Schleifen.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie ein Feldsymbol, um eine interne Tabelle zu durchlaufen und gleichzeitig eine Aggregation durchzuführen, ohne die Tabelle explizit zu kopieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` mit einem `REDUCE`-ähnlichen Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_loop_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_loop_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      rv_total_capacity = rv_total_capacity + <fs_sflight>-seatsmax.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Das Feldsymbol vermeidet das Kopieren von Zeilen, was besonders bei großen Tabellen vorteilhaft ist, auch wenn der `REDUCE`-Operator oft die präferierte, deklarative Lösung ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ita_sort_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_ita_sort_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    rt_sorted_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights ).
    SORT rt_sorted_flights BY carrid ASCENDING fldate DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ita_sort_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table is empty' act = lt_result ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 1.
      " Check if the table is sorted correctly (simplified check)
      DATA(ls_prev_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_current_flight) FROM 2.
        IF ls_current_flight-carrid < ls_prev_flight-carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Sorting by carrid failed' ).
        ELSEIF ls_current_flight-carrid = ls_prev_flight-carrid AND
                ls_current_flight-fldate > ls_prev_flight-fldate.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Sorting by fldate failed' ).
        ENDIF.
        ls_prev_flight = ls_current_flight.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: TABLES, SORT, Internal Tables, Sorting

Instructions: Erstelle eine Aufzählung für die Phasen eines Projekts (Planung, Entwicklung, Test, Go-Live, Abgeschlossen) und eine Methode, die die Gültigkeit eines Phasenübergangs prüft (z.B. von 'Planung' direkt zu 'Abgeschlossen' ist ungültig).
hint: Verwende eine interne Tabelle oder eine `MAP` zur Definition gültiger Übergänge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_project_phase DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_project_phase,
             planning,
             development,
             testing,
             go_live,
             completed,
           END OF ENUM t_project_phase.

    METHODS is_valid_transition
      IMPORTING
        iv_from_phase TYPE t_project_phase
        iv_to_phase   TYPE t_project_phase
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_project_phase IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_transition.
    DATA(lt_valid_transitions) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF REF TO DATA WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line (
      ( REF #( VALUE #( from = t_project_phase=>planning to = t_project_phase=>development ) ) )
      ( REF #( VALUE #( from = t_project_phase=>development to = t_project_phase=>testing ) ) )
      ( REF #( VALUE #( from = t_project_phase=>testing to = t_project_phase=>go_live ) ) )
      ( REF #( VALUE #( from = t_project_phase=>go_live to = t_project_phase=>completed ) ) )
      ( REF #( VALUE #( from = t_project_phase=>development to = t_project_phase=>planning ) ) ) " Example of backward transition
    ).

    " Check if the transition exists in the set of valid transitions
    IF lt_valid_transitions IS INITIAL.
      " Initialize the table if it's empty (e.g., first call)
      " This is a simplified example; in a real scenario, this would be static or loaded once.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REF #( VALUE #( from = iv_from_phase to = iv_to_phase ) ) IN TABLE lt_valid_transitions.
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Ermittle die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge, die im aktuellen Jahr und im Vorjahr stattgefunden haben, und zeige sie in einer einzigen Liste an.
hint: Nutze `SELECT ... GROUP BY ... UNION ALL SELECT ... GROUP BY ...` und `sy-datum` für die Jahresberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_yearly_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_count,
             year      TYPE char4,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_union_yearly_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_yearly_passenger_counts.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_previous_year) = lv_current_year - 1.

    SELECT FROM sflight AS sf
           FIELDS @lv_current_year AS year, sf~carrid, SUM( sf~seatsocc ) AS total_pass
           WHERE sf~fldate BETWEEN @( lv_current_year && '0101' ) AND @( lv_current_year && '1231' )
           GROUP BY sf~carrid
      UNION ALL
    SELECT FROM sflight AS sf
           FIELDS @lv_previous_year AS year, sf~carrid, SUM( sf~seatsocc ) AS total_pass
           WHERE sf~fldate BETWEEN @( lv_previous_year && '0101' ) AND @( lv_previous_year && '1231' )
           GROUP BY sf~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_passenger_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definiere eine Aufzählung für die Maßeinheiten (KG, L, ST) und eine Methode, die einen Wert von einer Einheit in eine andere umrechnet (vereinfacht, z.B. 1 KG = 1000 L, 1 L = 1 ST).
hint: Nutze `CASE` für die Umrechnungslogik und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von Umrechnungsfaktoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_unit_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_unit,
             kg,
             l,
             st,
           END OF ENUM t_unit.

    METHODS convert_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value    TYPE decfloat16
        iv_from_unit TYPE t_unit
        iv_to_unit   TYPE t_unit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_value) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_unit_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_value.
    " Simplified conversion factors for demonstration
    CONSTANTS: lc_kg_to_l TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '1000',
               lc_l_to_st TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '1'.

    DATA(lv_base_value) = iv_value.

    " Convert to a common base unit (e.g., L for this example)
    CASE iv_from_unit.
      WHEN t_unit=>kg.
        lv_base_value = iv_value * lc_kg_to_l.
      WHEN t_unit=>l.
        lv_base_value = iv_value.
      WHEN t_unit=>st.
        lv_base_value = iv_value * lc_l_to_st.
    ENDCASE.

    " Convert from base unit to target unit
    CASE iv_to_unit.
      WHEN t_unit=>kg.
        rv_converted_value = lv_base_value / lc_kg_to_l.
      WHEN t_unit=>l.
        rv_converted_value = lv_base_value.
      WHEN t_unit=>st.
        rv_converted_value = lv_base_value / lc_l_to_st.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_value( iv_value = '1' iv_from_unit = zcl_enum_unit_conversion=>t_unit=>kg iv_to_unit = zcl_enum_unit_conversion=>t_unit=>l ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_l_to_st.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_enum_unit_conversion( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_kg_to_st.

Instructions: Kombiniere die Top 3 meistgebuchten Flüge des letzten Monats mit den Top 3 meistgebuchten Flügen des Vormonats in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste, sortiert nach der Anzahl der Buchungen.
hint: Nutze `SELECT ... ORDER BY ... UP TO ... UNION ALL SELECT ... ORDER BY ... UP TO ...` mit Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_top_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_top_booking,
             month_year TYPE char7,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             bookings   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_top_booking.
    TYPES: tt_top_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_top_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_bookings_last_two_months
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_bookings) TYPE tt_top_bookings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_top_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_bookings_last_two_months.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_last_month_start) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_month( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_previous_month( lv_current_date ) ).
    DATA(lv_last_month_end) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_last_day_of_month( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_previous_month( lv_current_date ) ).
    DATA(lv_month_before_last_start) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_month( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_previous_month( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_previous_month( lv_current_date ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_month_before_last_end) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_last_day_of_month( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_previous_month( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_previous_month( lv_current_date ) ) ).

    DATA(lv_last_month_str) = |{ lv_last_month_start(4) }-{ lv_last_month_start+4(2) }|.
    DATA(lv_month_before_last_str) = |{ lv_month_before_last_start(4) }-{ lv_month_before_last_start+4(2) }|.

    SELECT FROM sbook AS sb
           FIELDS @lv_last_month_str AS month_year, sb~carrid, sb~connid, COUNT( * ) AS bookings
           WHERE sb~fldate BETWEEN @lv_last_month_start AND @lv_last_month_end
           GROUP BY sb~carrid, sb~connid
           ORDER BY bookings DESC
           UP TO 3 ROWS
      UNION ALL
    SELECT FROM sbook AS sb
           FIELDS @lv_month_before_last_str AS month_year, sb~carrid, sb~connid, COUNT( * ) AS bookings
           WHERE sb~fldate BETWEEN @lv_month_before_last_start AND @lv_month_before_last_end
           GROUP BY sb~carrid, sb~connid
           ORDER BY bookings DESC
           UP TO 3 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_top_bookings.

    SORT rt_top_bookings BY bookings DESC.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_top_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_top_bookings( ).
    DATA(lt_top_bookings) = lo_cut->get_top_bookings_last_two_months( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_top_bookings, msg = 'Should not be initial if SBOOK has data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_top_bookings, msg = 'Top bookings list should not be empty' ).

    " Check if the number of entries is at most 6 (3 for each month)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_top_bookings ) <= 6 ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Should have at most 6 entries' ).

    " Verify sorting (optional, as it's done in ABAP after UNION)
    IF lines( lt_top_bookings ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_top_bookings[ 1 ]-bookings >= lt_top_bookings[ 2 ]-bookings ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Results should be sorted by bookings' ).
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_flight_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_number,
             flight_number TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_number.
    TYPES tt_flight_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE tt_flight_numbers.

CLASS zcl_flight_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_flight_numbers.
    DATA: lv_regex_pattern TYPE string VALUE `[A-Z]{2}\d{3}`. " Matches two uppercase letters followed by three digits

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_match_results).

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_match_results
                                 ( flight_number = iv_text+<match>-offset(<match>-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             airpfrom TYPE sflight-airpfrom,
             airpto   TYPE sflight-airpto,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_city TYPE sflight-airpfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " In a real scenario, data would be fetched from DB. For demo, we'll simulate.
    " SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    " Simulate sflights data for demonstration
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'NEW YORK' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 200 ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'CHICAGO'   airpto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 250 ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'LONDON'   seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' airpfrom = 'DALLAS'    airpto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 180 ) 
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE airpfrom = iv_city )
                          MAP   #( VALUE ty_flight_info( carrid   = carrid
                                                          connid   = connid
                                                          fldate   = fldate
                                                          airpfrom = airpfrom
                                                          airpto   = airpto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein gegebener Text eines von mehreren verbotenen Wörtern enthält. Die Prüfung soll case-insensitive erfolgen.

CLASS zcl_forbidden_word_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_forbidden_word
      IMPORTING
        iv_text          TYPE string
        it_forbidden_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_contains) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_forbidden_word_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_forbidden_word.
    LOOP AT it_forbidden_words INTO DATA(lv_forbidden_word).
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_forbidden_word IN iv_text IGNORING CASE.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_contains = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_contains = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_document,
             id      TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_document.
    TYPES tt_documents TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_document WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS search_documents
      IMPORTING
        it_documents TYPE tt_documents
        iv_keyword   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_documents) TYPE tt_documents.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_documents.
    rt_filtered_documents = FILTER #( it_documents USING KEY primary_key
                                      WHERE ( COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_keyword IS INITIAL THEN abap_true
                                                              WHEN CONTAINS( val = content sub = iv_keyword case = abap_false ) THEN abap_true
                                                              ELSE abap_false ) ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften, die Flüge von 'NEW YORK' anbieten.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` und dann `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_unique_carriers_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_city TYPE sflight-airpfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_unique_carriers_from_city.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Simulate sflights data
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'NEW YORK' airpto = 'FRANKFURT' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'NEW YORK' airpto = 'LONDON' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' airpfrom = 'NEW YORK' airpto = 'PARIS' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' airpfrom = 'CHICAGO'  airpto = 'NEW YORK' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250102' airpfrom = 'NEW YORK' airpto = 'FRANKFURT' ) 
    ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR GROUPS OF <flight> IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE airpfrom = iv_city )
                         GROUP BY <flight>-carrid
                         WITHOUT MEMBERS
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_from_city.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_counter->count_unique_carriers_from_city( 'SYDNEY' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF`. Zuerst wird die Tabelle mit `FILTER` auf die relevanten Flüge eingeschränkt. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um über die gefilterten Daten zu iterieren und diese nach `carrid` zu gruppieren (`GROUP BY <flight>-carrid`). `WITHOUT MEMBERS` stellt sicher, dass nur die Gruppenschlüssel verarbeitet werden. Für jede eindeutige Gruppe wird der Zähler (`count`) inkrementiert, was eine effiziente Zählung der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften ermöglicht.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Ersetze alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wortes in einem Text durch ein anderes Wort. Die Ersetzung soll case-sensitive erfolgen.
hint: Nutze `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_text_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_word
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_old_word TYPE string
        iv_new_word TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_word.
    rv_modified_text = iv_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_word IN rv_modified_text WITH iv_new_word.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_single_replacement FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_replacements FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_replacement FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_case_sensitive FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_single_replacement.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_text_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = `Hello World`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_word( iv_text = lv_original iv_old_word = 'World' iv_new_word = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `Hello ABAP` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_replacements.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_text_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = `The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy fox.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_word( iv_text = lv_original iv_old_word = 'fox' iv_new_word = 'dog' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `The quick brown dog jumps over the lazy dog.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_replacement.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_text_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = `No match here.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_word( iv_text = lv_original iv_old_word = 'word' iv_new_word = 'replacement' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `No match here.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_case_sensitive.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_text_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = `Hello world, hello World.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_word( iv_text = lv_original iv_old_word = 'world' iv_new_word = 'universe' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `Hello universe, hello World.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` ist die Standardanweisung in ABAP, um alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem String durch einen anderen zu ersetzen. Sie ist einfach zu verwenden und effizient für diese Aufgabe. Ohne die Option `IGNORING CASE` erfolgt die Ersetzung case-sensitiv.
keywords: REPLACE, String

Instructions: Filtere die Tabelle `sflights`, um Flüge zu finden, deren Abflugort auch als Zielort für *mindestens einen anderen Flug* in der gleichen Tabelle vorkommt.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` mit einer Subquery oder `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_connecting_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_with_connecting_cities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_connecting_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_connecting_cities.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Simulate sflights data
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'NEW YORK' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'NEW YORK'  airpto = 'FRANKFURT' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'LONDON' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' airpfrom = 'DALLAS'    airpto = 'CHICAGO' ) 
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250104' airpfrom = 'LONDON'    airpto = 'PARIS' ) 
    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ airpto = airpfrom ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein gegebener String dem Datumsformat 'YYYY-MM-DD' entspricht. Es soll keine Validierung des Datums selbst (z.B. 30. Februar) erfolgen, nur des Formats.
hint: Nutze `FIND REGEX` mit einem passenden Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_format_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_date_format
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_format_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_date_format.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$`. " YYYY-MM-DD

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_date_string.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_format FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_format FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_partial_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_format.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_date_format_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '2023-11-21' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '1999-01-01' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_format.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_date_format_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '2023/11/21' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '2023-11-2' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '23-11-21' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '2023-11-21T10:00:00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_date_format_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_partial_match.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_date_format_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( 'ABC2023-11-21XYZ' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX` ist das ideale Werkzeug zur Validierung von String-Formaten. Der reguläre Ausdruck `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` stellt sicher, dass der gesamte String genau dem Muster 'YYYY-MM-DD' entspricht (Dank `^` für Start und `$` für Ende des Strings). Dies ist eine präzise und effiziente Methode zur Formatprüfung.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String, Validation, Date

Instructions: Filtere die Tabelle `sflights` dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Die Ergebnis-Tabelle soll alle Felder von `sflight` enthalten.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` in Kombination mit einem dynamischen Feldzugriff über Feldsymbole oder `COND` mit `CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_field_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Simulate sflights data
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'NEW YORK' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'CHICAGO'   airpto = 'FRANKFURT' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'LONDON' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' airpfrom = 'DALLAS'    airpto = 'FRANKFURT' ) 
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                     WHERE ( COND abap_bool( 
                                               WHEN iv_field_name = 'CARRID' AND carrid = iv_field_value THEN abap_true
                                               WHEN iv_field_name = 'CONNID' AND connid = iv_field_value THEN abap_true
                                               WHEN iv_field_name = 'AIRPFROM' AND airpfrom = iv_field_value THEN abap_true
                                               WHEN iv_field_name = 'AIRPTO' AND airpto = iv_field_value THEN abap_true
                                               ELSE abap_false ) ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_by_airpfrom FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights_dynamic( iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_field_value = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_by_airpfrom.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights_dynamic( iv_field_name = 'AIRPFROM' iv_field_value = 'FRANKFURT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-airpfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `FILTER` und einer `COND`-Expression eine dynamische Filterung implementieren kann. Anstatt den Feldnamen direkt zu codieren, wird er zur Laufzeit über `iv_field_name` übergeben. Die `COND`-Expression mit mehreren `WHEN`-Zweigen prüft, welcher Feldname gemeint ist, und wendet die entsprechende Bedingung an. Dies ist eine moderne und sichere Alternative zu dynamischen `WHERE`-Klauseln mit Feldsymbolen, da es Compile-Zeit-Prüfungen ermöglicht.
keywords: FILTER, Dynamic, Internal Tables, COND, CASE, sflights

Instructions: Extrahiere alle Wörter aus einem Text, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen und mindestens 3 Zeichen lang sind.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem passenden Muster und `MATCH RESULT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_word_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_word,
             word TYPE string,
           END OF ty_word.
    TYPES tt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_word WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_capitalized_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE tt_words.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_capitalized_words.
    DATA: lv_regex_pattern TYPE string VALUE `\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]{2,}\b`. " Matches words starting with capital, min 3 chars

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_match_results).

    rt_words = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_match_results
                         ( word = iv_text+<match>-offset(<match>-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extraction FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_case FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extraction.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_word_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Dies ist Ein Test mit Mehreren Wörtern.`. `Ein` and `Mehreren` should be found.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_capitalized_words( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-word exp = 'Dies' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-word exp = 'Ein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-word exp = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-word exp = 'Wörtern' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_word_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `dies ist ein test.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_capitalized_words( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_case.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_word_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `ABAP ist Eine Sprache.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_capitalized_words( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-word exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-word exp = 'Eine' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-word exp = 'Sprache' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` ist hier wieder das Schlüsselwerkzeug. Der Regex `\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]{2,}\b` ist präzise: `\b` für Wortgrenzen, `[A-Z]` für den Start mit einem Großbuchstaben und `[a-zA-Z]{2,}` für mindestens zwei weitere Buchstaben (insgesamt 3+ Zeichen). Die Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine elegante Extraktion der gefundenen Wörter.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String, Extraction, Words, Capitalized

Instructions: Filtere die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die in den nächsten 7 Tagen stattfinden, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` mit einer Datumsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_upcoming_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_upcoming_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upcoming_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_upcoming_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lv_today TYPE sy-datum.
    DATA: lv_seven_days_later TYPE sy-datum.

    lv_today = sy-datum.
    lv_seven_days_later = lv_today + 7.

    " Simulate sflights data
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum - 10 airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'NEW YORK' ) " Past
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum + 2  airpfrom = 'NEW YORK'  airpto = 'FRANKFURT' ) " Upcoming
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum + 7  airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'LONDON' ) " Upcoming (inclusive)
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' fldate = sy-datum + 8  airpfrom = 'DALLAS'    airpto = 'CHICAGO' ) " Too far in future
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = sy-datum      airpfrom = 'LONDON'    airpto = 'PARIS' ) " Today, Upcoming
    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE fldate >= lv_today AND fldate <= lv_seven_days_later ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_upcoming_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_upcoming_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upcoming_flights.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_upcoming_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_finder->get_upcoming_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate exp = sy-datum + 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-fldate exp = sy-datum + 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-fldate exp = sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_upcoming_flights.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_upcoming_flights( ).
    " To properly test 'no upcoming flights', the solution would need to accept a table.
    " For this example, we'll rely on the existing test data.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_finder->get_upcoming_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FILTER` wird hier verwendet, um Datensätze basierend auf einem Datumsbereich zu selektieren. Die Berechnung von `lv_today` und `lv_seven_days_later` erfolgt vor der Filterung. Die `WHERE`-Klausel nutzt einfache Vergleichsoperatoren, um Flüge innerhalb des definierten Zeitfensters zu finden. Dies ist eine klare und effiziente Methode für datumsbasierte Filterungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Date, sflights

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein gegebener String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt.
hint: Nutze `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF` mit der Option `STARTING AT` oder die Funktion `STARTS_WITH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_prefix_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS starts_with_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_starts) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prefix_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD starts_with_prefix.
    " Option 1: Using STARTS_WITH (ABAP 7.40+)
    rv_starts = COND abap_bool( WHEN STARTS_WITH( val = iv_text sub = iv_prefix ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).

    " Option 2: Using FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF (older but still valid)
    " FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_prefix IN iv_text STARTING AT 0.
    " IF sy-subrc = 0.
    "   rv_starts = abap_true.
    " ELSE.
    "   rv_starts = abap_false.
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_starts_with FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_not_starts_with FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_prefix FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_text FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_starts_with.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_prefix_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_checker->starts_with_prefix( iv_text = 'ABAP Development' iv_prefix = 'ABAP' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_checker->starts_with_prefix( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_prefix = 'Hello' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_not_starts_with.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_prefix_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_checker->starts_with_prefix( iv_text = 'Development ABAP' iv_prefix = 'ABAP' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_checker->starts_with_prefix( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_prefix = 'world' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_prefix.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_prefix_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_checker->starts_with_prefix( iv_text = 'Any Text' iv_prefix = '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_text.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_prefix_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_checker->starts_with_prefix( iv_text = '' iv_prefix = 'A' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_checker->starts_with_prefix( iv_text = '' iv_prefix = '' ) ).

explanation: Die String-Funktion `STARTS_WITH` ist die modernste und lesbarste Methode, um zu prüfen, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt. Sie liefert direkt einen booleschen Wert. Alternativ könnte `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF ... STARTING AT 0` verwendet werden, aber `STARTS_WITH` ist prägnanter und semantisch klarer.
keywords: FIND, STARTS_WITH, String, Prefix

Instructions: Filtere die Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge zu erhalten, deren Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in einer separaten Liste von bevorzugten Fluggesellschaften enthalten ist.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` auf der Liste der bevorzugten Fluggesellschaften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_preferred_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_by_preferred_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_preferred_carriers TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_preferred_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_preferred_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Simulate sflights data
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'NEW YORK' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'NEW YORK'  airpto = 'FRANKFURT' ) 
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250102' airpfrom = 'LONDON'    airpto = 'PARIS' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' airpfrom = 'DALLAS'    airpto = 'CHICAGO' ) 
    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE LINE_EXISTS( it_preferred_carriers[ table_line = carrid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String per Regex in seine Bestandteile. Der String soll durch Kommas oder Semikolons getrennt sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und `MATCH RESULT` zur Extraktion der Teile, da ein direkter Regex-Split in ABAP komplexer ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_res) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_regex.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `[^,;]+`. " Matches one or more characters that are not a comma or semicolon

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_val
      RESULTS DATA(lt_match_results).

    rt_res = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_match_results
                       ( |{ iv_val+<match>-offset(<match>-length) }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 1 ] exp = 'Apfel' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 2 ] exp = 'Birne' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 3 ] exp = 'Kirsche' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_split_semicolon.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 1 ] exp = 'Rot' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 2 ] exp = 'Grün' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 3 ] exp = 'Blau' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_delimiters.

    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->split_regex( 'Eins,Zwei;Drei' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 1 ] exp = 'Eins' ).

  METHOD test_empty_string.

explanation: Während ABAP keine direkte `SPLIT`-Anweisung mit Regex-Delimitern wie in anderen Sprachen bietet, kann man den Effekt mit `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` erzielen. Der Regex `[^,;]+` findet alle Sequenzen von Zeichen, die *nicht* Komma oder Semikolon sind, und extrahiert sie als separate Elemente. Dies ist eine moderne und flexible Methode, um Strings basierend auf komplexen Trennzeichen zu zerlegen.
keywords: REGEX, SPLIT, String, FIND, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Filtere die Tabelle `sflights` und gib nur die Flüge zurück, die eine Flugnummer (CONNID) haben, die mit '0' beginnt.

CLASS zcl_connid_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_connid_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_starting_with_zero.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Simulate sflights data
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' airpto = 'NEW YORK' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' fldate = '20250101' airpfrom = 'NEW YORK'  airpto = 'FRANKFURT' )

    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
