Instructions: Extrahiere alle URLs (beginnend mit 'http://' oder 'https://') aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem passenden Muster für URLs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_url_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_url,
             url TYPE string,
           END OF ty_url.
    TYPES tt_urls TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_url WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_urls
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_urls) TYPE tt_urls.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_urls.
    DATA: lv_regex_pattern TYPE string VALUE `https?://(?:[a-zA-Z]|[0-9]|[$-_@.&+]|[!*\(\),]|(?:%[0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]))+`. " Regex for URLs

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_match_results).

    rt_urls = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_match_results
                       ( url = iv_text+<match>-offset(<match>-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_single_url FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_urls FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_url FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_content FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_single_url.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_url_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Besuchen Sie unsere Website: https://www.sap.com`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_urls( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-url exp = 'https://www.sap.com' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_urls.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_url_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Links: http://example.com und https://another.org/path?query=1`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_urls( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-url exp = 'http://example.com' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-url exp = 'https://another.org/path?query=1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_url.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_url_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Keine URLs hier.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_urls( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_content.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_url_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Text mit http://url1.de und etwas anderem, dann https://url2.com/test.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_urls( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-url exp = 'http://url1.de' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-url exp = 'https://url2.com/test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Extraktion von URLs aus Texten ist eine klassische Anwendung von regulären Ausdrücken. `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem robusten URL-Regex-Muster ist die effizienteste Methode. Der Regex `https?://(?:[a-zA-Z]|[0-9]|[$-_@.&+]|[!*\(\),]|(?:%[0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]))+` deckt die meisten gängigen URL-Formate ab. Die Ergebnisse werden dann mit `FOR` und `VALUE` in eine interne Tabelle überführt.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String, URL, Extraction

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING #` Operator für Strukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field4 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transfer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transfer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_transfer( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_transfer=>ty_source( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 field3 = 'World' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->transfer_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field1 sollte übertragen werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 msg = 'Field2 sollte übertragen werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-field4 msg = 'Field4 sollte initial sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING #` Operator ist die moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`. Er ermöglicht die einfache Zuweisung von Feldern mit identischen Namen zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structure, Data Transfer, MOVE-CORRESPONDING

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, wobei nur die Felder CARRID, CONNID und FLDATE in eine Zieltabelle mit passenden Feldnamen übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #` für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_reduced_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reduced_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_reduced_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_reduced_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_table_transfer FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Dabei soll das Feld `source_id` der Quellstruktur auf `target_id` der Zielstruktur gemappt werden. Das Feld `ignore_me` der Quellstruktur soll ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` im `CORRESPONDING #` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             source_id TYPE string,
             value1    TYPE i,
             value2    TYPE string,
             ignore_me TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_id TYPE string,
             value1    TYPE i,
             value2    TYPE string,
             extra_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_and_exclude
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_and_exclude.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING target_id = source_id EXCEPT ignore_me ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping_exclude FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping_exclude.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapping=>ty_source(
      source_id = 'SRC123'
      value1    = 456
      value2    = 'Test Value'
      ignore_me = 'Should be ignored' ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_and_exclude( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_id exp = 'SRC123' msg = 'target_id sollte gemappt werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-value1 exp = 456 msg = 'value1 sollte übertragen werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-value2 exp = 'Test Value' msg = 'value2 sollte übertragen werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-extra_field msg = 'extra_field sollte initial sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Zusätze `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` im `CORRESPONDING #` Operator bieten eine mächtige Möglichkeit, die Feldzuweisung zu steuern. `MAPPING` erlaubt die Umbenennung von Feldern während der Zuweisung, während `EXCEPT` bestimmte Felder von der Übertragung ausschließt.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, EXCEPT, Data Transformation, Structure

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie eine Zielstruktur mit Standardwerten und überschreiben Sie dann spezifische Felder aus einer Quellstruktur, die identische Namen haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `BASE` im `CORRESPONDING #` Ausdruck, um eine Basis für die Zuweisung zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_base_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string VALUE 'Default Value',
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS transfer_with_base
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_base_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_with_base.
    DATA(ls_initial_target) = VALUE ty_target( ). " Target with default values
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( ls_initial_target ) is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_base_transfer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_base_transfer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_base_transfer( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_base_transfer=>ty_source(
      field_a = 'Source A'
      field_b = 999 ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->transfer_with_base( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_a exp = 'Source A' msg = 'Field A sollte von der Quelle kommen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_b exp = 999 msg = 'Field B sollte von der Quelle kommen' ).

explanation: Der `BASE` Zusatz im `CORRESPONDING #` Operator ermöglicht es, eine bereits existierende Struktur oder einen Initialwert als Basis für die Zuweisung zu verwenden. Felder, die nicht in der Quellstruktur vorhanden sind oder nicht gemappt werden, behalten ihre Werte aus der Basisstruktur.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, BASE, Initialization, Data Transfer, Structure

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten zwischen zwei komplexen Strukturen, die verschachtelte Strukturen und interne Tabellen enthalten. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Daten korrekt in die entsprechenden Felder der Zielstruktur kopiert werden.
hint: Der `CORRESPONDING #` Operator kann auch für verschachtelte Strukturen und Tabellen verwendet werden, ohne dass explizite Schleifen erforderlich sind.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_source,
             doc_id TYPE string,
             doc_date TYPE d,
             items TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_header_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_target,
             document_id TYPE string,
             document_date TYPE d,
             items TYPE tt_items,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_header_target.

    METHODS transfer_nested_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_header_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_header_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_nested_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING document_id = doc_id document_date = doc_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_nested_transfer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_transfer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_transfer( ).

    DATA(lt_source_items) = VALUE zcl_nested_transfer=>tt_items(
      ( item_id = 'A1' quantity = 10 )
      ( item_id = 'B2' quantity = 20 ) ).

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_nested_transfer=>ty_header_source(
      doc_id   = 'DOC001'
      doc_date = sy-datum
      items    = lt_source_items ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->transfer_nested_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-document_id exp = 'DOC001' msg = 'Document ID sollte gemappt werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-document_date exp = sy-datum msg = 'Document Date sollte gemappt werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_target-items ) exp = 2 msg = 'Zwei Items sollten übertragen werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-items[1]-item_id exp = 'A1' msg = 'Erste Item ID ist falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-items[2]-quantity exp = 20 msg = 'Zweite Item Menge ist falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-status msg = 'Status sollte initial sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING #` Operator ist intelligent genug, um auch verschachtelte Strukturen und interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten. Durch die Verwendung von `MAPPING` können Felder auf verschiedenen Ebenen der Hierarchie umbenannt werden, was die Datenübertragung von komplexen Objekten stark vereinfacht.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Nested Structures, Internal Tables, Data Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Zahl entgegennimmt. Wenn die Zahl negativ ist, soll eine Ausnahme vom Typ `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR` ausgelöst werden.

    ENDIF.

explanation: Das Auslösen von Ausnahmen mit `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` ist der moderne und objektorientierte Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Es ersetzt ältere Mechanismen wie `MESSAGE ... RAISING` und ermöglicht eine strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahmeklasse für einen 'Ungültigen Parameter' und lösen Sie diese aus, wenn ein übergebener String leer ist.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_parameter DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_parameter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          textid = VALUE if_t100_message=>t100key(
            msgid = 'ZMSG_APP'
            msgno = '001'
            attr1 = 'IV_INPUT' ). " Beispiel: Nachricht aus Nachrichtenklasse ZMSG_APP, Nummer 001
    ENDIF.
    " Verarbeitung des Strings
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Das Definieren eigener Ausnahmeklassen (z.B. von `CX_STATIC_CHECK`) ermöglicht eine sehr spezifische und semantisch aussagekräftige Fehlerbehandlung. Durch die Implementierung von `IF_T100_MESSAGE` können Nachrichten aus dem Nachrichten-Framework verwendet werden.

Instructions: Lösen Sie eine Ausnahme vom Typ `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` aus, wenn ein String nicht in eine Zahl konvertiert werden kann. Fügen Sie der Ausnahme eine aussagekräftige Nachricht und den fehlerhaften String als Attribut hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `MESSAGE` Zusatz und füllen Sie Attribute der Ausnahmeklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_with_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_number) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_with_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_int.
    TRY.
        rv_number = iv_string.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Fügen Sie den fehlerhaften String als Attribut hinzu, falls die Klasse dies unterstützt
        " (CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR hat kein direktes Attribut für den fehlerhaften Wert, 
        " aber man kann eine eigene Exception mit solchem Attribut erstellen oder die Message nutzen)
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_conv_error->textid
            previous = lx_conv_error
            " Hier könnte man ein eigenes Attribut setzen, wenn es eine eigene Exception wäre
            " faulty_value = iv_string
          MESSAGE E002(ZMSG_APP) WITH iv_string. " Beispiel: Nachrichtenklasse ZMSG_APP, Nummer 002
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_conversion_ok FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_conversion_raises_exception RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_conversion_ok.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_with_message( ).
    DATA(lv_number) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_int( '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_number exp = 123 msg = 'Gültige Konvertierung sollte erfolgreich sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_conversion_raises_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_with_message( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_string_to_int( 'ABC' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Erwartete Ausnahme CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR wurde nicht ausgelöst' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Korrekte Ausnahme ausgelöst' ).
        " Überprüfung der Nachricht (Beispiel, genaue Nachricht hängt von ZMSG_APP ab)
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'ABC' in = lx_conv_error->get_text( ) msg = 'Fehlerhafter Wert sollte in der Nachricht sein' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch den `MESSAGE` Zusatz beim Auslösen einer Ausnahme kann eine Nachricht aus dem Nachrichten-Framework direkt an die Ausnahme gebunden werden. Dies verbessert die Fehlerdiagnose erheblich, da die Ausnahme nicht nur den Fehlertyp, sondern auch eine kontextbezogene, lokalisierbare Nachricht enthält.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Message, Attributes, Error Reporting, CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine `CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` Ausnahme fängt und diese in eine eigene, spezifischere Ausnahme `ZCX_APPLICATION_ERROR` umwandelt, wobei die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als 'previous' Ausnahme erhalten bleibt.
hint: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme und lösen Sie eine andere mit dem `PREVIOUS` Zusatz aus.
solution:
CLASS zcx_application_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_application_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS access_array_element
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_application_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_array_element.
    TRY.
        rv_value = it_data[ iv_index ].
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_range_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_application_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = VALUE if_t100_message=>t100key(
              msgid = 'ZMSG_APP'
              msgno = '003'
              attr1 = 'IV_INDEX' )
            previous = lx_range_error. " Die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als 'previous' übergeben
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_out_of_bounds_raises_chained_exception RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_valid_access_ok FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_out_of_bounds_raises_chained_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_chaining( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->access_array_element( it_data = lt_data iv_index = 3 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Erwartete Ausnahme ZCX_APPLICATION_ERROR wurde nicht ausgelöst' ).
      CATCH zcx_application_error INTO DATA(lx_app_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Korrekte Anwendungs-Ausnahme ausgelöst' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_app_error->previous msg = 'Previous-Ausnahme sollte vorhanden sein' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_app_error->previous->get_class_name( ) exp = 'CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS' msg = 'Previous-Ausnahme ist vom richtigen Typ' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_access_ok.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_chaining( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->access_array_element( it_data = lt_data iv_index = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 10 msg = 'Gültiger Zugriff sollte erfolgreich sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Exception Chaining mit dem `PREVIOUS` Zusatz ermöglicht es, die Ursache einer Ausnahme zu verfolgen. Eine gefangene Ausnahme kann in eine spezifischere umgewandelt werden, wobei die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als Kontext erhalten bleibt. Dies ist entscheidend für die Fehleranalyse in komplexen Systemen.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY...CATCH, Exception Chaining, PREVIOUS, CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein Wert außerhalb eines gültigen Bereichs liegt. Im `CATCH`-Block soll der Wert korrigiert und die Ausführung fortgesetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION` und `RESUME`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA invalid_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA corrected_value TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        invalid_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->invalid_value = invalid_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_resumable_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    CONSTANTS: lc_min TYPE i VALUE 0, lc_max TYPE i VALUE 100.

    IF iv_input < lc_min OR iv_input > lc_max.
      RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = VALUE if_t100_message=>t100key(
            msgid = 'ZMSG_APP'
            msgno = '004'
            attr1 = 'IV_INPUT' )
          invalid_value = iv_input
          corrected_value = COND #( WHEN iv_input < lc_min THEN lc_min ELSE lc_max ).
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_input.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resumable_exception_handled FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_valid_value_ok FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_exception_handled.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resumable_exception_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lv_result = lo_cut->process_value( 150 ). " Wert außerhalb des Bereichs
      CATCH RESUMABLE zcx_resumable_error INTO DATA(lx_resumable_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_resumable_error->invalid_value exp = 150 msg = 'Invalid value should be 150' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_resumable_error->corrected_value exp = 100 msg = 'Corrected value should be 100' ).
        " Korrektur anwenden und fortfahren
        lv_result = lx_resumable_error->corrected_value.
        RESUME.
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 100 msg = 'Verarbeitung sollte mit korrigiertem Wert fortgesetzt werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_value_ok.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resumable_exception_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_value( 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 50 msg = 'Gültiger Wert sollte direkt verarbeitet werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (`RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION`) ermöglichen es, Fehler im `CATCH`-Block zu beheben und die Programmausführung an der Stelle des Fehlers fortzusetzen (`RESUME`). Dies ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen eine automatische Korrektur möglich ist und ein Programmabbruch vermieden werden soll.
keywords: RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION, RESUME, Error Recovery, Exception Handling

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf den Schlüsselfeldern 'carrid' und 'connid'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...` nach einer Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_adj_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_adj_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid. "Wichtig für ADJACENT DUPLICATES"
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_adj_dup=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'. "Duplikat auf Schlüsselbasis"
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_adj_dup( ).
    DATA(lt_unique) = lo_cut->delete_duplicates( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um redundante Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, vorausgesetzt, die Tabelle ist nach den Vergleichsfeldern sortiert. Dies ist eine klassische, aber immer noch relevante ABAP-Funktion.
keywords: DELETE, ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Table, SORT

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Flugdatum vor einem bestimmten Datum liegt, unter Verwendung moderner Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE itab WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_for_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_date    TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_for_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE fldate < iv_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_old_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fetch_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_sflights_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.

CLASS zcl_fetch_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit einem Cursor und einer `FOR ALL ENTRIES`-ähnlichen Logik, indem Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften filtern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR ... WHERE carrid IN @it_carrids` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_for_all_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_sflights_for_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_for_all_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_for_carrids.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_data.

    IF it_carrids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrids.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

      ( carrid = 'FA2' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' )

    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_filter_carrids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY( ( 'FA1' ) ( 'FA3' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fetch_for_all_cursor( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflights_for_carrids( lt_filter_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'FA1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'FA3' ).

    " Cleanup
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ( 'FA1', 'FA2', 'FA3' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist nützlich, wenn eine große Menge von Daten aus der Datenbank basierend auf einer Liste von Kriterien abgerufen werden muss, ohne die gesamte Tabelle in den Speicher zu laden.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Tabellentyp für Flugbuchungen (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Buchungsdatum) mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel über Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Fügen Sie Daten hinzu und demonstrieren Sie, wie ein doppelter Eintrag abgefangen wird.

CLASS zcl_flight_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             bookdate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_booking.
    TYPES: ty_bookings_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_booking WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_booking
      IMPORTING is_booking TYPE ty_booking
      RETURNING VALUE(rb_success) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_bookings RETURNING VALUE(rt_bookings) TYPE ty_bookings_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  DATA mt_bookings TYPE ty_bookings_tt.

  METHOD add_booking.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_booking INTO TABLE mt_bookings.
        rb_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
        rb_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_bookings.
    rt_bookings = mt_bookings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_duplicate_booking.
    DATA(lo_bookings) = NEW zcl_flight_bookings( ).
    DATA(ls_booking1) = VALUE zcl_flight_bookings=>ty_booking( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' bookdate = sy-datum ).
    lo_bookings->add_booking( ls_booking1 ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Flugstatus (Geplant, Verspätet, Gelandet, Abgesagt). Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die alle Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle liest und jedem Flug einen zufälligen Status aus der Enumeration zuweist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM ... END OF ENUM` und `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM flight_status,
             planned,
             delayed,
             landed,
             cancelled,
           END OF ENUM flight_status.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE flight_status,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES: ty_flights_with_status_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_random_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flights_with_status_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_random_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(ls_flight_with_status) = VALUE ty_flight_with_status(
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
      ).

      DATA(lv_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = 3 )->get_next( ).
      CASE lv_random.
        WHEN 0.
          ls_flight_with_status-status = flight_status-planned.
        WHEN 1.
          ls_flight_with_status-status = flight_status-delayed.
        WHEN 2.
          ls_flight_with_status-status = flight_status-landed.
        WHEN 3.
          ls_flight_with_status-status = flight_status-cancelled.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_flight_with_status TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_flight_status) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_flight_status->get_flights_with_random_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( ls_flight-status = zcl_flight_status=>flight_status-planned OR
                 ls_flight-status = zcl_flight_status=>flight_status-delayed OR
                 ls_flight-status = zcl_flight_status=>flight_status-landed OR
                 ls_flight-status = zcl_flight_status=>flight_status-cancelled ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die typsichere Definition von Flugstatus mittels Enumeration mit der dynamischen Zuweisung dieser Status zu realen Flugdaten. Die Enumeration verbessert die Lesbarkeit und verhindert ungültige Statuswerte.

CLASS zcl_payment_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM payment_status,
             open,
             partially_paid,
             fully_paid,
           END OF ENUM payment_status.

    METHODS determine_status
      IMPORTING iv_total_amount TYPE decfloat16
      IMPORTING iv_paid_amount  TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE payment_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_payment_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD determine_status.
    IF iv_paid_amount = 0.
      rv_status = payment_status-open.
    ELSEIF iv_paid_amount > 0 AND iv_paid_amount < iv_total_amount.
      rv_status = payment_status-partially_paid.
    ELSEIF iv_paid_amount >= iv_total_amount.
      rv_status = payment_status-fully_paid.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = payment_status-open.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM message_severity,
             info,
             warning,
             error,
             critical,
           END OF ENUM message_severity.

    METHODS format_message
      IMPORTING iv_message  TYPE string
      IMPORTING iv_severity TYPE message_severity
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_message.
    DATA(lv_severity_text) = SWITCH string( iv_severity
      WHEN message_severity-info     THEN 'INFO'
      WHEN message_severity-warning  THEN 'WARNING'
      WHEN message_severity-error    THEN 'ERROR'
      WHEN message_severity-critical THEN 'CRITICAL'
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN' ).

    rv_formatted_message = |[{ lv_severity_text }] { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_key_value_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_value_pair.

CLASS zcl_key_value_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_hash_map.
    ro_hash_map = NEW cl_abap_container_utilities=>hash_map( ).

    LOOP AT it_key_value_pairs INTO DATA(ls_pair).
      ro_hash_map->put( key = ls_pair-key value = ls_pair-value ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Alternativ mit REDUCE (ABAP 7.50+)
    " ro_hash_map = REDUCE #( INIT map = NEW cl_abap_container_utilities=>hash_map( )
    "                         FOR ls_pair IN it_key_value_pairs
    "                         NEXT map->put( key = ls_pair-key value = ls_pair-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Typ für Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Preis). Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Tabelle dieser Flugdaten entgegennimmt und den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft berechnet. Nutzen Sie dabei `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` und `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group)` in Kombination mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: ty_flight_prices_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carr,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carr.
    TYPES: ty_avg_prices_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carr
      IMPORTING it_flight_prices TYPE ty_flight_prices_tt
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE ty_avg_prices_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carr.
    LOOP AT it_flight_prices INTO DATA(ls_flight_price) GROUP BY ls_flight_price-carrid INTO DATA(group).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0
                                          FOR <fs_flight> IN group
                                          NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-price ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( group ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_avg_price_by_carr(
        carrid = group-carrid
        avg_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ) )
      TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_price_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_price_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_price_calculation.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_price_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = VALUE zcl_flight_price_agg=>ty_flight_prices_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' price = '300.00' ) ).

    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_aggregator->calculate_avg_price_by_carr( lt_prices ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_avg_prices ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_avg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_avg-avg_price exp = '150.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_avg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_avg-avg_price exp = '233.33' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_price_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_price_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_prices) = VALUE zcl_flight_price_agg=>ty_flight_prices_tt( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_aggregator->calculate_avg_price_by_carr( lt_empty_prices ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_avg_prices ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `TYPES` für die Datenmodellierung und modernen ABAP-Sprachkonstrukten wie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` zur effizienten Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und performante Art, Gruppierungen und Berechnungen durchzuführen.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie den dynamischen Aufruf einer Methode einer Klasse unter Verwendung von `REF TO` und `CALL METHOD`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` für eine Referenzvariable und `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_value       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS _add
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i.
    METHODS _multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO zcl_dynamic_method_call.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_object.

    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_importing.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_returning.
    GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _add.
    rv_output = iv_input + 10.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _multiply.
    rv_output = iv_input * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiply FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call(
      iv_method_name = '_ADD'
      iv_value       = 5
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call(
      iv_method_name = '_MULTIPLY'
      iv_value       = 7
    ).

explanation: Die Verwendung von `REF TO` in Verbindung mit `CALL METHOD` ermöglicht den dynamischen Aufruf von Methoden zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Verarbeitungen, bei denen die aufzurufende Methode erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_dynamically.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Inhalt einer beliebigen internen Tabelle (als Datenreferenz übergeben) in eine andere interne Tabelle kopiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPE REF TO data` für generische Referenzen und `CREATE DATA LIKE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_table_content
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data " Generic reference to any table
      EXPORTING
        er_target_table TYPE REF TO data. " Generic reference to any table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_table_content.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_target_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_source_table->* TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Create target table with same type as source table
      CREATE DATA er_target_table LIKE <fs_source_table>.
      ASSIGN er_target_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.
      IF <fs_target_table> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_target_table> = <fs_source_table>. " Copy content
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    GET REFERENCE OF lt_sflight_source INTO lr_sflight_source.

    DATA lr_sflight_target TYPE REF TO data.

      EXPORTING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf ein Interface entgegennimmt und je nach implementierender Klasse unterschiedliche Verhaltensweisen aufruft.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und implementieren Sie es in mehreren Klassen. Verwenden Sie `TYPE REF TO` für das Interface.

INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Circle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Square'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape " Polymorphic reference
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    rv_info = |Shape: { io_shape->get_name( ) }, Area: { io_shape->get_area( ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen und befüllen Sie diese.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE`, `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " C for CHAR, I for INT, D for DATE, T for TIME, P for PACKED
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_populate_structure
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(er_dynamic_structure) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_structure.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'C'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = ls_field_def-length ).
        WHEN 'I'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
        WHEN 'D'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ).
        WHEN 'T'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_t( ).
        WHEN 'P'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p( p_length = ls_field_def-length p_decimals = 2 ). " Example for packed
        WHEN OTHERS.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA er_dynamic_structure TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_structure> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN er_dynamic_structure->* TO <fs_dynamic_structure>.

    IF <fs_dynamic_structure> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Populate with some dummy data for demonstration
      LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_structure> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          CASE ls_field_def-type.
            WHEN 'C'.
              <fs_field> = |Value for { ls_field_def-name }|.
            WHEN 'I'.
              <fs_field> = sy-tabix * 100.
            WHEN 'D'.
              <fs_field> = sy-datum.
            WHEN 'T'.
              <fs_field> = sy-uzeit.
            WHEN 'P'.
              <fs_field> = sy-tabix * '12.34'.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              <fs_field> = 'Default'.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_field_a> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field_b> TYPE ANY.

  METHOD test_create_complex_struct.

    DATA lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_dynamic_struct_create=>tt_field_def.

    INSERT VALUE #( name = 'AMOUNT' type = 'P' length = 10 ) INTO TABLE lt_field_defs.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_date_field> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_date_field> exp = sy-datum ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_amount> TYPE p.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'AMOUNT' OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_amount>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_amount> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_amount> exp = '24.68' ).

Die Befüllung erfolgt über `ASSIGN COMPONENT`, was eine hohe Flexibilität bei der Verarbeitung unbekannter Datenstrukturen bietet.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle mit `FOR` und `WHERE` und speichern Sie die Referenzen auf die gefilterten Zeilen in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `REF TO` für die Zeilenreferenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_table_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ref TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_refs) TYPE tt_sflight_ref.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_table_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_carrid.
    rt_filtered_refs = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                 ( REF TO <fs_sflight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_existing_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_non_existing_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_existing_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_table_ref( ).
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE zcl_filter_table_ref=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20250103' price = 150 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_filtered_refs) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_by_carrid(
      it_sflights = lt_sflight
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_refs ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_refs[ 1 ]->carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_refs[ 2 ]->connid exp = '0500' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_non_existing_carrid.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Swap-Funktion für zwei beliebige Variablen unter Verwendung von Field-Symbols.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` für die Parameter und eine temporäre Variable für den Tausch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_swap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS swap_values
      IMPORTING
        ir_value1 TYPE REF TO data
        ir_value2 TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_swap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD swap_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value1> TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_value2> TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_temp>   TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_value1->* TO <fs_value1>.
    ASSIGN ir_value2->* TO <fs_value2>.

    IF <fs_value1> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_value2> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Create temporary variable with the type of <fs_value1>
      CREATE DATA REF TO <fs_value1>.
      ASSIGN sy->r_data->* TO <fs_temp>.

      IF <fs_temp> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_temp>   = <fs_value1>.
        <fs_value1> = <fs_value2>.
        <fs_value2> = <fs_temp>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die temporäre Variable wird dynamisch mit dem Typ der zu tauschenden Variablen erzeugt (`CREATE DATA REF TO <fs_value1>`), was die Typsicherheit und Flexibilität gewährleistet.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines übergebenen Parameters (Datenreferenz) und geben Sie dessen technische Eigenschaften aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF` und die RTTI-Klassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_data_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data " Generic data reference
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_data_type.
    DATA lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    rv_type_info = |Type Kind: { lo_type_descr->type_kind }, Name: { lo_type_descr->name }|.

    CASE lo_type_descr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_elem.
        lo_elem_descr ?= lo_type_descr.
        rv_type_info = rv_type_info && | (Length: { lo_elem_descr->length }, Decimals: { lo_elem_descr->decimals })|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_type_descr.
        rv_type_info = rv_type_info && | (Components: { lines( lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) ) })|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
        lo_table_descr ?= lo_type_descr.
        rv_type_info = rv_type_info && | (Table Kind: { lo_table_descr->table_kind }, Line Type: { lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->name })|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Do nothing
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_analyze_structure.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_info exp = 'Type Kind: H' ). " H for table
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_info exp = 'Table Kind: STANDARD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_info exp = 'Line Type: I' ).

Mittels `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF` kann der Typ einer Datenreferenz zur Laufzeit ermittelt werden. Durch Downcasting zu spezifischeren Deskriptor-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) können detaillierte technische Eigenschaften des Typs abgefragt werden. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Frameworks und Tools.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem übergebenen Feld sortiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT ... BY (lv_field_name)` mit einem Field-Symbol für die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_sort_field TYPE fieldname
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ct_sflights TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die dynamisch Instanzen von Klassen erzeugt, deren Namen zur Laufzeit übergeben werden, und diese als Referenz auf ein gemeinsames Interface zurückgibt.

INTERFACE zif_product.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Speicherverbrauch einer internen Tabelle dynamisch reduziert, indem sie leere Zeilen entfernt und die Tabelle neu organisiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ... WHERE` und `ASSIGN` für die Tabelle, um die Änderungen direkt zu beeinflussen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_memory_optimizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS optimize_table_memory
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data. " Generic reference to any table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_memory_optimizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD optimize_table_memory.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Remove initial lines (assuming 'initial' means 'empty' for memory optimization)
      DELETE <fs_table> WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.

      " Reorganize memory (optional, but good practice after deletions)
      " This is implicitly handled by modern ABAP, but can be forced for older versions
      " or specific scenarios if needed (e.g., by copying to a new table and back).
      " For modern ABAP, DELETE usually reclaims memory efficiently.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_optimize_table_with_initial_lines FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_optimize_table_no_initial_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_optimize_table_with_initial_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_memory_optimizer( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_memory_optimizer=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'A' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'B' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_data INTO lr_data.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 4 ).

    lo_cut->optimize_table_memory( ir_table = lr_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_optimize_table_no_initial_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_memory_optimizer( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_memory_optimizer=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'A' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'B' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_data INTO lr_data.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).

    lo_cut->optimize_table_memory( ir_table = lr_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert, wie man den Speicherverbrauch einer internen Tabelle dynamisch optimieren kann. Durch die Übergabe einer Datenreferenz (`REF TO data`) kann die Methode generisch mit jeder internen Tabelle arbeiten. Das Field-Symbol (`<fs_table>`) ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff und die Manipulation der Tabelle. `DELETE ... WHERE table_line IS INITIAL` entfernt effizient alle Zeilen, die den Initialwert des Zeilentyps haben.
keywords: ASSIGN, REF TO, Field-Symbols, Internal Tables, Memory Management, DELETE

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Referenz auf eine Struktur, um dynamisch einen Wert zu aggregieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `REF TO` in Kombination mit Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_with_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             value TYPE i,
             factor TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_with_factor
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_with_factor.
    rv_total = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = '0.0'
      FOR <fs_item> REF TO ty_item IN it_items
      NEXT sum = sum + ( <fs_item>->value * <fs_item>->factor )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_positive_values FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_mixed_values FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_positive_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_with_ref( ).
    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_reduce_with_ref=>tt_item.
    INSERT VALUE #( value = 10 factor = '1.5' ) INTO TABLE lt_items.
    INSERT VALUE #( value = 20 factor = '2.0' ) INTO TABLE lt_items.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_with_factor( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '55.0' ). " (10*1.5) + (20*2.0) = 15 + 40 = 55
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_mixed_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_with_ref( ).
    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_reduce_with_ref=>tt_item.
    INSERT VALUE #( value = 5 factor = '0.5' ) INTO TABLE lt_items.
    INSERT VALUE #( value = 10 factor = '-1.0' ) INTO TABLE lt_items.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_with_factor( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '-7.5' ). " (5*0.5) + (10*-1.0) = 2.5 - 10 = -7.5
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_with_ref( ).
    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_reduce_with_ref=>tt_item.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_with_factor( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP. In diesem Beispiel wird `FOR <fs_item> REF TO ty_item IN it_items` verwendet, um direkt mit Referenzen auf die Zeilen der internen Tabelle zu arbeiten. Dies ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf die Komponenten der Zeile (`<fs_item>->value`, `<fs_item>->factor`) innerhalb der Aggregationslogik, ohne die Zeile explizit in eine Arbeitsstruktur kopieren zu müssen.
keywords: REF TO, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf eine beliebige interne Tabelle entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle mit den Zeilen erzeugt, die einen bestimmten Wert in einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit `REF TO` und dynamischem Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_by_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data " Generic reference to any table
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_value        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(er_filtered_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_by_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line>  TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>        TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_source_table->* TO <fs_source_table>.

    IF <fs_source_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Create target table with same type as source table
      CREATE DATA er_filtered_table LIKE <fs_source_table>.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_filtered_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
      ASSIGN er_filtered_table->* TO <fs_filtered_table>.

      IF <fs_filtered_table> IS ASSIGNED.
        LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> = iv_value.
            INSERT <fs_source_line> INTO TABLE <fs_filtered_table>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Die Methode kann jede interne Tabelle nach einem beliebigen Feld filtern, dessen Name und Wert zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für hochflexible Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle (als Datenreferenz) entgegennimmt und die Werte eines bestimmten Feldes in allen Zeilen auf einen neuen Wert setzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_field_in_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data " Generic reference to any table
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                           ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                             connid   = flight-connid,
                             cityfrom = flight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugnummer (`connid`). Für jede Gruppe soll die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der freien Sitzplätze (`seatsocc`) ermittelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_data.
    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                    connid = ls_flight-connid
                                                    group_size = GROUP SIZE
                                                    total_occupied_seats = SUM( ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
                                                    INTO DATA(ls_group).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                      connid = ls_group-connid
                      flight_count = ls_group-group_size
                      total_occupied_seats = ls_group-total_occupied_seats ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_data( ).

    " Assuming sflights has data, otherwise this test might fail or need mocking.
    IF lines( sflights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).
      " Example: Check if a specific group exists and its aggregated values are plausible
      " This requires knowledge of test data or mocking sflights.
      " For simplicity, we just check if results are not empty.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion in ABAP 7.50, die es ermöglicht, Daten direkt während der Iteration zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ersetzt komplexe manuelle Gruppierungslogik und ist sehr effizient.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SUM

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der freien Sitzplätze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Expression zum Filtern und Summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-seatsocc
                                FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
