Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein abstraktes Basis-Reporting-Framework. Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `cl_abstract_report` mit einer abstrakten Methode `get_report_data` und einer konkreten Methode `display_report`. Leiten Sie davon eine konkrete Klasse `cl_flight_report` ab, die Flugdaten aus `sflights` liefert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS`.
solution:
CLASS cl_abstract_report DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor PROTECTED,
             display_report FINAL,
             get_report_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_abstract_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_report.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_report_data( ).
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(lv_line).
      WRITE: / lv_line.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_flight_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_abstract_report FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS: get_report_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_flight_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_report_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = sflights.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |{ ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-cityfrom } -> { ls_flight-cityto }| TO rt_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_report FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_report.
    DATA(lo_report) = CAST cl_abstract_report( NEW cl_flight_report( ) ).
    " The display_report method writes to the output, which is hard to test directly in unit tests.
    " We can test the get_report_data method directly.
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_report->get_report_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_data ). " sflights might be empty in test system
    IF lines( sflights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_data ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_data ) = lines( sflights ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Abstrakte Klassen und Methoden ermöglichen es, eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle und teilweise Implementierung für eine Familie von Objekten zu definieren. `cl_abstract_report` erzwingt, dass abgeleitete Klassen die Methode `get_report_data` implementieren, während `display_report` eine gemeinsame Logik bereitstellt. Dies fördert Wiederverwendbarkeit und Polymorphie.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Method, Object Orientation, Inheritance, Polymorphism

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Strategie für die Berechnung von Flugpreisen. Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `cl_price_strategy` mit einer abstrakten Methode `calculate_price`. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Strategien: `cl_economy_price` und `cl_business_price`. Nutzen Sie eine Factory-Methode, um die Strategien zu instanziieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie das Strategie-Muster mit abstrakten Klassen und einer Factory-Methode.
solution:
CLASS cl_price_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING iv_base_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_price_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_economy_price DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_price_strategy FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_economy_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price * '0.8'. " 20% Rabatt für Economy
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_business_price DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_price_strategy FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_business_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price * '1.2'. " 20% Aufschlag für Business
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_strategy_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_strategy_type TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_strategy_type,
                 economy  TYPE ty_strategy_type VALUE 'E',
                 business TYPE ty_strategy_type VALUE 'B',
               END OF gc_strategy_type.

    CLASS-METHODS get_strategy
      IMPORTING iv_strategy_type TYPE ty_strategy_type
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_strategy) TYPE REF TO cl_price_strategy
      RAISING   cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_strategy_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_strategy.
    CASE iv_strategy_type.
      WHEN gc_strategy_type-economy.
        ro_strategy = NEW cl_economy_price( ).
      WHEN gc_strategy_type-business.
        ro_strategy = NEW cl_business_price( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Unbekannte Strategie angefordert'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_economy_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_business_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_strategy FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_economy_price.
    DATA(lo_strategy) = zcl_price_strategy_factory=>get_strategy( zcl_price_strategy_factory=>gc_strategy_type-economy ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_strategy->calculate_price( 100 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_business_price.

    DATA(lv_price) = lo_strategy->calculate_price( 100 ).

Die Factory-Methode kapselt die Instanziierung der konkreten Strategien, was die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit des Codes erhöht. Dies ist ein Kernprinzip der objektorientierten Programmierung.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Object Orientation, Strategy Pattern, Factory Method, Polymorphism

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines) und der Flugnummer '0017' in der Tabelle `sflights` existiert. Geben Sie 'Flug gefunden' oder 'Flug nicht gefunden' zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    IF line_exists( sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rv_message = 'Flug gefunden'.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = 'Flug nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    " Assuming 'LH', '0400' exists in sflights for testing purposes.
    " In a real scenario, test data should be inserted or mocked.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_check( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Flug gefunden' ).
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_check( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Flug nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `LINE_EXISTS` mit einem Tabellenausdruck ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um die Existenz eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, ohne eine explizite `LOOP`-Schleife oder `READ TABLE` verwenden zu müssen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Check

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Template-Methoden-Muster für die Datenverarbeitung. Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `cl_abstract_data_processor` mit einer Template-Methode `process_data` und abstrakten Schritten `read_data`, `transform_data` und `write_data`. Leiten Sie eine konkrete Klasse `cl_flight_data_processor` ab, die Flugdaten verarbeitet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS`, `ABSTRACT METHODS` und eine `FINAL` Template-Methode.
solution:
CLASS cl_abstract_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: process_data FINAL,
             read_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_raw_data) TYPE string_table,
             transform_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_raw_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE string_table,
             write_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_transformed_data TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_abstract_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lt_raw) = read_data( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = transform_data( lt_raw ).
    write_data( lt_transformed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_flight_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_abstract_data_processor FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS: read_data REDEFINITION,
             transform_data REDEFINITION,
             write_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_flight_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_data.
    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |Raw Flight: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }| TO rt_raw_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_data.
    LOOP AT it_raw_data INTO DATA(lv_raw_line).
      APPEND |Transformed Flight: { lv_raw_line } - Processed| TO rt_transformed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD write_data.
    LOOP AT it_transformed_data INTO DATA(lv_transformed_line).
      " In a real scenario, this would write to a file, database, or display.
      WRITE: / lv_transformed_line.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_data_processor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_data_processor.
    DATA(lo_processor) = CAST cl_abstract_data_processor( NEW cl_flight_data_processor( ) ).
    " Testing the full process_data is difficult due to WRITE statements.
    " We can test individual steps if they are public or via friend classes.
    " For this example, we'll just ensure the process runs without dump.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking the output or making write_data testable.
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_data( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Flight data processing completed without dump' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Processing dumped: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template-Methoden-Muster, basierend auf abstrakten Klassen, definiert den Skelett-Algorithmus einer Operation und überlässt die Implementierung bestimmter Schritte den Unterklassen. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendung von Code und stellt sicher, dass der Gesamtalgorithmus konsistent bleibt, während spezifische Details angepasst werden können.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Object Orientation, Template Method Pattern, Inheritance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Objekten, die von einer abstrakten Basisklasse `cl_abstract_shape` erben. Jede konkrete Form (z.B. `cl_circle`, `cl_rectangle`) soll eine Methode `calculate_area` implementieren. Iterieren Sie über die Liste und rufen Sie polymorph die `calculate_area`-Methode auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS`, `ABSTRACT METHODS` und `LOOP AT` über eine Liste von Referenzen auf die abstrakte Klasse.
solution:
CLASS cl_abstract_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_name ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_abstract_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_abstract_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_name REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Circle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_abstract_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_name REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Rectangle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_abstract_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    LOOP AT it_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      APPEND |Shape: { lo_shape->get_name( ) }, Area: { lo_shape->calculate_area( ) }| TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_polymorphic_area_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphic_area_calculation.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_abstract_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW cl_circle( iv_radius = 5 ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW cl_rectangle( iv_length = 4 iv_width = 6 ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_results[ 1 ]-table_line pattern = 'Circle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_results[ 2 ]-table_line pattern = 'Rectangle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert Polymorphie in ABAP. Eine Liste von Referenzen auf die abstrakte Basisklasse `cl_abstract_shape` kann Objekte verschiedener konkreter Typen enthalten. Beim Iterieren über diese Liste (`LOOP AT`) wird die korrekte `calculate_area`-Methode zur Laufzeit aufgerufen, basierend auf dem tatsächlichen Typ des Objekts. Dies ist ein Eckpfeiler der objektorientierten Programmierung.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, LOOP, Inheritance

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, deren Abflugort 'NEW YORK' ist, und sammeln Sie die Flugnummern in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie eine `FILTER`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einem `WHERE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_ny_flight_connids
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flight_connids.
    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
                           ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_ny_flights_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ny_flights_filter.
    " Insert test data if sflights is empty or to ensure specific results.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_expr( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_ny_flight_connids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_connids[ table_line = '0017' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_connids[ table_line = '0001' ] ) ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' OR cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern. In Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression kann man direkt die gefilterten Daten transformieren und in eine neue Tabelle überführen. Dies ist deutlich lesbarer und performanter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND` Konstrukte.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filter, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `cl_logger` mit einer abstrakten Methode `log_message` und einer konkreten Methode `log_info`. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Klasse `cl_console_logger`, die Nachrichten auf der Konsole ausgibt.

solution:

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = CAST cl_logger( NEW cl_console_logger( ) ).

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle `sflights` und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften enthält, die mindestens 3 Flüge haben. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `FOR`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und einer `FOR`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_carrid_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_carrid_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                           HAVING GROUP SIZE >= iv_min_flights
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_carriers_with_min_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carriers_with_min_flights.
    " Setup test data
    DELETE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '001' ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_carrid_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_min_flights( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-table_line exp = 'LH' ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` mit der `HAVING GROUP SIZE`-Klausel ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, Aggregationen und Filterungen auf Gruppenebene durchzuführen. Dies ersetzt komplexe manuelle Schleifen und temporäre Tabellen und ist sehr effizient.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, FOR, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Filter

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `cl_document` mit einer abstrakten Methode `render` und einer konkreten Methode `get_metadata`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Dokumenttypen wie `cl_pdf_document` und `cl_html_document`, die jeweils eine spezifische `render`-Logik haben.

Die `LOOP`-Iteration über die Liste der abstrakten Dokumentreferenzen ruft polymorph die korrekte `render`-Methode auf, was eine flexible und erweiterbare Architektur ermöglicht.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, LOOP, Inheritance, Design Pattern

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, deren Abflugort 'NEW YORK' ist, und deren Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit mehreren `WHERE`-Bedingungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `AND` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_specific_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_specific_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND carrid = 'AA' )
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multi_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_filter.
    " Setup test data
    DELETE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' cityfrom = 'LONDON' ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_specific_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ] ) ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression erlaubt die Kombination mehrerer `WHERE`-Bedingungen mit logischen Operatoren (`AND`, `OR`), um komplexe Filterungen direkt in der Expression durchzuführen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Methode, um Daten aus internen Tabellen zu extrahieren und zu transformieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: LOOP, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filter, Multiple Conditions

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen dividiert und eine Division durch Null mit `TRY...CATCH` abfängt. Die Methode soll die Ausnahme weiterleiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und die System-Exception `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_div_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_div_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse und werfen Sie diese, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme anschließend ab.

solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_number.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD setup.
    " No initial setup needed, tests will insert/update
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_sflight_modifier( ).
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '0400'
      fldate = sy-datum

    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_modifier->modify_flight( ls_new_flight ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_update.
    " First insert a record
    DATA(ls_existing_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = 'AA'
      connid = '0017'
      fldate = sy-datum
      price  = 300.00
      currency = 'USD'
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM ls_existing_flight.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_sflight_modifier( ).
    ls_existing_flight-price = 350.00.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_modifier->modify_flight( ls_existing_flight ).

      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = 350.00 msg = 'Updated flight price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: UPDATE, MODIFY, Upsert, Database, SFLIGHTS, Open SQL

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis von Flügen in `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einem Prozentsatz, der in einer internen Tabelle definiert ist. Verwenden Sie eine moderne `UPDATE` Syntax mit `FROM` für die Berechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE dbtab SET field = @( expression ) WHERE condition` oder `UPDATE dbtab FROM @wa` mit einer berechneten Workarea.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_adjuster DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_adjustment,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate      TYPE s_date,
             percentage  TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1,
           END OF ty_price_adjustment.
    TYPES tt_price_adjustment TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_adjustment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_adjustments TYPE tt_price_adjustment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_adjuster IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT it_adjustments INTO DATA(ls_adjustment).
      DATA(lv_new_price) = 0.
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_current_price)
        WHERE carrid = @ls_adjustment-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_adjustment-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_adjustment-fldate.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_new_price = lv_current_price * ( 1 + ls_adjustment-percentage / 100 ).
        UPDATE sflights
          SET price = @lv_new_price
          WHERE carrid = @ls_adjustment-carrid
            AND connid = @ls_adjustment-connid
            AND fldate = @ls_adjustment-fldate.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_updated_count = rv_updated_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung eines `CLEANUP`-Blocks in einer `TRY...CATCH` Struktur, um Ressourcen freizugeben, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP...ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_resource_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA: lv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Simulate opening a resource
        WRITE: / 'Resource opened.'.
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.

        IF iv_input = 'ERROR'.
          " Simulate an error, e.g., division by zero
          DATA(lv_dummy) = 1 / 0.
        ENDIF.

        rv_result = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
        WRITE: / 'Data processed successfully.'.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        WRITE: / |Error caught: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

      CLEANUP.
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          " Simulate closing the resource
          WRITE: / 'Resource closed in CLEANUP block.'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_converted,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE i, " Converted to integer
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_converted.

    CLASS zcl_conv_for_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS convert_connid_to_int RETURNING VALUE(rt_converted_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_converted_tt.

    CLASS zcl_conv_for_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD convert_connid_to_int.
        DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
        " Sample data for consistent testing, or fetch from DB
        INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tt(
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A380' )
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' )
        ) ).
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 2 ROWS WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA').

        rt_converted_sflight = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                                        ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                          connid = CONV i( ls_sflight-connid )
                                          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle (`ANY TABLE`) akzeptiert und die Werte der ersten Spalte als String-Tabelle zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_generic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_column_values IMPORTING it_any_table TYPE any table RETURNING VALUE(rt_first_column_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_generic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_first_col> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_any_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_first_col>.
      IF <fs_first_col> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND CONV string( <fs_first_col> ) TO rt_first_column_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_variable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_assign_dynamic_var IMPORTING iv_type TYPE string iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_variable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_assign_dynamic_var.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_var> TYPE any.
    DATA dref TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA dref TYPE (iv_type).
        ASSIGN dref->* TO <fs_dynamic_var>.
        IF <fs_dynamic_var> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_dynamic_var> = iv_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein häufiges Muster in generischen ABAP-Programmen, bei denen Daten dynamisch gelesen und für die weitere Verarbeitung in einen einheitlichen Typ (hier String) umgewandelt werden müssen. keywords: ASSIGN, CONV, Field Symbol, Dynamic Access, Type Conversion, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Integer-Werten in einen einzelnen String, wobei die Werte durch Kommas getrennt sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `CONV` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_int_list_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_list_to_string IMPORTING it_int_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_int_list_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_list_to_string.
    rv_result_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i IN it_int_list
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN CONV string( i )
        ELSE |{ s },{ CONV string( i ) }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_list_to_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_list_to_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_int_list_to_string( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_list_to_string( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '1,2,3' msg = 'List to string conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_int_list_to_string( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_list_to_string( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Empty list should return empty string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein funktionales Programmierkonstrukt, das eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert reduziert. In diesem Beispiel wird sie verwendet, um eine Liste von Integern in einen kommagetrennten String zu konvertieren. Der `CONV`-Operator wandelt jeden Integer in einen String um, und String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die effiziente String-Verkettung verwendet. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, solche Transformationen durchzuführen.
keywords: CONV, REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Table, String Processing

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und weisen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes einer anderen internen Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit bekannten Feldnamen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` in Kombination.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value1 TYPE string,
             value2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES ty_source_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id TYPE i,
             dynamic_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES ty_target_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_itab_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS assign_dynamic_field IMPORTING it_source TYPE ty_source_data_tt iv_field_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_data_tt.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_assign_dynamic_itab_field IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD assign_dynamic_field.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE ty_source_data.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_field> TYPE any.
        DATA ls_target TYPE ty_target_data.

        LOOP AT it_source ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
          ls_target-id = <fs_source_line>-id.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF <fs_dynamic_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            ls_target-dynamic_value = CONV string( <fs_dynamic_field> ).
          ELSE.
            ls_target-dynamic_value = 'Field Not Found'.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_target TO rt_target.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_assign_dynamic_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_assign_dynamic_field_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_dynamic_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_dynamic_itab_field( ).
    DATA(lt_source_input) = VALUE ty_source_data_tt(
      ( id = 1 value1 = 'A' value2 = 'X' )
      ( id = 2 value1 = 'B' value2 = 'Y' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->assign_dynamic_field( it_source = lt_source_input iv_field_name = 'VALUE1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of rows' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-dynamic_value exp = 'A' msg = 'Dynamic field assignment failed for row 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-dynamic_value exp = 'B' msg = 'Dynamic field assignment failed for row 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_assign_dynamic_field_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_dynamic_itab_field( ).
    DATA(lt_source_input) = VALUE ty_source_data_tt(
      ( id = 1 value1 = 'A' value2 = 'X' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->assign_dynamic_field( it_source = lt_source_input iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect number of rows for not found field' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-dynamic_value exp = 'Field Not Found' msg = 'Handling of not found field incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Iteration über eine interne Tabelle mit Field-Symbols (`LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING`) und den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`). Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für die flexible Verarbeitung von Daten, bei der die zu verarbeitenden Felder erst zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die Verwendung von `CONV` stellt sicher, dass der dynamisch gelesene Wert in den gewünschten Zieltyp umgewandelt wird.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbol, Dynamic Access, Internal Table, CONV, Generic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem bestimmten Abflugort enthält. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Inline-Deklarationen und den VALUE-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` für die Tabellenerstellung und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sgeocity-cityname,
             cityto   TYPE sgeocity-cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sgeocity-cityname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                           FOR connection IN lt_spfli WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid AND connid = flight-connid )
                           FOR carrier IN lt_scarr WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                           WHERE ( flight-carrid = iv_carrid AND connection-cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
                           ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                             connid   = flight-connid,
                             fldate   = flight-fldate,
                             cityfrom = connection-cityfrom,
                             cityto   = connection-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for LH from FRANKFURT' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    " Assuming there are flights for 'AA' from 'NEW YORK' in SFLIGHT/SPFLI
    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find flights for AA from NEW YORK' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID must be AA' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Departure city must be NEW YORK' act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` können Daten aus anderen Tabellen gelesen, gefiltert und transformiert werden, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Table, Inline Declaration, BEGIN OF, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_passengers) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has some occupied seats in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Total passengers for LH should not be zero' act = lv_total_passengers exp = 0 ).

    " Test with a carrier that might not exist or has no flights
    DATA(lv_total_passengers_non_existent) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total passengers for non-existent carrier should be zero' act = lv_total_passengers_non_existent exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und wendet dann eine Operation (`sum + flight-seatsocc`) auf jedes Element an, was zu einem einzigen Ergebnis führt. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und klarer als eine explizite `LOOP`-Anweisung mit manueller Summenbildung.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugverbindungen (SPFLI) nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und nach 'NEW YORK' fliegen. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_connections_frankfurt_ny
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE spfli_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections_frankfurt_ny.
    DATA: lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.

    rt_connections = FILTER #( lt_spfli USING KEY primary_key
                                WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_connections) = lo_cut->get_connections_frankfurt_ny( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find connections from FRANKFURT to NEW YORK' act = lines( lt_connections ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_connections INTO DATA(ls_connection).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Departure city must be FRANKFURT' act = ls_connection-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Destination city must be NEW YORK' act = ls_connection-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren. Die Angabe von `USING KEY primary_key` ist optional, kann aber die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Selection, SPFLI

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen String, der eine Flugnummer und ein Datum enthält, in einem lesbaren Satz. Verwenden Sie String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie Backticks (`) für String-Templates und die Einbettung von Variablen mit `{}`, sowie Funktionen wie `TO_UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_info.
    rv_formatted_string = |Der Flug { TO_UPPER( iv_carrid ) } { iv_connid } startet am { iv_fldate DATE = USER }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_flight_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_flight_info( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20251121' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Der Flug LH 0400 startet am 21.11.2025.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->format_flight_info( iv_carrid = 'aa' iv_connid = '0010' iv_fldate = '20240115' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Der Flug AA 0010 startet am 15.01.2024.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu erstellen und zu manipulieren. Sie erlauben die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken (`{...}`) sowie die Anwendung von Formatierungsoptionen (z.B. `DATE = USER` für Datumsformatierung) und Funktionen (`TO_UPPER`), was den Code sehr lesbar und wartbar macht.
keywords: String Template, TO_UPPER, Date Formatting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein Interface implementiert, um eine 'Fluent Interface'-Methode zu demonstrieren, bei der Methodenaufrufe verkettet werden können.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit Methoden, die eine Referenz auf das eigene Interface zurückgeben, und implementieren Sie diese in einer Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_fluent_builder.
  METHODS set_value1 IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ri_self) TYPE REF TO zif_fluent_builder.
  METHODS set_value2 IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ri_self) TYPE REF TO zif_fluent_builder.
  METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_fluent_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_fluent_builder.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_value1 TYPE i,
          mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_fluent_builder~set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_value.
    ri_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_fluent_builder~set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_value.
    ri_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_fluent_builder~get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_interface.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_example( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->zif_fluent_builder~set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 20 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_builder->zif_fluent_builder~set_value2( 5 )->set_value1( 15 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein Fluent Interface ermöglicht das Verketten von Methodenaufrufen, indem jede Methode eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (oder ein Interface davon) zurückgibt. Dies führt zu einem sehr lesbaren und ausdrucksstarken Code, der oft als 'Method Chaining' bezeichnet wird. Die Verwendung von Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`) fördert dabei die Abstraktion und Flexibilität.
keywords: Fluent Interface, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Interface, IMPLEMENTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode mit optionalen Parametern, die Standardwerte verwenden, wenn sie nicht explizit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DEFAULT` in der `IMPORTING`-Parameterdeklaration, um Standardwerte zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optional_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_val2 TYPE i DEFAULT 20
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optional_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_optional_params( ).

    " Test with default values
    DATA(lv_sum_default) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_default exp = 30 ).

    " Test with one explicit value
    DATA(lv_sum_one_param) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( iv_val1 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_one_param exp = 25 ).

    " Test with both explicit values
    DATA(lv_sum_both_params) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( iv_val1 = 1 iv_val2 = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_both_params exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Seit ABAP 7.50 können `IMPORTING`-Parameter mit dem `DEFAULT`-Zusatz versehen werden, um Standardwerte zu definieren. Dies macht Methoden flexibler, da Aufrufer nicht alle Parameter explizit übergeben müssen. Der Code wird dadurch kürzer und die Schnittstelle einfacher zu handhaben.
keywords: Optional Parameters, DEFAULT, Method Parameters

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabewert verschiedene Strings zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_day_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_name.
    rv_day_name = SWITCH #( iv_day_number
                            WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
                            WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
                            WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
                            WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
                            WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
                            WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
                            WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
                            ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_day_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_day_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_day_name( 1 ) exp = 'Montag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_day_name( 5 ) exp = 'Freitag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_day_name( 7 ) exp = 'Sonntag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_day_name( 0 ) exp = 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_day_name( 8 ) exp = 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck (seit ABAP 7.50) ist eine funktionale Alternative zu `CASE`-Anweisungen, die einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zurückgibt. Er ist kompakter und lesbarer, insbesondere wenn viele Fälle behandelt werden müssen, und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit temporärer Variablen.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expression

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Objekt einer Klasse und initialisieren Sie dessen Attribute direkt bei der Instanziierung. Verwenden Sie Konstruktor-Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `NEW`-Operator in Kombination mit Klammern `()` zur direkten Attributinitialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_person DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_name TYPE string READ-ONLY,
          mv_age  TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_age  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_person IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
    mv_age  = iv_age.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und Abflugort und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Der `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` ermöglicht leistungsstarke Gruppierungen und Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier_city
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier_city.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                    cityfrom = REDUCE string( INIT city = '' FOR member IN GROUP WHERE ( member-carrid = flight-carrid AND member-connid = lt_spfli[ carrid = member-carrid connid = member-connid ]-connid ) NEXT city = lt_spfli[ carrid = member-carrid connid = member-connid ]-cityfrom ) , " Simplified for demo, real join needed
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    " A more robust approach would involve joining SFLIGHT and SPFLI first
    " For simplicity and to demonstrate GROUP BY, we'll use a simplified cityfrom lookup.
    " Let's refine the cityfrom lookup to be more accurate for the example.
    DATA(lt_joined_flights) = VALUE #( FOR sflight_entry IN lt_sflight
                                       FOR spfli_entry IN lt_spfli WHERE ( spfli_entry-carrid = sflight_entry-carrid AND spfli_entry-connid = sflight_entry-connid )
                                       ( carrid = sflight_entry-carrid,
                                         cityfrom = spfli_entry-cityfrom,
                                         connid = sflight_entry-connid ) ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight_entry IN lt_joined_flights
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = flight_entry-carrid, cityfrom = flight_entry-cityfrom ) ASCENDING
                                  ( carrid = flight_entry-carrid,
                                    cityfrom = flight_entry-cityfrom,
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier_city( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped flights should not be empty' act = lines( lt_grouped_flights ) ).

    " Example: Check if 'LH' from 'FRANKFURT' exists and has a count
    READ TABLE lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Flight count for LH from FRANKFURT should be greater than 0' act = ls_group-flight_count exp = 0 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Group for LH from FRANKFURT not found' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Verify that all entries have a positive flight count
    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO ls_group.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count must be positive' act = ( ls_group-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` (seit ABAP 7.50) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, Einträge basierend auf bestimmten Schlüsseln zu gruppieren und dann Aggregationen (wie `GROUP SIZE` für die Anzahl der Elemente in einer Gruppe) oder weitere Transformationen auf die Gruppen anzuwenden. Dies ersetzt komplexe `LOOP`- und `AT NEW`/`AT END` Konstrukte durch eine deklarative und effiziente Syntax.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, SPFLI, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugverbindungen (SPFLI) und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte hinzu, die den vollen Namen der Fluggesellschaft enthält. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `LET` für temporäre Variablen und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `LET` um temporäre Variablen zu definieren und `VALUE` um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_enricher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_enriched_connection,
             carrid    TYPE spfli-carrid,
             carrname  TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid    TYPE spfli-connid,
             cityfrom  TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto    TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_enriched_connection.
    TYPES: tt_enriched_connection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_enriched_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enriched_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_connections) TYPE tt_enriched_connection.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_enricher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_connections.
    DATA: lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_enriched_connections = VALUE #( FOR connection IN lt_spfli
                                       LET lv_carrname = VALUE scarr-carrname( lt_scarr[ carrid = connection-carrid ]-carrname OPTIONAL )
                                       IN
                                       ( carrid    = connection-carrid,
                                         carrname  = lv_carrname,
                                         connid    = connection-connid,
                                         cityfrom  = connection-cityfrom,
                                         cityto    = connection-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_enriched_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_enriched_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_enricher( ).
    DATA(lt_enriched_connections) = lo_cut->get_enriched_connections( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Enriched connections should not be empty' act = lines( lt_enriched_connections ) ).

    " Check a known entry, e.g., 'LH' (Lufthansa)
    READ TABLE lt_enriched_connections INTO DATA(ls_enriched) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier name for LH should be Lufthansa' act = ls_enriched-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Entry for LH not found in enriched connections' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check an entry that might not have a carrier name (if any, or create a dummy one)
    " For this example, assuming all SPFLI entries have a corresponding SCARR entry.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE`, `FOR` und `LET` (seit ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation und Anreicherung von internen Tabellen. `LET` erlaubt die Definition von lokalen, temporären Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks, was den Code sauberer und lesbarer macht, insbesondere wenn Zwischenergebnisse benötigt werden. `OPTIONAL` im `VALUE`-Operator verhindert einen Dump, falls der Eintrag in der Lookup-Tabelle nicht gefunden wird.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, LET, Internal Table, Transformation, SPFLI, SCARR, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die ein Interface für eine Strategie implementiert, um verschiedene Berechnungen dynamisch auszuführen. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FINAL` für Methoden und Klassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein Interface für die Strategie und lassen Sie konkrete Klassen dieses Interface implementieren. `FINAL` verhindert die Vererbung oder das Überschreiben.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculation_strategy.
  METHODS calculate
    IMPORTING
      iv_val1 TYPE i
      iv_val2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy
        iv_val1     TYPE i
        iv_val2     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    rv_result = io_strategy->calculate( iv_val1 = iv_val1 iv_val2 = iv_val2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_pattern.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).

    " Addition strategy
    DATA(lo_add_strategy) = NEW zcl_add_strategy( ).
    DATA(lv_add_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( io_strategy = lo_add_strategy iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_add_result exp = 8 ).

    " Multiplication strategy
    DATA(lo_multiply_strategy) = NEW zcl_multiply_strategy( ).
    DATA(lv_multiply_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( io_strategy = lo_multiply_strategy iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_multiply_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Designmuster, implementiert mit Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`), ermöglicht es, Algorithmen zur Laufzeit auszutauschen. Die `FINAL`-Deklaration für Klassen und Methoden (seit ABAP 7.55 für Methoden, früher für Klassen) verhindert, dass diese vererbt oder überschrieben werden, was die Stabilität und Vorhersehbarkeit des Codes erhöht. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks oder Bibliotheken, bei denen die Implementierung nicht geändert werden soll.
keywords: Strategy Pattern, Interface, IMPLEMENTS, FINAL, Object Orientation

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in der Tabelle SFLIGHT, der eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer hat. Verwenden Sie den `LINE_EXISTS` und `TABLE_LINE` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` um zu prüfen ob ein Eintrag existiert und `TABLE_LINE` um direkt auf den Eintrag zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rs_flight = TABLE_LINE( lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_finder( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' '0400' exists in SFLIGHT
    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->find_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight LH 0400 should be found' act = ls_found_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).

    " Test for a non-existent flight
    DATA(ls_not_found_flight) = lo_cut->find_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Non-existent flight should not be found' act = ls_not_found_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Ausdrücke `LINE_EXISTS` und `TABLE_LINE` (seit ABAP 7.50) bieten eine moderne und sichere Möglichkeit, auf einzelne Zeilen in internen Tabellen zuzugreifen. `LINE_EXISTS` prüft, ob ein Eintrag mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel existiert, bevor `TABLE_LINE` den Eintrag selbst zurückgibt. Dies verhindert Dumps bei nicht gefundenen Einträgen und macht den Code robuster und lesbarer als die traditionelle `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfung.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, TABLE_LINE, Internal Table, Table Expression, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Datum enthält, und sortieren Sie diese nach Fluggesellschaft und Datum. Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `SORT`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Transformation und `SORT` für die Sortierung der resultierenden Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_simple_flight.
    TYPES: tt_simple_flight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_simple_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_simple_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                   connid = flight-connid,
                                   fldate = flight-fldate ) ).

    " The target table is a SORTED TABLE, so it's automatically sorted upon insertion.
    " If it were a standard table, an explicit SORT would be needed:
    " SORT rt_sorted_flights BY carrid ASCENDING fldate ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_sorter( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Sorted flights should not be empty' act = lines( lt_sorted_flights ) ).

    " Verify sorting (check first few elements)
    DATA: ls_prev_flight TYPE zcl_flight_sorter=>ty_simple_flight.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted_flights INTO DATA(ls_current_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        IF ls_current_flight-carrid < ls_prev_flight-carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Sorting by carrid failed' ).
        ELSEIF ls_current_flight-carrid = ls_prev_flight-carrid AND ls_current_flight-fldate < ls_prev_flight-fldate.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Sorting by fldate failed for same carrid' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      ls_prev_flight = ls_current_flight.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Indem die Ziel-Tabelle als `SORTED TABLE` deklariert wird, wird die Sortierung automatisch beim Einfügen der Daten gewährleistet, was explizite `SORT`-Anweisungen überflüssig macht und die Performance bei großen Datenmengen verbessern kann. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, Daten zu verarbeiten und zu sortieren.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, SORTED TABLE, Internal Table, Sorting, SFLIGHT, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_flights( ).
    " Annahme: Für 'AA' gibt es Flüge mit Preisen, die summiert werden können.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man Testdaten einfügen oder einen bekannten Wert erwarten.
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total >= 0 ). " Prüfen, ob ein nicht-negativer Wert zurückgegeben wird.
    " Optional: cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = <expected_value> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle LOOP-Anweisungen mit expliziter Akkumulation.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Summe

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Städtenamen der Abflugorte aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, ohne Duplikate.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `SET` für eindeutige Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_cities_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cities_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_cities_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_cities_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT unique_cities = VALUE string_table( )
           result_string = ''
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET current_city = <fs_flight>-cityfrom IN
      NEXT
        unique_cities = COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( unique_cities[ table_line = current_city ] ) THEN VALUE string_table( BASE unique_cities ( current_city ) ) ELSE unique_cities ),
        result_string = COND #( WHEN result_string IS INITIAL THEN current_city ELSE result_string && ', ' && current_city )
    ).
    " The above REDUCE concatenates as it adds, but doesn't handle duplicates in the final string well if not careful.
    " A better approach for unique and then concatenate:
    DATA(lv_unique_cities_set) = REDUCE string_hash_set(
      INIT set = VALUE string_hash_set( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT set = VALUE string_hash_set( BASE set ( <fs_flight>-cityfrom ) )
    ).
    rv_cities_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR city IN lv_unique_cities_set
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN city ELSE result && ', ' && city )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concat_cities FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_cities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_cities( ).
    DATA(lv_cities) = lo_cut->get_unique_cities_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_cities ).
    " Beispiel: Wenn 'FRANKFURT' und 'NEW YORK' in SFLIGHTS sind, könnte der String 'FRANKFURT, NEW YORK' sein.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( CONTAINS( val = lv_cities sub = 'FRANKFURT' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einem Hash-Set (`string_hash_set`) zur effizienten Ermittlung eindeutiger Werte und deren anschließender Verkettung. Dies ist deutlich performanter und lesbarer als eine Schleife mit `APPEND` und `SORT/DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, String Concatenation, Unique Values, SFLIGHTS, Hash Set

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_by_carrid,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             max_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_max_price_by_carrid.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_max_price_by_carrid.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_max_prices = REDUCE tt_max_price_by_carrid(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_max_price_by_carrid( )
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
      LET max_price_for_group = REDUCE s_price(
                                  INIT max_p = 0
                                  FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP <fs_flight>
                                  NEXT max_p = nmax( max_p, <fs_group_flight>-price )
                                ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_max_price_by_carrid( BASE result
                                                  ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                                    max_price = max_price_for_group ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
