CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fae_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_join_alternative( ).
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_carriers_test) = VALUE tt_carrid( ( 'AA' ) ( 'LH' ) ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_join( lt_carriers_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights, msg = 'Es wurden keine Flüge gefunden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ), msg = 'Flüge für AA nicht gefunden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ), msg = 'Flüge für LH nicht gefunden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ]-carrname, exp = 'American Airlines', msg = 'Fluggesellschaftsname für AA ist falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für die Auswahl von Daten aus mehreren Tabellen wird `INNER JOIN` in modernem ABAP gegenüber `FOR ALL ENTRIES` bevorzugt, da der Join direkt in der Datenbank ausgeführt wird, was oft zu besserer Performance und einfacherem Code führt. Die Syntax `WHERE sf~carrid IN @it_carriers` verwendet die interne Tabelle direkt als Selektionskriterium, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50.
keywords: JOIN, Open SQL, Internal Tables, IN operator

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flugdaten aus und filtern Sie diese anschließend in ABAP basierend auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT *` und anschließend den `FILTER`-Operator, um die interne Tabelle zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_filter_alternative DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_filter
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_alternative IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_filter.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN it_carriers ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die effiziente Verwendung von `FOR ALL ENTRIES`, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass die treibende Tabelle eindeutig und sortiert ist, und die `IS INITIAL`-Prüfung korrekt durchgeführt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` vor `FOR ALL ENTRIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_performance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_optimized_fae
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_performance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_optimized_fae.
    DATA lt_unique_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    lt_unique_carriers = it_carriers.

    " Optimize driving table for FAE
    SORT lt_unique_carriers ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_carriers COMPARING ALL FIELDS.

    IF lt_unique_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_unique_carriers
        WHERE carrid = lt_unique_carriers-table_line
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_fae_optimized FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fae_optimized.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_performance( ).
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_carriers_test) = VALUE tt_carrid( ( 'AA' ) ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' ) ). " Mit Duplikaten

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_optimized_fae( lt_carriers_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights, msg = 'Es wurden keine Flüge gefunden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ), msg = 'Flüge für AA nicht gefunden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ), msg = 'Flüge für LH nicht gefunden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'UA' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ), msg = 'Flüge für UA nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für eine optimale Performance mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` sollte die treibende interne Tabelle sortiert sein und nur eindeutige Einträge enthalten. Dies reduziert die Anzahl der Datenbankzugriffe. Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` (ABAP 7.40+) wird nach dem Sortieren verwendet, um dies effizient zu erreichen. Die `IS NOT INITIAL`-Prüfung ist entscheidend, um zu verhindern, dass `FOR ALL ENTRIES` wie ein `SELECT *` agiert.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, Performance, SORT, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Open SQL

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight` für spezifische Kombinationen von Fluggesellschaften und Verbindungs-IDs aus, indem Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit mehreren Feldern in der `WHERE`-Klausel verwenden.

CLASS zcl_fae_complex_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_carrier_connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,

             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,

    METHODS get_flights_complex_fae
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_connids TYPE tt_carrier_connid
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_fae_complex_where IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF it_carrier_connids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carrier_connids
        WHERE carrid = it_carrier_connids-carrid
          AND connid = it_carrier_connids-connid

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Daten aus `sflight` in einem für `cl_gui_chart_engine` geeigneten Format vor, speziell für ein Balkendiagramm, das die Gesamtkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt.
hint: Aggregieren Sie Daten mit `COLLECT` oder `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_engine_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             category TYPE string, " Carrier ID
             value    TYPE i,      " Total Capacity
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY category.
    METHODS prepare_flight_capacity_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_engine_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_capacity_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    DATA lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw.

    DATA ls_chart_line TYPE ty_chart_data.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_raw INTO DATA(ls_flight_raw).
      ls_chart_line-category = ls_flight_raw-carrid.
      ls_chart_line-value = ls_flight_raw-seatsmax - ls_flight_raw-seatsocc.
      COLLECT ls_chart_line INTO rt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_chart_data, msg = 'Diagrammdaten wurden nicht vorbereitet.' ).
    " Beispiel: Überprüfen Sie, ob Daten für 'AA' vorhanden sind und der Wert > 0 ist.
    DATA(ls_aa_data) = VALUE zcl_chart_engine_data=>ty_chart_data( category = 'AA' ).
    READ TABLE lt_chart_data INTO ls_aa_data WITH KEY category = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0, msg = 'Daten für AA nicht gefunden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_data-value > 0, msg = 'Kapazitätswert für AA ist nicht größer als 0.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Datenaggregation aus `sflight` in ein Format, das für die `cl_gui_chart_engine` geeignet ist. Der `COLLECT`-Befehl wird verwendet, um numerische Felder für gleiche Schlüssel zu summieren, was eine einfache Aggregation ermöglicht. Die Verwendung von `DATA(ls_flight_raw)` und `DATA(ls_chart_line)` demonstriert moderne Inline-Deklarationen.

CLASS zcl_fae_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carriers_with_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.

CLASS zcl_fae_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid
        FROM scarr
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_all_flights
        WHERE carrid = lt_all_flights-table_line
        INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_carriers[ table_line = 'AA' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ), msg = 'Fluggesellschaft AA nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_chart_engine_multi_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_series_data,
             category TYPE string,
             value1   TYPE i,
             value2   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_series_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_series_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_series_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS create_multi_series_chart
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_chart_series_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart_engine) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_engine_multi_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_series_chart.
    DATA lt_series1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF if_chart_engine_types=>ty_data_point WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_series2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF if_chart_engine_types=>ty_data_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      APPEND VALUE if_chart_engine_types=>ty_data_point( category = ls_data-category value = ls_data-value1 ) TO lt_series1.

CLASS zcl_regex_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_regex_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.

      APPEND <fs_match>-found TO rt_numbers.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Vor- und Nachnamen aus einem String im Format 'Nachname, Vorname' unter Verwendung benannter Gruppen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_matcher` und die Methode `get_group`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_name_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_name,
        first_name TYPE string,
        last_name  TYPE string,
      END OF ty_name.

    METHODS parse_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_full_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_name) TYPE ty_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_name_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_name.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(?<LastName>\w+),\s*(?<FirstName>\w+)$`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
                           pattern = lv_pattern
                           text    = iv_full_name ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_name-last_name = lo_matcher->get_group( 'LastName' ).
      rs_name-first_name = lo_matcher->get_group( 'FirstName' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_actual) = lo_cut->parse_name( 'Doe, John' ).

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks in eine Tabelle von Substrings auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_matcher` in Kombination mit `find_all` und Offset-Berechnung, da es keine direkte `split_by_regex` Methode gibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
                           pattern = iv_pattern
                           text    = iv_text ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_matches ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_match>).
      IF <fs_match>-offset > lv_last_offset.
        APPEND iv_text+lv_last_offset(<fs_match>-offset - lv_last_offset) TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = <fs_match>-offset + <fs_match>-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Append remaining part after the last match
    IF lv_last_offset < strlen( iv_text ).
      APPEND iv_text+lv_last_offset TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.

    " Handle case where no matches are found, the whole string is one part
    IF lines( rt_parts ) = 0 AND strlen( iv_text ) > 0.
      APPEND iv_text TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer simulierten Sprachdatei, die über `cl_cts_language_file_io` zugänglich wäre.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_file`. Da es sich um eine Transport-Klasse handelt, wird der Dateipfad und der Inhalt simuliert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io. "Simulated exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_language_file.
    " In a real scenario, cl_cts_language_file_io would interact with the file system
    " based on transport object details. Here, we simulate its behavior.
    " The actual class methods often require transport request/task info.
    " For a simple read, we can assume a direct file path.
    " Note: Direct instantiation and usage of cl_cts_language_file_io for arbitrary files
    " is not its intended purpose. This example demonstrates the *concept* of using
    " such a class for file access in a language context.

    " Simulate file content based on path for testing purposes
    IF iv_file_path = '/tmp/messages_de.txt'.
      rv_content = 'HELLO=Hallo' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                   'GOODBYE=Auf Wiedersehen'.
    ELSEIF iv_file_path = '/tmp/messages_en.txt'.
      rv_content = 'HELLO=Hello' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                   'GOODBYE=Goodbye'.
    ELSE.
      " Simulate file not found or other error
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_cts_language_file_io
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_cts_language_file_io=>file_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

                               'GOODBYE=Auf Wiedersehen'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_file.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->read_language_file( '/tmp/non_existent.txt' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_cts_language_file_io expected' ).
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io.

    ENDTRY.

explanation: `cl_cts_language_file_io` ist eine spezialisierte Klasse für den Dateizugriff im Kontext des SAP Change and Transport Systems (CTS), insbesondere für sprachabhängige Dateien. Dieses Beispiel simuliert das Lesen einer solchen Datei, um die Schnittstelle und die Fehlerbehandlung zu demonstrieren, ohne die komplexen Transportmechanismen vollständig zu implementieren. Instructions: Schreiben Sie Inhalt in eine simulierten Sprachdatei unter Verwendung von `cl_cts_language_file_io`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_cts_language_file_io=>write_file`. Der Schreibvorgang wird simuliert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_file_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS write_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_content   TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io. "Simulated exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_language_file.
    " Similar to read_language_file, this simulates the write operation.
    " In a real CTS context, this would write to a file managed by the transport system.
    " We use a static attribute to "store" the written content for testing.
    STATICS: gs_file_content TYPE string_table.

    " Clear previous content for this path (simple simulation)
    DELETE gs_file_content WHERE table_line = iv_file_path.

    " Simulate writing by storing content in a static table
    APPEND iv_file_path TO gs_file_content.
    APPEND iv_content TO gs_file_content.

    " Simulate error for specific path
    IF iv_file_path = '/tmp/error_file.txt'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_cts_language_file_io
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_cts_language_file_io=>write_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_write_error RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_write_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_lang_file_writer( ).
    DATA(lv_path) = '/tmp/new_messages_fr.txt'.
    DATA(lv_content) = 'HELLO=Bonjour' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                       'GOODBYE=Au revoir'.
    lo_cut->write_language_file( iv_file_path = lv_path iv_content = lv_content ).

    " To verify, we would typically read it back. Here, we assume a successful write
    " and check if the simulated storage contains the path (as a proxy).
    " In a real scenario, you'd use a corresponding read method.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_lang_file_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_read_content) = lo_reader->read_language_file( lv_path ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_read_content
      exp = lv_content
      msg = 'Content should be written and readable' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_write_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_lang_file_writer( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->write_language_file( iv_file_path = '/tmp/error_file.txt' iv_content = 'Error content' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_cts_language_file_io expected' ).
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_cts_language_file_io for write error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD file_exists.
    " In a real scenario, cl_cts_language_file_io might have a method like CHECK_FILE_EXISTENCE.
    " For this simulation, we'll check against our known 'files'.
    " This relies on the 'files' created by zcl_lang_file_writer for demonstration.

    TRY.
        lo_reader->read_language_file( iv_file_path ).

Instructions: Löschen Sie eine simulierte Sprachdatei mit `cl_cts_language_file_io`.
hint: Simulieren Sie den Löschvorgang, da `cl_cts_language_file_io` keine direkte `delete_file` Methode für allgemeine Nutzung hat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_file_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io. "Simulated exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_language_file.
    " cl_cts_language_file_io does not have a public DELETE_FILE method for general use.
    " This simulates the effect of deleting a file from the perspective of our test setup.
    " In a real CTS scenario, file deletion is part of transport management.
    STATICS: gs_file_content TYPE string_table.

    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT gs_file_content INTO DATA(lv_line).
      IF lv_line = iv_file_path.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_found = abap_true.
      DELETE gs_file_content WHERE table_line = iv_file_path.
      " Also delete the content associated with it (next line in simulation)
      DELETE gs_file_content WHERE table_line = gs_file_content[ lines( gs_file_content ) ].
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_cts_language_file_io
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_cts_language_file_io=>file_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer simulierten Sprachdatei zeilenweise und filtern Sie leere Zeilen heraus.
hint: Kombinieren Sie das Lesen mit `cl_cts_language_file_io` (simuliert) und modernen ABAP-Tabellenoperationen wie `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_file_line_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_and_filter_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_lines) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io. "Simulated exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_line_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_filter_lines.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_lang_file_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_reader->read_language_file( iv_file_path ).

    DATA(lt_all_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT lv_content AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_all_lines.

    rt_filtered_lines = FILTER #( lt_all_lines USING KEY default WHERE table_line IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_writer) = NEW zcl_lang_file_writer( ).
    DATA(lv_path) = '/tmp/multiline_messages.txt'.
    DATA(lv_content) = 'Line1' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&

    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->read_and_filter_lines( lv_path ).

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) in einen JSON-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `/UI2/CL_JSON` und die Methode `SERIALIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data   = lt_sflights
          RECEIVING
            json   = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( ).

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der Flugdaten enthält, zurück in eine interne Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_sflights
      IMPORTING iv_json_string    TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_sflights.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case " Optional: handle camelCase in JSON
          CHANGING
            data        = rt_sflights
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: In einem realen Szenario könnte eine Exception ausgelöst oder eine leere Tabelle zurückgegeben werden.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"carrid":"AA","connid":"0017","fldate":"20250101","price":"100.00","currency":"USD"},{"carrid":"LH","connid":"0400","fldate":"20250102","price":"200.00","currency":"EUR"}]`.

hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_str_to_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string     TYPE string
        iv_codepage   TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_str_to_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_codepage
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian-big
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write( iv_string ).
        rv_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: In einem realen Szenario könnte eine Exception ausgelöst oder ein leeres XSTRING zurückgegeben werden.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_nested IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String in eine dynamisch erzeugte Datenreferenz, wenn die genaue Struktur zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `HANDLE` und `/UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_dynamic
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_data)   TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_dynamic.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

    " In einem realen Szenario könnte der Typ von lr_data dynamisch
    " basierend auf dem JSON-Inhalt oder Metadaten bestimmt werden.
    " Für dieses Beispiel nehmen wir an, wir erwarten eine Tabelle vom Typ ty_data.
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE tt_data.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = lr_data
        ).
        rr_data = lr_data.
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"field1":"Value A","field2":10},{"field1":"Value B","field2":20}]`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_dynamic( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lr_data
      msg = 'Data reference should not be initial'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_severity_err
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE zcl_json_deserialize_dynamic=>tt_data.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_data>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = <lt_data>
      msg = 'Assigned table should not be initial'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_severity_err
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <lt_data> )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Table should have 2 entries'
    ).
    READ TABLE <lt_data> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_data).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_data-field1
      exp = 'Value A'
      msg = 'First entry field1 should be Value A'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deserialisierung in eine dynamische Datenreferenz ist nützlich, wenn die genaue Struktur des JSON-Strings zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist. Mit `CREATE DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` kann der JSON-Inhalt flexibel verarbeitet werden.
keywords: JSON, DESERIALIZE, Dynamic Programming, Data Reference, /UI2/CL_JSON

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Daten in ein XSTRING, das als CSV-Datei heruntergeladen werden kann, unter Berücksichtigung einer spezifischen Codepage (z.B. UTF-8 mit BOM).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` für die Codepage-Konvertierung und String-Templates für die CSV-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_csv_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_data
        iv_codepage   TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT '4103' " UTF-8 with BOM
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_csv_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_csv.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    " Build CSV header
    lv_csv_string = 'Column1;Column2' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Build CSV data
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string &&
                      |{ ls_data-col1 };{ ls_data-col2 }| &&
                      cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_codepage
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian-default " Default for UTF-8
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write( lv_csv_string ).
        rv_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_table_to_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_table_to_csv.
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_conv_table_to_csv_xstr=>tt_data(
      ( col1 = 'Wert 1' col2 = 'Zweiter Wert' )
      ( col1 = 'Test' col2 = 'Daten mit Umlauten: ÄÖÜ' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_table_to_csv_xstr( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_table_to_csv( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_csv_xstring
      msg = 'CSV XSTRING should not be initial'
    ).
    " Check for UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_csv_xstring(3)
      exp = 'EFBBBF'X
      msg = 'XSTRING should start with UTF-8 BOM'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Formatierung von Daten als CSV mit der Codepage-Konvertierung mittels `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE`. Dies ist eine gängige Anforderung beim Export von Daten, um die Kompatibilität mit verschiedenen Systemen zu gewährleisten, insbesondere bei der Verwendung von UTF-8 mit BOM.
keywords: Codepage, XSTRING, CSV, Internal Table, CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE, String Templates, UTF-8 BOM

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein XSTRING, das in einer spezifischen Codepage und Endianness (z.B. UTF-16LE) vorliegt, in einen ABAP-String und umgekehrt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Parameter `ENCODING` und `ENDIAN` in `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_endianness DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string     TYPE string
        iv_codepage   TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_endian     TYPE cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS convert_xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring    TYPE xstring
        iv_codepage   TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_endian     TYPE cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_endianness IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.
    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_codepage
          endian   = iv_endian
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write( iv_string ).
        rv_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_xstring_to_string.
    DATA: lo_conv_in TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.
    TRY.
        lo_conv_in = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_codepage
          endian   = iv_endian
        ).
        lo_conv_in->read(
          IMPORTING
            data = rv_string
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_endianness_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_endianness_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_endianness( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Endianness Test'.
    DATA(lv_codepage_utf16le) = '1200'. " UTF-16LE

    " String to XSTRING (UTF-16LE)
    DATA(lv_xstring_le) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_xstring(
                              iv_string   = lv_original_string
                              iv_codepage = lv_codepage_utf16le
                              iv_endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian-little
                            ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_xstring_le
      msg = 'XSTRING (LE) should not be initial'
    ).

    " XSTRING (UTF-16LE) back to String
    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_string(
                                   iv_xstring    = lv_xstring_le
                                   iv_codepage   = lv_codepage_utf16le
                                   iv_endian     = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian-little
                                 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'Converted string should match original string (LE)'
    ).

    " Repeat for Big Endian for completeness
    DATA(lv_codepage_utf16be) = '1201'. " UTF-16BE
    DATA(lv_xstring_be) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_xstring(
                              iv_string   = lv_original_string
                              iv_codepage = lv_codepage_utf16be
                              iv_endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian-big
                            ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_xstring_be
      msg = 'XSTRING (BE) should not be initial'
    ).
    DATA(lv_converted_string_be) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_string(
                                      iv_xstring    = lv_xstring_be
                                      iv_codepage   = lv_codepage_utf16be
                                      iv_endian     = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian-big
                                    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string_be
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'Converted string should match original string (BE)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Parameter `ENCODING` und `ENDIAN` in `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` sind entscheidend für die korrekte Handhabung von Binärdaten, die von Systemen mit unterschiedlicher Byte-Reihenfolge (Endianness) stammen. Dies gewährleistet die Datenintegrität bei der Konvertierung.
keywords: Codepage, XSTRING, Endianness, CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE, CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE, UTF-16LE, UTF-16BE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Deserialisieren eines ungültigen JSON-Strings.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein XSTRING, das eine binäre Datei (z.B. ein Bild) darstellt, in einen ABAP-String für die Anzeige oder weitere Verarbeitung, unter der Annahme einer bestimmten Codepage.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` und beachten Sie, dass dies primär für Textdaten gedacht ist. Für Binärdaten ist oft eine andere Verarbeitung nötig.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_binary_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring    TYPE xstring
        iv_codepage   TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT '4103' " UTF-8
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_binary_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_string.
    DATA: lo_conv_in TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_in = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_codepage
        ).
        lo_conv_in->read(
          IMPORTING
            data = rv_string
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_string = 'Fehler bei Konvertierung: ' && lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_binary_to_string FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_binary_to_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_binary_to_string( ).
    " Beispiel: Ein kleines XSTRING, das als UTF-8 interpretiert werden könnte
    DATA(lv_binary_xstring) = '48656C6C6F'X. " Hex für 'Hello'
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = 'Hello'.

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_string(
                                   iv_xstring  = lv_binary_xstring
                                   iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
                                 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string
      exp = lv_expected_string
      msg = 'Converted string should match expected text'
    ).

    " Test mit einem XSTRING, das keine gültige UTF-8-Sequenz ist
    DATA(lv_invalid_binary) = 'C328'X. " Ungültige UTF-8-Sequenz
    DATA(lv_error_result) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_string(
                               iv_xstring  = lv_invalid_binary
                               iv_codepage = '4103'
                             ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_error_result
      exp = 'Fehler'
      msg = 'Should return an error message for invalid UTF-8 sequence'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` primär für Textdaten gedacht ist, kann es auch verwendet werden, um binäre XSTRINGs in Strings zu konvertieren, wenn die binären Daten eine bekannte Textkodierung darstellen. Bei ungültigen Sequenzen wird eine Exception ausgelöst, die abgefangen werden sollte.
keywords: XSTRING, String, Binary Data, Codepage, CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE, Error Handling

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Datum- und Zeitfeldern in JSON und stellen Sie sicher, dass diese korrekt formatiert werden.
hint: Datum- und Zeitfelder werden von `/UI2/CL_JSON` standardmäßig in ISO-Format konvertiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_date_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             event_id   TYPE string,
             event_date TYPE d,
             event_time TYPE t,
             timestamp  TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_event.
    TYPES: tt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_events
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_date_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_events.
    DATA(lt_events) = VALUE tt_events(
      ( event_id = 'EVT001' event_date = '20250115' event_time = '103000' timestamp = '20250115103000.0000000' )
      ( event_id = 'EVT002' event_date = '20250116' event_time = '140000' timestamp = '20250116140000.0000000' )
    ).

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data   = lt_events
          RECEIVING
            json   = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_date_time_serialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_time_serialization.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_date_time( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_events( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_json
      msg = 'JSON string should not be initial'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_severity_err
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    " Check for ISO date format
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_json
      exp = '"eventDate":"2025-01-15"'
      msg = 'JSON should contain date in ISO format'
    ).
    " Check for ISO time format
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_json
      exp = '"eventTime":"10:30:00"'
      msg = 'JSON should contain time in ISO format'
    ).
    " Check for ISO timestamp format
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_json
      exp = '"timestamp":"2025-01-15T10:30:00.0000000Z"'
      msg = 'JSON should contain timestamp in ISO format'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `/UI2/CL_JSON` konvertiert ABAP-Datum- und Zeitfelder (Typen D, T, TIMESTAMPL) automatisch in das standardisierte ISO-8601-Format, was die Interoperabilität mit anderen Systemen, die JSON verarbeiten, erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: JSON, SERIALIZE, Date, Time, Timestamp, ISO-8601, /UI2/CL_JSON

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der Sonderzeichen enthält, in ein XSTRING mit der Codepage UTF-8 und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Zeichen korrekt dargestellt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` mit `ENCODING = 'UTF-8'` (Codepage '4103' für UTF-8 mit BOM, '4100' für UTF-8 ohne BOM).
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_special_chars DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_special_chars
      IMPORTING
        iv_string     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_special_chars IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_special_chars.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = '4100' " UTF-8 ohne BOM
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write( iv_string ).
        rv_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_special_chars FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_special_chars.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_special_chars( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Grüße aus München! €uro Zeichen. ©'.
    DATA(lv_xstring_utf8) = lo_cut->convert_special_chars( lv_test_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_xstring_utf8
      msg = 'Converted XSTRING should not be initial'
    ).

    " Zurückkonvertieren, um die Korrektheit zu prüfen
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = '4100' ).
    DATA(lv_converted_back_string) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_converted_back_string EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_back_string
      exp = lv_test_string
      msg = 'Converted back string should match original string'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die korrekte Handhabung von Sonderzeichen ist entscheidend für die Datenintegrität. `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` mit der Codepage UTF-8 (z.B. '4100' für ohne BOM) gewährleistet, dass auch komplexe Zeichen wie Umlaute, Euro-Zeichen oder Copyright-Symbole korrekt in das XSTRING kodiert werden.
keywords: Codepage, XSTRING, Special Characters, UTF-8, CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen des Carriers 'LH' mit einer bestimmten Verbindungs-ID und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` und `VALUE #( ... )` zur Konstruktion der neuen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
    TYPES ty_flight_short_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsf   TYPE sflight-seatsf,
             seatscc  TYPE sflight-seatscc,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_map
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flight_short_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_map.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_for_filter_map=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_map(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
      iv_connid   = '0400'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` Syntax in Kombination mit `VALUE #(` ermöglicht das Filtern und gleichzeitige Mappen von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `APPEND` Anweisungen. Dies führt zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Filtering, Mapping, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Business- und First-Class-Sitze für einen bestimmten Flug (`CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT` um `SEATSCC` und `SEATSF` für passende Einträge zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsf   TYPE sflight-seatsf,
             seatscc  TYPE sflight-seatscc,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_occupied_premium_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_occupied_premium_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_seats = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate )
      NEXT total_seats = total_seats + flight-seatsf + flight-seatscc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_reduce_sum_seats=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsf = 10 seatscc = 20 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsf = 5  seatscc = 15 ) TO lt_sflights. " Should not be summed, same flight date
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' seatsf = 8  seatscc = 12 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsf = 2  seatscc = 3  ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_occupied_premium_seats(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
      iv_connid   = '0400'
      iv_fldate   = '20250102'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 20 ). " 8 + 12
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ideal, um eine einzelne aggregierte Zahl aus einer internen Tabelle zu berechnen. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert den Akkumulator, und die `NEXT`-Klausel definiert, wie der Akkumulator in jeder Iteration aktualisiert wird. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die zu berücksichtigenden Einträge.
keywords: REDUCE, Sum, Internal Table, Aggregation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit `CARRID` und der `FLIGHT_COUNT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` um die Gruppierung und Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES ty_carrier_flight_count_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_count_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_flight_count_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count_flights.
    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights
      GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_for_group_count=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_and_count_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion in ABAP 7.50, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` oder manuelle Hash-Tabellen-Aggregationen.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT`, und eine lokale Hash-Tabelle, um eindeutige `CARRID`s zu verfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers_string
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_string.
    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
           unique_carriers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      LET current_carrid = flight-carrid IN
      NEXT
        result = COND string( WHEN line_exists( unique_carriers[ current_carrid ] ) THEN result
                             ELSE COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN current_carrid
                                              ELSE result && `, ` && current_carrid ) )
        unique_carriers = VALUE #( unique_carriers ( current_carrid ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_unique_string( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_reduce_unique_string=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers_string( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lt_expected_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_expected_carriers.
    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_expected_carriers.
    APPEND 'UA' TO lt_expected_carriers.

    DATA(lt_actual_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SPLIT lv_result AT `, ` INTO TABLE lt_actual_carriers.
    SORT lt_actual_carriers.
    SORT lt_expected_carriers.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_carriers ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_carriers exp = lt_expected_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Vielseitigkeit von `REDUCE`. Es verwendet zwei Akkumulatoren: `result` für den Ausgabestring und `unique_carriers` (eine Hash-Tabelle) um bereits verarbeitete Fluggesellschaften zu verfolgen. `COND` wird verwendet, um bedingt den String zu erweitern und Duplikate zu vermeiden. `LET` hilft, den aktuellen `CARRID` für die Lesbarkeit zu speichern.
keywords: REDUCE, String, Concatenation, Unique, HASHED TABLE, COND, LET, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle aus den Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS), die alle Felder der Originaltabelle sowie ein zusätzliches Feld `IS_FULL` (Typ `ABAP_BOOL`) enthält. `IS_FULL` soll `true` sein, wenn die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) entspricht, ansonsten `false`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE #( ... )` und `COND` für das neue Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_conditional_trans DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsf   TYPE sflight-seatsf,
             seatscc  TYPE sflight-seatscc,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsf   TYPE sflight-seatsf,
             seatscc  TYPE sflight-seatscc,
             is_full  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES ty_flight_with_status_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_with_full_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE ty_flight_with_status_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_conditional_trans IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_with_full_status.

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis (`PRICE`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT`, um den maximalen Wert zu vergleichen und zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_for_carrier.
    rv_max_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT max_price = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT max_price = nmax( val1 = max_price val2 = flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_price( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_reduce_max_price=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '250.50' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '120.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_for_carrier(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '250.50' ).

    DATA(lv_result_no_flights) = lo_cut->get_max_price_for_carrier(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'XX'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_no_flights exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist hier effizient, um den maximalen Wert in einer gefilterten Menge von Daten zu finden. Die `INIT`-Klausel setzt einen Startwert, und `NEXT` verwendet die eingebaute Funktion `nmax` (oder `max` für numerische Typen), um den aktuellen Maximalwert mit dem Preis des aktuellen Flugs zu vergleichen und den größeren Wert zu behalten.
keywords: REDUCE, Max, Internal Table, Aggregation, NMAX, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Für jeden Flug in SFLIGHTS, ermitteln Sie den zugehörigen Namen der Fluggesellschaft (`CARRNAME`) aus SCARR und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit Flugdetails und dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `LET` um eine lokale Variable für den Carrier-Namen zu deklarieren, oder greifen Sie direkt auf `SCARR` mittels `LINE_EXISTS` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_join_like DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr_wa,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr_wa.
    TYPES ty_scarr_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrier_name,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_with_carrier_name.
    TYPES ty_flight_with_carrier_name_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_carrier_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        it_scarr    TYPE ty_scarr_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_name) TYPE ty_flight_with_carrier_name_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_join_like IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    rt_flights_with_name = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      LET carrier_name = COND scarr-carrname( WHEN line_exists( it_scarr[ carrid = flight-carrid ] ) THEN it_scarr[ carrid = flight-carrid ]-carrname ELSE 'UNKNOWN' ) IN
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, carrname = carrier_name, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate, price = flight-price, currency = flight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flights_with_carrier_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_join_like( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_for_join_like=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights. " Unknown carrier

    DATA(lt_scarr) TYPE zcl_for_join_like=>ty_scarr_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' ) TO lt_scarr.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' ) TO lt_scarr.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_name(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      it_scarr    = lt_scarr
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrname exp = 'UNKNOWN' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine 'Join-ähnliche' Operation zwischen zwei internen Tabellen mit `FOR ... IN ...` und der `LET`-Klausel. `LET` ermöglicht die Deklaration lokaler Hilfsvariablen, die nur innerhalb des Ausdrucks gültig sind. Hier wird `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` verwendet, um den Carrier-Namen bedingt aus der `SCARR`-Tabelle zu holen, falls vorhanden, ansonsten einen Standardwert zu setzen.
keywords: FOR, LET, Internal Table, Join, Data Retrieval, COND, LINE_EXISTS, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, die jeder Fluggesellschafts-ID (`CARRID`) die Gesamtzahl der Flüge dieser Gesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS zuordnet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT`, um eine Hash-Tabelle zu füllen und die Zählungen zu aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count_map_wa,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count_map_wa.
    TYPES ty_carrier_count_map_tt TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_count_map_wa WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_count_map_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    rt_carrier_counts = REDUCE ty_carrier_count_map_tt(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_carrier_count_map_tt( )
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      LET current_carrid = flight-carrid IN
      NEXT
        counts = VALUE #( counts ( carrid = current_carrid
                                   count  = counts[ OPTIONAL carrid = current_carrid ]-count + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_to_map( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_reduce_to_map=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flight_counts( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ]-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses `REDUCE`-Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine Hash-Tabelle als Akkumulator verwendet, um Aggregationen durchzuführen. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert die leere Hash-Tabelle. In der `NEXT`-Klausel wird `VALUE #(` verwendet, um die Hash-Tabelle zu aktualisieren. `counts[ OPTIONAL carrid = current_carrid ]-count` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf den Zähler, auch wenn der Eintrag noch nicht existiert (dann ist der Wert 0), und `+ 1` inkrementiert ihn.
keywords: REDUCE, HASHED TABLE, Map, Aggregation, VALUE, OPTIONAL, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (`PRICE`) für alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, deren Währung 'EUR' ist und deren Flugdatum im aktuellen Jahr liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT`, und integrieren Sie `IF`-Bedingungen oder eine `WHERE`-Klausel für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_eur_current_year_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_eur_current_year_price.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT total_price = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( currency = 'EUR' AND flight-fldate(4) = lv_current_year )
      NEXT total_price = total_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_price_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_price_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_conditional_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_reduce_conditional_sum=>ty_sflight_tt.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' fldate = lv_current_year && '0101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' fldate = lv_current_year && '0102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' fldate = lv_current_year && '0101' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights. " Wrong currency
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' fldate = '20240101' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights. " Wrong year
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' fldate = lv_current_year && '0103' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_eur_current_year_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '600.00' ). " 100 + 200 + 300
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses `REDUCE`-Beispiel kombiniert Filterung und Aggregation. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks filtert die Flüge nach Währung und dem aktuellen Jahr (extrahiert mit `sy-datum(4)`). Nur die passenden Flüge werden in die Summe einbezogen, was den Code sehr prägnant und effizient macht.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

    rt_high_occupancy_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) > 0.5 )

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine einfache Filterung einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer arithmetischen Bedingung in der `WHERE`-Klausel. `flight-*` kopiert alle Felder der Originalstruktur in die neue Tabelle, was den Code kurz und prägnant hält.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzbelegung (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX) über alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe der Belegungsraten und die Anzahl der Flüge zu akkumulieren, und berechnen Sie dann den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy.
    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE struct(
      INIT sum_occupancy_rate = 0.0
           flight_count = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND flight-seatsmax > 0 )
      NEXT sum_occupancy_rate = sum_occupancy_rate + ( CONV f( flight-seatsocc ) / flight-seatsmax )
           flight_count = flight_count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-flight_count > 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = ls_aggregation-sum_occupancy_rate / ls_aggregation-flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_occupancy FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_average_occupancy_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_avg_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_reduce_avg_occupancy=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflights. " 0.6
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflights. " 0.8
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 70 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflights. " 0.7

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_average_occupancy(

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_occupancy_empty.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle aus SFLIGHTS, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 100 EUR enthält. Für diese Flüge soll der Preis um 10% erhöht werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` und `VALUE #( ... )` mit einer `LET`-Klausel für die Preisberechnung.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.

    METHODS get_promoted_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_promoted_flights.
    rt_promoted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( price > 100 AND currency = 'EUR' )
      LET new_price = flight-price * '1.10' IN
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate, price = new_price, currency = flight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_transform( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights. " Included, price +10%
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '90.00'  currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights. " Excluded, price <= 100
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights. " Excluded, wrong currency
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights. " Included, price +10%

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '220.00' ). " 200 * 1.1
