Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs (`CARRID`) aus SFLIGHTS enthält, die mindestens 2 Flüge haben, getrennt durch Semikolons.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS` um zuerst die Zählungen zu ermitteln und dann den String zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_grouped_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_wa,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_wa.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_wa WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_multi_flight_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_grouped_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multi_flight_carriers.
    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      WHERE ( GROUP SIZE >= 2 )
      NEXT
        result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN flight-carrid ELSE result && `;` && flight-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multi_flight_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_flight_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_grouped_string( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE zcl_reduce_grouped_string=>ty_sflight_tt.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_multi_flight_carriers( lt_sflights ).

    " Order might vary, check for presence of expected carriers
    DATA(lt_expected_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_expected_carriers.
    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_expected_carriers.
    SORT lt_expected_carriers.

    DATA(lt_actual_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SPLIT lv_result AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_actual_carriers.
    SORT lt_actual_carriers.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_carriers ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_carriers exp = lt_expected_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel auf Gruppenebene (`GROUP SIZE`). Es iteriert über die gruppierten Fluggesellschaften, filtert diejenigen heraus, die mindestens zwei Flüge haben, und konkateniert deren IDs zu einem Semikolon-separierten String. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, komplexe Aggregationen und String-Operationen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, WHERE, String, Concatenation, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe des 'price'-Feldes aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit INIT und NEXT, um die Summe zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_sum_price FOR TESTING.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum_price=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = 300.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_price( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle 'carrid'-Werte aus einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit INIT und NEXT für die String-Verkettung. Achten Sie auf das erste Element, um kein führendes Komma zu haben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_carrids) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carrids.
    rv_concatenated_carrids = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN <fs_sflight>-carrid ELSE result && ',' && <fs_sflight>-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_carrids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_concat_carrid=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_carrid( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carrids( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'LH,AA,UA'
      msg = 'Concatenated string should be "LH,AA,UA"' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    lv_result = lo_cut->concatenate_carrids( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = ''
      msg = 'Concatenated string should be empty for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator wird hier verwendet, um eine Liste von Strings effizient zu einem einzigen String zu verketten. Die COND-Expression innerhalb von NEXT sorgt dafür, dass das Komma nur zwischen den Elementen hinzugefügt wird und nicht am Anfang.
keywords: REDUCE, String, Concatenation, Internal Tables, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten 'price'-Wert in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight

        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_max_price.
    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe des 'price'-Feldes für jeden 'carrid' in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT und geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator in Kombination mit FOR GROUPS und GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_total.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_totals) TYPE tt_carrid_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrid.
    rt_carrid_totals = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid_total( )
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid
      LET total_price_for_group = REDUCE #( 
                                    INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                    FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP <group>
                                    NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_member>-price ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = <group> total_price = total_price_for_group ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_group_sum=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-price = 150.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-price = 300.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-price = 250.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_by_carrid( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should be 3 entries in result table' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_total).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_total-total_price
      exp = 250
      msg = 'Total price for LH should be 250' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_total).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_total-total_price
      exp = 450
      msg = 'Total price for AA should be 450' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' INTO DATA(ls_ua_total).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_ua_total-total_price
      exp = 300
      msg = 'Total price for UA should be 300' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von REDUCE mit FOR GROUPS und GROUP BY ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Es ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung, was den Code extrem lesbar und wartbar macht.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur 'carrid' und 'connid' für Flüge mit einem 'price' größer als 1000 enthält, unter Verwendung von REDUCE und FOR.
hint: Kombinieren Sie REDUCE mit einer FOR-Expression, um die Quelltabelle zu filtern und die Zieltabelle zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_transform_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_key( )
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      WHERE <fs_sflight>-price > 1000
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid connid = <fs_sflight>-connid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in einen Integer. Wenn der String leer ist, soll 0 zurückgegeben werden, ansonsten der konvertierte Wert. Verwenden Sie CONV und COND.

CLASS zcl_conv_cond_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine JSON-ähnliche String-Darstellung von Flugdaten (carrid, connid, price) aus einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT unter Verwendung von REDUCE und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um den JSON-String iterativ aufzubauen, und String-Templates für die Formatierung der einzelnen Objekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_to_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flights_to_json
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_to_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flights_to_json.
    DATA(lv_flights_json) = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT result = COND string(
                       WHEN result IS INITIAL
                       THEN |{{"carrid":"{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }","connid":"{ <fs_sflight>-connid }","price":{ <fs_sflight>-price } }}|
                       ELSE result && |,{ "carrid":"{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }","connid":"{ <fs_sflight>-connid }","price":{ <fs_sflight>-price } }}| ) ).

    rv_json_string = |[{ lv_flights_json }]|. 
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_to_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_to_json.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_to_json=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 950.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-price = 1200.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_to_json( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->convert_flights_to_json( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lv_expected_json) = 
      |[{ "carrid":"LH","connid":"0400","price":950 }| &&
      |, { "carrid":"AA","connid":"0017","price":1200 }]|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_json
      exp = lv_expected_json
      msg = 'Generated JSON string should match expected' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    lv_json = lo_cut->convert_flights_to_json( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_json
      exp = '[]'
      msg = 'Empty table should result in empty JSON array' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Ansatz nutzt REDUCE und String-Templates, um dynamisch einen JSON-Array-String aus einer internen Tabelle zu erstellen. Die COND-Expression innerhalb von NEXT sorgt für die korrekte Komma-Trennung. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und moderne Art, strukturierte Daten in String-Form zu bringen.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, JSON, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_reduce_transform_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_inc,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             increased_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price_inc.

      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_increased_prices) TYPE tt_flight_price_inc.

CLASS zcl_reduce_transform_price IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_increased_prices = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_price_inc( )
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid 
                                          increased_price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.1' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: ty_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_unique_carrids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids.
    rt_unique_carrids = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid( )
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      WHERE <fs_sflight>-carrid IS NOT INITIAL
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( <fs_sflight>-carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = ''. " Empty carrid

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_unique_carrids( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrids( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie REDUCE und CONV.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um die Summe und die Anzahl der Elemente zu ermitteln, und CONV für die abschließende Division, um einen Dezimalwert zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
           count     = 0 TYPE i
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price,
           count     = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = CONV decfloat34( ls_aggregation-sum_price ) / ls_aggregation-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_avg_price=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = 300.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_average
      exp = '200'
      msg = 'Average price should be 200' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    lv_average = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_sflights ).

REDUCE wird verwendet, um mehrere Werte (Summe und Anzahl) gleichzeitig zu akkumulieren. CLASS zcl_itab_sum_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_itab_sum_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.

                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_values_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_abap_dyn_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_values_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_column_name TYPE string VALUE iv_column_name.
    DATA: lt_result_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        SELECT DISTINCT (lv_column_name)
          FROM sflights
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_dynamic_result).

        LOOP AT lt_dynamic_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND <fs_value> TO rt_values.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_dyn_sql
            textid   = cx_abap_dyn_sql_error=>cx_abap_dyn_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT DISTINCT` in einer Subquery mit `GROUP BY` und `ORDER BY` sowie `UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_top_distinct_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_top_5_carrids_by_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_top_distinct_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_5_carrids_by_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      ORDER BY count DESC
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_top_carrids).

    LOOP AT lt_top_carrids INTO DATA(ls_top_carrid).
      APPEND ls_top_carrid-carrid TO rt_carrids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SORTED TABLE` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus `sflights`, sortiert nach `carrid` und `connid`. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Schlüssel eindeutig ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS get_sorted_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    " Füllt die SORTED TABLE direkt aus der Datenbanktabelle sflights.
    " Die Sortierung und Eindeutigkeit wird durch die Deklaration sichergestellt.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ). " Annahme: sflights enthält Daten

    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        IF ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Tabelle ist nicht nach carrid sortiert' ).
        ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid.
          IF ls_flight-connid < lv_prev_connid.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Tabelle ist nicht nach connid innerhalb von carrid sortiert' ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SORTED TABLE`s sind interne Tabellen, die automatisch nach einem definierten Schlüssel sortiert bleiben. Die `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Syntax ist eine moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu füllen und dabei die Sortierung des Quellobjekts zu nutzen oder neu zu sortieren, wenn der Schlüssel passt. `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge existieren.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer `SORTED TABLE` basierend auf dem Schlüssel (`carrid`, `connid`). Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS read_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight.
    DATA(lt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    lt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO rs_flight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->read_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    ).

Dies ist effizienter als eine sequentielle Suche bei großen Tabellen. Die Ausnahmebehandlung mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` ist der moderne Weg, Fehler zu signalisieren.

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Einträge in eine `SORTED TABLE` ein und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierung beibehalten wird. Versuchen Sie auch, einen doppelten Eintrag einzufügen, um das Verhalten bei `UNIQUE KEY` zu beobachten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ...` und `TRY ... CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS insert_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_flight INTO TABLE ct_flights.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        rv_success = abap_false. " Doppelter Schlüssel, Einfügen fehlgeschlagen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_new_entry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_duplicate_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_new_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) TYPE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>tt_sflight_sorted.

    " Initialisierung mit einigen Flügen
    lt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_flights ).

    " Neuer Eintrag
    DATA(ls_new_flight) TYPE sflight.
    ls_new_flight-carrid = 'XX'.
    ls_new_flight-connid = '0001'.
    ls_new_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_new_flight-price = '100.00'.
    ls_new_flight-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight( EXPORTING is_flight = ls_new_flight CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_initial_lines + 1 ).

    " Überprüfung der Sortierung (vereinfacht)
    READ TABLE lt_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) TYPE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>tt_sflight_sorted.

    " Initialisierung mit einem bekannten Eintrag
    DATA(ls_existing_flight) TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO ls_existing_flight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Falls der Flug nicht existiert, einen Dummy erstellen
      ls_existing_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
      ls_existing_flight-connid = '0400'.
      ls_existing_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
      ls_existing_flight-price = '200.00'.
      ls_existing_flight-currency = 'EUR'.
    ENDIF.
    INSERT ls_existing_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_flights ).

    " Versuch, denselben Eintrag erneut einzufügen
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight( EXPORTING is_flight = ls_existing_flight CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_initial_lines ). " Keine neue Zeile hinzugefügt
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine `SORTED TABLE` wird der neue Eintrag automatisch an der korrekten Position eingefügt, um die Sortierreihenfolge beizubehalten. Bei einem `UNIQUE KEY` wird eine `cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key` Ausnahme ausgelöst, wenn versucht wird, einen Eintrag mit bereits existierendem Schlüssel einzufügen. Die `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke sind der Standard für die Ausnahmebehandlung.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT, UNIQUE KEY, cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key, Exception Handling

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ). " Alle Flüge laden

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( " Aggregation mit REDUCE
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
           count     TYPE i             VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ) " Filtert nach Fluggesellschaft
      NEXT
        sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price,
        count     = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `FILTER` kann man gezielt über eine Teilmenge der Daten iterieren und dabei Summen und Zähler akkumulieren, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Syntax, die die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen reduziert.

CLASS zcl_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy_rate.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( " Aggregation mit REDUCE
      INIT total_occupied TYPE i VALUE 0
           total_max      TYPE i VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT
        total_occupied = total_occupied + ls_flight-seatsocc,
        total_max      = total_max + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).

    IF ls_result-total_max > 0.
      rv_occupancy_rate = CONV f( ls_result-total_occupied ) / ls_result-total_max. " Umwandlung in Float für genaue Division
    ELSE.
      rv_occupancy_rate = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anstatt den Durchschnitt pro Zeile zu berechnen und dann zu mitteln, werden hier die Zähler und Nenner separat akkumuliert und erst am Ende dividiert, um eine korrekte Gesamtauslastung zu erhalten. Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die 5 teuersten Flüge aus `sflights` und berechnen Sie deren durchschnittlichen Preis.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SORTED TABLE` (temporär) mit `FOR` und `REDUCE`. Nutzen Sie `UP TO 5 ROWS` oder `LINES UP TO 5`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_top_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_top_n
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_top_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_top_n.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY price DESCENDING.

    DATA(lt_top_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_price_sorted(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid, connid = ls_sflight-connid, price = ls_sflight-price )
      LINES UP TO iv_top_n " Nimmt die ersten N Einträge nach Sortierung
    ).

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( " Aggregation mit REDUCE
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
           count     TYPE i             VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_top_flights
      NEXT
        sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price,
        count     = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `LINES UP TO iv_top_n` Klausel im `FOR`-Ausdruck sorgt dafür, dass nur die obersten N Einträge berücksichtigt werden. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue `SORTED TABLE` aus `sflights`, die nur `carrid`, `connid` und `price` enthält, und sortieren Sie diese nach `carrid` und `price` (aufsteigend).
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( component = source-component ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid price connid.
    METHODS get_transformed_sorted_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_sorted_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( " Erstellt eine neue SORTED TABLE
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights " Iteriert über sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        price  = ls_sflight-price ) " Wählt und transformiert Felder
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_transformed_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_transformed_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_transformed_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_price)  TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        IF ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Tabelle ist nicht nach carrid sortiert' ).
        ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid.
          IF ls_flight-price < lv_prev_price.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Tabelle ist nicht nach price innerhalb von carrid sortiert' ).
          ELSEIF ls_flight-price = lv_prev_price.
            IF ls_flight-connid < lv_prev_connid.
              cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Tabelle ist nicht nach connid innerhalb von carrid und price sortiert' ).
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_price  = ls_flight-price.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Syntax ist ideal, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen und gleichzeitig Daten aus einer Quelltabelle zu transformieren oder zu filtern. Hier wird eine `SORTED TABLE` mit einem spezifischen Schlüssel und einer reduzierten Feldmenge erzeugt. Die Sortierung wird automatisch durch die Deklaration der Zieltabelle und die Reihenfolge der Schlüsselkomponenten (`carrid`, `price`, `connid`) gewährleistet.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für jede einzigartige Flugverbindung (`carrid`, `connid`) in `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_avg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_connection_avg.
    TYPES: tt_connection_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_average_price_per_connection RETURNING VALUE(rt_averages) TYPE tt_connection_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_per_connection.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( " Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe
        INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
             count     TYPE i             VALUE 0
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP <fs_group>
        NEXT
          sum_price = sum_price + ls_grouped_flight-price,
          count     = count + 1
      ).

      IF ls_result-count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
                        connid = <fs_group>-connid
                        average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count ) TO rt_averages.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_price_per_connection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price_per_connection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_group( ).
    DATA(lt_averages) = lo_cut->get_average_price_per_connection( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_averages ).

    " Überprüfen Sie einige spezifische Verbindungen (Beispiel)
    READ TABLE lt_averages INTO DATA(ls_avg_lh_0400) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_avg_lh_0400-average_price > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_avg_lh_0400-average_price < 10000 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Überprüfen Sie, ob die Anzahl der Verbindungen plausibel ist
    DATA(lv_distinct_connections) TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT carrid ) + COUNT( DISTINCT connid ) FROM sflights INTO lv_distinct_connections.
    " Dies ist eine grobe Schätzung, da es sich um eine Kombination handelt.
    " Ein genauerer Test würde die erwarteten Werte aus Testdaten berechnen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_averages ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten direkt in ABAP. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe kann dann der `REDUCE` Operator verwendet werden, um spezifische Berechnungen wie den Durchschnitt durchzuführen. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Verarbeitung von gruppierten Daten, ohne dass temporäre Tabellen oder manuelle Schleifen für jede Gruppe erforderlich sind.
keywords: AVERAGE, GROUP BY, LOOP, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` mit einem `UNIQUE KEY` und versuchen Sie, Einträge hinzuzufügen, die Duplikate des Schlüssels enthalten würden. Beobachten Sie das Verhalten und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ...` und `TRY ... CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_unique TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS add_flight_and_handle_duplicate
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_unique
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_and_handle_duplicate.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_flight INTO TABLE ct_flights.
        rv_message = |Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } erfolgreich hinzugefügt.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        rv_message = |Fehler: Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } existiert bereits (doppelter Schlüssel).|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_unique_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) TYPE zcl_sorted_table_unique=>tt_sflight_unique.

    DATA(ls_flight1) TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight1-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight1-connid = '001'.
    DATA(lv_msg1) = lo_cut->add_flight_and_handle_duplicate( EXPORTING is_flight = ls_flight1 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_msg1 exp = 'Flug AA 001 erfolgreich hinzugefügt.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) TYPE zcl_sorted_table_unique=>tt_sflight_unique.

    DATA(ls_flight1) TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight1-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight1-connid = '001'.
    lo_cut->add_flight_and_handle_duplicate( EXPORTING is_flight = ls_flight1 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    DATA(ls_flight2) TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight2-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight2-connid = '001'. " Duplikat
    DATA(lv_msg2) = lo_cut->add_flight_and_handle_duplicate( EXPORTING is_flight = ls_flight2 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_msg2 exp = 'Fehler: Flug AA 001 existiert bereits (doppelter Schlüssel).' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ). " Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich bleiben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine zwei Einträge denselben Schlüssel haben können. Wenn versucht wird, einen doppelten Schlüssel einzufügen, wird die Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key` ausgelöst. Dies ist ein robuster Mechanismus zur Sicherstellung der Datenintegrität. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, Strings zu formatieren.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, Duplicates, Exception Handling, String Templates

CLASS zcl_avg_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_flights WHERE seatsocc > iv_min_seatsocc ) " Filtert nach Auslastung
      NEXT
        sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price,
        count     = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES: tt_connections_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_connection WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS check_connection_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_connection_exists.
    DATA(lt_connections) TYPE tt_connections_sorted.
    lt_connections = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid, connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_connections[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von Flugdaten und verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu zählen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_count_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_per_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    DATA(lt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    lt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP <fs_group> NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_flight_count_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).

    " Überprüfen Sie den Zähler für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft (Beispiel)
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count_lh-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Überprüfen Sie, ob die Gesamtzahl der Flüge korrekt ist
    DATA(lv_total_flights_db) TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO lv_total_flights_db.

    DATA(lv_total_flights_calc) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR ls_entry IN lt_counts NEXT c = c + ls_entry-flight_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_flights_calc exp = lv_total_flights_db ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination einer `SORTED TABLE` als Quelle für eine `GROUP BY` Operation. Obwohl `GROUP BY` mit jeder Art von interner Tabelle funktioniert, kann eine vorsortierte Tabelle in bestimmten Szenarien die Performance verbessern. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Anzahl der Elemente zu zählen, was eine moderne und prägnante Alternative zu einem expliziten Zähler in einer Schleife ist.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Flugzeugtyp (`planetype`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_planetype DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_planetype_avg,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_planetype_avg.
    TYPES: tt_planetype_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_planetype_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_average_price_per_planetype RETURNING VALUE(rt_averages) TYPE tt_planetype_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_planetype IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_per_planetype.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( planetype = ls_flight-planetype ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( " Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe
        INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
             count     TYPE i             VALUE 0
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP <fs_group>
        NEXT
          sum_price = sum_price + ls_grouped_flight-price,
          count     = count + 1
      ).

      IF ls_result-count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( planetype = <fs_group>-planetype
                        average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count ) TO rt_averages.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_price_per_planetype FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price_per_planetype.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_planetype( ).
    DATA(lt_averages) = lo_cut->get_average_price_per_planetype( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_averages ).

    " Überprüfen Sie den Durchschnitt für einen bekannten Flugzeugtyp (Beispiel)
    READ TABLE lt_averages INTO DATA(ls_avg_747) WITH KEY planetype = '747'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_avg_747-average_price > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_avg_747-average_price < 10000 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Überprüfen Sie, ob die Anzahl der Flugzeugtypen plausibel ist
    DATA(lv_distinct_planetype) TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT planetype ) FROM sflights INTO lv_distinct_planetype.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_averages ) exp = lv_distinct_planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` auf eine andere Gruppierungseigenschaft (`planetype`). Es zeigt die Flexibilität dieser modernen ABAP-Konstrukte, um Aggregationen für verschiedene Kategorien von Daten durchzuführen. Die Lösung ist deklarativ und vermeidet manuelle Schleifen und temporäre Variablen für die Gruppierung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_basic_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_unassign RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_unassigned) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_basic_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_number TYPE i VALUE 100.

    ASSIGN lv_number TO <fs_value>.
    IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Feldsymbol ist zugewiesen
      <fs_value> = 200.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_value>.

    IF <fs_value> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      rv_is_unassigned = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_unassigned = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer internen Tabelle zu, ändern Sie deren Wert und heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols anschließend auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_dynamic_component
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_dynamic_component.
    rt_data = it_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT rt_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_component>.
    ENDLOOP.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_dynamic_component FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_dynamic_component.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_component=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'Old Value 1' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'Old Value 2' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_component( ).
    DATA(lt_updated_data) = lo_updater->update_dynamic_component(
      it_data      = lt_test_data
      iv_component = 'VALUE'
      iv_new_value = 'New Value'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated_data[ 1 ]-value exp = 'New Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated_data[ 2 ]-value exp = 'New Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Feldsymbole für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten von Strukturen innerhalb einer internen Tabelle verwendet werden können. `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Felder, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. `UNASSIGN` ist hier wichtig, um das Feldsymbol nach jeder Zuweisung oder nach Beendigung der Schleife zu 'resetten' und mögliche unerwünschte Seiteneffekte zu vermeiden.
keywords: Field Symbols, Dynamic, Component, Internal Table, ASSIGN COMPONENT, UNASSIGN

CLASS zcl_fs_loop_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD process_sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      " Verarbeitung des Feldsymbols
      " WRITE: / <fs_sflight>-carrid, <fs_sflight>-connid.
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>.

    IF <fs_sflight> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      rv_last_fs_unassigned = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_last_fs_unassigned = abap_false.

CLASS zcl_fs_generic_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_generic_fs.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_int TYPE i VALUE 10.
    DATA lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello World'.
    DATA lv_date TYPE d VALUE '20231121'.

    " Zuweisung eines Integer
    ASSIGN lv_int TO <fs_any>.
    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED AND sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_any> = 20.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_any>.
    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Zuweisung eines Strings
    ASSIGN lv_string TO <fs_any>.
    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED AND sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_any> = 'New String'.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_any>.
    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Zuweisung eines Datums
    ASSIGN lv_date TO <fs_any>.
    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED AND sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_any> = '20240101'.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_any>.
    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol eine Variable nur unter einer bestimmten Bedingung zu und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol danach immer unzugewiesen ist, unabhängig davon, ob die Zuweisung erfolgte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF ... ASSIGN ... ENDIF` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_conditional_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE abap_bool
        iv_value     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_conditional_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_conditionally.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target> TYPE i.
    DATA lv_local_value TYPE i = 0.

    IF iv_condition = abap_true.
      ASSIGN iv_value TO <fs_target>.
      IF <fs_target> IS ASSIGNED.
        lv_local_value = <fs_target> * 2.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_target> IS ASSIGNED.
      UNASSIGN <fs_target>.
    ENDIF.

    rv_final_value = lv_local_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_conditionally( iv_condition = abap_true iv_value = 5 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den sicheren Umgang mit Feldsymbolen in bedingten Zuweisungen. Selbst wenn die Zuweisung innerhalb der `IF`-Bedingung nicht stattfindet, wird durch die abschließende `IF <fs> IS ASSIGNED. UNASSIGN <fs>. ENDIF.`-Struktur sichergestellt, dass das Feldsymbol am Ende der Methode immer unzugewiesen ist. Dies ist eine gute Praxis für defensive Programmierung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Feld sortiert, dessen Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und heben Sie deren Zuweisung auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT ... BY (field_name)` und Feldsymbole für den Zugriff auf die Tabellenzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    rt_sorted_data = it_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rt_sorted_data TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_table>.

    " Although SORT BY (field_name) doesn't directly use a field symbol for the field,
    " the table itself is accessed via a field symbol, and UNASSIGN is good practice.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sort_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_by_fldate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_sort=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231121' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231122' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20231120' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_sorter->sort_table_dynamically( it_data = lt_flights iv_sort_field = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_fldate.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_sort=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231121' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231122' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20231120' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_sorter->sort_table_dynamically( it_data = lt_flights iv_sort_field = 'FLDATE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20231120' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20231121' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20231122' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle, wobei der Sortierbegriff zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Obwohl `SORT ... BY (field_name)` den Feldnamen direkt als String akzeptiert, wird hier die Tabelle selbst über ein Feldsymbol (`<fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE`) zugewiesen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn der Tabellentyp ebenfalls dynamisch ist. `UNASSIGN` stellt sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach der Operation freigegeben wird.
keywords: Internal Table, Dynamic Sort, Field Symbols, ASSIGN, UNASSIGN, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Attribut einer Objektinstanz zu, ändern Sie dessen Wert und heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols auf. Der Attributname wird als String übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(CLASS_NAME)OBJECT_REFERENCE->ATTRIBUTE_NAME') TO <fs>` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dyn_object_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE string.
    METHODS update_attribute_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dyn_object_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_attribute_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_attribute> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_full_path TYPE string.

    lv_full_path = |(ZCL_FS_DYN_OBJECT_ATTR)ME->{ iv_attribute_name }|.

    ASSIGN (lv_full_path) TO <fs_attribute>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_attribute> = iv_new_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_attribute>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_existing_attribute FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_attribute FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_existing_attribute.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_fs_dyn_object_attr( 'Initial' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_instance->update_attribute_dynamically(
      iv_attribute_name = 'MV_VALUE'
      iv_new_value      = 'Updated Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance->mv_value exp = 'Updated Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_attribute.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_fs_dyn_object_attr( 'Initial' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_instance->update_attribute_dynamically(
      iv_attribute_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_ATTRIBUTE'
      iv_new_value      = 'Some Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance->mv_value exp = 'Initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den sehr mächtigen dynamischen Zugriff auf Attribute einer Objektinstanz mittels Feldsymbolen. Der vollständige Pfad zum Attribut, inklusive Klassenname und Objektinstanz (`(CLASS_NAME)OBJECT_REFERENCE->ATTRIBUTE_NAME`), wird zur Laufzeit konstruiert und dem Feldsymbol zugewiesen. Dies ermöglicht hochflexible, aber auch komplexe Szenarien. `UNASSIGN` ist hier unerlässlich, um die Referenz nach der dynamischen Operation zu lösen.
keywords: Field Symbols, Dynamic, Object Attribute, ASSIGN, UNASSIGN, Object Orientation

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, eine nicht-existierende GUI-Eigenschaft zu lesen und fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zu generieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error` um die Ausnahme abzufangen, die bei Zugriff auf eine nicht-existierende Eigenschaft ausgelöst wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_prop_error_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_non_existent_prop RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_prop_error_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_non_existent_prop.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = cl_gui_props_consumer=>get_instance( ).
    CONSTANTS lc_non_existent_prop TYPE string VALUE 'NON_EXISTENT_GUI_PROPERTY'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_value) = lo_props_consumer->get_property_value( iv_property_name = lc_non_existent_prop ).
        rv_message = |Value of { lc_non_existent_prop }: { lv_value }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_message = |Error reading property '{ lc_non_existent_prop }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_non_existent_prop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_non_existent_prop.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_gui_prop_error_handle( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_handler->get_non_existent_prop( ).
    " Expecting an error message as the property 'NON_EXISTENT_GUI_PROPERTY' should not exist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'Error reading property' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die robuste Fehlerbehandlung beim Zugriff auf GUI-Eigenschaften. Wenn `get_property_value()` versucht, eine nicht-existierende Eigenschaft zu lesen, wird eine Ausnahme vom Typ `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ausgelöst. Durch das Abfangen dieser Ausnahme mit `TRY...CATCH` kann das Programm elegant reagieren und eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung liefern, anstatt abzustürzen.
keywords: GUI, Properties, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, cx_sy_dyn_call_error, cl_gui_props_consumer

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch ausliest und zurückgibt. Der Feldname wird als String übergeben. Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach der Operation unzugewiesen ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und `UNASSIGN`. Nutzen Sie `TYPE any` für das Feldsymbol und den Rückgabewert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_read_dyn_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure  TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_read_dyn_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found or not accessible'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine generische Funktion zum dynamischen Auslesen von Feldwerten aus einer beliebigen Struktur. Durch die Verwendung von `TYPE any` für die Struktur und das Feldsymbol kann die Methode mit verschiedenen Strukturtypen arbeiten. `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...` ist der Schlüssel zum dynamischen Zugriff. `UNASSIGN` am Ende ist entscheidend, um die Referenz des Feldsymbols zu lösen und die Methode idempotent zu machen.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine einfache Enumeration für den Status eines Dokuments (z.B. 'Draft', 'InReview', 'Approved', 'Rejected') und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, um den Status zu setzen und abzurufen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ENUM ... END OF ENUM` für die Enumerationsdefinition und `CLASS-METHODS` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_document_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_document_status,
             draft      VALUE IS INITIAL,
             in_review  VALUE 'R',
             approved   VALUE 'A',
             rejected   VALUE 'X',
           END OF ENUM t_document_status.

    METHODS set_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE t_document_status.

    METHODS get_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE t_document_status.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_status TYPE t_document_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_status.
    mv_current_status = iv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status.
    rv_status = mv_current_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_flow FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_flow.
    DATA(lo_doc) = NEW zcl_document_status( ).

    lo_doc->set_status( zcl_document_status=>t_document_status=>draft ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_doc->get_status( ) exp = zcl_document_status=>t_document_status=>draft ).

    lo_doc->set_status( zcl_document_status=>t_document_status=>approved ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_doc->get_status( ) exp = zcl_document_status=>t_document_status=>approved ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_doc->get_status( )->* exp = 'A' ). " Accessing underlying value
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Enumerationen (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglichen die Definition von semantisch bedeutsamen Konstanten, die den Code lesbarer und typsicherer machen. Anstatt mit 'A', 'R', 'X' zu arbeiten, verwenden wir sprechende Namen wie 'approved', 'rejected'. Dies verbessert die Wartbarkeit und reduziert Fehler.
keywords: ENUMERATION, TYPES, CONSTANTS, STATUS, Object Orientation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem übergebenen Enumerationswert für einen 'Aktionstyp' unterschiedliche String-Beschreibungen zurückgibt, z.B. mit einem `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck für prägnante Fallunterscheidungen basierend auf dem Enumerationswert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_action_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_action_type,
             create_item,
             update_item,
             delete_item,
             view_report,
           END OF ENUM t_action_type.

    METHODS get_action_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_action TYPE t_action_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_action_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_action
      WHEN t_action_type=>create_item THEN 'Neuen Eintrag erstellen'
      WHEN t_action_type=>update_item THEN 'Eintrag aktualisieren'
      WHEN t_action_type=>delete_item THEN 'Eintrag löschen'
      WHEN t_action_type=>view_report THEN 'Bericht anzeigen'
      ELSE 'Unbekannte Aktion' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_action_descriptions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_action_descriptions.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_action_processor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_action_description( zcl_action_processor=>t_action_type=>create_item ) exp = 'Neuen Eintrag erstellen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->get_action_description( zcl_action_processor=>t_action_type=>view_report ) exp = 'Bericht anzeigen' ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Enumerationswert für einen 'Benutzertyp' in einen lesbaren String und umgekehrt. Behandeln Sie dabei auch ungültige Eingaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates für die Konvertierung zu String und `VALUE #` mit `COND` für die umgekehrte Zuweisung, um Fehler abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_user_type_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_user_type,
             admin,
             developer,
             guest,
             support,
           END OF ENUM t_user_type.

    METHODS to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_user_type TYPE t_user_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_user_type) TYPE t_user_type
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_user_type_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_string.
    rv_string = SWITCH #( iv_user_type
      WHEN t_user_type=>admin     THEN 'Administrator'
      WHEN t_user_type=>developer THEN 'Entwickler'
      WHEN t_user_type=>guest     THEN 'Gast'
      WHEN t_user_type=>support   THEN 'Support-Mitarbeiter'
      ELSE THROW cx_sy_conversion_error( text = 'Unbekannter Benutzertyp' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD from_string.
    rv_user_type = VALUE #( LET
      admin_str = to_string( t_user_type=>admin )
      dev_str = to_string( t_user_type=>developer )
      guest_str = to_string( t_user_type=>guest )
      support_str = to_string( t_user_type=>support )
    IN
      COND t_user_type(
        WHEN iv_string = admin_str   THEN t_user_type=>admin
        WHEN iv_string = dev_str     THEN t_user_type=>developer
        WHEN iv_string = guest_str   THEN t_user_type=>guest
        WHEN iv_string = support_str THEN t_user_type=>support
        ELSE THROW cx_sy_conversion_error( text = 'Ungültiger String für Benutzertyp' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Einträge einer internen Tabelle von 'Flügen' (sflights) basierend auf einem simulierten 'Flugstatus' (Enumeration) und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Status.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_flight_status,
             scheduled,
             departed,
             arrived,
             cancelled,
           END OF ENUM t_flight_status.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE t_flight_status,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_count,
             status TYPE t_flight_status,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_status_count.
    TYPES: ty_status_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_counts) TYPE ty_status_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_status.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-status ASCENDING.
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP WHERE ( 1 = 1 ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      APPEND VALUE #( status = ls_flight-status count = lv_count ) TO rt_status_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
