        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: BEGIN OF gs_document,
            id    TYPE string,
            state TYPE t_document_state,
          END OF gs_document.

    METHODS is_valid_transition
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_state TYPE t_document_state
        iv_new_state     TYPE t_document_state
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_valid)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clb_document_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_document_state.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde hier das Dokument aus einer DB geladen
    " und der aktuelle Status ermittelt werden.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir ein Dokument.
    gs_document-id = iv_document_id.
    IF gs_document-state IS INITIAL.
      gs_document-state = t_document_state=>created.
    ENDIF.

    IF is_valid_transition( iv_current_state = gs_document-state iv_new_state = iv_new_state ).
      gs_document-state = iv_new_state.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      " Hier könnte ein Aufruf an CL_CLB_TOOLS erfolgen, um den Status zu aktualisieren
      " oder Benachrichtigungen zu senden.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Ungültiger Statusübergang von { gs_document-state } zu { iv_new_state } für Dokument { iv_document_id }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_valid_transition.
    rv_valid = abap_false.
    CASE iv_current_state.
      WHEN t_document_state=>created.
        IF iv_new_state = t_document_state=>in_edit OR iv_new_state = t_document_state=>archived.
          rv_valid = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN t_document_state=>in_edit.
        IF iv_new_state = t_document_state=>in_review OR iv_new_state = t_document_state=>archived.
          rv_valid = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN t_document_state=>in_review.
        IF iv_new_state = t_document_state=>in_edit OR iv_new_state = t_document_state=>approved OR iv_new_state = t_document_state=>archived.
          rv_valid = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN t_document_state=>approved.
        IF iv_new_state = t_document_state=>published OR iv_new_state = t_document_state=>archived.
          rv_valid = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN t_document_state=>published.
        IF iv_new_state = t_document_state=>archived.
          rv_valid = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN t_document_state=>archived.
        " Keine Übergänge aus dem archivierten Zustand erlaubt
        rv_valid = abap_false.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    rv_name = SWITCH #( iv_weekday
      WHEN t_weekday=>monday    THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN t_weekday=>tuesday   THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN t_weekday=>wednesday THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN t_weekday=>thursday  THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN t_weekday=>friday    THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN t_weekday=>saturday  THEN 'Samstag'

CLASS zcl_user_preferences DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_theme,
             light,
             dark,

           END OF ENUM t_theme.

CLASS zcl_user_preferences IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_theme_preference.
    DATA(lv_index) = ct_preferences[ KEY user_id COMPONENTS user_id = iv_user_id ]-user_id.
    IF line_exists( ct_preferences[ KEY user_id COMPONENTS user_id = iv_user_id ] ).
      ct_preferences[ KEY user_id COMPONENTS user_id = iv_user_id ]-theme = iv_new_theme.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

INTERFACE zif_message_handler PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_message_type,
           info,

         END OF ENUM t_message_type.

CLASS zcl_console_message_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_handler~handle_message.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN zif_message_handler=>t_message_type=>info.

        " oder eine Ausgabe auf der Konsole.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |INFO: { iv_message }| ).
      WHEN zif_message_handler=>t_message_type=>warning.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |WARN: { iv_message }| ).
      WHEN zif_message_handler=>t_message_type=>error.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob ein gegebener String einem gültigen Wert einer Enumeration für 'Benutzerrollen' entspricht.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_ENUM_UTILITIES` und `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` zur dynamischen Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_role_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_user_role,
             admin,
             user,
             auditor,
           END OF ENUM t_user_role.

    METHODS is_valid_role_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_role_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_role_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_role_string.
    DATA(lo_enum_descr) = cl_abap_enum_utilities=>get_enum_type_descr( p_enum_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'ZCL_ROLE_VALIDATOR=>T_USER_ROLE' ) ).
    DATA(lt_enum_names) = lo_enum_descr->get_names( ).

    LOOP AT lt_enum_names INTO DATA(lv_enum_name).
      IF lv_enum_name = iv_role_string.
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_is_valid = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE mt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von einer Zeichenkodierung in eine andere (z.B. von UTF-8 nach ISO-8859-1 und zurück) unter Verwendung von 'cl_abap_char_utilities'.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden 'char_cp_to_byte_cp' und 'byte_cp_to_char_cp'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_cp_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_iso IMPORTING iv_utf8_string TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string.
    METHODS convert_iso_to_utf8 IMPORTING iv_iso_string TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_cp_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Convert UTF-8 string to XSTRING (UTF-8 byte representation)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_utf8_string
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Convert XSTRING (UTF-8) to XSTRING (ISO-8859-1)
    lv_xstring = cl_abap_char_utilities=>char_cp_to_byte_cp( 
                   byte_cp = cl_abap_char_utilities=>co_cp_iso_8859_1 
                   char_cp = cl_abap_char_utilities=>co_cp_utf8 
                   xstring = lv_xstring ).

    " Convert XSTRING (ISO-8859-1) to string
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING'
      EXPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring
        encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        text     = rv_iso_string
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_iso_to_utf8.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Convert ISO-8859-1 string to XSTRING (ISO-8859-1 byte representation)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_iso_string
        encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Convert XSTRING (ISO-8859-1) to XSTRING (UTF-8)
    lv_xstring = cl_abap_char_utilities=>byte_cp_to_char_cp( 
                   byte_cp = cl_abap_char_utilities=>co_cp_iso_8859_1 
                   char_cp = cl_abap_char_utilities=>co_cp_utf8 
                   xstring = lv_xstring ).

    " Convert XSTRING (UTF-8) to string
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING'
      EXPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        text     = rv_utf8_string
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_cp_conversion( ).
    DATA(lv_original_utf8) = 'Hallo Welt mit Umlauten: äöüß'.

    DATA(lv_iso_string) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_iso( lv_original_utf8 ).
    DATA(lv_converted_back_utf8) = lo_cut->convert_iso_to_utf8( lv_iso_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_back_utf8 exp = lv_original_utf8 msg = 'UTF-8 to ISO-8859-1 and back conversion failed' ).

    " Test with a string that might cause issues if not handled correctly
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Test €uro Symbol'. " Euro symbol is multi-byte in UTF-8, single-byte in some ISO variants (but not 8859-1)
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_iso_euro) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_iso( lv_test_string ).
        DATA(lv_utf8_euro) = lo_cut->convert_iso_to_utf8( lv_iso_euro ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_utf8_euro exp = lv_test_string msg = 'Euro symbol conversion failed' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        " Expected if Euro symbol cannot be represented in ISO-8859-1
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Test passes if exception is caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden 'char_cp_to_byte_cp' und 'byte_cp_to_char_cp' der Klasse 'cl_abap_char_utilities' sind essenziell für die korrekte Handhabung von Zeichenkodierungen in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen die Konvertierung von XSTRING-Daten zwischen verschiedenen Code Pages. Dies ist besonders wichtig beim Austausch von Daten mit externen Systemen oder Dateien, die unterschiedliche Kodierungen verwenden, um Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten. Die Verwendung von Funktionsbausteinen wie 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING' und 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING' ist oft notwendig, um zwischen STRING und XSTRING zu wechseln.
keywords: cl_abap_char_utilities, Character Encoding, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, Code Page, XSTRING

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String nur gültige Zeichen für eine bestimmte Zeichenkodierung (z.B. UTF-8) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode 'check_string_valid'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_string_valid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_string_valid_utf8 IMPORTING iv_string TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_string_valid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_string_valid_utf8.
    rv_is_valid = cl_abap_char_utilities=>check_string_valid( 
                    string   = iv_string
                    encoding = cl_abap_char_utilities=>co_cp_utf8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_string_valid( ).
    DATA(lv_valid_string) = 'Valid UTF-8 String äöüß'.
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->is_string_valid_utf8( lv_valid_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_valid msg = 'Valid string reported as invalid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_string_valid( ).
    " Create an invalid UTF-8 sequence (e.g., a lone continuation byte)
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) TYPE xstring VALUE 'C328'. " C3 is start of 2-byte sequence, 28 is not a valid continuation byte
    DATA(lv_invalid_string) TYPE string.
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING'
      EXPORTING
        buffer   = lv_invalid_xstring
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        text     = lv_invalid_string
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " If conversion itself fails, we can't test check_string_valid with this specific invalid string
      " For robust testing, one might need to manually craft a string with invalid characters
      " or use a known invalid sequence that ABAP can represent as a string.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Skip if cannot create invalid string
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->is_string_valid_utf8( lv_invalid_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_valid msg = 'Invalid string reported as valid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode 'check_string_valid' der Klasse 'cl_abap_char_utilities' ist ein wichtiges Werkzeug zur Validierung von Strings. Sie überprüft, ob alle Zeichen in einem String für die angegebene Zeichenkodierung gültig sind. Dies ist entscheidend, um Fehler bei der Datenverarbeitung zu vermeiden, insbesondere wenn Strings aus externen Quellen stammen oder in andere Systeme übertragen werden sollen.
keywords: cl_abap_char_utilities, String Validation, UTF-8, Character Set

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Zeichenlänge und die Bytelänge eines Strings, der Multibyte-Zeichen enthalten kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden 'char_length' und 'byte_length'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_length_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_string_lengths IMPORTING iv_string TYPE string
                               RETURNING VALUE(rs_lengths) TYPE ty_string_lengths.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_string_lengths,
             char_len TYPE i,
             byte_len TYPE i,
           END OF ty_string_lengths.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_length_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_string_lengths.
    rs_lengths-char_len = cl_abap_char_utilities=>char_length( iv_string ).
    rs_lengths-byte_len = cl_abap_char_utilities=>byte_length( iv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_ascii_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multibyte_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ascii_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_length_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(ls_lengths) = lo_cut->get_string_lengths( lv_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lengths-char_len exp = 11 msg = 'ASCII char length mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lengths-byte_len exp = 11 msg = 'ASCII byte length mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multibyte_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_length_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Hallo Welt mit Umlauten: äöüß€'. " ä, ö, ü, ß, € are multi-byte in UTF-8
    DATA(ls_lengths) = lo_cut->get_string_lengths( lv_string ).

    " Expected character length: 29 (24 + 5 special chars)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lengths-char_len exp = 29 msg = 'Multibyte char length mismatch' ).
    " Expected byte length: 24 (ASCII) + 4*2 (äöüß) + 1*3 (€) = 24 + 8 + 3 = 35
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lengths-byte_len exp = 35 msg = 'Multibyte byte length mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_length_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = ''.
    DATA(ls_lengths) = lo_cut->get_string_lengths( lv_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lengths-char_len exp = 0 msg = 'Empty string char length mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lengths-byte_len exp = 0 msg = 'Empty string byte length mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden 'char_length' und 'byte_length' der Klasse 'cl_abap_char_utilities' sind unerlässlich für die präzise Messung der Länge von Strings, insbesondere in Unicode-Systemen. 'char_length' gibt die Anzahl der sichtbaren Zeichen zurück, während 'byte_length' die tatsächliche Anzahl der Bytes im Speicher angibt. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte String-Manipulation, die Berechnung von Speicherplatz und die Einhaltung von Längenbeschränkungen, besonders bei der Verarbeitung von Multibyte-Zeichen.
keywords: cl_abap_char_utilities, String Length, Byte Length, Unicode, Multibyte

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein einzelnes Zeichen eine Ziffer ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode 'is_digit'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_is_digit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_is_digit_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_is_digit_false FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_digit_true.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_is_digit( ).
    DATA(lv_is_digit) = lo_cut->check_if_digit( '5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_digit msg = 'Digit 5 not recognized as digit' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_digit_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_is_digit( ).
    DATA(lv_is_digit) = lo_cut->check_if_digit( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_digit msg = 'Character A recognized as digit' ).
    lv_is_digit = lo_cut->check_if_digit( '-' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_digit msg = 'Character - recognized as digit' ).
    lv_is_digit = lo_cut->check_if_digit( ' ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_digit msg = 'Space recognized as digit' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode 'is_digit' der Klasse 'cl_abap_char_utilities' bietet eine einfache und zuverlässige Möglichkeit, zu überprüfen, ob ein einzelnes Zeichen eine numerische Ziffer ist. Dies ist nützlich für grundlegende Validierungen von Benutzereingaben oder bei der Analyse von Zeichenketten, um sicherzustellen, dass bestimmte Teile nur Ziffern enthalten.
keywords: cl_abap_char_utilities, is_digit, Character Validation, String Processing

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in Großbuchstaben und Kleinbuchstaben unter Verwendung von 'cl_abap_char_utilities' (obwohl 'TO UPPER'/'TO LOWER' bevorzugt werden).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_to_upper FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_to_lower FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_case FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD test_to_upper.
      DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_case_conversion( ).
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->to_upper( 'hello world' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELLO WORLD' msg = 'To upper conversion failed' ).
      lv_result = lo_cut->to_upper( 'ÄÖÜß' ).

    ENDMETHOD.

    METHOD test_to_lower.
      DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_case_conversion( ).
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->to_lower( 'HELLO WORLD' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'hello world' msg = 'To lower conversion failed' ).
      lv_result = lo_cut->to_lower( 'ÄÖÜSS' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'äöüss' msg = 'To lower conversion with umlauts failed' ).
    ENDMETHOD.

    METHOD test_mixed_case.
      DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_case_conversion( ).
      DATA(lv_mixed) = 'AbAp PrOgRaMmInG äÖüß'.
      DATA(lv_upper) = lo_cut->to_upper( lv_mixed ).
      DATA(lv_lower) = lo_cut->to_lower( lv_mixed ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_upper exp = 'ABAP PROGRAMMING ÄÖÜSS' msg = 'Mixed case to upper failed' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lower exp = 'abap programming äöüss' msg = 'Mixed case to lower failed' ).
    ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden 'convert_to_upper' und 'convert_to_lower' der Klasse 'cl_abap_char_utilities' ermöglichen die Umwandlung von Strings in Groß- bzw. Kleinbuchstaben. Obwohl in modernen ABAP-Versionen oft die direkten Operatoren 'TO UPPER' und 'TO LOWER' bevorzugt werden, bieten diese Methoden eine alternative Möglichkeit, insbesondere wenn eine explizite Klassenmethode gewünscht wird oder in älteren Kontexten. Sie sind nützlich für die Normalisierung von Textdaten und Vergleichen.
keywords: cl_abap_char_utilities, String Processing, Case Conversion, TO UPPER, TO LOWER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Hashed Table, indem Sie eine bestehende Hashed Table von Flugdaten (sflights) transformieren und dabei nur bestimmte Felder übernehmen und umbenennen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine 'FOR' Expression mit 'CORRESPONDING' oder manueller Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             ticket_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY airline_id flight_num.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
                             ( airline_id   = ls_flight-carrid
                               flight_num   = ls_flight-connid
                               flight_date  = ls_flight-fldate
                               ticket_price = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_transform=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0026' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_transform( lt_test_flights ).

    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summaries ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of summaries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_summaries WITH TABLE KEY airline_id = 'LH' flight_num = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_summary_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh-ticket_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'LH summary price mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh-flight_date exp = '20250101' msg = 'LH summary date mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_summaries WITH TABLE KEY airline_id = 'SQ' flight_num = '0026' INTO DATA(ls_summary_sq).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_sq-ticket_price exp = '250.00' msg = 'SQ summary price mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table_transform.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_transform=>tt_sflight_hashed( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_transform( lt_test_flights ).

    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_summaries ) msg = 'Empty table transformation should result in empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die 'FOR' Expression (ab ABAP 7.40) in Kombination mit dem 'VALUE #' Operator ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier wird eine neue Hashed Table erstellt, indem über die Zeilen der Quelltabelle iteriert und für jede Zeile ein neues Struktur-Literal mit den gewünschten Feldern und Umbenennungen erzeugt wird. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit APPEND-Anweisungen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` in Kombination mit `@DATA` und `INTO TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_fetch_top DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_limit  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fetch_top IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO @iv_limit ROWS
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_fetch_top( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_limit = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Flüge zurückgegeben werden.' ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Der erste Flug sollte von LH sein.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` Syntax ist die moderne und effiziente Art, eine begrenzte Anzahl von Zeilen aus der Datenbank abzurufen. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`@DATA`) und Hostvariablen (`@iv_limit`, `@iv_carrid`) macht den Code kompakt und lesbar.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, SELECT, UP TO N ROWS, Database, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Holen Sie die nächsten 3 Flüge von 'AA' (American Airlines) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, beginnend nach einem bestimmten Flugdatum. Simulieren Sie eine Paginierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... ORDER BY ... UP TO N ROWS` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel für das Startdatum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_fetch_next DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_next_page_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_start_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_limit    TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fetch_next IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_page_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO @iv_limit ROWS
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND fldate > @iv_start_date
      ORDER BY fldate ASC, connid ASC.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_next_page FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_next_page.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_fetch_next( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '19900101'. "Ein frühes Datum, um Ergebnisse zu erhalten

    DATA(lt_flights_page1) = lo_cut->get_next_page_flights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_limit = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_page1 ) exp = 2 msg = 'Seite 1 sollte 2 Flüge enthalten.' ).

    IF lines( lt_flights_page1 ) = 2.
      DATA(lv_last_fldate_page1) = lt_flights_page1[ 2 ]-fldate.
      DATA(lt_flights_page2) = lo_cut->get_next_page_flights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_start_date = lv_last_fldate_page1 iv_limit = 2 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_than( act = 0 exp = lines( lt_flights_page2 ) msg = 'Seite 2 sollte Flüge enthalten (wenn vorhanden).' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine einfache Paginierung, indem es `UP TO N ROWS` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel kombiniert, die auf dem Datum des letzten abgerufenen Eintrags basiert. `ORDER BY` ist entscheidend, um konsistente Ergebnisse über Seiten hinweg zu gewährleisten.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, Paging, SELECT, ORDER BY, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie die ersten 3 Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... FROM ... TO ...` für eine funktionale Extraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_fetch_first_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_all_data TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_limit    TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_fetch_first_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_entries.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_limit AND i <= lines( it_all_data ) FROM it_all_data[ i ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_n FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_n.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_it_fetch_first_n=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Flight A' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Flight B' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'Flight C' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 name = 'Flight D' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_fetch_first_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_first_n_entries( it_all_data = lt_test_data iv_limit = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge zurückgegeben werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'Der erste Eintrag sollte ID 1 haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 msg = 'Der zweite Eintrag sollte ID 2 haben.' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_first_n_entries( it_all_data = lt_test_data iv_limit = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 msg = 'Es sollten alle 4 Einträge zurückgegeben werden.' ).
  METHOD test_get_first_n.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_it_fetch_first_n=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Flight A' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Flight B' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'Flight C' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 name = 'Flight D' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_fetch_first_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_first_n_entries( it_all_data = lt_test_data iv_limit = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge zurückgegeben werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'Der erste Eintrag sollte ID 1 haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 msg = 'Der zweite Eintrag sollte ID 2 haben.' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_first_n_entries( it_all_data = lt_test_data iv_limit = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 msg = 'Es sollten alle 4 Einträge zurückgegeben werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #( FOR ... FROM ... TO ... )` Syntax ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Extraktion eines Teilbereichs einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` Schleifen mit Zählern.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, Slice

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach einem bestimmten Flugdatum und holen Sie dann die ersten 2 Einträge der gefilterten Liste.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Filterung und anschließend `FOR ... FROM ... TO ...` für die Begrenzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_and_limited
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_limit       TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_limited.
    DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE fldate = iv_fldate ).
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_limit AND i <= lines( lt_filtered ) FROM lt_filtered[ i ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_limit FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_limit.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_it_filter_fetch=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = '20251121' price = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20251122' price = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' fldate = '20251121' price = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '004' fldate = '20251121' price = 120 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '005' fldate = '20251123' price = 300 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_fetch( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_limited( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_fldate = '20251121' iv_limit = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 gefilterte Einträge zurückgegeben werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' msg = 'Der erste Flug sollte ConnID 001 haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '003' msg = 'Der zweite Flug sollte ConnID 003 haben.' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_limited( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_fldate = '20251123' iv_limit = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Es sollte 1 gefilterter Eintrag zurückgegeben werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die funktionale Filterung einer internen Tabelle mittels `FILTER` mit der anschließenden Begrenzung der Ergebnisse durch eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `FROM` und `TO`. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und moderne Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu manipulieren.

Instructions: Holen Sie die ersten 5 eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die Flüge mit einem Preis über 1000 anbieten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT DISTINCT ... UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_fetch_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fetch_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `SELECT DISTINCT` und `UP TO N ROWS` ermöglicht es, eine begrenzte Anzahl von eindeutigen Werten direkt aus der Datenbank abzurufen. Dies ist effizienter, als alle Daten zu holen und dann in ABAP zu filtern.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis für eine bestimmte Anzahl von Sitzen, indem Sie den Sitzpreis mit der Anzahl der Sitze multiplizieren.

CLASS zcl_math_multiply_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

unit_test:

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_seat_price = '100.00' iv_num_seats = 5 ).

keywords: MULTIPLY, Math, Arithmetic, Price Calculation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtwert aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, indem Sie den Preis jedes Fluges mit der Anzahl der belegten Sitze multiplizieren und die Ergebnisse summieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_multiply_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_calc,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_calc,
           tt_sflight_calc TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_calc WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_value
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_calc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_value) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_multiply_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_value.
    rv_total_value = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ) )
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ( flight-price * flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_value.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_math_multiply_reduce=>tt_sflight_calc.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' price = '100.00' seatsocc = 5 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' price = '200.00' seatsocc = 2 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' price = '50.00' seatsocc = 10 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_multiply_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_value( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    " Erwartung: (100*5) + (200*2) + (50*10) = 500 + 400 + 500 = 1400
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '1400.00' msg = 'Der Gesamtwert sollte 1400 sein.' ).

    CLEAR lt_test_flights.
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_total_value( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.00' msg = 'Der Gesamtwert für eine leere Tabelle sollte 0 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Konstrukt in modernem ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren. Hier wird sie verwendet, um über die Flüge zu iterieren, den Wert jedes Fluges zu berechnen (Preis * belegte Sitze) und diese Werte zu summieren.
keywords: MULTIPLY, REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Wenden Sie einen Rabattprozentsatz auf den Preis jedes Fluges in einer internen Tabelle an und geben Sie die aktualisierte Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE` und Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_multiply_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price,
           tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS apply_discount
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_price
        iv_discount_pct TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 " z.B. 0.10 für 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_multiply_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_discount.
    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                     ( flight-carrid = flight-carrid
                                       flight-connid = flight-connid
                                       price         = flight-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_pct ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_apply_discount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_apply_discount.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_math_multiply_for=>tt_sflight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' price = '250.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_multiply_for( ).
    DATA(lv_discount_10_pct) = '0.10'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->apply_discount( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_discount_pct = lv_discount_10_pct ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der Flüge sollte gleich bleiben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '90.00' msg = '100 mit 10% Rabatt sollte 90 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '225.00' msg = '250 mit 10% Rabatt sollte 225 sein.' ).

    DATA(lv_discount_20_pct) = '0.20'.
    lt_result = lo_cut->apply_discount( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_discount_pct = lv_discount_20_pct ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '80.00' msg = '100 mit 20% Rabatt sollte 80 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... IN ...` Schleife innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Konstruktion ermöglicht die Transformation jedes Eintrags einer internen Tabelle. Hier wird der Preis jedes Fluges direkt mit dem Rabattfaktor multipliziert, um eine neue Tabelle mit den rabattierten Preisen zu erstellen. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und lesbare Methode.
keywords: MULTIPLY, FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Transformation, Discount

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gewichteten Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, wobei der Preis jedes Fluges mit der Anzahl der belegten Sitze multipliziert wird, bevor der Durchschnitt gebildet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in `SELECT` und anschließend `REDUCE` oder eine Schleife für die gewichtete Summe und Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_multiply_weighted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_value TYPE sflight-price,
             total_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_agg,
           tt_flight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_avg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_weighted_avg,
           tt_weighted_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_avg_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_weighted_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_multiply_weighted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_avg_price.
    DATA: lt_aggregated_data TYPE tt_flight_agg.

    " Aggregieren der Daten: Summe (Preis * Sitze) und Summe (Sitze) pro Fluggesellschaft
    SELECT carrid, SUM( price * seatsocc ) AS total_value, SUM( seatsocc ) AS total_seats
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_aggregated_data
      GROUP BY carrid.

    " Berechnung des gewichteten Durchschnitts
    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR flight_agg IN lt_aggregated_data
                                 LET lv_avg = COND sflight-price( WHEN flight_agg-total_seats > 0
                                                                  THEN flight_agg-total_value / flight_agg-total_seats
                                                                  ELSE '0.00' ) IN
                                 ( carrid    = flight_agg-carrid
                                   avg_price = lv_avg ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weighted_avg_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weighted_avg_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_multiply_weighted( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_weighted_avg_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lt_avg_prices IS NOT INITIAL ) msg = 'Es sollten gewichtete Durchschnittspreise gefunden werden.' ).

    " Beispiel: Wenn LH Flüge mit (100, 5 Sitze) und (200, 2 Sitze) hat
    " Gewichteter Durchschnitt: (100*5 + 200*2) / (5+2) = (500 + 400) / 7 = 900 / 7 = 128.57
    DATA(ls_lh_avg) = lt_avg_prices[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    IF ls_lh_avg IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_avg-avg_price exp = '128.57' decimals = 2 msg = 'Gewichteter Durchschnitt für LH sollte korrekt sein.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Aggregation. Zuerst werden die Daten in der Datenbank mit `SUM( price * seatsocc )` und `SUM( seatsocc )` pro Fluggesellschaft voraggregiert. Anschließend wird in ABAP der gewichtete Durchschnitt berechnet, wobei `VALUE #( FOR ... LET ... IN ... )` für die funktionale Transformation und bedingte Zuweisung (`COND`) verwendet wird, um Division durch Null zu vermeiden.
keywords: MULTIPLY, GROUP BY, SELECT, REDUCE, Weighted Average, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->convert_km_to_miles( iv_distance_km = '100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = '62.1371' decimals = 4 msg = '100 km sollte 62.1371 Meilen sein.' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->convert_km_to_miles( iv_distance_km = '10' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in einer internen Tabelle den potenziellen Umsatz, wenn alle freien Sitze zum aktuellen Preis verkauft würden. Multiplizieren Sie dazu den Preis mit der Anzahl der freien Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE` und Multiplikation, um eine neue Tabelle mit dem potenziellen Umsatz zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_multiply_potential DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             seatsfree  TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
             potential_revenue TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext,
           tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_potential_revenue
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_ext
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_revenue) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_multiply_potential IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_potential_revenue.
    rt_flights_with_revenue = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                       ( flight-carrid = flight-carrid
                                         flight-connid = flight-connid
                                         flight-price  = flight-price
                                         flight-seatsfree = flight-seatsfree
                                         potential_revenue = flight-price * flight-seatsfree ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und den Multiplikationsoperator für die Quadratberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_multiply_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_of_squares) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_multiply_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-price WITH EMPTY KEY
      FOR flight IN SELECT price FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ( flight-price ).

    rv_sum_of_squares = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ) )
                                FOR price_val IN lt_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ( price_val * price_val ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    " Annahme: SFLIGHTS enthält für 'LH' Flüge mit Preisen 100 und 200
    " Summe der Quadrate: 100*100 + 200*200 = 10000 + 40000 = 50000

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_multiply_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    " Dieser Test hängt von den tatsächlichen Daten in SFLIGHTS ab.
    " Für einen robusten Test müsste man Testdaten in SFLIGHTS einfügen oder mocken.
    " Hier wird ein erwarteter Wert angenommen, der in einer typischen SFLIGHTS-Installation vorkommen könnte.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '50000.00' decimals = 2 msg = 'Summe der Quadrate für LH sollte 50000 sein (Beispielwert).' ).

    DATA(lv_result_no_data) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_no_data exp = '0.00' msg = 'Summe der Quadrate für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft sollte 0 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung der Summe der Quadrate von Werten. Zuerst werden die Preise der relevanten Flüge in eine interne Tabelle geladen. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um über diese Preise zu iterieren, jeden Preis mit sich selbst zu multiplizieren (quadrieren) und die Ergebnisse zu summieren. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität von `REDUCE` für komplexe Aggregationen.
keywords: MULTIPLY, REDUCE, Math, Squares, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflights_report.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_worksheet( 'SFLIGHTS Data' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).

    " Add data rows
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen von Daten aus einem XLSX-Dokument und extrahieren Sie die Werte einer bestimmten Spalte. Da `cl_xlsx_document` primär zum Schreiben ist, wird hier ein konzeptioneller Ansatz für das Lesen demonstriert.
hint: Für echtes Lesen wäre `cl_xlsx_reader` oder ähnliches nötig. Hier wird die Logik des Extrahierens nach dem Laden simuliert. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_concept DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_excel_row.
    TYPES tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_column_data
      IMPORTING
        it_excel_data TYPE tt_excel_data
        iv_column_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_concept IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_column_data.
    " In a real scenario, it_excel_data would be populated by parsing an XLSX file.
    " This example focuses on extracting a specific column using modern ABAP.
    rt_column_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_row IN it_excel_data
                                ( COND string( WHEN iv_column_index = 1 THEN ls_row-col1
                                               WHEN iv_column_index = 2 THEN ls_row-col2
                                               WHEN iv_column_index = 3 THEN ls_row-col3
                                               ELSE '' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_read_column FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_column.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_read_concept( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_xlsx_read_concept=>tt_excel_data(
      ( col1 = 'A1' col2 = 'B1' col3 = 'C1' )
      ( col1 = 'A2' col2 = 'B2' col3 = 'C2' )
      ( col1 = 'A3' col2 = 'B3' col3 = 'C3' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_col2_values) = lo_cut->read_column_data( it_excel_data = lt_test_data iv_column_index = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_col2_values ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_col2_values[ 1 ] exp = 'B1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_col2_values[ 2 ] exp = 'B2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_col2_values[ 3 ] exp = 'B3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument aus einer verschachtelten Datenstruktur (z.B. Fluggesellschaften mit ihren Flügen). Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Konstrukte zur Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` um die verschachtelten Daten zu verarbeiten und in das XLSX zu schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_nested_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             flights  TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_nested_report
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_flights TYPE tt_carrier_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_nested_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_nested_report.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_worksheet( 'Carrier Flights' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    LOOP AT it_carrier_flights INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      " Carrier Name
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier:' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_carrier-carrname ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.

      " Flight Header
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'FLDATE' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.

      " Flights
      LOOP AT ls_carrier-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_flight-price ).
        lv_row = lv_row + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1. " Add an empty row for separation
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    DATA(lv_language) TYPE sy-langu.

    TRY.
        lv_language = lo_props_consumer->get_property( cl_gui_props_consumer=>c_property_language ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        lv_language = 'E'. " Fallback to English for non-GUI context
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_worksheet( 'Filtered SFLIGHTS' ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'CURRENCY' ).

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    " Filter flights based on language (simplified: e.g., show only specific currencies for a language)
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE currency = COND string( WHEN lv_language = 'D' THEN 'EUR'
                                                                                                        WHEN lv_language = 'E' THEN 'USD'
                                                                                                        ELSE 'USD' ) ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen XLSX-Report, der aggregierte Daten (z.B. die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft) aus `SFLIGHTS` enthält. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Daten zu aggregieren und `cl_xlsx_document` für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_reduce_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS generate_aggregated_report
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_reduce_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_aggregated_report.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_carrier_total(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_total( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) IN
      NEXT result = COND tt_carrier_total(
        WHEN lv_index IS NOT INITIAL THEN
          VALUE tt_carrier_total( FOR ls_res IN result
                                  ( COND ty_carrier_total( WHEN ls_res-carrid = ls_flight-carrid THEN
                                                              VALUE ty_carrier_total( carrid = ls_res-carrid
                                                                                      total_price = ls_res-total_price + ls_flight-price )
                                                          ELSE ls_res ) ) )
        ELSE
          VALUE tt_carrier_total( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = ls_flight-price ) )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_worksheet( 'Aggregated Prices' ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'TOTAL PRICE' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_agg_data-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_agg_data-total_price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument, dessen Spalten dynamisch zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen bestimmt werden. Nutzen Sie RTTI für die Datenextraktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_datadescr` für RTTI und `cl_xlsx_document` für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_dynamic_report
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_report.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_worksheet( 'Dynamic SFLIGHTS' ).

    " Add header row dynamically
    DATA(lv_col_idx) = 1.
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = lv_field_name ).
      lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_col_idx = 1.
      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_value> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = CONV string( <lv_value> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die sich als 'Consumer' für GUI-Eigenschaften registriert und bei Änderungen einer bestimmten Eigenschaft (simuliert) eine Methode aufruft. Nutzen Sie Interfaces und Event-Handling-Konzepte.
hint: Obwohl `cl_gui_props_consumer` selbst keine direkten Events für Änderungen bietet, kann man das Konzept eines 'Property Change Listeners' mit einem eigenen Interface und Event simulieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_property_change_listener PUBLIC.
  METHODS on_property_changed
    IMPORTING
      iv_property_name TYPE string
      iv_new_value     TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_property_change_listener.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_props_consumer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_props_consumer.

    METHODS simulate_property_change
      IMPORTING
        iv_property_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_props_consumer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_props_consumer.
    EVENTS property_changed EXPORTING PARAMETERS iv_property_name TYPE string iv_new_value TYPE string.

    METHODS handle_property_changed FOR EVENT property_changed OF zcl_gui_event_consumer
      IMPORTING
        iv_property_name
        iv_new_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_props_consumer = io_props_consumer.
    SET HANDLER handle_property_changed FOR ME.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_property_change.
    " In a real scenario, this would be triggered by the GUI framework.
    " Here, we simulate it to demonstrate the event handling.
    RAISE EVENT property_changed EXPORTING iv_property_name = iv_property_name iv_new_value = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_property_change_listener~on_property_changed.
    " This method is called when the event is handled.
    " Implement specific logic here.
    MESSAGE |Property '{ iv_property_name }' changed to '{ iv_new_value }'.| TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_property_changed.
    " Delegate to the interface method
    zif_property_change_listener~on_property_changed( iv_property_name = iv_property_name iv_new_value = iv_new_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_event_consumer->simulate_property_change( iv_property_name = 'LANGUAGE' iv_new_value = 'ES' ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->add_new_worksheet( 'SFLIGHTS with Labels' ).

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Get field descriptions for header
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights )->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lv_col_idx) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = ls_component-astext ).
      lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_col_idx = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_value> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = CONV string( <lv_value> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine bestimmte GUI-Eigenschaft gesetzt ist und geben Sie einen entsprechenden Status zurück. Nutzen Sie `OPTIONAL` Parameter für Methodenaufrufe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_props_consumer->get_property` und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass die Eigenschaft nicht existiert oder leer ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_check_property DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_property_set
      IMPORTING
        iv_property_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_set) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_check_property IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_property_set.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    DATA(lv_property_value) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_property_value = lo_props_consumer->get_property( iv_property_name ).
        IF lv_property_value IS NOT INITIAL.
          rv_is_set = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_set = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Property not found or other GUI error
        rv_is_set = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_property_is_set FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_property_is_not_set FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_property_is_set.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_check_property( ).
    " Assuming 'LANGUAGE' is always set in a GUI context or has a fallback
    DATA(lv_is_set) = lo_cut->is_property_set( cl_gui_props_consumer=>c_property_language ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_set exp = abap_true msg = 'Language property should be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_property_is_not_set.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_check_property( ).
    " Assuming 'NON_EXISTENT_PROPERTY' is not a valid GUI property
    DATA(lv_is_set) = lo_cut->is_property_set( 'NON_EXISTENT_PROPERTY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_set exp = abap_false msg = 'Non-existent property should not be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `cl_gui_props_consumer->get_property` überprüft, ob eine bestimmte GUI-Eigenschaft gesetzt ist. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` fängt Ausnahmen ab, wenn die Eigenschaft nicht existiert oder ein GUI-Fehler auftritt, und liefert einen klaren Status zurück.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DATA_PROVIDER` mit einer privaten Methode. Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_DATA_CONSUMER`, das als Freund von `ZCL_DATA_PROVIDER` deklariert wird.     INTERFACES zif_data_consumer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_consumer_impl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_consumer~consume_data.
    " Accessing private method of zcl_data_provider via friend interface
    rv_data = io_provider->_get_internal_value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    FRIENDS zcl_counter_util. " Grant access to utility class
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_utility.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW zcl_data_container( ).
    DATA(lo_util) = NEW zcl_counter_util( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_container->get_counter_value( ) exp = 0 msg = 'Initial counter wrong' ).

    lo_util->perform_increment( lo_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_container->get_counter_value( ) exp = 1 msg = 'Counter after 1st increment wrong' ).

    lo_util->perform_increment( lo_container ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in ein CSV-Format als XSTRING.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_csv,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_csv.
    TYPES tt_sflight_csv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_csv WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight RETURNING VALUE(rx_csv_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lt_sflight_csv TYPE tt_sflight_csv.

    " Populate a simplified structure for CSV
    FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights.
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_csv( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                   connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                   fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate ) TO lt_sflight_csv.
    ENDFOR.

    " Build CSV header
    lv_csv_string = 'Carrid;Connid;Fldate' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Build CSV data
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_csv INTO DATA(ls_sflight_csv).
      lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string && |{ ls_sflight_csv-carrid };{ ls_sflight_csv-connid };{ ls_sflight_csv-fldate DATE = ENVIRONMENT->DATE TIME = ENVIRONMENT->TIME }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Convert string to XSTRING
    rx_csv_data = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( iv_string   = lv_csv_string
                                                     iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
                                                     iv_endian   = 'B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_csv_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_csv_conversion.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der gebuchten Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators mit `SUM`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen. Der `SUM`-Operator kann direkt im `REDUCE` verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sum_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_lh_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sum_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_lh_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_pass = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum_pass = sum_pass + flight-bookedoccupancy
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_lh_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_sum_passengers( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_lh_passengers( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt LH-Flüge in SFLIGHT. Ein genauer Wert hängt von den Testdaten ab.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob das Ergebnis größer oder gleich 0 ist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_result >= 0 ) msg = 'Total passengers should be non-negative' ).

    " Für einen spezifischeren Test, wenn die Daten bekannt sind:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = <expected_value> ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Er ist kompakt und vermeidet explizite Schleifen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert den Akkumulator, und die `NEXT`-Klausel definiert die Aggregationslogik.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten verarbeitet und eine Warnmeldung im Application Log (BAL) protokolliert, wenn die gebuchte Auslastung eines Fluges die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität überschreitet. Verwenden Sie `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG` und deren Methode `ADD_MSG` oder `ADD_MSG_FROM_EXCEPTION` zur Protokollierung von Nachrichten im Application Log.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_log_overbooking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookedoccupancy TYPE sflight-bookedoccupancy,
             seatsmax      TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS check_and_log_overbooking
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_log_overbooking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_log_overbooking.
    DATA: lo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_bal_log.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-bookedoccupancy > ls_flight-seatsmax.
        lo_bal_log->add_msg(
          i_msgty = 'W' " Warning
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' " Example message class
          i_msgno = '001' " Example message number
          i_msgv1 = ls_flight-carrid
          i_msgv2 = ls_flight-connid
          i_msgv3 = ls_flight-fldate
          i_msgv4 = |Überbuchung: { ls_flight-bookedoccupancy } > { ls_flight-seatsmax }|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Optional: Speichern des Logs, um es später anzuzeigen
    " lo_bal_log->save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_overbooking_logging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_overbooking_logging.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_log_overbooking=>ty_flight_data_tt.

    " Testfall 1: Überbuchter Flug
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookedoccupancy = 160 seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    " Testfall 2: Nicht überbuchter Flug
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' bookedoccupancy = 100 seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_log_overbooking( ).

    " Da CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG direkt in den BAL schreibt, ist ein direkter Assert auf die BAL-Einträge komplex.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob die Methode ohne Fehler durchläuft.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG mocken oder eine Methode in zcl_flight_log_overbooking
    " implementieren, die die Anzahl der hinzugefügten Nachrichten zurückgibt.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_and_log_overbooking( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true msg = 'Method should execute without dump' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG` bietet eine standardisierte Schnittstelle zum Schreiben von Nachrichten in das Application Log (BAL). Dies ist entscheidend für die Nachvollziehbarkeit und Fehlerbehebung in komplexen Anwendungen. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) für die Formatierung der Nachricht ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: CL_S_AUT_BAL_LOG, Application Log, BAL, Error Handling, Logging, String Templates

             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_free_seats,
           tt_free_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_free_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_free_seats_per_flight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_free_seats) TYPE tt_free_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_free_seats_per_flight.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax, bookedoccupancy
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_free_seats = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                                  connid    = flight-connid
                                  free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-bookedoccupancy ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
