Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Voll', 'Fast voll', 'Verfügbar') basierend auf der Auslastung. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen in einem einzigen Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING iv_booked_occupancy TYPE sflight-bookedoccupancy
                iv_seats_max      TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status)    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA lv_occupancy_percentage TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

    IF iv_seats_max > 0.
      lv_occupancy_percentage = ( iv_booked_occupancy * 100 ) / iv_seats_max.
    ELSE.
      lv_occupancy_percentage = 0.
    ENDIF.

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 95 THEN 'Voll'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 70 THEN 'Fast voll'
      ELSE 'Verfügbar'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_booked_occupancy = 95 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'Voll' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_booked_occupancy = 75 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'Fast voll' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_booked_occupancy = 50 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'Verfügbar' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_booked_occupancy = 0 iv_seats_max = 0 ) exp = 'Verfügbar' ). " Edge case
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen, wenn ein Wert basierend auf Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Er verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes erheblich, insbesondere bei mehreren Fallunterscheidungen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, IF, Status

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle mit Flugdetails in eine andere Struktur, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der gebuchten Passagiere enthält, wobei die Feldnamen unterschiedlich sein können. Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
hint: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator mit `MAPPING` oder `EXCEPT` ist ideal für die flexible Datenübertragung zwischen Strukturen/Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrier_id      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_number   TYPE sflight-connid,
             booking_count   TYPE sflight-bookedoccupancy,
             max_seats       TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_source_flight,
           tt_source_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_summary,
             airline_id      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_booked    TYPE sflight-bookedoccupancy,
           END OF ty_target_summary,
           tt_target_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_data
      IMPORTING it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_summaries) TYPE tt_target_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_data.
    rt_target_summaries = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING airline_id = carrier_id
                                                                    total_booked = booking_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mapping_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping_flights.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_flight_data_mapping=>tt_source_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrier_id = 'LH' flight_number = '0400' booking_count = 100 max_seats = 150 ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrier_id = 'AA' flight_number = '0017' booking_count = 80 max_seats = 120 ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_data_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->map_flight_data( lt_source_flights = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_lh) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-total_booked exp = 100 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_aa) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-airline_id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-total_booked exp = 80 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Zuweisung von Komponenten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen. Mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel können Sie explizit angeben, welche Quellfelder welchen Zielfeldern zugewiesen werden sollen, selbst wenn die Namen unterschiedlich sind. Dies reduziert den Bedarf an manuellen Zuweisungen und macht den Code robuster gegenüber Feldnamensänderungen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, Internal Tables, Data Transfer, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Utility-Klasse für Flugberechnungen, die Methoden für die Berechnung der Auslastung und der freien Sitzplätze bereitstellt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methoden (`method chaining`) bei der Nutzung.
hint: Methoden, die `ME` als Rückgabewert haben, ermöglichen die Verkettung von Aufrufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_booked_occupancy TYPE sflight-bookedoccupancy READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_seats_max      TYPE sflight-seatsmax      READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING iv_booked_occupancy TYPE sflight-bookedoccupancy
                iv_seats_max      TYPE sflight-seatsmax.

    METHODS set_flight_data
      IMPORTING iv_booked_occupancy TYPE sflight-bookedoccupancy
                iv_seats_max      TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me)        TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_calculator.

    METHODS get_occupancy_percentage
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_percentage) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

    METHODS get_free_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_booked_occupancy = iv_booked_occupancy.
    me->mv_seats_max      = iv_seats_max.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_flight_data.
    me->mv_booked_occupancy = iv_booked_occupancy.
    me->mv_seats_max      = iv_seats_max.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_occupancy_percentage.
    IF mv_seats_max > 0.
      rv_percentage = ( mv_booked_occupancy * 100 ) / mv_seats_max.
    ELSE.
      rv_percentage = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_free_seats.
    rv_free_seats = mv_seats_max - mv_booked_occupancy.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_calculator( iv_booked_occupancy = 50 iv_seats_max = 200 ).

    " Methode chaining
    DATA(lv_percentage) = lo_calculator->set_flight_data( iv_booked_occupancy = 100 iv_seats_max = 200 )->get_occupancy_percentage( ).
    DATA(lv_free_seats) = lo_calculator->get_free_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_percentage exp = '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_free_seats exp = 100 ).

    " Test mit anderen Werten
    lv_percentage = lo_calculator->set_flight_data( iv_booked_occupancy = 180 iv_seats_max = 180 )->get_occupancy_percentage( ).
    lv_free_seats = lo_calculator->get_free_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_percentage exp = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_free_seats exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) ist ein Designmuster, das die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes verbessert, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung kombiniert werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem Methoden, die den Zustand des Objekts ändern, das Objekt selbst (`ME`) zurückgeben. Der `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung ist ebenfalls ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, NEW, Class, Utility

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtzahl der gebuchten Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` in einer `LOOP`-Anweisung.
hint: Der `GROUP BY` in einer `LOOP`-Anweisung ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten direkt beim Iterieren über eine interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary,
           tt_carrier_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passengers_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passengers_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, bookedoccupancy FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA ls_summary TYPE ty_carrier_summary.
      ls_summary-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        ls_summary-total_passengers = ls_summary-total_passengers + ls_grouped_flight-bookedoccupancy.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_passengers_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) msg = 'Result table should contain entries' ).

    " Überprüfen Sie, ob die Summen für bekannte Fluggesellschaften korrekt sind
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_summary-total_passengers >= 0 ) msg = 'LH total passengers should be non-negative' ).
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_aa_summary-total_passengers >= 0 ) msg = 'AA total passengers should be non-negative' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist ein mächtiges Feature für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und dann innerhalb jeder Gruppe weitere Operationen durchzuführen, was den Code für solche Szenarien erheblich vereinfacht und optimiert.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der gebuchten Passagiere für alle Flüge in SFLIGHT, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden, und deren Flugnummern mit '04' beginnen. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `SUM`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel für die Filterung und `SUM` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sum_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_lh_flights_04
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Fluggesellschaften und der durchschnittlichen Auslastung für jede Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife, um die Durchschnittswerte zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_occupancy,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_avg_occupancy,
           tt_avg_occupancies TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_occupancies) TYPE tt_avg_occupancies.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, bookedoccupancy, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA ls_avg_entry TYPE ty_avg_occupancy.
      ls_avg_entry-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.

      DATA(lv_total_booked) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_booked = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_booked = sum_booked + grouped_flight-bookedoccupancy
      ).

      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_seats = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + grouped_flight-seatsmax
      ).

      IF lv_total_seats > 0.
        ls_avg_entry-avg_occupancy = ( lv_total_booked * 100 ) / lv_total_seats.
      ELSE.
        ls_avg_entry-avg_occupancy = 0.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND ls_avg_entry TO rt_avg_occupancies.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Seat' value = ls_passenger-seat ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Passenger
      ENDLOOP.
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Passengers
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Booking

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Flugdetails enthält. Fügen Sie ein `<Notes>`-Element nur dann hinzu, wenn für einen Flug eine bestimmte Bedingung (z.B. `fldate` in der Zukunft) erfüllt ist. Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `IF` für die Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `IF` oder `COND` innerhalb des `LOOP`s, um Elemente bedingt zu schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_conditional_xml
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_conditional_xml.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum status = 'On Time' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum + 1 status = 'Delayed' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = sy-datum - 1 status = 'Departed' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).
    lo_writer->open_element( 'FlightSchedule' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'FlightDetail' ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Carrier' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Date' value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Status' value = ls_flight-status ).

      IF ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum. 
        lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Notes' value = 'Future flight, check for updates.' ).
      ENDIF.

      lo_writer->close_element( ). " FlightDetail
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " FlightSchedule

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das aggregierte Flugdaten (z.B. Anzahl der Flüge pro Carrier) enthält. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation, bevor Sie das XML generieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` zur Datenaggregation und `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_aggregated DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count,
           tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_aggregated_xml
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_aggregated IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_aggregated_xml.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).
    lo_writer->open_element( 'AggregatedFlightData' ).
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'CarrierSummary' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'ID' value = ls_agg-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'FlightCount' value = ls_agg-count ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " CarrierSummary
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " AggregatedFlightData

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_error_xml
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_error_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_error_message) = ``.

    TRY.
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Root' ).
        lo_writer->write_element( name = 'ValidElement' value = 'OK' ).
        " Absichtlich ungültiger Elementname, um eine Ausnahme auszulösen
        lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Invalid Element Name' value = 'Error' ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Root

        rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO DATA(lx_sxml_error).
        lv_error_message = lx_sxml_error->get_text( ).
        rv_xml_string = |<Error>{ lv_error_message }</Error>|.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_filtered_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD generate_filtered_xml.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate

      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Connid' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Fldate' value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Flight

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Flugdaten enthält, wobei die Fluggesellschafts-IDs in ihre vollständigen Namen umgewandelt werden sollen. Nutzen Sie eine Mapping-Tabelle und `MAP` oder `COND` für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Hash-Tabelle für das Mapping und `MAP` oder `COND` zur Transformation der Daten vor der XML-Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_data_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_mapped_xml
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_data_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_mapped_xml.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      UP TO 3 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_carrier_names) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_name
      WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid
      ( ( carrid = 'LH' name = 'Lufthansa' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' name = 'American Airlines' )
        ( carrid = 'UA' name = 'United Airlines' ) ).

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).
    lo_writer->open_element( 'FlightsWithFullNames' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_full_carrier_name) = VALUE string(
        COND #( WHEN lt_carrier_names[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] IS NOT INITIAL
                THEN lt_carrier_names[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-name
                ELSE 'Unknown Carrier' ) ).

      lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'CarrierID' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'CarrierName' value = lv_full_carrier_name ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Date' value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Flight
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " FlightsWithFullNames

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_name,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         name   TYPE string,
       END OF ty_carrier_name.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'XML should contain <FlightsWithFullNames>' substring = '<FlightsWithFullNames>' in = lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'XML should contain <CarrierName>Lufthansa</CarrierName>' substring = '<CarrierName>Lufthansa</CarrierName>' in = lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'XML should contain <CarrierName>American Airlines</CarrierName>' substring = '<CarrierName>American Airlines</CarrierName>' in = lv_xml ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das die Eigenschaften eines Objekts (z.B. einer Fluggesellschaft) darstellt. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Eigenschaften dynamisch zu lesen und in XML zu schreiben.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_rtti_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             currcode TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_carrier_data.

    METHODS generate_rtti_xml
      IMPORTING is_carrier TYPE ty_carrier_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_rtti_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_rtti_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).
    lo_writer->open_element( 'CarrierDetails' ).

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_carrier ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lv_field_value) = ``.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_carrier TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_field_value = <fs_value>.
      ENDIF.
      lo_writer->write_element( name = ls_component-name value = lv_field_value ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_writer->close_element( ). " CarrierDetails

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String der Länge 10.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` in einer Schleife und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 0
      max = lv_chars_len - 1
    ).
    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führe eine Division durch und fange die Ausnahme `cx_sy_zerodivide` ab, falls der Divisor Null ist. Gib eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.

CLASS zcl_division_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_division_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        MESSAGE 'Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_zerodivide exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught cx_sy_arithmetic_error as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).

Instructions: Erstelle eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse `zcx_invalid_input` und werfe diese, wenn eine Eingabe kleiner als Null ist. Fange die Ausnahme in der aufrufenden Methode ab.
hint: Erbe von `cx_static_check` oder `cx_dynamic_check` und verwende `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_positive_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
    METHODS process_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_positive_number.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_number.
    TRY.
        validate_positive_number( iv_number ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führe eine Operation durch, die verschiedene Ausnahmen auslösen kann (z.B. Division durch Null und Index-Out-Of-Bounds). Fange spezifische Ausnahmen ab und verwende `CATCH OTHERS` für alle anderen.
hint: Verwende mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke und `CATCH OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE i
        iv_index  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA: lv_temp_result TYPE i.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY VALUE #( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).

    TRY.
        lv_temp_result = iv_value1 / iv_value2.
        lv_temp_result = lt_data[ iv_index ].
        rv_result = |Operation erfolgreich: { lv_temp_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Division durch Null.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Index für Tabelle nicht gefunden.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_result = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler: Index für Tabelle nicht gefunden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_operation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_operation( iv_value1 = 10 iv_value2 = 2 iv_index = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Operation erfolgreich: 20' ).

Instructions: Mische die Einträge einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) zufällig.
hint: Implementiere den Fisher-Yates-Shuffle-Algorithmus mit `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled_table = it_input_table.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( rt_shuffled_table ).

    IF lv_table_size <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_table_size
    ).

    DO lv_table_size - 1 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-index.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      DATA(ls_temp) = rt_shuffled_table[ lv_current_index ].
      rt_shuffled_table[ lv_current_index ] = rt_shuffled_table[ lv_random_index ].
      rt_shuffled_table[ lv_random_index ] = ls_temp.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_original INTO DATA(ls_original).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_shuffled[ carrid = ls_original-carrid connid = ls_original-connid ] ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lt_original = lt_shuffled.
      DATA(lt_shuffled_again) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_original <> lt_shuffled_again ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Implementiert den Fisher-Yates-Shuffle-Algorithmus, um die Reihenfolge der Elemente in einer internen Tabelle zufällig zu ändern. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um Zufälligkeit in Listen zu erzielen.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, Shuffle, cl_abap_random_int

Instructions: Berechne die Quadratwurzel einer Zahl. Fange die Ausnahme ab, wenn die Zahl negativ ist, und gib stattdessen einen Standardwert zurück, ohne die Programmausführung zu unterbrechen. Nutze dabei funktionale Ansätze.

CLASS zcl_sqrt_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_default TYPE f

        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sqrt_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sqrt.
    rv_result = get_sqrt_or_default( iv_value = iv_number iv_default = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sqrt_or_default.

        rv_result = sqrt( iv_value ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result = iv_default.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere eine interne Tabelle mit 5 zufälligen Flugverbindungen (Carrid und Connid) aus der `sflights` Tabelle. Stelle sicher, dass keine Duplikate enthalten sind.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_random_int` und `COLLECT` oder `INSERT` mit `LINE_EXISTS` zur Duplikatsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS generate_unique_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0030' )
      ( carrid = 'AF' connid = '0040' )
      ( carrid = 'KL' connid = '0050' )
      ( carrid = 'IB' connid = '0060' )
      ( carrid = 'LX' connid = '0070' )
      ( carrid = 'OS' connid = '0080' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_all_sflights ).
    IF lv_table_size = 0 OR iv_count <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_table_size
    ).

    DO.
      IF lines( rt_flights ) >= iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_all_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(ls_random_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        INSERT ls_random_flight INTO TABLE rt_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_generate_unique_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_unique_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->generate_unique_flights( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    " Check for uniqueness (already ensured by UNIQUE KEY, but good to assert)
    DATA(lv_unique_lines) = lines( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_lines exp = lines( lt_flights ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Generiert eine Liste von eindeutigen zufälligen Einträgen aus einer Quelltabelle. Die Verwendung eines internen Tabellentyps mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine Duplikate hinzugefügt werden, während `cl_abap_random_int` die Zufälligkeit gewährleistet.

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine E-Mail-Adresse mit einem Regex-Muster. Werfen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme `zcx_invalid_email`, wenn das Muster nicht übereinstimmt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` mit einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_email DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_email TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_email.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_email.
    CONSTANTS: lc_email_pattern TYPE string VALUE '^\S+@\S+\.\S+$'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lc_email_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_email ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_email
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_email=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_valid_email FOR TESTING. METHODS test_invalid_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_email_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_email( 'test@example.com' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Valid email did not raise exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_email.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Valid email raised unexpected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_email_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_email( 'invalid-email' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Invalid email did not raise exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_email.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Invalid email raised expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verwendet `cl_abap_regex` zur Validierung von Strings gegen ein reguläres Ausdrucksmuster. Bei Nichtübereinstimmung wird eine spezifische benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme geworfen, was eine klare und strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: CATCH, Exception Handling, Regex, Data Validation, cl_abap_regex

Instructions: Simuliere das Lesen einer Datei. Fange die Ausnahme `cx_static_check` ab, wenn die Datei nicht existiert, und gib eine informative Fehlermeldung zurück. Verwende dabei `MESSAGE ... INTO`.
hint: Verwende `OPEN DATASET` und `CATCH cx_static_check`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_content.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          " This branch is typically not reached if cx_sy_file_open is raised directly
          " but good for defensive programming if OPEN DATASET fails silently in some cases.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_open.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          rv_content = rv_content && lv_line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.

      CATCH cx_sy_file_open INTO DATA(lx_file_open).
        MESSAGE lx_file_open->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' INTO lv_message.
        rv_content = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei: { lv_message }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' INTO lv_message.
        rv_content = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lv_message }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_file_not_found FOR TESTING. METHODS test_file_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->read_file_content( '/tmp/non_existent_file.txt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result CS 'Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_file_found.
    " Create a dummy file for testing
    DATA(lv_test_file) = '/tmp/test_file_for_abap_unit.txt'.
    OPEN DATASET lv_test_file FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER 'Hello World!' TO lv_test_file.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_test_file.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->read_file_content( lv_test_file ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World!' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).

    " Clean up the dummy file
    DELETE DATASET lv_test_file.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei Dateizugriffen. `OPEN DATASET` kann `cx_sy_file_open` auslösen, die hier spezifisch abgefangen wird. `MESSAGE ... INTO` wird verwendet, um die Fehlermeldung der Ausnahme in eine Variable zu schreiben.
keywords: CATCH, Exception Handling, File Operations, OPEN DATASET, cx_sy_file_open

Instructions: Gruppiere eine Tabelle von Flugverbindungen (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und wähle für jede Fluggesellschaft eine zufällige Verbindung aus.
hint: Verwende `FOR GROUPS` und `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_grouped_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_grouped_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_per_carrier.
    rt_random_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR GROUPS <wa_group> OF ls_flight IN it_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      LET lt_group_flights = FILTER tt_sflight( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = <wa_group>-carrid ) IN
      LET lv_group_size = lines( lt_group_flights ) IN
      LET lo_random = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_group_size ) IN
      LET lv_random_index = lo_random->get_next( ) IN
      ( lt_group_flights[ lv_random_index ] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_random_flight_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_random_grouped_flights=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouped_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result_flights) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_per_carrier( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    " Check if each carrier is present exactly once
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result_flights[ carrid = 'UA' ] ) ).

    " Check if the selected flight for LH is one of the original LH flights
    DATA(ls_lh_flight) = lt_result_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_flight-connid = '0400' OR ls_lh_flight-connid = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Nutzt die `FOR GROUPS`-Expression, um Einträge nach `carrid` zu gruppieren. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird dann mit `cl_abap_random_int` ein zufälliger Eintrag ausgewählt. `LET` wird verwendet, um Zwischenergebnisse zu speichern und den Code lesbarer zu machen.
keywords: RANDOM, Grouping, FOR GROUPS, cl_abap_random_int, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Führe einen dynamischen Methodenaufruf durch. Fange die Ausnahme `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ab, wenn die Methode nicht existiert, und gib eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwende `CALL METHOD (lv_class_name)->(lv_method_name)` und `CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_call_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_call_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_dynamic_call.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name).
        rv_message = |Methode '{ iv_method_name }' der Klasse '{ iv_class_name }' erfolgreich aufgerufen.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des Objekts: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_message = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_valid_dynamic_call FOR TESTING. METHODS test_invalid_method_call FOR TESTING. METHODS test_invalid_class_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_dynamic_call.
    " Create a dummy class for testing dynamic call
    DATA: lv_class_name TYPE string VALUE 'ZCL_DUMMY_CLASS_FOR_TEST'.
    DATA: lv_method_name TYPE string VALUE 'DUMMY_METHOD'.

    " This part would typically be done in a separate transport or setup
    " For a unit test, we assume such a class/method exists or mock it.
    " For simplicity, we'll just test the error handling paths.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call_handler( ).
    " Assuming a valid class and method exist for a positive test case
    " For this example, we'll focus on the error cases.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_call( iv_class_name = 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' iv_method_name = 'ASSERT_TRUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result CS 'erfolgreich aufgerufen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_call( iv_class_name = 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result CS 'Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_class_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_call( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' iv_method_name = 'ANY_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result CS 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Objekts' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert den dynamischen Aufruf von Methoden und die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` und `cx_sy_create_object_error`. Dies ist entscheidend für flexible Architekturen, bei denen Methoden oder Klassen zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
keywords: CATCH, Dynamic Programming, Exception Handling, CALL METHOD, cx_sy_dyn_call_error

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit 5 zufälligen Datumsangaben im Bereich der letzten 30 Tage.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_random_int` und Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_days_back TYPE i DEFAULT 30
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dates) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_dates.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 0
      max = iv_days_back - 1
    ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_days_offset) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_random_date) = lv_today - lv_random_days_offset.
      APPEND lv_random_date TO rt_dates.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_generate_random_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_dates) = lo_cut->generate_random_dates( iv_count = 3 iv_days_back = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_dates ) exp = 3 ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    LOOP AT lt_dates INTO DATA(lv_date).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_date <= lv_today ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_date >= lv_today - 9 ). " 10 days back means today - 9 is the earliest date
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Generiert eine Liste von zufälligen Datumsangaben innerhalb eines bestimmten Zeitraums. `cl_abap_random_int` wird verwendet, um einen zufälligen Offset von Tagen zu bestimmen, der vom aktuellen Datum abgezogen wird.
keywords: RANDOM, Date/Time, cl_abap_random_int, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for LH' act = lt_flights ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'First flight should be LH'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben und Zeilen manuell zu prüfen, wird die Bedingung direkt im Ausdruck angegeben, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge, die entweder von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) oder 'UA' (United Airlines) durchgeführt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `IN`-Operator innerhalb der `FILTER`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_ua_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_ua_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ).
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid IN lt_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_lh_ua_flights FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Flugnummern (CONNID) der Fluggesellschaft 'DL' (Delta Airlines) als eine Liste von Strings.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die gefilterten Daten zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität (SITAS_MAX) aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'SQ' (Singapore Airlines).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             sitas_max TYPE sflight-sitas_max,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sq_total_capacity
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sq_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, sitas_max
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                  WHERE ( carrid = 'SQ' )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-sitas_max ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sq_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sq_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_cut->get_sq_total_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_total_capacity >= 0 )
      msg = 'Total capacity should be non-negative'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei er in jedem Schritt die Variable basierend auf einer Bedingung (`WHERE`) und einer Operation (`NEXT`) aktualisiert. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, Summen, Zählungen oder andere Aggregationen zu berechnen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_for_date_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) 
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ( c = c + 1 ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_count_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_count( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_carrier( ).

    IF lines( lt_carrier_counts ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_count) = lt_carrier_counts[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_count-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_first_count-flight_count > 0 )
        msg = 'Flight count should be greater than 0'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` kann man Aggregationen pro Gruppe durchführen, was eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` oder manuellen Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END` darstellt.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, FOR GROUPS OF, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Angenommen, Sie haben eine Liste von 'Bildinformationen' (Objekte einer lokalen Klasse `lcl_image_info`). Filtern Sie alle Bilder, die den MIME-Typ 'image/jpeg' haben und deren Breite größer als 1024 Pixel ist.
hint: Definieren Sie eine lokale Klasse `lcl_image_info` und verwenden Sie `FILTER` auf einer Tabelle von Objektreferenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_data,
             name      TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_image_data.
    TYPES tt_image_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS lcl_image_info DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA name      TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        DATA mime_type TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        DATA width     TYPE i READ-ONLY.
        DATA height    TYPE i READ-ONLY.

        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            iv_name      TYPE string
            iv_mime_type TYPE string
            iv_width     TYPE i
            iv_height    TYPE i.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_image_info IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        me->name      = iv_name.
        me->mime_type = iv_mime_type.
        me->width     = iv_width.
        me->height    = iv_height.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tr_image_info TYPE REF TO lcl_image_info.
    TYPES tt_image_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tr_image_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_large_jpegs
      IMPORTING it_all_images TYPE tt_image_info
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_images) TYPE tt_image_info.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_large_jpegs.
    rt_filtered_images = FILTER #( it_all_images 
                                   WHERE mime_type = 'image/jpeg' 
                                     AND width > 1024 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_large_jpegs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_large_jpegs.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_image_filter( ).
    DATA lt_test_images TYPE zcl_image_filter=>tt_image_info.

    APPEND NEW zcl_image_filter=>lcl_image_info( iv_name = 'img1.jpg' iv_mime_type = 'image/jpeg' iv_width = 1920 iv_height = 1080 ) TO lt_test_images.
    APPEND NEW zcl_image_filter=>lcl_image_info( iv_name = 'img2.png' iv_mime_type = 'image/png' iv_width = 1280 iv_height = 720 ) TO lt_test_images.
    APPEND NEW zcl_image_filter=>lcl_image_info( iv_name = 'img3.jpg' iv_mime_type = 'image/jpeg' iv_width = 800 iv_height = 600 ) TO lt_test_images.
    APPEND NEW zcl_image_filter=>lcl_image_info( iv_name = 'img4.jpg' iv_mime_type = 'image/jpeg' iv_width = 2560 iv_height = 1440 ) TO lt_test_images.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_large_jpegs( lt_test_images ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]->name exp = 'img1.jpg' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]->name exp = 'img4.jpg' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators auf einer internen Tabelle von Objektreferenzen. Obwohl `cl_fxs_image_info` eine spezialisierte Klasse für XSL-FO-Verarbeitung ist, zeigt dieses Beispiel, wie man mit einer konzeptionellen 'Image Information'-Klasse und modernen ABAP-Features wie `FILTER` und Objekten umgehen kann. Dies ist ein häufiges Muster in der objektorientierten Programmierung, um Listen von Objekten effizient zu manipulieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine vorhandene Tabelle durchlaufen und die Daten transformieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor, um eine Schleife zu durchlaufen und Elemente zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES tt_flights_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             flight_key TYPE string,
             adjusted_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES tt_flights_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights_in
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flights_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                          ( flight_key     = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
                                            adjusted_price = flight-price * '0.9' ) ). "10% discount
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_it_for_loop=>tt_flights_in(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '1000.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '500.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 1 ]-flight_key exp = 'LH-0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 1 ]-adjusted_price exp = '900.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 2 ]-adjusted_price exp = '450.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_prices
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( ) )
                                   FOR flight IN it_flight_prices
                                   NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_it_reduce_sum=>tt_flight_prices(
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' price = '300.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '600.00' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_input) = VALUE zcl_it_reduce_sum=>tt_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_empty_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_empty exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung, was eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung darstellt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle über einen Tabellenausdruck zu und geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück, falls die Zeile nicht gefunden wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
           END OF ty_flight.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_city_from.
    rv_cityfrom = it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-cityfrom DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN'.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` und füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit passenden Feldern unter Verwendung von Inline-Deklaration und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_open_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_prices IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_prices) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_prices.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    rt_flight_prices = lt_sflight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_open_sql( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_prices( 'LH' ). "Assuming LH has entries in SFLIGHT

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ). "Should return some data for LH
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus Inline-Deklaration (`DATA(...)`) und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` vereinfacht den Datenbankzugriff erheblich. Es entfällt die Notwendigkeit, die interne Tabelle vorab zu deklarieren und die Feldzuordnung manuell vorzunehmen, was den Code kürzer und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Database Access

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variable einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu, unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` anstelle von verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                            iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                              WHEN 'LH' THEN
                                SWITCH #( iv_connid
                                          WHEN '0400' THEN 'On Time'
                                          WHEN '0401' THEN 'Delayed'
                                          ELSE 'Unknown LH Flight' )
                              WHEN 'AA' THEN 'Check-in Open'
                              WHEN 'BA' THEN 'Boarding'
                              ELSE 'Unknown Airline' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck bietet eine elegante und kompakte Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.

solution:

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FINAL` für Methoden und Klassen, um die Vererbung und das Überschreiben zu kontrollieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` in der Definition von Klassen und Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_base_info FINAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_base_info.
    rv_info = 'This is a base flight information.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_specific_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_base_flight.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_specific_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_desc = 'This is a specific flight description.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_specific_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_base_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_specific_flight.
    DATA(lo_specific_flight) = NEW zcl_specific_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_desc) = lo_specific_flight->get_description( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc exp = 'This is a specific flight description.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_base_info.
    DATA(lo_specific_flight) = NEW zcl_specific_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_specific_flight->get_base_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'This is a base flight information.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` verhindert, dass eine Klasse beerbt oder eine Methode überschrieben wird. Dies fördert die Kapselung und Stabilität des Codes, indem es die Erweiterbarkeit an bestimmten Punkten bewusst einschränkt. Die Klasse `zcl_specific_flight` ist `FINAL`, kann also nicht weiter beerbt werden. Die Methode `get_base_info` ist `FINAL` und kann in `zcl_specific_flight` nicht überschrieben werden.
keywords: Object Orientation, FINAL, Inheritance, Encapsulation

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Daten aus zwei internen Tabellen (z.B. Flüge und deren Passagiere) in einer neuen Struktur, um eine 'freundliche' Datenansicht zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `IN` und `WHERE` Bedingungen, um Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu verknüpfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_friends_data_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             passname TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger.
    TYPES tt_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_passengers,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             passengers TYPE string_table,
           END OF ty_flight_with_passengers.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_flight_and_passengers
      IMPORTING it_flights    TYPE tt_flights
                it_passengers TYPE tt_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_data) TYPE tt_flight_with_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friends_data_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_flight_and_passengers.
    rt_combined_data = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                    connid = flight-connid
                                    fldate = flight-fldate
                                    passengers = VALUE string_table( FOR passenger IN it_passengers
                                                                      WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid AND
                                                                              connid = flight-connid AND
                                                                              fldate = flight-fldate )
                                                                      ( passenger-passname ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_friends_data_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_friends_data_combine=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251121' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251121' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_passengers) = VALUE zcl_friends_data_combine=>tt_passengers(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251121' passname = 'Alice' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251121' passname = 'Bob' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251121' passname = 'Charlie' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_flight_and_passengers( it_flights = lt_flights
                                                                 it_passengers = lt_passengers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined[ 1 ]-passengers ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-passengers[ 1 ] exp = 'Alice' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined[ 2 ]-passengers ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_friends_data_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_friends_data_combine=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251121' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_passengers) = VALUE zcl_friends_data_combine=>tt_passengers(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251121' passname = 'Charlie' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_flight_and_passengers( it_flights = lt_flights
                                                                 it_passengers = lt_passengers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined[ 1 ]-passengers ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit modernen ABAP-Konstruktoren (`VALUE`, `FOR`, `WHERE`) Daten aus 'befreundeten' oder verwandten internen Tabellen effizient kombinieren kann. Anstatt manueller Schleifen und `READ TABLE`, wird eine deklarative Syntax verwendet, um eine neue, angereicherte Datenstruktur zu erstellen, was den Code kompakter und verständlicher macht.
keywords: FRIENDS, Data Combination, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, WHERE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, um mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Methoden, die verkettet werden sollen, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_builder.
    METHODS append_text IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_builder.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_builder.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD append_text.
    me->mv_value = me->mv_value && iv_text.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE me->mv_value TO UPPER CASE.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_chainable_builder( ).
    lo_builder->set_value( 'hello' )->append_text( ' world' )->to_upper( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_builder->mv_value exp = 'HELLO WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den 'Flow' des Codes, insbesondere bei Builder-Pattern oder Fluent Interfaces. Jede verkettbare Methode muss eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Builder Pattern
