Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus einer bestehenden (`sflights`), wobei im Feld `CURRENCY` alle Vorkommen von 'EUR' durch 'USD' ersetzt werden, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `VALUE` und `REPLACE` innerhalb des Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             currency  TYPE s_currcode,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS transform_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_currency.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                      WHERE ( seatsmax >= iv_min_seats )
                                      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid    = ls_flight-connid
                                        currency  = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-currency = 'EUR' THEN 'USD' ELSE ls_flight-currency ) " Using COND for direct replacement
                                        seatsmax  = ls_flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_currency FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_currency.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_for_replace=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0020' currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0030' currency = 'GBP' seatsmax = 50 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_for_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_currency( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_seats = 120 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = `Anzahl der transformierten Flüge falsch` ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = `Fluggesellschaft 1 falsch` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-currency exp = 'USD' msg = `Währung 1 falsch` ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = `Fluggesellschaft 2 falsch` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-currency exp = 'USD' msg = `Währung 2 falsch` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne `FOR`-Schleife in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und dem `COND`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen. Es filtert die Einträge und ersetzt bedingt den Wert des `CURRENCY`-Feldes. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, COND, Transformation, Datenmanipulation

CLASS zcl_str_multi_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapping,
             old_char TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             new_char TYPE c LENGTH 2,
           END OF ty_mapping.
    TYPES tt_mapping TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapping WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS replace_multiple_chars
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        it_mapping TYPE tt_mapping
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_multi_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_multiple_chars.
    rv_result = iv_text.
    LOOP AT it_mapping ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_map>).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF <fs_map>-old_char IN rv_result WITH <fs_map>-new_char.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Leerzeichen am Anfang und Ende eines Strings und ersetzen Sie mehrere aufeinanderfolgende Leerzeichen im Inneren des Strings durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONDENSE` und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_clean_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_clean_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string_spaces.
    rv_result = iv_text.
    CONDENSE rv_result NO-GAPS. " Removes leading/trailing and replaces multiple internal spaces with one
    " CONDENSE NO-GAPS removes all spaces. We need to replace multiple internal spaces with one.
    " Let's use a different approach for modern ABAP.
    rv_result = cl_abap_string_utilities=>trim( rv_result ). " Trim leading/trailing spaces
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_result WITH ' '. " Replace multiple internal spaces with one
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sys_prod_check IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_systype) = cl_abap_syst=>get_systype( ).

    rv_message = CASE lv_systype
                   WHEN 'P' THEN 'Das System ist ein Produktivsystem.'
                   WHEN 'Q' THEN 'Das System ist ein Qualitätssicherungssystem.'

    CASE lv_systype.
      WHEN 'P' THEN lv_expected_message = 'Das System ist ein Produktivsystem.'.

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die von 'FRA' (Frankfurt) abfliegen, zu einer neuen internen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie APPEND LINES OF in Kombination mit einem FILTER-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights.

    DATA(lt_temp_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ).
    APPEND LINES OF lt_temp_filtered TO rt_filtered_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_city( `FRA` ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = `FRA` ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Quadraten der Zahlen von 1 bis 5 und hängen Sie diese an eine bestehende leere Tabelle an.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen FOR-Ausdruck, um die Zahlen zu generieren, und dann APPEND LINES OF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_append_squares
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_squares) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_append_squares.
    DATA(lt_generated_squares) = VALUE tt_numbers(
        FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 5
        ( i * i )
    ).
    APPEND LINES OF lt_generated_squares TO rt_squares.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_connid_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_connid_shift IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_flights_shifted = it_flights.
    LOOP AT rt_flights_shifted ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      SHIFT <fs_flight>-connid LEFT DELETING LEADING ZERO.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Flüge von 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS zu einer internen Tabelle hinzu und anschließend alle Flüge von 'AA' (American Airlines) zur selben Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie zweimal APPEND LINES OF, einmal für jede Fluggesellschaft, nach dem Filtern der Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_multi_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier1 TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrier2 TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_multi_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carriers.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights.

    DATA(lt_flights_carr1) = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier1 ).
    APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_carr1 TO rt_combined_flights.

    DATA(lt_flights_carr2) = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier2 ).
    APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_carr2 TO rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) zu einer neuen Tabelle, wobei nur eindeutige Einträge basierend auf CARRIER und CONNECTION ID übernommen werden sollen. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie APPEND LINES OF in Kombination mit einem REDUCE-Ausdruck oder einer Hash-Tabelle für die Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_unique_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_unique_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights1 TYPE tt_sflight
        it_flights2 TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_unique_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_unique_flights.
    DATA lt_temp_combined TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA ls_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA lt_seen_keys TYPE tt_sflight_key.

    " Append first table
    LOOP AT it_flights1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
      ls_key = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight1 ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_seen_keys[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_key-carrid connid = ls_key-connid ] ).
        INSERT ls_key INTO TABLE lt_seen_keys.
        APPEND ls_flight1 TO lt_temp_combined.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Append second table, checking for uniqueness
    LOOP AT it_flights2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
      ls_key = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight2 ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_seen_keys[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_key-carrid connid = ls_key-connid ] ).
        INSERT ls_key INTO TABLE lt_seen_keys.
        APPEND ls_flight2 TO lt_temp_combined.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_unique_flights = lt_temp_combined.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_connid_len DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_connid_len IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE strlen( ls_flight-connid ) > 3.
      APPEND ls_flight-connid TO rt_long_connids.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die einen String um eine variable Anzahl von Positionen nach links verschiebt und die am Ende entstehenden Lücken mit den am Anfang entfernten Zeichen auffüllt (ähnlich einem zirkulären Shift, aber mit expliziter SHIFT-Anweisung).
hint: Verwenden Sie SHIFT LEFT BY n PLACES und String-Templates, um die entfernten Zeichen wieder anzuhängen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_shift_reinsert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_left_and_reinsert
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
        iv_places TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_shift_reinsert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_left_and_reinsert.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_length = 0 OR iv_places <= 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_places) = iv_places MOD lv_length.
    IF lv_actual_places = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_removed_part) = iv_input(lv_actual_places).
    DATA(lv_shifted_part) = iv_input.
    SHIFT lv_shifted_part LEFT BY lv_actual_places PLACES.

    rv_output = |{ lv_shifted_part+0(lv_length - lv_actual_places) }{ lv_removed_part }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle an eine andere an, wobei die Quelltabelle das Ergebnis eines REDUCE-Ausdrucks ist, der eine Aggregation durchführt.
hint: Verwenden Sie APPEND LINES OF mit einer Tabelle, die durch einen REDUCE-Ausdruck erzeugt wurde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_and_append
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_append.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_reduced_data) = REDUCE tt_flight_data(
        INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_data( )
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
        LET lv_count = GROUP SIZE IN GROUP ls_flight
        IN
        result = VALUE tt_flight_data( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = lv_count ) )
    ).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_reduced_data TO rt_aggregated_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) basierend auf einem dynamisch erstellten Ranges-Tabelle für die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID). Verwenden Sie dabei Konstanten aus `if_fsbp_const_range` für die Ranges-Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator und die Konstanten für Ranges-Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_range_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign   = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include
                    option = if_fsbp_const_range=>option_equal
                    low    = iv_carrid ) TO lt_range_carrid.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid IN lt_range_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft und Währung aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für Flüge, die teurer als 200 sind. Verwenden Sie dabei modernes Open SQL mit Aggregatsfunktionen und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT AVG(...)`, `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in modernem Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             curr   TYPE sflight-curr,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_prices.
    SELECT carrid, curr, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE price > 200
      GROUP BY carrid, curr
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_prices.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Erwartete aggregierte Flugpreise' ).

    " Dieser Teil muss möglicherweise an die tatsächlichen SFLIGHTS-Daten angepasst werden.
    DATA(ls_expected_entry) = VALUE zcl_sflight_agg=>ty_avg_price( carrid = 'LH' curr = 'EUR' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_expected_entry WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' curr = 'EUR'.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_expected_entry-avg_price > 200 ) msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für LH/EUR sollte > 200 sein' ).
    ENDIF.

Die Ergebnisse werden direkt in eine interne Tabelle (`@rt_avg_prices`) mit Inline-Deklaration (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) gelesen. Dies ist die bevorzugte Methode für Datenbankzugriffe in modernen ABAP-Anwendungen, da sie prägnanter und oft performanter ist als ältere Syntax.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und fügen Sie ein Präfix zur Flugnummer hinzu. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FOR` Operator und den `VALUE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             airline TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_raw_flights
        ( airline = ls_flight-carrid
          flight_id = |FLIGHT-{ ls_flight-connid }| ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = CONV sflight-price( 0 )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) in einer einfachen Klasse.
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden `ME` zurück, um die Verkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_object.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_mult TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_object.

    METHODS get_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit zwei Spalten (z.B. `CARRID` und `CONNID` aus `SFLIGHTS`) zur Laufzeit und fügen Sie Daten hinzu. Verwenden Sie dabei RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für die Typbeschreibung und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Erzeugung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    " Dynamische Strukturdefinition
    ls_component-name = 'CARRID'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( 'S_CARR_ID' ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'CONNID'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( 'S_CONN_ID' ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    " Dynamische Tabellenerzeugung
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Daten hinzufügen
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 3 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight_data).
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrid>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_connid>).

      IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED.
        <lv_carrid> = ls_sflight_data-carrid.
        <lv_connid> = ls_sflight_data-connid.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamische Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 3 msg = 'Erwartete 3 Zeilen in der dynamischen Tabelle' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_line> msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte zugewiesen sein' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lv_carrid> msg = 'Komponente CARRID sollte zugewiesen sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lv_carrid> msg = 'CARRID sollte nicht leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information). Mit Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` können Typbeschreibungen erstellt und dann mit `CREATE DATA` dynamische Datenobjekte erzeugt werden. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Datumsangaben unter Verwendung der modernen Datums-/Zeit-Klassen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_date_time_utilities` oder `cl_abap_tstmp`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE d
        iv_date2 TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between.
    DATA(lv_timestamp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date = iv_date1 ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date = iv_date2 ).

    cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract_tstmp(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp1 = lv_timestamp2
        tstmp2 = lv_timestamp1
      IMPORTING
        r_secs = DATA(lv_seconds_diff)
    ).

    rv_days = lv_seconds_diff / ( 24 * 3600 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie dabei den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck für interne Tabellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit dem `COUNT` Aggregat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_key.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                    connid = ls_flight-connid
                    count  = GROUP SIZE ) 
         INTO DATA(ls_group).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                      connid = ls_group-connid
                      flight_count = ls_group-count ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_flights_empty FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Schreibe eine Schleife, die Zahlen von 1 bis 10 verarbeitet. Überspringe gerade Zahlen (`CONTINUE`) und beende die Schleife, wenn die Zahl 7 erreicht ist (`EXIT`). Speichere die verarbeiteten Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze `WHILE` zusammen mit `CONTINUE` und `EXIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_continue_exit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_continue_exit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA(lv_number) = 0.
    WHILE lv_number < 10.
      lv_number = lv_number + 1.
      IF lv_number MOD 2 = 0. " Skip even numbers
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_number = 7. " Exit at 7
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND |{ lv_number }| TO rv_output.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simuliere das zeilenweise Lesen von Flugdaten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, bis maximal 3 Flüge gefunden wurden oder keine weiteren Flüge mehr verfügbar sind. Verwende eine `WHILE`-Schleife und `SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS`.
hint: Nutze `WHILE` und `SELECT ... UP TO 1 ROWS` mit einer dynamisch angepassten `WHERE`-Klausel, um den 'Cursor' zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_db_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_info.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_limited_flights IMPORTING iv_max_flights TYPE i
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_db_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_limited_flights.
    DATA(lv_flights_found) = 0.
    DATA(lv_current_carrid) = ''.
    DATA(lv_current_connid) = ''.
    DATA(lv_current_fldate) = '19000101'. " Start date for comparison

    DATA(ls_flight) TYPE ty_s_flight_info.

    WHILE lv_flights_found < iv_max_flights.
      CLEAR ls_flight.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights
        INTO @ls_flight
        WHERE carrid > @lv_current_carrid
           OR ( carrid = @lv_current_carrid AND connid > @lv_current_connid )
           OR ( carrid = @lv_current_carrid AND connid = @lv_current_connid AND fldate > @lv_current_fldate )
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate
        UP TO 1 ROWS.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
          lv_flights_found = lv_flights_found + 1.
          lv_current_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
          lv_current_connid = ls_flight-connid.
          lv_current_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
        ELSE.
          " No more flights found
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDSELECT.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_limited_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_limited_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_db_cursor( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_limited_flights( 3 ). " Get 3 flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).

Instructions: Iteriere über eine interne Tabelle von Flugpreisen (`carrid`, `connid`, `price`) mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`, um die Flugpreise zu verdoppeln, bis ein Gesamtpreis von 1000 überschritten wird. Die ursprüngliche Tabelle soll dabei modifiziert werden.
hint: Nutze `WHILE` mit einem Index und `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` zur Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_field_symbols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_price.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS double_prices_until_limit IMPORTING it_flights    TYPE ty_t_flight_prices
                                      IMPORTING iv_price_limit TYPE s_price
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_field_symbols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD double_prices_until_limit.
    rt_flights = it_flights. " Copy input table to modify
    DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_s_flight_price.

    WHILE lv_total_price < iv_price_limit AND lv_index <= lines( rt_flights ).
      READ TABLE rt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX lv_index.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * 2.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + <fs_flight>-price.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if lv_index is within bounds
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_double_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_double_prices.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_test_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_test_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_test_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE ty_t_test_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0002' price = '400.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_field_symbols( ).
    DATA(lt_result_flights) = lo_cut->double_prices_until_limit( it_flights = lt_input_flights iv_price_limit = '1000.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_flights ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_flights[1]-price exp = '200.00' ). " 100 * 2
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_flights[2]-price exp = '400.00' ). " 200 * 2
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_flights[3]-price exp = '600.00' ). " 300 * 2
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_flights[4]-price exp = '400.00' ). " 400 (not doubled as limit reached before this)

    DATA(lv_total_check) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_check).
      lv_total_check = lv_total_check + ls_flight_check-price.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_check exp = '1600.00' ). " 200+400+600+400
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING` zur effizienten und direkten Modifikation von Einträgen in einer internen Tabelle. Die Schleife terminiert, sobald eine bestimmte Bedingung (Gesamtpreislimit) erfüllt ist, was eine flexible Steuerung der Datenverarbeitung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine Sequenz von Fibonacci-Zahlen generiert, bis ein bestimmter Wert (z.B. 1000) überschritten wird, unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Speichere die generierten Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze `WHILE` und zwei Variablen, um die vorherigen Werte zu speichern und die nächste Fibonacci-Zahl zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_fibonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_fibonacci_sequence IMPORTING iv_limit TYPE i
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rt_sequence) TYPE i_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_fibonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_fibonacci_sequence.
    DATA(lv_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_b) = 1.
    DATA(lv_next) = 0.

    IF iv_limit <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND lv_a TO rt_sequence.
    IF iv_limit = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND lv_b TO rt_sequence.

    WHILE lv_next <= iv_limit.
      lv_next = lv_a + lv_b.
      IF lv_next > iv_limit.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_next TO rt_sequence.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_next.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die versucht, eine Operation (z.B. das Lesen einer Datei oder einen externen Aufruf) bis zu 3 Mal zu wiederholen, falls ein Fehler auftritt. Bei Erfolg soll die Schleife beendet werden, nach 3 Fehlversuchen soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Nutze `WHILE`, `TRY...CATCH`, `CONTINUE` und `EXIT` sowie eine Zählervariable für Wiederholungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_retry_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_reliable_operation IMPORTING iv_succeed_on_try TYPE i
                                       RAISING   cx_sy_open_sql_error " Example exception
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_retry_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_reliable_operation.
    DATA(lv_retries) = 0.
    DATA(lv_max_retries) = 3.
    DATA(lv_operation_successful) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_retries < lv_max_retries AND lv_operation_successful = abap_false.
      lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
      TRY.
          " Simulate an operation that might fail
          IF lv_retries = iv_succeed_on_try.
            " Operation successful
            lv_operation_successful = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            " Simulate a failure
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
          ENDIF.

        CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error.
          " Log error, wait, then retry
          " cl_demo_output=>display( |Operation failed (retry { lv_retries }/{ lv_max_retries })| ).
          IF lv_retries < lv_max_retries.
            " Simulate a short delay before retrying
            WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
            CONTINUE.
          ELSE.
            " Max retries reached, re-raise exception
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
          ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_success = lv_operation_successful.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operation_succeeds FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_fails FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_error.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_succeeds.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_retry_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_reliable_operation( 2 ). " Succeeds on 2nd try
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_fails.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_retry_logic( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_reliable_operation( 99 ). " Always fails
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_ERROR' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_ERROR after retries' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert eine robuste Wiederholungslogik (`retry logic`) mithilfe einer `WHILE`-Schleife und `TRY...CATCH`. Es demonstriert, wie man fehlertolerante Operationen implementiert, indem man bei temporären Fehlern eine bestimmte Anzahl von Wiederholungen versucht, bevor ein endgültiger Fehler gemeldet wird. `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen und `abap_bool` sind moderne ABAP-Elemente.
keywords: WHILE, RETRY, ERROR HANDLING, EXCEPTION, TRY CATCH, ABAP_BOOL

Instructions: Verarbeite eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften (`s_carr_id`) in einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Entferne jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Liste, die mit 'A' beginnt, bis die Liste leer ist oder eine bestimmte Anzahl von Elementen verarbeitet wurde. Gib die verbleibenden Elemente zurück.
hint: Nutze `WHILE`, `DELETE TABLE` und `READ TABLE` mit `INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_process_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_airlines IMPORTING it_airlines TYPE s_carr_id_tt
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_remaining_airlines) TYPE s_carr_id_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_process_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_airlines.
    rt_remaining_airlines = it_airlines.
    DATA(lv_processed_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_max_process) = 2. " Process max 2 items

    WHILE lines( rt_remaining_airlines ) > 0 AND lv_processed_count < lv_max_process.
      DATA(lv_current_airline) = rt_remaining_airlines[1]. " Get first element

      IF lv_current_airline CP 'A*'. " Check if starts with 'A'
        DELETE rt_remaining_airlines INDEX 1.
      ELSE.
        " If not starting with 'A', move to next (conceptually, by not deleting)
        " For this example, we'll just increment count and let the loop continue
        " If we wanted to skip and keep, we'd need a different approach (e.g., new table)
        " For simplicity, we'll just remove the first element regardless after processing
        DELETE rt_remaining_airlines INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflight`. Formatieren Sie die Zellen der Spalte 'PRICE' basierend auf dem Wert: grün für Preise unter 200, gelb für 200-500, rot für über 500. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Erstellen der Excel-Datei und `SWITCH` für die bedingte Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_format_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_formatted_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_format_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_excel->create_spreadsheet( ).

    " Header
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).

      DATA(lv_color) = SWITCH i(
        WHEN ls_sflight-price < 200 THEN cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>c_color_green
        WHEN ls_sflight-price >= 200 AND ls_sflight-price <= 500 THEN cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>c_color_yellow
        WHEN OTHERS THEN cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>c_color_red
      ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_background_color( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_color = lv_color ).

      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_excel->save_spreadsheet( ip_file_name = iv_file_path ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die ein generisches Interface-Referenzobjekt akzeptiert und basierend auf dem tatsächlichen Typ des Objekts unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt. Verwenden Sie hierfür `CASE TYPE OF`.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und mehrere Klassen, die dieses implementieren. Nutzen Sie dann `CASE TYPE OF` zur Typunterscheidung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_width TYPE decfloat16 iv_height TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_height TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_description = |Kreis mit Radius { lo_circle->mv_radius } und Fläche { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area() }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_rectangle INTO DATA(lo_rectangle).
        rv_description = |Rechteck mit Breite { lo_rectangle->mv_width }, Höhe { lo_rectangle->mv_height } und Fläche { lo_rectangle->zif_shape~get_area() }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannte Form'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_count_lh TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_count_aa TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_count_other TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CASE ls_sflight-carrid.
        WHEN 'LH'.
          lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
        WHEN 'AA'.
          lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lv_count_other = lv_count_other + 1.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    APPEND |Flüge mit LH: { lv_count_lh }| TO rt_result.
    APPEND |Flüge mit AA: { lv_count_aa }| TO rt_result.
    APPEND |Flüge mit anderen Airlines: { lv_count_other }| TO rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei und schreiben Sie die Daten aus der `sflight`-Tabelle. Fügen Sie eine Spalte 'Status' hinzu, deren Wert dynamisch mit einem `SWITCH`-Ausdruck basierend auf dem Preis ('PRICE') gesetzt wird (z.B. 'Günstig', 'Standard', 'Teuer').
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` mit `SWITCH` für die dynamische Statuszuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_dynamic_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_excel_with_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_dynamic_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_excel_with_status.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_excel->create_spreadsheet( ).

    " Header
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'STATUS' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).

      DATA(lv_status) = SWITCH string(
        WHEN ls_sflight-price < 300 THEN 'Günstig'
        WHEN ls_sflight-price >= 300 AND ls_sflight-price <= 700 THEN 'Standard'
        WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Teuer'
      ).
      lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = lv_status ).

      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_excel->save_spreadsheet( ip_file_name = iv_file_path ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_daily_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_daily_message.
    DATA(lv_date) = COND sy-datum( WHEN iv_date IS INITIAL THEN sy-datum ELSE iv_date ).
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_date ).

    CASE lv_weekday.
      WHEN 1. " Montag
        rv_message = 'Es ist Montag. Starten Sie gut in die Woche!' .
      WHEN 2. " Dienstag
        rv_message = 'Dienstag: Zeit für neue Herausforderungen.' .
      WHEN 3. " Mittwoch
        rv_message = 'Bergfest! Die Woche ist halb geschafft.' .
      WHEN 4. " Donnerstag
        rv_message = 'Fast Wochenende! Halten Sie durch.' .
      WHEN 5. " Freitag
        rv_message = 'Freitag! Das Wochenende steht vor der Tür.' .
      WHEN 6. " Samstag
        rv_message = 'Samstag: Genießen Sie Ihre Freizeit.' .
      WHEN 7. " Sonntag
        rv_message = 'Sonntag: Zeit zum Entspannen.' .
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Wochentag.' .
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             msgid TYPE sy-msgid,
             msgno TYPE sy-msgno,
             msgv1 TYPE sy-msgv,
             msgv2 TYPE sy-msgv,
             msgv3 TYPE sy-msgv,
             msgv4 TYPE sy-msgv,
           END OF ty_message_raw.
    TYPES tt_messages_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_formatted,
             type    TYPE sy-msgty,
             text    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message_formatted.
    TYPES tt_messages_formatted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message_formatted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS collect_and_format_messages
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_messages) TYPE tt_messages_formatted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_collect_and_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_and_format_messages.
    DATA: lt_raw_messages TYPE tt_messages_raw.
    DATA: ls_message_wa TYPE ty_message_raw.

    " Verwenden Sie existierende Nachrichten, z.B. aus Nachrichtenklasse 'SY'
    MESSAGE I000(SY) WITH 'Process' 'started' INTO ls_message_wa.
    APPEND ls_message_wa TO lt_raw_messages.

    MESSAGE E001(SY) WITH 'Error' 'occurred' INTO ls_message_wa.
    APPEND ls_message_wa TO lt_raw_messages.

    rt_formatted_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_messages ( 
        type = ls_raw-msgty,
        text = cl_message_helper=>get_message_text(
                 i_msgid = ls_raw-msgid,
                 i_msgno = ls_raw-msgno,
                 i_msgv1 = ls_raw-msgv1,
                 i_msgv2 = ls_raw-msgv2,
                 i_msgv3 = ls_raw-msgv3,
                 i_msgv4 = ls_raw-msgv4
               )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_raise_exc_formatted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD raise_formatted_exception.
    IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
      " Verwenden Sie eine existierende Nachricht, z.B. 'SY' 000 'Program &1 started'

Instructions: Rufen Sie die vollständige Hierarchie eines Pakets bis zum Wurzelpaket ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_parent_package` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_get_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_package_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF devclass WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_pak_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_get_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_package_hierarchy.
    DATA: lv_current_package TYPE devclass.

    lv_current_package = iv_package_name.

    WHILE lv_current_package IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_current_package TO rt_hierarchy.
      TRY.
          lv_current_package = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_parent_package(
            i_package_name = lv_current_package
          ).
        CATCH cx_pak_exception.
          " Parent not found or error, stop traversal
          CLEAR lv_current_package.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Sort in ascending order (root to child)
    SORT rt_hierarchy ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_get_hierarchy( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_package_hierarchy( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_PACKAGE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_PAK_EXCEPTION was not raised for non-existent package' ).
      CATCH cx_pak_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = '' " Exception caught, test passed
          msg = 'CX_PAK_EXCEPTION should be raised'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die iterative Ermittlung der Pakethierarchie bis zum Wurzelpaket unter Verwendung von `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_parent_package`. Die `WHILE`-Schleife und die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` sind moderne Ansätze für solche Traversierungsaufgaben.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Range-Tabelle für Flugnummern (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die alle Flugnummern enthält, die mit 'AA' beginnen oder 'LH' sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR und VALUE, um die Range-Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carrid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_range.
    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight AS sflight WHERE carrid LIKE 'AA%' OR carrid = 'LH' ) 
      ( sign   = 'I'
        option = 'EQ'
        low    = ls_sflight-carrid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrid_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_carrid_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_range[ sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ] OPTIONAL ). " Should not contain UA
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_range[ sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ] OPTIONAL ). " Should contain AA
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_range[ sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ). " Should contain LH
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_range ). " Should not be empty
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `VALUE #(...)` mit einer `FOR`-Iteration über das Ergebnis einer `SELECT`-Anweisung ermöglicht die kompakte und deklarative Erstellung einer Range-Tabelle. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`- und `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
keywords: RANGES, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, SELECT DISTINCT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten basierend auf einer dynamisch erstellten Range-Tabelle für die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID). Die Range soll alle Fluggesellschaften außer 'UA' enthalten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILTER mit einer Range-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_carrid_exclude_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) TO lt_carrid_exclude_range.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_exclude_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_with_range( ).
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_with_range=>tt_sflight_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '9300' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrid( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered[ carrid = 'UA' ] OPTIONAL ). " UA should be filtered out
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered[ carrid = 'AA' ] OPTIONAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit einer Range-Tabelle bietet eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Die Syntax ist deklarativ und vermeidet explizite Schleifen.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 zufälligen Ganzzahlen zwischen 1 und 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT und eine Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_integers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_integers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = iv_min
      max  = iv_max
    ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND lo_random->get_next( ) TO rt_random_numbers.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_integers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->generate_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT aus.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen und generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
      DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
        seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
        min  = 1
        max  = lv_num_flights
      ).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rs_random_flight = lt_all_flights[ lv_random_index ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_random_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selection( ).
    DATA(ls_flight1) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight2) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight1 ). " Should return a flight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight2 ). " Should return a flight

    " Due to randomness, it's hard to assert equality, but we can check if it's a valid flight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight1-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight1-connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight1-fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Auswahl eines zufälligen Eintrags aus einer internen Tabelle. Es kombiniert die `lines()`-Funktion zur Bestimmung der Tabellengröße mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` zur Generierung eines gültigen Index.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, SELECT

Instructions: Generieren Sie 3 zufällige Daten innerhalb des aktuellen Jahres.
hint: Konvertieren Sie Daten in Ganzzahlen, generieren Sie Zufallszahlen und konvertieren Sie zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_dates_in_year
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_dates) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_dates_in_year.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_year) = lv_current_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_year)  = lv_current_year && '1231'.

    DATA(lv_first_day_int) = lv_first_day_of_year. " Implicit conversion to integer
    DATA(lv_last_day_int)  = lv_last_day_of_year.  " Implicit conversion to integer

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = lv_first_day_int
      max  = lv_last_day_int
    ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_date_int) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      APPEND CAST d( lv_random_date_int ) TO rt_random_dates. " Cast integer back to date
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_random_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_dates( ).
    DATA(lt_dates) = lo_cut->generate_random_dates_in_year( iv_count = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_dates ) exp = 3 ).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_year) = lv_current_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_year)  = lv_current_year && '1231'.

    LOOP AT lt_dates INTO DATA(lv_date).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_date >= lv_first_day_of_year AND lv_date <= lv_last_day_of_year ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Zufallsdaten innerhalb eines Bereichs generiert, indem man Daten in ihre interne Ganzzahldarstellung umwandelt, Zufallszahlen generiert und diese dann zurück in Daten umwandelt. Der `CAST`-Operator für Typkonvertierung ist ein modernes Feature.
keywords: RANDOM, Date/Time, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, CAST

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in einer internen SFLIGHT-Tabelle, deren Flugnummern in einer bestimmten Range liegen (z.B. '001' bis '005').
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Range und verwenden Sie REDUCE mit einer FOR Schleife und IN Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_in_range
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        it_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_in_range.
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
      WHERE ( connid IN it_connid_range )
      NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_with_range( ).
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_with_range=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA lt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '006' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '005' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_test_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '001' high = '005' ) TO lt_connid_range.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_flights_in_range( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights it_connid_range = lt_connid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, die eine Range-Tabelle verwendet, ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Daten. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Syntax für komplexe Schleifenlogik.
keywords: RANGES, REDUCE, Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE IN

Instructions: Klassifizieren Sie eine Flugnummer (z.B. '001', '002', '003') in Kategorien ('Kurzstrecke', 'Mittelstrecke', 'Langstrecke') basierend auf vordefinierten Ranges für Flugnummern.
hint: Definieren Sie Ranges für jede Kategorie und verwenden Sie SWITCH mit IN Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS classify_flight_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_flight_connid.
    DATA lt_short_haul TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0099' ) TO lt_short_haul.

    DATA lt_medium_haul TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0100' high = '0499' ) TO lt_medium_haul.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 10 Einträgen, wobei jeder Eintrag eine zufällige Fluggesellschaft ('AA', 'LH', 'UA') und eine zufällige Flugnummer zwischen '001' und '999' enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE #( FOR ... ) mit CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT und SWITCH für die Fluggesellschaften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_data_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_data_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_flights.
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 3
    ).
    DATA(lo_random_connid) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 999
    ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
      ( carrid = SWITCH sflight-carrid(
                  WHEN lo_random_int->get_next( ) = 1 THEN 'AA'
                  WHEN lo_random_int->get_next( ) = 2 THEN 'LH'
                  ELSE 'UA' )
        connid = |{ lo_random_connid->get_next( ) ALPHA = IN }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT, deren Flugdatum im nächsten Quartal liegt, unter Verwendung einer dynamisch erstellten Range-Tabelle.
hint: Bestimmen Sie den Start- und Endtag des nächsten Quartals und erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_next_quarter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_next_quarter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_quarter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_next_quarter.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_current_month) = lv_current_date+4(2).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = lv_current_date+0(4).

    DATA lv_next_quarter_start TYPE d.
    DATA lv_next_quarter_end TYPE d.

    CASE lv_current_month.
      WHEN '01' TO '03'. " Q1 -> next Q2
        lv_next_quarter_start = lv_current_year && '0401'.
        lv_next_quarter_end   = lv_current_year && '0630'.
      WHEN '04' TO '06'. " Q2 -> next Q3
        lv_next_quarter_start = lv_current_year && '0701'.
        lv_next_quarter_end   = lv_current_year && '0930'.
      WHEN '07' TO '09'. " Q3 -> next Q4
        lv_next_quarter_start = lv_current_year && '1001'.
        lv_next_quarter_end   = lv_current_year && '1231'.
      WHEN OTHERS. " Q4 -> next Q1 of next year
        DATA(lv_next_year) = lv_current_year + 1.
        lv_next_quarter_start = lv_next_year && '0101'.
        lv_next_quarter_end   = lv_next_year && '0331'.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA lt_fldate_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-fldate.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = lv_next_quarter_start high = lv_next_quarter_end ) TO lt_fldate_range.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE fldate IN @lt_fldate_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_next_quarter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_next_quarter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_next_quarter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_next_quarter( ).

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_current_month) = lv_current_date+4(2).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = lv_current_date+0(4).

    DATA lv_expected_start TYPE d.
    DATA lv_expected_end TYPE d.

    CASE lv_current_month.
      WHEN '01' TO '03'.
        lv_expected_start = lv_current_year && '0401'.
        lv_expected_end   = lv_current_year && '0630'.
      WHEN '04' TO '06'.
        lv_expected_start = lv_current_year && '0701'.
        lv_expected_end   = lv_current_year && '0930'.
      WHEN '07' TO '09'.
        lv_expected_start = lv_current_year && '1001'.
        lv_expected_end   = lv_current_year && '1231'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        DATA(lv_next_year) = lv_current_year + 1.
        lv_expected_start = lv_next_year && '0101'.
        lv_expected_end   = lv_next_year && '0331'.
    ENDCASE.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_expected_start AND ls_flight-fldate <= lv_expected_end ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Berechnung des nächsten Quartals und die Erstellung einer entsprechenden Range-Tabelle. Die `CASE`-Anweisung für die Quartalslogik und die Verwendung der Range in der `SELECT`-Anweisung sind moderne und klare Ansätze für datumsbasierte Selektionen.
keywords: RANGES, Date/Time, SELECT, CASE, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie die gesammelten Nachrichten eines `cl_message_helper`-Objekts, um nur Fehlermeldungen zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_msg_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             type    TYPE symsgty,

             number  TYPE symsgno,

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein `cl_message_helper`-Objekt eine Fehlermeldung mit einer bestimmten Nachrichten-ID enthält.

CLASS zcl_msg_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS has_specific_error
      IMPORTING
        io_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper
        iv_msg_id         TYPE symsgid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_error) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_specific_error.
    rv_has_error = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( io_message_helper->get_messages( ) WHERE type = 'E' AND id = iv_msg_id )
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein `cl_message_helper`-Objekt aus einer internen Tabelle von Nachrichten, die nicht im `BAPIRET2`-Format vorliegen, und fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Nachricht hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper=>create_empty` und `add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_custom_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_message,
             type    TYPE symsgty,
             id      TYPE symsgid,
             number  TYPE symsgno,
             text    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_custom_message.
    TYPES: tt_custom_message TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_custom_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_add_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_custom_messages TYPE tt_custom_message
        iv_additional_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_helper) TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_custom_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_add_messages.
    ro_message_helper = cl_message_helper=>create_empty( ).

    LOOP AT it_custom_messages INTO DATA(ls_custom_msg).
      ro_message_helper->add_message(
        i_msgty = ls_custom_msg-type
        i_msgid = ls_custom_msg-id
        i_msgno = ls_custom_msg-number
        i_msgv1 = ls_custom_msg-text ).
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_message_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '999'
      i_msgv1 = iv_additional_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_custom_messages TYPE zcl_msg_custom_add=>tt_custom_message.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_custom_messages ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_msg>).
    <fs_msg>-type = 'W'.
    <fs_msg>-id = 'ZTEST'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_custom_add( ).
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = lo_cut->create_and_add_messages( it_custom_messages = lt_custom_messages iv_additional_text = 'Added Info' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_msg_helper->has_warnings( ) ).

CLASS zcl_msg_placeholder IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = cl_message_helper=>create_empty( ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_msg_helper->get_messages( ).

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             uuid TYPE sysuuid_c32,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY uuid.

    CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS add_and_get_data IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.

      METHOD add_and_get_data.
        STATICS: st_data_table TYPE tt_data_hashed.

        DATA(lv_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid( )->if_system_uuid_rfc4122~get_uuid_c32( ).
        DATA(ls_new_data) = VALUE ty_data( uuid = lv_uuid text = iv_text ).

        INSERT ls_new_data INTO TABLE st_data_table.

        " Access using TABLE LINE
        READ TABLE st_data_table WITH TABLE KEY uuid = lv_uuid INTO rs_data.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Geben Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle von Strings zeilenweise aus. Jede Zeile soll dabei mit einer fortlaufenden Nummer versehen sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP AT`-Schleife und die `WRITE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS write_string_table IMPORTING it_strings TYPE string_table
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_output_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_string_table.
    DATA lv_line_num TYPE i VALUE 0.
    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      lv_line_num = lv_line_num + 1.
      DATA(lv_output_line) TYPE string.
      WRITE lv_line_num TO lv_output_line LEFT-JUSTIFIED.
      CONCATENATE lv_output_line ` - ` lv_string INTO lv_output_line.
      APPEND lv_output_line TO rt_output_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` existiert. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung aus, die den Status und die Flugdetails enthält, falls der Flug gefunden wurde. Nutzen Sie dabei `LINE_EXISTS` und den Inline-Deklarations-`READ TABLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF line_exists(...)` und `READ TABLE ... INTO DATA(...) FOR KEY ...`
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_sflight_and_write IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                              iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                              iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_sflight_and_write.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS. " Example data

    IF line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate INTO DATA(ls_found_sflight).
      DATA(lv_price_formatted) TYPE string.
      WRITE ls_found_sflight-price TO lv_price_formatted CURRENCY ls_found_sflight-currency.
      rv_output = |Flug { ls_found_sflight-carrid } { ls_found_sflight-connid } am { ls_found_sflight-fldate DATE = USER } gefunden. Preis: { lv_price_formatted } { ls_found_sflight-currency }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_output = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
