solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             duration TYPE i, " Duration in minutes
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_duration TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg.
    TYPES ty_carrier_averages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_duration
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_averages) TYPE ty_carrier_averages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_duration.
    rt_averages = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN it_flights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
      LET ls_sum_count = REDUCE struct(
                             INIT sum_duration = 0 TYPE i
                                  count = 0 TYPE i
                             FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP carrier_group
                             NEXT sum_duration = sum_duration + <fs_group_flight>-duration,
                                  count = count + 1 )
      IN
      ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid,
        average_duration = COND decfloat16(
                             WHEN ls_sum_count-count > 0
                             THEN CONV decfloat16( ls_sum_count-sum_duration ) / ls_sum_count-count
                             ELSE 0 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_max_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             max_price_connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             max_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_max_flight.
    TYPES ty_carrier_max_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_max_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_flight_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE ty_carrier_max_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flight_per_carrier.
    rt_max_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN it_flights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
      LET ls_max_flight = REDUCE ty_flight(
                              INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_flight( price = 0 )
                              FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP carrier_group
                              NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN <fs_group_flight>-price > max_flight-price
                                                         THEN <fs_group_flight>
                                                         ELSE max_flight ) )
      IN
      ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid,
        max_price_connid = ls_max_flight-connid,
        max_price = ls_max_flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        ev_max  = lv_max
        ev_min  = lv_min
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max exp = '-5' msg = 'Max negative value incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min exp = '-10' msg = 'Min negative value incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden `max` und `min` in `cl_abap_math` bieten eine einfache Möglichkeit, den größten oder kleinsten Wert zwischen zwei Zahlen zu ermitteln, was in vielen Vergleichs- und Sortieralgorithmen nützlich ist.
keywords: cl_abap_math, Max, Min, DECFLOAT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen ALV-Bericht mit `cl_salv_ex_util` und zeigen Sie ihn an. (Hinweis: `cl_salv_ex_util` ist primär für den Export, aber kann indirekt mit `cl_salv_table` kombiniert werden, um den Feldkatalog zu nutzen).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_ex_util=>if_salv_ex_util~factory` für den Feldkatalog und `cl_salv_table=>factory` für die Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_alv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                  t_tab     = lt_sflights ).
          " Optional: Get field catalog via cl_salv_ex_util and apply to ALV
          DATA(lt_field_cat) = cl_salv_ex_util=>if_salv_ex_util~factory( )->get_field_catalog(
                                  EXPORTING i_t_data = lt_sflights ).
          lo_alv->set_field_catalog( lt_field_cat ).

          lo_alv->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Direct display of ALV in unit test is not possible as it requires GUI context.
    " This test primarily checks if the method can be called without immediate syntax errors.
    " A real test would involve mocking cl_salv_table or checking for exceptions.
    lo_alv_displayer->display_sflights_alv( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_salv_ex_util` zur dynamischen Generierung eines Feldkatalogs verwendet werden kann, der dann zur Konfiguration eines `cl_salv_table`-basierten ALV-Berichts dient. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und moderne ALV-Erstellung.
keywords: cl_salv_ex_util, cl_salv_table, ALV, Dynamic Programming, Field Catalog

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einem dynamisch erstellten Bereich für die Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator und den `VALUE` Operator, um den Bereich zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_by_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_low  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_carrid_high TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_by_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    " Dynamically create a range table for CARRID
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ranges of s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = iv_carrid_low high = iv_carrid_high )
    ).

    " Fetch all flights (for simplicity, in real scenario, filter in DB)
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Filter the internal table using the range table
    rt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_by_range( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights( iv_carrid_low = 'AA' iv_carrid_high = 'LH' ).

    " Assert that some known flights are present and others are not
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_result WHERE carrid = 'AZ' )
      msg = 'Flights with AZ should not be present'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_result WHERE carrid = 'AA' )
      msg = 'Flights with AA should be present'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_result WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      msg = 'Flights with LH should be present'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht das effiziente Filtern interner Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen, einschließlich der Verwendung von Range-Tabellen. In Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator zur dynamischen Erstellung der Range-Tabelle wird der Code sehr kompakt und lesbar.
keywords: FILTER, VALUE, RANGES, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`), die explizit 'AA' und 'SQ' enthält, sowie alle Fluggesellschaften außer 'LH'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator, um mehrere Einträge mit verschiedenen `SIGN` und `OPTION` Werten zu initialisieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`), die alle Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `scarr` enthält, deren Name mit 'L' beginnt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife innerhalb des `VALUE` Operators, um die Range-Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrid_range_starting_with_l
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE ranges of s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_range_starting_with_l.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_carriers.

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR <fs_carrier> IN lt_carriers WHERE ( carrid CP 'L*' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <fs_carrier>-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_range_for_loop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_range_for_loop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_for_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_carrid_range_starting_with_l( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' and 'LX' are in SCARR and start with 'L'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_range WHERE low = 'LH' )
      msg = 'Range should contain LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_range WHERE low = 'LX' )
      msg = 'Range should contain LX'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_range WHERE low = 'AA' )
      msg = 'Range should not contain AA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression (ABAP 7.40+) in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung von internen Tabellen. Hier wird eine Range-Tabelle basierend auf einer Schleife über eine andere Tabelle und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung gefüllt, was den Code sehr ausdrucksstark und effizient macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, RANGES, Internal Tables, SCARR

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei Range-Tabellen für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) in einer neuen Range-Tabelle. Die erste Range-Tabelle enthält 'AA' und 'DL', die zweite 'LH' und 'UA'. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression und `COND` um die Einträge zu konsolidieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN` über eine Liste von Range-Tabellen und `COND` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_combine_ranges DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS combine_carrid_ranges
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_range) TYPE ranges of s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_combine_ranges IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_carrid_ranges.
    DATA(lt_range1) = VALUE ranges of s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'DL' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_range2) = VALUE ranges of s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
    ).

    rt_combined_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR <fs_entry> IN lt_range1
      ( <fs_entry> )
      FOR <fs_entry> IN lt_range2
      ( <fs_entry> )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_ranges FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_ranges.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_combine_ranges( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_carrid_ranges( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_combined WHERE low = 'AA' )
      msg = 'Combined range should contain AA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_combined WHERE low = 'DL' )
      msg = 'Combined range should contain DL'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_combined WHERE low = 'LH' )
      msg = 'Combined range should contain LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_combined WHERE low = 'UA' )
      msg = 'Combined range should contain UA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression (ABAP 7.40+) kann über mehrere interne Tabellen iterieren und deren Inhalte in einer neuen Tabelle konsolidieren. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und performante Art, Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu aggregieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, RANGES, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Einträge in eine bereits existierende `SORTED TABLE` von Fluggesellschaften ein. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` mit `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`.
hint: Beachten Sie, dass `INSERT` in eine `SORTED TABLE` die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch beibehält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_sorted_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid carrname.

    METHODS insert_new_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_carrname TYPE s_carrname
      CHANGING
        ct_carriers TYPE tt_sorted_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_new_carrier.
    DATA(ls_new_carrier) = VALUE ty_carrier( carrid = iv_carrid carrname = iv_carrname ).
    INSERT ls_new_carrier INTO TABLE ct_carriers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier>).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle duplicate key error if UNIQUE KEY is used
      " For this example, we assume no duplicates for simplicity or let it dump for demonstration
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted_table=>tt_sorted_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' )
    ).

    lo_cut->insert_new_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_carrname = 'Lufthansa' CHANGING ct_carriers = lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carriers ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carriers[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ). " LH should be in the middle due to sorting
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carriers[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carriers[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` Statement (ABAP 7.40+) für `SORTED TABLE`s fügt neue Einträge an der korrekten Position ein, um die Sortierreihenfolge beizubehalten. Die Verwendung von `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf den eingefügten Eintrag, was performanter ist als ein anschließendes `READ TABLE`.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT, FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer `SORTED TABLE` von Fluggesellschaften (`scarr`) basierend auf dem `carrid`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY` auf der `SORTED TABLE`. Der `BINARY SEARCH` wird implizit angewendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_sorted_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid carrname.

    METHODS get_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        it_carriers TYPE tt_sorted_carriers READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrname) TYPE s_carrname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_name.
    READ TABLE it_carriers WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_carrname = ls_carrier-carrname.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_read_sorted_table=>tt_sorted_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_name_lh) = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_carriers = lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name_lh exp = 'Lufthansa' ).

    DATA(lv_name_az) = lo_cut->get_carrier_name( iv_carrid = 'AZ' it_carriers = lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_name_az msg = 'AZ should not be found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY` Statement (ABAP 7.40+) auf einer `SORTED TABLE` ist hochperformant, da der ABAP-Kernel automatisch einen binären Suchalgorithmus verwendet. Dies ist die effizienteste Methode, um einzelne Einträge in einer sortierten Tabelle zu finden.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, BINARY SEARCH, Internal Tables

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Namen einer Fluggesellschaft in einer `SORTED TABLE` von Fluggesellschaften. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `MODIFY`.
hint: Wenn Sie mit `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` arbeiten, können Sie die Daten direkt im Field-Symbol ändern, ohne ein explizites `MODIFY` Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_sorted_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid carrname.

    METHODS update_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_carrname TYPE s_carrname
      CHANGING
        ct_carriers    TYPE tt_sorted_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_carrier_name.
    LOOP AT ct_carriers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_carrier>-carrname = iv_new_carrname.
      " No explicit MODIFY needed when using FIELD-SYMBOL
      EXIT. " Only update the first occurrence if key is not unique, or exit for unique key
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_carrier_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_carrier_name.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht das effiziente Auffinden und direkte Modifizieren von Einträgen in einer internen Tabelle. Bei `SORTED TABLE`s ist dies besonders performant, da die Suche optimiert ist. Ein explizites `MODIFY` ist nicht notwendig, wenn ein Field-Symbol verwendet wird.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` als Nachschlagetabelle, um Fluggesellschaftsnamen zu einer Liste von Flug-IDs (`sflight-carrid`) hinzuzufügen. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `FOR`-Expression mit `IN` und `FROM`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit einer `FROM` Klausel, um die `SORTED TABLE` effizient zu durchsuchen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_sorted_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS enrich_flights_with_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights READ-ONLY
        it_carriers TYPE tt_sorted_carriers READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD enrich_flights_with_carrier_name.
    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      LET ls_carrier = it_carriers[ KEY primary_key carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] IN
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_flight-connid,
        carrname = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN ls_carrier-carrname ELSE 'Unknown' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_enrich_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enrich_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_lookup( ).

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' )
      ( carrid = 'AZ' connid = '003' ) " Unknown carrier
    ).

    DATA(lt_test_carriers) = VALUE zcl_sorted_lookup=>tt_sorted_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_enriched_flights) = lo_cut->enrich_flights_with_carrier_name(
      it_flights = lt_test_flights
      it_carriers = lt_test_carriers
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_enriched_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_flight_aa) = lt_enriched_flights[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_lh) = lt_enriched_flights[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_az) = lt_enriched_flights[ 3 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_az-carrname exp = 'Unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression (ABAP 7.40+) in Kombination mit dem `LET` Ausdruck und dem Tabellen-Ausdruck `it_carriers[ KEY primary_key carrid = ... ]` ermöglicht eine deklarative und performante Anreicherung von Daten. Da `it_carriers` eine `SORTED TABLE` ist, erfolgt der Zugriff über den Schlüssel sehr effizient. Der `COND` Operator (ABAP 7.40+) wird verwendet, um bedingt einen Wert zuzuweisen, falls der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, LET, Table Expression, COND, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), die nur die Fluggesellschaften enthält, die mehr als 10 Flüge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Expression, um die Fluggesellschaften zu zählen, und dann `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_from_grouped DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrid_range_by_flight_count
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE ranges of s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_from_grouped IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_range_by_flight_count.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid ) 
      WHERE ( lines( GROUP ls_group ) > iv_min_flights )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls_group-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_range_from_grouped FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_range_from_grouped.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_from_grouped( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_carrid_range_by_flight_count( iv_min_flights = 10 ).

    " Assuming 'AA' has more than 10 flights and 'AZ' has less (or none)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_range WHERE low = 'AA' )
      msg = 'Range should contain AA if it has >10 flights'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_range WHERE low = 'AZ' )
      msg = 'Range should not contain AZ if it has <=10 flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle, ähnlich wie in SQL. Hier werden Fluggesellschaften nach der Anzahl ihrer Flüge gruppiert und nur diejenigen in die Range-Tabelle aufgenommen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl überschreiten. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Methode zur Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, VALUE, RANGES, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von Fluggesellschaften (`scarr`) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `scarr`. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Tabelle nur Einträge enthält, deren `carrid` nicht 'AZ' ist, und verwenden Sie hierfür den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die `SORTED TABLE` iterativ zu füllen und dabei unerwünschte Einträge zu überspringen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_sorted_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_filtered_sorted_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_sorted_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sorted_carriers.
    DATA: lt_scarr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr_data.

    rt_carriers = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sorted_carriers( )
      FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr_data
      WHERE ( ls_scarr-carrid <> 'AZ' )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_sorted_carriers( BASE result ( carrid = ls_scarr-carrid carrname = ls_scarr-carrname ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sorted_carriers( ).

    " Assuming 'AA' and 'LH' are in SCARR and 'AZ' might be
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_carriers WHERE carrid = 'AZ' )
      msg = 'AZ should not be present'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_carriers WHERE carrid = 'AA' )
      msg = 'AA should be present'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_carriers WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      msg = 'LH should be present'
    ).

    " Verify sorting (implicit for SORTED TABLE)
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      IF lv_prev_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( ls_carrier-carrid > lv_prev_carrid )
          msg = 'Table is not sorted correctly'
        ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_carrier-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ABAP 7.50+) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Transformation und Aggregation von Daten. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine `SORTED TABLE` deklarativ zu füllen, wobei unerwünschte Einträge (`carrid = 'AZ'`) direkt während der Iteration ausgeschlossen werden. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, SORTED TABLE, VALUE, Internal Tables, SCARR, Filtering

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer `SORTED TABLE` von Fluggesellschaften, deren `carrid` mit 'A' beginnt. Verwenden Sie den `DELETE` Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Der `DELETE` Operator kann direkt mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel auf internen Tabellen verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_sorted_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS delete_carriers_by_pattern
      CHANGING
        ct_carriers TYPE tt_sorted_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_carriers_by_pattern.
    DELETE ct_carriers WHERE carrid CP 'A*'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_carriers_by_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_carriers_by_pattern.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_delete_sorted_table=>tt_sorted_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( carrid = 'AZ' carrname = 'Alitalia' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' )
    ).

    lo_cut->delete_carriers_by_pattern( CHANGING ct_carriers = lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_carriers WHERE carrid = 'AA' )
      msg = 'AA should be deleted'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_carriers WHERE carrid = 'AZ' )
      msg = 'AZ should be deleted'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_carriers WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      msg = 'LH should remain'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carriers ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `DELETE` Operator (ABAP 7.40+) mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel ist die moderne und effiziente Art, Einträge aus internen Tabellen zu entfernen. Bei `SORTED TABLE`s bleibt die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch erhalten. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und performanter als ältere `LOOP`- und `DELETE`-Konstrukte.
keywords: DELETE, SORTED TABLE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[2]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne und sehr lesbare Methode, um interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen und `DELETE` Anweisungen und ist ideal für die Vorbereitung von Daten für eine `if_salv_gui_table_ida` Instanz.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, ALV IDA, Data Filtering

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und formatieren Sie diese als String.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw,
           tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             flight_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_id,
           tt_flight_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_ids) TYPE tt_flight_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flight_ids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_raw_flights
                             ( flight_id = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_itab_for_value=>tt_sflight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[1]-flight_id exp = 'LH-00000400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[2]-flight_id exp = 'AA-00000017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Schleife und `VALUE`-Konstruktor ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Formatierung verwendet.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price,
           tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_prices TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) ) " Initialwert für Summe
                               FOR ls_price IN it_flight_prices
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_price-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = VALUE zcl_itab_reduce=>tt_sflight_price(
      ( price = '100.00' )
      ( price = '250.50' )
      ( price = '50.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_prices ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr funktionale und ausdrucksstarke Weise, was zu kürzerem und klarerem Code führt als traditionelle Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in einer modernen Open SQL Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_avg_price,
           tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_avg_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_prices_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( price ) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_avg_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_group_having( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_prices_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_avg_prices ).
    " Weitere spezifische Assertions könnten hier hinzugefügt werden, 
    " z.B. Überprüfung, ob 'LH' enthalten ist und COUNT(*) > 5 ist.
    DATA(ls_entry) = lt_avg_prices[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    IF ls_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_entry-flight_count > 5 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne Open SQL Syntax erlaubt die direkte Verwendung von Aggregatfunktionen, `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` Klauseln, was komplexe Datenanalysen direkt in der Datenbank ermöglicht und die Notwendigkeit von nachfolgender ABAP-Verarbeitung reduziert.
keywords: Open SQL, GROUP BY, HAVING, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Instanz einer anderen Klasse erstellt und eine Methode dieser Instanz aufruft (Method Chaining).

CLASS zcl_method_chain_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Status-Code einen beschreibenden Text zurückgibt, wobei Sie eine moderne `SWITCH`-Expression verwenden.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_status_code
                               WHEN 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'
                               WHEN 'I' THEN 'Inaktiv'
                               WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blockiert'
                               ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_description( 'A' ) exp = 'Aktiv' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_description( 'X' ) exp = 'Unbekannter Status' ).

explanation: Die `SWITCH`-Expression ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zur traditionellen `CASE`-Anweisung, insbesondere wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Sie verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Codezeilen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, SWITCH Expression, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch aus einer Struktur, dessen Feldname zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und den dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data    TYPE ty_data
        iv_fieldname TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'Testwert'
      field2 = 123
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_fieldname = 'FIELD1' ) exp = 'Testwert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_fieldname = 'FIELD2' ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_fieldname = 'NONEXISTENT' ) exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Programmierung. Es ist zwar schon länger verfügbar, aber in modernen Kontexten oft in Kombination mit RTTI oder anderen dynamischen Techniken zu finden.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Feldsymbole, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RTTI

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage nach einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die moderne Datumskalkulation mit `+` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Klasse mit einer `FINAL` Methode, die nicht überschrieben werden kann, und demonstrieren Sie deren Aufruf.
hint: Verwenden Sie das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` in der Methodendefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_final_method_base DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_base_info FINAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_specific_info ABSTRACT
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_final_method_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_base_info.
    rv_info = 'Dies ist die Basisinformation (final).'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_final_method_derived DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_final_method_base PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_specific_info REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_final_method_derived IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_specific_info.
    rv_info = 'Dies ist die spezifische Information der abgeleiteten Klasse.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_final_method_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_demo
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_final_method_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_demo.
    DATA(lo_derived) = NEW zcl_final_method_derived( ).
    APPEND lo_derived->get_base_info( ) TO rt_output.
    APPEND lo_derived->get_specific_info( ) TO rt_output.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_final_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_final_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_final_method_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->run_demo( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[1] exp = 'Dies ist die Basisinformation (final).' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[2] exp = 'Dies ist die spezifische Information der abgeleiteten Klasse.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `FINAL`-Schlüsselwort für Methoden verhindert, dass diese in Unterklassen überschrieben werden können. Dies fördert die Stabilität der Klassenhierarchie und die Einhaltung von Designprinzipien, indem es die Implementierung bestimmter Logik festschreibt. Die Kombination mit `ABSTRACT` zeigt ein modernes OO-Design.
keywords: Object Orientation, FINAL, Method, Inheritance, Abstract Class

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von der internen ABAP-Codepage (UTF-8) nach UTF-16 Big Endian und geben Sie das Ergebnis als XSTRING zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create` mit `codepage = '1200'` und `endian = 'BIG'`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_utf16 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_utf16 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
                                codepage = '1200' " UTF-16 Big Endian
                                endian   = 'BIG' ).
    lo_conv->write( iv_input ).
    rv_output = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_utf8_utf16( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜ'.
    " UTF-16BE for 'Hello World! ÄÖÜ'
    DATA(lv_expected_hex) = '00480065006C006C006F00200057006F0072006C00640021002000C400D600DC'.
    DATA(lv_output_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_string( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_output_xstring
      exp = lv_expected_hex
      msg = 'UTF-8 to UTF-16BE conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` zur Konvertierung eines ABAP-Strings (intern UTF-8) in ein XSTRING im UTF-16 Big Endian-Format. Dies ist nützlich für die Erstellung von Dateien oder Datenströmen, die eine spezifische Codierung erfordern.
keywords: Codepage, UTF-8, UTF-16, Conversion, XSTRING

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen ABAP-Integer (Typ I, 4 Bytes) in seine binäre XSTRING-Darstellung im Big Endian-Format.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` mit `codepage = '1103'` (binär) und `endian = 'BIG'`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_endian DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS int_to_big_endian_raw
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i

CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv.
    DATA: lv_csv_line TYPE string,
          lt_csv_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    " Add header
    APPEND 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY' TO lt_csv_lines.

    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_csv_line = |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency }|.
      APPEND lv_csv_line TO lt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
                                codepage = iv_codepage
                                endian   = 'BIG' ). " Endian doesn't matter much for character data

    LOOP AT lt_csv_lines INTO lv_csv_line.
      lo_conv->write( lv_csv_line ).
      lo_conv->write( cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ). " Add newline
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen großen String blockweise von der internen ABAP-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage (z.B. UTF-16BE), um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `write` und `get_buffer` von `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` in einer Schleife, indem Sie den Eingabestring in Chunks verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_stream DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_large_string_stream
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT '1200' " UTF-16BE
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i DEFAULT 1000 " Characters
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_stream IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_large_string_stream.
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
                                   codepage = iv_target_codepage
                                   endian   = 'BIG' ).

    DATA(lv_current_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_input_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    DATA: lv_sub_string TYPE string.

    WHILE lv_current_offset < lv_input_length.
      lv_sub_string = iv_input+lv_current_offset(MIN( iv_chunk_size, lv_input_length - lv_current_offset )).
      lo_conv_out->write( lv_sub_string ).
      lv_current_offset = lv_current_offset + strlen( lv_sub_string ).
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_output_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_stream_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_stream( ).
    DATA(lv_long_string) = 'A' && REPEAT( val = 'B' occ = 999 ) && 'C' && REPEAT( val = 'D' occ = 500 ) && 'E'.
    DATA(lv_chunk_size) = 500.

    DATA(lv_output_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_large_string_stream(
                                         iv_input = lv_long_string
                                         iv_chunk_size = lv_chunk_size ).

    " Convert back to string for assertion (assuming system codepage is compatible)
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
                                  codepage = '1200' " UTF-16BE
                                  endian   = 'BIG' ).
    lo_conv_in->write( lv_output_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_output_string) = lo_conv_in->read( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_output_string
      exp = lv_long_string
      msg = 'Stream conversion of large string failed' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = xstrlen( lv_output_xstring ) / 2 " UTF-16BE uses 2 bytes per char
      exp = strlen( lv_long_string )
      msg = 'Output xstring length mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die blockweise Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen verwendet werden kann. Anstatt den gesamten String auf einmal zu konvertieren, wird er in kleineren 'Chunks' verarbeitet, was den Speicherverbrauch reduziert und die Leistung bei sehr großen Datenobjekten verbessern kann. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode für das Stream-Processing.
keywords: Stream, Large Data, Codepage, Performance, Chunking

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container mit einem Button und reagieren Sie auf das `click`-Event des Buttons. (Hinweis: Für einen echten Test ist ein Dynpro erforderlich, hier wird nur die Event-Registrierung geprüft).
hint: Implementieren Sie eine Event-Handler-Methode mit `FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button` und registrieren Sie diese mit `SET HANDLER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dock_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_button            TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    DATA mv_button_clicked    TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    METHODS create_and_register_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.

    METHODS on_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button.

    METHODS free_controls.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_register_event.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
        extension = 50
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_button
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_docking_container
          text   = 'Click Me!'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
      ENDIF.

      IF mo_button IS BOUND.
        SET HANDLER on_button_click FOR mo_button.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_button_click.
    mv_button_clicked = abap_true.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde hier eine Aktion ausgeführt
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_controls.
    IF mo_button IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_button->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      CLEAR mo_button.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_docking_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      CLEAR mo_docking_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie ein Docking Container von seinem Dynpro gelöst (`undock`) und anschließend zerstört (`free`) wird, um GUI-Ressourcen freizugeben. (Hinweis: Für einen echten Test ist ein Dynpro erforderlich, hier wird nur die Methode aufgerufen).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `undock` und `free` des Docking Containers in der richtigen Reihenfolge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dock_free DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.

    METHODS create_docking_container
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.

    METHODS undock_and_free.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dock_free IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_docking_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension = 100
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD undock_and_free.
    IF mo_docking_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_docking_container->undock
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
      ENDIF.

      CALL METHOD mo_docking_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR mo_docking_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse enthält. Die E-Mail-Adresse muss dem Muster 'name@domain.com' folgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `MATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_email IMPORTING iv_email TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_email.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '^\w+([\.-]?\w+)*@\w+([\.-]?\w+)*(\.\w{2,3})+$' ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_regex->match( text = iv_email ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_email FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_email.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_email_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'test@example.com' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'first.last@sub.domain.co.uk' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_email.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_email_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'invalid-email' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'test@.com' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'test@example' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_REGEX` bietet eine objektorientierte Schnittstelle für reguläre Ausdrücke. Die Methode `MATCH` ist ideal, um zu prüfen, ob ein gesamter String einem bestimmten Muster entspricht, was zu sauberem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, MATCH, String, Validierung

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem String, die von Klammern umschlossen sind, z.B. '(123)', '(45)'. Geben Sie die extrahierten Zahlen als Liste zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit Capturing Groups und `FIND_ALL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_bracketed_numbers IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_bracketed_numbers.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\((\d+)\)' ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_regex->find_all( text = iv_text ).

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_matches
                          LET lv_number = lo_regex->get_submatch( match = <match> submatch_index = 1 )
                          IN ( lv_number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_multiple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_none FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_mixed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_multiple.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_number_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_bracketed_numbers( 'Text mit (123) und (45) Zahlen.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '45' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_none.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_number_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_bracketed_numbers( 'Keine Zahlen hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_mixed.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_number_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_bracketed_numbers( 'Mix (1) und Text (2) und (abc) ungültig.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit Capturing Groups (`(\d+)`) und der `FOR`-Iteration mit `VALUE` und `LET`. `FIND_ALL` liefert alle Treffer, und `get_submatch` extrahiert den Inhalt der Capturing Group. Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, eine neue Tabelle aus den extrahierten Werten zu konstruieren.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, FIND_ALL, Capturing Groups, FOR, VALUE, LET, String

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften ('CARRID') aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, die 'LH' (Lufthansa) sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_flight_id.
    TYPES tt_flight_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lufthansa_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_lufthansa_flights) TYPE tt_flight_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lufthansa_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_lufthansa_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                    ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_lufthansa_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lufthansa_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_lufthansa_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_id).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_id-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` und `WHERE` ist eine sehr elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig neue Tabellen zu konstruieren. Sie ersetzt explizite `LOOP`s und `APPEND`s und macht den Code lesbarer und kompakter.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Internal Tables, sflights, Filter

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise ('PRICE') für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `REDUCE` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_aa RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_aa.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price_aa FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_aa.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflights_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_aggregator->get_total_price_aa( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge von AA in sflight und deren Preise sind > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist perfekt für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. Sie initialisiert einen Wert (`sum_price`) und iteriert dann über die gefilterten Elemente (`FOR ... WHERE`), um diesen Wert schrittweise zu aktualisieren. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr ausdrucksstarke Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`s mit `SUM`.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, WHERE, Internal Tables, sflights, Aggregation, Summe

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft ('CARRID') und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                            ( carrid       = flight-carrid
                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                              avg_price    = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                                         FOR member IN GROUP
                                                         NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob LH vorhanden ist und die Werte plausibel sind
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    IF ls_lh_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-avg_price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob AA vorhanden ist und die Werte plausibel sind
    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    IF ls_aa_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_aa_summary-avg_price > 0 ).
    END IF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY`-Expression ist ein mächtiges Feature für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht sie komplexe Aggregationen pro Gruppe in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights, Gruppierung, Aggregation

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Wörter in einem Text, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen und mindestens 3 Zeichen lang sind. Geben Sie diese Wörter als Liste zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit `FIND_ALL` und einem geeigneten Muster für Wörter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_capital_word_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_capital_words IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_capital_word_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_capital_words.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]{2,}\b' ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_regex->find_all( text = iv_text ).

    rt_words = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_matches
                          ( lo_regex->get_match( match = <match> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_multiple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_none FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_mixed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_multiple.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_capital_word_finder( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_finder->find_capital_words( 'Dies Ist Ein Test Satz. ABAP ist Super.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, deren Flugpreis ('PRICE') über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Fügen Sie zusätzlich ein Feld 'IS_EXPENSIVE' hinzu, das 'X' ist, wenn der Preis über dem Schwellenwert liegt, sonst leer.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE`, `WHERE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_expensive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             is_expensive TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights IMPORTING iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_flight_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_expensive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    WHERE ( price > iv_threshold )
                                    ( carrid     = flight-carrid,
                                      connid     = flight-connid,
                                      price      = flight-price,
                                      is_expensive = COND #( WHEN flight-price > iv_threshold THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein String nur aus Ziffern besteht.

CLASS zcl_numeric_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` den Flugpreis um 10% erhöht. Die neue Tabelle soll nur die Felder 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und den neuen 'PRICE' enthalten.

CLASS zcl_sflights_price_increase DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_increased_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_increased_flight.
    TYPES tt_increased_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_increased_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_increased_flights) TYPE tt_increased_flights.

CLASS zcl_sflights_price_increase IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_increased_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    ( carrid    = flight-carrid,
                                      connid    = flight-connid,
                                      new_price = flight-price * '1.1' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_modifier->increase_prices( ).

    DATA(ls_original_flight) TYPE sflight.

Hier wird für jeden Eintrag der Quelltabelle ein neuer Eintrag in der Zieltabelle erstellt, wobei der Preis direkt im Ausdruck um 10% erhöht wird. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Art der Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Validieren Sie einen String, der eine Liste von durch Komma getrennten Wörtern darstellt. Jedes Wort muss alphanumerisch sein und darf keine Leerzeichen enthalten. Die Liste darf auch leer sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit einem komplexeren Muster und `MATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_wordlist_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_word_list IMPORTING iv_list TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_wordlist_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_word_list.
    " Muster: Leerer String ODER (alphanumerisches Wort (ohne Leerzeichen) optional gefolgt von ',alphanumerisches Wort')*
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '^(?:\w+(?:,\w+)*)?$' ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_regex->match( text = iv_list ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_lists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_lists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_lists.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_wordlist_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'word1,word2,word3' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'singleword' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'word123' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_lists.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_wordlist_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'word1, word2' ) ). " Leerzeichen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'word1,word2,' ) ). " Endet mit Komma
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( ',word1' ) ). " Beginnt mit Komma
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'word1,w@rd2' ) ). " Sonderzeichen
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_wordlist_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Regex-Muster `^(?:\w+(?:,\w+)*)?$` ist komplexer, da es eine optionale, nicht-fangende Gruppe `(?:...)` verwendet, um die gesamte Liste als optional zu markieren. `\w+` steht für alphanumerische Zeichen (Wörter), und `(?:,\w+)*` erlaubt beliebig viele weitere durch Komma getrennte Wörter. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Listenstrukturen zu validieren.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, MATCH, Validierung, String, Liste, Muster

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouped_connids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_connids,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_carrid_connids.
    TYPES tt_carrid_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_by_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_connids) TYPE tt_carrid_connids.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouped_connids IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    rt_grouped_connids = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                                  ( carrid  = flight-carrid,

                                                       ( member-connid ) ) ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` den Flugpreis in eine Währung umrechnet (z.B. von USD in EUR mit einem festen Kurs von 0.9). Die neue Tabelle soll die ursprüngliche Währung und den umgerechneten Preis enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` und `LET` für Zwischenberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_currency_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_converted_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             original_price TYPE sflight-price,
             original_currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             converted_price TYPE sflight-price,
             target_currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_converted_price.
    TYPES tt_converted_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_converted_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_prices IMPORTING iv_exchange_rate TYPE decfloat16
                                     iv_target_currency TYPE sflight-currency
                           RETURNING VALUE(rt_converted_prices) TYPE tt_converted_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_currency_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_converted_prices = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   LET lv_converted_price = flight-price * iv_exchange_rate
                                   IN ( carrid          = flight-carrid,
                                        connid          = flight-connid,
                                        original_price  = flight-price,
                                        original_currency = flight-currency,
                                        converted_price = lv_converted_price,
                                        target_currency = iv_target_currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_currency_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_currency_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_sflights_currency_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_exchange_rate) = '0.9'.
    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'EUR'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_converter->convert_prices( iv_exchange_rate = lv_exchange_rate
                                                    iv_target_currency = lv_target_currency ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Prüfen Sie einen bekannten Flug (z.B. LH 0400) oder den ersten Eintrag
    DATA(ls_original_flight) TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_original_flight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(ls_converted_flight) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = ls_original_flight-carrid connid = ls_original_flight-connid DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_converted_flight ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted_flight-converted_price exp = ls_original_flight-price * lv_exchange_rate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted_flight-target_currency exp = lv_target_currency ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LET`-Expression innerhalb einer `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen (`lv_converted_price`), die nur für die aktuelle Iteration gültig sind. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in ein XSTRING im UTF-8 Format, um sie für den Versand per Business Communication Services (BCS) vorzubereiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>STRING_TO_SOLIX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_string_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_strings_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_string_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings_to_xstring.
    DATA: lt_solix TYPE solix_tab.

    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string  = REDUCE string(
                       INIT s = ``
                       FOR <fs> IN it_strings
                       NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <fs> )
                     )
        iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
        iv_add_bom  = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        et_solix   = lt_solix
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_solix INTO DATA(ls_solix).
      rv_xstring = rv_xstring && ls_solix-line.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_string_to_xstring_cp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_strings_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_string_to_xstring_cp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings_to_xstring.
    DATA: lt_solix TYPE solix_tab,
          lv_string_concatenated TYPE string.

    lv_string_concatenated = REDUCE string(
                               INIT s = ``
                               FOR <fs> IN it_strings
                               NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <fs> )
                             ).

    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string   = lv_string_concatenated
        iv_codepage = iv_codepage
        iv_add_bom  = abap_false " BOM usually not needed for specific codepages like 1100
      IMPORTING
        et_solix    = lt_solix
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_solix INTO DATA(ls_solix).
      rv_xstring = rv_xstring && ls_solix-line.
    ENDLOOP.
