CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_iso88591 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_iso88591.
    DATA: lt_test_strings TYPE string_table,
          lv_expected_string TYPE string,
          lv_converted_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lv_back_to_string TYPE string.

    APPEND 'Grüße aus Deutschland' TO lt_test_strings.
    lv_expected_string = 'Grüße aus Deutschland'.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_bcs_string_to_xstring_cp( ).
    lv_converted_xstring = lo_converter->convert_strings_to_xstring( it_strings = lt_test_strings iv_codepage = '1100' ).

    cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_string(
      EXPORTING
        it_solix    = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix( lv_converted_xstring )
        iv_codepage = '1100'
      IMPORTING
        ev_string   = lv_back_to_string
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_back_to_string exp = lv_expected_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA: lt_test_strings TYPE string_table.
    APPEND '€uro Zeichen' TO lt_test_strings.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_bcs_string_to_xstring_cp( ).
    TRY.
        lo_converter->convert_strings_to_xstring( it_strings = lt_test_strings iv_codepage = '1100' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_BCS expected for Euro sign in ISO-8859-1' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_BCS caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Konvertierung mit einer expliziten Codepage ('1100' für ISO-8859-1). Es ist wichtig, die Codepage korrekt zu wählen, um Datenverluste bei Zeichen zu vermeiden, die in der Zielcodepage nicht darstellbar sind (z.B. das Euro-Zeichen in ISO-8859-1). Die Methode kann `CX_BCS` auslösen, wenn die Konvertierung fehlschlägt, was im Unit Test abgefangen wird. `REDUCE` wird wieder für die String-Verkettung verwendet.
keywords: BCS, XSTRING, Codepage, Character Set, CX_BCS, REDUCE

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Laufzeit von zwei verschiedenen Operationen auf internen Tabellen: eine klassische `LOOP`-Verarbeitung und eine moderne `FOR`-Expression, um die Performance-Vorteile moderner Syntax zu demonstrieren.
hint: Füllen Sie eine große interne Tabelle und messen Sie die Zeit für beide Ansätze separat mit `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_table_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_loop_vs_for
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO struct_runtimes.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_test_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_runtimes,
             loop_runtime TYPE i,
             for_runtime  TYPE i,
           END OF struct_runtimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_table_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_test_data.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
      ls_sflight-connid = sy-index.
      ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
      ls_sflight-price  = sy-index * 10.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_loop_vs_for.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_sflight,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time TYPE i,
          lt_result_loop TYPE tt_sflight,
          lt_result_for TYPE tt_sflight.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes.

    lt_data = get_test_data( iv_num_entries ).

    " Measure LOOP runtime
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-price > 500000.
        APPEND ls_entry TO lt_result_loop.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    rs_runtimes->loop_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure FOR runtime
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lt_result_for = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_data WHERE ( price > 500000 ) ( ls_entry ) ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    rs_runtimes->for_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_loop_vs_for_runtime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_vs_for_runtime.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_runtime_table_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_loop_vs_for( 1000000 ). " 1 Million entries

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_runtimes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->loop_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'Loop runtime should be non-negative' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->for_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'FOR runtime should be non-negative' ).

    " Optional: Assert FOR is faster, but this can be environment-dependent
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->for_runtime < ls_runtimes->loop_runtime ) msg = 'FOR should be faster than LOOP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel vergleicht die Performance einer klassischen `LOOP`-Verarbeitung mit einer modernen `FOR`-Expression für die Filterung einer internen Tabelle. Es demonstriert, wie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` verwendet werden kann, um Performance-Unterschiede zwischen verschiedenen Implementierungsansätzen zu quantifizieren. Oft sind moderne Ausdrücke wie `FOR` nicht nur kompakter, sondern auch performanter, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen, da sie intern optimiert werden können.
keywords: Runtime, Performance, Internal Tables, FOR Expression, LOOP, Comparison

    DATA mv_accumulated_runtime TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_runtime_accumulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    reset_measurement( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_measurement.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = mv_start_time ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_measurement.
    DATA(lv_end_time) TYPE i.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    mv_accumulated_runtime = mv_accumulated_runtime + ( lv_end_time - mv_start_time ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_accumulated_runtime.
    rv_total_runtime_microseconds = mv_accumulated_runtime.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reset_measurement.
    mv_start_time = 0.
    mv_accumulated_runtime = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit einer komplexen Datenaggregation unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und vergleichen Sie diese mit einer klassischen `LOOP`-basierten Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` für präzise Messungen und `REDUCE` für die moderne Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_reduce_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_aggregation_runtimes
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO struct_aggregation_runtimes.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_test_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_aggregation_runtimes,
             loop_runtime TYPE i,
             reduce_runtime TYPE i,
           END OF struct_aggregation_runtimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_reduce_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_test_data.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      ls_sflight-carrid = COND #( WHEN sy-index MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'LH' ELSE 'AA' ).
      ls_sflight-connid = sy-index.
      ls_sflight-price  = sy-index * 10.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_aggregation_runtimes.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_sflight_data,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time TYPE i,
          lv_total_price_loop TYPE i,
          lv_total_price_reduce TYPE i.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes.

    lt_data = get_test_data( iv_num_entries ).

    " Measure LOOP aggregation runtime
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lv_total_price_loop = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      lv_total_price_loop = lv_total_price_loop + ls_entry-price.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    rs_runtimes->loop_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure REDUCE aggregation runtime
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lv_total_price_reduce = REDUCE i(
                               INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_entry IN lt_data
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_entry-price
                             ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    rs_runtimes->reduce_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_vs_loop_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_vs_loop_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_runtime_reduce_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_aggregation_runtimes( 500000 ). " 500.000 entries

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_runtimes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->loop_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'Loop runtime should be non-negative' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->reduce_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'REDUCE runtime should be non-negative' ).

    " Optional: Assert REDUCE is faster, but this can be environment-dependent
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->reduce_runtime < ls_runtimes->loop_runtime ) msg = 'REDUCE should be faster than LOOP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance der Datenaggregation mit einer klassischen `LOOP`-Anweisung und der modernen `REDUCE`-Expression. `REDUCE` bietet eine kompaktere und oft performantere Möglichkeit, Werte aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren, da es intern optimiert werden kann. `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` wird verwendet, um die Laufzeiten beider Ansätze zu messen und die Effizienz der modernen Syntax zu demonstrieren.
keywords: Runtime, Performance, REDUCE, LOOP, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Comparison

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit `GROUP BY` verarbeitet, und vergleichen Sie diese mit einer manuellen Gruppierung mittels `LOOP` und `AT NEW`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` für die Messung und `GROUP BY` für die moderne Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_group_by_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_group.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE i,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_grouping_runtimes
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO struct_grouping_runtimes.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_test_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight_group.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_grouping_runtimes,
             loop_at_new_runtime TYPE i,
             group_by_runtime TYPE i,
           END OF struct_grouping_runtimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_group_by_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_test_data.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_group.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      ls_sflight-carrid = COND #( WHEN sy-index MOD 3 = 0 THEN 'LH' WHEN sy-index MOD 3 = 1 THEN 'AA' ELSE 'UA' ).
      ls_sflight-connid = sy-index.
      ls_sflight-price  = sy-index * 10.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
    SORT rt_data BY carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_grouping_runtimes.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_sflight_group,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time TYPE i,
          lt_result_loop TYPE tt_grouped_result,
          lt_result_group_by TYPE tt_grouped_result.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes.

    lt_data = get_test_data( iv_num_entries ).

    " Measure LOOP AT NEW grouping runtime
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    DATA: ls_grouped_entry TYPE ty_grouped_result.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      AT NEW carrid.
        CLEAR ls_grouped_entry.
        ls_grouped_entry-carrid = ls_entry-carrid.
      ENDAT.
      ls_grouped_entry-total_price = ls_grouped_entry-total_price + ls_entry-price.
      ls_grouped_entry-flight_count = ls_grouped_entry-flight_count + 1.
      AT END carrid.
        APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO lt_result_loop.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    rs_runtimes->loop_at_new_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure GROUP BY runtime
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_start_time ).
    lt_result_group_by = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_entry IN lt_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_entry-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                  ( carrid       = GROUP carrid
                                    total_price  = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + member-price )
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
    cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( IMPORTING runtime = lv_end_time ).
    rs_runtimes->group_by_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_vs_loop_at_new FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_vs_loop_at_new.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_runtime_group_by_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_grouping_runtimes( 100000 ). " 100.000 entries

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_runtimes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->loop_at_new_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'LOOP AT NEW runtime should be non-negative' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->group_by_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'GROUP BY runtime should be non-negative' ).

    " Optional: Assert GROUP BY is faster, but this can be environment-dependent
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_runtimes->group_by_runtime < ls_runtimes->loop_at_new_runtime ) msg = 'GROUP BY should be faster than LOOP AT NEW' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance der Datenaggregation und Gruppierung mit der klassischen `LOOP AT ... AT NEW/END` Syntax und der modernen `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Expression. Die `GROUP BY`-Expression ist nicht nur wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer, sondern kann auch intern optimiert werden, was zu einer besseren Performance bei großen Datenmengen führen kann. `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` wird verwendet, um diese Performance-Unterschiede zu messen und die Vorteile der modernen Syntax hervorzuheben.
keywords: Runtime, Performance, GROUP BY, LOOP AT NEW, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Comparison, REDUCE

solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_avg_price_comparison DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_comparison,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price_period TYPE s_price,
             total_avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_price_comparison.
    TYPES tt_price_comparison TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_comparison WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_comparison
      IMPORTING iv_start_date TYPE s_date
                iv_end_date   TYPE s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_comparison) TYPE tt_price_comparison.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_avg_price_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_comparison.
    WITH
      total_avg AS (
        SELECT AVG( price ) AS total_avg_price FROM sflights
      )
    SELECT s~carrid, AVG( s~price ) AS avg_price_period, ta~total_avg_price
      FROM sflights AS s
      CROSS JOIN total_avg AS ta
      INTO TABLE @rt_comparison
      WHERE s~fldate BETWEEN @iv_start_date AND @iv_end_date
      GROUP BY s~carrid, ta~total_avg_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.

    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO @lv_expected_price WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_expected_price

CLASS zcl_sum_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für jede Fluggesellschaft und Währung aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             curr   TYPE s_curr,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_sum.
    TYPES tt_flight_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_total_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_prices) TYPE tt_flight_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_total_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-curr.
      DATA(lv_current_carrid) = ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_current_curr) = ls_flight-curr.

      DATA(lv_group_sum) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + grouped_flight-price
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_sum(
        carrid      = lv_current_carrid
        curr        = lv_current_curr
        total_price = lv_group_sum
      ) TO rt_grouped_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_group( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_prices) = lo_cut->get_grouped_total_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_actual_prices )
      msg = 'Should return at least one grouped price entry'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lv_expected_aa_eur_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO @lv_expected_aa_eur_sum WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND currency = 'EUR'.

    READ TABLE lt_actual_prices INTO DATA(ls_aa_eur) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' curr = 'EUR'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_aa_eur-total_price
        exp = lv_expected_aa_eur_sum
        msg = 'Grouped sum for AA/EUR should match'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'AA/EUR group not found in result' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` ist ein mächtiges Feature für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung innerhalb jeder Gruppe bietet es eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und performante Möglichkeit, komplexe Aggregationen im ABAP-Anwendungsserver durchzuführen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping

CLASS zcl_sum_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sum_currency IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Zahl von einem Startwert bis zu einem Endwert zählt und dabei jeden Schritt in einer internen Tabelle speichert.

CLASS zcl_while_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_up
      IMPORTING
        iv_start TYPE i
        iv_end   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_up.
    DATA(lv_current) = iv_start.
    WHILE lv_current <= iv_end.
      APPEND lv_current TO rt_numbers.
      lv_current = lv_current + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_actual_numbers) = lo_cut->count_up( iv_start = 1 iv_end = 5 ).

    DATA(lt_expected_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_numbers
      exp = lt_expected_numbers
      msg = 'Numbers should be counted correctly from 1 to 5'
    ).

    lt_actual_numbers = lo_cut->count_up( iv_start = 5 iv_end = 1 ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und verarbeiten Sie diese in Blöcken von maximal 3 Einträgen, bis alle Flüge verarbeitet wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und Indexzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_chunks DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_chunk,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_chunk.
    TYPES tt_flight_chunk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_chunk WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_chunks) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_flight_chunk WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_chunks IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_lines TYPE i.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    lv_lines = lines( lt_all_flights ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_lines.
      DATA(lt_current_chunk) = VALUE tt_flight_chunk(
        FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_chunk_size AND ( lv_offset + i - 1 ) < lv_lines
        (
          carrid = lt_all_flights[ lv_offset + i ]-carrid
          connid = lt_all_flights[ lv_offset + i ]-connid
          fldate = lt_all_flights[ lv_offset + i ]-fldate
        )
      ).
      APPEND lt_current_chunk TO rt_processed_chunks.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + iv_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_chunks FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_chunks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_chunks( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_chunk_size) = 2.

    DATA(lt_actual_chunks) = lo_cut->process_flights_in_chunks(
                                   iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                   iv_chunk_size = lv_chunk_size
                                 ).

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_total_flights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_expected_chunks) = ceil( lv_total_flights / lv_chunk_size ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_chunks )
      exp = lv_expected_chunks
      msg = 'Number of chunks should be correct'
    ).

    IF lines( lt_actual_chunks ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lines( lt_actual_chunks[ 1 ] )
        exp = lv_chunk_size
        msg = 'First chunk should have correct size'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung verwendet eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Verarbeitung von Daten in Blöcken zu steuern. Innerhalb der Schleife wird der `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHILE`-Bedingung verwendet, um dynamisch die Elemente für den aktuellen Block zu extrahieren. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, große Datenmengen schrittweise zu verarbeiten.
keywords: WHILE, FOR, Internal Tables, Chunk Processing, Data Processing

Instructions: Berechne alle Arbeitstage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten, unter Berücksichtigung eines einfachen Wochenendmusters (Samstag/Sonntag).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Tage zu inkrementieren, und prüfen Sie das Wochentagsattribut.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_end_date   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_workdays) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_between.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
        APPEND lv_current_date TO rt_workdays.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_workdays_between FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_workdays_between.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_workdays( ).

    " Test case: Monday to Friday in a single week
    DATA(lv_start) = '20250106'. " Monday
    DATA(lv_end)   = '20250110'. " Friday
    DATA(lt_actual_workdays) = lo_cut->get_workdays_between( iv_start_date = lv_start iv_end_date = lv_end ).
    DATA(lt_expected_workdays) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum(
      ( '20250106' ) ( '20250107' ) ( '20250108' ) ( '20250109' ) ( '20250110' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_workdays
      exp = lt_expected_workdays
      msg = 'Workdays for a full week should be correct'
    ).

    " Test case: Including a weekend
    lv_start = '20250103'. " Friday
    lv_end   = '20250106'. " Monday
    lt_actual_workdays = lo_cut->get_workdays_between( iv_start_date = lv_start iv_end_date = lv_end ).
    lt_expected_workdays = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum(
      ( '20250103' ) ( '20250106' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_workdays
      exp = lt_expected_workdays
      msg = 'Workdays including a weekend should skip Saturday/Sunday'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday` ist eine moderne und zuverlässige Methode, um den Wochentag zu bestimmen, und vermeidet manuelle Datumsberechnungen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode zur Berechnung der Fakultät einer Zahl unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die die Zahl schrittweise dekrementiert und das Produkt akkumuliert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 0.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factorial FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_negative EXPECTING CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factorial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_factorial( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 5 ) exp = 120 msg = 'Factorial of 5 should be 120' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 3 ) exp = 6 msg = 'Factorial of 3 should be 6' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factorial_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_factorial( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 0 ) exp = 1 msg = 'Factorial of 0 should be 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factorial_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_factorial( ).
    lo_cut->calculate_factorial( -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_currency_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_currencies
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        it_currencies  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_curr WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_sum_currency_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_currencies.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( currency IN it_currencies )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine einfache 'Exponential Backoff'-Strategie für Wiederholungsversuche, bei der die Wartezeit zwischen den Versuchen exponentiell ansteigt, bis eine maximale Anzahl von Versuchen erreicht ist oder ein Erfolg eintritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Versuche zu steuern, und `WAIT UP TO` für die Verzögerung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_backoff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_with_backoff
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i
        iv_initial_wait_sec TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_backoff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_with_backoff.
    DATA(lv_retries) = 0.
    DATA(lv_current_wait) = iv_initial_wait_sec.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_retries < iv_max_retries.
      " Simulate an operation that might fail
      IF lv_retries = 2. " Simulate success on the 3rd attempt
        rv_success = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
      IF lv_retries < iv_max_retries.
        WAIT UP TO lv_current_wait SECONDS.
        lv_current_wait = lv_current_wait * 2. " Exponential increase
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_backoff( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Should succeed after 3 attempts' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_backoff_failure.

Die Verwendung von `WAIT UP TO` und die exponentielle Erhöhung der Wartezeit demonstrieren eine praktische Anwendung für robuste Systemintegrationen.
keywords: WHILE, Exponential Backoff, Retries, Dynamic Programming, WAIT UP TO

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für jede Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für die Top N teuersten Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` in Kombination mit `SORT` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_sum_top,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_sum_top.
    TYPES tt_flight_sum_top TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_sum_top WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_flight_sums
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_n_sums) TYPE tt_flight_sum_top.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flight_sums.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_current_carrid) = ls_flight-carrid.

      DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( grouped_flight )
      ).

      SORT lt_grouped_flights BY price DESCENDING.

      DATA(lv_group_sum) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_top_n AND i <= lines( lt_grouped_flights )
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + lt_grouped_flights[ i ]-price
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_sum_top(
        carrid      = lv_current_carrid
        total_price = lv_group_sum
      ) TO rt_top_n_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_top_n_flight_sums FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_n_flight_sums.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_top_n( ).
    DATA(lv_top_n) = 2.
    DATA(lt_actual_sums) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flight_sums( iv_top_n = lv_top_n ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_actual_sums )
      msg = 'Should return at least one grouped sum entry'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lv_expected_aa_sum) = 0.
    DATA: lt_aa_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_aa_flights WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    SORT lt_aa_flights BY price DESCENDING.
    IF lines( lt_aa_flights ) >= 1. lv_expected_aa_sum = lv_expected_aa_sum + lt_aa_flights[ 1 ]-price. ENDIF.
    IF lines( lt_aa_flights ) >= 2. lv_expected_aa_sum = lv_expected_aa_sum + lt_aa_flights[ 2 ]-price. ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_actual_sums INTO DATA(ls_aa_sum) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_aa_sum-total_price
        exp = lv_expected_aa_sum
        msg = 'Top N sum for AA should match'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'AA group not found in result' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit einer Sortierung innerhalb der Gruppe und einem `REDUCE`-Operator, der einen `FOR`-Loop mit einer `WHILE`-Bedingung verwendet, um nur die Top N Elemente zu summieren. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität und Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Konstruktoren für komplexe Datenaggregationen.
keywords: SUM, REDUCE, LOOP AT GROUP BY, SORT, TOP N, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen durchläuft und die Verarbeitung stoppt, sobald eine negative Zahl gefunden wird. Alle bis dahin verarbeiteten positiven Zahlen sollen zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einem Index und einer `IF`-Bedingung zum Abbruch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_positive_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_positive_numbers_until_negative
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_positive_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_positive_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_positive_numbers_until_negative.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_numbers ).

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_lines.
      DATA(lv_current_number) = it_numbers[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_current_number < 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_current_number TO rt_positive_numbers.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate aller Zahlen in einer gegebenen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie die REDUCE-Anweisung mit dem CALCULATE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_sum_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        iv_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_sum_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR n IN iv_numbers
                       NEXT s = s + CALCULATE n ** 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 14 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Endwert einer Investition nach einer bestimmten Anzahl von Jahren mit Zinseszins, unter Verwendung des CALCULATE-Operators für die Potenzierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie CALCULATE für die Potenzfunktion (**) und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_compound_interest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_future_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_principal TYPE decfloat16 " Startkapital
        iv_rate      TYPE decfloat16 " Jahreszinssatz (z.B. 0.05 für 5%)
        iv_years     TYPE i         " Anzahl der Jahre
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_value) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_compound_interest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_future_value.
    rv_future_value = CALCULATE iv_principal * ( ( 1 + iv_rate ) ** iv_years ).
    " Round to 2 decimal places
    rv_future_value = round( val = rv_future_value dec = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_compound_interest( ).
    DATA(lv_principal) = CONV decfloat16( '1000.00' ).
    DATA(lv_rate) = CONV decfloat16( '0.05' ).
    DATA(lv_years) = 10.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_future_value(
                        iv_principal = lv_principal
                        iv_rate       = lv_rate
                        iv_years      = lv_years
                      ).
    " Expected: 1000 * (1.05)^10 = 1628.89462677744140625 -> 1628.89
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = CONV decfloat16( '1628.89' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_years.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_compound_interest( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_future_value(
                        iv_principal = lv_principal
                        iv_rate       = lv_rate
                        iv_years      = lv_years
                      ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = CONV decfloat16( '500.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gewichteten Durchschnitt einer Liste von Werten, wobei jeder Wert ein Gewicht hat. Verwenden Sie CALCULATE und eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um die Summe der Produkte und die Summe der Gewichte zu berechnen, und dann CALCULATE für die Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_weighted_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_value,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             weight TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_weighted_value.
    TYPES: tt_weighted_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_value WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_weighted_average
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE tt_weighted_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_weighted_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_weighted_average.
    DATA(lv_sum_products) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = CONV decfloat16( '0.0' )
                                              FOR item IN it_values
                                              NEXT s = s + CALCULATE item-value * item-weight ).
    DATA(lv_sum_weights) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = CONV decfloat16( '0.0' )
                                             FOR item IN it_values
                                             NEXT s = s + item-weight ).

    IF lv_sum_weights > 0.
      rv_average = CALCULATE lv_sum_products / lv_sum_weights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = CONV decfloat16( '0.0' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Definieren Sie eine verschachtelte ABAP-Struktur, die der JSON-Struktur entspricht, und lassen Sie CL_CLB_PARSE_JSON die Deserialisierung übernehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parse_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_inner_data,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_inner_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_outer_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             detail TYPE ty_inner_data,
           END OF ty_outer_data.
    METHODS extract_nested_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_nested_value.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_outer_data( ).
    lo_json_parser->parse_json_to_abap(
      EXPORTING
        iv_json_string = iv_json_string
      IMPORTING
        es_abap_data   = ls_data
    ).
    rv_value = ls_data-detail-value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die euklidische Distanz zwischen zwei Punkten (x1, y1) und (x2, y2) im zweidimensionalen Raum. Nutzen Sie den CALCULATE-Operator für die Quadratwurzel und Potenzierung.
hint: Die euklidische Distanz ist sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2). Verwenden Sie SQRT und ** mit CALCULATE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_euclidean_distance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_distance
      IMPORTING
        iv_x1 TYPE decfloat16
        iv_y1 TYPE decfloat16
        iv_x2 TYPE decfloat16
        iv_y2 TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_distance) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_euclidean_distance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_distance.
    DATA(lv_delta_x) = CALCULATE iv_x2 - iv_x1.
    DATA(lv_delta_y) = CALCULATE iv_y2 - iv_y1.
    rv_distance = CALCULATE SQRT( ( lv_delta_x ** 2 ) + ( lv_delta_y ** 2 ) ).
    " Round to 2 decimal places for practical use
    rv_distance = round( val = rv_distance dec = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Preis eines Artikels inklusive Mehrwertsteuer, wobei der Mehrwertsteuersatz basierend auf dem Artikeltyp variiert. Verwenden Sie CALCULATE und eine CASE-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie CALCULATE für die Multiplikation und eine CASE-Anweisung, um den korrekten Steuersatz zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_vat_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_article,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
             type  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_article.
    METHODS calculate_price_with_vat
      IMPORTING
        is_article TYPE ty_article
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_vat_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_with_vat.
    DATA(lv_vat_rate) = CONV decfloat16( '0.0' ).

    CASE is_article-type.
      WHEN 'STANDARD'.
        lv_vat_rate = CONV decfloat16( '0.19' ). " 19% VAT
      WHEN 'REDUCED'.
        lv_vat_rate = CONV decfloat16( '0.07' ). " 7% VAT
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_vat_rate = CONV decfloat16( '0.00' ). " No VAT or unknown
    ENDCASE.

    rv_total_price = CALCULATE is_article-price * ( 1 + lv_vat_rate ).
    rv_total_price = round( val = rv_total_price dec = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in einer gegebenen Flugtabelle berechnet.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE in der Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_calculator( ).
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_calculator=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price should be 350.00' act = lv_total exp = '350.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von REDUCE in einer funktionalen Methode ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist ein Beispiel für funktionales Programmieren in modernem ABAP.
keywords: METHOD, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Flügen, deren Flugnummer eine bestimmte Prüfsumme erfüllt, die durch eine separate Methode berechnet wird.
hint: Definieren Sie eine private Methode zur Prüfsummenberechnung und rufen Sie diese im FILTER auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_with_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_checksum
      IMPORTING iv_target_checksum TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_checksum
      IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_checksum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_checksum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE calculate_checksum( connid ) = iv_target_checksum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_checksum.
    rv_checksum = 0.
    DATA(lv_connid_str) = |{ iv_connid ALPHA = OUT }|.
    DO strlen( lv_connid_str ) TIMES.
      rv_checksum = rv_checksum + ( CONV i( lv_connid_str+sy-index(1) ) ).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_with_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_with_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_with_method( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_checksum( 10 ). " Assuming 10 is a valid checksum for some connid

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_checksum) = lo_cut->calculate_checksum( ls_flight-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Checksum should match target' act = lv_checksum exp = 10 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 können Methodenaufrufe direkt in Tabellen-Expressions wie FILTER verwendet werden, was eine sehr flexible und modulare Filterlogik ermöglicht. Dies fördert die Kapselung und Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code.
keywords: FILTER, METHOD, Table Expression, Functional Call, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die verkettet werden können, um eine Flugabfrage zu konstruieren (z.B. get_flights()->from('FRA')->to('NYC')->execute()).
hint: Jede Methode sollte ME zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS from
      IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_query.

    METHODS to
      IMPORTING iv_cityto TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_query.

    METHODS execute
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom.
    DATA mv_cityto TYPE sflight-cityto.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD from.
    mv_cityfrom = iv_cityfrom.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to.
    mv_cityto = iv_cityto.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = mv_cityfrom AND cityto = mv_cityto ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine Tabelle von Flugobjekten. Filtern Sie diese Tabelle, um nur die Flüge zu erhalten, die noch nicht ausgebucht sind.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Hilfsmethode im Flugobjekt, die den Status zurückgibt, und verwenden Sie diese im FILTER.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_comparable.
    DATA carrid TYPE sflight-carrid READ-ONLY.
    DATA connid TYPE sflight-connid READ-ONLY.
    DATA fldate TYPE sflight-fldate READ-ONLY.
    DATA seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc READ-ONLY.
    DATA seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax.

    METHODS is_booked_out
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_booked_out) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->connid = iv_connid.
    me->fldate = iv_fldate.
    me->seatsocc = iv_seatsocc.
    me->seatsmax = iv_seatsmax.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_booked_out.
    rv_booked_out = COND #( WHEN seatsocc >= seatsmax THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_comparable~compare.
    IF me->carrid = other->carrid AND
       me->connid = other->connid AND
       me->fldate = other->fldate.
      result = 0.
    ELSEIF me->carrid < other->carrid OR
           ( me->carrid = other->carrid AND me->connid < other->connid ) OR
           ( me->carrid = other->carrid AND me->connid = other->connid AND me->fldate < other->fldate ).
      result = -1.
    ELSE.
      result = 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_object_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_objects
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_available_flights) TYPE tt_flight_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_object_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    rt_available_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE is_booked_out( ) = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_object_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_object_table.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_object_filter( ).
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE zcl_flight_object_filter=>tt_flight_objects.

    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '001' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_seatsocc = 100 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_all_flights. " Booked out
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '002' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_seatsocc = 50 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_all_flights.  " Available
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '003' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_seatsocc = 120 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_all_flights. " Overbooked (still considered booked out)

    DATA(lt_available) = lo_filter->get_available_flights( lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Only one flight should be available' act = lines( lt_available ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Available flight connid should be 002' act = lt_available[ 1 ]->connid exp = '002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Bedingung kann dabei eine Methode des Objekts aufrufen, was eine sehr flexible und objektorientierte Filterung ermöglicht. Dies zeigt die Integration von objektorientierten Konzepten mit modernen Tabellen-Expressions.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine statische Methode, die eine Instanz einer Flugklasse basierend auf Flugdaten erstellt und zurückgibt.

CLASS zcl_flight_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

    CLASS-METHODS create_flight_instance

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben, und zeigen Sie den Unterschied zu einer älteren Syntax auf.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_comparison DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_modern
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS get_flights_legacy
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_modern.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_legacy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      APPEND CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_dest_service IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen, und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft, wobei Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis ermitteln.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER, FOR und GROUP BY in Kombination.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
                               GROUP BY carrid = ls_group-carrid
                               ( carrid       = ls_group-carrid,
                                 flight_count = GROUP SIZE,
                                 avg_price    = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                                            FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                            NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_group_aggregate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_group_aggregate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_aggregate( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrid should not be initial' act = ls_summary-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count should be positive' act = ( ls_summary-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average price should be positive' act = ( ls_summary-avg_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von Tabellen-Expressions, indem FILTER, FOR und GROUP BY kombiniert werden. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Datenmanipulationen (Filtern, Gruppieren, Aggregieren) in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung, was die Code-Komplexität reduziert und die Performance verbessert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Flugobjekten verwaltet. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die Flüge basierend auf einem dynamischen Kriterium filtert, das als Lambda-Funktion übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine funktionale Schnittstelle und eine Methode, die diese als Parameter akzeptiert. Nutzen Sie FILTER mit einer Inline-Methode oder einer Lambda-Expression (ab 7.55).
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_filter_criteria PUBLIC.
  METHODS matches
    IMPORTING io_flight TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_object
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_matches) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING it_initial_flights TYPE tt_flight_objects OPTIONAL.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING io_criteria TYPE REF TO zif_flight_filter_criteria
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_objects.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF it_initial_flights IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_flights = it_initial_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights_by_criteria.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( mt_flights WHERE io_criteria->matches( table_line ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter_lambda FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter_lambda.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE zcl_flight_manager=>tt_flight_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '001' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_seatsocc = 100 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '002' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_seatsocc = 50 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '003' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_seatsocc = 75 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_flight_manager( lt_all_flights ).

    " Lambda-ähnliche Implementierung für das Kriterium (ab ABAP 7.55)
    DATA(lo_criteria_lh) = NEW zif_flight_filter_criteria( )
      " Inline-Implementierung der Schnittstellenmethode
      " (Dies ist eine Vereinfachung, in der Praxis würde man eine lokale Klasse verwenden)
      " Für ABAP 7.55+ könnte man hier eine Lambda-ähnliche Syntax verwenden, die aber nicht direkt im FILTER-WHERE-Teil geht.
      " Stattdessen wird ein Objekt übergeben, das die Logik kapselt.
      .
    " Da ABAP keine echten Lambdas im FILTER-Kontext hat, simulieren wir dies mit einer lokalen Klasse.
    CLASS lcl_lh_filter DEFINITION FINAL FOR IMPLEMENTATION OF zif_flight_filter_criteria.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_flight_filter_criteria.
        METHODS zif_flight_filter_criteria~matches.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_lh_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_flight_filter_criteria~matches.
        rv_matches = COND #( WHEN io_flight->carrid = 'LH' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
    DATA(lo_lh_criteria) = NEW lcl_lh_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_manager->filter_flights_by_criteria( lo_lh_criteria ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should find 2 LH flights' act = lines( lt_filtered_lh ) exp = 2 ).

    CLASS lcl_available_filter DEFINITION FINAL FOR IMPLEMENTATION OF zif_flight_filter_criteria.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_flight_filter_criteria.
        METHODS zif_flight_filter_criteria~matches.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_available_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_flight_filter_criteria~matches.
        rv_matches = COND #( WHEN io_flight->is_booked_out( ) = abap_false THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
    DATA(lo_available_criteria) = NEW lcl_available_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_available) = lo_manager->filter_flights_by_criteria( lo_available_criteria ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should find 2 available flights' act = lines( lt_filtered_available ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamische Filterkriterien durch die Übergabe von Objekten implementiert, die eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementieren. Dies ist ein mächtiges Muster für erweiterbare und flexible Filterlogik. Obwohl ABAP keine echten Lambda-Funktionen im Kontext von Tabellen-Expressions hat, kann man dieses Verhalten durch die Übergabe von Objekten mit einer einzelnen Methode simulieren, die die Filterlogik kapselt. Dies fördert das Open/Closed-Prinzip.
keywords: METHOD, Interface, Dynamic Filter, Object Orientation, FILTER, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode zur Berechnung des CO2-Fußabdrucks eines Fluges bereitstellt. Die Berechnung soll von der Flugzeugtype abhängen und in einer separaten, privaten Methode gekapselt sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine öffentliche Methode, die eine private Hilfsmethode aufruft, um die spezifische Logik zu kapseln. Nutzen Sie CASE für verschiedene Flugzeugtypen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_co2_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             distance  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS calculate_co2_footprint
      IMPORTING is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_co2_emissions) TYPE decfloat16.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_emission_factor
      IMPORTING iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_factor) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_co2_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_co2_footprint.
    DATA(lv_emission_factor) = get_emission_factor( is_flight_data-planetype ).
    rv_co2_emissions = lv_emission_factor * is_flight_data-distance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_emission_factor.
    CASE iv_planetype.
      WHEN '747'.
        rv_factor = '0.15'. " Beispielwert für 747
      WHEN 'A380'.
        rv_factor = '0.18'. " Beispielwert für A380
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_factor = '0.10'. " Standardwert
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_co2_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_co2_calculation_a380 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_co2_calculation_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_co2_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_co2_calculator( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE zcl_co2_calculator=>ty_flight_data.
    ls_flight-planetype = '747'.
    ls_flight-distance = 1000.

    DATA(lv_co2) = lo_calculator->calculate_co2_footprint( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CO2 for 747 should be 150' act = lv_co2 exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_co2_calculation_a380.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_co2_calculator( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE zcl_co2_calculator=>ty_flight_data.
    ls_flight-planetype = 'A380'.
    ls_flight-distance = 500.

    DATA(lv_co2) = lo_calculator->calculate_co2_footprint( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CO2 for A380 should be 90' act = lv_co2 exp = '90.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_co2_calculation_unknown.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_co2_calculator( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE zcl_co2_calculator=>ty_flight_data.
    ls_flight-planetype = 'UNKNOWN'.
    ls_flight-distance = 2000.

Instructions: Simuliere das Werfen eines Würfels (Zahlen 1-6) 100 Mal und zähle die Häufigkeit jeder Zahl. Gib das Ergebnis als Map zurück.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` (oder leite von `cl_abap_random_float` ab) und den `REDUCE` Operator zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_simulation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dice_roll,
             roll TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dice_roll.
    TYPES ty_dice_rolls TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dice_roll WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_roll_counts TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS simulate_dice_rolls RETURNING VALUE(rt_roll_counts) TYPE ty_roll_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_simulation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_dice_rolls.
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 1 max = 6 ).

    rt_roll_counts = REDUCE ty_roll_counts( INIT counts = VALUE ty_roll_counts( )
                                            FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 100
                                            LET lv_roll = lo_random_int->get_next( ) IN
                                            NEXT counts = VALUE #( counts ( key = lv_roll value = counts[ KEY table_line = lv_roll ] + 1 DEFAULT 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dice_simulation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dice_simulation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_simulation( ).
    DATA(lt_roll_counts) = lo_cut->simulate_dice_rolls( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_roll_counts ) exp = 6 ). " Expecting 6 unique rolls (1-6)
    LOOP AT lt_roll_counts INTO DATA(lv_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count > 0 ). " Each number should appear at least once
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_total_rolls) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR roll_count IN lt_roll_counts NEXT sum = sum + roll_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_rolls exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Zähloperationen. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Häufigkeit der Würfelergebnisse in einer Hash-Tabelle zu speichern. `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` generiert direkt Ganzzahlen im gewünschten Bereich, was die Simulation vereinfacht. Die Inline-Deklaration und der `VALUE` Operator für die Initialisierung der Hash-Tabelle sind weitere moderne Features.
keywords: RANDOM, REDUCE, MATH, SIMULATION, HASHED TABLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine zufällige Auswahl von N Elementen aus einer gegebenen internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung von Zufallsindizes und den `FOR` Operator mit `COND` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count        TYPE i
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_flights) TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flights.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR it_source_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_source_flights ).
    IF iv_count >= lv_table_size.
      rt_selected_flights = it_source_flights.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_index) = lo_random_int->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
      IF sy-dbcnt = iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      " Ensure unique indices, re-roll if duplicate
      WHILE sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_index = lo_random_int->get_next( ).
        INSERT lv_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDDO.

    rt_selected_flights = VALUE #( FOR lv_idx IN lt_selected_indices
                                   ( it_source_flights[ lv_idx ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_flight_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_greater_than_table_size FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_selection.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_select( ).
    DATA(lt_selected) = lo_cut->get_random_flights( iv_count = 10 it_source_flights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_selected ) exp = 10 ).
    " Check if all selected flights are actually from the source table
    LOOP AT lt_selected INTO DATA(ls_selected).
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_source).
        IF ls_selected = ls_source.
          lv_found = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_select( ).
    DATA(lt_selected) = lo_cut->get_random_flights( iv_count = 5 it_source_flights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_selected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_zero.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_select( ).
    DATA(lt_selected) = lo_cut->get_random_flights( iv_count = 0 it_source_flights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_selected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_greater_than_table_size.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_select( ).
    DATA(lt_selected) = lo_cut->get_random_flights( iv_count = 10 it_source_flights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_selected ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_selected exp = lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` zur Generierung von Zufallsindizes, um Elemente aus einer internen Tabelle auszuwählen. Eine Hash-Tabelle wird verwendet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Index nur einmal ausgewählt wird. Der `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife ermöglicht die effiziente Konstruktion der Ergebnistabelle basierend auf den zufällig ausgewählten Indizes. Die Verwendung von `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist ein modernes Feature für die Inline-Deklaration und Befüllung von internen Tabellen.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLES, SFLIGHTS, SELECT, FOR, VALUE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Fülle eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) und füge jeder Zeile eine zufällige Verspätung (in Minuten, 0-60) hinzu. Die Verspätung soll als neues Feld in der Struktur der internen Tabelle gespeichert werden.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `cl_abap_random_int` für die Verspätung. Verwende `FOR` mit `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_delay_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_delay,
             INCLUDE TYPE sflight,
             delay_minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_delay.
    TYPES ty_sflights_with_delay TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_delay WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_random_delay RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_with_delay.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_delay_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_random_delay.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 0 max = 60 ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight
                                             delay_minutes = lo_random_int->get_next( ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
