Instructions: Generiere eine Liste von 10 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 100.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `WHILE` Schleife mit einer Hash-Tabelle, um Eindeutigkeit zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_ints
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_ints.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR iv_min > iv_max OR iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      " Invalid input or impossible to get unique numbers
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = iv_min max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_unique_set) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO.
      DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random_int->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_random_num INTO TABLE lt_unique_set.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_random_num TO rt_unique_numbers.
      ENDIF.
      IF lines( rt_unique_numbers ) = iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_random_generation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_possible_unique FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_int( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 10 ).

    " Check for uniqueness
    DATA(lt_unique_check) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                             FOR num IN lt_numbers ( num ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_check ) exp = 10 ).

    " Check range
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_int( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 10 iv_max = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_numbers ).

    lt_numbers = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_possible_unique.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_int( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eindeutige Zufallszahlen zu generieren, wird `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` verwendet, um Zahlen zu erzeugen. Eine Hash-Tabelle (`HASHED TABLE`) dient als effizienter Set, um bereits generierte Zahlen zu speichern und Duplikate zu vermeiden. Die `DO ... TIMES` Schleife wird durch eine `WHILE` Schleife ersetzt, die abbricht, sobald die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen erreicht ist. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Methode, um eindeutige Zufallszahlen zu erhalten.
keywords: RANDOM, UNIQUE, HASHED TABLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, MATH

Instructions: Generiere eine interne Tabelle mit 50 Zufallszahlen vom Typ `FLTP` zwischen 0 und 1. Berechne den Durchschnitt und die Standardabweichung dieser Zahlen.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_float`, `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` für die Berechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_stats_result,
             average          TYPE fltp,
             standard_deviation TYPE fltp,
           END OF ty_stats_result.

    METHODS calculate_random_stats RETURNING VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ty_stats_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_random_stats.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_random_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF fltp WITH EMPTY KEY
                               FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 50
                               ( lo_random->get_next( ) ).

    IF lt_random_numbers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_random_numbers ).

    " Calculate average
    rs_stats-average = REDUCE fltp( INIT sum = 0.0
                                    FOR num IN lt_random_numbers
                                    NEXT sum = sum + num ) / lv_count.

    " Calculate standard deviation
    DATA(lv_variance) = REDUCE fltp( INIT sum_sq_diff = 0.0
                                     FOR num IN lt_random_numbers
                                     NEXT sum_sq_diff = sum_sq_diff + ( ( num - rs_stats-average ) ** 2 ) ) / lv_count.
    rs_stats-standard_deviation = sqrt( lv_variance ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_stats_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list_handling FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_stats_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_stats( ).
    DATA(ls_stats) = lo_cut->calculate_random_stats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_stats-average ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_stats-standard_deviation ).

    " Random numbers between 0 and 1 should have an average close to 0.5
    " and a standard deviation close to 1/sqrt(12) approx 0.288
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_float_equals( act = ls_stats-average exp = 0.5 tolerance = 0.1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_float_equals( act = ls_stats-standard_deviation exp = 0.288 tolerance = 0.1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list_handling.
    " This test would require mocking cl_abap_random_float to return an empty list,
    " or directly calling the calculation logic with an empty list.
    " For simplicity, we assume the random generation always produces numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_stats( ).
    DATA(ls_stats) = lo_cut->calculate_random_stats( ).
    " If the list were empty, average and std dev would be initial.
    " Since it's not, we expect values.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_stats-average ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Verwendung von `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der internen Tabelle ist ebenfalls ein modernes und kompaktes Feature.

Instructions: Erstelle eine GUI-Anwendung mit einem `cl_gui_splitter_container`, der zwei `cl_gui_textedit` Controls enthält. Der Benutzer soll Text in beiden Feldern bearbeiten können.
hint: Nutze `cl_gui_custom_container`, `cl_gui_splitter_container` und zwei `cl_gui_textedit` Instanzen.
solution:
REPORT z_gui_splitter_textedit.

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_splitter  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
                go_editor1   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
                go_editor2   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS 'MAIN100'.
  SET TITLEBAR 'SPLITTER_TEXTEDIT_DEMO'.

  IF lcl_app=>go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT lcl_app=>go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lcl_app=>go_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent            = lcl_app=>go_container
        orientation       = cl_gui_splitter_container=>orientation_vertical " Vertikale Teilung
        rows              = 2
        columns           = 1.

    " Erster Texteditor im oberen Bereich
    CREATE OBJECT lcl_app=>go_editor1
      EXPORTING
        parent = lcl_app=>go_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    lcl_app=>go_editor1->set_text_as_stream( 'Text im oberen Bereich.' ).

    " Zweiter Texteditor im unteren Bereich
    CREATE OBJECT lcl_app=>go_editor2
      EXPORTING
        parent = lcl_app=>go_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).
    lcl_app=>go_editor2->set_text_as_stream( 'Text im unteren Bereich.' ).

    " Optional: Größe des Splitters anpassen
    lcl_app=>go_splitter->set_row_sash( id = 1 value = 50 ). " 50% für die erste Zeile
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.
  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  lcl_app=>main( ).

Instructions: Generiere eine einzelne Zufallszahl vom Typ `I` (Integer) zwischen 1 und 10 (inklusive).
hint: Nutze die statische Factory-Methode `cl_abap_random_int=>create` und die Instanzmethode `get_next`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_single_random_int RETURNING VALUE(rv_random_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_random_int.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 1 max = 10 ).
    rv_random_value = lo_random->get_next( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_random ).

Die Factory-Methode `CREATE` erlaubt die Angabe eines Seed-Wertes (hier `sy-uzeit` für eine pseudo-zufällige Initialisierung) sowie des Minimal- und Maximalwertes. `GET_NEXT` liefert die nächste Zufallszahl. Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden.

CLASS zcl_del_sflights_lh DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_del_sflights_lh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_lh_flights.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_del_sflights_lh=>tt_sflight.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, basierend auf der Kombination aus Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugnummer (`connid`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`. Die Tabelle muss vorher sortiert sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_adj_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_adj_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt und deren Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, unter Verwendung einer Tabellenexpression zur Filterung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `DELETE TABLE` mit einer `FOR` Expression oder `FILTER` um die zu löschenden Zeilen zu identifizieren.

CLASS zcl_del_past_cheap_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_old_cheap_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_past_cheap_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_cheap_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights FROM 1
      FOR ( lines( rt_filtered_flights ) )
      WHERE fldate < sy-datum AND price < iv_price_threshold.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten, um alle Flüge zu entfernen, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer), und geben Sie die verbleibenden Flüge zurück. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `VALUE` für eine funktionale Herangehensweise.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FILTER ... )` um die gewünschten Zeilen zu behalten, was implizit die anderen löscht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_out_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_out_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights EXCEPT IN it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum. "Keep

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_out_flights(
      it_flights = lt_sflights

Dies ist oft lesbarer und kürzer als explizite `DELETE` Anweisungen, wenn man die "zu behaltenden" Zeilen leichter definieren kann.

Instructions: Löschen Sie die ersten N Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE itab FROM 1 TO N`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_first_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_num_to_delete TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_first_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_first_n_flights.
    rt_remaining_flights = it_flights.
    IF iv_num_to_delete > 0.
      DELETE rt_remaining_flights FROM 1 TO iv_num_to_delete.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_first_n FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_first_n.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_del_first_n=>tt_sflight.
    DO 5 TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = sy-index. <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_first_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_first_n_flights( it_flights = lt_sflights iv_num_to_delete = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten drei Flüge übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `DELETE itab FROM ... TO ...` Syntax ermöglicht das Löschen eines spezifischen Bereichs von Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen Zeilen basierend auf ihrer Position gelöscht werden müssen, z.B. die ersten oder letzten N Zeilen.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen, indem Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `CONDENSE` und `DELETE` kombinieren, um eine Liste von zu löschenden Schlüsseln zu erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR` Expression, um die Schlüssel der zu löschenden Zeilen zu sammeln, und dann `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_for_condense DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_complex_cond
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_for_condense IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_complex_cond.
    DATA(lt_connids_to_delete) = VALUE tt_connid(
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( flight-price < iv_min_price AND flight-fldate < sy-datum )
      ( flight-connid )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE TABLE rt_filtered_flights WHERE connid IN lt_connids_to_delete.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_for_condense FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_for_condense.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_del_for_condense=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum - 1 price = '50' ) TO lt_sflights. "Delete
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200' ) TO lt_sflights. "Keep
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum - 1 price = '30' ) TO lt_sflights. "Delete
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = '150' ) TO lt_sflights. "Keep
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = sy-datum - 1 price = '120' ) TO lt_sflights. "Keep (price too high)

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_for_condense( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_complex_cond(
      it_flights = lt_sflights
      iv_min_price = '100'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten drei Flüge übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid
      exp = '0017'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid
      exp = '0401'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid
      exp = '0020'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Kombination von `FOR` Expressions und `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE IN`. Zuerst wird eine temporäre Tabelle von Schlüsseln (hier `connid`) erstellt, die die komplexen Löschkriterien erfüllen. Anschließend wird diese Liste verwendet, um die entsprechenden Zeilen effizient aus der Haupttabelle zu entfernen. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster für komplexe Löschoperationen.
keywords: DELETE TABLE, FOR, Table Expressions, WHERE IN, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle `lt_target` aus `lt_source`, wobei ein Feld mit `CONV` umgewandelt wird und nur bestimmte Zeilen übernommen werden. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `CONV`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_source,
         id     TYPE i,
         value  TYPE string,
       END OF ty_s_source.
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_target,
         id     TYPE i,
         value  TYPE c LENGTH 10,
       END OF ty_s_target.
TYPES: ty_t_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_source WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: ty_t_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_t_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_t_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table.
    rt_target = VALUE ty_t_target(
      FOR ls_source IN it_source WHERE ( id > 1 )
      ( id = ls_source-id, value = CONV c LENGTH 10( ls_source-value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_conversion FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_table_for( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE ty_t_source(
      ( id = 1 value = 'One' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Two' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'Three' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->convert_table( lt_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = 'Two       ' msg = 'First converted value incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Preise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " For a robust test, specific test data for SFLIGHT would be needed.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total_price ). " Expecting a non-zero sum if data exists
    " Further assertions would depend on known test data.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und komplexe Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable aus einer Tabelle zu berechnen, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Differenzen zwischen der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität und den tatsächlich gebuchten Sitzen für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Nutze hierfür eine funktionale Aggregation.
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit dem Subtraktionsoperator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_diff_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             max_seats  TYPE i,
             booked_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seat_difference
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_diff_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seat_difference.
    rv_total_diff = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ( flight-max_seats - flight-booked_seats )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             max_seats  TYPE i,
             booked_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_total_seat_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seat_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_diff_sum( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' max_seats = 150 booked_seats = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' max_seats = 200 booked_seats = 180 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' max_seats = 120 booked_seats = 120 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_seat_difference( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 70 msg = 'Total difference should be 70' ).

    CLEAR lt_flights.
    lv_result = lo_cut->get_total_seat_difference( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Total difference for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein leistungsstarker funktionaler Operator in ABAP 7.50+, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren und dabei komplexe Berechnungen (hier Subtraktion) in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung durchzuführen. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und ausdrucksstärker als eine klassische `LOOP` Schleife.
keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf den Wert eines Feldes in einer Flugdatenstruktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Der Wert soll dann als String zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwende `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und ein Feldsymbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             planetype  TYPE s_planetye,
             max_seats  TYPE i,
             booked_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
        iv_field_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Field not found or not accessible'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             planetype  TYPE s_planetye,
             max_seats  TYPE i,
             booked_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_data.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-max_seats = 150.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID should be LH' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'MAX_SEATS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '150' msg = 'MAX_SEATS should be 150' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Field not found or not accessible' msg = 'Non-existent field should return error message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. Dies ist unerlässlich für generische Programme, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Feldsymbole (`<fs>`) sind dabei der Schlüssel zur Referenzierung der dynamisch zugewiesenen Datenbereiche.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Structure, RTTI

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf eine interne Tabelle zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird, und gib die Anzahl der Zeilen zurück. Die interne Tabelle muss global oder lokal im aufrufenden Kontext deklariert sein.
hint: Verwende `ASSIGN (lv_table_name) TO <ft>` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf die Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_line_count_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_line_count_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <ft_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <ft_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_line_count = lines( <ft_table> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_line_count = -1. "Indicates error or table not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    DATA gt_sflights_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_get_table_line_count_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_table_line_count_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_access( ).

    " Populate the global mock table
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_mock( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO gt_sflights_mock.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_mock( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO gt_sflights_mock.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_table_line_count_dynamic( 'GT_SFLIGHTS_MOCK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 2 msg = 'Line count should be 2' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_table_line_count_dynamic( 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -1 msg = 'Non-existent table should return -1' ).

    CLEAR gt_sflights_mock.
    lv_result = lo_cut->get_table_line_count_dynamic( 'GT_SFLIGHTS_MOCK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Empty table should return 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ASSIGN (lv_table_name) TO <ft>` Syntax ermöglicht den Zugriff auf interne Tabellen über ihren Namen als String. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme, die zur Laufzeit mit verschiedenen Tabellen interagieren müssen. Das Feldsymbol `<ft_table>` wird dann verwendet, um auf die Tabelle zuzugreifen, z.B. mit `lines(<ft_table>)`.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Internal Table, Generic

Instructions: Dereferenziere eine Datenreferenz, um auf den Inhalt der referenzierten Variablen zuzugreifen und diesen zu ändern.
hint: Verwende `ASSIGN dref->* TO <fs>` um den Inhalt der Referenz einem Feldsymbol zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dereference_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS manipulate_data_by_ref
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dereference_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_data_by_ref.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Assuming the referenced data is compatible with integer assignment
      TRY.
          <fs_data> = iv_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
          " Handle type mismatch if necessary
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_manipulate_data_by_ref FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_manipulate_data_by_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dereference_data( ).
    DATA lv_number TYPE i VALUE 10.
    DATA lr_number TYPE REF TO data.

    GET REFERENCE OF lv_number INTO lr_number.

    lo_cut->manipulate_data_by_ref( ir_data = lr_number iv_value = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_number exp = 20 msg = 'Number should be 20 after manipulation' ).

    DATA lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.
    DATA lr_string TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_string INTO lr_string.

    " Test with incompatible type (will not change lv_string due to TRY-CATCH)
    lo_cut->manipulate_data_by_ref( ir_data = lr_string iv_value = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_string exp = 'Hello' msg = 'String should remain Hello due to type mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN dref->* TO <fs>` ist der moderne und effiziente Weg, den Inhalt einer Datenreferenz zu dereferenzieren. Dies ermöglicht die indirekte Manipulation von Daten, was in generischen oder objektorientierten Szenarien, in denen der genaue Datentyp zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt ist, sehr nützlich ist. Feldsymbole sind hierbei unverzichtbar.
keywords: ASSIGN, Data Reference, Field Symbols, Object Orientation, Dereferencing

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf eine bestimmte Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem übergebenen Index, und gib den Wert eines Feldes dieser Zeile zurück.
hint: Verwende `READ TABLE ... INDEX ... ASSIGNING <fs>` für den effizienten Zeilenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_row_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrid_from_row
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
        iv_index       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_row_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_from_row.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight_key> TYPE ty_flight_key.

    READ TABLE it_flight_keys INDEX iv_index ASSIGNING <fs_flight_key>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_flight_key> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_carrid = <fs_flight_key>-carrid.
    ELSE.
      rv_carrid = ''. "Indicates error or row not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,

  METHOD test_get_carrid_from_row.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_row_access( ).
    DATA lt_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_keys.

    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_flight_data.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_carrid_from_row( it_flight_keys = lt_flight_data iv_index = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'AA' msg = 'CARRID for index 2 should be AA' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_carrid_from_row( it_flight_keys = lt_flight_data iv_index = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID for index 1 should be LH' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_carrid_from_row( it_flight_keys = lt_flight_data iv_index = 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' msg = 'Invalid index should return empty CARRID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs>` ist die bevorzugte Methode, um auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen, insbesondere wenn die Zeile zur Bearbeitung benötigt wird. Die Zuweisung an ein Feldsymbol ist effizient, da keine Daten kopiert werden, sondern direkt auf den Speicherbereich der Tabellenzeile verwiesen wird. Dies ist ein Standardmuster in modernem ABAP für performanten Tabellenzugriff.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, Dynamic Access, READ TABLE
