CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data1,
             col_a TYPE string,
             col_b TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data1.
    TYPES tt_data1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data1 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data2,
             item_id TYPE i,
             item_desc TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data2.
    TYPES tt_data2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_multi_sheet_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_sheet1_data TYPE tt_data1
        it_sheet2_data TYPE tt_data2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).

    " Sheet 1
    DATA(lo_worksheet1) = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Sheet1' ).
    lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Col A' ).
    lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Col B' ).
    LOOP AT it_sheet1_data INTO DATA(ls_data1).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_data1-col_a ).
      lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_data1-col_b ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sheet 2
    DATA(lo_worksheet2) = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Sheet2' ).
    lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Item ID' ).
    lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Description' ).
    LOOP AT it_sheet2_data INTO DATA(ls_data2).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_data2-item_id ).
      lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_data2-item_desc ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem Typnamen, der zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)` und `ASSIGN` um auf die dynamisch erstellten Daten zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
        iv_field1_value TYPE string
        iv_field2_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any STRUCTURE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    DATA(lv_table_type_name) = |STANDARD TABLE OF { iv_type_name }|.

    CREATE DATA ro_data_ref TYPE (lv_table_type_name).
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Create a new line and assign values dynamically
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE (iv_type_name).
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_field> = iv_field1_value.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_field> = iv_field2_value.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Funktion, die den Wert eines beliebigen Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur oder Tabelle anhand seines Namens setzen kann, unter Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `DATA`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` mit `DATA` für die Referenz auf die Struktur/Tabelle und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für das Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_field_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value_generic
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_field_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value_generic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_target> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data_ref->* TO <fs_target>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>not_assigned.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if target is a structure or table
    IF cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_target> ) IS BOUND.
      " Target is a structure
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target> TO <fs_field>.
    ELSEIF cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_target> ) IS BOUND.
      " Target is a table, assume we want to set field in first line for simplicity
      " For a real generic solution, line index or key would be needed
      ASSIGN <fs_target>[ 1 ] TO <fs_target>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target> TO <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error EXPORTING previous = lx_conv.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>component_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über die Komponenten einer Struktur und lesen Sie deren Werte aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        is_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any STRUCTURE,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN is_data_ref->* TO <fs_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>not_assigned.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_struct> ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->components INTO DATA(ls_component_descr).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component_descr-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ ls_component_descr-name }: { <fs_component> }| TO rt_components.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Prüfung durch, ob ein Feld in einer Struktur existiert und einen bestimmten Wert hat, ohne den Feldnamen hart zu kodieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             status TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS check_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_expected_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any STRUCTURE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN is_data_ref->* TO <fs_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rb_is_match = COND abap_bool( WHEN <fs_field> = iv_expected_value THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld sortiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit `BY (field_name)` und `ASSIGN` für den Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_sort,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_sort.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sort TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_sort WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN io_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>not_a_table.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if the field exists in the table line type
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    READ TABLE lo_line_descr->components WITH KEY name = iv_sort_field TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Status eines Fluges aus und geben Sie 'Available' zurück, wenn `seatsocc` kleiner als `seatsmax` ist, ansonsten 'Full'.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Expression direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_select_single_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid,
      CASE WHEN seatsocc < seatsmax THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Full' END AS status
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Flugpreis eines bestimmten Fluges von seiner ursprünglichen Währung in EUR.
hint: Verwenden Sie die SQL-Funktion `CURR_CONVERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_curr_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_converted_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price_eur TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_converted_price.

    METHODS get_price_in_eur
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_target_curr TYPE s_curr
        iv_date      TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_converted_price) TYPE ty_converted_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_curr_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_in_eur.
    " Hinweis: CURR_CONVERT erfordert, dass Währungsumrechnungskurse in TCUR* Tabellen gepflegt sind.
    " Für ein reales Szenario stellen Sie sicher, dass diese Tabellen gefüllt sind.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid,
      CURR_CONVERT( amount = price,
                    source_currency = currency,
                    target_currency = @iv_target_curr,
                    exchange_rate_date = @iv_date ) AS price_eur
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @rs_converted_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_price_in_eur FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_price_in_eur.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculate_curr_convert( ).
    " Dieser Test ist stark von TCUR* Tabelleneinträgen abhängig.
    " Für einen robusten Test müssten Sie die Datenbank mocken oder spezifische Umrechnungskurse sicherstellen.
    " Beispiel: Wenn 100 USD -> 90 EUR am 20251122
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251122' price = 100 currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 ).
    " Für diesen Test müssen entsprechende Einträge in TCURR, TCURF, TCURX, TCURV vorhanden sein.
    " Da dies nicht garantiert werden kann, wird hier nur die Syntax geprüft.
    DATA(ls_converted_price) = lo_cut->get_price_in_eur( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_target_curr = 'EUR' iv_date = '20251122' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted_price-price_eur exp = '90.00' ). " Erfordert korrekte TCUR* Daten
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_converted_price-price_eur ). " Erwartet initial, wenn keine Umrechnungskurse vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die SQL-Funktion `CURR_CONVERT` ermöglicht die direkte Währungsumrechnung auf der Datenbankebene, was die Komplexität der Währungsumrechnungslogik im ABAP-Code erheblich reduziert und die Performance verbessert.
keywords: CALCULATE, CURR_CONVERT, Currency Conversion, Database Access, Math

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Wert aus einem dynamisch bestimmten Feld der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit einem Field Symbol in der `INTO`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    DATA: ls_sflights TYPE sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @ls_sflights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflights TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_value>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_field_name = 'PRICE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = '100.00' ). " Price ist ein CURR-Feld, kann Dezimalstellen haben
    DATA(lv_currency) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_field_name = 'CURRENCY' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den absoluten Wert der Differenz zwischen maximalen und belegten Sitzen für einen Flug und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf die nächste ganze Zahl auf.

CLASS zcl_calculate_math_funcs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_seat_diff,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             rounded_abs_diff TYPE i,
           END OF ty_seat_diff.

    METHODS get_rounded_abs_seat_diff
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_seat_diff) TYPE ty_seat_diff.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_math_funcs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_rounded_abs_seat_diff.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid,
      CEIL( ABS( seatsmax - seatsocc ) ) AS rounded_abs_diff
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @rs_seat_diff.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_seat_diff-rounded_abs_diff exp = 50 ). " CEIL(ABS(200-150)) = 50
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für einen Flug, ob er überbucht ist (seatsocc > seatsmax), und geben Sie 'Overbooked' oder 'Normal' zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_overbook DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_overbook_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             overbook_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_overbook_status.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status) TYPE ty_overbook_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_overbook IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_overbook_status.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid,
      CASE WHEN seatsocc > seatsmax THEN 'Overbooked' ELSE 'Normal' END AS overbook_status
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @rs_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_overbook_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_overbook( ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251122' price = 100 currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 210 ).
    DATA(ls_status_overbooked) = lo_cut->get_overbook_status( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status_overbooked-overbook_status exp = 'Overbooked' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.

    DATA(ls_status_normal) = lo_cut->get_overbook_status( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status_normal-overbook_status exp = 'Normal' ).

explanation: Die Verwendung von `CASE`-Ausdrücken in `SELECT SINGLE` ermöglicht es, komplexe Geschäftslogik direkt in der Datenbankabfrage zu implementieren, was die Lesbarkeit und Effizienz des Codes verbessert.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, CASE, Conditional Logic, Database Access

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an belegten Sitzen überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COUNT` mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_count_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_count_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_seats.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING SUM(seatsocc) > @iv_min_seatsocc
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_count_by_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_count_by_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculate_count_having( ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251122' price = 100 currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 100 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20251123' price = 200 currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251122' price = 300 currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).

    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_seats( iv_min_seatsocc = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0001'.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0002'.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0001'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `HAVING`-Klausel in `SELECT`-Anweisungen ermöglicht es, Aggregatfunktionen zu filtern, nachdem die Gruppierung erfolgt ist. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Ergebnisse basierend auf aggregierten Werten zu selektieren.
keywords: CALCULATE, COUNT, GROUP BY, HAVING, Database Access, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Zeilennummer (ähnlich `sy-tabix`) und den Wert einer Quelltabelle enthält, aber unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `INDEX INTO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tabix_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_source_line,
      tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
        index TYPE i,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_line,
      tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tabix_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table.
    rt_target_table = VALUE #( FOR ls_line IN it_source_table INDEX INTO DATA(lv_index)
                               ( index = lv_index value = ls_line-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tabix_for( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_tabix_for=>tt_source_table(
      ( value = 'Alpha' )
      ( value = 'Beta' )
      ( value = 'Gamma' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-index exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-value exp = 'Gamma' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `INDEX INTO` ermöglicht es, die Zeilennummer einer internen Tabelle in einer funktionalen Weise zu ermitteln, ohne auf `sy-tabix` in einer klassischen `LOOP`-Schleife angewiesen zu sein. Dies führt zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code.
keywords: sy-tabix, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, LINE_INDEX

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Akkumulatorvariablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
        price TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_price,
      tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR ls_price IN it_flight_prices
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_price-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_flight_prices(
      ( price = 100.00 )
      ( price = 250.50 )
      ( price = 50.00 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_prices ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 400.50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren, indem er eine Schleife und einen Akkumulator in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung kombiniert. Dies ist prägnanter und oft performanter als eine explizite `LOOP`-Schleife.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Math, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Constructor Injection für eine Abhängigkeit in einer ABAP-Klasse.
hint: Definieren Sie einen `IMPORTING` Parameter im `CONSTRUCTOR`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to console or a log file.
    " For unit test, we just simulate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
    METHODS perform_action.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_logger = io_logger.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD perform_action.
    mo_logger->log_message( 'Action performed successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    " Mock logger for testing
    CLASS lcl_mock_logger DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_logger.
        DATA mv_last_message TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_mock_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
        mv_last_message = iv_message.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_mock_logger) = NEW lcl_mock_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_service( io_logger = lo_mock_logger ).
    lo_service->perform_action( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_mock_logger->mv_last_message exp = 'Action performed successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Injection ist ein Designmuster, das die Abhängigkeiten einer Klasse über ihren Konstruktor bereitstellt. Dies fördert lose Kopplung, erleichtert das Unit Testing (durch Mocking von Abhängigkeiten) und verbessert die Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, Dependency Injection, Interface, Mocking

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das aktuelle Datum und die aktuelle Uhrzeit in UTC unter Verwendung der modernen ABAP-Datum/Zeit-Klassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date_utc()` und `get_system_time_utc()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_utc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_datetime_utc,
        date TYPE d,
        time TYPE t,
      END OF ty_datetime_utc.

    METHODS get_current_utc_datetime
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_datetime) TYPE ty_datetime_utc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_utc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_utc_datetime.
    rs_datetime-date = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date_utc( ).
    rs_datetime-time = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_time_utc( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_current_utc_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_current_utc_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_utc( ).
    DATA(ls_datetime) = lo_cut->get_current_utc_datetime( ).

    " Assert that date and time are valid (not initial)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_datetime-date msg = 'Date should not be initial' exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_datetime-time msg = 'Time should not be initial' exp = abap_false ).

    " More specific check: within a reasonable time frame (e.g., last 5 seconds)
    DATA(lv_current_utc_time) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_time_utc( ).
    DATA(lv_diff) = lv_current_utc_time - ls_datetime-time.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_diff >= 0 AND lv_diff < 5 ) msg = 'Time should be recent' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_abap_context_info`-Klasse bietet eine standardisierte und zuverlässige Methode, um systembezogene Informationen wie das aktuelle Datum und die Uhrzeit in UTC abzurufen, was besonders in globalen Anwendungen wichtig ist.
keywords: Date/Time, UTC, cl_abap_context_info, System Date, System Time

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle unter Verwendung moderner Open SQL-Syntax mit Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_from_db)
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.
    rt_flights = lt_flights_from_db.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_inline( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights( iv_max_rows = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Flights table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_flights ) LE 5 ) msg = 'Should retrieve at most 5 rows' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen in Open SQL (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) ermöglichen eine kompaktere und lesbarere Syntax, da die interne Tabelle direkt im `SELECT`-Statement deklariert wird. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Übersichtlichkeit.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Database Access, sflights

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dynamischen 3D-Objekt-Eigenschaften (Position, Farbe), die von einem 3D-Viewer wie `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` verarbeitet werden könnten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` Schleifen, um die Datenstruktur zu füllen. Die Daten sind für die Visualisierung mit `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` gedacht, die eigentliche GUI-Interaktion ist hier nicht enthalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_data_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_3d_object_prop,
        id      TYPE i,
        pos_x   TYPE f,
        pos_y   TYPE f,
        pos_z   TYPE f,
        color_r TYPE i,
        color_g TYPE i,
        color_b TYPE i,
      END OF ty_3d_object_prop,
      tt_3d_object_props TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_3d_object_prop WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_3d_object_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_objects TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_3d_data) TYPE tt_3d_object_props.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_data_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_3d_object_data.
    DATA: lv_id TYPE i VALUE 0.
    rt_3d_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_objects
                           ( id      = ( lv_id = lv_id + 1 )
                             pos_x   = ( i * 10.0 )
                             pos_y   = ( i * 5.0 )
                             pos_z   = ( i * 2.0 )
                             color_r = ( i MOD 256 )
                             color_g = ( ( i * 2 ) MOD 256 )
                             color_b = ( ( i * 3 ) MOD 256 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_3d_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_3d_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3d_data_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_3d_data) = lo_cut->generate_3d_object_data( iv_num_objects = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_3d_data ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_3d_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_3d_data[ 1 ]-pos_x exp = 10.0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_3d_data[ 3 ]-color_r exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung strukturierter Daten für 3D-Objekte unter Verwendung moderner `VALUE` und `FOR` Konstrukte. Solche Daten könnten als Input für einen 3D-Viewer wie `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` dienen, um Objekte dynamisch darzustellen. Die Logik konzentriert sich auf die Datenaufbereitung, die von der GUI-Komponente konsumiert wird.
keywords: cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, 3D Data

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke, um direkt auf einen Wert in einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen und dabei die Zeilennummer (`sy-tabix`-Kontext) zu berücksichtigen, falls der Zugriff fehlschlägt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `itab[ index ]` und den `OPTIONAL` Zusatz für den Zugriff auf nicht-existierende Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        key   TYPE i,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS get_value_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_key  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_value_by_index
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_by_key.
    TRY.
        rv_value = it_data[ key = iv_key ]-value.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_value = 'Key not found'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value_by_index.
    " Hier wird sy-tabix nicht direkt verwendet, aber der Index-Zugriff
    " ist die moderne Alternative zum klassischen LOOP mit sy-tabix.
    TRY.
        rv_value = it_data[ iv_index ]-value.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_value = 'Index not found'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_value_by_key FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_value_by_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_value_by_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression_tabix( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_expression_tabix=>tt_data(
      ( key = 1 value = 'First' )
      ( key = 2 value = 'Second' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_value_by_key( it_data = lt_data iv_key = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Second' ).
    lv_value = lo_cut->get_value_by_key( it_data = lt_data iv_key = 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Key not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_value_by_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression_tabix( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_expression_tabix=>tt_data(
      ( key = 1 value = 'First' )
      ( key = 2 value = 'Second' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_value_by_index( it_data = lt_data iv_index = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'First' ).
    lv_value = lo_cut->get_value_by_index( it_data = lt_data iv_index = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Index not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) bieten einen direkten und prägnanten Zugriff auf Zeilen interner Tabellen. Dies ist die moderne Alternative zum iterativen Zugriff mit `LOOP AT` und `READ TABLE` und kann in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` oder `OPTIONAL` verwendet werden, um Fehler beim Zugriff auf nicht-existierende Zeilen elegant zu behandeln, ohne `sy-tabix` explizit prüfen zu müssen.
keywords: sy-tabix, Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Index Access, Key Access, Exception Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die ersten N Zeilen einer Quelltabelle enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators mit `UNTIL`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... UNTIL ...` um die Schleife zu begrenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_until_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_line,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_line,
      tt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_lines
        iv_n            TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_lines.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_until_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_lines.
    rt_target_table = VALUE #( FOR ls_line IN it_source_table UNTIL sy-tabix > iv_n
                               ( ls_line ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_n_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_n_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_until_tabix( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_for_until_tabix=>tt_lines(
      ( value = 'A' )
      ( value = 'B' )
      ( value = 'C' )
      ( value = 'D' )
      ( value = 'E' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_first_n_lines( it_source_table = lt_source iv_n = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-value exp = 'C' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_first_n_lines( it_source_table = lt_source iv_n = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_first_n_lines( it_source_table = lt_source iv_n = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator mit dem `UNTIL`-Zusatz ermöglicht es, eine Schleife basierend auf einer Bedingung zu beenden, die auch `sy-tabix` nutzen kann. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, die Verarbeitung von internen Tabellen auf eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeilen zu begrenzen, ohne eine explizite `IF` und `EXIT` Anweisung zu benötigen.
keywords: sy-tabix, FOR, UNTIL, Internal Tables, Limiting Rows

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_flight,
      tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        count  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrier_count,
      tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_all_flights BY ls_group-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                   count  = lines( GROUP ls_group ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_for( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_for=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'UA' ]-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt komplexe `LOOP AT ... AT NEW/END OF` Konstrukte und führt zu deutlich lesbarerem und wartbarerem Code für Aggregationen und Gruppierungen.
keywords: Grouping, FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Schreiben Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in ein Excel-Dokument. Die Spaltenüberschriften sollen aus den Feldnamen der Struktur abgeleitet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` und iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle, um die Daten zeilenweise zu schreiben. Nutzen Sie RTTI für Spaltenüberschriften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_write_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS write_sflights_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_file_name TYPE string DEFAULT 'SFlights.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_write_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_excel->get_active_worksheet( ).

    " Write header row using RTTI
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( it_sflights[ 1 ] ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>get_column_name( sy-tabix ) ip_row = 1 ip_value = ls_component-name ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Write data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'A' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'B' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'C' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'D' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'E' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_write_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_write_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_excel_write_sflights=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_write_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->write_sflights_to_excel( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).
    " More advanced tests would involve parsing the generated Excel, which is beyond simple unit testing.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert das Schreiben von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in ein Excel-Dokument. Die Spaltenüberschriften werden dynamisch über RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) ermittelt, was eine flexible Lösung darstellt.
keywords: cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet, Excel, Internal Tables, RTTI, SFlight

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für einen Datenprovider, der eine interne Tabelle zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse, die Flugdaten (`sflights`) liefert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` zur Definition des Vertrags und `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING INTERFACE` zur Implementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_provider PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_row,
           field1 TYPE string,
           field2 TYPE string,
         END OF ty_data_row.
  TYPES: tt_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_raw
                       ( field1 = ls_sflight-carrid
                         field2 = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_data.
    DATA(lo_data_provider) = CAST zif_data_provider( NEW zcl_sflight_data_provider( ) ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_data_provider->get_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die Verwendung eines Interfaces (`zif_data_provider`) zur Definition eines standardisierten Datenzugriffs. Die Implementierung (`zcl_sflight_data_provider`) nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax (`SELECT INTO TABLE @DATA`, `VALUE #( FOR ... )`) zur Datenbeschaffung und Transformation.
keywords: INTERFACE, Object Orientation, SELECT, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Erweitern Sie Beispiel 2 und 3. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein Excel-Dokument aus Daten generiert, die von einem `zif_excel_data_provider` Interface geliefert werden.
hint: Die Excel-Generierungsklasse sollte eine Instanz des Interfaces als Parameter akzeptieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_excel_data_provider PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
           col1 TYPE string,
           col2 TYPE string,
           col3 TYPE string,
         END OF ty_excel_row.
  TYPES: tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_excel_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_excel_data.
  METHODS get_header_names
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_headers) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_excel_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_excel_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_excel_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_excel_data_provider~get_excel_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
      UP TO 3 ROWS.

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_raw
                       ( col1 = ls_sflight-carrid
                         col2 = ls_sflight-connid
                         col3 = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ENVIRONMENT->OSTR_DATE }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_excel_data_provider~get_header_names.
    rt_headers = VALUE #( ( 'Airline' ) ( 'Connection' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_excel
      IMPORTING
        io_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_excel_data_provider
        iv_file_name     TYPE string DEFAULT 'Report.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_excel->get_active_worksheet( ).

    " Write header
    DATA(lt_headers) = io_data_provider->get_header_names( ).
    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(lv_header).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>get_column_name( sy-tabix ) ip_row = 1 ip_value = lv_header ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Write data
    DATA(lt_data) = io_data_provider->get_excel_data( ).
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'A' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_data-col1 ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'B' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_data-col2 ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'C' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_data-col3 ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_excel_with_provider FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_excel_with_provider.
    DATA(lo_sflight_provider) = CAST zif_excel_data_provider( NEW zcl_sflight_excel_provider( ) ).
    DATA(lo_excel_generator) = NEW zcl_excel_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_excel_generator->generate_excel( io_data_provider = lo_sflight_provider ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit von Interfaces in Kombination mit `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet`. Instructions: Laden Sie eine Textdatei vom Frontend hoch und geben Sie den Inhalt zeilenweise zurück. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Konstrukte zur Verarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload` und verarbeiten Sie den Inhalt mit `FOR` oder `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_file_upload DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS upload_text_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_file_content) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_upload IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_text_file.
    DATA: lv_file_length TYPE i.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_filepath
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = rt_file_content
        filelength              = lv_file_length
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_error         = 1
        file_read_error         = 2
        no_batch                = 3
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 4
        invalid_type            = 5
        no_authority            = 6
        unknown_error           = 7
        bad_data_format         = 8
        cancel_by_user          = 9
        dp_error                = 10
        header_not_allowed      = 11
        separator_not_allowed   = 12
        header_too_long         = 13
        unknown_dp_error        = 14
        access_denied           = 15
        OTHERS                  = 16
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_upload_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_upload_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upload_success.
    DATA: lt_mock_content TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Line 1' TO lt_mock_content.
    APPEND 'Line 2' TO lt_mock_content.

    cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>set_mock_for_static_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES'
      iv_method_name = 'GUI_UPLOAD'
      iv_parameters  = VALUE #( ( name = 'DATA_TAB' value = REF #( lt_mock_content ) ) )
      iv_sy_subrc    = 0
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_file_upload( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->upload_text_file( 'C:\temp\test.txt' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Line 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Line 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_upload_failure.
    cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>set_mock_for_static_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES'
      iv_method_name = 'GUI_UPLOAD'
      iv_sy_subrc    = 1 " Simulate file_open_error
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_file_upload( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->upload_text_file( 'C:\temp\nonexistent.txt' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_gui_frontend_services expected' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Upload einer Textdatei vom Frontend. Die `GUI_UPLOAD` Methode der Klasse `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES` wird verwendet. Die Verarbeitung des Dateiinhalts erfolgt direkt in eine `string_table`, was eine moderne und effiziente Art der Datenhaltung in ABAP ist. Der Unit Test verwendet Mocking, um die Frontend-Interaktion zu simulieren und sowohl Erfolgs- als auch Fehlerfälle abzudecken.
keywords: cl_gui_frontend_services, GUI_UPLOAD, File Upload, Internal Tables, Mocking, Unit Test

CLASS zcl_fes_file_download DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS download_csv_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
        it_data     TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_csv_file.
    DATA: lt_csv_lines TYPE string_table.
    DATA: lv_header    TYPE string.

    " Prepare header line
    lv_header = `CARRIER_ID;CONNECTION_ID;FLIGHT_DATE;PRICE`.
    APPEND lv_header TO lt_csv_lines.

    " Prepare data lines using REDUCE and String Templates
    lt_csv_lines = VALUE #( BASE lt_csv_lines
      FOR wa IN it_data
      ( |{ wa-carrid };{ wa-connid };{ wa-fldate };{ wa-price }| )
    ).

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_filepath
        filetype                = 'ASC'
        write_field_separator   = abap_false " Separator already in string
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_csv_lines
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_write_error        = 1
        no_batch                = 2
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
        invalid_type            = 4
        no_authority            = 5
        unknown_error           = 6
        bad_data_format         = 7
        cancel_by_user          = 8
        dp_error                = 9
        header_not_allowed      = 10
        separator_not_allowed   = 11
        header_too_long         = 12
        unknown_dp_error        = 13
        access_denied           = 14
        OTHERS                  = 15
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_download_success.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lv_mock_filename) = 'C:\temp\download.csv'.
    DATA(lt_downloaded_data) = VALUE string_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>set_mock_for_static_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES'
      iv_method_name = 'GUI_DOWNLOAD'
      iv_parameters  = VALUE #( ( name = 'DATA_TAB' value = REF #( lt_downloaded_data ) ) )
      iv_sy_subrc    = 0
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_file_download( ).
    lo_cut->download_csv_file( iv_filepath = lv_mock_filename it_data = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_downloaded_data ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_downloaded_data[1] exp = 'CARRIER_ID;CONNECTION_ID;FLIGHT_DATE;PRICE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_downloaded_data[2] exp = 'LH;0400;20250101;100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_downloaded_data[3] exp = 'AA;0017;20250102;250.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_download_failure.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE tt_sflight.
    cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>set_mock_for_static_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES'
      iv_method_name = 'GUI_DOWNLOAD'
      iv_sy_subrc    = 1 " Simulate file_write_error
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_file_download( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->download_csv_file( iv_filepath = 'C:\temp\error.csv' it_data = lt_test_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_gui_frontend_services expected' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_dialog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_filepath) TYPE string

        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_dialog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_selected_file.
    DATA: lt_file_table TYPE filetable.
    DATA: lv_rc         TYPE i.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        window_title            = 'Datei auswählen'
        default_extension       = '*.txt'
        multiselection          = abap_false
      CHANGING
        file_table              = lt_file_table
        rc                      = lv_rc
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_dialog_failed = 1
        OTHERS                  = 2
    ).

    IF lv_rc = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.

    IF lines( lt_file_table ) > 0.
      rv_filepath = lt_file_table[ 1 ]-fullpath.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_exist IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lv_rc TYPE i.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_exist(
      EXPORTING

    ENDIF.

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_rc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_result_data_table` und `if_salv_ex_util_r_result_data~export_to_excel`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_excel_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_sflights_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_salv_ex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_excel_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Modern ABAP: SELECT into internal table with inline declaration
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data_from_db)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_data_from_db IS INITIAL.
      " If no data from DB, use some dummy data for demonstration
      lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '101.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                             ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) ).
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights = lt_data_from_db.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_result_data) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_result_data_table(
                               EXPORTING
                                 t_data = lt_sflights
                             ).

    TRY.
        lo_result_data->if_salv_ex_util_r_result_data~export_to_excel(
          EXPORTING
            filename = iv_filepath
        ).
      CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_salv_ex_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_salv_ex_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_test_framework=>set_mock_for_instance_method(
      iv_object      = lo_mock_result_data

      iv_parameters  = VALUE #( ( name = 'R_RESULT_DATA' value = REF #( lo_mock_result_data ) ) )

CLASS zcl_salv_pdf_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_sflights_to_pdf
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
        iv_title    TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RAISING
        cx_salv_ex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_pdf_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_pdf.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data_from_db)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_data_from_db IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '101.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                             ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) ).
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights = lt_data_from_db.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_result_data) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_result_data_table(
                               EXPORTING
                                 t_data = lt_sflights
                             ).

    TRY.
        lo_result_data->if_salv_ex_util_r_result_data~export_to_pdf(
          EXPORTING
            filename = iv_filepath
            title    = iv_title
        ).
      CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_salv_ex_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_salv_ex_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_filter_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_string_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_salv_ex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_filter_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_string_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA: lt_string_data TYPE string_table.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data_from_db)
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    IF lt_data_from_db IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '101.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                             ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
                             ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights = lt_data_from_db.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_result_data) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_result_data_table(
                               EXPORTING
                                 t_data = lt_sflights
                             ).

    TRY.
        lt_string_data = lo_result_data->if_salv_ex_util_r_result_data~get_data_as_string_table( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_salv_ex_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_salv_ex_error.
    ENDTRY.

    " Modern ABAP: Filter the string table
    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( lt_string_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE table_line CS iv_filter_carrid ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_salv_ex_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_salv_ex_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_salv_ex_error.
    ENDTRY.

    " Modern ABAP: Combine string table into a single string using REDUCE
    rv_combined_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR line IN lt_string_data
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && line )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den minimalen Wert in einer Spalte einer internen Tabelle mit moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um den minimalen Wert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_value_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             id    TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES: tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_minimum_value
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE tt_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_value_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_minimum_value.
    IF it_values IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_value = 0. " Oder eine geeignete Fehlerbehandlung
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_value = REDUCE i(
      INIT min_val = it_values[ 1 ]-value
      FOR <fs_value> IN it_values
      NEXT min_val = COND i( WHEN <fs_value>-value < min_val THEN <fs_value>-value ELSE min_val ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'A' value = 5 ) TO lt_test_values.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'B' value = 2 ) TO lt_test_values.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'C' value = 8 ) TO lt_test_values.

    DATA(lv_min) = lo_cut->find_minimum_value( lt_test_values ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) in einer Klasse, um mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung auszuführen.
hint: Designen Sie Methoden so, dass sie `ME` (die aktuelle Objektinstanz) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.
    METHODS subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.
    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_number.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_result = mv_result - iv_number.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen CSV-String aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei numerische Felder in einem spezifischen Format (z.B. mit Dezimalkomma statt -punkt) ausgegeben werden sollen.
hint: Die `cl_icf_csv`-Klasse verwendet standardmäßig die ABAP-Konvertierung. Für spezifische Formatierungen müssen die Daten vorab angepasst oder eine eigene Konvertierungslogik implementiert werden.

CLASS zcl_csv_format_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             item_id TYPE string,
             amount  TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES: tt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_data,
             item_id TYPE string,
             amount  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_data.
    TYPES: tt_formatted_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_formatted_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv_with_formatted_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_raw_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_format_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_with_formatted_numbers.
    DATA lt_formatted_data TYPE tt_formatted_data.

    lt_formatted_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_raw> IN it_source_data
                                 ( item_id = <fs_raw>-item_id
                                   amount  = |{ <fs_raw>-amount COUNTRY = 'DE' }| ) ).

    DATA(lo_csv_generator) = cl_icf_csv=>create_with_table(
      i_table      = lt_formatted_data
      i_delimiter  = ';'
      i_has_header = abap_true ).

    rv_csv_output = lo_csv_generator->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste aller Flugnummern (CONNID) der Fluggesellschaft 'DL' (Delta Airlines), die mehr als 100 freie Plätze haben. Die Liste soll aufsteigend nach Flugnummer sortiert sein.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILTER- und FOR-Ausdrücke, um die Daten zu filtern und dann zu transformieren.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             planetype TYPE s_planety_l,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_sorted_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsocc
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sorted_connids.
    rt_connids = VALUE tt_connid(
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND seatsfree > iv_min_seats )
      ( flight-connid )
    ).
    SORT rt_connids ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der freien Plätze (SEATSFREE) für alle Flüge in der Tabelle 'sflights'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Werte zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             planetype TYPE s_planety_l,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE s_seatsfree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_free_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE s_seatsfree(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + flight-seatsfree
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus 'sflights' eine neue Struktur mit der Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und einem berechneten 'Auslastungsgrad' (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX * 100) enthält. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge, deren Auslastungsgrad über 70% liegt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FOR- und FILTER-Ausdrücke, wobei der Filter auf einem berechneten Wert basiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             planetype TYPE s_planety_l,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_load,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             load_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1,
           END OF ty_flight_load.
    TYPES tt_flight_load TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_load WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_load_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_high_load_flights) TYPE tt_flight_load.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_load_flights.
    rt_high_load_flights = VALUE tt_flight_load(
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      LET load = COND p(
        WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) * 100
        ELSE 0
      ) IN
      WHERE ( load > 70 )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid load_percentage = load )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus 'sflights' nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Anzahl der freien Plätze (SEATSFREE).
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit GROUP BY und REDUCE für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             planetype TYPE s_planety_l,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_seats,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_seatsfree TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 1,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_seats_by_carrier.
    rt_avg_seats = VALUE tt_carrier_avg_seats(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        avg_seatsfree = REDUCE p(
          INIT sum_seats = 0 count = 0
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + member-seatsfree
               count = count + 1
          FINALLY = COND p( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_seats / count ELSE 0 )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_basic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_preferred_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_basic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carriers.
    IF it_preferred_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @rt_filtered_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_preferred_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_preferred_carriers-carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
