Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Flugdatum.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit der `ORDER BY`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_order_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_ordered_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_preferred_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_order_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_ordered_by_date.
    IF it_preferred_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @rt_filtered_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_preferred_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_preferred_carriers-carrid
        ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_order_by_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_order_by_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_order_by( ).
    DATA(lt_preferred_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_order_by=>tt_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_ordered_by_date( lt_preferred_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) EXP = 0 ).

    DATA(lv_previous_date) = '00000000'.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = xsdbool( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_previous_date )
        msg = 'Flights should be sorted by date ascending'
      ).
      lv_previous_date = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel kann direkt mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` verwendet werden, um die Ergebnisse bereits auf der Datenbank zu sortieren, bevor sie in die interne Tabelle geladen werden. Dies ist oft performanter, als die Sortierung nachträglich in ABAP durchzuführen.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, ORDER BY, Sorting, Database Access

Instructions: Wählen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `SFLIGHTS` aus.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_fae_up_to_n IMPLEMENTATION.

        INTO TABLE @rt_filtered_flights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    rv_average_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.0 " Use float for sum to avoid integer division issues
                                      count = 0
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                WHERE ( price IS NOT INITIAL )
                                NEXT
                                  sum = sum + flight-price,
                                  count = count + 1
                                RESULT COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0.0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_zero_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_avg_reduce=>tt_flights(
      ( price = 100 )
      ( price = 200 )
      ( price = 300 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 200 msg = 'Average should be 200' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_avg_reduce=>tt_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0 msg = 'Average of empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_zero_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_avg_reduce=>tt_flights(
      ( price = 0 )
      ( price = 100 )
      ( price = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 100 msg = 'Average should handle zero prices' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe und die Anzahl der Flüge zu akkumulieren und daraus den Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Die `COND`-Expression sorgt für eine sichere Division durch Null.
keywords: AVERAGE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für eine spezifische Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine bedingte Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price_by_carrier.
    rv_average_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.0
                                      count = 0
                                FOR flight IN it_flights FILTER ( WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                                WHERE ( price IS NOT INITIAL )
                                NEXT
                                  sum = sum + flight-price,
                                  count = count + 1
                                RESULT COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0.0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_avg_filter_reduce=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = 500 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = 300 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 200 msg = 'Average for LH should be 200' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_avg_filter_reduce=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = 500 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0 msg = 'Average for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination des `FILTER`-Operators mit `REDUCE`. Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle nach der gewünschten Fluggesellschaft gefiltert, und dann wird der `REDUCE`-Operator auf die gefilterten Daten angewendet, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr lesbare und effiziente Methode für bedingte Aggregationen in ABAP.
keywords: AVERAGE, FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Conditional Aggregation

CLASS zcl_da_temp_scope DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_with_cold_temp

CLASS zcl_da_temp_scope IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_with_cold_temp.

CLASS zcl_da_conditional_logic IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von `SFLIGHTS`-Datensätzen basierend auf der aktuellen Datentemperatur filtert. Wenn die Temperatur 'Hot' ist, werden alle Datensätze zurückgegeben; wenn 'Cold', nur Datensätze mit einem `FLDATE` vor dem aktuellen Jahr.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_TEMPERATURE` und `FILTER` für die interne Tabelle. Für das 'Cold'-Szenario filtern Sie nach `FLDATE` < aktuelles Jahr.
solution:
CLASS zcl_da_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    METHODS get_current_temperature RETURNING VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflights.
    DATA(lv_current_temp) = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature( ).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).

    CASE lv_current_temp.
      WHEN if_abap_stack_temperature=>gcs_temperature-hot.
        rt_filtered_sflights = it_sflights.
      WHEN if_abap_stack_temperature=>gcs_temperature-cold.
        rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE fldate < |{ lv_current_year }0101| ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Keine Filterung oder Fehlerbehandlung
        rt_filtered_sflights = it_sflights.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_current_temperature.
    rv_temperature = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des ersten Tages des nächsten Quartals für ein gegebenes Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `GET_QUARTER` und `ADD_MONTHS` der Klasse `CL_RECA_DATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_next_quarter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_day_of_next_quarter
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_next_quarter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_day_of_next_quarter.
    DATA(lo_date) = cl_reca_date=>create_date( iv_date ).
    DATA(lv_current_quarter) = lo_date->get_quarter( ).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = lo_date->get_year( ).

    DATA(lv_next_quarter_month) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_next_quarter_year) TYPE i.

    CASE lv_current_quarter.
      WHEN 1. " Q1 (Jan-Mär) -> Nächstes Quartal beginnt im April
        lv_next_quarter_month = 4.
        lv_next_quarter_year = lv_current_year.
      WHEN 2. " Q2 (Apr-Jun) -> Nächstes Quartal beginnt im Juli
        lv_next_quarter_month = 7.
        lv_next_quarter_year = lv_current_year.
      WHEN 3. " Q3 (Jul-Sep) -> Nächstes Quartal beginnt im Oktober
        lv_next_quarter_month = 10.
        lv_next_quarter_year = lv_current_year.
      WHEN 4. " Q4 (Okt-Dez) -> Nächstes Quartal beginnt im Januar des nächsten Jahres
        lv_next_quarter_month = 1.
        lv_next_quarter_year = lv_current_year + 1.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lv_first_day_next_quarter) = |{ lv_next_quarter_year ALPHA = OUT }| &&
                                      |{ lv_next_quarter_month ALPHA = OUT PAD LEFT = '0' WIDTH = 2 }| && '01'.

    rv_result_date = lv_first_day_next_quarter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20230401' ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->get_first_day_of_next_quarter( '20231120' ). " Q4
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20240101' ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->get_first_day_of_next_quarter( '20240601' ). " Q2 (Schaltjahr)

CLASS zcl_da_access_warning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_da_access_warning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_data_with_warning.
    DATA(lv_current_temp) = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature( ).

    IF lv_current_temp = if_abap_stack_temperature=>gcs_temperature-hot AND iv_data_type = 'COLD'.
      MESSAGE |Warnung: Versuchter Zugriff auf COLD-Daten im HOT-Kontext für { iv_data_type }!| TYPE 'W'.
    ELSEIF lv_current_temp = if_abap_stack_temperature=>gcs_temperature-cold AND iv_data_type = 'HOT'.
      MESSAGE |Warnung: Versuchter Zugriff auf HOT-Daten im COLD-Kontext für { iv_data_type }!| TYPE 'W'.
    ELSE.
      " Normaler Zugriff oder keine Warnung erforderlich
      MESSAGE |Zugriff auf { iv_data_type } im { lv_current_temp }-Kontext.| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_current_temperature.
    rv_temperature = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des N-ten Wochentags (z.B. 3. Dienstag) eines bestimmten Monats und Jahres.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_RECA_DATE` und eine Schleife, um die Tage zu inkrementieren und den Wochentag zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_nth_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_nth_weekday_of_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_year     TYPE syear
        iv_month    TYPE sy_monat
        iv_weekday  TYPE i " 1=Mon, 7=Sun
        iv_n        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_nth_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nth_weekday_of_month.
    DATA(lv_date_str) = |{ iv_year ALPHA = OUT }| && |{ iv_month ALPHA = OUT PAD LEFT = '0' WIDTH = 2 }| && '01'.
    DATA(lo_date) = cl_reca_date=>create_date( lv_date_str ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    DO.
      IF lo_date->get_weekday( ) = iv_weekday.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_count = iv_n.
        rv_result_date = lo_date->get_date( ).
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lo_date->add_days( 1 ).
      IF lo_date->get_month( ) <> iv_month.
        " N-ter Wochentag nicht im Monat gefunden
        CLEAR rv_result_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_nth_weekday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_nth_weekday( ).
    " 3. Dienstag im Januar 2023 (17.01.2023)
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_nth_weekday_of_month( iv_year = 2023 iv_month = 1 iv_weekday = 2 iv_n = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20230117' ).

    " 1. Sonntag im Februar 2024 (04.02.2024)
    lv_result = lo_cut->get_nth_weekday_of_month( iv_year = 2024 iv_month = 2 iv_weekday = 7 iv_n = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20240204' ).

    " 5. Samstag im Februar 2023 (existiert nicht)
    lv_result = lo_cut->get_nth_weekday_of_month( iv_year = 2023 iv_month = 2 iv_weekday = 6 iv_n = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Datum von der internen ABAP-Darstellung (YYYYMMDD) in ein benutzerdefiniertes Format (z.B. DD.MM.YYYY).

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_date_to_display
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_display_date) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_date_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_date_to_display.
    " CONVERT DATE iv_date INTO INVERTED-DATE rv_display_date. " This converts to YYYYDDMM
    " For DD.MM.YYYY, string templates are more direct and modern.
    rv_display_date = |{ iv_date DATE = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Zeit von einer Zeitzone in eine andere.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT DATE ... TIME ZONE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timezone_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_time_zone
      IMPORTING
        iv_date      TYPE sy-datum
        iv_time      TYPE sy-uzeit
        iv_source_tz TYPE tznzone
        iv_target_tz TYPE tznzone
      EXPORTING
        ev_target_date TYPE sy-datum
        ev_target_time TYPE sy-uzeit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timezone_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_time_zone.
    CONVERT DATE iv_date TIME iv_time
      INTO DATE ev_target_date TIME ev_target_time
      DAYLIGHT SAVING TIME ' '
      TIME ZONE iv_source_tz
      INTO TIME ZONE iv_target_tz.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_time_zone_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_time_zone_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timezone_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = '20251122'.
    DATA(lv_test_time) = '100000'. " 10:00:00 CET
    DATA(lv_source_tz) = 'CET'.
    DATA(lv_target_tz) = 'EST'.

    DATA lv_target_date TYPE sy-datum.
    DATA lv_target_time TYPE sy-uzeit.

    lo_cut->convert_time_zone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date      = lv_test_date
        iv_time      = lv_test_time
        iv_source_tz = lv_source_tz
        iv_target_tz = lv_target_tz
      IMPORTING
        ev_target_date = lv_target_date
        ev_target_time = lv_target_time
    ).

    " 10:00 CET (UTC+1) is 04:00 EST (UTC-5) on the same day, assuming no DST changes for this specific date.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_target_date exp = '20251122' msg = 'Datum nach Zeitzonenkonvertierung falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_target_time exp = '040000' msg = 'Zeit nach Zeitzonenkonvertierung falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die präzise Zeitzonenkonvertierung mit `CONVERT DATE ... TIME ZONE`, einer wichtigen Funktion für globale Anwendungen, die Datums- und Zeitwerte über verschiedene Zeitzonen hinweg korrekt anpasst.
keywords: CONVERT, TIME ZONE, Datum, Zeit, Zeitzone

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` von einer Währung in eine andere, basierend auf einem bestimmten Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT CURRENCY` mit `RATE` und `DATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_currency_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
        converted_price TYPE sflight-price,
        target_currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_currency TYPE sflight-currency
        iv_exchange_date   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_prices) TYPE tt_sflight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_currency_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(ls_converted_price) = VALUE ty_sflight_price(
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency
        target_currency = iv_target_currency
      ).

      CONVERT CURRENCY ls_sflight-price
        FROM ls_sflight-currency
        TO iv_target_currency
        DATE iv_exchange_date
        INTO ls_converted_price-converted_price.

      APPEND ls_converted_price TO rt_converted_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_currency_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_currency_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_currency_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'USD'.
    DATA(lv_exchange_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lt_converted_prices) = lo_cut->convert_flight_prices(
      iv_target_currency = lv_target_currency
      iv_exchange_date   = lv_exchange_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_converted_prices IS INITIAL msg = 'Keine Preise konvertiert' ).
    LOOP AT lt_converted_prices INTO DATA(ls_price).
      " Assert that the target currency is correct
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_price-target_currency exp = lv_target_currency msg = 'Zielwährung falsch' ).
      " Assert that the price has potentially changed (unless source and target are the same or rate is 1:1)
      IF ls_price-currency <> lv_target_currency.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = ls_price-price exp = ls_price-converted_price msg = 'Preis nicht konvertiert, obwohl Währungen unterschiedlich' ).
      ENDIF.
      EXIT. " Only check first entry for simplicity
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die Währungsumrechnung mit `CONVERT CURRENCY` unter Verwendung von Daten aus der `sflight`-Tabelle, was für Finanzanwendungen relevant ist. Die Umrechnung berücksichtigt den Wechselkurs zum angegebenen Datum.
keywords: CONVERT, CURRENCY, sflight, Währung, Datenbank

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie die Entfernung von Flügen aus der Tabelle `sflights` von einer Einheit in eine andere (z.B. von KM in Meilen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT UNIT` mit `UNIT` und `TARGET UNIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unit_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_distance,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        distance TYPE sflight-distance,
        unit     TYPE sflight-distid,
        converted_distance TYPE sflight-distance,
        target_unit TYPE sflight-distid,
      END OF ty_sflight_distance.
    TYPES tt_sflight_distances TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_distance WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flight_distances
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_unit TYPE sflight-distid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_distances) TYPE tt_sflight_distances.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unit_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flight_distances.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, distance, distid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(ls_converted_distance) = VALUE ty_sflight_distance(
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        distance = ls_sflight-distance
        unit     = ls_sflight-distid
        target_unit = iv_target_unit
      ).

      CONVERT UNIT ls_sflight-distance
        FROM UNIT ls_sflight-distid
        TO UNIT iv_target_unit
        INTO ls_converted_distance-converted_distance.

      APPEND ls_converted_distance TO rt_converted_distances.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Währungsumrechnung direkt in einer Open SQL-Abfrage durch, um Flugpreise in eine Zielwährung umzurechnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Open SQL-Funktion `CONVERT_CURRENCY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_currency_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_converted,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        original_price TYPE sflight-price,
        original_currency TYPE sflight-currency,
        converted_price TYPE sflight-price,
        target_currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_converted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_converted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_converted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_converted_prices_sql
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_currency TYPE sflight-currency
        iv_exchange_date   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_prices) TYPE tt_sflight_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_currency_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_converted_prices_sql.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price AS original_price, currency AS original_currency,
           CONVERT_CURRENCY(
             amount = price,
             source_currency = currency,
             target_currency = @iv_target_currency,
             exchange_rate_date = @iv_exchange_date
           ) AS converted_price,
           @iv_target_currency AS target_currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_converted_prices
      UP TO 5 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sql_currency_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sql_currency_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_currency_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'USD'.
    DATA(lv_exchange_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lt_converted_prices) = lo_cut->get_converted_prices_sql(
      iv_target_currency = lv_target_currency
      iv_exchange_date   = lv_exchange_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_converted_prices IS INITIAL msg = 'Keine Preise per SQL konvertiert' ).
    LOOP AT lt_converted_prices INTO DATA(ls_price).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_price-target_currency exp = lv_target_currency msg = 'Zielwährung per SQL falsch' ).
      IF ls_price-original_currency <> lv_target_currency.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = ls_price-original_price exp = ls_price-converted_price msg = 'Preis nicht per SQL konvertiert, obwohl Währungen unterschiedlich' ).
      ENDIF.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die direkte Währungsumrechnung in Open SQL mit `CONVERT_CURRENCY`, was die Datenverarbeitung auf der Datenbankebene optimiert und die Performance verbessert, da die Umrechnung direkt im Datenbankserver erfolgt.
keywords: CONVERT, CURRENCY, Open SQL, Datenbank, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit einem spezifischen Objekt und Unterobjekt und lesen Sie die hinzugefügten Meldungen anschließend aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` für das Schreiben und `cl_bal_db_load` für das Lesen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_read_write DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bal_s_msg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS write_and_read_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_object    TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d
        iv_message   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE ty_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_read_write IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_and_read_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log(
      i_log_object    = iv_object
      i_log_subobject = iv_subobject
    ).
    lo_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '001'
      i_msgv1 = iv_message
    ).
    lo_log->save_log( ).

    " Now read the log back
    DATA(lt_log_handle) = VALUE bal_t_logh( ( lo_log->get_log_handle( ) ) ).
    DATA(lo_log_loader) = NEW cl_bal_db_load( ).
    lo_log_loader->load_log_from_db(
      EXPORTING
        i_t_log_handle = lt_log_handle
      IMPORTING
        e_t_msg        = rt_messages
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_write_read_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_write_read_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_read_write( ).
    DATA(lv_object) = 'Z_TEST_OBJ'.
    DATA(lv_subobject) = 'Z_TEST_SUB'.
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Dies ist eine Testnachricht'.

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->write_and_read_log(
      iv_object    = lv_object
      iv_subobject = lv_subobject
      iv_message   = lv_message
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_messages IS INITIAL msg = 'Keine Nachrichten aus dem Log gelesen' ).
    READ TABLE lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-msgv1 exp = lv_message msg = 'Gelesene Nachricht stimmt nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den vollständigen Zyklus des Schreibens und Lesens von Anwendungsprotokollen. Instructions: Fügen Sie einem Anwendungsprotokoll eine Meldung mit variablen Platzhaltern hinzu und stellen Sie sicher, dass diese korrekt ersetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log->add_message` mit `i_msgv1` bis `i_msgv4`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_placeholders DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_message_with_placeholders
      IMPORTING
        iv_param1 TYPE string
        iv_param2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_placeholders IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message_with_placeholders.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).
    " Message ZMSG 004: 'Parameter 1: &1, Parameter 2: &2'
    lo_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '004'
      i_msgv1 = iv_param1
      i_msgv2 = iv_param2
    ).
    lo_log->save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_placeholders FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_placeholders.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_placeholders( ).
    DATA(lv_param1) = 'Wert A'.
    DATA(lv_param2) = 'Wert B'.
    lo_cut->log_message_with_placeholders(
      iv_param1 = lv_param1
      iv_param2 = lv_param2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( 1 = 1 msg = 'Log-Methode sollte keine Fehler verursachen' ).
    " Actual verification would involve reading the log and checking the message text.
    " This requires a message ZMSG 004 to exist in the system with placeholders &1 and &2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie Meldungen mit variablen Platzhaltern im Anwendungsprotokoll verwendet werden. Durch die Übergabe von Werten an `i_msgv1` bis `i_msgv4` werden die Platzhalter in der Meldungstextdefinition dynamisch ersetzt, was zu flexiblen und informativen Protokolleinträgen führt.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen numerischen Wert in einen String und umgekehrt, unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates für die Konvertierung zu String und `CONV` für die Konvertierung von String zu numerisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_str_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS num_to_string
      IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS string_to_num
      IMPORTING iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_str_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD num_to_string.
    rv_string = |{ iv_number }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD string_to_num.
    TRY.
        rv_number = CONV i( iv_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        " Handle conversion error, e.g., if string is not a valid number
        rv_number = 0. " Default value or raise exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_num_str_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_num_str_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_str_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_number) = 12345.
    DATA(lv_string) = '67890'.
    DATA(lv_invalid_string) = 'ABC'.

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->num_to_string( lv_number ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_string exp = '12345' msg = 'Zahl zu String Konvertierung fehlgeschlagen' ).

    DATA(lv_converted_num) = lo_cut->string_to_num( lv_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_num exp = 67890 msg = 'String zu Zahl Konvertierung fehlgeschlagen' ).

    DATA(lv_converted_invalid_num) = lo_cut->string_to_num( lv_invalid_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_invalid_num exp = 0 msg = 'Fehlerhafte String zu Zahl Konvertierung nicht abgefangen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Konvertierung zwischen numerischen Werten und Strings. String-Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine einfache und lesbare Methode zur Konvertierung von Zahlen in Strings. Der `CONV`-Operator ermöglicht die Typkonvertierung von Strings in Zahlen, wobei eine Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für ungültige Eingaben empfohlen wird.
keywords: CONVERT, CONV, String Templates, Typkonvertierung, Numerisch, String

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten in eine JSON-Struktur und umgekehrt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_json_reader` und `cl_abap_conv_json_writer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS flights_to_json
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS json_to_flights
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flights_to_json.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_abap_conv_json_writer=>create(
      pretty_print = abap_true
    ).
    lo_writer->write( it_flights ).
    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD json_to_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = cl_abap_conv_json_reader=>create(
      json_string = iv_json_string
    ).
    lo_reader->read( CHANGING data = rt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_json_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_json_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_converter( ).
    DATA lt_original_flights TYPE zcl_json_converter=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_json_converter=>ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251122' ) TO lt_original_flights.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_json_converter=>ty_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251123' ) TO lt_original_flights.

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->flights_to_json( lt_original_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_json IS INITIAL msg = 'JSON-String ist leer' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'LH' in = lv_json msg = 'JSON enthält nicht die erwarteten Daten' ).

    DATA(lt_converted_flights) = lo_cut->json_to_flights( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_converted_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der konvertierten Flüge stimmt nicht überein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted_flights[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Konvertierte Flugdaten stimmen nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Konvertierung von ABAP-Datenstrukturen (interne Tabellen) in JSON-Strings und umgekehrt. Die Klassen `cl_abap_conv_json_writer` und `cl_abap_conv_json_reader` bieten eine leistungsstarke und flexible Möglichkeit, Daten für die Kommunikation mit externen Systemen oder APIs zu serialisieren und deserialisieren.
keywords: CONVERT, JSON, Serialisierung, Deserialisierung, cl_abap_conv_json_writer, cl_abap_conv_json_reader

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einem CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE an. Lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus, wenn die Aggregation zu keinem Ergebnis führt.
hint: Nutzen Sie die REDUCE-Expression in Kombination mit GROUP BY für die Aggregation. RAISE EXCEPTION bei leerem Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_sflight,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_agg_sflight.
    TYPES tt_agg_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_and_display_agg
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights_raw TYPE zcl_tree_sflights_basic=>tt_sflight OPTIONAL
        io_column_tree  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree
      RAISING
        cx_abap_no_data_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_and_display_agg.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = it_sflights_raw.
    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 100 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_data.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE zcl_tree_sflights_agg=>tt_agg_sflight(
      INIT result = VALUE zcl_tree_sflights_agg=>tt_agg_sflight( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid )
      LET sum_seats = SUM( ls_sflight-seatsocc ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid total_seats = sum_seats ) )
    ).

    IF lt_aggregated_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate tree population logic
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR) um Feldinformationen zu prüfen. RAISE EXCEPTION bei ungültigem Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS define_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD define_dynamic_columns.
    DATA: ls_column_info TYPE cl_gui_column_tree=>item_layout_column.
    DATA: lt_column_list TYPE cl_gui_column_tree=>item_layout_column_table.

    IF it_field_names IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Feldnamenliste darf nicht leer sein.'.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      TRY.
          " Check if field exists (simplified RTTI check)
          DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
          lo_struct_descr->get_component( lv_field_name ).

          ls_column_info-column_id = lv_field_name.
          ls_column_info-text = lv_field_name.
          ls_column_info-width = 10.
          APPEND ls_column_info TO lt_column_list.

        CATCH cx_sy_struct_component_not_found.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
            EXPORTING
              text = |Feld '{ lv_field_name }' existiert nicht in SFLIGHT.|.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Simulate setting columns (io_column_tree->set_column_list( lt_column_list ) would be called)

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_gui_event_handler.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.

    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_column_tree

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mapped,

             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_mapped.

    METHODS transform_and_display
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights_raw TYPE zcl_tree_sflights_basic=>tt_sflight OPTIONAL

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_display.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = it_sflights_raw.
    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 100 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_data.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_transformed_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_mapped(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_raw_data
      LET lv_total_seats = 200 " Assuming a fixed total for simplicity, or fetch from another table
          lv_free_seats = lv_total_seats - ls_sflight-seatsocc IN
      ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid    = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
        planetype = ls_sflight-planetype
        seatsocc  = ls_sflight-seatsocc
        free_seats = COND #( WHEN lv_free_seats < 0 THEN THROW cx_abap_invalid_parameter( text = 'Negative freie Sitze berechnet!' ) ELSE lv_free_seats ) )
    ).

    " Simulate tree population logic
  ENDMETHOD.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

        cx_abap_no_data_found.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_and_display.
    IF iv_search_pattern IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Suchmuster darf nicht leer sein.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_raw_data) = it_sflights_raw.
    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 100 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_data.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_filtered_data) = FILTER #( lt_raw_data USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE CONTAINS( carrid, iv_search_pattern ) OR CONTAINS( connid, iv_search_pattern ) ).

    IF lt_filtered_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        node_key
        item_name
        column_id

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_context_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 'ACTION_A' text = 'Aktion A' ).
    lo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 'ACTION_B' text = 'Aktion B' ).

    SET HANDLER me->handle_function_selected FOR lo_context_menu.
    menu = lo_context_menu.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_function_selected.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'ACTION_A'.
        " Simulate action A
      WHEN 'ACTION_B'.
        " Simulate action B
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannte Menüaktion: { fcode }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_and_display.
    DATA(lt_raw_sflights) = it_sflights_raw.
    IF lt_raw_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 100 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_scarr) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY
      FOR ls_scarr IN SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_joined_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_joined(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_raw_sflights
      FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr WHERE ls_scarr-carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        carrname = ls_scarr-carrname
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate )
    ).

    IF lt_joined_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate tree population logic
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_avg,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             avg_seats TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sflight_avg.
    TYPES tt_sflight_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_and_display
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights_raw TYPE zcl_tree_sflights_basic=>tt_sflight OPTIONAL
        io_column_tree  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree
      RAISING
        cx_abap_no_data_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_and_display.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = it_sflights_raw.
    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 100 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_data.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_raw_data
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_raw_data ).
    DATA(lv_average_seats) = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_seats / lv_count
      ELSE 0 " Should not happen due to initial check, but for completeness
    ).

    DATA(lt_data_with_avg) = VALUE tt_sflight_avg(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_raw_data
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
        avg_seats = lv_average_seats )
    ).

    " Simulate tree population logic
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE string,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             is_header TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_nested_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights_raw TYPE zcl_tree_sflights_basic=>tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nested_data) TYPE tt_flight_node
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter,
        cx_abap_no_data_found.

    METHODS display_nested_data
      IMPORTING
        it_nested_data TYPE tt_flight_node
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree
      RAISING
        cx_abap_no_data_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_nested_data.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = it_sflights_raw.
    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 100 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_data.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.

    rt_nested_data = VALUE tt_flight_node(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_carr_node_key = |CARR_{ ls_sflight-carrid }| IN
      ( node_key = lv_carr_node_key
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        is_header = abap_true )
      FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_sflight
      ( node_key = |FLIGHT_{ ls_flight-carrid }_{ ls_flight-connid }|
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        is_header = abap_false )
    ).

    IF rt_nested_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Verschachtelte Datenstruktur konnte nicht aufgebaut werden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_nested_data.
    IF it_nested_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate tree population logic for hierarchical display
    " This would involve methods like io_column_tree->add_nodes with parent_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             flight_count TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_summary_and_display.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = it_sflights_raw.
    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 100 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_data.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_raw_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_summary_data) = REDUCE tt_sflight_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid )
      LET lv_count = COUNT( GROUP ls_sflight ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) )
    ).

    IF lt_summary_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_no_data_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Zusammenfassung enthält keine Daten.'.
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate tree population logic
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie alle Flugnummern (CARRID, CONNID) aus `SFLIGHTS` zu einem einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
hint: `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_all_flight_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_numbers) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flight_numbers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_flight_numbers = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <fs_flight>-carrid }{ <fs_flight>-connid }|
                 ELSE |{ s }, { <fs_flight>-carrid }{ <fs_flight>-connid }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_all_flight_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_all_flight_numbers( ).

    " Since SFLIGHTS content can vary, we check for typical patterns.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking SFLIGHTS or using a fixed test data set.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Result string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lv_result CS ',' ) msg = 'Result should contain commas' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lv_result CP '*LH*0400*' ) msg = 'Result should contain expected flight numbers' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Liste aus `SFLIGHTS` und machen Sie die Spalte `CARRID` zu einem Hotspot, der bei Klick eine Meldung ausgibt.
hint: Implementieren Sie das `LINK_CLICK` Event des `cl_salv_events_list` Interface.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_hotspot DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_salv_events_list.
    METHODS display_sflights_hotspot.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_hotspot IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_hotspot.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = mo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>hotspot ).

        DATA(lo_events) = mo_salv_table->get_event_manager( ).
        SET HANDLER me->if_salv_events_list~link_click FOR lo_events.

        mo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_salv_events_list~link_click.
    MESSAGE |Fluggesellschaft { e_salv_link_click-value } wurde geklickt!| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } existiert.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } existiert NICHT.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge von 'LH' aus `SFLIGHTS` und erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Flugnummern dieser Flüge (CARRID, CONNID) durch Semikolon getrennt auflistet, unter Verwendung von `FILTER` und String-Templates.
hint: `FILTER` für effizientes Filtern, dann `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_numbers) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_numbers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab FROM lt_sflights
                                 WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_flight_numbers = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <fs_flight>-carrid }{ <fs_flight>-connid }|
                 ELSE |{ s }; { <fs_flight>-carrid }{ <fs_flight>-connid }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: `FOR` Expression für die Iteration und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_for_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_high_occupancy_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_list) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_for_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_occupancy_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_list = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( seatsocc > 200 )
      ( |Flug { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_no_high_occupancy_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_occupancy_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_for_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_occupancy_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ table_line CP '*LH*' ] ) ) msg = 'Result should contain LH flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_high_occupancy_flights.
    " To properly test this, we would need to mock SFLIGHTS data
    " or ensure a scenario where no flights meet the criteria.
    " For simplicity, this test assumes SFLIGHTS has some high occupancy flights.
    " A more robust test would involve inserting test data into a local temporary table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_for_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_occupancy_flights( ).
    " If SFLIGHTS is empty or has no flights > 200, this test might fail.
    " Assuming some data exists for demonstration.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ) msg = 'Result table should have non-negative lines' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Liste aus `SFLIGHTS` und fügen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Schaltfläche zur Toolbar hinzu, die eine Meldung ausgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_functions()`, `add_function()` und implementieren Sie das `FUNCTION_SELECTED` Event.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_toolbar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_salv_events_functions.
    METHODS display_sflights_toolbar.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    CONSTANTS: gc_function_id TYPE salv_de_function VALUE 'MY_BUTTON'.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_toolbar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_toolbar.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_functions) = mo_salv_table->get_functions( ).
        lo_functions->add_function( name = gc_function_id text = 'Meine Aktion' tooltip = 'Führt eine benutzerdefinierte Aktion aus' icon = icon_execute ).
        lo_functions->set_all( abap_true ). " Enable all standard functions

        DATA(lo_event_manager) = mo_salv_table->get_event_manager( ).
        SET HANDLER me->if_salv_events_functions~function_selected FOR lo_event_manager.

        mo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_salv_events_functions~function_selected.
    IF e_salv_function = gc_function_id.
      MESSAGE 'Benutzerdefinierte Aktion wurde ausgeführt!' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) aus `SFLIGHTS` auflistet, die mindestens einen Flug mit mehr als 300 belegten Sitzen haben. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und String-Templates.
hint: `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` für Aggregationen und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carriers_high_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_high_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( seatsocc > 300 )
        GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
        WITHOUT MEMBERS
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <carrier_group> }|
                 ELSE |{ s }, { <carrier_group> }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_grouped_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_high_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Result string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lv_result CP '*LH*' ) msg = 'Result should contain LH if it has high occupancy flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_grouped_carriers.
    " This test would require specific SFLIGHTS data where no carrier has > 300 seatsocc.
    " For demonstration, we assume SFLIGHTS has at least one such carrier.
    " If SFLIGHTS is empty or has no flights > 300, this test might fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_high_occupancy( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lv_result IS NOT INITIAL OR lv_result IS INITIAL ) msg = 'Result can be empty or not' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke funktionale Erweiterung in ABAP, die es ermöglicht, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren, ähnlich wie in SQL. In diesem Beispiel wird sie verwendet, um Fluggesellschaften zu identifizieren, die Flüge mit hoher Auslastung haben, und diese dann mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates zu einem String zu verketten. `WITHOUT MEMBERS` sorgt dafür, dass nur die Gruppenschlüssel verarbeitet werden.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming, CONCATENATE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` enthält. Konvertieren Sie dabei `carrid` in Kleinbuchstaben und `connid` in einen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR ... IN` Schleife mit `VALUE` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier_id TYPE string,
             connection_id TYPE string,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrier_id    = CONV string( to_lower( ls_sflight-carrid ) )
                             connection_id = CONV string( ls_sflight-connid )
                             flight_date   = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_sflights_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_transformer->get_transformed_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrier_id exp = to_lower( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrier_id ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = typeof( lt_result[ 1 ]-connection_id ) exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_string( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #(...)` mit einer `FOR ... IN` Schleife und dem `CONV` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle LOOP-Anweisungen mit expliziten APPENDs und MOVE-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, CONV, Internal Tables, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für einen bestimmten Flug (`carrid` und `connid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `CONV`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die `seatsocc` zu summieren und `CONV` für die Typkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + CONV i( ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_reducer->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    " Annahme: Für LH 0400 gibt es Daten in SFLIGHTS, die zu einer Summe > 0 führen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_total IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_no_data.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_reducer->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `CONV` kann man sicherstellen, dass die zu summierenden Felder korrekt in den Zieltyp umgewandelt werden, was den Code prägnanter und fehlerresistenter macht als manuelle Schleifen und Additionen.
keywords: REDUCE, CONV, Aggregation, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Weisen Sie Werte von einer Quellstruktur zu einer Zielstruktur zu. Konvertieren Sie dabei ein numerisches Feld der Quellstruktur in ein String-Feld in der Zielstruktur.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,

      RETURNING

    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_conv_struct_assign=>ty_source_data,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_conv_struct_assign=>ty_target_data.

    ls_source-id = 42.
    ls_source-value = 'Hello'.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    " Mock des CL_GUI_ALV_GRID, um das Event auszulösen
    CLASS lcl_mock_alv_grid DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_alv_grid.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_parent TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
        METHODS raise_double_click_event.

        super->constructor( i_parent ).
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD raise_double_click_event.
        RAISE EVENT double_click EXPORTING e_row = 1 e_column = 'CARRID'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    " Dummy-Container für den Mock-ALV
    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).

    " Event auslösen

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Ereignisbehandlung von GUI-Controls. Mit `SET HANDLER` wird eine Methode als Ereignisbehandler für ein spezifisches Ereignis eines Controls registriert. Die `FOR EVENT` Klausel in der Methodendefinition kennzeichnet die Methode als Ereignisbehandler. Dies ist ein zentrales Paradigma in der objektorientierten GUI-Programmierung und ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung von Logik und UI-Interaktion. Der Unit Test simuliert das Auslösen des Events, um die korrekte Registrierung und Ausführung des Handlers zu überprüfen.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` für die Anzeige in einem ALV-Grid vor. Konvertieren Sie dabei das Datumsfeld `fldate` in ein benutzerfreundliches String-Format (z.B. 'DD.MM.YYYY') unter Verwendung von `CONV` und String Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und eine `FOR` Schleife mit `VALUE`, `CONV` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alv_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE string,
             seatsocc    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_alv_flight.
    TYPES tt_alv_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alv_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_alv_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_alv_flights) TYPE tt_alv_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_alv_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_alv_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid,
                                 connid      = ls_flight-connid,
                                 flight_date = |{ CONV d( ls_flight-fldate ) DATE = USER }|,
                                 seatsocc    = CONV i( ls_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_alv_data_preparation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_data_preparation.
    DATA(lo_preparer) = NEW zcl_alv_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_preparer->get_alv_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
    DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].

    " Überprüfen, ob das Datum im erwarteten Format ist (z.B. 'DD.MM.YYYY')
    " Dies ist eine einfache Prüfung, die nicht alle möglichen Benutzerformate abdeckt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_match( act = ls_first_flight-flight_date exp = '\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_flight-seatsocc > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert moderne ABAP-Features zur effizienten Datenaufbereitung: `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration, `VALUE #(...)` mit `FOR ... IN` für die Transformation der internen Tabelle, `CONV d(...)` zur Umwandlung des Datums in einen internen Datentyp und String Templates mit der `DATE = USER` Option zur Formatierung des Datums gemäß den Benutzereinstellungen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten für die Anzeige in GUI-Controls wie dem ALV-Grid vorzubereiten.
keywords: cl_gui_cfw, CONV, ALV, Internal Tables, String Templates, sflights, Date Formatting

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Konvertierungsmethode, die einen Wert dynamisch in einen Zieltyp konvertiert, der durch ein Typdeskriptor-Objekt repräsentiert wird. Verwenden Sie `CONV` und RTTI (Run-Time Type Information). Dies ist ein konzeptionelles Beispiel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und Feld-Symbole mit `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_value      TYPE string
        io_target_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_value) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_dynamic.
    CREATE DATA rv_converted_value TYPE HANDLE io_target_type.
    ASSIGN rv_converted_value->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).

    IF <fs_target> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          " Dynamische Konvertierung mit CONV und Feld-Symbol
          <fs_target> = CONV #( iv_value ).
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Fehlerbehandlung für Konvertierungsfehler
          CLEAR <fs_target>.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_int_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_string_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_failed_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_int_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_converter( ).
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'I' ).
    DATA(lo_converted_data) = lo_converter->convert_dynamic( iv_value = '123' io_target_type = lo_type_descr ).

    ASSIGN lo_converted_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_int>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_int> IS ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_int> exp = 123 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_string_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_converter( ).
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'STRING' ).
    DATA(lo_converted_data) = lo_converter->convert_dynamic( iv_value = 'Hello World' io_target_type = lo_type_descr ).

    ASSIGN lo_converted_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_string>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_string> IS ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_string> exp = 'Hello World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_failed_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_converter( ).
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'I' ).
    DATA(lo_converted_data) = lo_converter->convert_dynamic( iv_value = 'NotANumber' io_target_type = lo_type_descr ).

    ASSIGN lo_converted_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_int>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_int> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`) und Feld-Symbole, um eine dynamische Typkonvertierung zu ermöglichen. Der `CONV` Operator kann auch mit Feld-Symbolen verwendet werden, um Werte in einen zur Laufzeit bestimmten Typ zu konvertieren. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für generische Frameworks oder Tools, die mit unbekannten Datentypen umgehen müssen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hier entscheidend, da dynamische Konvertierungen fehlschlagen können.
keywords: CONV, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere Strings zu einem einzigen String, wobei ein Trennzeichen zwischen den einzelnen Teilen eingefügt wird. Verwenden Sie String Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates mit der `&&` Verkettung oder direkt im Template.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_delimiter TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    IF iv_delimiter IS INITIAL.
      rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR str IN it_strings NEXT s = s && str ).
    ELSE.
      rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR str IN it_strings
                                               NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN str ELSE s && iv_delimiter && str ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_concatenate_with_delimiter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_concatenate_no_delimiter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_concatenate_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_with_delimiter.
    DATA(lo_concatenator) = NEW zcl_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apfel' ) ( 'Birne' ) ( 'Kirsche' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_concatenator->concatenate_strings( it_strings = lt_strings iv_delimiter = ', ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Apfel, Birne, Kirsche' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concatenate_no_delimiter.
    DATA(lo_concatenator) = NEW zcl_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apfel' ) ( 'Birne' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_concatenator->concatenate_strings( it_strings = lt_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ApfelBirne' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concatenate_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_concatenator) = NEW zcl_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_concatenator->concatenate_strings( it_strings = lt_strings iv_delimiter = '-' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Liste von Strings effizient zu einem einzigen String zu verketten. Die `COND` Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, das Trennzeichen nur zwischen den Elementen einzufügen, nicht am Anfang oder Ende. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art der String-Verkettung, die wesentlich kürzer und lesbarer ist als traditionelle Schleifen mit `CONCATENATE`.
keywords: String Processing, String Templates, REDUCE, CONCATENATE, COND

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben, und geben Sie nur die `carrid` und `connid` der passenden Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES tt_filtered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsocc < ( seatsmax - iv_min_free_seats ) )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_flights_with_free_seats( 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
    " Weitere spezifische Assertions könnten hier hinzugefügt werden, z.B. Prüfung auf bekannte Flüge
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_flights_with_free_seats( 9999 ). " Sehr hohe Anforderung an freie Sitze

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern von internen Tabellen basierend auf einer Bedingung. In Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` und einer `FOR` Schleife kann man die gefilterten Daten direkt in eine neue Struktur transformieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode, um Daten zu selektieren und zu projizieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: FILTER, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, sflights, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie das Wort 'vertraulich' nur dann durch 'öffentlich', wenn der String das Wort 'intern' enthält.
