solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS conditional_replace
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_cond_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD conditional_replace.
    rv_output_string = COND string(
      WHEN iv_input_string CONTAINS 'intern'
      THEN REPLACE( val = iv_input_string sub = 'vertraulich' with = 'öffentlich' occ = ALL )
      ELSE iv_input_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Auslesen von Text aus einem cl_gui_textedit-Control, entfernen Sie führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und geben Sie den bereinigten Text zurück.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Ersetzen mehrerer definierter Schlüsselwörter im Inhalt eines cl_gui_textedit-Controls. Ersetzen Sie 'SAP' durch 'SAP SE' und 'ABAP' durch 'ABAP-Programmierung'.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle für die Ersetzungspaare und iterieren Sie mit FOR über diese Tabelle, wobei Sie den REPLACE-Operator anwenden.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_replace_pair,
             old_text TYPE string,
             new_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_replace_pair.
    TYPES tt_replace_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_replace_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_textedit_mass_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS mass_replace_in_content
          IMPORTING
            iv_current_content TYPE string " Simuliert den Inhalt von cl_gui_textedit
            it_replace_pairs   TYPE tt_replace_pairs
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_modified_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_mass_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_replace_in_content.
    rv_modified_content = iv_current_content.
    LOOP AT it_replace_pairs INTO DATA(ls_pair).
      rv_modified_content = REPLACE( val = rv_modified_content sub = ls_pair-old_text with = ls_pair-new_text occ = ALL ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_mass_replace FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_textedit_mass_replace( ).
    DATA(lt_pairs) = VALUE tt_replace_pairs(
      ( old_text = 'SAP'  new_text = 'SAP SE' )
      ( old_text = 'ABAP' new_text = 'ABAP-Programmierung' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->mass_replace_in_content(
      iv_current_content = 'Lernen Sie ABAP bei SAP.'
      it_replace_pairs   = lt_pairs
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Lernen Sie ABAP-Programmierung bei SAP SE.'
      msg = 'Alle definierten Ersetzungen sollten durchgeführt werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die effiziente Massenbearbeitung von Text, wie sie oft in einem Texteditor-Control vorkommt. Durch die Verwendung einer internen Tabelle für Ersetzungspaare und eine LOOP-Anweisung mit dem REPLACE-Operator wird der Code flexibel und wartbar. Die moderne Syntax für interne Tabellen (VALUE) und der REPLACE-Operator tragen zur Kompaktheit bei.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das zeilenweise Verarbeiten des Textinhalts eines cl_gui_textedit-Controls. Filtern Sie alle Zeilen heraus, die das Wort 'Fehler' enthalten, und geben Sie die verbleibenden Zeilen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie SPLIT, um den String in Zeilen zu zerlegen, und FILTER, um die gewünschten Zeilen auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_filter_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_textedit_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_content TYPE string " Simuliert den Inhalt von cl_gui_textedit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_filter_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_textedit_lines.
    DATA(lt_all_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input_content AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_all_lines.

    rt_filtered_lines = FILTER #( lt_all_lines USING KEY default WHERE table_line NOT CONTAINS 'Fehler' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_textedit_filter_lines( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Erste Zeile ohne Fehler.' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                      'Zweite Zeile mit Fehler.' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                      'Dritte Zeile auch ohne Fehler.'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_textedit_lines( lv_input ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Erste Zeile ohne Fehler.' )
      ( 'Dritte Zeile auch ohne Fehler.' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Zeilen übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]
      exp = lt_expected[ 1 ]
      msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]
      exp = lt_expected[ 2 ]
      msg = 'Zweite Zeile sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die zeilenweise Verarbeitung von Text, wie sie oft bei der Analyse von Inhalten aus einem cl_gui_textedit-Control erforderlich ist. Die Kombination aus SPLIT für die Zerlegung in Zeilen und dem FILTER-Operator für die selektive Auswahl ist eine sehr moderne und performante Methode in ABAP 7.40+.
keywords: cl_gui_textedit (conceptual), SPLIT, FILTER, Internal Tables, String Processing

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem gegebenen String alle Vorkommen von 'http://' oder 'https://' durch 'www.' und entfernen Sie den nachfolgenden Domain-Namen bis zum nächsten '/' oder dem Ende des Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REPLACE REGEX Operator mit einer komplexeren Regex-Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_complex_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_urls_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_complex_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_urls_regex.
    " Regex: (http|https):\/\/([a-zA-Z0-9.-]+)(\/|$) -> Ersetzt durch 'www.' und den Rest der URL bis zum nächsten '/' oder Ende
    " Hier wird nur das Protokoll und der Domain-Teil ersetzt.
    rv_output_string = REPLACE( val = iv_input_string regex = '(http|https):\/\/([a-zA-Z0-9.-]+)' with = 'www.' occ = ALL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_urls FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_urls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_complex_regex( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_urls_regex( 'Besuchen Sie https://www.sap.com/de/ und http://help.sap.com/doc/.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Besuchen Sie www./de/ und www./doc/.'
      msg = 'URLs sollten korrekt ersetzt werden.'
    ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_urls_regex( 'Nur ein Text ohne URL.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Nur ein Text ohne URL.'
      msg = 'Text ohne URLs sollte unverändert bleiben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REPLACE-Operator mit REGEX ist extrem mächtig für komplexe String-Manipulationen. Hier wird ein regulärer Ausdruck verwendet, um sowohl 'http://' als auch 'https://' zusammen mit dem nachfolgenden Domain-Namen zu finden und durch 'www.' zu ersetzen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um URLs zu normalisieren oder zu anonymisieren.
keywords: REPLACE REGEX, String, Regex, URL, String Processing

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Bereinigung von HTML-Tags aus dem Inhalt eines cl_gui_textedit-Controls, um nur den reinen Text zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REPLACE REGEX Operator, um HTML-Tags zu entfernen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_clean_html DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_html_from_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_html_content TYPE string " Simuliert HTML-Inhalt von cl_gui_textedit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_plain_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_clean_html IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_html_from_content.
    " Regex, um alle HTML-Tags zu finden und zu entfernen
    rv_plain_text = REPLACE( val = iv_html_content regex = '<[^>]*>' with = '' occ = ALL ).
    " Optional: Mehrere Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes ersetzen
    rv_plain_text = REPLACE( val = rv_plain_text regex = '\s+' with = ' ' occ = ALL ).
    rv_plain_text = TRIM( rv_plain_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_clean_html FOR TESTING. ENDCLASS. CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD test_clean_html. DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_textedit_clean_html( ). DATA(lv_html_input) = '

Titel

Dies ist ein Text mit Formatierung.


'. DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_html_from_content( lv_html_input ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Titel Dies ist ein Text mit Formatierung.' msg = 'HTML-Tags sollten entfernt und Text bereinigt werden.' ). lv_html_input = '

Keine Tags hier.

'. lv_result = lo_cut->clean_html_from_content( lv_html_input ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Keine Tags hier.' msg = 'Einfache Tags sollten entfernt werden.' ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Bereinigung von HTML-Inhalten ist eine häufige Aufgabe, insbesondere wenn Text aus Rich-Text-Editoren wie cl_gui_textedit verarbeitet wird. Der REPLACE-Operator mit REGEX und dem Ausdruck '<[^>]*>' ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um alle HTML-Tags aus einem String zu entfernen und den reinen Text zu extrahieren. Zusätzliche Ersetzungen können Leerzeichen normalisieren.
keywords: cl_gui_textedit (conceptual), REPLACE REGEX, HTML, String Processing, Regex

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem String alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens (z.B. '.' durch ',') und anschließend alle Vorkommen eines anderen Zeichens (z.B. ',' durch ';').
hint: Ketten Sie mehrere REPLACE-Operationen aneinander.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_chained_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS chained_replace_chars
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_char1_old    TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_char1_new    TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_char2_old    TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_char2_new    TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_chained_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD chained_replace_chars.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = REPLACE( val = iv_input_string sub = iv_char1_old with = iv_char1_new occ = ALL ).
    rv_output_string = REPLACE( val = lv_temp_string sub = iv_char2_old with = iv_char2_new occ = ALL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_replace FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_chained_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->chained_replace_chars(
      iv_input_string = '1.234.567,89'

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie mehrere REPLACE-Operationen nacheinander auf einen String angewendet werden können. Die moderne Syntax des REPLACE-Operators ermöglicht eine klare und direkte Verkettung von String-Manipulationen, ohne dass temporäre Variablen explizit deklariert werden müssen, wenn man die Ergebnisse direkt weiterverarbeitet.
keywords: REPLACE, String, Chained Operations, String Processing

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie für ein gegebenes Datum die zugehörige Geschäftsperiode und das Geschäftsjahr unter Verwendung des Perioden-Toolsets. Die Geschäftsjahresvariante 'K4' soll verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` und die Methode `GET_PERIOD_FOR_DATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_for_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_fiscal_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_date         TYPE d
        iv_fisc_year_vr TYPE fisc_year_vr
      EXPORTING
        ev_fiscal_year  TYPE gjahr
        ev_fiscal_period TYPE poper.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_for_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_fisc_year_vr) = 'K4'. " Example fiscal year variant

    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    lo_period_toolset->get_period_for_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date         = lv_date
        iv_fisc_year_vr = lv_fisc_year_vr
      IMPORTING
        ev_fiscal_year  = DATA(lv_fiscal_year)
        ev_fiscal_period = DATA(lv_fiscal_period)
    ).

    out->write( |Datum: { lv_date }, Geschäftsjahresvariante: { lv_fisc_year_vr }| ).
    out->write( |Geschäftsjahr: { lv_fiscal_year }, Geschäftsperiode: { lv_fiscal_period }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_fiscal_period.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    lo_period_toolset->get_period_for_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date         = iv_date
        iv_fisc_year_vr = iv_fisc_year_vr
      IMPORTING
        ev_fiscal_year  = ev_fiscal_year
        ev_fiscal_period = ev_fiscal_period
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_fiscal_period FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_fiscal_period.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_for_date( ).
    DATA(lv_fiscal_year)  = ''.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_period) = ''.

    " Test date in current year (assuming K4 variant) - January
    lo_cut->get_fiscal_period(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date         = '20230115'
        iv_fisc_year_vr = 'K4'
      IMPORTING
        ev_fiscal_year  = lv_fiscal_year
        ev_fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_fiscal_year  exp = '2023' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_fiscal_period exp = '001' ).

    " Test date in another period - July
    lo_cut->get_fiscal_period(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date         = '20230720'
        iv_fisc_year_vr = 'K4'
      IMPORTING
        ev_fiscal_year  = lv_fiscal_year
        ev_fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_fiscal_year  exp = '2023' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_fiscal_period exp = '007' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet die moderne ABAP-Syntax `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen und `NEW` für die Objekterzeugung. Die Klasse implementiert `if_oo_adt_classrun`, um direkt in ADT ausführbar zu sein. Die Kernlogik zur Periodenbestimmung wird durch die Methode `GET_PERIOD_FOR_DATE` der Klasse `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` bereitgestellt, die eine standardisierte und effiziente Möglichkeit zur Handhabung von Geschäftsperioden bietet.
keywords: CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS, if_oo_adt_classrun, Date, Fiscal Period, Object Orientation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für eine gegebene Geschäftsperiode (z.B. '003') und ein Geschäftsjahr (z.B. '2023') die Start- und Enddaten dieser Periode unter Verwendung der Geschäftsjahresvariante 'K4'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` und die Methoden `GET_PERIOD_START_DATE` und `GET_PERIOD_END_DATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_period_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year   TYPE gjahr
        iv_fiscal_period TYPE poper
        iv_fisc_year_vr  TYPE fisc_year_vr
      EXPORTING
        ev_start_date    TYPE d
        ev_end_date      TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_year) = '2023'.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_period) = '003'.
    DATA(lv_fisc_year_vr) = 'K4'.

    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    lo_period_toolset->get_period_start_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year   = lv_fiscal_year
        iv_fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
        iv_fisc_year_vr  = lv_fisc_year_vr
      IMPORTING
        ev_date          = DATA(lv_start_date)
    ).
    lo_period_toolset->get_period_end_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year   = lv_fiscal_year
        iv_fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
        iv_fisc_year_vr  = lv_fisc_year_vr
      IMPORTING
        ev_date          = DATA(lv_end_date)
    ).

    out->write( |Periode { lv_fiscal_period }/{ lv_fiscal_year } ({ lv_fisc_year_vr }): Start { lv_start_date }, Ende { lv_end_date }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_period_dates.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    lo_period_toolset->get_period_start_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year   = iv_fiscal_year
        iv_fiscal_period = iv_fiscal_period

CLASS zcl_date_in_period_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

      IMPORTING
        iv_date          TYPE d
        iv_fiscal_year   TYPE gjahr
        iv_start_period  TYPE poper
        iv_end_period    TYPE poper
        iv_fisc_year_vr  TYPE fisc_year_vr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_date_in_period_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_check_date) = '20230510'.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_year) = '2023'.
    DATA(lv_start_period) = '004'.
    DATA(lv_end_period) = '006'.
    DATA(lv_fisc_year_vr) = 'K4'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_in_period_range( ).
    DATA(lv_in_range) = lo_cut->is_date_in_period_range(
      iv_date          = lv_check_date
      iv_fiscal_year   = lv_fiscal_year
      iv_start_period  = lv_start_period
      iv_end_period    = lv_end_period
      iv_fisc_year_vr  = lv_fisc_year_vr
    ).

    out->write( |Datum { lv_check_date } in Bereich { lv_start_period }-{ lv_end_period }/{ lv_fiscal_year } ({ lv_fisc_year_vr }): { COND string( WHEN lv_in_range = abap_true THEN 'Ja' ELSE 'Nein' ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_date_in_period_range.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).

    lo_period_toolset->get_period_start_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year   = iv_fiscal_year
        iv_fiscal_period = iv_start_period
        iv_fisc_year_vr  = iv_fisc_year_vr
      IMPORTING
        ev_date          = DATA(lv_range_start_date)
    ).

    lo_period_toolset->get_period_end_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year   = iv_fiscal_year
        iv_fiscal_period = iv_end_period
        iv_fisc_year_vr  = iv_fisc_year_vr
      IMPORTING
        ev_date          = DATA(lv_range_end_date)
    ).

    rv_in_range = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_date BETWEEN lv_range_start_date AND lv_range_end_date THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Perioden und nutzen Sie `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` zur Datumsprüfung. Verwenden Sie `FOR` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_info,
         fiscal_year  TYPE gjahr,
         fiscal_period TYPE poper,
         start_date   TYPE d,
         end_date     TYPE d,
       END OF ty_period_info.
TYPES tt_period_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_list_periods_in_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_periods_in_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date    TYPE d
        iv_end_date      TYPE d
        iv_fisc_year_vr  TYPE fisc_year_vr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE tt_period_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_periods_in_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_range_start) = '20230101'.
    DATA(lv_range_end)   = '20230630'.
    DATA(lv_fisc_year_vr) = 'K4'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_list_periods_in_range( ).
    DATA(lt_periods) = lo_cut->get_periods_in_date_range(
      iv_start_date    = lv_range_start
      iv_end_date      = lv_range_end
      iv_fisc_year_vr  = lv_fisc_year_vr
    ).

    out->write( |Perioden im Bereich { lv_range_start } - { lv_range_end } ({ lv_fisc_year_vr }):| ).
    LOOP AT lt_periods INTO DATA(ls_period).
      out->write( |  { ls_period-fiscal_year }/{ ls_period-fiscal_period }: { ls_period-start_date } - { ls_period-end_date }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_periods_in_date_range.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_year)  = ''.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_period) = ''.

    DO.
      lo_period_toolset->get_period_for_date(
        EXPORTING
          iv_date         = lv_current_date
          iv_fisc_year_vr = iv_fisc_year_vr
        IMPORTING
          ev_fiscal_year  = lv_fiscal_year
          ev_fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
      ).

      DATA(lv_period_start_date) = lo_period_toolset->get_period_start_date(
                                     iv_fiscal_year   = lv_fiscal_year
                                     iv_fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
                                     iv_fisc_year_vr  = iv_fisc_year_vr
                                   ).
      DATA(lv_period_end_date)   = lo_period_toolset->get_period_end_date(
                                     iv_fiscal_year   = lv_fiscal_year
                                     iv_fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
                                     iv_fisc_year_vr  = iv_fisc_year_vr
                                   ).

      " Check for overlap
      IF lv_period_start_date <= iv_end_date AND lv_period_end_date >= iv_start_date.
        APPEND VALUE ty_period_info(
          fiscal_year  = lv_fiscal_year
          fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
          start_date   = lv_period_start_date
          end_date     = lv_period_end_date
        ) TO rt_periods.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_period_end_date >= iv_end_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = lv_period_end_date + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Ermitteln Sie den Datumsbereich der Periode und iterieren Sie über die Tage, um Wochenenden auszuschließen. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_working_days_in_period DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_working_days_in_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_fiscal_year   TYPE gjahr
        iv_fiscal_period TYPE poper
        iv_fisc_year_vr  TYPE fisc_year_vr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_working_days_in_period IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_year) = '2023'.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_period) = '005'.
    DATA(lv_fisc_year_vr) = 'K4'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_working_days_in_period( ).
    DATA(lv_working_days) = lo_cut->get_working_days_in_period(
      iv_fiscal_year   = lv_fiscal_year
      iv_fiscal_period = lv_fiscal_period
      iv_fisc_year_vr  = lv_fisc_year_vr
    ).

    out->write( |Arbeitstage in Periode { lv_fiscal_period }/{ lv_fiscal_year } ({ lv_fisc_year_vr }): { lv_working_days }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_working_days_in_period.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).

    DATA(lv_start_date) = lo_period_toolset->get_period_start_date(
                             iv_fiscal_year   = iv_fiscal_year
                             iv_fiscal_period = iv_fiscal_period
                             iv_fisc_year_vr  = iv_fisc_year_vr
                           ).
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = lo_period_toolset->get_period_end_date(
                             iv_fiscal_year   = iv_fiscal_year
                             iv_fiscal_period = iv_fiscal_period
                             iv_fisc_year_vr  = iv_fisc_year_vr
                           ).

    rv_working_days = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR d = lv_start_date THEN d + 1 UNTIL d > lv_end_date
      LET day_of_week = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( d ) IN
      WHERE day_of_week <> 6 AND day_of_week <> 7 " 6=Saturday, 7=Sunday
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und das Zieldatum enthält, wobei das Zieldatum um einen Tag verschoben ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE #()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookdate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_sflights ).

    out->write( |Transformierte Flugdaten:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_transformed INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |  Flug: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }, Datum: { ls_flight-fldate }, Buchungsdatum: { ls_flight-bookdate }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate + 1, " Zieldatum um einen Tag verschoben
        bookdate = ls_sflight-bookdate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate

        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20230101'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_passengers) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lv_fldate ).

    out->write( |Gesamtzahl Passagiere für Flüge am { lv_fldate }: { lv_total_passengers }| ).

  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE fldate = iv_fldate.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und mehr als 100 freie Sitze haben.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_departure_airport TYPE sflight-airpfrom
        iv_min_free_seats    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_departure_airport) = 'FRA'.
    DATA(lv_min_free_seats)    = 100.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights(
      iv_departure_airport = lv_departure_airport
      iv_min_free_seats    = lv_min_free_seats
    ).

    out->write( |Gefilterte Flüge ab { lv_departure_airport } mit mehr als { lv_min_free_seats } freien Sitzen:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |  Flug: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }, Freie Sitze: { ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE airpfrom = iv_departure_airport
                                    AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischer Angabe des Methodennamens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_message_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_message_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'GET_MESSAGE_A' ).
    out->write( |Dynamischer Aufruf 'GET_MESSAGE_A': { lv_result_a }| ).

    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'GET_MESSAGE_B' ).
    out->write( |Dynamischer Aufruf 'GET_MESSAGE_B': { lv_result_b }| ).

    DATA(lv_result_invalid) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'INVALID_METHOD' ).
    out->write( |Dynamischer Aufruf 'INVALID_METHOD': { lv_result_invalid }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message_a.
    rv_message = 'Dies ist Nachricht A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message_b.
    rv_message = 'Dies ist Nachricht B'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING RESULT rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Fehler: Methode '{ iv_method_name }' nicht gefunden oder ungültiger Aufruf.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    " Test valid method call A
    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'GET_MESSAGE_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_a exp = 'Dies ist Nachricht A' ).

    " Test valid method call B
    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'GET_MESSAGE_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_b exp = 'Dies ist Nachricht B' ).

    " Test invalid method call
    DATA(lv_result_invalid) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler' in = lv_result_invalid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name)` ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen. Es erlaubt, den Namen der aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen, was in Szenarien wie Plugin-Architekturen oder regelbasierten Systemen nützlich ist. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist dabei essenziell. Die Klasse ist über `if_oo_adt_classrun` direkt ausführbar.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Object Orientation, if_oo_adt_classrun, Reflection

Instructions: Verketten Sie die Flugnummern aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_concat_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS concatenate_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_concat_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_concat_connid( ).
    DATA(lv_connids) = lo_cut->concatenate_connids( lv_carrid ).

    out->write( |Flugnummern für { lv_carrid }: { lv_connids }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD concatenate_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_connids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_sflight-connid ELSE |{ s }, { ls_sflight-connid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_test_sflights.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Passagiere pro Flug. Geben Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
         carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
         total_passengers TYPE i,
       END OF ty_flight_summary.
TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS group_and_sum_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->group_and_sum_passengers( ).

    out->write( |Flugzusammenfassung nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      out->write( |  { ls_summary-carrid } { ls_summary-connid }: { ls_summary-total_passengers } Passagiere| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD group_and_sum_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, connid = ls_group-connid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        connid = ls_group-connid,
        total_passengers = REDUCE i(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_group_and_sum.
    " Prepare test data (assuming sflight has entries)
    " For a real test, you might insert test data or mock the SELECT statement.
    " Here, we assume some data exists for demonstration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_by( ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->group_and_sum_passengers( ).

    " This test is dependent on actual SFLIGHTS data. For robust testing, mock DB access.
    " Assert that the table is not empty
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary ).

    " Find a specific entry and assert its passenger count
    DATA(ls_summary_lh_0400) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' DEFAULT `NOT_FOUND` ].
    IF ls_summary_lh_0400-carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Adjust expected value based on your SFLIGHTS data for LH 0400
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh_0400-total_passengers exp = 100 ). " Example value
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_summary_aa_0017) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' DEFAULT `NOT_FOUND` ].
    IF ls_summary_aa_0017-carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Adjust expected value based on your SFLIGHTS data for AA 0017
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa_0017-total_passengers exp = 50 ). " Example value
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sflights_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.

CLASS zcl_sflights_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_status( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_status) = lo_cut->add_status_to_flights( lt_sflights ).

    out->write( |Flüge mit Status:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights_with_status INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |  { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-fldate }): { ls_flight-seatsocc }/{ ls_flight-seatsmax } -> { ls_flight-status }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_status_to_flights.
    rt_flights_with_status = VALUE tt_flight_with_status(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax,
        status   = COND string(
                     WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN 'Full'
                     ELSE 'Available'
                   )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String (z.B. 'ABAP Development') mit einem bestimmten Präfix (z.B. 'ABAP') beginnt und mit einem Suffix (z.B. 'ment') endet. Nutzen Sie moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die String-Funktionen `starts_with` und `ends_with`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_check_prefix_suffix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS check_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_prefix  TYPE string
        iv_suffix  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_check_prefix_suffix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_text)    = 'ABAP Development'.
    DATA(lv_prefix)  = 'ABAP'.
    DATA(lv_suffix)  = 'ment'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_check_prefix_suffix( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->check_string(
      iv_text    = lv_text
      iv_prefix  = lv_prefix
      iv_suffix  = lv_suffix
    ).

    out->write( |String '{ lv_text }' beginnt mit '{ lv_prefix }' und endet mit '{ lv_suffix }'? { COND string( WHEN lv_is_valid = abap_true THEN 'Ja' ELSE 'Nein' ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_string.
    rv_result = xsdbool( starts_with( val = iv_text sub = iv_prefix ) AND
                         ends_with( val = iv_text sub = iv_suffix ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

        iv_text    = 'ABAP Development'

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Method Chaining, indem Sie mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt verketten, um eine komplexe Operation in einer einzigen Anweisung auszuführen.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Methoden, die verkettet werden sollen, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS add_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_factor TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).

    DATA(lv_final_result) = lo_calculator->set_value( 10 )->add_value( 5 )->multiply_value( 2 )->get_result( ).

    out->write( |Ergebnis der Methodenkette: { lv_final_result }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_value.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_factor.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).

    " Test a simple chain: (10 + 5) * 2 = 30
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->set_value( 10 )->add_value( 5 )->multiply_value( 2 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).

    " Test another chain: (5 * 3) + 10 = 25
    lv_result = lo_calculator->set_value( 5 )->multiply_value( 3 )->add_value( 10 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 25 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ist ein objektorientiertes Designmuster, das die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes verbessert, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede verkettbare Methode eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. Es ist ein Merkmal modernen, flüssigen API-Designs. Die Klasse ist über `if_oo_adt_classrun` direkt ausführbar.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, if_oo_adt_classrun, Fluent API, Design Patterns

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Nachrichten (Fehler, Warnungen, Informationen) sammelt und diese anschließend ausgibt. Nutzen Sie hierfür die moderne Klasse `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_BAG`.

CLASS zcl_message_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS collect_and_display_messages.

CLASS zcl_message_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_and_display_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_bag) = NEW cl_abap_message_bag( ).

    " Nachrichten hinzufügen
    lo_message_bag->add_message( msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '001' msgty = 'E' msgv1 = 'Flug' msgv2 = 'LH400' ).
    lo_message_bag->add_message( msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '002' msgty = 'W' msgv1 = 'Datum' msgv2 = 'ungültig' ).
    lo_message_bag->add_message( msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '003' msgty = 'I' msgv1 = 'Verarbeitung' msgv2 = 'gestartet' ).

    " Nachrichten ausgeben
    LOOP AT lo_message_bag->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
      WRITE: / ls_message-msgty, ls_message-msgid, ls_message-msgno, ls_message-msgv1, ls_message-msgv2.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen HTTP-Statuscode als numerischen Wert entgegennimmt und den entsprechenden Text aus der Klasse `CL_REST_STATUS_CODE` zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `SWITCH`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Konstanten von `CL_REST_STATUS_CODE` in einer `SWITCH`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_status_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string( iv_status_code
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>ok THEN 'OK'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>created THEN 'Created'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>no_content THEN 'No Content'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>bad_request THEN 'Bad Request'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>unauthorized THEN 'Unauthorized'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>forbidden THEN 'Forbidden'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>not_found THEN 'Not Found'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>internal_server_error THEN 'Internal Server Error'
      ELSE 'Unknown Status Code' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) validiert. Bei Validierungsfehlern sollen Nachrichten in einem `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_BAG` gesammelt werden. Basierend auf der höchsten Nachrichtenschwere (E = Error, W = Warning, I = Info) soll ein entsprechender `CL_REST_STATUS_CODE` zurückgegeben werden. Wenn keine Fehler auftreten, soll `OK` zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_BAG` zum Sammeln von Nachrichten und `REDUCE` oder `COND` zur Bestimmung der höchsten Schwere. Nutzen Sie `CL_REST_STATUS_CODE` für die Rückgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      EXPORTING
        eo_message_bag TYPE REF TO cl_abap_message_bag
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_http_status) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flights.
    eo_message_bag = NEW cl_abap_message_bag( ).
    DATA(lv_has_error) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_warning) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid IS INITIAL.
        eo_message_bag->add_message( msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '001' msgty = 'E' msgv1 = 'Fluggesellschaft' msgv2 = 'fehlt' ).
        lv_has_error = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_flight-fldate IS INITIAL.
        eo_message_bag->add_message( msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '002' msgty = 'W' msgv1 = 'Flugdatum' msgv2 = 'fehlt' ).
        lv_has_warning = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_http_status = COND #( WHEN lv_has_error = abap_true THEN cl_rest_status_code=>bad_request
                             WHEN lv_has_warning = abap_true THEN cl_rest_status_code=>ok " Warnings are often still OK
                             ELSE cl_rest_status_code=>ok ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_validation_with_errors FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_validation_with_warnings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_validation_no_issues FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validation_with_errors.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_validator=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = '' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_message_bag) = NEW cl_abap_message_bag( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->validate_flights( EXPORTING it_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING eo_message_bag = lo_message_bag ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = cl_rest_status_code=>bad_request ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_message_bag->get_messages( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message_bag->get_number_of_messages( msgty = 'E' ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_validation_with_warnings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_validator=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_message_bag) = NEW cl_abap_message_bag( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->validate_flights( EXPORTING it_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING eo_message_bag = lo_message_bag ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = cl_rest_status_code=>ok ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_message_bag->get_messages( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message_bag->get_number_of_messages( msgty = 'W' ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_validation_no_issues.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_validator=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_message_bag) = NEW cl_abap_message_bag( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->validate_flights( EXPORTING it_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING eo_message_bag = lo_message_bag ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = cl_rest_status_code=>ok ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_message_bag->get_messages( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
        iv_custom_message TYPE string OPTIONAL

CLASS zcl_status_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_status_text) = get_status_text( iv_status_code ).

    IF iv_custom_message IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_formatted_string = rv_formatted_string && | ({ iv_custom_message })|.
    ENDIF.

  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string( iv_status_code
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>ok THEN 'OK'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>bad_request THEN 'Bad Request'
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>not_found THEN 'Not Found'
      ELSE 'Unknown Status Code' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Nachrichten (`CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_BAG`) so, dass nur Fehlermeldungen ('E') übrig bleiben. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` auf dem Ergebnis von `lo_message_bag->get_messages()`.
solution:

hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt und ein Attribut für den Statuscode hat. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION NEW` und `TRY...CATCH`.

    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA mv_http_status TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid       LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous     TYPE REF TO cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_http_status TYPE i.

CLASS zcx_rest_error IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_service_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_request
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_rest_error.

    METHODS handle_request
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_status) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_request.
    " Simulieren eines Fehlers
    RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_rest_error(
      textid = zcx_rest_error=>default_text
      iv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>not_found
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_request.
    TRY.
        rv_result = process_request( ).
        rv_response_status = cl_rest_status_code=>ok.
      CATCH zcx_rest_error INTO DATA(lx_rest_error).
        rv_response_status = lx_rest_error->mv_http_status.
        " Optional: Nachricht aus der Exception loggen oder verarbeiten
        " DATA(lv_error_message) = lx_rest_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Nachrichten pro Nachrichtentyp (E, W, I) in einem `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_BAG`. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Hash-Tabelle, um die Zähler für jeden Nachrichtentyp zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_count,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_message_count.
    TYPES: tt_message_counts TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_message_count WITH UNIQUE KEY msgty.

    METHODS count_messages_by_type
      IMPORTING
        io_message_bag TYPE REF TO cl_abap_message_bag
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_message_counts) TYPE tt_message_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_messages_by_type.
    rt_message_counts = REDUCE tt_message_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_message_counts( )
      FOR ls_message IN io_message_bag->get_messages( )
      LET lv_index = line_index( counts[ msgty = ls_message-msgty ] ) IN
      NEXT counts = COND #( WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL
                            THEN VALUE tt_message_counts( BASE counts ( msgty = ls_message-msgty count = 1 ) )
                            ELSE VALUE tt_message_counts( BASE counts ( msgty = ls_message-msgty count = counts[ lv_index ]-count + 1 ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_status_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_status_code.
    rv_status_code = SWITCH i( iv_status_key
      WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>ok
      WHEN 'CREATED' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>created
      WHEN 'BAD_REQUEST' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>bad_request
      WHEN 'NOT_FOUND' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>not_found
      WHEN 'INTERNAL_ERROR' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>internal_server_error
      ELSE cl_rest_status_code=>internal_server_error " Default für unbekannte Schlüssel
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_messenger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS create_flight_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_bag) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_message_bag.

CLASS zcl_flight_messenger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_messages.
    ro_message_bag = NEW cl_abap_message_bag( ).

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights) UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      ro_message_bag->add_message(
        msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
        msgno = '003'
        msgty = 'I'
        msgv1 = ls_flight-carrid
        msgv2 = ls_flight-connid
        msgv3 = 'Flugdetails'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_BAG` Nachrichten entgegennimmt und den 'besten' (höchsten Schweregrad) HTTP-Statuscode aus `CL_REST_STATUS_CODE` zurückgibt. Fehler ('E') führen zu `BAD_REQUEST`, Warnungen ('W') zu `OK` (aber mit Warnung), und nur Infos ('I') oder keine Nachrichten zu `OK`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` über die Nachrichten, um den höchsten Schweregrad zu finden, und dann `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Statuscode-Zuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_to_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_messages_to_status
      IMPORTING
        io_message_bag TYPE REF TO cl_abap_message_bag
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_http_status) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_to_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_messages_to_status.
    DATA(lv_highest_severity) = REDUCE symsgty(
      INIT highest = ''
      FOR ls_message IN io_message_bag->get_messages( )
      NEXT highest = COND #( WHEN ls_message-msgty = 'E' THEN 'E'
                             WHEN ls_message-msgty = 'W' AND highest <> 'E' THEN 'W'
                             WHEN ls_message-msgty = 'I' AND highest <> 'E' AND highest <> 'W' THEN 'I'
                             ELSE highest )
    ).

    rv_http_status = SWITCH i( lv_highest_severity
      WHEN 'E' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>bad_request
      WHEN 'W' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>ok " Warnings are often still OK
      WHEN 'I' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>ok
      WHEN '' THEN cl_rest_status_code=>ok " No messages
      ELSE cl_rest_status_code=>internal_server_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) entgegennimmt. Für jeden Flug soll geprüft werden, ob das Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt. Wenn ja, soll eine Warnung in einem `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_BAG` hinzugefügt werden. Die Methode soll die verarbeiteten Flüge zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` um die Tabelle zu verarbeiten und gleichzeitig Nachrichten zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_date_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_dates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      EXPORTING
        eo_message_bag TYPE REF TO cl_abap_message_bag
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_date_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_dates.
    eo_message_bag = NEW cl_abap_message_bag( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                    ( ls_flight ) ). " Alle Flüge übernehmen

    LOOP AT rt_processed_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-fldate < lv_current_date.
        eo_message_bag->add_message(
          msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          msgno = '002'
          msgty = 'W'
          msgv1 = <fs_flight>-carrid
          msgv2 = <fs_flight>-connid
          msgv3 = 'Datum in Vergangenheit'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_BAG` entgegennimmt und alle Nachrichten in einem einzigen String zusammenfasst, wobei jede Nachricht mit ihrem Typ (E, W, I) und dem formatierten Text versehen ist. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem String als Akkumulator und String-Templates für die Formatierung jeder Nachricht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_summarizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS summarize_messages
      IMPORTING
        io_message_bag TYPE REF TO cl_abap_message_bag
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_summarizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_messages.
    rv_summary_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_message IN io_message_bag->get_messages( )
      NEXT s = s && |
{ ls_message-msgty }: { ls_message-msgv1 } { ls_message-msgv2 } { ls_message-msgv3 } { ls_message-msgv4 }|
    ).
    IF rv_summary_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_summary_string = rv_summary_string+1( ). " Ersten Zeilenumbruch entfernen
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen einfachen XML-String, der eine Liste von Elementen enthält, die in einem OpenXML-Dokument verwendet werden könnten. Nutzen Sie dafür eine `FOR`-Schleife und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit den generierten XML-Zeilen zu erstellen, und dann `REDUCE` oder eine weitere Schleife, um sie zu einem String zu verbinden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_xml_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS generate_xml_list
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_xml_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_xml_list.
    DATA(lv_header) = `<items>`. 
    DATA(lv_footer) = `</items>`. 

    DATA(lt_item_xml) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR item IN it_items
      ( |  <item name="{ item }"/>| )
    ).

    rv_xml_content = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_header
      FOR xml_line IN lt_item_xml
      NEXT s = s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && xml_line
      FINALLY s = s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && lv_footer
    ).
    " In a real scenario, cl_openxml_helper would then process this XML content.
    " For example: lo_openxml_doc->add_part( iv_part_name = '/customXml/item.xml' iv_content = rv_xml_content ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_xml.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_openxml_xml_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Cherry' ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_xml) = `<items>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                                    `  <item name="Apple"/>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                                    `  <item name="Banana"/>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                                    `  <item name="Cherry"/>` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                                    `</items>`. 
    DATA(lv_generated_xml) = lo_generator->generate_xml_list( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Generated XML does not match expected'
      act = lv_generated_xml
      exp = lv_expected_xml
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Schleife mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle, indem sie über eine bestehende iteriert und für jedes Element eine neue Zeile generiert. String-Templates (`|...|`) vereinfachen die dynamische Erstellung von Strings, hier für XML-Elemente. Der `REDUCE`-Operator wird verwendet, um die einzelnen XML-Zeilen effizient zu einem einzigen String zu verbinden.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, String Templates, XML, OpenXML, REDUCE

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie eine Liste von Dateinamen nach ihrer MIME-Typ-Kategorie (z.B. 'text', 'application'). Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator und Konstanten aus `cl_fxs_mime_types` zur Kategorisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer internen Tabelle als Akkumulator und `GROUP BY` oder `COND` für die Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_info,
             filename TYPE string,
             extension TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_info.
    TYPES tt_file_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mime_category_count,
             category TYPE string,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_mime_category_count.
    TYPES tt_mime_category_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mime_category_count WITH UNIQUE KEY category.

    METHODS aggregate_by_mime_category
      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_category_counts) TYPE tt_mime_category_count.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_mime_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_by_mime_category.
    rt_category_counts = REDUCE tt_mime_category_count(
      INIT categories = VALUE tt_mime_category_count( )
      FOR file IN it_files
      LET lv_category = get_mime_category( file-extension ) IN
      NEXT categories = VALUE #( categories ( category = lv_category count = categories[ category = lv_category ]-count + 1 DEFAULT 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mime_category.
    CASE iv_extension.
      WHEN 'txt' OR 'html' OR 'xml'.
        rv_category = 'text'.
      WHEN 'pdf' OR 'docx' OR 'xlsx'.
        rv_category = 'application'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_category = 'unknown'.
    ENDCASE.
    " In a more complex scenario, cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_... could be used for direct comparison
    " or a mapping table could be built from its constants.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_mime_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_files) = VALUE zcl_mime_aggregator=>tt_file_info(
      ( filename = 'doc1.docx' extension = 'docx' )
      ( filename = 'report.pdf' extension = 'pdf' )
      ( filename = 'index.html' extension = 'html' )
      ( filename = 'data.txt' extension = 'txt' )
      ( filename = 'image.jpg' extension = 'jpg' )
      ( filename = 'sheet.xlsx' extension = 'xlsx' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_by_mime_category( lt_files ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect count for application' act = lt_counts[ category = 'application' ]-count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect count for text' act = lt_counts[ category = 'text' ]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect count for unknown' act = lt_counts[ category = 'unknown' ]-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Anzahl der Dateien pro MIME-Typ-Kategorie zu zählen. Die `LET`-Expression verbessert die Lesbarkeit, indem sie Zwischenergebnisse (hier die Kategorie) lokal definiert.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LET, MIME Types

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Dateinamen, um nur diejenigen zu erhalten, die einem bestimmten MIME-Typ entsprechen. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und Konstanten aus `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_mime_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_data,
             filename  TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_data.
    TYPES tt_file_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_files_by_mime
      IMPORTING
        it_all_files TYPE tt_file_data
        iv_target_mime TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_files) TYPE tt_file_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_files_by_mime.
    rt_filtered_files = FILTER #( 
      it_all_files
      WHERE mime_type = iv_target_mime
    ).
    " iv_target_mime could be cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_pdf for example.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_mime.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_mime_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_files) = VALUE zcl_mime_filter=>tt_file_data(
      ( filename = 'document.docx' mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_vnd_openxmlformats_officedocument_wordprocessingml_document )
      ( filename = 'image.png' mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_image_png )
