      it_all_files = lt_files
      iv_target_mime = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_pdf
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of PDF files' act = lines( lt_pdf_files ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_pdf_files WITH KEY filename = 'report.pdf' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'report.pdf not found' act = sy-subrc = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_pdf_files WITH KEY filename = 'document.docx' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'document.docx should not be found' act = sy-subrc <> 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine prägnante und funktionale Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Dies führt zu kürzerem und besser lesbarem Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukten.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, MIME Types, cl_fxs_mime_types

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen XML-String für einen einfachen Textabsatz in einem OpenXML-Word-Dokument. Verwenden Sie String-Templates, um den Text und Attribute dynamisch einzufügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Syntax `|...{ variable }...|` für String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_paragraph DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS create_paragraph_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_style TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_paragraph IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_paragraph_xml.
    DATA(lv_style_attr) = COND string( WHEN iv_style IS NOT INITIAL THEN | w:val="{ iv_style }"| ELSE `` ).
    rv_xml = |<w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle{ lv_style_attr }/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>{ iv_text }</w:t></w:r></w:p>|.
    " This XML content could then be added to a Word document part using cl_openxml_helper.
    " E.g., lo_openxml_doc->add_part( iv_part_name = '/word/document.xml' iv_content = rv_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_paragraph_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_paragraph_xml.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_openxml_paragraph( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_style) = 'Heading1'.

    DATA(lv_expected_xml_with_style) = |<w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading1"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Hello World</w:t></w:r></w:p>|.
    DATA(lv_generated_xml_with_style) = lo_creator->create_paragraph_xml( iv_text = lv_text iv_style = lv_style ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'XML with style does not match expected'
      act = lv_generated_xml_with_style
      exp = lv_expected_xml_with_style
    ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xml_no_style) = |<w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Hello World</w:t></w:r></w:p>|.
    DATA(lv_generated_xml_no_style) = lo_creator->create_paragraph_xml( iv_text = lv_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'XML without style does not match expected'
      act = lv_generated_xml_no_style
      exp = lv_expected_xml_no_style
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne und leistungsstarke Methode zur String-Manipulation. Sie ermöglichen das einfache Einbetten von Variablen und Ausdrücken in Strings, was besonders nützlich für die Generierung von strukturierten Daten wie XML ist. Die `COND`-Expression wird hier verwendet, um bedingt ein Attribut in den String einzufügen.
keywords: String Templates, XML, OpenXML, COND

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie eine Builder-Klasse erstellen, die schrittweise ein Objekt konfiguriert. Die Builder-Klasse könnte intern `cl_openxml_helper` verwenden, um ein Dokument vorzubereiten.
hint: Methoden, die Chaining ermöglichen, müssen `ME` als Rückgabewert haben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_document_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS set_title
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_document_builder.
    METHODS add_paragraph
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_document_builder.
    METHODS build_document
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_document_id) TYPE string. " Simulate returning a document ID

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_title TYPE string.
    DATA mt_paragraphs TYPE string_table.
    " DATA mo_openxml_helper TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper. " In a real scenario
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_title.
    mv_title = iv_title.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_paragraph.
    APPEND iv_text TO mt_paragraphs.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_document.
    " In a real scenario, mo_openxml_helper would be used here
    " to create the document based on mv_title and mt_paragraphs.
    " For this example, we just simulate a document ID.
    rv_document_id = |Document '{ mv_title }' created with { lines( mt_paragraphs ) } paragraphs.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_document_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_document_info) = lo_builder->set_title( 'My Report' )->add_paragraph( 'Introduction.' )->add_paragraph( 'Conclusion.' )->build_document( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_info) = 'Document ''My Report'' created with 2 paragraphs.'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Method chaining result incorrect'
      act = lv_document_info
      exp = lv_expected_info
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf dasselbe Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, insbesondere bei Builder-Pattern oder Fluent Interfaces. Jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, muss eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Builder Pattern, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Kategorie für einen Dateityp basierend auf seinem MIME-Typ. Nutzen Sie die `COND`-Expression und Konstanten aus `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
hint: Die `COND`-Expression erlaubt bedingte Zuweisungen in einer Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_category_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_file_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_category_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_file_category.
    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN iv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_text_plain THEN 'Textdokument'
      WHEN iv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_pdf THEN 'PDF-Dokument'
      WHEN iv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_vnd_openxmlformats_officedocument_spreadsheetml_sheet THEN 'Tabellenkalkulation'
      WHEN iv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_image_jpeg THEN 'Bild'
      ELSE 'Sonstiges'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_file_category FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_category.
    DATA(lo_categorizer) = NEW zcl_mime_category_cond( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for PDF incorrect' act = lo_categorizer->get_file_category( cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_pdf ) exp = 'PDF-Dokument' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for XLSX incorrect' act = lo_categorizer->get_file_category( cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_vnd_openxmlformats_officedocument_spreadsheetml_sheet ) exp = 'Tabellenkalkulation' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for JPG incorrect' act = lo_categorizer->get_file_category( cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_image_jpeg ) exp = 'Bild' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for unknown incorrect' act = lo_categorizer->get_file_category( 'application/octet-stream' ) exp = 'Sonstiges' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art der bedingten Wertzuweisung. Anstatt mehrerer `IF`-Anweisungen kann der Rückgabewert direkt basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen definiert werden, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, MIME Types, cl_fxs_mime_types

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie die moderne `SELECT`-Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

    " This flight data could then be used to generate an OpenXML report
    " using cl_openxml_helper, e.g., an Excel spreadsheet.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_data_reader( ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'All flights table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_all_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH flights table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_lh_flights ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH flights should be fewer than all flights' act = lines( lt_lh_flights ) < lines( lt_all_flights ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect carrier ID' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne `SELECT`-Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration (`INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data)`) vereinfacht den Datenbankzugriff erheblich, indem sie die explizite Deklaration der Zielvariablen überflüssig macht. Die Verwendung von Host-Variablen mit `@` ist ebenfalls Teil des modernen Syntaxstandards.
keywords: SELECT, Database Access, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz von `cl_openxml_helper` und rufen Sie eine grundlegende Methode auf, um die Initialisierung eines OpenXML-Dokuments zu simulieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `NEW`-Operator zur Instanziierung und rufen Sie dann eine Methode auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS initialize_openxml_doc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD initialize_openxml_doc.
    TRY.
        " cl_openxml_helper is an abstract class, so we cannot directly instantiate it.
        " We simulate its usage by calling a static method or a method of a concrete subclass.
        " For demonstration, we assume a concrete helper class exists or use a static method if available.
        " In a real scenario, you would instantiate a specific helper, e.g., for XLSX or DOCX.
        " Example: DATA(lo_openxml_doc) = NEW cl_openxml_helper_xlsx( ).
        " As cl_openxml_helper is abstract, we'll simulate a successful operation.
        " If a concrete class like cl_openxml_helper_xlsx existed, it would be:
        " DATA(lo_openxml_doc) = NEW cl_openxml_helper_xlsx( ).
        " lo_openxml_doc->create_document( ).
        " rv_success = abap_true.

        " For this example, we'll just indicate success as direct instantiation is not possible.
        " A more realistic example would involve a factory or a concrete subclass.
        rv_success = abap_true.

    CATCH cx_openxml_exception.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_initialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_initialization.
    DATA(lo_initializer) = NEW zcl_openxml_init( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_initializer->initialize_openxml_doc( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'OpenXML document initialization should be successful' act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `NEW`-Operator ist die moderne Art, Objekte in ABAP zu instanziieren. Er ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Objektreferenz und ist Teil der funktionalen Programmierparadigmen in ABAP. Da `cl_openxml_helper` eine abstrakte Klasse ist, kann sie nicht direkt instanziiert werden; stattdessen würde man eine konkrete Unterklasse oder eine Factory-Methode verwenden. Das Beispiel simuliert den Erfolg einer solchen Initialisierung.
keywords: NEW, Object Orientation, Instantiation, OpenXML, cl_openxml_helper

Instructions: Übertragen Sie ausgewählte Felder von Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer anderen Struktur, die für einen OpenXML-Bericht optimiert ist. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
hint: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator kopiert Felder mit gleichen Namen zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_report_line,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             aircraft_type TYPE sflight-planetype,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_report_line.
    TYPES tt_report_line TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_report_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_data_for_report
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_report_data) TYPE tt_report_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_data_for_report.
    rt_report_data = CORRESPONDING #( it_sflights MAPPING
      carrid = airline_id
      connid = flight_num
      fldate = flight_date
      planetype = aircraft_type
      EXCEPT seatsocc seatsmax " These will be handled manually
    ).

    LOOP AT rt_report_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_report_line>).
      READ TABLE it_sflights WITH KEY airline_id = <fs_report_line>-airline_id
                                     flight_num = <fs_report_line>-flight_num
                                     flight_date = <fs_report_line>-flight_date
                                     INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_sflight_raw-seatsmax > 0.
        <fs_report_line>-occupancy_rate = ( ls_sflight_raw-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_sflight_raw-seatsmax.
      ELSE.
        <fs_report_line>-occupancy_rate = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " The rt_report_data could then be used to populate an OpenXML Excel sheet
    " using cl_openxml_helper.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_data_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_mapping.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_flight_data_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_data_mapping=>tt_sflight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 300 seatsmax = 400 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 0 seatsmax = 0 ) " Edge case
    ).

    DATA(lt_mapped_data) = lo_mapper->map_flight_data_for_report( lt_raw_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of mapped lines' act = lines( lt_mapped_data ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_mapped_data WITH KEY airline_id = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_report).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH flight_num incorrect' act = ls_lh_report-flight_num exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH occupancy_rate incorrect' act = ls_lh_report-occupancy_rate exp = '66.67' ).

    READ TABLE lt_mapped_data WITH KEY airline_id = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_report).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA occupancy_rate incorrect' act = ls_aa_report-occupancy_rate exp = '75.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_mapped_data WITH KEY airline_id = 'UA' INTO DATA(ls_ua_report).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'UA occupancy_rate incorrect' act = ls_ua_report-occupancy_rate exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist ideal, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, aber ähnlichem Inhalt, effizient zu übertragen. Die `MAPPING`-Klausel erlaubt die explizite Zuordnung von Feldern, während `EXCEPT` Felder ausschließt, die manuell verarbeitet werden sollen. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu manuellen Zuweisungen oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Data Mapping, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie die Dateiendung aus einem vollständigen Dateinamen. Nutzen Sie die moderne String-Funktion `FIND` und `SUBSTRING`.
hint: Suchen Sie nach dem letzten Punkt im String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_extension_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_extension
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_extension) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_extension_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_extension.
    FIND LAST OCCURRENCE OF '.' IN iv_filename IGNORING CASE MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_extension = iv_filename+lv_offset( ).
      " Remove the dot itself
      rv_extension = rv_extension+1( ).
    ELSE.
      rv_extension = ''. " No extension found
    ENDIF.
    " This extension could then be used to determine the MIME type via cl_fxs_mime_types.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_extension FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_extension.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_file_extension_extractor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Correct extension for docx' act = lo_extractor->get_extension( 'document.docx' ) exp = 'docx' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Correct extension for tar.gz' act = lo_extractor->get_extension( 'archive.tar.gz' ) exp = 'gz' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Empty extension for no dot' act = lo_extractor->get_extension( 'filename' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Empty extension for dot at end' act = lo_extractor->get_extension( 'filename.' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Correct extension for path' act = lo_extractor->get_extension( '/path/to/file.pdf' ) exp = 'pdf' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die String-Funktionen `FIND LAST OCCURRENCE` und `SUBSTRING` (hier als Offset- und Längenangabe) sind effiziente und moderne Wege, um Teile von Strings zu manipulieren. Die Inline-Deklaration von `lv_offset` macht den Code kompakter. Dies ist eine saubere Alternative zu älteren `SEARCH` oder `OFFSET` Anweisungen.
keywords: String Processing, FIND, SUBSTRING, Offset, Extension

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem MIME-Typ eine spezifische OpenXML-Dokumenten-Handler-Klasse zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie den `NEW`-Operator und `CASE` für die Auswahl.
hint: Die Factory-Methode sollte eine Referenz auf eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle oder Oberklasse zurückgeben.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_openxml_handler.
  METHODS process_document
    IMPORTING
      iv_content TYPE xstring
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_openxml_docx_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_openxml_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_docx_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_openxml_handler~process_document.
    " Simulate processing a DOCX document using cl_openxml_helper internally
    " DATA(lo_docx_helper) = NEW cl_openxml_helper_docx( ).
    " lo_docx_helper->load_document( iv_content ).
    " rv_result = lo_docx_helper->get_text_content( ).
    rv_result = |DOCX content processed (length: { xstrlen( iv_content ) }).|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_xlsx_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_openxml_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_xlsx_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_openxml_handler~process_document.
    " Simulate processing an XLSX document using cl_openxml_helper internally
    " DATA(lo_xlsx_helper) = NEW cl_openxml_helper_xlsx( ).
    " lo_xlsx_helper->load_document( iv_content ).
    " rv_result = lo_xlsx_helper->get_sheet_data( 'Sheet1' ).
    rv_result = |XLSX content processed (length: { xstrlen( iv_content ) }).|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS get_handler
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_handler) TYPE REF TO zif_openxml_handler
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_handler.
    CASE iv_mime_type.
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_vnd_openxmlformats_officedocument_wordprocessingml_document.
        ro_handler = NEW zcl_openxml_docx_handler( ).
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mime_application_vnd_openxmlformats_officedocument_spreadsheetml_sheet.
        ro_handler = NEW zcl_openxml_xlsx_handler( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |No handler for MIME type '{ iv_mime_type }'|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine andere ein, wobei nur Zeilen hinzugefügt werden, die noch nicht vorhanden sind. Nutzen Sie den `INSERT ... FROM TABLE` mit `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... FROM TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` für effizientes Einfügen ohne Fehler bei Duplikaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_merge DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS merge_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_data
      CHANGING
        ct_target TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_merge IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source INTO TABLE ct_target ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    " This operation could be part of preparing a dataset for an OpenXML report,
    " where unique entries are required, or for managing MIME type mappings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_merge_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_tables.
    DATA(lo_merger) = NEW zcl_table_merge( ).

    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_table_merge=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_table_merge=>tt_data(
      ( id = 2 value = 'B_new' ) " Duplicate ID
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' )
      ( id = 4 value = 'D' )
    ).

    lo_merger->merge_tables( EXPORTING it_source = lt_source CHANGING ct_target = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of lines after merge' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value for ID 1 incorrect' act = lt_target[ id = 1 ]-value exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value for ID 2 should be original' act = lt_target[ id = 2 ]-value exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value for ID 3 incorrect' act = lt_target[ id = 3 ]-value exp = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value for ID 4 incorrect' act = lt_target[ id = 4 ]-value exp = 'D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`-Anweisung ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle in eine andere einzufügen, ohne dass es zu Laufzeitfehlern kommt, wenn doppelte Schlüssel vorhanden sind. Vorhandene Zeilen werden dabei nicht überschrieben, was besonders nützlich für das Zusammenführen von Daten ist.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, Duplicate Keys, Merge

CLASS zcl_avg_last_30_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      WHERE fldate >= @lv_30_days_ago
      INTO @rv_avg_price.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die im aktuellen Monat liegen, und berechnen Sie dann den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis dieser gefilterten Flüge mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die Datumsfilterung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation über die gefilterten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_current_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_current_month RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_current_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_current_month.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_first_day_of_month) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_first_day_of_month( sy-datum ).
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_month)  = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_last_day_of_month( sy-datum ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab FROM lt_sflights
      WHERE fldate >= lv_first_day_of_month AND fldate <= lv_last_day_of_month.

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 0.
      rv_avg_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0.0
                                count_flights = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                  NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
                                       count_flights = count_flights + 1
                                FINALLY sum_price / count_flights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_current_month FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_avg_current_month.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_current_month( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->get_average_price_current_month( ).

    " Similar to previous test, we can't assert a specific value without test data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_avg >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Verwendung von `FILTER` für die Selektion von Daten aus internen Tabellen basierend auf Datumsbereichen und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation (Berechnung des Durchschnitts). Die Datumsverwaltung erfolgt hier mit `cl_abap_date_time_utilities`, einer Standardklasse für Datumsoperationen, die ähnliche Funktionalitäten wie spezialisierte Klassen wie `cl_reca_date` für die Datumsberechnung bietet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste aller Samstage und Sonntage im aktuellen Jahr. Die Liste soll die Daten im Format 'JJJJMMTT' enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` Iteratoren, `cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_day_of_week` und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekend_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekend_dates_current_year RETURNING VALUE(rt_weekend_dates) TYPE TABLE OF sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekend_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekend_dates_current_year.
    DATA(lv_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = lv_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = lv_year && '1231'.

    rt_weekend_dates = VALUE #( FOR d = lv_start_date THEN d + 1 WHILE d <= lv_end_date
                                 LET day_of_week = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_day_of_week( d ) IN
                                 WHERE ( day_of_week = 6 OR day_of_week = 7 )
                                 ( d ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weekend_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekend_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weekend_dates( ).
    DATA(lt_weekends) = lo_cut->get_weekend_dates_current_year( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_weekends ). " Should contain at least 104 weekend days
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_weekends ) >= 104 ). " At least 52 weekends * 2 days

    " Check a few dates to ensure they are indeed weekends
    IF lines( lt_weekends ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_first_weekend_day) = lt_weekends[1].
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_day_of_week( lv_first_weekend_day ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_day_of_week = 6 OR lv_day_of_week = 7 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR`-Iterator in Kombination mit `VALUE` für die Konstruktion einer internen Tabelle. Die `LET`-Expression und die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks ermöglichen eine kompakte und funktionale Erzeugung der Liste von Wochenendtagen. `cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_day_of_week` ist hierbei ein Schlüssel für die 'Datumsverwaltung'.
keywords: Functional Programming, FOR, VALUE, Datumsverwaltung, cl_abap_date_time_utilities, Wochenenden

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die für ein gegebenes Flugdatum zurückgibt, ob der Flug 'Vergangen', 'Heute' oder 'Zukünftig' ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` Ausdrücke für die bedingte Logik, um den Status des Datums zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_date_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status IMPORTING iv_flight_date TYPE sy-datum RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_date_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_flight_date < sy-datum THEN 'Vergangen'
      WHEN iv_flight_date = sy-datum THEN 'Heute'
      WHEN iv_flight_date > sy-datum THEN 'Zukünftig'

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Monat und berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Monat. Geben Sie das Jahr, den Monat und den Durchschnittspreis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe. Extrahieren Sie Jahr und Monat aus dem Flugdatum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_per_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_avg,
             year        TYPE sy-jahr,
             month       TYPE sy-monat,
             average_price TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_monthly_avg,
           tt_monthly_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_average_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_monthly_avg) TYPE tt_monthly_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_per_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_average_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( year  = ls_flight-fldate(4)
                                                        month = ls_flight-fldate+4(2) )
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE sflights-price(
        INIT sum = 0.0
        FOR <flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <flight>-price ).

      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_monthly_avg(
        year        = ls_group_key-year
        month       = ls_group_key-month
        average_price = lv_sum_price / lv_count
      ) TO rt_monthly_avg.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_monthly_avg FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_monthly_avg.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_per_month( ).
    DATA(lt_monthly_avg) = lo_cut->get_monthly_average_prices( ).

    " Assert that some monthly averages are returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_monthly_avg ).

    " Check if the average prices are non-negative
    LOOP AT lt_monthly_avg INTO DATA(ls_monthly_avg).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_monthly_avg-average_price >= 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_monthly_avg-year ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_monthly_avg-month ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax, um Daten aus einer internen Tabelle nach Jahr und Monat zu gruppieren. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Aggregation und 'Datumsverwaltung' auf Anwendungsebene.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, AVG, Datumsverwaltung

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie für eine Liste von Flugdaten, wie viele Tage bis zum jeweiligen Flug verbleiben. Negative Werte für vergangene Flüge sind erlaubt. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_date_time_utilities`.

CLASS zcl_days_until_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_date_diff,
             flight_date TYPE sy-datum,
             days_diff   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_date_diff,
           tt_flight_date_diff TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_date_diff WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_days_diff
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_dates TYPE TABLE OF sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_diffs) TYPE tt_flight_date_diff.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_days_until_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_days_diff.
    rt_diffs = REDUCE tt_flight_date_diff(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_date_diff( )
      FOR flight_date IN it_flight_dates
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_date_diff( BASE result
                                                ( flight_date = flight_date
                                                  days_diff   = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>diff_days( iv_date1 = flight_date iv_date2 = sy-datum ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( sy-datum - 5 )
      ( sy-datum )
      ( sy-datum + 10 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_diffs) = lo_cut->calculate_days_diff( lt_test_dates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_diffs ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of results' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_diffs[1]-days_diff exp = -5 msg = 'Diff for past date failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_diffs[2]-days_diff exp = 0 msg = 'Diff for today failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_diffs[3]-days_diff exp = 10 msg = 'Diff for future date failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length    TYPE i,
             decimals  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_info.

    METHODS analyze_field_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_field_info) TYPE ty_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_field_type.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_field_name ).
        DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_descr ).

        rs_field_info-type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind.
        rs_field_info-length    = lo_elem_descr->length.
        rs_field_info-decimals  = lo_elem_descr->decimals.

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error if field not found or not elementary
        CLEAR rs_field_info.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Laufzeit zweier Methoden zum Summieren von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle: einmal mit einem klassischen `LOOP` und einmal mit einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` für beide Messungen und `REDUCE` für die moderne Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_sum_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      EXPORTING
        ev_runtime_loop_us TYPE i
        ev_runtime_reduce_us TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_sum_methods.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_table( FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_entries ( i ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = 0.

    " Measure LOOP AT
    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_number.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    ev_runtime_loop_us = lv_end_loop - lv_start_loop.

    " Measure REDUCE
    DATA(lv_start_reduce) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN lt_numbers NEXT s = s + n ).
    DATA(lv_end_reduce) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    ev_runtime_reduce_us = lv_end_reduce - lv_start_reduce.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_sum_methods FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_sum_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_loop) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_reduce) TYPE i.

    lo_cut->compare_sum_methods(
      EXPORTING
        iv_num_entries     = 10000
      IMPORTING
        ev_runtime_loop_us = lv_runtime_loop
        ev_runtime_reduce_us = lv_runtime_reduce
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Loop runtime should be positive' act = ( lv_runtime_loop > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Reduce runtime should be positive' act = ( lv_runtime_reduce > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance einer klassischen `LOOP`-Iteration mit einem modernen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck zur Summenbildung. `cl_abap_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Laufzeiten beider Ansätze zu messen. `REDUCE` ist oft effizienter und lesbarer für Aggregationen.
keywords: PERFORMANCE, RUNTIME, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, INTERNAL TABLES, LOOP, REDUCE

CLASS zcl_perf_for_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        curr   TYPE s_currkey,
        flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
      END OF ty_flight_group,
      tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_for_group_by RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_perf_for_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_for_group_by.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_all).

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_group(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_all GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, curr = ls_flight-curr )
      (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        curr = ls_flight-curr,
        flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( flight ) )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit einer Operation nur, wenn die Anzahl der zu verarbeitenden Datensätze einen bestimmten Schwellenwert (z.B. 10.000) überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `IF`-Bedingung und `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_if_large_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE string_table
        iv_threshold TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_if_large_data.
    rv_runtime_us = 0. " Default to 0 if not measured

    IF lines( it_data ) > iv_threshold.
      DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

      " Simulate processing
      DATA(lt_processed_data) = VALUE string_table( FOR item IN it_data ( |Processed { item }| ) ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_processed_data ).

      DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
      rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für die Verkettung einer großen Anzahl von Strings mit dem alten `CONCATENATE` und dem modernen String-Template.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und vergleichen Sie `CONCATENATE` mit `|...{ variable }...|`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_string_concat
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      EXPORTING
        ev_runtime_concat_us TYPE i
        ev_runtime_template_us TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_string_concat.
    DATA(lv_result_old) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_result_new) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_part) = 'Teilstring '.

    " Measure CONCATENATE
    DATA(lv_start_concat) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_num_iterations TIMES.
      CONCATENATE lv_result_old lv_part INTO lv_result_old.
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_end_concat) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    ev_runtime_concat_us = lv_end_concat - lv_start_concat.

    " Measure String Template
    DATA(lv_start_template) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_num_iterations TIMES.
      lv_result_new = |{ lv_result_new }{ lv_part }|.
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_end_template) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    ev_runtime_template_us = lv_end_template - lv_start_template.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_concat) TYPE i.

      EXPORTING
        iv_num_iterations      = 1000
      IMPORTING

        ev_runtime_template_us = lv_runtime_template
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Template runtime should be positive' act = ( lv_runtime_template > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance der String-Verkettung mit dem traditionellen `CONCATENATE` und den modernen String-Templates. String-Templates sind nicht nur lesbarer, sondern oft auch performanter, insbesondere bei komplexeren Verkettungen. `cl_abap_runtime` wird zur Messung der Effizienzunterschiede eingesetzt.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine hierarchische Struktur (z.B. Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge) in einem Tree Control an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` oder `cl_gui_list_tree` und `cl_gui_cfw=>flush`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_control DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flight_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_control IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_node_key) TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.

    " Add root nodes for carriers
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( ls_flight-carrid )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_node_text      = lv_carrier
        i_node_key       = lv_carrier ).

      " Add child nodes for flights
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrier.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_relat_node_key = lv_carrier
          i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_node_text      = |Flight { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-fldate })|
          i_node_key       = |{ lv_carrier }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->expand_node( cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key_root ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TRY.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Filtern einer internen Tabelle mit `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und dem modernen `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und vergleichen Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_filter_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_filter_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      EXPORTING
        ev_runtime_loop_us TYPE i
        ev_runtime_filter_us TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_filter_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_filter_methods.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE string_table( FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_entries ( |Item { i }| ) ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_loop) TYPE string_table.
    DATA(lt_filtered_filter) TYPE string_table.

    " Measure LOOP AT ... WHERE
    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(lv_item) WHERE lv_item CS '100'.
      APPEND lv_item TO lt_filtered_loop.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    ev_runtime_loop_us = lv_end_loop - lv_start_loop.

    " Measure FILTER
    DATA(lv_start_filter) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lt_filtered_filter = FILTER #( lt_data WHERE table_line CS '100' ).
    DATA(lv_end_filter) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    ev_runtime_filter_us = lv_end_filter - lv_start_filter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_filter_methods FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_filter_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_filter_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_loop) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_filter) TYPE i.

    lo_cut->compare_filter_methods(
      EXPORTING
        iv_num_iterations      = 10000
      IMPORTING
        ev_runtime_loop_us   = lv_runtime_loop
        ev_runtime_filter_us = lv_runtime_filter
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Loop runtime should be positive' act = ( lv_runtime_loop > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Filter runtime should be positive' act = ( lv_runtime_filter > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance des Filterns einer internen Tabelle mit dem traditionellen `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und dem modernen `FILTER`-Operator. Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und oft performantere Möglichkeit, Daten zu filtern, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen. `cl_abap_runtime` wird zur Messung der Effizienzunterschiede eingesetzt.
keywords: PERFORMANCE, RUNTIME, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, INTERNAL TABLES, FILTER, LOOP AT WHERE

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für die Erstellung und Verarbeitung einer großen Anzahl von Objekten im Vergleich zur Verwendung von strukturierten Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime` und vergleichen Sie die Performance von `CREATE OBJECT` in einer Schleife mit der Initialisierung einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_object_vs_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data_struct,
        id TYPE i,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data_struct,
      tt_data_struct TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_struct WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS lcl_data_object DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA id TYPE i.
        DATA value TYPE string.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i iv_value TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_data_object IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        me->id = iv_id.
        me->value = iv_value.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tt_data_object TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO lcl_data_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_object_creation
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      EXPORTING
        ev_runtime_object_us TYPE i
        ev_runtime_struct_us TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_object_vs_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_object_creation.
    DATA(lt_objects) TYPE tt_data_object.
    DATA(lt_structs) TYPE tt_data_struct.

    " Measure Object Creation
    DATA(lv_start_object) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      DATA(lo_data) = NEW lcl_data_object( iv_id = sy-index iv_value = |Object { sy-index }| ).
      APPEND lo_data TO lt_objects.
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_end_object) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    ev_runtime_object_us = lv_end_object - lv_start_object.

    " Measure Structured Data Creation
    DATA(lv_start_struct) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lt_structs = VALUE tt_data_struct( FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_entries ( id = i value = |Struct { i }| ) ).
    DATA(lv_end_struct) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    ev_runtime_struct_us = lv_end_struct - lv_start_struct.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_object_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_object_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_object_vs_struct( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_object) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_struct) TYPE i.

    lo_cut->compare_object_creation(
      EXPORTING
        iv_num_entries       = 1000
      IMPORTING
        ev_runtime_object_us = lv_runtime_object
        ev_runtime_struct_us = lv_runtime_struct
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Object creation runtime should be positive' act = ( lv_runtime_object > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Struct creation runtime should be positive' act = ( lv_runtime_struct > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance der Erstellung und Verwaltung einer großen Anzahl von Objekten im Vergleich zur Verwendung von internen Tabellen mit strukturierten Daten. Die Objekterstellung (`CREATE OBJECT`) ist in der Regel ressourcenintensiver als die Initialisierung von Strukturen in internen Tabellen, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. `cl_abap_runtime` hilft, diesen Unterschied zu quantifizieren. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der strukturierten Tabelle ist modern.

solution:
CLASS zcl_utc_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_string_to_utclong
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utclong) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utc_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_string_to_utclong.
    DATA(lv_date_part) = iv_timestamp_string+0(10).
    DATA(lv_time_part) = iv_timestamp_string+11(8).
    DATA(lv_timestamp_packed) = |{ lv_date_part(4) }{ lv_date_part+5(2) }{ lv_date_part+8(2) }{ lv_time_part(2) }{ lv_time_part+3(2) }{ lv_time_part+6(2) }0000000|.
    DATA(lo_utc) = cl_abap_utclong=>create( lv_timestamp_packed ).
    rv_utclong = lo_utc->get_utclong( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` so, dass sie als Serien für ein Liniendiagramm der Anzahl der Flüge pro Monat für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft dargestellt werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in `SELECT` und anschließend `VALUE #(...) FOR ...` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_series_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_month_flight,
             month TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_month_flight.
    TYPES tt_month_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_month_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_monthly_flights) TYPE tt_month_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_series_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_flights.
    DATA: lt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_month_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT LEFT( fldate, 6 ) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      GROUP BY LEFT( fldate, 6 )
      ORDER BY LEFT( fldate, 6 )

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zeitstempeln, um nur Einträge innerhalb eines bestimmten Zeitfensters (Start- und End-UTCLONG) zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die `CL_ABAP_UTCLONG` Objekte vergleicht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utc_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_timestamp_entry,
             id TYPE i,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_timestamp_entry.
    TYPES tt_timestamp_entry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_timestamp_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        it_timestamps TYPE tt_timestamp_entry
        iv_start_ts TYPE timestampl
        iv_end_ts TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_timestamps) TYPE tt_timestamp_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utc_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_timestamps.
    DATA(lo_start_utc) = cl_abap_utclong=>create( iv_start_ts ).
    DATA(lo_end_utc) = cl_abap_utclong=>create( iv_end_ts ).

    rt_filtered_timestamps = FILTER #( it_timestamps USING KEY primary_key
                                        WHERE timestamp >= lo_start_utc->get_utclong( )
                                          AND timestamp <= lo_end_utc->get_utclong( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_filter_timestamps FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_timestamps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utc_filter_table( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_utc_filter_table=>tt_timestamp_entry(
      ( id = 1 timestamp = '20230101100000.0000000' )
      ( id = 2 timestamp = '20230101110000.0000000' )
      ( id = 3 timestamp = '20230101120000.0000000' )
      ( id = 4 timestamp = '20230101130000.0000000' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_start) = '20230101103000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_end) = '20230101123000.0000000'.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_timestamps( it_timestamps = lt_test_data
                                                    iv_start_ts = lv_start
                                                    iv_end_ts = lv_end ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten basierend auf Zeitstempelbereichen zu selektieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein gegebener UTCLONG-Zeitstempel in der Zukunft liegt, unter Berücksichtigung der lokalen Zeitzone des Benutzers.
hint: Vergleichen Sie den Zeitstempel mit dem aktuellen lokalen Zeitstempel, der über `CL_ABAP_UTCLONG` ermittelt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utc_is_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_future_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utc_is_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_future_local.
    DATA(lo_given_utc) = cl_abap_utclong=>create( iv_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_current_utc) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).

    DATA(lv_given_local) = lo_given_utc->get_local_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_current_local) = lo_current_utc->get_local_timestamp( ).

    IF lv_given_local > lv_current_local.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_is_future_local FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_future_local.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utc_is_future( ).

    " Test for future timestamp (e.g., 1 hour from now)
    DATA(lv_future_ts) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( )->add( 3600 * 10000000 )->get_utclong( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Future timestamp should be recognized' act = lo_cut->is_future_local( lv_future_ts ) ).

    " Test for past timestamp (e.g., 1 hour ago)
    DATA(lv_past_ts) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( )->add( -3600 * 10000000 )->get_utclong( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Past timestamp should not be recognized as future' act = lo_cut->is_future_local( lv_past_ts ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `CL_ABAP_UTCLONG` prüft, ob ein Zeitstempel in der Zukunft liegt, wobei die Konvertierung in die lokale Zeitzone des Benutzers berücksichtigt wird. Dies ist wichtig für Anwendungen, die zeitzonenabhängige Logik erfordern. Die Verwendung von Methodenketten (`->add(...)->get_utclong()`) ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: UTCLONG, Timestamp, Future, Date/Time, CL_ABAP_UTCLONG, Local Time

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazitäten aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS`.

CLASS zcl_reduce_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp erzeugt und mit Beispieldaten füllt. Dies könnte für generische DDIC-Operationen nützlich sein.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE ir_table_type.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
      ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_line>.

      IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Fill with some dummy data (example for SFLIGHTS structure)
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 'AZ'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = '1234'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
        APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

        CLEAR <ls_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 'BZ'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = '5678'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = sy-datum + 1. ENDIF.
        APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS_TT' ) ). " SFLIGHTS_TT is a standard table type for SFLIGHTS

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lo_table_descr ).

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lt_sflights> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflights> ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sflights>[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AZ' ).

Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn der Typ einer internen Tabelle erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. beim Verarbeiten von DDIC-Objekten oder generischen Datenimporten.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS get_sflights_hashed RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_hashed.

                              carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS read_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.

    READ TABLE mt_sflights INTO rs_sflight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error EXPORTING text = 'Flight not found'.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer Hashed Table (z.B. die Summe der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft).
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für funktionale Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seats TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS aggregate_seats_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD aggregate_seats_by_carrier.
    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE tt_carrier_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats( )
      FOR ls_flight IN mt_sflights
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) IN
      NEXT result = COND tt_carrier_seats(
        WHEN lv_index IS NOT INITIAL THEN
          VALUE #( result INSERT VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_seats = result[ lv_index ]-total_seats + ls_flight-seatsocc ) INDEX lv_index )
        ELSE
          VALUE #( result INSERT VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_seats = ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_aggregate_seats FOR TESTING.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_test_data TYPE zcl_hashed_table_reduce=>tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_test_data = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 200 )
                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 150 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_aggregate_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_reduce( mt_test_data ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_seats_by_carrier( ).

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-total_seats exp = 150 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-total_seats exp = 350 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und deklarativen Weise. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie Einträge in einer Hashed Table basierend auf einem Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` oder `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS update_flight_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_planetype.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE mt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-planetype = iv_new_planetype.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights.
    rt_sflights = mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

      EXPORTING
        i_parent = io_parent_container.

    CALL METHOD ro_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_embed_alv_grid.
    DATA(lo_container_creator) = NEW zcl_gui_container_creator( ).
    DATA(lo_container) = lo_container_creator->create_container( iv_container_name = 'CONTAINER_AREA' ).

    DATA lt_sflights_data TYPE zcl_gui_alv_embedder=>tt_sflight_alv.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_data UP TO 5 ROWS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT und sammeln Sie nur die Felder CARRIER, CONNECTION ID, FLIGHT DATE, OCCUPIED SEATS und MAXIMUM SEATS in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `WHERE` und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_idt_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aa_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aa_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_idt_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_aa_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' )
                               ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                                 connid   = flight-connid,
                                 fldate   = flight-fldate,
                                 seatsocc = flight-seatsocc,
                                 seatsmax = flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_idt_for_filter( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All flights should be from carrier AA' act = ( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) ) ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und Flugnummer (connid) und berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze (seatsocc) für jede Gruppe. Sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_idt_reduce_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid          TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid          TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_idt_reduce_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_grouped_data = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE tt_grouped_flights( )
                                 FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ) INTO DATA(group_key)
                                 APPEND VALUE #( carrid          = group_key-carrid
                                                 connid          = group_key-connid
                                                 total_seats_occ = SUM( flight-seatsocc ) ) TO result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_grouped_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_idt_reduce_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Verify a specific group's aggregation (example for AA 001)
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '001' INTO @lv_expected_sum.

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' INTO DATA(ls_group_aa001).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect sum for AA 001' act = ls_group_aa001-total_seats_occ exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. In Kombination mit `GROUP BY` können komplexe Gruppierungen und Summierungen sehr kompakt ausgedrückt werden, was zu effizienterem und lesbarerem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, INTO TABLE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT, bei denen noch freie Plätze verfügbar sind (seatsocc < seatsmax), und sammeln Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_idt_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_alv_fcat_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alv_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_alv_data.
    TYPES: tt_alv_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alv_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_catalog
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_fcat_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_ALV_FCAT_GEN=>TY_ALV_DATA' ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        rt_field_catalog = VALUE #( FOR comp IN lt_components
                                      ( fieldname = comp-name
                                        coltext   = comp-name
                                        outputlen = 10 ) ). " Example output length
      CATCH cx_sy_runtime_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., type not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein benutzerdefiniertes Layout für eine ALV-Anzeige, das die Spaltenreihenfolge und die Spaltenbreite für die Felder CARRIER und FLIGHT DATE festlegt. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
