Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten in eine Struktur umwandelt, die für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid` geeignet ist, und dabei die Feldnamen in Großbuchstaben umwandelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #` mit `MAPPING` und `TO UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_data_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alv_display,
             CARRID    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             CONNID    TYPE sflight-connid,
             FLDATE    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             PLANETYPE TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_alv_display.
    TYPES: tt_alv_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alv_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflight_to_alv
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_alv_data) TYPE tt_alv_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflight_to_alv.
    rt_alv_data = CORRESPONDING #( it_sflight MAPPING
                                      CARRID    = carrid
                                      CONNID    = connid
                                      FLDATE    = fldate
                                      PLANETYPE = planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_sflight_to_alv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_sflight_to_alv.
    DATA: lt_sflight_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_sflight_test.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_data_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->map_sflight_to_alv( lt_sflight_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 1 entry' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid mismatch' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-CARRID exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Planetype mismatch' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-PLANETYPE exp = 'A320' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator mit `MAPPING` ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen oder -typen zu verschieben. Er reduziert den manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand erheblich und ist besonders nützlich bei der Vorbereitung von Daten für UI-Komponenten wie ALV, wo oft spezifische Feldnamen oder -formate erforderlich sind.
keywords: cl_gui_alv_grid, CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, INTO TABLE, Data Transformation, UI

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Fluggesellschaft nur dann in eine interne Tabelle ein, wenn diese noch nicht existiert. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `INSERT` mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_idt_conditional_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carrier TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS add_carrier_if_not_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrname TYPE scarr-carrname
      CHANGING
        ct_carriers TYPE tt_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_idt_conditional_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_carrier_if_not_exists.
    IF NOT line_exists( ct_carriers[ carrid = iv_carrid ] ).
      INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid carrname = iv_carrname ) INTO TABLE ct_carriers.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_new_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_new_carrier.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE zcl_idt_conditional_insert=>tt_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_idt_conditional_insert( ).

    lo_cut->add_carrier_if_not_exists( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_carrname = 'American Airlines' CHANGING ct_carriers = lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 1 entry' act = lines( lt_carriers ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid mismatch' act = lt_carriers[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_existing_carrier.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE zcl_idt_conditional_insert=>tt_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_idt_conditional_insert( ).

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' ) INTO TABLE lt_carriers.
    lo_cut->add_carrier_if_not_exists( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_carrname = 'American Airlines (New)' CHANGING ct_carriers = lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should still have 1 entry' act = lines( lt_carriers ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrname should not be updated' act = lt_carriers[ 1 ]-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `LINE_EXISTS` mit Tabellen-Key-Zugriff und `INSERT VALUE # INTO TABLE` ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare bedingte Einfügung von Zeilen in interne Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `READ TABLE` gefolgt von `IF sy-subrc <> 0`. Die Verwendung von `SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY` ist hierbei entscheidend für die Performance von `LINE_EXISTS`.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, INSERT, VALUE, INTO TABLE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften aus SFLIGHT und formatieren Sie den Namen jeder Fluggesellschaft so, dass er in Anführungszeichen gesetzt wird (z.B. 'Lufthansa' wird zu "Lufthansa").
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_idt_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_carrier,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname_q TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_formatted_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_formatted_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_carriers) TYPE tt_formatted_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_idt_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_carriers.
    DATA: lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    rt_formatted_carriers = VALUE #( FOR carrier IN lt_scarr
                                      ( carrid     = carrier-carrid,
                                        carrname_q = |"{ carrier-carrname }"| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_formatted_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_idt_string_template( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Formatted name should end with "' act = ( ls_first_entry-carrname_q CO '"' ) ).

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne und flexible Methode zur String-Manipulation und -Formatierung in ABAP. In Kombination mit dem `FOR`-Operator und `VALUE #` können Daten aus internen Tabellen effizient verarbeitet und in eine neue Tabelle mit formatierten String-Werten überführt werden, was den Code sehr lesbar macht.

Instructions: Sammeln Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT, die in der Zukunft liegen (Flugdatum > aktuelles Systemdatum), in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `WHERE` und `sy-datum`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_idt_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_idt_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_idt_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Note: SFLIGHT data might not always contain future dates, so this test might return an empty table.
    " The assertion checks if the logic is correct, assuming future flights *could* exist.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date should be in the future' act = ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " To make the test more robust, you could insert a future flight into a test double of sflight
    " or assert that if there are no future flights, the table is empty.
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'No future flights found (expected for test data)' act = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator mit `WHERE` bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Datumsbedingungen zu filtern. Die direkte Referenzierung von `sy-datum` innerhalb der `WHERE`-Klausel ist prägnant und modern.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, VALUE, INTO TABLE, Internal Tables, Date, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Wähle einen zufälligen Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Ermittle die Anzahl der Zeilen und nutze `cl_abap_random_int` für einen Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX ( lv_random_index + 1 ) INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_flight_selection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid msg = 'No flight selected if table is empty' ).

    " Assuming sflight has data for a meaningful test
    IF ls_flight-carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid msg = 'A flight should be selected' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-connid msg = 'Connection ID should not be initial' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man `cl_abap_random_int` verwendet, um einen zufälligen Index für eine interne Tabelle zu generieren. Die moderne Syntax `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)` und `READ TABLE ... INDEX` mit Inline-Deklaration macht den Code kompakt und lesbar.
keywords: Random, Tabelle, Auswahl, SFLIGHTS, cl_abap_random_int

Instructions: Simuliere einen Münzwurf (Kopf oder Zahl) und gib das Ergebnis als String zurück.
hint: Generiere eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_coin_flipper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flip_coin RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_coin_flipper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = 1 ).

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date_in_30_days.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = 29 ). " 0 to 29 days for 'next 30 days'

Instructions: Wähle 3 zufällige, eindeutige Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Schleife mit `COLLECT` oder `INSERT` mit `SORTED` Tabelle, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_3_unique_carrids RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_3_unique_carrids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) < 3.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
        INSERT lv_carrid-carrid INTO TABLE rt_carrids.
      ENDLOOP.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_max_index ).

    DO 100 TIMES. " Max 100 tries to find 3 unique carriers
      IF lines( rt_carrids ) = 3.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX ( lv_random_index + 1 ) INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        INSERT ls_flight-carrid INTO TABLE rt_carrids.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_3_unique_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_carrids ) <= 3 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_carrids ) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR carrid IN lt_carrids WHERE ( carrid IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT c = c + 1 ) ) ).
    " Check for uniqueness (already guaranteed by SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrids ) exp = lines( VALUE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line FOR carrid IN lt_carrids ( carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `cl_abap_random_int` in Kombination mit internen Tabellen, um eine bestimmte Anzahl eindeutiger Elemente aus einer Datenquelle zu extrahieren. Die Verwendung einer `SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine Duplikate hinzugefügt werden. Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung im Unit Test ist ein modernes Feature zur Aggregation.

Instructions: Erstelle eine einfache Excel-Datei (.xlsx) mit einem Header und Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichere sie im Anwendungsverzeichnis.

CLASS zcl_excel_exporter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_to_excel IMPORTING iv_filename TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_excel_exporter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel_document TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_document,
          lo_worksheet      TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_worksheet,
          lt_sflights       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel_document TYPE cl_openxml_helper.
    lo_worksheet = lo_excel_document->add_worksheet( 'Flüge' ).

    " Header
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Datum' ).

    " Data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_excel_document->save( iv_filename ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_multi_sheet IMPORTING iv_filename TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_multi_sheet.
    DATA: lo_excel_document TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_document,
          lo_worksheet_all  TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_worksheet,
          lo_worksheet_lh   TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_worksheet,
          lt_sflights       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel_document TYPE cl_openxml_helper.

    " Sheet 1: All Flights
    lo_worksheet_all = lo_excel_document->add_worksheet( 'Alle Flüge' ).
    lo_worksheet_all->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_worksheet_all->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_worksheet_all->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Datum' ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_row_all) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_all).
      lo_worksheet_all->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_all ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight_all-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet_all->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_all ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight_all-connid ).
      lo_worksheet_all->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_all ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight_all-fldate ).
      lv_row_all = lv_row_all + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sheet 2: LH Flights
    lo_worksheet_lh = lo_excel_document->add_worksheet( 'LH Flüge' ).
    lo_worksheet_lh->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_worksheet_lh->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_worksheet_lh->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Datum' ).

    DATA(lv_row_lh) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lo_worksheet_lh->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_lh ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight_lh-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet_lh->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_lh ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight_lh-connid ).
      lo_worksheet_lh->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_lh ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight_lh-fldate ).
      lv_row_lh = lv_row_lh + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_excel_document->save( iv_filename ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Exportiere dynamisch ausgewählte Spalten (z.B. CARRID, CONNID) aus `sflights` in eine Excel-Datei. Die auszuwählenden Spalten sollen als String-Tabelle übergeben werden.
hint: Nutze RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) und Feldsymbole, um die Spalten dynamisch zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_dynamic_sflights_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
        it_columns  TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel_document TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_document,
          lo_worksheet      TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_worksheet,
          lt_sflights       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight_wa     TYPE sflight.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel_document TYPE cl_openxml_helper.
    lo_worksheet = lo_excel_document->add_worksheet( 'Dynamische Flüge' ).

    " Get structure description for SFLIGHT
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Write Header dynamically
    DATA(lv_col_idx) = 1.
    LOOP AT it_columns INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = lv_column_name ).
      lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Data
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight_wa.
      lv_col_idx = 1.
      LOOP AT it_columns INTO lv_column_name.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_value> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight_wa TO <lv_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col_idx ip_value = <lv_value> ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_excel_document->save( iv_filename ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8 kodierten String in das interne SAP-Format unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ=>CREATE` und die Methode `CONVERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_charset_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_sap
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sap_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_charset_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_sap.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_obj.

    " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8 assumed for input)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_utf8_string
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error, e.g., raise exception or log
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create converter object for SAP internal format
    TRY.
        lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
        lo_conv->convert( EXPORTING in = lv_xstring IMPORTING out = rv_sap_string ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_obj_create cx_abap_conv_obj_ce.
        " Handle error, e.g., raise exception or log
        rv_sap_string = 'ERROR_CONVERSION_FAILED'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD convert_sap_to_utf8.

    TRY.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugnummern (als numerische Werte) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_connid_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_connid_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                       NEXT sum = sum + CONV i( ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_connid_sum.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_reducer=>tt_flight_info(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0030' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_sum) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_connid_sum( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_sum
      exp = 60 " 10 + 20 + 30
      msg = 'Incorrect sum of connids'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_reducer=>tt_flight_info( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_sum) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_connid_sum( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_empty_sum
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Sum of empty table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen oder anderen Iterationen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und einen Akkumulator aktualisiert. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr ausdrucksstarke Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: internal table, REDUCE, aggregation, functional programming, sum, BEGIN OF

  ENDMETHOD.

Jede Methode gibt dabei eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt zurück, wodurch weitere Methoden direkt auf dem Ergebnis aufgerufen werden können.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine Variable und ein Field-Symbol inline, wenn sie zum ersten Mal verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(...)` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS(...)` direkt bei der Zuweisung oder Schleifeniteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declaration_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_inline_declarations.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declaration_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_inline_declarations.
    " Inline data declaration
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Hello Inline!'.
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_text ).

    " Inline field-symbol declaration in a loop
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE i_tab( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_numbers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_number>).
      cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Number: { <fs_number> }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Inline data declaration with method call
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( lv_text ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Length of text: { lv_length }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inline_declarations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inline_declarations.
    " This test primarily checks for syntax errors and runtime exceptions
    " as cl_demo_output is not directly testable in a unit test.
    " A real test would capture output or check side effects.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_inline_declaration_demo( ).
    lo_demo->demonstrate_inline_declarations( ).

    " Assert that no dump occurred (implicit check for successful execution)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = abap_true
      msg = 'Inline declarations should execute without dump'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`, `FIELD-SYMBOLS(...)`) sind ein Eckpfeiler des modernen ABAP. Sie ermöglichen es, Variablen und Field-Symbols genau dort zu deklarieren, wo sie zum ersten Mal verwendet werden, was den Code kompakter, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht, da der Gültigkeitsbereich der Variablen klarer ist.
keywords: inline declaration, DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, modern ABAP, code readability

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Gesellschaft, unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` Ausdrucks in einer `LOOP` Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und den `GROUP SIZE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count(
        carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
        count  = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_group_by_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_demo=>tt_flight_info(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0030' fldate = '20250104' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0012' fldate = '20250105' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_demo->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_counts )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Incorrect number of groups'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_count-count
      exp = 3
      msg = 'LH flight count incorrect'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_count-count

    ).

explanation: Der `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `LOOP` Anweisung (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er vereinfacht Aggregationen und die Verarbeitung von Gruppen erheblich, indem er die Notwendigkeit manueller Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END` eliminiert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit einer Struktur, die zur Laufzeit definiert wird, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Struktur und Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " Example: all fields are string
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lo_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any structure.
          CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

          " Fill with some sample data
          LOOP AT 1 TO 3 INTO DATA(idx).
            LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
              IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_field> = |{ lv_field_name }_Value_{ idx }|.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
            APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.
        " Handle error
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD1' ) ( 'FIELD2' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lr_dynamic_table
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial'
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <lt_table> )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Dynamic table should contain 3 entries'
    ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_line).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field1> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE ls_first_line TO <fs_field1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <fs_field1>
      exp = 'FIELD1_Value_1'
      msg = 'First field of first line incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit dynamisch Strukturen und interne Tabellen erstellt und befüllt. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept des Dynamic Programming in ABAP, das oft in generischen Frameworks oder bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten verwendet wird. `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` sind die Schlüsselklassen hierfür.
keywords: dynamic programming, RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Absolutwert einer Zahl und runden Sie eine Gleitkommazahl auf die nächste ganze Zahl, unter Verwendung moderner mathematischer Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABS()` für den Absolutwert und `CEIL()`, `FLOOR()` oder `TRUNC()` für Rundungsoperationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_functions_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_absolute_and_round
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_int   TYPE i
        iv_number_float TYPE f
      EXPORTING
        ev_abs_value    TYPE i
        ev_rounded_ceil TYPE i
        ev_rounded_floor TYPE i
        ev_rounded_trunc TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_functions_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_absolute_and_round.
    ev_abs_value = abs( iv_number_int ).
    ev_rounded_ceil = ceil( iv_number_float ).
    ev_rounded_floor = floor( iv_number_float ).
    ev_rounded_trunc = trunc( iv_number_float ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_math_functions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_math_functions.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_math_functions_demo( ).
    DATA: lv_abs_value    TYPE i,
          lv_rounded_ceil TYPE i,
          lv_rounded_floor TYPE i,
          lv_rounded_trunc TYPE i.

    lo_demo->calculate_absolute_and_round(
      EXPORTING
        iv_number_int   = -10
        iv_number_float = 3.7
      IMPORTING
        ev_abs_value    = lv_abs_value
        ev_rounded_ceil = lv_rounded_ceil
        ev_rounded_floor = lv_rounded_floor
        ev_rounded_trunc = lv_rounded_trunc
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_abs_value   exp = 10  msg = 'ABS failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rounded_ceil exp = 4   msg = 'CEIL failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rounded_floor exp = 3   msg = 'FLOOR failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rounded_trunc exp = 3   msg = 'TRUNC failed' ).

    lo_demo->calculate_absolute_and_round(
      EXPORTING
        iv_number_int   = 5
        iv_number_float = -2.3
      IMPORTING
        ev_abs_value    = lv_abs_value
        ev_rounded_ceil = lv_rounded_ceil
        ev_rounded_floor = lv_rounded_floor
        ev_rounded_trunc = lv_rounded_trunc
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_abs_value   exp = 5   msg = 'ABS (positive) failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rounded_ceil exp = -2  msg = 'CEIL (negative) failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rounded_floor exp = -3  msg = 'FLOOR (negative) failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rounded_trunc exp = -2  msg = 'TRUNC (negative) failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP bietet eine Reihe von eingebauten mathematischen Funktionen wie `ABS()`, `CEIL()`, `FLOOR()` und `TRUNC()`, die direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden können. Diese Funktionen sind effizient und verbessern die Lesbarkeit des Codes im Vergleich zu manuellen Berechnungen oder Funktionsbausteinaufrufen für einfache mathematische Operationen.
keywords: math, ABS, CEIL, FLOOR, TRUNC, rounding, absolute value

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking-Container mit einem TextEdit-Control, das die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt. Ein Timer soll die Anzeige alle 10 Sekunden mit zufälligen Flugdaten aktualisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer`, `cl_gui_docking_container`, `cl_gui_textedit` und lesen Sie Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` mit `SELECT SINGLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_timer_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS start_flight_display
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE syrepid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sydynnr.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_textedit          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_timer             TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS get_random_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_flight_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_timer_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_flight_display.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid                       = iv_repid
        dynnr                       = iv_dynnr
        side                        = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension                   = 350
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                      = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Docking-Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent                      = mo_docking_container
        wordwrap_mode               = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_windowborder
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                      = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des TextEdit-Controls' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 10. " 10 seconds
    mo_timer->run( ).
    MESSAGE 'Flugdaten-Anzeige gestartet.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    DATA(lv_flight_info) = get_random_flight_data( ).
    mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( lv_flight_info ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_random_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_carrid TYPE TABLE OF sflight-carrid, 
          lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, 
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_carrid UP TO 100 ROWS.
    IF lt_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Zufällige Auswahl eines Fluganbieters
      DATA(lv_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 1 max = lines( lt_carrid ) )->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_carrid INDEX lv_random_index INTO lv_carrid.

      " Zufälligen Flug für den ausgewählten Anbieter finden
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_flight_info = |Flug: { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }\n|
                       && |Von: { ls_sflight-cityfrom } Nach: { ls_sflight-cityto }\n|
                       && |Datum: { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER } Preis: { ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency }|.
      ELSE.
        rv_flight_info = 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_flight_info = 'Keine Fluganbieter in SFLIGHT gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_display_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_random_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_display_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_timer_display( ).
    lo_cut->start_flight_display( iv_repid = sy-repid iv_dynnr = sy-dynnr ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_random_flight_data.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_flight_info msg = 'Flugdaten sollten nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_flight_info exp = 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' msg = 'Sollte Flugdaten finden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die dynamische Anzeige von Daten aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle in einem `cl_gui_textedit`-Control, das in einem `cl_gui_docking_container` eingebettet ist. Ein `cl_gui_timer` aktualisiert die Anzeige regelmäßig mit neuen, zufällig ausgewählten Flugdaten. Moderne Features wie String-Templates und `cl_abap_random_int` werden verwendet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) und lesen Sie einen Eintrag über den Primärschlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORTED TABLE` und `TABLE LINE` oder `VALUE #` für die Initialisierung und den Tabellenausdruck `[...]` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    rs_flight = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '250.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_basic( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      EXPORTING
        x_class = 'CX_SY_READ_SRC_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
      CHANGING
        act     = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SORTED TABLE` mit einem `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle immer sortiert ist und der Zugriff über den Primärschlüssel extrem performant ist. Die `VALUE #` Syntax ermöglicht eine kompakte Initialisierung, und der Tabellenausdruck `lt_sflights[...]` bietet einen modernen und prägnanten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, Table Expression, VALUE, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers aus einer sortierten Tabelle und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit nur den Flugnummern und Preisen, wobei der Preis um 10% erhöht wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` innerhalb eines `VALUE #` Konstruktors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_and_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_transformed_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_raw_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    rt_flight_info = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( connid = ls_flight-connid
        new_price = ls_flight-price * '1.10' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_transform FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_transform.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_transformed_flights( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-new_price exp = '110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-new_price exp = '121.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_transformed_flights( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE`-Klausel und der `VALUE #` Konstruktor ermöglichen eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und wartungsfreundlicher als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ...` Konstrukte.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Functional Programming, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers aus einer sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einem `SORTED` Table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_raw_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ) )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '360.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum_price`) und wendet dann eine Operation auf jedes Element der gefilterten Tabelle an, um das Endergebnis zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue sortierte Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert enthält, basierend auf einer vorhandenen sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_raw_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_raw_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    rt_expensive_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( '120.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-price exp = '300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine sehr elegante und performante Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die eine Teilmenge der ursprünglichen Tabelle darstellt, basierend auf einer bestimmten Bedingung. Da die Quelltabelle `SORTED` ist, bleibt die Sortierung in der Ergebnistabelle erhalten.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, FILTER, Functional Programming, Sub-table

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Carrier und berechnen Sie für jeden Carrier die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Verwenden Sie eine sortierte Tabelle als Quelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `COND` für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             avg_price     TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_raw_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ).

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_group_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        avg_price = COND #( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_flight_count ELSE '0.00' )
      ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings (z.B. Zeilen einer CSV-Datei) in ein XSTRING-Format, das als Anhang einer E-Mail gesendet werden kann. Verwenden Sie dabei eine bestimmte Kodierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` in einer Schleife oder `cl_bcs_convert=>xtab_to_xstring` für Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_convert_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_string_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_string
        iv_codepage TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT '4103' " Default UTF-8
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_convert_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_xstring.
    DATA: lt_binary_content TYPE solix_tab.

    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      APPEND cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
        iv_string = lv_string
        iv_codepage = iv_codepage
      ) TO lt_binary_content.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Concatenate all xstrings into one if needed, or handle as multiple parts
    " For simplicity, we'll just return the first one or concatenate if it's a single line
    IF lines( lt_binary_content ) = 1.
      rv_xstring = lt_binary_content[ 1 ].
    ELSEIF lines( lt_binary_content ) > 1.
      " For multiple lines, a more robust concatenation or handling as multiple parts is needed.
      " For this example, we'll simulate concatenation by joining with newline and then converting.
      DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR lv_line IN it_strings
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN lv_line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && lv_line )
      ).
      rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
        iv_string = lv_concatenated_string
        iv_codepage = iv_codepage
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_from_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS create_csv_xstring_from_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_from_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_csv_xstring_from_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_raw_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv_header) = 'Carrier,Connection,FlightDate,Price'.
    DATA(lv_csv_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
               |{ ls_flight-carrid },{ ls_flight-connid },{ ls_flight-fldate },{ ls_flight-price }|
    ).

    rv_csv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string = lv_csv_content
      iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) und aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #` mit `FOR` und `COND` für die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    rt_updated_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid AND
                     ls_flight-connid = iv_connid AND
                     ls_flight-fldate = iv_fldate
                THEN VALUE ty_sflight( ls_flight EXCEPT price ) price = iv_new_price
                ELSE ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_update( ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_new_price = '275.00'
    ).

    DATA(ls_flight) = lt_updated[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '275.00' ).

    DATA(ls_other_flight) = lt_updated[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_other_flight-price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_update( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_update=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = 'XX'
      iv_connid = '9999'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_new_price = '500.00'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_updated ) exp = 4 ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lt_updated[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '100.00' ).

explanation: Die Aktualisierung von Einträgen in einer internen Tabelle kann mit `FOR` und `COND` in einem `VALUE #` Konstruktor deklarativ erfolgen. Hier wird eine neue Tabelle erstellt, wobei der zu aktualisierende Eintrag mit `VALUE ty_sflight( ls_flight EXCEPT price ) price = iv_new_price` modifiziert wird, während alle anderen Einträge unverändert übernommen werden. Dies ist ein funktionaler Ansatz, der die ursprüngliche Tabelle nicht direkt ändert.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache In-Memory-Cache-Logik, die prüft, ob ein Eintrag noch gültig ist (z.B. nicht älter als 5 Minuten).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` für Zeitstempel-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_cache_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key       TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    PRIVATE SECTION.
      CLASS-DATA gt_cache TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
      CONSTANTS: gc_cache_validity_seconds TYPE i VALUE 300. " 5 minutes

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_cache_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string.

    METHODS get_cache_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS is_cache_entry_valid
      IMPORTING
        iv_key        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_cache_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_cache_entry.
    DATA(ls_entry) = VALUE ty_cache_entry(
      key       = iv_key
      value     = iv_value
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( )
    ).
    MODIFY gt_cache FROM ls_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_cache_entry.
    READ TABLE gt_cache INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY key = iv_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND is_cache_entry_valid( iv_key = iv_key ) = abap_true.
      rv_value = ls_entry-value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_cache_entry_valid.
    READ TABLE gt_cache INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY key = iv_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
      DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( ts1 = lv_current_timestamp ts2 = ls_entry-timestamp ).
      IF lv_diff_seconds <= gc_cache_validity_seconds.
        rb_is_valid = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    " In a real test, one might mock cl_abap_tstmp or use a test double.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cache->is_cache_entry_valid( 'EXPIRED_KEY' ) ).

Instructions: Erweitern Sie die Cache-Logik, um Daten aus einer simulierten Quelle abzurufen und den Cache zu aktualisieren, wenn ein Eintrag ungültig oder nicht vorhanden ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie optionale Parameter und eine Methode zur Datenbeschaffung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cache_with_fallback DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key       TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    PRIVATE SECTION:
      CLASS-DATA gt_cache TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
      CONSTANTS: gc_cache_validity_seconds TYPE i VALUE 60. " 1 minute for demo

    METHODS get_data_from_source
      IMPORTING
        iv_key        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_or_load_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_key        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.

    METHODS invalidate_cache_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_with_fallback IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_source.
    " Simulate a slow data source
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    rv_data = |Data for { iv_key } from source at { cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_or_load_data.
    DATA: ls_entry TYPE ty_cache_entry.

    READ TABLE gt_cache INTO ls_entry WITH KEY key = iv_key.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
      DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( ts1 = lv_current_timestamp ts2 = ls_entry-timestamp ).
      IF lv_diff_seconds <= gc_cache_validity_seconds.
        rv_data = ls_entry-value.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Cache miss or expired, load from source and update cache
    rv_data = get_data_from_source( iv_key ).
    ls_entry = VALUE ty_cache_entry(
      key       = iv_key
      value     = rv_data
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( )
    ).
    MODIFY gt_cache FROM ls_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD invalidate_cache_entry.
    DELETE TABLE gt_cache WITH KEY key = iv_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_or_load_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cache_invalidation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_or_load_data.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_cache_with_fallback( ).
    DATA(lv_data1) = lo_cache->get_or_load_data( 'ITEM_A' ).
    DATA(lv_data2) = lo_cache->get_or_load_data( 'ITEM_A' ). " Should be from cache

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_data1 exp = lv_data2 ).

    " Simulate time passing for cache expiration (not directly testable without mocking time)
    " For a real test, one would mock cl_abap_tstmp or use a test double.
    " Here, we just ensure the initial caching works.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cache_invalidation.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_cache_with_fallback( ).
    DATA(lv_data1) = lo_cache->get_or_load_data( 'ITEM_B' ).
    lo_cache->invalidate_cache_entry( 'ITEM_B' ).
    DATA(lv_data2) = lo_cache->get_or_load_data( 'ITEM_B' ). " Should be reloaded

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_data1 exp = lv_data2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Klasse implementiert eine 'Cache-aside'-Strategie. Wenn Daten angefordert werden, wird zuerst der Cache geprüft. Ist der Eintrag nicht vorhanden oder abgelaufen, werden die Daten von einer (simulierten) Quelle geladen und der Cache aktualisiert. `WAIT UP TO` simuliert eine langsame Datenquelle. `cl_abap_tstmp` wird für die Zeitstempelverwaltung verwendet.
keywords: Caching, Fallback, cl_abap_tstmp, Data Retrieval, Cache Invalidation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Cache-Einträgen, um nur die gültigen Einträge zu erhalten, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. Schlüssel beginnt mit 'A').

solution:
CLASS zcl_cache_filter_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key       TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    TYPES: tt_cache_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    PRIVATE SECTION.
      CLASS-DATA gt_cache TYPE tt_cache_entries.
      CONSTANTS: gc_cache_validity_seconds TYPE i VALUE 300.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string.

    METHODS get_filtered_valid_entries
      IMPORTING
        iv_key_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_entries) TYPE tt_cache_entries.

    METHODS is_entry_valid
      IMPORTING
        is_entry      TYPE ty_cache_entry
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_filter_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    DATA(ls_entry) = VALUE ty_cache_entry(
      key       = iv_key
      value     = iv_value
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( )
    ).
    MODIFY gt_cache FROM ls_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_entry_valid.
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( ts1 = lv_current_timestamp ts2 = is_entry-timestamp ).
    IF lv_diff_seconds <= gc_cache_validity_seconds.
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_valid_entries.
    rt_filtered_entries = FILTER gt_cache
      WHERE ( key CP iv_key_prefix && '*' AND is_entry_valid( table_line ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_valid_entries FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_valid_entries.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_cache_filter_demo( ).
    lo_cache->add_entry( iv_key = 'APPLE' iv_value = 'Red' ).
    lo_cache->add_entry( iv_key = 'APRICOT' iv_value = 'Orange' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[2]-key exp = 'APRICOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Hier wird er verwendet, um Einträge nach einem Schlüsselpräfix und ihrer Gültigkeit zu filtern, wobei die Gültigkeitsprüfung in einer separaten Methode gekapselt ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode zur vollständigen Invalidierung eines Caches, die von einem externen Ereignis (z.B. Datenänderung) ausgelöst werden könnte.
hint: Eine einfache `CLEAR` oder `DELETE` Operation auf der internen Tabelle ist ausreichend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cache_invalidation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key       TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    TYPES: tt_cache_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    PRIVATE SECTION.
      CLASS-DATA gt_cache TYPE tt_cache_entries.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string.

    METHODS get_entry_count
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS invalidate_all_cache.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_invalidation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    DATA(ls_entry) = VALUE ty_cache_entry(
      key       = iv_key
      value     = iv_value
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( )
    ).
    MODIFY gt_cache FROM ls_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_entry_count.
    rv_count = lines( gt_cache ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD invalidate_all_cache.
    CLEAR gt_cache.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalidate_all_cache FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalidate_all_cache.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_cache_invalidation( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Cache, der benutzerspezifische Einstellungen speichert. Der Cache-Schlüssel soll dynamisch aus dem Benutzernamen und einem Einstellungstyp gebildet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_syst=>get_uname()` und String-Templates für die Schlüsselbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_user_settings_cache DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_setting_entry,
             key       TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_setting_entry.
    TYPES: tt_setting_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_setting_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    PRIVATE SECTION.
      CLASS-DATA gt_user_settings_cache TYPE tt_setting_entries.
      CONSTANTS: gc_cache_validity_seconds TYPE i VALUE 3600. " 1 hour

    METHODS get_cache_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_setting_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_key)   TYPE string.

    METHODS is_entry_valid
      IMPORTING
        is_entry      TYPE ty_setting_entry
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_user_setting
      IMPORTING
        iv_setting_type TYPE string
        iv_value        TYPE string.

    METHODS get_user_setting
      IMPORTING
        iv_setting_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS clear_user_setting
      IMPORTING
        iv_setting_type TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_user_settings_cache IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cache_key.
    DATA(lv_username) = cl_abap_syst=>get_uname( ).
    rv_key = |{ lv_username }-{ iv_setting_type }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_entry_valid.
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( ts1 = lv_current_timestamp ts2 = is_entry-timestamp ).
    IF lv_diff_seconds <= gc_cache_validity_seconds.
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_user_setting.
    DATA(lv_key) = get_cache_key( iv_setting_type ).
    DATA(ls_entry) = VALUE ty_setting_entry(
      key       = lv_key
      value     = iv_value
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( )
    ).
    MODIFY gt_user_settings_cache FROM ls_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_user_setting.
    DATA(lv_key) = get_cache_key( iv_setting_type ).
    READ TABLE gt_user_settings_cache INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY key = lv_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND is_entry_valid( ls_entry ) = abap_true.
      rv_value = ls_entry-value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD clear_user_setting.
    DATA(lv_key) = get_cache_key( iv_setting_type ).
    DELETE TABLE gt_user_settings_cache WITH KEY key = lv_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    lo_cache->set_user_setting( iv_setting_type = 'THEME' iv_value = 'Dark' ).
    lo_cache->set_user_setting( iv_setting_type = 'LANGUAGE' iv_value = 'EN' ).
