Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Cache, der eine maximale Anzahl von Einträgen nicht überschreitet (Least Recently Used - LRU-ähnlich).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle und logische Operationen, um alte Einträge zu entfernen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lru_cache_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key       TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
             access_ts TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    TYPES: tt_cache_entries TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    PRIVATE SECTION.
      CLASS-DATA gt_cache TYPE tt_cache_entries.
      CONSTANTS: gc_max_cache_size TYPE i VALUE 3.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string.

    METHODS get_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_current_size
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_size) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lru_cache_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_entry.
    DATA(ls_new_entry) = VALUE ty_cache_entry(
      key       = iv_key
      value     = iv_value
      access_ts = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( )
    ).

    " Update existing entry or add new one
    MODIFY TABLE gt_cache FROM ls_new_entry.

    " If cache size exceeds limit, remove oldest (least recently used)
    IF lines( gt_cache ) > gc_max_cache_size.
      DATA(lt_sorted_by_ts) = SORTED gt_cache BY access_ts ASCENDING.
      DELETE gt_cache INDEX 1. " Remove the oldest entry
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_entry.
    READ TABLE gt_cache INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY key = iv_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = ls_entry-value.
      " Update access timestamp to mark as recently used
      ls_entry-access_ts = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
      MODIFY gt_cache FROM ls_entry.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_size.
    rv_size = lines( gt_cache ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_lru_cache_behavior FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lru_cache_behavior.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_lru_cache_demo( ).

    lo_cache->set_entry( iv_key = 'A' iv_value = 'ValA' ).
    lo_cache->set_entry( iv_key = 'B' iv_value = 'ValB' ).
    lo_cache->set_entry( iv_key = 'C' iv_value = 'ValC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cache->get_current_size( ) exp = 3 ).

    " Access A to make it recently used
    DATA(lv_val_a) = lo_cache->get_entry( 'A' ).

    " Add D, B should be removed (oldest after A was accessed)
    lo_cache->set_entry( iv_key = 'D' iv_value = 'ValD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cache->get_current_size( ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cache->get_entry( 'B' ) ). " B should be gone
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cache->get_entry( 'A' ) exp = 'ValA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cache->get_entry( 'C' ) exp = 'ValC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cache->get_entry( 'D' ) exp = 'ValD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert einen einfachen LRU-Cache (Least Recently Used). Wenn der Cache seine maximale Größe erreicht, wird der am längsten nicht verwendete Eintrag entfernt. `cl_abap_tstmp` wird verwendet, um den Zugriffszeitstempel zu verfolgen. `SORTED` und `DELETE INDEX` sind effiziente Operationen für interne Tabellen.
keywords: Caching, LRU, Internal Tables, Sorted Table, cl_abap_tstmp

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Cache, der eine 'Cache-Hit'-Rate verfolgt und diese Information bereitstellt.
hint: Fügen Sie Zähler für Cache-Zugriffe und Treffer hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cache_hit_rate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
             key       TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_entry.
    TYPES: tt_cache_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    PRIVATE SECTION.
      CLASS-DATA gt_cache TYPE tt_cache_entries.
      CLASS-DATA gv_hits  TYPE i.
      CLASS-DATA gv_accesses TYPE i.
      CONSTANTS: gc_cache_validity_seconds TYPE i VALUE 60.

    METHODS is_entry_valid
      IMPORTING
        is_entry      TYPE ty_cache_entry
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string.

    METHODS get_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_hit_rate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hit_rate) TYPE f.

    METHODS reset_statistics.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_hit_rate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_entry_valid.
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( ts1 = lv_current_timestamp ts2 = is_entry-timestamp ).
    IF lv_diff_seconds <= gc_cache_validity_seconds.
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_entry.
    DATA(ls_entry) = VALUE ty_cache_entry(
      key       = iv_key
      value     = iv_value
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( )
    ).
    MODIFY gt_cache FROM ls_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_entry.
    gv_accesses = gv_accesses + 1.
    READ TABLE gt_cache INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY key = iv_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND is_entry_valid( ls_entry ) = abap_true.
      gv_hits = gv_hits + 1.
      rv_value = ls_entry-value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_hit_rate.
    IF gv_accesses > 0.
      rv_hit_rate = gv_hits / gv_accesses.
    ELSE.
      rv_hit_rate = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reset_statistics.
    gv_hits = 0.
    gv_accesses = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hit_rate_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_hit_rate_reset FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hit_rate_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_cache_hit_rate( ).
    lo_cache->reset_statistics( ).

    lo_cache->set_entry( iv_key = 'DATA1' iv_value = 'Value1' ).
    lo_cache->set_entry( iv_key = 'DATA2' iv_value = 'Value2' ).

    DATA(lv_val1) = lo_cache->get_entry( 'DATA1' ). " Hit
    DATA(lv_val_miss) = lo_cache->get_entry( 'DATA3' ). " Miss
    DATA(lv_val2) = lo_cache->get_entry( 'DATA2' ). " Hit

    DATA(lv_hit_rate) = lo_cache->get_hit_rate( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hit_rate exp = 2.0 / 3.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hit_rate_reset.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_cache_hit_rate( ).
    lo_cache->set_entry( iv_key = 'DATA4' iv_value = 'Value4' ).
    DATA(lv_val4) = lo_cache->get_entry( 'DATA4' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cache->get_hit_rate( ) exp = 1.0 ).

    lo_cache->reset_statistics( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cache->get_hit_rate( ) exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Cache-Logik um die Verfolgung der 'Cache-Hit'-Rate. Zähler für Zugriffe und Treffer werden geführt, um die Effizienz des Caches zu bewerten. Die Berechnung der Rate erfolgt modern mit Fließkommazahlen. `cl_abap_tstmp` wird weiterhin für die Gültigkeitsprüfung verwendet.
keywords: Caching, Hit Rate, Statistics, Performance, cl_abap_tstmp

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt von Dezimalzahlen in einer internen Tabelle und runde das Ergebnis auf zwei Nachkommastellen.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` für die Summe und `DIVIDE` oder arithmetische Ausdrücke mit `DECFLOAT`.

CLASS zcl_num_average_dec DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_dec_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_average IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_dec_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_average_dec IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
      rv_average = round( val = rv_average dec = 2 ). " Explizites Runden auf 2 Nachkommastellen
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Fakultät einer gegebenen Zahl rekursiv unter Verwendung eines funktionalen Ansatzes.
hint: Verwende eine lokale Methode mit `RESULT` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Input must be non-negative'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 
      COND i( WHEN iv_number = 0 THEN 1
              WHEN iv_number = 1 THEN 1
              ELSE iv_number * calculate_factorial( iv_number - 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Sekunden zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln unter Verwendung der XCO Time API (`XCO_CP_TIME`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `XCO_CP_TIME=>TIMESTAMP` um Zeitstempel-Objekte zu erstellen und die Methode `GET_DIFFERENCE_IN_SECONDS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_time_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_diff_in_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_diff_in_seconds.
    DATA(lo_timestamp1) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_timestamp2) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp2 ).
    rv_seconds = lo_timestamp1->get_difference_in_seconds( lo_timestamp2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_time_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_time_difference.
    DATA(lv_timestamp1) = '20251122100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_timestamp2) = '20251122100100.0000000'. " 1 Minute später

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_time_difference( ).
    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_cut->calculate_diff_in_seconds(
      iv_timestamp1 = lv_timestamp1
      iv_timestamp2 = lv_timestamp2
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Differenz sollte 60 Sekunden betragen.' act = lv_diff exp = 60 ).

    DATA(lv_timestamp3) = '20251122100100.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_timestamp4) = '20251122100000.0000000'. " 1 Minute früher
    lv_diff = lo_cut->calculate_diff_in_seconds(
      iv_timestamp1 = lv_timestamp3
      iv_timestamp2 = lv_timestamp4
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Differenz sollte -60 Sekunden betragen.' act = lv_diff exp = -60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und robuster als manuelle Berechnungen.
keywords: Zeit, Zeitstempel, Differenz, XCO, XCO_CP_TIME

CLASS zcl_xco_time_add_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_minutes_to_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_minutes   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_add_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_minutes_to_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_timestamp) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp ).

    DATA(lo_new_timestamp) = lo_timestamp->add( lo_duration ).

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch in JSON, wobei nur eine bestimmte Auswahl von Feldern berücksichtigt wird. Verwenden Sie hierfür die Klasse `/UI2/CL_JSON` in Kombination mit RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (z.B. `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) um die Struktur dynamisch zu manipulieren oder die Optionen von `/UI2/CL_JSON` zur Feldselektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_dynamic_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_data         TYPE tt_sflight
        it_field_names  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_dynamic_fields.
    DATA lo_json_writer TYPE REF TO /ui2/cl_json.
    DATA lo_data_ref    TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any TABLE.

    CREATE DATA lo_data_ref LIKE it_data.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_data>.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_line>).
      DATA ls_filtered_line TYPE REF TO data.
      CREATE DATA ls_filtered_line TYPE zcl_json_dynamic_serialize=>ty_sflight.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_filtered_line> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN ls_filtered_line->* TO <fs_filtered_line>.

      LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_field_name>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_source_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_filtered_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_target_field>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_filtered_line> TO <fs_data>.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_json_writer = /ui2/cl_json=>create( ).
    lo_json_writer->set_pretty_print( abap_true ).
    lo_json_writer->serialize( EXPORTING data = <fs_data> IMPORTING json = rv_json_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_serialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_serialization.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_json_dynamic_serialize=>tt_sflight,
          lt_fields  TYPE string_table.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 1 ROWS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Es sollten Flugdaten ausgewählt werden.' act = lt_sflight ).

    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_fields.
    APPEND 'CONNID' TO lt_fields.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_serialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_dynamic_fields( it_data = lt_sflight it_field_names = lt_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON-String sollte nicht leer sein.' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON sollte CARRID enthalten.' substring = 'CARRID' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON sollte CONNID enthalten.' substring = 'CONNID' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'JSON sollte FLDATE NICHT enthalten.' substring = 'FLDATE' in_string = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine dynamische JSON-Serialisierung, bei der nur ausgewählte Felder einer internen Tabelle in den JSON-Output aufgenommen werden. Dies wird durch die dynamische Erstellung einer temporären Datenstruktur erreicht, die nur die gewünschten Felder enthält, bevor `/UI2/CL_JSON` zur Serialisierung aufgerufen wird. Dies ist nützlich für APIs, die nur spezifische Datenfelder benötigen, und reduziert die Größe der Payload.
keywords: JSON, Serialisierung, Dynamisch, RTTI, Feldselektion, /UI2/CL_JSON

CLASS zcl_xco_time_subtract_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

        iv_hours     TYPE i

CLASS zcl_xco_time_subtract_duration IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_new_timestamp) = lo_timestamp->subtract( lo_duration ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den ersten Tag des nächsten Monats für ein gegebenes Datum unter Verwendung der XCO Time API (`XCO_CP_TIME`).

solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_time_next_month_start DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_day_of_next_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE dats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_month_start) TYPE dats.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_next_month_start IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_day_of_next_month.
    DATA(lo_date) = xco_cp_time=>date( iv_date ).
    DATA(lo_end_of_current_month) = lo_date->get_end_of_month( ).
    DATA(lo_duration_one_day) = xco_cp_time=>duration( )->set_days( 1 ).
    DATA(lo_first_day_next_month) = lo_end_of_current_month->add( lo_duration_one_day ).
    rv_next_month_start = lo_first_day_next_month->get_value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erster Tag des nächsten Monats (Nov) stimmt nicht überein.' act = lv_result1 exp = lv_expected1 ).

    DATA(lv_date2) = '20240131'.

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->get_first_day_of_next_month( lv_date2 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert mehrere Funktionen der XCO Time API, um den ersten Tag des nächsten Monats zu berechnen. Zuerst wird das Monatsende mit `get_end_of_month()` ermittelt, und dann wird mit `ADD` eine Dauer von einem Tag hinzugefügt. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit der API, komplexe Datumslogik durch Verkettung einfacher, lesbarer Operationen zu lösen.
keywords: Datum, Nächster Monat, XCO, XCO_CP_TIME, Datumsberechnung

CLASS zcl_oxml_read_cell DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_cell
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_sheet_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_sheet_index TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_column TYPE string
        iv_row TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_openxml_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oxml_read_cell IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_cell.
    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = cl_openxml_helper=>factory( iv_xstring ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = COND #( WHEN iv_sheet_name IS NOT INITIAL THEN lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_name( iv_sheet_name )
                             WHEN iv_sheet_index IS NOT INITIAL THEN lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_index( iv_sheet_index )
                             ELSE lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ) ).
    rv_value = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_column = iv_column ip_row = iv_row ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie Daten in eine spezifische Zelle (z.B. 'B2') einer im Speicher befindlichen XLSX-Datei und geben Sie die geänderte Datei als XSTRING zurück.

CLASS zcl_oxml_write_cell DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_oxml_write_cell IMPLEMENTATION.

      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'C' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).

    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_oxml_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_excel_row,
           ty_excel_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sheet_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_sheet_index TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_excel_table
      RAISING
        cx_openxml_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oxml_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sheet_to_table.
    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = cl_openxml_helper=>factory( iv_xstring ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = COND #( WHEN iv_sheet_index IS NOT INITIAL THEN lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_index( iv_sheet_index )
                             ELSE lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ) ).

    DATA(lv_max_row) = lo_sheet->get_max_row( ).
    DATA(lv_max_col) = lo_sheet->get_max_column( ).

    LOOP AT cl_abap_int_tools=>get_range( low = 1 high = lv_max_row ) INTO DATA(lv_row).
      DATA(ls_row) = VALUE ty_excel_row( ).
      ls_row-col1 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_column = 'A' ip_row = lv_row ).
      ls_row-col2 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_column = 'B' ip_row = lv_row ).
      ls_row-col3 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_column = 'C' ip_row = lv_row ).
      APPEND ls_row TO rt_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oxml_update_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_cell_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_search_column TYPE string
        iv_search_value TYPE string
        iv_update_column TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string
        iv_sheet_index TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_openxml_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oxml_update_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_cell_conditionally.
    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = cl_openxml_helper=>factory( iv_xstring ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = COND #( WHEN iv_sheet_index IS NOT INITIAL THEN lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_index( iv_sheet_index )
                             ELSE lo_spreadsheet->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ) ).

    DATA(lv_max_row) = lo_sheet->get_max_row( ).

    LOOP AT cl_abap_int_tools=>get_range( low = 1 high = lv_max_row ) INTO DATA(lv_row).
      DATA(lv_current_search_value) = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_column = iv_search_column ip_row = lv_row ).
      IF lv_current_search_value = iv_search_value.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = iv_update_column ip_row = lv_row ip_value = iv_new_value ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen großen String in Chunks von UTF-8 zu einer anderen Codepage, um Speicher zu sparen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in` und `create_out` mit `read` und `write` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_chunked DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_chunked
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_source_encoding TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE string
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i DEFAULT 1024
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_target_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_chunked IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_chunked.
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in( encoding = iv_source_encoding ).
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = iv_target_encoding ).

    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = xstrlen( iv_source_string ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_buffer) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_chunk_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_chunk_string) TYPE string.

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length.
      lv_chunk_string = iv_source_string+lv_offset(iv_chunk_size).
      lo_conv_in->write( EXPORTING data = lv_chunk_string IMPORTING buffer = lv_chunk_xstring ).
      lv_xstring_buffer = lv_xstring_buffer && lv_chunk_xstring.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + iv_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.

    lo_conv_out->read( EXPORTING data = lv_xstring_buffer IMPORTING buffer = rv_target_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_table_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
        length TYPE i,
      END OF ty_component_info,
      ty_component_info_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_structure
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE ty_component_info_tab.

CLASS zcl_rtt_table_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_structure.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
    DATA(lo_line_type_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_line_type_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(ls_info) = VALUE ty_component_info(
        name   = ls_component-name
        type   = ls_component-type_descr->type_kind
        length = ls_component-type_descr->length
      ).
      APPEND ls_info TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_test_interface.

CLASS zcl_implementer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_test_interface.

CLASS zcl_implementer IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Dummy implementation

      IF ls_interface_descr->name = iv_interface_name.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Paginierungsfunktion für die Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, die jeweils eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeilen zurückgibt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in Methoden für die Paginierungslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_page,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        planetype TYPE s_planety,
      END OF ty_sflight_page,
      ty_sflight_page_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_page WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS open_flight_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL.
    METHODS fetch_next_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_page_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_page_data) TYPE ty_sflight_page_tab.
    METHODS close_flight_cursor.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA mv_is_cursor_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CLEAR mv_cursor.
    mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD open_flight_cursor.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_carrier IS NOT INITIAL.
      OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD mv_cursor FOR
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
          FROM sflight
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
          ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.
    ELSE.
      OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD mv_cursor FOR
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
          FROM sflight
          ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.
    ENDIF.
    mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fetch_next_page.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    FETCH NEXT CURSOR mv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_page_data UP TO iv_page_size ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD close_flight_cursor.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
      mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_db_dynamic_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_dyn,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_db_dynamic_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CLEAR mv_cursor.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD open_dynamic_cursor.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_dynamic_where) = COND string( WHEN iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL THEN |WHERE { iv_where_clause }| ELSE '' ).

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD mv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight
        { lv_dynamic_where }
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR mv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_page_data UP TO iv_page_size ROWS.

  METHOD close_dynamic_cursor.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
      mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie paginiert Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` und aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft für jede Seite.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und anschließend `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_raw,
      ty_sflight_raw_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrier_count,
      ty_carrier_count_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS open_flight_cursor.
    METHODS fetch_and_aggregate_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_page_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE ty_carrier_count_tab.
    METHODS close_flight_cursor.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA mv_is_cursor_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CLEAR mv_cursor.
    mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD open_flight_cursor.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD mv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fetch_and_aggregate_page.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_raw_page) TYPE ty_sflight_raw_tab.
    FETCH NEXT CURSOR mv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_raw_page UP TO iv_page_size ROWS.

    IF lt_raw_page IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_aggregated_data = VALUE ty_carrier_count_tab(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_page GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD close_flight_cursor.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
      mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie paginiert Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` und aktualisieren Sie für die gelesenen Datensätze ein Feld in der Datenbank.
hint: `FETCH NEXT` zum Lesen, dann `UPDATE` mit den gelesenen Schlüsseln. Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN` für die Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      ty_sflight_key_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS open_flight_cursor.
    METHODS fetch_and_update_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_page_size TYPE i
        iv_new_planetype TYPE s_planety
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
    METHODS close_flight_cursor.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA mv_is_cursor_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CLEAR mv_cursor.
    mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD open_flight_cursor.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD mv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fetch_and_update_page.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_keys_to_update) TYPE ty_sflight_key_tab.
    FETCH NEXT CURSOR mv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_keys_to_update UP TO iv_page_size ROWS.

    IF lt_keys_to_update IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflight SET planetype = @iv_new_planetype
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_keys_to_update
        WHERE carrid = @lt_keys_to_update-carrid
          AND connid = @lt_keys_to_update-connid
          AND fldate = @lt_keys_to_update-fldate.
      rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD close_flight_cursor.
    IF mv_is_cursor_open = abap_true.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
      mv_is_cursor_open = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

          ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' )

        )

    ENDIF.

    " Rollback changes made by test
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' OR carrid = 'YY'.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE mt_original_sflight.
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 2 msg = 'Should update 2 rows' ).

    " Verify update
    DATA(lt_check) TYPE zcl_db_fetch_update=>ty_sflight_key_tab.

    DATA(ls_first_updated_key) = lt_check[ 1 ].
    DATA(ls_second_updated_key) = lt_check[ 2 ].

    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_planetype2)
      WHERE carrid = ls_second_updated_key-carrid
        AND connid = ls_second_updated_key-connid
        AND fldate = ls_second_updated_key-fldate.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer beliebigen Anzahl von Spalten und füllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_data()` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` in Kombination mit Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_column_def,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
        length TYPE i,
      END OF ty_column_def,
      ty_column_def_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table_with_cols
      IMPORTING
        it_column_definitions TYPE ty_column_def_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table_with_cols.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_column_definitions INTO DATA(ls_col_def).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( ls_col_def-type ).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_col_def-name
        type = lo_type_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

    " Fill with example data
    LOOP AT it_column_definitions INTO ls_col_def.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_col_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CASE ls_col_def-type.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
            <fs_field> = |{ ls_col_def-name }_Value|.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
            <fs_field> = sy-tabix * 10.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Handle other types or leave initial
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

    " Add another row
    CREATE DATA lr_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.
    LOOP AT it_column_definitions INTO ls_col_def.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_col_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CASE ls_col_def-type.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
            <fs_field> = |Another_{ ls_col_def-name }|.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
            <fs_field> = sy-tabix * 20.
          WHEN OTHERS.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      ( name = 'COL_A' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char length = 10 )
      ( name = 'COL_B' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int length = 4 )

CLASS zcl_db_select_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        fldate TYPE s_date,
        price TYPE s_price,

      IMPORTING

        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_db_select_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_filtered_tab.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` und transformieren Sie diese in eine neue interne Tabelle, wobei Sie nur bestimmte Felder auswählen und ein neues berechnetes Feld hinzufügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)` und anschließend `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_select_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
        carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
        connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_date TYPE s_date,
        is_expensive TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_sflight_transformed,
      ty_sflight_transformed_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price_for_expensive TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_transformed_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_select_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_raw_flights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE ty_sflight_transformed_tab(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_raw_flights
      ( carrier_id    = ls_flight-carrid,
        connection_id = ls_flight-connid,
        flight_date   = ls_flight-fldate,
        is_expensive  = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight-price >= iv_min_price_for_expensive THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch setzt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `cl_abap_datadescr` für die Typüberprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_dynamic_set_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        io_structure TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_dynamic_set_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_structure->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          " Dynamische Zuweisung mit Typkonvertierung
          <fs_field> = iv_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Fehlerbehandlung bei Typkonvertierung
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
              message = |Conversion error for field { iv_field_name } with value { iv_value }|.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_dynamic_set_field( ).

    lo_cut->set_field_value( io_structure = lr_test_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_value = 'Any' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_test_data-field_char exp = 'Initial' msg = 'Should not modify existing fields' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE ty_data( field_char = 'Initial' field_int = 0 ).
    DATA(lr_test_data) = REF #( ls_test_data ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_dynamic_set_field( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>raise_exception(

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` und erstellen Sie eine Map (Hash-Tabelle), die Fluggesellschaften auf die Anzahl ihrer Flüge abbildet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)` und anschließend `REDUCE` für die Aggregation in eine Map.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_select_reduce_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_sflight_simple,
      ty_sflight_simple_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: ty_carrier_flight_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_flight_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_select_reduce_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_simple_tab.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_carrier_counts = REDUCE ty_carrier_flight_map(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_carrier_flight_map( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET lv_count = result[ ls_flight-carrid ] THEN
      result = VALUE ty_carrier_flight_map(
        result
        ( key = ls_flight-carrid value = lv_count + 1 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen, die zuvor mit SELECT gefüllt wurde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_prices.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flight_prices.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR ls_price IN lt_flight_prices
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_price-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming some known data in SFLIGHTS for LH
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_price_lh exp = 0 ).
    " A more precise test would require mocking SFLIGHTS or knowing exact sum
    " For example, if we know LH 0400 has price 400 and LH 0401 has price 500, total should be 900

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle eindeutigen Länder, aus denen Flüge starten (Countryfr), und die Länder, in denen Flüge landen (Countryto), aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Kombinieren Sie diese zu einer einzigen Liste eindeutiger Länder.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT DISTINCT für beide Spalten und kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse mit VALUE und FOR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_distinct_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_countries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_country WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_countries RETURNING VALUE(rt_countries) TYPE tt_countries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_distinct_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_countries.
    DATA lt_countryfr TYPE tt_countries.
    DATA lt_countryto TYPE tt_countries.

    SELECT DISTINCT countryfr
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_countryfr.

    SELECT DISTINCT countryto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_countryto.

    rt_countries = VALUE #( FOR country IN lt_countryfr ( country )
                            FOR country IN lt_countryto ( country ) ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_countries.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_countries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_countries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_distinct_union( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_countries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = 'DE' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = 'US' ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    " Check for duplicates after DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_result ).
    SORT lt_result BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_result.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_initial_lines ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man SELECT DISTINCT für verschiedene Spalten verwendet und die Ergebnisse dann mit VALUE und FOR in einer einzigen internen Tabelle zusammenführt. Das anschließende DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES stellt sicher, dass die endgültige Liste wirklich eindeutig ist.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT, VALUE, FOR, SFLIGHTS, Union, Duplicates

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um zufällige Indizes zu generieren und die Tabelle zu mischen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled_table = it_input.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( rt_shuffled_table ).
    IF lv_size <= 1. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = 1 iv_max = lv_size ).

    DO lv_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_rand_idx1) = lo_random_int->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_rand_idx2) = lo_random_int->get_next( ).
      IF lv_rand_idx1 <> lv_rand_idx2.
        SWAP rt_shuffled_table[ lv_rand_idx1 ] WITH rt_shuffled_table[ lv_rand_idx2 ].
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA lt_original TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'A' TO lt_original.
    APPEND 'B' TO lt_original.
    APPEND 'C' TO lt_original.
    APPEND 'D' TO lt_original.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) msg = 'Table size changed' ).
    " Assert that content is the same, but order is likely different
    DATA(lt_sorted_original) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_sorted_original ASCENDING.
    DATA(lt_sorted_shuffled) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled ASCENDING.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled exp = lt_sorted_original msg = 'Content mismatch after shuffle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Mischen einer internen Tabelle ist eine gängige Anforderung. CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT ermöglicht eine effiziente Generierung von Zufallsindizes, um Elemente in der Tabelle zu tauschen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu älteren, oft weniger performanten oder deterministischen Ansätzen.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 10 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT in einer Schleife und prüfen Sie auf Einzigartigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ) OR iv_count < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid count or range'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = iv_min iv_max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line.

    DO.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_new_number INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
      IF lines( lt_temp_numbers ) = iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rt_random_numbers = lt_temp_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_range FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 10 msg = 'Incorrect number of unique random numbers' ).
    DATA(lv_unique_count) = lines( VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line FOR number IN lt_numbers ( number ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_count exp = 10 msg = 'Numbers are not unique' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_numbers( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = NEW zcx_abap_unit_assert( ) exp_class = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR' msg = 'Exception not raised for invalid range' ).
    lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung einer Menge von eindeutigen Zufallszahlen, eine komplexere Anforderung. Die Verwendung einer sortierten Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel (`UNIQUE SORTED KEY`) in Kombination mit CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Duplikate zu vermeiden und die Performance zu optimieren.

CLASS zcl_http_secure_token DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_secure_token
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 32
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_token) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_http_secure_token IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_secure_token.
    DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_char=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_raw_token) TYPE string.

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      lv_raw_token = lv_raw_token && lo_random_char->get_next( ).
    ENDDO.

    rv_token = cl_http_utility=>url_encode( lv_raw_token ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Flugnummer, um die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Passagierkapazität pro Flug zu ermitteln. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und der summierten Kapazität sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_capacity
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_capacity) TYPE tt_flight_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    rt_capacity = VALUE tt_flight_capacity(
      FOR GROUPS OF flights_by_carrid IN lt_sflight GROUP BY flights_by_carrid-carrid
      ( FOR GROUPS OF flights_by_connid IN flights_by_carrid GROUP BY flights_by_connid-connid
        ( carrid = flights_by_carrid-carrid,
          connid = flights_by_connid-connid,
          total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight IN flights_by_connid NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " sflight might be empty in test systems

    " Example for a specific check if sflight has data

      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_entry-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_entry-total_capacity >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Flugdauer jedes Fluges aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in Minuten. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei die Abflug- und Ankunftszeit sowie das Abflug- und Ankunftsdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` und die Methode `SUBTRACT` für die Zeitberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             duration_minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES tt_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_durations
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_durations) TYPE tt_flight_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_durations.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    rt_durations = VALUE tt_flight_duration(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      LET lv_dep_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( date = flight-fldate time = flight-deptime )
          lv_arr_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( date = flight-arrdate time = flight-arrtime )
      IN
        ( carrid = flight-carrid,
          connid = flight-connid,
          fldate = flight-fldate,
          duration_minutes = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( tstmp1 = lv_arr_tstmp tstmp2 = lv_dep_tstmp ) / 60 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_durations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_durations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_duration( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_durations( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " sflight might be empty in test systems

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_entry-duration_minutes >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test with specific values
    DATA(lv_dep_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_dep_time) = '100000'.
    DATA(lv_arr_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_arr_time) = '113000'. " 90 minutes later

    DATA(lv_tstmp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( date = lv_arr_date time = lv_arr_time ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( date = lv_dep_date time = lv_dep_time ).
    DATA(lv_calculated_duration) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( tstmp1 = lv_tstmp1 tstmp2 = lv_tstmp2 ) / 60.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_calculated_duration exp = 90 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>create_tstmp_from_date_time` und `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>subtract` in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `LET`-Ausdrücken. Dies ermöglicht eine funktionale und lesbare Berechnung von Zeitdifferenzen direkt bei der Tabellenkonstruktion, was als modern und effizient gilt.

Instructions: Gegeben sind zwei interne Tabellen mit Flugnummern. Ermitteln Sie alle Flugnummern aus der ersten Tabelle, die nicht in der zweiten Tabelle (bereits verarbeitete Flüge) enthalten sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE NOT line_exists` für eine effiziente Subtraktion von Tabelleninhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unprocessed_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights      TYPE tt_connid
        it_processed_flights TYPE tt_connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_unprocessed) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unprocessed_flights.
    rt_unprocessed = VALUE tt_connid(
      FOR flight_id IN it_all_flights
      WHERE NOT line_exists( it_processed_flights[ table_line = flight_id ] )
      ( flight_id )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_unprocessed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unprocessed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_subtract( ).

    DATA(lt_all) = VALUE zcl_table_subtract=>tt_connid(
      ( '001' ) ( '002' ) ( '003' ) ( '004' ) ( '005' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = VALUE zcl_table_subtract=>tt_connid(
      ( '002' ) ( '004' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_unprocessed) = lo_cut->get_unprocessed_flights( it_all_flights = lt_all it_processed_flights = lt_processed ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unprocessed ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unprocessed[ 1 ] exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unprocessed[ 2 ] exp = '003' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unprocessed[ 3 ] exp = '005' ).

    " Test with empty processed list
    lt_unprocessed = lo_cut->get_unprocessed_flights( it_all_flights = lt_all it_processed_flights = VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unprocessed ) exp = 5 ).

    " Test with all processed
    lt_unprocessed = lo_cut->get_unprocessed_flights( it_all_flights = lt_all it_processed_flights = lt_all ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_unprocessed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die 'Subtraktion' von internen Tabelleninhalten mithilfe eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks in Kombination mit der `WHERE NOT line_exists`-Bedingung. Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Auftrags (z.B. 'Offen', 'Teilweise geliefert', 'Vollständig geliefert', 'Storniert') basierend auf dem Lieferstatus (0=offen, 1=teilweise, 2=vollständig) und einem Stornierungsflag ('X'=storniert, ' '=nicht storniert), unter Verwendung von verschachtelten `COND`-Ausdrücken.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `COND`-Ausdrücke für komplexe bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_delivery_status TYPE i VALUE IS INITIAL.
    TYPES: ty_cancellation_flag TYPE abap_boolean.
    TYPES: ty_order_status TYPE string.

    METHODS get_order_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_delivery_status TYPE ty_delivery_status
        iv_cancellation_flag TYPE ty_cancellation_flag
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_order_status) TYPE ty_order_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_status.
    rv_order_status = COND ty_order_status(
      WHEN iv_cancellation_flag = abap_true THEN 'Storniert'
      WHEN iv_delivery_status = 2 THEN 'Vollständig geliefert'
      WHEN iv_delivery_status = 1 THEN 'Teilweise geliefert'
      WHEN iv_delivery_status = 0 THEN 'Offen'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das verbleibende Budget, nachdem eine Liste von Ausgaben von einem Startbudget abgezogen wurde. Verwenden Sie dabei eine funktionale Herangehensweise.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `SUBTRACT`-Operator für eine kumulative Subtraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_budget_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_expenses TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_budget
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_budget TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
        it_expenses       TYPE tt_expenses
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_remaining_budget) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_budget_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_budget.
    rv_remaining_budget = REDUCE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2(
      INIT budget = iv_initial_budget
      FOR expense IN it_expenses
      NEXT budget = budget - expense
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_remaining_budget FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_remaining_budget.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_budget_subtract( ).

    DATA(lt_expenses1) = VALUE zcl_budget_subtract=>tt_expenses(
      ( '10.00' ) ( '5.50' ) ( '2.00' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_budget( iv_initial_budget = '100.00' it_expenses = lt_expenses1 ) exp = '82.50' ).

    DATA(lt_expenses2) = VALUE zcl_budget_subtract=>tt_expenses(
      ( '50.00' ) ( '30.00' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_budget( iv_initial_budget = '80.00' it_expenses = lt_expenses2 ) exp = '0.00' ).

    " Test with empty expenses
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_budget( iv_initial_budget = '50.00' it_expenses = VALUE #( ) ) exp = '50.00' ).

    " Test with negative result (overspending)
    DATA(lt_expenses3) = VALUE zcl_budget_subtract(
      ( '100.00' ) ( '50.00' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_budget( iv_initial_budget = '120.00' it_expenses = lt_expenses3 ) exp = '-30.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ideal für kumulative Berechnungen. Hier wird er verwendet, um iterativ Ausgaben von einem Startbudget abzuziehen. Dies ist eine moderne, funktionale und sehr lesbare Art, solche Berechnungen durchzuführen, die den Code kompakt hält.
keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Math, Functional, Aggregation

Instructions: Nehmen Sie einen Eingabestring, entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen, konvertieren Sie ihn in Großbuchstaben und extrahieren Sie dann ein Substring von der 3. bis zur 7. Position (Länge 5), alles in einer einzigen Anweisung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_string_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_string_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    rv_output = substring(
                  val = to_upper(
                          val = trim(
                                  val = iv_input
                                )
                        )
                  off = 2 " 0-based index, so 3rd position is index 2
                  len = 5
                ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->process_string( iv_input = '  abap programming  ' ) exp = 'AP PR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->process_string( iv_input = '  short' ) exp = 'ORT' ). " String too short for 5 chars
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->process_string( iv_input = '  a' ) exp = '' ). " String too short

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit einer Reihe von fortlaufenden Zahlen (z.B. 1, 2, 4, 5). Finden Sie alle fehlenden Zahlen in einem vorgegebenen Bereich (z.B. von 1 bis 5).
hint: Erstellen Sie eine vollständige Zahlenreihe und subtrahieren Sie dann die vorhandenen Zahlen mithilfe von `FOR` und `WHERE NOT line_exists`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_missing_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_missing_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_range TYPE i
        iv_end_range   TYPE i
        it_existing_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_missing_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_missing_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_missing_numbers.
    DATA(lt_full_range) = VALUE tt_numbers(
      FOR i = iv_start_range THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_end_range
      ( i )
    ).

    rt_missing_numbers = VALUE tt_numbers(
      FOR number IN lt_full_range
      WHERE NOT line_exists( it_existing_numbers[ table_line = number ] )
      ( number )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_missing_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_missing_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_missing_numbers( ).

    DATA(lt_existing1) = VALUE zcl_missing_numbers=>tt_numbers(
      ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_missing1) = lo_cut->find_missing_numbers( iv_start_range = 1 iv_end_range = 5 it_existing_numbers = lt_existing1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_missing1 ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_missing1[ 1 ] exp = 3 ).

    DATA(lt_existing2) = VALUE zcl_missing_numbers=>tt_numbers(
      ( 10 ) ( 12 ) ( 15 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_missing2) = lo_cut->find_missing_numbers( iv_start_range = 10 iv_end_range = 15 it_existing_numbers = lt_existing2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_missing2 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_missing2[ 1 ] exp = 11 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_missing2[ 2 ] exp = 13 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_missing2[ 3 ] exp = 14 ).

    " Test with no missing numbers
    DATA(lt_existing3) = VALUE zcl_missing_numbers=>tt_numbers(
      ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_missing3) = lo_cut->find_missing_numbers( iv_start_range = 1 iv_end_range = 3 it_existing_numbers = lt_existing3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_missing3 ).

    " Test with all numbers missing
    DATA(lt_missing4) = lo_cut->find_missing_numbers( iv_start_range = 1 iv_end_range = 3 it_existing_numbers = VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_missing4 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_missing4[ 1 ] exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung verwendet zwei `FOR`-Ausdrücke. Der erste generiert eine vollständige Zahlenreihe. Der zweite 'subtrahiert' die vorhandenen Zahlen aus dieser vollständigen Reihe, indem er `WHERE NOT line_exists` verwendet. Dies ist ein elegantes und effizientes Muster für die Ermittlung fehlender Elemente in einer Sequenz.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Internal Tables, Sequence, FOR, LINE_EXISTS, Set Operations

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT alle Flüge heraus, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden und deren maximale Passagierkapazität (SEATSMAX) über 200 liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei verschachtelte Filterlogik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit mehreren Bedingungen oder verschachtelte `FILTER`-Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND seatsmax > 200 ).

    " Alternative with conceptual nesting (multiple filter steps)
    " DATA(lt_lh_flights) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
    " rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_lh_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE seatsmax > 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " sflight might be empty in test systems

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-seatsmax > 200 ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " To properly test, we might need to insert test data into SFLIGHT
    " For simplicity, we assume SFLIGHT contains some data for LH with seatsmax > 200
    " or assert_initial if no such data exists.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `FILTER` direkt mehrere Bedingungen mit `AND`/`OR` verknüpfen kann, demonstriert dieses Beispiel das Konzept der verschachtelten Filterung. Man kann entweder mehrere Bedingungen direkt im `WHERE`-Teil des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks kombinieren oder das Ergebnis eines `FILTER`-Ausdrucks als Eingabe für einen weiteren `FILTER`-Ausdruck verwenden. Dies ist eine moderne und deklarative Art, Daten aus internen Tabellen zu selektieren.
keywords: NESTING, FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Conditional

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren, basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum. Das Ergebnis soll eine ganze Zahl sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie Datumsarithmetik und `sy-datum` für das aktuelle Datum. Beachten Sie, dass ABAP die Subtraktion von Daten direkt unterstützt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_age DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_age_in_years
      IMPORTING iv_birth_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_age IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_age_in_years.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_years_diff) = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).

    " Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year
    IF lv_current_date(4) = iv_birth_date(4).
      rv_age = 0.
    ELSEIF lv_current_date(6) < iv_birth_date(6).
      rv_age = lv_years_diff - 1.
    ELSE.
      rv_age = lv_years_diff.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_age_in_years FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_age_in_years.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculate_age( ).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).

    " Test case: Birthday already passed this year
    DATA(lv_birth_date1) = lv_current_year && '0101'. " Jan 1st of current year
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_age_in_years( lv_birth_date1 ) exp = 0 ).

    " Test case: Birthday in previous year
    DATA(lv_prev_year) = lv_current_year - 1.
    DATA(lv_birth_date2) = lv_prev_year && '0101'. " Jan 1st of previous year
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_age_in_years( lv_birth_date2 ) exp = 1 ).

    " Test case: Birthday later this year
    DATA(lv_next_month) = sy-datum+4(2) + 1.
    IF lv_next_month > 12. lv_next_month = 1. ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_birth_date3) = lv_current_year && lv_next_month && '01'. " Next month, 1st day
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_age_in_years( lv_birth_date3 ) exp = 0 ).

    " Test case: Specific age
    DATA(lv_birth_date4) = '19900515'. " May 15, 1990
    DATA(lv_expected_age) = sy-datum(4) - 1990.
    IF sy-datum(6) < '0515'.
      lv_expected_age = lv_expected_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_age_in_years( lv_birth_date4 ) exp = lv_expected_age ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Altersberechnung erfolgt durch Subtraktion der Jahreszahlen und anschließende Korrektur, falls der Geburtstag im aktuellen Jahr noch nicht stattgefunden hat. Obwohl ABAP keine direkte Funktion für 'Alter in Jahren' bietet, ist die Datumsarithmetik (`sy-datum(4) - iv_birth_date(4)`) eine einfache und effiziente Methode, die in modernem ABAP gut lesbar ist.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Date/Time, Age, sy-datum, Arithmetic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse erzeugt und eine Methode dieser Instanz aufruft. Die Klasse und die Methode sollen zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben werden. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die dynamische Objekterzeugung und den Methodenaufruf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW #( )` für die dynamische Objekterzeugung und den dynamischen Methodenaufruf mit `(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_handler.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param       TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.

    TRY.
        lo_object = NEW #( iv_class_name ). " Dynamic object creation

        " Dynamic method call
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_param " Assuming method has an iv_input parameter
          RECEIVING
            rv_output = rv_result. " Assuming method returns rv_output

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_dyn_call_error(
          textid = lx_dyn_call_error->textid
          previous = lx_dyn_call_error
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for testing dynamic call
CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_string
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_fixed_string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_string.
    rv_output = iv_input && ' - Processed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_fixed_string.
    rv_output = 'Fixed String Result'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_no_param FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call(
      iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET'
      iv_method_name = 'CONCATENATE_STRING'
      iv_param = 'Hello'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello - Processed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_no_param.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call(
      iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET'
      iv_method_name = 'GET_FIXED_STRING'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Fixed String Result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_call( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = NEW cx_sy_dyn_call_error( ) 
                                         exp = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call(
                                           iv_class_name = 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT'
                                           iv_method_name = 'ANY_METHOD'
                                         ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Objekterzeugung mit `NEW #(class_name)` und der dynamische Methodenaufruf `object->(method_name)` sind leistungsstarke Features des modernen ABAP. Sie ermöglichen es, zur Laufzeit auf Klassen und Methoden zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Implementierungen.
keywords: NESTING, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, NEW, Dynamic Call

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und innerhalb jeder Fluggesellschaft nach dem Abflugdatum (FLDATE). Für jede dieser Untergruppen sollen die Flugnummern (CONNID) gesammelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_connids,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_connids.
    TYPES tt_flight_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flights_by_date,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             connids TYPE tt_flight_connids,
           END OF ty_flights_by_date.
    TYPES tt_flights_by_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flights_by_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flights_by_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights_per_date TYPE tt_flights_by_date,
           END OF ty_flights_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_flights_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flights_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flights_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE tt_flights_by_carrid(
      FOR GROUPS OF flights_by_carrid IN lt_sflight GROUP BY flights_by_carrid-carrid
      ( carrid = flights_by_carrid-carrid,
        flights_per_date = VALUE tt_flights_by_date(
          FOR GROUPS OF flights_by_date IN flights_by_carrid GROUP BY flights_by_date-fldate
          ( fldate = flights_by_date-fldate,
            connids = VALUE tt_flight_connids(
              FOR flight IN flights_by_date
              ( connid = flight-connid )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
