Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag).
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und verwenden Sie die Datumsarithmetik sowie die Funktion `cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_end_date   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_day_of_week <> 6 AND lv_day_of_week <> 7. " 6=Saturday, 7=Sunday
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1. " Subtracting 1 day from current date
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_working_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_working_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_working_days( ).

    " Test case: Monday to Friday (5 working days)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20251117' iv_end_date = '20251121' ) exp = 5 ).

    " Test case: Monday to Sunday (5 working days)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20251117' iv_end_date = '20251123' ) exp = 5 ).

    " Test case: Saturday and Sunday (0 working days)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20251122' iv_end_date = '20251123' ) exp = 0 ).

    " Test case: Single working day
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20251117' iv_end_date = '20251117' ) exp = 1 ).

    " Test case: Start date after end date (0 working days)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20251120' iv_end_date = '20251119' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine Schleife, um Tage zu inkrementieren (`lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1`) und die `cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week`-Methode, um Wochenenden zu identifizieren. Obwohl es keine direkte 'SUBTRACT'-Operation für Arbeitstage gibt, ist die iterative Datumsarithmetik eine gängige und effiziente Methode, die in modernem ABAP gut umgesetzt werden kann.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld sortiert. Die Sortierreihenfolge (aufsteigend/absteigend) soll ebenfalls dynamisch sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit dynamischen Feldnamen und `(field_name)` sowie `ASCENDING`/`DESCENDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_direction  TYPE string " 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE tt_data
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    rt_sorted_data = it_data.

    TRY.
        IF iv_direction = 'ASCENDING'.
          SORT rt_sorted_data BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
        ELSEIF iv_direction = 'DESCENDING'.
          SORT rt_sorted_data BY (iv_field_name) DESCENDING.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_dyn_call_error(
            textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>dyn_sort_invalid_direction
          ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_dyn_call_error(
          textid = lx_dyn_call_error->textid
          previous = lx_dyn_call_error
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sort_ascending FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_descending FOR TESTING.

    ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_by_id) = lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'ID' iv_direction = 'ASCENDING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_id[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_id[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_by_name) = lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'NAME' iv_direction = 'ASCENDING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_name[ 1 ]-name exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_name[ 2 ]-name exp = 'B' ).

  METHOD test_sort_descending.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_data(
      ( id = 3 name = 'C' value = 30 )
      ( id = 1 name = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 name = 'B' value = 20 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_by_value) = lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'VALUE' iv_direction = 'DESCENDING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_value[ 1 ]-value exp = 30 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = NEW cx_sy_dyn_call_error( ) 
                                         exp = lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically(
                                           it_data = lt_data
                                           iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
                                           iv_direction = 'ASCENDING'
                                         ) ).

  METHOD test_invalid_direction.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = NEW cx_sy_dyn_call_error( )

                                           iv_field_name = 'ID'

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHT). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die alle Flüge enthält, deren maximale Passagierkapazität (SEATSMAX) um mehr als 50 Plätze von der durchschnittlichen Kapazität aller Flüge abweicht. Verwenden Sie dabei funktionale Ausdrücke.
hint: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt mit `REDUCE` und filtern Sie dann mit `FILTER` und `ABS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_capacity_deviation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_deviating_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_deviating_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_capacity_deviation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_deviating_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    IF lines( lt_all_flights ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax
    ).

    DATA(lv_average_capacity) = lv_total_capacity / lines( lt_all_flights ).

    rt_deviating_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE abs( seatsmax - lv_average_capacity ) > 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_deviating_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_deviating_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_capacity_deviation( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_deviating_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " sflight might be empty in test systems

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_capacity) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR flight IN VALUE zcl_capacity_deviation=>tt_sflight( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight ( <fs_sflight> ) )
        NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax
      ).
      DATA(lv_average_capacity) = lv_total_capacity / lines( VALUE zcl_capacity_deviation=>tt_sflight( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflight ( <fs_sflight> ) ) ).

      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abs( ls_flight-seatsmax - lv_average_capacity ) > 50 ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_capacity_deviation( ).
    " Temporarily clear sflight for this test if possible, or mock it.
    " For now, we assume sflight is empty or the method handles it.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_deviating_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` zur Berechnung des Durchschnitts und `FILTER` mit der `ABS`-Funktion, um Flüge zu finden, die erheblich von diesem Durchschnitt abweichen. Die Subtraktion (`seatsmax - lv_average_capacity`) ist hier ein zentraler Bestandteil der Filterbedingung. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Ausdrücke für komplexe Datenanalysen.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Internal Tables, REDUCE, FILTER, ABS, sflights, Deviation

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem gegebenen Text alle Wörter, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen und mindestens 3 Zeichen lang sind. Die Extraktion soll in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_word_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_capitalized_words
      IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_words) TYPE tt_words.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_word_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_capitalized_words.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = '\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]{2,}\b'. " Matches words starting with capital, min 3 chars

    rt_words = VALUE tt_words(
      FOR MATCH RESULT m IN REGEX lv_regex_pattern FOR iv_text
      ( m-submatch[1] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_word_extract( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Dies ist Ein Test mit Mehreren Wörtern. ABAP ist Toll!'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_capitalized_words( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).

CLASS zcl_date_month_offset DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_month_offset IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (seatsocc) für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_calc_reduce_sum.
      PUBLIC SECTION.

    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_sflight_data.

CLASS zcl_calc_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_calc_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_calc_cond_classify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_group_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_seats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_seatsocc TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS calculate_avg_seats_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_group_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_avg_seats_per_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    rt_avg_seats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid
                               avg_seatsocc = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0 count = 0
                                                                 FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                                 NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc
                                                                      count = count + 1 )
                                              / WHEN count > 0 THEN count ELSE 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_seats_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_seats_per_carrier.
    CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_calc_group_avg.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_sflight_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_sflight_data.
        rt_sflights = VALUE #( 
          ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 50 )
          ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 70 )
          ( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 100 )
          ( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 80 )
          ( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 60 )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW lcl_test_class( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_seats_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_avg_seats ) exp = 2
                                      msg = 'Incorrect number of carriers' ).

    DATA(lv_lh_avg) = lt_avg_seats[ carrid = 'LH' ]-avg_seatsocc.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lh_avg exp = '60.00'
                                      msg = 'Incorrect average for LH' ).

    DATA(lv_aa_avg) = lt_avg_seats[ carrid = 'AA' ]-avg_seatsocc.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_aa_avg exp = '80.00'
                                      msg = 'Incorrect average for AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten. Für jede Gruppe wird ein `REDUCE`-Ausdruck verwendet, um die Summe und Anzahl der belegten Sitze zu berechnen und daraus den Durchschnitt zu ermitteln. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Gruppierungsaufgaben zu lösen.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermittle den Gesamtumsatz aller Flüge, die mehr als 50% ihrer Kapazität ausgelastet sind, nach Abzug einer Provision von 5%.
hint: Nutze `LET` Ausdrücke für Zwischenberechnungen, `FILTER` für die Auswahl und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_let_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS calculate_net_revenue RETURNING VALUE(rv_net_revenue) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_let_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, currency, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_net_revenue.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    rv_net_revenue = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT total_revenue = 0
                                           FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsmax > 0 AND ( seatsocc / seatsmax ) > '0.5' )
                                           LET gross_revenue = flight-price * flight-seatsocc
                                               commission = gross_revenue * '0.05' IN
                                           NEXT total_revenue = total_revenue + ( gross_revenue - commission ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_net_revenue FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_net_revenue.
    CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_calc_let_filter_reduce.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_sflight_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_sflight_data.
        rt_sflights = VALUE #( 
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 60 ) " 60% > 50%, Revenue: 6000 * 0.95 = 5700
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 90 ) " 45% <= 50%, Excluded
          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0030' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 120 seatsocc = 70 ) " ~58% > 50%, Revenue: 10500 * 0.95 = 9975
          ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 0 seatsocc = 0 ) " seatsmax = 0, Excluded
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW lcl_test_class( ).
    DATA(lv_net_revenue) = lo_cut->calculate_net_revenue( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_net_revenue exp = '15675.00'
                                      msg = 'Incorrect net revenue' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER`, `LET` und `REDUCE`. `FILTER` wählt relevante Flüge aus, `LET` definiert temporäre Variablen für Zwischenberechnungen (Bruttoeinnahmen, Provision) und `REDUCE` aggregiert die bereinigten Einnahmen. Dies führt zu einem sehr ausdrucksstarken und effizienten Code für komplexe Datenverarbeitungsaufgaben.
keywords: LET, FILTER, REDUCE, Aggregation, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables

Instructions: Finde den ersten Flug nach 'NEW YORK' mit mehr als 100 freien Sitzen (seatsmax - seatsocc).
hint: Nutze den `FILTER` Operator und den `VALUE` Operator mit Tabellenindex `[ 1 ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_filter_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS get_first_matching_flight RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_filter_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityto, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_first_matching_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    TRY.
        rs_flight = VALUE #( FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 100 )[ 1 ] ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle case where no matching flight is found
        CLEAR rs_flight.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_first_matching_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_first_matching_flight.
    CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_fetch_filter_value.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_sflight_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_sflight_data.
        rt_sflights = VALUE #( 
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 50 )
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 80 ) " Free: 120
          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0030' fldate = '20250103' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 60 ) " Free: 90
          ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 100 ) " Free: 150
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW lcl_test_class( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_matching_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA'
                                      msg = 'Incorrect carrier for first matching flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017'
                                      msg = 'Incorrect connection ID for first matching flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flight.
    CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_fetch_filter_value.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_sflight_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_sflight_data.
        rt_sflights = VALUE #( 
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 50 )
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 80 ) " Free: 20
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW lcl_test_class( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_matching_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid
                                      msg = 'Flight should be initial if no match found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator erzeugt eine temporäre, gefilterte Tabelle, auf die dann mit einem Tabellenausdruck `[ 1 ]` zugegriffen wird, um das erste Element zu erhalten. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Methode, um den ersten Treffer einer Bedingung zu finden. Die `TRY...CATCH` Block ist notwendig, um den Fall abzufangen, dass kein passender Eintrag gefunden wird.
keywords: FILTER, VALUE, Table Expression, Internal Tables, First Match

Instructions: Ermittle den drittgünstigsten Flug von 'FRANKFURT' nach 'LONDON'.
hint: Nutze `SORT` in einem `FOR` Ausdruck und greife mit einem Tabellenindex auf das Element zu.

CLASS zcl_fetch_nth_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Simuliere die Vergabe der nächsten freien Flugnummer, die größer ist als alle bestehenden Flugnummern für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Finde die maximale bestehende Flugnummer mit `REDUCE` und addiere 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_next_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS get_next_connection_id IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_next_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_next_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_connection_id.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_max_connid) = REDUCE sflight-connid( INIT max_id = 0
                                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                                NEXT max_id = nmax( max_id, flight-connid ) ).
    rv_next_connid = lv_max_connid + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Für jede Fluggesellschaft, finde den Flug mit der frühesten Abflugzeit, der noch nicht stattgefunden hat (Datum in der Zukunft).
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `MIN` Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_group_min_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_next_flight_per_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_next_flight_per_carrier.
    TYPES tt_next_flight_per_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_next_flight_per_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS get_next_flight_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_next_flights) TYPE tt_next_flight_per_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_group_min_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_current_time) = sy-uzeit.

    rt_next_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                                LET earliest_flight = REDUCE ty_sflight(
                                    INIT min_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( fldate = '99991231' fltime = '235959' )
                                    FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                    WHERE ( member-fldate > lv_current_date ) OR
                                          ( member-fldate = lv_current_date AND member-fltime > lv_current_time )
                                    NEXT min_flight = COND ty_sflight(
                                        WHEN member-fldate < min_flight-fldate THEN member
                                        WHEN member-fldate = min_flight-fldate AND member-fltime < min_flight-fltime THEN member
                                        ELSE min_flight ) )
                                IN
                                ( COND #( WHEN earliest_flight-fldate <> '99991231' THEN earliest_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_next_flight_per_carrier FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_next_flight_per_carrier.
    CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_fetch_group_min_date.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_sflight_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_sflight_data.
        rt_sflights = VALUE #( 
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum fltime = '100000' ) " Past
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0020' fldate = sy-datum fltime = '150000' ) " Future (if current time < 15:00)
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0030' fldate = sy-datum + 1 fltime = '080000' ) " Future
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0005' fldate = sy-datum fltime = '120000' ) " Past
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0006' fldate = sy-datum + 2 fltime = '090000' ) " Future
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0007' fldate = sy-datum + 1 fltime = '110000' ) " Future
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW lcl_test_class( ).
    DATA(lt_next_flights) = lo_cut->get_next_flight_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_next_flights ) exp = 2
                                      msg = 'Incorrect number of carriers with future flights' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_flight) = lt_next_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_flight-connid exp = '0020'
                                      msg = 'Incorrect next flight for LH' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_flight) = lt_next_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_flight-connid exp = '0007'
                                      msg = 'Incorrect next flight for AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_future_flights.
    CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_fetch_group_min_date.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_sflight_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_sflight_data.
        rt_sflights = VALUE #( 
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum - 1 fltime = '100000' )
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0005' fldate = sy-datum - 2 fltime = '120000' )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW lcl_test_class( ).
    DATA(lt_next_flights) = lo_cut->get_next_flight_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_next_flights )
                                      msg = 'Should be empty if no future flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY` zur Gruppierung nach Fluggesellschaften. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird ein `REDUCE` Ausdruck verwendet, um den Flug mit der frühesten Abflugzeit in der Zukunft zu finden. Die `WHERE`-Klausel im `REDUCE` filtert vergangene Flüge, und der `COND` Operator wählt den frühesten Flug basierend auf Datum und Uhrzeit aus. Dies ist eine sehr fortgeschrittene und funktionale Methode, um komplexe Gruppierungs- und Suchanforderungen zu erfüllen.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, MIN, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, Future Date

Instructions: Berechne den maximalen Preis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator mit der Funktion `nmax`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_reduce_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS calculate_max_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_reduce_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_max_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    rv_max_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT max_val = 0
                                         FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                         NEXT max_val = nmax( max_val, flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Flüge, die am heutigen Datum oder später stattfinden und mehr als 50 freie Sitze haben. Gib diese Flüge in einer neuen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutze den `FILTER` Operator mit mehreren Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_filter_multi_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS get_available_future_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_filter_multi_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_available_future_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE fldate >= lv_today AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne für jeden Flug, wie viele Tage bis zum Abflugdatum verbleiben. Flüge in der Vergangenheit sollen 0 Tage anzeigen.

CLASS zcl_calc_date_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_days_left,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             days_left TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_days_left.
    TYPES tt_flight_days_left TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_days_left WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS calculate_days_left RETURNING VALUE(rt_days_left) TYPE tt_flight_days_left.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_date_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_days_left.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_days_left = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             LET lv_diff = cl_abap_date_helper=>diff_in_days( iv_date1 = lv_today iv_date2 = flight-fldate ) IN
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid
                               connid = flight-connid
                               days_left = COND i( WHEN lv_diff > 0 THEN lv_diff ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde für jede Fluggesellschaft den Flug mit der höchsten Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax).
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY` und `REDUCE` mit `nmax` für die Auslastung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_group_max_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_max_utilization,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             utilization TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_max_utilization.
    TYPES tt_carrier_max_utilization TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_max_utilization WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS get_max_utilization_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_util) TYPE tt_carrier_max_utilization.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_group_max_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_max_utilization_per_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).

    rt_max_util = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                             LET max_util_flight = REDUCE ty_sflight(
                                 INIT best_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( seatsmax = 1 seatsocc = 0 ) " Initialize with 0 utilization
                                 FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                 WHERE member-seatsmax > 0
                                 NEXT best_flight = COND ty_sflight(
                                     WHEN ( member-seatsocc / member-seatsmax ) > ( best_flight-seatsocc / best_flight-seatsmax ) THEN member
                                     ELSE best_flight ) )
                             IN
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid
                               connid = max_util_flight-connid
                               utilization = COND decfloat16(
                                   WHEN max_util_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( max_util_flight-seatsocc / max_util_flight-seatsmax )
                                   ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Preis enthält, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über dem Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge liegt.
hint: Berechne zuerst den Durchschnittspreis mit `REDUCE` und nutze dann `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_avg_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS get_flights_above_average_price RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_avg_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_above_average_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                 FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                                 NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lv_average_price) = COND sflight-price( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > lv_average_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_group_max_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_max_free_seats,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_max_free_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_max_free_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_max_free_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS get_max_free_seats_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_free_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_max_free_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_group_max_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_max_free_seats_per_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( ).

    rt_max_free_seats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                                   LET best_flight_with_free_seats = REDUCE ty_sflight(
                                       INIT max_free_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( seatsmax = 0 seatsocc = 0 ) " Initialize with 0 free seats
                                       FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                       NEXT max_free_flight = COND ty_sflight(
                                           WHEN ( member-seatsmax - member-seatsocc ) > ( max_free_flight-seatsmax - max_free_flight-seatsocc ) THEN member
                                           ELSE max_free_flight ) )
                                   IN
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                     connid = best_flight_with_free_seats-connid
                                     free_seats = best_flight_with_free_seats-seatsmax - best_flight_with_free_seats-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die dynamische Zuweisung einer Strukturkomponente zu einem Feldsymbol und dessen anschließende Freigabe mittels UNASSIGN. Verwenden Sie eine einfache Struktur und greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS process_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_component TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_result = |Feld '{ iv_component }' hat Wert: { <fs> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Feld '{ iv_component }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs>. " Freigabe des Feldsymbols
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die einen HTTP GET-Request verarbeitet. Die Klasse soll einen URL-Parameter namens 'name' auslesen und eine Begrüßungsnachricht zurückgeben. Wenn 'name' nicht vorhanden ist, soll 'World' verwendet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `if_http_request~get_form_field` zum Auslesen des Parameters und `if_http_response~set_cdata` für die Antwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_get_request
      FOR EVENT if_http_extension~handle_request OF cl_http_server
      IMPORTING
        request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    handle_get_request( request = request response = response ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_get_request.
    DATA(lv_name) = request->get_form_field( 'name' ).
    IF lv_name IS INITIAL.
      lv_name = 'World'.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_response_text) = |Hello, { lv_name }!|.
    response->set_cdata( data = lv_response_text ).
    response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die einen HTTP POST-Request mit Formular-Daten verarbeitet. Lesen Sie die Felder 'item' und 'quantity' aus und geben Sie eine Bestätigungsnachricht zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `if_http_request~get_form_field` für POST-Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_form_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_post_request
      FOR EVENT if_http_extension~handle_request OF cl_http_server
      IMPORTING
        request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_form_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    IF request->get_method( ) = 'POST'.
      handle_post_request( request = request response = response ).
    ELSE.
      response->set_status( code = 405 reason = 'Method Not Allowed' ).
      response->set_cdata( data = 'Only POST method is allowed.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_post_request.
    DATA(lv_item) = request->get_form_field( 'item' ).
    DATA(lv_quantity) = request->get_form_field( 'quantity' ).

    IF lv_item IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_quantity IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_response_text) = |Bestellung empfangen: { lv_quantity }x { lv_item }.|.
      response->set_cdata( data = lv_response_text ).
      response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
    ELSE.
      response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
      response->set_cdata( data = 'Fehlende Parameter: item und quantity sind erforderlich.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der einen JSON-Request-Body empfängt, diesen parst und die extrahierten Daten in einer JSON-Antwort zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_unit_json` für die JSON-Verarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `if_http_request~get_cdata` für den Request-Body und `cl_abap_unit_json` zum Parsen und Generieren von JSON.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_json_request
      FOR EVENT if_http_extension~handle_request OF cl_http_server
      IMPORTING
        request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    handle_json_request( request = request response = response ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_json_request.
    DATA(lv_json_input) = request->get_cdata( ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_json_input ).

    DATA: lo_json_parser TYPE REF TO cl_abap_unit_json,
          ls_data        TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_json_parser.
        lo_json_parser->parse( EXPORTING json = lv_json_string IMPORTING data = ls_data ).

        " Assuming input JSON is like { "name": "Alice", "age": 30 }
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_input> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN ls_data->* TO <ls_input>.

        IF <ls_input> IS ASSIGNED.
          DATA(lv_name) = <ls_input>-name.
          DATA(lv_age) = <ls_input>-age.

          DATA(lv_response_json) = cl_abap_unit_json=>create_json_string(
            VALUE #( name = lv_name age = lv_age + 1 ) ). " Increment age for demo

          response->set_cdata( data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( lv_response_json ) ).
          response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        ELSE.
          response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
          response->set_cdata( data = 'Invalid JSON structure.' ).
        ENDIF.

    CATCH cx_abap_unit_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
        response->set_cdata( data = lx_json_error->get_text( ) ).
    CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
        response->set_cdata( data = 'JSON structure mismatch.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einem Fluggesellschaftscode (Parameter 'carrid') abruft und als JSON-Array zurückgibt. Wenn kein 'carrid' angegeben ist, sollen alle Flüge zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `cl_abap_unit_json` zur JSON-Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_sflights_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_sflights_request
      FOR EVENT if_http_extension~handle_request OF cl_http_server
      IMPORTING
        request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_sflights_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    handle_sflights_request( request = request response = response ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_sflights_request.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = request->get_form_field( 'carrid' ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    IF lv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_json_output) = cl_abap_unit_json=>create_json_string( lt_sflights ).

    response->set_cdata( data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( lv_json_output ) ).
    response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der den HTTP-Statuscode der Antwort dynamisch basierend auf einem URL-Parameter 'status' setzt. Wenn 'status' nicht angegeben oder ungültig ist, soll ein Standardstatus 200 zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `if_http_response~set_status` und `COND` für die Statusprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_status_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_status_request
      FOR EVENT if_http_extension~handle_request OF cl_http_server
      IMPORTING
        request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_status_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    handle_status_request( request = request response = response ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_status_request.
    DATA(lv_status_param) = request->get_form_field( 'status' ).
    DATA(lv_status_code) = 200.
    DATA(lv_status_reason) = 'OK'.

    IF lv_status_param IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          lv_status_code = CONV i( lv_status_param ).
          CASE lv_status_code.
            WHEN 200. lv_status_reason = 'OK'.
            WHEN 201. lv_status_reason = 'Created'.
            WHEN 204. lv_status_reason = 'No Content'.
            WHEN 400. lv_status_reason = 'Bad Request'.
            WHEN 401. lv_status_reason = 'Unauthorized'.
            WHEN 403. lv_status_reason = 'Forbidden'.
            WHEN 404. lv_status_reason = 'Not Found'.
            WHEN 500. lv_status_reason = 'Internal Server Error'.
            WHEN OTHERS. " Fallback for unknown but valid integer status codes
              lv_status_reason = |Custom Status { lv_status_code }|.
          ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        lv_status_code = 400.
        lv_status_reason = 'Invalid Status Code Format'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    response->set_status( code = lv_status_code reason = lv_status_reason ).
    response->set_cdata( data = |Response with status { lv_status_code } - { lv_status_reason }| ).
    response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der den Request-URI analysiert, um dynamische Pfadsegmente zu extrahieren. Zum Beispiel, wenn der URI '/users/123/details' ist, soll '123' als Benutzer-ID extrahiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `if_http_request~get_request_uri` und String-Funktionen wie `SPLIT` oder `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_uri_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_uri_request
      FOR EVENT if_http_extension~handle_request OF cl_http_server
      IMPORTING
        request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_uri_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    handle_uri_request( request = request response = response ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_uri_request.
    DATA(lv_request_uri) = request->get_request_uri( ).
    DATA(lv_user_id) = ''.
    DATA(lv_response_text) = ''.

    " Example: /users/123/details
    DATA(lt_segments) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT lv_request_uri AT '/' INTO TABLE lt_segments.

    " Remove empty first segment if URI starts with '/'
    IF lt_segments IS NOT INITIAL AND lt_segments[ 1 ] IS INITIAL.
      DELETE lt_segments INDEX 1.
    ENDIF.

    IF lines( lt_segments ) >= 2 AND lt_segments[ 1 ] = 'users'.
      lv_user_id = lt_segments[ 2 ].
      lv_response_text = |Benutzer-ID extrahiert: { lv_user_id }|.
    ELSE.
      lv_response_text = |Keine Benutzer-ID im URI gefunden oder ungültiger Pfad: { lv_request_uri }|.
    ENDIF.

    response->set_cdata( data = lv_response_text ).
    response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine Datei (simuliert als String) basierend auf einem Dateinamen (URL-Parameter 'filename') zurückgibt. Setzen Sie den `Content-Disposition`-Header, um den Browser zum Download zu bewegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `if_http_response~set_header_field` für `Content-Disposition` und `set_cdata` für den Dateinhalt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_file_download DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_download_request
      FOR EVENT if_http_extension~handle_request OF cl_http_server
      IMPORTING
        request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_file_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    handle_download_request( request = request response = response ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_download_request.
    DATA(lv_filename) = request->get_form_field( 'filename' ).
    DATA(lv_file_content) = ''.
    DATA(lv_content_type) = 'application/octet-stream'. " Default for binary data

    IF lv_filename IS INITIAL.
      response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
      response->set_cdata( data = 'Dateiname fehlt.' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate file content based on filename
    CASE lv_filename.
      WHEN 'report.txt'.
        lv_file_content = 'Dies ist der Inhalt des Berichts.'.
        lv_content_type = 'text/plain'.
      WHEN 'data.csv'.
        lv_file_content = 'Header1,Header2\nValue1,Value2'.
        lv_content_type = 'text/csv'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        response->set_status( code = 404 reason = 'Not Found' ).
        response->set_cdata( data = |Datei '{ lv_filename }' nicht gefunden.| ).
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lv_content_disposition) = |attachment; filename="{ lv_filename }"|.
    response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Disposition' value = lv_content_disposition ).
    response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = lv_content_type ).
    response->set_cdata( data = lv_file_content ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine einfache Authentifizierung mittels eines 'Authorization'-Headers (Bearer Token) simuliert. Nur Anfragen mit einem gültigen Token sollen verarbeitet werden.
hint: Lesen Sie den 'Authorization'-Header mit `if_http_request~get_header_field` und prüfen Sie den Token.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_auth_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_valid_token TYPE string VALUE 'mysecrettoken123'.

    METHODS handle_auth_request
      FOR EVENT if_http_extension~handle_request OF cl_http_server
      IMPORTING
        request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_auth_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    handle_auth_request( request = request response = response ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_auth_request.
    DATA(lv_auth_header) = request->get_header_field( 'Authorization' ).
    DATA(lv_is_authenticated) = abap_false.

    IF lv_auth_header IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_auth_header CS 'Bearer '.
      DATA(lv_token) = substring_after( val = lv_auth_header sub = 'Bearer ' ).
      IF lv_token = gc_valid_token.
        lv_is_authenticated = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_is_authenticated = abap_true.
      response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
      response->set_cdata( data = 'Authentifizierung erfolgreich. Willkommen!' ).
    ELSE.
      response->set_status( code = 401 reason = 'Unauthorized' ).
      response->set_header_field( name = 'WWW-Authenticate' value = 'Bearer realm="ABAP API"' ).
      response->set_cdata( data = 'Authentifizierung fehlgeschlagen. Ungültiger oder fehlender Token.' ).
    ENDIF.
    response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch und fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab, falls eine Division durch Null versucht wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.

CLASS zcl_try_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus.
hint: Lesen Sie alle Flüge in eine interne Tabelle, generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_sel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_data_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_sel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @sflight ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_data_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Keine Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_table_size
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    IF lv_count = 0.

      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) ).

    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '' msg = 'Flugnummer sollte nicht leer sein' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_try_file_open DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS open_file_safely

        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_file_access.

CLASS zcl_try_file_open IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_file_safely.
    DATA: lv_file_content TYPE string.
    TRY.
        OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_open

        READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_file_content.
        CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_authority.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access
          EXPORTING
            text = |Keine Berechtigung für den Zugriff auf Datei '{ iv_file_path }'.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_open.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access
          EXPORTING
            text = |Datei '{ iv_file_path }' konnte nicht geöffnet werden (existiert nicht oder ist gesperrt).|.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_access.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access
          EXPORTING
            text = |Allgemeiner Fehler beim Dateizugriff auf '{ iv_file_path }'.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen (shufflen) Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `FOR` Schleife mit `INSERT` oder `MOVE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE ty_string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE ty_string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_temp_table) = it_input_table.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( lt_temp_table ).

    IF lv_size = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_size
    ).

    DO lv_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_temp_table INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(lv_entry).
      APPEND lv_entry TO rt_shuffled_table.
      DELETE TABLE lt_temp_table INDEX lv_random_index.
      lo_random->set_max( lines( lt_temp_table ) ). " Adjust max for remaining elements
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_random_table_shuffle=>ty_string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).

    " Check if all elements are still present (just reordered)
    LOOP AT lt_original INTO DATA(lv_orig_entry).
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_shuffled INTO DATA(lv_shuff_entry).
        IF lv_orig_entry = lv_shuff_entry.
          lv_found = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found exp = abap_true msg = |Element '{ lv_orig_entry }' nicht gefunden.| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " It's highly improbable for a shuffled table to be identical to the original (for >1 elements)
    IF lines( lt_original ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_original msg = 'Tabelle wurde nicht gemischt (unwahrscheinlich).' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_empty) = VALUE zcl_random_table_shuffle=>ty_string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_shuffled ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine interne Tabelle zufällig mischen kann. Es verwendet `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`, um zufällige Indizes zu generieren, und entnimmt dann Elemente aus der Quelltabelle, um sie in die Zieltabelle einzufügen. Die `set_max` Methode des Zufallszahlengenerators ist wichtig, um den Bereich der Zufallszahlen an die schrumpfende Quelltabelle anzupassen.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, Shuffle, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, FOR, DELETE TABLE

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Passwort einer bestimmten Länge, das Kleinbuchstaben, Großbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und String-Templates, um Zeichen aus vordefinierten Zeichensätzen zu wählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_lower_chars TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_upper_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_digits      TYPE string VALUE '0123456789'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_all_chars   TYPE string VALUE lc_lower_chars && lc_upper_chars && lc_digits.

    IF iv_length <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Passwortlänge muss größer als 0 sein.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_all_chars_len) = strlen( lc_all_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_all_chars_len - 1
    ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_password = rv_password && lc_all_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_has_lower) = abap_false.

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie eine Klasse dynamisch und fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab, falls die Klasse nicht existiert oder nicht instanziierbar ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (class_name)` und fangen Sie `CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_create_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS create_object_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_object) TYPE REF TO object
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_create_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_create_object( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_instance) = lo_cut->create_object_safely( 'ZCL_TRY_CREATE_OBJECT' ).
        out->write( |Erfolgreich instanziiert: { cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( lo_instance ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        out->write( |Fehler beim Instanziieren: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_instance_fail) = lo_cut->create_object_safely( 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        out->write( |Fehler beim Instanziieren (erwartet): { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_object_safely.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Instanziieren der Klasse '{ iv_class_name }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig eine bestimmte Anzahl von eindeutigen Flügen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `LOOP AT ... WHERE` oder `FILTER` mit einer internen Tabelle, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_random_unique_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds,
        cx_sy_no_data_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_unique_flights.
    IF iv_count <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Anzahl der Flüge muss größer als 0 sein.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_key( FOR sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @sflight ).

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_data_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Keine Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
    IF iv_count > lv_total_flights.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
        EXPORTING
          text = |Angeforderte Anzahl ({ iv_count }) übersteigt die verfügbare Anzahl von Flügen ({ lv_total_flights }).|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_total_flights
    ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_all_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(ls_flight_key).
      INSERT ls_flight_key INTO TABLE rt_unique_flights.
      DELETE TABLE lt_all_flights INDEX lv_random_index.
      lo_random->set_max( lines( lt_all_flights ) ).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_unique_count) = lines( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_count exp = 3 msg = 'Ergebnis sollte eindeutige Flüge enthalten.' ).

  METHOD test_random_unique_flights_too_many.

          i_object = lo_cut
          i_method = 'GET_RANDOM_UNIQUE_FLIGHTS'
          i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_COUNT' value = 1 ) )
        )
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) ).

  METHOD test_random_unique_flights_zero_count.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Datenbankoperation durch und fangen Sie eine generische SQL-Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY` oder `INSERT` und fangen Sie `CX_SY_SQL_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_db_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_insert,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_insert.

    METHODS insert_flight_safely
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_sflight_insert
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_db_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_safely.
    TRY.
        INSERT INTO sflight VALUES is_flight_data.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          " This path is usually not taken if an exception is raised for primary key violation
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Fehler beim Einfügen des Fluges (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }).|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Datenbankfehler beim Einfügen des Fluges: { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_insert_flight_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_db_error( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_try_db_error=>ty_sflight_insert(
      carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '747'
    ).
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_safely( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate.

  METHOD test_insert_flight_duplicate.

    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_try_db_error=>ty_sflight_insert(
      carrid = 'YY' connid = '8888' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A380'
    ).
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.

    lo_cut->insert_flight_safely( ls_flight ). " First insert should succeed

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class_name = 'CX_SY_SQL_ERROR'
      ACT =
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>run_test_method(
          i_object = lo_cut
          i_method = 'INSERT_FLIGHT_SAFELY'
          i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IS_FLIGHT_DATA' value = ls_flight ) )
        )
    ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie ein zufälliges Ereignis mit einer bestimmten Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 30% Chance auf 'Erfolg').
hint: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 99 und prüfen Sie, ob sie unter einem Schwellenwert liegt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_probability DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_success_probability TYPE i " 0-100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_probability IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_event.
    IF iv_success_probability < 0 OR iv_success_probability > 100.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Wahrscheinlichkeit muss zwischen 0 und 100 liegen.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = 99
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_value < iv_success_probability.
      rv_is_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_event_high_prob.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_probability( ).
    DATA(lv_success_count) = 0.
    DO 1000 TIMES.
      IF lo_cut->simulate_event( 90 ) = abap_true.
        lv_success_count = lv_success_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    " Assert that the success rate is roughly within expected bounds (e.g., 80-100% for 90% prob)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_success_count exp_min = 800 exp_max = 1000 msg = 'Erfolgsrate nicht im erwarteten Bereich für 90% Wahrscheinlichkeit.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_simulate_event_low_prob.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_probability( ).
    DATA(lv_success_count) = 0.
    DO 1000 TIMES.
      IF lo_cut->simulate_event( 10 ) = abap_true.
        lv_success_count = lv_success_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    " Assert that the success rate is roughly within expected bounds (e.g., 0-20% for 10% prob)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_success_count exp_min = 0 exp_max = 200 msg = 'Erfolgsrate nicht im erwarteten Bereich für 10% Wahrscheinlichkeit.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_simulate_event_invalid_prob.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_probability( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class_name = 'CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS'
      ACT =
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>run_test_method(
          i_object = lo_cut
          i_method = 'SIMULATE_EVENT'
          i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_SUCCESS_PROBABILITY' value = 101 ) )
        )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class_name = 'CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS'
      ACT =
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>run_test_method(
          i_object = lo_cut
          i_method = 'SIMULATE_EVENT'
          i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_SUCCESS_PROBABILITY' value = -1 ) )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man ein zufälliges Ereignis mit einer bestimmten Wahrscheinlichkeit simulieren kann. Durch die Generierung einer Zufallszahl im Bereich 0-99 und den Vergleich mit der gewünschten Wahrscheinlichkeit kann ein 'Erfolg' oder 'Misserfolg' bestimmt werden. Die Vorabprüfung der Wahrscheinlichkeit mit `IF` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` sorgt für Robustheit.
keywords: RANDOM, Probability, Conditional Logic, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Simulation, CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS

Instructions: Führen Sie mehrere String-Ersetzungen in einem einzigen Ausdruck mit String-Templates durch, um einen Text zu bereinigen (z.B. Leerzeichen am Anfang/Ende entfernen, doppelte Leerzeichen reduzieren, bestimmte Zeichen ersetzen).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REPLACE` mit String-Templates und Funktionen wie `condense` oder `replace` als Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_text.
    rv_cleaned_text = |
      { replace( val = iv_text regex = '\s+' with = ` ` ) }|.
    rv_cleaned_text = condense( rv_cleaned_text ).
    rv_cleaned_text = replace( val = rv_cleaned_text sub = ',' with = ';' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
