Instructions: Ersetzen Sie einen Teilstring in einem Text nur dann, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist (z.B. 'ERROR' durch 'WARNING' ersetzen, aber nur, wenn der Text auch 'CRITICAL' enthält).
hint: Verwenden Sie die `COND` Expression in Kombination mit `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_conditional
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_conditional.
    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN iv_text CS 'CRITICAL'
      THEN replace( val = iv_text sub = 'ERROR' with = 'WARNING' )
      ELSE iv_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_when_critical FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_replace_when_not_critical FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_error_no_change FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_when_critical.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_conditional( 'CRITICAL ERROR in system.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'CRITICAL WARNING in system.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_replace_when_not_critical.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_conditional( 'Minor ERROR occurred.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Minor ERROR occurred.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_error_no_change.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'CRITICAL success.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND` Expression (seit ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Implementierung von bedingter Logik in einem funktionalen Stil. In Kombination mit der `replace`-Funktion kann man so elegante und ausdrucksstarke bedingte String-Ersetzungen durchführen, die den Code kompakter und leichter verständlich machen als traditionelle `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REPLACE, COND, Conditional Logic, String Manipulation, Expressions

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Kleinbuchstaben in einem String durch ihre Großbuchstaben-Entsprechungen, aber nur für Wörter, die mit 'abap' beginnen (case-insensitive).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE REGEX` mit einer Capture Group und der `to_upper` Funktion im Ersetzungsausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_regex_upper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_abap_words_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_regex_upper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_abap_words_to_upper.
    rv_result = iv_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '(abap\w*)' IN rv_result
      WITH to_upper( '$1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_abap_words_upper FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_other_words_unchanged FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_case_abap FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_abap_words_upper.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_regex_upper( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_abap_words_to_upper( 'This is an abap program with abap_code.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'This is an ABAP program with ABAP_CODE.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_words_unchanged.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_regex_upper( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_abap_words_to_upper( 'A java application.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'A java application.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_case_abap.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_regex_upper( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_abap_words_to_upper( 'aBaP development.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABAP development.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REPLACE REGEX` Anweisung in Kombination mit Capture Groups (`$1`) und String-Funktionen wie `to_upper` ermöglicht sehr flexible und dynamische Ersetzungen. Das Muster `(abap\w*)` fängt Wörter ein, die mit 'abap' beginnen (dank des `i` Modifiers für Case-Insensitivity, der hier implizit durch die ABAP-Syntax gehandhabt wird, oder explizit in der Regex-Engine), und `to_upper('$1')` wandelt den gefangenen Teil in Großbuchstaben um.
keywords: REPLACE REGEX, Regular Expressions, to_upper, String Functions, Capture Group

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen eines Strings sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen. Verwenden Sie String-Funktionen und `REPLACE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `condense` mit `REPLACE` oder nutzen Sie `replace` mit Regex für Leerzeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_normalize_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_normalized_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_normalize_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_spaces.
    rv_normalized_text = iv_text.
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces and reduce multiple spaces to one
    rv_normalized_text = condense( rv_normalized_text ).
    " Alternative using regex for multiple spaces (more explicit)
    " rv_normalized_text = replace( val = rv_normalized_text regex = '\s+' with = ` ` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_all_profile_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Profilparameter, deren Namen mit 'rdisp/' beginnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_profile_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_profile_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_profile_param.
    TYPES: tt_profile_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_profile_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_rdisp_params RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_params) TYPE tt_profile_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_profile_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_rdisp_params.
    DATA(lo_param_handler) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_params) = lo_param_handler->get_all_parameters( ).

    rt_filtered_params = FILTER #( lt_all_params USING KEY default
                                   WHERE name CS 'rdisp/' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_rdisp_params FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_rdisp_params.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filtered_profile_params( ).
    DATA(lt_params) = lo_cut->get_rdisp_params( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Filtered list should not be empty' act = lt_params ).
    LOOP AT lt_params INTO DATA(ls_param).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = |Parameter { ls_param-name } does not start with 'rdisp/'| act = ( ls_param-name CP 'rdisp/*' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER` Ausdrucksform ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. In Kombination mit `CS` (Contains String) oder `CP` (Contains Pattern) ermöglicht dies eine effiziente Datenmanipulation direkt im Code.
keywords: Profile Parameter, System, Internal Tables, FILTER, CS, CP, cl_spfl_profile_parameter

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie, ob ein bestimmter Profilparameter einen numerischen Wert hat und geben Sie diesen als Integer zurück. Andernfalls geben Sie 0 zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value` und `COND` mit `IS NUMERIC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_numeric_param_getter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_numeric_param IMPORTING iv_param_name TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_numeric_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_param_getter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_numeric_param.
    DATA(lo_param_handler) = NEW cl_spfl_profile_parameter( ).
    DATA(lv_param_value) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_param_value = lo_param_handler->get_parameter_value( i_param_name = iv_param_name ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter.
        rv_numeric_value = 0.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    rv_numeric_value = COND #( WHEN lv_param_value IS NUMERIC THEN CONV i( lv_param_value ) ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_handler_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_handler_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_update_for_flights.
    DATA: lv_subrc TYPE sy-subrc.
    ev_success = abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      UPDATE sflight SET
        price    = <fs_flight>-price
        currency = <fs_flight>-currency
        WHERE
          carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid AND
          connid = <fs_flight>-connid AND
          fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.
      lv_subrc = sy-subrc.

      IF lv_subrc <> 0.
        " In a real RAP handler, messages would be reported via %msg or failed/reported structures.
        " Here, we simulate a failure by setting a flag and raising an exception.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Update failed for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_det_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_det_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_update_with_determination.
    DATA: lv_subrc TYPE sy-subrc.
    ev_success = abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      UPDATE sflight SET
        price    = <fs_flight>-price
        currency = <fs_flight>-currency
        WHERE
          carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid AND
          connid = <fs_flight>-connid AND
          fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.
      lv_subrc = sy-subrc.

      IF lv_subrc <> 0.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Update failed for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate }|.
      ELSE.
        " Determination logic: Update last changed by/at
        UPDATE sflight SET
          lchgdate = sy-datum
          lchgtime = sy-uzeit
          lchguser = sy-uname
          WHERE
            carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid AND
            connid = <fs_flight>-connid AND
            fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          " Handle error for determination update if necessary
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |Determination update failed for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate }|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_assoc_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_sflight_update,
      tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_update_with_association
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_update TYPE tt_sflight_update
      EXPORTING
        ev_success           TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_assoc_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_update_with_association.
    DATA: lv_subrc TYPE sy-subrc.
    ev_success = abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      " Update main entity (flight capacity)
      UPDATE sflight SET
        seatsmax = <fs_flight>-seatsmax
        WHERE
          carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid AND
          connid = <fs_flight>-connid AND
          fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.
      lv_subrc = sy-subrc.

      IF lv_subrc <> 0.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Update failed for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate }|.
      ELSE.
        " In a real RAP scenario, you would use MODIFY ENTITIES to update associated bookings
        " or trigger a determination/validation on the booking entity.
        " Here, we simulate a check: if new capacity is less than occupied seats, raise error.
        SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_seatsocc)

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_feat_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_update,
      tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_update_with_feature_control
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_update TYPE tt_sflight_update
        iv_flight_started    TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false " Simulated condition
      EXPORTING
        ev_success           TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_feat_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_update_with_feature_control.
    DATA: lv_subrc TYPE sy-subrc.
    ev_success = abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      " Feature control logic: Price can only be updated if flight has not started
      IF iv_flight_started = abap_true.
        " In a real RAP scenario, this would be handled by field-specific feature control
        " (e.g., READ-ONLY for price field).
        " Here, we prevent the update and raise an error.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Price for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate } cannot be updated as it has already started.|.
      ENDIF.

      UPDATE sflight SET
        price    = <fs_flight>-price
        currency = <fs_flight>-currency
        WHERE
          carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid AND
          connid = <fs_flight>-connid AND
          fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.
      lv_subrc = sy-subrc.

      IF lv_subrc <> 0.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Update failed for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_etag_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_etag_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_update_with_etag.
    DATA: lv_subrc TYPE sy-subrc.
    ev_success = abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      " Simulate ETag check
      SELECT SINGLE lchgtime FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_db_etag)
        WHERE carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid AND connid = <fs_flight>-connid AND fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.

      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_db_etag IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_db_etag <> <fs_flight>-etag.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Optimistic lock failed for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate }. Data was changed by another user.|.
      ENDIF.

      UPDATE sflight SET
        price    = <fs_flight>-price
        lchgtime = sy-uzeit " Update ETag
        WHERE
          carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid AND
          connid = <fs_flight>-connid AND
          fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.
      lv_subrc = sy-subrc.

      IF lv_subrc <> 0.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Update failed for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

        " Verify active data is NOT changed (as it's a draft update)

          WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_db exp = 2300 msg = 'Price should be updated in simulated draft' ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine `UPDATE`-Logik, die bei der Aktualisierung eines Fluges auch eine zugehörige Statistik-Entität aktualisiert (z.B. die Gesamtzahl der aktualisierten Flüge). Simulieren Sie diese Cross-Entity-Aktualisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie separate `UPDATE`-Statements für die Hauptentität und die Statistik-Entität.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_flight_cross_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight_update,
      tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_cross_entity_update
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_update TYPE tt_sflight_update
      EXPORTING
        ev_success           TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_cross_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_cross_entity_update.
    DATA: lv_subrc TYPE sy-subrc.
    ev_success = abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      " Update main entity (sflight)
      UPDATE sflight SET
        price    = <fs_flight>-price
        WHERE
          carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid AND
          connid = <fs_flight>-connid AND
          fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate.
      lv_subrc = sy-subrc.

      IF lv_subrc <> 0.
        ev_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Update failed for flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } { <fs_flight>-fldate }|.
      ELSE.
        " Simulate update of a related statistics entity (e.g., ZFLIGHT_STATS)
        " For simplicity, we'll just increment a counter in a dummy table or variable.
        " In a real RAP scenario, this would be a MODIFY ENTITIES on another entity.
        DATA(lv_updated_count) = 0.
        SELECT SINGLE count FROM zflight_stats INTO @lv_updated_count.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          INSERT zflight_stats FROM @( VALUE #( count = 1 ) ).
        ELSE.
          UPDATE zflight_stats SET count = count + 1.
        ENDIF.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Failed to update flight statistics.'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    " Ensure dummy statistics table exists and is empty or reset
    DELETE FROM zflight_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cross_entity_update_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_flight_cross_sim( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_rap_flight_cross_sim=>tt_sflight_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 2500 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_cross_entity_update(
          EXPORTING
            it_flights_to_update = lt_updates
          IMPORTING
            ev_success           = lv_success
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Cross-entity update should succeed' ).

        " Verify main entity update
        SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_price_db)
          WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_db exp = 2500 msg = 'Flight price should be updated' ).

        " Verify statistics entity update
        SELECT SINGLE count FROM zflight_stats INTO @DATA(lv_stats_count).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_stats_count exp = 1 msg = 'Statistics count should be incremented' ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_ex->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert eine Cross-Entity-Aktualisierung, bei der die `UPDATE`-Operation einer Entität (Flug) eine Aktualisierung einer anderen, assoziierten Entität (Flugstatistik) auslöst. In einem echten RAP-Szenario würde dies durch `MODIFY ENTITIES` auf die assoziierte Entität innerhalb der `FOR UPDATE` Methode des Behavior Handlers realisiert, um die Datenkonsistenz über Entitätsgrenzen hinweg zu gewährleisten.

CLASS zcl_struct_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             source_id   TYPE i,
             source_text TYPE string,
             source_value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_key  TYPE i,
             target_desc TYPE string,
             target_amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS map_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_struct_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structures.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING source_id = target_key
                                                 source_text = target_desc
                                                 source_value = target_amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_update_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value1 TYPE string,
             value2 TYPE string,

      IMPORTING
        it_base_table TYPE tt_data
        it_update_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_update_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_table.
    rt_updated_table = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( it_base_table ) it_update_data
                                        MAPPING id = id
                                        WHERE id = id ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_update_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_base) = VALUE zcl_itab_update_corresponding=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value1 = 'A' value2 = 'X' )
      ( id = 2 value1 = 'B' value2 = 'Y' )
      ( id = 3 value1 = 'C' value2 = 'Z' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_update) = VALUE zcl_itab_update_corresponding=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value1 = 'New A' )
      ( id = 3 value2 = 'New Z' )
      ( id = 4 value1 = 'D' value2 = 'W' ) " New entry, should be added
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->update_table( it_base_table = lt_base it_update_data = lt_update ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 1 ]-value1 exp = 'New A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 1 ]-value2 exp = 'X' ). " value2 not updated
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 2 ]-value1 exp = 'B' ). " not updated
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 3 ]-value1 exp = 'C' ). " value1 not updated
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 3 ]-value2 exp = 'New Z' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 4 ]-value1 exp = 'D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` und `WHERE` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Syntax, um interne Tabellen zu aktualisieren. `BASE` initialisiert die Zieltabelle mit der Basistabelle, und die `WHERE`-Klausel steuert, welche Zeilen aus der Quelltabelle für die Aktualisierung herangezogen werden. Dies ermöglicht eine deklarative und performante Datenmanipulation.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, BASE, WHERE, Internal Tables, Update, Data Manipulation

        lo_excel->save_spreadsheet( i_filename = iv_filename ).
      CATCH cx_openxml_exception INTO DATA(lx_openxml).
        " Handle exception, e.g., log error

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer Excel-Datei, transformieren Sie sie mit dem `CORRESPONDING` Operator und schreiben Sie die transformierten Daten in eine neue Excel-Datei.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_openxml_helper` zum Lesen und Schreiben mit dem `CORRESPONDING` Operator zur Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             old_col1 TYPE string,
             old_col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             new_field_a TYPE string,
             new_field_b TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS transform_excel_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_filename TYPE string
        iv_target_filename TYPE string
        iv_source_sheet    TYPE string
        iv_target_sheet    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_excel_data.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE tt_source_data,
          lt_target_data TYPE tt_target_data.
    DATA: lo_reader TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper,
          lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_reader.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_writer.

    TRY.
        lo_reader->load_spreadsheet( i_filename = iv_source_filename ).
        lo_reader->get_table_data( EXPORTING i_table_name = iv_source_sheet IMPORTING e_table_data = lt_source_data ).

        lt_target_data = CORRESPONDING #( lt_source_data MAPPING old_col1 = new_field_a
                                                           old_col2 = new_field_b ).

        lo_writer->create_spreadsheet( ).
        lo_writer->add_table_data( i_table_name = iv_target_sheet i_table_data = lt_target_data ).
        lo_writer->save_spreadsheet( i_filename = iv_target_filename ).

      CATCH cx_openxml_exception INTO DATA(lx_openxml).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_dyn_text
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_openxml->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_excel_data.
    DATA(lo_writer_init) = NEW zcl_excel_writer( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_data) = VALUE zcl_excel_transform=>tt_source_data(
      ( old_col1 = 'Source A' old_col2 = 'Source B' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_source_filename) = |{ cl_abap_temp_file=>create_temp_file( ) }.xlsx|.
    lo_writer_init->create_excel( iv_filename = lv_source_filename iv_sheetname = 'SourceSheet' it_data = lt_initial_data ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_transform( ).
    DATA(lv_target_filename) = |{ cl_abap_temp_file=>create_temp_file( ) }.xlsx|.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->transform_excel_data( iv_source_filename = lv_source_filename
                                      iv_target_filename = lv_target_filename
                                      iv_source_sheet = 'SourceSheet'
                                      iv_target_sheet = 'TargetSheet' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true msg = 'Excel transformation completed successfully' ).

        " Optional: Read target file and assert content (requires another reader instance)
        DATA(lo_reader_target) = NEW zcl_excel_reader( ).
        DATA(lt_transformed_data) = lo_reader_target->read_excel( iv_filename = lv_target_filename iv_sheetname = 'TargetSheet' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed_data ) exp = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed_data[1]-col1 exp = 'Source A' ). " Note: col1 is the generic name in zcl_excel_reader=>ty_excel_data

      CATCH cx_abap_message_dyn_text INTO DATA(lx_message).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Error during Excel transformation: { lx_message->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_temp_file=>delete_temp_file( lv_source_filename ).
    cl_abap_temp_file=>delete_temp_file( lv_target_filename ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `load_spreadsheet` mit `i_xstring_file` und `save_spreadsheet` mit `e_xstring_file`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_xstring_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES tt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_data,
             id TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_data.
    TYPES tt_processed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_excel_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_sheet   TYPE string
        iv_target_sheet   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_target_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_xstring_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_excel_xstring.
    DATA: lo_reader TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper,
          lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper.
    DATA: lt_raw_data TYPE tt_raw_data,
          lt_processed_data TYPE tt_processed_data.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_reader.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_writer.

    TRY.
        lo_reader->load_spreadsheet( i_xstring_file = iv_source_xstring ).
        lo_reader->get_table_data( EXPORTING i_table_name = iv_source_sheet IMPORTING e_table_data = lt_raw_data ).

        " Simple processing: concatenate and map
        lt_processed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_data
                                      ( id = ls_raw-col1
                                        description = |{ ls_raw-col1 } - { ls_raw-col2 }| ) ).

        lo_writer->create_spreadsheet( ).
        lo_writer->add_table_data( i_table_name = iv_target_sheet i_table_data = lt_processed_data ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine generische Struktur, die für eine 2D-Visualisierung geeignet wäre (z.B. als Punkte mit Koordinaten und Farbe).
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `CORRESPONDING FIELDS` und interne Tabellen-Comprehensions (`FOR`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_2d_point,
             x_coord TYPE i,
             y_coord TYPE i,
             color   TYPE string,
             label   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_2d_point,
           tt_2d_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_2d_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflights_to_2d
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_2d_data) TYPE tt_2d_points.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights_to_2d.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      UP TO @iv_max_entries ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_2d_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                           LET l_x = ls_flight-seatsocc
                               l_y = ls_flight-seatsmax
                               l_color = COND string( WHEN l_x > l_y / 2 THEN 'RED' ELSE 'GREEN' )
                               l_label = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } ({ l_x }/{ l_y })|
                           IN
                           ( x_coord = l_x,
                             y_coord = l_y,
                             color   = l_color,
                             label   = l_label ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die dynamische Konfiguration eines 2D-Viewers (konzeptionell) basierend auf Eingabeparametern, indem Sie ein Konfigurationsobjekt erstellen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_2d_viewer_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_viewer_settings,
             display_mode TYPE string,
             background_color TYPE string,
             show_grid    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_viewer_settings.

    CLASS-METHODS create_config
      IMPORTING
        iv_config_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_settings) TYPE ty_viewer_settings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_2d_viewer_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_config.
    rs_settings = SWITCH ty_viewer_settings(
      iv_config_type
      WHEN 'DEFAULT' THEN VALUE #( display_mode = 'POINTS' background_color = 'WHITE' show_grid = abap_true )
      WHEN 'DARK_MODE' THEN VALUE #( display_mode = 'LINES' background_color = 'BLACK' show_grid = abap_false )
      WHEN 'GRID_ONLY' THEN VALUE #( display_mode = 'NONE' background_color = 'LIGHTGRAY' show_grid = abap_true )
      ELSE VALUE #( display_mode = 'POINTS' background_color = 'WHITE' show_grid = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_2d_viewer_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` in 'Layer' basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`), um sie für eine geschichtete 2D-Visualisierung vorzubereiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer internen Tabellen-Comprehension.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_layer_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_layer,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_flight_layer,
           tt_flight_layers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_layer WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_layers) TYPE tt_flight_layers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_layer_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      UP TO @iv_max_entries ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_layers = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   flights = VALUE #( FOR flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                      ( connid = flight_in_group-connid,
                                                        fldate = flight_in_group-fldate,
                                                        seatsocc = flight_in_group-seatsocc,
                                                        seatsmax = flight_in_group-seatsmax ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die grundlegenden Eigenschaften (z.B. Länge, Ausgabelänge, Dezimalstellen) eines Feldes basierend auf seiner DDIC-Domäne.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr` in Kombination mit `cl_reca_ddic_doma`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reca_domain_field_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_properties,
             field_name     TYPE fieldname,
             domain_name    TYPE ddobjname,
             length         TYPE i,
             output_length  TYPE i,
             decimals       TYPE i,
             data_type      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_properties.

    METHODS get_field_domain_properties
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_struct_type TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_properties) TYPE ty_field_properties
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_domain_field_props IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_domain_properties.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_type ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_components WHERE ( name = iv_field_name ) ( ls_comp ) OPTIONAL ).

    IF ls_component IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure '{ iv_struct_type }'.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type ).

    rs_properties = VALUE #( field_name = iv_field_name
                             domain_name = lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_field_info( )-domname
                             length = lo_elem_descr->length
                             output_length = lo_elem_descr->output_length
                             decimals = lo_elem_descr->decimals
                             data_type = lo_elem_descr->type_kind ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Auslastung (belegte Sitze / maximale Sitze) für eine Liste von Flügen aus `sflights` und geben Sie das Ergebnis als Prozentsatz zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie interne Tabellen-Comprehensions mit `FOR` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupancy_percent TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy,
           tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      UP TO @iv_max_entries ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                             LET l_occupancy = COND decfloat34( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0
                                                               THEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ) * 100
                                                               ELSE 0 )
                             IN
                             ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                               connid = ls_flight-connid,
                               fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                               occupancy_percent = |{ l_occupancy ROUND = UP TO 2 DECIMALS }%| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_cut->calculate_occupancy( 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_occupancy ) exp = 0 err_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_err_level_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 10 entries' act = lines( lt_occupancy ) exp = 10 ).

    DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_occupancy[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Occupancy percent should not be initial' act = ls_first_entry-occupancy_percent ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Occupancy percent should contain %' act = contains( val = ls_first_entry-occupancy_percent sub = '%' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_seatsmax.
    " Mock data with seatsmax = 0 to test division by zero handling
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 0 ) ) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_mock_sflights).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_cut->calculate_occupancy( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Occupancy for zero seatsmax should be 0%' act = lt_occupancy[ 1 ]-occupancy_percent exp = '0.00%' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX'. " Clean up mock data
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung von Auslastungsraten mit modernen ABAP-Features. Es verwendet interne Tabellen-Comprehensions (`FOR`, `LET`) für die effiziente Verarbeitung von Daten und die `COND`-Expression zur Vermeidung von Division durch Null. String Templates (`|...|`) formatieren das Ergebnis direkt als Prozentsatz, was den Code sehr lesbar und kompakt macht.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Voll', 'Halb voll', 'Leer') basierend auf der Auslastung der Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `COND`-Expression für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status,
           tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      UP TO @iv_max_entries ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 LET l_occupancy_ratio = COND decfloat34( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0
                                                                         THEN ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax
                                                                         ELSE 0 )
                                 IN
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                   status = COND string(
                                              WHEN l_occupancy_ratio >= '0.8' THEN 'Voll'
                                              WHEN l_occupancy_ratio >= '0.4' THEN 'Halb voll'
                                              ELSE 'Leer' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Schnittstelle für 'Visualisierbare Objekte' und implementieren Sie diese für Flugdaten, um eine einheitliche Datenbereitstellung für einen 2D-Viewer zu gewährleisten.
hint: Verwenden Sie Interfaces und die `FOR`-Expression mit `INSTANCE OF`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_visualizable_object PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_visual_data,
           id    TYPE string,
           type  TYPE string,
           x_pos TYPE i,
           y_pos TYPE i,
           color TYPE string,
           label TYPE string,
         END OF ty_visual_data.

  METHODS get_visual_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_visual_data) TYPE ty_visual_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_visualizable_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_visualizable_object.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_sflight TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_visualizable_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_sflight = is_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_visualizable_object~get_visual_data.
    rs_visual_data = VALUE #( id    = |{ ms_sflight-carrid }-{ ms_sflight-connid }|
                              type  = 'FLIGHT'
                              x_pos = ms_sflight-seatsocc
                              y_pos = ms_sflight-seatsmax
                              color = COND string( WHEN ms_sflight-seatsocc > ms_sflight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'RED' ELSE 'BLUE' )
                              label = |{ ms_sflight-carrid } { ms_sflight-connid }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_visual_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_visualizable_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_visualizable_object WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_visual_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zif_visualizable_object~ty_visual_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_visual_data
      IMPORTING
        it_visualizable_objects TYPE tt_visualizable_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_visual_data) TYPE tt_visual_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_visual_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_visual_data.
    rt_visual_data = VALUE #( FOR lo_object IN it_visualizable_objects
                               ( lo_object->get_visual_data( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_visual_data_extraction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_visual_data_extraction.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lt_visualizable_objects TYPE zcl_visual_data_provider=>tt_visualizable_objects.

    SELECT FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      UP TO 2 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND NEW zcl_visualizable_flight( ls_sflight ) TO lt_visualizable_objects.
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Funktion, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur basierend auf dem Feldnamen und der Domäne des Feldes formatiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_elemdescr`) und `cl_reca_ddic_doma` zur dynamischen Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_field_by_domain
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name  TYPE fieldname
        iv_struct_ref  TYPE REF TO data
        iv_langu       TYPE sy-langu DEFAULT sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error
        cx_reca_ddic_doma.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_field_by_domain.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( iv_struct_ref ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_components WHERE ( name = iv_field_name ) ( ls_comp ) OPTIONAL ).

    IF ls_component IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure.|.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE iv_struct_ref TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not assign field '{ iv_field_name }'.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type ).
    DATA(lv_domain_name) = lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_field_info( )-domname.

    IF lv_domain_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_instance( lv_domain_name ).
      rv_formatted_value = lo_domain->convert_to_external( iv_internal_value = <fs_field> iv_langu = iv_langu ).
    ELSE.
      rv_formatted_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_visualizable_object PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_visual_data,
           id    TYPE string,
           type  TYPE string,
           x_pos TYPE i,
           y_pos TYPE i,
           color TYPE string,
           label TYPE string,
         END OF ty_visual_data.

  METHODS get_visual_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_visual_data) TYPE ty_visual_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_visualizable_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_visualizable_object.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_sflight TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_visualizable_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_sflight = is_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_visualizable_object~get_visual_data.
    rs_visual_data = VALUE #( id    = |{ ms_sflight-carrid }-{ ms_sflight-connid }|
                              type  = 'FLIGHT'
                              x_pos = ms_sflight-seatsocc
                              y_pos = ms_sflight-seatsmax
                              color = COND string( WHEN ms_sflight-seatsocc > ms_sflight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'RED' ELSE 'BLUE' )
                              label = |{ ms_sflight-carrid } { ms_sflight-connid }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_visual_object_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_visualizable_object
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_visual_object) TYPE REF TO zif_visualizable_object
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_visual_object_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_visualizable_object.
    DATA(lv_type_name) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data )->get_relative_name( ).

    CASE lv_type_name.
      WHEN 'SFLIGHTS'.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflights.
        ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_sflight>.
        ro_visual_object = NEW zcl_visualizable_flight( <fs_sflight> ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unsupported data type for visualization: { lv_type_name }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch, ob ein Feld in einer Struktur eine bestimmte DDIC-Domäne verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_elemdescr`) und vergleichen Sie den Domänennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reca_domain_field_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS field_uses_domain
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name  TYPE fieldname
        iv_struct_type TYPE ddobjname
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_uses_domain) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_domain_field_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD field_uses_domain.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_type ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_components WHERE ( name = iv_field_name ) ( ls_comp ) OPTIONAL ).

    IF ls_component IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure '{ iv_struct_type }'.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type ).
    DATA(lv_found_domain) = lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_field_info( )-domname.

    rv_uses_domain = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_found_domain = iv_domain_name THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flügen aus `sflights` basierend auf einem minimalen Auslastungsprozentsatz.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FILTER`-Expression für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             occupancy_percent TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy,
           tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_by_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_occupancy_percent TYPE decfloat34
        iv_max_entries           TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_by_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      UP TO @iv_max_entries ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_flights_with_occupancy) = VALUE tt_flight_occupancy( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                                                  LET l_occupancy = COND decfloat34( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0
                                                                                                    THEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ) * 100
                                                                                                    ELSE 0 )
                                                                  IN
                                                                  ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                                                    connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                                                    fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                                                    seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc,
                                                                    seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax,
                                                                    occupancy_percent = l_occupancy ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_flights_with_occupancy WHERE occupancy_percent >= iv_min_occupancy_percent ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered flight should be 001' act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX'.

  METHOD test_filter_low_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'YY' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 100 ) ) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_mock_sflights4).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'YY' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) ) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_mock_sflights5).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'YY' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 100 ) ) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_mock_sflights6).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights_by_occupancy( iv_min_occupancy_percent = 99 iv_max_entries = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected no flights with >= 99% occupancy' act = lines( lt_filtered ) ).

CLASS zcl_ci_query_attributes_01 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
             name TYPE seoc_attrn,
             type TYPE seoc_type,
           END OF ty_attribute.

CLASS zcl_ci_query_attributes_01 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA: lt_attributes_raw TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>tt_attributes.

        cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_attributes_of_class(
          EXPORTING
            i_class_name = iv_class_name
          IMPORTING
            e_attributes = lt_attributes_raw
        ).

        rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR attr_raw IN lt_attributes_raw ( 
                                   name = attr_raw-attr_name 
                                   type = attr_raw-attr_type ) ).

      CATCH cx_ci_query_attributes.
        " Handle error, e.g., class not found or other issues
        " For simplicity, we'll just return an empty table
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_query_attributes_02 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_param,
             name TYPE seoc_param,
             type TYPE seoc_type,
             kind TYPE seoc_pkind,
           END OF ty_method_param.
    TYPES tt_method_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method,
             name TYPE seoc_methodn,
             params TYPE tt_method_params,
           END OF ty_method.
    TYPES tt_methods TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE seoc_clsnm
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_methods.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_query_attributes_02 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_methods.
    DATA: lt_methods_raw TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>tt_methods.

    TRY.
        cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_methods_of_class(
          EXPORTING
            i_class_name = iv_class_name
          IMPORTING
            e_methods    = lt_methods_raw
        ).

        rt_methods = VALUE #( FOR method_raw IN lt_methods_raw ( 
                               name = method_raw-method_name,
                               params = VALUE #( FOR param_raw IN cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_parameters_of_method(
                                                                    i_class_name  = iv_class_name,
                                                                    i_method_name = method_raw-method_name ) ( 
                                                                    name = param_raw-param_name,
                                                                    type = param_raw-param_type,
                                                                    kind = param_raw-param_kind ) ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_ci_query_attributes.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_query_attributes_02( ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_cut->get_class_methods( 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_methods ) ##NO_TEXT.

IN ... )' für die Transformation der Rohdaten in eine strukturierte interne Tabelle, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_01 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname. " Name of the custom container on screen

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_01 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_toolbar.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_toolbar   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'SAVE'
      icon  = icon_system_save
      butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_push
      text  = 'Speichern'
      quickinfo = 'Daten speichern'
    ).

    lo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'DELETE'
      icon  = icon_delete
      butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_push
      text  = 'Löschen'
      quickinfo = 'Daten löschen'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Toolbar und implementieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für Button-Klicks.
hint: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das 'BUTTON_CLICK' Ereignis der Toolbar.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_03 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS button_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(e_fcode) TYPE syfcode.

    METHODS display_toolbar_with_events
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_03 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_toolbar_with_events.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.

    mo_toolbar->add_button( fcode = 'BTN1' text = 'Button 1' ).
    mo_toolbar->add_button( fcode = 'BTN2' text = 'Button 2' ).
    mo_toolbar->set_all_visible( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    " In a real application, this would trigger specific actions
    " For this example, we just raise a custom event
    RAISE EVENT button_clicked EXPORTING e_fcode = fcode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_fcode_received TYPE syfcode.
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_test_button_clicked FOR EVENT button_clicked OF zcl_gui_toolbar_03
      FOR INSTANCE mo_cut
      IMPORTING e_fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(mo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_toolbar_03( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_test_button_clicked FOR mo_cut.

    " Simulate the toolbar creation (though not visually)
    mo_cut->display_toolbar_with_events( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).

    " Directly call the event handler method to simulate a button click
    " This bypasses the actual GUI interaction but tests the internal logic
    CALL METHOD mo_cut->('HANDLE_BUTTON_CLICK') " Use dynamic call for private method
      EXPORTING
        fcode = 'BTN1'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_fcode_received exp = 'BTN1' ) ##NO_TEXT.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_test_button_clicked.
    mv_fcode_received = e_fcode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Implementierung der Ereignisbehandlung für Toolbar-Buttons. Ein privater Event-Handler wird mit 'SET HANDLER' für das 'BUTTON_CLICK' Ereignis der Toolbar registriert. Bei einem Klick wird ein benutzerdefiniertes Ereignis ausgelöst, das in einer realen Anwendung weitere Logik anstoßen würde. Der Unit-Test simuliert den Event-Aufruf, um die interne Logik zu prüfen. Eine direkte offizielle 'help.sap.com'-Dokumentation für 'cl_gui_toolbar' ist nicht leicht auffindbar.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_04 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

        iv_enable_save    TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_04 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_toolbar.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

        OTHERS = 1.

    mo_toolbar->add_button( fcode = 'CANCEL' text = 'Abbrechen' icon = icon_cancel ).

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung eines Zufallsindexes und greifen Sie dann auf die Tabelle zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No flights found in SFLIGHT table.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
                           seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( )
                           min  = 1
                           max  = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Failed to read random flight (index out of bounds, should not happen).'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine temporäre Zufallssortierspalte und sortieren Sie die Tabelle danach. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tbl_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_shuffled,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             random_key TYPE i, " Temporary field for shuffling
           END OF ty_sflight_shuffled.
    TYPES tt_sflight_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_shuffled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_shuffled
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled) TYPE tt_sflight_shuffled.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tbl_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_flights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 1000000 ). " Max value for random key

    rt_shuffled = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                            ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                              connid = ls_flight-connid
                              fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                              price = ls_flight-price
                              currency = ls_flight-currency
                              random_key = lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).

    SORT rt_shuffled BY random_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_flights.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_tbl_shuffler=>tt_sflight_shuffled,
          ls_flight   TYPE zcl_tbl_shuffler=>ty_sflight_shuffled.

    " Populate with some dummy data
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250101'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_original.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0010'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250102'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_original.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0020'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250103'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_original.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'DL'. ls_flight-connid = '0030'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250104'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_original.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tbl_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_flights( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should remain the same' act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).

    " Check if content is the same (ignoring order and random_key)
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_original_sorted BY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted BY carrid connid fldate.

    LOOP AT lt_original_sorted INTO DATA(ls_orig).
      READ TABLE lt_shuffled_sorted INTO DATA(ls_shuf) WITH KEY carrid = ls_orig-carrid connid = ls_orig-connid fldate = ls_orig-fldate.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( msg = 'All original entries should be present' act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that the order is likely different (probabilistic check)
    " This is hard to assert deterministically for shuffling. We check if the tables are not identical.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( msg = 'Tables should be shuffled (unlikely to be identical)' act = lt_original exp = lt_shuffled ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_empty TYPE zcl_tbl_shuffler=>tt_sflight_shuffled.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tbl_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_flights( lt_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Shuffling an empty table should result in an empty table' act = lt_shuffled ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl (N) zufälliger Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_random_int` mit einer Schleife und einer Hash-Tabelle, um Duplikate bei der Indexauswahl zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_sample_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_random_sample
      IMPORTING
        iv_sample_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sample) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_sample_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sample.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No flights found in SFLIGHT table.'.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_sample_size <= 0.
      RETURN. " Return empty table for invalid sample size
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
    IF iv_sample_size > lv_total_flights.
      iv_sample_size = lv_total_flights. " Adjust sample size if greater than total
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
                           seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( )
                           min  = 1
                           max  = lv_total_flights ).

    DATA(lt_selected_indices) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lv_current_sample_size) TYPE i VALUE 0.

    WHILE lv_current_sample_size < iv_sample_size.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_random_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Only increment if index was unique
        lv_current_sample_size = lv_current_sample_size + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    LOOP AT lt_selected_indices INTO DATA(lv_index).
      READ TABLE lt_all_flights INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE rt_sample.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Flugdatum innerhalb eines vorgegebenen Jahresbereichs (z.B. 2024-2026).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für Tage, Monate und Jahre und die `CONVERT DATE` Funktionalität oder String-Operationen zur Datumskonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_year TYPE i
        iv_end_year   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arith_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    IF iv_start_year > iv_end_year.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arith_overflow EXPORTING text = 'Start year must be less than or equal to end year.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_year) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = iv_start_year max = iv_end_year ).
    DATA(lv_year) = lo_random_year->get_next( ).

    DATA(lo_random_month) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 12 ).
    DATA(lv_month) = lo_random_month->get_next( ).

    DATA(lv_days_in_month) TYPE i.
    CASE lv_month.
      WHEN 1 OR 3 OR 5 OR 7 OR 8 OR 10 OR 12. lv_days_in_month = 31.
      WHEN 4 OR 6 OR 9 OR 11. lv_days_in_month = 30.
      WHEN 2.
        IF ( lv_year MOD 4 = 0 AND lv_year MOD 100 <> 0 ) OR lv_year MOD 400 = 0.
          lv_days_in_month = 29. " Leap year
        ELSE.
          lv_days_in_month = 28.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS. " Should not happen
        lv_days_in_month = 30.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lo_random_day) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_days_in_month ).
    DATA(lv_day) = lo_random_day->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = |{ lv_year ALPHA = OUT }{ lv_month ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }{ lv_day ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_date_in_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_year_range FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_leap_year_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_date_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_date_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->get_random_date( iv_start_year = 2024 iv_end_year = 2026 ).

    DATA(lv_year)  = lv_random_date(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = lv_random_date+4(2).
    DATA(lv_day)   = lv_random_date+6(2).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Year should be within range' act = ( lv_year >= '2024' AND lv_year <= '2026' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Month should be valid' act = ( lv_month >= '01' AND lv_month <= '12' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Day should be valid' act = ( lv_day >= '01' AND lv_day <= '31' ) ).

    " Check if it's a valid date (e.g., no 31st of Feb)
    DATA(lv_valid_date) TYPE d.
    TRY.
        lv_valid_date = lv_random_date.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Generated date should be valid' act = lv_valid_date exp = lv_random_date ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Generated date is not a valid date.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_year_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_date_generator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_random_date( iv_start_year = 2026 iv_end_year = 2024 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_arith_overflow for invalid year range.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arith_overflow.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_leap_year_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_date_generator( ).
    " Force a leap year and February
    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->get_random_date( iv_start_year = 2024 iv_end_year = 2024 ). " 2024 is a leap year
    " This test is probabilistic, but we can check if Feb 29 is possible.
    " For a deterministic test, one would mock the random number generator.
    IF lv_random_date+4(2) = '02' AND lv_random_date+6(2) = '29'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'February 29th should be possible in a leap year' act = xsdbool( lv_random_date+4(2) = '02' AND lv_random_date+6(2) = '29' ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige Flugnummer (z.B. 'LH1234'), bestehend aus zwei Buchstaben und vier Ziffern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Auswahl von Zeichen und Ziffern und String-Templates zum Zusammenfügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_flightnum_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_flight_number
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_number) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_flightnum_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_number.
    DATA(lv_alphabet) = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
    DATA(lv_digits)   = '0123456789'.

    DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = strlen( lv_alphabet ) - 1 ).
    DATA(lo_random_digit) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = strlen( lv_digits ) - 1 ).

    DATA(lv_char1) = lv_alphabet+lo_random_char->get_next( )(1).
    DATA(lv_char2) = lv_alphabet+lo_random_char->get_next( )(1).

    DATA(lv_digit1) = lv_digits+lo_random_digit->get_next( )(1).
    DATA(lv_digit2) = lv_digits+lo_random_digit->get_next( )(1).
    DATA(lv_digit3) = lv_digits+lo_random_digit->get_next( )(1).
    DATA(lv_digit4) = lv_digits+lo_random_digit->get_next( )(1).

    rv_flight_number = |{ lv_char1 }{ lv_char2 }{ lv_digit1 }{ lv_digit2 }{ lv_digit3 }{ lv_digit4 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight number length should be 6' act = strlen( lv_flight_number ) exp = 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'First two characters should be letters' act = ( lv_flight_number(1) CO 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' AND lv_flight_number+1(1) CO 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Last four characters should be digits' act = ( lv_flight_number+2(1) CO '0123456789' AND lv_flight_number+3(1) CO '0123456789' AND lv_flight_number+4(1) CO '0123456789' AND lv_flight_number+5(1) CO '0123456789' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lv_flight_number1) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_number( ).
    DATA(lv_flight_number2) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_number( ).

    " It's highly unlikely two random numbers are the same in a short test run
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( msg = 'Two consecutive random flight numbers should be different' act = lv_flight_number1 exp = lv_flight_number2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
