hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für eine Ganzzahl im Bereich und skalieren Sie diese dann auf den gewünschten Dezimalbereich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_price_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE decfloat16
        iv_max_price TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_price) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arith_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_price_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_price.
    IF iv_min_price > iv_max_price.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arith_overflow EXPORTING text = 'Minimum price must be less than or equal to maximum price.'.
    ENDIF.

    " Scale to integers for random number generation, then scale back.
    " We multiply by 100 to handle two decimal places.
    DATA(lv_min_int) = CONV i( iv_min_price * 100 ).
    DATA(lv_max_int) = CONV i( iv_max_price * 100 ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
                           seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( )
                           min  = lv_min_int
                           max  = lv_max_int ).
    DATA(lv_random_int) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_price = CONV decfloat16( lv_random_int ) / 100.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen Flug basierend auf einer zufälligen Wahrscheinlichkeit aus, z.B. 10% Chance für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH', sonst einen beliebigen anderen Flug.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für eine Zufallszahl zwischen 1 und 100 und `IF`-Bedingungen. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die Vorauswahl der Flüge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_prob_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_by_probability
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_probability TYPE i " Probability in percent (0-100)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_prob_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_probability.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No flights found in SFLIGHT table.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_percent) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 100 ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random_percent->get_next( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    IF lv_random_value <= iv_probability.
      " Try to select from the specified carrier
      lt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier_id ).
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      " If no flights for carrier or probability not met, select from all remaining flights
      lt_filtered_flights = lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No suitable flights found after filtering.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lv_index) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered_flights INDEX lv_index INTO rs_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Failed to read random flight from filtered list.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_probability_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_prob_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_probability) = 90. " 90% chance for LH
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_other_count) = 0.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_probability( iv_carrier_id = lv_carrier iv_probability = lv_probability ).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = lv_carrier.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_other_count = lv_other_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Assert that LH flights are significantly more frequent
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH flights should be selected with high probability' act = ( lv_lh_count > 70 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_low_probability_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_prob_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_probability) = 10. " 10% chance for LH
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_other_count) = 0.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_probability( iv_carrier_id = lv_carrier iv_probability = lv_probability ).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = lv_carrier.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_other_count = lv_other_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Assert that LH flights are less frequent
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH flights should be selected with low probability' act = ( lv_lh_count < 30 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_prob_selector( ).

        lo_cut->get_flight_by_probability( iv_carrier_id = 'XX' iv_probability = 50 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_read_error for empty SFLIGHT table.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Weisen Sie Flüge zufällig verschiedenen Gruppen zu (z.B. 'Gruppe A', 'Gruppe B', 'Gruppe C').

solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_grouped,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             group_id TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_sflight_grouped.
    TYPES tt_sflight_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_grouped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_random_groups
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_grouped
        it_group_names  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_grouped
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_random_groups.
    IF it_group_names IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error EXPORTING text = 'Group names cannot be empty.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_group_index) = lines( it_group_names ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_max_group_index ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  DATA(lv_random_group_index) = lo_random->get_next( )
                                  DATA(lv_group_name) = it_group_names[ lv_random_group_index ]
                                  ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    connid = ls_flight-connid
                                    fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                    price = ls_flight-price
                                    currency = ls_flight-currency
                                    group_id = lv_group_name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_groups.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_rnd_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight_grouped,
          ls_flight   TYPE zcl_rnd_flight_grouper=>ty_sflight_grouped.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_original.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0010'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_original.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0020'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_original.

    DATA(lt_group_names) TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Group A' TO lt_group_names.
    APPEND 'Group B' TO lt_group_names.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->assign_random_groups( it_flights = lt_original it_group_names = lt_group_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should remain the same' act = lines( lt_grouped_flights ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Group ID should be assigned' act = ls_grouped_flight-group_id ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Group ID should be one of the provided names' act = ( line_exists( lt_group_names[ table_line = ls_grouped_flight-group_id ] ) ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_group_names.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_rnd_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight_grouped.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_flight_grouper( ).

        lo_cut->assign_random_groups( it_flights = lt_original it_group_names = VALUE string_table( ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_read_error for empty group names.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->assign_random_groups( it_flights = VALUE zcl_rnd_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight_grouped( ) it_group_names = lt_group_names ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Assigning groups to an empty table should result in an empty table' act = lt_grouped_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle, um eine zufällige Auswahl von Fluggesellschaften anzuzeigen (z.B. 2-3 zufällige Fluggesellschaften).
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Liste zufälliger Fluggesellschaften und verwenden Sie dann den `FILTER`-Ausdruck auf der `sflights`-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_carrier_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_random_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_carriers TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_carrier_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_random_carriers.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No flights found in SFLIGHT table.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                                    ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).

    IF lt_unique_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN. " No carriers to filter by
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_carriers) = lines( lt_unique_carriers ).
    DATA(lv_num_to_select) = COND i( WHEN iv_num_carriers <= 0 THEN 1
                                     WHEN iv_num_carriers > lv_total_carriers THEN lv_total_carriers
                                     ELSE iv_num_carriers ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_total_carriers ).
    DATA(lt_selected_carrier_indices) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lv_current_selected) TYPE i VALUE 0.

    WHILE lv_current_selected < lv_num_to_select.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_random_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_carrier_indices.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_current_selected = lv_current_selected + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    DATA(lt_random_carriers) TYPE string_table.
    LOOP AT lt_selected_carrier_indices INTO DATA(lv_index).
      APPEND lt_unique_carriers[ lv_index ] TO lt_random_carriers.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN lt_random_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie zufällige Testdaten für ein Flugbuchungsszenario, einschließlich Flugnummer, Datum und Preis, und geben Sie diese als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und String-Templates, um verschiedene Felder zu füllen. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_testdata_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_data,
             booking_id   TYPE n LENGTH 10,
             flight_number TYPE string,
             flight_date   TYPE d,
             price         TYPE decfloat16,
             currency      TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_booking_data.
    TYPES tt_booking_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_random_bookings
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_bookings TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_bookings) TYPE tt_booking_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_testdata_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_bookings.
    DATA(lo_random_num) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 999999999 ).
    DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = 25 ). " A-Z
    DATA(lo_random_digit) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = 9 ).
    DATA(lo_random_year) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 2024 max = 2026 ).
    DATA(lo_random_month) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 12 ).
    DATA(lo_random_price_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 10000 max = 100000 ). " 100.00 to 1000.00

    DATA(lv_alphabet) = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
    DATA(lv_digits)   = '0123456789'.

    rt_bookings = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_bookings
                             LET lv_year = lo_random_year->get_next( )
                                 lv_month = lo_random_month->get_next( )
                                 lv_days_in_month = COND i( WHEN lv_month = 2 THEN COND i( WHEN ( lv_year MOD 4 = 0 AND lv_year MOD 100 <> 0 ) OR lv_year MOD 400 = 0 THEN 29 ELSE 28 )
                                                            WHEN lv_month = 4 OR lv_month = 6 OR lv_month = 9 OR lv_month = 11 THEN 30
                                                            ELSE 31 )
                                 lv_day = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_days_in_month )->get_next( )
                                 lv_flight_date = |{ lv_year ALPHA = OUT }{ lv_month ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }{ lv_day ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }|
                                 lv_char1 = lv_alphabet+lo_random_char->get_next( )(1)
                                 lv_char2 = lv_alphabet+lo_random_char->get_next( )(1)
                                 lv_digit1 = lv_digits+lo_random_digit->get_next( )(1)
                                 lv_digit2 = lv_digits+lo_random_digit->get_next( )(1)
                                 lv_digit3 = lv_digits+lo_random_digit->get_next( )(1)
                                 lv_digit4 = lv_digits+lo_random_digit->get_next( )(1)
                                 lv_flight_number = |{ lv_char1 }{ lv_char2 }{ lv_digit1 }{ lv_digit2 }{ lv_digit3 }{ lv_digit4 }|
                                 lv_price_int = lo_random_price_int->get_next( )
                                 lv_price = CONV decfloat16( lv_price_int ) / 100
                             IN (
                               booking_id    = |{ lo_random_num->get_next( ) ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }|
                               flight_number = lv_flight_number
                               flight_date   = lv_flight_date
                               price         = lv_price
                               currency      = 'EUR' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) mit mehreren Einträgen unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators und nutzen Sie diese in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE RANGE OF ... ( ... )` um die Range-Tabelle zu füllen und `IN` in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_value_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_flights_with_value_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_value_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_with_value_range.
    DATA(lt_carriers_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).
    rt_flights = get_flights_by_carrier( lt_carriers_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_value_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_value_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_value_select( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_value_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Die Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein, wenn Daten in SFLIGHT vorhanden sind.'
      tolerating_empty_table = abap_true
    ).
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSE IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_lh_count > 0 OR lv_aa_count > 0 )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge für LH oder AA gefunden werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator wird hier verwendet, um eine Range-Tabelle direkt mit `SIGN`, `OPTION` und `LOW`-Werten zu initialisieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um dynamische Selektionskriterien zu definieren, die dann direkt in Open SQL `WHERE`-Klauseln verwendet werden können.
keywords: VALUE, Range Table, SELECT, Open SQL, Dynamic Selection

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach einem bestimmten Flugdatum und mappen Sie die Ergebnisse in eine neue Tabelle, die nur Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer enthält, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression und `VALUE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` mit `VALUE #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_value_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_full.
    TYPES tt_flight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
    TYPES tt_flight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_map_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_full
        iv_fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_value_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_map_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( fldate = iv_fldate )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_value_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_value_filter_map=>tt_flight_full(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'NYC' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'ORD' cityto = 'LAX' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'MUC' cityto = 'LHR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0064' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'DFW' cityto = 'MIA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_map_flights(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_fldate      = '20250101'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge für das angegebene Datum gefunden werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[1]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Der erste gefilterte Eintrag sollte LH sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[2]-connid
      exp = '0401'
      msg = 'Der zweite gefilterte Eintrag sollte 0401 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig in eine neue Struktur zu mappen. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP`s und `APPEND`s und verbessert die Lesbarkeit erheblich.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Filtering, Mapping, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für eine Liste von Flügen unter Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Expression und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und einen Wert zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_value_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             passnum TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_flight_booking
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_value_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_booking IN it_bookings
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_booking-passnum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_value_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_test_bookings) = VALUE zcl_reduce_value_sum=>tt_flight_booking(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' passnum = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' passnum = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' passnum = 75 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_test_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = 225
      msg = 'Die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere sollte 225 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für Aggregationen. Sie ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle zu durchlaufen und einen einzelnen Wert (hier die Summe der Passagiere) zu berechnen, ohne explizite `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Anweisungen. Dies führt zu sehr prägnantem und funktionalem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, VALUE, Aggregation, Internal Table, Functional Programming

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen basierend auf einer Bedingung einen Wert zu, unter Verwendung der `COND`-Expression und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_cond_value_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_occupied TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_max_seats      TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status)  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_value_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_seats_occupied >= iv_max_seats THEN 'Fully Booked'
      WHEN iv_seats_occupied >= iv_max_seats / 2 THEN 'Partially Booked'
      ELSE 'Many Seats Available'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_value_assign( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 100 iv_max_seats = 100 )
      exp = 'Fully Booked'
      msg = 'Status sollte "Fully Booked" sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 60 iv_max_seats = 100 )
      exp = 'Partially Booked'
      msg = 'Status sollte "Partially Booked" sein.'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Sie ersetzt traditionelle `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Blöcke für einfache Zuweisungen und macht den Code deutlich kürzer und lesbarer.

Instructions: Mappen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur mit teilweise unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING` und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_corr_value_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source_data TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target_data) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_value_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_data.
    rs_target_data = VALUE #( 
      CORRESPONDING #( is_source_data MAPPING carrier_id TO carrid
                                        flight_num TO connid
                                        flight_date TO fldate )
      status = 'Mapped' " Add a new field
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_value_map=>ty_source_data(

explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` bietet eine sehr flexible und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu mappen, selbst wenn Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind. CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

          mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid READ-ONLY.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Range-Tabelle für Flugdaten (`fldate`) basierend auf einem Start- und Enddatum unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators und nutzen Sie diese in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE RANGE OF ... ( ... )` mit `BT` (Between) Option.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_end_date   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_date_range.
    DATA(lt_date_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-fldate(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = iv_start_date high = iv_end_date )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE fldate IN @lt_date_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_date_range_selection FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_range_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_date_range( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20000101'. " Use dates where SFLIGHT data is likely to exist
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = '20000131'.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_date_range(
      iv_start_date = lv_start_date
      iv_end_date   = lv_end_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Die Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein, wenn Daten in SFLIGHT vorhanden sind.'
      tolerating_empty_table = abap_true
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_start_date AND ls_flight-fldate <= lv_end_date )
        msg = 'Flugdatum liegt nicht im erwarteten Bereich.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist besonders nützlich für dynamische Berichte oder Schnittstellen, bei denen die Selektionskriterien zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften zu einem kommagetrennten String unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem String-Template für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carriers.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                            FOR carrid IN it_carrids
                                            NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ carrid }|
                                                                 ELSE |{ s }, { carrid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_test_carrids) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_carrids(
      ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'SQ' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( lt_test_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'LH, UA, AA, SQ'
      msg = 'Der verkettete String sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).

    DATA(lt_single_carrier) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_carrids(
      ( 'DL' )
    ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( lt_single_carrier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'DL'
      msg = 'Einzelner Carrier sollte korrekt verkettet werden.'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_carriers) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_carrids( ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( lt_empty_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = ''
      msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte leeren String ergeben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression in Kombination mit String-Templates und der `COND`-Expression bietet eine sehr elegante und funktionale Methode, um Elemente einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzigen String zu verketten. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`- und `CONCATENATE`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, VALUE, String Templates, String Processing, Concatenation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die nur eindeutige Fluggesellschaften aus einer Quelltabelle enthält, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.

CLASS zcl_for_group_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_unique_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_unique_carrier.
    TYPES tt_unique_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_unique_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carriers) TYPE tt_unique_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    rt_unique_carriers = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_all_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_group_unique=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0064' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme-Klasse und werfen Sie diese, wenn ein bestimmter Wert ungültig ist. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und extrahieren Sie die Fehlermeldung.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt und das Interface `IF_T100_MESSAGE` implementiert. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_value DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 001 'Invalid value &1'
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '001' attr1 = 'MV_VALUE' ).
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_value
        EXPORTING
          iv_value = iv_input.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_value FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_value.
    METHODS test_valid_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_value.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_value_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_value( -10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception ZCX_INVALID_VALUE was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_invalid_value->mv_value,
          exp = '-10',
          msg = 'Incorrect value in exception'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_invalid_value->get_text(),
          exp = 'Invalid value -10', " Assuming ZMSG_APP 001 'Invalid value &1'
          msg = 'Exception text is incorrect'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_value.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_value_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_value( 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Valid value processed without exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception ZCX_INVALID_VALUE was raised for a valid value.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Definition einer eigenen Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt und das Interface `IF_T100_MESSAGE` implementiert, ist der moderne Weg, um spezifische Fehlerzustände zu modellieren. Die Ausnahme kann mit `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` geworfen und mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen werden. Die Übergabe von Werten an den Konstruktor ermöglicht es, kontextbezogene Informationen in der Ausnahme zu speichern und über `get_text()` abzurufen.
keywords: EXCEPTION, CUSTOM EXCEPTION, CX_STATIC_CHECK, IF_T100_MESSAGE, RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY CATCH

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die mehrere Validierungen durchführt und alle Fehlermeldungen sammelt, anstatt sofort eine Ausnahme zu werfen. Verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_message_helper=>add_message` und `cl_message_helper=>get_messages`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_data.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    IF iv_value1 <= 0.
      lo_message_helper->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E',
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 002 'Value 1 must be positive'
        i_msgno = '002'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_value2 IS INITIAL.
      lo_message_helper->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E',
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 003 'Value 2 cannot be empty'
        i_msgno = '003'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_messages = lo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_all_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_one_invalid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_all_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_all_valid.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_data_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_validator->validate_data( iv_value1 = 10 iv_value2 = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_messages ),
      msg = 'No messages expected for valid data'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_one_invalid.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_data_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_validator->validate_data( iv_value1 = 10 iv_value2 = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_messages ),
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'One message expected for one invalid field'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgno,
      exp = '003',
      msg = 'Incorrect message number'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_all_invalid.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_data_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_validator->validate_data( iv_value1 = 0 iv_value2 = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_messages ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Two messages expected for two invalid fields'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgno,
      exp = '002',
      msg = 'Incorrect first message number'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgno,
      exp = '003',
      msg = 'Incorrect second message number'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_message_helper` bietet eine flexible Möglichkeit, Nachrichten zu sammeln und zu verwalten, ohne die Programmausführung sofort zu unterbrechen. Dies ist nützlich für Validierungsszenarien, bei denen alle Fehler auf einmal gemeldet werden sollen. Die Methode `add_message` fügt Nachrichten hinzu, und `get_messages` liefert sie als interne Tabelle zurück.
keywords: MESSAGE HANDLING, CL_MESSAGE_HELPER, VALIDATION, ERROR HANDLING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme, die dynamische Platzhalter in ihrer Fehlermeldung verwendet. Werfen Sie die Ausnahme mit variablen Werten und fangen Sie sie ab, um die vollständige Meldung zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `IF_T100_MESSAGE` und die `MESSAGE ... WITH` Syntax im Konstruktor der Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_dynamic_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_param1 TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_param2 TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_dynamic_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_param1 = iv_param1.
    me->mv_param2 = iv_param2.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 004 'Error with &1 and &2'
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '004'
                                          attr1 = 'MV_PARAM1' attr2 = 'MV_PARAM2' ).
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Abfangen einer generischen Ausnahme und das erneute Werfen einer spezifischeren, benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme, die die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als 'previous' enthält.

CLASS zcx_application_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_low_level_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RAISING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_low_level_service IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer `FOR`-Schleife. Wenn ein ungültiger Eintrag gefunden wird, werfen Sie eine Ausnahme, die den Index des ungültigen Eintrags enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` mit einem Attribut für den Index.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_index TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_index TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_index = iv_index.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 006 'Invalid entry found at index &1'
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '006' attr1 = 'MV_INDEX' ).
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE id <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_entry
        EXPORTING
          iv_index = sy-tabix.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_entry_in_table FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_entry.
    METHODS test_valid_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_entry_in_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_table_processor=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Entry 1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 0 text = 'Invalid Entry' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Entry 2' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_table_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_table( lt_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception ZCX_INVALID_ENTRY was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_entry INTO DATA(lx_invalid_entry).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_invalid_entry->mv_index,
          exp = 2,
          msg = 'Incorrect index in exception'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_invalid_entry->get_text(),
          exp = 'Invalid entry found at index 2', " Assuming ZMSG_APP 006 'Invalid entry found at index &1'
          msg = 'Exception text incorrect'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_table_processor=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Entry 1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Entry 2' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_table_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_table( lt_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Valid table processed without exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_entry.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception ZCX_INVALID_ENTRY raised for valid table.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination einer `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleife mit dem direkten Werfen einer spezifischen Ausnahme (`RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`) ist ein effizienter Weg, um Fehler in internen Tabellen zu behandeln. Das `sy-tabix` liefert den genauen Index des fehlerhaften Eintrags, der in der Ausnahme gespeichert und für die Fehlerbehebung genutzt werden kann.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, FOR LOOP, EXCEPTION, RAISE EXCEPTION, SY-TABIX

Instructions: Verwenden Sie die `MESSAGE` Anweisung, um eine Fehlermeldung zu generieren, und fangen Sie diese Meldung mit `cl_message_helper` ab, anstatt sie direkt auf dem Bildschirm anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MESSAGE ... INTO DATA(lv_msg)` und `cl_message_helper=>add_message_from_sy`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_capture DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_capture_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_capture IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_capture_message.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    IF iv_condition = abap_true.
      MESSAGE E007(ZMSG_APP) WITH 'Parameter' 'is invalid' INTO DATA(lv_msg). " Assuming ZMSG_APP 007 'Parameter &1 is invalid: &2'
      lo_message_helper->add_message_from_sy( ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_messages = lo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_capture_message FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_capture_message.
    DATA(lo_capturer) = NEW zcl_message_capture( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_capturer->generate_and_capture_message( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_messages ),
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'One message expected'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgid,
      exp = 'ZMSG_APP',
      msg = 'Incorrect message ID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgno,
      exp = '007',
      msg = 'Incorrect message number'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1,
      exp = 'Parameter',
      msg = 'Incorrect message variable 1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv2,
      exp = 'is invalid',
      msg = 'Incorrect message variable 2'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_message.
    DATA(lo_capturer) = NEW zcl_message_capture( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_capturer->generate_and_capture_message( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_messages ),
      msg = 'No messages expected'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MESSAGE ... INTO DATA(lv_msg)` Anweisung füllt die Systemfelder (`sy-msgid`, `sy-msgno`, etc.) ohne die Meldung direkt auszugeben. `cl_message_helper=>add_message_from_sy()` ist dann der moderne Weg, diese Systemfelder zu nutzen, um die Meldung in einem zentralen Nachrichten-Container zu speichern. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Nachrichtenbehandlung, z.B. für die Anzeige in einer UI.
keywords: MESSAGE, CL_MESSAGE_HELPER, SY-MSGID, SY-MSGNO, MESSAGE INTO

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen konditionalen Ausdruck (`COND` oder `SWITCH`), um zu entscheiden, ob eine Ausnahme geworfen werden soll, basierend auf einer komplexen Bedingung.
hint: Integrieren Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` direkt in einen `COND` Ausdruck, um eine Ausnahme zu erzeugen, wenn die Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist.
solution:
CLASS zcx_condition_failed DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_condition_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 008 'Condition failed for value &1'
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '008' attr1 = 'MV_VALUE' ).
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_condition_failed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_value.
    rv_result = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_input > 10 AND iv_input < 100 THEN abap_true
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_condition_failed EXPORTING iv_value = iv_input
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

explanation: Die Möglichkeit, `RAISE EXCEPTION` direkt in einem konditionalen Ausdruck (`COND` oder `SWITCH`) zu verwenden, ist eine sehr moderne und kompakte Syntax (ABAP 7.50+). Sie erlaubt es, komplexe Bedingungen zu prüfen und bei Nichterfüllung sofort eine Ausnahme zu werfen, was den Code lesbarer und kürzer macht.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Ausnahmebehandlung über eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen hinweg, wobei eine Methode eine Ausnahme wirft und eine höhere Methode diese abfängt.
hint: Definieren Sie Methoden mit `RAISING` und verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` in der aufrufenden Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcx_chain_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_chain_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 009 'Error in method chain'
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '009' ).
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS do_something
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_chain_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD do_something.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_chain_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_a
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_chain_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_a.
    DATA(lo_method_a) = NEW zcl_method_a( ).
    lo_method_a->do_something( iv_value ). " Propagates zcx_chain_error
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_c DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_chain
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_c IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_chain.
    DATA(lo_method_b) = NEW zcl_method_b( ).
    TRY.
        lo_method_b->call_method_a( iv_value ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH zcx_chain_error INTO DATA(lx_chain_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chain_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chain_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chain_success.
    DATA(lo_method_c) = NEW zcl_method_c( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_method_c->execute_chain( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chain_failure.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_method_c->execute_chain( -5 ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die explizite Deklaration von Ausnahmen mit `RAISING` in Methodensignaturen und die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` in den aufrufenden Methoden ist der Standard für die Ausnahmebehandlung in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Dies ermöglicht eine klare Definition, welche Fehler eine Methode werfen kann und wo diese Fehler behandelt werden sollen, was die Robustheit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme, die Kontextinformationen aus einem Geschäftsobjekt (z.B. `SFLIGHTS` Flugnummer) enthält, wenn ein Fehler auftritt.
hint: Fügen Sie der Ausnahme Attribute hinzu, um die relevanten Geschäftsschlüssel zu speichern. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_flight_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->mv_connid = iv_connid.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 010 'Error processing flight &1 &2'
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '010'
                                          attr1 = 'MV_CARRID' attr2 = 'MV_CONNID' ).
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights
      RAISING
        zcx_flight_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_error
        EXPORTING
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid
          iv_connid = iv_connid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_flight_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    TRY.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Nachrichten, die mit `cl_message_helper` gesammelt wurden, basierend auf dem Nachrichtentyp und geben Sie nur die Fehlermeldungen zurück.

CLASS zcl_message_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_error_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_all_messages TYPE tt_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE tt_messages.

    METHODS simulate_and_filter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_messages.
    rt_error_messages = FILTER #( it_all_messages WHERE msgty = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'S', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '011', i_msgv1 = 'Success' ). " Assuming ZMSG_APP 011 'Success message &1'
    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'W', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '012', i_msgv1 = 'Warning' ). " Assuming ZMSG_APP 012 'Warning message &1'
    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'E', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '013', i_msgv1 = 'Error' ). " Assuming ZMSG_APP 013 'Error message &1'

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
    rt_error_messages = get_error_messages( lt_all_messages ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_date DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->ms_flight = is_flight.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 014 'Flight &1 &2 on &3 has invalid date'
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '014'
                                          attr1 = 'MS_FLIGHT-CARRID' attr2 = 'MS_FLIGHT-CONNID' attr3 = 'MS_FLIGHT-FLDATE' ).
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_dates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_dates.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < lv_today.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_date
          EXPORTING
            is_flight = ls_flight.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper`, um Nachrichten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu aggregieren und dann eine zusammenfassende Fehlermeldung zu generieren, falls Fehler aufgetreten sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_message_helper=>add_message` und `cl_message_helper=>get_message_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_multiple_steps
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_multiple_steps.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    " Step 1: Validate value1
    IF iv_value1 <= 0.
      lo_message_helper->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '002' ). " Value 1 must be positive
    ENDIF.

    " Step 2: Validate value2
    IF iv_value2 IS INITIAL.
      lo_message_helper->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '003' ). " Value 2 cannot be empty
    ENDIF.

    " Step 3: Perform another check (e.g., division by zero simulation)
    IF iv_value1 = 1.
      lo_message_helper->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '015', i_msgv1 = 'Division by 1' ). " Assuming ZMSG_APP 015 'Simulated error: &1'
    ENDIF.

    IF lo_message_helper->has_errors( ) = abap_true.
      rv_summary_message = lo_message_helper->get_message_string( i_msgty = 'E' ).
    ELSE.
      rv_summary_message = 'All steps processed successfully.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_reduce_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_invalid_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_invalid_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_reduce_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_invalid_value = iv_invalid_value.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      " Assuming ZMSG_APP exists with message 016 'Invalid value &1 found during reduction'
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '016' attr1 = 'MV_INVALID_VALUE' ).
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_positive_values
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_reduce_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_positive_values.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR value IN it_values
      NEXT
        s = COND #( WHEN value > 0 THEN s + value
                    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_reduce_error EXPORTING iv_invalid_value = value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Nachrichten (Fehler, Warnungen, Informationen) generiert und diese dann mit `cl_message_helper` in einem strukturierten Format für die Protokollierung aufbereitet.

CLASS zcl_message_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_log_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.

    METHODS format_messages_for_log
      IMPORTING
        it_messages TYPE tt_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_log_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '017', i_msgv1 = 'Start' ). " Assuming ZMSG_APP 017 'Process &1'
    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'W', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '012', i_msgv1 = 'Configuration' ). " Warning message &1
    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'E', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '013', i_msgv1 = 'Data' ). " Error message &1

    rt_messages = lo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_messages_for_log.
    LOOP AT it_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
      DATA(lv_message_text) = cl_message_helper=>get_message_text(
                                 i_msgty = ls_message-msgty,
                                 i_msgid = ls_message-msgid,
                                 i_msgno = ls_message-msgno,
                                 i_msgv1 = ls_message-msgv1,
                                 i_msgv2 = ls_message-msgv2,
                                 i_msgv3 = ls_message-msgv3,
                                 i_msgv4 = ls_message-msgv4 ).
      rv_log_string = rv_log_string && |{ sy-datum } { sy-uzeit } { ls_message-msgty }: { lv_message_text }\n|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Ausnahmebehandlung, die den Typ der aufgetretenen Ausnahme zur Laufzeit ermittelt (RTTI) und eine spezifische Meldung basierend auf dem Ausnahmetyp generiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root)` und `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_with_rtti_exception_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _simulate_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide
        zcx_invalid_value. " Reusing from exc_001
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_rtti_exception_handling.
    TRY.
        _simulate_error( iv_value ).
        rv_status_message = 'Processing successful.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        DATA(lv_exception_class_name) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( lx_root ).
        CASE lv_exception_class_name.
          WHEN 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE'.
            rv_status_message = |Error: Division by zero occurred. ({ lx_root->get_text() })|.
          WHEN 'ZCX_INVALID_VALUE'.
            DATA(lx_invalid_value) = CAST zcx_invalid_value( lx_root ).
            rv_status_message = |Error: Invalid value { lx_invalid_value->mv_value } provided. ({ lx_root->get_text() })|.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_status_message = |An unexpected error occurred: { lv_exception_class_name }. ({ lx_root->get_text() })|.
        ENDCASE.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _simulate_error.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_value. " Raises CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
    ELSEIF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_value EXPORTING iv_value = iv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_no_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zerodivide_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_value_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_other_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_no_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_rtti_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_handler->process_with_rtti_exception_handling( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message,
      exp = 'Processing successful.',
      msg = 'Status message incorrect for no error'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zerodivide_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_rtti_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_handler->process_with_rtti_exception_handling( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_message,
      exp = 'Error: Division by zero occurred.',
      msg = 'Status message incorrect for zero divide error'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_value_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_rtti_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_handler->process_with_rtti_exception_handling( -5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_message,
      exp = 'Error: Invalid value -5 provided.',
      msg = 'Status message incorrect for invalid value error'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_error.
    " Simulate an unexpected error by raising a different exception type
    CLASS lcx_unexpected_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcx_unexpected_error IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_rtti_exception_handler( ).
    TRY.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_unexpected_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        DATA(lv_message) = lo_handler->process_with_rtti_exception_handling( 1 ). " Dummy call, exception already caught
        lv_message = |An unexpected error occurred: { cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( lx_root ) }. ({ lx_root->get_text() })|.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
          act = lv_message,
          exp = 'An unexpected error occurred: LCX_UNEXPECTED_ERROR.',
          msg = 'Status message incorrect for other error'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) in der Ausnahmebehandlung ermöglicht eine flexible Reaktion auf verschiedene Ausnahmetypen, ohne für jeden Typ einen separaten `CATCH`-Block schreiben zu müssen. Durch `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name` kann der genaue Ausnahmetyp zur Laufzeit ermittelt und eine spezifische Logik oder Meldung angewendet werden, was besonders in generischen Fehlerbehandlungsroutinen nützlich ist.
keywords: RTTI, EXCEPTION HANDLING, CX_ROOT, CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR, GET_CLASS_NAME, CASE

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Generierung von Nachrichten in einem Hintergrundprozess und stellen Sie diese Nachrichten dann für die Anzeige in einer UI-Anwendung bereit, indem Sie `cl_message_helper` verwenden.
hint: Sammeln Sie Nachrichten mit `cl_message_helper` und übergeben Sie die gesammelten Nachrichten an eine UI-Komponente (hier simuliert durch eine Rückgabetabelle).
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui_message_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ui_message,
             type TYPE symsgty,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_ui_message.
    TYPES: tt_ui_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ui_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ui_messages
      IMPORTING
        iv_process_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ui_messages) TYPE tt_ui_messages.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS _simulate_background_process
      IMPORTING
        iv_process_id TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui_message_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ui_messages.
    " Clear previous messages for a fresh run (in a real scenario, this might be managed differently)
    cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->clear_messages( ).

    _simulate_background_process( iv_process_id ).

    DATA(lt_raw_messages) = cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->get_messages( ).

    rt_ui_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw_msg IN lt_raw_messages
                               ( type = ls_raw_msg-msgty,
                                 text = cl_message_helper=>get_message_text(
                                          i_msgty = ls_raw_msg-msgty,
                                          i_msgid = ls_raw_msg-msgid,
                                          i_msgno = ls_raw_msg-msgno,
                                          i_msgv1 = ls_raw_msg-msgv1,
                                          i_msgv2 = ls_raw_msg-msgv2,
                                          i_msgv3 = ls_raw_msg-msgv3,
                                          i_msgv4 = ls_raw_msg-msgv4 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _simulate_background_process.
    " Simulate some operations and message generation
    cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '017', i_msgv1 = iv_process_id ). " Process &1

    IF iv_process_id = 'ERROR_PROCESS'.
      cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '013', i_msgv1 = 'Critical Data' ). " Error message &1
    ELSEIF iv_process_id = 'WARNING_PROCESS'.
      cl_message_helper=>get_instance( )->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'W', i_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP', i_msgno = '012', i_msgv1 = 'Minor Issue' ). " Warning message &1
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und die Flugnummer (CONNID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                            connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestkapazität zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine neue gefilterte Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax >= iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID sollte AA sein' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Gesamtsitze für LH sollten > 0 sein' act = lv_total_lh > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Gesamtsitze für AA sollten > 0 sein' act = lv_total_aa > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Sie ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen durch eine deklarative Syntax.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Enddatum eines Termins, der an einem bestimmten Startdatum beginnt und eine bestimmte Dauer in Tagen hat, unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_APPOINTMENT`.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_APPOINTMENT` und nutzen Sie die Methode `ADD_DURATION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_end_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_duration_days TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_end_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_end_date.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment(
                              i_date = iv_start_date
                              i_time = '000000' ). " Startzeit irrelevant für reine Datumsberechnung

    lo_appointment->add_duration(
      EXPORTING
        i_duration = cl_appointment=>duration_days
        i_value     = iv_duration_days
      IMPORTING
        e_date     = rv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = sy-datum.

CLASS zcl_salv_display IMPLEMENTATION.
