Instructions: Generieren Sie zwei UUIDs und vergleichen Sie diese. Fügen Sie das Ergebnis des Vergleichs (gleich/ungleich) zusammen mit den UUIDs in eine interne Tabelle ein.
hint: Generieren Sie zwei UUIDs und verwenden Sie den Vergleichsoperator `=` oder `<>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_compare_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_compare_result,
             uuid1       TYPE sysuuid_c32,
             uuid2       TYPE sysuuid_c32,
             is_equal    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_compare_result,
           ty_compare_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_compare_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_uuids RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE ty_compare_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_compare_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_uuids.
    DATA(lv_uuid_a) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid_b) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid_c) = lv_uuid_a.

    " Vergleich 1: Zwei unterschiedliche UUIDs
    INSERT VALUE #( uuid1 = lv_uuid_a uuid2 = lv_uuid_b is_equal = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_uuid_a = lv_uuid_b THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) INTO TABLE rt_results.

    " Vergleich 2: Zwei gleiche UUIDs
    INSERT VALUE #( uuid1 = lv_uuid_a uuid2 = lv_uuid_c is_equal = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_uuid_a = lv_uuid_c THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) INTO TABLE rt_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_uuids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_uuids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_compare_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->compare_uuids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-uuid1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-uuid2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_equal exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_equal exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung und den Vergleich von UUIDs. Da UUIDs als Character- oder XSTRING-Felder behandelt werden, können sie direkt mit den Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren (`=`, `<>`) verglichen werden. Die `COND`-Expression wird hier verwendet, um das Ergebnis des Vergleichs kompakt in ein `abap_bool`-Feld zu überführen, was eine moderne und lesbare Syntax darstellt. Die Ergebnisse werden dann mittels `INSERT VALUE #()` in eine interne Tabelle eingefügt.
keywords: UUID, Comparison, Conditional Logic, INSERT VALUE, cl_system_uuid, abap_bool

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS`. Fügen Sie dann für jede Fluggesellschaft eine neue Zeile mit einer generierten UUID und dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft in eine separate interne Tabelle ein, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die generierte UUID enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei den `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE`, `FOR ... IN GROUP ...`, `cl_system_uuid` und `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_uuid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrier_uuid TYPE sysuuid_c32,
           END OF ty_carrier_uuid,
           ty_carrier_uuid_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_uuid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_uuids RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_uuids) TYPE ty_carrier_uuid_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_uuids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_flight_table.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_uuids = VALUE ty_carrier_uuid_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        carrier_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_uuids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_uuids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_uuids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrier_uuid ).

    " Überprüfen, ob für jede Fluggesellschaft eine UUID generiert wurde
    DATA(lv_distinct_carriers) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT carrid ) FROM sflights UP TO 50 ROWS INTO lv_distinct_carriers.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_distinct_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR`-Operator mit der `GROUP BY`-Klausel, um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaften zu gruppieren. Für jede eindeutige Fluggesellschaft wird dann eine neue UUID generiert und zusammen mit der Fluggesellschaft in eine neue interne Tabelle eingefügt. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Methode, um aggregierte Daten zu verarbeiten und dabei eindeutige Identifikatoren für die Gruppierung zu erstellen.
keywords: Internal Table, GROUP BY, FOR, SFLIGHTS, UUID, cl_system_uuid, Advanced

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Datensätzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( price = '50.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_source_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price,

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen, bei denen ein einzelner Wert aus einer internen Tabelle berechnet wird. Er ersetzt explizite LOOP-Anweisungen und macht den Code funktionaler und prägnanter.
keywords: REDUCE Operator, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die nacheinander aufgerufen werden können (Method Chaining), um einen String zu manipulieren (z.B. Großbuchstaben, Leerzeichen entfernen).
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden die Instanz der eigenen Klasse zurück (ME->).
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_method_chain.
    METHODS remove_spaces RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_method_chain.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE mv_string TO UPPER CASE.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_spaces.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ' ' IN mv_string WITH ''.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chain.
    DATA(lv_result) = NEW zcl_oo_method_chain( 'Hello World ABAP' )->to_upper( )->remove_spaces( )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'HELLOWORLDABAP',
      msg = 'Chained methods result incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit von Objektinteraktionen, indem Methoden die eigene Instanz zurückgeben. Der NEW-Operator erlaubt die direkte Instanziierung und den Aufruf von Methoden in einer Zeile.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, NEW Operator

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, die teilweise gleiche Feldnamen hat, aber auch zusätzliche Felder.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator, um Felder mit gleichen Namen automatisch zu übertragen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id          TYPE i,
             name        TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
             status      TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
    " Manuelle Zuweisung für Felder, die nicht übereinstimmen oder speziell behandelt werden müssen
    rs_target-description = |Mapped from source ID { is_source-id }|.
    rs_target-status = 'A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_corresponding=>ty_source( id = 10 name = 'Test Item' value = 100 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_corresponding( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 10 msg = 'ID not mapped correctly' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Test Item' msg = 'Name not mapped correctly' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-description exp = 'Mapped from source ID 10' msg = 'Description not set correctly' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'A' msg = 'Status not set correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING-Operator ermöglicht die einfache und effiziente Übertragung von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit (teilweise) gleichen Feldnamen. Er reduziert den Boilerplate-Code für Feldzuweisungen erheblich.
keywords: CORRESPONDING Operator, Data Transfer, Structures

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Datensätzen einen neuen Eintrag hinzu, wobei Sie den VALUE-Operator und die INSERT-Anweisung verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den VALUE-Operator für die Erstellung des neuen Eintrags mit INSERT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

explanation: Die Kombination des VALUE-Operators mit der INSERT-Anweisung ermöglicht das direkte Erstellen und Einfügen von Datensätzen in interne Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Zeile, ohne separate Arbeitsbereiche deklarieren zu müssen.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, VALUE Operator

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Dateinamen ohne Erweiterung aus einem vollständigen Dateipfad (z.B. '/usr/local/data/report.txt' -> 'report').
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Funktionen wie FIND, SUBSTRING und die Kombination mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_filename_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filename_without_ext
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_filename) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_filename_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filename_without_ext.
    DATA(lv_last_slash_pos) = find( val = iv_file_path sub = '/' occ = -1 ).
    DATA(lv_filename_with_ext) = substring( val = iv_file_path off = lv_last_slash_pos + 1 ).
    DATA(lv_dot_pos) = find( val = lv_filename_with_ext sub = '.' ).

    IF lv_dot_pos IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_filename = substring( val = lv_filename_with_ext len = lv_dot_pos ).
    ELSE.
      rv_filename = lv_filename_with_ext.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filename_extract FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filename_extract.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_filename_extract( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_filename_without_ext( '/usr/local/data/report.txt' ),
      exp = 'report',
      msg = 'Filename with extension incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_filename_without_ext( 'document' ),
      exp = 'document',
      msg = 'Filename without extension incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_filename_without_ext( '/path/to/archive.tar.gz' ),
      exp = 'archive.tar',
      msg = 'Filename with multiple dots incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne String-Funktionen wie FIND und SUBSTRING können direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden, oft in Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen, um komplexe String-Manipulationen kompakt und lesbar zu gestalten. Dies vermeidet temporäre Variablen und lange Kaskaden von MOVE- oder SPLIT-Anweisungen.
keywords: String Processing, FIND, SUBSTRING, File Path

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des nächsten Montags, ausgehend von einem beliebigen Datum.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_TSTMP für Datumsberechnungen und den Wochentag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_next_monday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_monday
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_monday) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_next_monday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_monday.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( iv_date = iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lv_days_to_add) = 0.

    IF lv_day_of_week = 1. " Monday
      lv_days_to_add = 7.
    ELSE.
      lv_days_to_add = 8 - lv_day_of_week.
    ENDIF.

    rv_next_monday = iv_start_date + lv_days_to_add.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_next_monday FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_next_monday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_next_monday( ).

    " Assuming 20251122 is a Saturday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_next_monday( '20251122' ),
      exp = '20251124',
      msg = 'Next Monday from Saturday incorrect'
    ).
    " Assuming 20251124 is a Monday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_next_monday( '20251124' ),
      exp = '20251201',
      msg = 'Next Monday from Monday incorrect'
    ).
    " Assuming 20251120 is a Thursday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_next_monday( '20251120' ),
      exp = '20251124',
      msg = 'Next Monday from Thursday incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER bietet nützliche Methoden für Datumsberechnungen, die die manuelle Handhabung von Wochentagen und Schaltjahren vereinfachen. Die direkte Addition von Tagen zu einem Datum ist eine grundlegende, aber effiziente Operation.
keywords: Date, Time, CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER, Wochentag

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von zwei verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften ('AA' und 'LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights` mittels `UNION`, um eine Liste eindeutiger Flüge zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION SELECT ...` und achten Sie auf kompatible Spalten. `UNION` entfernt automatisch Duplikate.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_unique_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_unique_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_msg_type_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Check if both carriers are present (assuming data exists)
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No AA flights found' act = lv_aa_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No LH flights found' act = lv_lh_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UNION`-Operation in Open SQL kombiniert die Ergebnismengen zweier `SELECT`-Anweisungen und entfernt dabei automatisch Duplikate. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um konsolidierte, eindeutige Datensätze aus mehreren Quellen zu erhalten.
keywords: UNION, Open SQL, SELECT, sflights, Duplikate

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von zwei verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften ('AA' und 'LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights` mittels `UNION ALL`, um eine Liste aller Flüge, einschließlich potenzieller Duplikate, zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UNION ALL` anstelle von `UNION`, um Duplikate beizubehalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_all_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_all( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_all_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Get counts for comparison (assuming data exists)
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @DATA(lv_count_aa).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @DATA(lv_count_lh).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total lines mismatch' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_count_aa + lv_count_lh ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Im Gegensatz zu `UNION` behält `UNION ALL` alle Zeilen aus den kombinierten Ergebnismengen bei, auch wenn sie identisch sind. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die vollständige Datenmenge, einschließlich Duplikaten, benötigt wird und die Duplikatsentfernung von `UNION` nicht gewünscht ist.
keywords: UNION ALL, Open SQL, SELECT, sflights, Duplikate beibehalten

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights`, wobei die erste Menge Flüge mit Ziel 'FRA' und die zweite Menge Flüge vor dem aktuellen Systemdatum anzeigt. Fügen Sie eine Spalte hinzu, die die Herkunft der Daten ('DEST_FRA' oder 'OLD_DATE') kennzeichnet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT`-Ausdrücke, um eine Literalspalte hinzuzufügen, und `UNION ALL` für die Kombination.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_with_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             source TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined_flight.
    TYPES tt_combined_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_source RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_combined_flight.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von zwei Fluggesellschaften ('AA' und 'LH') aus `sflights` und sortieren Sie das Gesamtergebnis nach Flugdatum und Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel wird einmal am Ende der gesamten `UNION`-Anweisung platziert und wirkt sich auf die gesamte Ergebnismenge aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_order_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,

    METHODS get_sorted_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_order_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      ORDER BY fldate, carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_order_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Check if the results are sorted
    DATA(lv_prev_fldate) TYPE sflights-fldate VALUE '00000000'.
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflights-carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < lv_prev_fldate OR ( ls_flight-fldate = lv_prev_fldate AND ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid AND lv_prev_carrid IS NOT INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Results are not correctly sorted' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_pass( msg = 'Results are correctly sorted' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel in einer `UNION`-Abfrage sortiert die gesamte, bereits kombinierte Ergebnismenge. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion, um konsolidierte Daten direkt in der gewünschten Reihenfolge zu erhalten, ohne eine nachträgliche Sortierung in ABAP durchführen zu müssen.
keywords: UNION, ORDER BY, Open SQL, sflights, Sortierung

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights`, wobei Sie die Flugverbindungs-ID (`connid`) als String ausgeben. Im zweiten Teil der `UNION` soll ein Platzhalter-String verwendet werden, um die Typkompatibilität zu gewährleisten.

CLASS zcl_union_type_cast DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

    SELECT carrid, CAST(connid AS abap.char(4)) AS connid_str, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    UNION ALL

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_str_id.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_type_cast( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_str_id( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Check if 'N/A' is present in connid_str for LH flights
    DATA(lv_na_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'N/A not found for LH flights' act = lv_na_found exp = abap_true ).

    " Check if connid_str for AA flights is numeric (after cast)
    DATA(lv_numeric_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
      IF ls_flight-connid_str IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_flight-connid_str CO '0123456789'.
        lv_numeric_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Numeric connid_str not found for AA flights' act = lv_numeric_found exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei `UNION`-Operationen müssen die entsprechenden Spalten in allen `SELECT`-Anweisungen typkompatibel sein. Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CAST` in Open SQL, um einen numerischen Wert in einen String umzuwandeln und so die Typkompatibilität mit einem Literal-String ('N/A') herzustellen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Daten unterschiedlicher Typen in einer kombinierten Ergebnismenge zu harmonisieren.
keywords: UNION, CAST, Open SQL, Type Conversion, sflights, SELECT expressions

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie aggregierte Flugdaten von `sflights` für zwei verschiedene Jahre (z.B. 2000 und 2001) mittels `UNION ALL` und bereiten Sie diese für eine `cl_time_chart_simple`-Instanz auf, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Tag über beide Jahre hinweg darzustellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UNION ALL` mit zwei `SELECT`-Anweisungen, die jeweils nach `fldate` gruppieren und nach einem Jahresbereich filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_union_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_daily_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_union_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_daily_flights.
    " Annahme: sflights enthält Daten für die Jahre 2000 und 2001.
    " Die WHERE-Klauseln filtern entsprechend.
    SELECT fldate, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20000101' AND '20001231'
      GROUP BY fldate
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fldate, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20010101' AND '20011231'
      GROUP BY fldate
      ORDER BY fldate " Sortierung des Gesamtergebnisses
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_combined_daily_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_daily_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_union_data( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->get_combined_daily_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No combined flight data found' act = lines( lt_data ) ).

    " Check if data from both years is present (assuming data exists)
    DATA(lv_2000_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_2001_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-fldate BETWEEN '20000101' AND '20001231'.
        lv_2000_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_entry-fldate BETWEEN '20010101' AND '20011231'.
        lv_2001_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Data for year 2000 not found' act = lv_2000_found exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Data for year 2001 not found' act = lv_2001_found exp = abap_true ).

    " Check sorting
    DATA(lv_prev_fldate) TYPE sflights-fldate VALUE '00000000'.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-fldate < lv_prev_fldate.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Combined data is not sorted by date' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_entry-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_pass( msg = 'Combined data sorted correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Stärke von `UNION ALL` zur Konsolidierung von Daten aus verschiedenen Zeiträumen mit der Aggregation mittels `GROUP BY`. Die resultierende interne Tabelle enthält eine konsolidierte Zeitreihe, die direkt für die Visualisierung in einem `cl_time_chart_simple`-Objekt verwendet werden kann, um Trends über mehrere Jahre hinweg darzustellen.
keywords: UNION ALL, cl_time_chart_simple, Data Aggregation, Open SQL, sflights, Zeitreihe

CLASS zcl_union_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    UNION ALL

ABAP ordnet die Felder automatisch anhand ihrer Namen zu. hint: Nutzen Sie eine Schleife über die Fluggesellschaften und aggregieren Sie die Daten für jede Serie separat mittels `GROUP BY`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_series_point,
         date TYPE d,
         value TYPE i,
       END OF ty_chart_series_point.
TYPES tt_chart_series_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_series_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_series,
         series_id TYPE string,
         series_name TYPE string,
         data TYPE tt_chart_series_points,
       END OF ty_chart_series.
TYPES tt_chart_series TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_series WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_series
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_series_data) TYPE tt_chart_series.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_series.
    LOOP AT it_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      DATA(ls_series) = VALUE ty_chart_series( series_id = lv_carrier series_name = lv_carrier ).
      SELECT fldate, COUNT(*) AS value
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @lv_carrier
        GROUP BY fldate
        ORDER BY fldate
        INTO TABLE @ls_series-data.
      APPEND ls_series TO rt_series_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Check data for 'LH'

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von `sflights` mit einer hypothetischen Liste von 'Sonderflügen' (simuliert durch `VALUE #(...)`), die zusätzliche Informationen wie einen 'Sonderstatus' enthalten. Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Spalten typkompatibel sind und die Sonderflüge entsprechend gekennzeichnet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UNION ALL` und `SELECT`-Ausdrücke mit `CAST` und Literalen, um die Daten zu harmonisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_special_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_special_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lt_special_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251224' status = 'Christmas Special' )
      ( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0002' fldate = '20251231' status = 'New Year Event' )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, 'Regular' AS status
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, status
      FROM @lt_special_flights AS special_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_special_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No combined flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Check if special flights are included and have correct status
    DATA(lv_christmas_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_new_year_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'XX' AND ls_flight-connid = '0001' AND ls_flight-status = 'Christmas Special'.
        lv_christmas_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'YY' AND ls_flight-connid = '0002' AND ls_flight-status = 'New Year Event'.
        lv_new_year_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Christmas Special not found' act = lv_christmas_found exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'New Year Event not found' act = lv_new_year_found exp = abap_true ).

    " Check if regular flights are also present
    DATA(lv_regular_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE ls_flight-status = 'Regular'.
      lv_regular_found = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Regular flights not found' act = lv_regular_found exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von `sflights` mit einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften, die als 'Premium' gekennzeichnet sind (simuliert durch eine interne Tabelle). Verwenden Sie `UNION ALL` und fügen Sie eine Spalte 'is_premium' hinzu, die 'X' für Premium-Fluggesellschaften und ' ' für andere enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UNION ALL` mit `FROM @internal_table` und `SELECT`-Ausdrücken, um die 'is_premium'-Spalte zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_premium_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_status,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             is_premium TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_carrier_status.
    TYPES tt_carrier_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_premium_info,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             is_premium TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_premium_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_premium_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_premium_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_premium_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_premium_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_premium_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_premium_status.
    DATA(lt_premium_carriers) = VALUE tt_carrier_status(
      ( carrid = 'LH' is_premium = abap_true )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' is_premium = abap_true )
    ).

    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~is_premium
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN @lt_premium_carriers AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~is_premium
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN @lt_premium_carriers AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = 'AA' " Example for a non-premium carrier
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

    " The above UNION ALL is a bit redundant for this specific case, a single SELECT with LEFT OUTER JOIN would be simpler.
    " However, to demonstrate UNION ALL with different conditions/sources, we keep it.
    " A more realistic UNION ALL scenario would involve two distinct SELECTs that cannot be easily joined.
    " For the purpose of this example, we'll simplify the first part to avoid redundancy while still using UNION ALL.

    CLEAR rt_flights.

    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, CASE WHEN p~is_premium IS NOT NULL THEN p~is_premium ELSE abap_false END AS is_premium
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN @lt_premium_carriers AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = 'LH' OR s~carrid = 'SQ'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, abap_false AS is_premium
      FROM sflights AS s
      WHERE s~carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_premium_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_premium_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_premium_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_premium_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Check premium status for LH (should be true)
    DATA(lv_lh_premium_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
      IF ls_flight-is_premium = abap_true.
        lv_lh_premium_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH not marked as premium' act = lv_lh_premium_found exp = abap_true ).

    " Check premium status for AA (should be false)
    DATA(lv_aa_not_premium_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
      IF ls_flight-is_premium = abap_false.
        lv_aa_not_premium_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA incorrectly marked as premium' act = lv_aa_not_premium_found exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `UNION ALL` in Kombination mit `LEFT OUTER JOIN` auf eine interne Tabelle (`FROM @internal_table`) und `CASE`-Ausdrücken, um eine 'is_premium'-Spalte dynamisch zu setzen. Es zeigt, wie man Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen (Datenbanktabelle und In-Memory-Tabelle) zusammenführt und gleichzeitig zusätzliche Geschäftslogik (Premium-Status) in die Abfrage integriert. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Muster für die Datenanreicherung direkt in Open SQL.

CLASS zcl_chart_filtered_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_single_day_flights,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,

           END OF ty_single_day_flights.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail mit einem statischen Betreff und Text an einen Empfänger unter Verwendung von `CL_BCS_UTILITIES` und modernen ABAP-String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BCS_UTILITIES=>SEND_MAIL` und String-Templates für den Inhalt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_simple_mail DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_simple_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_simple_mail IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_simple_email.
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_textn( ( iv_body ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_current_user( ).
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
      iv_address_string = iv_recipient_email
    ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
    lo_send_request->set_sender( lo_sender ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    IF lv_sent = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bcs
        EXPORTING
          text = 'E-Mail konnte nicht gesendet werden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_simple_email FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_simple_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_simple_mail( ).
    " ACHTUNG: Ersetzen Sie 'test@example.com' durch eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse für den Test.
    " In einem echten System würde man hier einen Mock verwenden.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_simple_email(
          iv_recipient_email = 'test@example.com'
          iv_subject         = |Test E-Mail von ABAP { sy-uname }|
          iv_body            = |Dies ist eine Test-E-Mail, gesendet am { sy-datum DATE = USER } um { sy-uzeit TIME = USER }.|

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'E-Mail sollte erfolgreich gesendet werden (keine Exception).' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es verwendet moderne ABAP-Features wie Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`), Konstruktor-Ausdrücke (`VALUE`, `cl_document_bcs=>create_document(...)`) und String-Templates (`|...|`) für die dynamische Erstellung des E-Mail-Betreffs und -Inhalts.     DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    IF lv_sent = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger, deren E-Mail-Adressen in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert sind, unter Verwendung von `CL_BCS_UTILITIES`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife, um Empfänger aus einer internen Tabelle hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_recipient,
             email TYPE ad_smtpadr,
           END OF ty_recipient,
           tt_recipients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_recipient WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_mail_to_multiple
      IMPORTING
        it_recipients TYPE tt_recipients
        iv_subject    TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body       TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_to_multiple.
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_textn( ( iv_body ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_current_user( ).
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
    lo_send_request->set_sender( lo_sender ).

    LOOP AT it_recipients INTO DATA(ls_recipient).
      DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
        iv_address_string = ls_recipient-email
      ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    IF lv_sent = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bcs
        EXPORTING

CLASS zcl_bcs_sflights_mail DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_flight_info_mail
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr

        iv_connid          TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate          TYPE s_date
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_sflights_mail IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_flight_info_mail.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bcs
        EXPORTING
          text = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_subject) = |Fluginformationen für Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|.
    DATA(lv_body) = |
Sehr geehrte/r Kunde/in,

anbei finden Sie die Details zu Ihrem Flug:

Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }
Flugnummer: { ls_flight-connid }
Flugdatum: { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }
Abflugort: { ls_flight-cityfrom }
Zielort: { ls_flight-cityto }
Abflugzeit: { ls_flight-deptime TIME = USER }
Ankunftszeit: { ls_flight-arrtime TIME = USER }
Preis: { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency }

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Ihr ABAP-Team|
.

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_textn( ( lv_body ) )
      i_subject = lv_subject
    ).

    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_current_user( ).
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
      iv_address_string = iv_recipient_email
    ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
    lo_send_request->set_sender( lo_sender ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    IF lv_sent = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bcs
        EXPORTING
          text = 'E-Mail mit Flugdaten konnte nicht gesendet werden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_write_sflights_list IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      WRITE / 'Keine Flüge gefunden.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WRITE: / 'Fluggesellschaft', 20 'Flugnummer', 35 'Datum', 50 'Von', 65 'Nach'.
    ULINE.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      WRITE: / ls_flight-carrid,
               20 ls_flight-connid,
               35 ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER,
               50 ls_flight-cityfrom,
               65 ls_flight-cityto.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_with_error_handling.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = VALUE bcs_textn( ( iv_body ) )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_current_user( ).
        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
          iv_address_string = iv_recipient_email
        ).

        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        lo_send_request->set_sender( lo_sender ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        IF lv_sent = abap_true.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
          " Hier könnte man eine spezifischere Fehlerbehandlung implementieren
          " oder eine eigene Exception werfen.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Protokollierung, Benachrichtigung etc.
        " cl_demo_output=>write( |Fehler beim Senden der E-Mail: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von E-Mail-Adressen und senden Sie eine E-Mail nur an gültige Adressen unter Verwendung von `CL_BCS_UTILITIES` und dem `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck, um die Liste der Empfänger zu bereinigen, bevor Sie sie hinzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_filter_recipients DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_recipient,
             email TYPE ad_smtpadr,
           END OF ty_recipient,
           tt_recipients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_recipient WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_mail_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_all_recipients TYPE tt_recipients
        iv_subject        TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body           TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_filter_recipients IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_filtered.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    DATA(lt_valid_recipients) = FILTER zcl_bcs_filter_recipients=>tt_recipients(
      it_all_recipients WHERE is_valid_email( email ) = abap_true
    ).

    IF lt_valid_recipients IS INITIAL.
      " cl_demo_output=>write( 'Keine gültigen Empfänger gefunden. E-Mail nicht gesendet.' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = VALUE bcs_textn( ( iv_body ) )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_current_user( ).
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        lo_send_request->set_sender( lo_sender ).

        LOOP AT lt_valid_recipients INTO DATA(ls_recipient).
          DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
            iv_address_string = ls_recipient-email
          ).
          lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
        ENDLOOP.

        DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        IF lv_sent = abap_true.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_valid_email.
    " Einfache Validierung für Demo-Zwecke
    IF iv_email CS '@' AND iv_email CS '.' AND NOT iv_email CS ' '.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Fassen Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` zusammen (z.B. Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft) und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `WRITE` und dem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren und dann `WRITE` für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count,
           tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.

    METHODS display_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT l_result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET l_index = line_index( l_result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) IN
      IF l_index IS INITIAL.
        l_result = VALUE #( BASE l_result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = 1 ) ).
      ELSE.
        l_result = VALUE #( BASE l_result ( l_result[ l_index ]-count = l_result[ l_index ]-count + 1 ) ).
      ENDIF.
      FINALLY l_result
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flight_counts.
    DATA(lt_counts) = get_flight_counts( ).

    IF lt_counts IS INITIAL.
      WRITE / 'Keine Flugzählungen verfügbar.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WRITE: / 'Fluggesellschaft', 20 'Anzahl Flüge'.
    ULINE.

    LOOP AT lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      WRITE: / ls_count-carrid, 20 ls_count-count.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_display_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).
    " Überprüfen Sie, ob die Zählungen plausibel sind (z.B. keine negativen Werte)
    LOOP AT lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count-count > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    lo_cut->display_flight_counts( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Methode sollte ohne Fehler aufgerufen werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, ein sehr mächtiges Feature ab ABAP 7.55 für die Aggregation und Transformation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle zu zählen. Die `LET`-Anweisung und die bedingte Logik innerhalb von `REDUCE` zeigen die Flexibilität dieses Ausdrucks. Das Ergebnis wird dann mit der `WRITE`-Anweisung ausgegeben, was die Kombination von modernster Datenverarbeitung mit traditioneller Ausgabe zeigt.
keywords: REDUCE, Interne Tabellen, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, WRITE, Funktionale Programmierung

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Betreff und Text, die aus einer Methode einer anderen Klasse stammen, unter Verwendung von `CL_BCS_UTILITIES`.

CLASS zcl_bcs_external_content DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail_with_external_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_external_content IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_with_external_content.
    DATA(lo_content_provider) = NEW zcl_mail_content_provider( ).
    DATA(lv_subject) = lo_content_provider->get_subject( ).
    DATA(lv_body) = lo_content_provider->get_body( sy-uname ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_textn( ( lv_body ) )
      i_subject = lv_subject
    ).

    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_current_user( ).
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
      iv_address_string = iv_recipient_email
    ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
    lo_send_request->set_sender( lo_sender ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    DATA(lv_sent) = lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    IF lv_sent = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bcs
        EXPORTING
          text = 'E-Mail mit externem Inhalt konnte nicht gesendet werden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Geben Sie eine Liste von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle mit `WRITE` aus, wobei Sie die `FOR`-Schleife für die Iteration verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN itab` für die Iteration und `WRITE` für die Ausgabe jedes Elements.

CLASS zcl_write_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_list_with_for
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_write_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_list_with_for.
    IF it_values IS INITIAL.
      WRITE / 'Die Liste ist leer.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WRITE / 'Liste der Werte:'.
    ULINE.

    FOR lv_value IN it_values.
      WRITE / lv_value.
    ENDFOR.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie Aggregatfunktionen wie `SUM` und die `GROUP BY`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_agg_groupby DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupied_seats,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_occupied_seats.
    TYPES tt_occupied_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupied_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_agg_data) TYPE tt_occupied_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_agg_groupby IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    SELECT carrid, SUM(seatsocc) AS total_occupied_seats
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_agg_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wähle die Top 3 Flüge mit den meisten belegten Sitzen aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_dbq_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights_by_seats.
    SELECT * FROM sflights
      ORDER BY seatsocc DESCENDING
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_top_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wähle Flüge aus und kategorisiere sie basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitze als 'Full', 'Half-Full' oder 'Empty'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CASE`-Ausdruck direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_case_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid          TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate          TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc        TYPE s_seatsocc,
             occupancy_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_case_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc,
           CASE WHEN seatsocc = seatsmax THEN 'Full'
                WHEN seatsocc >= seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Half-Full'
                ELSE 'Empty'
           END AS occupancy_status
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_case_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_status) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_status ).
    " Find a flight and check its status (example, assuming data exists)
    READ TABLE lt_flight_status INTO DATA(ls_flight) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( ls_flight-occupancy_status = 'Full' OR
                 ls_flight-occupancy_status = 'Half-Full' OR
                 ls_flight-occupancy_status = 'Empty' )
        msg = 'Belegungsstatus sollte korrekt zugewiesen sein'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE`-Ausdrücke in Open SQL (ab 7.50) ermöglichen es, bedingte Logik direkt auf der Datenbank auszuführen. Dies verbessert die Performance, da weniger Daten zum Anwendungsserver übertragen werden müssen und die Logik näher an den Daten verarbeitet wird.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von zwei verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `UNION`-Operator, um die Ergebnisse von zwei `SELECT`-Anweisungen zu vereinen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_select_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             planetype TYPE string, " Dummy field for type compatibility
           END OF ty_combined_flight.
    TYPES tt_combined_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_combined_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_select_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax, '' AS planetype FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax, '' AS planetype FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_select_union( ).
    DATA(lt_combined_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_combined_flights ).
    " Check if both carriers are present in the result
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_aa_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_combined_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_lh_found msg = 'LH Flüge sollten enthalten sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_aa_found msg = 'AA Flüge sollten enthalten sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION` (ab 7.50) ermöglicht das effiziente Kombinieren von Ergebnismengen aus mehreren `SELECT`-Anweisungen direkt auf der Datenbank. Dies ist performanter als das Sammeln von Daten in separaten internen Tabellen und deren anschließende Zusammenführung im Anwendungsserver.
keywords: SELECT, UNION, Combine Results, 7.50

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS interval_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_new_interval) TYPE i.
    METHODS start_dynamic_timer IMPORTING iv_initial_interval TYPE i iv_decrease_by TYPE i iv_min_interval TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_decrease_by TYPE i.
    DATA mv_min_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_dynamic_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_initial_interval.
    mo_timer->run_count = 0. " Run indefinitely until deactivated
    mv_decrease_by = iv_decrease_by.
    mv_min_interval = iv_min_interval.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    mo_timer->deactivate( ). " Deactivate to change interval
    mo_timer->interval = mo_timer->interval - mv_decrease_by.
    IF mo_timer->interval < mv_min_interval.
      mo_timer->interval = mv_min_interval.
    ENDIF.
    RAISE EVENT interval_changed EXPORTING iv_new_interval = mo_timer->interval.
    mo_timer->activate( ). " Reactivate with new interval
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_user_interact DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS action_performed.
    EVENTS waiting_for_input.
    METHODS start_action_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS simulate_user_input.

    DATA mv_action_done TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_user_interact IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_action_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run_count = 1.
    mv_action_done = abap_false.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    IF mv_action_done = abap_false.
      RAISE EVENT action_performed.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ). " Stop timer, wait for user input
      mv_action_done = abap_true.
      RAISE EVENT waiting_for_input.
    ELSE.
      " Timer finished after user input, can perform next action or stop
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
      mv_action_done = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_user_input.
    IF mv_action_done = abap_true.
      mo_timer->activate( ). " Restart timer after user input
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD test_user_interaction_timer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_user_interact( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_action_performed FOR lo_cut.
    SET HANDLER handle_waiting_for_input FOR lo_cut.

    mv_action_performed = abap_false.
    mv_waiting_for_input = abap_false.
    lo_cut->start_action_timer( 1 ).

    " Simulate first timer trigger (action performed, then waits)
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->(handle_finished) EXPORTING sender = lo_cut->mo_timer.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Action should be performed' act = mv_action_performed exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should be waiting for input' act = mv_waiting_for_input exp = abap_true ).

    " Simulate user input
    lo_cut->simulate_user_input( ).
    mv_waiting_for_input = abap_false. " Reset flag for next check

    " Simulate second timer trigger (after user input)
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->(handle_finished) EXPORTING sender = lo_cut->mo_timer.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should not be waiting for input after second trigger' act = mv_waiting_for_input exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_action_performed.
    mv_action_performed = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_waiting_for_input.
    mv_waiting_for_input = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_error_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS error_occurred EXPORTING VALUE(iv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS start_timer_with_error_handling IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.

    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_error_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer_with_error_handling.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run_count = 0. " Run indefinitely until deactivated
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    TRY.
        simulate_error( ). " This method will raise an exception
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        mo_timer->deactivate( ).
        RAISE EVENT error_occurred EXPORTING iv_message = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_error.
    DATA(lv_zero) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_result) TYPE i.
    lv_result = 1 / lv_zero. " This will cause a CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_at_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS triggered_at_time.
    METHODS schedule_timer_at_time IMPORTING iv_trigger_time TYPE timestampl.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_at_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD schedule_timer_at_time.
    DATA(lv_current_time) TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_time.

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) TYPE i.
    IF iv_trigger_time > lv_current_time.
      lv_diff_seconds = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( high = iv_trigger_time low = lv_current_time ).
    ELSE.
      " Trigger immediately if time is in the past or current
      lv_diff_seconds = 1.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = lv_diff_seconds.
    mo_timer->run_count = 1.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    RAISE EVENT triggered_at_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_at_time( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_triggered_at_time FOR lo_cut.

    mv_triggered = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_future_time) TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_future_time.
    lv_future_time = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = lv_future_time secs = 5 ). " 5 seconds in the future

    lo_cut->schedule_timer_at_time( lv_future_time ).

    " Simulate timer trigger
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->(handle_finished) EXPORTING sender = lo_cut->mo_timer.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Timer should be triggered at scheduled time' act = mv_triggered exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Timer interval should be 5 (simulated)' act = lo_cut->mo_timer->interval exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_triggered_at_time.
    mv_triggered = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_theme_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_theme_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum ein Arbeitstag ist, unter Berücksichtigung eines Fabrikkalenders, und geben Sie die nächsten N Arbeitstage zurück. Verwenden Sie `cl_reca_date`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_working_day,
             date TYPE d,
             is_working_day TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_working_day,
           tt_working_days TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_working_day WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_and_get_next_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_factory_calendar_id TYPE scalfid
        iv_number_of_days TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_working_days_info) TYPE tt_working_days.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_next_working_days.
    DATA(lo_factory_calendar) = cl_reca_factory_calendar=>create( iv_factory_calendar_id ).
    DATA(lo_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( iv_start_date ).

    LOOP AT cl_abap_int_utilities=>get_sequence( from = 0 to = iv_number_of_days - 1 ) INTO DATA(idx).
      DATA(lv_current_date) = lo_date->add_days( idx )->get_date( ).
      DATA(lo_current_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( lv_current_date ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_working_day(
        date = lv_current_date
        is_working_day = lo_factory_calendar->is_working_day( lo_current_date )
      ) TO rt_working_days_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer Reihe von Daten, beginnend von einem Startdatum bis zu einem Enddatum, unter Verwendung von `cl_reca_date` und dem `FOR` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_date` in einer `FOR` Schleife mit dem `VALUE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_range_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_date_range) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_range_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_date_range.
    DATA(lo_start_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lo_end_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( iv_end_date ).
    DATA(lv_days_diff) = lo_start_date->get_difference_in_days( lo_end_date ).

    IF lv_days_diff < 0.
      " Startdatum ist nach Enddatum, Schleife in die andere Richtung
      rt_date_range = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 THEN i - 1 WHILE i >= lv_days_diff
                                  ( lo_start_date->add_days( i )->get_date( ) ) ).
    ELSE.
      rt_date_range = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lv_days_diff
                                  ( lo_start_date->add_days( i )->get_date( ) ) ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_relative DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_time_relative IMPLEMENTATION.

      rs_date_status-status = 'Zukunft'.
    ELSE.
      rs_date_status-status = 'Gegenwart'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des N-ten Wochentags in einem bestimmten Monat und Jahr (z.B. den 3. Dienstag im Oktober 2023) unter Verwendung von `cl_reca_date` und modernen Schleifenkonstrukten.
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage des Monats und nutzen Sie `get_weekday` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_nth_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_nth_weekday_of_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_year TYPE syear
        iv_month TYPE sy_monat
        iv_weekday TYPE i " 1=Mo, ..., 7=So
        iv_occurrence TYPE i " 1=1st, 2=2nd, etc.
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_nth_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nth_weekday_of_month.
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_month) = |{ iv_year ALPHA = OUT }{ iv_month ALPHA = OUT }01|.
    DATA(lo_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( lv_first_day_of_month ).
    DATA(lv_current_occurrence) = 0.

    rv_date = REDUCE d(
      INIT r = lv_first_day_of_month
      FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i < 31 " Max 31 Tage im Monat
      NEXT
        date = lo_date->add_days( i )->get_date( )
        lo_current_date = cl_reca_date=>create( date )
        IF lo_current_date->get_weekday( ) = iv_weekday
          lv_current_occurrence = lv_current_occurrence + 1
        ENDIF
        IF lv_current_occurrence = iv_occurrence
          r = date
          EXIT
        ENDIF
        r = date " Keep iterating
    ).

    IF lv_current_occurrence < iv_occurrence.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
        EXPORTING
          text = |{ iv_occurrence }. { iv_weekday } im { iv_month }. { iv_year } nicht gefunden|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rel_read_links DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_link,
             obj_a_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             obj_a_key  TYPE borident-objkey,

             obj_b_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             rel_type   TYPE sreltypid,
           END OF ty_link.

CLASS zcl_rel_read_links IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_all_links.
    DATA(ls_object) = VALUE borident( objtype = iv_obj_type objkey = iv_obj_key ).

    cl_binary_relation=>read_links_of_object(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = ls_object
      IMPORTING
        et_links  = lt_links_raw
    ).

    rt_links = VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_links_raw
                        ( obj_a_type = ls_link-objtype_a
                          obj_a_key  = ls_link-objkey_a
                          obj_b_type = ls_link-objtype_b
                          obj_b_key  = ls_link-objkey_b
                          rel_type   = ls_link-reltype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_rel_delete_link( ).

    DATA(lv_obj_a_type) = 'BUS1001'.
    DATA(lv_obj_a_key) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_b_type) = 'BUS1006'.
    DATA(lv_obj_b_key) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_rel_type) = 'Z_TEST_REL'.

    " Test 1: Link does not exist initially
    DATA(lv_exists_initial) = lo_checker->check_relation_exists(
      iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type
      iv_obj_a_key  = lv_obj_a_key
      iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type
      iv_obj_b_key  = lv_obj_b_key
      iv_rel_type   = lv_rel_type
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exists_initial
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Link should not exist initially'
    ).

    " Create a link
    lo_creator->create_relation(
      iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type
      iv_obj_a_key  = lv_obj_a_key
      iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type
      iv_obj_b_key  = lv_obj_b_key
      iv_rel_type   = lv_rel_type
    ).

    " Test 2: Link should now exist
    DATA(lv_exists_after_create) = lo_checker->check_relation_exists(
      iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type
      iv_obj_a_key  = lv_obj_a_key
      iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type
      iv_obj_b_key  = lv_obj_b_key
      iv_rel_type   = lv_rel_type
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_exists_after_create
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Link should exist after creation'
    ).

    " Clean up
    lo_deleter->delete_relation(
      iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type
      iv_obj_a_key  = lv_obj_a_key
      iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type
      iv_obj_b_key  = lv_obj_b_key
      iv_rel_type   = lv_rel_type
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `check_link` liefert einen booleschen Wert zurück, der angibt, ob eine Verknüpfung zwischen den angegebenen Objekten mit dem gegebenen Verknüpfungstyp existiert. Dies ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, die Existenz zu prüfen, ohne alle Verknüpfungen lesen zu müssen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Festwerte einer Domäne nach einem bestimmten Muster und geben Sie nur die passenden Werte zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA=>GET_FIXED_VALUES` in Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_doma_filter_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low  TYPE ddtext,
             text TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.
    TYPES tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_domain_fixed_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_pattern     TYPE string
        iv_langu       TYPE langu DEFAULT sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_doma_filter_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_domain_fixed_values.
    DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_instance(
                         iv_domain_name = iv_domain_name
                         iv_langu       = iv_langu
                       ).

    DATA(lt_all_fixed_values) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( ).

    rt_filtered_values = FILTER #( lt_all_fixed_values USING KEY primary_key
                                   WHERE low CP iv_pattern OR ddtext CP iv_pattern ).

    rt_filtered_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN rt_filtered_values
                                ( low = ls_raw-low
                                  text = ls_raw-ddtext ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
