CLASS zcl_rel_count_links DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_links_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_obj_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_obj_key  TYPE borident-objkey
        iv_rel_type TYPE sreltypid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rel_count_links IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_links_by_type.
    DATA(ls_object) = VALUE borident( objtype = iv_obj_type objkey = iv_obj_key ).
    DATA lt_links_raw TYPE obl_t_link.

    cl_binary_relation=>read_links_of_object(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = ls_object
      IMPORTING
        et_links  = lt_links_raw
    ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR ls_link IN lt_links_raw
                         WHERE ( reltype = iv_rel_type )
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_rel_create_link( ).
    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_rel_delete_link( ).

    DATA(lv_obj_a_type) = 'BUS1001'.
    DATA(lv_obj_a_key) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_b_type_1) = 'BUS1006'.
    DATA(lv_obj_b_key_1) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_b_type_2) = 'BUS1006'.
    DATA(lv_obj_b_key_2) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_rel_type_1) = 'Z_TEST_REL_A'.
    DATA(lv_rel_type_2) = 'Z_TEST_REL_B'.

    " Create two links of type Z_TEST_REL_A
    lo_creator->create_relation( iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type iv_obj_a_key = lv_obj_a_key iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type_1 iv_obj_b_key = lv_obj_b_key_1 iv_rel_type = lv_rel_type_1 ).
    lo_creator->create_relation( iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type iv_obj_a_key = lv_obj_a_key iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type_2 iv_obj_b_key = lv_obj_b_key_2 iv_rel_type = lv_rel_type_1 ).
    " Create one link of type Z_TEST_REL_B
    lo_creator->create_relation( iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type iv_obj_a_key = lv_obj_a_key iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type_1 iv_obj_b_key = lv_obj_b_key_1 iv_rel_type = lv_rel_type_2 ).

    DATA(lv_count_a) = lo_counter->count_links_by_type(
      iv_obj_type = lv_obj_a_type
      iv_obj_key  = lv_obj_a_key
      iv_rel_type = lv_rel_type_1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count_a
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should count 2 links of type Z_TEST_REL_A'
    ).

    DATA(lv_count_b) = lo_counter->count_links_by_type(
      iv_obj_type = lv_obj_a_type
      iv_obj_key  = lv_obj_a_key
      iv_rel_type = lv_rel_type_2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count_b
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Should count 1 link of type Z_TEST_REL_B'
    ).

    " Clean up
    lo_deleter->delete_relation( iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type iv_obj_a_key = lv_obj_a_key iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type_1 iv_obj_b_key = lv_obj_b_key_1 iv_rel_type = lv_rel_type_1 ).
    lo_deleter->delete_relation( iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type iv_obj_a_key = lv_obj_a_key iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type_2 iv_obj_b_key = lv_obj_b_key_2 iv_rel_type = lv_rel_type_1 ).
    lo_deleter->delete_relation( iv_obj_a_type = lv_obj_a_type iv_obj_a_key = lv_obj_a_key iv_obj_b_type = lv_obj_b_type_1 iv_obj_b_key = lv_obj_b_key_1 iv_rel_type = lv_rel_type_2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine CSV-Zeichenkette, die in UTF-8 kodiert ist, konvertieren Sie sie nach UTF-16 und parsen Sie die Daten in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen. Die CSV-Daten enthalten Flugnummer, Fluggesellschaft und Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in=>create` für die Konvertierung und `SPLIT ... INTO TABLE` für das Parsen jeder Zeile und jedes Feldes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_utf8 TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_utf8.
    DATA: lv_csv_utf16 TYPE string,
          lt_lines     TYPE string_table,
          ls_flight    TYPE ty_flight_data.

    " 1. Convert UTF-8 xstring to UTF-16 string
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      input    = iv_csv_utf8
    ).
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_csv_utf16 ).

    " 2. Split CSV into lines
    SPLIT lv_csv_utf16 AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    " 3. Parse each line into structure and append to result table
    LOOP AT lt_lines INTO DATA(lv_line) WHERE lv_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      SPLIT lv_line AT ',' INTO DATA(lv_carrid) DATA(lv_connid) DATA(lv_fldate).
      ls_flight-carrid = lv_carrid.
      ls_flight-connid = lv_connid.
      ls_flight-fldate = lv_fldate.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flight_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = 'LH,0400,20250101' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'AA,0017,20250201'.
    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->write( lv_csv_data )->get_buffer( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_csv_utf8( lv_csv_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTO TABLE`. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` für Zeilenumbrüche und `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine einzelne, durch Semikolons getrennte Zeichenkette und kodieren Sie diese Zeichenkette in UTF-8.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit String-Templates für die String-Erstellung und `cl_abap_conv_out=>create` für die UTF-8-Kodierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_sflights_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights_to_utf8.
    DATA: lv_flight_string TYPE string.

    " 1. Build a single string from the internal table using String Templates and FOR
    lv_flight_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <fs_flight>-carrid };{ <fs_flight>-connid };{ <fs_flight>-fldate }|
        ELSE s && |;{ <fs_flight>-carrid };{ <fs_flight>-connid };{ <fs_flight>-fldate }|
      )
    ).

    " 2. Convert the string to UTF-8 xstring
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      output   = lv_flight_string
    ).
    rv_utf8_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250201'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_serializer( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights_to_utf8( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' input = lv_utf8_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_result_string) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_result_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_string exp = 'LH;0400;20250101;AA;0017;20250201' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN` und String-Templates, um eine interne Tabelle effizient in eine einzelne Zeichenkette zu serialisieren. Anschließend wird `cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create` verwendet, um diese Zeichenkette in eine UTF-8-kodierte XSTRING zu konvertieren. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Art der Datenverarbeitung und -konvertierung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Struktur, lesen Sie einen binären Datenstrom (simulierend eine Datei) in einer bestimmten Kodierung (z.B. UTF-16), konvertieren Sie diesen nach UTF-8 und füllen Sie die dynamische Tabelle mit geparsten Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF`, Feld-Symbole, `cl_abap_conv_x2x` für die Konvertierung und `SPLIT ... INTO TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.

    METHODS parse_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_binary_data TYPE xstring
        iv_source_encoding TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lv_converted_string TYPE string,
          lt_lines            TYPE string_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    " 1. Convert binary data from source encoding to target encoding (string)
    DATA(lo_conv_x2x) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create(
      in_encoding  = iv_source_encoding
      out_encoding = iv_target_encoding
      input        = iv_binary_data
    ).
    lo_conv_x2x->convert( IMPORTING buffer = lv_converted_string ).

    " 2. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 3. Split converted string into lines
    SPLIT lv_converted_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    " 4. Parse each line and populate dynamic table
    LOOP AT lt_lines INTO DATA(lv_line) WHERE lv_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      SPLIT lv_line AT ',' INTO DATA(lv_field1) DATA(lv_field2).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
      IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field1> = lv_field1. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
      IF <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field2> = lv_field2. ENDIF.

      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_parse FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_parse.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_raw_data_utf16) = 'FieldA,Value1' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'FieldB,Value2'.
    DATA(lv_binary_data) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-16LE' )->write( lv_raw_data_utf16 )->get_buffer( ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->parse_dynamic_data(
      iv_binary_data     = lv_binary_data
      iv_source_encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
      iv_target_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE zcl_dynamic_parser=>ty_dynamic_data.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_line>-field1 exp = 'FieldA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_line>-field2 exp = 'Value1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert dynamische Programmierung mit Datenkonvertierung. `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce` wird verwendet, um Binärdaten zwischen verschiedenen Kodierungen zu konvertieren. Anschließend wird `CREATE DATA` genutzt, um eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu erstellen, die dann über Feld-Symbole und `SPLIT ... INTO TABLE` mit den konvertierten und geparsten Daten gefüllt wird. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario für flexible Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und bilden Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (`connid`) und das Datum (`fldate`) enthält.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_filtered_flights(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group_key)` und `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_flight_count TYPE ty_flight_count.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      ls_flight_count-carrid = group_key-carrid.
      ls_flight_count-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0500'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0100'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung der `LOOP AT`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was den Code sehr kompakt macht. Dies ist eine wesentliche Verbesserung gegenüber manuellen Gruppierungen in älteren ABAP-Versionen.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch Semikolons getrennte Werte enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von Strings auf und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Anzahl der Elemente zu zählen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT ... INTO TABLE` und `REDUCE` für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_count
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_count.
    DATA(lt_parts) TYPE string_table.

    SPLIT iv_input_string AT iv_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT c = 0
      FOR <part> IN lt_parts
      WHERE ( <part> IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT c = c + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_and_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_and_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_utils( ).

    DATA(lv_count1) = lo_cut->split_and_count( iv_input_string = 'A;B;C' iv_delimiter = ';' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count1 exp = 3 ).

    DATA(lv_count2) = lo_cut->split_and_count( iv_input_string = 'X,Y,Z' iv_delimiter = ',' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count2 exp = 3 ).

    DATA(lv_count3) = lo_cut->split_and_count( iv_input_string = 'SingleValue' iv_delimiter = ';' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count3 exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lv_count4) = lo_cut->split_and_count( iv_input_string = '' iv_delimiter = ';' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count4 exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lv_count5) = lo_cut->split_and_count( iv_input_string = 'A;;B' iv_delimiter = ';' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count5 exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SPLIT ... INTO TABLE`-Anweisung ist der Standardweg, um Strings in eine interne Tabelle von Teil-Strings aufzuteilen. Die anschließende Verwendung von `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung zum Zählen nicht-leerer Elemente ist eine moderne, funktionale Methode, die den Code sehr prägnant und lesbar macht.

CLASS zcl_table_merger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'Entry 2'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_table1.

CLASS zcl_flight_enricher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

             fldate TYPE s_date,

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE tt_enriched_flights(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        price  = flight-price,
        travel_time_hours = ( flight-connid MOD 100 ) + 1 " Simulated calculation

    ).

Instructions: Sammeln Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einer neuen internen Tabelle von Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `VALUE #(...)` und `DISTINCT` (implizit durch `SET` oder `SORT/DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carriers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      ( flight-carrid )
    ).

    SORT lt_all_carriers ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_all_carriers.

    rt_unique_carriers = lt_all_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BA'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

IN` alle Werte sammeln und dann mit `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` die Eindeutigkeit herstellen. Dies ist eine gängige und effiziente Methode, um eindeutige Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu extrahieren und in eine neue Tabelle zu überführen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (`price`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH').
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-price = '200.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-price = '150.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und fügen Sie ein Statusfeld hinzu ('Expensive' oder 'Normal').

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_classifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_classified_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_classified_flight.
    TYPES tt_classified_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_classified_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS classify_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_classified_flights) TYPE tt_classified_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_classifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_flights_by_price.
    rt_classified_flights = VALUE tt_classified_flights(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( price > iv_price_threshold )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        price  = flight-price,
        status = COND string(
          WHEN flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN 'Expensive'
          ELSE 'Normal' " This branch won't be hit due to WHERE clause, but shown for completeness
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-price = '250.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_classifier( ).

Dies ermöglicht es, Daten basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern und gleichzeitig neue Felder mit bedingten Werten zu füllen, alles in einer einzigen, sehr lesbaren und modernen Anweisung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_example_struct,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_example_struct.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        io_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    " 1. Create dynamic internal table based on RTTI structure description
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (io_struct_descr->get_relative_name( )).
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 2. Populate with example data
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_a>).
    IF <fs_field_a> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field_a> = 'Value 1'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_b>).
    IF <fs_field_b> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field_b> = 100. ENDIF.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_field_a>.
    IF <fs_field_a> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field_a> = 'Value 2'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_field_b>.
    IF <fs_field_b> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field_b> = 200. ENDIF.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den prozentualen Anteil eines Wertes an einem Gesamtbetrag und runde das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.

CLASS zcl_math_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_part  TYPE decfloat34
        iv_total TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_percentage) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING

CLASS zcl_math_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF iv_total = 0.

Instructions: Berechne die durchschnittliche Auslastung (OCCUPANCY) aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und `DIVIDE` für den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_occup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_occup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy.
    DATA(lv_total_occupancy) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0
                                                FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( it_sflights ).

    IF lv_flight_count = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.

    rv_avg_occupancy = lv_total_occupancy DIVIDE BY lv_flight_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch, aber fangen Sie den Fehler ab, wenn der Divisor Null ist, und geben Sie eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.

CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_divisor  TYPE decfloat34

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_safely.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_quotient) = iv_dividend DIVIDE BY iv_divisor.
        rv_result = |Ergebnis: { lv_quotient }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Arithmetischer Fehler aufgetreten.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie eine Liste von Zahlen durch einen konstanten Divisor und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Liste. Runden Sie dabei auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit `DIVIDE` und `DECFLOAT_ROUND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS divide_list
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_divisor TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_divided_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_list.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.

    rt_divided_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_numbers
                                  ( decfloat_round( val = number DIVIDE BY iv_divisor n = 2 mode = cl_abap_math=>round_half_up ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Serialisieren Sie die Tabelle zuerst in einen JSON-String (`CALL TRANSFORMATION ID`), dann komprimieren/dekomprimieren Sie mit `cl_abap_gzip` und deserialisieren Sie zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_itab_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_gzip_error.

    METHODS decompress_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_gzip_error,
        cx_transformation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_itab_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize( data = it_sflights pretty_print = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text(
      EXPORTING
        text   = lv_json_string
      IMPORTING
        gziped = rv_compressed_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_sflights.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = ''_string.
    cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text(
      EXPORTING
        gziped = iv_compressed_data
      IMPORTING
        text   = lv_json_string
    ).
    cl_abap_json_deserializer=>deserialize( json = lv_json_string data = rt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, ungültige (nicht-GZIP-formatierte) Daten zu dekomprimieren und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahme `CX_ABAP_GZIP_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_invalid_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_invalid_data.
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = ''_string.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text(
          EXPORTING
            gziped = iv_invalid_data
          IMPORTING
            text   = lv_decompressed_string
        ).
        rv_message = |Erfolgreich dekomprimiert: { lv_decompressed_string }|.
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler bei der Dekomprimierung: { lx_gzip_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Quotienten und den Rest einer Ganzzahl-Division. Der Rest soll dabei immer positiv sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DIVIDE` für den Quotienten und den `MOD` Operator für den Rest. Achten Sie auf die Behandlung negativer Zahlen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_division_result,
             quotient TYPE i,
             remainder TYPE i,
           END OF ty_division_result.

    METHODS divide_with_positive_remainder
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_division_result
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_with_positive_remainder.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.

    rs_result-quotient = iv_dividend DIV iv_divisor.
    rs_result-remainder = iv_dividend MOD iv_divisor.

    IF rs_result-remainder < 0 AND iv_divisor > 0.
      rs_result-remainder = rs_result-remainder + iv_divisor.
      rs_result-quotient = rs_result-quotient - 1.
    ELSEIF rs_result-remainder < 0 AND iv_divisor < 0.
      rs_result-remainder = rs_result-remainder - iv_divisor.
      rs_result-quotient = rs_result-quotient + 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) in ein `XSTRING` und dekomprimieren Sie sie wieder, wobei Sie die Komprimierungsstufe anpassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring` und `cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring` mit dem Parameter `level`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_level DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_sflights_with_level
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_level    TYPE i " 0-9, 0=no compression, 9=best compression
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_gzip_error.

    METHODS decompress_sflights_with_level
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_gzip_error,
        cx_transformation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_level IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights_with_level.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize( data = it_sflights pretty_print = abap_false ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_json_string ).

    cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        uncompressed = lv_xstring_data
        level        = iv_level
      IMPORTING
        gziped       = rv_compressed_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_sflights_with_level.
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = VALUE xstring( ).
    cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        gziped       = iv_compressed_data
      IMPORTING
        uncompressed = lv_xstring_data
    ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_xstring_data ).
    cl_abap_json_deserializer=>deserialize( json = lv_json_string data = rt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) in ein `XSTRING` und dekomprimieren Sie sie wieder, wobei Sie die Komprimierungsstufe anpassen.

CLASS zcl_gzip_level DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_sflights_with_level
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_level    TYPE i " 0-9, 0=no compression, 9=best compression
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_gzip_error.

    METHODS decompress_sflights_with_level
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_gzip_error,
        cx_transformation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_level IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights_with_level.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize( data = it_sflights pretty_print = abap_false ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_json_string ).

    cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        uncompressed = lv_xstring_data
        level        = iv_level
      IMPORTING
        gziped       = rv_compressed_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_sflights_with_level.
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = VALUE xstring( ).
    cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        gziped       = iv_compressed_data
      IMPORTING
        uncompressed = lv_xstring_data
    ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_xstring_data ).
    cl_abap_json_deserializer=>deserialize( json = lv_json_string data = rt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine Mindestanzahl an freien Plätzen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 190 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 120 )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_free = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 190 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 120 )
    ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 290 ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 250 ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. "Pünktlich", "Verspätet", "Annulliert") basierend auf einem Statuscode, unter Verwendung eines konditionalen Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'P' THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'D' THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'C' THEN 'Annulliert'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'D' ) exp = 'Verspätet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'C' ) exp = 'Annulliert' ).

CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der freien Plätze enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_map_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_free_seats,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_free_seats.
    TYPES tt_free_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_free_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_to_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_free_seats) TYPE tt_free_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_map_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_to_free_seats.
    rt_free_seats = VALUE tt_free_seats(
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_map_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_map_flights=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 180 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->map_to_free_seats( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-free_seats exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-free_seats exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht eine deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen, ähnlich wie `map` Funktionen in anderen Sprachen. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und moderne Art, Daten zu verarbeiten.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Mapping, Transformation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null verhindert und stattdessen eine Ausnahme auslöst, die direkt in einem Ausdruck verwendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error` in einem `COND` oder `SWITCH` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    rv_result = COND #(
      WHEN iv_denominator = 0 THEN THROW cx_sy_arithmetic_error( textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error )
      ELSE iv_numerator / iv_denominator
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero EXPECTING EXCEPTION cx_sy_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `THROW` Syntax in einem `COND` oder `SWITCH` Ausdruck ermöglicht das Auslösen von Ausnahmen direkt innerhalb eines Ausdrucks. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art der Fehlerbehandlung, die den Code lesbarer macht, indem sie die Fehlerlogik direkt in den Wertausdruck integriert.
keywords: Error Handling, Exceptions, THROW, COND, Expressions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbolen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_descr,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE abap_type_kind,
             len  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_descr.
    TYPES tt_field_descr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_descr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_itab
      IMPORTING
        it_field_descriptions TYPE tt_field_descr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_itab.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  LIKE LINE OF lt_components.

    LOOP AT it_field_descriptions INTO DATA(ls_field_descr).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_descr-name.
      ls_component-type = ls_field_descr-type.
      ls_component-length = ls_field_descr-len.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Example: Add one row
    CREATE DATA DATA(lo_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'Value A'. ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 123. ENDIF.

    INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_itab FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_itab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_itab=>tt_field_descr(
      ( name = 'FIELD1' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char len = 10 )
      ( name = 'FIELD2' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int len = 4 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_itab( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 1 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_line> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 'Value A' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 123 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Datenobjekten und die Arbeit mit Feld-Symbolen sind Kernkonzepte der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP. Moderne ABAP-Versionen verbessern die Lesbarkeit durch Inline-Deklarationen und die Verwendung von Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` zur Typbeschreibung.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) und füllen Sie diese mit dem `VALUE` Operator. Die Tabelle soll nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit der Syntax `VALUE #( ... )` und geben Sie den Tabellentyp als `SORTED TABLE` an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_sflight_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should be sorted' act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>is_sorted( lt_flights ) ).

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 1.
      DATA(ls_first) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      DATA(ls_second) = lt_flights[ 2 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'First element should be less than or equal to second' 
        act = ( ls_first-carrid < ls_second-carrid OR ( ls_first-carrid = ls_second-carrid AND ls_first-connid <= ls_second-connid ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Initialisierung und Befüllung interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife kann man Daten aus einer anderen Quelle (hier `sflights`) effizient in die sortierte Zieltabelle übertragen, wobei die Sortierung automatisch durch den Tabellentyp gewährleistet wird.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue sortierte Tabelle, die nur die `CARRID` und `CONNID` aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle enthält, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FOR` Ausdruck.

      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE ty_flight_key_sorted_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_keys.
    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price ) 
        ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid = ls_sflight-connid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Quelldaten, bevor sie in die Zieltabelle eingefügt werden, was die Effizienz erhöht, da nur relevante Daten verarbeitet werden.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine bestehende sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten nach einem bestimmten `CARRID` und geben Sie die gefilterten Einträge in einer neuen sortierten Tabelle zurück. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator ist ideal für das Filtern von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_sflight_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tt
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_filter=>ty_sflight_sorted_tt(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' price = 250 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_aa) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier(

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should find 2 flights for AA' act = lines( lt_filtered_aa ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight should be AA' act = lt_filtered_aa[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Filtered table should be sorted' act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>is_sorted( lt_filtered_aa ) ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid      = 'LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should find 2 flights for LH' act = lines( lt_filtered_lh ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight should be LH' act = lt_filtered_lh[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Für sortierte Tabellen kann er die Sortierung nutzen, um den Filtervorgang zu optimieren, was zu einer besseren Performance führt als eine manuelle Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingung.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FILTER, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer sortierten Tabelle für einen bestimmten `CARRID` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: `REDUCE` ist ideal für Aggregationen. Initialisieren Sie eine Variable und addieren Sie in der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_sflight_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tt
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) 
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for AA should be 250' act = lv_total_aa exp = 250 ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_by_carrier(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid      = 'LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for LH should be 450' act = lv_total_lh exp = 450 ).

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Weise. Er ersetzt klassische `LOOP ... ENDLOOP` Konstrukte mit einer lokalen Hilfsvariable und ist besonders nützlich für Summen, Zählungen oder die Ermittlung von Min/Max-Werten.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Eintrag aus einer sortierten Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) basierend auf `CARRID` und `CONNID`. Demonstrieren Sie die implizite Nutzung des binären Suchalgorithmus.
hint: Bei sortierten Tabellen wird `READ TABLE` mit dem vollständigen Schlüssel automatisch eine binäre Suche durchführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_sflight_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS read_flight_entry
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tt
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid      TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight_entry.
    READ TABLE it_all_flights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_flight_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_flight_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_read=>ty_sflight_sorted_tt(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(ls_flight_aa001) = lo_cut->read_flight_entry(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid      = 'AA'
      iv_connid      = '001'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should be AA' act = ls_flight_aa001-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CONNID should be 001' act = ls_flight_aa001-connid exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should be 100' act = ls_flight_aa001-price exp = 100 ).

    DATA(ls_flight_xx001) = lo_cut->read_flight_entry(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid      = 'XX'
      iv_connid      = '001'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Non-existent flight should be initial' act = ls_flight_xx001 ).

    DATA(ls_flight_aa003) = lo_cut->read_flight_entry(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid      = 'AA'
      iv_connid      = '003'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Non-existent connection for existing carrier should be initial' act = ls_flight_aa003 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei sortierten Tabellen führt die `READ TABLE` Anweisung mit dem vollständigen Tabellenschlüssel automatisch eine binäre Suche durch. Dies ist wesentlich performanter als eine sequentielle Suche, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen. Die explizite Angabe von `BINARY SEARCH` ist nicht mehr notwendig und sollte vermieden werden, da sie bei nicht sortierten Tabellen zu falschen Ergebnissen führen kann.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, BINARY SEARCH, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flug in eine sortierte Tabelle ein und löschen Sie anschließend einen bestehenden Flug. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierung erhalten bleibt.
hint: `INSERT` und `DELETE` auf sortierten Tabellen erhalten die Sortierung automatisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_sflight_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS modify_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tt.

    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tt.

    METHODS remove_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flights.
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'AZ' connid = '999' fldate = '20251231' price = 500 ).
    add_flight( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_new_flight CHANGING ct_flights = ct_flights ).
    remove_flight( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '001' CHANGING ct_flights = ct_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE ct_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_flight.
    DELETE TABLE ct_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_and_remove_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_and_remove_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>ty_sflight_sorted_tt(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_flights ).

    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '007' fldate = '20250303' price = 300 ).
    lo_cut->add_flight( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_new_flight CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should increase by 1 after add' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_initial_lines + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should remain sorted after add' act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>is_sorted( lt_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'New flight should be found' act = lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'BA' connid = '007' ] ).

    lo_cut->remove_flight( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '001' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should decrease by 1 after remove' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_initial_lines ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should remain sorted after remove' act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>is_sorted( lt_flights ) ).
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_removed_flight) = lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Removed flight should not be found' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Removed flight not found as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_cut->remove_flight( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '000' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should not change for non-existent remove' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_initial_lines ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei sortierten Tabellen stellen `INSERT` und `DELETE` Operationen sicher, dass die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch beibehalten wird. Dies vereinfacht die Logik erheblich, da keine manuelle Sortierung nach jeder Änderung erforderlich ist. Die Performance dieser Operationen ist logarithmisch (O(log n)) für die Suche nach der Einfüge-/Löschposition und linear (O(n)) für das Verschieben der Elemente.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT, DELETE, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ einer beliebigen Variablen zur Laufzeit mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data`.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_type_name_by_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_type_name_by_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_describe_data( ).

Es liefert ein Typbeschreibungsobjekt, das detaillierte Informationen über den Typ der übergebenen Variablen zur Laufzeit bereitstellt. Dies ist nützlich für generische Programmierung, bei der der Typ einer Variablen zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_typedescr, describe_by_data, Dynamic Programming, Type Information

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist, unter Verwendung von RTTI und dem `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Statement.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` um die Komponenten einer Struktur zu erhalten und dann `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_field( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_field=>ty_data( field1 = 'Test String' field2 = 123 ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `STANDARD`, `SORTED` oder `HASHED` ist, unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und casten Sie das Ergebnis zu `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_type_kind
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_table_kind) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_type_kind.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_table ).

    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
      DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
      CASE lo_tabledescr->table_kind.
        WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard.
          rv_table_kind = 'STANDARD'.
        WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_sorted.
          rv_table_kind = 'SORTED'.
        WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed.
          rv_table_kind = 'HASHED'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          rv_table_kind = 'UNKNOWN_TABLE_KIND'.
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      rv_table_kind = 'NOT_A_TABLE'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit bekannten Zeilentyp und Tabellentyp (z.B. `STANDARD`, `SORTED`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` mit einem `cl_abap_structdescr` für den Zeilentyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_line_type_name TYPE string
        iv_table_kind     TYPE c LENGTH 1 " S=Standard, T=Sorted, H=Hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_line_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_line_type_name ).

        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
          p_line_type = lo_line_descr
          p_table_kind = iv_table_kind
          p_unique = abap_true " For sorted/hashed tables, a unique key is often desired
          p_key = VALUE cl_abap_tabledescr=>t_key_comp_tab( ( name = lo_line_descr->get_components( )[ 1 ]-name ) ) " Use first component as key
        ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

      CATCH cx_sy_runtime_error cx_sy_table_creation.
        " Handle error, e.g., type not found or table creation failed
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Sorted table should be created' act = lr_srt_table ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Komponenten (Felder) einer Struktur zur Laufzeit und deren Typen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info,
           ty_component_info_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_struct TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE ty_component_info_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_struct ).

    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        DATA(lo_comp_type_descr) = ls_component-type.
        APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
          name = ls_component-name
          type_kind = lo_comp_type_descr->type_kind
          length = lo_comp_type_descr->length
        ) TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Inhalt einer beliebigen internen Tabelle in eine String-Tabelle konvertiert, wobei jede Zeile der String-Tabelle eine durch Kommas getrennte Darstellung der Felder der Tabellenzeile ist. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_string_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_string_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_string_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_p_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DATA(lv_line_string) = ``.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_line_string = |
            { lv_line_string }{ COND string( WHEN lv_line_string IS NOT INITIAL THEN ',' ELSE '' ) }{ <fs_field> }|
            .
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lv_line_string TO rt_string_table.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First line should be correct' act = lt_string_output[ 1 ] exp = '1,Item A,10.5' ).

Durch die Kombination von `cl_abap_tabledescr` (für Tabelleninformationen), `cl_abap_structdescr` (für Zeilenstrukturinformationen) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` (für dynamischen Feldzugriff) kann der Inhalt jeder Tabellenzeile extrahiert und formatiert werden.
