Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtumsatz aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`, indem Sie den `PRICE` jedes Fluges mit der Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) multiplizieren und die Summe bilden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer Inline-Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_revenue
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_rev TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT total_rev = total_rev + ( <fs_flight>-price * <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_revenue FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_revenue.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_math_reduce_multiply=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 5.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '50.00'.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 10.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '1000.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung. Hier wird der Gesamtumsatz durch Multiplikation von Preis und belegten Sitzen für jeden Flug berechnet und summiert, was eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen darstellt.
keywords: REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf `sflights`, in der der `PRICE` jedes Fluges um einen gegebenen Faktor erhöht (multipliziert) wird. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und einer Inline-Struktur, um neue Zeilen zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_for_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price_adjusted,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price, " Adjusted price
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_price_adjusted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price_adjusted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price_adjusted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_input,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_input.
    TYPES tt_sflight_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_input
        iv_factor   TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price_adjusted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_for_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_prices.
    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      ( 
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
        price    = ls_flight-price * iv_factor,
        currency = ls_flight-currency
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_adjust_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjust_prices.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_tab_for_multiply=>tt_sflight_input.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_for_multiply( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->adjust_flight_prices( it_sflights = lt_test_flights iv_factor = '1.2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '120.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier wird für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle ein neuer Eintrag in der Zieltabelle erzeugt, wobei der Preis direkt im Ausdruck multipliziert wird. Dies ist eine sehr lesbare und leistungsstarke Methode zur Tabellenmanipulation.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, MULTIPLY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Multiplizieren Sie einen gegebenen Wert mit einem Faktor, aber nur, wenn der Wert größer als Null ist. Andernfalls soll der Wert unverändert bleiben. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.

CLASS zcl_cond_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_if_positive.
    rv_result = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_value > 0 THEN iv_value * iv_factor
      ELSE iv_value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Multiplizieren Sie den Wert eines dynamisch angegebenen Feldes in einer Struktur mit einem Faktor. Behandeln Sie Fehler, falls das Feld nicht existiert oder nicht numerisch ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und dynamische Zuweisungen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO ...`) in Kombination mit Exception-Handling.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS multiply_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_factor   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_modified_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_dynamic_field.
    rs_modified_data = is_data. " Copy input structure

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE rs_modified_data TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.

    IF <lv_field> IS SUPPLIED AND <lv_field> IS NUMERIC.
      <lv_field> = <lv_field> * iv_factor.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' is not numeric or initial.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_multiply FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_numeric_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_multiply.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_multiply=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 10.
    ls_data-field2 = 20.
    ls_data-field3 = 30.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_multiply( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->multiply_dynamic_field(
      is_data     = ls_data,
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD2',
      iv_factor   = 3
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field1 exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field2 exp = 60 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field3 exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_multiply=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 10.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_multiply( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->multiply_dynamic_field(
          is_data     = ls_data,
          iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD',
          iv_factor   = 2
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for non-existent field' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_numeric_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_multiply=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 10.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_multiply( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->multiply_dynamic_field(
          is_data     = ls_data,
          iv_field_name = 'FIELD1',
          iv_factor   = 2
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 10 ).
    CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Did not expect cx_sy_assign_error for numeric field' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt Feldsymbole und die `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Anweisung, um zur Laufzeit auf Felder einer Struktur zuzugreifen und deren Werte dynamisch zu manipulieren. Die Überprüfung auf Existenz und numerischen Typ des Feldes sowie das Exception-Handling sind Best Practices für robusten dynamischen Code.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, MULTIPLY, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Exception Handling

Instructions: Wandeln Sie einen String im Format 'Key:Value;Key2:Value2' in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen um, wobei jede Struktur zwei Felder (Key, Value) hat. Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` und `VALUE #( FOR ... )`.
hint: Verschachtelte `FOR`-Iteratoren und `SPLIT` sind hier nützlich, um die Transformation in einem Ausdruck durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_split_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_value,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_value.
    TYPES tt_key_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_string_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_values) TYPE tt_key_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_split_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_string_to_table.
    DATA(lt_pairs) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_pairs.

    rt_key_values = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_pair IN lt_pairs
      LET lv_key_val_pair = VALUE string_table( ) IN
        SPLIT ls_pair AT ':' INTO TABLE lv_key_val_pair
      IN
      ( 
        key   = lv_key_val_pair[ 1 ] OPTIONAL
        value = lv_key_val_pair[ 2 ] OPTIONAL
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_rejoin
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_delimiter TYPE c
        iv_new_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rejoined_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_rejoin.
    DATA(lt_components) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT iv_old_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_components.

    rv_rejoined_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lines( lt_components )
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN i = 1 THEN lt_components[ i ]
        ELSE |{ s }{ iv_new_delimiter }{ lt_components[ i ] }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_product_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_math_product_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE #( 
      INIT prod = 1 TYPE i
      FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
      NEXT prod = prod * lv_number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Iteriere durch die Tage und nutze `GET_DAY_OF_WEEK` der Klasse `cl_hrpad_date_computations`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days.
    DATA(lo_date_comp) = NEW cl_hrpad_date_computations( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_date_from.
    rv_working_days = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_date_to.
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = lo_date_comp->get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_day_of_week >= 1 AND lv_day_of_week <= 5. "1=Monday, 7=Sunday
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_working_days exp = 5 msg = 'Should be 5 working days' ).

    lv_working_days = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_date_from = '20230101' iv_date_to = '20230101' ). "Sunday

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_field_exists.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    IF line_exists( lt_components[ name = iv_field_name ] ).
      rb_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermittle die Länge eines Feldes in einer Struktur zur Laufzeit unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_structdescr`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             char_field TYPE c LENGTH 20,
             num_field  TYPE n LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    METHODS get_field_length
      IMPORTING
        is_data    TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_length) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_length.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = ls_component-type_descr.
      rv_length = lo_type_descr->length.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_length( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_length exp = 3 msg = 'CARRID length should be 3' ).

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr`.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data`, `get_table_line_type` und dann `create_table_type`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_original,
             id   TYPE c LENGTH 5,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_original.
    TYPES: ty_t_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_original WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_template_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_template_table ).
    DATA(lo_line_type_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_line_type_descr
      p_table_kind = lo_table_descr->table_kind
      p_unique = lo_table_descr->is_unique
      p_with_empty_key = lo_table_descr->has_empty_key
    ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_dynamic_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_table=>ty_t_original.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_original ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should be created' ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    DATA(lo_original_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_dynamic_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->type_kind
                                        exp = lo_original_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->type_kind
                                        msg = 'Line types should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI und RTTC (Run Time Type Creation) ermöglichen die dynamische Erstellung von Datenobjekten. Hier wird die Struktur einer vorhandenen internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit ausgelesen und eine neue, identisch strukturierte interne Tabelle dynamisch erzeugt. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept für generische Datenverarbeitung und Frameworks, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: RTTI, RTTC, Dynamic Table, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate von Flügen (basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer) aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...` nach einer Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_adj_dups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_adjacent_duplicates
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_adj_dups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    SORT ct_sflights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_sflights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS lcl_test_data DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        CLASS-METHODS get_sflights_with_dups RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_data IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_sflights_with_dups.
        rt_sflights = VALUE #(
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231122' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 50 )
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231122' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 100 )
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231123' price = '110.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 60 ) " Duplicate for ADJACENT
          ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20231122' price = '300.00' currency = 'SGD' planetype = 'A350' seatsocc = 150 )
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231123' price = '110.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 60 ) " Another duplicate
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231123' price = '210.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 110 )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_delete_dups FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_delete_dups.
        DATA(lt_sflights) = lcl_test_data=>get_sflights_with_dups( ).
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_adj_dups( ).
        lo_cut->delete_adjacent_duplicates( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 4 ). " Original 6, 2 duplicates removed
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 4 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine leistungsstarke Anweisung, um direkt aufeinanderfolgende doppelte Zeilen zu entfernen. Eine vorherige Sortierung der Tabelle nach den Vergleichsfeldern ist entscheidend, um alle Duplikate zu erfassen.
keywords: DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Table, SORT, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob der Wert einer Variablen dem Initialwert ihres Typs entspricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_initial_value`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_is_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_value_initial
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_initial) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_value_initial.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_descr ).
    DATA(lv_initial_value) = lo_elem_descr->get_initial_value( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF <fs_data> = lv_initial_value.
      rv_is_initial = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_initial = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL durch und geben Sie den Statuscode sowie den Antworttext zurück. Behandeln Sie dabei grundlegende Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` zur Instanziierung und anschließend `send` und `receive`. Den Antworttext erhalten Sie mit `get_cdata`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             status_text TYPE string,
             response_body TYPE string,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des HTTP-Clients für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Senden des Requests für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Empfangen der Antwort für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        rs_response-status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).
        rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found INTO DATA(lx_dest_not_found).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Destination nicht gefunden: { lx_dest_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_response-error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine externe API und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort. Setzen Sie den Content-Type-Header korrekt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_method('POST')`, `set_header_field('Content-Type', 'application/json')` und `set_cdata` für den Request-Body. Für JSON-Serialisierung/-Deserialisierung nutzen Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_request_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_request_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             status  TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS post_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        is_data TYPE ty_request_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response_data) TYPE ty_response_data
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    DATA: lv_json_request TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_json_response TYPE string.

    " Serialize request data to JSON
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = is_data
      RECEIVING
        json        = lv_json_request
    ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        e_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. " Simplified error handling
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( 'POST' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
      name  = 'Content-Type'
      value = 'application/json'
    ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    " Deserialize response data from JSON
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json        = lv_json_response
      CHANGING
        data        = rs_response_data
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_post_json_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_post_json_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_post_json_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_post_json( ).
    DATA(ls_request_data) = VALUE zcl_http_post_json=>ty_request_data( key = 'item' value = 'test_value' ).
    DATA(ls_expected_response) = VALUE zcl_http_post_json=>ty_response_data( status = 'success' message = 'Data received' ).

    " Due to the difficulty of mocking cl_http_client directly in standard ABAP Unit,
    " this test focuses on the JSON serialization/deserialization and assumes a successful HTTP call.
    " In a real scenario, consider using a test double for cl_http_client.
    " For demonstration, we simulate the expected response.

    " Simulate a successful response from a dummy API
    DATA(lv_dummy_url) = 'https://httpbin.org/post'. " A public echo service
    DATA(ls_actual_response) = lo_cut->post_json( iv_url = lv_dummy_url is_data = ls_request_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_response-status
      exp = 'success'
      msg = 'Erwarteter Status "success" in der JSON-Antwort'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_response-message
      exp = 'Data received'
      msg = 'Erwartete Nachricht "Data received" in der JSON-Antwort'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_post_json_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_post_json( ).
    DATA(ls_request_data) = VALUE zcl_http_post_json=>ty_request_data( key = 'error_test' value = 'trigger_error' ).
    DATA(ls_expected_error_response) = VALUE zcl_http_post_json=>ty_response_data( status = 'error' message = 'Invalid input' ).

    " Simulate an error response from a dummy API
    DATA(lv_dummy_url) = 'https://httpbin.org/post'. " A public echo service
    " For a real error test, the mock would return an error status or body.
    " Here, we'd need to manually adjust the mock client's response for a true unit test.
    " As a workaround, we'll just check if the method handles a non-200 status (which it currently raises as cx_static_check).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->post_json( iv_url = lv_dummy_url is_data = ls_request_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_static_check sollte bei einem Fehler ausgelöst werden' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_static_check wurde wie erwartet ausgelöst' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen POST-Request mit JSON-Payload. Die Verwendung von `/UI2/CL_JSON` für die Serialisierung und Deserialisierung ist der moderne Standard in ABAP. Das Setzen des `Content-Type`-Headers ist entscheidend für die korrekte Interpretation des Request-Bodys durch die Ziel-API.
keywords: HTTP, POST, JSON, cl_http_client, /UI2/CL_JSON, Web Services

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit SSL-Client-Zertifikat-Authentifizierung durch. Die URL erfordert eine sichere Verbindung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und setzen Sie den SSL-Client-Zertifikat-Namen mit `property_client_ssl_cert`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_ssl_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             status_text TYPE string,
             response_body TYPE string,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_url_with_ssl
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_ssl_id TYPE ssf_csn
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.

CLASS zcl_http_get_ssl_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_with_ssl.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des HTTP-Clients für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Set SSL Client Certificate ID
        lo_http_client->property_client_ssl_cert = iv_ssl_id.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Senden des Requests für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Empfangen der Antwort für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        rs_response-status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).
        rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found INTO DATA(lx_dest_not_found).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Destination nicht gefunden: { lx_dest_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_response-error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_ssl_auth_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_ssl_auth_no_cert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ssl_auth_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_ssl_auth( ).
    " HINWEIS: Für einen echten Test müsste hier eine URL verwendet werden,
    " die SSL-Client-Zertifikate erfordert und ein gültiges Zertifikat im System vorhanden sein.
    " Da dies eine Testumgebung ist, verwenden wir eine Dummy-URL und ein Dummy-Zertifikat.
    " Ein echtes Szenario würde eine entsprechende Konfiguration in STRUST erfordern.
    DATA(lv_dummy_ssl_id) = 'ANONYMOUS'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige SSL-Client-ID, falls verfügbar
    DATA(lv_dummy_url) = 'https://www.example.com'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine URL, die SSL-Auth erfordert

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_url_with_ssl( iv_url = lv_dummy_url iv_ssl_id = lv_dummy_ssl_id ).

    " Die Assertions müssen an das erwartete Verhalten der Dummy-URL angepasst werden.
    " Wenn die Dummy-URL keine SSL-Auth erfordert, wird der Request erfolgreich sein.
    " Wenn sie es erfordert und das Zertifikat nicht passt, wird ein Fehler erwartet.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_response-status_code
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Erwarteter HTTP-Status 200 für erfolgreichen GET mit SSL-Auth (oder ohne Anforderung)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_response-error_message
      msg = 'Keine Fehlermeldung erwartet'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_ssl_auth_no_cert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_ssl_auth( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_ssl_id) = 'NON_EXISTENT_CERT'.
    DATA(lv_dummy_url) = 'https://www.example.com'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine URL, die SSL-Auth erfordert

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_url_with_ssl( iv_url = lv_dummy_url iv_ssl_id = lv_invalid_ssl_id ).

    " Hier würde man erwarten, dass der Request fehlschlägt, wenn die URL SSL-Auth erfordert
    " und das Zertifikat ungültig ist. Die genaue Fehlermeldung kann variieren.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_response-error_message
      msg = 'Fehlermeldung erwartet für ungültiges SSL-Zertifikat'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = ls_response-status_code
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Kein Status 200 erwartet bei fehlgeschlagener SSL-Authentifizierung'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein HTTP-Request mit SSL-Client-Zertifikat-Authentifizierung durchgeführt wird. Die Eigenschaft `property_client_ssl_cert` des `cl_http_client`-Objekts wird verwendet, um die ID des im Trust Manager (Transaktion STRUST) konfigurierten SSL-Client-Zertifikats zu übergeben. Dies ist entscheidend für die Kommunikation mit externen Systemen, die eine gegenseitige Authentifizierung erfordern.

        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.

        rs_error_info-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).

      CATCH cx_http_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_error_info-abap_error_message = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_error_info-abap_error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und fügen Sie einen benutzerdefinierten Header (z.B. 'X-API-Key') hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lo_http_client->request->set_header_field`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_custom_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             status_text TYPE string,
             response_body TYPE string,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_url_with_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_header_name TYPE string
        iv_header_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_custom_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_with_header.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des HTTP-Clients für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = iv_header_name
          value = iv_header_value
        ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Senden des Requests für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Empfangen der Antwort für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        rs_response-status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).
        rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found INTO DATA(lx_dest_not_found).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Destination nicht gefunden: { lx_dest_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_response-error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Profilparameter, die einem bestimmten Muster entsprechen (z.B. alle 'rdisp/*' Parameter), und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `get_parameters_by_pattern` von `cl_spfl_profile_parameter`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_param_pattern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_entry,
             name  TYPE spfl_param_name,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param_entry.
    TYPES: tt_param_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_parameters_by_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_param_entries) TYPE tt_param_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_pattern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_parameters_by_pattern.
    DATA: lo_profile_parameter TYPE REF TO cl_spfl_profile_parameter.
    DATA: lt_param_names TYPE spfl_param_name_tab.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_profile_parameter.

    TRY.
        lt_param_names = lo_profile_parameter->get_parameters_by_pattern(
          i_pattern = iv_pattern
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_param_names INTO DATA(lv_param_name).
          TRY.
              DATA(lv_param_value) = lo_profile_parameter->get_parameter( lv_param_name ).
              APPEND VALUE ty_param_entry( name = lv_param_name value = lv_param_value ) TO rt_param_entries.
            CATCH cx_spfl_parameter_not_found.
              " Should not happen if get_parameters_by_pattern works correctly, but handle defensively
              APPEND VALUE ty_param_entry( name = lv_param_name value = 'Nicht lesbar oder nicht mehr vorhanden' ) TO rt_param_entries.
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_spfl_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        APPEND VALUE ty_param_entry( name = 'ERROR' value = |Fehler beim Lesen von Parametern: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ) TO rt_param_entries.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine URL mit Query-Parametern, die Sonderzeichen enthalten, und stellen Sie sicher, dass diese korrekt URL-kodiert werden, bevor ein HTTP GET-Request gesendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>url_encode` für die Kodierung der Parameterwerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_url_encode DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_query_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_query_param.
    TYPES: tt_query_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_query_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             status_text TYPE string,
             response_body TYPE string,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_url_with_encoded_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_url TYPE string
        it_params   TYPE tt_query_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_url_encode IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_with_encoded_params.
    DATA: lv_encoded_url TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_query_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.

    LOOP AT it_params INTO DATA(ls_param).
      DATA(lv_encoded_value) = cl_http_utility=>url_encode( ls_param-value ).
      IF lv_query_string IS INITIAL.
        lv_query_string = |{ ls_param-name }={ lv_encoded_value }|.
      ELSE.
        lv_query_string = |{ lv_query_string }&{ ls_param-name }={ lv_encoded_value }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_query_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_encoded_url = |{ iv_base_url }?{ lv_query_string }|.
    ELSE.
      lv_encoded_url = iv_base_url.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = lv_encoded_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des HTTP-Clients für URL: { lv_encoded_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Senden des Requests für URL: { lv_encoded_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Empfangen der Antwort für URL: { lv_encoded_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        rs_response-status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).
        rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found INTO DATA(lx_dest_not_found).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Destination nicht gefunden: { lx_dest_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_response-error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request über einen explizit konfigurierten Proxy-Server durch.

CLASS zcl_http_proxy_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_http_proxy_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_via_proxy.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des HTTP-Clients für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Configure proxy settings
        lo_http_client->property_proxy_host = iv_proxy_host.
        lo_http_client->property_proxy_service = iv_proxy_port.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Senden des Requests über Proxy für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Empfangen der Antwort über Proxy für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        rs_response-status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).
        rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found INTO DATA(lx_dest_not_found).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Destination nicht gefunden: { lx_dest_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_response-error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert des Profilparameters 'login/system_client' und geben Sie ihn zurück.

CLASS zcl_profile_client_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_profile_client_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_system_client.
    DATA: lo_profile_parameter TYPE REF TO cl_spfl_profile_parameter.
    DATA: lv_client_string TYPE string.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_profile_parameter.

    TRY.
        lv_client_string = lo_profile_parameter->get_parameter(
          i_name = 'login/system_client'
        ).
        rv_client = CONV sy-mandt( lv_client_string ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_parameter_not_found.
        " Fallback oder Fehlerbehandlung, wenn der Parameter nicht gefunden wird
        rv_client = '000'. " Standardwert oder Fehler
      CATCH cx_spfl_error.
        " Fehler beim Lesen des Parameters
        rv_client = 'ERR'. " Fehlerindikator
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        " Fehler bei der Konvertierung
        rv_client = 'CON'. " Konvertierungsfehlerindikator
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit Basic Authentication (Benutzername und Passwort) durch.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             status_text TYPE string,
             response_body TYPE string,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_url_with_basic_auth
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_username TYPE string
        iv_password TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.

CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_with_basic_auth.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    DATA: lv_auth_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_encoded_auth TYPE string.

    lv_auth_string = |{ iv_username }:{ iv_password }|.
    lv_encoded_auth = cl_http_utility=>encode_base64( lv_auth_string ).

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des HTTP-Clients für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'Authorization'
          value = |Basic { lv_encoded_auth }|
        ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Senden des Requests für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Empfangen der Antwort für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        rs_response-status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).
        rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found INTO DATA(lx_dest_not_found).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Destination nicht gefunden: { lx_dest_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_response-error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Profilparameter, die einem bestimmten Muster entsprechen, und filtern Sie diese nach einem zusätzlichen Kriterium (z.B. nur Parameter, deren Wert eine bestimmte Länge überschreitet).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `get_parameters_by_pattern` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `FILTER` oder `COND` für die zusätzliche Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_param_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_entry,
             name  TYPE spfl_param_name,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param_entry.
    TYPES: tt_param_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string
        iv_min_value_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_params) TYPE tt_param_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_parameters.
    DATA: lo_profile_parameter TYPE REF TO cl_spfl_profile_parameter.
    DATA: lt_param_names TYPE spfl_param_name_tab.
    DATA: lt_all_params TYPE tt_param_entries.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_profile_parameter.

    TRY.
        lt_param_names = lo_profile_parameter->get_parameters_by_pattern(
          i_pattern = iv_pattern
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_param_names INTO DATA(lv_param_name).
          TRY.
              DATA(lv_param_value) = lo_profile_parameter->get_parameter( lv_param_name ).
              APPEND VALUE ty_param_entry( name = lv_param_name value = lv_param_value ) TO lt_all_params.
            CATCH cx_spfl_parameter_not_found.
              " Ignore parameters that cannot be read
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

        " Filter parameters based on value length using a FOR expression
        rt_filtered_params = VALUE #( FOR ls_param IN lt_all_params
                                      WHERE ( strlen( ls_param-value ) > iv_min_value_length )
                                      ( ls_param ) ).

      CATCH cx_spfl_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle general errors during parameter reading
        APPEND VALUE ty_param_entry( name = 'ERROR' value = |Fehler: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ) TO rt_filtered_params.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit einem benutzerdefinierten Timeout durch, um lange Wartezeiten zu vermeiden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lo_http_client->property_timeout`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_timeout_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             status_text TYPE string,
             response_body TYPE string,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_url_with_timeout
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_timeout_seconds TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_timeout_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_with_timeout.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des HTTP-Clients für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Set the timeout in seconds
        lo_http_client->property_timeout = iv_timeout_seconds.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Senden des Requests für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response-error_message = |Fehler beim Empfangen der Antwort für URL: { iv_url }|.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        rs_response-status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).
        rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found INTO DATA(lx_dest_not_found).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Destination nicht gefunden: { lx_dest_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_response-error_message = |HTTP-Fehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_response-error_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION MEDIUM.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timeout_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_timeout_exceeded FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timeout_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_timeout_config( ).
    " Eine URL, die schnell antwortet
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://www.example.com'.
    DATA(lv_timeout) = 5. " 5 Sekunden Timeout

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_url_with_timeout(
      iv_url             = lv_url
      iv_timeout_seconds = lv_timeout
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_response-status_code
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Erwarteter HTTP-Status 200 für erfolgreichen Request'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_response-error_message
      msg = 'Keine Fehlermeldung erwartet'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timeout_exceeded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_timeout_config( ).
    " Eine URL, die absichtlich langsam antwortet (z.B. httpbin.org/delay/X)
    " HINWEIS: Für diesen Test muss eine URL verwendet werden, die länger als das Timeout dauert.
    " httpbin.org/delay/X kann hierfür verwendet werden, wobei X > iv_timeout_seconds ist.
    DATA(lv_slow_url) = 'https://httpbin.org/delay/3'. " Verzögert um 3 Sekunden
    DATA(lv_timeout) = 1. " 1 Sekunde Timeout

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_url_with_timeout(
      iv_url             = lv_slow_url
      iv_timeout_seconds = lv_timeout
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_response-error_message
      msg = 'Fehlermeldung erwartet, da Timeout überschritten wurde'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = ls_response-status_code
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Kein Status 200 erwartet bei Timeout'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = ls_response-error_message
      needle   = 'Timeout'
      msg      = 'Fehlermeldung sollte auf Timeout hinweisen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Setzen eines Timeouts für HTTP-Requests ist entscheidend, um zu verhindern, dass Anwendungen bei langsamen oder nicht reagierenden externen Systemen blockieren. Die Eigenschaft `property_timeout` des `cl_http_client`-Objekts ermöglicht die Konfiguration der maximalen Wartezeit in Sekunden. Dies verbessert die Stabilität und Benutzerfreundlichkeit der Anwendung.
keywords: HTTP, Timeout, Performance, cl_http_client, Error Handling

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und konvertieren Sie das Feld `PRICE` (Typ `CURR`) in einen String, um es in einem String-Template zu verwenden. Geben Sie eine Tabelle mit formatierten Strings zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CONV`-Operator innerhalb einer `FOR`-Schleife und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_price_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_price_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.
    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_formatted_prices = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid     = flight-carrid,
                                     connid     = flight-connid,
                                     fldate     = flight-fldate,
                                     price_text = |{ CONV string( flight-price ) } { flight-currency }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_formatted_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_price_to_string( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_cut->get_formatted_prices( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_prices IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_prices ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_prices INTO DATA(ls_price).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_price-price_text ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = contains( val = ls_price-price_text sub = 'EUR' ) OR contains( val = ls_price-price_text sub = 'DM' )
        msg = 'Price text should contain currency' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `CONV`-Operator direkt in einem String-Template innerhalb einer `FOR`-Schleife, um den Währungswert (`CURR`) in einen String zu konvertieren. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art der Datenverarbeitung in modernem ABAP.
keywords: CONV, FOR, String Template, sflights, Type Conversion, CURR

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie das Ergebnis als formatierten String zurück. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `CONV`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `CONV` und String-Templates für die Aggregation und Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conv_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conv_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_text.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price
      FROM lt_sflights
      INTO DATA(sum) TYPE sflight-price
      NEXT sum = sum + sflight-price.

    rv_total_price_text = |Gesamtpreis für { iv_carrid }: { CONV string( lv_total_price ) } EUR|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = contains( val = lv_result sub = lv_carrid )
      msg = 'Result should contain carrier ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

    " Further checks could involve calculating the sum manually and comparing
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = REDUCE sflight-price
      FROM lt_sflights

      NEXT sum = sum + sflight-price.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und konvertieren Sie nur die Preise der Flüge, die über einem Schwellenwert liegen, in einen String. Geben Sie eine Tabelle mit den Flugdetails und dem bedingt formatierten Preis zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `COND` für die bedingte Konvertierung mit `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_conv_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_conditional_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_conv_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rt_details = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid     = flight-carrid,
                             connid     = flight-connid,
                             fldate     = flight-fldate,
                             price_info = COND string(
                                            WHEN flight-price > iv_price_threshold
                                            THEN |Preis: { CONV string( flight-price ) } { flight-currency }|
                                            ELSE 'Preis unter Schwellenwert' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_conv_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 500.
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_conditional_prices( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_price_threshold = lv_threshold ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results ).

    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      IF ls_result-price_info CP '*Preis:*'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = contains( val = ls_result-price_info sub = 'EUR' ) OR contains( val = ls_result-price_info sub = 'DM' )
          msg = 'Formatted price should contain currency' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_result-price_info
          exp = 'Preis unter Schwellenwert'
          msg = 'Price below threshold should have specific text' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FOR` und den `COND`-Operator, um eine bedingte Logik direkt in der Wertzuweisung zu implementieren. Der `CONV`-Operator wird innerhalb des `COND`-Ausdrucks verwendet, um den Preis nur dann in einen String zu konvertieren, wenn er einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode für bedingte Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: CONV, FILTER, FOR, COND, sflights, Conditional Conversion, String Template

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen ABAP `STRING` in einen `XSTRING` mit der Codepage '1100' (ISO-8859-1) und anschließend diesen `XSTRING` wieder zurück in einen ABAP `STRING`. Überprüfen Sie die Datenintegrität.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_roundtrip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_roundtrip
      IMPORTING
        iv_abap_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_roundtrip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_roundtrip.
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                              source          = iv_abap_string
                              target_codepage = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
                              endian          = 'L' ).

    rv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                            source          = lv_iso_xstring
                            source_codepage = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
                            target_codepage = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_roundtrip_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_roundtrip_unrepresentable FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_roundtrip_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Test mit Umlauten: äöüß'.
    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->perform_roundtrip( lv_original_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'Roundtrip conversion for representable characters failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_roundtrip_unrepresentable.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'String mit Eurozeichen: €'. " Euro sign is not in ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->perform_roundtrip( lv_original_string ).

    " Expect replacement character or loss for unrepresentable characters
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'Roundtrip conversion for unrepresentable characters should not be equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = contains( val = lv_converted_string sub = '#' ) OR contains( val = lv_converted_string sub = '?' )
      msg = 'Unrepresentable character should be replaced' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen vollständigen Roundtrip einer Zeichenkette von einem ABAP `STRING` zu einem `XSTRING` in einer spezifischen Codepage (ISO-8859-1) und zurück. Es ist entscheidend, die Datenintegrität zu überprüfen, insbesondere wenn Zeichen verwendet werden, die in der Ziel-Codepage nicht darstellbar sind, da diese durch Ersatzzeichen ersetzt werden können.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, Codepage Conversion, XSTRING, STRING, Data Integrity, ISO-8859-1

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Tabelle von ABAP-Strings in eine Tabelle von `XSTRING`s, wobei jeder `XSTRING` in UTF-16 Big Endian kodiert ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` mit der entsprechenden Endian-Einstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_table_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_xstring TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_strings_to_utf16be_xstrings
      IMPORTING
        it_abap_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_utf16be_xstrings) TYPE tt_xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_table_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings_to_utf16be_xstrings.
    rt_utf16be_xstrings = VALUE #( FOR lv_string IN it_abap_strings
                                   ( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                       source          = lv_string
                                       target_codepage = '4103' " UTF-16 Big Endian
                                       endian          = 'B' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_table_conv( ).
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( 'World' ) ( 'ÄÖÜ' ) ).
    DATA(lt_converted_xstrings) = lo_cut->convert_strings_to_utf16be_xstrings( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_converted_xstrings )
      exp = lines( lt_input_strings )
      msg = 'Number of XSTRINGs should match number of input strings' ).

    LOOP AT lt_input_strings INTO DATA(lv_original_string).
      READ TABLE lt_converted_xstrings INTO DATA(lv_utf16be_xstring) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_utf16be_xstring ).

      " Convert back to verify
      DATA(lv_back_to_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                   source          = lv_utf16be_xstring
                                   source_codepage = '4103' " UTF-16 Big Endian
                                   target_codepage = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage( ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_back_to_string
        exp = lv_original_string
        msg = 'Roundtrip for individual string failed' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine `FOR`-Iteration, um eine Tabelle von ABAP-Strings effizient in eine Tabelle von `XSTRING`s zu konvertieren, die in einer spezifischen Codepage (UTF-16 Big Endian) kodiert sind. Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen einer externen Datei, die in einer nicht-Unicode-Codepage (z.B. '1100' für ISO-8859-1) vorliegt, und konvertieren Sie den Inhalt zeilenweise in eine Tabelle von ABAP-Strings. Verwenden Sie dabei `cl_abap_codepage` und moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Erzeugen Sie einen `XSTRING` als simulierte Datei, konvertieren Sie ihn in einen ABAP `STRING` und splitten Sie diesen dann zeilenweise.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_file_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_and_convert_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_codepage      TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_file_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_convert_file.
    DATA(lv_abap_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                              source          = iv_file_content_xstring
                              source_codepage = iv_source_codepage
                              target_codepage = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage( ) ).

    SPLIT lv_abap_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE rt_lines.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_file_read_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_read_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_file_read( ).
    DATA(lv_original_content) = 'Zeile 1 mit Umlauten: äöüß' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Zeile 2 mit Sonderzeichen: €'.
    DATA(lv_source_codepage) = '1100'. " ISO-8859-1

    " Simulate file content in ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_simulated_file_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                         source          = lv_original_content
                                         target_codepage = lv_source_codepage
                                         endian          = 'L' ).

    DATA(lt_converted_lines) = lo_cut->read_and_convert_file(
                                  iv_file_content_xstring = lv_simulated_file_xstring
                                  iv_source_codepage      = lv_source_codepage ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_converted_lines )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should have 2 lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_converted_lines[ 1 ]
      exp = 'Zeile 1 mit Umlauten: äöüß'
      msg = 'First line content mismatch' ).
    " Note: Euro sign might be replaced if not representable in source codepage
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lt_converted_lines[ 2 ] = 'Zeile 2 mit Sonderzeichen: ?' OR lt_converted_lines[ 2 ] = 'Zeile 2 mit Sonderzeichen: #' )
      msg = 'Second line content mismatch (Euro sign replacement expected)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert das Lesen einer externen Datei mit einer spezifischen Codepage. Zuerst wird der gesamte `XSTRING`-Inhalt mit `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` in einen ABAP `STRING` konvertiert. Anschließend wird dieser String mit `SPLIT` und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` zeilenweise aufgeteilt. Dies ist die moderne und robuste Methode zur Verarbeitung von externen Textdateien.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, External Data, File Processing, XSTRING, STRING, SPLIT, ISO-8859-1

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine Tabelle von Strings, wobei jede Zeile ein durch Kommas getrennter String der Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` ist. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `CONV`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und String-Templates mit `CONV` für die Feldkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_sflights_to_csv_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_csv_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_csv_lines.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.
    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_csv_lines = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             ( |{ flight-carrid },{ CONV string( flight-connid ) },{ CONV string( flight-fldate ) }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_csv_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_table_to_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lt_csv) = lo_cut->convert_sflights_to_csv_lines( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_csv ).
    LOOP AT lt_csv INTO DATA(lv_line).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

        msg = 'CSV line should contain carrier ID' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = count( val = lv_line sub = ',' ) = 2
        msg = 'CSV line should have two commas' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die effiziente Umwandlung einer internen Tabelle in ein CSV-ähnliches Format unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Iteration und String-Templates. Der `CONV`-Operator wird hier verwendet, um numerische Felder (`CONNID`, `FLDATE`) direkt in Strings zu konvertieren, was eine saubere und moderne Art der Datenaufbereitung für den Export darstellt.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein bestimmtes Datum mit der neuen Open SQL Syntax und Inline-Deklaration. Bereiten Sie die Daten für die Anzeige in einem ALV mit IDA vor.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `WHERE` Klauseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_ida_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_ida
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_ida.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

    " In a real scenario, rt_flights would be passed to an ALV with IDA instance
    " e.g., by setting the data source for if_salv_gui_table_ida.
    " DATA(lo_alv_ida) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_cds_view( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    " lo_alv_ida->set_data_source( rt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_for_ida.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
    " Die gefilterten Daten könnten dann an ein ALV mit IDA übergeben werden.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS, um die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln, unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in Open SQL. Die aggregierten Daten sollen für ein ALV mit IDA bereitgestellt werden.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.

    " Die aggregierten Daten könnten dann an ein ALV mit IDA übergeben werden.
  ENDMETHOD.
