Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS für die Darstellung in einem Diagramm vor. Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und der Anzahl ihrer Flüge unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( label = ls_flight-carrid
        value = GROUP SIZE )
    ).

    rt_chart_data = lt_grouped_flights.

    " Diese Daten könnten dann an cl_gui_chart_engine_win übergeben werden.
    " DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( ).
    " lo_chart_engine->set_data_table( rt_chart_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die einen zusätzlichen Status 'High Price' oder 'Normal Price' basierend auf einer Preisbedingung enthält, unter Verwendung des `COND`-Ausdrucks. Diese Daten sollen für ein Diagramm vorbereitet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck, um bedingt Werte zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_cond_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status_for_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_cond_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_for_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE tt_flight_status(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        price  = ls_flight-price,
        status = COND string(
          WHEN ls_flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN 'High Price'
          ELSE 'Normal Price' )
      )
    ).
    " Diese Daten könnten dann an cl_gui_chart_engine_win übergeben werden, z.B. für eine farbliche Unterscheidung.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_cond_data( ).
    DATA(lt_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status_for_chart( iv_price_threshold = '500.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_status ).

    " Find a flight with price > 500 and check its status
    DATA(ls_high_price_flight) = lt_status[ FILTER #( lt_status WHERE price > '500.00' ) INDEX 1 ] .
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_high_price_flight-status exp = 'High Price' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Find a flight with price <= 500 and check its status
    DATA(ls_normal_price_flight) = lt_status[ FILTER #( lt_status WHERE price <= '500.00' ) INDEX 1 ] .
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_normal_price_flight-status exp = 'Normal Price' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. In diesem Fall wird er verwendet, um dynamisch einen Status für Flugpreise zu bestimmen, der dann in einem Diagramm visualisiert werden könnte.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, Chart Engine, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators. Das Ergebnis soll als Kennzahl für ein ALV mit IDA dienen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu einem einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_ida_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).

    " Dieses Ergebnis könnte als aggregierte Kennzahl in einem ALV mit IDA angezeigt werden.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_ida_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total_price ).
    " Überprüfen Sie den Wert manuell oder mit Testdaten
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_salv_ida_reduce=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ) )
                                        FOR ls_flight IN lt_test_flights
                                        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ) exp = lv_expected_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Schleife durchlaufen und ein Akkumulator aktualisiert wird. Dies ist eine funktionale und moderne Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ALV, IDA, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie effizient, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer internen Tabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie dessen Index, falls vorhanden, unter Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`. Dies ist nützlich für die Interaktion mit einem ALV mit IDA.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Tabellenausdrücke `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_ida_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_and_get_index
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists  TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index   TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    ev_exists = xsdbool( LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) ).

    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = LINE_INDEX( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
    " Diese Operationen sind nützlich, wenn man z.B. auf eine Zeile in einem ALV mit IDA reagieren muss.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nur Flüge mit einem bestimmten Währungscode enthält, und fügen Sie eine fortlaufende Nummer hinzu, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `GROUP BY` mit `GROUP INDEX`. Diese Daten sollen für ein Diagramm vorbereitet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `GROUP INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_group_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_indexed,
             index    TYPE i,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_indexed.
    TYPES tt_flight_indexed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_indexed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_indexed_flights_for_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_indexed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_indexed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_group_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_indexed_flights_for_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE currency = @iv_currency
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_indexed_flights = VALUE tt_flight_indexed(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( currency = ls_flight-currency ) ASCENDING
      FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
      ( index    = sy-tabix,
        carrid   = ls_member-carrid,
        connid   = ls_member-connid,
        price    = ls_member-price,
        currency = ls_member-currency )
    ).
    " Diese indizierten Daten könnten dann an cl_gui_chart_engine_win übergeben werden, z.B. für eine Reihenfolge.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_indexed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_indexed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_group_index( ).
    DATA(lt_indexed_flights) = lo_cut->get_indexed_flights_for_chart( iv_currency = 'EUR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_indexed_flights ).
    " Überprüfen Sie, ob die Indizes korrekt sind und die Währung stimmt.
    DATA(lv_first_index) = lt_indexed_flights[ 1 ]-index.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_first_index exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_indexed_flights[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und einem weiteren `FOR` über `GROUP` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Verarbeitung von gruppierten Daten. `sy-tabix` innerhalb der inneren Schleife kann verwendet werden, um einen Index für die Elemente innerhalb jeder Gruppe zu erhalten. Dies ist eine sehr flexible Methode zur Datenaufbereitung für komplexe Diagramme.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, GROUP INDEX, Internal Tables, Chart Engine, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit ausgewählten Spalten aus SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn ein ALV mit IDA dynamisch Spalten anzeigen soll.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)` mit dynamischer Spaltenliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_ida_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             " Platzhalter für dynamische Felder
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flight_data.
    DATA: lv_field_list TYPE string.
    DATA: lt_sflights_dynamic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      IF lv_field_list IS INITIAL.
        lv_field_list = lv_field_name.
      ELSE.
        lv_field_list = lv_field_list && ',' && lv_field_name.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_list IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          SELECT (lv_field_list)
            FROM sflight
            UP TO 10 ROWS
            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights_dynamic.

          CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_data LIKE lt_sflights_dynamic.
          ASSIGN lt_sflights_dynamic TO CAST cl_abap_datadescr( rt_dynamic_data->* )->get_table_type( )->get_table_line_type( )->get_data_ref( ).
          " In einem echten Szenario würde man hier die Daten an das ALV mit IDA übergeben.
          " DATA(lo_alv_ida) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_cds_view( 'SFLIGHT' ).
          " lo_alv_ida->set_data_source( rt_dynamic_data ).

        CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          " Fehlerbehandlung für dynamisches SQL
          MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_dynamic_flight_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_dynamic_flight_data_invalid_field EXPECTING CX_SY_DYNAMIC_SQL_ERROR FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_dynamic_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_ida_dynamic_cols( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_flight_data( lt_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_dynamic_data ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_data> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_data> ) exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_dynamic_flight_data_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_ida_dynamic_cols( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'INVALID_FIELD' ) ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_flight_data( lt_fields ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dynamisches SQL mit der Möglichkeit, Spaltenlisten zur Laufzeit zu definieren (`SELECT (lv_field_list)`), ist eine mächtige Funktion für Szenarien, in denen die anzuzeigenden Daten flexibel sein müssen, wie z.B. in einem ALV mit IDA. Die Verwendung von `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` in Kombination mit Inline-Deklaration und Datenreferenzen ist der moderne Ansatz.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Open SQL, ALV, IDA, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation von Flugdaten durch, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert zu erhalten und gleichzeitig eine neue Spalte für den 'Status' hinzuzufügen, unter Verwendung einer Kombination aus `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `VALUE`. Die Daten sollen für ein ALV mit IDA vorbereitet werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für eine mehrstufige Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_ida_complex_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_enriched,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_enriched.
    TYPES tt_flight_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enriched_flights_for_ida
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_flight_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_complex_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_flights_for_ida.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE tt_flight_enriched(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > iv_price_threshold )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        price  = ls_flight-price,
        status = 'Above Threshold' )
    ).
    " Diese angereicherten Daten könnten dann an ein ALV mit IDA übergeben werden.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den maximalen Flugpreis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung des `MAX`-Operators in einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck. Das Ergebnis soll für die Skalierung eines Diagramms verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `MAX`-Logik im `NEXT`-Teil.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = ( VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ) )
                              FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                              NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = ls_flight-price ) ).
    " Dieser maximale Preis könnte dann verwendet werden, um die Y-Achse eines Diagramms zu skalieren.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_max_price ).
    " Test mit bekannten Werten (Beispiel)
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '250.00' )

    DATA(lv_expected_max) = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = ( VALUE sflight-price( '0.00' ) )

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist nicht nur für Summen, sondern auch für andere Aggregationen wie das Finden des Maximums geeignet. Durch die Verwendung der eingebauten Funktion `nmax` im `NEXT`-Teil wird der maximale Wert effizient ermittelt. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Kennzahlen für die Diagrammskalierung zu berechnen.

hint: Verwende `REDUCE` zur Aggregation und Transformation der Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep_pie DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             segment TYPE string,
             value   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_booking_class_dist RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep_pie IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_booking_class_dist.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR ls_flight IN sflights ( ls_flight ) ). " Read all flights

    rt_chart_data = REDUCE tt_chart_data(
      INIT lv_result = VALUE tt_chart_data( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_class = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-class = 'C' THEN 'Business'
                                  WHEN ls_flight-class = 'F' THEN 'First'
                                  WHEN ls_flight-class = 'Y' THEN 'Economy'
                                  ELSE 'Other' ) IN
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lv_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entry>) WHERE segment = lv_class.
        <fs_entry>-value = <fs_entry>-value + 1.
        lv_found = abap_true.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_found = abap_false.
        APPEND VALUE ty_chart_data( segment = lv_class value = 1 ) TO lv_result.
      ENDIF.
      NEXT lv_result = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_revenue,
             month_year TYPE string,
             revenue    TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_monthly_revenue.
    TYPES tt_monthly_revenue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_revenue WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_monthly_revenue RETURNING VALUE(rt_monthly_revenue) TYPE tt_monthly_revenue.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_revenue.
    SELECT fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE tt_monthly_revenue(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      LET lv_month_year = |{ ls_flight-fldate(6) }| IN " YYYYMM
      ( month_year = lv_month_year,
        revenue    = ls_flight-price ) ).

    rt_monthly_revenue = REDUCE tt_monthly_revenue(
      INIT lv_result = VALUE tt_monthly_revenue( )
      FOR ls_entry IN lt_aggregated_data
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lv_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entry>) WHERE month_year = ls_entry-month_year.
        <fs_entry>-revenue = <fs_entry>-revenue + ls_entry-revenue.
        lv_found = abap_true.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_found = abap_false.
        APPEND VALUE ty_monthly_revenue( month_year = ls_entry-month_year revenue = ls_entry-revenue ) TO lv_result.
      ENDIF.
      NEXT lv_result = lv_result ).

    SORT rt_monthly_revenue BY month_year ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Parse einen XML-String, der Flugdaten enthält, und extrahiere die Flugnummern und Abflugorte in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen und den `FOR`-Operator, um die Daten in eine interne Tabelle zu transformieren.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        flight_number TYPE sflight-carrid,
        departure_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>ucode( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = lo_root_node->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR <ls_node> IN lt_flight_nodes
        LET lv_flight_number = <ls_node>->get_attribute( 'Number' )
            lv_departure_city = <ls_node>->get_attribute( 'Departure' ) IN
        ( flight_number = lv_flight_number
          departure_city = lv_departure_city )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeuge einen XML-String aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten. Der XML-String soll die Struktur `<Flight Number="XXX" Departure="YYY"/>` haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Erstellen des XML-Baums und String Templates für die Attributwerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_gen_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        flight_number TYPE sflight-carrid,
        departure_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_gen_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root_node ).

    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'Number' value = |{ ls_flight-flight_number }| ).
      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'Departure' value = |{ ls_flight-departure_city }| ).
      lo_root_node->append_child( lo_flight_node ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lo_xml_document->display_xstring( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus einem XML-Dokument alle Flugknoten heraus, deren Abflugort 'FRA' ist, und geben Sie deren Flugnummern zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_departure
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_departure_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_departure.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>ucode( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flight_nodes) = lo_root_node->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE #( 
      FOR <ls_node> IN FILTER #( lt_all_flight_nodes WHERE get_attribute( 'Departure' ) = iv_departure_city )
        ( <ls_node>->get_attribute( 'Number' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge in einem XML-Dokument, die einen bestimmten Abflugort haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen und den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Anzahl zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_by_departure
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_departure_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_departure.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>ucode( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flight_nodes) = lo_root_node->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

    rv_flight_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR <ls_node> IN lt_all_flight_nodes
      WHERE ( <ls_node>->get_attribute( 'Departure' ) = iv_departure_city )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen potenziell fehlerhaften XML-String zu parsen. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um Ausnahmen von `cl_xml_document` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_xml_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      EXPORTING
        ev_error_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_xml_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    rv_success = abap_true.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>ucode( iv_xml_string ) ).
        " Further processing if successful, e.g., get root node
        DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
        IF lo_root_node IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'XML document is empty or has no root element.'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rv_success = abap_false.
        ev_error_message = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch any other potential exceptions
        rv_success = abap_false.
        ev_error_message = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` so auf, dass sie in einem 2D-Viewer als Punkte dargestellt werden können. Die Daten sollen Flugnummer, Abflug- und Zielort enthalten. Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` für die Transformation.
hint: Definieren Sie eine geeignete Struktur für den Viewer und nutzen Sie `VALUE` in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` zur effizienten Datenübernahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_viewer_point,
        id      TYPE string,
        x_coord TYPE i,
        y_coord TYPE i,
        label   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_viewer_point,
      tt_viewer_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_viewer_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_data_for_viewer
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_viewer_data) TYPE tt_viewer_points.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_data_for_viewer.
    " Simulate coordinate mapping for cities
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_city_coord,
             city TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             x    TYPE i,
             y    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_city_coord.
    DATA(lt_city_coords) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_city_coord WITH EMPTY KEY OF ty_city_coord(
      ( city = 'FRANKFURT' x = 10 y = 20 )
      ( city = 'NEW YORK'  x = 80 y = 30 )
      ( city = 'LONDON'    x = 30 y = 15 )
      ( city = 'TOKYO'     x = 100 y = 50 )
      ( city = 'SAN FRANCISCO' x = 90 y = 40 )
    ).

    rt_viewer_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
        LET lv_x = lt_city_coords[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS city = ls_sflight-cityfrom ]-x DEFAULT 0
            lv_y = lt_city_coords[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS city = ls_sflight-cityfrom ]-y DEFAULT 0 IN
        ( id      = ls_sflight-carrid && ls_sflight-connid
          x_coord = lv_x
          y_coord = lv_y
          label   = |{ ls_sflight-cityfrom }-{ ls_sflight-cityto }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten, die für einen 2D-Viewer bestimmt sind, um die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Abflugort zu ermitteln. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`, um eine Map (Hash-Tabelle) mit den Zählergebnissen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_data_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_viewer_point,
        id      TYPE string,
        x_coord TYPE i,
        y_coord TYPE i,
        label   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_viewer_point,
      tt_viewer_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_viewer_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: ty_departure_counts TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS aggregate_flights_by_departure
      IMPORTING
        it_viewer_data TYPE tt_viewer_points
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_departure_counts) TYPE ty_departure_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_data_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flights_by_departure.
    rt_departure_counts = REDUCE ty_departure_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_departure_counts( )
      FOR ls_point IN it_viewer_data
        LET lv_departure_city = SUBSTRING( val = ls_point-label len = FIND( val = ls_point-label sub = '-' ) ) IN
      NEXT counts = VALUE ty_departure_counts( 
        BASE counts
        ( lv_departure_city = counts[ lv_departure_city ] + 1 DEFAULT 1 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung von Benutzerinteraktionen in einem 2D-Viewer. Wenn ein Punkt ausgewählt wird, dessen X-Koordinate größer als 50 ist, soll eine spezielle Aktion ausgelöst werden. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_event_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_viewer_point,
        id      TYPE string,
        x_coord TYPE i,
        y_coord TYPE i,
        label   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_viewer_point.

    METHODS process_viewer_selection
      IMPORTING
        is_selected_point TYPE ty_viewer_point
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_viewer_selection.
    rv_action_message = COND string(
      WHEN is_selected_point-x_coord > 50 THEN |Spezialaktion für Punkt { is_selected_point-id } ausgelöst (X > 50)!|
      WHEN is_selected_point-x_coord <= 50 THEN |Standardaktion für Punkt { is_selected_point-id } ausgelöst (X <= 50).|
      ELSE |Keine Aktion für Punkt { is_selected_point-id }.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_viewer_point,
        id      TYPE string,
        x_coord TYPE i,
        y_coord TYPE i,
        label   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_viewer_point,
      tt_viewer_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_viewer_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_dynamic_viewer_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_id_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_points) TYPE tt_viewer_points.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_viewer_data.
    rt_points = VALUE #( 
      FOR i = 1 FROM 1 TO iv_count
        ( id      = |{ iv_id_prefix }{ i ALPHA = OUT }|
          x_coord = i * 10
          y_coord = i * 5
          label   = |Punkt { i ALPHA = OUT }|
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen und den `FOR`-Operator mit `DISTINCT` um eindeutige Werte zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_distinct_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_departure_cities
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cities) TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-cityfrom WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_distinct_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_departure_cities.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>ucode( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = lo_root_node->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Flight' ).

    rt_cities = VALUE #( 
      FOR DISTINCT <ls_node> IN lt_flight_nodes
      GROUP BY <ls_node>->get_attribute( 'Departure' ) INTO GROUP lv_departure_city
        ( lv_departure_city )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_distinct_cities FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distinct_cities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_distinct_cities( ).
    DATA(lv_xml_input) =
      `<Flights>` &&
        `<Flight Number="LH456" Departure="FRA"/>` &&
        `<Flight Number="UA789" Departure="ORD"/>` &&
        `<Flight Number="AF123" Departure="FRA"/>` &&
        `<Flight Number="DL999" Departure="JFK"/>` &&
      `</Flights>`.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_distinct_departure_cities( lv_xml_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Expected 3 distinct cities'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]
      exp = 'FRA'
      msg = 'First city mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]
      exp = 'JFK'
      msg = 'Second city mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 3 ]
      exp = 'ORD'
      msg = 'Third city mismatch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen mit dem `FOR`-Operator und der `GROUP BY`-Klausel, um eindeutige Abflugorte aus dem XML zu extrahieren. Die Verwendung von `FOR DISTINCT` und `GROUP BY` ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Methode, um eindeutige Werte aus einer Liste von Objekten zu aggregieren und direkt in eine sortierte interne Tabelle zu überführen.
keywords: XML, Distinct, Grouping, FOR, VALUE, cl_xml_document, Internal Tables

hint: Nutze `XCO_CP_ABAP_DICTIONARY=>TABLE->FOR(...)->FIELDS->ALL->GET()` und den `FOR` Operator.

CLASS zcl_xco_table_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_table_field_info,
             field_name TYPE fieldname,
             data_type  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_table_field_info.
    TYPES tt_table_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_table_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_field_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE xco_ar_object_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE tt_table_field_info.

CLASS zcl_xco_table_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_field_info.
    DATA(lo_table) = xco_cp_abap_dictionary=>table->for( iv_table_name ).
    IF lo_table->exists( ) EQ abap_true.
      rt_field_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_field IN lo_table->fields->all->get( )
                                 ( field_name = ls_field->name->value( ),
                                   data_type  = ls_field->data_type->value( ),
                                   length     = ls_field->length->value( ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_program_description IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Ermittle alle Parameter einer Methode einer ABAP-Klasse.
hint: Nutze `XCO_CP_ABAP_REPOSITORY=>CLASS->FOR(...)->METHODS->FOR(...)->PARAMETERS->ALL->GET()`.

CLASS zcl_xco_method_parameters DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                   ( name      = ls_param->name->value( ),
                                     direction = ls_param->direction->value( ),

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHTS-Daten, sortiert nach CARRID und CONNID, und füllen Sie diese mit den ersten 10 Einträgen aus der Datenbank.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES ... SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS get_sorted_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_sflights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 10 entries' act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 10 ).

    " Verify sorting
    DATA lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA lv_prev_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        IF ls_sflight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid OR ( ls_sflight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_sflight-connid < lv_prev_connid ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Table is not sorted correctly' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_sflight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine `SORTED TABLE` wird direkt beim Füllen sortiert gehalten. Dies ist effizient für Lesezugriffe über den Schlüssel. Die `SELECT` Anweisung füllt die Tabelle direkt, wobei die Sortierung durch die Tabellendefinition sichergestellt wird.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Internal Tables, SELECT, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHTS-Daten basierend auf CARRID und CONNID.
hint: `READ TABLE` auf einer `SORTED TABLE` nutzt implizit den binären Suchalgorithmus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
    METHODS read_sflight IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                   iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                         RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_sflight.
    READ TABLE mt_sflights INTO rs_sflight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_sflight. " Ensure empty structure if not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_existing_sflight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_sflight FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_test_data TYPE zcl_sorted_table_read=>ty_sflight_sorted_tab.

  METHOD setup.
    DATA ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_existing_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( mt_test_data ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->read_sflight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should match' act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CONNID should match' act = ls_result-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( mt_test_data ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->read_sflight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for non-existing entry' act = ls_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `READ TABLE` Statement auf einer `SORTED TABLE` ist hochperformant, da ABAP intern einen binären Suchalgorithmus verwendet. Dies ist wesentlich schneller als eine sequentielle Suche bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, BINARY SEARCH, sy-subrc

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den PRICE eines spezifischen SFLIGHTS-Eintrags in einer SORTED TABLE.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für effiziente Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
    METHODS update_price IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                   iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                   iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
                         RETURNING VALUE(rb_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE mt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rb_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights.
    rt_sflights = mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_existing_sflight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_sflight FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_test_data TYPE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-price = '100.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-price = '200.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existing_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( mt_test_data ).
    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_price = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Entry should be updated' act = lv_updated ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_sflights( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_updated_sflight) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should be updated' act = ls_updated_sflight-price exp = '250.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( mt_test_data ).
    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->update_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_new_price = '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Entry should not be updated' act = lv_updated ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation des Tabelleninhalts ohne explizites `MODIFY` Statement. Dies ist effizient, da keine Daten kopiert werden müssen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FIELD-SYMBOLS, READ TABLE, MODIFY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue SORTED TABLE mit einer Untermenge von SFLIGHTS-Daten, die nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft enthält, und transformieren Sie dabei die Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` für eine deklarative Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_reduced_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
    METHODS get_reduced_sflights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_reduced_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_reduced_sorted_tab.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_reduced_sflights.
    rt_reduced_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN mt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                     price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_reduced_sflights FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_test_data TYPE zcl_sorted_table_for_value=>ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-price = '100.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-price = '200.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0018'. ls_sflight-price = '150.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. ls_sflight-price = '300.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_reduced_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for_value( mt_test_data ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_reduced_sflights( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 2 entries for AA' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_first) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry CARRID should be AA' act = ls_first-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry CONNID should be 0017' act = ls_first-connid exp = '0017' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_second) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry CARRID should be AA' act = ls_second-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry CONNID should be 0018' act = ls_second-connid exp = '0018' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE #(` und `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Die resultierende Tabelle ist ebenfalls eine `SORTED TABLE`, deren Sortierung automatisch beibehalten wird.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Führen Sie zwei SORTED TABLES von SFLIGHTS-Daten zusammen, wobei Duplikate basierend auf dem Schlüssel vermieden werden.
hint: `INSERT LINES OF` in eine `SORTED TABLE` behandelt Duplikate automatisch (bei `UNIQUE KEY`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights1 TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab
                                       it_sflights2 TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
    METHODS get_combined_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = it_sflights1.
    " INSERT LINES OF will automatically handle unique key constraint
    " and only insert non-duplicate entries, maintaining sort order.
    INSERT LINES OF it_sflights2 INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_combined_sflights.
    rt_sflights = mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_tables_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_combine_tables_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_tables_no_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_sflights1 TYPE zcl_sorted_table_combine=>ty_sflight_sorted_tab,
          lt_sflights2 TYPE zcl_sorted_table_combine=>ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
    DATA ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF lt_sflights1.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights1.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights1.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights2.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'DL'. ls_sflight-connid = '0002'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_combine( it_sflights1 = lt_sflights1 it_sflights2 = lt_sflights2 ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->get_combined_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Combined table should have 4 entries' act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 4 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001'. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'DL' connid = '0002'. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_combine_tables_with_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_sflights1 TYPE zcl_sorted_table_combine=>ty_sflight_sorted_tab,
          lt_sflights2 TYPE zcl_sorted_table_combine=>ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
    DATA ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF lt_sflights1.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights1.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights1.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights2. " Duplicate
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_combine( it_sflights1 = lt_sflights1 it_sflights2 = lt_sflights2 ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->get_combined_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Combined table should have 3 entries (duplicate removed)' act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001'. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wenn Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle in eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` eingefügt werden, werden Duplikate automatisch ignoriert. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um zwei sortierte Tabellen zu mergen und dabei die Eindeutigkeit des Schlüssels und die Sortierreihenfolge zu gewährleisten.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT LINES OF, UNIQUE KEY, Merging Tables

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP` Blocks in einem `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP` Statement, um Ressourcen freizugeben, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Der `CLEANUP` Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY` Block verlassen wird, auch bei Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
                            RAISING   cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA lv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Simulate opening a resource
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        rv_result = 'Resource opened.'.

        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ENDIF.

        rv_result = rv_result && ' Operation successful.'.

      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = rv_result && ' Caught zero divide exception.'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.

      CLEANUP.
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          " Simulate closing the resource
          rv_result = rv_result && ' Resource closed in CLEANUP.'.
          lv_resource_open = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operation_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_operation( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( msg = 'Success path: Resource should be opened and closed' pattern = 'Resource opened. Operation successful. Resource closed in CLEANUP.' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_cleanup( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_operation( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( msg = 'Exception path: Resource should be opened and closed' pattern = 'Resource opened. Caught zero divide exception. Resource closed in CLEANUP.' act = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP` Block ist entscheidend für die Sicherstellung der Ressourcenfreigabe (z.B. Dateihandles, Datenbankverbindungen) in ABAP. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY` Block verlassen wird, unabhängig davon, ob dies durch eine normale Beendigung oder durch eine Ausnahme geschieht.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Exception Handling, Resource Management

CLASS zcl_exception_db_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_exception_db_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_sflight.
    TRY.
        INSERT sflight FROM is_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rb_success = abap_true.

          ROLLBACK WORK.
          rb_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).

        " Log the error or handle it appropriately
        rb_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Kette von Operationen ausführt, wobei jede Operation eine Ausnahme auslösen kann, und fangen Sie die Ausnahmen hierarchisch ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um verschiedene Ausnahmetypen auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcx_operation_failed DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_operation_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_exceptions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS operation_a IMPORTING iv_input TYPE i RAISING zcx_operation_failed.
    METHODS operation_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE i RAISING zcx_operation_failed.
    METHODS execute_chain IMPORTING iv_input_a TYPE i
                                  iv_input_b TYPE i
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_exceptions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD operation_a.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_operation_failed EXPORTING textid = zcx_operation_failed=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD operation_b.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_operation_failed EXPORTING textid = zcx_operation_failed=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_chain.
    TRY.
        operation_a( iv_input_a ).
        rv_status = 'Operation A successful. '.

        TRY.
            operation_b( iv_input_b ).
            rv_status = rv_status && 'Operation B successful.'.
          CATCH zcx_operation_failed INTO DATA(lx_op_b).
            rv_status = rv_status && 'Caught exception in Operation B: ' && lx_op_b->get_text( ).
        ENDTRY.

      CATCH zcx_operation_failed INTO DATA(lx_op_a).
        rv_status = 'Caught exception in Operation A: ' && lx_op_a->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chain_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chain_fail_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chain_fail_b FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chain_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_exceptions( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->execute_chain( iv_input_a = 1 iv_input_b = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Both operations should succeed' act = lv_status exp = 'Operation A successful. Operation B successful.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chain_fail_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_exceptions( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->execute_chain( iv_input_a = -1 iv_input_b = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( msg = 'Operation A should fail' pattern = 'Caught exception in Operation A:' act = lv_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chain_fail_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_exceptions( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->execute_chain( iv_input_a = 1 iv_input_b = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( msg = 'Operation B should fail' pattern = 'Operation A successful. Caught exception in Operation B:' act = lv_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke ermöglichen eine granulare Fehlerbehandlung. Eine innere Ausnahme kann lokal behandelt werden, ohne die äußere Operation vollständig abzubrechen, oder sie kann weitergegeben werden, um von einem höheren Block behandelt zu werden. Dies ist nützlich für komplexe Prozessketten.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Nested Exceptions, Error Handling, Process Chain

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHTS-Daten nach Flügen mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen SORTED TABLE.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.

    DATA mt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( mt_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-price = '100.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-price = '250.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO mt_test_data.

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_first) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First expensive flight CARRID should be LH' act = ls_first-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_second) INDEX 2.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer SORTED TABLE für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` für eine effiziente Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = it_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN mt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine externe Funktion aufruft, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zu generieren.

CLASS zcl_exception_external_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_external_function IMPORTING iv_input TYPE i
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_external_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_external_function.
    DATA lv_output TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Simulate a call to an external function module that might raise an exception
        " For demonstration, we'll use a dummy logic here.
        IF iv_input = 0.
          " Simulate an error condition that would lead to an exception in a real FM
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        ELSE.
          lv_output = |External function executed successfully with input { iv_input }|.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = lv_output.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error calling external function: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_as_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie die Details der Ausnahme, einschließlich der Aufrufhierarchie (Call Stack).
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_TEXT()` und `GET_LONGTEXT()` der Ausnahmeobjekte sowie `CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT=>GET_CALLSTACK()` (oder ähnliche Methoden für den Produktivcode).
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_logging DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_and_log_error IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS internal_method IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_logging IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD internal_method.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_and_log_error.
    DATA lv_error_details TYPE string.
    TRY.
        internal_method( iv_value ).
        rv_log_message = 'Operation successful.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        lv_error_details = |Exception: { lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) }\n| &&
                           |Long Text: { lx_zerodivide->get_longtext( ) }\n| &&
                           |Call Stack: { lx_zerodivide->get_stack( ) }|.
        rv_log_message = |Error occurred: { lv_error_details }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lv_error_details = |Unexpected Exception: { lx_root->get_text( ) }\n| &&
                           |Call Stack: { lx_root->get_stack( ) }|.
        rv_log_message = |Unexpected Error: { lv_error_details }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_log_error_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_logging( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->trigger_and_log_error( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Success message expected' act = lv_log exp = 'Operation successful.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_log_error_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_logging( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->trigger_and_log_error( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( msg = 'Log should contain exception text' pattern = 'Exception: Division by zero' act = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( msg = 'Log should contain call stack' pattern = 'Call Stack:' act = lv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Abfangen von Ausnahmen ist es gute Praxis, detaillierte Informationen zu protokollieren. Methoden wie `GET_TEXT()`, `GET_LONGTEXT()` und `GET_STACK()` von Ausnahmeobjekten liefern wertvolle Debugging-Informationen, einschließlich der genauen Fehlermeldung und der Aufrufhierarchie, die für die Fehleranalyse unerlässlich sind.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception Logging, GET_TEXT, GET_LONGTEXT, GET_STACK, Call Stack

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_filter_with_in=>tt_customers(
      ( customer_id = 'CUST001' name = 'Alice' )
      ( customer_id = 'CUST003' name = 'Charlie' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_customers_by_id( it_all_customers = lt_all_customers it_allowed_ids = lt_allowed_ids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `IN`-Operator innerhalb von `FILTER` ermöglicht das Filtern einer Tabelle basierend auf Werten, die in einer anderen internen Tabelle (hier `it_allowed_ids`) enthalten sind. keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, IN Operator, Range Table, ABAP 7.40, ASSERT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Produkten, wobei die Filterbedingung durch einen Methodenaufruf bestimmt wird, der die Gültigkeit eines Produkts prüft.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen statischen Methodenaufruf direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel des `FILTER`-Operators.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             product_id TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             status     TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             expiry_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS is_product_valid
      IMPORTING
        is_product TYPE ty_product
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS filter_valid_products
      IMPORTING
        it_all_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_product_valid.
    IF is_product-status = 'A' AND is_product-expiry_date > sy-datum.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_valid_products.
    rt_valid_products = FILTER #( it_all_products USING KEY primary_key WHERE zcl_product_validator=>is_product_valid( CORRESPONDING #( sy-tabix ) ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_with_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_with_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_product_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_all_products) = VALUE zcl_product_validator=>tt_products(
      ( product_id = 'P001' status = 'A' expiry_date = sy-datum + 10 )
      ( product_id = 'P002' status = 'I' expiry_date = sy-datum + 5 )
      ( product_id = 'P003' status = 'A' expiry_date = sy-datum - 1 )
      ( product_id = 'P004' status = 'A' expiry_date = sy-datum + 20 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_product_validator=>tt_products(
      ( product_id = 'P001' status = 'A' expiry_date = sy-datum + 10 )
      ( product_id = 'P004' status = 'A' expiry_date = sy-datum + 20 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_valid_products( lt_all_products ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 können Methodenaufrufe direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel von `FILTER` verwendet werden, was eine sehr flexible und modulare Filterlogik ermöglicht. `CORRESPONDING #( sy-tabix )` wird verwendet, um die aktuelle Zeile der internen Tabelle an die Methode zu übergeben.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Method Call, ABAP 7.50, Functional Programming, ASSERT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Zahlen, um nur gerade Zahlen zu erhalten, und summieren Sie diese anschließend.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_sum_even
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_even) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_sum_even.
    DATA(lt_even_numbers) = FILTER #( it_numbers USING KEY primary_key WHERE table_line MOD 2 = 0 ).

    rv_sum_even = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR number IN lt_even_numbers NEXT sum = sum + number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_sum_even FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_sum_even.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_and_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_filter_and_reduce=>tt_numbers(
      1
      2
      3
      4
      5
      6
    ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 12. " 2 + 4 + 6

    DATA(lv_result_sum) = lo_cut->filter_and_sum_even( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_sum exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der Kombination von Tabellen-Operatoren. Zuerst wird `FILTER` verwendet, um die geraden Zahlen zu selektieren, und anschließend `REDUCE`, um die Summe dieser gefilterten Zahlen zu berechnen. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionales Programmieren in modernem ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50, ASSERT

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') haben und deren Flugnummer (CONNID) in einer Liste von erlaubten Nummern enthalten ist.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        it_allowed_connids TYPE tt_connids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier_and_connid.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab( SELECT * FROM sflights AS flight ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights_connid FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights_connid( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lt_allowed_connids) = VALUE zcl_filter_sflights_connid=>tt_connids(
      '0400'
      '0017'
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier_and_connid( iv_carrid = lv_carrid it_allowed_connids = lt_allowed_connids ).

    " Assuming sflights contains LH 0400 and LH 0017
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0. " Default to 0, as sflights content can vary or be empty for specific criteria
    " To make this test robust, one would need to ensure test data exists or mock the sflights table.
    " For demonstration, we'll check if any results are returned for known entries.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ) ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " Example with mock data for a more controlled test
    DATA(lt_mock_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'MUNICH' cityto = 'PARIS' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0000' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'BERLIN' cityto = 'ROME' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_mock) = FILTER #( lt_mock_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND
                                            connid IN lt_allowed_connids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_mock ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( line_exists( lt_filtered_mock[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( line_exists( lt_filtered_mock[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' ] ) ) ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination von direkten Feldvergleichen und dem `IN`-Operator innerhalb eines `FILTER`-Ausdrucks. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Werten und zählen Sie die Anzahl der gefilterten Elemente.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_filtered_values) = FILTER #( it_input USING KEY primary_key WHERE table_line > iv_threshold ).

  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Count, lines(), ABAP 7.40, ASSERT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Objektreferenzen, um nur die Objekte zu erhalten, die eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementieren.

CLASS zcl_interface_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      PUBLIC SECTION.

    CLASS zcl_implementation2 DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_interface_filter FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.

    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_non_implementer DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_interface_filter FINAL.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_interface_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_interface
      IMPORTING

ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_processable.
  METHODS process.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_interface_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_interface.
    rt_processable_objects = FILTER #( it_objects USING KEY primary_key WHERE table_line IS INSTANCE OF zif_processable ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_interface_filter=>zcl_implementation1 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process.
    " Implementation specific logic
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_interface_filter=>zcl_implementation2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process.
    " Implementation specific logic
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_interface_filter=>zcl_non_implementer IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
