    METHODS test_filter_by_interface FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_interface.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_interface_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_objects) = VALUE zcl_interface_filter=>tt_objects(
      NEW zcl_interface_filter=>zcl_implementation1( )
      NEW zcl_interface_filter=>zcl_non_implementer( )

    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_interface( lt_objects ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lt_result[ 1 ] IS INSTANCE OF zif_processable ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lt_result[ 2 ] IS INSTANCE OF zif_processable ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `IS INSTANCE OF`-Prüfung innerhalb des `FILTER`-Operators ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für die objektorientierte Programmierung. Sie ermöglicht das Filtern von Objektreferenzen basierend auf der Implementierung einer bestimmten Schnittstelle, was die Typsicherheit und Flexibilität erhöht.
keywords: FILTER, Object Orientation, Interfaces, IS INSTANCE OF, ABAP 7.50, ASSERT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Objekten, um nur die Objekte zu erhalten, deren Attributwert einem bestimmten Wert entspricht, wobei das Attribut dynamisch übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit dynamischem Zugriff auf Attribute (Field-Symbols oder Data References) in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_dynamic_attribute
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE tt_data
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
        iv_attribute_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_dynamic_attribute.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_input USING KEY primary_key
                                  WHERE ( ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_attribute_name OF STRUCTURE table_line TO <fs_field> AND
                                          <fs_field> = iv_attribute_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.

Die Bedingung wird in Klammern gesetzt, um die logische Verknüpfung zu gewährleisten.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Anhang, der aus einer internen Tabelle generiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD_ATTACHMENT` und konvertieren Sie die interne Tabelle in einen Binärinhalt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS send_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
        it_attachment_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_filename        TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_text( ( iv_body ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Convert internal table to CSV string
    DATA(lv_csv_content) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR <wa> IN it_attachment_data NEXT s = s && <wa>-field1 && ',' && <wa>-field2 && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( )->create_xstring( lv_csv_content ).

    DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW' " Or 'BIN' for binary, 'TXT' for text
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_text( ( lv_csv_content ) ) " For RAW/TXT
      i_length  = xstrlen( lv_xstring_content ) " For BIN
      i_contents_bin = lv_xstring_content " For BIN
      i_subject = iv_filename
    ).
    lo_send_request->add_attachment(
      i_document = lo_attachment
      i_filename = iv_filename
      i_attachment_type = 'CSV' " Or 'TXT', 'PDF', etc.
    ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_attachment FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_attachment.
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_bcs_send_attachment=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_bcs_send_attachment=>ty_data( field1 = 'Value1' field2 = 'ValueA' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_bcs_send_attachment=>ty_data( field1 = 'Value2' field2 = 'ValueB' ) TO lt_data.

    zcl_bcs_send_attachment=>send_email_with_attachment(
      iv_recipient_email = 'attach_test@example.com'
      iv_subject         = 'Email with Attachment'
      iv_body            = 'Please find the attached data.'
      it_attachment_data = lt_data
      iv_filename        = 'data.csv'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception should occur during attachment email send attempt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert das Hinzufügen eines Anhangs. Die interne Tabelle wird mit `REDUCE` in einen CSV-String umgewandelt und dann in `XSTRING` konvertiert, um als Anhang hinzugefügt zu werden. `CL_ABAP_CONV_CE` wird für die Codierung verwendet.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail und fangen Sie mögliche Ausnahmen ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke für `cx_bcs` Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS send_email_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_error_handling.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = VALUE bcs_text( ( iv_body ) )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
        lo_send_request->send( ).
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Log error or handle it appropriately
        " In a real application, you would use a proper logging framework.
        WRITE: / 'Error sending email:', lx_bcs->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      iv_recipient_email = 'error_test_success@example.com'
      iv_subject         = 'Error Handling Test Success'
      iv_body            = 'This email should succeed.'

    DATA(lv_success_false) = zcl_bcs_error_handling=>send_email_with_error_handling(
      iv_recipient_email = 'invalid-email' " This might not immediately cause CX_BCS during send()
      iv_subject         = 'Error Handling Test Failure'
      iv_body            = 'This email should fail (simulated).' 
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success_false exp = abap_false msg = 'Failed send should return false' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit CC- und BCC-Empfängern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD_RECIPIENT` mit dem Parameter `i_copy`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_cc_bcc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_recipients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ad_smtpadr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS send_email_with_cc_bcc
      IMPORTING
        iv_to_email        TYPE ad_smtpadr
        it_cc_emails       TYPE tt_recipients OPTIONAL
        it_bcc_emails      TYPE tt_recipients OPTIONAL
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_cc_bcc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_cc_bcc.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_text( ( iv_body ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add TO recipient
    DATA(lo_to_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_to_email ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_to_recipient ).

    " Add CC recipients
    LOOP AT it_cc_emails INTO DATA(lv_cc_email).
      DATA(lo_cc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_cc_email ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_cc_recipient i_copy = abap_true ). " i_copy = ABAP_TRUE for CC
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add BCC recipients
    LOOP AT it_bcc_emails INTO DATA(lv_bcc_email).
      DATA(lo_bcc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_bcc_email ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_bcc_recipient i_blind_copy = abap_true ). " i_blind_copy = ABAP_TRUE for BCC
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einer komplexeren Struktur, die verschiedene Empfängertypen und dynamische Inhalte kombiniert.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die bisher gelernten Techniken für Empfänger, Betreff und Inhalt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_complex_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_recipient_data,
             email TYPE ad_smtpadr,
             type  TYPE char1, " T=TO, C=CC, B=BCC
           END OF ty_recipient_data.
    TYPES: tt_recipient_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_recipient_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS send_complex_email
      IMPORTING
        it_recipients      TYPE tt_recipient_data
        iv_template_name   TYPE string
        iv_dynamic_value   TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_complex_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_complex_email.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " Dynamic Subject and Body using String Templates
    DATA(lv_subject) = |Benachrichtigung: { iv_template_name } - { iv_dynamic_value }|.
    DATA(lv_body) = |Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }
                     Dies ist eine automatische Benachrichtigung bezüglich '{ iv_template_name }'.{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }
                     Der Wert '{ iv_dynamic_value }' wurde verarbeitet.{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }
                     Mit freundlichen Grüßen,{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }
                     Ihr System|.

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_text( ( lv_body ) )
      i_subject = lv_subject
    ).
    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add recipients based on type
    LOOP AT it_recipients INTO DATA(ls_recipient).
      DATA(lo_address) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( ls_recipient-email ).
      CASE ls_recipient-type.
        WHEN 'T'. " TO
          lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_address ).
        WHEN 'C'. " CC
          lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_address i_copy = abap_true ).
        WHEN 'B'. " BCC
          lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_address i_blind_copy = abap_true ).
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_complex FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_complex.
    DATA(lt_recipients) = VALUE zcl_bcs_complex_email=>tt_recipient_data(
      ( email = 'to_main@example.com' type = 'T' )
      ( email = 'cc_info@example.com' type = 'C' )
      ( email = 'bcc_audit@example.com' type = 'B' )
    ).

    zcl_bcs_complex_email=>send_complex_email(
      it_recipients    = lt_recipients
      iv_template_name = 'Bestellbestätigung'
      iv_dynamic_value = '123456789'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception should occur during complex email send attempt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert verschiedene moderne ABAP-Techniken: `CLASS-METHODS`, `DATA()`, `VALUE`, String-Templates für dynamische Inhalte und eine `CASE`-Anweisung innerhalb einer `LOOP` zur flexiblen Zuweisung von Empfängertypen (TO, CC, BCC). Es zeigt eine robuste und flexible Methode zum E-Mail-Versand.
keywords: CL_BCS, Email, Complex, Dynamic Content, Multiple Recipients, CC, BCC, CASE, String Templates

CLASS zcl_bom_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS test_xstring_to_string FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_to_string.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_xstring_to_string( ).
    DATA(lv_input_string) = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lv_codepage) = '4103'. " UTF-16BE (interne ABAP Unicode-Darstellung)

    " String zu XSTRING für Testzwecke konvertieren (simuliert Eingabe)
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      EXPORTING
        encoding = lv_codepage
        output   = ''
    ).
    lo_conv_out->convert( EXPORTING data = lv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_output_string) = lo_converter->convert_xstring_to_string(
          iv_xstring_data = lv_xstring_input
          iv_codepage     = lv_codepage
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lv_output_string
          exp = lv_input_string
          msg = 'XSTRING zu STRING Konvertierung sollte erfolgreich sein'
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_conv_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist unerlässlich beim Import von Daten aus externen Quellen, die in verschiedenen Codierungen vorliegen können, und stellt sicher, dass die Daten im ABAP-System korrekt interpretiert werden.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen HTTP-Content-Type-Header-String (z.B. 'Application/Json ; charset=utf-8; boundary="abc"') und extrahieren Sie den Haupttyp, Untertyp und alle Parameter in eine interne Tabelle. Nutzen Sie moderne String-Operationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT`, `CONDENSE`, `TO_LOWER` und den `VALUE FOR` Ausdruck für die Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_header_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_header_info,
             main_type TYPE string,
             sub_type  TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE string_table,
           END OF ty_s_header_info.
    METHODS parse_content_type IMPORTING iv_header_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rs_header_info) TYPE ty_s_header_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_header_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_content_type.
    DATA(lv_value) = iv_header_value.
    DATA(lv_main_part) = ``.
    DATA(lv_param_part) = ``.

    SPLIT lv_value AT ';' INTO lv_main_part lv_param_part.

    SPLIT lv_main_part AT '/' INTO rs_header_info-main_type rs_header_info-sub_type.
    rs_header_info-main_type = to_lower( condense( rs_header_info-main_type ) ).
    rs_header_info-sub_type  = to_lower( condense( rs_header_info-sub_type ) ).

    IF lv_param_part IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_header_info-parameters = VALUE #( FOR <param_str> IN SPLIT lv_param_part AT ';' 
                                           WHERE ( <param_str> IS NOT INITIAL ) 
                                           ( condense( <param_str> ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sys_multi_param_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_param_value,
             name  TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_sys_multi_param_reader IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_itb_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_itb_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT total = 0
                                     FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                                     NEXT total = total + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten eines gemeinsamen Interfaces entgegennimmt und für jedes Objekt eine spezifische Aktion ausführt, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `CAST`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck, um über die Liste zu iterieren, und `CAST` um auf spezifische Implementierungen zu prüfen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_actionable DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS execute_action.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_action_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
    METHODS get_log RETURNING VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_log TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_actionable~execute_action.
    mv_log = 'Action A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_log.
    rv_log = mv_log.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
    METHODS get_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_actionable~execute_action.
    mv_status = 'Action B completed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_status.
    rv_status = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_actions IMPORTING it_actionables TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_actionable WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_actions.
    FOR <lo_action> IN it_actionables.
      <lo_action>->execute_action( ).
      IF <lo_action> IS INSTANCE OF zcl_action_a.
        DATA(lo_action_a) = CAST zcl_action_a( <lo_action> ).
        " Optionally do something specific with lo_action_a
      ELSE IF <lo_action> IS INSTANCE OF zcl_action_b.
        DATA(lo_action_b) = CAST zcl_action_b( <lo_action> ).
        " Optionally do something specific with lo_action_b
      ENDIF.
    ENDFOR.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_actions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_actions.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_action_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_action_a) = NEW zcl_action_a( ).
    DATA(lo_action_b) = NEW zcl_action_b( ).

    DATA(lt_actions) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_actionable WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( lo_action_a )
      ( lo_action_b )
    ).

    lo_processor->process_actions( lt_actions ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_action_a->get_log( ) exp = 'Action A executed' msg = 'Action A not executed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_action_b->get_status( ) exp = 'Action B completed' msg = 'Action B not executed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Polymorphie und die Verwendung von Interfaces in modernem ABAP. Der `FOR` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine elegante Iteration über eine Liste von Interface-Referenzen. `IS INSTANCE OF` und `CAST` werden verwendet, um zur Laufzeit den konkreten Typ eines Objekts zu bestimmen und auf typspezifische Methoden zuzugreifen, was eine flexible und erweiterbare Architektur ermöglicht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Polymorphism, FOR, CAST, IS INSTANCE OF

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der Preise. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_total,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_carrier_total.
    TYPES ty_t_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_sum_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE ty_t_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE ty_t_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sum_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price( INIT total = 0
                                             FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                             NEXT total = total + <fs_group_member>-price ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_s_carrier_total( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                       total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_carrier_totals.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_total,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_carrier_total.
    TYPES ty_t_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_group_and_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_t_flights( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) 
                                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' ) 
                                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' ) 
                                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' ) 
                                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '100.00' ) ).
    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->group_and_sum_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_totals ) exp = 3 msg = 'Group count failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First group carrier failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[1]-total_price exp = '250.00' msg = 'First group total failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[2]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second group carrier failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[2]-total_price exp = '350.50' msg = 'Second group total failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[3]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Third group carrier failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[3]-total_price exp = '50.00' msg = 'Third group total failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_t_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->group_and_sum_flights( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_totals msg = 'Grouping empty table failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature ab ABAP 7.55, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE` Operator für die Summenbildung innerhalb jeder Gruppe entsteht ein äußerst kompakter, lesbarer und performanter Code für komplexe Aggregationsaufgaben, der früher viele manuelle Schritte erforderte.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Table, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen ABAP-String, der möglicherweise spezielle Zeichen enthält, in eine bestimmte externe Codepage (z.B. UTF-8 mit Byte Order Mark - BOM) und geben Sie das Ergebnis als XSTRING zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und seine Methoden zur Codepage-Konvertierung, insbesondere `create` und `write`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cnv_codepage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_xstring TYPE xstring.
    METHODS convert_string_to_utf8_bom
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE ty_xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_init_error
        cx_abap_conv_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cnv_codepage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_utf8_bom.
    DATA:
      lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce,
      lv_buffer   TYPE xstring.

    " Create converter for UTF-8 with BOM
    lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
                      encoding = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>con_cp_utf8_bom
                      endian   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>con_endian_little ). " Endian for BOM

    " Write the string to the converter
    lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = iv_input_string ).

    " Get the converted xstring
    lo_conv_out->read( IMPORTING data = lv_buffer ).

    rv_xstring = lv_buffer.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_utf8_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf8_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_cnv_codepage( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Hallo Welt mit Umläuten: äöüß'.
    " Manuell ermittelter UTF-8-BOM Hex-Wert für 'Hallo Welt mit Umläuten: äöüß'
    DATA(lx_expected_utf8) = 'EFBBBF48616C6C6F2057656C74206D697420556D6C61CC887574656E3A20C3A4C3B6C3BCC39F'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lx_converted) = lo_converter->convert_string_to_utf8_bom( lv_test_string ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_converted ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_converted,
          exp = lx_expected_utf8
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = substring( val = lx_converted off = 0 len = 6 ), " Check for BOM prefix (EFBBBF is for UTF-8 BOM)
          exp = 'EFBBBF'
        ).
    CATCH cx_abap_conv_error INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_ex->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die explizite Konvertierung eines Strings in eine externe Codepage (hier UTF-8 mit BOM), was für die Interaktion mit externen Systemen oder Dateiformaten unerlässlich ist. Die Klasse `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` bietet hierfür eine robuste und standardisierte Lösung. Inline-Deklarationen vereinfachen den Code.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_out_ce, Codepage Conversion, UTF-8, XSTRING, BOM, Data Conversion

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine öffentliche Methode zur Berechnung der Quadratwurzel eines Produkts zweier Zahlen anbietet. Intern soll eine private Hilfsmethode verwendet werden, um die Quadratwurzel einer einzelnen Zahl zu bestimmen. Demonstrieren Sie die Verkapselung.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Hilfsmethode im `PRIVATE SECTION` der Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_product_sqrt
      IMPORTING
        iv_number1 TYPE i
        iv_number2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _calculate_sqrt
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sqrt) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product_sqrt.
    DATA(lv_product) = iv_number1 * iv_number2.
    IF lv_product < 0.
      " Handle negative product, e.g., return 0 or raise exception
      rv_result = 0.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = _calculate_sqrt( lv_product ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _calculate_sqrt.
    " In a real scenario, use SQRT function for floats. Here, assuming integer input for simplicity.
    IF iv_number >= 0.
      rv_sqrt = sqrt( iv_number ).
    ELSE.
      rv_sqrt = 0. " Cannot calculate sqrt of negative number
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_product_sqrt FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_product FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_product_sqrt.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_math->calculate_product_sqrt( iv_number1 = 4 iv_number2 = 9 ).
    " Product is 36, sqrt is 6
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = CAST f( 6 ) ).

    lv_result = lo_math->calculate_product_sqrt( iv_number1 = 2 iv_number2 = 8 ).
    " Product is 16, sqrt is 4
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = CAST f( 4 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_product.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_math->calculate_product_sqrt( iv_number1 = -1 iv_number2 = 9 ).
    " Product is -9, should be handled as 0 or exception
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = CAST f( 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `PRIVATE SECTION` demonstriert das Prinzip der Datenkapselung in der Objektorientierung. Die Hilfsmethode `_calculate_sqrt` ist nur innerhalb der Klasse sichtbar und zugänglich, was die interne Implementierung vor externen Zugriffen schützt und den Code wartbarer macht. Eine Prüfung auf negative Zahlen wurde ergänzt.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, METHODS, CLASS

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHT mit CARID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE). Filtern Sie alle Flüge von 'LH' (Lufthansa) und geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Flugnummern und Preisen zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Der `FOR` Operator ermöglicht es, Iterationen und Transformationen direkt in einer Zuweisung durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,

           BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight,
           ty_filtered_flight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_lh_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_flight_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE ty_filtered_flight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_lh_flights.
    rt_lh_flights = VALUE ty_filtered_flight_tab(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( connid = ls_flight-connid, price = ls_flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Preise von Flügen aus einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT, die einen Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert haben. Nutzen Sie dafür den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator kann zum Aggregieren von Werten verwendet werden. Initialisieren Sie einen Akkumulator und addieren Sie bedingt die Preise.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_of_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_flight_data_tab
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_expensive_flights.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = CAST sflight-price( '0.00' )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
      WHERE ( price > iv_threshold )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_expensive_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_it_reduce_operator=>ty_flight_data_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '500.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250115' price = '750.50' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20250201' price = '600.00' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250301' price = '450.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_reducer->calculate_sum_of_expensive_flights(
                       it_all_flights = lt_flights
                       iv_threshold = '550.00' ).
    " Expected: 750.50 (AA) + 600.00 (LH) = 1350.50
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '1350.50' ).

    lv_total = lo_reducer->calculate_sum_of_expensive_flights(
                       it_all_flights = lt_flights
                       iv_threshold = '700.00' ).
    " Expected: 750.50 (AA)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '750.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_expensive_flights_empty.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_it_reduce_operator=>ty_flight_data_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '500.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_reducer->calculate_sum_of_expensive_flights(
                       it_all_flights = lt_flights
                       iv_threshold = '1000.00' ).
    " Expected: 0.00
     cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Dies ist wesentlich effizienter und lesbarer als manuelle Schleifen mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregate, Sum, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einer gegebenen Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHT mit CARID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE) alle Flugnummern (`CONNID`) von Flügen, die am 01.01.2025 stattfinden. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um die Daten zu selektieren.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf den Elementen einer anderen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Kombinieren Sie ihn mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck für die Extraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           ty_connid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_for_date
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_flight_data_tab
        iv_date        TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE ty_connid_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_for_date.
    rt_connids = VALUE ty_connid_tab(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER ty_flight_data_tab(
                             it_all_flights
                             WHERE fldate = iv_date )
      ( ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ordnen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seinem Preis ('P' für Premium, 'E' für Economy Class) einen Tickettyp zu. Nutzen Sie dafür einen `COND`-Ausdruck, wobei 'Premium' über 800 EUR liegt, sonst 'Economy'.
hint: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht bedingte Zuweisungen direkt im Ausdruck, ähnlich einem ternären Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_ticket_type TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    METHODS get_ticket_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_ticket_type) TYPE ty_ticket_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ticket_type.
    rv_ticket_type = COND ty_ticket_type(
      IS INITIAL OF iv_price THEN '?' " Fallback for initial price
      WHEN iv_price > '800.00' THEN 'P'
      ELSE 'E'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum (als Zahl 1-7). Nutzen Sie dafür einen `SWITCH`-Ausdruck. Geben Sie den Namen des Wochentags in Deutsch zurück (z.B. 'Montag', 'Dienstag').
hint: Der `SWITCH` Operator wählt einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen `WHEN`-Bedingungen aus, ähnlich einer `CASE`-Anweisung, aber als Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_weekday_name TYPE string.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_day_of_week TYPE i " 1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE ty_weekday_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH ty_weekday_name(
      iv_day_of_week
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Wochentag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_switch) = NEW zcl_switch_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_switch->get_weekday_name( 1 ) exp = 'Montag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_switch->get_weekday_name( 5 ) exp = 'Freitag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_switch->get_weekday_name( 7 ) exp = 'Sonntag' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_switch->get_weekday_name( 8 ) exp = 'Ungültiger Wochentag' ).

explanation: Der `SWITCH` Ausdruck vereinfacht bedingte Zuweisungen basierend auf einem diskreten Wert. Er ist eine moderne und prägnante Alternative zur klassischen `CASE`-Anweisung, wenn der zurückgegebene Wert direkt zugewiesen werden soll.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expression, Weekday

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die zwei öffentliche Methoden hat: eine zum Setzen eines numerischen Wertes und eine zum Abrufen des Doppelten dieses Wertes. Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chain) und nutzen Sie Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Um Methodenaufrufe zu verketten, muss eine Methode `ME->` zurückgeben, wenn sie keine andere Rückgabe hat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chaining_and_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chaining_and_inline. " Return SELF for chaining

    METHODS get_doubled_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_doubled_value) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chaining_and_inline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_doubled_value.
    rv_doubled_value = mv_value * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle anhand eines Tabellennamens und eines Feldes ('CARRID' oder 'CONNID' aus SFLIGHT) prüft, ob ein gegebener Wert in diesem Feld existiert. Die Methode soll einen generischen Tabellentyp akzeptieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und den `LINE_EXISTS` oder `READ TABLE` mit dynamischer WHERE-Klausel. Beachten Sie, dass für dynamische WHERE-Klauseln auf generischen Tabellen oft `cl_abap_table_utils` oder `LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` in Kombination mit Field-Symbols die flexibelste Option sind.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_value_in_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_field    TYPE string
        iv_value    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_value_in_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_data> TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <ls_data>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_field_value> = iv_value.
        rb_exists = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rb_exists = abap_false.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250115' price = '750.50' )
    ).

    DATA(rb_exists) = lo_checker->check_value_in_dynamic_table(
                        it_data  = lt_flights

    rb_exists = lo_checker->check_value_in_dynamic_table(
                        it_data  = lt_flights

  METHOD test_check_value_not_exists.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_flight_data_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '500.00' )
    ).

                        it_data  = lt_flights
                        iv_field = 'CARRID'
                        iv_value = 'SQ' ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHT mit CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE) nach der Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und summieren Sie deren Preise. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR GROUPS` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation pro Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_groupby DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,

           BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           ty_flight_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_flight_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_groupby IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = VALUE ty_flight_summary_tab(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_all_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE,
        total_price  = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum_price = CAST sflight-price( '0.00' )
          FOR flight_in_group IN GROUP
          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight_in_group-price
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_flight_data_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '500.00' )

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20250201' price = '600.00' )

explanation: Der `GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist eine der mächtigsten modernen Sprachfunktionen in ABAP, die es ermöglicht, Daten in internen Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und pro Gruppe Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies rationalisiert die Datenverarbeitung erheblich und macht den Code extrem kompakt und expressiv.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert. Implementieren Sie eine moderne, klassenbasierte Fehlerbehandlung, indem Sie eine vordefinierte mathematische Exception fangen und eine benutzerdefinierte Fehlermeldung zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_errors...ENDTRY` und die Exception-Attribute zur Fehlermeldungsgenerierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_exception_hdl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_errors
        zcx_division_error.

     " Custom exception class definition (would be a separate global class in real system)
     CLASS zcx_division_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check PUBLIC.
       PUBLIC SECTION.
         INTERFACES if_t100_message.
         METHODS constructor
           IMPORTING
             textid         LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
             previous       LIKE previous OPTIONAL
             iv_dividend    TYPE i OPTIONAL
             iv_divisor     TYPE i OPTIONAL.
         DATA mv_dividend TYPE i.
         DATA mv_divisor TYPE i.
     ENDCLASS.

     CLASS zcx_division_error IMPLEMENTATION.
       METHOD constructor.
         CALL METHOD super->constructor
           EXPORTING
             previous = previous.

         me->mv_dividend = iv_dividend.
         me->mv_divisor = iv_divisor.

         IF textid IS INITIAL.
           if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_division_error.
           " Standard text if no specific ID is given
           MESSAGE E001(ZMSG_APP) WITH mv_dividend mv_divisor INTO DATA(lv_msg).
           REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '&' IN lv_msg WITH '' IN CHARACTER MODE.
           if_t100_message~t100key-msgv1 = lv_msg.
         ELSE.
           if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
         ENDIF.
       ENDMETHOD.
     ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_exception_hdl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        IF iv_divisor = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_division_error(
            textid = zcx_division_error=>default_message
            iv_dividend = iv_dividend
            iv_divisor = iv_divisor
          ).
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
    CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_errors INTO DATA(lx_arith_err).
        " Re-raise with more context or handle specifically
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_division_error(
          textid = zcx_division_error=>default_message
          previous = lx_arith_err
          iv_dividend = iv_dividend
          iv_divisor = iv_divisor
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

MESSAGE E001(ZMSG_APP) WITH '&1 / &2 ist nicht möglich.' INTO DATA(dummy).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_modern_exception_hdl( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_divider->divide_numbers( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = CAST decfloat34( 5 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_modern_exception_hdl( ).
    TRY.
        lo_divider->divide_numbers( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception zcx_division_error wurde nicht ausgelöst.' ).
    CATCH zcx_division_error INTO DATA(lx_div_err).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_div_err->mv_dividend exp = 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_div_err->mv_divisor exp = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_div_err->get_text( ) ).
        " Check that the message content is as expected (needs message class ZMSG_APP with message 001)
        " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_string_contains( haystack = lx_div_err->get_text( ) needle = 'nicht möglich' ).
    CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_errors INTO DATA(lx_too_generic).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Falsche Exception gefangen (zu generisch): ' && lx_too_generic->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Klassenbasierte Exceptions (ab ABAP 7.0) sind der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung. Sie ermöglichen die Definition spezialisierter Fehlerklassen (`zcx_division_error`) mit zusätzlichen Attributen und der Möglichkeit zur Verkettung von Exceptions (`previous`-Attribut), um den Kontext des Fehlers umfassend zu dokumentieren und zu behandeln. Das Beispiel zeigt auch die Verwendung von `RAISE EXCEPTION NEW` für prägnante Exception-Auslösung.
keywords: Class-based Exceptions, TRY...CATCH, cx_sy_arithmetic_errors, Exception Handling, Error Handling

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Flüge einer Fluggesellschaft aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, die einen bestimmten Preis überschreiten. Nutzen Sie INSERT LINES OF und den FILTER Operator.
hint: Kombinieren Sie INSERT LINES OF mit FILTER für eine elegante Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS insert_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_source_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' )
    ).

    INSERT LINES OF FILTER tt_sflight(
      FROM lt_source_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price
    ) INTO TABLE rt_target_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_insert_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_filter.
    DATA(lo_insert) = NEW zcl_insert_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_insert->insert_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = '110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: INSERT LINES OF ermöglicht das Einfügen mehrerer Zeilen aus einer anderen internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit dem FILTER Operator kann dies sehr effizient und lesbar erfolgen, um nur relevante Zeilen zu übertragen.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein und weisen Sie die neu eingefügte Zeile direkt einem Feldsymbol zu, um sie unmittelbar zu bearbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... ASSIGNING <field-symbol>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS insert_and_modify RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_and_modify.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) INTO TABLE rt_flights.

    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO TABLE rt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'.
      <fs_flight>-connid = '0007'.
      <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'.
      <fs_flight>-price = '300.00'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_insert_assign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_assign.
    DATA(lo_insert) = NEW zcl_insert_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_insert->insert_and_modify( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0007' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Einfügen einer Zeile mit ASSIGNING <field-symbol> ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf die neu erstellte Zeile im Speicher. Dies ist effizienter als ein nachträgliches READ TABLE und ideal für die sofortige Bearbeitung der eingefügten Daten.
keywords: INSERT, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGNING, Internal Tables

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und modifizieren Sie Zeilen direkt, indem Sie ein Feldsymbol verwenden. Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge um 10%.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field-symbol>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS modify_prices IMPORTING CHANGING ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_prices.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_loop_assign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_assign.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_loop_assign=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_loop_assign( ).
    lo_modifier->modify_prices( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price exp = '110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-price exp = '220.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field-symbol> ist die effizienteste Methode, um interne Tabellen zeilenweise zu bearbeiten, da sie direkten Zugriff auf die Tabellenzeile im Speicher ermöglicht und keine Kopie erstellt wird.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, In-place modification

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine interne Tabelle zu, deren Typ zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und lesen Sie einen Wert aus einer bestimmten Spalte.
hint: Verwenden Sie ASSIGN (table_name) TO <field-symbol> und ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE <field-symbol> TO <field-symbol>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_dynamic_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_index      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_value.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflight.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " In a real scenario, iv_table_name would refer to a global data object.
    " For this example, we'll simulate by assigning a local table based on the name.
    IF iv_table_name = 'LT_SFLIGHT'.
      ASSIGN lt_sflight TO <fs_table>.
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX iv_index ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lo_dyn) = NEW zcl_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_dyn->get_dynamic_value( iv_table_name = 'LT_SFLIGHT' iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_index = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_dyn->get_dynamic_value( iv_table_name = 'LT_SFLIGHT' iv_field_name = 'PRICE' iv_index = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Feldsymbole sind unerlässlich für die dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen den Zugriff auf Datenobjekte, deren Typ oder Name erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, was flexible und generische Lösungen erlaubt.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, ANY TABLE, ANY

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten aus einer Struktur in eine interne Tabelle ein, wobei nur die übereinstimmenden Felder übertragen werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie INSERT CORRESPONDING oder den CORRESPONDING Operator mit VALUE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.

    METHODS insert_corresponding_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_sflight_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_corresponding_data.
    INSERT CORRESPONDING #( is_source ) INTO TABLE rt_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_insert_corr FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_corr.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_corr=>ty_sflight_full(
      carrid   = 'LH'
      connid   = '0400'
      fldate   = '20250101'
      price    = '100.00'
      currency = 'EUR'
    ).
    DATA(lo_insert) = NEW zcl_insert_corr( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).

explanation: INSERT CORRESPONDING ist eine moderne und typsichere Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen und internen Tabellen zu übertragen, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen und kompatiblen Typen berücksichtigt werden. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code erheblich.
keywords: INSERT, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Structures

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige Struktur als Eingabe akzeptiert und den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes zurückgibt, dessen Name dynamisch übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE ANY und ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data     TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>     TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF <fs_structure> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_generic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_access.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_test_data.
    ls_data-id = 123.
    ls_data-name = 'TestName'.

    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_generic_field_access( ).
    DATA(lv_id_value) = lo_accessor->get_field_value( ir_data = REF #( ls_data ) iv_field_name = 'ID' ).
    DATA(lv_name_value) = lo_accessor->get_field_value( ir_data = REF #( ls_data ) iv_field_name = 'NAME' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_id_value exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name_value exp = 'TestName' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von Feldsymbolen für die generische Datenverarbeitung. Durch die Verwendung von TYPE REF TO data und ASSIGN ir_data->* kann die Methode mit beliebigen Strukturen arbeiten und dynamisch auf deren Komponenten zugreifen, was die Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code erhöht.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, REF TO DATA, ANY

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile in eine interne Tabelle nur dann ein, wenn eine Zeile mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel noch nicht existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... in Kombination mit LINE_EXISTS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS insert_if_not_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight_key
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_if_not_exists.
    IF NOT LINE_EXISTS( ct_flights[ KEY primary_key
                                    carrid = is_new_flight-carrid
                                    connid = is_new_flight-connid ] ).
      INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE ct_flights.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_inserted = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_insert_line_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_line_exists.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_insert_line_exists=>tt_sflight_key.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_insert) = NEW zcl_insert_line_exists( ).

    " Should be inserted
    DATA(ls_new_flight1) = VALUE zcl_insert_line_exists=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ).
    DATA(lv_inserted1) = lo_insert->insert_if_not_exists( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_new_flight1 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_inserted1 ).

    " Should not be inserted (duplicate)
    DATA(ls_new_flight2) = VALUE zcl_insert_line_exists=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ).
    DATA(lv_inserted2) = lo_insert->insert_if_not_exists( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_new_flight2 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_inserted2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion LINE_EXISTS (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine prägnante und effiziente Überprüfung, ob eine Zeile mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel in einer internen Tabelle existiert, bevor eine INSERT-Operation durchgeführt wird. Dies ist besonders nützlich bei sortierten oder Hash-Tabellen.
keywords: INSERT, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Weisen Sie das Ergebnis eines Tabellenausdrucks direkt einem Feldsymbol zu, um effizient auf die gefundene Zeile zuzugreifen und sie zu modifizieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie ASSIGN (table_expression) TO <field-symbol>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    ASSIGN ct_flights[ KEY primary_key carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] TO <fs_flight>.

    IF <fs_flight> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_assign_table_expr FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_table_expr.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_assign_table_expr=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_assign_table_expr( ).

    " Update existing flight
    DATA(lv_updated1) = lo_updater->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_price = '150.00' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_updated1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-price exp = '150.00' ).

    " Try to update non-existing flight
    DATA(lv_updated2) = lo_updater->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'BA' iv_connid = '0007' iv_new_price = '300.00' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_updated2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 kann das Ergebnis eines Tabellenausdrucks direkt einem Feldsymbol zugewiesen werden. Dies ermöglicht einen sehr effizienten und direkten Zugriff auf die gefundene Tabellenzeile zur Bearbeitung, ohne eine Kopie zu erstellen.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN, Table Expression, Internal Tables

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur bestimmte Flüge enthält und dabei den Preis jedes Fluges um einen festen Betrag erhöht. Nutzen Sie dabei ein Feldsymbol für die Zwischenbearbeitung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie REDUCE mit einem Feldsymbol und dem VALUE Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_price_increase TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_processed_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_source_flights
      WHERE ( <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_sflight(
        BASE result
        ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
          connid = <fs_flight>-connid
          fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate
          price  = <fs_flight>-price + iv_price_increase )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_reduce_fs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_fs.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_reduce_fs=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_reduce_fs( ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei die Zeilen der Quelltabelle vor dem Einfügen transformiert werden. Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit einem Feldsymbol.
hint: Verwenden Sie INSERT LINES OF in Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und einem Feldsymbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS transform_and_insert
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_prefix         TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_insert.
    INSERT LINES OF VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_source_flights
      ( carrid = iv_prefix && <fs_flight>-carrid
        connid = <fs_flight>-connid
        fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate
        price  = <fs_flight>-price )
    ) INTO TABLE rt_target_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_for_fs=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_insert_for_fs( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_transformer->transform_and_insert( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_prefix = 'X' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus. Nutzen Sie RTTI und Feldsymbole.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_type.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).
      TRY.
          lo_structdescr ?= lo_typedescr.
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
          RETURN. " Not a structure
      ENDTRY.

      LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
          name = ls_component-name
          type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( )
        ) TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_rtti_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_components.
    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_rtti_components=>ty_test_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'ABC'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_data-field3 = 'Hello'.

    DATA(lo_rtti) = NEW zcl_rtti_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_rtti->get_structure_components( REF #( ls_data ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-type exp = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-type exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 3 ]-name exp = 'FIELD3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 3 ]-type exp = 'STRING' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) in Kombination mit Feldsymbolen ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse und Verarbeitung von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit. Hier wird gezeigt, wie man die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur ermittelt, was für generische Frameworks oder Tools unerlässlich ist.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, die aus einer anderen Zeile kopiert und dabei ein Feld modifiziert wird. Nutzen Sie den BASE-Zusatz des VALUE-Operators mit einem Feldsymbol.
hint: Verwenden Sie INSERT VALUE #( BASE ... ) INTO TABLE ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_base_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS copy_and_insert_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_source_flight TYPE ty_sflight
        iv_new_connid    TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_base_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_and_insert_flight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    APPEND is_source_flight TO rt_flights.

    " Insert a new flight based on the source, but with a new connection ID
    INSERT VALUE #( BASE is_source_flight connid = iv_new_connid ) INTO TABLE rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
