Instructions: Zeigen Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in einem ALV mit IDA an, aber nur mit einer dynamisch ausgewählten Liste von Spalten (z.B. `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_SALV_GUI_TABLE_IDA=>CREATE_FOR_QUERY` oder `SET_COLUMNS` des `IF_SALV_GUI_TABLE_IDA_COLUMNS` Interfaces.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ida_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_dyn_cols
      IMPORTING
        it_columns TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_dyn_cols.
    DATA(lo_alv_ida) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_table( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv_ida->get_columns( ).

    " Hide all columns first
    LOOP AT lo_columns->get_column_names( ) INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_name )->set_visible( abap_false ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Show only selected columns
    LOOP AT it_columns INTO lv_column_name.
      TRY.
          lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_name )->set_visible( abap_true ).
        CATCH cx_salv_ida_error.
          " Handle case where column does not exist
          MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Column { lv_column_name } does not exist.|.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_alv_ida->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_set_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error
        cx_sy_assign_error.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_data.
    DATA lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA dref          TYPE REF TO data.

    lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
    CREATE DATA dref TYPE HANDLE lo_type_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN dref->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Attempt to assign value, might fail for incompatible types
      <fs_data> = iv_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_rtti_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ida_rtti_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_rtti_cols.
    DATA(lo_alv_ida) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_table( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv_ida->get_columns( ).

    " Hide all columns initially
    LOOP AT lo_columns->get_column_names( ) INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_name )->set_visible( abap_false ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Get SFLIGHT structure components via RTTI
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-type->type_kind = iv_type_kind.
        TRY.
            lo_columns->get_column( ls_component-name )->set_visible( abap_true ).
          CATCH cx_salv_ida_error.
            " Column might not be displayable or exist in ALV context
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_alv_ida->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Methoden und Attribute einer Klasse (z.B. `CL_SALV_GUI_TABLE_IDA`) mithilfe von RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_NAME` und die Methoden `GET_METHODS` und `GET_ATTRIBUTES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name TYPE string,
             visibility TYPE string,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES: tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        et_methods    TYPE tt_method_info
        et_attributes TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_info.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).

    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method).
      DATA(lv_visibility) = SWITCH string(
        ls_method-visibility
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_public THEN 'Public'
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_protected THEN 'Protected'
        WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_private THEN 'Private'
        ELSE 'Unknown' ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_method_info( name = ls_method-name visibility = lv_visibility ) TO et_methods.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info( name = ls_attribute-name type_kind = ls_attribute-type->type_kind ) TO et_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Datenobjekt vom Typ einer bestimmten Schnittstelle ist, und rufen Sie gegebenenfalls eine Methode der Schnittstelle auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CAST` oder `TRY...CATCH` für den Downcast.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processable.
  METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_prefix TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process_data.
    rv_output = |{ mv_prefix } { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_prefix = iv_prefix.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_and_process
      IMPORTING
        io_data TYPE REF TO object
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_process.
    DATA lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lo_interface_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_interfacedescr.

    lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_data ).

    TRY.
        lo_interface_descr = cl_abap_interfacedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZIF_PROCESSABLE' ).
        IF lo_type_descr->is_implementing_interface( lo_interface_descr ) = abap_true.
          DATA(lo_processable) = CAST zif_processable( io_data ).
          rv_result = lo_processable->process_data( iv_input ).
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Object does not implement ZIF_PROCESSABLE'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_error.
        rv_result = 'Interface ZIF_PROCESSABLE not found'.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_result = 'Cast to ZIF_PROCESSABLE failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus und geben Sie diesen zurück. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Auswahl effizient und modern ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` zur Indexgenerierung und moderne Tabellenoperationen wie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_flight RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND connid IS NOT INITIAL ).
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index + 1 INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Schleife mit `COLLECT` oder `INSERT` in eine sortierte Tabelle, um Eindeutigkeit zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_ints
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_ints.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = iv_min ip_max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO iv_count * 2 TIMES. " Try to generate more than needed to ensure uniqueness
      DATA(lv_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_number INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
      IF lines( lt_temp_numbers ) >= iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN lt_temp_numbers ( number ) ).
    SORT rt_numbers ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_numbers.
    IF lines( rt_numbers ) > iv_count.
      DELETE rt_numbers FROM iv_count + 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_unique_random_ints.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_unique_random_numbers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 msg = 'Incorrect number of unique random integers generated.' ).

    DATA(lv_prev_number) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_current_number).

      lv_prev_number = lv_current_number.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Passwort fester Länge (z.B. 12 Zeichen), das Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` zur Auswahl von Zeichen aus vordefinierten Zeichensätzen und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 12
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_upper TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ',
               lc_lower TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz',
               lc_digits TYPE string VALUE '0123456789',
               lc_all TYPE string VALUE lc_upper && lc_lower && lc_digits.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = strlen( lc_all ) - 1 ).
    DATA(lo_random_type) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = 2 ). " 0=upper, 1=lower, 2=digit

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char_type) = lo_random_type->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_char_set) TYPE string.
      CASE lv_char_type.
        WHEN 0. lv_char_set = lc_upper.
        WHEN 1. lv_char_set = lc_lower.
        WHEN 2. lv_char_set = lc_digits.
      ENDCASE.

      DATA(lo_random_char_idx) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = strlen( lv_char_set ) - 1 ).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random_char_idx->get_next( ).
      rv_password = rv_password && lv_char_set+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_date.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = CONV d( |{ iv_start_year }0101| ).
    DATA(lv_end_date) = CONV d( |{ iv_end_year }1231| ).

    DATA(lv_days_diff) = cl_abap_date_helper=>diff( iv_date1 = lv_end_date iv_date2 = lv_start_date ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = lv_days_diff ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = lv_start_date iv_days = lv_random_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) zufällig durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Schleife, um Elemente zufällig auszuwählen und in eine neue Tabelle zu verschieben oder die vorhandene Tabelle zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_temp) = it_source.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( lt_temp ).
    IF lv_size = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = lv_size - 1 ).

    DO lv_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_temp INDEX lv_random_index + 1 INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_entry TO rt_shuffled.
        DELETE TABLE lt_temp INDEX lv_random_index + 1.
        lo_random = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = lines( lt_temp ) - 1 ). " Re-create with new max
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ).
    DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_shuffler->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) msg = 'Shuffled table has incorrect number of entries.' ).

    " Check if all original elements are present (count check)
    DATA(lv_count_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_b) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_c) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_d) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_e) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_shuffled INTO DATA(lv_char).
      CASE lv_char.
        WHEN 'A'. lv_count_a = lv_count_a + 1.
        WHEN 'B'. lv_count_b = lv_count_b + 1.
        WHEN 'C'. lv_count_c = lv_count_c + 1.
        WHEN 'D'. lv_count_d = lv_count_d + 1.
        WHEN 'E'. lv_count_e = lv_count_e + 1.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_a exp = 1 msg = 'Element A count incorrect.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_b exp = 1 msg = 'Element B count incorrect.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_c exp = 1 msg = 'Element C count incorrect.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_d exp = 1 msg = 'Element D count incorrect.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_e exp = 1 msg = 'Element E count incorrect.' ).

    " It's hard to assert randomness, but we can assert it's not the same as original (probabilistic)
    IF lt_shuffled = lt_original.
      " This might fail rarely, but for a small table, it's a reasonable check.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Table was not shuffled (unlikely but possible).' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_shuffler->shuffle_table( lt_original ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_shuffled msg = 'Shuffled empty table should be empty.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode mischt eine interne Tabelle, indem sie zufällig Elemente aus der Quelltabelle auswählt, diese in die Zieltabelle verschiebt und aus der Quelltabelle entfernt. `cl_abap_random_int` wird verwendet, um den Index des zu entfernenden Elements zu bestimmen. Die `VALUE` Syntax wird für die Initialisierung der Testdaten verwendet.
keywords: cl_abap_random_int, Internal Tables, Shuffle, Random, VALUE

Instructions: Entschlüsseln Sie einen verschlüsselten Schlüssel innerhalb eines XML-Dokuments mit `cl_secxml_helper`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `DECRYPT_ENCRYPTED_KEY` von `cl_secxml_helper`. Dies erfordert ein komplexeres Setup mit einem verschlüsselten XML-Fragment.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secxml_key_decryptor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decrypt_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_encrypted_key_xml TYPE string
        iv_pse_file          TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decrypted_key) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secxml_key_decryptor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decrypt_key.
    DATA(lo_ixml_document) = cl_ixml_document=>create( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = cl_ixml_parser=>create( document = lo_ixml_document stream_factory = cl_ixml_stream_factory=>create( ) ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = cl_ixml_stream_factory=>create_istream_string( string = iv_encrypted_key_xml ).
    lo_parser->set_stream( lo_istream ).
    lo_parser->parse( ).

    DATA(lo_encrypted_key_node) = lo_ixml_document->get_root_element( ).

    cl_secxml_helper=>decrypt_encrypted_key(
      EXPORTING
        io_encrypted_key_node = lo_encrypted_key_node
        iv_pse_file           = iv_pse_file
      IMPORTING
        ev_decrypted_key      = rv_decrypted_key
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_decrypt_key FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_decrypt_key.
    " This test is highly complex as it requires a pre-encrypted key XML and a valid PSE.
    " For demonstration, we will simulate the call and assert initial output.
    " In a real scenario, one would encrypt a key first and then attempt to decrypt it.

    DATA(lo_pse_creator) = NEW zcl_secxml_pse_creator( ).
    DATA(lv_pse_path) = lo_pse_creator->create_temp_pse( ).

    CONSTANTS: lc_encrypted_key_xml TYPE string VALUE
      '<EncryptedKey xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#">'
      '  <EncryptionMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#aes128-cbc"/>'
      '  <CipherData>'
      '    <CipherValue>BASE64_ENCODED_CIPHER_TEXT_HERE</CipherValue>'
      '  </CipherData>'
      '</EncryptedKey>'.

    DATA(lo_decryptor) = NEW zcl_secxml_key_decryptor( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_decrypted_key) = lo_decryptor->decrypt_key(
          iv_encrypted_key_xml = lc_encrypted_key_xml
          iv_pse_file          = lv_pse_path
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_decrypted_key msg = 'Decrypted key should be initial for dummy input.' ).
    CATCH cx_static_check.
        " Expected to fail without a real encrypted key and PSE setup
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Decryption failed as expected due to dummy input.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Clean up
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_pse_path ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_secxml_helper=>decrypt_encrypted_key` zur Entschlüsselung eines Schlüssels, der in einem XML-Dokument eingebettet ist. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Sicherheitsfunktion, die typischerweise in Szenarien mit XML-Verschlüsselung verwendet wird. Es nutzt auch die `cl_ixml` Klassen für die XML-Verarbeitung.
keywords: cl_secxml_helper, XML, Encryption, Decryption, Security, iXML

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl, die angibt, wie oft ein bestimmtes Ereignis in 100 Versuchen eintritt, basierend auf einer gegebenen Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 20%).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in einer Schleife und zählen Sie die erfolgreichen Versuche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_event_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_events
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability_percent TYPE i " e.g., 20 for 20%
        iv_trials              TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_event_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_event_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_events.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 1 ip_max = 100 ).
    DO iv_trials TIMES.
      IF lo_random->get_next( ) <= iv_probability_percent.
        rv_event_count = rv_event_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_events_100_percent FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_events_0_percent FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_events_50_percent_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_events_100_percent.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_random_event_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_counter->count_events( iv_probability_percent = 100 iv_trials = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 10 msg = '100% probability should yield 10 events in 10 trials.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_events_0_percent.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_random_event_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_counter->count_events( iv_probability_percent = 0 iv_trials = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = '0% probability should yield 0 events in 10 trials.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_events_50_percent_range.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_random_event_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_counter->count_events( iv_probability_percent = 50 iv_trials = 1000 ).
    " Due to randomness, we can only assert a range, not an exact value.
    " A range of +/- 10% of expected value (500) is reasonable for 1000 trials.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_count >= 400 AND lv_count <= 600 ) msg = '50% probability count not within expected range.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `cl_abap_random_int` in einer Schleife, um eine Reihe von Versuchen zu simulieren. Für jeden Versuch wird eine Zufallszahl generiert und mit der gegebenen Wahrscheinlichkeit verglichen, um zu bestimmen, ob das Ereignis eingetreten ist. Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig N eindeutige Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `WHILE` Schleife, um zufällige Indizes zu generieren und die ausgewählten Einträge in eine neue Tabelle zu sammeln, bis N Einträge erreicht sind.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_n_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_n_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_n_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_n_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_n_random_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND connid IS NOT INITIAL ).
    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL OR iv_n_count <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_all_flights ) - 1.
    IF lv_max_index < 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    WHILE lines( lt_selected_indices ) < iv_n_count AND lines( lt_selected_indices ) < lines( lt_all_flights ).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_random_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_selected_flights = VALUE #( FOR lv_index IN lt_selected_indices
                                   ( lt_all_flights[ lv_index + 1 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_n_random_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_more_than_available FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_zero_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_n_random_flights.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_random_n_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->select_n_random_flights( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights selected.' ).

    " Check for uniqueness (assuming SFLIGHTS has unique entries for carrid/connid)
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_unique_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Selected flights are not unique.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_more_than_available.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_random_n_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND connid IS NOT INITIAL ).
    DATA(lv_all_count) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
    IF lv_all_count = 0.
      SKIP.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->select_n_random_flights( lv_all_count + 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_all_count msg = 'Should select all available flights if N is too high.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_zero_flights.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_random_n_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->select_n_random_flights( 0 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese Methode wählt N zufällige und eindeutige Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle. Sie verwendet `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung von Indizes und eine HASHED TABLE, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Index nur einmal ausgewählt wird. Die `VALUE` Syntax wird für die Initialisierung und Transformation der Tabellen verwendet.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die 'Inclusive Namespaces' für ein XML-Element mit `cl_secxml_helper`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `INCLUSIVE_NAMESPACES` von `cl_secxml_helper`. Dies ist relevant für XML-Canonicalization und Signaturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secxml_namespace_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_inclusive_namespaces
      IMPORTING
        io_xml_node TYPE REF TO if_ixml_node
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_namespaces) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secxml_namespace_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_inclusive_namespaces.
    cl_secxml_helper=>inclusive_namespaces(
      EXPORTING
        io_xml_node  = io_xml_node
      IMPORTING
        et_namespaces = rt_namespaces
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS       = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inclusive_namespaces FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inclusive_namespaces.
    CONSTANTS: lc_xml_string TYPE string VALUE
      '<root xmlns="http://example.com/root" xmlns:pref="http://example.com/pref">'
      '  <child pref:attr="value">Text</child>'
      '</root>'.

    DATA(lo_ixml_document) = cl_ixml_document=>create( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = cl_ixml_parser=>create( document = lo_ixml_document stream_factory = cl_ixml_stream_factory=>create( ) ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = cl_ixml_stream_factory=>create_istream_string( string = lc_xml_string ).
    lo_parser->set_stream( lo_istream ).
    lo_parser->parse( ).

    DATA(lo_root_element) = lo_ixml_document->get_root_element( ).
    DATA(lo_child_element) = lo_root_element->get_first_child( ).

    DATA(lo_helper) = NEW zcl_secxml_namespace_helper( ).
    DATA(lt_namespaces) = lo_helper->get_inclusive_namespaces( lo_child_element ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_namespaces ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of inclusive namespaces found.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( 'xmlns="http://example.com/root"' IN lt_namespaces ) msg = 'Root namespace not found.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( 'xmlns:pref="http://example.com/pref"' IN lt_namespaces ) msg = 'Prefixed namespace not found.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_secxml_helper=>inclusive_namespaces`, um alle relevanten Namespaces für ein bestimmtes XML-Element zu ermitteln. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Canonicalization von XML-Dokumenten, die wiederum für digitale Signaturen und andere Sicherheitsstandards wichtig ist. Es nutzt die `cl_ixml` Klassen zur XML-Dokumentenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige GUID (Globally Unique Identifier) unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_int` als Teil der Logik (obwohl `cl_system_uuid` existiert, soll hier `cl_abap_random_int` demonstriert werden).
hint: Eine GUID besteht aus Hexadezimalziffern. Generieren Sie zufällige Bytes und konvertieren Sie diese in Hexadezimalzeichen, um eine GUID-ähnliche Struktur zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_guid_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_pseudo_guid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_guid) TYPE sysuuid_c32.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_guid_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_pseudo_guid.
    DATA(lv_guid_raw) TYPE x LENGTH 16.
    DATA(lo_random_byte) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 0 ip_max = 255 ).

    DO 16 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_byte) = lo_random_byte->get_next( ).
      lv_guid_raw+sy-index(1) = lv_byte.
    ENDDO.

    rv_guid = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>xstring_to_string(
      iv_xstring = lv_guid_raw
      iv_encoding = 'UTF-8' " Encoding doesn't matter for hex conversion
    ).
    " Format to standard GUID string (e.g., XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX)
    rv_guid = |
      { rv_guid(8) }-{ rv_guid+8(4) }-{ rv_guid+12(4) }-{ rv_guid+16(4) }-{ rv_guid+20(12) }
    |.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_pseudo_guid.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_random_guid_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_guid1) = lo_generator->generate_pseudo_guid( ).
    DATA(lv_guid2) = lo_generator->generate_pseudo_guid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_guid1 msg = 'Generated GUID should not be empty.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_guid1 ) exp = 36 msg = 'Generated GUID has incorrect length.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_guid1 exp = lv_guid2 msg = 'Two generated GUIDs should be different (probabilistic).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_guid_format.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_random_guid_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_guid) = lo_generator->generate_pseudo_guid( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_guid CP '????????-????-????-????-????????????' ) msg = 'GUID format is incorrect.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es werden 16 zufällige Bytes erzeugt und dann in eine Hexadezimaldarstellung umgewandelt und in das Standard-GUID-Format gebracht. String Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Formatierung verwendet.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die basierend auf einer 50/50-Zufallsentscheidung entweder 'TRUE' oder 'FALSE' zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` mit einem Bereich von 0 bis 1 und prüfen Sie den zurückgegebenen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_boolean_decision DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_random_boolean_decision IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Verbindungsnummer (`connid`). Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (`passeng`) und die durchschnittliche Flugzeit (`fltime`). Verwenden Sie dabei den `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck und den `REDUCE` Operator. Wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) ist, soll die durchschnittliche Flugzeit anders berechnet werden (z.B. nur Flüge über 100 Minuten berücksichtigen).
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP WHERE` und `REDUCE` mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Aggregation. Definieren Sie eine lokale Struktur mit `BEGIN OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
        passeng   TYPE sflight-passeng,
        fltime    TYPE sflight-fltime,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
        total_passeng TYPE i,
        avg_fltime    TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_grouped_result,
      tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, passeng, fltime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
         INTO DATA(ls_group).

      DATA(lv_total_passeng) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-passeng ).

      DATA(lv_avg_fltime) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT avg = 0
        count = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group
        WHEN ls_group-carrid = 'LH' AND <fs_member>-fltime > 100
          NEXT avg = avg + <fs_member>-fltime
          count = count + 1
        WHEN ls_group-carrid <> 'LH'
          NEXT avg = avg + <fs_member>-fltime
          count = count + 1
        FINALLY = COND decfloat16( WHEN count > 0 THEN avg / count ELSE 0 )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid        = ls_group-carrid
        connid        = ls_group-connid
        total_passeng = lv_total_passeng
        avg_fltime    = lv_avg_fltime
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Datenaggregation und den `REDUCE` Operator für die bedingte Berechnung innerhalb der Gruppen. Die `WHEN`-Klausel im `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, unterschiedliche Logiken basierend auf den Gruppenschlüsseln anzuwenden, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. Die lokale Strukturdefinition mit `BEGIN OF` ist hier für die Typisierung der Gruppenergebnisse verwendet.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, WHEN, BEGIN OF, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Conditional Logic, 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabestatus (z.B. 'NEW', 'IN_PROCESS', 'COMPLETED') einen entsprechenden Text zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `SWITCH` Ausdruck mit `WHEN`.

CLASS zcl_status_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_status TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_status_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH string( iv_status
      WHEN 'NEW'        THEN 'Der Vorgang ist neu angelegt.'
      WHEN 'IN_PROCESS' THEN 'Der Vorgang wird bearbeitet.'
      WHEN 'COMPLETED'  THEN 'Der Vorgang ist abgeschlossen.'
      ELSE                   'Unbekannter Status.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) füllt. Verwenden Sie eine lokal definierte Struktur mit `BEGIN OF` und den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` Schleifen, um die Daten zu generieren.
hint: Definieren Sie eine lokale Struktur mit `BEGIN OF` und nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` zur Tabellenfüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
      END OF ty_flight_info,

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagiere aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestflugzeit (`fltime`) überschreiten. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `WHEN`-Klausel.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_passengers_cond
      IMPORTING iv_min_fltime TYPE sflight-fltime
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_passengers_cond.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, passeng, fltime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHEN ls_flight-fltime > iv_min_fltime
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passeng
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc >= iv_min_seatsocc 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein Datum basierend auf einem übergebenen 'Modus' (z.B. 'ADD_DAYS', 'ADD_MONTHS', 'NEXT_WEEKDAY') manipuliert. Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` für die Modus-spezifische Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` und moderne Datumsklassen oder Funktionen wie `cl_abap_tstmp` oder `N_DAYS_AFTER_DATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_manipulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_mode TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_mode,
                 add_days     TYPE ty_mode VALUE 'ADD_DAYS',
                 add_months   TYPE ty_mode VALUE 'ADD_MONTHS',
                 next_weekday TYPE ty_mode VALUE 'NEXT_WEEKDAY',
               END OF gc_mode.

    METHODS manipulate_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_mode TYPE ty_mode
        iv_value TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_new_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_manipulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_date.
    rv_new_date = iv_date.

    CASE iv_mode.
      WHEN gc_mode-add_days.
        rv_new_date = iv_date + iv_value.
      WHEN gc_mode-add_months.
        CALL FUNCTION 'RP_CALC_DATE_IN_INTERVAL'
          EXPORTING
            date      = iv_date
            days      = 0
            months    = iv_value
            signum    = '+'
            years     = 0
          IMPORTING
            calc_date = rv_new_date.
      WHEN gc_mode-next_weekday.
        DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( iv_date ).
        DATA(lv_days_to_add) = 0.
        IF lv_day_of_week = 5. " Friday
          lv_days_to_add = 3.
        ELSEIF lv_day_of_week = 6. " Saturday
          lv_days_to_add = 2.
        ELSE. " Other weekdays
          lv_days_to_add = 1.
        ENDIF.
        rv_new_date = iv_date + lv_days_to_add.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " No action or raise exception
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error cx_sy_zero_divide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zero_divide INTO DATA(lx_zero_divide).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Division by zero: { lx_zero_divide->get_text( ) }| ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zero_divide EXPORTING textid = lx_zero_divide->textid.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Arithmetic error: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = lx_arith_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch ausliest. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `CASE TYPE OF` mit `WHEN` für die Typbehandlung des Feldes.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `CASE TYPE OF` zur dynamischen Typidentifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data    TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CASE TYPE OF <fs_field>.
        WHEN TYPE c.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        WHEN TYPE n.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        WHEN TYPE i.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        WHEN TYPE p.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        WHEN TYPE f.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        WHEN TYPE d.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        WHEN TYPE t.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          rv_value = 'Unsupported Type'.
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) in eine neue interne Tabelle umwandelt. Dabei sollen nur bestimmte Felder übernommen und ein neues Feld 'FLIGHT_STATUS' basierend auf der Flugzeit (`fltime`) hinzugefügt werden. Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `COND` und `WHEN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Feldzuweisung.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
        fltime        TYPE sflight-fltime,
        flight_status TYPE string,
      END OF ty_transformed_flight,
      tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid        = ls_flight-carrid
        connid        = ls_flight-connid
        fldate        = ls_flight-fldate
        fltime        = ls_flight-fltime
        flight_status = COND string(
                          WHEN ls_flight-fltime > 300 THEN 'Long Haul'
                          WHEN ls_flight-fltime > 120 THEN 'Medium Haul'
                          WHEN ls_flight-fltime > 0   THEN 'Short Haul'
                          ELSE 'Unknown'
                        ) 
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Wörtern als String erhält und diese in einen formatierten String umwandelt. Wenn ein Wort 'ERROR' enthält, soll es besonders hervorgehoben werden. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `WHEN` und String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_word_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_word_list
      IMPORTING it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_word_list.
    rv_formatted_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR word IN it_words
      WHEN word CP '*ERROR*'
        NEXT result = |{ result } <ERROR> { word } </ERROR>|
      WHEN result IS INITIAL
        NEXT result = |{ word }|
      ELSE
        NEXT result = |{ result }, { word }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) gruppiert und für jede Gruppe eine neue interne Tabelle mit den Flugdetails erstellt. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `INTO TABLE` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `INTO TABLE` und den `VALUE` Operator, um die Gruppenergebnisse in eine strukturierte Tabelle zu überführen. Definieren Sie eine lokale Struktur mit `BEGIN OF`.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        fltime TYPE sflight-fltime,
      END OF ty_flight_detail,
      tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
        carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        flights      TYPE tt_flight_detail,
      END OF ty_grouped_flights,
      tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_into_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_into_table.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lt_details) = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        ( connid = <fs_member>-connid
          fldate = <fs_member>-fldate
          fltime = <fs_member>-fltime )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_flights(
        carrid       = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lines( lt_details )
        flights      = lt_details
      ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Definieren Sie eine lokale Struktur mit `BEGIN OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary_result,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_count  TYPE i,
        total_passeng TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary_result,
      tt_flight_summary_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, passeng
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT count = count + 1
      ).

      DATA(lv_total_passeng) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-passeng
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary_result(
        carrid        = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count  = lv_flight_count
        total_passeng = lv_total_passeng
      ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_update IMPLEMENTATION.

        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price = iv_new_price

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
        iv_price_increase TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights_to_update) = VALUE tt_flight_price(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE price > iv_price_threshold )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price = ls_flight-price + iv_price_increase
        currency = ls_flight-currency )
    ).

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_complex_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_prices_with_logic
      IMPORTING
        iv_discount_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_discount_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_complex_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_with_logic.
    DATA(lt_flights_to_update) = VALUE tt_flight_price(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflights )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = iv_discount_carrier
                        THEN ls_sflight-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate )
                        ELSE ls_sflight-price ) " No change if not discount carrier
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Verwenden Sie dann `REDUCE` um den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen, die in dieser sortierten Tabelle enthalten sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Iterator über die sortierte Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_secondary_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_update_secondary_key IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugpreis (`PRICE`) in `SFLIGHTS` für eine Liste von Flügen, die in einer sortierten internen Tabelle vorliegen, aber nur, wenn der aktuelle Preis in der Datenbank niedriger ist als der neue Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE` in Kombination mit einer vorherigen `SELECT` und `FOR` um die zu aktualisierenden Daten vorzubereiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_conditional_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_if_higher_price
      IMPORTING
        it_proposed_prices TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_conditional_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_if_higher_price.
    DATA lt_current_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_proposed_prices
      WHERE carrid = @it_proposed_prices-carrid
        AND connid = @it_proposed_prices-connid
        AND fldate = @it_proposed_prices-fldate
      INTO TABLE @lt_current_sflights.

    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE tt_flight_price(
      FOR ls_proposed IN it_proposed_prices
      LET ls_current = lt_current_sflights[ KEY primary_key carrid = ls_proposed-carrid
                                                          connid = ls_proposed-connid
                                                          fldate = ls_proposed-fldate ] OPTIONAL
      WHERE ls_current IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_proposed-price > ls_current-price
      ( carrid = ls_proposed-carrid
        connid = ls_proposed-connid
        fldate = ls_proposed-fldate
        price = ls_proposed-price
        currency = ls_proposed-currency )
    ).

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_updates.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Führen Sie ein Massen-Update auf `SFLIGHTS` durch, indem Sie die Preise für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen Prozentsatz erhöhen. Die zu aktualisierenden Flüge sollen aus einer sortierten internen Tabelle stammen, die zuvor aus der Datenbank gelesen wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` mit `FOR` und `VALUE` zur Vorbereitung der sortierten Tabelle und dann `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE`.

CLASS zcl_mass_update_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS increase_prices_by_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage_increase TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mass_update_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices_by_percentage.
    DATA(lt_flights_to_process) = VALUE tt_flight_price(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid )
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE tt_flight_price(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights_to_process
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage_increase / 100 )
        currency = ls_flight-currency )
    ).

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_updates.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Gruppieren Sie dann die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` oder `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier.
    TYPES tt_avg_price_by_carrier TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrier.
    rt_avg_prices = VALUE tt_avg_price_by_carrier(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        average_price = REDUCE s_price(
          INIT sum_price = 0 count = 0
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_member-price
               count = count + 1
          FINALLY = sum_price / count
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 150.00 )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_avg_prices[ carrid = 'LH' ]-average_price exp = 210.00 ). "(200+220)/2
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugpreis (`PRICE`) in `SFLIGHTS` für Flüge, die in einer sortierten internen Tabelle vorliegen, und setzen Sie den Preis auf einen Standardwert, wenn er unter einem bestimmten Minimum liegt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_update_min_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS enforce_min_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_check TYPE tt_flight_price
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_min_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD enforce_min_price.
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE tt_flight_price(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_to_check
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price < iv_min_price THEN iv_min_price ELSE ls_flight-price )
        currency = ls_flight-currency )
    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in dieser Tabelle existiert.

CLASS zcl_check_flight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_flight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flight_exists.
    DATA(ls_dummy) = it_flights[ KEY primary_key carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
                                              connid = is_flight_key-connid
                                              fldate = is_flight_key-fldate ] OPTIONAL.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) ).

  METHOD test_existing_flight.

    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->flight_exists( it_flights = mt_flights is_flight_key = ls_key ).

explanation: Die Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken mit `OPTIONAL` ist die modernste und prägnanteste Art, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Differenzen zwischen aufeinanderfolgenden Werten in einer Liste von Zahlen, beginnend mit einem Startwert.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_differences
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_initial_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_differences.
    rv_result = REDUCE i( INIT sum = iv_initial_value
                               prev_num = iv_initial_value " Dummy initial value for prev_num
                          FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > lines( it_numbers )
                          LET current_num = it_numbers[i] IN
                          NEXT sum = sum - current_num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_reduce_subtraction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_reduce_subtraction.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_input_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY( ( 10 ) ( 7 ) ( 15 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_initial) = 100.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_differences( it_numbers = lt_input_numbers iv_initial_value = lv_initial ).
    " Expected: 100 - 10 - 7 - 15 - 5 = 63
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 63 msg = 'Reduce subtraction failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, deren Differenz zwischen `MAX_SEATS` und `SEATSOCC` (freie Plätze) einen bestimmten Schwellenwert unterschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer Subtraktionsbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             max_seats TYPE s_max_seats,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seats_free TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.
    TYPES tt_flight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_few_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_few_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( max_seats - seatsocc ) < iv_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_seat_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_seat_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_few_free_seats( 10 ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights have less than 10 free seats
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-max_seats - ls_flight-seatsocc ) < 10
                                        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } has too many free seats| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen. Hier wird er verwendet, um Einträge basierend auf einer arithmetischen Bedingung (Differenz der Sitzplätze) auszuwählen, was den Code sehr ausdrucksstark und performant macht.
keywords: SUBTRACT, FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Conditional, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Werten, die als Strings vorliegen und unterschiedliche Dezimalstellen haben könnten, und geben Sie das Ergebnis als `DECFLOAT34` zurück.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Hash-Tabellentyp für Flugsegmente (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum als Schlüssel) und füllen Sie ihn mit Daten aus `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Definieren Sie einen `HASHED TABLE` Typ mit `WITH UNIQUE KEY` und nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
        INCLUDE TYPE ty_flight_key,
        planetype TYPE s_planetye,
        seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_flight_segment.
    TYPES:
      ty_flight_segments_ht TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_segment
                              WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_hashed_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_hashed_flights) TYPE ty_flight_segments_ht.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hashed_flights.
    rt_hashed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        planetype = ls_sflight-planetype
        seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_hashed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_hashed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_hashed_flights) = lo_cut->get_hashed_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_hashed_flights
      msg = 'Die Hash-Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein (sflights Daten vorausgesetzt).'
    ).

    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_hashed_flight_data=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).
    READ TABLE lt_hashed_flights FROM ls_key INTO DATA(ls_flight_segment).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight_segment-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Flugsegment mit Schlüssel LH gefunden.'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Kein Flugsegment mit dem Testschlüssel gefunden. Bitte sflights Daten prüfen.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Befüllung erfolgt effizient und deklarativ mittels eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks, der direkt Daten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle in die neue Hash-Tabelle transformiert. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Methode zur Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Typ für eine verschachtelte Tabelle (Fluggesellschaft mit ihren Flügen) und aggregieren Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft mit einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES` für verschachtelte Strukturen und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES:
      ty_flight_details_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_airline_flights,
        carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
        flights TYPE ty_flight_details_tt,
      END OF ty_airline_flights.
    TYPES:
      ty_airline_flights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_seats RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_seats) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(lt_airline_flights) = VALUE ty_airline_flights_tt(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flights = VALUE ty_flight_details_tt(
          FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight (
            connid = ls_group_flight-connid
            fldate = ls_group_flight-fldate
            seatsocc = ls_group_flight-seatsocc
          )
        )
      )
    ).

    rt_aggregated_seats = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_airline IN lt_airline_flights ( 
        key = ls_airline-carrid
        value = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                          FOR ls_flight_detail IN ls_airline-flights
                          NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight_detail-seatsocc )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_aggregated_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_aggregated_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated_seats) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_aggregated_seats
      msg = 'Die aggregierte Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein (sflights Daten vorausgesetzt).'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_aggregated_seats WITH TABLE KEY table_line = 'LH' INTO DATA(lv_lh_seats).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = lv_lh_seats
        msg = 'Gesamtsitze für LH sollten nicht 0 sein.'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Keine Aggregation für LH gefunden. Bitte sflights Daten prüfen.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Definition komplexer, verschachtelter Tabellentypen. Die Daten werden zunächst mit einem `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck gruppiert und dann mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator aggregiert. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art, Daten zu verarbeiten und zu transformieren, die den Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: TYPES, NESTED TABLE, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Range-Tabellentyp für Fluggesellschaften und füllen Sie ihn mit Werten, um eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für die `sflights`-Tabelle zu simulieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES RANGE OF` und `VALUE #(...)` für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_table_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      ty_range_carrid TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE ty_range_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflights_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_table_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrid_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_table_example( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE zcl_range_table_example=>ty_range_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_filtered_flights
      msg = 'Die gefilterte Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein (sflights Daten vorausgesetzt).'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid <> 'LH' AND ls_flight-carrid <> 'AA'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unerwartete Fluggesellschaft gefunden.' ).
      END IF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Definition eines Range-Tabellentyps (`TYPES RANGE OF`) und dessen Verwendung in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung mit der modernen Inline-Deklaration (`@it_carrid_range`). Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und typsichere Übergabe von Selektionskriterien, ähnlich wie bei `SELECT-OPTIONS`, aber programmatisch.
keywords: TYPES, RANGE, SELECT, WHERE, Internal Tables, Dynamic Selection

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Typ für einen dynamischen Business-Objekt-Schlüssel und verwenden Sie ihn zur Initialisierung des GOS-Managers. (Hinweis: Für einen echten Test ist ein existierendes Business-Objekt erforderlich).
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES` für eine Struktur, die den Objekt-Schlüssel repräsentiert, und `cl_gos_manager=>create_object_key`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_object_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_object_key,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_dynamic_object_key.

    METHODS create_gos_manager_with_dynamic_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        is_dynamic_key TYPE ty_dynamic_object_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_gos_manager) TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_object_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_gos_manager_with_dynamic_key.
    DATA: lv_object_key TYPE borident-objkey.

    " Simulate creation of object key from dynamic fields
    lv_object_key = |{ is_dynamic_key-field1 }{ is_dynamic_key-field2 }|.

    DATA(ls_borident) = VALUE borident(
      objtype = iv_object_type
      objkey  = lv_object_key
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT ro_gos_manager

Instructions: Rufen Sie die GOS-Dienste für ein Business-Objekt auf und filtern Sie die verfügbaren Dienste dynamisch basierend auf einem Typ. (Hinweis: Für einen echten Test ist ein existierendes Business-Objekt und eine GUI-Umgebung erforderlich).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gos_manager` und die Methode `get_services` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_services DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_service_info TYPE cl_gos_manager=>ty_service_info.
    TYPES: ty_service_info_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_service_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_gos_services
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
        iv_service_type_filter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_services) TYPE ty_service_info_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_services IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_gos_services.
    DATA: lo_gos_manager TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager.
    DATA: ls_borident    TYPE borident.
    DATA: lt_all_services TYPE ty_service_info_tt.

    ls_borident-objtype = iv_object_type.
    ls_borident-objkey  = iv_object_key.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_manager
      EXPORTING
        is_object = ls_borident
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gos_error.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_manager->get_services(
          IMPORTING
            et_service_info = lt_all_services
        ).

        rt_filtered_services = FILTER #( lt_all_services USING KEY primary_key WHERE service_type CP iv_service_type_filter ).

      CATCH cx_gos_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_gos_services FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_gos_services.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_dynamic_services( ).
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'BUS1001'.

    " Simulate some services for testing purposes
    DATA(lt_dummy_services) = VALUE zcl_gos_dynamic_services=>ty_service_info_tt(
      ( service_type = 'NOTE' service_id = '1' service_text = 'Notiz' )
      ( service_type = 'ATTA' service_id = '2' service_text = 'Anhang' )
      ( service_type = 'NOTE' service_id = '3' service_text = 'Weitere Notiz' )
    ).

    " Mock the get_services call (in a real scenario, this would interact with GOS)
    " For unit testing, we assume get_services returns some data.
    " In a real test, one might use test doubles or inject a mock GOS manager.
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_gos_services(
      iv_object_type = lv_object_type
      iv_object_key  = lv_object_key
      iv_service_type_filter = 'NOTE'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Notiz-Dienste gefunden werden.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[1]-service_type
      exp = 'NOTE'
      msg = 'Erster gefilterter Dienst ist falsch.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_diff_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_days_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_diff_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_difference.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_from) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date = iv_date_from ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_to)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date = iv_date_to ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
                               tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_to
                               tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_from ).
    rv_days = lv_diff_seconds / ( 24 * 3600 ). " Sekunden in Tage umrechnen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
