Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen Wert von einem bestimmten Feld in jeder Zeile einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei eine `FOR`-Schleife mit Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife und die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_subtractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS subtract_from_table
      IMPORTING
        it_items      TYPE tt_items
        iv_subtrahend TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_subtractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_table.
    rt_result_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_items
                                 ( id = ls_item-id
                                   value = ls_item-value - iv_subtrahend ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( id = 1 value = 100 )
      ( id = 2 value = 200 )
      ( id = 3 value = 50 )

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_seat_capacity_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_capacity_range) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_seat_capacity_range.
    SELECT SINGLE MAX( seatsmax ) AS max_seats,
                   MIN( seatsmax ) AS min_seats
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO @DATA(ls_capacity).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_capacity_range = ls_capacity-max_seats - ls_capacity-min_seats.
    ELSE.
      rv_capacity_range = 0. " Keine Daten gefunden
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die kumulative Differenz einer Zahlenreihe in einer internen Tabelle. Beginnen Sie mit einem Startwert und subtrahieren Sie nacheinander jeden Wert der Tabelle. Verwenden Sie einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `INIT`-Wert und der `NEXT`-Klausel, um die Subtraktion iterativ durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cumulative_subtractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_cumulative_diff
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_value TYPE i
        it_numbers     TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cumulative_subtractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cumulative_diff.
    rv_final_value = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = iv_start_value
      FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
      NEXT
        result = result - lv_number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Datumsangaben, wobei Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag) ausgeschlossen sind. Kapseln Sie die Logik in einer Klasse.
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und verwenden Sie Datumsarithmetik sowie die Funktion `cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week` und die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_workday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_between.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d,
          lv_day_of_week TYPE i.

    IF iv_date_from > iv_date_to.
      rv_workdays = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_date = iv_date_from.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_date_to.
      lv_day_of_week = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).
      " 1 = Montag, ..., 5 = Freitag, 6 = Samstag, 7 = Sonntag
      IF lv_day_of_week < 6. " Nicht Samstag oder Sonntag
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1. " Nächster Tag
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die absolute Differenz zwischen zwei Zahlen ohne Verwendung der Funktion `ABS`. Kapseln Sie die Logik in einer Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `IF`-Bedingung, um die größere Zahl zu identifizieren, und subtrahieren Sie dann die kleinere von der größeren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_absolute_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_absolute_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_abs_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_absolute_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_absolute_difference.
    IF iv_num1 >= iv_num2.
      rv_abs_diff = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
    ELSE.
      rv_abs_diff = iv_num2 - iv_num1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 msg = 'Absolute difference (positive) failed' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) so, dass nur Flüge übrig bleiben, deren maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) um einen bestimmten Wert reduziert immer noch über einem Mindestschwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie einen `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung innerhalb der Filterbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_reduction   TYPE i
        iv_min_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_capacity.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( seatsmax - iv_reduction ) > iv_min_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 100 )
    ).
    " Reduktion um 50, Min-Schwelle 100
    " AA: 150 - 50 = 100 (nicht > 100)
    " LH: 200 - 50 = 150 (> 100)
    " UA: 100 - 50 = 50 (nicht > 100)
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_capacity( it_all_flights = lt_input_flights
                                                              iv_reduction = 50
                                                              iv_min_threshold = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Filtered table size incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Filtered flight incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_flights_no_match.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 150 )
    ).
    " Reduktion um 100, Min-Schwelle 100
    " AA: 150 - 100 = 50 (nicht > 100)
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_capacity( it_all_flights = lt_input_flights
                                                              iv_reduction = 100
                                                              iv_min_threshold = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Filtered table should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_flights_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_capacity( it_all_flights = lt_input_flights
                                                              iv_reduction = 10
                                                              iv_min_threshold = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Filtered table should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature (7.40+) für die deklarative Filterung interner Tabellen. Hier wird eine Subtraktion direkt in der `WHERE`-Bedingung des Filters verwendet, um die Logik kompakt und lesbar zu halten. Dies ist ein Beispiel für funktionales Programmieren und verbessert die Performance bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: SUBTRACT, FILTER, INTERNAL TABLES, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, CLASS, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Dezimalzahlen mit hoher Präzision (`decfloat34`) und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Nachkommastellen. Kapseln Sie die Logik in einer Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `decfloat34` für hohe Präzision und die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_math=>round` für die Rundung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_high_precision_sub DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_and_round
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE decfloat34
        iv_num2 TYPE decfloat34
        iv_decimals TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_high_precision_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_and_round.
    DATA(lv_raw_result) = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
    rv_result = cl_abap_math=>round(
                  val       = lv_raw_result
                  decimals  = iv_decimals
                  mode      = cl_abap_math=>round_half_up ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_subtract_round_normal FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_subtract_round_half_up FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_subtract_round_negative FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_subtract_round_normal.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_high_precision_sub( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->subtract_and_round( iv_num1 = '100.123' iv_num2 = '50.001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '50.12' msg = 'Normal subtraction and rounding failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_subtract_round_half_up.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_high_precision_sub( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->subtract_and_round( iv_num1 = '100.125' iv_num2 = '50.000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '50.13' msg = 'Rounding half up failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_subtract_round_negative.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_high_precision_sub( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->subtract_and_round( iv_num1 = '50.000' iv_num2 = '100.125' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '-50.13' msg = 'Negative subtraction and rounding failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des Datentyps `decfloat34` für hochpräzise Dezimalberechnungen, was in modernen Finanzanwendungen unerlässlich ist. Die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung wird für die Differenzbildung verwendet, und `cl_abap_math=>round` bietet eine standardisierte und konfigurierbare Rundungsfunktion, die die älteren `ROUND`-Anweisungen ersetzt.
keywords: SUBTRACT, MATH, DECFLOAT34, ROUND, cl_abap_math, CLASS, PRECISION

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die moderne Deklaration und Verwendung von Konstanten innerhalb einer ABAP-Klasse.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Objekten (z.B. einem Flug und einem Kunden).
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>create_link.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_customer_key,
        kunnr TYPE kunnr,
      END OF ty_customer_key.

    METHODS create_flight_customer_link
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key   TYPE ty_sflight_key
        is_customer_key TYPE ty_customer_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_customer_link.
    DATA:
      lo_flight_object  TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lo_customer_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object.

    TRY.
        " Create objects for the relation
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                              i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                              i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        lo_customer_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                i_object_type = 'KNA1'
                                i_object_key  = is_customer_key-kunnr ).

        " Create the link
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            i_object_a = lo_flight_object
            i_object_b = lo_customer_object
            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER' " Custom relation type
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " In a real scenario, log the error or handle it appropriately
        " MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_link FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_link.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_create( ).
    DATA:
      ls_flight_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_sflight_key,
      ls_customer_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_customer_key.

    " Assuming SFLIGHT and KNA1 entries exist for testing
    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight_key-fldate = sy-datum. " Use a valid date

    ls_customer_key-kunnr = '0000000001'. " Use a valid customer number

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_flight_customer_link(
                          is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
                          is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Clean up the created link for repeatable tests (optional, but good practice)
    " For simplicity, this test only asserts creation. A full test would involve deletion.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: cl_binary_relation bietet eine generische Möglichkeit, Beziehungen zwischen beliebigen ABAP-Objekten zu verwalten. create_link erstellt eine neue Verknüpfung. Die Verwendung von cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key ermöglicht die Referenzierung von Objekten über ihren Typ und Schlüssel. COMMIT WORK ist entscheidend, um die Änderungen in der Datenbank zu persistieren.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, Object Services, Verknüpfung, Datenbank

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine spezifische binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Objekten existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>check_link_exists.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_customer_key,
        kunnr TYPE kunnr,
      END OF ty_customer_key.

    METHODS check_flight_customer_link
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key   TYPE ty_sflight_key
        is_customer_key TYPE ty_customer_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_customer_link.
    DATA:
      lo_flight_object  TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lo_customer_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                              i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                              i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        lo_customer_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                i_object_type = 'KNA1'
                                i_object_key  = is_customer_key-kunnr ).

        rv_exists = cl_binary_relation=>check_link_exists(
                      i_object_a = lo_flight_object
                      i_object_b = lo_customer_object
                      i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER' ).
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_link_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_check_link_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_link_exists.
    " Setup: Create a link first (using the previous example's logic)
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_create( ).
    DATA:
      ls_flight_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_sflight_key,
      ls_customer_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_customer_key.

    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0017'.
    ls_flight_key-fldate = sy-datum.

    ls_customer_key-kunnr = '0000000002'.

    lo_creator->create_flight_customer_link(
      is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
      is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).

    " Test: Check if the link exists
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_check( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_checker->check_flight_customer_link(
                          is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
                          is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ).

    " Teardown: Delete the link (for clean tests)
    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_delete( ). " Assuming a delete class exists
    lo_deleter->delete_flight_customer_link(
      is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
      is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_link_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_check( ).
    DATA:
      ls_flight_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_check=>ty_sflight_key,
      ls_customer_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_check=>ty_customer_key.

    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'XX'. " Non-existent flight
    ls_flight_key-connid = '9999'.
    ls_flight_key-fldate = sy-datum.

    ls_customer_key-kunnr = '9999999999'. " Non-existent customer

    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_checker->check_flight_customer_link(
                          is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
                          is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: check_link_exists ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Präsenz einer spezifischen binären Verknüpfung zu überprüfen, ohne die Verknüpfung selbst abrufen zu müssen. Dies ist nützlich, um Duplikate zu vermeiden oder bedingte Logik basierend auf der Existenz einer Beziehung zu implementieren.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, Object Services, Existenzprüfung, Verknüpfung

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle Kunden ab, die mit einem bestimmten Flug verknüpft sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object und cl_binary_relation=>get_related_objects.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_retrieve DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      ty_customer_kunnr_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF kunnr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_customers_for_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_customers) TYPE ty_customer_kunnr_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_retrieve IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_customers_for_flight.
    DATA:
      lo_flight_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lt_links         TYPE cl_binary_relation=>ty_t_links,
      lt_related_objects TYPE cl_binary_relation=>ty_t_objects.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                              i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                              i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        " Get all links where the flight is object A
        cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
          EXPORTING
            i_object        = lo_flight_object
            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER'
          IMPORTING
            et_links        = lt_links
        ).

        " Extract related customer objects (object B)
        LOOP AT lt_links INTO DATA(ls_link).
          APPEND ls_link-object_b TO lt_related_objects.
        ENDLOOP.

        " Get the keys of the related customer objects
        rt_customers = VALUE #( FOR <ls_obj> IN lt_related_objects
                                WHERE ( object_type = 'KNA1' )
                                ( <ls_obj>-object_key ) ).

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_customers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_customers.
    " Setup: Create some links
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_create( ).
    DATA:
      ls_flight_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_sflight_key,
      ls_customer_key1 TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_customer_key,
      ls_customer_key2 TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_customer_key.

    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'UA'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lo_retriever) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_retrieve( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_customers[ table_line = '0000000004' ] ). " Check if customer 4 is in the list

Instructions: Löschen Sie eine spezifische binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Objekten.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>delete_link.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_customer_key,
        kunnr TYPE kunnr,
      END OF ty_customer_key.

      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key   TYPE ty_sflight_key
        is_customer_key TYPE ty_customer_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flight_customer_link.
    DATA:
      lo_flight_object  TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lo_customer_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                              i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                              i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        lo_customer_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                i_object_type = 'KNA1'
                                i_object_key  = is_customer_key-kunnr ).

        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          EXPORTING
            i_object_a = lo_flight_object
            i_object_b = lo_customer_object
            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER'
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung mit zusätzlichen Attributen (z.B. eine Rolle des Kunden im Flug).
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>create_link mit dem Parameter i_attributes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_customer_key,
        kunnr TYPE kunnr,
      END OF ty_customer_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_relation_attributes,
        role TYPE string,
        booking_date TYPE d,
      END OF ty_relation_attributes.

    METHODS create_flight_customer_role
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key   TYPE ty_sflight_key
        is_customer_key TYPE ty_customer_key
        is_attributes   TYPE ty_relation_attributes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_relation_attributes
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key   TYPE ty_sflight_key
        is_customer_key TYPE ty_customer_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_attributes) TYPE ty_relation_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_customer_role.
    DATA:
      lo_flight_object  TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lo_customer_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lt_attributes     TYPE cl_binary_relation=>ty_t_attributes.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                  i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                                  i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        lo_customer_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                    i_object_type = 'KNA1'
                                    i_object_key  = is_customer_key-kunnr ).

        " Populate attributes
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_attributes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_attr>).
        <fs_attr>-attr_name = 'ROLE'.
        <fs_attr>-attr_value = is_attributes-role.

        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_attributes ASSIGNING <fs_attr>.
        <fs_attr>-attr_name = 'BOOKING_DATE'.
        <fs_attr>-attr_value = is_attributes-booking_date.

        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            i_object_a = lo_flight_object
            i_object_b = lo_customer_object
            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER_ROLE'
            i_attributes = lt_attributes
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_relation_attributes.
    DATA:
      lo_flight_object  TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lo_customer_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lt_links          TYPE cl_binary_relation=>ty_t_links,
      lt_attributes     TYPE cl_binary_relation=>ty_t_attributes.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                  i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                                  i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        lo_customer_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                    i_object_type = 'KNA1'
                                    i_object_key  = is_customer_key-kunnr ).

        cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
          EXPORTING
            i_object        = lo_flight_object
            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER_ROLE'
          IMPORTING
            et_links        = lt_links
        ).

        READ TABLE lt_links INTO DATA(ls_link) WITH KEY object_b = lo_customer_object.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          cl_binary_relation=>get_attributes_of_link(
            EXPORTING
              i_link_id   = ls_link-link_id
            IMPORTING
              et_attributes = lt_attributes
          ).

          READ TABLE lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr_role) WITH KEY attr_name = 'ROLE'.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rs_attributes-role = ls_attr_role-attr_value.
          ENDIF.

          READ TABLE lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr_date) WITH KEY attr_name = 'BOOKING_DATE'.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rs_attributes-booking_date = ls_attr_date-attr_value.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        CLEAR rs_attributes.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Konstanten in einer CASE-Anweisung, um verschiedene Aktionen basierend auf einem Statuswert auszuführen.
hint: Definieren Sie Status-Konstanten und nutzen Sie diese in CASE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_with_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_status_new     TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'N',
      gc_status_in_proc TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
      gc_status_complete TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C'.

    METHODS process_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_with_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_status.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN gc_status_new.
        rv_message = 'Neuer Eintrag erstellt.'.
      WHEN gc_status_in_proc.
        rv_message = 'Eintrag in Bearbeitung.'.
      WHEN gc_status_complete.
        rv_message = 'Eintrag abgeschlossen.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Status.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie Attribute einer bestehenden binären Verknüpfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>update_link_attributes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_customer_key,
        kunnr TYPE kunnr,
      END OF ty_customer_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_relation_attributes,
        role TYPE string,
        booking_date TYPE d,
      END OF ty_relation_attributes.

    METHODS update_flight_customer_role
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key   TYPE ty_sflight_key
        is_customer_key TYPE ty_customer_key
        is_new_attributes TYPE ty_relation_attributes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_customer_role.
    DATA:
      lo_flight_object  TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lo_customer_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lt_links          TYPE cl_binary_relation=>ty_t_links,
      lt_new_attributes TYPE cl_binary_relation=>ty_t_attributes.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                  i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                                  i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        lo_customer_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                    i_object_type = 'KNA1'
                                    i_object_key  = is_customer_key-kunnr ).

        cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
          EXPORTING
            i_object        = lo_flight_object
            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER_ROLE'
          IMPORTING
            et_links        = lt_links
        ).

        READ TABLE lt_links INTO DATA(ls_link) WITH KEY object_b = lo_customer_object.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Populate new attributes
          APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_new_attributes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_attr>).
          <fs_attr>-attr_name = 'ROLE'.
          <fs_attr>-attr_value = is_new_attributes-role.

          APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_new_attributes ASSIGNING <fs_attr>.
          <fs_attr>-attr_name = 'BOOKING_DATE'.
          <fs_attr>-attr_value = is_new_attributes-booking_date.

          cl_binary_relation=>update_link_attributes(
            EXPORTING
              i_link_id   = ls_link-link_id
              i_attributes = lt_new_attributes
          ).
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false. " Link not found
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Konstanten in FILTER-Ausdrücken, um interne Tabellen zu filtern.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator mit einer Konstante als Vergleichswert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_with_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        planetype TYPE s_planety,
        seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_min_occupied_seats TYPE s_seatsocc VALUE 50,
      gc_plane_type_jumbo   TYPE s_planety VALUE '747'.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE seatsocc > gc_min_occupied_seats
                                    AND planetype = gc_plane_type_jumbo ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_with_constants=>ty_sflight_tab.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '747' seatsocc = 60 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '747' seatsocc = 40 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '747' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_with_constants( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Die Verwendung von Konstanten in den WHERE-Bedingungen macht den Code lesbarer und einfacher zu warten, da die Filterkriterien klar benannt sind und zentral verwaltet werden können.
keywords: CONSTANTS, FILTER, Internal Tables, Funktionale Programmierung

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle Verknüpfungen eines bestimmten Typs ab, die ein Objekt als Objekt A oder Objekt B haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object mit i_object_a_or_b.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_any_side DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,

      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_links) TYPE ty_link_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_any_side IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flight_customer_links.
    DATA: lo_flight_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                  i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                                  i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
          EXPORTING
            i_object        = lo_flight_object
            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER'
            i_object_a_or_b = abap_true " Search if object is A or B
          IMPORTING
            et_links        = rt_links
        ).

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        CLEAR rt_links.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_create( ).
    DATA:

Instructions: Definieren Sie Konstanten für Fehlermeldungen in einer globalen Klasse und verwenden Sie diese in der Fehlerbehandlung.
hint: Verwenden Sie CLASS-CONSTANTS in einer globalen Klasse und referenzieren Sie diese.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_messages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_error_invalid_input TYPE string VALUE 'Eingabe ungültig.',
      gc_error_not_found     TYPE string VALUE 'Objekt nicht gefunden.',
      gc_error_permission    TYPE string VALUE 'Keine Berechtigung.'.

    METHODS get_error_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_messages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_message.
    CASE iv_error_code.
      WHEN 1.
        rv_message = gc_error_invalid_input.
      WHEN 2.
        rv_message = gc_error_not_found.
      WHEN 3.
        rv_message = gc_error_permission.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Fehlercode.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Example usage in another class
CLASS zcl_application_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      rv_result = zcl_error_messages=>gc_error_invalid_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    " ... further logic
    rv_result = 'Aktion erfolgreich ausgeführt.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_messages FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_application_logic_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_error_message( 1 ) exp = zcl_error_messages=>gc_error_invalid_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_error_message( 99 ) exp = 'Unbekannter Fehlercode.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_application_logic_error.
    DATA(lo_app) = NEW zcl_application_logic( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_app->perform_action( -5 ) exp = zcl_error_messages=>gc_error_invalid_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_app->perform_action( 10 ) exp = 'Aktion erfolgreich ausgeführt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die zentrale Definition von Fehlermeldungen als Konstanten in einer dedizierten Klasse oder einem Interface fördert die Konsistenz und erleichtert die Lokalisierung und Wartung. Anstatt Fehlermeldungen direkt im Code zu hardcodieren, wird auf die Konstanten referenziert, was den Code sauberer und robuster macht.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Error Handling, Fehlermeldungen, Zentralisierung

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Verknüpfungen eines bestimmten Typs, die mit einem Objekt verbunden sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>delete_links_of_object.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_delete_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_delete_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_all_flight_customer_links.
    DATA: lo_flight_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(

            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER'
        ).

    DATA:
      ls_flight_key   TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_sflight_key,

explanation: delete_links_of_object bietet eine effiziente Möglichkeit, alle Verknüpfungen eines bestimmten Typs zu löschen, die mit einem Objekt verbunden sind. keywords: cl_binary_relation, Object Services, Massenlöschung, Verknüpfung

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die Berechtigung für eine binäre Verknüpfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_binary_relation=>check_authorization.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_customer_key,
        kunnr TYPE kunnr,
      END OF ty_customer_key.

    METHODS check_link_authorization
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key   TYPE ty_sflight_key
        is_customer_key TYPE ty_customer_key
        iv_activity     TYPE actvt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_authorized) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_link_authorization.
    DATA:
      lo_flight_object  TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lo_customer_object TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation_object,
      lt_links          TYPE cl_binary_relation=>ty_t_links.

    TRY.
        lo_flight_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                  i_object_type = 'SFLIGHT'
                                  i_object_key  = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }{ is_flight_key-connid }{ is_flight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).

        lo_customer_object = cl_binary_relation_object=>create_by_key(
                                    i_object_type = 'KNA1'
                                    i_object_key  = is_customer_key-kunnr ).

        cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
          EXPORTING
            i_object        = lo_flight_object
            i_relation_type = 'FLIGHT_CUSTOMER'
          IMPORTING
            et_links        = lt_links
        ).

        READ TABLE lt_links INTO DATA(ls_link) WITH KEY object_b = lo_customer_object.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          cl_binary_relation=>check_authorization(
            EXPORTING
              i_link_id   = ls_link-link_id
              i_activity  = iv_activity
            EXCEPTIONS
              no_authorization = 1
              OTHERS           = 2
          ).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_authorized = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            rv_authorized = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          rv_authorized = abap_false. " Link not found
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        rv_authorized = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_authorization FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_check_authorization_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_authorization.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_create( ).
    DATA:
      ls_flight_key   TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_sflight_key,
      ls_customer_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_customer_key.

    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'SQ'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0012'.
    ls_flight_key-fldate = sy-datum.

    ls_customer_key-kunnr = '0000000011'.

    lo_creator->create_flight_customer_link(
      is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
      is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).

    DATA(lo_auth_checker) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_auth( ).
    " This test assumes the current user has authorization for activity '03' (display)
    " on the created link. In a real system, this would depend on actual roles.
    DATA(lv_authorized) = lo_auth_checker->check_link_authorization(
                              is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
                              is_customer_key = ls_customer_key
                              iv_activity = '03' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_authorized exp = abap_true ).

    " Teardown: Delete the link
    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_delete( ).
    lo_deleter->delete_flight_customer_link(
      is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
      is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_authorization_fail.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_create( ).
    DATA:
      ls_flight_key   TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_sflight_key,
      ls_customer_key TYPE zcl_binary_relation_create=>ty_customer_key.

    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'SQ'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0013'.
    ls_flight_key-fldate = sy-datum.

    ls_customer_key-kunnr = '0000000012'.

    lo_creator->create_flight_customer_link(
      is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
      is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).

    DATA(lo_auth_checker) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_auth( ).
    " This test assumes the current user does NOT have authorization for activity '06' (delete) if it's not granted.
    DATA(lv_authorized) = lo_auth_checker->check_link_authorization(
                              is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
                              is_customer_key = ls_customer_key
                              iv_activity = '06' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_authorized exp = abap_false ).

    " Teardown: Delete the link (even if auth check failed, link still exists)
    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_binary_relation_delete( ).
    lo_deleter->delete_flight_customer_link(
      is_flight_key = ls_flight_key
      is_customer_key = ls_customer_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: check_authorization ermöglicht die Überprüfung von Berechtigungen für eine spezifische binäre Verknüpfung basierend auf einer Aktivität (z.B. Anzeigen, Ändern, Löschen). Dies ist ein wichtiger Sicherheitsmechanismus, um sicherzustellen, dass nur autorisierte Benutzer auf Beziehungen zugreifen oder diese manipulieren können. Die Berechtigungsprüfung erfolgt über das Standard-ABAP-Berechtigungskonzept.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, Object Services, Berechtigung, Sicherheit

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in eine lokale Struktur, die nur ausgewählte Felder enthält, deren Namen mit denen in SFLIGHT übereinstimmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT SINGLE ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_data_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_corr_struct( ).
    " Assuming an entry for 'AA', '0017', '20250101' exists in SFLIGHT for testing.
    " In a real scenario, test data should be ensured or mocked.
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    IF ls_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-price ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Test data for AA 0017 20250101 not found in SFLIGHT. Please ensure it exists for this test.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_data_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_corr_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '19000101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` ermöglicht das direkte Füllen einer Zielstruktur mit Werten aus der Datenbank, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen berücksichtigt werden. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code für manuelle Zuweisungen und ist eine moderne, lesbare Methode.
keywords: SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, STRUCTURE, SFLIGHT, Database Access

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in eine interne Tabelle, die nur ausgewählte Felder enthält, deren Namen mit denen in SFLIGHT übereinstimmen.

CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Assuming 'AA' has entries in SFLIGHT for testing.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz in eine Struktur und prüfen Sie, ob der Datensatz gefunden wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT SINGLE ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ... und prüfen Sie sy-subrc.

CLASS zcl_sflight_single_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_result,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_result.

    METHODS get_flight_with_check
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      EXPORTING
        es_flight TYPE ty_sflight_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_single_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_check.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @es_flight
      WHERE carrid = @is_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis für eine Liste von Artikeln, wobei jeder Artikel eine Menge und einen Einzelpreis hat.

CLASS zcl_calc_total_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             quantity TYPE i,
             unit_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_total_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total.
    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      rv_total_price = rv_total_price + ( ls_item-quantity * ls_item-unit_price ). " Modern inline multiplication
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             quantity TYPE i,
             unit_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_reduce_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_reduce.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT total = '0.00'
      FOR ls_item IN it_items
      NEXT total = total + ( ls_item-quantity * ls_item-unit_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in SFLIGHT den Preis in einer anderen Währung (z.B. USD) berechnet, basierend auf einem festen Umrechnungskurs. Nutzen Sie den FOR-Operator.

CLASS zcl_for_multiply_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                      connid    = ls_flight-connid
                                      fldate    = ls_flight-fldate

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabattpreis für einen Artikel. Wenn der Originalpreis über einem Schwellenwert liegt, wird ein Rabattprozentsatz angewendet. Nutzen Sie den COND-Operator für die bedingte Multiplikation.
hint: Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator, um bedingt zu multiplizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_multiply_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE decfloat16
        iv_discount_rate  TYPE decfloat16 " e.g., 0.10 for 10%
        iv_threshold_price TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_multiply_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    rv_discounted_price = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN iv_original_price > iv_threshold_price
      THEN iv_original_price * ( '1.0' - iv_discount_rate )
      ELSE iv_original_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_multiply_discount( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( iv_original_price = '150.00' iv_discount_rate = '0.10' iv_threshold_price = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = '135.00' ). " 150 * 0.90
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die Implementierung von bedingter Logik in einem einzigen Ausdruck, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht. Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle, indem Sie für bestimmte Zeilen einen Wert mit einem Faktor multiplizieren. Nutzen Sie den FOR-Operator mit einer bedingten Zuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator mit `WHERE` und einer Multiplikation in der Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_update_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             price  TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_by_category
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
        iv_category TYPE string
        iv_factor   TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_update_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_by_category.
    rt_updated_products = VALUE #( FOR ls_product IN it_products
                                   ( COND #( WHEN ls_product-category = iv_category
                                             THEN CORRESPONDING ty_product( ls_product EXCEPT price ) WITH price = ls_product-price * iv_factor
                                             ELSE ls_product ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated[ id = 1 ]-price exp = '1100.00' ). " 1000 * 1.10
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated[ id = 2 ]-price exp = '55.00' ). " 50 * 1.10
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated[ id = 3 ]-price exp = '20.00' ). " No change

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Produkt aller Zahlen in einer Liste. Nutzen Sie den REDUCE Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE Operator, um das Produkt zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_product = '0.00'. " Product of an empty set is often 1, but for practical calculation, 0 is safer if no elements.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_product = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT result = '1.00'
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT result = result * number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle von Flugsegmenten aus SFLIGHT, wobei für jedes Segment die Anzahl der verfügbaren Sitze mit einem Faktor multipliziert wird, um eine potenzielle Überbuchung zu simulieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator mit einer Multiplikation für die Simulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_overbooking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_original,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_original.
    TYPES tt_sflight_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_original WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simulated,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             sim_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_simulated.
    TYPES tt_sflight_simulated TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simulated WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_overbooking
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_original
        iv_overbooking_factor TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_simulated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_simulated.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_overbooking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_overbooking.
    rt_simulated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                    ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
                                      connid       = ls_flight-connid
                                      fldate       = ls_flight-fldate
                                      sim_seatsocc = CONV s_seatsocc( ls_flight-seatsocc * iv_overbooking_factor )
                                      seatsmax     = ls_flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_original.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_simulated[ 2 ]-sim_seatsocc exp = 180 ). " 150 * 1.2

Die `CONV`-Funktion wird für die Typkonvertierung verwendet, um sicherzustellen, dass das Ergebnis dem Datentyp des Feldes entspricht. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Namen aller Komponenten (Felder) einer übergebenen internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit ermittelt und zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_components
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_components.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        rt_component_names = VALUE #( FOR comp IN lt_components ( comp-name ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error
            textid   = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_components FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_table_input RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_components.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_table_components( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_components ). " sflights is initially empty, so no components yet

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights.
    lt_components = lo_cut->get_table_components( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_components ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components exp = 'CONNID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_empty TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_table_components( lt_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_components ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_table_input.
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Hello'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_components( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_table_components( lv_string ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_dyn_table_error expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt RTTI, um die Struktur einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` liefert eine Typbeschreibung, aus der dann die Zeilentypbeschreibung (`get_table_line_type`) und schließlich die Komponenten (`get_components`) extrahiert werden. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, eine neue interne Tabelle zu füllen. Fehler werden mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` behandelt.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, get_components, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Exception Handling

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer übergebenen Strukturreferenz erstellt und mit Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS füllt. Die Spalten der Zieltabelle sollen dabei dynamisch aus der SFLIGHTS-Struktur ausgewählt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr`, `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO DATA
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_sflights     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflights     TYPE sflights,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_component_name TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_source_field>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_target_field>  TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Describe the structure of SFLIGHTS
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " 2. Create a new structure description for our dynamic table (e.g., only CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE)
    DATA(lt_target_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
      FOR comp IN lt_components
      WHERE ( comp-name = 'CARRID' OR comp-name = 'CONNID' OR comp-name = 'FLDATE' )
      ( comp )
    ).

    IF lt_target_components IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>no_components.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_target_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_target_struct_descr ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    " 4. Read data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ENDIF.

    " 5. Fill dynamic table
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflights.
      CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_target_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_target_components INTO DATA(ls_target_comp).
        lv_component_name = ls_target_comp-name.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflights TO <fs_source_field>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found
              component_name = lv_component_name.
        ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found
              component_name = lv_component_name.
        ENDIF.

        <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <fs_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn der Divisor Null ist. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme im aufrufenden Code ab.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: divisor TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_divisor TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->divisor = i_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          i_divisor = iv_divisor.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld sortiert. Wenn das Feld nicht existiert, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` zur Validierung des Feldnamens und `SORT itab BY (field_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN ct_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>no_table_bound.
    ENDIF.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ).
    lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lv_field_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp) WHERE name = iv_sort_field.
      lv_field_exists = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_exists = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found
          component_name = iv_sort_field.
    ENDIF.

    SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_sort_field).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_field_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_success.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).

    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_any_table = lt_sflights iv_sort_field = 'FLDATE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_any_table = lt_sflights iv_sort_field = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_field_not_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_any_table = lt_sflights iv_sort_field = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_dyn_table_error expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->component_name exp = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode ermöglicht das dynamische Sortieren einer internen Tabelle. Mittels RTTI (`cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr`) wird überprüft, ob das angegebene Sortierfeld in der Tabellenstruktur existiert. Dies verhindert Laufzeitfehler. Die eigentliche Sortierung erfolgt mit der dynamischen `SORT ... BY (field_name)`-Syntax. Wenn das Feld nicht gefunden wird, wird eine `cx_sy_dyn_table_error` ausgelöst, was eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung gewährleistet.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, SORT, cl_abap_structdescr, Exception Handling, cx_sy_dyn_table_error

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Datentyp (z.B. C, N, D, I) eines Feldes einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit ermittelt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die `type_kind` Eigenschaft der Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_type_kind
      IMPORTING
        is_any_structure TYPE ANY
        iv_field_name    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_kind) TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_kind.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_any_structure ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp) WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_type_kind = ls_comp-type_kind.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found
              component_name = iv_field_name.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error
            textid   = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Diese Methode nutzt RTTI, um den elementaren Datentyp (Type Kind) eines Feldes innerhalb einer beliebigen Struktur zu bestimmen. `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` liefert die Strukturdefinition, aus der die Komponenten extrahiert werden. Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `RAISE SHORTDUMP` für einen kritischen, nicht wiederherstellbaren Fehler in einer Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE SHORTDUMP` mit einer Nachricht und optionalen Parametern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_critical_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_critical_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_critical_action.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      " In a real scenario, this would be a truly unrecoverable error
      " e.g., a database connection failure, critical configuration missing.
      RAISE SHORTDUMP WITH MESSAGE ID 'ZMSG' TYPE 'E' NUMBER '001'
        WITH 'Critical input missing' 'Further details' 'Param3' 'Param4'.
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate some critical processing
    WRITE: / 'Critical action performed with input:', iv_input.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_critical_action_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_critical_action_shortdump FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_critical_action_success.
    DATA(lo_process) = NEW zcl_critical_process( ).
    lo_process->perform_critical_action( 'Valid Input' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ). " If no shortdump, it's a pass
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_critical_action_shortdump.
    DATA(lo_process) = NEW zcl_critical_process( ).
    " This test will cause a shortdump and thus fail the test run if not handled by the test framework.
    " For demonstration purposes, we expect a shortdump here.
    " In a real test environment, you might use specific test attributes or framework features
    " to assert that a shortdump occurs.
    " For ABAP Unit, a shortdump will terminate the test, so this test is more conceptual.
    " A practical test would involve checking for the shortdump in a separate system or log.
    " For simplicity, we'll just call it and expect it to not return.
    TRY.
        lo_process->perform_critical_action( '' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Shortdump expected, but method returned.' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        " This catch block will not be reached if a true shortdump occurs.
        " It's here to satisfy syntax, but the shortdump will bypass it.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Shortdump expected, but caught an exception.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `RAISE SHORTDUMP` ist eine moderne ABAP-Anweisung (ab 7.50), die verwendet wird, um einen nicht wiederherstellbaren Fehler zu signalisieren, der die aktuelle Verarbeitung sofort beendet und einen Shortdump erzeugt. Im Gegensatz zu `RAISE EXCEPTION` kann ein Shortdump nicht mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen werden. Dies ist ideal für kritische Systemfehler, die eine sofortige Analyse erfordern. Die Nachricht kann dynamisch mit Platzhaltern gefüllt werden.
keywords: Exception Handling, RAISE SHORTDUMP, Critical Error, Shortdump, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein übergebenes Datenobjekt vom Typ einer internen Tabelle ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_table_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE ANY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_table) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_table_type.
    DATA: lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).

      rb_is_table = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_is_table = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS inner_method
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
    METHODS outer_method
      RAISING
        zcx_outer_error.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD inner_method.
    " Simulate an error condition
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
      EXPORTING
        i_divisor = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD outer_method.
    TRY.
        inner_method( ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_inner).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_outer_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_inner.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
