Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS füllt und dann dynamisch einen Wert in einem bestimmten Feld jeder Zeile aktualisiert. Wenn das Feld nicht existiert, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight_line> TYPE sflights,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Read data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE rt_sflights.

    " 2. Check if field exists using RTTI
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( rt_sflights[ 1 ] ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lv_field_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp) WHERE name = iv_field_name.
      lv_field_exists = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_exists = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found
          component_name = iv_field_name.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Update field dynamically using FOR expression
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight_line> IN rt_sflights
                             ( LET lv_current_line = <fs_sflight_line> IN
                                 ( ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE lv_current_line TO <fs_target_field>.
                                   IF sy-subrc = 0.
                                     <fs_target_field> = iv_new_value.
                                   ENDIF.
                                   lv_current_line ) ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name`, `create` und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` mit Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_custom_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_custom_sflights_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO DATA
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_custom_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_custom_sflights_table.
    DATA: lo_sflights_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_sflights_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_target_components     TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_target_struct_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr           TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_sflights_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflights_data         TYPE sflights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_source_field>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_target_field>  TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Describe the structure of SFLIGHTS
    lo_sflights_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    lt_sflights_components = lo_sflights_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " 2. Build target components based on input field names and validate
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights_components INTO DATA(ls_sflights_comp) WITH KEY name = lv_field_name.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_sflights_comp TO lt_target_components.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found
            component_name = lv_field_name.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_target_components IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>no_components.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Create dynamic structure and table description
    lo_target_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_target_struct_descr ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    " 5. Read data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_data.

    " 6. Fill dynamic table
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data INTO ls_sflights_data.
      CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_target_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_target_components INTO DATA(ls_target_comp).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflights_data TO <fs_source_field>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <fs_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_search_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight_line> TYPE sflights,
                   <fs_field_value> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Read data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " 2. Check if field exists using RTTI
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights[ 1 ] ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lv_field_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp) WHERE name = iv_field_name.
      lv_field_exists = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_exists = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found
          component_name = iv_field_name.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Filter table dynamically
    rt_filtered_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight_line> IN lt_sflights
                                      WHERE ( ( ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_field_value> )
                                              AND ( <fs_field_value> = iv_search_value ) ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_transform_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_sflights_to_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_target_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO DATA
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.

CLASS zcl_rtti_transform_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights_to_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_sflights_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_sflights_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_target_components     TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_target_struct_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr           TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_sflights_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_sflights_line> TYPE sflights.

    " 1. Describe the structure of SFLIGHTS
    lo_sflights_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    lt_sflights_components = lo_sflights_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " 2. Build target components based on input field names and validate
    LOOP AT it_target_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights_components INTO DATA(ls_sflights_comp) WITH KEY name = lv_field_name.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_sflights_comp TO lt_target_components.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>component_not_found
            component_name = lv_field_name.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_target_components IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>no_components.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Create dynamic structure and table description
    lo_target_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_target_struct_descr ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    " 5. Read data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_data.

    " 6. Fill dynamic table using CORRESPONDING and MAPPING
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflights_line>.
      CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_target_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

      " Build dynamic mapping for CORRESPONDING

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_class_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_type_error.
    METHODS validate_interface_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_type_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_class_type.
    DATA: lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        IF lo_type_descr->is_kind_of( cl_abap_classdescr=>kind ) = abap_true.
          rb_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_type_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_dyn_type_error=>type_kind_mismatch
              type_name = iv_type_name.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_type_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_type_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error
            textid   = lx_error->textid
            type_name = iv_type_name.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_interface_type.
    DATA: lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        IF lo_type_descr->is_kind_of( cl_abap_intfdescr=>kind ) = abap_true.
          rb_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_type_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_dyn_type_error=>type_kind_mismatch
              type_name = iv_type_name.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_type_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_type_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error
            textid   = lx_error->textid
            type_name = iv_type_name.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create`, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und String-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_lowercase_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_sflights_to_lowercase
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO DATA
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_lowercase_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights_to_lowercase.
    DATA: lo_sflights_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_sflights_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_target_components     TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_target_struct_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr           TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_sflights_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_sflights_line> TYPE sflights.

    " 1. Describe the structure of SFLIGHTS
    lo_sflights_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    lt_sflights_components = lo_sflights_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " 2. Build target components with lowercase names
    lt_target_components = VALUE #( FOR comp IN lt_sflights_components
                                      ( name = to_lower( comp-name ) type = comp-type length = comp-length decimals = comp-decimals ) ).

    IF lt_target_components IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>no_components.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Create dynamic structure and table description
    lo_target_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_target_struct_descr ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    " 5. Read data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_data.

    " 6. Fill dynamic table using CORRESPONDING and MAPPING
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflights_line>.
      CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_target_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

      " Build dynamic mapping for CORRESPONDING
      DATA(lt_mapping) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>mapping_table(
        FOR comp IN lt_sflights_components ( target = to_lower( comp-name ) source = comp-name ) ).

      CORRESPONDING #( EXPORTING source = <fs_sflights_line>
                       MAPPING  lt_mapping
                       CHANGING  <fs_dynamic_line> ).

      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <fs_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO DATA
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_uppercase_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights_to_uppercase.
    DATA: lo_sflights_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_sflights_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_target_components     TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_target_struct_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr           TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_sflights_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_sflights_line> TYPE sflights.

    " 1. Describe the structure of SFLIGHTS
    lo_sflights_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    lt_sflights_components = lo_sflights_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " 2. Build target components with uppercase names
    lt_target_components = VALUE #( FOR comp IN lt_sflights_components
                                      ( name = to_upper( comp-name ) type = comp-type length = comp-length decimals = comp-decimals ) ).

    IF lt_target_components IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_error=>no_components.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Create dynamic structure and table description
    lo_target_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_target_struct_descr ).

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    " 5. Read data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_data.

    " 6. Fill dynamic table using CORRESPONDING and MAPPING
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflights_line>.
      CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_target_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

      " Build dynamic mapping for CORRESPONDING
      DATA(lt_mapping) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>mapping_table(
        FOR comp IN lt_sflights_components ( target = to_upper( comp-name ) source = comp-name ) ).

      CORRESPONDING #( EXPORTING source = <fs_sflights_line>
                       MAPPING  lt_mapping
                       CHANGING  <fs_dynamic_line> ).

      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <fs_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Textdatei zeilenweise vom Applikationsserver und speichern Sie jede Zeile in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN DATASET`, `READ DATASET` und `CLOSE DATASET`.

CLASS zcl_file_read_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS read_file_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_file_content) TYPE tt_lines
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_read_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_to_table.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'File could not be opened.'.
    ENDIF.
    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_line TO rt_file_content.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einer Liste von Textzeilen alle Zeilen, die eine E-Mail-Adresse enthalten, und geben Sie die E-Mail-Adressen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `MATCH` Operator mit einem regulären Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_extract_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING
        it_text_lines TYPE tt_lines
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE tt_lines.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex) = ` [A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,} `.
    LOOP AT it_text_lines INTO DATA(lv_line).
      IF lv_line MATCH REGEX lv_regex.
        FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX lv_regex IN lv_line MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset) MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_length).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND lv_line+lv_offset(lv_length) TO rt_emails.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Dateinamen, indem Sie nur die `.txt`-Dateien auswählen und deren vollständige Pfade zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` oder `FILTER` mit String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_list_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_file_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_file_list
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_files TYPE tt_file_names
        iv_base_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_txt_files) TYPE tt_file_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_list_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_file_list.
    rt_txt_files = VALUE #( FOR file_name IN it_raw_files
                             WHERE ( file_name CS '.txt' )
                             ( |{ iv_base_path }/{ file_name }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Methode dynamisch aus, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_message = rv_message.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error.
        rv_message = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or callable.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_a.
    rv_text = 'Method A executed.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_text = 'Method B executed.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( 'METHOD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Method A executed.' ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( 'METHOD_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Method B executed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Method ''NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'' not found or callable.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf `CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name)` ermöglicht es, den Namen der aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für flexible Architekturen und Plugin-Systeme. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Reflection, Method Call

Instructions: Laden Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHT) als CSV-Datei auf das Frontend herunter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` und moderne Tabellenverarbeitung für die CSV-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsv_download_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_sflight_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_frontend_services_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsv_download_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflight_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lv_csv_data TYPE string.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Build CSV header
    lv_csv_data = |CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC;SEATSFREE{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.

    " Build CSV data using REDUCE and String Templates
    lv_csv_data = lv_csv_data &&
                  REDUCE string(
                    INIT s = ``
                    FOR <fs_line> IN lt_sflight
                    NEXT s = s && |{ <fs_line>-carrid };{ <fs_line>-connid };{ <fs_line>-fldate };{ <fs_line>-price };{ <fs_line>-currency };{ <fs_line>-planetype };{ <fs_line>-seatsmax };{ <fs_line>-seatsocc };{ <fs_line>-seatsfree }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|
                  ).

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = iv_filename
            filetype                = 'ASC'
            has_field_separator     = abap_true
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = VALUE string_table( ( lv_csv_data ) )
        ).
      CATCH cx_frontend_services_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_frontend_services_error(
          text = |Fehler beim Herunterladen der Datei: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_download_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_download_error EXPECTED EXCEPTION cx_frontend_services_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_download_success.
    " This test can only verify that the call doesn't dump,
    " as actual file download requires user interaction.
    " In a real scenario, you might mock cl_gui_frontend_services.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsv_download_csv( ).
    lo_cut->download_sflight_csv( |C:\temp\sflight_test_{ sy-uzeit }.csv| ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_download_error.
    " Simulate an error by passing an invalid path (e.g., root directory without permissions)

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` für den Dateidownload. Die CSV-Daten werden effizient mit `REDUCE` und `String Templates` aus einer internen Tabelle generiert, was eine moderne und kompakte Syntax darstellt. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt über `TRY...CATCH`.
keywords: cl_gui_frontend_services, GUI_DOWNLOAD, REDUCE, String Templates, File Handling, CSV

Instructions: Laden Sie eine CSV-Datei vom Frontend hoch und parsen Sie deren Inhalt in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload` und `SPLIT` für das Parsen der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsv_upload_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_upload,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight_upload.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_upload TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_upload WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS upload_csv_to_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_upload
      RAISING
        cx_frontend_services_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsv_upload_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_csv_to_sflight.
    DATA: lt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    DATA: ls_sflight_line TYPE ty_sflight_upload.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = iv_filename
            filetype                = 'ASC'
            has_field_separator     = abap_true
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = lt_file_content
        ).
      CATCH cx_frontend_services_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_frontend_services_error(
          text = |Fehler beim Hochladen der Datei: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Skip header line
    DELETE lt_file_content INDEX 1.

    LOOP AT lt_file_content INTO DATA(lv_line).
      SPLIT lv_line AT ';' INTO
        ls_sflight_line-carrid
        ls_sflight_line-connid
        ls_sflight_line-fldate
        ls_sflight_line-price
        ls_sflight_line-currency
        ls_sflight_line-planetype
        ls_sflight_line-seatsmax
        ls_sflight_line-seatsocc
        ls_sflight_line-seatsfree.
      APPEND ls_sflight_line TO rt_sflight_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_upload_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_upload_error EXPECTED EXCEPTION cx_frontend_services_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upload_success.
    " This test requires a dummy CSV file to exist on the frontend for a real test.
    " For demonstration, we'll simulate a file content.
    " In a real scenario, you might mock cl_gui_frontend_services.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsv_upload_csv( ).
    " Create a dummy file for testing purposes (manual step or mock)
    " Example content:
    " CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC;SEATSFREE
    " LH;0400;20250101;100.00;EUR;A320;150;100;50
    " AA;0017;20250101;200.00;USD;B747;300;250;50
    " Assuming 'C:\temp\sflight_upload_test.csv' exists with above content.
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->upload_csv_to_sflight( |C:\temp\sflight_upload_test.csv| ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Upload einer CSV-Datei vom Frontend mittels `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload`. Die hochgeladenen Zeilen werden anschließend mit `SPLIT` in die Struktur `ty_sflight_upload` geparst und in eine interne Tabelle eingefügt. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt über `TRY...CATCH`.

Instructions: Führen Sie ein externes Programm auf dem Frontend aus (z.B. Notepad mit einer Textdatei).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute` und `String Templates` für die Parameterübergabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsv_execute_program DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_notepad
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_frontend_services_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsv_execute_program IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_notepad.
    DATA(lv_program) = 'notepad.exe'.
    DATA(lv_parameters) = |"{ iv_filepath }"|. " Enclose filepath in quotes for spaces

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute(
          EXPORTING
            application = lv_program
            parameter    = lv_parameters
            minimized   = abap_false
            maximized   = abap_false
            synchronous = abap_false " Execute asynchronously
        ).
      CATCH cx_frontend_services_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_frontend_services_error(
          text = |Fehler beim Ausführen von '{ lv_program }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lv_button TYPE i.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer internen Tabelle zugreift und diese verarbeitet. Verwenden Sie dabei Feld-Symbole und `UNASSIGN` Sie das Feld-Symbol nach jeder Verwendung explizit.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_fs_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_table_component
      IMPORTING
        it_data      TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_component TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_fs_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table_component.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Komponente '{ iv_component }' nicht gefunden.|.
      ENDIF.
      " Beispielverarbeitung: Inhalt in den Demo-Output schreiben
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Komponente '{ iv_component }' Wert: { <fs_component> }| ).
      UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Explizites Unassign nach Gebrauch
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_sflights_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_component EXPECTED EXCEPTION cx_sy_assign_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_sflights_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_fs_unassign( ).
    lo_cut->process_table_component( it_data = lt_sflights iv_component = 'CARRID' ).
    " Für diesen Test wird nur geprüft, ob keine Ausnahme auftritt.
    " Eine detailliertere Prüfung würde den Inhalt von cl_demo_output mocken oder auslesen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Platzhalter-Assert
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_component.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROW.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_fs_unassign( ).
    lo_cut->process_table_component( it_data = lt_sflights iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf eine Strukturkomponente innerhalb einer internen Tabelle mittels Feld-Symbolen. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` wird verwendet, um das Feld-Symbol `<fs_component>` dynamisch zuzuweisen. `UNASSIGN` wird explizit aufgerufen, um das Feld-Symbol nach jeder Iteration freizugeben. Obwohl in modernen ABAP-Versionen Feld-Symbole oft automatisch den Gültigkeitsbereich verlassen, kann `UNASSIGN` für explizite Ressourcenfreigabe oder in speziellen Performance-Szenarien verwendet werden.
keywords: Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, UNASSIGN, ASSIGN COMPONENT, cl_demo_output

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsv_file_copy( ).
    " Create a dummy source file
    DATA: lt_dummy_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string VALUE `('Source content')`.
    DATA(lv_source_file) = |C:\temp\source_file_{ sy-uzeit }.txt|.
    DATA(lv_target_file) = |C:\temp\target_file_{ sy-uzeit }.txt|.

        ).
      CATCH cx_frontend_services_error.
    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen durch Kommas getrennten String in einzelne Wörter auf und konvertieren Sie jedes Wort in Großbuchstaben. Sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse in einer internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_str_csv_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_table) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_str_csv_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_upper.
    DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_csv_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rt_result_table = VALUE string_table(
                        FOR <fs> IN lt_parts
                        WHERE ( <fs> IS NOT INITIAL )
                        ( to_upper( <fs> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_path_segment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_path TYPE string

CLASS zcl_str_path_segment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_segment.
    DATA(lt_segments) = VALUE string_table( ).

Instructions: Gegeben ist ein String, der Zahlen und andere Zeichen enthält (z.B. "10 EUR, 20 USD; 50 JPY"). Extrahieren Sie alle numerischen Werte und berechnen Sie deren Summe.
hint: Verwenden Sie FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX, um alle Zahlen zu finden, und REDUCE, um sie zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_sum_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_numbers_in_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_sum_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numbers_in_string.
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_input_string RESULTS lt_matches.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
               INIT total_sum = 0
               FOR <fs> IN lt_matches
               NEXT total_sum = total_sum + CONV i( iv_input_string+<fs>-offset(<fs>-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch Semikolons getrennte Elemente enthält. Filtern Sie alle leeren oder nur aus Leerzeichen bestehenden Einträge heraus und geben Sie die bereinigte Liste zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie SPLIT INTO TABLE und anschließend eine FOR-Schleife mit VALUE und LET, um die unerwünschten Einträge zu entfernen und zu kondensieren.

CLASS zcl_str_filter_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_split_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_list) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_filter_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_split_string.
    DATA(lt_raw_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_raw_parts.

    rt_filtered_list = VALUE string_table(
                         FOR <fs> IN lt_raw_parts
                         LET lv_trimmed = condense( <fs> ) IN
                         WHERE ( lv_trimmed IS NOT INITIAL )
                         ( lv_trimmed ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem geeigneten Muster, um alle Wörter zu extrahieren, und `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` mit `INSERT` für Eindeutigkeit und Sortierung.

CLASS zcl_str_multi_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_unique_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_words) TYPE sorted TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_multi_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_unique_words.
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.
    " Regex to find sequences of word characters (letters, numbers, underscore)
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\w+' IN iv_input_string RESULTS lt_matches.

    rt_unique_words = VALUE #(
                        FOR <fs> IN lt_matches
                        LET lv_word = iv_input_string+<fs>-offset(<fs>-length) IN
                        ( lv_word ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie Schlüssel-Wert-Paare aus einem String im Format "key1=value1;key2=value2". Speichern Sie diese Paare in einer Hash-Tabelle (Hashed Table).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` zweimal: zuerst nach dem Semikolon, dann nach dem Gleichheitszeichen. Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` für die Konstruktion der Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_key_value_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_value_pair,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_value_pair.
    TYPES: ty_key_value_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_key_value_pair WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS parse_key_value_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_value_map) TYPE ty_key_value_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_key_value_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_key_value_string.
    DATA(lt_pairs_raw) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_pairs_raw.

    rt_key_value_map = VALUE ty_key_value_map(
                         FOR lv_pair_raw IN lt_pairs_raw
                         LET lv_trimmed_pair = condense( lv_pair_raw ) IN
                         WHERE ( lv_trimmed_pair IS NOT INITIAL )
                         ( LET lt_kv_parts = VALUE string_table( )
                               lv_key      = ``
                               lv_value    = `` IN
                             SPLIT lv_trimmed_pair AT '=' INTO TABLE lt_kv_parts.
                             IF lines( lt_kv_parts ) = 2.
                               lv_key = condense( lt_kv_parts[1] ).
                               lv_value = condense( lt_kv_parts[2] ).
                             ENDIF.
                             WHERE ( lv_key IS NOT INITIAL )
                             ( key = lv_key, value = lv_value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String per Regex.
hint: Nutzen Sie `split` mit Regex-Objekt oder Workarounds in älteren Versionen, hier modern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_regex IMPORTING iv_val TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_res) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_regex.
    " Modern ABAP doesn't have functional REGEX split built-in simply like other langs yet without classes.
    " Using FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX and substring is the modern way to achieve this.
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[^,]+' IN iv_val RESULTS lt_matches.
    rt_res = VALUE string_table(
               FOR <fs> IN lt_matches
               ( substring( val = iv_val off = <fs>-offset len = <fs>-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in zwei Teile an der ersten gefundenen Zahl. Der erste Teil enthält alles vor der Zahl, der zweite Teil die Zahl und den Rest des Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` mit `REGEX` und `substring` oder `segment`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_at_number DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_split_result,
             part1 TYPE string,
             part2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_split_result.

    METHODS split_at_first_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_split_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_at_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_at_first_number.
    DATA: ls_match TYPE match_result.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\d' IN iv_input_string RESULTS ls_match.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_result-part1 = iv_input_string(ls_match-offset).
      rs_result-part2 = iv_input_string+ls_match-offset.
    ELSE.
      rs_result-part1 = iv_input_string.
      rs_result-part2 = ''.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in eine interne Tabelle auf, wobei der Delimiter ein Leerzeichen ist. Entfernen Sie dabei alle leeren Einträge, die durch mehrere aufeinanderfolgende Leerzeichen entstehen könnten.

CLASS zcl_str_split_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_space
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_space.
    DATA(lt_raw_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ' ' INTO TABLE lt_raw_parts.

    rt_words = VALUE string_table(
                 FOR <fs> IN lt_raw_parts
                 WHERE ( <fs> IS NOT INITIAL )
                 ( <fs> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_segments) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_quoted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_ignoring_quotes.
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.
    DATA: lv_regex_pattern TYPE string.

    " Regex to split by delimiter, but not if delimiter is inside quotes.
    " This regex matches either a quoted string OR a sequence of non-delimiter characters.
    " It's a simplified approach, a full CSV parser would be more complex.
    " For example, to split by comma, ignoring commas in quotes:
    " (?:"[^"]*"|[^,])+
    " This example will focus on extracting segments that are NOT the delimiter.
    " A more robust solution for splitting would involve CL_ABAP_REGEX and iterating.

    " Let's simplify for demonstration: find segments that are not the delimiter
    " and are not part of a quoted string (this is a common simplification).
    " A true split-ignoring-quotes is very complex with single regex.
    " A common pattern for splitting by comma outside quotes is: ,(?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*$)
    " However, ABAP's FIND ALL OCCURRENCES doesn't directly support splitting, but finding tokens.

    " Let's use a simpler approach: find sequences of characters that are not the delimiter,
    " or quoted strings. This is more about tokenizing than splitting.
    " For a true split, we'd need to iterate and manage state.

    " Alternative: Find all parts that are NOT the delimiter, and handle quotes separately.
    " This is a common workaround for lack of direct regex split.
    " Let's assume the delimiter is a single character for simplicity.
    lv_regex_pattern = |"[^"]*"| && '|' && |[^|{ iv_delimiter }]+|.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_input_string RESULTS lt_matches.

    rt_segments = VALUE string_table(
                    FOR <fs> IN lt_matches
                    ( substring( val = iv_input_string off = <fs>-offset len = <fs>-length ) ) ).

    " Post-processing to remove quotes if they were part of the match
    rt_segments = VALUE string_table(
                    FOR lv_segment IN rt_segments
                    ( COND string(
                        WHEN lv_segment CP '"*"' THEN lv_segment+1(strlen(lv_segment)-2)
                        ELSE lv_segment ) ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der Regex-Pattern muss so konstruiert sein, dass er entweder einen in Anführungszeichen stehenden String oder eine Sequenz von Nicht-Delimiter-Zeichen matcht. Die anschließende Post-Verarbeitung mit `VALUE` und `COND` entfernt die Anführungszeichen von den extrahierten Segmenten. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle von Ganzzahlen.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <num> IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + <num> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche Flugdauer für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `COUNT`, `AVG` und `GROUP BY` in Kombination mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        avg_fltime  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid,
           COUNT(*) AS flight_count,
           AVG(fltime) AS avg_fltime
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_summary
      msg = 'Summary table should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_error
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = ls_aa_summary
      msg = 'Summary for carrier AA not found'
    ).
    IF ls_aa_summary IS BOUND.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count
        msg = 'Flight count for AA should not be initial'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_aa_summary-avg_fltime
        msg = 'Average flight time for AA should not be initial'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = ls_lh_summary
      msg = 'Summary for carrier LH not found'
    ).
    IF ls_lh_summary IS BOUND.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count
        msg = 'Flight count for LH should not be initial'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_lh_summary-avg_fltime
        msg = 'Average flight time for LH should not be initial'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration (`@DATA(...)`) in Open SQL ab ABAP 7.40 vereinfacht das Lesen von Datenbanktabellen erheblich, da keine explizite Deklaration der Zielvariablen mehr erforderlich ist. In Kombination mit Aggregatfunktionen (`COUNT`, `AVG`) und `GROUP BY` können komplexe Datenanalysen direkt in der Datenbank durchgeführt und die Ergebnisse effizient in eine interne Tabelle geladen werden.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Aggregation, GROUP BY, SFLIGHT, NUMBER

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) für die Anzeige in einem ALV vor, indem Sie eine zusätzliche Spalte für den 'Status' basierend auf der Flugdauer hinzufügen (z.B. 'Kurz' für FLTIME < 100, 'Mittel' für FLTIME < 300, 'Lang' sonst).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `COND` für die Transformation und die Inline-Deklaration von Strukturen.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime   TYPE sflight-fltime,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_alv.
    TYPES tt_flights_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_alv_data
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flights_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_alv_data) TYPE tt_flights_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_alv_data.
    rt_alv_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_raw_flights
                             ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                               connid = ls_flight-connid
                               fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                               fltime = ls_flight-fltime
                               status = COND string(
                                          WHEN ls_flight-fltime < 100 THEN 'Kurz'
                                          WHEN ls_flight-fltime < 300 THEN 'Mittel'
                                          ELSE 'Lang' )
                             ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittswert einer internen Tabelle von Dezimalzahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu bilden, und teilen Sie dann durch die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR <num> IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + <num> ).
    IF lines( it_numbers ) > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lines( it_numbers ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen aus einem String und ersetzen Sie mehrere Leerzeichen innerhalb des Strings durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONDENSE` mit der Option `NO-GAPS` und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.

CLASS zcl_str_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_str_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input.
    CONDENSE rv_cleaned_string NO-GAPS.
    rv_cleaned_string = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein übergebener Integer-Wert innerhalb der gültigen Grenzen des Typs `i` liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value` und `get_max_value` für die Grenzwerte und vergleichen Sie den Eingabewert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_validate_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_integer IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_validate_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_integer.
    DATA(lv_min) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 'i' ).
    DATA(lv_max) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( 'i' ).

    IF iv_value >= lv_min AND iv_value <= lv_max.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_valid_integer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_valid_integer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_validate_int( ).

    " Test valid value
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->is_valid_integer( 100 ),
      msg = '100 should be valid'
    ).

    " Test min value
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->is_valid_integer( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 'i' ) ),
      msg = 'Min value should be valid'
    ).

    " Test max value
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->is_valid_integer( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( 'i' ) ),
      msg = 'Max value should be valid'
    ).

    " Note: For a method accepting TYPE i, any value passed is by definition within the valid range of type i.
    " A more meaningful test for boundary violations would involve converting from a larger type or external input.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine praktische Anwendung von `cl_abap_exceptional_values` zur Validierung von Werten. Durch den Abruf der typspezifischen Grenzwerte kann sichergestellt werden, dass ein Wert innerhalb des zulässigen Bereichs liegt. Dies ist eine robuste Methode zur Vermeidung von Dateninkonsistenzen oder Laufzeitfehlern. Beachten Sie, dass bei der Übergabe eines Werts vom Typ `i` an die Methode `is_valid_integer` dieser Wert bereits innerhalb der Grenzen des Typs `i` liegt. Ein sinnvollerer Anwendungsfall wäre die Validierung eines Werts, der aus einer externen Quelle oder einem größeren Datentyp stammt.
keywords: cl_abap_exceptional_values, Validation, Conditional Logic, Data Integrity

Instructions: Finden Sie den minimalen und maximalen Flugpreis in einer Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_exceptional_values` für die Initialwerte.
hint: Initialisieren Sie die `REDUCE`-Variablen für Min und Max mit den extremen Werten für den Preis-Typ (`sflight-price`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_reduce_min_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_range,
             min_price TYPE s_price,
             max_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_price_range.

    METHODS get_price_range
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_range) TYPE ty_price_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_reduce_min_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_range.
    rs_range = REDUCE ty_price_range(
      INIT
        min_p = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( 's_price' )
        max_p = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 's_price' )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT
        min_p = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price < min_p THEN <fs_flight>-price ELSE min_p )
        max_p = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > max_p THEN <fs_flight>-price ELSE max_p )
      FINALLY
        min_price = min_p
        max_price = max_p
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_price_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_price_range.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_exc_reduce_min_max=>ty_sflight_tab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_reduce_min_max( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '50.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '250.75' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum price = '75.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(ls_range) = lo_cut->get_price_range( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_range-min_price,
      exp = '50.50',
      msg = 'Min price should be 50.50'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_range-max_price,
      exp = '250.75',
      msg = 'Max price should be 250.75'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_exc_reduce_min_max=>ty_sflight_tab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_reduce_min_max( ).

    DATA(ls_range) = lo_cut->get_price_range( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_range-min_price,
      exp = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( 's_price' ),
      msg = 'Min price for empty table should be max possible'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_range-max_price,
      exp = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 's_price' ),
      msg = 'Max price for empty table should be min possible'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation von Tabellendaten mit `cl_abap_exceptional_values` zur sicheren Initialisierung der Minimal- und Maximalwerte. Dies ist ein modernes und funktionales Muster, um Aggregationen in internen Tabellen effizient und robust durchzuführen, insbesondere wenn die Tabelle leer sein könnte.

CLASS zcl_ins_for_value_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_ins_for_value_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_multiple_flights.
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                             ( carrid   = 'AA'
                               connid   = CONV s_conn_id( 100 + i )
                               fldate   = sy-datum + i
                               price    = CONV s_price( 150 + ( i * 10 ) )

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `sflights` ein, aber nur, wenn der Datensatz noch nicht existiert.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ins_db_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ins_db_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_if_not_exists.

      rv_success = abap_true.

      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA: BEGIN OF gs_test_flight,
            carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
            connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
            fldate   TYPE s_date,
            price    TYPE s_price,
            currency TYPE s_currcode,
          END OF gs_test_flight.

    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_new_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    gs_test_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = gs_test_flight-carrid AND connid = gs_test_flight-connid AND fldate = gs_test_flight-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = gs_test_flight-carrid AND connid = gs_test_flight-connid AND fldate = gs_test_flight-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_new_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_db_insert( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_if_not_exists( gs_test_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success,
      msg = 'New flight should be inserted successfully'
    ).

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_check_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @gs_test_flight-carrid
        AND connid = @gs_test_flight-connid
        AND fldate = @gs_test_flight-fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = sy-subrc,
      msg = 'Flight should exist in DB'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_db_insert( ).

    " First insert the flight
    INSERT sflights FROM CORRESPONDING #( gs_test_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = sy-subrc,
      msg = 'Pre-condition: First insert should be successful'
    ).

    " Try to insert the same flight again
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_if_not_exists( gs_test_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_success,
      msg = 'Existing flight should not be inserted again'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Verwendung von `INSERT` für Datenbanktabellen mit dem `CORRESPONDING`-Operator, um Daten aus einer Struktur direkt in die Datenbankzeile zu übertragen. Die Überprüfung von `sy-subrc` nach dem `INSERT` ist entscheidend, um festzustellen, ob der Datensatz erfolgreich eingefügt wurde (sy-subrc = 0) oder ob ein Duplikatfehler auftrat (sy-subrc = 4).
keywords: INSERT, Database, sy-subrc, CORRESPONDING, Data Persistence

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten aus einer Quellstruktur in eine interne Zieltabelle ein, wobei die Feldzuordnung automatisch über `CORRESPONDING` erfolgt.

CLASS zcl_ins_corresponding_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrier   TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES ty_target_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight_from_source
      IMPORTING
        is_source_data TYPE ty_source_data
      CHANGING
        ct_target_flights TYPE ty_target_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_corresponding_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_from_source.
    INSERT CORRESPONDING #( is_source_data
                             MAPPING carrid = carrier
                                     connid = flight_id
                                     fldate = flight_date
                             EXCEPT status ) INTO TABLE ct_target_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_default_min_val DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight_with_min_defaults
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date OPTIONAL
        iv_price    TYPE s_price OPTIONAL
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode OPTIONAL
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_default_min_val IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_with_min_defaults.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid   = COND #( WHEN iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_carrid ELSE cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 's_carr_id' ) )
                    connid   = COND #( WHEN iv_connid IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_connid ELSE cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 's_conn_id' ) )
                    fldate   = COND #( WHEN iv_fldate IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_fldate ELSE cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 's_date' ) )
                    price    = COND #( WHEN iv_price IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_price ELSE cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 's_price' ) )
                    currency = COND #( WHEN iv_currency IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_currency ELSE cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 's_currcode' ) ) )
           INTO TABLE ct_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Zeilen einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur Zeilen übernommen werden, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ins_filter_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
        iv_min_price      TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_filter_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_filtered_flights.
    INSERT LINES OF ( FILTER ty_sflight_tab FROM it_source_flights
                               WHERE price > iv_min_price ) INTO TABLE rt_target_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_ins_filter_insert=>ty_sflight_tab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_filter_insert( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '50.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '250.75' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_source.

      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Target table should contain 2 filtered entries'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid,
      exp = 'LH',

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'UA',

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in modernem ABAP, um interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. In diesem Beispiel wird er direkt im `INSERT LINES OF`-Statement verwendet, um nur die gefilterten Zeilen einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle zu kopieren. CLASS zcl_ins_sorted_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             key_field TYPE i,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sorted_line.

        iv_key    TYPE i
        iv_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data   TYPE ty_sorted_tab.

CLASS zcl_ins_sorted_insert IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_to_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_duplicate_key FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_to_sorted_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_ins_sorted_insert=>ty_sorted_tab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_sorted_insert( ).

    lo_cut->add_to_sorted_table( iv_key = 3 iv_value = 'Three' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).
    lo_cut->add_to_sorted_table( iv_key = 1 iv_value = 'One' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).
    lo_cut->add_to_sorted_table( iv_key = 2 iv_value = 'Two' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_data ),
      exp = 3,
      msg = 'Table should contain 3 entries'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 1 ]-key_field,
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'First entry key should be 1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 2 ]-key_field,
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Second entry key should be 2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 3 ]-key_field,
      exp = 3,
      msg = 'Third entry key should be 3'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_duplicate_key.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_ins_sorted_insert=>ty_sorted_tab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_sorted_insert( ).

    lo_cut->add_to_sorted_table( iv_key = 1 iv_value = 'One' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).
    lo_cut->add_to_sorted_table( iv_key = 1 iv_value = 'Duplicate One' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_data ),
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'Table should still contain 1 entry due to unique key'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = sy-subrc,
      exp = 4,
      msg = 'sy-subrc should be 4 for duplicate key insertion'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine sortierte interne Tabelle (`SORTED TABLE`) ohne Angabe eines `INDEX` wird die neue Zeile automatisch an der korrekten Position eingefügt, um die Sortierreihenfolge beizubehalten. Bei Tabellen mit `UNIQUE KEY` wird ein Duplikatfehler (`sy-subrc = 4`) ausgelöst, wenn versucht wird, eine Zeile mit einem bereits vorhandenen Schlüssel einzufügen. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um sortierte Datenmengen zu verwalten.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Tables, Sorted Table, Unique Key, sy-subrc

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei die Zeilen der Quelltabelle nach dem Einfügen gelöscht werden.

CLASS zcl_ins_move_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_line,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_line.
    TYPES ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS move_lines_between_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_lines_to_move TYPE ty_data_tab
      CHANGING
        ct_source_table  TYPE ty_data_tab
        ct_target_table  TYPE ty_data_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_move_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD move_lines_between_tables.
    INSERT LINES OF it_lines_to_move INTO TABLE ct_target_table AND DELETE FROM ct_source_table.

CLASS zcl_exc_validate_dec DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dec_bounds,
             min_val TYPE decfloat34,
             max_val TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_dec_bounds.

    METHODS get_dec_bounds RETURNING VALUE(rs_bounds) TYPE ty_dec_bounds.

CLASS zcl_exc_validate_dec IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dec_bounds.
    rs_bounds-min_val = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 'decfloat34' ).
    rs_bounds-max_val = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( 'decfloat34' ).

  METHOD is_valid_decimal.
    DATA(lv_min) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( 'decfloat34' ).
    DATA(lv_max) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( 'decfloat34' ).

    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value >= lv_min AND iv_value <= lv_max THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Für jede Fluggesellschaft soll eine eindeutige UUID generiert und den Flügen dieser Gesellschaft zugeordnet werden. Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach dieser UUID und geben Sie die UUID und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und eine Map für die UUID-Zuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_grouping_classrun DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .

  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS zcl_uuid_grouping_classrun IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_uuid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             uuid   TYPE sysuuid_c,
           END OF ty_sflight_uuid.
    TYPES tt_sflight_uuid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_uuid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_sflights_with_uuid) = VALUE tt_sflight_uuid(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      LET lv_uuid = COND sysuuid_c( WHEN NOT line_exists( lt_sflights_with_uuid[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ] ) THEN cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )
                                     ELSE lt_sflights_with_uuid[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ]-uuid )
      IN
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        uuid   = lv_uuid )
    ).

    " Alternative: Use a map to store UUIDs per carrid first
    DATA(lt_sflights_with_uuid_map) = VALUE tt_sflight_uuid(
      LET lt_carrids = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid(
                         FOR GROUPS OF carrid IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY carrid
                         ( carrid ) )
          lt_carrid_uuids = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_uuid-uuid
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                                  ( FOR ls_carrid IN lt_carrids ( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( ) ) )
      IN
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        uuid   = lt_carrid_uuids[ ls_sflight-carrid ] )
    ).

    out->write( 'Flüge gruppiert nach UUID der Fluggesellschaft:' ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_with_uuid_map INTO DATA(ls_flight_uuid)
         GROUP BY ls_flight_uuid-uuid ASCENDING
         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).

      DATA(lv_count) = GROUP SIZE IN <fs_group>.
      out->write( |UUID: { <fs_group>-uuid }, Flüge: { lv_count }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD test_uuid_grouping.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_uuid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             uuid   TYPE sysuuid_c,
           END OF ty_sflight_uuid.
    TYPES tt_sflight_uuid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_uuid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_sflights_with_uuid_map) = VALUE tt_sflight_uuid(
      LET lt_carrids = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid(
                         FOR GROUPS OF carrid IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY carrid
                         ( carrid ) )
          lt_carrid_uuids = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_uuid-uuid
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                                  ( FOR ls_carrid IN lt_carrids ( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( ) ) )
      IN
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        uuid   = lt_carrid_uuids[ ls_sflight-carrid ] )
    ).

    DATA(lv_unique_uuids) = 0.
    DATA(lt_grouped_results) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_uuid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_with_uuid_map INTO DATA(ls_flight_uuid)
         GROUP BY ls_flight_uuid-uuid ASCENDING
         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      lv_unique_uuids = lv_unique_uuids + 1.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_grouped_results ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_grouped_line>).
      <fs_grouped_line>-uuid = <fs_group>-uuid.
      <fs_grouped_line>-carrid = <fs_group>-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_distinct_carrids) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_raw_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_raw_flight-carrid.
      lv_distinct_carrids = lv_distinct_carrids + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_uuids exp = lv_distinct_carrids
                                        msg = 'Anzahl der eindeutigen UUIDs sollte der Anzahl der Fluggesellschaften entsprechen' ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_results INTO DATA(ls_grouped_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_grouped_entry-uuid is_initial = abap_false
                                          msg = 'Gruppen-UUID sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ausführbare ABAP-Klasse, die eine Hashed Table verwendet, um Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` zu speichern, wobei jede Zeile eine generierte UUID als eindeutigen Schlüssel hat. Fügen Sie einige Einträge hinzu und lesen Sie einen Eintrag über die UUID aus.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Hashed Table mit `UNIQUE HASHED KEY` und verwenden Sie `VALUE #()` zum Befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table_classrun DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun .

  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table_classrun IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_uuid,
             uuid   TYPE sysuuid_c,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_uuid.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hashed_uuid TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_uuid
                                   WITH UNIQUE KEY uuid.

    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_flights_by_uuid) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed_uuid(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( ),
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate )
    ).

    out->write( 'Hashed Table Einträge:' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights_by_uuid INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      out->write( |UUID: { ls_entry-uuid }, Flug: { ls_entry-carrid } { ls_entry-connid }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lines( lt_flights_by_uuid ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_first_uuid) = lt_flights_by_uuid[ 1 ]-uuid.
      out->write( |\nVersuche, Eintrag mit UUID '{ lv_first_uuid }' zu lesen:| ).

      TRY.
          DATA(ls_found_entry) = lt_flights_by_uuid[ uuid = lv_first_uuid ].
          out->write( |Gefunden: { ls_found_entry-carrid } { ls_found_entry-connid }| ).
        CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
          out->write( 'Eintrag nicht gefunden.' ).
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
