Instructions: Extrahieren Sie Datum, Zeit, Level und Nachricht aus einer Logzeile im Format `[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS] [LEVEL] MESSAGE` und geben Sie diese als Struktur zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie Capturing Groups im Regex-Muster, um die einzelnen Bestandteile zu erfassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_parse_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             log_date TYPE string,
             log_time TYPE string,
             log_level TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

    METHODS parse_log_line
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_parse_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_line.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) (\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\] \[([A-Z]+)\] (.*)' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) = abap_true.
      rs_log_entry-log_date  = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_log_entry-log_time  = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_log_entry-log_level = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
      rs_log_entry-message   = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 4 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Passwort als 'stark' gilt. Ein starkes Passwort muss mindestens 8 Zeichen lang sein und Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben, eine Zahl und ein Sonderzeichen enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `cl_abap_matcher`-Instanzen oder ein komplexes Regex mit Lookaheads für die verschiedenen Kriterien.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_strong_password DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_strong_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_password TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_strong) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_strong_password IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_strong_password.
    " Mindestens 8 Zeichen
    IF strlen( iv_password ) < 8.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Enthält Großbuchstaben
    DATA(lo_regex_upper) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '[A-Z]' ).
    IF lo_regex_upper->create_matcher( text = iv_password )->match( ) = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Enthält Kleinbuchstaben
    DATA(lo_regex_lower) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '[a-z]' ).
    IF lo_regex_lower->create_matcher( text = iv_password )->match( ) = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Enthält eine Zahl
    DATA(lo_regex_digit) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\d' ).
    IF lo_regex_digit->create_matcher( text = iv_password )->match( ) = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Enthält ein Sonderzeichen (hier: alles außer Buchstaben und Zahlen)
    DATA(lo_regex_special) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '[^a-zA-Z0-9]' ).
    IF lo_regex_special->create_matcher( text = iv_password )->match( ) = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_is_strong = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_format_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_image_format.
    DATA: ls_image_info TYPE cl_fxs_image_info=>ty_s_image_info.

    TRY.
        cl_fxs_image_info=>get_image_info(
          EXPORTING
            i_image_data = iv_image_data
          IMPORTING
            e_image_info = ls_image_info
        ).

        IF ls_image_info-mime_type = 'image/jpeg' OR
           ls_image_info-mime_type = 'image/png'.
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info_error. " Invalid image data will raise this exception
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String eine gültige URL enthält, die mit 'http://' oder 'https://' beginnt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit einem Pattern, das den Anfang des Strings und das URL-Format prüft.

CLASS zcl_regex_url_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_valid_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_url) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_url_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_valid_url.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = 'https?://(www\.)?[-a-zA-Z0-9@:%._\+~#=]{1,256}\.[a-zA-Z0-9()]{1,6}\b([-a-zA-Z0-9()@:%_\+.~#?&//=]*)' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    rv_has_url = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Hashtags (Wörter, die mit '#' beginnen) aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und `find_all` mit einem Pattern, das '#' und nachfolgende Wortzeichen erfasst.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_hashtags DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_hashtags
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashtags) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_hashtags IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_hashtags.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '#\w+' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    rt_hashtags = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches ( substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_multiple_hashtags FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_hashtags FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_hashtags_with_punctuation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_multiple_hashtags.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_hashtags( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_hashtags( 'Dies ist ein #Beispieltext mit #mehreren #Hashtags.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = '#Beispieltext' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = '#mehreren' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = '#Hashtags' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_hashtags.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_hashtags( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_hashtags( 'Keine Hashtags hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hashtags_with_punctuation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_hashtags( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_hashtags( 'Ein #Test! #ABAP-Code.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = '#Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = '#ABAP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Regex-Muster `#\w+` ist eine effiziente Methode, um Hashtags zu identifizieren, die mit '#' beginnen und von einem oder mehreren Wortzeichen gefolgt werden. Die Kombination mit `find_all` und einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte Extraktion aller Vorkommen.
keywords: REGEX, String Processing, Hashtags, Extract, cl_abap_regex, cl_abap_matcher, FOR

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle HTML-Tags aus einem gegebenen String, um reinen Text zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und die Methode `replace` mit einem Pattern für HTML-Tags.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_remove_html DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_html_tags
      IMPORTING
        iv_html_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_plain_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_remove_html IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_html_tags.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '<[^>]+>' ). " Matches any HTML tag
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_html_string ).
    rv_plain_text = lo_matcher->replace( new_sub = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String eine gültige IPv4-Adresse enthält.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein Regex-Muster, das die Struktur einer IPv4-Adresse (vier Oktette, durch Punkte getrennt) validiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_ipv4_address
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_ipv4) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_ipv4_address.
    " Regex for an IPv4 address: (0-255).(0-255).(0-255).(0-255)
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\b(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\b' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    rv_has_ipv4 = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_no_ipv4 FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_check( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_ipv4_address( 'Die IP ist 192.168.1.100' ) msg = 'Valid IPv4' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_ipv4_address( '0.0.0.0' ) msg = 'Valid IPv4' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_ipv4_address( '255.255.255.255' ) msg = 'Valid IPv4' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_ipv4_address( '256.0.0.0' ) msg = 'Invalid octet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_ipv4_address( '192.168.1' ) msg = 'Too few octets' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_ipv4_address( '192.168.1.1.1' ) msg = 'Too many octets' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_ipv4_address( '192.168.1.abc' ) msg = 'Non-numeric octet' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_ipv4_address( 'Keine IP hier.' ) msg = 'No IPv4 in text' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die nur Flüge nach 'NEW YORK' enthält und nur die Felder CARRIER, CONNECTION_ID und FLIGHT_DATE. Die neue Tabelle soll eine Standardtabelle sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einer FOR-Schleife und einer WHERE-Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ny_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ny_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flights.
    rt_ny_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights WHERE ( cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
                               ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                 connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                 fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_ny_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ny_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityto = 'NEW YORK' fldate = sy-datum )
                                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityto = 'LONDON' fldate = sy-datum )
                                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' cityto = 'NEW YORK' fldate = sy-datum ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_ny_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und Flugnummer ('0400') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten mittels binärer Suche. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Tabelle vor der Suche sortiert ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... BINARY SEARCH. Die Tabelle muss vorher nach den Schlüsselfeldern sortiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_flight_binary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_found_flight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_binary.
    DATA lt_sflights_sorted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    lt_sflights_sorted = it_sflights.
    SORT lt_sflights_sorted BY carrid connid fldate.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_sorted INTO rs_found_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate
      BINARY SEARCH.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_non_existing_flight RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_search( ).
    DATA(ld_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = ld_fldate cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
                                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = ld_fldate cityfrom = 'LONDON' ) ).

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->find_flight_binary( it_sflights = lt_sflights
                                                  iv_carrid = 'LH'
                                                  iv_connid = '0400'
                                                  iv_fldate = ld_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_search( ).
    DATA(ld_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = ld_fldate ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      EXPORTING
        class = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
      ACT = cl_abap_unit_assert=>run_test_method( 
        lo_cut->find_flight_binary( it_sflights = lt_sflights
                                    iv_carrid = 'XX'
                                    iv_connid = '9999'
                                    iv_fldate = ld_fldate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: BINARY SEARCH ist eine performante Methode, um Einträge in einer *sortierten* internen Tabelle zu finden. Es ist entscheidend, die Tabelle vor der Suche nach den Schlüsselfeldern zu sortieren, um die korrekte Funktionalität und den Performance-Vorteil zu gewährleisten. Obwohl die Syntax von READ TABLE älter ist, ist die Option BINARY SEARCH weiterhin relevant für die Optimierung.
keywords: BINARY SEARCH, READ TABLE, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Factory Pattern für die Erstellung von Objekten, die ein gemeinsames Interface implementieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein Interface für die Produkte und eine Factory-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode zur Objekterzeugung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.

  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_create_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown product type: { iv_product_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_factory_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_pattern.
    DATA(lo_product_a) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product_a->get_name( ) exp = 'Product A' ).

    DATA(lo_product_b) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product_b->get_name( ) exp = 'Product B' ).

    TRY.
        zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'C' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for unknown product type' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_create_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory Pattern entkoppelt die Objekterzeugung von der Verwendung und ermöglicht eine flexible Erweiterung um neue Produkttypen, ohne bestehenden Client-Code ändern zu müssen. Interfaces sind hier der Schlüssel zur Abstraktion.
keywords: INTERFACE, Factory Pattern, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, CLASS-METHODS

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_row_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rs_sflight_data) TYPE sflight.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_row_access IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine generische Datenreferenz empfängt und deren Inhalt über ein Feldsymbol ausliest und als String zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs>` und `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref` für RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_generic_data
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_generic_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          rv_content = |
            Content: { <fs_data> }
            Type: { cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data )->get_relative_name( ) }|.
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
          rv_content = 'Cannot convert data to string or describe type'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_content = 'Data reference is invalid or initial'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_with_initial_ref FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lr_string) = REF #( lv_string ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_generic_data( lr_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Hello World' in_string = lv_result
                                        msg = 'Should contain string content' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'STRING' in_string = lv_result
                                        msg = 'Should identify type as STRING' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_integer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_integer) = 42.
    DATA(lr_integer) = REF #( lv_integer ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_generic_data( lr_integer ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '42' in_string = lv_result
                                        msg = 'Should contain integer content' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'I' in_string = lv_result
                                        msg = 'Should identify type as I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_initial_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_data_processor( ).
    DATA lr_initial TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_generic_data( lr_initial ).

                                        msg = 'Should handle initial reference' ).

explanation: Die Kombination aus `ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>` und RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) über `cl_abap_typedescr` ermöglicht es, generische Methoden zu schreiben, die mit beliebigen Datenreferenzen arbeiten können. Dies ist ein Eckpfeiler für flexible Frameworks und Tools.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine interne Tabelle und anschließend auf ein spezifisches Feld einer Zeile dieser Tabelle zu, wobei beide Namen zur Laufzeit als Strings vorliegen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM)TABLE_NAME') TO <fs_table>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_field_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_table_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    DATA gt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_index      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @gt_flights UP TO 5 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND iv_index > 0 AND iv_index <= lines( <fs_table> ).
      ASSIGN <fs_table>[ iv_index ] TO <fs_table_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_table_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie den Speicherverbrauch von zwei Variablen unterschiedlichen Typs (`string` vs. `c` Feld) mit gleichem Inhalt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data` für jede Variable.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_type_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_comparison,
             string_size TYPE i,
             char_size   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_memory_comparison.

    METHODS compare_string_and_char_memory
      IMPORTING
        iv_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_comparison) TYPE ty_memory_comparison.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_type_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_string_and_char_memory.
    DATA lv_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_char   TYPE c LENGTH 255.

    lv_string = iv_content.
    lv_char = iv_content.

    rs_comparison-string_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data( lv_string ).
    rs_comparison-char_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data( lv_char ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_difference FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_content FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_type_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_comparison) = lo_cut->compare_string_and_char_memory( 'A relatively long string content for comparison' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-string_size > ls_comparison-char_size )
                                       msg = 'String should consume more memory than fixed-length char' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-string_size > 0 )
                                       msg = 'String size should be positive' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-char_size > 0 )
                                       msg = 'Char size should be positive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_type_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_comparison) = lo_cut->compare_string_and_char_memory( '' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-string_size > ls_comparison-char_size )
                                       msg = 'String should still consume more memory even if empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-string_size > 0 )
                                       msg = 'Empty string size should be positive (overhead)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comparison-char_size exp = 255
                                        msg = 'Empty char size should be its defined length' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verdeutlicht, dass `string`-Variablen aufgrund ihrer dynamischen Natur in der Regel mehr Speicher verbrauchen als fest definierte `c`-Felder, selbst bei gleichem Inhalt. `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data` ist hier entscheidend für die Analyse.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über eine interne Tabelle, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und verarbeiten Sie jede Zeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM)TABLE_NAME') TO <fs_table>` und `LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    DATA gt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @gt_flights UP TO 5 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        " Simulate processing, e.g., read a field
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Do something with <fs_carrid>
          rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie den Speicherverbrauch einer Standardtabelle und einer Hash-Tabelle mit der gleichen Anzahl von Einträgen und Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data` für beide Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_itab_type_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value_fld TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_comparison,
             standard_table_size TYPE i,
             hashed_table_size   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_memory_comparison.

    METHODS compare_table_types_memory
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_comparison) TYPE ty_memory_comparison.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_itab_type_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_types_memory.
    DATA lt_standard_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_hashed_table   TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    LOOP AT VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO iv_num_entries (
                       key_field = |Key_{ i }|
                       value_fld = |Value for entry { i }|
                     ) ) INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      INSERT ls_entry INTO TABLE lt_standard_table.
      INSERT ls_entry INTO TABLE lt_hashed_table.
    ENDLOOP.

    rs_comparison-standard_table_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data( lt_standard_table ).
    rs_comparison-hashed_table_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data( lt_hashed_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_type_memory_diff FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_type_memory_diff.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_itab_type_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_comparison) = lo_cut->compare_table_types_memory( 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-hashed_table_size > ls_comparison-standard_table_size )
                                       msg = 'Hashed table should consume more memory due to hash management' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-standard_table_size > 0 )
                                       msg = 'Standard table size should be positive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_tables.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_itab_type_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_comparison) = lo_cut->compare_table_types_memory( 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-hashed_table_size > ls_comparison-standard_table_size )
                                       msg = 'Hashed table overhead even when empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_comparison-standard_table_size > 0 )
                                       msg = 'Empty standard table has some overhead' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht den Speicherverbrauch verschiedener interner Tabellentypen. Hash-Tabellen benötigen in der Regel mehr Speicher als Standardtabellen, da sie zusätzliche Datenstrukturen für die Hash-Verwaltung vorhalten müssen. `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data` hilft, diese Unterschiede zu quantifizieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch setzt, wobei der Feldname und der Wert als Strings übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und `cl_abap_typedescr` zur Typüberprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_field_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure  TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_field_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    TRY.
        <fs_field> = iv_value.
        rb_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        " Handle conversion error if value cannot be assigned to field type
        rb_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie den Speicherverbrauch einer internen Tabelle vor und nach dem Hinzufügen einer großen Anzahl von Zeilen, um den inkrementellen Speicherbedarf zu ermitteln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data` und vergleichen Sie die Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_incremental_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry,
           tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_incremental_memory
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_entries TYPE i
        iv_additional_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_memory_delta) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_incremental_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_incremental_memory.
    DATA lt_log TYPE tt_log_entries.
    DATA lv_size_before TYPE i.
    DATA lv_size_after TYPE i.

    " Initial population
    lt_log = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO iv_initial_entries (
                        timestamp = cl_abab_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( )
                        message = |Initial log entry { i }|
                      ) ).

    lv_size_before = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data( lt_log ).

    " Add more entries
    LOOP AT VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO iv_additional_entries (
                       timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( )
                       message = |Additional log entry { i }|
                     ) ) INTO DATA(ls_new_entry).
      INSERT ls_new_entry INTO TABLE lt_log.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_size_after = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_data( lt_log ).

    rs_memory_delta = lv_size_after - lv_size_before.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle empfängt und deren Zeilen dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld sortiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM)TABLE_NAME') TO <fs_table>` und `SORT <fs_table> BY (lv_field_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sort_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sort_data,
           tt_sort_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sort_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA gt_data TYPE tt_sort_data.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS sort_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE tt_sort_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    gt_data = VALUE #( ( id = 3 name = 'C' value = 30 )
                       ( id = 1 name = 'A' value = 10 )
                       ( id = 2 name = 'B' value = 20 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    rt_sorted_data = gt_data.
    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
          " Handle error if field does not exist or is not sortable
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    rt_sorted_data = <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und erhöhen Sie den Preis (`price`) für alle Flüge, deren Währung (`currency`) 'EUR' ist, um 10%. Verwenden Sie dabei Feld-Symbole für den Zugriff auf die Tabellenzeilen und Komponenten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_flight> TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_price>  TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      IF <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO <fs_price>.
        IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_price> = <fs_price> * '1.10'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_data_ref IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lr_flight_data TYPE REF TO sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_flight_struct> TYPE sflight,

    lr_flight_data->* = is_flight.

    ASSIGN lr_flight_data->* TO <fs_flight_struct>.
    IF <fs_flight_struct> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight_struct> TO <fs_carrid>.

CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Preise (`price`) für Flüge in der internen Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'AA' (American Airlines) durchgeführt werden. Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression und greifen Sie auf die Zeilen über ein Feld-Symbol zu.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) und Flugnummern (`connid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die von 'UA' (United Airlines) durchgeführt werden. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und Feld-Symbolen, um die Ergebnisse zu gruppieren.
hint: `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_ua_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_ua_flights.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS <fs_group> OF <fs_flight> IN it_flights
        WHERE ( carrid = 'UA' )
        GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
        ASCENDING
      ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid,
        connids = VALUE #(
          FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP <fs_group>
          ( <fs_member>-connid )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` die Flugnummern auflistet, die mehr als 100 freie Sitze haben. Nutzen Sie dafür geschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen äußeren `FOR`-Ausdruck für Fluggesellschaften und einen inneren `FOR`-Ausdruck für Flüge, kombiniert mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflights WHERE ( seatsocc < seatsmax - 100 ) ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
        connids = VALUE #( 
          FOR <fs_grouped_flight> IN GROUP <fs_flight>
          ( <fs_grouped_flight>-connid )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    " Mock SFLIGHTS data for reproducible test
    DATA(lt_mock_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 200 ) " 150 free
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 200 ) " 50 free
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 150 ) " 140 free
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150 ) " 50 free
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 100 ) " 90 free
    ).
    " In a real scenario, you'd use test doubles or inject data.
    " For this example, we assume SFLIGHTS is accessible or mocked globally.
    " Since SFLIGHTS is a global table, direct mocking is complex for a simple example.
    " The test will run against actual SFLIGHTS data.
    " For demonstration, let's assume SFLIGHTS has some data matching the criteria.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_for( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( ).

    " Assertions will depend on actual SFLIGHTS data.
    " Example: Check if LH has at least one flight with >100 free seats
    DATA(lv_found_lh) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      IF lines( ls_summary-connids ) > 0.
        lv_found_lh = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_lh msg = 'LH should have flights with >100 free seats' ).

    " Check for AA
    DATA(lv_found_aa) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO ls_summary WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
      IF lines( ls_summary-connids ) > 0.
        lv_found_aa = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_aa msg = 'AA should have flights with >100 free seats' ).

    " Check for UA (assuming it has no flights with >100 free seats based on mock)
    DATA(lv_found_ua) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO ls_summary WHERE carrid = 'UA'.
      IF lines( ls_summary-connids ) > 0.
        lv_found_ua = abap_true;
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_found_ua msg = 'UA should not have flights with >100 free seats' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere über alle Flüge in einer geschachtelten internen Tabelle, die Sie zuvor mit dem `VALUE`-Operator erstellt haben. Nutzen Sie dafür den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen äußeren `REDUCE`-Operator, um über die Flüge zu iterieren, und einen inneren `REDUCE`-Operator (oder `LINES OF`), um die Passagiere pro Flug zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger.
    TYPES: tt_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers TYPE tt_passengers,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flight_data
      NEXT total = total + lines( ls_flight-passengers )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten so, dass nur Flüge übrig bleiben, die mindestens einen Passagier mit einem bestimmten Namen enthalten.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger.
    TYPES: tt_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers TYPE tt_passengers,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_passenger
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_passenger_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_passenger.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      it_flight_data
      WHERE ( 
        LINE_EXISTS( passengers[ name = iv_passenger_name ] )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die dynamische Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols zu einer Komponente einer Struktur und dessen anschließende Freigabe (`UNASSIGN`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und anschließend `UNASSIGN <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS process_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_result = |Component '{ iv_component_name }' has value: { <fs_component> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Component '{ iv_component_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Explicitly unassign the field symbol

    " After unassign, <fs_component> is no longer assigned.
    " Any attempt to use it without re-assignment would lead to a dump.
    " For demonstration, we just return rv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unassign_effect FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_unassign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field(
      is_data = ls_test_data
      iv_component_name = 'FIELD1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Component ''FIELD1'' has value: Hello' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field(
      is_data = ls_test_data
      iv_component_name = 'FIELD2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'Component ''FIELD2'' has value: 123' ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field(
      is_data = ls_test_data
      iv_component_name = 'NONEXISTENT'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 'Component ''NONEXISTENT'' not found.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unassign_effect.
    " This test primarily checks that the method runs without dump,
    " implying UNASSIGN works as expected. Direct testing of UNASSIGN's
    " internal effect is not straightforward in ABAP Unit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_unassign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Test' field2 = 456 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_field(
      is_data = ls_test_data
      iv_component_name = 'FIELD1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Check no dump occurred
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNASSIGN` wird verwendet, um die Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols zu einem Speicherbereich explizit aufzuheben. Dies ist wichtig in dynamischen Szenarien, um Ressourcen freizugeben oder um sicherzustellen, dass ein Feldsymbol nicht versehentlich auf einen alten, möglicherweise ungültigen Speicherbereich zeigt.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als generischen Parameter akzeptiert, die erste Zeile liest und dann das Feldsymbol freigibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IMPORTING it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE` und `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_line_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_first_line_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_line_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE it_any_table INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Convert the content of the generic line to a string for return
      " This requires careful handling as <fs_line> can be any type.
      " For simplicity, we'll assume it can be converted to string.
      " In a real scenario, RTTI would be used for type-safe conversion.
      TRY.
          rv_first_line_content = |{ <fs_line> }|.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          rv_first_line_content = 'Conversion Error'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_first_line_content = 'Table is empty or index out of bounds'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_line>. " Explicitly unassign
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_first_line_and_unassign( lt_sflights ).

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_sflight) = lt_sflights[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = ls_first_sflight-carrid act = lv_result ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = ls_first_sflight-connid act = lv_result ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Table is empty or index out of bounds' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_empty_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_first_line_and_unassign( lt_empty_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Table is empty or index out of bounds' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der generischen Datenverarbeitung mit `ANY TABLE` sind Feldsymbole unerlässlich, um auf die Zeilen zugreifen zu können. `UNASSIGN` stellt sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch keine ungültigen Referenzen mehr hält, was die Robustheit des Codes erhöht.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Generic Programming, ANY TABLE, READ TABLE

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer geschachtelten Struktur zu, die sich in einer internen Tabelle befindet, und geben Sie das Feldsymbol anschließend frei.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` nach dem Zuweisen der Tabellenzeile zu einem Feldsymbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_data,
             sub_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sub_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_main_data,
             id        TYPE i,
             nested    TYPE ty_sub_data,
           END OF ty_main_data.
    TYPES: tt_main_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_main_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_component_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_main_data
        iv_index TYPE i
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_component_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_main_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_nested_component> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE it_data INDEX iv_index ASSIGNING <fs_line>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line>-nested TO <fs_nested_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = |{ <fs_nested_component> }|.
      ELSE.
        rv_value = |Nested component '{ iv_component_name }' not found.|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = |Line with index { iv_index } not found.|.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_nested_component>. " Freigabe des inneren Feldsymbols
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>. " Freigabe des äußeren Feldsymbols
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_nested_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_nested_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_nested_dynamic_access=>tt_main_data(
      ( id = 1 nested = VALUE #( sub_field = 'Value A' ) )
      ( id = 2 nested = VALUE #( sub_field = 'Value B' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_nested_component_dynamic(
      it_data = lt_test_data
      iv_index = 1
      iv_component_name = 'SUB_FIELD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Value A' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_nested_component_dynamic(
      it_data = lt_test_data
      iv_index = 2

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen akzeptiert. Die Methode soll den Wert des angegebenen Feldes für jede Zeile der Tabelle auslesen und in einer neuen Tabelle sammeln. Nach dem Zugriff auf jede Zeile soll das Feldsymbol freigegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS collect_dynamic_field_values
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_dynamic_field_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_any_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            APPEND 'Conversion Error' TO rt_values.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        APPEND |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in line.| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Freigabe des Feldsymbols für das Feld
    ENDLOOP.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>. " Freigabe des Feldsymbols für die Zeile (nach der Schleife)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` in einer Schleife, um sicherzustellen, dass ein Feldsymbol nach jeder Iteration freigegeben wird, was in bestimmten Szenarien zur Vermeidung von unerwünschten Seiteneffekten oder zur Ressourcenverwaltung beitragen kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` und `UNASSIGN <fs>` am Ende jeder Schleifeniteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_in_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_in_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      " Verarbeitung der Zeile
      APPEND |Processed: { <fs_line> }| TO rt_processed_data.

      " Explizite Freigabe des Feldsymbols nach jeder Nutzung
      UNASSIGN <fs_line>.

      " Nach UNASSIGN ist <fs_line> nicht mehr zugewiesen.
      " Ein erneuter Zugriff würde zu einem Dump führen, bis es wieder zugewiesen wird.
      " In der nächsten Schleifeniteration wird es automatisch neu zugewiesen.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Obwohl Feldsymbole am Ende einer Schleife oder eines Scopes automatisch freigegeben werden, kann die explizite Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` innerhalb einer Schleife in komplexen Szenarien nützlich sein. Es stellt sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach jeder Iteration keine Referenz mehr hält, was potenzielle Fehler bei der Wiederverwendung oder bei der Arbeit mit dynamisch zugewiesenen Speicherbereichen verhindern kann. Dies ist eher eine defensive Programmierpraxis.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, LOOP AT, Performance, Resource Management

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, wobei jede Zeile eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle der zugehörigen Flüge (Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) enthält. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE`.
hint: Gruppieren Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und verwenden Sie dann `FOR` und `VALUE` für die geschachtelte Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom  TYPE s_city_fr,
             cityto    TYPE s_city_to,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights   TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN sflights ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    rt_carrier_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
        flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR <fs_grouped_flight> IN GROUP <fs_flight>
          ( connid = <fs_grouped_flight>-connid
            fldate = <fs_grouped_flight>-fldate
            cityfrom = <fs_grouped_flight>-cityfrom
            cityto = <fs_grouped_flight>-cityto
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has at least 'LH' and 'AA' with some flights
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_carrier_flights ).

    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_aa_found) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_carrier_flights INTO DATA(ls_carrier_flights).

      ELSEIF ls_carrier_flights-carrid = 'AA'.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige Struktur und einen Feldnamen akzeptiert. Die Methode soll den Wert des Feldes dynamisch auslesen und in einen String umwandeln. Wenn das Feld ein interner Tabellentyp ist, soll die Anzahl der Zeilen zurückgegeben werden. Das Feldsymbol soll nach der Verwendung freigegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <fs>`, RTTI zur Typprüfung und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_field_info
      IMPORTING
        is_any_structure TYPE ANY
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_any_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> ).

      IF lo_type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
        ASSIGN <fs_field> TO <fs_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_info = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' is an internal table with { lines( <fs_table> ) } lines.|.
          UNASSIGN <fs_table>.
        ELSE.
          rv_info = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' is a table, but could not be assigned.|.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        TRY.
            rv_info = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' has value: { <fs_field> }|.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            rv_info = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' has unconvertible value.|.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_info = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_info FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_field_info FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existent_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_info.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA(ls_test) = VALUE ty_test_struct( id = 123 name = 'Test Name' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_type_check( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_info(
      is_any_structure = ls_test
      iv_field_name = 'NAME'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Field ''NAME'' has value: Test Name' ).

    lv_info = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_info(
      is_any_structure = ls_test
      iv_field_name = 'ID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Field ''ID'' has value: 123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_field_info.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_struct,
             item TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sub_struct.
    TYPES: tt_sub_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sub_struct WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_main_struct,
             header TYPE string,
             items TYPE tt_sub_table,
           END OF ty_main_struct.

    DATA(ls_main) = VALUE ty_main_struct(
      header = 'Main Header'
      items = VALUE #( 
        ( item = 'Item A' )
        ( item = 'Item B' )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_type_check( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_info(
      is_any_structure = ls_main
      iv_field_name = 'ITEMS'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Field ''ITEMS'' is an internal table with 2 lines.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_field.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_struct,
             data TYPE string,
           END OF ty_simple_struct.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen (ganze Zahlen und Dezimalzahlen) aus einem gegebenen String.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+(\.\d+)?`. " Matches integers and decimals
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.

    lo_regex->find_all( EXPORTING text = iv_text CHANGING results = lt_matches ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( '123' ) ( '45.67' ) ( '8' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_numbers( 'Text with 123 and 45.67 and also 8.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

    lt_expected = VALUE string_table( ( '100' ) ).
    lt_result = lo_cut->extract_numbers( 'Only 100 here.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

    lt_expected = VALUE string_table( ).
    lt_result = lo_cut->extract_numbers( 'No numbers here.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `find_all` von `cl_abap_regex` ist perfekt, um alle Vorkommen eines Musters in einem String zu finden. Die Ergebnisse (`match_result_tab`) enthalten Offset und Länge, was die Extraktion der gefundenen Substrings sehr effizient macht.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie spezifische Teile (Gruppen) aus einem String, der einem bestimmten Muster folgt, z.B. Datum und Uhrzeit aus einem Log-Eintrag.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und die Methode `create_matcher` mit `match_result=>get_submatch`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_log_entry,
             date TYPE d,
             time TYPE t,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_log_entry.
    TYPES: ty_t_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_log_data IMPORTING iv_log_line TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_s_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_log_data.
    " Pattern: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS - Message
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+-\s+(.*)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_log_entry-date = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_log_entry-time = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_log_entry-message = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_log_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_log_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_groups( ).
    DATA(lv_log_line) = '2023-10-26 14:30:00 - User logged in successfully.'.
    DATA(ls_expected) = VALUE zcl_regex_extract_groups=>ty_s_log_entry(
      date = '20231026'
      time = '143000'
      message = 'User logged in successfully.'
    ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->extract_log_data( lv_log_line ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-date exp = ls_expected-date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-time exp = ls_expected-time ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-message exp = ls_expected-message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_groups( ).
    DATA(lv_log_line) = 'Invalid log entry format.'.
    DATA(ls_expected) = VALUE zcl_regex_extract_groups=>ty_s_log_entry( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->extract_log_data( lv_log_line ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result exp = ls_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `cl_abap_regex=>create_matcher` und `match_result=>get_submatch` ist eine sehr mächtige Methode, um spezifische, strukturierte Daten aus komplexen Strings zu extrahieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für das Parsen von Log-Dateien oder anderen unstrukturierten Texten.
keywords: CL_ABAP_REGEX, REGEX, Groups, Extraction, Log Parsing

CLASS zcl_regex_find_position DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->find_first_occurrence( iv_text = lv_text
                                                     iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result exp = ls_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `find` des Matcher-Objekts von `cl_abap_regex` ist ideal, um die erste Position eines Musters in einem String zu lokalisieren. Dies ist nützlich, wenn man nur das erste Vorkommen eines Musters finden muss, ohne alle Treffer zu extrahieren.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Barcode als BMP-Grafik für eine gegebene Zeichenkette und geben Sie die Binärdaten zurück.

CLASS zcl_barcode_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_barcode_bmp
      IMPORTING
        iv_content TYPE string
        iv_barcode_type TYPE c LENGTH 10 DEFAULT 'C128A' " e.g., C128A, EAN13
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_bmp_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_barcode_bmp.
    DATA: lo_barcode_renderer TYPE REF TO cl_rstx_barcode_renderer,
          lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_barcode_renderer.

    TRY.
        lo_barcode_renderer->set_barcode_type( iv_barcode_type ).
        lo_barcode_renderer->set_barcode_content( iv_content ).
        lo_barcode_renderer->set_barcode_width( 200 ). " Example width
        lo_barcode_renderer->set_barcode_height( 100 ). " Example height
        lo_barcode_renderer->set_barcode_resolution( 300 ). " DPI

        lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode_to_xstring(
          EXPORTING
            iv_format = 'BMP'
          IMPORTING
            ev_xstring = lv_xstring
        ).
        rv_bmp_data = lv_xstring.
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_barcode_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_barcode_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer Struktur, die zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen definiert wird. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle anschließend mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` für die Strukturdefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
        name TYPE fieldname,
        type TYPE abap_type_descr_kind, " e.g., C, N, I, D, T, P, F, X
        length TYPE i,
      END OF ty_field_def,
      tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind( ls_field_def-type )->get_handle( ).
      IF ls_field_def-length IS NOT INITIAL.
        ls_component-length = ls_field_def-length.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        " Fill with example data (simplified for demonstration)
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                       <lv_field> TYPE any.

        ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
        IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
          ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

          " Add first row
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 'Value A'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 100. ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

          " Add second row
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 'Value B'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 200. ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation_error cx_sy_table_creation_error.
        " Handle errors
        MESSAGE 'Dynamic table creation failed' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_dynamic_table=>tt_field_def,
          ls_field_def  TYPE zcl_dynamic_table=>ty_field_def.

    ls_field_def-name = 'FIELD1'.
    ls_field_def-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>kind_char.
    ls_field_def-length = 10.
    APPEND ls_field_def TO lt_field_defs.

    ls_field_def-name = 'FIELD2'.
    ls_field_def-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>kind_int.
    ls_field_def-length = 0. " Length not needed for INT
    APPEND ls_field_def TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_field1> TYPE any,
                   <lv_field2> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field1>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field1> exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field2> exp = 100 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field1>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field1> exp = 'Value B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field2> exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Datentypen und Tabellen zur Laufzeit ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Anwendungen. Hier wird `cl_abap_structdescr` verwendet, um die Struktur zu definieren, und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` um die Tabelle zu instanziieren. Der Zugriff auf die Felder erfolgt über Field Symbols.
keywords: Dynamic, Internal Tables, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String als Parameter akzeptieren und einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object_reference) EXPORTING ... IMPORTING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_target DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS reverse_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_text.
    rv_output = iv_input && ' - Concatenated!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reverse_text.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      rv_output = rv_output && iv_input+((lv_length - sy-index)*1)(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input_param TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE string.

    CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
      EXPORTING
        iv_input = iv_input_param
      IMPORTING
        rv_output = lv_result.

    rv_result = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_concatenate FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_reverse FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method_call FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_concatenate.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_target( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
                           io_object = lo_target
                           iv_method_name = 'CONCATENATE_TEXT'
                           iv_input_param = 'Hello' ).
