  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_reverse.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_target( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
                           io_object = lo_target
                           iv_method_name = 'REVERSE_TEXT'
                           iv_input_param = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'dlroW' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_target( ).

    TRY.
        lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(

        ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_dyn_call_error' ).
    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische SELECT-Abfrage auf der Tabelle `sflights` aus, bei der die auszuwählenden Felder zur Laufzeit als Liste von Feldnamen übergeben werden. Das Ergebnis soll in eine dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle geschrieben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT (field_list_string) FROM ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @(dynamic_table_ref)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_dynamic_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic_fields.
    DATA: lv_field_list TYPE string,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Construct field list string for SELECT
    lv_field_list = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR field IN it_field_names NEXT s = COND #( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && `,` && field ) ).

    " Dynamically create structure for the target table
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( |SFLIGHT-{lv_field_name}| ) ).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = lo_elem_descr->get_handle( ).
      ls_component-length = lo_elem_descr->length.
      ls_component-decimals = lo_elem_descr->decimals.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
        ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

        SELECT (lv_field_list)
          FROM sflight
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_table>.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation_error cx_sy_table_creation_error cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
        MESSAGE 'Dynamic SELECT with dynamic fields failed' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String bekannt ist, und lesen oder ändern Sie deren Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (component_name) OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS access_component
      IMPORTING
        is_data         TYPE ty_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value    TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_current_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_component.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA: ls_local_data TYPE ty_data.

    ls_local_data = is_data.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE ls_local_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
      IF iv_new_value IS SUPPLIED.
        " Attempt to convert new value to component type
        TRY.
            <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            MESSAGE 'Type conversion failed for new value' TYPE 'E'.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
      rv_current_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Component '{iv_component_name}' not found.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus `sflights` dynamisch, indem Sie ein Feld zur Gruppierung und ein Feld zur Summenbildung zur Laufzeit angeben. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit Field Symbols und `REDUCE` für dynamischen Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw,
           tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_group_field TYPE fieldname
        iv_sum_field   TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE string_table " Return as string table for generic output
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_raw.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_group_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_sum_field>   TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
         GROUP BY (iv_group_field) ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO <fs_group_field>.
      IF <fs_group_field> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = |Group field '{iv_group_field}' not found.|.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat34(
        INIT s = 0
        FOR <fs_grouped_flight> IN GROUP <ls_group_key>
        LET lv_current_sum_value = 0 IN
        BLOCK: " Dynamic access to sum field
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_sum_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_grouped_flight> TO <fs_sum_field>.
          IF <fs_sum_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            TRY.
                lv_current_sum_value = <fs_sum_field>.
              CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = |Sum field '{iv_sum_field}' is not numeric.|.
            ENDTRY.
          ELSE.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = |Sum field '{iv_sum_field}' not found.|.
          ENDIF.
        ENDBLOCK:
        NEXT s = s + lv_current_sum_value
      ).

      APPEND |Group: { <fs_group_field> }, Sum of { iv_sum_field }: { lv_sum }| TO rt_aggregated_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Create a deep copy of the input table to filter
    CREATE DATA rt_filtered_data LIKE it_data.
    ASSIGN rt_filtered_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    <lt_data> = it_data.

    " Filter using FILTER operator with dynamic field access
    <lt_data> = FILTER #( <lt_data> USING KEY default WHERE
      BLOCK: " Dynamic access to filter field
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_filter_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF <fs_field> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = |Filter field '{iv_filter_field}' not found.|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDBLOCK:
      ( <fs_field> = iv_filter_value ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen Prozentsatz und aktualisieren Sie die Einträge.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle, ändern Sie die Arbeitszeile und verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_loop_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_loop_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      ls_sflight-price = ls_sflight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
      MODIFY TABLE ct_sflights FROM ls_sflight.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in einen `xstring` und dekomprimieren Sie sie wieder zurück.
hint: Wandeln Sie die Tabelle zuerst in einen einzelnen String um (z.B. mit `REDUCE` oder `CONCATENATE LINES OF`), komprimieren Sie diesen und dekomprimieren Sie ihn dann wieder, um die Tabelle zu rekonstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS decompress_string_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_decompressed_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_string_table.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs> IN it_strings
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <fs> )
    ).
    rv_compressed_xstring = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text( lv_concatenated_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_string_table.
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text( iv_compressed_xstring ).
    SPLIT lv_decompressed_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE rt_decompressed_strings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_compression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_table_compress( ).
    DATA(lt_original_strings) = VALUE string_table(
      ( `Zeile 1: Dies ist der erste Eintrag.` )
      ( `Zeile 2: Ein weiterer Eintrag in der Tabelle.` )
      ( `Zeile 3: Der letzte Eintrag.` )
    ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = lo_cut->compress_string_table( lt_original_strings ).
    DATA(lt_decompressed_strings) = lo_cut->decompress_string_table( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_decompressed_strings ) exp = lines( lt_original_strings ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decompressed_strings[ 1 ] exp = lt_original_strings[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decompressed_strings[ 2 ] exp = lt_original_strings[ 2 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decompressed_strings[ 3 ] exp = lt_original_strings[ 3 ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst werden die Tabellenzeilen mit dem `REDUCE` Operator und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` zu einem einzigen String zusammengeführt. Dieser String wird dann komprimiert. Bei der Dekomprimierung wird der String wieder in eine Tabelle aufgeteilt. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um strukturierte Textdaten zu speichern oder zu übertragen.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung von Preisen in der `sflights` Tabelle durch, indem Sie den `FOR` Operator und `MODIFY` in einer funktionalen Kette verwenden, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `MODIFY` (implizit durch die Erstellung einer neuen Tabelle).
solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_for_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_for_carrier_functional
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_for_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_for_carrier_functional.
    rt_updated_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = iv_carrid
                THEN VALUE ty_sflight( BASE ls_sflight price = ls_sflight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) )
                ELSE ls_sflight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_struct_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_decompressed_string CHANGING data = rt_decompressed_sflights ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und löschen Sie anschließend alle Flüge, die vor dem aktuellen Datum liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Auswahl und `DELETE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights by carrier
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).

    " Delete flights older than today
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE fldate < sy-datum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_delete FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_delete.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights( 'LH' ).

    " Assert that all remaining flights are 'LH' and not in the past
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate >= sy-datum ) msg = 'Flight date is in the past' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some flights are returned (assuming 'LH' has future flights)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) err_msg = 'No flights returned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Verwendung von `FILTER` für die Selektion von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle und anschließend `DELETE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um unerwünschte Einträge zu entfernen. Beide Operationen sind kompakt und gut lesbar.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle eindeutigen Flugverbindungen (CARRID, CONNID) aus `sflights`. Löschen Sie anschließend alle Verbindungen, bei denen der `CONNID` mit '00' beginnt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY` für eindeutige Einträge und `DELETE` mit `CONTAINS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_unique_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES tt_connection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE tt_connection.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_unique_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_connections.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Get unique connections using FOR and GROUP BY
    rt_connections = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid connid = ls_group-connid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS ( 
                                   carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                   connid = ls_group-connid ) ).

    " Delete connections where CONNID starts with '00'
    DELETE rt_connections WHERE connid CS '00'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_and_delete.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_unique_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_connections( ).

    " Assert that no connection ID starts with '00'
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_conn).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ( ls_conn-connid CS '00' ) msg = 'Connection ID starts with 00' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some connections are returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) err_msg = 'No connections returned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_unique_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_dup_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_unique_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights with price > iv_min_price
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).

    " Sort before deleting adjacent duplicates
    SORT rt_flights BY carrid connid.

    " Delete adjacent duplicates based on carrid and connid
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_delete_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_dup_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_unique_flights( 500 ).

    " Assert that all prices are > 500
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > 500 ) msg = 'Price not greater than 500' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that there are no adjacent duplicates for carrid and connid
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-connid = lv_prev_connid ) msg = 'Adjacent duplicate found' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some flights are returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) err_msg = 'No flights returned' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und nach 'JFK' fliegen. Löschen Sie anschließend den ersten Eintrag aus der gefilterten Liste.

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete_idx DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_route,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight_route.
    TYPES tt_sflight_route TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_route WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_routes
      IMPORTING
        iv_city_from TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_city_to   TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_routes) TYPE tt_sflight_route.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete_idx IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_routes.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights from iv_city_from to iv_city_to
    rt_routes = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = iv_city_from AND cityto = iv_city_to ).

    " Delete the first entry if it exists
    IF lines( rt_routes ) > 0.
      DELETE TABLE rt_routes INDEX 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_delete_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_delete_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_delete_idx( ).
    DATA(lt_result_before) = lo_cut->get_filtered_routes( iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' iv_city_to = 'NEW YORK' ).
    DATA(lv_count_before) = lines( lt_result_before ).

    " Re-run to get the actual count after deletion
    DATA(lt_result_after) = lo_cut->get_filtered_routes( iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' iv_city_to = 'NEW YORK' ).
    DATA(lv_count_after) = lines( lt_result_after ).

    " Assert that one entry was deleted if there was at least one initially
    IF lv_count_before > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_after exp = lv_count_before - 1 msg = 'Expected one less entry after deletion' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_after exp = 0 msg = 'Expected zero entries if none initially' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Assert that all remaining flights match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_result_after INTO DATA(ls_route).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_route-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' msg = 'City From mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_route-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'City To mismatch' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `FILTER` mit mehreren Bedingungen, um eine spezifische Teilmenge von Daten zu erhalten. Anschließend wird `DELETE TABLE ... INDEX` verwendet, um einen Eintrag an einer bestimmten Position zu entfernen, was eine präzise Manipulation der internen Tabelle ermöglicht.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die in einem bestimmten Datumsbereich liegen. Iterieren Sie dann über die gefilterte Liste und löschen Sie jeden zweiten Eintrag.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für den Datumsbereich und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` mit `DELETE FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_loop_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_date,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_date.
    TYPES tt_sflight_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_by_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_date_to   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_date.

    METHODS get_all_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_loop_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_by_date.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights within the date range
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE fldate BETWEEN iv_date_from AND iv_date_to ).

    " Delete every second entry
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.
    LOOP AT rt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
      IF lv_counter MOD 2 = 0.
        DELETE rt_flights INDEX sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_loop_delete FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_loop_delete.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_loop_delete( ).
    DATA(lv_date_from) = sy-datum - 365. " One year ago
    DATA(lv_date_to) = sy-datum + 365.  " One year from now

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights_by_date( iv_date_from = lv_date_from iv_date_to = lv_date_to ).

    " Assert that the number of entries is roughly halved (if original count > 0)
    " This test is a bit tricky due to the nature of deleting every second entry
    " and the exact number of flights in sflight.
    " A more robust test would involve a known test data set.
    " For now, we check if the count is less than the original filtered count.
    DATA(lt_original_filtered) = FILTER #( VALUE zcl_it_filter_loop_delete=>tt_sflight_date( FOR ls_sflight IN lo_cut->get_all_sflights( ) WHERE ls_sflight-fldate BETWEEN lv_date_from AND lv_date_to ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_original_count) = lines( lt_original_filtered ).

    IF lv_original_count > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_result ) < lv_original_count ) msg = 'Expected fewer entries after deletion' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_result ) >= lv_original_count / 2 - 1 ) msg = 'Expected roughly half entries' ). " Allow for off-by-one
    ENDIF.

    " Assert that all remaining flights are within the date range
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_date_from AND ls_flight-fldate <= lv_date_to ) msg = 'Flight date out of range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FILTER` für die Vorauswahl von Daten mit einer `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `DELETE` innerhalb der Schleife. Das Löschen von Einträgen während der Iteration erfordert Vorsicht, da sich die Indizes verschieben können. Die Verwendung von `DELETE ... INDEX sy-tabix` ist hier korrekt, da `sy-tabix` den aktuellen Index vor der Löschung referenziert.
keywords: FILTER, DELETE, LOOP AT, FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables, Date Range

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise dieser gefilterten Flüge. Löschen Sie anschließend alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der ursprünglichen gefilterten Liste.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und `DELETE` mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_reduce_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_sum_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      EXPORTING
        ev_total_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_reduce_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_sum_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights with price > iv_min_price
    DATA(lt_filtered_by_price) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).

    " Calculate total price using REDUCE
    ev_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                   FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_by_price
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).

    " Delete flights with carrier 'AA' from the filtered list
    DELETE lt_filtered_by_price WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    rt_remaining_flights = lt_filtered_by_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_reduce_delete FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_reduce_delete.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_reduce_delete( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_and_sum_flights( EXPORTING iv_min_price = 1000 IMPORTING ev_total_price = lv_total_price ).

    " Assert that no 'AA' flights remain
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'AA flight found after deletion' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > 1000 ) msg = 'Price not greater than 1000' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that total price is calculated (simple check, exact value depends on DB content)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_total_price err_msg = 'Total price not calculated' ).

    " Verify total price calculation manually for a small subset if possible, or just check non-initial
    " For a more precise test, one would need to mock sflight data or know its exact content.
    " Here, we just ensure it's not zero if there are flights.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_price > 0 ) msg = 'Total price should be positive' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` zur Selektion, `REDUCE` zur Aggregation (Summenbildung) und `DELETE` zur weiteren Bereinigung einer internen Tabelle. Dies zeigt einen typischen Datenverarbeitungsfluss in modernem ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, DELETE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, WHERE

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, deren `CONNID` ein bestimmtes Muster enthält (z.B. '17'). Erstellen Sie eine zweite Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften, die gelöscht werden sollen. Löschen Sie dann aus der gefilterten Flugtabelle alle Einträge, deren `CARRID` in der zweiten Tabelle enthalten ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit `CP` (contains pattern) und `DELETE` mit `IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_conn,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_conn.
    TYPES tt_sflight_conn TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_conn WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_by_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid_pattern TYPE string
        it_carriers_to_delete TYPE tt_carriers OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_conn.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_by_pattern.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights where CONNID contains the pattern
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE connid CP iv_connid_pattern ).

    " Delete flights whose CARRIER is in the list of carriers to delete
    IF it_carriers_to_delete IS NOT INITIAL.
      DELETE rt_flights WHERE carrid IN it_carriers_to_delete.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_delete_in.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_delete_in( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers_to_delete) = VALUE zcl_it_filter_delete_in=>tt_carriers( ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights_by_pattern( iv_connid_pattern = '*17*' it_carriers_to_delete = lt_carriers_to_delete ).

    " Assert that no flights with 'LH' or 'UA' remain
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'UA' ) msg = 'Deleted carrier found' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-connid CP '*17*' ) msg = 'Connection ID pattern mismatch' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some flights are returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) err_msg = 'No flights returned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `FILTER` mit dem `CP` (contains pattern) Operator für eine flexible Mustersuche. Anschließend wird `DELETE` mit der `IN`-Operation verwendet, um Einträge zu entfernen, deren Feldwert in einer anderen internen Tabelle enthalten ist. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Daten basierend auf einer dynamischen Liste zu bereinigen.
keywords: FILTER, DELETE, Internal Tables, CP, IN, Pattern Matching

CLASS zcl_it_filter_new_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Flugnummer (CONNID) haben. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit diesen Flügen. Löschen Sie dann aus der ursprünglichen `sflights`-Tabelle alle Einträge, die in der neu erstellten Tabelle enthalten sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Selektion und `DELETE` mit `FOR ... IN` für die Löschung basierend auf einer anderen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      EXPORTING
        et_filtered_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_by_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights by CONNID into a new table
    et_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE connid = iv_connid ).

    " Delete entries from the original table that are present in the filtered table
    DELETE lt_sflights FOR ALL ENTRIES IN et_filtered_flights WHERE carrid = et_filtered_flights-carrid AND connid = et_filtered_flights-connid AND fldate = et_filtered_flights-fldate.

    rt_remaining_sflights = lt_sflights.

  METHOD test_filter_and_delete_for_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_delete_for( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) TYPE zcl_it_filter_delete_for=>tt_sflight_key.
    DATA(lv_connid_to_filter) = '0017'. " Example CONNID

    DATA(lt_initial_sflights) = VALUE zcl_it_filter_delete_for=>tt_sflight_key( FOR ls_sflight IN lo_cut->get_all_sflights( ) ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
    DATA(lv_initial_count) = lines( lt_initial_sflights ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights_by_connid( EXPORTING iv_connid = lv_connid_to_filter IMPORTING et_filtered_flights = lt_filtered ).

    " Assert that the filtered table contains only the specified CONNID
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_filtered_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_filtered_flight-connid exp = lv_connid_to_filter msg = 'Filtered CONNID mismatch' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that the original table no longer contains the filtered flights
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_deleted_flight).
      DATA(lv_line_exists) = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = ls_deleted_flight-carrid connid = ls_deleted_flight-connid fldate = ls_deleted_flight-fldate ] ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_line_exists msg = 'Deleted flight still found in remaining flights' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that the count of remaining flights is correct
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_initial_count - lines( lt_filtered ) msg = 'Incorrect number of remaining flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  " Helper method to get all sflights for testing purposes

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @RESULT.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine Hashed Table mit Daten aus der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle und verwenden Sie dann `FOR` und `REDUCE`, um die Summe der Preise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` um die Hashed Table zu füllen. `FOR` und `REDUCE` sind ideal für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_hashed_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_hashed_tab.

    " Hashed Table mit Daten aus SFLIGHT füllen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc, paymentsum, seatsfree
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflight_data.

    " Summe der Preise für die angegebene Fluggesellschaft berechnen
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0.00
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_data
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_crud DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_hashed_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS delete_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_hashed_tab.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_crud IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialdaten hinzufügen
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE mt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flight.
    DELETE TABLE mt_sflight_data FROM VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight.
    READ TABLE mt_sflight_data INTO rs_sflight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table mit Flugdaten. Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die durchschnittliche Anzahl der freien Plätze. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_hashed_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_seats,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_avg_seats.
    TYPES: ty_avg_seats_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_seats) TYPE ty_avg_seats_tab.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_hashed_tab.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialdaten hinzufügen
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 10 ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 5 ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 20 ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 15 ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 15 ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_avg_seats_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT mt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_sum_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT s = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT s = s + <fs_group_member>-seatsfree
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_avg_seats(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        avg_seats = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_seats / lv_count ELSE 0 )
      ) TO rt_avg_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_seats_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_seats_by_carrier( ).

    DATA(ls_aa_avg) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_group=>ty_avg_seats( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_aa_avg WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_avg-avg_seats exp = 15 msg = 'Average seats for AA should be 15' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_avg) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_group=>ty_avg_seats( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_avg WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_avg-avg_seats exp = 10 msg = 'Average seats for LH should be 10' ).

    DATA(ls_ba_avg) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_group=>ty_avg_seats( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_ba_avg WITH KEY carrid = 'BA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ba_avg-avg_seats exp = 15 msg = 'Average seats for BA should be 15' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 entries for 3 carriers' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die leistungsstarke `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax, um Einträge einer Hashed Table nach einem Kriterium zu gruppieren. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Summe der freien Plätze zu berechnen, und `lines( GROUP ... )` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Aggregation von Daten.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, GROUP BY, LOOP AT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit dem Tabellen-Ausdruck `itab[ key = value ]` bietet eine sehr prägnante und performante Möglichkeit, die Existenz eines Eintrags in einer Hashed Table zu überprüfen, ohne den gesamten Eintrag in eine Workarea zu lesen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für schnelle Prüfungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, `ZCL_DATA_PROVIDER` und `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR`. `ZCL_DATA_PROVIDER` soll eine private Methode `get_raw_data` haben. `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR` soll als `FRIENDS` von `ZCL_DATA_PROVIDER` deklariert werden, um auf diese private Methode zugreifen zu können.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FRIENDS`-Erweiterung in der `DEFINITION` Sektion der Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_processed_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_raw_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_raw) TYPE string.

    FRIENDS zcl_data_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_raw_data.
    rv_raw = 'Sensitive Raw Data'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_processed_data.
    " Diese Methode kann nur auf öffentliche/geschützte Daten zugreifen
    rv_data = 'Publicly available data'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        io_provider TYPE REF TO zcl_data_provider
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    " Zugriff auf die private Methode von zcl_data_provider ist hier möglich, da zcl_data_processor ein FRIEND ist.
    DATA(lv_raw_data) = io_provider->get_raw_data( ).
    rv_result = |Processed: { lv_raw_data }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_friend_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_direct_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_data( lo_provider ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: Sensitive Raw Data' msg = 'Processor should access private data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_direct_access.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_data_provider( ).
    " Der folgende Aufruf würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen, da get_raw_data privat ist
    " und der Testfall nicht als FRIEND deklariert ist.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_provider->get_raw_data( ) ).
    " Stattdessen testen wir, dass die öffentliche Methode funktioniert und die private nicht direkt zugänglich ist.
    DATA(lv_public_data) = lo_provider->get_processed_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_public_data exp = 'Publicly available data' msg = 'Public method should work' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration ermöglicht es einer spezifischen Klasse (oder einem Interface), auf die privaten und geschützten Komponenten einer anderen Klasse zuzugreifen. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen eine enge Kopplung zwischen zwei Klassen erforderlich ist, aber die Kapselung nicht vollständig aufgehoben werden soll, indem Komponenten öffentlich gemacht werden. Es bietet eine kontrollierte Ausnahme vom Kapselungsprinzip.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Kapselung, Private Methoden, Zugriffskontrolle

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Factory-Muster, bei dem eine Factory-Klasse Instanzen einer Produktklasse erstellt. Die Produktklasse soll einen privaten Konstruktor haben, und die Factory-Klasse soll als `FRIENDS` deklariert werden, um Instanzen erstellen zu können.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Konstruktor der Produktklasse im `PRIVATE SECTION` und die Factory-Klasse als `FRIENDS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE string.

    FRIENDS zcl_product_factory.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_id.
    rv_id = mv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zcl_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    " Zugriff auf den privaten Konstruktor von zcl_product ist hier möglich, da zcl_product_factory ein FRIEND ist.
    ro_product = NEW zcl_product( iv_id = iv_id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_private_constructor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_product_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_product) = lo_factory->create_product( iv_id = 'PRODUCT_001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_product msg = 'Product object should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_id( ) exp = 'PRODUCT_001' msg = 'Product ID should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_private_constructor.
    " Der folgende Aufruf würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen, da der Konstruktor von zcl_product privat ist
    " und der Testfall nicht als FRIEND deklariert ist.
    " DATA(lo_product) = NEW zcl_product( iv_id = 'TEST' ).
    " Wir können hier nur bestätigen, dass die Factory funktioniert.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_product_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_product) = lo_factory->create_product( iv_id = 'PRODUCT_002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_product msg = 'Factory should successfully create product' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory-Muster ist ein Entwurfsmuster, das die Objekterzeugung kapselt. Durch die Deklaration des Produktkonstruktors als `PRIVATE` und die Factory als `FRIENDS` wird sichergestellt, dass Instanzen der Produktklasse nur über die Factory erstellt werden können. Dies erzwingt eine konsistente Objekterzeugung und ermöglicht es der Factory, zusätzliche Logik (z.B. Pooling, Konfiguration) während der Instanziierung anzuwenden.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Private Constructor, Design Patterns

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_SECURE_CONFIG` mit einem privaten Attribut `mv_api_key`. Implementieren Sie eine separate Klasse `ZCL_CONFIG_READER`, die als `FRIENDS` von `ZCL_SECURE_CONFIG` deklariert ist, um den `mv_api_key` lesen zu können. Demonstrieren Sie, wie `ZCL_CONFIG_READER` den Schlüssel abruft und wie ein externer Zugriff fehlschlagen würde.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FRIENDS` für den kontrollierten Zugriff auf das private Attribut.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secure_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_api_key TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_api_key TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    FRIENDS zcl_config_reader.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secure_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_api_key = iv_api_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_api_key
      IMPORTING
        io_config TYPE REF TO zcl_secure_config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_api_key) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_api_key.
    " Zugriff auf das private Attribut mv_api_key ist hier möglich, da zcl_config_reader ein FRIEND ist.
    rv_api_key = io_config->mv_api_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_friend_access_to_private_attribute FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_direct_attribute_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_access_to_private_attribute.
    DATA(lo_secure_config) = NEW zcl_secure_config( iv_api_key = 'MY_SECRET_API_KEY' ).
    DATA(lo_config_reader) = NEW zcl_config_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_api_key) = lo_config_reader->get_api_key( lo_secure_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_api_key exp = 'MY_SECRET_API_KEY' msg = 'Config reader should access private API key' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_direct_attribute_access.
    DATA(lo_secure_config) = NEW zcl_secure_config( iv_api_key = 'ANOTHER_SECRET' ).
    " Der folgende Zugriff würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen, da mv_api_key privat ist
    " und der Testfall nicht als FRIEND deklariert ist.
    " DATA(lv_key_attempt) = lo_secure_config->mv_api_key.
    " Stattdessen testen wir, dass der Wert über den Reader korrekt ist.
    DATA(lo_config_reader) = NEW zcl_config_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_key_via_reader) = lo_config_reader->get_api_key( lo_secure_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_key_via_reader exp = 'ANOTHER_SECRET' msg = 'API key via reader should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht die Verwendung von `FRIENDS` für den kontrollierten Zugriff auf private Attribute. `mv_api_key` ist als `PRIVATE READ-ONLY` deklariert, was den direkten externen Zugriff verhindert. Nur die als `FRIENDS` deklarierte Klasse `ZCL_CONFIG_READER` kann auf diesen Wert zugreifen. Dies ist ein starkes Kapselungsprinzip, um sensible Daten zu schützen und gleichzeitig ausgewählten Komponenten den Zugriff zu ermöglichen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Private Attribute, Kapselung, Zugriffskontrolle, READ-ONLY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse `ZCL_BASE_LOGGER` mit einer geschützten Methode `log_message`. Erstellen Sie eine abgeleitete Klasse `ZCL_APP_LOGGER`, die diese Methode überschreibt. Deklarieren Sie eine separate Utility-Klasse `ZCL_LOGGER_UTIL` als `FRIENDS` von `ZCL_BASE_LOGGER`, um die geschützte Methode direkt aufrufen zu können, ohne von `ZCL_BASE_LOGGER` abzuleiten.
hint: Die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration ermöglicht den Zugriff auf `PROTECTED` und `PRIVATE` Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_info IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS log_message ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.

    FRIENDS zcl_logger_util.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_info.
    log_message( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_logger DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_logger PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS log_message REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message.
    WRITE: / 'App Logger:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS force_log
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zcl_base_logger
        iv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD force_log.
    " Zugriff auf die geschützte Methode log_message ist hier möglich, da zcl_logger_util ein FRIEND ist.
    io_logger->log_message( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_friend_access_protected FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_inheritance_protected FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_access_protected.
    DATA(lo_app_logger) = NEW zcl_app_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_logger_util) = NEW zcl_logger_util( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Message from friend utility'.
    " Erfassen der Ausgabe, da WRITE verwendet wird
    DATA(lv_output) = cl_abap_unit_test_utility=>capture_output(
      EXPORTING
        i_code = `lo_logger_util->force_log( io_logger = lo_app_logger iv_message = lv_message ).`
        i_variables = VALUE #( ( name = 'LO_LOGGER_UTIL' value = REF #( lo_logger_util ) )
                               ( name = 'LO_APP_LOGGER' value = REF #( lo_app_logger ) )
                               ( name = 'LV_MESSAGE' value = REF #( lv_message ) ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'App Logger: Message from friend utility' in_string = lv_output msg = 'Friend utility should call protected method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_inheritance_protected.
    DATA(lo_app_logger) = NEW zcl_app_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Message from public method'.
    DATA(lv_output) = cl_abap_unit_test_utility=>capture_output(
      EXPORTING
        i_code = `lo_app_logger->log_info( lv_message ).`
        i_variables = VALUE #( ( name = 'LO_APP_LOGGER' value = REF #( lo_app_logger ) )
                               ( name = 'LV_MESSAGE' value = REF #( lv_message ) ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'App Logger: Message from public method' in_string = lv_output msg = 'Public method should call protected method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, dass `FRIENDS` nicht nur auf private, sondern auch auf geschützte Komponenten zugreifen kann. Die Utility-Klasse `ZCL_LOGGER_UTIL` kann die `PROTECTED` Methode `log_message` der Basisklasse `ZCL_BASE_LOGGER` direkt aufrufen, ohne selbst von ihr abzuleiten. Dies ist nützlich für Hilfsklassen, die privilegierte Operationen auf Objekten durchführen müssen, ohne die Vererbungshierarchie zu stören.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Protected Methods, Vererbung, Utility Class

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_INTERNAL_ACCESS` mit einer Methode `get_internal_state`. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_STATEFUL_OBJECT` mit einem privaten Attribut. Deklarieren Sie das Interface `ZIF_INTERNAL_ACCESS` als `FRIENDS` von `ZCL_STATEFUL_OBJECT`. Implementieren Sie das Interface in einer separaten Klasse `ZCL_STATE_EXAMINER`, die dann über das Interface auf den privaten Zustand von `ZCL_STATEFUL_OBJECT` zugreifen kann.
hint: Ein Interface kann auch als `FRIENDS` deklariert werden. Die implementierende Klasse erhält dann den Zugriff.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_internal_access PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_internal_state RETURNING VALUE(rv_state) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_stateful_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_state TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_state TYPE string.

    FRIENDS zif_internal_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stateful_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_state = iv_initial_state.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_state_examiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_internal_access.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_stateful_object TYPE REF TO zcl_stateful_object.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_stateful_object TYPE REF TO zcl_stateful_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_state_examiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_stateful_object = io_stateful_object.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_internal_access~get_internal_state.
    " Zugriff auf das private Attribut mv_current_state ist hier möglich,
    " da zif_internal_access ein FRIEND von zcl_stateful_object ist
    " und zcl_state_examiner dieses Interface implementiert.
    rv_state = mo_stateful_object->mv_current_state.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_interface_friend_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_direct_private_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_stateful) = NEW zcl_stateful_object( iv_initial_state = 'Initial State Value' ).
    DATA(lo_examiner) = NEW zcl_state_examiner( io_stateful_object = lo_stateful ).
    DATA(li_internal_access) = CAST zif_internal_access( lo_examiner ).
    DATA(lv_state) = li_internal_access->get_internal_state( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_state exp = 'Initial State Value' msg = 'Examiner should access internal state via interface' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_direct_private_access.
    DATA(lo_stateful) = NEW zcl_stateful_object( iv_initial_state = 'Another State' ).
    " Der folgende Zugriff würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen, da mv_current_state privat ist
    " und der Testfall nicht über das FRIEND-Interface zugreift.
    " DATA(lv_state_attempt) = lo_stateful->mv_current_state.
    " Wir bestätigen, dass der Zugriff über das Interface funktioniert.
    DATA(lo_examiner) = NEW zcl_state_examiner( io_stateful_object = lo_stateful ).
    DATA(li_internal_access) = CAST zif_internal_access( lo_examiner ).
    DATA(lv_state_via_interface) = li_internal_access->get_internal_state( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_state_via_interface exp = 'Another State' msg = 'State via interface should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von `FRIENDS`, bei der ein Interface als Freund einer Klasse deklariert wird. Jede Klasse, die dieses Interface implementiert, erhält dadurch privilegierten Zugriff auf die privaten und geschützten Komponenten der Freund-Klasse. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und erweiterbare Architektur, bei der verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces auf interne Details zugreifen können, ohne die Kapselung für andere Klassen aufzuheben.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Interface, Private Attribute, Kapselung, Polymorphie

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table mit Flugdaten. Fügen Sie einen Sekundärschlüssel hinzu, um Flüge effizient nach `PLANETYPE` zu suchen. Demonstrieren Sie das Lesen über diesen Sekundärschlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY` oder `WITH NON-UNIQUE HASHED KEY` für den Sekundärschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_secondary_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_hashed_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate
                                  WITH NON-UNIQUE HASHED KEY plan_key COMPONENTS planetype.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_std_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_std_tab.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_hashed_tab.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_secondary_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialdaten hinzufügen
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '737' ) INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_planetype.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN mt_sflight_data USING KEY plan_key WHERE ( planetype = iv_planetype ) ( <fs_sflight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_by_secondary_key FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_by_non_existing_secondary_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_by_secondary_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_secondary_key( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_planetype( iv_planetype = '747' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 flights for planetype 747' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight should be AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_by_non_existing_secondary_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_secondary_key( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_planetype( iv_planetype = 'A320' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Should find no flights for non-existing planetype' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Sekundärschlüssel ermöglichen einen effizienten Zugriff auf Einträge in internen Tabellen, die nicht über den Primärschlüssel erfolgen. `WITH NON-UNIQUE HASHED KEY` erstellt einen Hash-Index für den angegebenen Schlüssel, was schnelle Zugriffe (nahezu O(1)) ermöglicht, auch wenn der Schlüssel nicht eindeutig ist. Die Verwendung von `FOR ... IN itab USING KEY` ist die moderne Syntax, um diesen Sekundärschlüssel zu nutzen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, Secondary Key, Internal Tables, USING KEY, SFLIGHT, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_SECRET_HOLDER` mit einem privaten Attribut `mv_secret`. Erstellen Sie eine Testklasse `LTCL_TEST` und deklarieren Sie diese als `FRIENDS` von `ZCL_SECRET_HOLDER`, um `mv_secret` direkt in einem Unit-Test überprüfen zu können.
hint: Die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration kann auch für Testklassen verwendet werden, um private Komponenten zu testen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secret_holder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_secret TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_secret TYPE string.

    FRIENDS ltcl_test.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secret_holder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_secret = iv_secret.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_secret_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_secret_value.
    DATA(lo_holder) = NEW zcl_secret_holder( iv_secret = 'MyHiddenValue' ).
    " Direkter Zugriff auf das private Attribut mv_secret ist hier möglich, da ltcl_test ein FRIEND ist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_holder->mv_secret exp = 'MyHiddenValue' msg = 'Private secret should be accessible in friend test class' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl es Best Practice ist, private Methoden und Attribute indirekt über öffentliche Schnittstellen zu testen, kann die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration in Testklassen eine schnelle Möglichkeit bieten, private Komponenten direkt zu überprüfen. Dies sollte jedoch sparsam und mit Bedacht eingesetzt werden, da es die Kapselung für Testzwecke aufweicht. Es demonstriert aber die Flexibilität der `FRIENDS`-Syntax.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table mit Flugdaten. Fügen Sie neue Einträge hinzu, wobei Sie sicherstellen, dass keine doppelten Einträge (basierend auf dem Primärschlüssel) erstellt werden. Verwenden Sie moderne Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` oder `MODIFY ... FROM TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_insert_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_hashed_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

      IMPORTING

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_insert_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialdaten hinzufügen

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight.
    INSERT is_flight INTO TABLE mt_sflight_data.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_number_of_flights.
    rv_count = lines( mt_sflight_data ).

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Bei Hashed Tables mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt das System sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge basierend auf dem Primärschlüssel existieren können. Ein `INSERT` eines bereits vorhandenen Schlüssels führt zu `sy-subrc <> 0`. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten und Duplikate zu vermeiden, ohne manuelle Prüfungen durchführen zu müssen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_EVENT_PUBLISHER` mit einem privaten Event `event_data_changed`. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_EVENT_SUBSCRIBER`, die dieses Event abonniert. Deklarieren Sie `ZCL_EVENT_SUBSCRIBER` als `FRIENDS` von `ZCL_EVENT_PUBLISHER`, um das private Event abonnieren zu können.
hint: Private Events können nur von `FRIENDS` Klassen abonniert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_event IMPORTING iv_new_data TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    EVENTS event_data_changed EXPORTING VALUE(ev_new_data) TYPE string.

    FRIENDS zcl_event_subscriber.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_event.
    RAISE EVENT event_data_changed EXPORTING ev_new_data = iv_new_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_publisher TYPE REF TO zcl_event_publisher.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT event_data_changed OF zcl_event_publisher IMPORTING ev_new_data.

    DATA mv_received_data TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Abonnement eines privaten Events ist hier möglich, da zcl_event_subscriber ein FRIEND ist.
    SET HANDLER handle_data_changed FOR io_publisher.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    mv_received_data = ev_new_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_private_event_subscription FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_private_event_subscription.
    DATA(lo_publisher) = NEW zcl_event_publisher( ).
    DATA(lo_subscriber) = NEW zcl_event_subscriber( lo_publisher ).

    DATA(lv_test_data) = 'Hello Event!'.
    lo_publisher->trigger_event( lv_test_data ).

ENDCLASS.

Nur Klassen, die als `FRIENDS` des Event-Publishers deklariert sind, können solche privaten Events abonnieren. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr feingranulare Kontrolle über die Event-Kommunikation und stellt sicher, dass nur vertrauenswürdige Komponenten auf bestimmte interne Ereignisse reagieren können.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table mit Flugdaten. Ersetzen Sie alle Einträge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durch neue Daten, falls sie existieren, oder fügen Sie sie hinzu, falls nicht. Verwenden Sie moderne Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ...` mit `UNIQUE KEY`.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_upsert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

    METHODS upsert_flight
      IMPORTING

    METHODS get_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate

FROM ...`-Anweisung auf einer Hashed Table mit `UNIQUE KEY` verhält sich wie ein 'UPSERT'-Vorgang: Wenn ein Eintrag mit dem gleichen Primärschlüssel bereits existiert, wird er aktualisiert; andernfalls wird ein neuer Eintrag hinzugefügt. Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Dezimalzahlen. Die Liste wird als interne Tabelle übergeben.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und den `/` Operator für die Division. Beachte die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR <num> IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + <num> ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    IF lv_count = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.

    rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_average_with_zero FOR TESTING.

  ENDMETHOD.

        lo_cut->calculate_average( lt_numbers ).

explanation: Die Lösung nutzt den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um die Summe der Zahlen in der internen Tabelle kompakt zu berechnen. Die Division erfolgt mit dem Standard-Operator `/`. Instructions: Führe eine Division durch und fange eine mögliche Division-by-zero-Ausnahme ab. Gib im Fehlerfall einen vordefinierten Wert zurück.

CLASS zcl_math_safe_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_safe_divide IMPLEMENTATION.

        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
