INTERFACE zif_processable_object.
  METHODS is_condition_met RETURNING VALUE(rv_met) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_processable_item DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable_object.
    DATA mv_id TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE string iv_value TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_threshold TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processable_item IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    mv_threshold = 50.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_processable_object~is_condition_met.
    IF mv_value > mv_threshold.
      rv_met = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_met = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_object_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_processable_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_processable_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_processable_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_object_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_objects.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.
    DATA(lo_object) TYPE REF TO zif_processable_object.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_objects ).
      READ TABLE it_objects INDEX lv_index INTO lo_object.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        IF lo_object->is_condition_met( ) = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_processed_count = lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Operation, die fehlschlagen kann, und verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Operation zu wiederholen, bis sie erfolgreich ist oder eine maximale Anzahl von Versuchen erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie moderne Exception-Behandlung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Zähler und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_retry_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_retry_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_max_retries_exceeded.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_attempt_count TYPE i.
    METHODS simulate_failing_operation RAISING zcx_simulated_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_simulated_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_simulated_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_max_retries_exceeded DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_max_retries_exceeded IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_retry_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_retry_operation.
    DATA(lv_retries) = 0.
    gv_attempt_count = 0.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_retries < iv_max_retries.
      TRY.
          simulate_failing_operation( ).
          rv_success = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        CATCH zcx_simulated_error.
          lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
          " Optional: Log the retry attempt
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF rv_success = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_max_retries_exceeded( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_failing_operation.
    gv_attempt_count = gv_attempt_count + 1.
    IF gv_attempt_count < 3. " Fails for the first 2 attempts
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_simulated_error( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_retry_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_retry_failure FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_max_retries_exceeded.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_retry_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry_operation( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lv_result = lo_cut->perform_retry_operation( 3 ).
      CATCH zcx_max_retries_exceeded.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unerwarteter Fehler: Max Retries Exceeded' ).
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true msg = 'Operation sollte erfolgreich sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_retry_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry_operation( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_retry_operation( 2 ). " Only 2 retries, but operation needs 3 attempts
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Erwarteter Fehler: Max Retries Exceeded' ).
      CATCH zcx_max_retries_exceeded.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' msg = 'Max Retries Exceeded wurde korrekt ausgelöst' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` für eine Retry-Logik verwendet werden kann. Die Schleife wiederholt eine potenziell fehlerhafte Operation, bis sie erfolgreich ist oder die maximale Anzahl von Versuchen erreicht wurde. Dies ist ein häufiges Muster in der robusten Programmierung.
keywords: WHILE, Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, Retry, Schleife, THROW

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle dynamisch verarbeitet. Die Verarbeitung soll mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife erfolgen und abbrechen, wenn ein bestimmter Feldwert erreicht wird. Nutzen Sie RTTI für den Feldzugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Index und RTTI (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) für den dynamischen Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_dynamic_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table    TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_target_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_dynamic_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_field_data   TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    lr_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ).
    lr_struct_descr ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( <lt_table> ).
      CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <ls_line>.
      READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX lv_index INTO <ls_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.

        TRY.
            lr_field_data = lr_struct_descr->get_component_by_name( iv_field_name )->get_data_ref( <ls_line> ).
            ASSIGN lr_field_data->* TO <lv_field>.
            IF <lv_field> = iv_target_value.
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
          CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
            " Feld nicht gefunden, ignorieren oder Fehlerbehandlung
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_processed_count = lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und einen Zähler, der herunterzählt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      rv_factorial = 0. " Oder eine Exception werfen
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_result) = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_num) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_num > 0.
      lv_result = lv_result * lv_current_num.
      lv_current_num = lv_current_num - 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_factorial = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factorial FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factorial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_factorial( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 0 ) exp = 1 msg = 'Fakultät von 0 sollte 1 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 1 ) exp = 1 msg = 'Fakultät von 1 sollte 1 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 5 ) exp = 120 msg = 'Fakultät von 5 sollte 120 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 7 ) exp = 5040 msg = 'Fakultät von 7 sollte 5040 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( -3 ) exp = 0 msg = 'Fakultät von negativer Zahl sollte 0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Zahlen in 'klein', 'mittel' und 'groß', indem Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife verwenden, die die Liste durchläuft und die Zahlen entsprechend zuordnet. Brechen Sie die Verarbeitung ab, wenn eine 'große' Zahl gefunden wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` mit einem Index und `COND` oder `CASE` für die Zuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_group_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_numbers,
             small  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
             medium TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
             large  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_grouped_numbers.

    METHODS group_numbers_until_large
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_grouped) TYPE ty_grouped_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_group_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_numbers_until_large.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_number) = 0.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_numbers ).
      READ TABLE it_numbers INDEX lv_index INTO lv_number.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CASE lv_number.
          WHEN 0 TO 10.
            APPEND lv_number TO rs_grouped-small.
          WHEN 11 TO 50.
            APPEND lv_number TO rs_grouped-medium.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            APPEND lv_number TO rs_grouped-large.
            EXIT. " Abbruch bei erster 'großer' Zahl
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_numbers.
    DATA(lt_input_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      5
      25
      8
      60
      12
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_group_numbers( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->group_numbers_until_large( lt_input_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result-small ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 kleine Zahlen haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-small[1] exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-small[2] exp = 8 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result-medium ) exp = 1 msg = 'Sollte 1 mittlere Zahl haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-medium[1] exp = 25 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result-large ) exp = 1 msg = 'Sollte 1 große Zahl haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-large[1] exp = 60 ).

    DATA(lt_input_no_large) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      1
      20
      3
    ).
    ls_result = lo_cut->group_numbers_until_large( lt_input_no_large ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result-small ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result-medium ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result-large ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Reihe von Operationen ausführt, solange eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und die `COND` Expression für eine kompakte Bedingungsprüfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `COND` für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_cond_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_until_condition
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_value TYPE i
        iv_limit       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_cond_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_until_condition.
    DATA(lv_current_value) = iv_start_value.
    DATA(lv_iteration) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_value < iv_limit AND lv_iteration < 10. " Max 10 Iterationen zur Sicherheit
      lv_current_value = COND #( WHEN lv_current_value MOD 2 = 0 THEN lv_current_value + 3 " Gerade Zahl
                                 ELSE lv_current_value + 1 ). " Ungerade Zahl
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_final_value = lv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Sammeln Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, bis eine maximale Anzahl von Flügen erreicht ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` mit einem Index und `APPEND` in eine neue Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_max_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_carrid.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_found_count) = 0.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE ty_sflight( ).

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_sflights ) AND lv_found_count < iv_max_flights.
      READ TABLE it_sflights INDEX lv_index INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF ls_sflight-carrid = iv_carrid.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_filtered_sflights.
          lv_found_count = lv_found_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_while_filter_sflights=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum price = '300' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '004' fldate = sy-datum price = '400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '005' fldate = sy-datum price = '500' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_by_carrid( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_max_flights = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 Flüge filtern' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-connid exp = '003' ).

    DATA(lt_result_all) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_by_carrid( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_max_flights = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_all ) exp = 3 msg = 'Sollte 3 Flüge filtern' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife zum Filtern einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung und einer maximalen Anzahl von Ergebnissen. Die Schleife iteriert durch die Tabelle und fügt passende Einträge zur Ergebnisliste hinzu, bis die maximale Anzahl erreicht ist oder die Tabelle vollständig durchlaufen wurde. Dies ist eine flexible Alternative zu `FOR` für Szenarien mit dynamischen Abbruchbedingungen.
keywords: WHILE, Internal Table, sflights, Filter, Schleife, APPEND

Instructions: Validieren Sie die Eingabe eines Methodenparameters, um sicherzustellen, dass er nicht initial ist, und verwenden Sie dafür die `ASSERT`-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSERT` direkt am Anfang der Methode, um Vorbedingungen zu prüfen. Erstellen Sie eine Check-Gruppe für die Assertion (z.B. Z_ASSERT_CHECK in SAAB).
solution:
CLASS zcl_assert_input_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_input_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    " Define a check group for this assertion (e.g., Z_ASSERT_CHECK)
    " This group must be created in transaction SAAB.
    ASSERT ID z_assert_check
           FIELDS iv_input
           CONDITION iv_input IS NOT INITIAL.

    " Further processing if assertion passes
    WRITE: / 'Input received:', iv_input.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_input FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assertion_failed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_input_validation( ).
    lo_cut->process_data( 'Hello' ).
    " If ASSERT is configured to dump, this test would fail. If configured to ignore, it passes.
    " Assuming SAAB is configured to raise an exception for Z_ASSERT_CHECK, this will pass.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Valid input processed without assertion failure' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_input_validation( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data( '' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected assertion failure for initial input' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assertion_failed.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Assertion failed as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ASSERT`-Anweisung dient der defensiven Programmierung und stellt sicher, dass Vorbedingungen erfüllt sind. Mit `ID` kann eine Check-Gruppe definiert werden, die über Transaktion `SAAB` konfiguriert werden kann, um z.B. bei Fehlern eine Exception auszulösen statt eines Dumps.
keywords: ASSERT, Input Validation, Defensive Programming, SAAB

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `ASSERT` mit einer benutzerdefinierten Nachricht, um eine spezifische Bedingung zu prüfen und bei Nichterfüllung eine informative Meldung auszugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `MESSAGE` Option der `ASSERT`-Anweisung, um Kontextinformationen bereitzustellen. Erstellen Sie eine Check-Gruppe (z.B. Z_ASSERT_CHECK_MSG in SAAB).
solution:
CLASS zcl_assert_with_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_with_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_value.
    " Define a check group for this assertion (e.g., Z_ASSERT_CHECK_MSG)
    " This group must be created in transaction SAAB.
    ASSERT ID z_assert_check_msg
           FIELDS iv_value
           CONDITION iv_value > 0
           MESSAGE 'Value must be greater than zero. Provided value:' && iv_value.
    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie nach der Manipulation einer internen Tabelle, ob die erwartete Anzahl von Einträgen vorhanden ist, indem Sie `ASSERT` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINES()` um die Anzahl der Einträge zu prüfen. Erstellen Sie eine Check-Gruppe (z.B. Z_ASSERT_CHECK_POST in SAAB).
solution:
CLASS zcl_assert_post_condition DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_text TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_post_condition IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_data ).
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = iv_id text = iv_text ) TO ct_data.

    " Define a check group for this assertion (e.g., Z_ASSERT_CHECK_POST)
    " This group must be created in transaction SAAB.
    ASSERT ID z_assert_check_post
           CONDITION lines( ct_data ) = lv_initial_lines + 1
           MESSAGE 'Expected one more line after append'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_post_condition( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_assert_post_condition=>tt_data( ).

    lo_cut->add_entry( EXPORTING iv_id = 1 iv_text = 'First' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 1 ).

    lo_cut->add_entry( EXPORTING iv_id = 2 iv_text = 'Second' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Post-condition `ASSERT`s sind wichtig, um die Korrektheit von Datenmanipulationen zu gewährleisten. Hier wird überprüft, ob nach dem Hinzufügen eines Eintrags die Zeilenanzahl der internen Tabelle korrekt erhöht wurde.
keywords: ASSERT, Internal Tables, Post-condition, LINES

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und stellen Sie mit `ASSERT` sicher, dass der Preis (`PRICE`) jedes Fluges positiv ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für effiziente Iteration und `ASSERT` innerhalb der Schleife. Erstellen Sie eine Check-Gruppe (z.B. Z_ASSERT_CHECK_LOOP in SAAB).
solution:
CLASS zcl_assert_loop_consistency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_prices_positive) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_loop_consistency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rv_all_prices_positive = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      " Define a check group for this assertion (e.g., Z_ASSERT_CHECK_LOOP)
      " This group must be created in transaction SAAB.
      ASSERT ID z_assert_check_loop
             FIELDS <fs_flight>-carrid, <fs_flight>-connid, <fs_flight>-fldate, <fs_flight>-price
             CONDITION <fs_flight>-price > 0
             MESSAGE 'Flight price must be positive for flight' && <fs_flight>-carrid && <fs_flight>-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_positive_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_loop_consistency( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_flight_prices( ).
    " Assuming SFLIGHTS data generally has positive prices. If not, this test would fail (dump or exception).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Überprüfen der Datenkonsistenz innerhalb einer Schleife mit `ASSERT` ist eine leistungsstarke Technik, um Invarianten zu gewährleisten. Hier wird sichergestellt, dass alle Flugpreise in der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle positiv sind, was eine grundlegende Geschäftsregel sein könnte.
keywords: ASSERT, LOOP AT, Field-Symbol, Data Consistency, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode auf, die einen Rückgabewert (`sy-subrc`) setzt, und verwenden Sie `ASSERT`, um zu überprüfen, ob der Aufruf erfolgreich war (`sy-subrc` = 0).
hint: Führen Sie den Methodenaufruf durch und prüfen Sie anschließend `sy-subrc` mit `ASSERT`. Erstellen Sie eine Check-Gruppe (z.B. Z_ASSERT_CHECK_SUBRC in SAAB).
solution:
CLASS zcl_assert_sy_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_subrc) TYPE sy-subrc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_sy_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    IF iv_condition = abap_true.
      rv_subrc = 0. " Simulate success
    ELSE.
      rv_subrc = 4. " Simulate failure
    ENDIF.

    " Define a check group for this assertion (e.g., Z_ASSERT_CHECK_SUBRC)
    " This group must be created in transaction SAAB.
    ASSERT ID z_assert_check_subrc
           FIELDS rv_subrc
           CONDITION rv_subrc = 0
           MESSAGE 'Operation failed, sy-subrc is not 0'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` (simuliert) um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften zu holen.
hint: Da `FOR ALL ENTRIES` nicht direkt mit `OPEN CURSOR` verwendet werden kann, simulieren Sie dies, indem Sie die `WHERE`-Klausel dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle aufbauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_fae_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_fae_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_where_clause TYPE string_table.
    DATA: lv_first_carrier TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND `CARRID IN (` TO lt_where_clause.
      LOOP AT it_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
        IF lv_first_carrier = abap_false.
          APPEND `,` TO lt_where_clause.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND `'` && lv_carrier && `'` TO lt_where_clause.
        lv_first_carrier = abap_false.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND `)` TO lt_where_clause.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights
        WHERE (lt_where_clause)
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE rt_flights.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `ASSERT` um sicherzustellen, dass eine interne Tabelle nicht leer ist, bevor Sie Operationen darauf ausführen.
hint: Prüfen Sie die interne Tabelle mit `IS NOT INITIAL` in der `ASSERT`-Anweisung. Erstellen Sie eine Check-Gruppe (z.B. Z_ASSERT_CHECK_TABLE in SAAB).
solution:
CLASS zcl_assert_table_not_empty DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_table
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_table_not_empty IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table.
    " Define a check group for this assertion (e.g., Z_ASSERT_CHECK_TABLE)
    " This group must be created in transaction SAAB.
    ASSERT ID z_assert_check_table
           FIELDS it_items
           CONDITION it_items IS NOT INITIAL
           MESSAGE 'Input table must not be empty'.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN it_items NEXT s = s + item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_non_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assertion_failed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_non_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_table_not_empty( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_assert_table_not_empty=>tt_item( ( value = 1 ) ( value = 2 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->process_table( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_table_not_empty( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_assert_table_not_empty=>tt_item( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_table( lt_items ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected assertion failure for empty table' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assertion_failed.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Assertion failed as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Überprüfen, ob eine interne Tabelle nicht leer ist, bevor darauf zugegriffen wird, ist eine grundlegende defensive Programmierpraxis. `ASSERT IS NOT INITIAL` stellt dies sicher und verhindert Laufzeitfehler bei leeren Tabellen.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` zu holen und gleichzeitig eine Aggregation (z.B. Summe der Preise) durchzuführen.
hint: Holen Sie die Daten in Paketen und aggregieren Sie die Werte in der Schleife. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_flight_prices_package TYPE tt_flight_price.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT price
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_flight_prices_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      rv_total_price = rv_total_price + REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN lt_flight_prices_package NEXT s = s + item-price ).
      CLEAR lt_flight_prices_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_aggregate( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_package_size = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_price > 0 ).
    " A more robust test would involve comparing with a direct SELECT SUM(price) from SFLIGHTS.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE s_price.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO lv_expected_sum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `OPEN CURSOR` mit paketweisem `FETCH` und der `REDUCE`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine effiziente Aggregation von Daten direkt während des Lesevorgangs. Dies ist besonders vorteilhaft für sehr große Datensätze, bei denen eine vollständige Ladung in den Speicher vermieden werden soll.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, Aggregation, REDUCE, Database Access, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von HTTP-Antworten (bestehend aus Statuscode und Nachricht), um nur die erfolgreichen (2xx) oder umgeleiteten (3xx) Antworten zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` Ausdrücke in Kombination mit `is_success` und `is_redirection`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
         status_code TYPE i,
         message     TYPE string,
       END OF ty_http_response.
TYPES: ty_http_responses TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_http_response WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_rest_response_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_successful_or_redirect
      IMPORTING
        it_responses TYPE ty_http_responses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_responses) TYPE ty_http_responses.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_response_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_successful_or_redirect.
    rt_filtered_responses = FILTER #( it_responses USING KEY primary_key WHERE
      ( cl_rest_status_code=>is_success( status_code ) OR
        cl_rest_status_code=>is_redirection( status_code ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_responses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_responses.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rest_response_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_responses) = VALUE zcl_rest_response_filter=>ty_http_responses(
      ( status_code = 200 message = 'OK' )
      ( status_code = 201 message = 'Created' )
      ( status_code = 302 message = 'Found' )
      ( status_code = 404 message = 'Not Found' )
      ( status_code = 500 message = 'Internal Server Error' )
      ( status_code = 301 message = 'Moved Permanently' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_successful_or_redirect( lt_responses ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 4 msg = 'Es sollten 4 Einträge gefiltert werden' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_filtered[ status_code = 302 ] ) ) msg = '302 sollte enthalten sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_filtered[ status_code = 404 ] ) ) msg = '404 sollte nicht enthalten sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen HTTP-Statuscode empfängt und basierend auf dessen Kategorie (Erfolg, Client-Fehler, Server-Fehler, Umleitung, Information) eine spezifische Meldung zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF...ELSE IF` oder `CASE` mit den `is_...` Methoden der `cl_rest_status_code`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_status_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_message.
    IF cl_rest_status_code=>is_success( iv_status_code ).
      rv_message = 'Anfrage erfolgreich verarbeitet.'.
    ELSE IF cl_rest_status_code=>is_client_error( iv_status_code ).
      rv_message = 'Client-seitiger Fehler aufgetreten.'.
    ELSE IF cl_rest_status_code=>is_server_error( iv_status_code ).
      rv_message = 'Server-seitiger Fehler aufgetreten.'.
    ELSE IF cl_rest_status_code=>is_redirection( iv_status_code ).
      rv_message = 'Anfrage wurde umgeleitet.'.
    ELSE IF cl_rest_status_code=>is_informational( iv_status_code ).
      rv_message = 'Informationeller Status.'.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = 'Unbekannter HTTP-Status.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie einen `decfloat34`-Wert, um sicherzustellen, dass er innerhalb der gültigen Grenzen liegt. Wenn er außerhalb liegt, geben Sie den nächstgelegenen Grenzwert zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_max_value` und `get_min_value` für `decfloat34` in einer `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_df34_boundary_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clamp_decfloat34
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_clamped_value) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_df34_boundary_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clamp_decfloat34.
    DATA(lv_min_df34_data) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( cl_abap_decfloat34descr=>get_instance( ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_df34_data) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( cl_abap_decfloat34descr=>get_instance( ) ).

    DATA(lv_min_df34) TYPE decfloat34 VALUE lv_min_df34_data.
    DATA(lv_max_df34) TYPE decfloat34 VALUE lv_max_df34_data.

    rv_clamped_value = COND #( WHEN iv_value < lv_min_df34 THEN lv_min_df34
                               WHEN iv_value > lv_max_df34 THEN lv_max_df34
                               ELSE iv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen `int8`-Wert in einen `i`-Wert. Falls der `int8`-Wert außerhalb des Bereichs von `i` liegt, soll stattdessen der nächstgelegene Grenzwert des `i`-Typs zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_min_value` und `get_max_value` für `i` in einem `COND`-Ausdruck, um den Wert vor der Zuweisung zu klemmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int8_to_i_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_int8_to_i
      IMPORTING
        iv_int8_value TYPE int8
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_i_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int8_to_i_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_int8_to_i.
    DATA(lv_min_i_data) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( cl_abap_intdescr=>get_instance( ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_i_data) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( cl_abap_intdescr=>get_instance( ) ).

    DATA(lv_min_i) TYPE i VALUE lv_min_i_data.
    DATA(lv_max_i) TYPE i VALUE lv_max_i_data.

    rv_i_value = COND #( WHEN iv_int8_value < lv_min_i THEN lv_min_i
                         WHEN iv_int8_value > lv_max_i THEN lv_max_i
                         ELSE CAST i( iv_int8_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_int8_to_i( -54321 ) exp = -54321 msg = 'Negativer Wert innerhalb des Bereichs sollte korrekt konvertiert werden' ).

    DATA(lv_min_i) TYPE i VALUE lv_min_i_data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_int8_to_i( lv_min_i - 100 ) exp = lv_min_i msg = 'Wert unter Min I sollte auf Min I geklemmt werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_convert_above_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int8_to_i_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_max_i_data) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( cl_abap_intdescr=>get_instance( ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_i) TYPE i VALUE lv_max_i_data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_int8_to_i( lv_max_i + 100 ) exp = lv_max_i msg = 'Wert über Max I sollte auf Max I geklemmt werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine robuste Typkonvertierung von `int8` nach `i` unter Berücksichtigung der Typgrenzen. Der `COND`-Ausdruck wird verwendet, um den `int8`-Wert vor der Zuweisung an `i` zu 'klemmen', falls er außerhalb des gültigen Bereichs liegt. Dies verhindert Laufzeitfehler durch Überlauf/Unterlauf und stellt sicher, dass die Konvertierung immer einen gültigen `i`-Wert liefert. Die dynamische Ermittlung der Grenzen durch `cl_abap_exceptional_values` macht die Lösung flexibel und sicher.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein einfaches Interface `IF_SHAPE` mit einer Methode `GET_AREA`, die die Fläche als Gleitkommazahl zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen, `CL_RECTANGLE` und `CL_CIRCLE`, und berechnen Sie deren jeweilige Flächen.

INTERFACE if_shape PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES if_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE i.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF mc_math,
                 pi TYPE f VALUE '3.14159',

CLASS cl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_ITEM_FILTER` mit einer Methode `IS_MATCHING`, die einen String (den Artikelnamen) entgegennimmt und einen booleschen Wert zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `CL_CONTAINS_FILTER`, um zu prüfen, ob der Artikelname eine bestimmte Teilzeichenfolge enthält. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck, um eine Tabelle von Artikelnamen basierend auf einer Instanz von `CL_CONTAINS_FILTER` zu filtern.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck kann eine Klasse, die ein Interface implementiert, für benutzerdefinierte Filterlogik verwenden.
solution:
INTERFACE if_item_filter PUBLIC.
  METHODS is_matching IMPORTING iv_item_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_contains_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_item_filter.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_substring TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_substring TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_contains_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_substring = iv_substring.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_item_filter~is_matching.
    IF iv_item_name CA mv_substring.
      rv_match = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_match = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_items
      IMPORTING
        it_all_items TYPE tt_items
        io_filter    TYPE REF TO if_item_filter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_items.
    rt_filtered_items = FILTER #( it_all_items USING io_filter->is_matching( name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_filter_demo=>tt_items(

      ( name = 'Orange' )
      ( name = 'Pineapple' )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_DATA_PROVIDER` mit einer Methode `GET_DATA` (gibt eine String-Tabelle zurück) und einer Standardmethode `GET_DATA_COUNT` (gibt die Anzahl der Zeilen zurück). Implementieren Sie es in `CL_STATIC_DATA_PROVIDER` mit festen Daten und in `CL_DYNAMIC_DATA_PROVIDER`, die Daten aus `sflights` liest. Demonstrieren Sie die Nutzung der Standardmethode und die Überschreibung in `CL_DYNAMIC_DATA_PROVIDER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DEFAULT` für die Standardmethode und `lines()` für die Zählung.
solution:
INTERFACE if_data_provider PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
  METHODS get_data_count DEFAULT 0 RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_static_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_static_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_provider~get_data.
    APPEND 'Static Data 1' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Static Data 2' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_data_provider~get_data_count.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_data( ).
    rv_count = lines( lt_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_dynamic_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_dynamic_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_data_provider~get_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.
    rt_data = VALUE string_table( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_data_provider~get_data_count.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO rv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_data_providers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_providers.
    DATA(lo_static) = NEW cl_static_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic) = NEW cl_dynamic_data_provider( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_static->if_data_provider~get_data_count( ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lo_dynamic->if_data_provider~get_data_count( ) exp = 0 ). " Should be > 0

    DATA(lt_static_data) = lo_static->if_data_provider~get_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_static_data ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Verwenden Sie eine Liste von Validatoren und den `ALL` Operator, um zu prüfen, ob ein String alle Validierungen besteht.

solution:
INTERFACE if_validator PUBLIC.
  METHODS validate IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS cl_not_empty_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_not_empty_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_validator~validate.
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_min_length_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_validator.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_min_length TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_min_length TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_min_length_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min_length = iv_min_length.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_validator~validate.
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN strlen( iv_value ) >= mv_min_length THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_composite_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_all
      IMPORTING
        iv_value     TYPE string
        it_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_validator WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_composite_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_all.
    rv_all_valid = ALL #( it_validators WHERE validate( iv_value ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_min_length_5) = NEW cl_min_length_validator( 5 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die zwei beliebige Strukturen miteinander vergleicht und die Namen der Felder zurückgibt, die unterschiedliche Werte haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und Feld-Symbole für den Vergleich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_diff_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_structures IMPORTING is_struct1 TYPE any
                                         is_struct2 TYPE any
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_diff_fields) TYPE tt_diff_fields.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_struct1 ) ).
    DATA: <fs_field1> TYPE any,
          <fs_field2> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_struct1 TO <fs_field1>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_struct2 TO <fs_field2>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Both fields exist
        IF <fs_field1> <> <fs_field2>.
          APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_diff_fields.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_structures FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_structures.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA: ls_data1 TYPE ty_data,
          ls_data2 TYPE ty_data.

    ls_data1 = VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'A' value = '1.0' ).
    ls_data2 = VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'B' value = '2.0' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_compare( ).
    DATA(lt_diffs) = lo_cut->compare_structures( is_struct1 = ls_data1 is_struct2 = ls_data2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_diffs ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_diffs[ 1 ] exp = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_diffs[ 2 ] exp = 'VALUE' ).

    ls_data2 = VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'A' value = '1.0' ).
    lt_diffs = lo_cut->compare_structures( is_struct1 = ls_data1 is_struct2 = ls_data2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_diffs ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von RTTI für generische Vergleiche von Strukturen. Durch die dynamische Analyse der Komponenten können zwei Strukturen beliebigen Typs verglichen werden, ohne dass der Typ zur Entwicklungszeit bekannt sein muss. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Flexibilität des Codes.
keywords: RTTI, Generisch, Vergleich, Feld-Symbol, Struktur, cl_abap_typedescr

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API durch und geben Sie den Statuscode zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url()`, `send()` und `receive()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_http_status IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_http_status.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            iv_url = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            eo_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RETURN. " Error creating client
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN. " Error sending request
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN. " Error receiving response
        ENDIF.

        rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error.
        rv_status_code = -1. " Indicate connection error
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        rv_status_code = -2. " Other errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-Request durch und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler (z.B. Verbindungsprobleme, HTTP-Fehlercodes) ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_http_dest_state_error` und prüfen Sie den Statuscode der Antwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_request_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_request_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    DATA: lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            iv_url = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            eo_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_result = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          rs_result = 'Error sending request'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          rs_result = 'Error receiving response'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          rs_result = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ELSE.
          rs_result = |Success: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_error).
        rs_result = |Connection Error: { lx_dest_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rs_result = |Other Error: { lx_static_check->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und setzen Sie einen benutzerdefinierten Header.
hint: Verwenden Sie `client->request->set_header_field()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_custom_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_with_custom_header IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string
                                             iv_header_name TYPE string
                                             iv_header_value TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rs_response_body) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_custom_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_with_custom_header.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            iv_url = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            eo_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = iv_header_name value = iv_header_value ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error.
        rs_response_body = 'CONNECTION_ERROR'.
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        rs_response_body = 'OTHER_ERROR'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit SSL-Zertifikatsprüfung durch.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Destination im SM59 oder über `cl_http_client=>create_by_destination` korrekt konfiguriert ist und SSL verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_ssl_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_with_ssl_check IMPORTING iv_destination TYPE string
                               RETURNING VALUE(rs_response_body) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_ssl_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_with_ssl_check.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_destination(
          EXPORTING
            destination = iv_destination
          IMPORTING
            client      = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS      = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_response_body = 'Error creating HTTP client by destination'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          rs_response_body = 'Error sending request'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          rs_response_body = 'Error receiving response'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_error).
        rs_response_body = |Connection Error: { lx_dest_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rs_response_body = |Other Error: { lx_static_check->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld sortiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `SORT` mit dynamischer Feldangabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically IMPORTING CHANGING ct_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                                   IMPORTING iv_field_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. " Not a table
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    IF lo_line_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ) IS INITIAL.
      RETURN. " Field not found in line type
    ENDIF.

    SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_table_dynamically FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_table_dynamically.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 2 name = 'B' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 1 name = 'A' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 3 name = 'C' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).

    " Sort by ID
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_table = lt_data
                                    IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).

    " Sort by Name
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_table = lt_data
                                    IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-name exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-name exp = 'B' ).

    " Test with non-existent field (should not change table)
    DATA(lt_data_orig) = lt_data.
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_table = lt_data
                                    IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data exp = lt_data_orig ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man RTTI verwendet, um interne Tabellen dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit bestimmten Feld zu sortieren. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Technik für generische Berichte oder Datenverarbeitung, bei der die Sortierkriterien flexibel sein müssen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamisch, Sortieren, Interne Tabelle, SORT, cl_abap_tabledescr

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request über einen konfigurierten Proxy-Server durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url()` und setzen Sie den Proxy über `client->property_set_static( iv_property = cl_http_client=>co_property_proxy_host ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_proxy_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_via_proxy IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string
                                    iv_proxy_host TYPE string
                                    iv_proxy_port TYPE string
                            RETURNING VALUE(rs_response_body) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_proxy_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_via_proxy.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO cl_http_client.
    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            iv_url = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            eo_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->property_set_static( iv_property = cl_http_client=>co_property_proxy_host iv_value = iv_proxy_host ).
        lo_http_client->property_set_static( iv_property = cl_http_client=>co_property_proxy_service iv_value = iv_proxy_port ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_error).
        rs_response_body = |Connection Error: { lx_dest_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rs_response_body = |Other Error: { lx_static_check->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " HINWEIS: Für diesen Test benötigen Sie einen funktionierenden Proxy-Server in Ihrer Umgebung.
    " Ersetzen Sie 'your.proxy.host' und '8080' durch die tatsächlichen Proxy-Informationen.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine interne Tabelle zu und lesen Sie einen Wert aus einer bestimmten Spalte, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_index    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE it_data INDEX iv_index ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_read( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( it_data = lt_sflight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_index = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_connid) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( it_data = lt_sflight iv_field_name = 'CONNID' iv_index = 1 ).

Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen.

hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb einer `LOOP AT` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data       TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE ty_data,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_modify( ).
    lo_cut->modify_dynamic_field( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'TEXT' iv_new_value = 'New Value' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-text exp = 'New Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-text exp = 'New Value' ).

solution:

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `sflights` generisch. Lesen Sie dynamisch die Werte der Spalten `carrid` und `connid` aus und geben Sie diese als String-Liste zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in einer `LOOP AT` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_sflight_generic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_sflight_generic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight,
                   <fs_carrid>  TYPE s_carr_id,
                   <fs_connid>  TYPE s_conn_id.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_carrid>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_connid>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |Flug: { <fs_carrid> } - { <fs_connid> }| TO rt_info.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sflight_generic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_generic.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fs_sflight_generic=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_sflight_generic( ).
    DATA(lt_info) = lo_cut->get_flight_info( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_info ) exp = lines( lt_sflights ) ).
    IF lines( lt_info ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 1 ] exp = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 1 ] exp = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-connid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die generische Verarbeitung von Daten aus der `sflight`-Tabelle. Durch die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` können Spaltennamen dynamisch zur Laufzeit referenziert werden, ohne dass die genaue Struktur der Tabelle zur Kompilierzeit fest codiert sein muss. Dies ist ideal für flexible Berichte oder Schnittstellen. Die `SELECT` Anweisung mit `@` ist moderne ABAP-Syntax für Open SQL.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, sflights, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Open SQL

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie einen String auf das Vorhandensein von Steuerzeichen (nicht druckbare Zeichen) mithilfe der Konstanten aus `cl_abap_char_utilities`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_char_utilities=>char_tab`, `cr_lf` etc. und `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_control_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_control_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_contains) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_control_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_control_char.
    DATA(lv_control_chars) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                             cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab &&
                             cl_abap_char_utilities=>form_feed &&
                             cl_abap_char_utilities=>vertical_tab.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX `[\x00-\x1F\x7F]` IN iv_input.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rb_contains = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_contains = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    " Alternative using FIND with character constants (less efficient for many chars)
    " FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_control_chars IN iv_input.
    " IF sy-subrc = 0.
    "   rb_contains = abap_true.
    " ELSE.
    "   rb_contains = abap_false.
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_control_char_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_control_char_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_control_char_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_control_check( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = |Hello{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }World|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_control_char( lv_input ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_control_char_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_control_check( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_control_char( lv_input ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet einen regulären Ausdruck (`REGEX`) mit `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF` um effizient nach Steuerzeichen im ASCII-Bereich 0x00-0x1F und 0x7F zu suchen. Obwohl `cl_abap_char_utilities` Konstanten für spezifische Steuerzeichen bietet, ist ein Regex-Ansatz oft flexibler und effizienter, um eine ganze Klasse von Zeichen zu prüfen. Dies ist wichtig für die Datenbereinigung und Validierung.
keywords: cl_abap_char_utilities, String, Control Characters, REGEX, FIND

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dem dynamischen Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS _method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF me RECEIVING RESULTS <fs_result>.
        rv_result = <fs_result>.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Methode nicht gefunden oder ungültiger Aufruf.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_a.
    rv_text = 'Methode A wurde aufgerufen.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_b.
    rv_text = 'Methode B wurde aufgerufen.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_dynamic_method_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_invalid FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_method( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( '_METHOD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Methode A wurde aufgerufen.' ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( '_METHOD_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Methode B wurde aufgerufen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF object` ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible Architekturen und Frameworks. Der Methodenname wird zur Laufzeit als String übergeben. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` (`<fs_result>`) zum Empfangen des Rückgabewerts ist hierbei die moderne und typsichere Methode. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ist essenziell.
