Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und den Tabellenindex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
                           seed = cl_abap_random=>seed(
                           min  = 1
                           max  = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rs_sflight = lt_sflights[ lv_random_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) zufällig durch (Shuffle).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` und eine Schleife mit Tauschoperationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    rt_shuffled_sflights = it_sflights.
    IF rt_shuffled_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( rt_shuffled_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
                           seed = cl_abap_random=>seed(
                           min  = 1
                           max  = lv_table_size ).

    DO lv_table_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-index.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Swap elements
      DATA(ls_temp) = rt_shuffled_sflights[ lv_current_index ].
      rt_shuffled_sflights[ lv_current_index ] = rt_shuffled_sflights[ lv_random_index ].
      rt_shuffled_sflights[ lv_random_index ] = ls_temp.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).
    DATA lt_original_sflights TYPE zcl_random_table_shuffle=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_original_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_original_sflights IS INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'SFLIGHT table is empty, cannot test shuffle.' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_shuffled_sflights) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_original_sflights ).

    " Assert that the size remains the same
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) ).

    " Assert that content is the same (just order changed)
    DATA(lt_sorted_original) = lt_original_sflights.
    SORT lt_sorted_original BY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA(lt_sorted_shuffled) = lt_shuffled_sflights.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled BY carrid connid fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled exp = lt_sorted_original ).

    " Assert that the order is likely different (probabilistic)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_shuffled_sflights <> lt_original_sflights OR lines( lt_original_sflights ) <= 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).
    DATA lt_empty_table TYPE zcl_random_table_shuffle=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_empty_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_shuffled ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_single_entry_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).
    DATA lt_single_entry_table TYPE zcl_random_table_shuffle=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100' ) TO lt_single_entry_table.
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_single_entry_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_single_entry_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie iteriert durch die Tabelle und tauscht jeden Eintrag mit einem zufällig ausgewählten Eintrag aus. `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` wird verwendet, um die zufälligen Indizes zu generieren. Dies ist eine effiziente und faire Methode, um die Reihenfolge von Elementen in einer internen Tabelle zu randomisieren.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLES, SHUFFLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 zufälligen Flugverbindungen aus der `sflight`-Tabelle, wobei jede Verbindung eindeutig sein muss.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und eine `LOOP` mit `COLLECT` oder `APPEND` und `LINE_EXISTS` zur Eindeutigkeitsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_flights.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid connid.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    IF lt_all_sflights IS INITIAL OR lines( lt_all_sflights ) < iv_number_of_flights.
      " Not enough flights available or table is empty
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_all_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
                           seed = cl_abap_random=>seed(
                           min  = 1
                           max  = lv_max_index )).

    DATA lt_selected_keys TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DO.
      IF lines( rt_unique_flights ) >= iv_number_of_flights.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      DATA(ls_random_flight) = lt_all_sflights[ lv_random_index ].

      DATA(ls_key) = VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = ls_random_flight-carrid connid = ls_random_flight-connid ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_selected_keys[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_key-carrid connid = ls_key-connid ] ).
        INSERT ls_key INTO TABLE lt_selected_keys.
        APPEND ls_random_flight TO rt_unique_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Check for uniqueness
    DATA lt_unique_check TYPE HASHED TABLE OF zcl_random_unique_flights=>ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) < 99999 ). " Should return fewer than requested or initial
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Methode liest zunächst alle Flüge aus `sflight` in eine interne Tabelle. Anschließend wird in einer Schleife mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` ein zufälliger Index generiert, um einen Flug aus der vollständigen Liste auszuwählen. Um die Eindeutigkeit zu gewährleisten, wird ein Hash-Tabelle (`lt_selected_keys`) verwendet, um bereits ausgewählte Flugschlüssel zu speichern. Nur wenn ein Flug noch nicht ausgewählt wurde, wird er zur Ergebnisliste hinzugefügt. Dies stellt sicher, dass die zurückgegebene Liste eindeutige, zufällige Flüge enthält.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle eines bestimmten Zeilentyps, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_line_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA lo_line_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lo_table_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_line_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( iv_line_type_name ).
        lo_table_type_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                  p_line_type = lo_line_type_descr
                                  p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                                  p_unique = abap_false ).
        CREATE DATA rr_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type_descr.

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Line type not found
        CLEAR rr_table_ref.
      CATCH cx_sy_table_descr_error.
        " Error creating table descriptor
        CLEAR rr_table_ref.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob der SHA256-Hashwert eines Strings mit einem erwarteten Wert übereinstimmt.
hint: Berechnen Sie den Hash des Eingabestrings und vergleichen Sie das Ergebnis mit dem erwarteten XSTRING-Hashwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_sha256_verify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_expected_hash TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_sha256_verify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_sha256.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_calculated_hash) = lo_digest->calculate_digest_for_string( iv_input_string ).
    rv_is_valid = COND #( WHEN lv_calculated_hash = iv_expected_hash THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sha256_verification.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_sha256_verify( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Test String'.
    DATA(lv_valid_hash) = '532EAABD9574880DBF76B9B8CC00832C20A6EC113D682299550D7A6E0F345E25'. "SHA256 of 'Test String'
    DATA(lv_invalid_hash) = 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->verify_sha256( iv_input_string = lv_input iv_expected_hash = lv_valid_hash )
      msg = 'Valid hash verification failed' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->verify_sha256( iv_input_string = lv_input iv_expected_hash = lv_invalid_hash )
      msg = 'Invalid hash verification succeeded' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine praktische Anwendung von Hashing zur Integritätsprüfung. Der berechnete Hash wird direkt mit einem erwarteten Hash verglichen. Die Verwendung des `COND` Operators macht den Code kompakt und lesbar.
keywords: Hashing, SHA256, Verification, Security, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, COND

Instructions: Berechne einen konsistenten SHA256-Hashwert für den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle von Strings.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die Tabelle in einen String oder XSTRING, bevor Sie den Hash berechnen. Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_GZIP` oder `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ_A_X`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_hash_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             line TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_table_sha256
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sha256_hash) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_hash_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_table_sha256.
    DATA(lv_serialized_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs> IN it_data
      NEXT s = s && <fs>-line ).

    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    rv_sha256_hash = lo_digest->calculate_digest_for_string( lv_serialized_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_sha256 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_sha256.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_hash_table( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_msg_hash_table=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 2' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 3' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_hash1) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_data ).

    CLEAR lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 2' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 3' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_hash2) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_hash1
      exp = lv_hash2
      msg = 'Hashes of identical tables should match' ).

    CLEAR lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 2' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( line = 'Line 4' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_hash3) = lo_cut->calculate_table_sha256( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs(
      act = lv_hash1
      exp = lv_hash3
      msg = 'Hashes of different tables should differ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der Inhalt einer internen Tabelle gehasht werden kann, um deren Integrität zu überprüfen. Die Tabelle wird zuerst mit einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck in einen einzelnen String serialisiert, was eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation darstellt. Anschließend wird der SHA256-Hash berechnet.
keywords: Hashing, Internal Table, Serialization, SHA256, REDUCE, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST

CLASS zcl_rng_single_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rng_single_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_carrid_range.
    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( ( sign   = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include
                                  option = if_fsbp_const_range=>operator_equal
                                  low    = iv_carrid ) ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_single_carrid_range.

    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_single_carrid_range( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 1 msg = 'Range table should have one entry' ).
    READ TABLE lt_range INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_range_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-sign   exp = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-option exp = if_fsbp_const_range=>operator_equal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-low    exp = lv_carrid ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Erstellung einer Range-Tabelle für einen einzelnen Wert mit dem `VALUE`-Operator. Die Verwendung von Konstanten aus `if_fsbp_const_range` verbessert die Lesbarkeit und vermeidet 'Magic Strings' für Zeichen und Optionen.

CLASS zcl_rng_multi_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_carrid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_multi_value( ).
    DATA lt_carrids TYPE zcl_rng_multi_value=>tt_carrids.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_carrids.
    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_carrids.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Range-Tabelle basierend auf optionalen Eingabeparametern (z.B. Einzelwert, Bereich, Muster).
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `CASE` Ausdrücke in Kombination mit den `if_fsbp_const_range` Konstanten, um die Range-Tabelle flexibel zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    METHODS get_dynamic_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_single_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_carrid_from   TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_carrid_to     TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_pattern       TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE ty_sflight_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_carrid_range.
    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( LET
      lv_single_set = xsdbool( iv_single_carrid IS NOT INITIAL )
      lv_range_set  = xsdbool( iv_carrid_from IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_carrid_to IS NOT INITIAL )
      lv_pattern_set = xsdbool( iv_pattern IS NOT INITIAL )
    IN
      COND #( WHEN lv_single_set THEN
                ( sign   = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include
                  option = if_fsbp_const_range=>operator_equal
                  low    = iv_single_carrid )
              WHEN lv_range_set THEN
                ( sign   = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include
                  option = if_fsbp_const_range=>operator_between
                  low    = iv_carrid_from
                  high   = iv_carrid_to )
              WHEN lv_pattern_set THEN
                ( sign   = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include
                  option = if_fsbp_const_range=>operator_contains_pattern
                  low    = iv_pattern )
              ELSE
                THROW cx_abap_invalid_parameter_value( textid = cx_abap_invalid_parameter_value=>default ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-option exp = if_fsbp_const_range=>operator_between ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_range_pattern.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_carrid_range( iv_pattern = 'A*' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 1 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_dynamic( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_dynamic_carrid_range( ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught exception for no parameters' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine interne Tabelle leer ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` an ein Field-Symbol vom Typ `ANY TABLE` und prüfen Sie mit `IS INITIAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_is_table_empty DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_table_empty
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_empty) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_table_empty IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_table_empty.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF <lt_any_table> IS INITIAL.
      rv_is_empty = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_empty = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_table_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_is_table_not_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_table_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_is_table_empty( ).
    DATA(lv_is_empty) = lo_cut->is_table_empty( REF #( lt_sflights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_empty exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_table_not_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_is_table_empty( ).
    DATA(lv_is_empty) = lo_cut->is_table_empty( REF #( lt_sflights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_empty exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch Zuweisung der Datenreferenz an ein Field-Symbol vom Typ `ANY TABLE` kann die `IS INITIAL`-Prüfung direkt auf die dynamische Tabelle angewendet werden.
keywords: RTTI, dynamisch, Tabelle, leer, IS INITIAL

Instructions: Zeigen Sie einen einfachen HTML-String in einem `CL_GUI_HTML_VIEWER` an.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_html
      IMPORTING
        iv_html_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_html.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_html_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_html_viewer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'HTML_CONTAINER'. " Needs a screen with a custom control named HTML_CONTAINER

    CREATE OBJECT lo_html_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_html_viewer->load_data
      EXPORTING
        url            = ' '
        html_xstring   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( iv_html_string )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error loading HTML data' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush. " Ensure GUI update
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_display_html FOR TESTING. ENDCLASS. CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD test_display_html. " This test cannot directly verify GUI display. " It can only check if the methods are called without exceptions. " For actual GUI testing, manual inspection or specialized tools are needed. DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'HTML_CONTAINER' ). " This will fail if run without screen DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_html_viewer_simple( ). TRY. lo_cut->display_html( '

Hello World

' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " If no dump, assume success for this limited test CATCH cx_root. cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception occurred during HTML display' ). ENDTRY. lo_container->free( ). " Clean up container ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Behandlung eines Klicks auf einen Link innerhalb des `CL_GUI_HTML_VIEWER`.
hint: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `ON_LCLICK` Ereignis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_html_viewer_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS link_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(i_url) TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    METHODS display_html IMPORTING iv_html_string TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_html_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_html_viewer.
    METHODS handle_lclick FOR EVENT on_lclick OF cl_gui_html_viewer
      IMPORTING
        p_url TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_html_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
    SET HANDLER handle_lclick FOR mo_html_viewer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_html.
    CALL METHOD mo_html_viewer->load_data
      EXPORTING
        url            = ' '
        html_xstring   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( iv_html_string )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error loading HTML data' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_lclick.
    RAISE EVENT link_clicked EXPORTING i_url = p_url.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_clicked_url TYPE string.
    METHODS test_link_click_event FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_test_event FOR EVENT link_clicked OF zcl_html_viewer_events
      IMPORTING
        i_url TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_link_click_event.
    " This test requires a custom container to be available, which is tricky in unit tests.
    " For demonstration, we'll simulate the event call.
    " In a real scenario, you'd need to mock the GUI environment or run in a test program.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'HTML_CONTAINER' ). " This will fail if run without screen
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_html_viewer_events( lo_container ).
    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR lo_cut.

    DATA(lv_test_url) = 'http://test.com/link'.
    " Directly call the event handler method to simulate the event
    lo_cut->handle_lclick( p_url = lv_test_url ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_clicked_url exp = lv_test_url ).
    lo_container->free( ). " Clean up container
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_test_event.
    mv_clicked_url = i_url.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein lokaler Event-Handler `handle_lclick` wird für das `ON_LCLICK`-Ereignis des `CL_GUI_HTML_VIEWER` registriert. Wenn ein Link im Viewer angeklickt wird, wird dieses Ereignis ausgelöst und die URL an den Handler übergeben. Die Klasse kann dann ein eigenes Ereignis `link_clicked` auslösen, um die Information weiterzugeben.
keywords: CL_GUI_HTML_VIEWER, Event Handling, ON_LCLICK, GUI, Link

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_TIMER` instanziiert, startet und nach einer bestimmten Zeit stoppt. Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Verwendung des Timers.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden `CREATE OBJECT`, `INTERVAL`, `RUN`, `STOP` und `FREE` der Klasse `CL_GUI_TIMER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS start_and_stop_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_and_stop_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).

    " In a real GUI scenario, the timer event would trigger asynchronously.
    " For demonstration, we simulate a wait and then stop.
    WAIT UP TO ( iv_interval_seconds + 1 ) SECONDS.

    mo_timer->stop( ).
    FREE OBJECT mo_timer.

    MESSAGE 'Timer gestartet und gestoppt.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_creation_and_stop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_creation_and_stop.
    DATA(lo_timer_handler) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_basic( ).

    " Test, dass die Methode ohne Dumps läuft
    lo_timer_handler->start_and_stop_timer( 1 ).

    " Eine direkte Überprüfung des Timer-Verhaltens in einem Unit-Test ist schwierig,
    " da CL_GUI_TIMER GUI-abhängig ist. Hier wird nur die Ausführbarkeit geprüft.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'No direct assertion for GUI timer behavior' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung zeigt die grundlegende Instanziierung und Steuerung eines `CL_GUI_TIMER`. Obwohl das Event-Handling in einem reinen Unit-Test nicht direkt simuliert werden kann, demonstriert sie die korrekte Verwendung der `RUN`, `STOP` und `FREE` Methoden. Die `WAIT` Anweisung dient hier nur der Simulation einer Laufzeit.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_TIMER` verwendet, um ein benutzerdefiniertes Event periodisch auszulösen. Die Klasse soll ein Event definieren und dieses im Timer-Event-Handler auslösen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für das Timer-Event `FINISHED` und definieren Sie ein eigenes Event in Ihrer Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_tick EXPORTING VALUE(iv_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_tick_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    MESSAGE 'Timer gestartet.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    FREE OBJECT mo_timer.
    MESSAGE 'Timer gestoppt.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    mv_tick_count = mv_tick_count + 1.
    RAISE EVENT timer_tick EXPORTING iv_count = mv_tick_count.
    " Re-run the timer if it should be periodic
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_event_triggered_count TYPE i.
    METHODS handle_timer_tick FOR EVENT timer_tick OF zcl_gui_timer_event IMPORTING iv_count.
    METHODS test_timer_event_setup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_timer_tick.
    mv_event_triggered_count = iv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timer_event_setup.
    DATA(lo_timer_event) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_event( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_tick FOR lo_timer_event.

    " Start the timer (will not actually tick in unit test, but checks setup)
    lo_timer_event->start_timer( 1 ).

    " Flush the GUI buffer to process any pending events (won't trigger timer event itself)
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

    " Assert that the event handler is set up, even if not triggered
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( mv_event_triggered_count
      MSG = 'Timer event should not trigger in non-GUI unit test' ).

    lo_timer_event->stop_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_GUI_TIMER` in Verbindung mit ABAP Objects Events. Die Klasse `zcl_gui_timer_event` definiert ein eigenes Event `timer_tick`, das im `FINISHED`-Event-Handler des Timers ausgelöst wird. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster, um asynchrone GUI-Ereignisse in die Anwendungslogik zu integrieren. Der Unit-Test prüft die korrekte Einrichtung des Event-Handlers.
keywords: CL_GUI_TIMER, Event Handling, ABAP Objects, GUI, Asynchron, SET HANDLER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_TIMER` mit einem variablen Intervall initialisiert und startet. Das Intervall soll über einen Importparameter gesteuert werden können.
hint: Die Eigenschaft `INTERVAL` des `CL_GUI_TIMER` kann zur Laufzeit gesetzt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_variable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS start_timer.
    METHODS stop_timer.
    METHODS set_interval IMPORTING iv_new_interval TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_variable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_initial_interval.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    MESSAGE 'Timer mit Intervall' && mo_timer->interval && ' Sekunden gestartet.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    FREE OBJECT mo_timer.
    MESSAGE 'Timer gestoppt.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_interval.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_new_interval.
    MESSAGE 'Timer-Intervall auf' && iv_new_interval && ' Sekunden geändert.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_TIMER` verwendet, um eine Zählung in einem globalen Attribut zu aktualisieren. Die Zählung soll bei jedem Timer-Tick erhöht werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein privates Attribut in Ihrer Klasse, um den Zählerstand zu speichern, und aktualisieren Sie diesen im `FINISHED`-Event-Handler des Timers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.
    METHODS get_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.

    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    MESSAGE 'Zähl-Timer gestartet.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    FREE OBJECT mo_timer.
    MESSAGE 'Zähl-Timer gestoppt.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_count.
    rv_count = mv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.
    " For periodic counting, re-run the timer
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_counter_setup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_counter_setup.
    DATA(lo_counter_timer) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_counter( ).

    lo_counter_timer->start_timer( 1 ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

    " In a unit test, the counter will not increment due to GUI dependency.
    " We assert that the initial count is 0 and the methods can be called.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter_timer->get_count( ) exp = 0
      MSG = 'Initial counter should be 0' ).

    lo_counter_timer->stop_timer( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein `CL_GUI_TIMER` verwendet werden kann, um einen internen Zähler in einer Klasse zu aktualisieren. Der Zähler (`mv_counter`) wird bei jedem Auslösen des `FINISHED`-Events des Timers erhöht. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen periodische Aktualisierungen oder Fortschrittsanzeigen erforderlich sind. Der Unit-Test bestätigt die korrekte Initialisierung und die Aufrufbarkeit der Methoden.
keywords: CL_GUI_TIMER, Zähler, Event Handling, GUI, Attribut, Periodisch

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die mehrere `CL_GUI_TIMER`-Instanzen mit unterschiedlichen Intervallen verwaltet und deren Events separat behandelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle oder eine Hash-Tabelle, um die Timer-Objekte zu speichern, und nutzen Sie `FOR EVENT ... OF ... SENDER` für die Event-Behandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_multi_timer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_timer_info,
             id        TYPE string,
             timer_ref TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer,
             interval  TYPE i,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_timer_info.
    TYPES: tt_timer_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_timer_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    EVENTS timer_tick EXPORTING VALUE(iv_id) TYPE string VALUE(iv_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS add_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_id       TYPE string
        iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS start_all_timers.
    METHODS stop_all_timers.
    METHODS get_timer_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_timer_info.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_timers TYPE tt_timer_info.

    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer IMPORTING sender.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_multi_timer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_timer.
    DATA(ls_timer_info) = VALUE ty_timer_info(
      id = iv_id
      interval = iv_interval
      count = 0
    ).
    CREATE OBJECT ls_timer_info-timer_ref.
    ls_timer_info-timer_ref->interval = iv_interval.
    INSERT ls_timer_info INTO TABLE mt_timers.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR ls_timer_info-timer_ref.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_all_timers.
    LOOP AT mt_timers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_timer>).
      <fs_timer>-timer_ref->run( ).
      MESSAGE 'Timer' && <fs_timer>-id && ' gestartet.' TYPE 'S'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_all_timers.
    LOOP AT mt_timers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_timer>).
      <fs_timer>-timer_ref->stop( ).
      FREE OBJECT <fs_timer>-timer_ref.
      MESSAGE 'Timer' && <fs_timer>-id && ' gestoppt.' TYPE 'S'.
    ENDLOOP.
    CLEAR mt_timers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_timer_counts.
    rt_counts = mt_timers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    DATA(lv_id) = ''.
    LOOP AT mt_timers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_timer>) WHERE timer_ref = sender.
      <fs_timer>-count = <fs_timer>-count + 1.
      lv_id = <fs_timer>-id.
      RAISE EVENT timer_tick EXPORTING iv_id = <fs_timer>-id iv_count = <fs_timer>-count.
      " Re-run for periodic behavior
      <fs_timer>-timer_ref->run( ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    MESSAGE 'Timer' && lv_id && ' tick: ' && <fs_timer>-count TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event_log,
             id    TYPE string,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_event_log.
    TYPES: tt_event_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event_log WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_event_log TYPE tt_event_log.

    METHODS handle_timer_tick FOR EVENT timer_tick OF zcl_gui_multi_timer IMPORTING iv_id iv_count.
    METHODS test_multi_timer_setup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_timer_tick.
    INSERT VALUE ty_event_log( id = iv_id count = iv_count ) INTO TABLE mt_event_log.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multi_timer_setup.
    DATA(lo_multi_timer) = NEW zcl_gui_multi_timer( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_tick FOR lo_multi_timer.

    lo_multi_timer->add_timer( iv_id = 'TimerA' iv_interval = 1 ).
    lo_multi_timer->add_timer( iv_id = 'TimerB' iv_interval = 2 ).

    lo_multi_timer->start_all_timers( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_multi_timer->get_timer_counts( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 2
      MSG = 'Should have two timers' ).

    " Assert initial counts are 0
    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY id = 'TimerA' INTO DATA(ls_timer_a).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_timer_a-count exp = 0 ).

    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY id = 'TimerB' INTO DATA(ls_timer_b).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_timer_b-count exp = 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( mt_event_log
      MSG = 'Events should not trigger in non-GUI unit test' ).

    lo_multi_timer->stop_all_timers( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel zeigt die Verwaltung mehrerer `CL_GUI_TIMER`-Instanzen in einer einzigen Klasse. Jede Timer-Instanz wird in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert und löst ein eigenes Event aus, das über `SET HANDLER ... FOR SENDER` spezifisch behandelt wird. Dies ermöglicht eine feingranulare Steuerung und Überwachung mehrerer asynchroner Prozesse. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` sind moderne ABAP-Syntaxelemente.
keywords: CL_GUI_TIMER, Multiple Timers, Event Handling, SENDER, GUI, Asynchron, VALUE, Field-Symbol

CLASS zcl_tstmp_add_seconds DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_seconds_to_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_seconds   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_add_seconds IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_seconds_to_tstmp.
    DATA(lo_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp ).
    lo_timestamp->add( iv_seconds = iv_seconds ).
    rv_new_timestamp = lo_timestamp->get_timestampl( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` verwendet, um die Differenz in Minuten zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `SUBTRACT` und anschließend die Konvertierung in Minuten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_diff_minutes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_diff_in_minutes
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_diff_minutes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_diff_in_minutes.
    DATA(lo_tstmp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_tstmp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp2 ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = lo_tstmp1->subtract( lo_tstmp2 ).
    rv_minutes = lv_diff_seconds / 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_diff_minutes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_diff_minutes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_diff_minutes( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_start) = '20231026100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_end) = '20231026101530.0000000'. " 15 minutes and 30 seconds later

    DATA(lv_result_minutes) = lo_cut->get_diff_in_minutes( iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp_end iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp_start ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_minutes exp = 15
      MSG = 'Difference should be 15 minutes (integer division)' ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp_end_exact) = '20231026101500.0000000'.
    lv_result_minutes = lo_cut->get_diff_in_minutes( iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp_end_exact iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp_start ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_minutes exp = 15
      MSG = 'Exact difference should be 15 minutes' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln mit `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` berechnet wird. Die Methode `SUBTRACT` gibt die Differenz in Sekunden zurück, die dann einfach in Minuten umgerechnet werden kann. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` verwendet, um einen Zeitstempel in Datum und Uhrzeit (lokale Zeitzone) zu konvertieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `CONVERT_TSTMP_TO_DATETIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_to_datetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_tstmp_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      EXPORTING
        ev_date      TYPE d
        ev_time      TYPE t.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_to_datetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_tstmp_to_local.
    DATA(lo_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp ).
    lo_timestamp->convert_tstmp_to_datetime(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp = iv_timestamp
        iv_tzone = sy-zonlo " Lokale Zeitzone des Benutzers
      IMPORTING
        ev_date  = ev_date
        ev_time  = ev_time
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_tstmp_to_local_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_tstmp_to_local_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_to_datetime( ).
    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) = '20231026100000.0000000'. " UTC 10:00:00
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d, lv_time TYPE t.

    " Annahme: Lokale Zeitzone ist CET/CEST (UTC+1 oder UTC+2)
    " Für den 26.10.2023 wäre es noch CEST (UTC+2)
    " Erwartet: 20231026 120000

    lo_cut->convert_tstmp_to_local( EXPORTING iv_timestamp = lv_utc_tstmp
                                    IMPORTING ev_date = lv_date ev_time = lv_time ).

    " Da sy-zonlo dynamisch ist, können wir hier nur eine Plausibilitätsprüfung machen
    " oder einen festen Offset annehmen, was den Test brüchig macht.
    " Besser: Testen mit einem bekannten Offset oder Mocking von sy-zonlo.
    " Für diesen Test nehmen wir an, dass die Konvertierung funktioniert und die Werte nicht initial sind.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_date MSG = 'Date should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_time MSG = 'Time should not be initial' ).

    " Beispiel für eine spezifischere Prüfung, wenn die Zeitzone bekannt ist (z.B. UTC+2)
    " IF sy-zonlo = 'CET'. " Oder eine andere bekannte Zeitzone
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_date exp = '20231026' ).
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_time exp = '120000' ).
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Konvertierung eines Zeitstempels in lokale Datum- und Uhrzeitkomponenten unter Berücksichtigung der Zeitzone des Benutzers (`sy-zonlo`). Die Methode `CONVERT_TSTMP_TO_DATETIME` ist die empfohlene Funktion für diese Aufgabe, da sie die Komplexität der Zeitzonenberechnung kapselt. Dies ist ein wesentliches Feature für internationale Anwendungen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Timestamp, Konvertierung, Datum, Uhrzeit, Zeitzone, Lokal

hint: Nutzen Sie die statische Methode `CREATE_FROM_DATETIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_from_datetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_tstmp_from_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_date      TYPE d
        iv_time      TYPE t

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_from_datetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_tstmp_from_local.
    rv_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_datetime(
      iv_date  = iv_date
      iv_time  = iv_time
      iv_tzone = iv_tzone
    )->get_timestampl( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_from_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_from_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_from_datetime( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20231026'.
    DATA(lv_time) = '120000'.
    DATA(lv_tzone) = 'CET'. " Central European Time (UTC+1 or UTC+2)

    " Für den 26.10.2023 12:00 CET wäre das 10:00 UTC (CEST ist UTC+2, CET ist UTC+1)
    " Am 26.10.2023 ist es noch CEST, also 12:00 CEST = 10:00 UTC
    DATA(lv_expected_utc_tstmp) = '20231026100000.0000000'.

    DATA(lv_result_tstmp) = lo_cut->create_tstmp_from_local(
      iv_date  = lv_date
      iv_time  = lv_time
      iv_tzone = lv_tzone
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_tstmp exp = lv_expected_utc_tstmp
      MSG = 'Timestamp should match expected UTC value for CET/CEST' ).

    " Test mit einer anderen Zeitzone (z.B. EST = UTC-5)
    lv_tzone = 'EST'.
    lv_date = '20231026'.
    lv_time = '050000'. " 05:00 EST = 10:00 UTC
    lv_expected_utc_tstmp = '20231026100000.0000000'.

    lv_result_tstmp = lo_cut->create_tstmp_from_local(
      iv_date  = lv_date
      iv_time  = lv_time
      iv_tzone = lv_tzone
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_tstmp exp = lv_expected_utc_tstmp
      MSG = 'Timestamp should match expected UTC value for EST' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung eines Zeitstempels aus separaten Datum-, Uhrzeit- und Zeitzonenkomponenten. Die statische Methode `CREATE_FROM_DATETIME` von `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` ist hierfür ideal, da sie die Umrechnung in den internen UTC-Zeitstempel übernimmt. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Handhabung von Zeitdaten in globalen Systemen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Timestamp, Erstellung, Datum, Uhrzeit, Zeitzone, Konvertierung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` verwendet, um zu einem Zeitstempel eine bestimmte Anzahl von Monaten zu addieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `ADD_MONTHS` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_add_months DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_months_to_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_months    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_add_months IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_months_to_tstmp.
    DATA(lo_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp ).

CLASS zcl_tstmp_comparison DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_comparison_result,
             is_before TYPE abap_bool,

             is_equal  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_comparison_result.

    METHODS compare_timestamps
      IMPORTING

        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl

CLASS zcl_tstmp_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.

    rs_result-is_before = lo_tstmp1->is_before( lo_tstmp2 ).
    rs_result-is_after  = lo_tstmp1->is_after( lo_tstmp2 ).

CLASS zcl_tstmp_add_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_days_to_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_days      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_add_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_days_to_tstmp.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d, lv_time TYPE t.
    DATA(lv_tzone) = sy-zonlo.

    " Convert timestamp to date and time in local timezone
    cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp )->convert_tstmp_to_datetime(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp = iv_timestamp
        iv_tzone = lv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_date  = lv_date
        ev_time  = lv_time
    ).

    " Add days to the date
    lv_date = lv_date + iv_days.

    " Convert back to timestamp
    rv_new_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_datetime(
      iv_date  = lv_date
      iv_time  = lv_time
      iv_tzone = lv_tzone
    )->get_timestampl( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` verwendet, um einen Zeitstempel auf die nächste volle Stunde aufzurunden.
hint: Konvertieren Sie den Zeitstempel in Datum/Uhrzeit, manipulieren Sie die Uhrzeit und konvertieren Sie zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_round_hour DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS round_to_next_hour
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rounded_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_round_hour IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD round_to_next_hour.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d, lv_time TYPE t.
    DATA(lv_tzone) = 'UTC'. " Für konsistente Rundung in UTC

    " Convert timestamp to date and time in UTC
    cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_timestamp )->convert_tstmp_to_datetime(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp = iv_timestamp
        iv_tzone = lv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_date  = lv_date
        ev_time  = lv_time
    ).

    DATA(lv_hour) = lv_time(2).
    DATA(lv_minute) = lv_time+2(2).
    DATA(lv_second) = lv_time+4(2).

    IF lv_minute > '00' OR lv_second > '00'.
      lv_hour = lv_hour + 1.
      IF lv_hour = '24'.
        lv_hour = '00'.
        lv_date = lv_date + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    lv_time = |{ lv_hour ALPHA = OUT }0000|.

    " Convert back to timestamp
    rv_rounded_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_datetime(
      iv_date  = lv_date
      iv_time  = lv_time
      iv_tzone = lv_tzone
    )->get_timestampl( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer internen Tabelle zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und geben Sie dessen Wert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lines( <fs_table> ) > 0.
      READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <fs_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test.
    DATA lt_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ) TO lt_test.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(lv_result_str) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( it_data = lt_test iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    DATA(lv_result_int) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( it_data = lt_test iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_str exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_int exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl Feldsymbole schon länger existieren, sind sie für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Datenstrukturen in ABAP unverzichtbar und werden auch in modernem Code verwendet, wenn der Feldname zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist. Sie ermöglichen eine flexible und typsichere Manipulation von Daten zur Laufzeit.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in Chunks mit einem expliziten Cursor und schließen Sie den Cursor anschließend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` für die chunkweise Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_explicit_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_sflight_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_explicit_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflight_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight,
          lt_chunk   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax
        FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_chunk
        PACKAGE SIZE iv_chunk_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT lt_chunk INTO ls_sflight.
        APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid } ({ ls_sflight-seatsmax } seats)| TO rt_processed_data.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_sflight_chunks FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_sflight_chunks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_explicit_cursor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_sflight_chunks( iv_chunk_size = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die explizite Cursor-Verwaltung mit `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` ist zwar eine ältere Technik, aber immer noch relevant für die effiziente Verarbeitung sehr großer Datenmengen in Chunks, um Speicherüberläufe zu vermeiden. `CLOSE CURSOR` ist hierbei entscheidend, um Datenbankressourcen freizugeben. In modernen ABAP-Versionen wird oft `SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE` ohne expliziten Cursor verwendet, aber für spezielle Szenarien ist der explizite Cursor weiterhin nützlich.
keywords: Database Access, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `CL_GUI_TIMER` zur Ausführung einer Methode nach einer bestimmten Zeitverzögerung. Die Methode soll einen Zähler erhöhen.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_GUI_TIMER`, setzen Sie das Intervall und registrieren Sie ein Ereignis für `FINISHED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_finished EXPORTING VALUE(ev_counter) TYPE i.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.
    METHODS get_counter RETURNING VALUE(rv_counter) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS NOT BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
      SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
    ENDIF.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS BOUND.
      mo_timer->stop( ).
      FREE mo_timer.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    ADD 1 TO mv_counter.
    RAISE EVENT timer_finished EXPORTING ev_counter = mv_counter.
    mo_timer->run( ). " Restart timer for continuous operation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_counter.
    rv_counter = mv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timer_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_demo( ).
    DATA lv_event_counter TYPE i.

    " Simulate timer event call directly for unit testing GUI-dependent logic
    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ).
    lv_event_counter = lo_cut->get_counter( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_event_counter exp = 1 ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ).
    lv_event_counter = lo_cut->get_counter( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_event_counter exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_GUI_TIMER` ist ein wichtiger Baustein für die Implementierung zeitgesteuerter Ereignisse in ABAP-GUI-Anwendungen. Die moderne Event-Behandlung (`SET HANDLER FOR`) ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung von Logik und Ereignisauslösung. Der Unit-Test demonstriert, wie die durch den Timer ausgelöste Logik isoliert getestet werden kann, ohne eine tatsächliche GUI-Umgebung zu benötigen.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, GUI, Events, Object Orientation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht und diese Ausnahme mit `TRY...CATCH` abfängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` als Ausnahme für die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_division_result) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Division erfolgreich: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt!' .
      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Ein unbekannter Fehler ist aufgetreten!' .
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_divide_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_divide_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result_ok) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    DATA(lv_result_error) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_ok exp = 'Division erfolgreich: 5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_error exp = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke sind der Standardweg für die strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung in modernem ABAP. Sie ermöglichen es, Ausnahmen (Exceptions) gezielt abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, was zu robusterem und fehlerresistenterem Code führt. `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ist die spezifische Ausnahme für die Division durch Null.
keywords: TRY CATCH, Exception Handling, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu berechnen, und teilen Sie diese durch die Anzahl der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    IF lines( lt_sflight ) = 0.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                       NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).

    rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lines( lt_sflight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_average_seats FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_average_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_average( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_average_seats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts wird hier durch die Kombination des `REDUCE`-Operators zur Summenbildung und der Funktion `lines()` zur Bestimmung der Anzahl der Elemente modern und effizient gelöst. Dies vermeidet explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Average, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    " Example: Check if LH has at least one flight
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungslogik erheblich und macht den Code viel lesbarer und effizienter als manuelle Sortierungen und `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Konstrukte.
keywords: Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Reihenfolge der Elemente in einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM=>SHUFFLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled_table = it_input_table.
    cl_abap_random=>shuffle( CHANGING c_table = rt_shuffled_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

CLASS zcl_data_aging_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_data_aging_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_record_temperature.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man das Data Aging Objekt für SFLIGHT erhalten.
    " Für Demonstrationszwecke simulieren wir hier eine Temperatur.
    " CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE erfordert ein Data Aging Objekt und einen Schlüssel.
    " Da die direkte Verwendung ohne ein konfiguriertes Data Aging Objekt für ein einfaches Beispiel nicht praktikabel ist,
    " simulieren wir das Ergebnis basierend auf einer einfachen Bedingung.
    " Eine reale Implementierung würde so aussehen:
    " DATA(lo_da_object) = cl_data_aging_object_factory=>get_instance( 'SFLIGHT_DA_OBJECT' ).
    " rv_temperature = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature(
    "   i_data_aging_object = lo_da_object
    "   i_key_value         = is_sflight_key ).

    " Simulation für Demonstrationszwecke:
    IF is_sflight_key-fldate < sy-datum - 365. " Älter als 1 Jahr
      rv_temperature = 'COLD'.
    ELSEIF is_sflight_key-fldate < sy-datum - 30. " Älter als 1 Monat
      rv_temperature = 'WARM'.
    ELSE.
      rv_temperature = 'HOT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Logik, die eine Aktion basierend auf der 'Temperatur' eines `SFLIGHT`-Datensatzes ausführt (z.B. Archivierung vorschlagen, wenn 'COLD').
hint: Nutzen Sie die simulierte Temperatur und eine `CASE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_da_conditional_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS process_record_by_temp
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_suggestion) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_simulated_temperature
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_conditional_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_record_by_temp.
    DATA(lv_temperature) = get_simulated_temperature( is_sflight_key ).

    CASE lv_temperature.
      WHEN 'HOT'.
        rv_action_suggestion = 'Sofortige Verarbeitung empfohlen.'.
      WHEN 'WARM'.
        rv_action_suggestion = 'Regelmäßige Verarbeitung, keine Archivierung.'.
      WHEN 'COLD'.
        rv_action_suggestion = 'Archivierung oder Löschung in Betracht ziehen.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_action_suggestion = 'Unbekannte Temperatur.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_simulated_temperature.
    IF is_sflight_key-fldate < sy-datum - 365.
      rv_temperature = 'COLD'.
    ELSEIF is_sflight_key-fldate < sy-datum - 30.
      rv_temperature = 'WARM'.
    ELSE.
      rv_temperature = 'HOT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_filter_hot DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_da_filter_hot IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_hot_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE is_record_hot( table_line ) = abap_true ).

  METHOD is_record_hot.
    " Simulation der Temperaturprüfung
    IF is_flight-fldate >= sy-datum - 7. " Flüge der letzten 7 Tage als 'HOT'
      rv_is_hot = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_hot = abap_false.

CLASS zcl_da_enrich_temp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_da_enrich_temp IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_da_temp_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_temp_hot  TYPE string VALUE 'HOT',
               gc_temp_warm TYPE string VALUE 'WARM',
               gc_temp_cold TYPE string VALUE 'COLD'.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS get_temperature_description
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_simulated_temperature
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_temp_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_temperature_description.
    DATA(lv_temperature) = get_simulated_temperature( is_sflight_key ).

    IF lv_temperature = gc_temp_hot.
      rv_description = 'Dieser Datensatz ist aktuell und wird aktiv genutzt.'.
    ELSEIF lv_temperature = gc_temp_warm.
      rv_description = 'Dieser Datensatz wird selten genutzt, aber noch benötigt.'.
    ELSEIF lv_temperature = gc_temp_cold.
      rv_description = 'Dieser Datensatz ist alt und kann archiviert werden.'.
    ELSE.
      rv_description = 'Unbekannter Temperaturstatus.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_simulated_temperature.
    IF is_sflight_key-fldate < sy-datum - 365.
      rv_temperature = gc_temp_cold.
    ELSEIF is_sflight_key-fldate < sy-datum - 30.
      rv_temperature = gc_temp_warm.
    ELSE.
      rv_temperature = gc_temp_hot.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " If count > (max - min + 1)
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Cannot generate enough unique numbers in the given range.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = iv_min iv_max = iv_max ).
      IF line_exists( rt_random_numbers[ table_line = lv_new_number ] ).
        CONTINUE. " Try again if not unique
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_new_number TO rt_random_numbers.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_dynamic_temp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS get_dynamic_temperature
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
        iv_warm_threshold_days TYPE i " e.g., 30 days
        iv_cold_threshold_days TYPE i " e.g., 365 days
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_dynamic_temp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_temperature.
    DATA(lv_days_old) = sy-datum - is_sflight_key-fldate.

    IF lv_days_old >= iv_cold_threshold_days.
      rv_temperature = 'COLD'.
    ELSEIF lv_days_old >= iv_warm_threshold_days.
      rv_temperature = 'WARM'.
    ELSE.
      rv_temperature = 'HOT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Passwort fester Länge, bestehend aus Großbuchstaben und Ziffern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM=>GET_NEXT` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    DATA(lc_chars) = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_password_builder) = ``.

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = strlen( lc_chars ) - 1 ).
      lv_password_builder = |{ lv_password_builder }{ lc_chars+lv_index(1) }|.
    ENDDO.
    rv_password = lv_password_builder.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_password_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_password( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_password ) exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_password_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_password( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( 15 ).
    DATA(lc_allowed_chars) = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_password ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_password+sy-index-1(1).
      IF NOT lc_allowed_chars CS lv_char.
        lv_is_valid = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_is_valid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_password_uniqueness.

    DATA(lv_password1) = lo_cut->generate_password( 8 ).
    DATA(lv_password2) = lo_cut->generate_password( 8 ).
    " It's highly improbable for two random passwords to be identical
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_password1 exp = lv_password2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen HMAC-SHA256 für eine gegebene Nachricht und einen geheimen Schlüssel. Das Ergebnis soll als Hexadezimal-String zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac` und die Methode `calculate_hmac`. Achten Sie auf die Konvertierung von STRING zu XSTRING und XSTRING zu Hex-String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_key     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_sha256.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>get_instance( if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256 ).

    DATA(lv_message_x) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_message ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)     = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_key ).

    lo_hmac->set_data( lv_message_x ).
    lo_hmac->set_key( lv_key_x ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac( ).

    DATA(lv_hmac_x) = lo_hmac->get_hmac( ).
    rv_hmac_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hmac_x ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener HMAC-SHA256 für eine Nachricht und einen Schlüssel gültig ist. Das zu überprüfende HMAC wird als Hexadezimal-String übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac` und die Methode `verify_hmac`. Denken Sie an die Konvertierung des Hex-Strings zurück zu XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_verify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_hmac_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_message    TYPE string
        iv_key        TYPE string
        iv_hmac_hex   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_verify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_hmac_sha256.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>get_instance( if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256 ).

    DATA(lv_message_x) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_message ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)     = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_key ).
    DATA(lv_hmac_x)    = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( iv_hmac_hex ).

    lo_hmac->set_data( lv_message_x ).
    lo_hmac->set_key( lv_key_x ).

    TRY.
        lo_hmac->verify_hmac( lv_hmac_x ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_abap_hmac_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen wiederholenden Timer, der alle 1 Sekunde ein Ereignis auslöst und einen Zähler erhöht. Nach 3 Wiederholungen soll der Timer stoppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` mit einem `interval` > 0. Im `finished`-Event-Handler erhöhen Sie einen Zähler und rufen `stop` auf, wenn der Zähler den Grenzwert erreicht hat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_repeating_timer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_stopped_event.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_interval_seconds TYPE i iv_max_runs TYPE i.
    METHODS get_run_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_run_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_max_runs TYPE i.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_repeating_timer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mv_run_count = 0.
    mv_max_runs = iv_max_runs.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_run_count.
    rv_count = mv_run_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    mv_run_count = mv_run_count + 1.
    MESSAGE |Timer run { mv_run_count } of { mv_max_runs }| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    IF mv_run_count >= mv_max_runs.
      mo_timer->stop( ).
      RAISE EVENT timer_stopped_event.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
