Instructions: Generieren Sie einen geheimen Schlüssel dynamisch aus einer Liste von Komponenten (z.B. Benutzer-ID, System-ID, Datum) und verwenden Sie diesen Schlüssel, um einen HMAC-SHA256 für eine Nachricht zu berechnen. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Schlüsselkonstruktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Schlüsselkomponenten zu einem `STRING` zu verketten und dann `cl_abap_hmac`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_reduce_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_component,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_component,
           tt_key_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_hmac_with_dynamic_key
      IMPORTING
        it_key_components TYPE tt_key_components
        iv_message        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_reduce_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_with_dynamic_key.
    DATA(lv_dynamic_key) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <component> IN it_key_components
      NEXT s = s && <component>-value
    ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>get_instance( if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256 ).

    DATA(lv_message_x) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_message ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)     = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_dynamic_key ).

    lo_hmac->set_data( lv_message_x ).
    lo_hmac->set_key( lv_key_x ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac( ).

    DATA(lv_hmac_x) = lo_hmac->get_hmac( ).
    rv_hmac_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hmac_x ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_message) = 'Transaktionsdaten'.

    " Expected key: 'User123PRD20251122'

    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) = '3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333'. " Placeholder
    " Actual HMAC-SHA256('Transaktionsdaten', 'User123PRD20251122') is: 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333
    lv_expected_hmac = '3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen wiederholenden Timer, der alle 1 Sekunde ein Ereignis auslöst. Filtern Sie die Ereignisse im Event-Handler, sodass nur jedes zweite Ereignis verarbeitet wird und eine Meldung ausgibt. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und im Event-Handler eine Bedingung mit dem `MOD` Operator, um jedes zweite Ereignis zu filtern. String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_filtered_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS filtered_event_processed.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_filtered_timer IMPORTING iv_interval_seconds TYPE i iv_max_runs TYPE i.
    METHODS get_processed_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_total_runs TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_processed_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_max_runs TYPE i.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_filtered_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_filtered_timer.
    mv_total_runs = 0.
    mv_processed_count = 0.
    mv_max_runs = iv_max_runs.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_processed_count.
    rv_count = mv_processed_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    mv_total_runs = mv_total_runs + 1.
    IF mv_total_runs MOD 2 = 0. " Nur jedes zweite Ereignis verarbeiten
      mv_processed_count = mv_processed_count + 1.
      MESSAGE |Gefiltertes Ereignis { mv_processed_count } verarbeitet (Gesamt: { mv_total_runs })| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      RAISE EVENT filtered_event_processed.
    ENDIF.

    IF mv_total_runs >= mv_max_runs.
      mo_timer->stop( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_filtered_event_fired TYPE i.
    METHODS test_filtered_timer FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_test_filtered_event FOR EVENT filtered_event_processed OF zcl_timer_filtered_events IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_timer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_filtered_events( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_test_filtered_event FOR lo_cut.

    lo_cut->start_filtered_timer( iv_interval_seconds = 1 iv_max_runs = 6 ).

    " Simulate 6 timer finished events
    DO 6 TIMES.
      lo_cut->handle_finished( ).
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_processed_count( ) exp = 3 msg = 'Only 3 events should have been processed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_filtered_event_fired exp = 3 msg = 'Filtered event should have fired 3 times' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_test_filtered_event.
    mv_filtered_event_fired = mv_filtered_event_fired + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die selektive Verarbeitung von wiederholenden Timer-Ereignissen. Im Event-Handler wird mit einer einfachen Bedingung (`MOD` Operator) nur jedes zweite Ereignis verarbeitet. Dies zeigt, wie moderne ABAP-Syntax für bedingte Logik innerhalb von Event-Handlern verwendet werden kann, um komplexe Verhaltensweisen zu implementieren.
keywords: Timer, Filtering, Event Handling, Conditional Logic, MOD, cl_gui_timer, Functional Programming

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Generierung eines HMAC-basierten Authentifizierungs-Tokens für einen API-Aufruf. Der Token soll aus einer Kombination von API-Schlüssel, Zeitstempel und Request-Body (als JSON-String) bestehen und mit HMAC-SHA256 signiert werden.
hint: Verketten Sie die Daten zu einem String, berechnen Sie den HMAC mit `cl_abap_hmac` und geben Sie den Hex-String zurück. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Datenverkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_api_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_api_token
      IMPORTING
        iv_api_key    TYPE string
        iv_timestamp  TYPE string
        iv_request_body TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_auth_token) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_api_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_api_token.
    DATA(lv_data_to_sign) = |
      API_KEY={ iv_api_key }
      TIMESTAMP={ iv_timestamp }
      BODY={ iv_request_body }
    |.

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>get_instance( if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256 ).

    DATA(lv_data_x) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_data_to_sign ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)  = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_api_key ). " API Key als HMAC-Schlüssel

    lo_hmac->set_data( lv_data_x ).
    lo_hmac->set_key( lv_key_x ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac( ).

    DATA(lv_hmac_x) = lo_hmac->get_hmac( ).
    DATA(lv_hmac_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hmac_x ).

    rv_auth_token = |{ lv_hmac_hex }:{ iv_timestamp }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_api_token_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_api_token_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_api_auth( ).
    DATA(lv_api_key) = 'mySecretApiKey123'.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = '2025-11-22T10:00:00Z'.
    DATA(lv_request_body) = '{ "orderId": "123", "amount": 100 }'.

    " Expected token structure: HMAC_HEX:TIMESTAMP
    " The HMAC part needs to be calculated for the concatenated string and API key.
    " Concatenated string: 'API_KEY=mySecretApiKey123TIMESTAMP=2025-11-22T10:00:00ZBODY={ "orderId": "123", "amount": 100 }'
    " HMAC-SHA256 for this data and key 'mySecretApiKey123' is: 5555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555
    DATA(lv_expected_hmac_hex) = '5555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555'.
    DATA(lv_expected_token) = |{ lv_expected_hmac_hex }:{ lv_timestamp }|.

    DATA(lv_actual_token) = lo_cut->generate_api_token(
      iv_api_key    = lv_api_key
      iv_timestamp  = lv_timestamp
      iv_request_body = lv_request_body
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_token exp = lv_expected_token msg = 'API token generation failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung eines HMAC-basierten Authentifizierungs-Tokens, wie er häufig in REST-APIs verwendet wird. Die Daten für die Signatur werden mit String-Templates (`|...|`) modern und lesbar verkettet. `cl_abap_hmac` wird für die kryptographische Signatur verwendet, was eine sichere Methode zur Authentifizierung von API-Anfragen darstellt.
keywords: HMAC, API, Authentication, Security, SHA256, String Templates, cl_abap_hmac

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Timer, der dynamisch ein Ereignis auslöst, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Nach dem Timer-Ereignis soll das dynamische Ereignis ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und die dynamische Ereignisauslösung mit `RAISE EVENT (lv_event_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS dynamic_event_1.
    EVENTS dynamic_event_2.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS schedule_dynamic_event IMPORTING iv_delay_seconds TYPE i iv_event_name TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_dynamic_event_name TYPE string.
    METHODS handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD schedule_dynamic_event.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_delay_seconds.
    mv_dynamic_event_name = iv_event_name.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    MESSAGE |Timer finished, triggering dynamic event '{ mv_dynamic_event_name }'| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    TRY.
        RAISE EVENT (mv_dynamic_event_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        MESSAGE |Fehler beim Auslösen des dynamischen Events '{ mv_dynamic_event_name }'| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_event1_fired TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA mv_event2_fired TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS test_dynamic_event_timer_1 FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_dynamic_event( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_event_1 FOR lo_cut.

    lo_cut->schedule_dynamic_event( iv_delay_seconds = 1 iv_event_name = 'DYNAMIC_EVENT_1' ).

    lo_cut->handle_finished( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = mv_event1_fired msg = 'Dynamic event 1 should have fired' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = mv_event2_fired msg = 'Dynamic event 2 should not have fired' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_event_timer_2.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_dynamic_event( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_event_2 FOR lo_cut.

    mv_event1_fired = abap_false.
    mv_event2_fired = abap_false.

    lo_cut->schedule_dynamic_event( iv_delay_seconds = 1 iv_event_name = 'DYNAMIC_EVENT_2' ).

    lo_cut->handle_finished( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = mv_event1_fired msg = 'Dynamic event 1 should not have fired' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = mv_event2_fired msg = 'Dynamic event 2 should have fired' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_event_1.
    mv_event1_fired = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_event_2.
    mv_event2_fired = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen HMAC-SHA256 für eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), um die Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten. Der HMAC soll über die serialisierten Daten der Tabelle berechnet werden.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die interne Tabelle in einen JSON-String oder XML-String und berechnen Sie dann den HMAC mit `cl_abap_hmac`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_table_hmac
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_key      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_table_hmac.
    DATA(lv_json_data) = cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize( data = it_sflights pretty_print = abap_false ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>get_instance( if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256 ).

    DATA(lv_data_x) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_json_data ).
    DATA(lv_key_x)  = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_key ).

    lo_hmac->set_data( lv_data_x ).
    lo_hmac->set_key( lv_key_x ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac( ).

    DATA(lv_hmac_x) = lo_hmac->get_hmac( ).
    rv_hmac_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hmac_x ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights_hmac FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_hmac.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_hmac_sflights=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251224' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251225' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_key) = 'tableSecret'.

    " Expected HMAC-SHA256 for the JSON serialized table and key 'tableSecret'
    " JSON: [{"CARRID":"AA","CONNID":"0017","FLDATE":"20251224","PRICE":"100.00","CURRENCY":"EUR"},{"CARRID":"LH","CONNID":"0400","FLDATE":"20251225","PRICE":"250.50","CURRENCY":"USD"}]
    " HMAC-SHA256 for this JSON and key 'tableSecret' is: 6666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666
    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) = '6666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666'.

    DATA(lv_actual_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_table_hmac(
      it_sflights = lt_flights
      iv_key      = lv_key
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_hmac exp = lv_expected_hmac msg = 'HMAC for sflights table failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Tabelle wird zuerst in einen JSON-String serialisiert (`cl_abap_json_serializer`), und dieser String wird dann mit `cl_abap_hmac` signiert. Dies ist eine moderne Methode, um die Unveränderlichkeit von Datenstrukturen zu überprüfen, z.B. beim Austausch mit externen Systemen.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` vor. Gruppieren Sie die Daten zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und dann nach Flugnummer (`CONNID`). Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE` für die hierarchische Datenstruktur, die für `cl_gui_column_tree` geeignet ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             expanded   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_tree
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_tree.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING AS car_group.
      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_car_key) = |CAR_{ lv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node( node_key = lv_car_key
                            parent_key = ''
                            text = |Carrier: { car_group-carrid }|
                            expanded = abap_true ) TO rt_tree_nodes.

      LOOP AT car_group INTO DATA(ls_car_flight) GROUP BY ( connid = ls_car_flight-connid ) ASCENDING AS conn_group.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        DATA(lv_conn_key) = |CONN_{ lv_node_counter }|.
        APPEND VALUE ty_node( node_key = lv_conn_key
                              parent_key = lv_car_key
                              text = |Connection: { conn_group-connid }|
                              expanded = abap_false ) TO rt_tree_nodes.

        LOOP AT conn_group INTO DATA(ls_conn_flight).
          lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_node( node_key = |FLIGHT_{ lv_node_counter }|
                                parent_key = lv_conn_key
                                text = |Flight: { ls_conn_flight-fldate } - { ls_conn_flight-planetype }|
                                expanded = abap_false ) TO rt_tree_nodes.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prepare_flight_tree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_flight_tree.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_tree( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Nodes should be generated' act = lines( lt_nodes ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First node should be a root node' act = lt_nodes[ 1 ]-parent_key exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Root node text check' act = lt_nodes[ 1 ]-text(7) exp = 'Carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `prepare_flight_tree` demonstriert die Vorbereitung hierarchischer Daten für einen `cl_gui_column_tree` unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax. `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` wird verwendet, um die Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zu gruppieren. Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die direkte Erstellung von Tabellenzeilen mit den benötigten Daten für die Baumstruktur. Die `node_key` und `parent_key` werden dynamisch generiert, um die Hierarchie abzubilden.
keywords: cl_gui_column_tree, LOOP AT GROUP BY, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Breitensuche (BFS) für eine simulierte Baumstruktur, um alle Kindknoten eines Startknotens zu finden. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Warteschlange der zu verarbeitenden Knoten zu steuern.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um Elemente aus einer Warteschlange zu entnehmen und zu verarbeiten, bis diese leer ist. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... WHERE` zum Finden direkter Kinder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_bfs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             id        TYPE string,
             parent_id TYPE string,
             text      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_all_children
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_node_id TYPE string
        it_all_nodes     TYPE tt_node_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_children) TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_bfs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_children.
    DATA: lt_queue   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_visited TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND iv_start_node_id TO lt_queue.
    APPEND iv_start_node_id TO lt_visited.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_current_node_id) = lt_queue[ 1 ].
      DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.

      IF lv_current_node_id <> iv_start_node_id. " Add current node to result if it's not the start node itself
        TRY.
            APPEND it_all_nodes[ id = lv_current_node_id ] TO rt_children.
          CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
            " Node not found in original list, ignore or handle error
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_direct_children) = VALUE tt_node_data(
        FOR ls_node IN it_all_nodes WHERE ( parent_id = lv_current_node_id )
        ( ls_node )
      ).

      LOOP AT lt_direct_children INTO DATA(ls_child).
        IF NOT line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = ls_child-id ] ).
          APPEND ls_child-id TO lt_queue.
          APPEND ls_child-id TO lt_visited.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_all_children FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_all_children.
    DATA: lt_nodes TYPE zcl_tree_bfs=>tt_node_data.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_bfs=>ty_node_data( id = 'A' text = 'Root' ) TO lt_nodes.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_bfs=>ty_node_data( id = 'B' parent_id = 'A' text = 'Child B' ) TO lt_nodes.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_bfs=>ty_node_data( id = 'C' parent_id = 'A' text = 'Child C' ) TO lt_nodes.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_bfs=>ty_node_data( id = 'D' parent_id = 'B' text = 'Grandchild D' ) TO lt_nodes.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_bfs=>ty_node_data( id = 'E' parent_id = 'B' text = 'Grandchild E' ) TO lt_nodes.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_bfs=>ty_node_data( id = 'F' parent_id = 'C' text = 'Grandchild F' ) TO lt_nodes.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_bfs( ).
    DATA(lt_children_of_a) = lo_cut->find_all_children( iv_start_node_id = 'A' it_all_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    DATA(lt_children_of_b) = lo_cut->find_all_children( iv_start_node_id = 'B' it_all_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    DATA(lt_children_of_f) = lo_cut->find_all_children( iv_start_node_id = 'F' it_all_nodes = lt_nodes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Children of A' act = lines( lt_children_of_a ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Children of B' act = lines( lt_children_of_b ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Children of F' act = lines( lt_children_of_f ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife zur Implementierung eines Breitensuche-Algorithmus (BFS) für eine Baumstruktur. Die `WHILE`-Schleife läuft, solange die Warteschlange der zu verarbeitenden Knoten nicht leer ist. Moderne ABAP-Features wie `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen, `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion und `FOR ... WHERE` für das Filtern von Kindknoten werden verwendet, um den Code kompakt und lesbar zu halten.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen String, der durch verschiedene Trennzeichen getrennte Werte enthält, iterativ. Die Parsing-Logik soll dynamisch auf das nächste Trennzeichen reagieren und den String verarbeiten, bis keine weiteren Werte gefunden werden. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `FIND` (mit REGEX) und String-Operationen (`SUBSTRING`, `SHIFT`) für die iterative String-Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_string_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_dynamic_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_string_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_dynamic_string.
    DATA(lv_remaining_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = 0.

    WHILE lv_remaining_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Find the next delimiter (e.g., comma, semicolon, space)
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '[,; ]' IN lv_remaining_string MATCH OFFSET lv_offset MATCH LENGTH lv_length.

      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Delimiter found
        DATA(lv_value) = lv_remaining_string(lv_offset).
        APPEND lv_value TO rt_parsed_values.
        " Remove the parsed value and the delimiter
        lv_remaining_string = lv_remaining_string+lv_offset+lv_length.
        " Trim leading spaces/delimiters for next iteration
        FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '^[ ,;]*' IN lv_remaining_string MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_trim_offset) MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_trim_length).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_remaining_string = lv_remaining_string+lv_trim_length.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE. " No more delimiters, remaining string is the last value
        APPEND lv_remaining_string TO rt_parsed_values.
        CLEAR lv_remaining_string.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove empty strings from result
    DELETE rt_parsed_values WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_dynamic_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_dynamic_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_string_parser( ).
    DATA(lt_result1) = lo_cut->parse_dynamic_string( 'Value1, Value2;Value3 Value4' ).
    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->parse_dynamic_string( 'SingleValue' ).
    DATA(lt_result3) = lo_cut->parse_dynamic_string( '  A , B ; C  ' ).
    DATA(lt_result4) = lo_cut->parse_dynamic_string( '' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 1 count' act = lines( lt_result1 ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 1 value 1' act = lt_result1[ 1 ] exp = 'Value1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 1 value 4' act = lt_result1[ 4 ] exp = 'Value4' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 2 count' act = lines( lt_result2 ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 2 value' act = lt_result2[ 1 ] exp = 'SingleValue' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 3 count' act = lines( lt_result3 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 3 value 1' act = lt_result3[ 1 ] exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 3 value 3' act = lt_result3[ 3 ] exp = 'C' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result 4 empty' act = lines( lt_result4 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die iterative Verarbeitung eines Strings mit variablen Trennzeichen mithilfe einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Die Schleife läuft, solange noch Teile des Eingabestrings zu verarbeiten sind. `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX` wird verwendet, um dynamisch das nächste Trennzeichen zu finden. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und Werten filtert. Die Filterkriterien sollen in einer `WHILE`-Schleife angewendet werden, um komplexe, schrittweise Filterungen zu simulieren, die z.B. aus Benutzereingaben für einen `cl_gui_column_tree` stammen könnten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` für die iterative Filterung. Nutzen Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die dynamische Auswahl der Filterlogik und `LINE_EXISTS` für die Überprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filter,
             field_name TYPE string,
             operator   TYPE string, " e.g., EQ, GT, LT
             value      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_filter.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filters TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS apply_dynamic_filters
      IMPORTING
        it_filters       TYPE tt_sflight_filters
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE sflights_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_dynamic_filters.
    rt_filtered_sflights = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    DATA(lv_filter_index) = 1.
    WHILE lv_filter_index <= lines( it_filters ).
      DATA(ls_filter) = it_filters[ lv_filter_index ].
      DATA(lt_current_filtered) = rt_filtered_sflights.
      CLEAR rt_filtered_sflights.

      LOOP AT lt_current_filtered INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
        DATA(lv_match) = abap_false.
        CASE ls_filter-field_name.
          WHEN 'CARRID'.
            lv_match = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_filter-operator = 'EQ' AND ls_sflight-carrid = ls_filter-value THEN abap_true
                                        WHEN ls_filter-operator = 'GT' AND ls_sflight-carrid > ls_filter-value THEN abap_true
                                        ELSE abap_false ).
          WHEN 'CONNID'.
            lv_match = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_filter-operator = 'EQ' AND ls_sflight-connid = ls_filter-value THEN abap_true
                                        WHEN ls_filter-operator = 'GT' AND ls_sflight-connid > ls_filter-value THEN abap_true
                                        ELSE abap_false ).
          WHEN 'FLDATE'.
            " Assuming FLDATE is handled as string for simplicity in this dynamic example
            lv_match = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_filter-operator = 'EQ' AND ls_sflight-fldate = ls_filter-value THEN abap_true
                                        WHEN ls_filter-operator = 'GT' AND ls_sflight-fldate > ls_filter-value THEN abap_true
                                        ELSE abap_false ).
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Handle unknown field or error
            lv_match = abap_true. " Or abap_false to exclude if field is unknown
        ENDCASE.

        IF lv_match = abap_true.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_filtered_sflights.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_filter_index = lv_filter_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA: lt_filters TYPE zcl_dynamic_filter=>tt_sflight_filters.

    " Test 1: Filter by CARRID = 'LH'
    APPEND VALUE zcl_dynamic_filter=>ty_sflight_filter( field_name = 'CARRID' operator = 'EQ' value = 'LH' ) TO lt_filters.
    DATA(lt_result1) = lo_cut->apply_dynamic_filters( lt_filters ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result 1 should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result1 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All results should be LH' act = all( lt_result1 WHERE carrid = 'LH' ) ).

    " Test 2: Filter by CARRID = 'LH' AND CONNID > '0000'
    CLEAR lt_filters.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_dynamic_filter=>ty_sflight_filter( field_name = 'CONNID' operator = 'GT' value = '0000' ) TO lt_filters.
    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->apply_dynamic_filters( lt_filters ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result 2 should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result2 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All results should be LH and CONNID > 0000' act = all( lt_result2 WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid > '0000' ) ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl iterativ mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Berechnung für positive ganze Zahlen korrekt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die die Zahl bei jeder Iteration dekrementiert und das Ergebnis multipliziert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_factorial_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factorial_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input number must be non-negative.'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 1.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 3 ) exp = 6 ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung von `cl_gui_column_tree`-Ereignissen in einer objektorientierten Weise. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Warteschlange von simulierten Ereignissen verarbeitet, bis diese leer ist. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Ereignisverarbeitung zu steuern.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Ereignisstruktur und eine Warteschlange. Nutzen Sie `WHILE` zum Entleeren der Warteschlange und `CASE` zur Ereignisbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_event_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_event,
             event_type TYPE string, " e.g., 'NODE_CLICK', 'NODE_EXPAND'
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             timestamp  TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_tree_event.
    TYPES tt_tree_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_events
      IMPORTING
        it_events TYPE tt_tree_events
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_event_queue TYPE tt_tree_events.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_events.
    mt_event_queue = it_events.
    SORT mt_event_queue BY timestamp ASCENDING.

    WHILE mt_event_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_event) = mt_event_queue[ 1 ].
      DELETE mt_event_queue INDEX 1.

      " Simulate event handling logic
      CASE ls_event-event_type.
        WHEN 'NODE_CLICK'.
          " Log or perform action for node click
          cl_demo_output=>write( |Node '{ ls_event-node_key }' clicked at { ls_event-timestamp }| ).
        WHEN 'NODE_EXPAND'.
          " Log or perform action for node expand
          cl_demo_output=>write( |Node '{ ls_event-node_key }' expanded at { ls_event-timestamp }| ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          cl_demo_output=>write( |Unknown event type '{ ls_event-event_type }' for node '{ ls_event-node_key }'| ).
      ENDCASE.
      rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_events FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_events.
    DATA: lt_simulated_events TYPE zcl_tree_event_processor=>tt_tree_events.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_event_processor=>ty_tree_event( event_type = 'NODE_CLICK' node_key = 'NODE1' timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ) ) TO lt_simulated_events.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_event_processor=>ty_tree_event( event_type = 'NODE_EXPAND' node_key = 'NODE2' timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ) secs = 1 ) ) TO lt_simulated_events.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_event_processor=>ty_tree_event( event_type = 'NODE_CLICK' node_key = 'NODE3' timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ) secs = 2 ) ) TO lt_simulated_events.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_event_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_events( lt_simulated_events ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'All events should be processed' act = lv_count exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Eine `WHILE`-Schleife wird verwendet, um eine Warteschlange von Ereignissen sequenziell zu verarbeiten, bis alle Ereignisse abgearbeitet sind. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Retry-Logik für eine simulierte Operation. Die Operation soll maximal N-Mal wiederholt werden, bis sie erfolgreich ist oder die maximale Anzahl an Versuchen erreicht ist. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einem Zähler und einer Bedingung für den Erfolg der Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_retry_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_retries
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_simulated_failure_count TYPE i VALUE 2. " Simulate failure 2 times
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_retry_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_retries.
    DATA(lv_current_retry) = 0.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_current_retry < iv_max_retries AND rv_success = abap_false.
      lv_current_retry = lv_current_retry + 1.
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Attempt { lv_current_retry } of { iv_max_retries }...| ).

      " Simulate an operation that might fail
      IF mv_simulated_failure_count > 0.
        mv_simulated_failure_count = mv_simulated_failure_count - 1.
        cl_demo_output=>write( '  Operation failed.' ).
      ELSE.
        rv_success = abap_true.
        cl_demo_output=>write( '  Operation successful!' ).
      ENDIF.

      IF rv_success = abap_false AND lv_current_retry < iv_max_retries.
        " Simulate a delay before next retry
        WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_retry_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_retry_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_retry_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_retry_logic( ).
    lo_cut->mv_simulated_failure_count = 1. " Fails once, succeeds on second try
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_retries( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should succeed within retries' act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_retry_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_retry_logic( ).
    lo_cut->mv_simulated_failure_count = 3. " Fails three times
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_retries( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should fail after max retries' act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert eine grundlegende Retry-Logik für eine Operation, die fehlschlagen kann. Eine `WHILE`-Schleife wird verwendet, um die Operation zu wiederholen, solange die maximale Anzahl an Versuchen nicht erreicht ist und die Operation noch nicht erfolgreich war. Dies ist ein häufiges Muster in der Softwareentwicklung, um die Robustheit von Systemen zu erhöhen. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen und `WAIT UP TO` für simulierte Verzögerungen sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.
keywords: WHILE, Retry Logic, Conditional Logic, Error Handling, Loop

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle `CARRID`-Werte aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `CONCATENATE` Operator oder String-Templates, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_carrids) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carrids.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    rv_concatenated_carrids = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_flight-carrid ELSE s && ',' && ls_flight-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result should contain LH' act = contains( val = lv_result sub = 'LH' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result should contain comma' act = contains( val = lv_result sub = ',' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators, um alle `CARRID`-Werte aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einem einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String zu verketten. `REDUCE` ist eine moderne ABAP-Funktion (ab 7.40), die es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert den Akkumulator, und die `NEXT`-Klausel definiert die Logik für jede Iteration. `COND` wird verwendet, um das erste Element ohne führendes Komma hinzuzufügen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, String Processing, CONCATENATE, sflights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING AS car_group.
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT c = 0
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN car_group
        NEXT c = c + 1
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count( carrid = car_group-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_counts ) ).
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH should have flights' act = ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Carrier LH not found in results' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator, um Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe zu zählen. `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine moderne ABAP-Funktion (ab 7.40) für die effiziente Gruppierung von Daten. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Zeilen zu zählen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und performante Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch auszulesen und in einer internen Tabelle zu speichern. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit der Struktur `sflight`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_by_name` und `cl_abap_typedescr=>get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lv_value) = ''.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->get_type_kind_as_string( )
        value = lv_value
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_components.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( ls_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Components should be found' act = lines( lt_components ) ).
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_carrid_info) = lt_components[ name = 'CARRID' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrid_info-value exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrid_info-type exp = 'Character String' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'CARRID component not found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification), um die Komponenten einer Struktur dynamisch zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` wird verwendet, um eine Typbeschreibung der Struktur zu erhalten. Anschließend können mit `get_components()` alle Feldnamen und Typen ausgelesen werden. Mit Field-Symbols (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <fs_value>`) kann dann dynamisch auf die Werte der Komponenten zugegriffen werden. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen oder zur Integration mit dynamischen UI-Elementen wie `cl_gui_column_tree`, wo Spalten und Daten dynamisch generiert werden müssen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Structure, Field-Symbols, cl_gui_column_tree

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von `sflights`-Objekten verwaltet. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Selektion.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um die interne Tabelle der Objekte zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE sflights_tt.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_flights = FILTER #( mt_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_manager( lt_all_sflights ).

    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH flights should be found' act = lines( lt_lh_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All results should be LH' act = all( lt_lh_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_no_match.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_manager( lt_all_sflights ).

    DATA(lt_xx_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No XX flights should be found' act = lines( lt_xx_flights ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die objektorientierte Verwaltung von Flugdaten und die Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators zur effizienten Selektion von Daten. Der `FILTER`-Operator (ab 7.40) ermöglicht das Filtern einer internen Tabelle basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. Die Daten werden im Konstruktor der Klasse initialisiert, was eine saubere Trennung von Datenhaltung und Logik ermöglicht.
keywords: Object Orientation, FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Data Selection

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einer komplexen Bedingung einen Wert zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator für die Auswahl des Rückgabewertes.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` als Ausdruck, um verschiedene Fälle elegant zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1
        iv_delay_minutes  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string(
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 60 THEN 'Strongly Delayed'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 15 THEN 'Delayed'
      WHEN iv_occupancy_rate > 90 AND iv_delay_minutes <= 15 THEN 'Full and On Time'
      WHEN iv_occupancy_rate > 70 AND iv_delay_minutes <= 15 THEN 'Almost Full and On Time'
      ELSE 'On Time'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_status_on_time FOR TESTING.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Operators (ab 7.50) als Ausdruck für die konditionale Zuweisung eines Wertes. Anstatt einer langen `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Struktur ermöglicht `SWITCH` eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Darstellung komplexer Bedingungsprüfungen. Die verschiedenen `WHEN`-Klauseln werden der Reihe nach ausgewertet, und der Wert des ersten zutreffenden Falls wird zurückgegeben. Dies ist ideal für die Bestimmung von Status-Texten oder anderen Werten basierend auf mehreren Kriterien.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die `CARRID` und `CONNID` aus `sflights` enthält, und entfernen Sie Duplikate. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `DISTINCT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `DISTINCT` in einer `VALUE`-Konstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_distinct_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_distinct_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_distinct_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_flight_keys.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    rt_distinct_keys = VALUE tt_flight_keys(
      FOR DISTINCT ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_distinct_flight_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_distinct_flight_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_distinct_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_distinct_keys) = lo_cut->get_distinct_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_distinct_keys ) ).
    " Check for uniqueness (implicitly handled by SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY)
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_distinct_keys ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_distinct_keys COMPARING carrid connid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'No duplicates should exist' act = lines( lt_distinct_keys ) exp = lv_initial_lines ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators mit der `DISTINCT`-Klausel (ab 7.40) innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Konstruktion, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit eindeutigen Kombinationen von `CARRID` und `CONNID` aus `sflights` zu erstellen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um Duplikate zu entfernen und eine aggregierte Sicht auf Daten zu erhalten, ohne explizite `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`-Anweisungen verwenden zu müssen. Die Ziel-Tabelle ist als `SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY` definiert, was die Eindeutigkeit zusätzlich sicherstellt.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR DISTINCT, VALUE, Duplicates, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazitäten (`SEATSMAX`) für alle Flüge in `sflights` pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`). Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_seats_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seat_sum,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seat_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seat_sums TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seat_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_seat_sums) TYPE tt_carrier_seat_sums.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_seats_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING AS car_group.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN car_group
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_grouped_flight-seatsmax
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_seat_sum( carrid = car_group-carrid total_seats = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_seat_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_seats_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_seats_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_seat_sums) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_seat_sums ) ).
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_seats) = lt_seat_sums[ carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH should have total seats > 0' act = ls_lh_seats-total_seats > 0 ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Carrier LH not found in results' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Aggregation von Daten mithilfe einer Kombination aus `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator. Die Flüge werden zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die `SEATSMAX`-Werte zu summieren. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Aggregationsfunktionen wie Summenbildung auf gruppierte Daten anzuwenden, was den Code sehr deklarativ und leicht verständlich macht.
keywords: Math, REDUCE, Grouping, Internal Tables, sflights, Summation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle öffentlichen Attribute einer angegebenen Klasse zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und anschließend die Methode `get_attributes` des Deskriptor-Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_attributes.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

        rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR attribute IN lt_attributes
                                   WHERE ( visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public )
                                   ( attribute-name ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., class not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_attributes_of_class FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_attributes_of_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_attributes_of_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_attrs) = lo_cut->get_public_attributes( 'CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_attrs msg = 'CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES should have no public attributes' ).

    " Test with a class that has public attributes (e.g., a custom class)
    " For this example, let's assume a class ZCL_TEST_CLASS with a public attribute 'MV_TEST_ATTR'
    " If such a class doesn't exist, this test might fail or need adjustment.
    " For demonstration, we'll use a class that is known to have public attributes, or create a dummy one.
    DATA(lt_attrs_self) = lo_cut->get_public_attributes( 'ZCL_RTTI_ATTRIBUTES' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_attrs_self msg = 'ZCL_RTTI_ATTRIBUTES should have no public attributes' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_attributes_of_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_attrs) = lo_cut->get_public_attributes( 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_attrs msg = 'Non-existent class should return an empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Abfrage von Klassenattributen mittels RTTI. Die Methode `get_attributes` des Klassen-Deskriptors liefert eine Tabelle aller Attribute. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE`-Klausel und `VALUE`-Konstruktor wird verwendet, um die öffentlichen Attribute zu filtern und deren Namen in einer neuen Tabelle zu sammeln. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und kompakte Art der Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: RTTI, ATTRIBUTES, CLASS_DESCR, FOR, VALUE, FILTER

Instructions: Listen Sie alle Methoden eines angegebenen Interfaces zur Laufzeit auf und geben Sie deren Namen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_intfdescr=>get_intf_descr` und die Methode `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_intf_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_interface_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_intf_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_interface_methods.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_intf_descr) = cl_abap_intfdescr=>get_intf_descr( iv_interface_name ).
        DATA(lt_methods) = lo_intf_descr->get_methods( ).

        rt_methods = VALUE #( FOR method IN lt_methods ( method-name ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., interface not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_type) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_type_descr( iv_type_name ).

          rv_line_type = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_name( ).

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., type not found
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error, if type is not a table type
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine vorhandene Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) filtern und transformieren. Filtern Sie Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und transformieren Sie die Daten in ein neues Format.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücke mit `WHERE` und `( )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                            WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                            ( carrier_id    = flight-carrid,
                              connection_id = flight-connid,
                              flight_date   = flight-fldate,
                              price         = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_transform FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_transform.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should find flights for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 10 msg = 'Should find 10 flights for LH (example data)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrier_id exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight should be LH' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` mit einem funktionalen Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 10000.00 msg = 'Total price for LH should be 10000.00 (example data)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_for_non_existent_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen durch einen kompakten und ausdrucksstarken Ausdruck. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und weniger fehleranfälligem Code. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(...)` und der `SELECT @( )` sind ebenfalls moderne ABAP-Features.
keywords: REDUCE, AGGREGATION, FUNCTIONAL_PROGRAMMING, INTERNAL_TABLES, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein Eingabewert negativ ist, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme modern ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_negative_value DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_negative_value IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_negative_value.

    METHODS safe_process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_negative_value.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = |Input value is { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_process_value.
    TRY.
        rv_result = process_value( iv_input ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_value.
        rv_result = |Error: Negative value provided ({ iv_input })|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_negative_value_caught FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_value_raised EXPECTING EXCEPTION zcx_negative_value FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_process_value( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Input value is 10' msg = 'Positive value should be processed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_value_caught.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_process_value( -5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Negative value provided (-5)' msg = 'Negative value should be caught' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_value_raised.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    lo_cut->process_value( -10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Modernes Error Handling in ABAP basiert auf klassenbasierten Ausnahmen (`CX_STATIC_CHECK`). Das Beispiel zeigt, wie eine eigene Ausnahme definiert, ausgelöst (`RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`) und mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen wird. Dies ist der bevorzugte Weg, um Fehlerzustände zu signalisieren und zu behandeln, da es die Fehlerbehandlung vom normalen Programmfluss trennt und die Robustheit des Codes erhöht. String Templates werden für die Ergebnisnachricht verwendet.
keywords: EXCEPTION_HANDLING, TRY_CATCH, RAISE_EXCEPTION, CUSTOM_EXCEPTION, ERROR_HANDLING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse und zwei konkrete Unterklassen. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie durch die Instanziierung der Unterklassen und den Aufruf einer gemeinsamen Methode über eine Referenz auf die Basisklasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT`, `INHERITING FROM`, `REDEFINITION` und `NEW` für die Instanziierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_desc = |This is a generic shape.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zcl_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    rv_area = io_shape->get_area( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des letzten Tages des Vormonats für ein gegebenes Datum.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_date_helper` oder moderne Datumskonstruktoren und arithmetische Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_last_day_of_prev_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_last_day) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_of_prev_month.
    " Get first day of current month
    DATA(lv_first_day_curr_month) = iv_date.
    lv_first_day_curr_month+6(2) = '01'. " Set day to 01

    " Subtract one day to get last day of previous month
    rv_last_day = lv_first_day_curr_month - 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fragen Sie alle Generic Object Services (GOS) Anlagen für ein spezifisches Business-Objekt (z.B. eine Flugbuchung aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT) ab. Die Methode soll eine interne Tabelle mit den Anlagendetails zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_gos_attachment_query` und konstruieren Sie den Business-Objekt-Schlüssel (`i_object_id`) korrekt. `REF TO` wird implizit für die Objektinstanz verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_query_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS query_attachments
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD query_attachments.
    DATA(lv_object_id) TYPE borident-objkey.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.

    " Konstruiere den Objekt-Schlüssel für SFLIGHT (Business-Objekt-Typ BUS2038)
    " Der Schlüssel setzt sich aus CARRID (3), CONNID (4, alpha-konvertiert) und FLDATE (8) zusammen.
    lv_object_id = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ is_sflight_key-fldate }|.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.
    rt_attachments = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
        i_object_type = 'BUS2038'
        i_object_id   = lv_object_id
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_query_attachments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_query_attachments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_query_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_key) = VALUE zcl_gos_query_basic=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = 'LH'
        connid = '0400'
        fldate = '20251122' " Verwenden Sie ein Datum, das in Ihrem Testsystem GOS-Anlagen haben könnte.
    ).
    DATA(lt_attachments) = lo_cut->query_attachments( ls_sflight_key ).

    " Da GOS-Anlagen oft systemabhängig sind, wird hier nur geprüft, ob die Tabelle initial ist.
    " Für einen echten Test müsste man entweder ein Business-Objekt mit bekannten Anlagen verwenden
    " oder die GOS-Klasse mocken.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_attachments ).
    " Beispiel für eine Assertion, wenn Anlagen erwartet werden:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_attachments ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_attachments ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die moderne Syntax `DATA(...) = NEW ...` und String-Templates (`|...|`) für die Schlüsselkonstruktion werden verwendet. `REF TO` ist hierbei die Grundlage für die Objektinstanziierung und -nutzung.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die GOS-Anlagen eines Business-Objekts nach einem bestimmten Dateityp (z.B. nur PDF-Dateien).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` zur Abfrage und anschließend den `FILTER` Operator für die Ergebnistabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_filter_by_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_attachments_by_type
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key    TYPE ty_sflight_key
        iv_file_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_by_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_attachments_by_type.
    DATA(lv_object_id) TYPE borident-objkey.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) TYPE zcl_gos_filter_by_type=>tt_attachment_list.

    lv_object_id = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ is_sflight_key-fldate }|.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.
    lt_all_attachments = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
        i_object_type = 'BUS2038'
        i_object_id   = lv_object_id
    ).

    " Filtern der Anlagen nach Dateierweiterung mit dem FILTER Operator
    rt_filtered_attachments = FILTER #( lt_all_attachments USING KEY primary_key WHERE file_extension = iv_file_extension ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_attachments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_attachments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_filter_by_type( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_key) = VALUE zcl_gos_filter_by_type=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = 'LH'
        connid = '0400'
        fldate = '20251122'
    ).

    " Für einen aussagekräftigen Test des FILTER-Operators, simulieren wir GOS-Ergebnisse.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man cl_gos_attachment_query mocken oder ein Objekt mit bekannten Anlagen verwenden.
    DATA(lt_mock_attachments) = VALUE zcl_gos_filter_by_type=>tt_attachment_list(
        ( file_extension = 'PDF' file_name = 'Dokument1.pdf' ) 
        ( file_extension = 'TXT' file_name = 'Notiz.txt' ) 
        ( file_extension = 'PDF' file_name = 'Bericht.pdf' ) 
        ( file_extension = 'JPG' file_name = 'Bild.jpg' ) 
    ).

    " Da die Lösung direkt GOS aufruft, können wir den FILTER-Teil nicht isoliert testen.
    " Wir rufen die Methode auf und prüfen das Ergebnis basierend auf der Annahme, dass GOS keine Anlagen liefert.
    " Wenn GOS Anlagen liefern würde, müsste der Test entsprechend angepasst werden.
    DATA(lt_filtered_pdf) = lo_cut->filter_attachments_by_type(
        is_sflight_key    = ls_sflight_key
        iv_file_extension = 'PDF'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered_pdf ).

    " Um den FILTER-Teil wirklich zu testen, müsste die Methode eine Tabelle als Input akzeptieren.
    " Beispiel (wenn die Methode so angepasst wäre):
    " DATA(lt_filtered_mock) = lo_cut->filter_mock_attachments( lt_mock_attachments, 'PDF' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_mock ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die GOS-Abfrage mit dem modernen `FILTER` Operator, um die Ergebnistabelle nach einem Kriterium zu reduzieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um interne Tabellen zu bearbeiten, die ab ABAP 7.40 verfügbar ist.
keywords: GOS, Anlagen, FILTER, Dateityp, Interne Tabellen, cl_gos_attachment_query

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Dateinamen der GOS-Anlagen für ein Business-Objekt in eine separate interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` zur Abfrage und anschließend eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_extract_filenames DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_filenames TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_filenames
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filenames) TYPE tt_filenames.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_extract_filenames IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_filenames.
    DATA(lv_object_id) TYPE borident-objkey.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) TYPE zcl_gos_extract_filenames=>tt_attachment_list.

    lv_object_id = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ is_sflight_key-fldate }|.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.
    lt_all_attachments = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
        i_object_type = 'BUS2038'
        i_object_id   = lv_object_id
    ).

    " Extrahieren der Dateinamen mit einer FOR-Schleife und VALUE-Operator
    rt_filenames = VALUE #( FOR ls_attachment IN lt_all_attachments ( ls_attachment-file_name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Business-Objekts (z.B. 'Mit Anlagen' oder 'Ohne Anlagen'), basierend darauf, ob es GOS-Anlagen besitzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` und den `COND` Operator für eine prägnante bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_status_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS get_attachment_status
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_status_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_status.
    DATA(lv_object_id) TYPE borident-objkey.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.
    DATA(lt_attachments) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lv_object_id = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ is_sflight_key-fldate }|.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.
    lt_attachments = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
        i_object_type = 'BUS2038'
        i_object_id   = lv_object_id
    ).

    " Bestimmen des Status mit dem COND Operator
    rv_status = COND string(
        WHEN lines( lt_attachments ) > 0 THEN 'Mit Anlagen'
        ELSE 'Ohne Anlagen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_attachment_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_status_cond( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_key) = VALUE zcl_gos_status_cond=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = 'LH'
        connid = '0400'
        fldate = '20251122'
