    " Erwartet 'Ohne Anlagen' für den Dummy-Schlüssel.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Ohne Anlagen' ).

    " Um 'Mit Anlagen' zu testen, müsste man ein Objekt mit GOS-Anlagen verwenden oder mocken.

    " DATA(ls_sflight_key_with_att) = VALUE zcl_gos_status_cond=>ty_sflight_key( ... ).

    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_with_att exp = 'Mit Anlagen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Implementierung von bedingter Logik. In diesem Fall wird der Status basierend auf dem Vorhandensein von GOS-Anlagen zugewiesen, was die Codezeilen reduziert und die Wartbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Fragen Sie GOS-Anlagen für eine Liste von Flugbuchungen ab und sammeln Sie alle gefundenen Anlagen in einer einzigen Ergebnistabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` für die Flugbuchungen und eine verschachtelte `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` und `cl_gos_attachment_query`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_multi_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS query_multiple_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_keys TYPE tt_sflight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_multi_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD query_multiple_sflights.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.

    " Sammeln aller Anlagen für die übergebenen Flugbuchungsschlüssel
    rt_all_attachments = VALUE #( FOR ls_key IN it_sflight_keys
                                  LET lv_object_id = |{ ls_key-carrid }{ ls_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ ls_key-fldate }|
                                  IN FOR ls_attachment IN lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
                                      i_object_type = 'BUS2038'
                                      i_object_id   = lv_object_id
                                  ) ( ls_attachment ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_query_multiple_sflights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_query_multiple_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_multi_query( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_keys) = VALUE zcl_gos_multi_query=>tt_sflight_keys(
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251122' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251123' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) = lo_cut->query_multiple_sflights( lt_sflight_keys ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_all_attachments ).
    " Für einen echten Test müsste man GOS-Anlagen für die verwendeten Schlüssel im System haben
    " oder die cl_gos_attachment_query-Instanz mocken, um definierte Ergebnisse zu erhalten.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR`-Iteratoren mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und dem `LET`-Ausdruck. Es ermöglicht das Sammeln von Daten aus mehreren GOS-Abfragen in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert. `REF TO` wird für die GOS-Query-Instanz verwendet.
keywords: GOS, Anlagen, FOR, VALUE, LET, Interne Tabellen, cl_gos_attachment_query, REF TO

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine polymorphe Funktion, die verschiedene Objekte verarbeitet, die ein gemeinsames Interface implementieren. Nutzen Sie dabei `REF TO` auf das Interface.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und lassen Sie mehrere Klassen dieses implementieren. Die verarbeitende Methode akzeptiert dann einen Parameter vom Typ `REF TO` auf das Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processable DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_processor_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processor A processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processor B transformed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphic_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_processor
      IMPORTING
        io_processor TYPE REF TO zif_processable
        iv_data      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphic_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_processor.
    rv_result = io_processor->process_data( iv_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_polymorphic_handler( ).

    DATA(lo_processor_a) = NEW zcl_processor_a( ).
    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_handler->handle_processor( io_processor = lo_processor_a iv_data = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_a exp = 'Processor A processed: Hello' ).

    DATA(lo_processor_b) = NEW zcl_processor_b( ).
    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_handler->handle_processor( io_processor = lo_processor_b iv_data = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_b exp = 'Processor B transformed: World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht Polymorphie in ABAP durch die Verwendung von Interfaces und `REF TO` auf diese Interfaces. Die Methode `handle_processor` kann Objekte verschiedener Klassen verarbeiten, solange diese das Interface `zif_processable` implementieren. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und flexible Architekturen.
keywords: REF TO, Interface, Polymorphie, Objektorientierung, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Datenreferenzen auf Zeilen einer anderen internen Tabelle (`SFLIGHT`), die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. alle Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `REF TO` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, um Datenreferenzen zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_ref_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ref TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_references
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_refs) TYPE tt_sflight_ref.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_ref_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_references.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Beispielhafte Daten für SFLIGHT
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( (
        carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251122' planetype = 'A320' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251122' planetype = 'A321' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251123' planetype = 'B747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251122' planetype = 'A380' )
    ).

    " Erstellen einer Tabelle von Datenreferenzen mit FOR und WHERE
    rt_flight_refs = VALUE #( FOR REF TO ty_sflight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_references FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_references.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_ref_for( ).

    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_references( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_lh_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(lt_aa_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_references( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aa_flights ) exp = 1 ).

    " Überprüfung des Inhalts über Dereferenzierung
    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_ref>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight_ref>->carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung von Datenreferenzen auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `REF TO` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um mit Teilmengen von Daten zu arbeiten, ohne diese zu kopieren, und ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Originaldaten modifiziert werden sollen.
keywords: REF TO, FOR, WHERE, Datenreferenz, Interne Tabellen, VALUE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie GOS-Anlagen nach ihrem Dateityp und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Anlagen pro Typ für ein Business-Objekt. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` und den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_group_by_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_summary,
             file_extension TYPE string,
             count          TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_summary.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_attachment_summary
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_attachment_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_group_by_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_summary.
    DATA(lv_object_id) TYPE borident-objkey.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lv_object_id = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ is_sflight_key-fldate }|.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.
    lt_all_attachments = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
        i_object_type = 'BUS2038'
        i_object_id   = lv_object_id
    ).

    " Gruppieren und Zählen mit REDUCE und GROUP BY
    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_attachment_summary(
        INIT result = VALUE tt_attachment_summary( )
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_attachment IN lt_all_attachments GROUP BY ( file_extension = ls_attachment-file_extension ) ASCENDING
        LET lv_count = lines( GROUP ls_attachment )
        IN VALUE #( result ( file_extension = file_extension count = lv_count ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_attachment_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_attachment_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_group_by_type( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_key) = VALUE zcl_gos_group_by_type=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = 'LH'
        connid = '0400'
        fldate = '20251122'
    ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_attachment_summary( ls_sflight_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summary ).

    " Um REDUCE mit GROUP BY zu testen, müsste man GOS-Anlagen mocken oder ein Objekt mit bekannten Anlagen verwenden.
    " Beispiel (wenn GOS Anlagen liefern würde):
    " DATA(lt_mock_attachments) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list(
    "     ( file_extension = 'PDF' file_name = 'D1.pdf' ) ( file_extension = 'TXT' file_name = 'N1.txt' )
    "     ( file_extension = 'PDF' file_name = 'D2.pdf' ) ( file_extension = 'JPG' file_name = 'I1.jpg' )
    " ).
    " " Angenommen, die Methode könnte eine Mock-Liste akzeptieren:
    " DATA(lt_expected_summary) = VALUE zcl_gos_group_by_type=>tt_attachment_summary(
    "     ( file_extension = 'JPG' count = 1 ) ( file_extension = 'PDF' count = 2 ) ( file_extension = 'TXT' count = 1 )
    " ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary exp = lt_expected_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`, um GOS-Anlagen nach Dateityp zu gruppieren und die Anzahl pro Typ zu ermitteln. Dies ist eine sehr fortgeschrittene und funktionale Programmiertechnik in ABAP, die ab Version 7.55 verfügbar ist und komplexe Aggregationen in einer einzigen Anweisung ermöglicht. `REF TO` wird für die GOS-Query-Instanz verwendet.
keywords: GOS, Anlagen, REDUCE, GROUP BY, Interne Tabellen, Aggregation, cl_gos_attachment_query, REF TO

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Datenreferenz auf eine interne Tabelle akzeptiert und die Anzahl der Zeilen in dieser Tabelle zurückgibt. Die Methode soll generisch für beliebige Tabellentypen sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REF TO DATA` als Importparameter und dereferenzieren Sie die Referenz, um auf die Tabelle zuzugreifen. `lines()` ist hier nützlich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_table_lines
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_table_lines.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_any_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_count = lines( <lt_any_table> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_table_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_table_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_table_counter( ).

    " Test mit einer leeren Tabelle
    DATA(lt_empty) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    DATA(lr_empty) TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_empty INTO lr_empty.
    DATA(lv_count_empty) = lo_cut->count_table_lines( lr_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_empty exp = 0 ).

    " Test mit einer gefüllten Tabelle
    DATA(lt_filled) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    lt_filled = VALUE #( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lr_filled) TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_filled INTO lr_filled.
    DATA(lv_count_filled) = lo_cut->count_table_lines( lr_filled ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_filled exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die generische Verarbeitung von internen Tabellen mittels `REF TO DATA`. Die Methode kann die Zeilenanzahl jeder internen Tabelle ermitteln, die als Datenreferenz übergeben wird. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für dynamische Programmierung und generische Frameworks.
keywords: REF TO DATA, Generisch, Interne Tabellen, lines, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Instanz einer Klasse dynamisch erzeugt, deren Name als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll eine Referenz auf die erzeugte Instanz zurückgeben.

        CREATE OBJECT ro_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

Dies ist ein Schlüsselkonzept für Frameworks und Plugins, bei denen die zu verwendende Klasse erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten GOS-Anlageneintrag eines Business-Objekts, der einem bestimmten Dateityp entspricht, und geben Sie diesen zurück. Wenn kein solcher Eintrag gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Initialwert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` und den `VALUE`-Operator mit `FOR` und `WHERE` sowie `COND` für die Rückgabe des ersten Treffers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_find_first_att DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_attachment_entry TYPE gos_s_att_list.
    METHODS find_first_attachment
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key    TYPE ty_sflight_key
        iv_file_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_attachment) TYPE ty_attachment_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_find_first_att IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_attachment.
    DATA(lv_object_id) TYPE borident-objkey.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lv_object_id = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ is_sflight_key-fldate }|.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.
    lt_all_attachments = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
        i_object_type = 'BUS2038'
        i_object_id   = lv_object_id
    ).

    " Finden des ersten Anlageneintrags mit VALUE, FOR und WHERE
    rs_attachment = VALUE #( lt_all_attachments[ KEY primary_key WHERE file_extension = iv_file_extension ] DEFAULT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Um einen Treffer zu testen, müsste man GOS-Anlagen mocken oder ein Objekt mit bekannten Anlagen verwenden.

    " DATA(lt_mock_attachments) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF gos_s_att_list(

    " ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf ein Objekt akzeptiert und versucht, eine Methode dieses Objekts dynamisch aufzurufen. Fangen Sie dabei mögliche Ausnahmen ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit der `(method_name)`-Syntax und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung. `REF TO OBJECT` ist der Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object    TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_parameter TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE string.

    TRY.
        IF iv_parameter IS SUPPLIED.
          CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              iv_input = iv_parameter " Annahme: Methode hat einen Parameter iv_input
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = lv_result. " Annahme: Methode hat einen Rückgabewert rv_output
        ELSE.
          CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name).
        ENDIF.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung für dynamische Aufrufe (z.B. Methode existiert nicht, falsche Parameter)
        MESSAGE 'Dynamischer Methodenaufruf fehlgeschlagen.' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_no_handler.
        " Weitere Fehlerbehandlung für nicht abgefangene Exceptions
        MESSAGE 'Unbehandelte Exception im dynamischen Aufruf.' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    " Dummy-Klasse für den Test
    CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS test_method_no_param.
        METHODS test_method_with_param
          IMPORTING
            iv_input TYPE string
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_method_no_param.
        " Do nothing
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD test_method_with_param.
        rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_test_object) = NEW lcl_test_class( ).

    " Erfolgreicher Aufruf ohne Parameter
    DATA(lv_success_no_param) = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically(
        io_object    = lo_test_object
        iv_method_name = 'TEST_METHOD_NO_PARAM'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success_no_param ).

    " Erfolgreicher Aufruf mit Parameter
    DATA(lv_success_with_param) = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically(
        io_object    = lo_test_object
        iv_method_name = 'TEST_METHOD_WITH_PARAM'
        iv_parameter = 'Data'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success_with_param ).

    " Fehlgeschlagener Aufruf (Methode existiert nicht)
    DATA(lv_fail) = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically(
        io_object    = lo_test_object
        iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_fail ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD` und der `(method_name)`-Syntax, wobei das Objekt als `REF TO OBJECT` übergeben wird. Die robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ist entscheidend für die Stabilität bei dynamischen Aufrufen.
keywords: REF TO OBJECT, Dynamisch, CALL METHOD, Exception Handling, TRY CATCH

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Namen und Typen aller Komponenten einer gegebenen Struktur zur Laufzeit aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component,
           tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_components IMPORTING is_struct TYPE any
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_struct ).
    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND VALUE ty_component( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type->get_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_struct_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_struct_components.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA: ls_test TYPE ty_test_struct.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_struct_components( ls_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-type exp = '\TYPE=STRING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-type exp = '\TYPE=I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit inspiziert. Nach dem Abrufen des `cl_abap_typedescr`-Objekts wird es zu `cl_abap_structdescr` gecastet, um auf die Methode `get_components()` zugreifen zu können. Dies ist grundlegend für die Implementierung generischer Datenverarbeitungslogik.
keywords: RTTI, Structure, Dynamic Programming, Components, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen generischen Mechanismus, um den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch zu lesen, basierend auf dem Feldnamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in Kombination mit RTTI, um den Feldnamen zu validieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value IMPORTING is_struct    TYPE any
                                      iv_field_name TYPE string
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
                              RAISING   cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_struct ).
    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_structdescr->get_components( ).

      IF NOT line_exists( lt_components[ name = iv_field_name ] ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found.|.
      ENDIF.

      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_struct TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_field>.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = |Could not assign field '{ iv_field_name }'.|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Input is not a structure.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_executable.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_interface_method IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
                                            iv_interface_name TYPE string
                                            iv_method_name    TYPE string
                                            iv_message        TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_interface_method.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).
    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_object.
      DATA(lo_objectdescr) = CAST cl_abap_objectdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      DATA(lt_interfaces) = lo_objectdescr->get_interface_names( ).

      IF line_exists( lt_interfaces[ table_line = iv_interface_name ] ).
        TRY.
            CALL METHOD (iv_interface_name)=>(iv_method_name) OF io_object
              EXPORTING
                iv_message = iv_message.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
            rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Funktion, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer Struktur basierend auf seinem Typ in einen String konvertiert. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um den Typ zu bestimmen und entsprechend zu reagieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung für `kind` oder `type_kind`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_field_to_string IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_string_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_field_to_string.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).

    CASE lo_typedescr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
        rv_string_value = iv_data.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
        rv_string_value = |{ iv_data ALPHA = OUT }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
        rv_string_value = |{ iv_data }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
        rv_string_value = |{ iv_data }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
        rv_string_value = |{ iv_data }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
        rv_string_value = |{ iv_data DATE = USER }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
        rv_string_value = |{ iv_data TIME = USER }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_string_value = 'Unsupported Type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_field_to_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_field_to_string.
    DATA: lv_char  TYPE char10 VALUE 'Text',
          lv_int   TYPE i VALUE 123,
          lv_date  TYPE d VALUE '20231122',
          lv_float TYPE f VALUE '123.456'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_converter( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_field_to_string( lv_char ) exp = 'Text' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_field_to_string( lv_int ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_field_to_string( lv_date ) exp = '22.11.2023' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_field_to_string( lv_float ) exp = '1.2345600000000000E+02' ).

    DATA(lo_object) = NEW object( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_field_to_string( lo_object ) exp = 'Unsupported Type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `type_kind` des Typbeschreibungsobjekts ermöglicht es, den grundlegenden Typ einer Variablen zu identifizieren und entsprechend zu formatieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld sortiert. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Existenz des Feldes zu prüfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT it_table BY (lv_field_name)` und RTTI zur Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_by_field IMPORTING CHANGING ct_table TYPE any table
                                          iv_field_name TYPE string
                                  RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_by_field.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ct_table ).
    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
      DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
      DATA(lo_line_typedescr) = lo_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ).

      IF lo_line_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
        DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_typedescr ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_structdescr->get_components( ).

        IF NOT line_exists( lt_components[ name = iv_field_name ] ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error EXPORTING text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in table line type.|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      TRY.
          SORT ct_table BY (iv_field_name).
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error EXPORTING text = 'Input is not a table.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 1 text = 'A' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld sortiert. keywords: RTTI, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, Sort, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr

CLASS zcl_uuid_table_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rt_uuid_table = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 5
                                ( id = i,
                                  uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_x16( ) ) ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugbuchungen (SFLIGHTS) nach einer bestimmten UUID, die als Buchungs-ID dient. Nehmen Sie an, die UUID ist im RAW16-Format gespeichert.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck und die Methode `compare` der Klasse `CL_SYSTEM_UUID`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_uuid,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             bookid   TYPE sysuuid_x16,
           END OF ty_sflight_uuid.
    TYPES tt_sflight_uuids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_uuid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_uuid IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_uuids
                                     iv_search_uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16
                           RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_uuids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_uuid.
    DATA(lo_search_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( iv_search_uuid ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE bookid = lo_search_uuid->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_x16( ) ).
    " Alternative using compare method if direct comparison is not desired or possible for some reason:
    " rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( bookid )->if_system_uuid_c~compare( lo_search_uuid ) = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid_1) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_x16( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid_2) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_x16( ).

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_uuid_filter=>tt_sflight_uuids(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = lv_uuid_1 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' bookid = lv_uuid_2 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' bookid = lv_uuid_1 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_by_uuid( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_search_uuid = lv_uuid_1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge gefunden werden' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-bookid exp = lv_uuid_1 msg = 'Gefundene UUID muss der Such-UUID entsprechen' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Die direkte Vergleichbarkeit von `SYSUUID_X16` ermöglicht eine einfache `WHERE`-Klausel. Alternativ kann die `compare`-Methode der `CL_SYSTEM_UUID` für komplexere Vergleiche genutzt werden.
keywords: UUID, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, Internal Tables, FILTER, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Verwalten Sie eine Liste von Objekten in einer Hashed Table, wobei die UUID (RAW16) des Objekts als eindeutiger Schlüssel dient. Fügen Sie Objekte hinzu und prüfen Sie, ob ein Objekt anhand seiner UUID existiert.
hint: Definieren Sie eine `HASHED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` auf dem UUID-Feld. Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_data,
             uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_object_data.
    TYPES tt_object_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_object_data
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY uuid.

    METHODS add_object IMPORTING is_object TYPE ty_object_data.
    METHODS object_exists IMPORTING iv_uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16 RETURNING VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_object_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_objects TYPE tt_object_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_object.
    INSERT is_object INTO TABLE mt_objects.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD object_exists.
    rb_exists = COND #( WHEN line_exists( mt_objects[ uuid = iv_uuid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_object_count.
    rv_count = lines( mt_objects ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid_1) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_x16( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid_2) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_x16( ).

    lo_cut->add_object( VALUE #( uuid = lv_uuid_1 name = 'Object A' ) ).
    lo_cut->add_object( VALUE #( uuid = lv_uuid_2 name = 'Object B' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_object_count( ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Objekte vorhanden sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->object_exists( lv_uuid_1 ) msg = 'Object A sollte existieren' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->object_exists( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( )->if_system_uuid_c~get_uuid_x16( ) ) msg = 'Nicht-existierendes Objekt sollte nicht gefunden werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Hashed Tables mit `UNIQUE KEY` bieten eine sehr performante Möglichkeit, auf Einträge über ihren Schlüssel zuzugreifen. `LINE_EXISTS` ist ein moderner Ausdruck, um die Existenz eines Eintrags zu prüfen, und `COND` ermöglicht eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
keywords: UUID, Hashed Table, UNIQUE KEY, LINE_EXISTS, COND

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie deren Wert. Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT <component_name> OF STRUCTURE <structure> TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,

    METHODS get_component_value IMPORTING is_data TYPE ty_data
                                        iv_component_name TYPE string

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_component> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:

    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_struct_access=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'Hello'

    ).

keywords: ASSIGN, Field-Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Structure, String Templates

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugbuchungen (SFLIGHTS) und aktualisieren Sie den Preis für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen festen Prozentsatz. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` für die In-Place-Modifikation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT <itab> ASSIGNING <field_symbol> WHERE ...` und modifizieren Sie das Field-Symbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices IMPORTING CHANGING ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight
                                         iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                         iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_updater( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_updater=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    lo_cut->update_flight_prices( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights
                                  iv_carrid = 'LH'
                                  iv_percentage = '10' ).

    LOOP AT lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        IF ls_flight-fldate = '20250101'.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'LH 0400 Preis korrekt' ).
        ELSEIF ls_flight-fldate = '20250103'.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '165.00' msg = 'LH 0400 Preis korrekt' ).
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'UA 0010 Preis unverändert' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` ist die performanteste Methode zur In-Place-Modifikation von internen Tabellen, da keine Kopie der Zeile erstellt wird. Dies ist besonders bei großen Tabellen effizient.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field-Symbols, Internal Tables, LOOP AT, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Setzen Sie den Wert eines Attributs eines Objekts dynamisch, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN ... OF OBJECT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (lv_attribute_name) OF OBJECT lo_object TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_object_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS set_attribute_value IMPORTING iv_attribute_name TYPE string
                                          iv_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_object_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_attribute_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_attribute> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN (iv_attribute_name) OF OBJECT me TO <fs_attribute>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_attribute> = iv_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error if type mismatch
          MESSAGE `Type conversion error for attribute` TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE `Attribute not found` TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_attribute FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_attribute_invalid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_attribute_type_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_attribute.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_object_access( ).
    lo_cut->set_attribute_value( iv_attribute_name = 'MV_VALUE1' iv_value = 'New String' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_value1 exp = 'New String' msg = 'MV_VALUE1 korrekt gesetzt' ).

    lo_cut->set_attribute_value( iv_attribute_name = 'MV_VALUE2' iv_value = '456' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_value2 exp = 456 msg = 'MV_VALUE2 korrekt gesetzt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_attribute_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_object_access( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_attribute_value( iv_attribute_name = 'MV_INVALID' iv_value = 'Test' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Erwartete Ausnahme für ungültiges Attribut nicht aufgetreten' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_message_type_e.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Erwartete Ausnahme für ungültiges Attribut aufgetreten' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_attribute_type_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_object_access( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_attribute_value( iv_attribute_name = 'MV_VALUE2' iv_value = 'ABC' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Erwartete Ausnahme für Typkonvertierungsfehler nicht aufgetreten' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_message_type_e.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Erwartete Ausnahme für Typkonvertierungsfehler aufgetreten' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN (lv_attribute_name) OF OBJECT me TO <field_symbol>` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Attribute einer Klasse. Dies ist nützlich für generische Setter oder bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist essentiell für robuste dynamische Programmierung.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field-Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, Attributes

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine generische interne Tabelle (`ANY TABLE`), deren Zeilentyp zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt ist. Zählen Sie die Zeilen und geben Sie den Wert der ersten Spalte jeder Zeile aus. Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE` und `LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>`. Für die erste Spalte `ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_any_table IMPORTING it_any_table TYPE any table
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_any_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Should not happen with IMPORTING TYPE any table
      rv_output = 'Error: Table assignment failed.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_line_count) = lines( <fs_table> ).
    rv_output = |Table has { lv_line_count } lines. First column values: |.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_output = rv_output && |{ <fs_field> } |.
      ELSE.
        rv_output = rv_output && '|Error reading first component| '.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_string_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_string_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_table_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_string_table) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_cut->process_any_table( lt_string_table ).

CLASS zcl_uuid_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (beliebigen Typs) entgegennimmt und die Werte einer bestimmten Spalte (Name zur Laufzeit bekannt) in einer neuen String-Tabelle sammelt. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `ASSIGN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_column_values IMPORTING it_any_table TYPE any table
                                          iv_column_name TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_values = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT result = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR <fs_line> IN <fs_table>
      LET lv_value = '' IN
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
        ENDIF.
        NEXT result = VALUE string_table( BASE result ( lv_value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Struktur und einen Feldnamen als String erhält. Basierend auf dem Typ des Feldes soll ein spezifischer Wert gesetzt werden (z.B. 'DEFAULT_STRING' für STRING, 0 für I). Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN` und `CASE TYPE OF`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>` und `CASE TYPE OF <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flexible_data,
             text_field TYPE string,
             num_field  TYPE i,
             date_field TYPE d,
           END OF ty_flexible_data.

    METHODS set_default_value IMPORTING iv_field_name TYPE string
                                        CHANGING cs_data TYPE ty_flexible_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_default_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CASE TYPE OF <fs_field>.
        WHEN TYPE string.
          <fs_field> = 'DEFAULT_STRING'.
        WHEN TYPE i.
          <fs_field> = 0.
        WHEN TYPE d.
          <fs_field> = sy-datum.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " No specific default for other types
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE `Field not found` TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_with_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        it_strings TYPE string_table

CLASS zcl_conv_table_with_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_int.

                                 CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number.
                                   CONTINUE.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') und mit einer Mindestkapazität (z.B. 200 Sitze) zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
                                      AND seatsmax >= iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_seats = REDUCE tt_carrier_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      LET lv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
                                INIT sum = 0
                                FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_seats = lv_total_seats ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_aggregate_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_aggregate( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Beispielhafte Überprüfung für einen bekannten Carrier (z.B. 'LH')
    DATA(ls_lh_entry) = VALUE zcl_sflights_aggregate=>ty_carrier_seats( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_entry WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_entry-total_seats > 0 ) msg = 'Total seats for LH should be greater than 0' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Entry for carrier LH not found' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernes ABAP.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugnummern (Typ `sflight-connid`) in eine kommaseparierte String-Liste, wobei Sie `CONV` und String-Templates verwenden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_connid_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_connid_list_as_string
      IMPORTING
        it_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_connid_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_list_as_string.
    rv_connid_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR lv_connid IN it_connids
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ CONV string( lv_connid ) }|
                 ELSE |{ s }, { CONV string( lv_connid ) }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_cond_string_to_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus `SFLIGHTS` enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die in 'FRA' starten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_map_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_fra_flights_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_map_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fra_flights_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fra_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_fra_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fra_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_map_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_fra_flights_summary( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'No flights from Frankfurt found' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-carrid msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-connid msg = 'Connection ID should not be initial' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_fra_flights.
    " Um diesen Test zu ermöglichen, müsste man entweder die SFLIGHTS-Daten manipulieren
    " oder einen Filter verwenden, der definitiv keine Ergebnisse liefert.
    " Hier wird angenommen, dass 'XYZ' kein gültiger Startort ist.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_map_filter( ).
    " Da die Methode keine Parameter für cityfrom hat, ist dieser Test nur bedingt aussagekräftig
    " ohne Mocking oder eine angepasste Methode.
    " Für diesen Test wird angenommen, dass die SFLIGHTS-Daten keine Flüge von 'XYZ' enthalten.
    " Ein direkter Test auf 'FRANKFURT' kann nur die Existenz prüfen, nicht die Abwesenheit.
    " Daher wird hier nur die Struktur des Ergebnisses geprüft.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_fra_flights_summary( ).
    " Wenn SFLIGHTS keine Flüge von 'FRANKFURT' hätte, wäre dieser Test sinnvoll.
    " Da es aber fast immer welche gibt, ist dies eher ein Beispiel für die Struktur.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ) msg = 'Result should be a table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine generische interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert. Das Ergebnis soll als Referenz auf eine dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb einer `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` Schleife und `CREATE DATA` für die Ergebnistabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data         TYPE any table
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_data> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_row> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA rt_filtered_data LIKE <lt_data>.
    ASSIGN rt_filtered_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lt_filtered_data>).

    LOOP AT <lt_data> ASSIGNING <ls_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_row> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> = iv_filter_value.
        APPEND <ls_row> TO <lt_filtered_data>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string. " Simplified return for demo

    METHODS _get_hello_world RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS _get_goodbye RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE string.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object RECEIVING RESULTS lv_result.
        rv_result = lv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found or call failed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_hello_world.
    rv_text = 'Hello World!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_goodbye.
    rv_text = 'Goodbye!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. " Error creating table
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate filling with data (e.g., from DB or external source)
    DO 3 TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_any_table> ASSIGNING <ls_any_line>.
      " Example of dynamic field access if needed:
      " FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
      " ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_line> TO <fs_field>.

INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.

    INTERFACES zif_shape.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * cl_abap_math=>pi( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lo_circle> TYPE zcl_circle.
    ASSIGN io_shape->* TO <lo_circle> CASTING.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. " Successfully casted to ZCL_CIRCLE
      rv_info = |Circle with radius { <lo_circle>-mv_radius } and area { io_shape->get_area( ) }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_info = |Unknown shape with area { io_shape->get_area( ) }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: id    TYPE string READ-ONLY,

hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_record,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data_record.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_component_values
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data_ref ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        " Handle error if not a structure or data reference is invalid
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_component_values.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data_ref->* TO <ls_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data_ref ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_settings,
             param1 TYPE string,
             param2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_settings.

    METHODS field_exists
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD field_exists.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data_ref->* TO <ls_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Typ eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch ermittelt. Dies ist nützlich für 'Common Tools' zur Typ-Inspektion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und dann `GET REFERENCE OF <fs> INTO lr_data_ref` und RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_type_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_info,
           tt_data_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_type_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA: lr_field_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    ASSIGN ir_data_ref->* TO <ls_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      GET REFERENCE OF <fs_field> INTO lr_field_ref.
      IF lr_field_ref IS BOUND.
        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_field_ref ).
        rv_type = lo_typedescr->get_relative_name( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_field_type_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_type_reader( ).
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_field_type_reader=>ty_data_info.

      iv_field_name = 'NAME'
    ).

  METHOD test_get_field_type_int.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_type_reader( ).
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_field_type_reader=>ty_data_info.
    ls_test_data-name = 'TestName'.
    ls_test_data-type = 'TestType'.

    DATA(lv_type) = lo_cut->get_field_type(
      ir_data_ref   = lr_test_data
      iv_field_name = 'TYPE'
    ).
    " Note: 'TYPE' is a reserved word, so it might be tricky. Let's use a different field for int.
    " Re-using ty_data_info, but assuming 'type' is a string. Let's define a new type for int.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_numeric_data,
             count TYPE i,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_numeric_data.
    DATA: ls_numeric_data TYPE ty_numeric_data.
    ls_numeric_data-count = 10.
    DATA(lr_numeric_data) = REF #( ls_numeric_data ).
    lv_type = lo_cut->get_field_type(

    DATA(lv_type) = lo_cut->get_field_type(
      ir_data_ref   = lr_test_data
      iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_type ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Daten in einen einzelnen UTF-8 Byte-Stream, wobei jede Zeile der Tabelle eine Zeile in einer CSV-Datei darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` in einer Schleife und fügen Sie Zeilenumbrüche hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_csv_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_to_utf8_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_csv_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_utf8_csv.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_header) = 'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PRICE,CURRENCY'.

    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_header ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf ).

    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_line).
      DATA(lv_csv_line) = |{ ls_line-carrid },{ ls_line-connid },{ ls_line-fldate },{ ls_line-price },{ ls_line-currency }|.
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_csv_line ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_conv->flush( IMPORTING buffer = rv_csv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_csv_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_csv_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_csv_utf8( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE zcl_conv_csv_utf8=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_csv) =
      'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PRICE,CURRENCY' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
      'LH,0400,20250101,100.00,EUR' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
      'AA,0017,20250102,200.50,USD' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_table_to_utf8_csv( lt_sflight_data ).
    DATA(lv_actual_csv_string) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING buffer = lv_actual_xstring IMPORTING data = lv_actual_csv_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_csv_string
      exp = lv_expected_csv
      msg = 'CSV to UTF-8 conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine interne Tabelle in ein CSV-Format konvertiert und dann den gesamten String in einen UTF-8 Byte-Stream umwandelt. Dies ist eine gängige Anforderung beim Export von Daten in Dateien. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` für Zeilenumbrüche ist modern. Der Unit-Test verwendet `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` zur Rückkonvertierung, um die Korrektheit zu überprüfen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE, CSV, Internal Tables, String Templates, File Handling, UTF-8

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `UPDATE`-Anweisung mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_sflight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_sflight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    UPDATE sflights
       SET price = @iv_new_price
     WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
       AND connid = @iv_connid
       AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_price_update FOR TESTING.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'LH'.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '0400'.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20250101'.
    DATA mv_original_price TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure test data exists and store original price
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflight(
        carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate
        price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING'
        seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50
      ) ).
      mv_original_price = '100.00'.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original price
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_price_update.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_update_sflight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '150.00'.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_updater->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid    = mv_carrid
      iv_connid    = mv_connid
      iv_fldate    = mv_fldate
      iv_new_price = lv_new_price
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Update should be successful'
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_actual_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_new_price
      msg = 'Flight price was not updated correctly'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine einfache `UPDATE`-Anweisung mit Hostvariablen (`@`) in der `SET`- und `WHERE`-Klausel, was seit ABAP 7.40 die bevorzugte Syntax ist. Der Unit-Test beinhaltet `setup` und `teardown` Methoden, um die Datenbank vor und nach dem Test in einen definierten Zustand zu bringen, was eine gute Praxis für Datenbanktests ist.
keywords: UPDATE, Open SQL, Database, sflights, Host Variables

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Preise mehrerer Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer internen Tabelle, die die zu aktualisierenden Flugschlüssel und neuen Preise enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `UPDATE`-Anweisung mit `FROM @(internal_table)`.

CLASS zcl_mass_update_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES: tt_flight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mass_update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_flight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mass_update_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_flight_prices.
    UPDATE sflights FROM @(
      VALUE sflights(
        FOR ls_update IN it_updates
        ( carrid = ls_update-carrid
          connid = ls_update-connid
          fldate = ls_update-fldate
          price  = ls_update-new_price )
      )
    ).
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mass_update FOR TESTING.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_original_data.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Prepare test data and store original prices
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.50' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'AIRBUS' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 75 )
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_price)
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight-connid AND fldate = @ls_flight-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_original_data( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid fldate = ls_flight-fldate price = lv_price ) TO mt_original_data.
        UPDATE sflights FROM @ls_flight. " Update existing
      ELSE.
        INSERT sflights FROM @ls_flight. " Insert new
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original prices
    LOOP AT mt_original_data INTO DATA(ls_original).
      UPDATE sflights SET price = @ls_original-price
        WHERE carrid = @ls_original-carrid AND connid = @ls_original-connid AND fldate = @ls_original-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mass_update.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_mass_update_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_mass_update_sflight=>tt_flight_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '110.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' new_price = '210.50' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_updater->mass_update_flight_prices( lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_rows_updated
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of rows updated'
    ).

    DATA(lv_price_lh) TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_price_lh
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_price_lh
      exp = '110.00'
      msg = 'Price for LH 0400 not updated correctly'
    ).

    DATA(lv_price_aa) TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_price_aa
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_price_aa
      exp = '210.50'
      msg = 'Price for AA 0017 not updated correctly'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis und die Währung von Flügen in `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen, die direkt in der `SET`-Klausel mit `CASE` ausgedrückt werden.

CLASS zcl_update_sflight_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_update_sflight_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_conditional.
    UPDATE sflights
       SET price    = CASE WHEN connid = '0400' THEN price * '1.10'

                           ELSE price END,
           currency = CASE WHEN carrid = 'LH' THEN 'USD'
                           WHEN carrid = 'AA' THEN 'EUR'

    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
