Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String mit potenziell nicht darstellbaren Zeichen in eine spezifische Codepage (z.B. ISO-8859-1) und behandeln Sie Konvertierungsfehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_CONV_CODEPAGE` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_encoding     TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'ISO-8859-1'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conv_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = iv_encoding ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = iv_input_string ).
        lo_conv->flush( IMPORTING buffer = rv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conv_codepage INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Log the error or handle it as appropriate
        " For this example, we re-raise the exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Hello World!'.
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = '48656C6C6F20576F726C6421'. "Hex for 'Hello World!' in ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_with_error_handling( lv_test_string ).

    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Preis: 100€'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW cx_sy_conv_codepage( )
      msg = 'Expected CX_SY_CONV_CODEPAGE for unrepresentable character'

Die explizite Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen, die mit externen Datenquellen interagieren.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE, Codepage, Error Handling, CX_SY_CONV_CODEPAGE, XSTRING

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'AIRBUS' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 75 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'BOEING' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_test_carriers) = VALUE scarr_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' currcode = 'EUR' url = 'http://www.lufthansa.com' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' currcode = 'USD' url = 'http://www.aa.com' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' currcode = 'USD' url = 'http://www.united.com' )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_planetype)
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight-connid AND fldate = @ls_flight-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.

        INSERT sflights FROM @ls_flight. " Insert new

    LOOP AT lt_test_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      INSERT scarr FROM @ls_carrier. " Insert new carriers
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Restore original planetypes and delete test carriers
    LOOP AT mt_original_data INTO DATA(ls_original).
      UPDATE sflights SET planetype = @ls_original-planetype
        WHERE carrid = @ls_original-carrid AND connid = @ls_original-connid AND fldate = @ls_original-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    DELETE scarr WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'UA').
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_subquery_update.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_update_sflight_subquery( ).
    DATA(lv_new_planetype) = 'JET'.

      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_planetype_aa exp = lv_new_planetype msg = 'Planetype for AA 0017 not updated correctly' ).

      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine ABAP-Datenstruktur in einen UTF-8 Byte-Stream für die externe Serialisierung, z.B. für die Übertragung über ein Netzwerkprotokoll.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_struct_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

      IMPORTING
        is_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_struct_to_utf8_xstring.
    DATA(lv_json_string) TYPE string.
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( EXPORTING data = is_flight_info PRETTY_PRINT = abap_false IMPORTING json = lv_json_string ).

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_json_string ).
    lo_conv->flush( IMPORTING buffer = rv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key_planetype,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_key_planetype.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key_planetype TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key_planetype WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_updates TYPE tt_flight_key_planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_dynamic.
    UPDATE sflights FROM @(
      VALUE sflights(
        FOR ls_update IN it_flight_updates
        ( carrid = ls_update-carrid
          connid = ls_update-connid
          fldate = ls_update-fldate
          planetype = ls_update-planetype )
      )
    ).
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_dynamic_encoding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die `PRICE` für Flüge in `SFLIGHTS`, die in einer internen Tabelle von Flugschlüsseln enthalten sind, die zuvor mit dem `FILTER`-Operator gefiltert wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine Untermenge von Schlüsseln zu erhalten, und nutzen Sie diese dann in der `UPDATE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_with_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_key
        iv_filter_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_filtered_keys) = FILTER tt_flight_key FROM it_all_flights
                                 WHERE carrid = iv_filter_carrid.

    UPDATE sflights FROM @(
      VALUE sflights(
        FOR ls_key IN lt_filtered_keys
        ( carrid = ls_key-carrid
          connid = ls_key-connid
          fldate = ls_key-fldate
          price  = iv_new_price )
      )
    ).
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_update FOR TESTING.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Prepare test data for SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'AIRBUS' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 75 )
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_price)
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight-connid AND fldate = @ls_flight-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_original_data( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid fldate = ls_flight-fldate price = lv_price ) TO mt_original_data.
        UPDATE sflights FROM @ls_flight. " Update existing
      ELSE.
        INSERT sflights FROM @ls_flight. " Insert new
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original prices
    LOOP AT mt_original_data INTO DATA(ls_original).
      UPDATE sflights SET price = @ls_original-price
        WHERE carrid = @ls_original-carrid AND connid = @ls_original-connid AND fldate = @ls_original-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_update.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_update_with_filter( ).

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '999.99'.
    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_updater->update_filtered_flights(
      it_all_flights   = lt_all_keys
      iv_filter_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_new_price     = lv_new_price
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_rows_updated
      exp = 2 " Two LH flights
      msg = 'Incorrect number of rows updated'
    ).

    DATA(lv_price_lh_0400) TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_price_lh_0400
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_lh_0400 exp = lv_new_price msg = 'Price for LH 0400 not updated correctly' ).

    DATA(lv_price_aa_0017) TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_price_aa_0017
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_aa_0017 exp = '200.00' msg = 'Price for AA 0017 should not be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine große interne Tabelle von Strings effizient in einen einzelnen UTF-8 Byte-Stream, um die Performance bei der Dateierstellung zu optimieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` und schreiben Sie die Daten in Blöcken, um die Pufferverwaltung zu optimieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_large_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_string_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_large_string_table_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        it_lines TYPE tt_string_lines
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_large_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_large_string_table_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    LOOP AT it_lines INTO DATA(lv_line).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_line ).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_conv->flush( IMPORTING buffer = rv_utf8_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_large_data_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_large_data_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_large_data( ).
    DATA(lt_test_lines) = VALUE zcl_conv_large_data=>tt_string_lines(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL 1000 ( |Line { i } with some content and special characters like ÄÖÜß| )
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_large_string_table_to_utf8( lt_test_lines ).

    " For verification, convert back and check length/content
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_actual_string) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING buffer = lv_actual_xstring IMPORTING data = lv_actual_string ).

    DATA(lt_result_lines) TYPE zcl_conv_large_data=>tt_string_lines.
    SPLIT lv_actual_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_result_lines.

    " Remove last empty line if present due to trailing CR_LF
    IF lines( lt_result_lines ) > 0 AND lt_result_lines[ lines( lt_result_lines ) ] IS INITIAL.
      DELETE TABLE lt_result_lines INDEX lines( lt_result_lines ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result_lines )
      exp = lines( lt_test_lines )
      msg = 'Number of lines after conversion mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result_lines[ 1 ]
      exp = lt_test_lines[ 1 ]
      msg = 'First line content mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result_lines[ lines( lt_result_lines ) ]
      exp = lt_test_lines[ lines( lt_test_lines ) ]
      msg = 'Last line content mismatch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die effiziente Konvertierung einer großen Menge von String-Daten (repräsentiert durch eine interne Tabelle) in einen einzelnen UTF-8 Byte-Stream. Durch das schrittweise Schreiben der Zeilen und das abschließende `flush` wird die Pufferverwaltung von `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` optimal genutzt, was bei großen Datenmengen zu einer besseren Performance führt als das Konvertieren eines riesigen Gesamtstrings.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE, UTF-8, XSTRING, Large Data, Performance, Internal Tables

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die `SEATSOCC` (belegte Sitze) in `SFLIGHTS` für Flüge, die eine bestimmte `PLANETYPE` haben, basierend auf einem berechneten Durchschnittswert aus anderen Flügen.

CLASS zcl_update_sflight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_seatsocc_by_avg
      IMPORTING
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_update_sflight_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_seatsocc_by_avg.
    UPDATE sflights
       SET seatsocc = ( SELECT AVG( seatsocc ) FROM sflights WHERE planetype = @iv_planetype )
     WHERE planetype = @iv_planetype.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deklarieren und füllen Sie eine Hashed Table mit Flugdaten aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie `CARRID` und `CONNID` als eindeutigen Schlüssel.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_populate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: ty_flights_h TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flights_hashed RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flights_h.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_populate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_hashed.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_flight_key) = VALUE zcl_hsh_table_populate=>ty_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer Hashed Table basierend auf seinem eindeutigen Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: ty_flights_h TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS read_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sample_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flights_h.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight_by_key.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_sample_flights( ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO rs_flight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer Hashed Table mit Flugdaten unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: ty_flights_h TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_totals_s TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS aggregate_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE ty_carrier_totals_s.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sample_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flights_h.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = get_sample_flights( ).

    rt_carrier_totals = REDUCE ty_carrier_totals_s(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_carrier_totals_s( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      LET current_carrid = flight-carrid IN
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_carrier_totals_s(
        BASE result
        ( carrid = current_carrid
          total_price = REDUCE s_price(
            INIT sum_price = 0
            FOR member IN GROUP flight
            NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250104' price = '180.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table aus einer Standardtabelle, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen und umbenannt werden (Mapping).

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_raw_t TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_mapped,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_nr  TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             ticket_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_mapped.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_raw_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_raw_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_raw_t.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_and_create_hashed_table.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die Existenz eines Eintrags in einer Hashed Table und fügen Sie ihn hinzu, falls er nicht existiert (UPSERT-ähnlich).
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ...` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` oder `COLLECT` für einfache Fälle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_table_upsert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: ty_flights_h TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS upsert_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flights_h.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sample_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flights_h.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_upsert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upsert_flight.
    rt_flights = get_sample_flights( ).

    " Check if entry exists
    READ TABLE rt_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_flight-carrid connid = is_flight-connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Entry exists, modify it
      MODIFY TABLE rt_flights FROM is_flight.
    ELSE.
      " Entry does not exist, insert it
      INSERT is_flight INTO TABLE rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_upsert_insert FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_upsert_modify FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upsert_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_table_upsert( ).
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_hsh_table_upsert=>ty_flight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->upsert_flight( ls_new_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 3 entries after insert' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_found) WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'New entry should be found' act = ls_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_upsert_modify.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_table_upsert( ).
    DATA(ls_modified_flight) = VALUE zcl_hsh_table_upsert=>ty_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->upsert_flight( ls_modified_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should still have 2 entries after modify' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_found) WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should be updated' act = ls_found-price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert ein 'UPSERT'-Verhalten für Hashed Tables. Zuerst wird geprüft, ob ein Eintrag existiert (`READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS`). Basierend auf dem Ergebnis (`sy-subrc`) wird entweder ein `MODIFY TABLE` oder ein `INSERT INTO TABLE` durchgeführt. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für die Datenpflege in Hashed Tables.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, UPSERT, INSERT, MODIFY, READ TABLE, SY-SUBRC

Instructions: Verketten Sie zwei Hashed Tables mit kompatiblen Strukturen zu einer neuen Hashed Table.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: ty_flights_h TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS concatenate_hashed_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_flights1 TYPE ty_flights_h
        it_flights2 TYPE ty_flights_h
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE ty_flights_h.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_hashed_tables.
    rt_combined_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights1 ( flight )
                                   FOR flight IN it_flights2 ( flight ) ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_tables.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_table_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_flights1) = VALUE zcl_hsh_table_concat=>ty_flights_h(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights2) = VALUE zcl_hsh_table_concat=>ty_flights_h(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250104' price = '400.00' ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Entry AA 0017 should exist' act = sy-subrc = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'DL' connid = '0002'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Entry DL 0002 should exist' act = sy-subrc = 0 ).

  METHOD test_concatenate_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_table_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_flights1) = VALUE zcl_hsh_table_concat=>ty_flights_h(

CLASS zcl_xco_time_compare IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_ts1) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp1 ).

Instructions: Konvertiere einen gegebenen String von UTF-8 nach ISO-8859-1 unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` und definiere die Encodings als Konstanten. Behandle dabei Zeichen, die nicht im Ziel-Zeichensatz vorhanden sind, durch ein Ersatzzeichen.
hint: Nutze `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE=>CREATE` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE=>CREATE` mit dem Parameter `REPLACEMENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_encoding_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_encoding_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_encoding_utf8  TYPE abap_encod VALUE 'UTF-8',
      lc_encoding_iso   TYPE abap_encod VALUE 'ISO-8859-1',
      lc_replacement    TYPE char1      VALUE '?'.

    DATA: lv_xstring_utf8 TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8)
        cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = lc_encoding_utf8 )->write(
          EXPORTING
            data = iv_input_string
          RECEIVING
            buffer = lv_xstring_utf8
        ).

        " Convert xstring (UTF-8) to string (ISO-8859-1) with replacement
        cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding   = lc_encoding_iso,
          replacement = lc_replacement
        )->read(
          EXPORTING
            buffer = lv_xstring_utf8
          RECEIVING
            data = rv_converted_string
        ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_converted_string = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_special_chars FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_encoding_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->convert_string( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'Simple conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_special_chars.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_encoding_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_input_euro) = 'Test mit € Zeichen'.
    DATA(lv_expected_iso) = 'Test mit ? Zeichen'. " Expected replacement for Euro sign in ISO-8859-1

    DATA(lv_result_euro) = lo_converter->convert_string( lv_input_euro ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_euro exp = lv_expected_iso msg = 'Euro sign replacement incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_input_umlaut) = 'Grüße'.
    DATA(lv_expected_umlaut) = 'Grüße'. " Umlaut 'ü' exists in ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_result_umlaut) = lo_converter->convert_string( lv_input_umlaut ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_umlaut exp = lv_expected_umlaut msg = 'Umlaut conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_encoding_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = ''.
    DATA(lv_expected) = ''.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->convert_string( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'Empty string conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` zur Konvertierung von Strings zwischen verschiedenen Zeichensätzen. Die Quell- und Ziel-Encodings sowie ein Ersatzzeichen werden als `CONSTANTS` definiert, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt mit `TRY...CATCH` und die Konvertierung von nicht darstellbaren Zeichen wird explizit mit einem Ersatzzeichen gehandhabt.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ, CONSTANTS, Encoding, String Conversion, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, TRY...CATCH, Replacement Character

Instructions: Bestimme den Status eines Fluges basierend auf dem `CARRID` aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Verwende `CONSTANTS` für die Fluggesellschaftscodes und einen `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutze den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck und `CONSTANTS` für die `CARRID`-Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_sflight_status
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_info) TYPE ty_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_lh  TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH', " Lufthansa
      lc_ua  TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'UA', " United Airlines
      lc_aa  TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA', " American Airlines
      lc_ba  TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'BA'. " British Airways

    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                               WHEN lc_lh THEN 'On Time (Lufthansa)'
                               WHEN lc_ua THEN 'Delayed (United)'
                               WHEN lc_aa THEN 'Cancelled (American)'
                               WHEN lc_ba THEN 'Boarding (British Airways)'
                               ELSE 'Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_status.
    rs_flight_info = VALUE #( 
      carrid = is_sflight-carrid
      connid = is_sflight-connid
      fldate = is_sflight-fldate
      status = get_flight_status( is_sflight-carrid )
    ).

Instructions: Simuliere das Lesen einer Datei mit einem bestimmten Zeichensatz (z.B. UTF-8) und konvertiere den Inhalt in einen internen ABAP-String (UTF-16/UCS-2), wobei Dateitypen und Encodings als Konstanten definiert sind.

CLASS zcl_file_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS read_and_convert_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content_xstring TYPE xstring " Simulated file content
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_convert_file.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_encoding_utf8 TYPE abap_encod VALUE 'UTF-8',
      lc_file_type_txt TYPE string     VALUE 'TXT'. " Example constant for file type

    TRY.
        " Create conversion object for input (from UTF-8 to internal ABAP string)
        DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = lc_encoding_utf8 ).

        " Read and convert the xstring buffer to string
        lo_conv_in->read(
          EXPORTING
            buffer = iv_file_content_xstring
          RECEIVING
            data = rv_converted_string
        ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_converted_string = |Error reading/converting file: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine kommagetrennte Liste von eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS`, wobei ein Trennzeichen als Konstante definiert ist und `FOR GROUPS OF` sowie `REDUCE` verwendet werden.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF` zur Ermittlung eindeutiger Werte und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation in einen String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_list_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers_list
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_list_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_list.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_separator TYPE string VALUE ', '.

    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights BY flight-carrid
      ( flight )
    ).

    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_unique_carriers
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-carrid ELSE s && lc_separator && flight-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: URL-encodiere einen String und decodiere ihn wieder, wobei das Encoding als Konstante definiert ist.
hint: Nutze `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` mit dem Encoding 'URL'.

CLASS zcl_url_encoder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS encode_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_encoded_string) TYPE string.
    METHODS decode_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_encoded_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decoded_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_encoder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encode_url.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_encoding_url TYPE abap_encod VALUE 'URL'.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = lc_encoding_url )->write( iv_input_string )->get_buffer( ).
    rv_encoded_string = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = lc_encoding_url )->read( lv_xstring )->get_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decode_url.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_encoding_url TYPE abap_encod VALUE 'URL'.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = lc_encoding_url )->write( iv_encoded_string )->get_buffer( ).
    rv_decoded_string = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = lc_encoding_url )->read( lv_xstring )->get_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Factory-Methode, die ein Konverter-Objekt (`CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` oder `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE`) basierend auf einem Konstanten-Parameter zurückgibt. Nutze dabei `NEW` mit Typinferenz.
hint: Verwende eine `CASE`-Anweisung oder `SWITCH` mit `NEW` und `TYPE` für die Objekterzeugung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES ty_conv_direction TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF gc_direction,
        in  TYPE ty_conv_direction VALUE 'I',
        out TYPE ty_conv_direction VALUE 'O',
      END OF gc_direction.

    CLASS-METHODS create_converter
      IMPORTING
        iv_direction TYPE ty_conv_direction
        iv_encoding  TYPE abap_encod
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_converter) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_obj
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_converter.
    CASE iv_direction.
      WHEN gc_direction-in.
        ro_converter = NEW cl_abap_conv_in_ce( encoding = iv_encoding ).
      WHEN gc_direction-out.
        ro_converter = NEW cl_abap_conv_out_ce( encoding = iv_encoding ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Ungültige Konvertierungsrichtung: { iv_direction }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen. Die Fluggesellschaft und die Mindestanzahl sollen als Konstanten definiert werden. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `WHERE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` für die Filterung und `VALUE #` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_target_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',
      lc_min_free_seats TYPE i         VALUE 50.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_filtered(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
        WHERE ( ls_flight-carrid = lc_target_carrid AND
                ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc >= lc_min_free_seats )
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
        seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_sflights. " 100 free
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 180 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_sflights. " 20 free (should not be included)
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_sflights. " 100 free (wrong carrier)
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_sflights. " 80 free

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First filtered flight incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' msg = 'Second filtered flight incorrect' ).

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 180 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_sflights. " 20 free
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_sflights. " 100 free (wrong carrier)

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und zähle die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwende `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF` zur Gruppierung und `REDUCE` zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_initial_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        count  = REDUCE i(
                   INIT c = lc_initial_count
                   FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                   NEXT c = c + 1 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer konstanten Anzahl von Spalten und fülle sie mit Daten. Verwende dabei `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
hint: Nutze RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` Familie) und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_columns TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_field_prefix TYPE string VALUE 'FIELD_',
      lc_field_type   TYPE string VALUE 'STRING'.

    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT sy-tab_range INTO DATA(lv_index) FROM 1 TO iv_num_columns.
      ls_component-name = |{ lc_field_prefix }{ lv_index ALPHA = OUT }|.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( lc_field_type ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT sy-tab_range INTO lv_index FROM 1 TO 3. " Add 3 rows for demo
        CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
        IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          DO iv_num_columns TIMES.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
            IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_field> = |Row { lv_index }, Col { sy-index }|.
            ENDIF.
          ENDDO.
          APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_list_converter IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine XSTRING, wobei jeder String durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt und in Codepage 4103 (UTF-8) kodiert ist.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` in einer Schleife und füge Zeilenumbrüche hinzu. Nutze `CONCATENATE LINES OF` oder `REDUCE` für die String-Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.
    DATA: lv_temp_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lv_crlf TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA: lv_crlf_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding    = '4103' " UTF-8
          replacement = '#' ).

        lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf
                             IMPORTING buffer = lv_crlf_xstring ).

        LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_line).
          lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_line
                               IMPORTING buffer = lv_temp_xstring ).
          rv_xstring = rv_xstring && lv_temp_xstring.
          IF sy-tabix < lines( it_strings ).
            rv_xstring = rv_xstring && lv_crlf_xstring.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese eine XSTRING, die CSV-Daten in Codepage 1103 (UTF-16 Little Endian) enthält, und konvertiere sie in eine interne Tabelle von Strings.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` zur Konvertierung in einen String und anschließend `SPLIT` den resultierenden String nach Zeilenumbrüchen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_table.
    DATA: lo_conv_in TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.
    DATA: lv_full_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_crlf TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_in = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding    = '1103' " UTF-16 Little Endian
          endian      = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
          replacement = '#' ).

        lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING buffer = iv_xstring
                            IMPORTING data = lv_full_string ).

        SPLIT lv_full_string AT lv_crlf INTO TABLE rt_strings.

        " Remove empty last line if present due to trailing CRLF
        IF lines( rt_strings ) > 0 AND rt_strings[ lines( rt_strings ) ] IS INITIAL.
          DELETE rt_strings INDEX lines( rt_strings ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_xstring_to_table( ).
    DATA(lv_input_xstring) = 'FFFE4C0069006E006500200031000D000A004C0069006E006500200032000D000A004C0069006E00650020003300'. " UTF-16LE for 'Line 1\r\nLine 2\r\nLine 3'
    DATA: lt_expected_strings TYPE string_table.

    APPEND 'Line 2' TO lt_expected_strings.

    DATA(lt_result_strings) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_table( lv_input_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_strings ) exp = lines( lt_expected_strings )
      msg = 'Number of lines mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_strings exp = lt_expected_strings

Instructions: Berechne die verbleibenden freien Plätze für jeden Flug in der `sflights`-Tabelle, indem die gebuchten Plätze von der maximalen Kapazität subtrahiert werden. Verwende dabei die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung.
hint: Iteriere über die `sflights`-Tabelle und wende `SUBTRACT` auf die Felder `SEATSMAX` und `SEATSOCC` an, um `SEATSFREE` zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_updated) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_free_seats.
    rt_sflights_updated = it_sflights.

    LOOP AT rt_sflights_updated ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-seatsfree = <fs_flight>-seatsmax.
      SUBTRACT <fs_flight>-seatsocc FROM <fs_flight>-seatsfree.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_free_seats( ).
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_sflights_free_seats=>tt_sflight_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 30 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '017' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '900' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 50 seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_free_seats( lt_test_data ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_res>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight_res>-seatsfree exp = 70 msg = 'LH 400 free seats incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_flight_res> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight_res>-seatsfree exp = 50 msg = 'AA 017 free seats incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_flight_res> INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight_res>-seatsfree exp = 0 msg = 'UA 900 free seats incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Test with positive discount
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->apply_discount_conditionally( iv_total_amount = '100.00' iv_discount = '10.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = '90.00' msg = 'Positive discount failed' ).

    " Test with zero discount
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->apply_discount_conditionally( iv_total_amount = '100.00' iv_discount = '0.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = '100.00' msg = 'Zero discount failed' ).

    " Test with negative discount (should not apply)
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->apply_discount_conditionally( iv_total_amount = '100.00' iv_discount = '-5.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = '100.00' msg = 'Negative discount applied incorrectly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung mit einer `IF`-Bedingung, um eine Subtraktion nur unter bestimmten Umständen durchzuführen. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Muster in der Programmierung. Auch hier wäre der `-` Operator die modernere Wahl, aber die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung funktioniert in diesem Kontext einwandfrei.

Instructions: Verwende eine funktionale Methode, um eine Liste von Zahlen zu verarbeiten und eine kumulative Subtraktion durchzuführen, beginnend mit einem Startwert.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit dem `-` Operator, da die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung nicht direkt in funktionalen Ausdrücken verwendet werden kann. Erkläre den Unterschied.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS cumulative_subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_value TYPE i
        it_numbers     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD cumulative_subtract.
    rv_result = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = iv_start_value
      FOR  number IN it_numbers
      NEXT result = result - number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cumulative_subtract FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_subtract.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_subtract( ).
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 1 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.

    " 10 - 1 - 2 - 3 = 4
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->cumulative_subtract( iv_start_value = 10 it_numbers = lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 4 msg = 'Cumulative subtraction failed' ).

    " 5 - 10 = -5
    lt_numbers = VALUE #( ( 10 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->cumulative_subtract( iv_start_value = 5 it_numbers = lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = -5 msg = 'Single subtraction with REDUCE failed' ).

    " 20 (empty table) = 20
    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->cumulative_subtract( iv_start_value = 20 it_numbers = lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 20 msg = 'Cumulative subtraction with empty table failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die kumulative Subtraktion unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators, einer modernen funktionalen Syntax in ABAP. Es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung eine prozedurale Anweisung ist und nicht direkt in funktionalen Ausdrücken wie `REDUCE` verwendet werden kann. Hier muss der `-` Operator eingesetzt werden, was die Präferenz für Operatoren in modernen ABAP-Kontexten unterstreicht.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Math, Subtraction

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von Strings, die jeweils eine Zeile darstellen, in eine XSTRING im Codepage 4103 (UTF-8), wobei die Zeilen durch das System-spezifische Zeilenumbruchzeichen getrennt sind. Nutze dabei String-Templates für die Verkettung.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` für den Zeilenumbruch. Kombiniere die Zeilen mit String-Templates und `LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstring_st DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstring_st IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.
    DATA: lv_combined_string TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding    = '4103' " UTF-8
          replacement = '#' ).

        " Combine lines with system-specific line break using String Templates
        lv_combined_string = |
          { REDUCE string(
              INIT s = ``
              FOR  line IN it_strings
              NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && line ) ) }|.

        lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_combined_string
                             IMPORTING buffer = rv_xstring ).

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_table_conversion_st FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion_st.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_table_to_xstring_st( ).
    DATA: lt_input_strings TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'First line' TO lt_input_strings.
    APPEND 'Second line' TO lt_input_strings.

    DATA(lv_crlf_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv_crlf) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = '4103' ).
    lo_conv_crlf->write( EXPORTING data = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf IMPORTING buffer = lv_crlf_utf8_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = '4669727374206C696E65' && lv_crlf_utf8_xstring && '5365636F6E64206C696E65'. " UTF-8 for 'First line\r\nSecond line'
    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_table_to_xstring( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring
      msg = 'Table to XSTRING conversion with String Templates failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Konvertierung einer String-Tabelle in eine XSTRING, indem es moderne String-Templates und den `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um die Zeilen effizient zu einem einzigen String zu verbinden, bevor die Codepage-Konvertierung erfolgt. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, solche Operationen in modernem ABAP durchzuführen.

Instructions: Berechne den Saldo eines Kontos, indem alle Buchungen (positive für Einzahlungen, negative für Abhebungen) von einem Startguthaben subtrahiert werden. Verwende dabei eine Kombination aus `SUBTRACT` und `ADD` in einer Schleife.
hint: Iteriere über die Buchungen. Wenn eine Buchung positiv ist, addiere sie zum Saldo. Wenn sie negativ ist, subtrahiere den Absolutwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_account_balance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_balance
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_balance TYPE i
        it_bookings        TYPE tt_bookings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_balance) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_account_balance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_balance.
    rv_final_balance = iv_initial_balance.

    LOOP AT it_bookings INTO DATA(lv_booking).
      IF lv_booking > 0.
        ADD lv_booking TO rv_final_balance.
      ELSEIF lv_booking < 0.
        " SUBTRACT expects a positive value to subtract
        SUBTRACT ABS( lv_booking ) FROM rv_final_balance.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_account_balance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_account_balance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_account_balance( ).
    DATA: lt_bookings TYPE zcl_account_balance=>tt_bookings.

    " Initial: 100, Bookings: +50, -20, +10, -30 => 100 + 50 - 20 + 10 - 30 = 110
    APPEND 50 TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND -20 TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND 10 TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND -30 TO lt_bookings.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_balance( iv_initial_balance = 100 it_bookings = lt_bookings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 110 msg = 'Account balance calculation failed' ).

    " Initial: 0, Bookings: -100 => -100
    CLEAR lt_bookings.
    APPEND -100 TO lt_bookings.
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_balance( iv_initial_balance = 0 it_bookings = lt_bookings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -100 msg = 'Negative balance failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine komplexere Anwendung von `SUBTRACT` und `ADD` in einer Schleife zur Berechnung eines Kontosaldos. Es verdeutlicht, wie man mit positiven und negativen Buchungen umgeht und dass `SUBTRACT` einen positiven Wert als zweiten Operanden erwartet, weshalb `ABS()` für negative Buchungen verwendet wird. In modernem ABAP würde man hier eher mit dem `+` und `-` Operator arbeiten, um die Logik zu vereinfachen (`rv_final_balance = rv_final_balance + lv_booking.`).
keywords: SUBTRACT, ADD, Math, Internal Tables, Loop, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von strukturierten Daten (z.B. Flugdaten aus `sflights`) in eine XSTRING im Codepage 4103 (UTF-8), wobei jede Zeile als JSON-Objekt formatiert und durch ein Zeilenumbruchzeichen getrennt ist.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die Codepage-Konvertierung und `cl_abap_json_serializer` für die JSON-Serialisierung jedes Tabelleneintrags.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_to_json_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_json,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_json.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_json TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_json WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_to_json_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_to_json_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_json_xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.
    DATA: lv_json_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_crlf TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA: lv_crlf_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lv_temp_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding    = '4103' " UTF-8
          replacement = '#' ).

        lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_crlf
                             IMPORTING buffer = lv_crlf_xstring ).

        LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
            EXPORTING
              data        = ls_flight
              pretty_print = abap_false
            RECEIVING
              json        = lv_json_string ).

          lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_json_string
                               IMPORTING buffer = lv_temp_xstring ).
          rv_json_xstring = rv_json_xstring && lv_temp_xstring.
          IF sy-tabix < lines( it_sflights ).
            rv_json_xstring = rv_json_xstring && lv_crlf_xstring.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_abap_json_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sflight_json_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_json_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_sflight_to_json_xstr( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_conv_sflight_to_json_xstr=>tt_sflight_json.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 30 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '017' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_crlf_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv_crlf) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = '4103' ).
    lo_conv_crlf->write( EXPORTING data = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf IMPORTING buffer = lv_crlf_utf8_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_expected_json1) = `{"CARRID":"LH","CONNID":"400","FLDATE":"20250101","SEATSMAX":100,"SEATSOCC":30}`.
    DATA(lv_expected_json2) = `{"CARRID":"AA","CONNID":"017","FLDATE":"20250101","SEATSMAX":200,"SEATSOCC":150}`.

    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv_json1) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = '4103' ).
    lo_conv_json1->write( EXPORTING data = lv_expected_json1 IMPORTING buffer = DATA(lx_json1) ).
    DATA(lo_conv_json2) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = '4103' ).
    lo_conv_json2->write( EXPORTING data = lv_expected_json2 IMPORTING buffer = DATA(lx_json2) ).

    lv_expected_xstring = lx_json1 && lv_crlf_utf8_xstring && lx_json2.

    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_sflights_to_json_xstring( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring
      msg = 'SFLIGHTS to JSON XSTRING conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel kombiniert `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` mit `cl_abap_json_serializer` zur Erstellung einer XSTRING, die mehrere JSON-Objekte (repräsentierend Tabellenzeilen) enthält, getrennt durch Zeilenumbrüche und in einer spezifischen Codepage kodiert. Dies ist ein häufiges Szenario für den Export komplexer Datenstrukturen in Dateiformate oder für die Kommunikation mit REST-APIs, die JSON-Payloads erwarten.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_out_ce, cl_abap_json_serializer, JSON, XSTRING, UTF-8, Data Conversion, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Differenzen zwischen aufeinanderfolgenden Elementen einer Liste von Zahlen. Verwende dabei `FOR` und den `-` Operator, um die moderne Herangehensweise zu demonstrieren, und erkläre, warum `SUBTRACT` hier ungeeignet wäre.
hint: Nutze einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `LINES OF` und `OFFSET` oder `INDEX` in Kombination mit dem `-` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_diff_sum_functional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_of_differences
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_diff_sum_functional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_differences.
    IF lines( it_numbers ) < 2.
      rv_sum_diff = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_sum_diff = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR i = 2 UP TO lines( it_numbers )
      NEXT sum = sum + ( it_numbers[ i ] - it_numbers[ i - 1 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_of_differences FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_differences.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_diff_sum_functional( ).
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE zcl_diff_sum_functional=>tt_numbers.

    " Numbers: 1, 3, 6, 2. Differences: (3-1)=2, (6-3)=3, (2-6)=-4. Sum: 2+3-4 = 1
    APPEND 1 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 6 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers.

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_differences( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 1 msg = 'Sum of differences failed for multiple elements' ).

    " Numbers: 5, 10. Difference: (10-5)=5. Sum: 5
    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    APPEND 5 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 10 TO lt_numbers.
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_differences( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 5 msg = 'Sum of differences failed for two elements' ).

    " Empty table
    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_differences( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 0 msg = 'Sum of differences failed for empty table' ).

    " Single element table
    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    APPEND 7 TO lt_numbers.
    DATA(lv_result4) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_differences( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result4 exp = 0 msg = 'Sum of differences failed for single element table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung der Summe von Differenzen aufeinanderfolgender Elemente in einer Liste unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators und des `-` Operators. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für moderne, funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung wäre hier ungeeignet, da sie eine prozedurale Anweisung ist und nicht in einem funktionalen Kontext wie `REDUCE` verwendet werden kann. Der `-` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Lösung.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Math, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Subtraction

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT und füllen Sie diese mit den ersten 3 Einträgen aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT. Geben Sie die Inhalte aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `ASSIGN` mit Feld-Symbolen, um dynamisch auf die Tabelle zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_sflight.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " Get description of SFLIGHT structure
    lr_line_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " Create table type description
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_line_descr ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rt_sflight_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_sflight> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rt_sflight_data->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    IF <lt_sflight> IS ASSIGNED.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @<lt_sflight> UP TO 3 ROWS.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_sflight( ).
    DATA(lr_sflight_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_sflight( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_sflight_data->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = <lt_sflight> IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should contain 3 entries' act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit mittels `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` und RTTI (`cl_abap_tabledescr`). Die Verwendung von `REF TO data` und Feld-Symbolen ermöglicht es, mit Datenstrukturen zu arbeiten, die erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, was für flexible Anwendungen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: REF TO, CREATE DATA, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für eine 'Flugzeug'-Funktionalität und implementieren Sie dieses in zwei verschiedenen Klassen (z.B. für Passagier- und Frachtflugzeuge). Rufen Sie eine gemeinsame Methode polymorph über eine Interface-Referenz auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING` und `REF TO` auf das Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_airplane.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_passenger_plane DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_airplane.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_passenger_plane IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_airplane~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Passagierflugzeug'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_airplane.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cargo_plane IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_airplane~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Frachtflugzeug'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airplane_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_airplane IMPORTING iv_plane_type TYPE string
                            RETURNING VALUE(ro_airplane) TYPE REF TO zif_airplane.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airplane_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_airplane.
    CASE iv_plane_type.
      WHEN 'PASSENGER'.
        ro_airplane = NEW zcl_passenger_plane( ).
      WHEN 'CARGO'.
        ro_airplane = NEW zcl_cargo_plane( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle error or return initial reference
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von Interfaces und Objekt-Referenzen für Polymorphie. Die Factory-Klasse erzeugt Objekte verschiedener Typen, die alle über eine gemeinsame Interface-Referenz angesprochen werden können. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und flexible Architekturen.
keywords: REF TO, Interface, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, NEW

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CARRID, CONNID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, deren Preis (PRICE) über 500 liegt. Nutzen Sie eine funktionale Programmierung mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` und `VALUE #(...)` mit einer Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                    WHERE ( price > 500 )
                                    ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                      connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( ).

    " Assuming there are flights with price > 500 in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    " Further assertions could check specific content if SFLIGHT data is known/mocked
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one expensive flight expected' act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Filterkriterien und Projektion zu erstellen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten zu transformieren und zu filtern, ohne explizite `LOOP`s.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, REF TO (implicit in table operations)

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein `cl_gui_column_tree` und zeigen Sie die Flugdaten (CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in einer Baumstruktur an. Jeder Flug soll ein Knoten sein, und die Details (CONNID, FLDATE) sollen als Spalten angezeigt werden.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_column_tree`, definieren Sie Spalten und füllen Sie die Datenstruktur für den Baum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_tree.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          mo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             node_key TYPE cl_gui_column_tree=>item_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_node_data TYPE ty_node_data,
          lt_node_data TYPE tt_node_data,
          lt_column_table TYPE cl_gui_column_tree=>column_table,
          ls_column TYPE cl_gui_column_tree=>column_item.

    " Create custom container
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " Replace with actual screen element name

    " Create column tree
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    " Define columns
    ls_column-id = 'CARRID'.
    ls_column-caption = 'Airline'.
    ls_column-width = 15.
    APPEND ls_column TO lt_column_table.

    ls_column-id = 'CONNID'.
    ls_column-caption = 'Connection'.
    ls_column-width = 10.
    APPEND ls_column TO lt_column_table.

    ls_column-id = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_column-caption = 'Flight Date'.
    ls_column-width = 12.
    APPEND ls_column TO lt_column_table.

    CALL METHOD mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        it_column_list   = lt_column_table.

    " Get SFLIGHT data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Prepare node data
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      ls_node_data-node_key = ls_flight-carrid && ls_flight-connid && ls_flight-fldate.
      ls_node_data-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_node_data-connid = ls_flight-connid.
      ls_node_data-fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
      APPEND ls_node_data TO lt_node_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add nodes to tree
    CALL METHOD mo_tree->add_nodes
      EXPORTING
        i_relative_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>root_node
        i_position          = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_position_last
        it_table_structure  = 'TY_NODE_DATA'
        it_table            = lt_node_data.

    CALL METHOD mo_tree->frontend_update.
    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_tree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_tree.
    " This unit test can only verify the instantiation, not the visual display.
    " For actual GUI testing, integration tests or manual checks are needed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_tree( ).
    " The method display_sflight_tree will try to create GUI objects.
    " In a unit test environment, this might lead to exceptions if no GUI context is available.
    " For a robust unit test, one might mock cl_gui_custom_container and cl_gui_column_tree.
    " For simplicity, we just call it and ensure no immediate dump.
    TRY.

Es zeigt die Instanziierung des Controls, die Definition von Spalten und das Hinzufügen von Daten als Knoten. Die Verwendung von `REF TO` ist hier zentral für die Handhabung der GUI-Objekte.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das `cl_gui_column_tree`-Beispiel um ein Event-Handling für das `NODE_DOUBLE_CLICK`-Ereignis. Bei einem Doppelklick soll eine Meldung mit dem Schlüssel des angeklickten Knotens ausgegeben werden.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS display_sflight_tree.

    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_node_data.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_node_data TYPE ty_node_data,
          lt_node_data TYPE tt_node_data,
